// The virtual desktop name popup goes through the same ShowText entry point as
// every other text indicator. The only thing that tells them apart at hook time
// is who called it: twinui.dll for the virtual desktop switch, the aeh module
// for everything else. Hooking twinui.dll directly crashes the shell, so the
// caller module is looked up from the return address instead. Cheap, no other
// module touched, no chance of conflicting with another mod that hooks the same
// twinui function. GetModuleHandleEx is used at call time rather than caching a
// range at init, since Wh_ModInit runs before the target process begins and
// twinui isn't loaded yet on a fresh explorer start.
bool ReturnAddressIsTwinui(void* returnAddress) {
    HMODULE fromModule = nullptr;
    if (!GetModuleHandleExW(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS |
                                GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
                            reinterpret_cast<PCWSTR>(returnAddress),
                            &fromModule)) {
        return false;
    }
    return fromModule == GetModuleHandleW(L"twinui.dll");
}

// A ShowText call from twinui goes through the thunk first, and the thunk then
// calls into the async ramp internally. The ramp is a private coroutine only
// reachable from inside the confirmator DLL, so its own return address can
// never be in twinui. The thunk records the decision in this thread_local and
// the ramp reads it back. Cleared when the thunk returns so it doesn't leak
// into a later plain text show on the same thread.
thread_local bool g_textCallFromTwinui = false;

struct ResetOnExit {
    bool& flag;
    ~ResetOnExit() { flag = false; }
};

using ShowTextThunk_t = int(WINAPI*)(void* pThis, void* text, bool value);
ShowTextThunk_t ShowTextThunk_Original;
int WINAPI ShowTextThunk_Hook(void* pThis, void* text, bool value) {
    bool fromTwinui = ReturnAddressIsTwinui(__builtin_return_address(0));
    const auto kind = fromTwinui ? Indicator::virtualDesktop : Indicator::text;
    if (ShouldHideIndicator(kind))
        return S_OK;
    g_textCallFromTwinui = fromTwinui;
    ResetOnExit reset{g_textCallFromTwinui};
    g_currentIndicator.store(fromTwinui ? Indicator::virtualDesktop
                                        : Indicator::text);
    return ShowTextThunk_Original(pThis, text, value);
}

// Each of these is winrt::fire_and_forget, an empty struct but not a trivial
// one, so MSVC still returns it through a hidden pointer rather than in a
// register: `this` first, the hidden retval pointer next, then the source
// arguments, with the pointer handed back as the return value. A signature
// without that slot compiles and links, but every real argument then arrives
// one register late and the original coroutine gets called with garbage
// where it expects its own arguments to be. Each name is optional;
// if neither layer resolves for a kind, Wh_ModInit disables per-indicator
// placement rather than reuse a previous kind's spot.
DEFINE_RECORDER_HOOK(ShowVolumeAsync,
                     void*,
                     Indicator::volume,
                     (void* pThis, void* retval, int value),
                     (pThis, retval, value),
                     retval);
DEFINE_RECORDER_HOOK(ShowBrightnessAsync,
                     void*,
                     Indicator::brightness,
                     (void* pThis, void* retval, int value),
                     (pThis, retval, value),
                     retval);
DEFINE_RECORDER_HOOK(ShowKeyboardBrightnessAsync,
                     void*,
                     Indicator::keyboardBrightness,
                     (void* pThis, void* retval, int value),
                     (pThis, retval, value),
                     retval);
DEFINE_RECORDER_HOOK(ShowAirplaneModeOnAsync,
                     void*,
                     Indicator::airplaneMode,
                     (void* pThis, void* retval, bool value),
                     (pThis, retval, value),
                     retval);
DEFINE_RECORDER_HOOK(ShowCameraOnAsync,
                     void*,
                     Indicator::camera,
                     (void* pThis, void* retval, bool value),
                     (pThis, retval, value),
                     retval);
DEFINE_RECORDER_HOOK(ShowCameraAccessEnabledAsync,
                     void*,
                     Indicator::camera,
                     (void* pThis, void* retval, bool value),
                     (pThis, retval, value),
                     retval);

// This one takes a message alongside the state on current builds and took only
// the state on older ones. Declared with the extra parameter for both, since
// the build that doesn't take it never reads the register it arrives in. That
// holds because the mod is 64-bit only, x64 and arm64 both, where arguments go
// in registers and the caller does the cleaning up. On a 32-bit stdcall build
// the callee pops its own arguments and the same mismatch would walk the stack.
// Never suppress this ramp: the original destroys its by-value hstring on
// current builds. Older signatures have no string, so inspecting the extra
// register here would be unsafe. The public microphone thunk handles hiding.
using ShowMicrophoneMutedAsync_t = void*(WINAPI*)(void*, void*, int, void*);
ShowMicrophoneMutedAsync_t ShowMicrophoneMutedAsync_Original;
void* WINAPI ShowMicrophoneMutedAsync_Hook(void* pThis, void* retval,
                                         int value, void* text) {
    g_currentIndicator.store(Indicator::microphone);
    return ShowMicrophoneMutedAsync_Original(pThis, retval, value, text);
}

#undef DEFINE_RECORDER_HOOK

using ShowTextAsync_t = void*(WINAPI*)(void* pThis,
                                       void* retval,
                                       void* text,
                                       bool value);
ShowTextAsync_t ShowTextAsync_Original;
void* WINAPI ShowTextAsync_Hook(void* pThis,
                                void* retval,
                                void* text,
                                bool value) {
    // The original owns the by-value hstring. Always forward so it is destroyed;
    // text hiding is handled by the public thunk with its borrowed string.
    g_currentIndicator.store(g_textCallFromTwinui ? Indicator::virtualDesktop
                                                  : Indicator::text);
    return ShowTextAsync_Original(pThis, retval, text, value);
}

// Called at startup and after settings changes, including when another missing
// entry point has disabled per-indicator placement. Hiding is independent of it.
void LogUnavailableHiding(const Settings& settings) {
    if (!ShowTextThunk_Original &&
        (settings.perIndicator[(size_t)Indicator::text] == Position::hidden ||
         settings.perIndicator[(size_t)Indicator::virtualDesktop] == Position::hidden)) {
        Wh_Log(L"ShowText thunk did not resolve; Hidden is unavailable for text "
               L"and virtual desktop indicators");
    }
    if (!ShowMicrophoneMutedThunk_Original &&
        settings.perIndicator[(size_t)Indicator::microphone] == Position::hidden) {
        Wh_Log(L"ShowMicrophoneMuted thunk did not resolve; Hidden is unavailable "
               L"for the microphone indicator");
    }
}

// The control hides itself two ways and Windows picks the animated one. Handing
// the call to the other is the whole feature, so nothing has to be torn out of
// the animation and nothing outside this control is touched.
using ConfirmatorHostControl_Hide_t = void(WINAPI*)(void* pThis);
ConfirmatorHostControl_Hide_t ConfirmatorHostControl_Hide_Original;

// Same shape as the one above today, declared separately so a drift in one
// doesn't quietly redefine the other.
using ConfirmatorHostControl_HideWithoutAnimation_t =
    void(WINAPI*)(void* pThis);
ConfirmatorHostControl_HideWithoutAnimation_t
    ConfirmatorHostControl_HideWithoutAnimation_Original;
void WINAPI ConfirmatorHostControl_Hide_Hook(void* pThis) {
    // Nothing on the builds this was written against calls back the other way,
    // but a build where HideWithoutAnimation went through Hide would otherwise
    // turn the redirect into unbounded recursion rather than a dead setting.
    thread_local bool redirecting = false;

    bool skip = !redirecting && g_settings.load()->skipHideAnimation &&
                ConfirmatorHostControl_HideWithoutAnimation_Original;
    Wh_Log(L"> skip=%d", (int)skip);

    if (skip) {
        // Restored however this returns. Hide is an implementation method rather
        // than an abi thunk, so an hresult_error coming out of it would otherwise
        // leave the flag latched and the setting dead for the rest of the session.
        ResetOnExit reset{redirecting};

        redirecting = true;
        return ConfirmatorHostControl_HideWithoutAnimation_Original(pThis);
    }

    return ConfirmatorHostControl_Hide_Original(pThis);
}

// GetDpiForMonitor returns the real effective DPI only to a per-monitor aware
// caller, so make sure of that for the call and restore the thread's own context.
UINT QueryMonitorDpi(HMONITOR monitor) {
    DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT previous =
        SetThreadDpiAwarenessContext(DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2);
    UINT dpiX = 0;
    UINT dpiY = 0;
    HRESULT hr = GetDpiForMonitor(monitor, MDT_EFFECTIVE_DPI, &dpiX, &dpiY);
    if (previous) {
        SetThreadDpiAwarenessContext(previous);
    }
    return SUCCEEDED(hr) && dpiX ? dpiX : 96;
}

// "<display name> <interface name>" for display profiles to match against.
// Looking up the interface name can be slow on some systems, and a volume
// change places the indicator once per step, so the last answer is reused for a
// few seconds. The short lifetime picks up a dock or monitor change promptly.
// Fixed-size buffers rather than thread_local strings, whose destructors could
// run after the mod is unloaded.
SRWLOCK g_monitorNameLock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
WCHAR g_cachedDevice[CCHDEVICENAME];
WCHAR g_cachedMonitorName[CCHDEVICENAME + 1 + 128];
ULONGLONG g_cachedMonitorNameTime;

std::wstring MonitorDisplayName(PCWSTR device) {
    constexpr ULONGLONG kCacheMs = 5000;
    const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_monitorNameLock);
    if (g_cachedMonitorNameTime && now - g_cachedMonitorNameTime < kCacheMs &&
        wcscmp(g_cachedDevice, device) == 0) {
        std::wstring cached = g_cachedMonitorName;
        ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_monitorNameLock);
        return cached;
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_monitorNameLock);

    std::wstring name = device;
    DISPLAY_DEVICEW displayDevice{};
    displayDevice.cb = sizeof(displayDevice);
    if (EnumDisplayDevicesW(device, 0, &displayDevice,
                            EDD_GET_DEVICE_INTERFACE_NAME)) {
        name += L" ";
        name += displayDevice.DeviceID;
    }

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_monitorNameLock);
    wcsncpy_s(g_cachedDevice, device, _TRUNCATE);
    wcsncpy_s(g_cachedMonitorName, name.c_str(), _TRUNCATE);
    g_cachedMonitorNameTime = now;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_monitorNameLock);
    return name;
}

void AdjustPositionRect(const WinrtRect& rect, WinrtRect* result) {
    const auto settings = g_settings.load();
    const Indicator kind = g_currentIndicator.load();
    RECT bounds{(LONG)rect.X, (LONG)rect.Y,
                (LONG)(rect.X + rect.Width), (LONG)(rect.Y + rect.Height)};
    HMONITOR monitor = MonitorFromRect(&bounds, MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST);
    std::wstring monitorName;
    if (!settings->profiles.empty()) {
        MONITORINFOEXW info{};
        info.cbSize = sizeof(info);
        if (GetMonitorInfoW(monitor, &info)) {
            monitorName = MonitorDisplayName(info.szDevice);
        }
    }
    Placement placement = ResolvePlacement(*settings, kind, monitorName.c_str(),
                                            GetSystemMetrics(SM_CMONITORS));
    const UINT dpi = placement.x || placement.y ? QueryMonitorDpi(monitor) : 96;
    placement.x = MulDiv(placement.x, dpi, 96);
    placement.y = MulDiv(placement.y, dpi, 96);
    WinrtRect area{0, 0, rect.Width, rect.Height};
    if (placement.position != Position::windowsDefault || placement.x || placement.y)
        PlaceInArea(area, placement.position, placement.x, placement.y, result);
    result->X += rect.X;
    result->Y += rect.Y;
    Wh_Log(L"Placement kind=%s monitor=%s dpi=%u", IndicatorName(kind),
           monitorName.c_str(), dpi);
}

// winrt::Windows::Foundation::Rect has a user-provided constructor, so MSVC
// returns it through a hidden pointer rather than in registers on both
// architectures it's built for here: `this` first, the hidden retval pointer
// next, then the rect argument (RCX/RDX/R8 on x64, x0/x1/x2 on ARM64), with
// the pointer handed back as the return value. A signature without that slot
// looks plausible and crashes the shell on the first call. One signature covers
// both, so there's nothing to branch on here.
using HardwareConfirmatorHost_GetPositionRect_t =
    WinrtRect*(WINAPI*)(void* pThis, WinrtRect* retval, const WinrtRect* rect);
HardwareConfirmatorHost_GetPositionRect_t
    HardwareConfirmatorHost_GetPositionRect_Original;
WinrtRect* WINAPI
HardwareConfirmatorHost_GetPositionRect_Hook(void* pThis,
                                             WinrtRect* retval,
                                             const WinrtRect* rect) {
    WinrtRect inputRect = *rect;
    WinrtRect shiftedRect{0, 0, inputRect.Width, inputRect.Height};

    WinrtRect* result = HardwareConfirmatorHost_GetPositionRect_Original(
        pThis, retval, &shiftedRect);

    if (result) {
        AdjustPositionRect(inputRect, result);
    }

    return result;
}

Position PositionFromString(PCWSTR value, Position fallback = Position::windowsDefault) {
    if (wcscmp(value, L"hidden") == 0) return Position::hidden;
    if (!*value || wcscmp(value, L"same") == 0) return Position::inherit;
    if (wcscmp(value, L"topLeft") == 0) {
        return Position::topLeft;
    } else if (wcscmp(value, L"topCenter") == 0) {
        return Position::topCenter;
    } else if (wcscmp(value, L"topRight") == 0) {
        return Position::topRight;
    } else if (wcscmp(value, L"middleLeft") == 0) {
        return Position::middleLeft;
    } else if (wcscmp(value, L"center") == 0) {
        return Position::center;
    } else if (wcscmp(value, L"middleRight") == 0) {
        return Position::middleRight;
    } else if (wcscmp(value, L"bottomLeft") == 0) {
        return Position::bottomLeft;
    } else if (wcscmp(value, L"bottomCenter") == 0) {
        return Position::bottomCenter;
    } else if (wcscmp(value, L"bottomRight") == 0) {
        return Position::bottomRight;
    }

    // A stale or mistyped stored value would otherwise look like the mod simply
    // isn't working.
    if (wcscmp(value, L"windowsDefault") != 0) {
        Wh_Log(L"Unknown position \"%s\", using the inherited/default position",
               value);
        return fallback;
    }

    return Position::windowsDefault;
}

OffsetOverride LoadOffsets(const std::wstring& prefix) {
    OffsetOverride result;
    result.customX = wcscmp(WindhawkUtils::StringSetting::make(
        (prefix + L".horizontal").c_str()).get(), L"custom") == 0;
    result.customY = wcscmp(WindhawkUtils::StringSetting::make(
        (prefix + L".vertical").c_str()).get(), L"custom") == 0;
    result.x = std::clamp(Wh_GetIntSetting((prefix + L".x").c_str()), -100000, 100000);
    result.y = std::clamp(Wh_GetIntSetting((prefix + L".y").c_str()), -100000, 100000);
    return result;
}

void LoadSettings() {
    auto settings = std::make_shared<Settings>();
    auto value = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting::make(L"position");
    settings->position = *value.get() ? PositionFromString(value.get()) : kDefaultPosition;
    if (settings->position == Position::inherit || settings->position == Position::hidden) settings->position = kDefaultPosition;
    settings->offsetX = std::clamp(Wh_GetIntSetting(L"offsetX"), -100000, 100000);
    settings->offsetY = std::clamp(Wh_GetIntSetting(L"offsetY"), -100000, 100000);
    settings->skipHideAnimation = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"skipHideAnimation") != 0;
    settings->durationSeconds = std::clamp(Wh_GetIntSetting(L"durationSeconds"), 0, 60);
    static const PCWSTR names[] = {L"volume", L"brightness", L"keyboardBrightness",
        L"airplaneMode", L"camera", L"microphone", L"text", L"virtualDesktop"};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < ARRAYSIZE(names); ++i) {
        std::wstring key = std::wstring(L"perIndicator.") + names[i];
        auto position = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting::make(key.c_str());
        settings->perIndicator[i] = PositionFromString(position.get(), Position::inherit);
        settings->offsets[i] = LoadOffsets(std::wstring(L"indicatorOffsets.") + names[i]);
    }
    for (int i = 0;; ++i) {
        const auto prefix = L"displayProfiles[" + std::to_wstring(i) + L"]";
        auto kind = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting::make((prefix + L".indicator").c_str());
        // Every stored entry has an indicator value, so an empty one is the end
        // of the array.
        if (!*kind.get()) break;

        if (!Wh_GetIntSetting((prefix + L".enabled").c_str())) continue;
        DisplayProfile profile;
        profile.monitor = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting::make((prefix + L".monitor").c_str()).get();
        profile.monitorCount = std::clamp(
            Wh_GetIntSetting((prefix + L".monitorCount").c_str()), 0, 64);
        bool valid = wcscmp(kind.get(), L"all") == 0;
        for (size_t j = 0; j < ARRAYSIZE(names); ++j) {
            if (wcscmp(kind.get(), names[j]) == 0) {
                profile.indicator = (Indicator)j;
                valid = true;
            }
        }
        if (!valid) continue;
        auto position = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting::make((prefix + L".position").c_str());
        profile.position = PositionFromString(position.get(), Position::inherit);
        if (profile.position == Position::hidden) profile.position = Position::inherit;
        profile.offsets = LoadOffsets(prefix);
        settings->profiles.push_back(std::move(profile));
    }
    g_settings.store(std::move(settings));
}

// Duration overrides are scoped to one-shot relative timers requested directly
// by HardwareConfirmator. Absolute, periodic, cancellation and short animation
// timers pass through. Hook both APIs because Windows builds use either one.
FILETIME* AdjustDueTime(void* caller, const FILETIME* due, DWORD period,
                        FILETIME& adjusted) {
    const int seconds = g_settings.duration();
    if (!seconds || !due || period) return const_cast<FILETIME*>(due);
    HMODULE module = nullptr;
    if (!GetModuleHandleExW(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS |
            GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
            reinterpret_cast<PCWSTR>(caller), &module) ||
        module != g_hardwareConfirmatorModule) return const_cast<FILETIME*>(due);
    LARGE_INTEGER value;
    value.LowPart = due->dwLowDateTime;
    value.HighPart = due->dwHighDateTime;
    if (value.QuadPart > -10000000LL || value.QuadPart < -600000000LL)
        return const_cast<FILETIME*>(due);
    Wh_Log(L"Indicator timeout %lld ms -> %d ms", -value.QuadPart / 10000,
           seconds * 1000);
    value.QuadPart = -10000000LL * seconds;
    adjusted = {value.LowPart, (DWORD)value.HighPart};
    return &adjusted;
}
decltype(&SetThreadpoolTimer) SetThreadpoolTimer_Original;
void WINAPI SetThreadpoolTimer_Hook(PTP_TIMER timer,
                                    PFILETIME due,
                                    DWORD period,
                                    DWORD window) {
    FILETIME adjusted;
    FILETIME* dueTime =
        AdjustDueTime(__builtin_return_address(0), due, period, adjusted);
    SetThreadpoolTimer_Original(timer, dueTime, period, window);
}

decltype(&SetThreadpoolTimerEx) SetThreadpoolTimerEx_Original;
BOOL WINAPI SetThreadpoolTimerEx_Hook(PTP_TIMER timer,
                                      PFILETIME due,
                                      DWORD period,
                                      DWORD window) {
    FILETIME adjusted;
    FILETIME* dueTime =
        AdjustDueTime(__builtin_return_address(0), due, period, adjusted);
    return SetThreadpoolTimerEx_Original(timer, dueTime, period, window);
}

BOOL Wh_ModInit() {
    Wh_Log(L">");

    LoadSettings();

    // Nothing to place and nothing to nudge, so don't load the DLL or install a
    // hook that would only pass the rect straight through. Windhawk reloads the
    // mod after a settings change, so it comes back as soon as there is work.
    const auto settings = g_settings.load();
    bool anyPerIndicator = AnyPerIndicator(*settings);

    if (settings->position == Position::windowsDefault && !anyPerIndicator &&
        !settings->offsetX && !settings->offsetY &&
        !settings->skipHideAnimation && !settings->durationSeconds) {
        Wh_Log(L"Nothing to do");
        return FALSE;
    }

    g_hardwareConfirmatorModule =
        LoadLibraryEx(L"Windows.Internal.HardwareConfirmator.dll", nullptr,
                      LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32);
    if (!g_hardwareConfirmatorModule) {
        Wh_Log(L"Couldn't load Windows.Internal.HardwareConfirmator.dll");
        return FALSE;
    }

    // Windows.Internal.HardwareConfirmator.dll
    WindhawkUtils::SYMBOL_HOOK symbolHooks[] = {
        {
            {LR"(private: struct winrt::Windows::Foundation::Rect __cdecl winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost::GetPositionRect(struct winrt::Windows::Foundation::Rect const &))"},
            &HardwareConfirmatorHost_GetPositionRect_Original,
            HardwareConfirmatorHost_GetPositionRect_Hook,
        },
        {
            {LR"(private: struct winrt::fire_and_forget __cdecl winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost::ShowVolumeAsync(int))"},
            &ShowVolumeAsync_Original,
            ShowVolumeAsync_Hook,
            true,  // optional
        },
        {
            {LR"(private: struct winrt::fire_and_forget __cdecl winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost::ShowBrightnessAsync(int))"},
            &ShowBrightnessAsync_Original,
            ShowBrightnessAsync_Hook,
            true,  // optional
        },
        {
            {LR"(private: struct winrt::fire_and_forget __cdecl winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost::ShowKeyboardBrightnessAsync(int))"},
            &ShowKeyboardBrightnessAsync_Original,
            ShowKeyboardBrightnessAsync_Hook,
            true,  // optional
        },
        {
            {LR"(private: struct winrt::fire_and_forget __cdecl winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost::ShowAirplaneModeOnAsync(bool))"},
            &ShowAirplaneModeOnAsync_Original,
            ShowAirplaneModeOnAsync_Hook,
            true,  // optional
        },
        {
            {LR"(private: struct winrt::fire_and_forget __cdecl winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost::ShowCameraOnAsync(bool))"},
            &ShowCameraOnAsync_Original,
            ShowCameraOnAsync_Hook,
            true,  // optional
        },
        {
            {LR"(private: struct winrt::fire_and_forget __cdecl winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost::ShowCameraAccessEnabledAsync(bool))"},
            &ShowCameraAccessEnabledAsync_Original,
            ShowCameraAccessEnabledAsync_Hook,
            true,  // optional
        },
        {
            {LR"(private: struct winrt::fire_and_forget __cdecl winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost::ShowTextAsync(struct winrt::hstring,bool))"},
            &ShowTextAsync_Original,
            ShowTextAsync_Hook,
            true,  // optional
        },
        {
            {LR"(private: struct winrt::fire_and_forget __cdecl winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost::ShowMicrophoneMutedAsync(enum winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::MicrophoneMuteState,struct winrt::hstring))",
             LR"(private: struct winrt::fire_and_forget __cdecl winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost::ShowMicrophoneMutedAsync(enum winrt::HWConfirmatorUI::MicrophoneMuteState,struct winrt::hstring))",
             LR"(private: struct winrt::fire_and_forget __cdecl winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost::ShowMicrophoneMutedAsync(enum winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::MicrophoneMuteState))",
             LR"(private: struct winrt::fire_and_forget __cdecl winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost::ShowMicrophoneMutedAsync(enum winrt::HWConfirmatorUI::MicrophoneMuteState))"},
            &ShowMicrophoneMutedAsync_Original,
            ShowMicrophoneMutedAsync_Hook,
            true,  // optional
        },
        {
            {LR"(public: virtual int __cdecl winrt::impl::produce<struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost,struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::IHardwareConfirmatorHost>::ShowVolume(int))"},
            &ShowVolumeThunk_Original,
            ShowVolumeThunk_Hook,
            true,  // optional
        },
        {
            {LR"(public: virtual int __cdecl winrt::impl::produce<struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost,struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::IHardwareConfirmatorHost>::ShowBrightness(int))"},
            &ShowBrightnessThunk_Original,
            ShowBrightnessThunk_Hook,
            true,  // optional
        },
        {
            {LR"(public: virtual int __cdecl winrt::impl::produce<struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost,struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::IHardwareConfirmatorHost>::ShowKeyboardBrightness(int))"},
            &ShowKeyboardBrightnessThunk_Original,
            ShowKeyboardBrightnessThunk_Hook,
            true,  // optional
        },
        {
            {LR"(public: virtual int __cdecl winrt::impl::produce<struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost,struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::IHardwareConfirmatorHost>::ShowAirplaneModeOn(bool))"},
            &ShowAirplaneModeOnThunk_Original,
            ShowAirplaneModeOnThunk_Hook,
            true,  // optional
        },
        {
            {LR"(public: virtual int __cdecl winrt::impl::produce<struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost,struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::IHardwareConfirmatorHost>::ShowCameraOn(bool))"},
            &ShowCameraOnThunk_Original,
            ShowCameraOnThunk_Hook,
            true,  // optional
        },
        {
            {LR"(public: virtual int __cdecl winrt::impl::produce<struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost,struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::IHardwareConfirmatorHost>::ShowCameraAccessEnabled(bool))"},
            &ShowCameraAccessEnabledThunk_Original,
            ShowCameraAccessEnabledThunk_Hook,
            true,  // optional
        },
        {
            {LR"(public: virtual int __cdecl winrt::impl::produce<struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost,struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::IHardwareConfirmatorHost>::ShowMicrophoneMuted(int,void *))",
             LR"(public: virtual int __cdecl winrt::impl::produce<struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost,struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::IHardwareConfirmatorHost>::ShowMicrophoneMuted(int))"},
            &ShowMicrophoneMutedThunk_Original,
            ShowMicrophoneMutedThunk_Hook,
            true,  // optional
        },
        {
            {LR"(public: virtual int __cdecl winrt::impl::produce<struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::implementation::HardwareConfirmatorHost,struct winrt::Windows::Internal::HardwareConfirmator::IHardwareConfirmatorHost>::ShowText(void *,bool))"},
            &ShowTextThunk_Original,
            ShowTextThunk_Hook,
            true,  // optional
        },
        {
            {LR"(public: void __cdecl winrt::HWConfirmatorUI::implementation::ConfirmatorHostControl::Hide(void))"},
            &ConfirmatorHostControl_Hide_Original,
            ConfirmatorHostControl_Hide_Hook,
            true,  // optional
        },
        {
            {LR"(public: void __cdecl winrt::HWConfirmatorUI::implementation::ConfirmatorHostControl::HideWithoutAnimation(void))"},
            &ConfirmatorHostControl_HideWithoutAnimation_Original,
            nullptr,  // wanted for its address, not hooked
            true,     // optional
        },
    };

    // The whole set goes in every time so the symbol cache doesn't need to be
    // resolved again when someone turns a setting on later.
    if (!HookSymbols(g_hardwareConfirmatorModule, symbolHooks,
                     ARRAYSIZE(symbolHooks))) {
        Wh_Log(L"HookSymbols failed");
        // Wh_ModUninit doesn't run when Wh_ModInit returns FALSE, so the
        // reference taken above has to go back here.
        FreeLibrary(g_hardwareConfirmatorModule);
        g_hardwareConfirmatorModule = nullptr;
        return FALSE;
    }

    // Each kind is recognised as long as one of its two entry points resolved.
    // Named after the symbols, not the kinds, since camera has two.
    const struct {
        PCWSTR name;
        const void* ramp;
        const void* thunk;
    } kindRecorders[] = {
        {L"ShowVolume",
         (void*)ShowVolumeAsync_Original,
         (void*)ShowVolumeThunk_Original},
        {L"ShowBrightness",
         (void*)ShowBrightnessAsync_Original,
         (void*)ShowBrightnessThunk_Original},
        {L"ShowKeyboardBrightness",
         (void*)ShowKeyboardBrightnessAsync_Original,
         (void*)ShowKeyboardBrightnessThunk_Original},
        {L"ShowAirplaneModeOn",
         (void*)ShowAirplaneModeOnAsync_Original,
         (void*)ShowAirplaneModeOnThunk_Original},
        {L"ShowCameraOn",
         (void*)ShowCameraOnAsync_Original,
         (void*)ShowCameraOnThunk_Original},
        {L"ShowCameraAccessEnabled",
         (void*)ShowCameraAccessEnabledAsync_Original,
         (void*)ShowCameraAccessEnabledThunk_Original},
        {L"ShowMicrophoneMuted",
         (void*)ShowMicrophoneMutedAsync_Original,
         (void*)ShowMicrophoneMutedThunk_Original},
        {L"ShowText",
         (void*)ShowTextAsync_Original,
         (void*)ShowTextThunk_Original},
    };

    if (!ConfirmatorHostControl_Hide_Original ||
        !ConfirmatorHostControl_HideWithoutAnimation_Original) {
        g_hideAnimationUnavailable = true;
        if (settings->skipHideAnimation) {
            Wh_Log(L"%s", kHideAnimationUnavailableMessage);
        }
    }

    // Report all of them before deciding, so a build that moved several shows all.
    for (const auto& recorder : kindRecorders) {
        Wh_Log(L"Entry point %s resolved through ramp=%d thunk=%d", recorder.name,
               !!recorder.ramp, !!recorder.thunk);

        if (!recorder.ramp && !recorder.thunk) {
            g_kindUnreliable = true;
        }
    }

    // Only worth saying to someone who has an override set. With the shipped
    // defaults there is nothing being ignored to complain about.
    if (g_kindUnreliable && anyPerIndicator) {
        Wh_Log(L"%s", kKindUnreliableMessage);
    }

    // The thread_local flag that tells virtual desktop popups apart from other
    // text indicators is set from ShowText's thunk, so if the thunk didn't
    // resolve, virtual desktop popups silently follow the Other indicators position.
    // The ramp resolving on its own is enough to keep text detection working,
    // so it wouldn't trip the recorder check above. Only worth saying if the
    // user has actually set a per-kind position for the virtual desktop popup, and
    // not when every kind already falls back to the main position.
    g_virtualDesktopUndetectable =
        !ShowTextThunk_Original && ShowTextAsync_Original;
    if (g_virtualDesktopUndetectable && !g_kindUnreliable &&
        settings->perIndicator[(size_t)Indicator::virtualDesktop] !=
            Position::inherit) {
        Wh_Log(L"%s", kVirtualDesktopUndetectableMessage);
    }
    LogUnavailableHiding(*settings);

    // Every threadpool timer in Explorer goes through these hooks, so they are
    // only installed while Seconds on screen is in use. Turning it on or off
    // reloads the mod (see Wh_ModSettingsChanged). Failure is logged and never
    // prevents the placement feature from loading.
    if (settings->durationSeconds &&
        (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(SetThreadpoolTimer,
                                         SetThreadpoolTimer_Hook,
                                         &SetThreadpoolTimer_Original) ||
         !WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(SetThreadpoolTimerEx,
                                         SetThreadpoolTimerEx_Hook,
                                         &SetThreadpoolTimerEx_Original))) {
        Wh_Log(L"Duration timer hook unavailable; Windows timeout may be retained");
    }
    return TRUE;
}

void Wh_ModUninit() {
    Wh_Log(L">");

    if (g_hardwareConfirmatorModule) {
        FreeLibrary(g_hardwareConfirmatorModule);
        g_hardwareConfirmatorModule = nullptr;
    }
}

BOOL Wh_ModSettingsChanged(BOOL* bReload) {
    Wh_Log(L">");

    const bool hadDuration = g_settings.duration() != 0;
    LoadSettings();
    const auto settings = g_settings.load();
    // Reload to install or remove the timer hooks.
    *bReload = hadDuration != (settings->durationSeconds != 0);
    if (g_kindUnreliable && AnyPerIndicator(*settings)) {
        Wh_Log(L"%s", kKindUnreliableMessage);
    }

    if (g_hideAnimationUnavailable && settings->skipHideAnimation) {
        Wh_Log(L"%s", kHideAnimationUnavailableMessage);
    }

    if (g_virtualDesktopUndetectable && !g_kindUnreliable &&
        settings->perIndicator[(size_t)Indicator::virtualDesktop] !=
            Position::inherit) {
        Wh_Log(L"%s", kVirtualDesktopUndetectableMessage);
    }
    LogUnavailableHiding(*settings);

    return TRUE;
}

// ==WindhawkMod==
// @id              quick-launch-dock
// @name            Quick Launch Dock
// @name:ru-RU      Панель быстрого запуска
// @description     A slim animated dock on the screen edge: drop a shortcut or pick a program with "+", then launch it in one click
// @description:ru-RU Тонкая анимированная панель у края экрана: перетащи ярлык или выбери программу через «+» и запускай в один клик
// @version         1.1.0
// @author          cheliks1123
// @github          https://github.com/cheliks1123
// @include         windhawk.exe
// @compilerOptions -lshell32 -lcomdlg32 -lgdi32 -luser32 -lole32 -loleaut32 -ldwmapi -lcomctl32 -ladvapi32 -lwininet
// ==/WindhawkMod==

// ==WindhawkModReadme==
/*
# Quick Launch Dock

![Quick Launch Dock demo - dragging a shortcut onto the dock](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cheliks1123/Quick-launch-dock/main/quck-lauch-dock.gif)

*Drag a shortcut onto the dock and it stays there. Click an icon to launch it.*

A slim, smoothly animated dock that lives on the edge of your screen and gives you
one-click access to your favourite programs, files and folders. Think of it as a
tiny launcher bar with "+" slots: drop a shortcut onto it, or click "+" and pick a
program, and it stays there until you remove it.

> ⚠️ **Website icons, please note:** not every website provides an icon, and the ones that do are not always in good quality. Many sites only offer a tiny 16×16 or 32×32 icon that can look blurry on a big dock, and some offer none at all. In that case a gray globe 🌐 stays in its place. You can always pick your own image with "Change icon" 🖼️.

## ✨ Features

- ➕ **Add programs your way**
  - Drag and drop shortcuts, executables, files or folders onto the dock.
  - Click the **+** slot to choose a program in a file dialog (shortcuts are kept as shortcuts, so their icons stay correct).
  - Right-click the **+** slot to choose a program, add a website, or paste a path or link from the clipboard (quotes and `%ENVIRONMENT%` variables are handled).
- 🌐 **Websites as slots** — right-click any icon and pick "Add to the dock", then "Add a website..." (or paste a link with "Paste a path or link"). A click opens the address in your default browser. Every site gets a gray globe icon. The optional "Download site icons" setting (off by default) lets the mod request the site's own /favicon.ico in the background and use it instead. A spinner is shown while the icon is downloading, and the globe stays if it cannot be downloaded. You can also pick your own image with "Change icon".
- 🚀 **One-click launch** — click an icon to start it. The working directory is set automatically.
- 🖱️ **Right-click menu** on any icon: Open, Run as administrator, Show in folder, Change icon / Reset icon, Move up / Move down, Add to the dock (choose a program, add a website, paste a path or link), Remove. For websites: Open, Change icon / Reset icon, Refresh site icon, Move up / Move down, Add to the dock, Remove.
- ↕️ **Reorder by dragging** — press and hold an icon, drag it along the dock and drop it where you want. The other icons move aside smoothly. You can also drop it onto another panel: while you drag, all panels slide out, so you can move an icon between panels. "Move up / Move down" in the menu still works too.
- 📐 **Dock size** — thickness of the dock, the space around every icon and the inner padding of the dock are set separately from the icon size.
- 🎨 **Custom icons** — pick any image (PNG, JPG, BMP, GIF or ICO) for an item from the right-click menu. The choice is remembered, and "Reset icon" brings back the original.
- 💾 **Persistent list** — your slots are saved by Windhawk and restored after a restart.
- 🙈 **Auto-hide** — the dock collapses into a thin strip and smoothly slides out when you move the mouse to the screen edge.
- 🎬 **Smooth animations** — slide-in/out, hover highlight fade, icon zoom on hover, a small press effect when you click an icon, appear/disappear and re-ordering animations. Frames are synchronized with your monitor's refresh rate, so it stays smooth on 60/144/240 Hz displays. You can also pick a fixed rate (120 to 360 Hz) in the settings.
- 💎 **High-quality rendering** — anti-aliased rounded corners and high-quality icon scaling (GDI+), per-pixel transparent window, DPI-aware sizes.
- 🎮 **Fullscreen aware** — optionally hides itself while a fullscreen app or game is active.
- 🌈 **Fully themeable** — background, hover, accent (plus sign and handle) and border colors are configurable (`#RRGGBB`).
- 🔮 **Panel opacity and glass style** — make the panel background translucent (icons stay fully opaque) and switch on a frosted-glass look with a soft highlight and a light border.
- 🌗 **Follows the Windows theme** — optionally takes the light or dark colors and the accent color from Windows, and updates when you switch the theme.
- 🔵 **Running indicator** — a small dot on the screen-edge side of an icon shows that its program is running.
- ✨ **Appear animation** — the dock slides in and fades in when it starts, and the icons pop in one after another when the dock slides out.
- 🎭 **Seven animation styles** — Slide and pop (default), Jelly (the dock overshoots and wobbles like jelly while the icons lag behind and squash), Ripple (a wave runs along the dock and lifts the icons as it passes), Fade (calm, no movement), Genie (the dock flows out of a point at the screen edge through a smooth funnel, like the macOS window effect), Oval (a small oval pops out of the edge, then unfolds into the dock) and Droplet (a drop leaves the edge on a thin neck, the neck snaps and the drop opens into the dock). Choose one in the settings.
- 🔎 **Icon magnification** — an optional macOS-style effect, independent of the animation style: icons grow smoothly around the cursor and the effect glides along the dock as you move the mouse.
- 🗂️ **Up to four panels** — turn on any combination of the right, left, top and bottom screen edges. Every panel keeps its own list of programs (for example one for apps and one for games), while appearance and animation settings are shared. Adjustable icon size, tooltips with the item name.
- 🛡️ Does not use the taskbar, does not hook any functions and does not modify system files. Disabling the mod removes the dock completely.

## 🆚 How it differs from existing mods

- **Quick Launch & Media Panel** is a collapsible panel at the top of the screen with shortcut pages and media controls. This mod is a minimal dock on any screen edge (left, right, top or bottom, in any combination): a row or column of icons and a "+" slot, with no pages and no media controls.
- **Left Taskbar Quick Pin Dock** is attached to the taskbar next to the Start button. This mod floats on the screen edge independently of the taskbar.
- What is specific to this mod: auto-hide into a thin strip that smoothly slides out on hover, hide-in-fullscreen, per-item "Run as administrator" and "Show in folder", and configurable colors.

## 📖 How to use

1. Enable the mod. A dock appears at the right edge of the primary monitor (vertically centered). Turn on more edges in the settings to get more panels.
2. Drag a shortcut/program/folder onto it, or click **+**.
3. Click an icon to launch. Right-click an icon for more actions. Hold an icon and drag it to change the order.
4. With auto-hide enabled, move the cursor to the screen edge to reveal the dock.

## ⚙️ Settings

| Setting | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Panel on the right / left / top / bottom edge | Turn on any combination of edges. Every panel keeps its own list of programs. If all four are off, the right panel is used. |
| Icon size | Icon size in pixels at 100% DPI (16–96). Scales with system DPI. |
| Panel thickness | Thickness of the dock in pixels at 100% DPI (0–300). 0 means automatic: just enough for the icon plus the paddings. A larger value makes the dock thicker and keeps the icons centered. A value that is too small is raised to the automatic size. |
| Space around each icon | Padding around every icon in pixels at 100% DPI (0–40). Sets the distance between icons and the size of the hover highlight. Default 8. |
| Panel inner padding | Padding between the dock border and its icons in pixels at 100% DPI (0–40). Default 4. |
| Corner radius | Roundness of the panel corners in pixels at 100% DPI (0-40). 0 makes the panel square. Default 12. |
| Download site icons | Off by default. When on, the mod requests /favicon.ico from the website of every website slot, in the background, and caches the file in the mod's storage folder. Only the sites you added are contacted and nothing is sent to third parties. If a site has no usable icon, it is not asked again for a week. If it just does not answer, the mod tries once more right away and again on the next start. |
| Auto-hide | Collapse to a thin strip until the cursor touches the edge. |
| Hide when a fullscreen app is active | Hides the dock above fullscreen windows/games. |
| Animations | Turns all animations on or off. |
| Animation style | How the dock appears and slides out of its strip: Slide and pop (default), Jelly, Ripple, Fade, Genie, Oval or Droplet. Jelly and Ripple play when the dock expands; it folds back with the plain slide. |
| Animation speed | Speed of all animations in percent. 100 is the original speed; the default is 25, which makes the differences between styles easy to see. |
| Animation refresh rate | Auto (default) draws one frame per monitor refresh. Pick 120, 144, 180, 240 or 360 Hz to draw at a fixed rate, for example on a laptop whose refresh rate changes or when animations look choppy. Higher values use more CPU and battery. |
| Show the "+" slot | Turn off to hide the "+" slot. Programs can still be added by dragging them onto the dock or from the "Add to the dock" item of the right-click menu of any icon. |
| Show a dot on running programs | Shows a small dot on the screen edge side of an icon whose program is running. Programs are matched by the file path of the program, so programs started through a launcher or an updater may not be detected. The process list is checked every few seconds while the dock is open. On by default. |
| Take the icon from the shortcut's target | Shows the icon of the program a shortcut points to instead of the icon stored in the shortcut. An icon chosen with "Change icon" always takes priority. |
| Icon magnification | macOS-style magnification of the icons around the cursor. Works with any animation style. Off by default. |
| Panel opacity | Opacity of the panel background, 10-100 percent. Icons always stay fully opaque. |
| Glass style | Frosted-glass look: tinted translucent panel, soft highlight and a light border. Works best with a lower panel opacity. This is a visual style, it does not blur what is behind the dock. |
| Background / Hover / Accent / Border color | Colors in `#RRGGBB` format. Invalid values fall back to the defaults. |

## 📝 Notes and limitations

- The mod runs as a standalone tool in its own dedicated process (it is not injected into Explorer and hooks nothing), so a problem in the mod can never affect the Windows shell, and only one instance is ever running.
- Drag and drop from windows running **as administrator** is blocked by Windows (UIPI). Use the **+** button in that case.
- The dock is placed on the **primary** monitor. With auto-hide and another monitor attached on the same side, the cursor may pass the edge too quickly to reveal the dock — disable auto-hide there.
- The number of slots is limited by the length of the screen edge, and room is left at the corners so that panels on neighbouring edges do not overlap.
- Slots are stored as file paths or web addresses (`http://` and `https://`). If a file is moved or deleted, its icon becomes generic until you remove it.
- The lists are stored separately for every Windows account. The first account that starts this version takes over the list saved by earlier versions.
- The mod makes no network requests unless "Download site icons" is on. In that case only the sites you added are contacted, one request each, and the icons are kept in the mod's storage folder, which Windhawk removes together with the mod.
- The list saved by earlier versions stays on the right-edge panel. Turning a panel off keeps its list, so it comes back when you turn the panel on again.

# Панель быстрого запуска

Тонкая плавно анимированная панель у края экрана для быстрого запуска любимых
программ, файлов и папок. По сути — мини-лаунчер с «плюсиками»: перетащи на него
ярлык или нажми «+» и выбери программу — она останется на панели, пока ты сам её не уберёшь.

> ⚠️ **Про иконки сайтов:** не все сайты отдают иконку, а те, что отдают, не всегда в хорошем качестве. У многих сайтов есть только крошечная иконка 16×16 или 32×32, которая на большой панели выглядит размыто, а у некоторых её нет совсем. Тогда на месте иконки остаётся серый глобус 🌐. Свою картинку всегда можно выбрать через «Сменить иконку» 🖼️.

## ✨ Возможности

- ➕ **Добавление как удобно**
  - Перетаскивание ярлыков, exe-файлов, файлов и папок прямо на панель.
  - Клик по **+** — выбор программы через диалог (ярлыки сохраняются как ярлыки, поэтому иконки остаются правильными).
  - ПКМ по **+** — выбрать программу, добавить сайт или вставить путь или ссылку из буфера обмена (кавычки и переменные вида `%APPDATA%` обрабатываются).
- 🌐 **Сайты в слотах** — ПКМ по любой иконке → «Добавить на панель» → «Добавить сайт…» (или вставь ссылку через «Вставить путь или ссылку»). Клик открывает адрес в браузере по умолчанию. Каждый сайт получает иконку в виде серого глобуса. Необязательная настройка «Скачивать иконки сайтов» (по умолчанию выключена) позволяет моду в фоне запросить /favicon.ico самого сайта и использовать его вместо глобуса. Пока иконка скачивается, показывается крутящийся кружок, а если скачать не удалось, остаётся глобус. Свою картинку можно выбрать через «Сменить иконку».
- 🚀 **Запуск в один клик** — рабочая папка выставляется автоматически.
- 🖱️ **Контекстное меню** на любой иконке: Открыть, Запуск от имени администратора, Показать в папке, Сменить иконку / Сбросить иконку, Переместить выше / ниже, Добавить на панель (выбрать программу, добавить сайт, вставить путь или ссылку), Удалить. Для сайтов: Открыть, Сменить иконку / Сбросить иконку, Обновить иконку сайта, Переместить выше / ниже, Добавить на панель, Удалить.
- ↕️ **Перестановка перетаскиванием** — зажми иконку, перетащи вдоль панели и отпусти там, где нужно. Остальные иконки плавно раздвигаются. Можно отпустить и на другой панели: пока тащишь, все панели выезжают, так что иконку можно переносить между панелями. «Переместить выше / ниже» в меню тоже остаются.
- 📐 **Размер панели** — толщина панели, отступ вокруг каждой иконки и внутренний отступ панели настраиваются отдельно от размера иконок.
- 🎨 **Свои иконки** — для любого элемента через меню можно выбрать картинку (PNG, JPG, BMP, GIF или ICO). Выбор запоминается, а «Сбросить иконку» возвращает исходную.
- 💾 **Список сохраняется** — слоты хранятся в Windhawk и восстанавливаются после перезагрузки.
- 🙈 **Автоскрытие** — в покое панель сворачивается в тонкую полоску и плавно выезжает, когда подводишь курсор к краю экрана.
- 🎬 **Плавные анимации** — выезд и сворачивание, плавная подсветка, увеличение иконки при наведении, лёгкий эффект нажатия на иконку, анимации появления, удаления и перестановки. Кадры синхронизированы с частотой монитора, поэтому всё плавно на 60/144/240 Гц. В настройках можно выбрать и фиксированную частоту (от 120 до 360 Гц).
- 💎 **Качественная отрисовка** — сглаженные скруглённые углы и качественное масштабирование иконок (GDI+), окно с попиксельной прозрачностью, учёт DPI.
- 🎮 **Полноэкранные приложения** — при желании панель сама прячется, пока открыта полноэкранная программа или игра.
- 🌈 **Настраиваемые цвета** — фон, подсветка, акцент (плюс и полоска) и рамка задаются в формате `#RRGGBB`.
- 🔮 **Прозрачность панели и стеклянный стиль** — фон панели можно сделать полупрозрачным (иконки остаются полностью непрозрачными) и включить вид матового стекла с мягким бликом и светлой рамкой.
- 🌗 **Тема Windows** — по желанию берёт светлые или тёмные цвета и цвет акцента из Windows и обновляется при смене темы.
- 🔵 **Индикатор запуска** — маленькая точка со стороны края экрана показывает, что программа запущена.
- ✨ **Анимация появления** — при запуске панель выезжает с плавным проявлением, а при выезде из полоски иконки по очереди «выпрыгивают».
- 🎭 **Семь стилей анимации** — Slide and pop (по умолчанию), Jelly (панель «перелетает» и дрожит как желе, а иконки запаздывают и сплющиваются), Ripple (по панели пробегает волна и приподнимает иконки), Fade (спокойное проявление без движения), Genie (панель вытекает из точки у края экрана плавной воронкой, как эффект окон в macOS), Oval (у края выскакивает небольшой овал, который затем раскрывается в панель) и Droplet (капля отрывается от края на тонкой «ножке», ножка рвётся, и капля раскрывается в панель). Выбирается в настройках.
- 🔎 **Увеличение иконок при наведении** — необязательный эффект как в macOS, не зависящий от стиля анимации: иконки плавно увеличиваются вокруг курсора, и эффект скользит вдоль панели за мышью.
- 🗂️ **До четырёх панелей** — включай любое сочетание правого, левого, верхнего и нижнего краёв экрана. У каждой панели свой список программ (например, одна для приложений, другая для игр), а внешний вид и анимации общие. Настраиваемый размер иконок, подсказки с названием элемента.
- 🛡️ Не использует панель задач, не перехватывает функции и не меняет системные файлы. При отключении мода панель полностью исчезает.

## 🆚 Чем отличается от существующих модов

- **Quick Launch & Media Panel** — сворачиваемая панель у верхнего края экрана со страницами ярлыков и управлением медиа. Этот мод — минимальная панель у любого края экрана (левого, правого, верхнего или нижнего, в любом сочетании): ряд или колонка иконок и слот «+», без страниц и без медиа-кнопок.
- **Left Taskbar Quick Pin Dock** — панель, прикреплённая к панели задач рядом с кнопкой «Пуск». Этот мод свободно располагается у края экрана и от панели задач не зависит.
- Особенности этого мода: автоскрытие в тонкую полоску с плавным выездом при наведении, скрытие в полноэкранных приложениях, «Запуск от имени администратора» и «Показать в папке» для каждого элемента, настраиваемые цвета.

## 📖 Как пользоваться

1. Включи мод. У правого края основного монитора по центру по вертикали появится панель. Чтобы получить больше панелей, включи другие края в настройках.
2. Перетащи на неё ярлык, программу или папку либо нажми **+**.
3. Клик по иконке — запуск. ПКМ по иконке — дополнительные действия. Зажми иконку и перетащи, чтобы поменять порядок.
4. При включённом автоскрытии подведи курсор к краю экрана, чтобы показать панель.

## Примечания и ограничения

- Мод работает как самостоятельный инструмент в собственном процессе (он не внедряется в проводник и ничего не перехватывает), поэтому сбой мода не может повлиять на оболочку Windows, а одновременно запущена всегда только одна копия.
- Перетаскивание из окон, запущенных **от имени администратора**, блокируется Windows (UIPI). В этом случае используй кнопку **+**.
- Панель располагается на **основном** мониторе. При автоскрытии и втором мониторе с той же стороны курсор может проскакивать край слишком быстро — в таком случае отключи автоскрытие.
- Количество слотов ограничено длиной края экрана, а у углов оставлено место, чтобы панели на соседних краях не перекрывались.
- Слоты хранятся как пути к файлам или веб-адреса (`http://` и `https://`). Если файл перенесён или удалён, иконка станет стандартной, пока ты не уберёшь слот.
- Списки хранятся отдельно для каждой учётной записи Windows. Список, сохранённый прошлыми версиями, забирает первая учётная запись, которая запустит эту версию.
- Мод не делает сетевых запросов, пока не включена настройка «Скачивать иконки сайтов». Если она включена, обращения идут только к добавленным вами сайтам, по одному запросу на сайт, а иконки хранятся в папке хранилища мода, которую Windhawk удаляет вместе с модом.
- Список, сохранённый прежними версиями, остаётся на панели у правого края. При выключении панели её список сохраняется и возвращается при повторном включении.

static UINT32 Argb(COLORREF c, int a) {
    a = std::clamp(a, 0, 255);
    return ((UINT32)a << 24) | ((UINT32)GetRValue(c) << 16) | ((UINT32)GetGValue(c) << 8) |
           (UINT32)GetBValue(c);
}

static COLORREF Mix(COLORREF a, COLORREF b, float t) {
    t = std::clamp(t, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    int r = (int)(GetRValue(a) + (GetRValue(b) - GetRValue(a)) * t);
    int g = (int)(GetGValue(a) + (GetGValue(b) - GetGValue(a)) * t);
    int bl = (int)(GetBValue(a) + (GetBValue(b) - GetBValue(a)) * t);
    return RGB(r, g, bl);
}

static float SmoothStep(float t) {
    t = std::clamp(t, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    return t * t * (3.0f - 2.0f * t);
}

static float JellySpring(float x) {
    x = std::max(0.0f, x);
    return 1.0f - expf(-5.5f * x) * cosf(15.0f * x);
}

static float LinearT(float p) {
    p = std::clamp(p, 0.0f, 0.9955f);
    return std::clamp(-logf(1.0f - p) / 5.4f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
}

static int Sc(int v) { return MulDiv(v, g_dpi, 96); }

static int Pad() { return Sc(g_cfg.iconPad); }
static int Margin() { return Sc(g_cfg.panelPad); }
static int StripW() { return Sc(6); }
static int SlotSize() { return IconPx() + Pad() * 2; }
static int FullW() { return std::max(SlotSize() + Margin() * 2, Sc(g_cfg.thickness)); }
static int CrossOff() { return (FullW() - SlotSize()) / 2; }
static bool PlusVisible() { return g_cfg.showPlus || P->items.empty(); }
static int TotalSlots() { return (int)P->items.size() + (PlusVisible() ? 1 : 0); }
static bool Expanded() { return !g_cfg.autoHide || P->expanded; }

static bool IsRu() { return (GetUserDefaultUILanguage() & 0x3FF) == LANG_RUSSIAN; }

static HMONITOR PrimaryMon() {
    return MonitorFromPoint(POINT{0, 0}, MONITOR_DEFAULTTOPRIMARY);
}

static RECT WorkArea() {
    MONITORINFO mi{};
    mi.cbSize = sizeof(mi);
    GetMonitorInfoW(PrimaryMon(), &mi);
    return mi.rcWork;
}

static int MaxItems() {
    RECT wa = WorkArea();
    int len = P->horiz ? (wa.right - wa.left) : (wa.bottom - wa.top);
    int avail = len - Sc(40) - FullW() * 2 - Margin() * 2;
    return std::max(1, avail / SlotSize() - (g_cfg.showPlus ? 1 : 0));
}

static RECT SlotRect(int i) {
    int s = SlotSize(), m = Margin(), c = CrossOff();
    RECT r{c, m + i * s, c + s, m + (i + 1) * s};
    if (P->horiz) return RECT{r.top, r.left, r.bottom, r.right};
    return r;
}

static int HitTest(POINT pt) {
    if (!Expanded()) return -1;
    int s = SlotSize(), m = Margin(), c = CrossOff();
    int lx = P->horiz ? pt.y : pt.x;
    int ly = P->horiz ? pt.x : pt.y;
    if (lx < c || lx >= c + s || ly < m) return -1;
    int i = (ly - m) / s;
    return i < TotalSlots() ? i : -1;
}

static double NowSec() {
    static double freq = 0;
    if (freq == 0) {
        LARGE_INTEGER f;
        QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
        freq = (double)f.QuadPart;
    }
    LARGE_INTEGER c;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&c);
    return (double)c.QuadPart / freq;
}

static COLORREF ParseColor(PCWSTR s, COLORREF def) {
    if (!s) return def;
    if (*s == L'#') s++;
    if (wcslen(s) != 6) return def;
    wchar_t* end = nullptr;
    unsigned long v = wcstoul(s, &end, 16);
    if (!end || *end) return def;
    return RGB((v >> 16) & 255, (v >> 8) & 255, v & 255);
}

static COLORREF ColorSetting(PCWSTR name, COLORREF def) {
    PCWSTR s = Wh_GetStringSetting(name);
    COLORREF c = ParseColor(s, def);
    if (s) Wh_FreeStringSetting(s);
    return c;
}

static void ApplySystemTheme() {
    DWORD light = 0, sz = sizeof(light);
    bool dark = true;
    if (RegGetValueW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, L"Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Themes\\Personalize",
                     L"AppsUseLightTheme", RRF_RT_REG_DWORD, nullptr, &light, &sz) == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        dark = light == 0;
    }
    COLORREF neutral;
    if (dark) {
        g_cfg.bg = RGB(0x20, 0x20, 0x20);
        g_cfg.hover = RGB(0x42, 0x42, 0x42);
        g_cfg.border = RGB(0x46, 0x46, 0x46);
        neutral = RGB(0xBE, 0xBE, 0xBE);
    } else {
        g_cfg.bg = RGB(0xF3, 0xF3, 0xF3);
        g_cfg.hover = RGB(0xDA, 0xDA, 0xDA);
        g_cfg.border = RGB(0xC8, 0xC8, 0xC8);
        neutral = RGB(0x5F, 0x5F, 0x5F);
    }
    g_cfg.accent = neutral;

    if (SUCCEEDED(DwmGetColorizationColor(&col, &opaque))) {
        COLORREF c = RGB((col >> 16) & 255, (col >> 8) & 255, col & 255);
        auto lum = [](COLORREF x) {
            return (0.2126 * GetRValue(x) + 0.7152 * GetGValue(x) + 0.0722 * GetBValue(x)) / 255.0;
        };
        if (fabs(lum(c) - lum(g_cfg.bg)) >= 0.25) g_cfg.accent = c;
    }
}

static void* Resample(void* src, int size) {
    void* bmp = nullptr;
    if (Gp.CreateBitmapFromScan0(size, size, 0, 0x000E200B, nullptr, &bmp) != 0 || !bmp) {
        return nullptr;
    }
    void* g = nullptr;
    if (Gp.GetImageGraphicsContext(bmp, &g) != 0 || !g) {
        Gp.DisposeImage(bmp);
        return nullptr;
    }
    Gp.SetInterp(g, 7);
    Gp.SetPixOff(g, 2);
    Gp.Clear(g, 0x00000000);
    Gp.DrawImageRect(g, src, 0.0f, 0.0f, (float)size, (float)size);
    Gp.DeleteGraphics(g);
    return bmp;
}

static void* ScaleTo(void* src, int dst) {
    UINT w = 0;
    Gp.GetImageWidth(src, &w);
    int cur = (int)w;
    void* tmp = nullptr;
    void* from = src;
    while (cur / 2 >= dst) {
        void* nb = Resample(from, cur / 2);
        if (!nb) break;
        if (tmp) Gp.DisposeImage(tmp);
        tmp = nb;
        from = nb;
        cur /= 2;
    }
    void* res = Resample(from, dst);
    if (tmp) Gp.DisposeImage(tmp);
    return res;
}

static void* BitmapFromHicon(HICON h, std::vector<UINT32>& pix) {
    ICONINFO ii{};
    if (!GetIconInfo(h, &ii)) return nullptr;
    BITMAP bm{};
    int w = 0, hgt = 0;
    if (ii.hbmColor && GetObjectW(ii.hbmColor, sizeof(bm), &bm)) {
        w = bm.bmWidth;
        hgt = bm.bmHeight;
    } else if (ii.hbmMask && GetObjectW(ii.hbmMask, sizeof(bm), &bm)) {
        w = bm.bmWidth;
        hgt = bm.bmHeight / 2;
    }
    if (ii.hbmColor) DeleteObject(ii.hbmColor);
    if (ii.hbmMask) DeleteObject(ii.hbmMask);
    if (w <= 0 || hgt <= 0 || w > 1024 || hgt > 1024) return nullptr;

    BITMAPINFO bi{};
    bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = w;
    bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -hgt;
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

    HDC dc = CreateCompatibleDC(nullptr);
    void* bitsB = nullptr;
    void* bitsW = nullptr;
    HBITMAP dibB = CreateDIBSection(dc, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bitsB, nullptr, 0);
    HBITMAP dibW = CreateDIBSection(dc, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bitsW, nullptr, 0);
    void* bmp = nullptr;
    if (dc && dibB && dibW && bitsB && bitsW) {
        size_t n = (size_t)w * (size_t)hgt;
        HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(dc, dibB);
        memset(bitsB, 0x00, n * 4);
        DrawIconEx(dc, 0, 0, h, w, hgt, 0, nullptr, DI_NORMAL);
        GdiFlush();
        SelectObject(dc, dibW);
        memset(bitsW, 0xFF, n * 4);
        DrawIconEx(dc, 0, 0, h, w, hgt, 0, nullptr, DI_NORMAL);
        GdiFlush();
        SelectObject(dc, old);

        pix.resize(n);
        const BYTE* pb = (const BYTE*)bitsB;
        const BYTE* pw = (const BYTE*)bitsW;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int db = pw[i * 4 + 0] - pb[i * 4 + 0];
            int dg = pw[i * 4 + 1] - pb[i * 4 + 1];
            int dr = pw[i * 4 + 2] - pb[i * 4 + 2];
            int a = std::clamp(255 - (db + dg + dr) / 3, 0, 255);
            int bl = std::min((int)pb[i * 4 + 0], a);
            int gr = std::min((int)pb[i * 4 + 1], a);
            int rd = std::min((int)pb[i * 4 + 2], a);
            pix[i] = ((UINT32)a << 24) | ((UINT32)rd << 16) | ((UINT32)gr << 8) | (UINT32)bl;
        }
        if (Gp.CreateBitmapFromScan0(w, hgt, w * 4, 0x000E200B, (BYTE*)pix.data(), &bmp) != 0) {
            bmp = nullptr;
        }
    }
    if (dibB) DeleteObject(dibB);
    if (dibW) DeleteObject(dibW);
    if (dc) DeleteDC(dc);
    return bmp;
}

static void* MakeSquare(void* src) {
    UINT w = 0, h = 0;
    Gp.GetImageWidth(src, &w);
    Gp.GetImageHeight(src, &h);
    if (w == 0 || h == 0) return nullptr;
    int side = (int)std::max(w, h);
    if (w == h && side <= 1024) return nullptr;
    int canvas = std::min(side, 1024);
    float sc = (float)canvas / (float)side;
    void* bmp = nullptr;
    if (Gp.CreateBitmapFromScan0(canvas, canvas, 0, 0x000E200B, nullptr, &bmp) != 0 || !bmp) {
        return nullptr;
    }
    void* g = nullptr;
    if (Gp.GetImageGraphicsContext(bmp, &g) != 0 || !g) {
        Gp.DisposeImage(bmp);
        return nullptr;
    }
    Gp.SetInterp(g, 7);
    Gp.SetPixOff(g, 2);
    Gp.Clear(g, 0x00000000);
    float dw = w * sc, dh = h * sc;
    Gp.DrawImageRect(g, src, (canvas - dw) / 2.0f, (canvas - dh) / 2.0f, dw, dh);
    Gp.DeleteGraphics(g);
    return bmp;
}

static HICON ExtractIconFromFile(const std::wstring& file, int index) {

static std::wstring LowerStr(std::wstring s) {
    for (auto& c : s) c = (wchar_t)towlower(c);
    return s;
}

static bool IsUrl(const std::wstring& s) {
    return _wcsnicmp(s.c_str(), L"http://", 7) == 0 || _wcsnicmp(s.c_str(), L"https://", 8) == 0;
}

static void ComputeExeKey(Item& it) {
    it.exeKey.clear();
    it.exeName.clear();
    if (IsUrl(it.path)) return;
    std::wstring target = it.path;
    size_t n = target.size();
    if (n >= 4 && _wcsicmp(target.c_str() + n - 4, L".lnk") == 0) target = LinkTarget(target);
    n = target.size();
    if (n < 4 || _wcsicmp(target.c_str() + n - 4, L".exe") != 0) return;
    std::wstring low = LowerStr(target);
    size_t sl = low.find_last_of(L"\\/");
    std::wstring name = sl == std::wstring::npos ? low : low.substr(sl + 1);
    if (name == L"explorer.exe") return;
    it.exeKey = low;
    it.exeName = name;
}

static std::wstring HostOf(const std::wstring& url) {
    size_t p = url.find(L"://");
    if (p == std::wstring::npos) return L"";
    size_t b = p + 3;
    size_t e = url.find_first_of(L"/?#", b);
    std::wstring a = url.substr(b, e == std::wstring::npos ? std::wstring::npos : e - b);
    size_t at = a.rfind(L'@');
    if (at != std::wstring::npos) a = a.substr(at + 1);
    if (!a.empty() && a[0] != L'[') {
        size_t c = a.find(L':');
        if (c != std::wstring::npos) a.resize(c);
    }
    for (auto& ch : a) ch = (wchar_t)towlower(ch);
    return a;
}

static std::wstring BareHost(const std::wstring& host) {
    if (host.size() > 4 && _wcsnicmp(host.c_str(), L"www.", 4) == 0) return host.substr(4);
    return host;
}

static std::wstring TrimUrl(std::wstring s) {
    auto bad = [](wchar_t c) { return iswspace(c) || c == L'"' || c == L'<' || c == L'>'; };
    while (!s.empty() && bad(s.front())) s.erase(s.begin());
    while (!s.empty() && bad(s.back())) s.pop_back();
    return s;
}

static bool LooksLikeUrl(const std::wstring& raw) {
    std::wstring s = TrimUrl(raw);
    return IsUrl(s) || _wcsnicmp(s.c_str(), L"www.", 4) == 0;
}

static std::wstring NormalizeUrl(const std::wstring& raw) {
    std::wstring s = TrimUrl(raw);
    if (s.empty() || s.size() > 2000) return L"";
    for (wchar_t c : s) {
        if (iswspace(c) || c < 0x20) return L"";
    }
    bool hadScheme = IsUrl(s);
    if (!hadScheme) {
        if (s.find(L"://") != std::wstring::npos) return L"";
        size_t ae = s.find_first_of(L"/?#");
        std::wstring auth = s.substr(0, ae);
        if (auth.find(L'@') != std::wstring::npos) return L"";
        size_t colon = auth.rfind(L':');
        if (colon != std::wstring::npos) {
            if (colon + 1 >= auth.size()) return L"";
            for (size_t i = colon + 1; i < auth.size(); i++) {
                if (auth[i] < L'0' || auth[i] > L'9') return L"";
            }
        }
        s = L"https://" + s;
    }
    std::wstring host = HostOf(s);
    if (host.empty()) return L"";
    if (!hadScheme && host.find(L'.') == std::wstring::npos && host != L"localhost") return L"";
    for (size_t p; (p = s.find(L'|')) != std::wstring::npos;) s.replace(p, 1, L"%7C");
    return s;
}
