// Check if the current process is in the dark-mode exclusion list. When
// another process has applied the session-wide dark system colors, the
// GetSysColor/GetSysColorBrush hooks return light defaults here, undoing
// those shared values for this process only.
// Whether this process is on the dark-mode exclusion list. No side effects:
// RecomputeCustomDarkModeActive decides the flags from it.
static bool IsCurrentProcessDarkModeExcluded() {
    // Get current process name (uppercase for case-insensitive match)
    wchar_t procPath[MAX_PATH] = {};
    GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, procPath, MAX_PATH);
    wchar_t* slash = wcsrchr(procPath, L'\\');
    std::wstring procName = slash ? (slash + 1) : procPath;
    for (auto& ch : procName) ch = towupper(ch);

    // Hardcoded exclusions: apps that manage their own dark mode or are
    // incompatible with our dark mode pipeline. Not exposed in settings.
    static const wchar_t* kHardcodedExclusions[] = {
        // Microsoft Office — manages own dark mode via Fluent UI
        L"WINWORD.EXE", L"EXCEL.EXE", L"POWERPNT.EXE",
        L"OUTLOOK.EXE", L"ONENOTE.EXE", L"MSACCESS.EXE", L"MSPUB.EXE",
        // WordPad — has its own dark mode (Win11)
        L"WORDPAD.EXE",
    };
    for (const wchar_t* exc : kHardcodedExclusions) {
        if (procName == exc)
            return true;
    }

    // Iterate YAML array: DarkModeExcludeList[%d].target (top-level)
    for (int i = 0; ; i++) {
        wchar_t key[128] = {};
        swprintf_s(key, 128, L"DarkModeExcludeList[%d].target", i);
        auto target = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(Wh_GetStringSetting(key));
        if (!*target) break;

        std::wstring entry = target.get();
        size_t pos = entry.find_last_of(L"\\/");
        if (pos != std::wstring::npos && pos + 1 < entry.length())
            entry = entry.substr(pos + 1);
        for (auto& ch : entry) ch = towupper(ch);

        if (procName == entry)
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// The exclusion is decided before either flag is written, so an excluded
// process never reads as dark, not even for the moment a recompute takes.
// Order matters within each branch too: dozens of call sites read
// g_darkModeActive alone and trust it never overlaps g_darkModeExcluded, so
// the only transient states allowed are non-dark ones.
static bool RecomputeCustomDarkModeActive()
{
    const bool wanted = ShouldCustomDarkModeBeActive();
    if (wanted && IsCurrentProcessDarkModeExcluded()) {
        g_darkModeActive.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        g_darkModeExcluded.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        ResetExcludedProcessDarkModeHints();
    } else {
        g_darkModeExcluded.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        g_darkModeActive.store(wanted, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    HwndDarkCacheInvalidate();
    return g_darkModeActive.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

// Create and bind a D2D DC render target (allocates every call; acceptable for
// non-animated drawing paths)
// Thread-local cached D2D render target — avoids CreateDCRenderTarget per draw.
// BindDC is ~5µs vs CreateDCRenderTarget ~500µs (100x faster).
// Caller's ComPtr AddRef/Release doesn't destroy the cache (cache holds its own ref).
// Solid-color brush reused across draws on the cached RT — SetColor() is a
// cheap field write, so this avoids a CreateSolidColorBrush COM allocation
// per glyph/icon paint. FLS owns every thread cache and releases all of them
// deterministically when the mod unloads.
struct RoundedSelectionTileKey
{
    UINT slot = 0;
    UINT dpi = 0;
    uint64_t variant = 0;

    bool operator==(const RoundedSelectionTileKey& other) const
    {
        return slot == other.slot && dpi == other.dpi &&
            variant == other.variant;
    }
};

struct RoundedSelectionTileKeyHash
{
    size_t operator()(const RoundedSelectionTileKey& key) const
    {
        size_t h = std::hash<uint64_t>{}(key.variant);
        h ^= std::hash<UINT>{}(key.slot) + 0x9e3779b9u + (h << 6) + (h >> 2);
        h ^= std::hash<UINT>{}(key.dpi) + 0x9e3779b9u + (h << 6) + (h >> 2);
        return h;
    }
};

struct RoundedSelectionTile
{
    HDC dc = nullptr;
    HBITMAP bitmap = nullptr;
    int size = 0;
    int margin = 0;
    uint64_t lastUse = 0;

    RoundedSelectionTile() = default;
    RoundedSelectionTile(const RoundedSelectionTile&) = delete;
    RoundedSelectionTile& operator=(const RoundedSelectionTile&) = delete;

    RoundedSelectionTile(RoundedSelectionTile&& other) noexcept
    {
        *this = std::move(other);
    }

    RoundedSelectionTile& operator=(RoundedSelectionTile&& other) noexcept
    {
        if (this != &other) {
            Reset();
            dc = std::exchange(other.dc, nullptr);
            bitmap = std::exchange(other.bitmap, nullptr);
            size = std::exchange(other.size, 0);
            margin = std::exchange(other.margin, 0);
            lastUse = std::exchange(other.lastUse, 0);
        }
        return *this;
    }

    ~RoundedSelectionTile()
    {
        Reset();
    }

    void Reset()
    {
        if (dc) { DeleteDC(dc); dc = nullptr; }
        if (bitmap) { DeleteObject(bitmap); bitmap = nullptr; }
        size = 0;
        margin = 0;
        lastUse = 0;
    }
};

// A destination column's source pair and 8-bit weight in a horizontally
// scaled row blend (BlendRowsOverScaled), -1 where nothing maps.
struct BlendScaleColumn { int xa, xb, wx; };

// WIC identifiers, defined here so the mod needs no windowscodecs import.
static const CLSID kClsidWicImagingFactory = {
    0xcacaf262, 0x9370, 0x4615, {0xa1, 0x3b, 0x9f, 0x55, 0x39, 0xda, 0x4c, 0x0a}};
static const GUID kWicPixelFormat32bppPBGRA = {
    0x6fddc324, 0x4e03, 0x4bfe, {0xb1, 0x85, 0x3d, 0x77, 0x76, 0x8d, 0xc9, 0x10}};

// Per-thread shell text raster: a CPU Direct2D target over a WIC bitmap,
// which rasterizes without the DC render target's GDI round trip, and the
// DIB the result is copied into for AlphaBlend.
struct ShellTextRaster {
    HDC dc = nullptr;
    HBITMAP bitmap = nullptr;
    BYTE* pixels = nullptr;
    UINT width = 0, height = 0;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IWICImagingFactory> wic;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IWICBitmap> wicBitmap;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1RenderTarget> target;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteGdiInterop> editInterop;
    std::vector<float> editAdvances;
    std::vector<DWRITE_GLYPH_OFFSET> editOffsets;
    UINT targetWidth = 0, targetHeight = 0;
    // A thread without COM can't create the WIC factory; it isn't retried.
    HRESULT wicError = S_OK;

    void Reset()
    {
        ResetTarget();
        wic.Reset();
        editInterop.Reset();
        editAdvances.clear();
        editOffsets.clear();
        wicError = S_OK;
        if (dc) DeleteDC(dc);
        if (bitmap) DeleteObject(bitmap);
        dc = nullptr;
        bitmap = nullptr;
        pixels = nullptr;
        width = height = 0;
    }
    void ResetTarget()
    {
        brush.Reset();
        target.Reset();
        wicBitmap.Reset();
        targetWidth = targetHeight = 0;
    }
    // Grows both sides to the largest label seen, so one thread alternating
    // between wide and tall labels doesn't recreate its surfaces on every
    // draw. Beyond 1 MB it keeps just the requested size.
    static void GrowSize(UINT currentWidth, UINT currentHeight,
        UINT requestedWidth, UINT requestedHeight, UINT* nextWidth,
        UINT* nextHeight)
    {
        UINT grownWidth = std::max(currentWidth, requestedWidth);
        UINT grownHeight = std::max(currentHeight, requestedHeight);
        if (static_cast<size_t>(grownWidth) * grownHeight * 4 > 1024 * 1024) {
            grownWidth = requestedWidth;
            grownHeight = requestedHeight;
        }
        *nextWidth = grownWidth;
        *nextHeight = grownHeight;
    }
    HRESULT EnsureTarget(ID2D1Factory1* factory, UINT requestedWidth,
        UINT requestedHeight)
    {
        if (target && targetWidth >= requestedWidth &&
            targetHeight >= requestedHeight)
            return S_OK;
        if (!factory) return E_POINTER;
        HRESULT hr = S_OK;
        if (!wic) {
            if (FAILED(wicError)) return wicError;
            hr = CoCreateInstance(kClsidWicImagingFactory, nullptr,
                CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(&wic));
            if (FAILED(hr)) {
                wicError = hr;
                return hr;
            }
        }
        UINT nextWidth = 0, nextHeight = 0;
        GrowSize(std::max(targetWidth, 64u), std::max(targetHeight, 32u),
            requestedWidth, requestedHeight, &nextWidth, &nextHeight);
        ResetTarget();
        hr = wic->CreateBitmap(nextWidth, nextHeight, kWicPixelFormat32bppPBGRA,
            WICBitmapCacheOnDemand, &wicBitmap);
        const auto properties = D2D1::RenderTargetProperties(
            D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_TYPE_SOFTWARE,
            D2D1::PixelFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM,
                D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED), 96.0f, 96.0f);
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr))
            hr = factory->CreateWicBitmapRenderTarget(wicBitmap.Get(),
                &properties, &target);
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr))
            hr = target->CreateSolidColorBrush(
                D2D1::ColorF(D2D1::ColorF::Black), &brush);
        if (FAILED(hr)) {
            ResetTarget();
            return hr;
        }
        target->SetTextAntialiasMode(D2D1_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_MODE_GRAYSCALE);
        targetWidth = nextWidth;
        targetHeight = nextHeight;
        return S_OK;
    }
    HRESULT EnsureDib(UINT requestedWidth, UINT requestedHeight)
    {
        if (dc && width >= requestedWidth && height >= requestedHeight)
            return S_OK;
        UINT nextWidth = 0, nextHeight = 0;
        GrowSize(width, height, requestedWidth, requestedHeight,
            &nextWidth, &nextHeight);
        HDC nextDc = CreateCompatibleDC(nullptr);
        if (!nextDc) return E_OUTOFMEMORY;
        BITMAPINFO info = {};
        info.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
        info.bmiHeader.biWidth = nextWidth;
        info.bmiHeader.biHeight = -static_cast<LONG>(nextHeight);
        info.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
        info.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
        void* nextPixels = nullptr;
        HBITMAP nextBitmap = CreateDIBSection(nextDc, &info, DIB_RGB_COLORS,
            &nextPixels, nullptr, 0);
        HGDIOBJ old = nextBitmap ? SelectObject(nextDc, nextBitmap) : nullptr;
        if (!nextBitmap || !nextPixels || !old || old == HGDI_ERROR) {
            DeleteDC(nextDc);
            if (nextBitmap) DeleteObject(nextBitmap);
            return E_OUTOFMEMORY;
        }
        SetLayout(nextDc, LAYOUT_BITMAPORIENTATIONPRESERVED);
        if (dc) DeleteDC(dc);
        if (bitmap) DeleteObject(bitmap);
        dc = nextDc;
        bitmap = nextBitmap;
        pixels = static_cast<BYTE*>(nextPixels);
        width = nextWidth;
        height = nextHeight;
        return S_OK;
    }
    ~ShellTextRaster() { Reset(); }
};

// Two one-pixel rows copied from under a text draw into a memory DC, to
// read its background (MemoryDcTextBackground). Grown to the widest rect
// seen, up to the 4096 px the reader accepts.
struct BackgroundSampleBuffer {
    HDC dc = nullptr;
    HBITMAP bitmap = nullptr;
    HGDIOBJ previous = nullptr;
    RGBQUAD* bits = nullptr;
    LONG width = 0;

    BackgroundSampleBuffer() = default;
    BackgroundSampleBuffer(const BackgroundSampleBuffer&) = delete;
    BackgroundSampleBuffer& operator=(const BackgroundSampleBuffer&) = delete;
    ~BackgroundSampleBuffer() { Reset(); }

    void Reset()
    {
        if (dc) {
            SelectObject(dc, previous);
            DeleteDC(dc);
        }
        if (bitmap) DeleteObject(bitmap);
        dc = nullptr;
        bitmap = nullptr;
        previous = nullptr;
        bits = nullptr;
        width = 0;
    }

    bool Ensure(HDC reference, LONG neededWidth)
    {
        if (dc && neededWidth <= width)
            return true;
        Reset();
        const LONG nextWidth = std::max<LONG>(neededWidth, 256);
        BITMAPINFO info = {};
        info.bmiHeader = {sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER), nextWidth, -2, 1, 32, BI_RGB};
        void* nextBits = nullptr;
        bitmap = CreateDIBSection(reference, &info, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &nextBits, nullptr, 0);
        dc = bitmap ? CreateCompatibleDC(reference) : nullptr;
        if (!dc) {
            Reset();
            return false;
        }
        previous = SelectObject(dc, bitmap);
        bits = static_cast<RGBQUAD*>(nextBits);
        width = nextWidth;
        return true;
    }
};

struct D2DThreadCache
{
    ID2D1DCRenderTarget* renderTarget = nullptr;
    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = nullptr;
    ID2D1RenderTarget* brushTarget = nullptr;
    // Thread-affine raster target and DIB; no HWND or paint coordinates.
    ShellTextRaster shellTextRaster;
    BackgroundSampleBuffer backgroundSample;

    // Named brush sets for paint functions that need several distinct
    // brushes alive at once (not just the single generic one above). Held
    // here -- instead of their own thread_local statics -- so a mod unload
    // while some other thread is still alive doesn't leave that thread's
    // eventual thread-exit cleanup pointing at a ComPtr destructor inside an
    // already-unmapped module: FlsFree (see D2DThreadCachesClear) walks
    // every thread's cache and releases it synchronously, right now, while
    // the module is still loaded, rather than waiting on each thread's own
    // exit timing. Same underlying class of bug as the "no global
    // value-type std::thread" case in the Windhawk skill, just reached via
    // thread_local destructor registration instead of an atexit table.
    // Both are tied to `renderTarget`'s identity, so they're invalidated
    // for free whenever CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget recreates a stale RT --
    // Reset() below clears everything in this struct together.
    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* rgDivPillBrush     = nullptr; // RegeditSection divider drag accent
    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* rgDivOutlineBrush  = nullptr;
    // Edit-border focus/rest line clip mask (PaintControlBorder). Tied to
    // renderTarget's identity the same way brush/brushTarget above are --
    // an ID2D1Layer isn't valid across a render target it wasn't created
    // from, and this cache is per-thread, so two threads painting at once
    // never share the same layer or fight over Reset()/Attach().
    ID2D1Layer* editBorderLineLayer = nullptr;
    ID2D1RenderTarget* editBorderLineLayerRT = nullptr; // identity check only

    // Animated Home glyph door cutout for HDC-backed render targets. The
    // DComp device context owns its layer in PillDComp instead.
    ID2D1Layer* homeDoorMaskLayer = nullptr;
    ID2D1RenderTarget* homeDoorMaskLayerRT = nullptr; // identity check only

    // Menu hover overlay brush (GetMenuHoverBrush), tied to the render
    // target it was made from.
    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* menuHoverBrush = nullptr;
    ID2D1DCRenderTarget* menuHoverBrushRT = nullptr; // identity check only

    // Heap state that would otherwise sit in a thread_local past unload.
    // Not part of Reset(): unrelated to the render target.
    std::wstring themeClassScratch;              // GetCachedThemeClass
    std::vector<BlendScaleColumn> blendScaleColumns; // BlendRowsOverScaled

    // Rounded ListView/TreeView tiles contain thread-affine memory DCs. Keep
    // them in the same FLS-owned cache instead of sharing HDCs between
    // Explorer UI threads. The bounded map can retain simultaneous DPI/theme
    // variants without one monitor continuously evicting another's tile.
    std::unordered_map<RoundedSelectionTileKey, RoundedSelectionTile,
        RoundedSelectionTileKeyHash> roundedSelectionTiles;
    uint32_t roundedSelectionGeneration = UINT32_MAX;
    uint64_t roundedSelectionUseCounter = 0;

    // Nav-pane pill slice and chevron render targets, with the pill's
    // brushes. Per thread because every Explorer window paints on its own
    // UI thread, and a DC render target can't be bound by one thread while
    // another draws through it. Not part of Reset(): a paint that holds
    // one of these may reach CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget midway.
    ID2D1DCRenderTarget* pillRT = nullptr;
    ID2D1DCRenderTarget* glyphRT = nullptr;
    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* pillSliceBrush = nullptr;
    ID2D1DCRenderTarget*  pillSliceBrushRT = nullptr;
    D2D1_COLOR_F          pillSliceBrushClr = {};
    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* pillSliceDropBrush = nullptr;
    ID2D1DCRenderTarget*  pillSliceDropBrushRT = nullptr;
    D2D1_COLOR_F          pillSliceDropBrushClr = {};
    ID2D1GradientStopCollection* pillSliceGradStops = nullptr;
    ID2D1LinearGradientBrush*    pillSliceGradBrush = nullptr;
    ID2D1DCRenderTarget*         pillSliceGradRT = nullptr;
    COLORREF                     pillSliceGradBaseClr = 0;
    COLORREF                     pillSliceGradIndClr = 0;

    void ReleasePillGlyph()
    {
        if (pillSliceBrush) { pillSliceBrush->Release(); pillSliceBrush = nullptr; }
        pillSliceBrushRT = nullptr;
        if (pillSliceDropBrush) { pillSliceDropBrush->Release(); pillSliceDropBrush = nullptr; }
        pillSliceDropBrushRT = nullptr;
        if (pillSliceGradBrush) { pillSliceGradBrush->Release(); pillSliceGradBrush = nullptr; }
        if (pillSliceGradStops) { pillSliceGradStops->Release(); pillSliceGradStops = nullptr; }
        pillSliceGradRT = nullptr;
        if (pillRT) { pillRT->Release(); pillRT = nullptr; }
        if (glyphRT) { glyphRT->Release(); glyphRT = nullptr; }
    }

    void ResetRoundedSelectionTiles()
    {
        roundedSelectionTiles.clear();
        roundedSelectionGeneration = UINT32_MAX;
        roundedSelectionUseCounter = 0;
    }

    void Reset()
    {
        ResetRoundedSelectionTiles();
        if (brush) { brush->Release(); brush = nullptr; }
        brushTarget = nullptr;
        if (renderTarget) { renderTarget->Release(); renderTarget = nullptr; }

        if (rgDivPillBrush)     { rgDivPillBrush->Release();     rgDivPillBrush = nullptr; }
        if (rgDivOutlineBrush)  { rgDivOutlineBrush->Release();  rgDivOutlineBrush = nullptr; }
        if (editBorderLineLayer) { editBorderLineLayer->Release(); editBorderLineLayer = nullptr; }
        editBorderLineLayerRT = nullptr;
        if (homeDoorMaskLayer) { homeDoorMaskLayer->Release(); homeDoorMaskLayer = nullptr; }
        homeDoorMaskLayerRT = nullptr;
        if (menuHoverBrush) { menuHoverBrush->Release(); menuHoverBrush = nullptr; }
        menuHoverBrushRT = nullptr;
    }

    ~D2DThreadCache() { Reset(); ReleasePillGlyph(); }
};

static std::atomic<DWORD> g_d2dThreadCacheFls{FLS_OUT_OF_INDEXES};
static std::atomic<bool> g_d2dThreadCacheDisabled{false};
static INIT_ONCE g_d2dThreadCacheInitOnce = INIT_ONCE_STATIC_INIT;

// True while the process is exiting (LdrShutdownProcess), when FLS callbacks
// run after the thread pool is gone.
static bool ProcessShutdownInProgress()
{
    using RtlDllShutdownInProgress_t = BOOLEAN(NTAPI*)();
    static const auto shutdownInProgress = reinterpret_cast<RtlDllShutdownInProgress_t>(
        GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleW(L"ntdll.dll"), "RtlDllShutdownInProgress"));
    return shutdownInProgress && shutdownInProgress();
}

static void CALLBACK D2DThreadCacheCleanup(void* value)
{
    // At process exit the cache is left to the system: releasing the WIC
    // bitmap target makes WARP flush through the thread pool, which fails
    // fast once the pool is torn down. FlsFree on mod unload still releases
    // everything here.
    if (ProcessShutdownInProgress())
        return;
    delete static_cast<D2DThreadCache*>(value);
}

static BOOL CALLBACK D2DThreadCachesInitOnce(PINIT_ONCE, PVOID, PVOID*)
{
    DWORD index = FlsAlloc(D2DThreadCacheCleanup);
    if (index != FLS_OUT_OF_INDEXES)
        g_d2dThreadCacheFls.store(index, std::memory_order_release);
    return TRUE;
}

static bool D2DThreadCachesInit()
{
    if (g_d2dThreadCacheDisabled.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return false;
    InitOnceExecuteOnce(&g_d2dThreadCacheInitOnce,
        D2DThreadCachesInitOnce, nullptr, nullptr);
    return g_d2dThreadCacheFls.load(std::memory_order_acquire) !=
        FLS_OUT_OF_INDEXES;
}

static D2DThreadCache* D2DGetThreadCache(bool create = true)
{
    if (g_d2dThreadCacheDisabled.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return nullptr;
    if (!D2DThreadCachesInit())
        return nullptr;
    DWORD index = g_d2dThreadCacheFls.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (index == FLS_OUT_OF_INDEXES)
        return nullptr;
    auto* cache = static_cast<D2DThreadCache*>(FlsGetValue(index));
    if (!cache && create) {
        cache = new (std::nothrow) D2DThreadCache{};
        if (!cache || !FlsSetValue(index, cache)) {
            delete cache;
            return nullptr;
        }
    }
    return cache;
}

static std::wstring* ThreadThemeClassScratch()
{
    D2DThreadCache* cache = D2DGetThreadCache();
    return cache ? &cache->themeClassScratch : nullptr;
}

static bool D2DThreadCachesClear()
{
    g_d2dThreadCacheDisabled.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    const DWORD index = g_d2dThreadCacheFls.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (index == FLS_OUT_OF_INDEXES)
        return true;

    // FlsFree only documents failure for an invalid index -- ours is a
    // private static written once by a successful FlsAlloc and never touched
    // elsewhere, so a failure here means real process-state corruption, not a
    // transient condition a retry (bounded or not) would clear. Deliberately
    // does not hold a module reference or pin the module on failure either:
    // per m417z (Windhawk's author), Windhawk expects the module to actually
    // unload once Wh_ModUninit returns, and both a leaked LoadLibrary/
    // GetModuleHandleEx reference and an explicit pin equally violate that --
    // the module never truly unloading is the same problem either way, just
    // via a "supported" mechanism instead of an unsupported one. If this ever
    // fires, the log below is the honest signal: something is already wrong
    // with the process, and artificially keeping this DLL resident doesn't
    // fix that.
    DWORD error = ERROR_SUCCESS;
    for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 3; ++attempt) {
        if (FlsFree(index)) {
            g_d2dThreadCacheFls.store(
                FLS_OUT_OF_INDEXES, std::memory_order_release);
            return true;
        }
        error = GetLastError();
        SwitchToThread();
    }

    Wh_Log(L"D2D FLS cleanup failed error=%lu", error);
    return false;
}

static void CachedRTRecreate(ID2D1DCRenderTarget*& rt)
{
    if (rt) { rt->Release(); rt = nullptr; }
}

static void CachedTlsRTRecreate()
{

static HRESULT CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect,
    ID2D1Factory1* pFactory, ID2D1DCRenderTarget** ppRT)
{
    if (!pFactory || !ppRT) return E_INVALIDARG;

    D2DThreadCache* cache = D2DGetThreadCache();

    // Try to reuse cached RT
    if (cache && cache->renderTarget) {
        RECT rc = *pRect;
        HRESULT hr = cache->renderTarget->BindDC(hdc, &rc);
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) {
            cache->renderTarget->AddRef(); // caller's ComPtr will Release
            *ppRT = cache->renderTarget;
            return S_OK;
        }
        // BindDC failed (stale RT) — recreate
        cache->Reset();
    }

    // Create new RT
    FPUGuard fpu;
    D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_PROPERTIES rtP = D2D1::RenderTargetProperties(
        D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_TYPE_SOFTWARE,
        D2D1::PixelFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED),
        96.f, 96.f,
        D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_USAGE_GDI_COMPATIBLE, D2D1_FEATURE_LEVEL_DEFAULT);
    ID2D1DCRenderTarget* pRT = nullptr;
    HRESULT hr = pFactory->CreateDCRenderTarget(&rtP, &pRT);
    if (FAILED(hr)) return hr;
    RECT rc = *pRect;
    hr = pRT->BindDC(hdc, &rc);
    if (FAILED(hr)) { pRT->Release(); return hr; }

    // Cache for future calls (AddRef for cache). If the per-thread allocation
    // failed, the caller still owns and can use this one-shot render target.
    if (cache) {
        cache->renderTarget = pRT;
        cache->renderTarget->AddRef();
    }
    // Caller gets ownership of one ref
    *ppRT = pRT;
    return S_OK;
}

// Returns a thread-local solid-color brush set to `clr`, creating it once
// per RT lifetime and reusing it (via SetColor) on subsequent calls.
static ID2D1SolidColorBrush* GetCachedSolidBrush(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const D2D1_COLOR_F& clr)
{
    D2DThreadCache* cache = D2DGetThreadCache();
    if (!cache)
        return nullptr;
    if (cache->brush && cache->brushTarget == rt) {
        cache->brush->SetColor(clr);
        return cache->brush;
    }
    if (cache->brush) {
        cache->brush->Release();
        cache->brush = nullptr;
        cache->brushTarget = nullptr;
    }
    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* raw = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(rt->CreateSolidColorBrush(clr, &raw)) || !raw) return nullptr;
    cache->brush = raw;
    cache->brushTarget = rt;
    return raw;
}

// ============================================================================
// Gradient brush helper for pill gradient fill
// Caller must Release() the returned brush. Returns nullptr on failure.
// x0,y0 = gradient start; x1,y1 = gradient end (render target local coords).
// ============================================================================
// ============================================================================
// Animation easing helpers
// ============================================================================

static FLOAT EaseOutBackGentle(DOUBLE t)
{
    if (t <= 0.0) return 0.0f;
    if (t >= 1.0) return 1.0f;
    const DOUBLE c1 = 1.20, c3 = 2.20;
    DOUBLE tm1 = t - 1.0;
    return (FLOAT)(1.0 + c3 * tm1 * tm1 * tm1 + c1 * tm1 * tm1);
}

static FLOAT EaseOutCubic(DOUBLE t)
{
    if (t <= 0.0) return 0.0f;
    if (t >= 1.0) return 1.0f;
    DOUBLE inv = 1.0 - t;
    return (FLOAT)(1.0 - inv * inv * inv);
}

static FLOAT EaseInOutCubic(DOUBLE t)
{
    if (t <= 0.0) return 0.0f;
    if (t >= 1.0) return 1.0f;
    if (t < 0.5) return (FLOAT)(4.0 * t * t * t);
    DOUBLE inv = -2.0 * t + 2.0;
    return (FLOAT)(1.0 - inv * inv * inv / 2.0);
}

static FLOAT PillFadeOpacity(DOUBLE t)
{
    t = std::clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0);
    if (t < PILL_FADE_SPLIT)
        return 1.0f - EaseInOutCubic(t / PILL_FADE_SPLIT);
    return EaseInOutCubic(
        (t - PILL_FADE_SPLIT) / (1.0 - PILL_FADE_SPLIT));
}

static FLOAT PillCubicBezierEase(
    DOUBLE t, FLOAT x1, FLOAT y1, FLOAT x2, FLOAT y2)
{
    t = std::clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0);
    auto sample = [](DOUBLE u, DOUBLE p1, DOUBLE p2) {
        DOUBLE inv = 1.0 - u;
        return 3.0 * inv * inv * u * p1 +
               3.0 * inv * u * u * p2 + u * u * u;
    };

    DOUBLE lo = 0.0;
    DOUBLE hi = 1.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 14; ++i) {
        DOUBLE u = (lo + hi) * 0.5;
        if (sample(u, x1, x2) < t)
            lo = u;
        else
            hi = u;
    }
    return (FLOAT)sample((lo + hi) * 0.5, y1, y2);
}

};
