// ============================================================================
// CheckBox animation
// ============================================================================

static constexpr UINT  kCheckTimerId    = 0xCB01;
// WinUI's reveal (AnimatedAcceptVisualSource, NormalOffToNormalOn): 19 frames
// at 60 fps; PaintCheckBox applies its easing.
static constexpr float kCheckAnimDuration = 19.f * 1000.f / 60.f; // ms

struct CheckAnim {
    float   progress  = 1.f;  // 0=start (invisible), 1=complete
    DWORD   lastTick  = 0;
    int     fromState = -1;
};
static std::unordered_map<ULONG_PTR, CheckAnim> g_checkAnims;
// g_checkAnims is reachable from multiple threads: WH_CBT is installed
// per thread ID (see InstallCbtHookForThread), and any process with more
// than one UI thread that owns checkboxes runs
// CbtProc/CheckBoxSubclassProc concurrently on separate OS threads,
// all touching this one global map -- a given HWND's own entry is only
// ever touched by its owning thread, but the map's shared bucket/rehash
// state is not. g_checkAnimsMutex protects every access.
// std::recursive_mutex, not a plain mutex/SRWLOCK: CheckBoxSubclassProc's
// own CallWindowProcW/SendMessageW calls can re-enter this same proc on
// the same thread (e.g. querying BM_GETCHECK dispatches back through the
// subclass), and a non-reentrant lock would deadlock the thread against
// itself if any lock scope were ever widened to span such a call.
static std::recursive_mutex g_checkAnimsMutex;

// Set first thing in Wh_ModUninit, before the (multi-second) thread joins
// that precede CheckAnims_Cleanup()/InitCbtHooks_Cleanup() further down
// -- otherwise a checkbox subclassed by CbtProc or the theme-draw lazy
// fallback during that window is never reached by that cleanup, and its
// subclass calls into freed code after the DLL actually unloads. Checked at
// both subclass-install sites. Same pattern as g_navDividerUnloading /
// g_menuAcrylicUnloading.
static std::atomic<bool> g_checkBoxAnimUnloading{ false };

static thread_local HWND t_currentCheckHWND = nullptr;

// Forward declaration
static LRESULT CALLBACK CheckBoxSubclassProc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM, DWORD_PTR);

static LRESULT CALLBACK CheckBoxSubclassProc(HWND hWnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR)
{
    bool  tracked  = false;
    float progress = 1.f;
    bool  stateUnknown = false;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_checkAnimsMutex);
        auto it = g_checkAnims.find((ULONG_PTR)hWnd);
        if (it != g_checkAnims.end()) {
            tracked = true;
            progress = it->second.progress;
            stateUnknown = it->second.fromState < 0;
        }
    }
    if (!tracked) return DefSubclassProc(hWnd, msg, wp, lp);

    if (msg == WM_PAINT && stateUnknown)
    {
        // Subclassed at creation (CbtProc), before the dialog set the initial
        // check state: capture it on the first paint, like the lazy install
        // paths do at their (later) install time.
        const int state = (int)SendMessageW(hWnd, BM_GETCHECK, 0, 0);
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_checkAnimsMutex);
        auto it = g_checkAnims.find((ULONG_PTR)hWnd);
        if (it != g_checkAnims.end()) it->second.fromState = state;
    }

    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY)
    {
        // Only reached when creation failed after CbtProc subclassed the
        // window, so WM_DESTROY never came; comctl32 drops the subclass itself.
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_checkAnimsMutex);
        g_checkAnims.erase((ULONG_PTR)hWnd);
        return DefSubclassProc(hWnd, msg, wp, lp);
    }

    if (msg == WM_TIMER && wp == kCheckTimerId)
    {
        bool finished;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_checkAnimsMutex);
            auto& anim    = g_checkAnims[(ULONG_PTR)hWnd];
            DWORD now     = GetTickCount();
            float dt      = (float)(now - anim.lastTick);
            anim.lastTick = now;
            anim.progress = std::min(1.f, anim.progress + dt / kCheckAnimDuration);
            finished = anim.progress >= 1.f;
        }
        if (finished) KillTimer(hWnd, kCheckTimerId);
        InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, FALSE);
        return 0;
    }

    // Detect unchecked->checked transition via mouse or keyboard
    auto StartAnimIfChecked = [&]()
    {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_checkAnimsMutex);
            if (g_checkAnims.find((ULONG_PTR)hWnd) == g_checkAnims.end()) return;
        }
        int newState = (int)SendMessageW(hWnd, BM_GETCHECK, 0, 0);
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_checkAnimsMutex);
        if (newState == BST_CHECKED || newState == BST_INDETERMINATE)
        {
            auto& anim = g_checkAnims[(ULONG_PTR)hWnd];
            if (anim.fromState != BST_CHECKED && anim.fromState != BST_INDETERMINATE)
            {
                if (SysAnimationsEnabled()) {
                    anim.progress = 0.f;
                    anim.lastTick = GetTickCount();
                    SetTimer(hWnd, kCheckTimerId, 16, NULL);
                } else {
                    // No OS/mod animation: the draw side already ignores
                    // anim.progress when disabled (see PaintCheckBox's
                    // g_animEnabled check), so just leave it at its resting
                    // 1.f value instead of arming a 16ms timer for nothing.
                    anim.progress = 1.f;
                }
            }
            anim.fromState = newState;
        }
        else
        {
            g_checkAnims[(ULONG_PTR)hWnd].fromState = newState;
        }
    };

    if (msg == WM_LBUTTONUP)
    {
        LRESULT r = DefSubclassProc(hWnd, msg, wp, lp);
        StartAnimIfChecked();
        return r;
    }
    if (msg == WM_KEYUP && wp == VK_SPACE)
    {
        // BUTTON commits the check-state toggle on key release, mirroring
        // WM_LBUTTONUP above (not WM_LBUTTONDOWN) -- querying on WM_KEYDOWN
        // would read BM_GETCHECK before the real toggle happens on key-up,
        // so the transition would never be observed.
        LRESULT r = DefSubclassProc(hWnd, msg, wp, lp);
        StartAnimIfChecked();
        return r;
    }
    // Stop the UxTheme buffered animation so our D2D draw is not blended over
    if (msg == WM_PAINT && progress < 1.f)
        BufferedPaintStopAllAnimations(hWnd);

    if (msg == WM_DESTROY)
    {
        KillTimer(hWnd, kCheckTimerId);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hWnd, CheckBoxSubclassProc);
        HWND prev2 = t_currentCheckHWND;
        t_currentCheckHWND = hWnd;
        LRESULT r2 = DefSubclassProc(hWnd, msg, wp, lp);
        t_currentCheckHWND = prev2;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_checkAnimsMutex);
            g_checkAnims.erase((ULONG_PTR)hWnd);
        }
        return r2;
    }

    HWND prev = t_currentCheckHWND;
    t_currentCheckHWND = hWnd;
    LRESULT r = DefSubclassProc(hWnd, msg, wp, lp);
    t_currentCheckHWND = prev;
    return r;
}

static void CheckAnims_Cleanup()
{
    // RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread is a synchronous cross-thread
    // SendMessage, and CheckBoxSubclassProc takes g_checkAnimsMutex at the
    // top of every message it handles. Holding the lock across that call
    // deadlocks whenever the checkbox lives on a different thread than
    // Wh_ModUninit. Copy the HWNDs out and release the lock first -- same
    // pattern as ButtonPopCleanup/BreadcrumbChevronCleanup/PlacesBarCleanup/
    // TabFlickerFixRemoveAll/AuxiliarySubclassCleanup.
    std::vector<HWND> owners;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_checkAnimsMutex);
        owners.reserve(g_checkAnims.size());
        for (const auto& [key, anim] : g_checkAnims) {
            (void)anim;
            owners.push_back((HWND)key);
        }
        g_checkAnims.clear();
    }
    for (HWND hw : owners) {
        if (!IsWindow(hw)) continue;
        KillTimer(hw, kCheckTimerId);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hw, CheckBoxSubclassProc);
        // Force repaint so the window uses the restored WndProc immediately.
        // Without this, the control keeps the last frame drawn by our proc
        // until the next manual hover/click triggers a redraw.
        InvalidateRect(hw, nullptr, TRUE);
    }
}
// Glyph (expand/collapse arrow) rotation animation
// ============================================================================

static constexpr UINT  kGlyphTimerId = 0xBBCC01;
static constexpr DWORD kGlyphAnimDurationMs = 160;

static float GlyphChevronAngleAt(
    float startAngle, float targetAngle, DWORD startTick, DWORD now)
{
    if (!startTick || startAngle == targetAngle)
        return targetAngle;

    DOUBLE t = (DOUBLE)(now - startTick) / (DOUBLE)kGlyphAnimDurationMs;
    if (t >= 1.0)
        return targetAngle;
    return startAngle + (targetAngle - startAngle) * EaseOutCubic(t);
}

struct GlyphAnim {
    float current   = 0.f;  // current rotation angle (0=right/closed, 90=down/open)
    float startAngle = 0.f;
    float target    = 0.f;
    DWORD startTick = 0;
    int   lastState = -1;
    RECT  rect      = {};   // last known pRect for precise invalidation
    DWORD lastSeen  = 0;
};
static constexpr DWORD kGlyphAnimStaticPruneMs = 3500;
// Past this many entries, a paint prunes the static ones first.
static constexpr size_t kGlyphAnimMaxItems = 512;

// Chevron rotation state of one tree. Owned by ChevronAnimSubclassProc (its
// ref data) and only touched on the tree's own thread, by the tree's paints
// and its timer, so windows on different UI threads never share it.
struct GlyphTreeAnims {
    std::unordered_map<ULONG_PTR, GlyphAnim> items;
    DWORD lastTick = 0;
};
// Trees carrying ChevronAnimSubclassProc; each leaves at its WM_NCDESTROY.
// The tree's GlyphTreeAnims is also kept in kPropChevronAnims: comctl32 v5
// (processes without a v6 manifest) doesn't export GetWindowSubclass by
// name, and importing it keeps the whole mod DLL from loading there.
static constexpr wchar_t kPropChevronAnims[] = L"Win32UIModernizer.ChevronAnims";
static std::mutex g_chevronTreesMutex;
static std::unordered_set<HWND> g_chevronTrees;
static LRESULT CALLBACK ChevronAnimSubclassProc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM,
    UINT_PTR, DWORD_PTR);

static UINT ChevronReleaseMessage()
{
    static const UINT message =
        RegisterWindowMessageW(L"Win32UIModernizer.ChevronRelease");
    return message;
}

static void ChevronAnimTick(HWND hwnd, GlyphTreeAnims& anims)
{
    DWORD now = GetTickCount();
    anims.lastTick = now;

    bool anyMoving = false;
    RECT unionRect = {}; bool hasRect = false;
    for (auto it = anims.items.begin(); it != anims.items.end(); )
    {
        auto& anim = it->second;
        if (anim.current == anim.target)
        {
            if (anim.lastSeen && now - anim.lastSeen > kGlyphAnimStaticPruneMs)
                it = anims.items.erase(it);
            else
                ++it;
            continue;
        }
        anim.current = GlyphChevronAngleAt(
            anim.startAngle, anim.target, anim.startTick, now);
        if (anim.current == anim.target)
            anim.startTick = 0;

        if (anim.rect.right > anim.rect.left)
        {
            if (!hasRect) { unionRect = anim.rect; hasRect = true; }
            else          UnionRect(&unionRect, &unionRect, &anim.rect);
        }

        if (anim.current != anim.target)
        {
            anyMoving = true;
            ++it;
        }
        else
        {
            // The final frame is covered by the invalidation below. Once the
            // repaint happens, the static state is drawn from the current
            // theme state instead of keeping animation data.
            it = anims.items.erase(it);
        }
    }

    // Only the glyph rects: repainting the whole tree would accumulate
    // semi-transparent alpha. A tick before an item's first paint has no
    // rect yet and skips this frame.
    if (hasRect)
        InvalidateRect(hwnd, &unionRect, FALSE);

    if (!anyMoving)
    {
        KillTimer(hwnd, kGlyphTimerId);
        anims.lastTick = 0;
    }
}

static void ChevronAnimRelease(HWND hwnd, GlyphTreeAnims* anims)
{
    KillTimer(hwnd, kGlyphTimerId);
    RemoveWindowSubclass(hwnd, ChevronAnimSubclassProc, 0);
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropChevronAnims);
    delete anims;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_chevronTreesMutex);
    g_chevronTrees.erase(hwnd);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK ChevronAnimSubclassProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg,
    WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, UINT_PTR, DWORD_PTR refData)
{
    auto* anims = reinterpret_cast<GlyphTreeAnims*>(refData);
    if (msg == WM_TIMER && wp == kGlyphTimerId) {
        ChevronAnimTick(hwnd, *anims);
        return 0;
    }
    if (const UINT releaseMsg = ChevronReleaseMessage();
        releaseMsg && msg == releaseMsg) {
        ChevronAnimRelease(hwnd, anims);
        return 0;
    }
    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY)
        ChevronAnimRelease(hwnd, anims);
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

// The tree's chevron state, installing its subclass on first use. Only from
// the tree's own thread: the subclass and the timer both belong to it.
static GlyphTreeAnims* ChevronAnimsForTree(HWND tree)
{
    if (!tree || GetWindowThreadProcessId(tree, nullptr) != GetCurrentThreadId())
        return nullptr;
    if (auto* anims = static_cast<GlyphTreeAnims*>(GetPropW(tree, kPropChevronAnims)))
        return anims;

    // Same mutex as the unload sweep, so a tree is either swept or never
    // subclassed.
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_chevronTreesMutex);
    if (g_pillUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return nullptr;
    auto* anims = new (std::nothrow) GlyphTreeAnims{};
    if (!anims)
        return nullptr;
    if (!SetPropW(tree, kPropChevronAnims, anims)) {
        delete anims;
        return nullptr;
    }
    if (!SetWindowSubclass(tree, ChevronAnimSubclassProc, 0,
                           reinterpret_cast<DWORD_PTR>(anims))) {
        RemovePropW(tree, kPropChevronAnims);
        delete anims;
        return nullptr;
    }
    g_chevronTrees.insert(tree);
    return anims;
}

static LRESULT SendMessageUnhooked(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp);

// Settings off and unload. The release runs on each tree's own thread, the
// only one that may free its state.
static void ChevronAnimRemoveAll()
{
    std::vector<HWND> trees;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_chevronTreesMutex);
        trees.assign(g_chevronTrees.begin(), g_chevronTrees.end());
    }
    const UINT releaseMsg = ChevronReleaseMessage();
    for (HWND tree : trees) {
        if (IsWindow(tree) && releaseMsg)
            SendMessageUnhooked(tree, releaseMsg, 0, 0);
    }
}

// The one tree carrying PillTreeSubclassProc. Installs and removals go
// through g_pillTreeSubclMutex, so two Explorer windows painting at once
// can't each install one while only the last is tracked.
static std::atomic<HWND> g_pillTreeSubclHWND{nullptr};
static std::mutex g_pillTreeSubclMutex;
// -1 means uncached. The subclass owns a single tree at a time, so retaining
// its host classification avoids GetAncestor/GetClassName/TVM_GETITEMHEIGHT
// (and the latter's subclass re-entry) on every TreeView message.
static std::atomic<int> g_pillTreeSubclContext{-1};

// Forward declaration (PillDCompInit_Locked already forward-declared above)
static int  PillAnimStyle();
static bool PillDCompAllowedForTree(HWND hwnd);
static void PillWakeThread();
static bool PillDCompDrawFrame_Locked(float,float,float,float,bool,float,float,
    bool,bool,int,const PillTransitionSnapshot&,bool,bool);
static void PillDrawGdiOutgoingItem(
    HWND tree, HTREEITEM item, HDC hdc, LPCRECT itemRect);
static LRESULT CALLBACK PillTreeSubclassProc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM, DWORD_PTR);

static void PillTreeSubclassRemove()
{
    HWND tree = nullptr;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_pillTreeSubclMutex);
        tree = g_pillTreeSubclHWND.exchange(nullptr, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        g_pillTreeSubclContext.store(-1, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    // The removal can be a blocking send to the tree's thread, so it runs
    // outside the mutex that thread's paints may take.
    if (tree && IsWindow(tree))
    {
        const UINT_PTR transitionId =
            g_pillTimer.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        const PillTransitionSnapshot snap = PillReadTransitionSnapshot();
        KillTimer(tree, PillGdiTimerId());
        if (transitionId && snap.generation == transitionId &&
            !snap.useDComp &&
            g_pillTreeHWND.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == tree) {
            UINT_PTR expected = transitionId;
            g_pillTimer.compare_exchange_strong(
                expected, 0, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            if (!g_pillUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
                PillInvalidateGdiItems(tree, snap);
        }
        PillClearGdiPaintHint();
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(tree, PillTreeSubclassProc);
    }
}

// From the tree's own thread (its paint), and only while no tree has it.
static void PillTreeSubclassInstall(HWND tree, int context)
{
    if (!tree || GetWindowThreadProcessId(tree, nullptr) != GetCurrentThreadId())
        return;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_pillTreeSubclMutex);
    if (g_pillTreeSubclHWND.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        g_pillUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return;
    }
    if (WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            tree, PillTreeSubclassProc, 0)) {
        g_pillTreeSubclContext.store(context, std::memory_order_release);
        g_pillTreeSubclHWND.store(tree, std::memory_order_release);
    }
}

static int CALLBACK FontFamilyExistsEnumProc(const LOGFONTW*, const TEXTMETRICW*,
    DWORD, LPARAM lp) { *(bool*)lp = true; return 0; }

static bool FontFamilyExists(LPCWSTR faceName)
{
    if (!faceName || !*faceName)
        return false;

    HDC hdc = GetDC(nullptr);
    if (!hdc)
        return false;

    LOGFONTW lf = {};
    lf.lfCharSet = DEFAULT_CHARSET;
    wcsncpy_s(lf.lfFaceName, faceName, _TRUNCATE);
    bool found = false;
    EnumFontFamiliesExW(hdc, &lf, FontFamilyExistsEnumProc, (LPARAM)&found, 0);
    ReleaseDC(nullptr, hdc);
    return found;
}

static LPCWSTR GetIconFontFaceWithFallback()
{
    if (FontFamilyExists(L"Segoe Fluent Icons"))
        return L"Segoe Fluent Icons";
    if (FontFamilyExists(L"Segoe MDL2 Assets"))
        return L"Segoe MDL2 Assets";
    if (FontFamilyExists(L"Segoe UI Symbol"))
        return L"Segoe UI Symbol";
    return nullptr;
}

static HFONT CreateIconFontWithFallback(int fontSize, int weight, BYTE quality)
{
    LPCWSTR face = GetIconFontFaceWithFallback();
    if (!face)
        return nullptr;

    return CreateFontW(-fontSize, 0, 0, 0, weight, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE,
        DEFAULT_CHARSET, OUT_DEFAULT_PRECIS, CLIP_DEFAULT_PRECIS,
        quality, DEFAULT_PITCH, face);
}

    int w = 0, h = 0;
    if (!ImageList_GetIconSize(list, &w, &h))
        return false;

    int count = ImageList_GetImageCount(list);
    if (count < 2 || count > 16)
        return false;

    // TreeView state images are small checkbox/pin-sized cells. Reject normal
    // icon/thumbnail image lists so an accidental handle can't become pin data.
    if (w < 8 || h < 8 || w > 64 || h > 64)
        return false;

    int minSide = (std::min)(w, h);
    int maxSide = (std::max)(w, h);
    return maxSide <= minSide * 2;
}

static bool DrawGlyphDW(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, const wchar_t* glyph, int size, float extraScale, float rotationDegrees);
static void GlyphDWriteCacheClear();

// DirectWrite only (no SVG, no supersampling) -- both looked worse than a
// plain font-glyph draw at this cell size. GDI fallback lives inline in
// BuildFluentPinList below for when no D2D factory is available.
static bool PinDrawGlyph(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, bool filled)
{
    constexpr wchar_t kPinGlyph = L'\uE718';
    const int fontSize = ((rc.bottom - rc.top) * 7) / 10;
    if (filled) {
        // Filled body first, then the outline glyph drawn unconditionally on
        // top, in the same color/DC (DrawGlyphDW doesn't clear its target) --
        // the outline's stroke sits at the silhouette's edge, giving the
        // filled shape a crisper boundary than its own antialiased edge alone.
        wchar_t buf2[2] = { L'\uE841', 0 };
        if (!DrawGlyphDW(hdc, rc, cr, buf2, fontSize, 1.0f, 0.0f))
            return false;
    }
    wchar_t buf[2] = { kPinGlyph, 0 };
    return DrawGlyphDW(hdc, rc, cr, buf, fontSize, 1.0f, 0.0f);
}

static void ConvertPremultipliedDibToStraightAlpha(void* bits, int width, int height)
{
    if (!bits || width <= 0 || height <= 0)
        return;

    BYTE* px = static_cast<BYTE*>(bits);
    const int count = width * height;
    for (int p = 0; p < count; ++p) {
        const BYTE a = px[3];
        if (a > 0 && a < 255) {
            px[0] = static_cast<BYTE>(std::min(255u, (static_cast<unsigned>(px[0]) * 255u + a / 2u) / a));
            px[1] = static_cast<BYTE>(std::min(255u, (static_cast<unsigned>(px[1]) * 255u + a / 2u) / a));
            px[2] = static_cast<BYTE>(std::min(255u, (static_cast<unsigned>(px[2]) * 255u + a / 2u) / a));
        }
        px += 4;
    }
}

static HBITMAP CreateAlphaZeroMaskBitmap(int width, int height, const void* bits)
{
    if (!bits || width <= 0 || height <= 0)
        return nullptr;

    const DWORD maskStride = ((static_cast<DWORD>(width) + 15) / 16) * 2;
    std::vector<BYTE> maskBits(maskStride * static_cast<DWORD>(height), 0);
    const BYTE* src = static_cast<const BYTE*>(bits);
    const size_t srcStride = static_cast<size_t>(width) * 4;
    for (int y = 0; y < height; ++y) {
        const BYTE* row = src + static_cast<size_t>(y) * srcStride;
        BYTE* maskRow = maskBits.data() + static_cast<size_t>(y) * maskStride;
        for (int x = 0; x < width; ++x) {
            if (row[x * 4 + 3] == 0)
                maskRow[x / 8] |= static_cast<BYTE>(0x80 >> (x & 7));
        }
    }

    return CreateBitmap(width, height, 1, 1, maskBits.data());
}

// Shared only while at least one custom pin image list exists. Building is
// serialized because the font is selected into the temporary DIB DC.
static HFONT g_pinFont = nullptr;
static int   g_pinFontH = 0;
static std::mutex g_pinFontMutex;
static std::unordered_set<HWND> g_pinFontOwners;

static void PinFontReleaseIfUnusedLocked()
{
    if (!g_pinFontOwners.empty())
        return;
    if (g_pinFont) {
        DeleteObject(g_pinFont);
        g_pinFont = nullptr;
    }
    g_pinFontH = 0;
}

static void PinFontCacheClear()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_pinFontMutex);
    g_pinFontOwners.clear();
    PinFontReleaseIfUnusedLocked();
}

static void PinFontReleaseIfUnused()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_pinFontMutex);
    PinFontReleaseIfUnusedLocked();
}

// Renders the current Fluent pin glyph into bits -- a premultiplied-alpha
// top-down 32bpp DIB of totalW x totalH already selected into hdc -- centered
// within a glyphW-wide area (glyphW <= totalW; BuildFluentPinList leaves the
// remainder as its trailing state-image margin, always transparent since
// nothing is drawn there). Applies PinIconColor/dark-mode opacity exactly
// once here so every consumer renders pixel-identical pins. Caller must
// already have zeroed bits, selected the DIB into hdc, and ensured g_pinFont
// is valid (used only by the GDI fallback path below).
static void PinRenderGlyphCell(HDC hdc, void* bits, int totalW, int glyphW, int totalH, bool filled)
{
    const bool dark = IsSystemDarkMode();
    const bool useAccent   = (g_settings.PinIconColor == 1);
    const bool useGradient = (g_settings.PinIconColor == 2);
    float opacity = dark ? 0.8f : 0.45f;
    float acR = 0, acG = 0, acB = 0;
    if (useAccent) {
        COLORREF ac = GetAccentIndicator();
        acR = GetRValue(ac) / 255.f;
        acG = GetGValue(ac) / 255.f;
        acB = GetBValue(ac) / 255.f;
        opacity = dark ? 0.85f : 0.75f;
    } else if (useGradient) {
        opacity = dark ? 0.85f : 0.75f;
    }

    // Same two colors the nav pill's accent gradient uses, so both
    // gradients read as the same feature, angled along the pin glyph's own
    // tail incline (~45°, upper-right to lower-left -- measured off the
    // Segoe Fluent Icons pin glyph's tail geometry) instead of top-to-bottom.
    const COLORREF accentIndicator = GetAccentIndicator();
    const COLORREF accentPalette = GetAccentFromPalette(12);
    const COLORREF gradTop = dark ? accentIndicator : accentPalette;
    const COLORREF gradBot = dark ? accentPalette : accentIndicator;
    const float gradSpan = (float)(totalW + totalH);
    auto gradientAt = [&](int x, int y) -> COLORREF {
        float t = gradSpan > 0.f ? ((float)(y - x) + totalW) / gradSpan : 0.f;
        t = std::clamp(t, 0.f, 1.f);
        BYTE r = (BYTE)(GetRValue(gradTop) + (GetRValue(gradBot) - GetRValue(gradTop)) * t);
        BYTE g = (BYTE)(GetGValue(gradTop) + (GetGValue(gradBot) - GetGValue(gradTop)) * t);
        BYTE b = (BYTE)(GetBValue(gradTop) + (GetBValue(gradBot) - GetBValue(gradTop)) * t);
        return RGB(r, g, b);
    };

    bool drewViaD2D = false;
    if (g_d2dFactory) {
        FPUGuard fpu;
        COLORREF finalColor = (useAccent || useGradient)
            ? GetAccentIndicator()
            : (dark ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0));
        RECT rcGlyph = { 0, 0, glyphW, totalH };
        drewViaD2D = PinDrawGlyph(hdc, rcGlyph, finalColor, filled);
    }

    if (drewViaD2D) {
        BYTE* px = static_cast<BYTE*>(bits);
        if (useGradient) {
            // px[3] alone is the premultiplied coverage the solid probe
            // fill wrote -- independent of which color painted it -- so
            // it can be recombined with a different color per pixel.
            for (int y = 0; y < totalH; ++y) {
                for (int x = 0; x < totalW; ++x) {
                    COLORREF gc = gradientAt(x, y);
                    BYTE coverage = px[3];
                    px[0] = (BYTE)(GetBValue(gc) * coverage / 255.f * opacity);
                    px[1] = (BYTE)(GetGValue(gc) * coverage / 255.f * opacity);
                    px[2] = (BYTE)(GetRValue(gc) * coverage / 255.f * opacity);
                    px[3] = (BYTE)(coverage * opacity);
                    px += 4;
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        // D2D's own antialiasing already wrote correct per-pixel
        // premultiplied alpha -- just scale the whole result by the
        // opacity dial (scaling all four channels by the same factor is
        // the correct way to layer extra opacity onto premultiplied-alpha
        // pixels).
        for (int p = 0; p < totalW * totalH; ++p) {
            px[0] = (BYTE)(px[0] * opacity);
            px[1] = (BYTE)(px[1] * opacity);
            px[2] = (BYTE)(px[2] * opacity);
            px[3] = (BYTE)(px[3] * opacity);
            px += 4;
        }
        return;
    }

    // GDI fallback when D2D/DirectWrite can't complete the glyph: draw
    // opaque black/white, then reconstruct alpha from luminance since GDI
    // text doesn't populate an alpha channel.
    ZeroMemory(bits, static_cast<SIZE_T>(totalW) * totalH * 4);
    HFONT hOldFont = static_cast<HFONT>(SelectObject(hdc, g_pinFont));
    SetBkMode(hdc, TRANSPARENT);
    if (dark) {
        SetTextColor(hdc, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    } else {
        memset(bits, 0xFF, static_cast<SIZE_T>(totalW) * totalH * 4);
        SetTextColor(hdc, RGB(0, 0, 0));
    }
    RECT rcText = { 0, 0, glyphW, totalH };
    const UINT dtFlags = DT_CENTER | DT_VCENTER | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_NOCLIP;
    if (filled) {
        DrawTextW(hdc, L"", 1, &rcText, dtFlags);
    }
    DrawTextW(hdc, L"", 1, &rcText, dtFlags);
    SelectObject(hdc, hOldFont);

    BYTE* px = static_cast<BYTE*>(bits);
    for (int p = 0; p < totalW * totalH; ++p) {
        BYTE r = px[2], g = px[1], b = px[0];
        if (dark) {
            BYTE lum = (std::max)({r, g, b});
            if (lum > 0) {
                if (useGradient) {
                    COLORREF gc = gradientAt(p % totalW, p / totalW);
                    px[0] = (BYTE)(GetBValue(gc) * lum / 255.f * opacity);
                    px[1] = (BYTE)(GetGValue(gc) * lum / 255.f * opacity);
                    px[2] = (BYTE)(GetRValue(gc) * lum / 255.f * opacity);
                } else if (useAccent) {
                    px[0] = (BYTE)(acB * lum * opacity);
                    px[1] = (BYTE)(acG * lum * opacity);
                    px[2] = (BYTE)(acR * lum * opacity);
                } else {
                    px[0] = (BYTE)(b * opacity);
                    px[1] = (BYTE)(g * opacity);
                    px[2] = (BYTE)(r * opacity);
                }
                px[3] = (BYTE)(lum * opacity);
            }
        } else {
            BYTE lum = (std::min)({r, g, b});
            BYTE aVal = (BYTE)((255 - lum) * opacity);
            if (aVal > 0) {
                if (useGradient) {
                    COLORREF gc = gradientAt(p % totalW, p / totalW);
                    float f = (255 - lum) / 255.f * opacity;
                    px[0] = (BYTE)(GetBValue(gc) * f);
                    px[1] = (BYTE)(GetGValue(gc) * f);
                    px[2] = (BYTE)(GetRValue(gc) * f);
                } else if (useAccent) {
                    float f = (255 - lum) / 255.f * opacity;
                    px[0] = (BYTE)(acB * 255.f * f);
                    px[1] = (BYTE)(acG * 255.f * f);
                    px[2] = (BYTE)(acR * 255.f * f);
                } else {
                    px[0] = 0; px[1] = 0; px[2] = 0;
                }
                px[3] = aVal;
            } else {
                px[0] = 0; px[1] = 0; px[2] = 0; px[3] = 0;
            }
        }
        px += 4;
    }
}

static HIMAGELIST BuildFluentPinList(HIMAGELIST src, int marginR)
{
    if (!PinIsLikelyStateImageList(src)) return nullptr;
    int srcW = 0, srcH = 0;
    if (!ImageList_GetIconSize(src, &srcW, &srcH) || srcW <= 0 || srcH <= 0)
        return nullptr;
    const int count = ImageList_GetImageCount(src);
    if (count < 2) return nullptr;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> fontLock(g_pinFontMutex);

    const int cellW = srcW + marginR;
    const int cellH = srcH;

    HIMAGELIST dst = ImageList_Create(cellW, cellH, ILC_COLOR32 | ILC_MASK, count, 0);
    if (!dst) return nullptr;

    const int fontSize = (srcH * 7) / 10;
    if (!g_pinFont || g_pinFontH != fontSize) {
        if (g_pinFont) DeleteObject(g_pinFont);
        g_pinFont = CreateIconFontWithFallback(fontSize, FW_NORMAL, ANTIALIASED_QUALITY);
        g_pinFontH = fontSize;
    }
    if (!g_pinFont) { ImageList_Destroy(dst); return nullptr; }

    HDC hScreen = GetDC(nullptr);
    if (!hScreen) {
        ImageList_Destroy(dst);
        PinFontReleaseIfUnusedLocked();
        return nullptr;
    }
    HDC hDC = CreateCompatibleDC(hScreen);
    if (!hDC) {
        ReleaseDC(nullptr, hScreen);
        ImageList_Destroy(dst);
        PinFontReleaseIfUnusedLocked();
        return nullptr;
    }
    BITMAPINFO bmi = {};
    bmi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
    bmi.bmiHeader.biWidth = cellW;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -cellH;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

    bool ok = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < count && ok; ++i) {
        void* bits = nullptr;
        HBITMAP hBmp = CreateDIBSection(hDC, &bmi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
        if (!hBmp) { ok = false; break; }
        HBITMAP hPrev = static_cast<HBITMAP>(SelectObject(hDC, hBmp));
        ZeroMemory(bits, static_cast<SIZE_T>(cellW) * cellH * 4);

        if (i > 0)
            PinRenderGlyphCell(hDC, bits, cellW, srcW, cellH, g_settings.PinIconStyle == 1);

        ConvertPremultipliedDibToStraightAlpha(bits, cellW, cellH);
        HBITMAP hMask = CreateAlphaZeroMaskBitmap(cellW, cellH, bits);

        SelectObject(hDC, hPrev);
        if (!hMask || ImageList_Add(dst, hBmp, hMask) == -1)
            ok = false;
        if (hMask)
            DeleteObject(hMask);
        DeleteObject(hBmp);
    }
    DeleteDC(hDC);
    ReleaseDC(nullptr, hScreen);
    if (!ok) {
        ImageList_Destroy(dst);
        PinFontReleaseIfUnusedLocked();
        return nullptr;
    }
    return dst;
}

// outPrevList, when given, receives the imagelist TVM_SETIMAGELIST(TVSIL_STATE)
// itself reports as previously installed -- the real per-message-contract
// return value, for callers (the SendMessageW_hook swallow site) that need
// to forward it instead of synthesizing a placeholder.
static bool PinInstallCustomList(HWND hwnd, HIMAGELIST srcList, HIMAGELIST* outPrevList = nullptr)
{
    if (!hwnd || !PinIsLikelyStateImageList(srcList))
        return false;

    HIMAGELIST ours = (HIMAGELIST)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropPinList);
    if (srcList == ours) {
        if (outPrevList) *outPrevList = ours;
        return true;
    }
    HIMAGELIST previousOrig =
        (HIMAGELIST)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropPinOrigList);

    HIMAGELIST custom = BuildFluentPinList(srcList, g_settings.PinMarginRight);
    if (!custom)
        return false;

    if (!SetPropW(hwnd, kPropPinOrigList, (HANDLE)srcList)) {
        ImageList_Destroy(custom);
        PinFontReleaseIfUnused();
        return false;
    }
    if (!SetPropW(hwnd, kPropPinList, (HANDLE)custom)) {
        if (previousOrig)
            SetPropW(hwnd, kPropPinOrigList, (HANDLE)previousOrig);
        else
            RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropPinOrigList);
        ImageList_Destroy(custom);
        PinFontReleaseIfUnused();
        return false;
    }
    LRESULT prev = SendMessageUnhooked(hwnd, TVM_SETIMAGELIST,
        TVSIL_STATE, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(custom));
    if (outPrevList) *outPrevList = reinterpret_cast<HIMAGELIST>(prev);

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_pinFontMutex);
        g_pinFontOwners.insert(hwnd);
    }

    if (ours)
        ImageList_Destroy(ours);

    return true;
}

static void PinRestoreOriginalList(HWND hwnd, bool destroyCustom)
{
    if (!hwnd)
        return;

    HIMAGELIST ours = (HIMAGELIST)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropPinList);
    HIMAGELIST orig = (HIMAGELIST)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropPinOrigList);

    if (ours && orig && TreeView_GetImageList(hwnd, TVSIL_STATE) == ours) {
        SendMessageUnhooked(hwnd, TVM_SETIMAGELIST,
            TVSIL_STATE, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(orig));
    }

    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropPinOrigList);
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropPinList);

    if (destroyCustom && ours)
        ImageList_Destroy(ours);

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_pinFontMutex);
        g_pinFontOwners.erase(hwnd);
        PinFontReleaseIfUnusedLocked();
    }
}

// Loads hIcon's color bitmap and draws it scaled to cellH x cellH at (0,0)
// on a render target bound to hDC -- same CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget used
// throughout this file, so the result is premultiplied alpha (that render
// target's own D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED format): the caller must run
// ConvertPremultipliedDibToStraightAlpha on it before ImageList_Add, same as
// BuildFluentPinList already does for its own D2D/DirectWrite draw. Quality
// upgrade over DrawIconEx's plain stretch, whose crude, alpha-unaware
// resample shows as jagged/fringed edges once scaled up to WinUI metrics'
// larger icon cell.
static bool NavMetricsDrawIconScaledD2D(HDC hDC, HICON hIcon, int cellH)
{
    EnsureD2DFactory();
    if (!g_d2dFactory || cellH <= 0)
        return false;

    ICONINFO ii = {};
    if (!GetIconInfo(hIcon, &ii))
        return false;

    bool ok = false;
    BITMAP bm = {};
    if (ii.hbmColor && GetObject(ii.hbmColor, sizeof(bm), &bm) &&
        bm.bmWidth > 0 && bm.bmHeight > 0) {
        const int iw = bm.bmWidth, ih = bm.bmHeight;
        std::vector<BYTE> pixels(static_cast<size_t>(iw) * ih * 4);
        BITMAPINFO bmi = {};
        bmi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
        bmi.bmiHeader.biWidth = iw;
        bmi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -ih;
        bmi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
        bmi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
        bmi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;
        // A modern icon's color bitmap is straight alpha (the native ICO/CUR
        // resource format) -- declared as such so D2D converts it correctly
        // when compositing onto the premultiplied render target below.
        if (GetDIBits(hDC, ii.hbmColor, 0, ih, pixels.data(), &bmi, DIB_RGB_COLORS)) {
            RECT rc = { 0, 0, cellH, cellH };
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
            if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hDC, &rc, g_d2dFactory, &pRT))) {
                D2D1_BITMAP_PROPERTIES props = D2D1::BitmapProperties(
                    D2D1::PixelFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_STRAIGHT));
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1Bitmap> iconBmp;
                if (SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateBitmap(
                        D2D1::SizeU(static_cast<UINT32>(iw), static_cast<UINT32>(ih)),
                        pixels.data(), static_cast<UINT32>(iw) * 4, &props, &iconBmp))) {
                    pRT->BeginDraw();
                    pRT->Clear(D2D1::ColorF(0, 0, 0, 0));
                    pRT->DrawBitmap(iconBmp.Get(),
                        D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f, static_cast<float>(cellH), static_cast<float>(cellH)),
                        1.f, D2D1_BITMAP_INTERPOLATION_MODE_LINEAR);
                    ok = SUCCEEDED(pRT->EndDraw());
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (ii.hbmColor) DeleteObject(ii.hbmColor);
    if (ii.hbmMask) DeleteObject(ii.hbmMask);
    return ok;
}

using NavMetricsSetImageCountFn = HRESULT(STDMETHODCALLTYPE*)(IImageList*, UINT);

static HRESULT NavMetricsQueryImageList(HIMAGELIST list, IImageList** output)
{
    using QueryFn = HRESULT(WINAPI*)(HIMAGELIST, REFIID, void**);
    static std::atomic<FARPROC> cachedAddress{nullptr};
    *output = nullptr;
    FARPROC address = cachedAddress.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    HMODULE owner = nullptr;
    // The cached export is only reused while its module is still loaded.
    if (address && !GetModuleHandleExW(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS |
            GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
            reinterpret_cast<LPCWSTR>(address), &owner))
        address = nullptr;
    if (!address) {
        HMODULE module = GetModuleHandleW(L"comctl32.dll");
        address = module ? GetProcAddress(module, "HIMAGELIST_QueryInterface") : nullptr;
    }
    // Borrow a loaded v6 export without adding a v6-only import to the mod.
    if (!address) {
        HANDLE snapshot = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(
            TH32CS_SNAPMODULE | TH32CS_SNAPMODULE32, GetCurrentProcessId());
        if (snapshot != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
            MODULEENTRY32W entry = {sizeof(entry)};
            if (Module32FirstW(snapshot, &entry)) {
                do {
                    if (_wcsicmp(entry.szModule, L"comctl32.dll") != 0) continue;
                    address = GetProcAddress(entry.hModule, "HIMAGELIST_QueryInterface");
                    if (address) break;
                } while (Module32NextW(snapshot, &entry));
            }
            CloseHandle(snapshot);
        }
    }
    if (address)
        cachedAddress.store(address, std::memory_order_release);
    return address ? reinterpret_cast<QueryFn>(address)(list, __uuidof(IImageList),
        reinterpret_cast<void**>(output)) : E_NOINTERFACE;
}

static std::array<NavMetricsSetImageCountFn, kMaxTargets> originals{};
static std::array<bool, kMaxTargets> applied{};

static bool PrepareCell(State& state, int width, int height)
{
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return false;
    if (state.blank && state.mask && state.width == width && state.height == height)
        return true;
    BITMAPINFO info = {};
    info.bmiHeader = {sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER), width, -height, 1, 32, BI_RGB};
    void* bits = nullptr;
    HBITMAP blank = CreateDIBSection(nullptr, &info, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
    HBITMAP mask = nullptr;
    if (blank && bits) {
        ZeroMemory(bits, static_cast<size_t>(width) * height * 4);
        mask = CreateAlphaZeroMaskBitmap(width, height, bits);
    }
    if (!blank || !mask) {
        if (blank) DeleteObject(blank);
        if (mask) DeleteObject(mask);
        return false;
    }
    if (state.blank) DeleteObject(state.blank);
    if (state.mask) DeleteObject(state.mask);
    state.blank = blank;
    state.mask = mask;
    state.width = width;
    state.height = height;
    return true;
}

template<size_t Slot>
static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE SetCountImpl(IImageList* self, UINT count)
{
    LastErrorScope error;
    const DWORD incomingError = error.value;
    std::shared_ptr<State> state;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(statesMutex);
        auto it = states.find(self);
        if (it != states.end()) state = it->second;
    }
    if (!state) {
        SetLastError(incomingError);
        const HRESULT result = originals[Slot](self, count);
        error.value = GetLastError();
        return result;
    }
    // Retain the COM object and serialize tracked resizes with list retirement.
    // No HWND messages or registry lock are held during the native operation.
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state->mutex);
    int before = -1;
    if (state->active) self->GetImageCount(&before);
    SetLastError(incomingError);
    const HRESULT result = originals[Slot](self, count);
    const DWORD resultError = GetLastError();
    if (state->active && SUCCEEDED(result) && before >= 0) {
        int after = -1;
        if (SUCCEEDED(self->GetImageCount(&after)) && after > before) {
            int width = 0, height = 0;
            if (SUCCEEDED(self->GetIconSize(&width, &height)) &&
                PrepareCell(*state, width, height)) {
                for (int i = before; i < after; ++i) {
                    const HRESULT repair = self->Replace(i, state->blank, state->mask);
                    if (FAILED(repair)) {
                        Wh_Log(L"Navigation icon transparency: failed to initialize list=%p index=%d hr=0x%08X",
                            state->list, i, (UINT)repair);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } else {
                Wh_Log(L"Navigation icon transparency: transparent cell unavailable for list=%p size=%dx%d",
                    state->list, width, height);
            }
        }
    }
    error.value = resultError;
    return result;
}

template<size_t Slot>
static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE SetCount(IImageList* self, UINT count)
{
    return SetCountImpl<Slot>(self, count);
}

static bool Register(HIMAGELIST list)
{
    LastErrorScope error;
    auto state = std::make_shared<State>();
    state->list = list;
    int width = 0, height = 0;
    if (FAILED(NavMetricsQueryImageList(list, state->imageList.GetAddressOf())) ||
        !state->imageList || !ImageList_GetIconSize(list, &width, &height) ||
        width <= 0 || height <= 0) {
        Wh_Log(L"Navigation icon transparency: image list interface or size unavailable");
        return false;
    }
    if (!PrepareCell(*state, width, height)) {
        Wh_Log(L"Navigation icon transparency: failed to create the transparent cell");
        return false;
    }
    const auto hookList = std::array<NavMetricsSetImageCountFn, kMaxTargets>{
        SetCount<0>, SetCount<1>, SetCount<2>, SetCount<3>};
    void* target = (*reinterpret_cast<void***>(state->imageList.Get()))[19];
    bool ready = false;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(hooksMutex);
        if (!stopping) {
            for (size_t slot = 0; slot < kMaxTargets; ++slot) {
                if (targets[slot] && targets[slot] != target) continue;
                if (!targets[slot] && WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(
                        reinterpret_cast<NavMetricsSetImageCountFn>(target),
                        hookList[slot], &originals[slot])) {
                    targets[slot] = target;
                }
                if (targets[slot] == target) {
                    if (!applied[slot]) applied[slot] = Wh_ApplyHookOperations() != FALSE;
                    ready = applied[slot];
                }
                break;
            }
            if (ready) {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> statesLock(statesMutex);
                states[state->imageList.Get()] = state;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!ready) Wh_Log(L"Navigation icon transparency: resize hook unavailable");
    return ready;
}

static void Forget(HIMAGELIST list)
{
    LastErrorScope error;
    std::shared_ptr<State> state;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(statesMutex);
        auto it = std::find_if(states.begin(), states.end(), [list](const auto& entry) {
            return entry.second->list == list;
        });
        if (it != states.end()) {
            state = it->second;
            states.erase(it);
        }
    }
    if (state) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state->mutex);
        state->active = false;
    }
}

static void BeforeUninit()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(hooksMutex);
    stopping = true;
}
}

static HIMAGELIST NavMetricsBuildNormalList(HIMAGELIST src, bool useWinUIMetrics,
                                            bool transparentIcons, UINT dpi,
                                            bool compact)
{
    if (!src)
        return nullptr;

    const int count = ImageList_GetImageCount(src);
    if (count <= 0)
        return nullptr;

    int srcW = 0, srcH = 0;
    if (!ImageList_GetIconSize(src, &srcW, &srcH) || srcW <= 0 || srcH <= 0)
        return nullptr;

    const int iconSizeAt125 = compact
        ? kNavMetricsIconSizeCompact : kNavMetricsIconSize;
    const int iconTextGapAt125 = compact
        ? kNavMetricsIconTextGapCompact : kNavMetricsIconTextGap;
    const int cellW = useWinUIMetrics
        ? NavMetricsScaleForDpi(iconSizeAt125, dpi) +
          NavMetricsScaleForDpi(iconTextGapAt125, dpi)
        : srcW;
    const int cellH = useWinUIMetrics
        ? NavMetricsScaleForDpi(iconSizeAt125, dpi)
        : srcH;
    HIMAGELIST dst = ImageList_Create(cellW, cellH, ILC_COLOR32 | ILC_MASK, count, 0);
    if (!dst)
        return nullptr;
    if (transparentIcons)
        ImageList_SetBkColor(dst, CLR_NONE);

    HDC hScreen = GetDC(nullptr);
    if (!hScreen) {
        ImageList_Destroy(dst);
        return nullptr;
    }

    HDC hDC = CreateCompatibleDC(hScreen);
    if (!hDC) {
        ReleaseDC(nullptr, hScreen);
        ImageList_Destroy(dst);
        return nullptr;
    }

    BITMAPINFO bmi = {};
    bmi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
    bmi.bmiHeader.biWidth = cellW;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -cellH;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

    bool ok = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < count && ok; ++i) {
        void* bits = nullptr;
        HBITMAP hBmp = CreateDIBSection(hDC, &bmi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
        if (!hBmp) {
            ok = false;
            break;
        }

        HBITMAP hPrev = static_cast<HBITMAP>(SelectObject(hDC, hBmp));
        if (bits)
            ZeroMemory(bits, static_cast<SIZE_T>(cellW) * cellH * 4);

        if (!transparentIcons) {
            HICON hIcon = ImageList_GetIcon(src, i, ILD_TRANSPARENT);
            if (hIcon) {
                bool drewViaD2D = useWinUIMetrics &&
                    NavMetricsDrawIconScaledD2D(hDC, hIcon, cellH);
                if (!drewViaD2D) {
                    DrawIconEx(hDC, 0, 0, hIcon,
                        cellH, cellH, 0, nullptr, DI_NORMAL);
                } else if (bits) {
                    ConvertPremultipliedDibToStraightAlpha(bits, cellW, cellH);
                }
                DestroyIcon(hIcon);
            }
        }

        SelectObject(hDC, hPrev);
        // A black chroma key is unreliable when comctl32 converts a 32-bit
        // list under DPI virtualization -- some hosts preserve RGB but lose
        // alpha, exposing the empty cell as a black rectangle (this is what
        // caused black squares behind normal icons with WinUI nav-pane
        // metrics and glyphs off). Pair zero alpha with an explicit 1-bit
        // mask, as the pin image list does. Needed regardless of
        // transparentIcons -- a real drawn icon's own masked-out background
        // pixels are zero-alpha too (from the ZeroMemory before DrawIconEx),
        // so it hits the same failure mode if added with hbmMask=NULL.
        HBITMAP hMask = CreateAlphaZeroMaskBitmap(cellW, cellH, bits);
        int added = hMask ? ImageList_Add(dst, hBmp, hMask) : -1;
        if (hMask)
            DeleteObject(hMask);
        if (added == -1)
            ok = false;
        DeleteObject(hBmp);
    }

    DeleteDC(hDC);
    ReleaseDC(nullptr, hScreen);

    if (!ok) {
        ImageList_Destroy(dst);
        return nullptr;
    }
    return dst;
}

static bool NavMetricsInstallNormalList(HWND hwnd, HIMAGELIST srcList,
                                        bool useWinUIMetrics,
                                        bool transparentIcons)
{
    if (!hwnd || !srcList)
        return false;

    const UINT dpi = NavMetricsGetDpi(hwnd);
    HIMAGELIST ours = (HIMAGELIST)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsList);
    HIMAGELIST builtFrom = (HIMAGELIST)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsOrigList);
    // Callers always pass the tree's ORIGINAL list (see NavMetricsApplyToTree),
    // never `ours` -- compare against what we last built from instead.
    if (ours && srcList == builtFrom &&
        NavMetricsUsesWinUIMetrics(hwnd) == useWinUIMetrics &&
        NavMetricsUsesTransparentIcons(hwnd) == transparentIcons &&
        (UINT)(ULONG_PTR)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsDpi) == dpi)
        return true;

    HIMAGELIST custom = NavMetricsBuildNormalList(srcList, useWinUIMetrics,
                                                  transparentIcons, dpi,
                                                  NavMetricsWantsCompact(hwnd));
    if (!custom)
        return false;
    if (transparentIcons && !NavMetricsTransparentList::Register(custom)) {
        ImageList_Destroy(custom);
        return false;
    }

    SetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsOrigList, (HANDLE)srcList);
    SetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsList, (HANDLE)custom);
    if (transparentIcons)
        SetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsTransparent, (HANDLE)1);
    else
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsTransparent);
    if (useWinUIMetrics)
        SetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsUsesWinUIMetrics, (HANDLE)1);
    else
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsUsesWinUIMetrics);
    SetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsDpi, (HANDLE)(ULONG_PTR)dpi);
    SendMessageUnhooked(hwnd, TVM_SETIMAGELIST,
        TVSIL_NORMAL, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(custom));

    if (ours) {
        NavMetricsTransparentList::Forget(ours);
        ImageList_Destroy(ours);
    }

    return true;
}

static void NavMetricsStoreOriginalHeight(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsOrigHeight)) {
        LRESULT h = SendMessageUnhooked(hwnd, TVM_GETITEMHEIGHT, 0, 0);
        if (h > 0)
            SetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsOrigHeight, (HANDLE)(INT_PTR)h);
    }
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK NavMetricsDpiSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR);

static void NavMetricsSetDpiSubclass(HWND hwnd, bool enable)
{
    const bool installed = GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsDpiSubclass) != nullptr;
    if (enable == installed)
        return;

    if (enable) {
        if (!WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                hwnd, NavMetricsDpiSubclassProc, 0)) {
            return;
        }
        if (!SetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsDpiSubclass, (HANDLE)1)) {
            WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                hwnd, NavMetricsDpiSubclassProc);
        }
    } else {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, NavMetricsDpiSubclassProc);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsDpiSubclass);
    }
}

static void NavMetricsApplyToTree(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd) || !GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(hwnd))
        return;

    const bool useWinUIMetrics = g_settings.NavPaneWinUIMetrics;
    const bool transparentIcons = GlyphOrColorIconsActive() && !IsCurrentProcessRegedit() &&
                                  GlyphIsTracked(hwnd);

    if (useWinUIMetrics) {
        NavMetricsSetDpiSubclass(hwnd, true);
        NavMetricsStoreOriginalHeight(hwnd);
        SendMessageUnhooked(hwnd, TVM_SETITEMHEIGHT,
            NavMetricsScale(hwnd, kNavMetricsItemHeight), 0);
    } else {
        NavMetricsSetDpiSubclass(hwnd, false);
        HANDLE origHeight = GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsOrigHeight);
        if (origHeight) {
            SendMessageUnhooked(hwnd, TVM_SETITEMHEIGHT, (WPARAM)(INT_PTR)origHeight, 0);
            RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsOrigHeight);
        }
    }

    HIMAGELIST ours = (HIMAGELIST)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsList);
    HIMAGELIST src = ours
        ? (HIMAGELIST)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsOrigList)
        : TreeView_GetImageList(hwnd, TVSIL_NORMAL);
    if (src) {
        NavMetricsInstallNormalList(hwnd, src, useWinUIMetrics, transparentIcons);
    } else if (useWinUIMetrics) {
        SetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsDpi,
            (HANDLE)(ULONG_PTR)NavMetricsGetDpi(hwnd));
    }

    InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
}

static void NavMetricsRestoreTree(HWND hwnd, bool destroyCustom)
{
    if (!hwnd)
        return;

    NavMetricsSetDpiSubclass(hwnd, false);

    HIMAGELIST ours = (HIMAGELIST)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsList);
    HIMAGELIST orig = (HIMAGELIST)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsOrigList);

    if (ours && orig && TreeView_GetImageList(hwnd, TVSIL_NORMAL) == ours) {
        SendMessageUnhooked(hwnd, TVM_SETIMAGELIST,
            TVSIL_NORMAL, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(orig));
    }

    HANDLE origHeight = GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsOrigHeight);
    if (origHeight)
        SendMessageUnhooked(hwnd, TVM_SETITEMHEIGHT, (WPARAM)(INT_PTR)origHeight, 0);

    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsOrigList);
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsList);
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsOrigHeight);
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsTransparent);
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsUsesWinUIMetrics);
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsDpi);

    if (destroyCustom && ours) {
        NavMetricsTransparentList::Forget(ours);
        ImageList_Destroy(ours);
    }
}

static void NavMetricsUpdateTree(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd) || !GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(hwnd))
        return;

    if (NavMetricsNeedsCustomNormalList(hwnd))
        NavMetricsApplyToTree(hwnd);
    else
        NavMetricsRestoreTree(hwnd, true);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK NavMetricsDpiSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        // Covers a tree whose TreeCursorSubclassProc install failed.
        NavMetricsRestoreTree(hwnd, true);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsDpiSubclass);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavMetricsDpi);
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    }

    LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    if (msg == WM_DPICHANGED_AFTERPARENT &&
        g_settings.NavPaneWinUIMetrics) {
        const UINT dpi = NavMetricsGetDpi(hwnd);
        const UINT appliedDpi = (UINT)(ULONG_PTR)GetPropW(
            hwnd, kPropNavMetricsDpi);
        if (dpi != appliedDpi)
            NavMetricsApplyToTree(hwnd);
    }
    return result;
}

static void NavMetricsApplyItemMargin(NMTVCUSTOMDRAW* pcd)
{
    if (!pcd)
        return;

    const int margin = NavMetricsScale(
        pcd->nmcd.hdr.hwndFrom, kNavMetricsItemMarginV);
    RECT& rc = pcd->nmcd.rc;
    if ((rc.bottom - rc.top) > margin * 2) {
        rc.top += margin;
        rc.bottom -= margin;
    }
}

static int NavMetricsSpecialScaledArtSize(HWND tv, wchar_t glyphCh, int fallback)
{
    if (!g_settings.NavPaneWinUIMetrics ||
        !NavMetricsIsOwnNormalList(tv, TreeView_GetImageList(tv, TVSIL_NORMAL)) ||
        !IsHostedInCabinetWClass(tv)) {
        return fallback;
    }

    // These SVGs intentionally keep their scaleOnlyInCabinet reductions. The
    // WinUI metrics option changes the base art box to 21px, so compensate the
    // box before DrawSvgGlyph applies the existing SVG scale.
    switch (glyphCh) {
    case L'\uE753': return (fallback * 100 + 73) / 74; // OneDrive base 0.74
    case L'\uE90E': return (fallback * 100 + 81) / 82; // Desktop 0.82
    case L'\uE714': return (fallback * 100 + 73) / 74; // Videos 0.74
    case L'\uEDA2': return (fallback * 100 + 69) / 70; // Drive 0.70
    case L'\uE115': return (fallback * 100 + 81) / 82; // Control Panel 0.82
    case L'\uE7FC': return (fallback * 100 + 71) / 72; // Saved Games 0.72
    default: return fallback;
    }
}

static void NavMetricsGetIconArtSize(HWND tv, wchar_t glyphCh, int cellW, int cellH, int* artW, int* artH)
{
    if (!artW || !artH)
        return;

    if (g_settings.NavPaneWinUIMetrics &&
        NavMetricsIsOwnNormalList(tv, TreeView_GetImageList(tv, TVSIL_NORMAL))) {
        int base = cellH > 0
            ? cellH
            : NavMetricsScale(tv, kNavMetricsIconSize);
        int art = NavMetricsSpecialScaledArtSize(tv, glyphCh, base);
        *artW = art;
        *artH = art;
        return;
    }

    *artW = cellW;
    *artH = cellH;
}

static int NavMetricsGetIconDrawLeft(HWND tv, int cellLeft, int artW, int cellArtW)
{
    // Always centers, not just under WinUI metrics: the monochrome glyph
    // path's own artW equals cellArtW whenever WinUI metrics is off (no
    // compensation applied there), making this a no-op for it either way.
    // The color-icon path keeps its own compensation regardless of this
    // setting, so artW can differ from cellArtW in both modes.
    return cellLeft + (cellArtW - artW) / 2;
}

static bool DrawGlyphGdiFallback(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr,
    const wchar_t* glyph, int size)
{
    if (!hdc || !glyph || !*glyph || size <= 0)
        return false;
    HFONT font = CreateIconFontWithFallback(size, FW_NORMAL, CLEARTYPE_QUALITY);
    if (!font)
        return false;
    HGDIOBJ oldFont = SelectObject(hdc, font);
    if (!oldFont || oldFont == HGDI_ERROR) {
        DeleteObject(font);
        return false;
    }
    int oldBkMode = SetBkMode(hdc, TRANSPARENT);
    COLORREF oldTextColor = SetTextColor(hdc, cr);
    RECT drawRc = rc;
    int result = DrawTextW(hdc, glyph, -1, &drawRc,
        DT_CENTER | DT_VCENTER | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_NOCLIP);
    SetTextColor(hdc, oldTextColor);
    SetBkMode(hdc, oldBkMode);
    SelectObject(hdc, oldFont);
    DeleteObject(font);
    return result != 0;
}

static const DOUBLE ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_RECYCLE  = 0.70; // arrows trace in + fade
static const DOUBLE ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_PHONE    = 0.50; // shake cycles + zigzag fade
static const DOUBLE ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_DRIVE    = 0.80; // border trace + blink + fade to Filled
static const DOUBLE ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_CDROM    = 0.72; // crossfade to a 2-hole Intermediate disc, spin a full turn, patch the holes back in
static const DOUBLE ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_HOME     = 0.80; // pause + door overshoot + crossfade + grow back
static const DOUBLE ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_DOCUMENTS = 0.70; // corner fold-in + fade to Filled
static const DOUBLE ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_VIDEOS   = 0.70; // fill-reveal + wedge undraw/pop + fade to Filled
static const DOUBLE ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_GALLERY  = 0.70; // shrink+separate, fill, snap back with overshoot, fade to Filled
static const DOUBLE ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_LIBRARY  = 0.62; // three books fan out, return, then quick fade to Filled
static const DOUBLE ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_FAVORITES = 0.62; // filled star pulses twice, then settles
static const DOUBLE ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_PROGFILES = 0.75; // fill hops TL->BL->BR, fade to Filled
static const DOUBLE ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_GOOGLEDRIVE = 0.75; // fill hops Top->Right->Left with scale pop; no crossfade needed since per-facet Filled geometry is pixel-identical to the combined Filled render
static const DOUBLE ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_NETWORK  = 0.75; // radar sweep reveal + settle pulse + fade to Filled
static const DOUBLE ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_ZIP      = 0.70; // unzip (halves slide apart + pull rises), zip closed with overshoot
static const DOUBLE ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_FOLDER   = 0.28; // crossfade Normal->Filled (DrawCrossfadeSingle); no bespoke geometry intro
static DOUBLE IconPopPreDuration(const wchar_t* glyph) {
    if (!glyph) return 0.0;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_ONEDRIVE[0]) return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_ONEDRIVE;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_DESKTOP[0])  return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_DESKTOP;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_THISPC[0])   return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_THISPC;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_PICTURES[0]) return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_PICTURES;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_RECYCLE[0] || glyph[0] == GLYPH_RECYCLE_FULL[0])
        return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_RECYCLE;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_PHONE[0])    return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_PHONE;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_DRIVE[0])    return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_DRIVE;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_CDROM[0])    return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_CDROM;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_HOME[0])     return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_HOME;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_DOCUMENTS[0]) return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_DOCUMENTS;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_VIDEOS[0])   return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_VIDEOS;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_GALLERY[0])  return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_GALLERY;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_LIBRARY[0])  return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_LIBRARY;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_FAVORITES[0] || glyph[0] == GLYPH_FAVORITES_FILLED[0])
        return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_FAVORITES;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_PROGFILES[0]) return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_PROGFILES;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_GOOGLEDRIVE[0]) return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_GOOGLEDRIVE;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_NETWORK[0])  return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_NETWORK;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_ZIPARCHIVE[0]) return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_ZIP;
    if (glyph[0] == GLYPH_FOLDER[0])   return ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_FOLDER;
    return 0.0;
}

static void GlyphTreeOwnerCleanup(HWND hwnd)
{
    const bool hadPinList = GetPropW(hwnd, kPropPinList) != nullptr;

    bool noTrackedTreesRemain = false;
    {

        noTrackedTreesRemain = g_glyphTrackedTrees.empty();

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_glyphActiveItemMutex);
        g_glyphActiveItem.erase(hwnd);
    }
    PinRestoreOriginalList(hwnd, true);
    if ((removedTrackedTree && noTrackedTreesRemain) || hadPinList)
        GlyphDWriteCacheClear();
}

static int IconPopComputeSleepMs(HWND hwnd)
{
    HMONITOR hMon = hwnd ? MonitorFromWindow(hwnd, MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST)
                         : MonitorFromPoint({0, 0}, MONITOR_DEFAULTTOPRIMARY);
    MONITORINFOEXW mi = {};
    mi.cbSize = sizeof(mi);
    if (!GetMonitorInfoW(hMon, &mi))
        return 10;

    DEVMODEW dm = {};
    dm.dmSize = sizeof(dm);
    if (!EnumDisplaySettingsW(mi.szDevice, ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS, &dm) ||
        dm.dmDisplayFrequency < 24)
        return 10;

    int sleepMs = (int)(1000.0 / (double)dm.dmDisplayFrequency + 0.5);
    return std::clamp(sleepMs, 4, 16);
}

static bool IsClassName(HWND hwnd, LPCWSTR className)
{
    if (!hwnd || !className)
        return false;

    wchar_t cls[64] = {};
    return GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)) &&
           _wcsicmp(cls, className) == 0;
}

static bool IsDesktopIconListView(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!IsClassName(hwnd, L"SysListView32") ||
        !IsClassName(GetParent(hwnd), L"SHELLDLL_DefView") ||
        !IsWindowVisible(hwnd))
        return false;

    HWND root = GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT);
    return IsClassName(root, L"Progman") || IsClassName(root, L"WorkerW");
}

static void DesktopSelectionQueueFullItemRedraw(
    HWND listView, int firstItem, int lastItem)
{
    if (!RoundedSelectionVisualsEnabled() ||
        !IsDesktopIconListView(listView) ||
        firstItem < 0 || lastItem < firstItem) {
        return;
    }

    // Marquee selection can invalidate only the strip it just crossed. Our
    // rounded background then obeys that update clip and can leave the rest
    // of an edge item in its previous state indefinitely. Defer the native
    // range-redraw message until the current selection transaction unwinds;
    // ListView will invalidate each visible item's complete bounds itself.
    PostMessageW(listView, LVM_REDRAWITEMS,
        static_cast<WPARAM>(firstItem), static_cast<LPARAM>(lastItem));
}

static bool IsTravelBandToolbarCustomDraw(HWND notifyTarget, const NMHDR* nm)
{
    if (!g_settings.ExplorerSection || !g_settings.LegacyRebarControls ||
        !nm || nm->code != NM_CUSTOMDRAW || !nm->hwndFrom)
        return false;

    if (!IsClassName(notifyTarget, L"TravelBand") ||
        !IsClassName(nm->hwndFrom, L"ToolbarWindow32"))
        return false;

    bool inRebar = false;
    for (HWND p = nm->hwndFrom; p; p = GetParent(p)) {
        if (IsClassName(p, L"ReBarWindow32")) {
            inRebar = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!inRebar)
        return false;

    HWND root = GetAncestor(nm->hwndFrom, GA_ROOT);
    if (!root)
        return false;

    wchar_t rootCls[64] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(root, rootCls, ARRAYSIZE(rootCls)))
        return false;

    return _wcsicmp(rootCls, L"CabinetWClass") == 0 ||
           _wcsicmp(rootCls, L"ExploreWClass") == 0 ||
           _wcsicmp(rootCls, L"#32770") == 0 ||
           _wcsicmp(rootCls, L"NativeHWNDHost") == 0;
}

static COLORREF GetExplorerFakeMicaColor(bool dark)
{
    auto blend = [](COLORREF base, COLORREF overlay, float alpha) -> COLORREF {
        alpha = std::clamp(alpha, 0.f, 1.f);
        auto channel = [alpha](BYTE baseChannel, BYTE overlayChannel) -> BYTE {
            return static_cast<BYTE>(
                baseChannel + (overlayChannel - baseChannel) * alpha + 0.5f);
        };
        return RGB(
            channel(GetRValue(base), GetRValue(overlay)),
            channel(GetGValue(base), GetGValue(overlay)),
            channel(GetBValue(base), GetBValue(overlay)));
    };

    const COLORREF micaBase = dark ? RGB(0x16, 0x16, 0x16)
                                   : RGB(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF);
    const COLORREF base = blend(
        micaBase, GetAccentIndicator(), dark ? 0.15f : 0.08f);
    return blend(base,
                 dark ? RGB(0x49, 0x49, 0x49) : RGB(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF),
                 dark ? 0.12f : 0.50f);
}

// ExplorerMicaBackdrop modes. 1..3 carry a real DWM Mica backdrop
// (ExplorerMicaActive): the black "reveal" fills, the DWM attributes and
// the light-mode glow text exist for it alone. 4 (ExplorerOpaqueMode) keeps
// the content pane layout on opaque surfaces instead: the file picker's
// shades -- nav pane FilePickerPaneColor, list kFilePickerContentDark /
// white, status bar FilePickerChromeColor -- and DividerStroke rules.
static bool ExplorerMicaActive()
{
    const int mode = ExplorerBackdropMode();
    return mode >= 1 && mode <= 3;
}

static bool ExplorerOpaqueMode()
{
    return ExplorerBackdropMode() == 4;
}

// Content pane layout (== 2, 3 or 4): the file list and its ScrollBar
// windows form a pane over the nav pane, with the pane edge and status bar
// rules. Under Mica (2) they take a lighter reveal shade instead of pure
// black, so DWM composes them as a slightly lighter, still translucent
// pane. Level = how much WinUI's untinted layer fill (LayerFillColorDefault
// over Mica: #272727 dark / #F9F9F9 light) lifts the Mica base (#202020 /
// #F3F3F3), reapplied from black.
static bool ExplorerMicaPaneMode()
{
    return ExplorerBackdropMode() >= 2;
}

// Solid pane (== 3 under Mica, == 4 opaque): the file list and its
// scrollbars are written opaque in ExplorerMicaPaneSolidColor instead of
// revealing a backdrop.
static bool ExplorerMicaSolidPaneMode()
{
    const int mode = ExplorerBackdropMode();
    return mode == 3 || mode == 4;
}

static COLORREF ExplorerMicaPaneSolidColor(bool dark)
{
    if (ExplorerOpaqueMode())
        return dark ? kFilePickerContentDark : RGB(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF);
    return dark ? ExplorerDarkColor : RGB(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF);
}

// WinUI's untinted layer over Mica, as the near-black a GDI fill adds to
// the backdrop (see ExplorerMicaPaneMode).

static COLORREF ExplorerMicaStatusBarTextColor(bool dark)
{
    // WinUI status-bar foregrounds: #9E000000 in light mode and
    // #C5FFFFFF in dark mode. Theme TEXTCOLOR is RGB-only, so flatten those
    // alphas against the secondary Mica bases used by this status bar.
    const int background = ExplorerOpaqueMode()
        ? (dark ? 0x2B : 0xEE) : (dark ? 0x2C : 0xFB);
    const int foreground = dark ? 0xFF : 0x00;
    const int alpha = dark ? 0xC5 : 0x9E;
    const BYTE channel = static_cast<BYTE>(
        (foreground * alpha + background * (0xFF - alpha) + 0x7F) / 0xFF);
    return RGB(channel, channel, channel);
}

// Prefer the DC window; validate the tracked HWND because popup recreation can
// leave it stale, and a zero DPI would collapse scaled geometry.
static UINT DpiForPaintHdc(HDC hdc)
{
    if (hdc) {
        if (HWND hwnd = WindowFromDC(hdc)) {
            const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);
            if (dpi)
                return dpi;
        }
    }

    if (g_tlsPaintHwnd) {
        const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(g_tlsPaintHwnd);
        if (dpi)
            return dpi;
    }

    if (hdc) {
        const int dpi = GetDeviceCaps(hdc, LOGPIXELSX);
        if (dpi > 0)
            return static_cast<UINT>(dpi);
    }

    return DpiForPaint(nullptr);
}

// Opaque solid-pane fill. SetDIBitsToDevice from a pre-filled tile writes
// the alpha byte verbatim like the 1x1 StretchBlt but runs at FillRect
// speed (measured: 0.30 ms vs 0.65 ms for a 1567x825 fill), and needs no
// GDI object: the tiles are read-only once filled, so any thread can use
// them. One tile per theme color.
static constexpr int kExplorerMicaSolidTileW = 512;
static constexpr int kExplorerMicaSolidTileH = 64;
static DWORD g_explorerMicaSolidTiles[2][kExplorerMicaSolidTileW * kExplorerMicaSolidTileH];
static std::atomic<bool> g_explorerMicaSolidTileReady[2] = {};

static void WriteExplorerMicaSolidPixels(HDC hdc, const RECT& rect, bool dark)
{
    if (!hdc || rect.right <= rect.left || rect.bottom <= rect.top)
        return;
    const int which = dark ? 1 : 0;
    DWORD* tile = g_explorerMicaSolidTiles[which];
    if (!g_explorerMicaSolidTileReady[which].load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        const COLORREF c = ExplorerMicaPaneSolidColor(dark);
        const DWORD bgra = 0xFF000000u | (static_cast<DWORD>(GetRValue(c)) << 16) |
                           (static_cast<DWORD>(GetGValue(c)) << 8) | GetBValue(c);
        std::fill_n(tile, kExplorerMicaSolidTileW * kExplorerMicaSolidTileH, bgra);
        g_explorerMicaSolidTileReady[which].store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    BITMAPINFO bi = {};
    bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(bi.bmiHeader);
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = kExplorerMicaSolidTileW;
    bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -kExplorerMicaSolidTileH;
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;
    for (int y = rect.top; y < rect.bottom; y += kExplorerMicaSolidTileH) {
        const int h = std::min<int>(kExplorerMicaSolidTileH, rect.bottom - y);
        for (int x = rect.left; x < rect.right; x += kExplorerMicaSolidTileW) {
            const int w = std::min<int>(kExplorerMicaSolidTileW, rect.right - x);
            SetDIBitsToDevice(hdc, x, y, w, h, 0, 0, 0, h, tile, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS);
        }
    }
}

static void StretchPremultipliedPixel(HDC hdc, const RECT& rect, DWORD bgra,
    bool blend)
{
    if (!hdc || rect.right <= rect.left || rect.bottom <= rect.top)
        return;
    BITMAPINFO bi = {};
    bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(bi.bmiHeader);
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;
    void* bits = nullptr;
    HBITMAP bmp = CreateDIBSection(nullptr, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
    if (!bmp)
        return;
    if (bits)
        *static_cast<DWORD*>(bits) = bgra;
    if (HDC mem = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc)) {
        HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(mem, bmp);
        const int w = rect.right - rect.left, h = rect.bottom - rect.top;
        if (blend) {
            const BLENDFUNCTION bf = { AC_SRC_OVER, 0, 255, AC_SRC_ALPHA };
            AlphaBlend(hdc, rect.left, rect.top, w, h, mem, 0, 0, 1, 1, bf);
        } else {
            StretchBlt(hdc, rect.left, rect.top, w, h, mem, 0, 0, 1, 1, SRCCOPY);
        }
        SelectObject(mem, old);
        DeleteDC(mem);
    }
    DeleteObject(bmp);
}

static void WriteExplorerMicaPixels(HDC hdc, const RECT& line, DWORD bgra)
{
    StretchPremultipliedPixel(hdc, line, bgra, false);
}

static void BlendPremultipliedPixels(HDC hdc, const RECT& rect, DWORD bgra)
{
    StretchPremultipliedPixel(hdc, rect, bgra, true);
}

// The dialog's own WM_CTLCOLORDLG answer when it paints its own
// background in dark mode (see IsAppOwnedCtlColorBrush), else CLR_INVALID.
static COLORREF AppOwnedDialogColor(HWND dialog, HDC hdc)
{
    if (!dialog || !hdc || !IsClassName(dialog, L"#32770"))
        return CLR_INVALID;
    const COLORREF savedBk = GetBkColor(hdc);
    const COLORREF savedText = GetTextColor(hdc);
    const int savedMode = GetBkMode(hdc);
    HBRUSH br = (HBRUSH)SendMessageUnhooked(dialog, WM_CTLCOLORDLG, (WPARAM)hdc, (LPARAM)dialog);
    SetBkColor(hdc, savedBk);
    SetTextColor(hdc, savedText);
    SetBkMode(hdc, savedMode);
    LOGBRUSH lb = {};
    if (IsAppOwnedCtlColorBrush(br) && GetObject(br, sizeof(lb), &lb) && lb.lbStyle == BS_SOLID)
        return lb.lbColor;
    return CLR_INVALID;
}

static COLORREF ParentBackgroundColor(HWND hwnd, HDC hdc, bool dark, int sysColor)
{
    if (FilePickerChromeBackgroundRoot(hwnd))
        return FilePickerControlBackground(dark);
    if (dark) {
        const COLORREF own = AppOwnedDialogColor(hwnd ? GetParent(hwnd) : nullptr, hdc);
        if (own != CLR_INVALID)
            return own;
        return sysColor == COLOR_WINDOW ? kElevatedPaneDark : Win32MainDark;
    }

    HWND parent = hwnd ? GetParent(hwnd) : nullptr;
    if (!parent)
        return GetSysColor(sysColor);
    if (g_settings.RoundedTabPane && IsInTabbedPropertyPane(parent)) {
        HWND root = GetAncestor(parent, GA_ROOT);
        if (root && GetPropW(root, kPropertySheetLightPaneSubclassMarker))
            return WinUI::Light::SolidBackgroundFillColorTertiary;
    }
    // DefWindowProc answers WM_CTLCOLORDLG with the COLOR_3DFACE brush for
    // any window, so outside a dialog the class brush -- what the default
    // WM_ERASEBKGND really paints -- has to be asked first.
    const bool dialog = IsClassName(parent, L"#32770");
    HBRUSH br = nullptr;
    auto askCtlColorDlg = [&]() {
        const COLORREF savedBk = GetBkColor(hdc);
        const COLORREF savedText = GetTextColor(hdc);
        br = (HBRUSH)SendMessageUnhooked(parent, WM_CTLCOLORDLG, (WPARAM)hdc, (LPARAM)parent);
        SetBkColor(hdc, savedBk);
        SetTextColor(hdc, savedText);
    };
    if (dialog)
        askCtlColorDlg();
    if (!br)
        br = (HBRUSH)GetClassLongPtrW(parent, GCLP_HBRBACKGROUND);
    if (!br && !dialog)
        askCtlColorDlg();
    if (br) {
        const ULONG_PTR sysIndex = reinterpret_cast<ULONG_PTR>(br);
        if (sysIndex >= 1 && sysIndex <= 31) // (HBRUSH)(COLOR_x + 1) class brush
            return GetSysColor((int)sysIndex - 1);
        LOGBRUSH lb = {};
        if (GetObject(br, sizeof(lb), &lb)) {
            if (lb.lbStyle == BS_SOLID)
                return lb.lbColor;
            if (lb.lbStyle == BS_PATTERN && lb.lbHatch) {
                // Themed dialog texture (EnableThemeDialogTexture): read the
                // brush's own bitmap; a memory-DC GetPixel is cheap.
                COLORREF texel = CLR_INVALID;
                if (HDC mem = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc)) {
                    HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(mem, reinterpret_cast<HBITMAP>(lb.lbHatch));
                    if (old && old != HGDI_ERROR) {
                        texel = GetPixel(mem, 0, 0);
                        SelectObject(mem, old);
                    }
                    DeleteDC(mem);
                }
                if (texel != CLR_INVALID)
                    return texel;
            }
        }
    }
    // Last resort is the dialog face, never COLOR_WINDOW: these callers sit
    // on dialogs, and a white guess shows up as a square behind the control.
    return GetSysColor(COLOR_BTNFACE);
}
