            COLORREF bg = (msg == WM_CTLCOLORDLG)
                ? (IsInsideExcludedFilePicker(ctl) ? kNativeExcludedPickerDarkBg
                   : FilePickerChromeBackgroundRoot(ctl) ? FilePickerControlBackground(true)
                   : IsInTabbedPropertyPane(ctl) ? kElevatedPaneDark : Win32MainDark)
                : DarkBgForPaint(ctl);
            if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(bg)) {
                if (msg == WM_CTLCOLORSTATIC || msg == WM_CTLCOLORBTN ||
                    msg == WM_CTLCOLORDLG)
                    SetBkMode(hdcCtl, TRANSPARENT);
                else
                    SetBkColor(hdcCtl, bg);
                SetTextColor(hdcCtl, WinUI::Dark::TextFillColorPrimary);
                return (LRESULT)br;
            }
        }
    }

    // Plain windows whose class background reduces to COLOR_WINDOW (the
    // lazy (HBRUSH)(COLOR_WINDOW+1) class-registration placeholder, or the
    // real handle GetSysColorBrush(COLOR_WINDOW) returns, captured once at
    // registration time) resolve it via DefWindowProc's own WM_ERASEBKGND
    // handling, which reads the live system color table directly --
    // bypassing GetSysColorBrush_hook entirely, same category as
    // ComboLBox and the WM_CTLCOLOR* messages above. COLOR_WINDOW is no
    // longer in kDarkSysColorElems (see its own comment), so this now has
    // to cover normal dark mode too, not just the excluded-file-picker
    // exception (IsInsideExcludedFilePicker) SetSysColors could never
    // reach anyway -- it's session-global and can't force just one
    // process's picker dark without leaking dark mode into the rest of
    // that process.
    if (msg == WM_ERASEBKGND) {
        bool dark = g_darkModeExcluded
            ? (IsInsideExcludedFilePicker(hwnd) && IsSystemDarkMode())
            : g_darkModeActive.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        // Desktop icons (Progman/WorkerW -> SHELLDLL_DefView -> SysListView32)
        // register with this exact (HBRUSH)(COLOR_WINDOW+1) placeholder like
        // countless other plain ListViews, but their WM_ERASEBKGND must stay
        // transparent so the wallpaper shows through -- this generalized
        // check would otherwise force-fill it opaque dark, hiding the
        // wallpaper entirely. Every other window this check targets is a
        // real dialog/control that legitimately wants an opaque dark fill,
        // so exclude just the desktop's own root rather than narrowing the
        // check itself.
        HWND eraseRoot = dark ? GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT) : nullptr;
        wchar_t eraseRootCls[16] = {};
        bool isDesktopRoot = eraseRoot &&
            GetClassNameW(eraseRoot, eraseRootCls, ARRAYSIZE(eraseRootCls)) &&
            (_wcsicmp(eraseRootCls, L"Progman") == 0 ||
             _wcsicmp(eraseRootCls, L"WorkerW") == 0);
        if (dark && !isDesktopRoot) {
            HBRUSH classBg = (HBRUSH)GetClassLongPtrW(hwnd, GCLP_HBRBACKGROUND);
            bool isWindowBg = classBg == (HBRUSH)(UINT_PTR)(COLOR_WINDOW + 1) ||
                (GetSysColorBrush_orig && classBg == GetSysColorBrush_orig(COLOR_WINDOW));
            // AeroWizard #32770 pages can register their own real, distinct
            // solid white brush -- neither the placeholder nor
            // GetSysColorBrush(COLOR_WINDOW)'s own handle -- so the
            // exact-match checks above never catch it. Sample its actual
            // color instead and near-match it. Scoped to AeroWizard windows
            // only -- a blanket near-white match would repaint legitimately
            // white class brushes elsewhere that aren't supposed to go dark.
            if (!isWindowBg && classBg && IsAeroWizardRawWindow(hwnd)) {
                LOGBRUSH lb = {};
                if (GetObject(classBg, sizeof(lb), &lb) && lb.lbStyle == BS_SOLID) {
                    int luma = (GetRValue(lb.lbColor) * 54 + GetGValue(lb.lbColor) * 183 +
                                GetBValue(lb.lbColor) * 19) >> 8;
                    isWindowBg = luma > 200;
                }
            }
            if (isWindowBg) {
                RECT rc;
                if (GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc)) {
                    if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(DarkBgForPaint(hwnd))) {
                        // Returning 1 without calling SendMessageW_orig is
                        // deliberate, not a shortcut: WM_ERASEBKGND's contract
                        // is "nonzero = already erased, do nothing else." The
                        // real handler here is just DefWindowProc's own
                        // class-brush fill (that's the whole reason isWindowBg
                        // matched -- a window that customized its own erase
                        // logic wouldn't have this lazy class brush), so calling
                        // through would just repaint the same rect light again
                        // right after this dark fill.
                        FillRect_orig((HDC)wp, &rc, br);
                        return 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // Excluded processes must never show dark; see
        // ExcludedUndoesSessionBtnFace.
        else if (g_darkModeExcluded && !dark &&
                 ExcludedEraseSessionBtnFace(hwnd, (HDC)wp)) {
            return 1;
        }
    }

    if (msg == LVM_SETEXTENDEDLISTVIEWSTYLE && IsCurrentProcessDiskCleanup()) {
        LRESULT ret = SendMessageW_orig(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        ApplyDiskCleanupCheckboxListViewDark(hwnd);
        return ret;
    }

    if (msg == WM_NOTIFY) {
        NMHDR* nm = reinterpret_cast<NMHDR*>(lp);

        LRESULT customDrawResult = 0;
        if (HandleTravelBandToolbarCustomDraw(hwnd, nm, &customDrawResult))
            return customDrawResult;
        if (HandleUpBandToolbarCustomDraw(hwnd, nm, &customDrawResult))
            return customDrawResult;
        if (HandleRefreshToolbarCustomDraw(hwnd, nm, &customDrawResult))
            return customDrawResult;
        if (HandleBreadcrumbRootCustomDraw(hwnd, wp, nm, &customDrawResult))
            return customDrawResult;
    }

    if (msg == TVM_SETITEMHEIGHT && NavMetricsEligible(hwnd)) {
        const int itemHeight = NavMetricsScale(hwnd, kNavMetricsItemHeight);
        if ((int)wp != itemHeight)
            NavMetricsStoreOriginalHeight(hwnd);
        return SendMessageW_orig(hwnd, TVM_SETITEMHEIGHT, itemHeight, lp);
    }

    // ── Fluent Pin: intercept TVM_SETIMAGELIST(TVSIL_STATE) ─────────────
    // Build custom pin list and substitute. Per-TreeView property tracking
    // via SetPropW avoids stale pointers during Explorer preloading.
    if (msg == TVM_SETIMAGELIST && wp == TVSIL_STATE
        && g_settings.FluentPinIcon && g_settings.ExplorerSection
        && GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(hwnd)
        && !PinIsDisabledDragDropTreeView(hwnd)) {
        HIMAGELIST srcList = reinterpret_cast<HIMAGELIST>(lp);
        HIMAGELIST prevList = nullptr;
        if (PinInstallCustomList(hwnd, srcList, &prevList))
            return reinterpret_cast<LRESULT>(prevList);
    }
    // ── Glyph Icons: track nav pane TreeViews ──────────────────────────────
    if (msg == TVM_SETIMAGELIST && wp == TVSIL_NORMAL) {
        if (GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(hwnd)) {
            TreeCursorTrySubclass(hwnd);
            // GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView also matches a modern file-picker's nav
            // pane hosted in another process, e.g. regedit's Import/Export/
            // Load Hive picker. Per-item glyph detection there resolves each
            // item's shell identity, triggering a security-zone + cloud-sync
            // check per item -- a multi-second stall when the tree shows
            // hundreds of items. Skip tracking entirely in regedit.exe so it
            // falls back to default icons instead of freezing.
            if (GlyphOrColorIconsActive() && !IsCurrentProcessRegedit()) {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_glyphTreeMutex);
                g_glyphTrackedTrees.insert(hwnd);
                GlyphEnsureMap();
            }
            if (NavMetricsNeedsCustomNormalList(hwnd)) {
                HIMAGELIST srcList = reinterpret_cast<HIMAGELIST>(lp);
                if (NavMetricsInstallNormalList(hwnd, srcList,
                        g_settings.NavPaneWinUIMetrics,
                        GlyphOrColorIconsActive() && !IsCurrentProcessRegedit() &&
                        GlyphIsTracked(hwnd)))
                    return 0;
            }
        }
    }

    // TVN_DELETEITEM is sent to the tree's parent, not the tree itself, so
    // this global SendMessageW interception -- not TreeCursorSubclassProc --
    // is the only place that sees it. Invalidates any nav-pane hover-fade
    // state still pointing at the item comctl32 is about to free, closing a
    // dangling-HTREEITEM window that would otherwise last until the next
    // mouse move/button event.
    if (msg == WM_NOTIFY && g_settings.RoundedButtons) {
        NMHDR* pnmDel = reinterpret_cast<NMHDR*>(lp);
        if (pnmDel && pnmDel->code == TVN_DELETEITEM &&
            GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(pnmDel->hwndFrom)) {
            NMTREEVIEWW* nmtv = reinterpret_cast<NMTREEVIEWW*>(lp);
            TreePressedHoldInvalidateItem(
                pnmDel->hwndFrom, nmtv->itemOld.hItem);
            NavHoverFadeInvalidateItem(pnmDel->hwndFrom, nmtv->itemOld.hItem);
        }
    }

    // TVN_SELCHANGEDW/A: TreeView's equivalent of LVN_ITEMCHANGED below, but
    // simpler -- comctl32 always reports both the outgoing and incoming item
    // in one notification (no ListView-style bulk/iItem==-1 case), and
    // HTREEITEM is a stable identity, so a real selection change is always
    // exactly one invalidate + one start. NMTREEVIEWW and NMTREEVIEWA share
    // the same layout for the fields read here (hItem), so one cast covers
    // both notification codes. isTreeView=true routes through
    // ShouldDrawSelectionBorder's nav-pane exclusion (GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView),
    // same as the drawing side.
    if (msg == WM_NOTIFY && g_settings.RoundedButtons) {
        NMHDR* pnmTv = reinterpret_cast<NMHDR*>(lp);
        if (pnmTv && (pnmTv->code == TVN_SELCHANGEDW || pnmTv->code == TVN_SELCHANGEDA)) {
            NMTREEVIEWW* nmtv = reinterpret_cast<NMTREEVIEWW*>(lp);
            if (nmtv->itemOld.hItem)
                ListSelectFadeInvalidateItem(
                    pnmTv->hwndFrom, (ULONG_PTR)nmtv->itemOld.hItem, true);
            if (nmtv->itemNew.hItem)
                ListSelectFadeStartItem(
                    pnmTv->hwndFrom, (ULONG_PTR)nmtv->itemNew.hItem, true);
        }
    }

    // LVN_ITEMCHANGED, like TVN_DELETEITEM above, is sent to the ListView's
    // parent, so this global interception is the only reliable place to see
    // a real deselection -- DrawRoundedItemBg's border path only ever gets
    // called with an already-selected state, so it never observes the
    // moment an item goes back to Normal. Without this, reselecting the same
    // item would find its ListSelectFade entry still parked at progress 1
    // and skip the fade-in entirely.
    if (msg == WM_NOTIFY && g_settings.RoundedButtons) {
        NMHDR* pnmLv = reinterpret_cast<NMHDR*>(lp);
        if (pnmLv && pnmLv->code == LVN_ITEMCHANGED) {
            NMLISTVIEW* pnmv = reinterpret_cast<NMLISTVIEW*>(lp);
            if (pnmv->uChanged & LVIF_STATE) {
                if (pnmv->iItem < 0) {
                    // Bulk notification (comctl32 coalesces "deselect
                    // everything" and "deselect old + select new" into this
                    // form) -- old/newState aren't meaningful per item here,
                    // so re-derive the real selection set instead of trying
                    // to read a transition out of these fields.
                    ListSelectFadeResyncWindow(pnmLv->hwndFrom);
                } else {
                    const bool wasSelected = (pnmv->uOldState & LVIS_SELECTED) != 0;
                    const bool isSelected = (pnmv->uNewState & LVIS_SELECTED) != 0;
                    if (wasSelected != isSelected) {
                        DesktopSelectionQueueFullItemRedraw(
                            pnmLv->hwndFrom, pnmv->iItem, pnmv->iItem);
                    }
                    if (wasSelected && !isSelected) {
                        ListSelectFadeInvalidateItem(
                            pnmLv->hwndFrom, (ULONG_PTR)(UINT)pnmv->iItem, false);
                    } else if (!wasSelected && isSelected) {
                        // The only place a fade entry is created -- see
                        // ListSelectFadeStartItem for why paint doesn't.
                        ListSelectFadeStartItem(
                            pnmLv->hwndFrom, (ULONG_PTR)(UINT)pnmv->iItem, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (pnmLv && pnmLv->code == LVN_ODSTATECHANGED) {
            // Owner-data ListViews report marquee/bulk changes as a range,
            // not as LVN_ITEMCHANGED for every item. This is the path the
            // desktop can use when the marquee only grazes an edge icon.
            NMLVODSTATECHANGE* change =
                reinterpret_cast<NMLVODSTATECHANGE*>(lp);
            const bool wasSelected =
                (change->uOldState & LVIS_SELECTED) != 0;
            const bool isSelected =
                (change->uNewState & LVIS_SELECTED) != 0;
            if (wasSelected != isSelected) {
                DesktopSelectionQueueFullItemRedraw(
                    pnmLv->hwndFrom, change->iFrom, change->iTo);
                ListSelectFadeResyncWindow(pnmLv->hwndFrom);
            }
        }
    }

    // LVN_DELETEITEM: see ListSelectFadeInvalidateWindowItems for why this
    // wipes the whole window's tracked set rather than just the deleted
    // index (deletion shifts every later item down by one).
    if (msg == WM_NOTIFY && g_settings.RoundedButtons) {
        NMHDR* pnmLvDel = reinterpret_cast<NMHDR*>(lp);
        if (pnmLvDel && pnmLvDel->code == LVN_DELETEITEM) {
            ListSelectFadeInvalidateWindowItems(pnmLvDel->hwndFrom);
        }
    }

    // TVN_DELETEITEM (select-fade): unlike ListView, HTREEITEM is a stable
    // identity, so a targeted erase of just the deleted item's own entry is
    // enough -- no index-shift concern, no need to wipe the whole window.
    // Defends against comctl32 ever recycling a freed HTREEITEM value for a
    // new item that gets selected before this fires: without this, a stale
    // parked (progress=1) entry under the reused key would make that new
    // selection silently skip its fade-in. Checks both notification codes
    // like the TVN_SELCHANGEDW/A block above -- the plain TVN_DELETEITEM
    // macro resolves to only the W variant under this project's UNICODE
    // build, but a real ANSI-window TreeView in some other process still
    // sends the A code regardless of how we were compiled.
    if (msg == WM_NOTIFY && g_settings.RoundedButtons) {
        NMHDR* pnmTvDel = reinterpret_cast<NMHDR*>(lp);
        if (pnmTvDel && (pnmTvDel->code == TVN_DELETEITEMW || pnmTvDel->code == TVN_DELETEITEMA)) {
            NMTREEVIEWW* nmtvDel = reinterpret_cast<NMTREEVIEWW*>(lp);
            if (nmtvDel->itemOld.hItem)
                ListSelectFadeInvalidateItem(
                    pnmTvDel->hwndFrom, (ULONG_PTR)nmtvDel->itemOld.hItem, true);
        }
    }

    // Keyboard-focus outline for nav pane items -- independent of
    // NavPaneWinUIMetrics/GlyphIcons below. Rounded selection suppresses the
    // themed focus indicator (DrawFocusRect_hook's TreeView exclusion), so
    // this fills in the same modern outline via CDIS_FOCUS instead.
    const bool wantFocusOutline = RoundedSelectionVisualsEnabled() &&
        g_settings.ModernFocusRect == 0;

    if (msg == WM_NOTIFY && (g_settings.NavPaneWinUIMetrics ||
                             g_settings.RoundedButtons ||
                             g_settings.NavPanePill)) {
        NMHDR* pnm = reinterpret_cast<NMHDR*>(lp);
        if (pnm && pnm->code == NM_CUSTOMDRAW && GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(pnm->hwndFrom) &&
            !(GlyphOrColorIconsActive() && GlyphIsTracked(pnm->hwndFrom))) {
            NMTVCUSTOMDRAW* pcd = reinterpret_cast<NMTVCUSTOMDRAW*>(lp);
            DWORD stage = pcd->nmcd.dwDrawStage;
            if (stage == CDDS_PREPAINT) {
                LRESULT lr = SendMessageW_orig(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
                return lr | CDRF_NOTIFYITEMDRAW;
            }
            if (stage == CDDS_ITEMPREPAINT) {
                if (g_settings.NavPaneWinUIMetrics)
                    NavMetricsApplyItemMargin(pcd);
                // Stash this item's real label rect -- see t_navTvItemLabelRect's
                // own comment. The actual native paint (DrawThemeTextEx/
                // Uniscribe) is NOT nested inside this SendMessage call: this
                // call only delivers the NM_CUSTOMDRAW query to the parent and
                // returns: comctl32 does its own drawing afterward, back in
                // its own internal per-item paint loop, once this notification
                // returns. So this deliberately stays set past this call,
                // like g_tlsPaintHwnd, and is simply overwritten by the next
                // item's CDDS_ITEMPREPAINT rather than cleared here.
                t_navTvItemLabelRectValid = g_settings.RoundedButtons &&
                    TreeView_GetItemRect(pnm->hwndFrom,
                        (HTREEITEM)pcd->nmcd.dwItemSpec,
                        &t_navTvItemLabelRect, TRUE) &&
                    t_navTvItemLabelRect.bottom > t_navTvItemLabelRect.top;
                LRESULT lr = SendMessageW_orig(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
                // Always notified now, not just for wantFocusOutline -- the
                // hover-fade-out pill below needs this stage on every row,
                // every repaint, too (see NavHoverFadeOutPaint).
                return lr | CDRF_NOTIFYPOSTPAINT;
            }
            if (stage == CDDS_ITEMPOSTPAINT) {
                LRESULT lr = SendMessageW_orig(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
                HTREEITEM hItem = (HTREEITEM)pcd->nmcd.dwItemSpec;
                HDC hdc = pcd->nmcd.hdc;
                if (!hItem || !hdc) return lr;
                NavHoverFadeOutPaint(pnm->hwndFrom, hItem, hdc);
                PillDrawGdiOutgoingItem(
                    pnm->hwndFrom, hItem, hdc, &pcd->nmcd.rc);
                if (wantFocusOutline && (pcd->nmcd.uItemState & CDIS_FOCUS) &&
                    NavFocusCuesVisible(pnm->hwndFrom)) {
                    RECT itemRect = {};
                    if (GetNavFocusItemRect(pnm->hwndFrom, hItem, &itemRect))
                        DrawModernFocusRect(hdc, &itemRect);
                }
                return lr;
            }
        }
    }

    // ── Glyph Icons: intercept NM_CUSTOMDRAW ────────────────────────────
    // Also handles the focus outline for GlyphIcons-tracked trees (mutually
    // exclusive with the block above, matching the pre-existing tracked-tree
    // gate) -- glyphTracked keeps every original glyph code path unchanged.
    if (msg == WM_NOTIFY && (GlyphOrColorIconsActive() || wantFocusOutline)) {
        NMHDR* pnm = reinterpret_cast<NMHDR*>(lp);
        // Both lookups walk windows or take a lock; only custom draw uses them.
        const bool customDraw = pnm && pnm->code == NM_CUSTOMDRAW;
        const bool glyphTracked = customDraw && GlyphIsTracked(pnm->hwndFrom);
        const bool focusHere = customDraw && wantFocusOutline &&
            GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(pnm->hwndFrom);
        if (customDraw && (glyphTracked || focusHere)) {
            NMTVCUSTOMDRAW* pcd = reinterpret_cast<NMTVCUSTOMDRAW*>(lp);
            DWORD stage = pcd->nmcd.dwDrawStage;

            if (stage == CDDS_PREPAINT) {
                LRESULT lr = SendMessageW_orig(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
                if (glyphTracked) {
                    const HWND tree = pnm->hwndFrom;
                    const bool stateOverridden =
                        g_dropPillActiveTree.load(
                            std::memory_order_acquire) == tree;
                    HTREEITEM dropItem = nullptr;
                    if (stateOverridden) {
                        dropItem = (HTREEITEM)g_dropPillActiveItem.load(
                            std::memory_order_acquire);
                    }
                    if (!stateOverridden) {
                        dropItem = (HTREEITEM)SendMessageW_orig(
                            tree, TVM_GETNEXTITEM, TVGN_DROPHILITE, 0);
                    }
                    s_glyphDropPaint.tree = tree;
                    s_glyphDropPaint.dropItem = dropItem;
                    s_glyphDropPaint.selectedItem = dropItem
                        ? (HTREEITEM)SendMessageW_orig(
                            tree, TVM_GETNEXTITEM, TVGN_CARET, 0)
                        : nullptr;
                }
                return lr | CDRF_NOTIFYITEMDRAW;
            }
            if (stage == CDDS_ITEMPREPAINT) {
                if (g_settings.NavPaneWinUIMetrics)
                    NavMetricsApplyItemMargin(pcd);
                // Stash this item's real label rect for the nested native
                // paint call below -- see t_navTvItemLabelRect's own comment.
                // Needed here too: a glyph-tracked tree never reaches the
                // other NM_CUSTOMDRAW block above (mutually exclusive gate),
                // so its own CDDS_ITEMPREPAINT is the only place this stash
                // can be populated for such a tree.
                t_navTvItemLabelRectValid = g_settings.RoundedButtons &&
                    TreeView_GetItemRect(pnm->hwndFrom,
                        (HTREEITEM)pcd->nmcd.dwItemSpec,
                        &t_navTvItemLabelRect, TRUE) &&
                    t_navTvItemLabelRect.bottom > t_navTvItemLabelRect.top;
                LRESULT lr = SendMessageW_orig(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
                HTREEITEM hItem = (HTREEITEM)pcd->nmcd.dwItemSpec;
                HDC hdc = pcd->nmcd.hdc;
                if (glyphTracked && hItem && hdc &&
                    !NavMetricsUsesTransparentIcons(pnm->hwndFrom)) {
                    RECT textRect = {};
                    if (TreeView_GetItemRect(pnm->hwndFrom, hItem, &textRect, TRUE)) {
                        HIMAGELIST himl = TreeView_GetImageList(pnm->hwndFrom, TVSIL_NORMAL);
                        int iw = 16, ih = 16;
                        if (himl) ImageList_GetIconSize(himl, &iw, &ih);
                        bool metricsList = NavMetricsIsOwnNormalList(pnm->hwndFrom, himl) &&
                                           NavMetricsUsesWinUIMetrics(pnm->hwndFrom);
                        int imageIndex = -1;
                        wchar_t textBuf[260] = {};
                        TVITEMW tviImage = {};
                        tviImage.mask = TVIF_IMAGE | TVIF_HANDLE | TVIF_TEXT;
                        tviImage.hItem = hItem;
                        tviImage.pszText = textBuf;
                        tviImage.cchTextMax = ARRAYSIZE(textBuf);
                        SendMessageW_orig(pnm->hwndFrom, TVM_GETITEMW, 0, (LPARAM)&tviImage);
                        imageIndex = tviImage.iImage;
                        bool preSelected = (pcd->nmcd.uItemState & CDIS_SELECTED) ||
                                           (pcd->nmcd.uItemState & CDIS_FOCUS);
                        const wchar_t* preGlyph = GlyphResolveItem(imageIndex, textBuf, preSelected);
                        int artW = iw, artH = ih;
                        NavMetricsGetIconArtSize(pnm->hwndFrom,
                            preGlyph ? preGlyph[0] : 0, iw, ih, &artW, &artH);
                        bool specialMetricsIcon = metricsList &&
                            (GlyphIsSpecialMetricImageIndex(imageIndex) ||
                             (preGlyph && GlyphIsSpecialMetricGlyph(preGlyph[0])));
                        const int iconOffset = NavMetricsScale(
                            pnm->hwndFrom, kNavMetricsIconOffset);
                        int ix = textRect.left - iw - iconOffset;
                        int artCellW = metricsList ? ih : iw;
                        int drawX = NavMetricsGetIconDrawLeft(pnm->hwndFrom, ix, artW, artCellW);
                        int iy = textRect.top + (textRect.bottom - textRect.top - artH) / 2;
                        RECT clipRect = { drawX, iy, drawX + artW, iy + artH };
                        if (metricsList) {
                            int cellY = textRect.top + (textRect.bottom - textRect.top - ih) / 2;
                            if (specialMetricsIcon) {
                                int cellEraseW = iw;
                                clipRect = {
                                    ix, cellY, ix + cellEraseW + iconOffset,
                                    cellY + ih
                                };
                            } else {
                                clipRect.left   = (std::min)(ix, drawX);
                                clipRect.top    = (std::min)(cellY, iy);
                                clipRect.right  = (std::max)(ix + iw, drawX + artW);
                                clipRect.bottom = (std::max)(cellY + ih, iy + artH);
                            }
                        }
                        ExcludeClipRect(hdc, clipRect.left, clipRect.top, clipRect.right, clipRect.bottom);
                    }
                }
                return lr | CDRF_NOTIFYPOSTPAINT;
            }
            if (stage == CDDS_ITEMPOSTPAINT) {
                LRESULT lr = SendMessageW_orig(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
                HWND tv = pcd->nmcd.hdr.hwndFrom;
                HTREEITEM hItem = (HTREEITEM)pcd->nmcd.dwItemSpec;
                HDC hdc = pcd->nmcd.hdc;
                if (!hItem || !hdc) return lr;

                SelectClipRgn(hdc, nullptr);

                NavHoverFadeOutPaint(tv, hItem, hdc);
                PillDrawGdiOutgoingItem(
                    tv, hItem, hdc, &pcd->nmcd.rc);

                if (focusHere && (pcd->nmcd.uItemState & CDIS_FOCUS) &&
                    NavFocusCuesVisible(tv)) {
                    RECT itemRect = {};
                    if (GetNavFocusItemRect(tv, hItem, &itemRect))
                        DrawModernFocusRect(hdc, &itemRect);
                }
                if (!glyphTracked) return lr;

                RECT iconRect = {};
                if (TreeView_GetItemRect(tv, hItem, &iconRect, TRUE)) {
                    HIMAGELIST himl = TreeView_GetImageList(tv, TVSIL_NORMAL);
                    int iconW = 16, iconH = 16;
                    if (himl) ImageList_GetIconSize(himl, &iconW, &iconH);
                    bool metricsList = NavMetricsIsOwnNormalList(tv, himl) &&
                                       NavMetricsUsesWinUIMetrics(tv);

                    const int iconOffset = NavMetricsScale(
                        tv, kNavMetricsIconOffset);
                    int iconX = iconRect.left - iconW - iconOffset;
                    if (g_iconPopTree.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == tv &&
                        g_iconPopItem.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == (LPARAM)hItem)
                        IconPopPublishDirtyRect(tv, hItem, iconRect, iconX, iconW, iconH);

                    bool isSelected = (pcd->nmcd.uItemState & CDIS_SELECTED) ||
                                      (pcd->nmcd.uItemState & CDIS_FOCUS);
                    if (s_glyphDropPaint.tree == tv &&
                        s_glyphDropPaint.dropItem) {
                        isSelected = hItem == s_glyphDropPaint.selectedItem;
                    }
                    const wchar_t* glyph = GlyphGetForItem(tv, hItem, isSelected);
                    int artW = iconW, artH = iconH;
                    NavMetricsGetIconArtSize(tv, glyph ? glyph[0] : 0, iconW, iconH, &artW, &artH);
                    int artCellW = metricsList ? iconH : iconW;
                    int drawX = NavMetricsGetIconDrawLeft(tv, iconX, artW, artCellW);
                    int iconY = iconRect.top + (iconRect.bottom - iconRect.top - artH) / 2;

                    RECT glyphRect = { drawX, iconY, drawX + artW, iconY + artH };

                    // Only the non-transparent compatibility list excludes
                    // this cell in CDDS_ITEMPREPAINT. A transparent placeholder
                    // leaves TreeView's premultiplied hover/selection background
                    // intact; filling over it here would discard that alpha and
                    // reveal bare Mica behind the glyph in light mode.
                    if (metricsList && !NavMetricsUsesTransparentIcons(tv)) {
                        int cellY = iconRect.top +
                            (iconRect.bottom - iconRect.top - iconH) / 2;
                        RECT eraseRect = {
                            (std::min)(iconX, drawX), (std::min)(cellY, iconY),
                            (std::max)(iconX + iconW, drawX + artW) + 1,
                            (std::max)(cellY + iconH, iconY + artH)
                        };
                        COLORREF eraseClr = GlyphSampleEraseColor(
                            hdc, glyphRect, IsSystemDarkMode());
                        if (HBRUSH eraseBr = GetCachedSolidBrush(eraseClr))
                            FillRect_orig(hdc, &eraseRect, eraseBr);
                    }

                    // Nav pane color icons: takes priority over the monochrome
                    // glyph below whenever this identity has a mapped color SVG
                    // and the setting is on. A failed render (colorIcon stays
                    // null despite a mapping) falls through to the glyph path
                    // unchanged -- this is what keeps the fallback to the
                    // monochrome glyph automatic, never the native icon.
                    //
                    // Own colorArtW/colorArtH (not artW/artH) so color-icon
                    // sizing is tunable independently via
                    // ColorIconGetCompensationScale. Forces square under
                    // WinUI metrics like NavMetricsGetIconArtSize does --
                    // iconW/iconH diverge there, and a non-square target
                    // stretches the (square-rendered) icon bitmap.
                    const double colorScale = ColorIconGetCompensationScale(glyph[0]);
                    int colorArtW, colorArtH;
                    if (g_settings.NavPaneWinUIMetrics &&
                        NavMetricsIsOwnNormalList(tv, TreeView_GetImageList(tv, TVSIL_NORMAL))) {
                        int colorBase = iconH > 0 ? iconH : NavMetricsScale(tv, kNavMetricsIconSize);
                        colorArtW = colorArtH = (std::max)(1, (int)std::lround(colorBase * colorScale));
                    } else {
                        colorArtW = (std::max)(1, (int)std::lround(iconW * colorScale));
                        colorArtH = (std::max)(1, (int)std::lround(iconH * colorScale));
                    }
                    int colorDrawX = NavMetricsGetIconDrawLeft(tv, iconX, colorArtW, artCellW);
                    int colorIconY = iconRect.top + (iconRect.bottom - iconRect.top - colorArtH) / 2;

                    const char* colorSvgText = g_settings.ColorNavIcons
                        ? ColorIconGetSvgForGlyph(glyph[0]) : nullptr;
                    HICON colorIcon = colorSvgText
                        ? ColorIconGetOrBuild(glyph[0], colorArtW) : nullptr;
                    const bool colorIconActive = colorIcon != nullptr;
                    if (colorIconActive && g_settings.ColorNavIconMode == 1) {
                        DrawIconEx(hdc, colorDrawX, colorIconY, colorIcon,
                                   colorArtW, colorArtH, 0, nullptr, DI_NORMAL);
                        return lr;
                    }

                    const bool glyphDark = IsHwndDarkMode(tv);
                    const bool glyphPressed = RoundedSelectionVisualsEnabled() &&
                        IsTreeRowPressed(tv, &iconRect);
                    COLORREF neutralColor = g_settings.GlyphColor != CLR_INVALID
                        ? g_settings.GlyphColor
                        : (glyphDark ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(25, 26, 26));
                    COLORREF color = isSelected ? GetAccentIndicator() : neutralColor;
                    if (RoundedSelectionVisualsEnabled()) {
                        // These glyph renderers take COLORREF, including their
                        // animated frames. Compose the foreground once, keeping
                        // the same RGB/geometry contract in every renderer.
                        const COLORREF background = glyphDark
                            ? ExplorerDarkColor : kExplorerListLight;
                        // A GlyphColor of the user's own wins over the neutral
                        // selection's text color, selected or not; only the
                        // WinUI opacity applies. The neutral selection keeps
                        // the accent off the selected glyph either way.
                        const bool customGlyph = g_settings.GlyphColor != CLR_INVALID;
                        const bool neutral = g_settings.NeutralSelection && !customGlyph;
                        if (g_settings.NeutralSelection && customGlyph)
                            color = neutralColor;
                        neutralColor = WinUI::FlattenOver(NavigationItemForegroundColor(
                            glyphDark, neutral, neutralColor, glyphPressed), background);
                        color = WinUI::FlattenOver(NavigationItemForegroundColor(
                            glyphDark, neutral, color, glyphPressed), background);
                    }

                    // Spring scale-pop on a genuine selection change to this item
                    if (isSelected) {
                        bool isNewSelection = false;
                        bool isFirstEver = false;
                        {
                            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_glyphActiveItemMutex);
                            auto activeIt = g_glyphActiveItem.find(tv);
                            isNewSelection = (activeIt == g_glyphActiveItem.end()) ||
                                             (activeIt->second != hItem);
                            if (isNewSelection) {
                                isFirstEver = (activeIt == g_glyphActiveItem.end());
                                g_glyphActiveItem[tv] = hItem;
                            }
                        }
                        if (isNewSelection) {
                            // When Windows' "play animations" setting is off, skip
                            // starting the wipe-intro/pop timer entirely -- selection
                            // just swaps straight from Normal to Filled below, with
                            // wiping staying false and popScale staying at 1.0.
                            // wantsColorPop lets a color icon share this same
                            // trigger/timer -- preDur forced to 0 below since a
                            // flat-palette icon has no wipe-intro of its own to
                            // play (several of the glyphs mapped to color icons
                            // have a nonzero IconPopPreDuration tuned for their
                            // monochrome wipe-in; without forcing 0 here, a color
                            // pop on those items would stall for up to ~1s before
                            // animating). This also makes
                            // g_iconPopDCHandoffPendingFor's own
                            // IconPopDirectComposition && preDur > 0.0 check below
                            // evaluate to false for every color icon automatically.
                            const bool wantsColorPop = colorIconActive &&
                                g_settings.ColorNavIconMode == 2;
                            if (!isFirstEver && SysAnimationsEnabled() &&
                                (g_settings.GlyphIconMode >= 2 || wantsColorPop)) {
                                DOUBLE preDur = colorIconActive ? 0.0 : IconPopPreDuration(glyph);
                                g_iconPopTree.store(tv, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                                g_iconPopItem.store((LPARAM)hItem, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                                IconPopPublishDirtyRect(tv, hItem, iconRect, iconX, iconW, iconH);
                                g_iconPopStart.store(TimerGetSeconds(), std::memory_order_relaxed);
                                g_iconPopPreDur.store(preDur, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                                g_iconPopSleepMs.store(IconPopComputeSleepMs(tv), std::memory_order_relaxed);
                                g_iconPopDCClearFor.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                                g_iconPopDCClearPending.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                                g_iconPopHandoffEnd.store(0.0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                                g_iconPopDCHandoffPendingFor.store(
                                    g_settings.IconPopDirectComposition && preDur > 0.0
                                        ? (LPARAM)hItem : 0,
                                    std::memory_order_relaxed);
                                g_iconPopTimer.store(1, std::memory_order_release);
                                HANDLE wakeEvent = nullptr;
                                {
                                    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_iconPopThreadStartMutex);
                                    wakeEvent = EnsureIconPopWakeEvent();
                                    if (wakeEvent && !g_iconPopThread) {
                                        g_iconPopThreadStop.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
                                        g_iconPopThread = CreateThread(nullptr, 0,
                                            IconPopAnimThread, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
                                    }
                                }
                                if (wakeEvent) SetEvent(wakeEvent);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    float popScale = 1.0f;
                    float popAnimT = -1.0f; // -1 = not animating (drives the Music shimmy)
                    bool initialStaticHold = false;
                    bool wiping = false;
                    bool dcompFinalHandoff = false;
                    bool dcompFinalCountdown = false;
                    float wipeElapsedSec = 0.0f;
                    // Gallery/Videos/Phone already play a full custom intro of their
                    // own (assemble/build/vibrate); a generic bounce afterward would
                    // be lost or redundant on top of that motion, so they hand off
                    // straight to the settled Filled render. Home, Documents,
                    // Network, and ThisPC each carry their own settle motion for the
                    // same reason. Desktop's bloom-rise already has enough motion
                    // (rise + fade) that a bounce reads as tacked-on. OneDrive's
                    // converge-wipe deliberately settles flat -- a bounce clips
                    // outside Explorer, where this icon renders unscaled with no
                    // scale-up headroom. CD's sweep-reveal already ends exactly at
                    // the settled Filled render, so a bounce would be redundant,
                    // same as Drive/Documents.
                    bool skipGenericPop = glyph[0] == GLYPH_GALLERY[0]   ||
                                          glyph[0] == GLYPH_VIDEOS[0]    ||
                                          glyph[0] == GLYPH_PHONE[0]     ||
                                          glyph[0] == GLYPH_HOME[0]      ||
                                          glyph[0] == GLYPH_DOCUMENTS[0] ||
                                          glyph[0] == GLYPH_NETWORK[0]   ||
                                          glyph[0] == GLYPH_DESKTOP[0]   ||
                                          glyph[0] == GLYPH_THISPC[0]    ||
                                          glyph[0] == GLYPH_ONEDRIVE[0]  ||
                                          glyph[0] == GLYPH_LIBRARY[0]   ||
                                          glyph[0] == GLYPH_FAVORITES[0] ||
                                          glyph[0] == GLYPH_FAVORITES_FILLED[0] ||
                                          glyph[0] == GLYPH_ZIPARCHIVE[0]  ||
                                          glyph[0] == GLYPH_CDROM[0]     ||
                                          glyph[0] == GLYPH_FOLDER[0];
                    if (g_iconPopTimer.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
                        g_iconPopTree.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == tv &&
                        g_iconPopItem.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == (LPARAM)hItem) {
                        DOUBLE now = TimerGetSeconds();
                        DOUBLE elapsed = now - g_iconPopStart.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
                        if (elapsed < ICON_POP_HOLD_DUR) {
                            initialStaticHold = true;
                        } else {
                            DOUBLE motionElapsed = elapsed - ICON_POP_HOLD_DUR;
                            // Use the trigger-time snapshot so paint and worker
                            // agree even if the resolved glyph changes mid-run.
                            DOUBLE preDur = isSelected
                                ? g_iconPopPreDur.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) : 0.0;
                            bool wantsDCompHandoff =
                                g_settings.IconPopDirectComposition && preDur > 0.0;
                            DOUBLE handoffEnd =
                                g_iconPopHandoffEnd.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
                            if (motionElapsed < preDur) {
                                wiping = true;
                                wipeElapsedSec = (FLOAT)motionElapsed;
                            } else if (wantsDCompHandoff && handoffEnd <= 0.0) {
                                if (IconPopFinalHandoffActive(hItem)) {
                                    dcompFinalCountdown = true;
                                } else {
                                    // Commit one exact final DComp frame, then let
                                    // actual static paints drive its eight-frame
                                    // handoff instead of relying on wall-clock time.
                                    wiping = true;
                                    dcompFinalHandoff = true;
                                    wipeElapsedSec = (FLOAT)preDur;
                                }
                            } else if (!skipGenericPop || colorIconActive) {
                                DOUBLE popElapsed = wantsDCompHandoff
                                    ? now - handoffEnd
                                    : motionElapsed - preDur;
                                if (popElapsed >= ICON_POP_DELAY) {
                                    DOUBLE animT = (popElapsed - ICON_POP_DELAY) / ICON_POP_DUR;
                                    if (animT > 1.0) animT = 1.0;
                                    popScale = EaseSpringPop(animT);
                                    popAnimT = (FLOAT)animT;
                                }
                                // Before ICON_POP_DELAY expires, keep the
                                // selected glyph at normal scale.
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    bool inCabinet = IsHostedInCabinetWClass(tv);
                    auto drawNormalStatic = [&] {
                        const wchar_t* normalGlyph = GlyphGetForItem(tv, hItem, false);
                        if (!normalGlyph)
                            normalGlyph = glyph;
                        if (!DrawSvgGlyph(hdc, glyphRect, neutralColor, normalGlyph[0],
                                          false, inCabinet, 1.0f, -1.0f) &&
                            !DrawGlyphDW(hdc, glyphRect, neutralColor, normalGlyph,
                                         iconH, 1.0f)) {
                            DrawGlyphGdiFallback(hdc, glyphRect, neutralColor,
                                                 normalGlyph, iconH);
                        }
                    };
                    bool filledStaticDrawn = false;
                    auto drawFilledStatic = [&] {
                        bool drawn = DrawSvgGlyph(
                            hdc, glyphRect, color, glyph[0], isSelected,
                            inCabinet, 1.0f, -1.0f);
                        if (!drawn)
                            drawn = DrawGlyphDW(hdc, glyphRect, color, glyph,
                                                iconH, 1.0f);
                        if (!drawn)
                            drawn = DrawGlyphGdiFallback(
                                hdc, glyphRect, color, glyph, iconH);
                        filledStaticDrawn = filledStaticDrawn || drawn;
                        return drawn;
                    };
                    // Clear any stale DComp content the instant this item's
                    // paint no longer wants it (wipe ended, item changed,
                    // glyph changed) -- lock-free in the common case (nothing
                    // shown) via g_iconPopDCShownFor. Glyph-agnostic: whatever
                    // was shown for this item gets hidden whenever it's not
                    // actively wiping, regardless of which glyph it was.
                    if (!wiping && !dcompFinalCountdown)
                        IconPopDCompHideIfShown(hItem);
                    bool dcompDrawn = false;
                    const bool useSettledDCompFrame =
                        dcompFinalHandoff && SvgGlyphGeometryAvailable(glyph[0], true);
                    IconPopDrawCoreFn settledDCompFrame;
                    if (useSettledDCompFrame) {
                        settledDCompFrame =
                            [color, glyphCh = glyph[0], inCabinet](
                                ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc,
                                float bx, float by) {
                                DrawSvgGlyphCore(rt, rc, color, glyphCh, true,
                                                 inCabinet, bx, by);
                            };
                    }
                    auto tryDrawDComp = [&](const IconPopDrawCoreFn& drawCore) {
                        dcompDrawn = IconPopTryDrawDComp(
                            tv, hItem, glyphRect,
                            useSettledDCompFrame ? settledDCompFrame : drawCore);
                        return dcompDrawn;
                    };
                    if (colorIconActive) {
                        // preDur was forced to 0 above, so wiping/
                        // dcompFinalHandoff can never be true here -- only the
                        // hold and the generic spring-scale pop apply, and no
                        // DComp helper above is ever invoked for this item.
                        const float scale = initialStaticHold ? 1.0f : popScale;
                        const int scaledW = (std::max)(1, (int)std::lround(colorArtW * scale));
                        const int scaledH = (std::max)(1, (int)std::lround(colorArtH * scale));
                        DrawIconEx(hdc, colorDrawX + (colorArtW - scaledW) / 2,
                                   colorIconY + (colorArtH - scaledH) / 2,
                                   colorIcon, scaledW, scaledH, 0, nullptr, DI_NORMAL);
                        return lr;
                    }
                    if (initialStaticHold) {
                        drawNormalStatic();
                    } else if (dcompFinalHandoff && useSettledDCompFrame) {
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(settledDCompFrame))
                            drawFilledStatic();
                    } else if (wiping && glyph[0] == GLYPH_ONEDRIVE[0]) {
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, wipeElapsedSec, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    DrawOneDriveWipeInCore(rt, rc, color, wipeElapsedSec, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                }))
                            DrawOneDriveWipeIn(hdc, glyphRect, color, wipeElapsedSec, inCabinet);
                    } else if (wiping && glyph[0] == GLYPH_DESKTOP[0]) {
                        if (wipeElapsedSec < (FLOAT)ICON_POP_DESKTOP_FADE_DUR) {
                            FLOAT fadeT = EaseOutCubic(wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_DESKTOP_FADE_DUR);
                            if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                    [color, fadeT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                        DrawCrossfadeSingleCore(rt, rc, color, GLYPH_DESKTOP[0], fadeT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                    }))
                                DrawCrossfadeSingle(hdc, glyphRect, color, GLYPH_DESKTOP[0], fadeT, inCabinet);
                        } else {
                            // Raw linear t -- DrawDesktopBloomRise applies its own
                            // easing to the rise and a separate hold/fade curve.
                            FLOAT bloomT = (wipeElapsedSec - (FLOAT)ICON_POP_DESKTOP_FADE_DUR) /
                                (FLOAT)ICON_POP_DESKTOP_BLOOM_DUR;
                            if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                    [color, bloomT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                        DrawDesktopBloomRiseCore(rt, rc, color, bloomT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                    }))
                                DrawDesktopBloomRise(hdc, glyphRect, color, bloomT, inCabinet);
                        }
                    } else if (wiping && glyph[0] == GLYPH_THISPC[0]) {
                        // Raw linear t -- DrawThisPcCrtOn applies its own two-stage
                        // (horizontal then vertical) expand easing internally.
                        FLOAT crtT = wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_THISPC;
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, crtT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    DrawThisPcCrtOnCore(rt, rc, color, crtT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                }))
                            DrawThisPcCrtOn(hdc, glyphRect, color, crtT, inCabinet);
                    } else if (wiping && glyph[0] == GLYPH_PICTURES[0]) {
                        // Raw linear t -- DrawPicturesSunOrbit applies its own
                        // easing to the sweep and a separate fade curve.
                        FLOAT orbitT = wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_PICTURES;
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, orbitT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    DrawPicturesSunOrbitCore(rt, rc, color, orbitT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                }))
                            DrawPicturesSunOrbit(hdc, glyphRect, color, orbitT, inCabinet);
                    } else if (wiping && (glyph[0] == GLYPH_RECYCLE[0] || glyph[0] == GLYPH_RECYCLE_FULL[0])) {
                        // Raw linear t -- DrawRecycleArrowsReveal applies its own
                        // per-arrow easing/stagger and a separate fade curve.
                        FLOAT revealT = wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_RECYCLE;
                        const char* bodyPath = (glyph[0] == GLYPH_RECYCLE_FULL[0]) ? kSvgRecycleFullBody : kSvgRecycleBody;
                        wchar_t recycleCh = glyph[0];
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, recycleCh, bodyPath, revealT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    DrawRecycleArrowsRevealCore(rt, rc, color, recycleCh, bodyPath, revealT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                }))
                            DrawRecycleArrowsReveal(hdc, glyphRect, color, recycleCh, bodyPath, revealT, inCabinet);
                    } else if (wiping && glyph[0] == GLYPH_PHONE[0]) {
                        FLOAT vibrateT = wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_PHONE;
                        // Try the DComp path first; on lock contention, the
                        // setting being off, or any failure, fall through to
                        // the proven hdc path unchanged.
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, vibrateT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    DrawPhoneVibrateCore(rt, rc, color, vibrateT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                }))
                            DrawPhoneVibrate(hdc, glyphRect, color, vibrateT, inCabinet);
                    } else if (wiping && glyph[0] == GLYPH_DRIVE[0]) {
                        // Raw linear t -- DrawDriveSwirlOn applies its own trace,
                        // blink, and crossfade easing internally.
                        FLOAT swirlT = wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_DRIVE;
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, swirlT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    DrawDriveSwirlOnCore(rt, rc, color, swirlT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                }))
                            DrawDriveSwirlOn(hdc, glyphRect, color, swirlT, inCabinet);
                    } else if (wiping && glyph[0] == GLYPH_CDROM[0]) {
                        // Raw linear t -- DrawCdromFacetSpinIn applies its own
                        // crossfade and facet grow/spin/shrink easing internally.
                        FLOAT facetT = wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_CDROM;
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, facetT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    DrawCdromFacetSpinInCore(rt, rc, color, facetT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                }))
                            DrawCdromFacetSpinIn(hdc, glyphRect, color, facetT, inCabinet);
                    } else if (wiping && glyph[0] == GLYPH_HOME[0]) {
                        // Raw linear t -- DrawHomeDoorFillIn applies its own
                        // shrink, door overshoot, crossfade, and spring easing internally.
                        FLOAT doorT = wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_HOME;
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, doorT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    ID2D1Layer* doorMaskLayer =
                                        HomeDoorDCompMaskLayerEnsureLocked(rt);
                                    DrawHomeDoorFillInCore(rt, rc, color, doorT,
                                                           inCabinet, bx, by,
                                                           doorMaskLayer);
                                }))
                            DrawHomeDoorFillIn(hdc, glyphRect, color, doorT, inCabinet);
                    } else if (wiping && glyph[0] == GLYPH_DOCUMENTS[0]) {
                        // Raw linear t -- DrawDocumentsFoldIn applies its own fold
                        // and crossfade easing internally.
                        FLOAT foldT = wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_DOCUMENTS;
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, foldT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    DrawDocumentsFoldInCore(rt, rc, color, foldT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                }))
                            DrawDocumentsFoldIn(hdc, glyphRect, color, foldT, inCabinet);
                    } else if (wiping && glyph[0] == GLYPH_VIDEOS[0]) {
                        // Raw linear t -- DrawVideosBuildIn applies its own wipe,
                        // spring-pop, and crossfade easing internally.
                        FLOAT buildT = wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_VIDEOS;
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, buildT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    DrawVideosBuildInCore(rt, rc, color, buildT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                }))
                            DrawVideosBuildIn(hdc, glyphRect, color, buildT, inCabinet);
                    } else if (wiping && glyph[0] == GLYPH_GALLERY[0]) {
                        // Raw linear t -- DrawGalleryAssembleIn applies its own
                        // separate/reassemble and crossfade easing internally.
                        FLOAT assembleT = wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_GALLERY;
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, assembleT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    DrawGalleryAssembleInCore(rt, rc, color, assembleT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                }))
                            DrawGalleryAssembleIn(hdc, glyphRect, color, assembleT, inCabinet);
                    } else if (wiping && glyph[0] == GLYPH_LIBRARY[0]) {
                        FLOAT booksT = wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_LIBRARY;
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, booksT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    DrawLibraryBooksInCore(rt, rc, color, booksT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                }))
                            DrawLibraryBooksIn(hdc, glyphRect, color, booksT, inCabinet);
                    } else if (wiping && (glyph[0] == GLYPH_FAVORITES[0] ||
                                           glyph[0] == GLYPH_FAVORITES_FILLED[0])) {
                        FLOAT favT = wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_FAVORITES;
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, favT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    DrawFavoritesPulseFillInCore(rt, rc, color, favT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                }))
                            DrawFavoritesPulseFillIn(hdc, glyphRect, color, favT, inCabinet);
                    } else if (wiping && glyph[0] == GLYPH_PROGFILES[0]) {
                        // Raw linear t -- DrawProgFilesHopIn applies its own hop
                        // and crossfade easing internally.
                        FLOAT hopT = wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_PROGFILES;
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, hopT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    DrawProgFilesHopInCore(rt, rc, color, hopT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                }))
                            DrawProgFilesHopIn(hdc, glyphRect, color, hopT, inCabinet);
                    } else if (wiping && glyph[0] == GLYPH_GOOGLEDRIVE[0]) {
                        // Raw linear t -- DrawGoogleDriveHopIn applies its own
                        // per-facet hop easing internally.
                        FLOAT hopT = wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_GOOGLEDRIVE;
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, hopT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    DrawGoogleDriveHopInCore(rt, rc, color, hopT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                }))
                            DrawGoogleDriveHopIn(hdc, glyphRect, color, hopT, inCabinet);
                    } else if (wiping && glyph[0] == GLYPH_NETWORK[0]) {
                        // Raw linear t -- DrawNetworkScanIn applies its own sweep,
                        // settle-pulse, and crossfade easing internally.
                        FLOAT scanT = wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_NETWORK;
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, scanT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    DrawNetworkScanInCore(rt, rc, color, scanT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                }))
                            DrawNetworkScanIn(hdc, glyphRect, color, scanT, inCabinet);
                    } else if (wiping && glyph[0] == GLYPH_ZIPARCHIVE[0]) {
                        // Raw linear t -- DrawZipUnzipCloseIn applies its own
                        // unzip/rezip and crossfade easing internally.
                        FLOAT zipT = wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_ZIP;
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, zipT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    DrawZipUnzipCloseInCore(rt, rc, color, zipT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                }))
                            DrawZipUnzipCloseIn(hdc, glyphRect, color, zipT, inCabinet);
                    } else if (wiping && glyph[0] == GLYPH_FOLDER[0]) {
                        // Simple crossfade, no scale/rotation -- see DrawCrossfadeSingle.
                        FLOAT fadeT = EaseOutCubic(wipeElapsedSec / (FLOAT)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_FOLDER);
                        if (!tryDrawDComp(
                                [color, fadeT, inCabinet](ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, float bx, float by) {
                                    DrawCrossfadeSingleCore(rt, rc, color, GLYPH_FOLDER[0], fadeT, inCabinet, bx, by);
                                }))
                            DrawCrossfadeSingle(hdc, glyphRect, color, GLYPH_FOLDER[0], fadeT, inCabinet);
                    } else if (popScale == 1.0f && popAnimT < 0.0f) {
                        drawFilledStatic();
                    } else if (!DrawSvgGlyph(hdc, glyphRect, color, glyph[0], isSelected, inCabinet, popScale, popAnimT) &&
                               !DrawGlyphDW(hdc, glyphRect, color, glyph, iconH, popScale)) {
                        DrawGlyphGdiFallback(hdc, glyphRect, color, glyph, iconH);
                    }
                    bool initialHandoff = dcompDrawn && IconPopConsumeStaticHandoff(hItem);
                    if (initialHandoff)
                        drawNormalStatic();
                    if (dcompFinalHandoff) {
                        if (dcompDrawn) {
                            // Frame one: establish the settled Filled glyph below
                            // the exact final composited frame before fading it.
                            if (drawFilledStatic()) {
                                IconPopBeginFinalHandoff(hItem);
                                IconPopAdvanceFinalHandoff(hItem);
                            }
                        } else {
                            IconPopCompleteFinalHandoffWithoutDComp(hItem);
                        }
                    } else if (dcompFinalCountdown && filledStaticDrawn) {
                        IconPopAdvanceFinalHandoff(hItem);
                    }
                }
                return lr;
            }
        }
    }

    [[clang::musttail]] return SendMessageW_orig(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}
static LRESULT CALLBACK PillTreeSubclassProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_TIMER && wp == PillGdiTimerId()) {
        const UINT_PTR transitionId =
            g_pillTimer.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        const PillTransitionSnapshot snap = PillReadTransitionSnapshot();
        if (!transitionId || snap.generation != transitionId ||
            snap.useDComp ||
            g_pillTreeHWND.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != hwnd) {
            KillTimer(hwnd, PillGdiTimerId());
            return 0;
        }

        const DOUBLE elapsed = TimerGetSeconds() - snap.startTime;
        const bool finished = elapsed >=
            snap.holdDuration + PillTransitionDuration(snap);
        if (finished) {
            KillTimer(hwnd, PillGdiTimerId());
            UINT_PTR expected = transitionId;
            if (g_pillTimer.compare_exchange_strong(
                    expected, 0, std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
                PillClearGdiPaintHint(transitionId);
            }
        }
        PillInvalidateGdiItems(hwnd, snap);
        return 0;
    }

    const bool dropDCompEnabled = g_settings.NavPanePill &&
        PillAnimStyle() != 0 &&
        PillDCompAllowedForTree(hwnd);
    HTREEITEM oldDropItem = nullptr;
    HWND previousDropTree = nullptr;
    LPARAM previousDropItem = 0;
    const bool dropTargetMessage = dropDCompEnabled &&
        msg == TVM_SELECTITEM && wp == TVGN_DROPHILITE;
    if (dropTargetMessage) {
        oldDropItem = (HTREEITEM)SendMessageUnhooked(
            hwnd, TVM_GETNEXTITEM, TVGN_DROPHILITE, 0);
        previousDropTree =
            g_dropPillActiveTree.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        previousDropItem =
            g_dropPillActiveItem.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        const HTREEITEM requestedDropItem = (HTREEITEM)lp;
        // Keep the tree as an override marker even for a pending clear; a
        // synchronous paint must not query the still-old native drop item.
        g_dropPillActiveTree.store(hwnd, std::memory_order_release);
        g_dropPillActiveItem.store(
            (LPARAM)requestedDropItem, std::memory_order_release);
    }

    const bool dcompLayoutMessage =
        msg == TVM_EXPAND || msg == TVM_ENSUREVISIBLE || msg == WM_SIZE;
    const bool gdiStructureMessage =
        msg == TVM_INSERTITEMA || msg == TVM_INSERTITEMW ||
        msg == TVM_DELETEITEM || msg == TVM_SORTCHILDREN ||
        msg == TVM_SORTCHILDRENCB;
    const bool gdiMetricsMessage =
        msg == TVM_SETITEMHEIGHT || msg == TVM_SETINDENT;
    const bool dcompScrollMessage =
        msg == WM_VSCROLL || msg == WM_HSCROLL ||
        msg == WM_MOUSEWHEEL || msg == WM_MOUSEHWHEEL || msg == WM_KEYDOWN;
    const bool dcompRelevantMessage =
        msg == WM_PAINT || dcompScrollMessage || dcompLayoutMessage;
    bool isDComp = dcompRelevantMessage && g_settings.NavPanePill &&
        PillDCompAllowedForTree(hwnd) &&
        (g_settings.NavPillStyle == 4 || g_settings.NavPillStyle == 3 ||
         g_settings.NavPillStyle == 2 || g_settings.NavPillStyle == 1);
    bool activeGdiAnimation = false;
    PillTransitionSnapshot activeGdiSnapshot{};
    const UINT_PTR activeTransition =
        g_pillTimer.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (activeTransition &&
        g_pillTreeHWND.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == hwnd) {
        const PillTransitionSnapshot snap = PillReadTransitionSnapshot();
        activeGdiAnimation = snap.generation == activeTransition &&
                             !snap.useDComp;
        if (activeGdiAnimation)
            activeGdiSnapshot = snap;
    }
    const bool tracksPillScroll = dcompScrollMessage &&
        (isDComp || dropDCompEnabled || activeGdiAnimation);

    // Capture scroll position BEFORE original proc (both axes -- a horizontal-
    // only scroll needs the same immediate clear a vertical one gets, or the
    // DComp overlay lags 1+ frames behind during a fast scroll).
    int scrollBeforeV = -1, scrollBeforeH = -1;
    if (tracksPillScroll)
    {
        SCROLLINFO siV{}; siV.cbSize = sizeof(siV); siV.fMask = SIF_POS;
        scrollBeforeV = GetScrollInfo(hwnd, SB_VERT, &siV) ? siV.nPos : -1;
        SCROLLINFO siH{}; siH.cbSize = sizeof(siH); siH.fMask = SIF_POS;
        scrollBeforeH = GetScrollInfo(hwnd, SB_HORZ, &siH) ? siH.nPos : -1;
    }

    HTREEITEM layoutItemBefore = nullptr;
    RECT layoutRectBefore = {};
    bool layoutRectBeforeValid = false;
    const bool trackLayoutChange = dcompLayoutMessage &&
        (activeGdiAnimation ||
         (isDComp &&
          (g_pillTimer.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != 0 ||
           g_pillDCContentAttached.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
           g_pillDCClearPending.load(std::memory_order_acquire) > 0 ||
           g_pillDCClearRequested.load(std::memory_order_acquire))));
    if (trackLayoutChange) {
        layoutItemBefore = (HTREEITEM)SendMessageUnhooked(
            hwnd, TVM_GETNEXTITEM, TVGN_CARET, 0);
        layoutRectBeforeValid = PillItemGetVisibleRect(
            hwnd, layoutItemBefore, &layoutRectBefore);
    }

    const bool trackGdiStructureChange =
        activeGdiAnimation && gdiStructureMessage;
    RECT gdiPrevRectBefore = {};
    RECT gdiCurRectBefore = {};
    bool gdiPrevRectBeforeValid = false;
    bool gdiCurRectBeforeValid = false;
    if (trackGdiStructureChange) {
        gdiPrevRectBeforeValid = PillItemGetVisibleRect(
            hwnd, reinterpret_cast<HTREEITEM>(activeGdiSnapshot.prevItem),
            &gdiPrevRectBefore);
        gdiCurRectBeforeValid = PillItemGetVisibleRect(
            hwnd, reinterpret_cast<HTREEITEM>(activeGdiSnapshot.curItem),
            &gdiCurRectBefore);
    }

    LRESULT r = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);

    if (dropTargetMessage) {
        HTREEITEM newDropItem = (HTREEITEM)SendMessageUnhooked(
            hwnd, TVM_GETNEXTITEM, TVGN_DROPHILITE, 0);
        if (newDropItem != oldDropItem) {
            DropPillTargetChanged(hwnd, oldDropItem, newDropItem);
            if (newDropItem &&
                (g_dropPillActiveTree.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != hwnd ||
                 (HTREEITEM)g_dropPillActiveItem.load(
                     std::memory_order_acquire) != newDropItem)) {
                RECT itemRect = {};
                *reinterpret_cast<HTREEITEM*>(&itemRect) = newDropItem;
                if (SendMessageUnhooked(hwnd, TVM_GETITEMRECT, TRUE,
                                      (LPARAM)&itemRect)) {
                    RECT clientRect = {};
                    if (GetClientRect(hwnd, &clientRect)) {
                        itemRect.left = clientRect.left;
                        itemRect.right = clientRect.right;
                    }
                    InvalidateRect(hwnd, &itemRect, FALSE);
                }
            }
        } else {
            g_dropPillActiveTree.store(
                previousDropTree, std::memory_order_release);
            g_dropPillActiveItem.store(
                previousDropItem, std::memory_order_release);
        }
    }

    if (trackLayoutChange) {
        const HTREEITEM layoutItemAfter = (HTREEITEM)SendMessageUnhooked(
            hwnd, TVM_GETNEXTITEM, TVGN_CARET, 0);
        RECT layoutRectAfter = {};
        const bool layoutRectAfterValid = PillItemGetVisibleRect(
            hwnd, layoutItemAfter, &layoutRectAfter);
        const bool layoutChanged =
            layoutItemAfter != layoutItemBefore ||
            layoutRectAfterValid != layoutRectBeforeValid ||
            (layoutRectAfterValid &&
             !EqualRect(&layoutRectAfter, &layoutRectBefore));
        if (layoutChanged) {
            PillCancelForGeometryChange(hwnd);
            g_pillJustScrolled = true;
            g_pillJustScrolledUp =
                layoutRectBeforeValid && layoutRectAfterValid
                    ? layoutRectAfter.top > layoutRectBefore.top
                    : true;
        }
    }

    if (trackGdiStructureChange) {
        RECT gdiPrevRectAfter = {};
        RECT gdiCurRectAfter = {};
        const bool gdiPrevRectAfterValid = PillItemGetVisibleRect(
            hwnd, reinterpret_cast<HTREEITEM>(activeGdiSnapshot.prevItem),
            &gdiPrevRectAfter);
        const bool gdiCurRectAfterValid = PillItemGetVisibleRect(
            hwnd, reinterpret_cast<HTREEITEM>(activeGdiSnapshot.curItem),
            &gdiCurRectAfter);
        const bool previousChanged =
            gdiPrevRectAfterValid != gdiPrevRectBeforeValid ||
            (gdiPrevRectAfterValid &&
             !EqualRect(&gdiPrevRectAfter, &gdiPrevRectBefore));
        const bool currentChanged =
            gdiCurRectAfterValid != gdiCurRectBeforeValid ||
            (gdiCurRectAfterValid &&
             !EqualRect(&gdiCurRectAfter, &gdiCurRectBefore));
        if ((previousChanged || currentChanged) &&
            PillCancelGdiTransition(
                hwnd, activeTransition, &activeGdiSnapshot)) {
            g_pillJustScrolled = true;
            if (gdiCurRectBeforeValid && gdiCurRectAfterValid) {
                g_pillJustScrolledUp =
                    gdiCurRectAfter.top > gdiCurRectBefore.top;
            } else if (gdiPrevRectBeforeValid && gdiPrevRectAfterValid) {
                g_pillJustScrolledUp =
                    gdiPrevRectAfter.top > gdiPrevRectBefore.top;
            } else {
                g_pillJustScrolledUp = true;
            }
        }
    } else if (activeGdiAnimation && gdiMetricsMessage &&
               PillCancelGdiTransition(
                   hwnd, activeTransition, &activeGdiSnapshot)) {
        // Item height/indent changes invalidate both cached vertical geometry
        // and the nested-item horizontal offset even if the selected handle is
        // unchanged.
        g_pillJustScrolled = true;
        g_pillJustScrolledUp = true;
    }

    if (tracksPillScroll && (scrollBeforeV >= 0 || scrollBeforeH >= 0))
    {
        bool scrolled = false;
        bool scrolledUp = true; // no vertical signal yet -> default to the
                                  // blindKind-3 case (see g_pillJustScrolledUp)
        if (scrollBeforeV >= 0)
        {
            SCROLLINFO si{}; si.cbSize = sizeof(si); si.fMask = SIF_POS;
            if (GetScrollInfo(hwnd, SB_VERT, &si) && si.nPos != scrollBeforeV)
            {
                scrolled = true;
                scrolledUp = (si.nPos < scrollBeforeV); // position decreased = scrolled up
            }
        }
        if (scrollBeforeH >= 0)
        {
            SCROLLINFO si{}; si.cbSize = sizeof(si); si.fMask = SIF_POS;
            if (GetScrollInfo(hwnd, SB_HORZ, &si) && si.nPos != scrollBeforeH) scrolled = true;
        }
        if (scrolled)
        {
            // Scroll detected: DComp surface is at wrong position; clear
            // immediately regardless of what follows below, to avoid a
            // stale/floating pill during the scroll.
            PillCancelForGeometryChange(hwnd);

            // Deliberately not reset on scroll: g_pillCurItem must stay
            // accurate for the trigger site's isSameItem check, or a
            // same-item scroll replays the blind pop-in every time. A second
            // case -- scroll immediately followed by a real selection change
            // with no intermediate repaint -- is handled separately via
            // justScrolled+isSameItem (see below).
            g_pillJustScrolled   = true;
            g_pillJustScrolledUp = scrolledUp;
        }
    }

    if (msg == WM_PAINT && isDComp && !g_pillTimer)
        g_pillTreeRepainted.store(true);

    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY)
    {
        const UINT_PTR transitionId =
            g_pillTimer.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        const PillTransitionSnapshot snap = PillReadTransitionSnapshot();
        KillTimer(hwnd, PillGdiTimerId());
        if (transitionId && snap.generation == transitionId &&
            !snap.useDComp &&
            g_pillTreeHWND.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == hwnd) {
            UINT_PTR expected = transitionId;
            g_pillTimer.compare_exchange_strong(
                expected, 0, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        }
        PillClearGdiPaintHint();
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, PillTreeSubclassProc);
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_pillTreeSubclMutex);
            HWND expected = hwnd;
            if (g_pillTreeSubclHWND.compare_exchange_strong(
                    expected, nullptr, std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
                g_pillTreeSubclContext.store(-1, std::memory_order_release);
            }
        }
        GlyphTreeOwnerCleanup(hwnd);
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_pillDCMutex);
            if (g_pillDC.hwnd == hwnd)
                PillDCompReleaseTarget_Locked();
        }
        PillWakeThread();
    }
    return r;
}


// ============================================================================
// PillAnimStyle / PillTreeContext / PillComputeSleepMs / PillFindTreeView
// ============================================================================

static INT PillAnimStyle()
{
    if (!g_settings.NavPanePill || g_settings.NavPillStyle == 0) return 0;
    return SysAnimationsEnabled() ? g_settings.NavPillStyle : 0;
}


// Returns: 0=no animation, 1=Explorer/ExploreWClass, 2=file picker/dialog
static int PillTreeContextForWindow(HWND tree)
{
    if (!tree || !IsWindow(tree)) return 0;
    HWND root = GetAncestor(tree, GA_ROOT);
    if (!root) return 0;
    wchar_t cls[64] = {};
    GetClassNameW(root, cls, 64);
    if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"CabinetWClass") == 0 || _wcsicmp(cls, L"ExploreWClass") == 0) return 1;
    if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"#32770") == 0 || _wcsicmp(cls, L"NativeHWNDHost") == 0)
    {
        if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"#32770") == 0)
        {
            // Reentrancy guard: this SendMessageW targets the same tree that
            // PillTreeSubclassProc (its only caller chain, via
            // dropDCompEnabled) is subclassing, so it re-enters that exact
            // subclass proc with msg=TVM_GETITEMHEIGHT. Unlike the sibling
            // isDComp check, dropDCompEnabled's call into this function is
            // NOT gated behind a message-type test, so without this guard
            // every single message to a file-picker tree caused unbounded
            // recursion -- an immediate hard freeze on the very first click.
