            // Real Explorer (CabinetWClass/ExploreWClass) never reaches this
            // branch at all, which is why the freeze was picker-only.
            static thread_local bool s_probingItemHeight = false;
            if (s_probingItemHeight) return 2;
            s_probingItemHeight = true;
            UINT  dpi   = GetDpiForWindow(tree);
            INT   itemH = (INT)SendMessageW(tree, TVM_GETITEMHEIGHT, 0, 0);
            s_probingItemHeight = false;
            FLOAT scale = (FLOAT)dpi / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
            if (itemH < (INT)(20.f * scale)) return 0;
        }
        return 2;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int PillTreeContextCached(HWND tree)
{
    if (tree && tree == g_pillTreeSubclHWND.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        const int cached =
            g_pillTreeSubclContext.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (cached >= 0 &&
            tree == g_pillTreeSubclHWND.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            return cached;
    }
    return PillTreeContextForWindow(tree);
}

static bool PillDCompAllowedForTree(HWND hwnd)
{
    return PillTreeContextCached(hwnd) == 1;
}

// Compute adaptive sleep interval for the animation thread (75% of one frame period)
static int PillComputeSleepMs(HWND hwnd)
{
    HMONITOR hMon = hwnd ? MonitorFromWindow(hwnd, MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST)
                         : MonitorFromPoint({0,0}, MONITOR_DEFAULTTOPRIMARY);
    MONITORINFOEXW mi = {}; mi.cbSize = sizeof(mi);
    if (!GetMonitorInfoW(hMon, &mi)) return 4;
    DEVMODEW dm = {}; dm.dmSize = sizeof(dm);
    if (!EnumDisplaySettingsW(mi.szDevice, ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS, &dm) || dm.dmDisplayFrequency < 24) return 4;
    int sleepMs = (int)((1000.0 / dm.dmDisplayFrequency) * 0.75);
    return sleepMs < 2 ? 2 : sleepMs;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK FindTreeViewChildProc(HWND hwnd, LPARAM lParam)
{
    wchar_t cls[64] = {};
    GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, 64);
    if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTreeView32") == 0 && IsWindowVisible(hwnd))
    { *(HWND*)lParam = hwnd; return FALSE; }
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK FindTreeViewEnumProc(HWND hwnd, LPARAM lParam)
{
    wchar_t cls[64] = {};
    GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, 64);
    if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"CabinetWClass")  == 0 || _wcsicmp(cls, L"ExploreWClass")  == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"#32770")         == 0 || _wcsicmp(cls, L"NativeHWNDHost") == 0)
    {
        EnumChildWindows(hwnd, FindTreeViewChildProc, lParam);
        if (*(HWND*)lParam) return FALSE;
    }
    return TRUE;
}

static HWND PillFindTreeView()
{
    HWND found = nullptr;
    EnumThreadWindows(GetCurrentThreadId(), FindTreeViewEnumProc, (LPARAM)&found);
    return found;
}

static bool PillIsUsableTreeItemRect(HWND hwnd, LPCRECT rc)
{
    if (!hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd) || !rc)
        return false;

    int w = rc->right - rc->left;
    int h = rc->bottom - rc->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
        return false;

    UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);
    int minH = MulDiv(10, (int)dpi, 96);
    int maxH = MulDiv(96, (int)dpi, 96);
    if (h < minH || h > maxH)
        return false;

    RECT client = {};
    if (!GetClientRect(hwnd, &client) ||
        client.right <= client.left || client.bottom <= client.top)
        return false;

    if (rc->right <= client.left || rc->left >= client.right)
        return false;

    int slack = std::max(h, MulDiv(8, (int)dpi, 96));
    if (rc->bottom < client.top - slack ||
        rc->top > client.bottom + slack)
        return false;

    return true;
}

// ============================================================================
// Pill animation thread
// Dedicated thread: independent timing, DComp surface updates, no message pump.
// ============================================================================
static HANDLE g_pillThread     = nullptr;
static std::atomic<bool> g_pillThreadStop{false};
static HANDLE g_pillWakeEvent = nullptr;
static std::mutex g_pillThreadStartMutex;

static HANDLE EnsurePillWakeEvent()
{
    if (!g_pillWakeEvent)
        g_pillWakeEvent = CreateEventW(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr);
    return g_pillWakeEvent;
}

static void PillWakeThread()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillThreadStartMutex);
    if (g_pillWakeEvent)
        SetEvent(g_pillWakeEvent);
}

static DWORD WINAPI PillAnimThread(LPVOID)
{
    bool highResActive = false;
    UINT_PTR deferredPreparedGeneration = 0;
    while (!g_pillThreadStop.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
    {
        // Process deferred DComp clear from UI thread (scroll while mutex was busy)
        if (g_pillDCClearRequested.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillDCMutex);
            PillDCompConsumeClearRequestLocked(g_dropPillDC.hwnd);
        }

        UINT_PTR transitionId = g_pillTimer.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (!transitionId)
        {
            if (highResActive) { timeEndPeriod(1); highResActive = false; }

            // Release stale/changed DComp when idle
            {
                HWND tree = g_pillTreeHWND.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillDCMutex);
                bool stale = g_pillDC.valid && !IsWindow(g_pillDC.hwnd);
                bool changed = g_pillDC.valid && tree && g_pillDC.hwnd != tree;
                // Only the window's target and visuals: the device stays
                // for the next tree (the prewarm), and device loss still
                // releases everything from the draw/commit failure paths.
                if (stale || changed)
                {
                    PillDCompReleaseTarget_Locked();
                    g_pillLastValid = false;
                }
            }
            // Every producer (transition, deferred clear, tree destroy,
            // unload) signals the event; only the no-event fallback polls.
            HANDLE wakeEvent = g_pillWakeEvent;
            if (wakeEvent) WaitForSingleObject(wakeEvent, INFINITE);
            else Sleep(200);
            continue;
        }
        HWND tree = g_pillTreeHWND.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (!tree || !IsWindow(tree))
        {
            g_pillTreeHWND.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
            UINT_PTR expected = transitionId;
            g_pillTimer.compare_exchange_strong(
                expected, 0, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            continue;
        }

        PillTransitionSnapshot snap = PillReadTransitionSnapshot();
        if (snap.generation != transitionId)
            continue;
        if (!highResActive) {
            timeBeginPeriod(1);
            highResActive = true;
        }

        // winui_top keeps the configured total timeline; the structural
        // hold is subtracted from the moving portion.
        DOUBLE totalDur = PillTransitionDuration(snap);
        DOUBLE elapsed = TimerGetSeconds() - snap.startTime;
        const bool needsDeferredPreRender = snap.useDComp &&
            snap.deferDCompPreparation &&
            deferredPreparedGeneration != transitionId;
        if (!needsDeferredPreRender && snap.holdDuration > 0.0 &&
            elapsed < snap.holdDuration)
        {
            DWORD waitMs = (DWORD)std::max(1.0,
                ceil((snap.holdDuration - elapsed) * 1000.0));
            HANDLE wakeEvent = g_pillWakeEvent;
            if (wakeEvent) WaitForSingleObject(wakeEvent, waitMs);
            else Sleep(waitMs);
            continue;
        }

        DOUBLE motionElapsed = elapsed - snap.holdDuration;
        DOUBLE animT = motionElapsed / totalDur;
        if (animT < 0.0) animT = 0.0;
        bool finished = (animT >= 1.0);
        if (animT > 1.0) animT = 1.0;
        if (needsDeferredPreRender) {
            // Mutex contention must not consume the structural hold or the
            // first motion frame. An open-only blind has zero visible area at
            // exactly t=0, so match the UI-thread pre-render's first sample.
            animT = snap.style == 4 &&
                (snap.blindKind == 3 || snap.blindKind == 4)
                    ? 0.001
                    : 0.0;
            finished = false;
        }

        // winui_top draws source and destination with their own indents. The
        // scalar indent remains the destination value for the other styles.
        int nestIndentPxNow = 0;
        float vTop = 0.0f, vBottom = 0.0f;
        if (!PillComputeTransitionFrame(snap, animT, finished, &vTop, &vBottom, &nestIndentPxNow))
        {
            UINT_PTR expected = transitionId;
            g_pillTimer.compare_exchange_strong(
                expected, 0, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            continue;
        }

        if (!snap.useDComp)
        {
            // GDI transitions are driven by the TreeView's own UI-thread
            // timer. If a worker already exists from an earlier Explorer
            // animation, park it without touching the shared generation;
            // the next DComp activation or unload will signal the event.
            if (highResActive) {
                timeEndPeriod(1);
                highResActive = false;
            }
            HANDLE wakeEvent = g_pillWakeEvent;
            if (wakeEvent)
                WaitForSingleObject(wakeEvent, INFINITE);
            else
                Sleep(kPillGdiTimerIntervalMs);
            continue;
        }
        else if (snap.style == 4 || snap.style == 3 || snap.style == 2 ||
                 snap.style == 1)
        {
            bool dcompAvailable = true;
            bool frameCommitted = false;
            // try_lock: don't block animation thread if UI thread holds mutex
            // Skipped frame is compensated by next frame's interpolation
            if (!g_pillDCMutex.try_lock())
            {
                HANDLE wakeEvent = g_pillWakeEvent;
                if (wakeEvent) WaitForSingleObject(wakeEvent, 1);
                else Sleep(1);
                continue;
            }
            if (g_pillTimer.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != transitionId)
            {
                PillDCompConsumeClearRequestLocked(tree);
                g_pillDCMutex.unlock();
                continue;
            }
            // Also rebinds when the target tree changed (another tab's
            // pane): PillDCompInit_Locked swaps the DComp target itself.
            if (!g_pillDC.valid || g_pillDC.hwnd != tree)
            {
                PillDCompInit_Locked(tree);
                g_pillLastValid = false;
            }
            if (g_pillDC.valid)
            {
                if (snap.style == 2) // fade: opacity only; geometry swaps at zero
                {
                    if (!finished) {
                        bool drawOk = PillDCompEnsureFadeVisual_Locked();
                        int fadePhase = animT < PILL_FADE_SPLIT ? 0 : 1;
                        if (drawOk &&
                            (g_pillDC.fadePhase != fadePhase || !g_pillLastValid))
                        {
                            drawOk = PillDCompDrawFrame_Locked(
                                vTop, vBottom,
                                g_pillLastVTop, g_pillLastVBot,
                                g_pillLastValid, snap.scale, (float)animT,
                                false, false, nestIndentPxNow,
                                snap, snap.useGradient, true);
                            if (drawOk) {
                                g_pillLastVTop = vTop;
                                g_pillLastVBot = vBottom;
                                g_pillLastValid = true;
                                g_pillDC.fadePhase = fadePhase;
                                frameCommitted = true;
                            }
                        }
                        if (drawOk)
                            PillDCompSetFadeOpacity_Locked(
                                PillFadeOpacity(animT));
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    // Skip the final intermediate draw when finished: the if(finished)
                    // block below draws without item-clip (rounded caps preserved).
                    // Drawing here AND in if(finished) causes two DComp Commits —
                    // the DWM may present the first (clipped, no rounding) before
                    // the second (rounded) arrives, causing a visible flash.
                    if (!finished)
                    {
                        bool drawOk = PillDCompDrawFrame_Locked(vTop, vBottom,
                            g_pillLastVTop, g_pillLastVBot, g_pillLastValid,
                            snap.scale, (float)animT, false, !snap.noClip, nestIndentPxNow,
                            snap, snap.useGradient, false);
                        if (drawOk) {
                            g_pillLastVTop = vTop;
                            g_pillLastVBot = vBottom;
                            g_pillLastValid = true;
                            frameCommitted = true;
                        }
                    }
                    // When finished: let if(finished) below draw the clean final frame
                }
            }
            else
            {
                dcompAvailable = false;
            }
            // A geometry change can cancel this transition while D2D is
            // finishing the frame. Detach that just-rendered stale content
            // before releasing the mutex instead of showing it for a cycle.
            PillDCompConsumeClearRequestLocked(tree);
            if (needsDeferredPreRender &&
                !g_pillDCContentAttached.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
                frameCommitted = false;
            }
            g_pillDCMutex.unlock();
            if (!dcompAvailable) {
                UINT_PTR expected = transitionId;
                g_pillTimer.compare_exchange_strong(
                    expected, 0, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
                if (IsWindow(tree))
                    InvalidateRect(tree, nullptr, FALSE);
                continue;
            }
            if (needsDeferredPreRender) {
                if (!frameCommitted) {
                    HANDLE wakeEvent = g_pillWakeEvent;
                    if (wakeEvent)
                        WaitForSingleObject(wakeEvent, 1);
                    else
                        Sleep(1);
                    continue;
                }

                const DOUBLE restartTime = TimerGetSeconds();
                if (!PillRestartTransitionClock(transitionId, restartTime))
                    continue;
                snap.startTime = restartTime;
                deferredPreparedGeneration = transitionId;
                elapsed = 0.0;
                finished = false;
            }
        }

        if (finished)
        {
            bool finalFrameReady = true;
            bool dcompFinalCommitted = false;
            if (snap.useDComp && snap.style == 2)
            {
                float h = (float)snap.itemH;
                float halfPad = NavPillHalfPad(h, snap.scale);
                float finalTop = (float)snap.curTop + halfPad;
                float finalBot = (float)snap.curTop + h - halfPad;
                {
                    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillDCMutex);
                    PillDCompConsumeClearRequestLocked(tree);
                    if (g_pillTimer.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != transitionId)
                        continue;
                    if (g_pillDC.valid &&
                        PillDCompEnsureFadeVisual_Locked()) {
                        finalFrameReady = PillDCompDrawFrame_Locked(
                            finalTop, finalBot,
                            g_pillLastVTop, g_pillLastVBot,
                            g_pillLastValid, snap.scale, 1.0f,
                            false, false, snap.curIndentPx,
                            snap, snap.useGradient, true);
                        if (finalFrameReady)
                            finalFrameReady =
                                PillDCompSetFadeOpacity_Locked(1.0f);
                        if (finalFrameReady) {
                            g_pillLastVTop = finalTop;
                            g_pillLastVBot = finalBot;
                            g_pillLastValid = false;
                            g_pillDC.fadePhase = 1;
                            dcompFinalCommitted = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            else if (snap.useDComp &&
                     (snap.style == 4 || snap.style == 3 || snap.style == 1))
            {
                float h       = (float)snap.itemH;
                float halfPad = NavPillHalfPad(h, snap.scale);
                float finalTop = (float)snap.curTop + halfPad;
                float finalBot = (float)snap.curTop + h - halfPad;
                {
                    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillDCMutex);
                    PillDCompConsumeClearRequestLocked(tree);
                    if (g_pillTimer.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != transitionId)
                        continue;
                    if (g_pillDC.valid) {
                        finalFrameReady = PillDCompDrawFrame_Locked(finalTop, finalBot,
                            g_pillLastVTop, g_pillLastVBot, g_pillLastValid,
                            snap.scale, 1.0f, false, false, snap.curIndentPx,
                            snap, snap.useGradient, false);
                        if (finalFrameReady) {
                            g_pillLastVTop = finalTop;
                            g_pillLastVBot = finalBot;
                            g_pillLastValid = false;
                            dcompFinalCommitted = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!finalFrameReady) {
                HANDLE wakeEvent = g_pillWakeEvent;
                if (snap.useDComp && WaitForCompositorFrame(wakeEvent, 100))
                    continue;
                int sleepMs = g_pillSleepMs.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
                if (wakeEvent) WaitForSingleObject(wakeEvent, sleepMs);
                else Sleep(sleepMs);
                continue;
            }

            UINT_PTR expected = transitionId;
            if (!g_pillTimer.compare_exchange_strong(
                    expected, 0, std::memory_order_acq_rel))
                continue;

            if (dcompFinalCommitted) {
                // DComp holds the confirmed final frame while GDI paints below.
                g_pillDCClearPending.store(8, std::memory_order_release);
                if (IsWindow(tree))
                    InvalidateRect(tree, nullptr, FALSE);
            }
        }

        // DComp frames follow the compositor clock where it exists, so each
        // composition gets exactly one new frame.
        HANDLE wakeEvent = g_pillWakeEvent;
        if (snap.useDComp && WaitForCompositorFrame(wakeEvent, 100))
            continue;
        if (wakeEvent) WaitForSingleObject(wakeEvent, g_pillSleepMs);
        else Sleep(g_pillSleepMs);
    }

    if (highResActive) timeEndPeriod(1);
    return 0;
}

// Guards the lazy/first-use thread creation below: without this, two UI
// threads each hosting their own nav pane in a non-Explorer process (e.g.
// two file-picker dialogs on separate threads) could both observe
// g_pillThread == nullptr and each CreateThread, leaking a handle and
// running two animators against the single g_pillDC.
static void PillEnsureThreadStarted()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillThreadStartMutex);
    if (g_pillUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return;
    if (!g_pillThread) {
        g_pillThreadStop.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        EnsurePillWakeEvent();
        g_pillThread = CreateThread(nullptr, 0, PillAnimThread, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
    }
}

static bool PillActivateTransition(UINT_PTR generation)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillThreadStartMutex);
    if (!generation || g_pillUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !g_pillThread)
        return false;

    g_pillTimer.store(generation, std::memory_order_release);
    if (g_pillWakeEvent)
        SetEvent(g_pillWakeEvent);
    return true;
}

static bool PillActivateGdiTransition(HWND tree, UINT_PTR generation)
{
    const PillTransitionSnapshot snap = PillReadTransitionSnapshot();
    if (!tree || !generation ||
        g_pillTreeSubclHWND.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != tree ||
        g_pillUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        snap.generation != generation || snap.useDComp) {
        if (tree && snap.generation == generation && !snap.useDComp)
            PillInvalidateGdiItems(tree, snap);
        return false;
    }

    PillPublishGdiPaintHint(generation, snap.prevItem);
    g_pillTimer.store(generation, std::memory_order_release);
    if (!SetTimer(
            tree, PillGdiTimerId(), kPillGdiTimerIntervalMs, nullptr)) {
        UINT_PTR expected = generation;
        g_pillTimer.compare_exchange_strong(
            expected, 0, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        PillClearGdiPaintHint(generation);
        PillInvalidateGdiItems(tree, snap);
        return false;
    }

    PillInvalidateGdiItems(tree, snap);
    return true;
}
// ============================================================================
// Cached render target accessors (cheap BindDC vs per-call CreateDCRenderTarget)
// ============================================================================

static ID2D1DCRenderTarget* PillGetCachedRT(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    D2DThreadCache* cache = D2DGetThreadCache();
    if (!cache)
        return nullptr;
    if (!cache->pillRT && g_d2dFactory)
    {
        FPUGuard fpu;
        D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_PROPERTIES rtP = D2D1::RenderTargetProperties(
            D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_TYPE_SOFTWARE,
            D2D1::PixelFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED),
            0, 0, D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_USAGE_GDI_COMPATIBLE, D2D1_FEATURE_LEVEL_DEFAULT);
        if (FAILED(g_d2dFactory->CreateDCRenderTarget(&rtP, &cache->pillRT)))
            cache->pillRT = nullptr;
    }
    if (cache->pillRT && FAILED(cache->pillRT->BindDC(hdc, pRect))) return nullptr;
    return cache->pillRT;
}

static void PillGdiFadeCacheClearLocked()
{
    if (g_pillGdiFadeCache.dc && g_pillGdiFadeCache.oldBitmap)
        SelectObject(g_pillGdiFadeCache.dc, g_pillGdiFadeCache.oldBitmap);
    if (g_pillGdiFadeCache.bitmap)
        DeleteObject(g_pillGdiFadeCache.bitmap);
    if (g_pillGdiFadeCache.dc)
        DeleteDC(g_pillGdiFadeCache.dc);
    g_pillGdiFadeCache = {};
}

static void PillGdiFadeCacheClear()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillGdiFadeCacheMutex);
    PillGdiFadeCacheClearLocked();
}

static bool PillGdiFadeCacheEnsureLocked(HDC hdc, float scale, int itemH,
                                         bool gradient)
{
    if (!hdc || itemH <= 0 || !EnsureD2DFactory())
        return false;

    const int dpi = std::max(1, (int)lroundf(scale * USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI));
    const COLORREF indicatorColor = GetAccentIndicator();
    const COLORREF baseColor = gradient ? GetCachedAccentBase() : CLR_INVALID;
    const float pillW = NavPillWidth(scale);
    const float pillH = NavPillHeight(scale);
    const float fracX = NAV_PILL_X_DIP * scale;
    const float halfPad = NavPillHalfPad((float)itemH, scale);
    const float fracY = halfPad - floorf(halfPad);
    constexpr float bitmapPad = 1.0f;
    const int width = std::max(1,
        (int)ceilf(bitmapPad + fracX + pillW) + 1);
    const int height = std::max(1,
        (int)ceilf(bitmapPad + fracY + pillH) + 1);

    if (g_pillGdiFadeCache.dc &&
        g_pillGdiFadeCache.width == width &&
        g_pillGdiFadeCache.height == height &&
        g_pillGdiFadeCache.dpi == dpi &&
        g_pillGdiFadeCache.itemH == itemH &&
        g_pillGdiFadeCache.gradient == gradient &&
        g_pillGdiFadeCache.baseColor == baseColor &&
        g_pillGdiFadeCache.indicatorColor == indicatorColor)
    {
        return true;
    }

    PillGdiFadeCacheClearLocked();

    HDC memDC = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
    if (!memDC)
        return false;

    BITMAPINFO bi = {};
    bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = width;
    bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -height;
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

    void* bits = nullptr;
    HBITMAP bitmap = CreateDIBSection(
        memDC, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
    if (!bitmap || !bits) {
        if (bitmap)
            DeleteObject(bitmap);
        DeleteDC(memDC);
        return false;
    }

    HGDIOBJ oldBitmap = SelectObject(memDC, bitmap);
    if (!oldBitmap || oldBitmap == HGDI_ERROR) {
        DeleteObject(bitmap);
        DeleteDC(memDC);
        return false;
    }
    ZeroMemory(bits, (SIZE_T)width * height * 4);

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_PROPERTIES rtProps = D2D1::RenderTargetProperties(
        D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_TYPE_SOFTWARE,
        D2D1::PixelFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM,
                          D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED),
        96.0f, 96.0f, D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_USAGE_GDI_COMPATIBLE,
        D2D1_FEATURE_LEVEL_DEFAULT);
    HRESULT hr = g_d2dFactory->CreateDCRenderTarget(&rtProps, &rt);
    RECT bitmapRect = {0, 0, width, height};
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr))
        hr = rt->BindDC(memDC, &bitmapRect);

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1Brush> brush;
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && gradient) {
        D2D1_GRADIENT_STOP stops[2] = {
            {0.0f, D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(baseColor) / 255.0f,
                                GetGValue(baseColor) / 255.0f,
                                GetBValue(baseColor) / 255.0f)},
            {1.0f, D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(indicatorColor) / 255.0f,
                                GetGValue(indicatorColor) / 255.0f,
                                GetBValue(indicatorColor) / 255.0f)}
        };
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GradientStopCollection> stopCollection;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1LinearGradientBrush> gradientBrush;
        hr = rt->CreateGradientStopCollection(
            stops, ARRAYSIZE(stops), &stopCollection);
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) {
            const float left = bitmapPad + fracX;
            const float top = bitmapPad + fracY;
            hr = rt->CreateLinearGradientBrush(
                D2D1::LinearGradientBrushProperties(
                    D2D1::Point2F(left, top + pillH),
                    D2D1::Point2F(left, top)),
                stopCollection.Get(), &gradientBrush);
        }
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr))
            brush = gradientBrush;
    } else if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) {
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> solidBrush;
        hr = rt->CreateSolidColorBrush(
            D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(indicatorColor) / 255.0f,
                         GetGValue(indicatorColor) / 255.0f,
                         GetBValue(indicatorColor) / 255.0f),
            &solidBrush);
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr))
            brush = solidBrush;
    }

    if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && brush) {
        const float left = bitmapPad + fracX;
        const float top = bitmapPad + fracY;
        const D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE previousAntialias =
            rt->GetAntialiasMode();
        rt->BeginDraw();
        rt->SetAntialiasMode(D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_PER_PRIMITIVE);
        rt->Clear(D2D1::ColorF(0, 0, 0, 0));
        rt->FillRoundedRectangle(
            D2D1::RoundedRect(
                D2D1::RectF(left, top, left + pillW, top + pillH),
                NavPillRadius(scale, pillW),
                NavPillRadius(scale, pillW)),
            brush.Get());
        rt->SetAntialiasMode(previousAntialias);
        hr = rt->EndDraw();
    }

    if (FAILED(hr) || !brush) {
        SelectObject(memDC, oldBitmap);
        DeleteObject(bitmap);
        DeleteDC(memDC);
        return false;
    }

    g_pillGdiFadeCache.dc = memDC;
    g_pillGdiFadeCache.bitmap = bitmap;
    g_pillGdiFadeCache.oldBitmap = oldBitmap;
    g_pillGdiFadeCache.width = width;
    g_pillGdiFadeCache.height = height;
    g_pillGdiFadeCache.dpi = dpi;
    g_pillGdiFadeCache.itemH = itemH;
    g_pillGdiFadeCache.gradient = gradient;
    g_pillGdiFadeCache.baseColor = baseColor;
    g_pillGdiFadeCache.indicatorColor = indicatorColor;
    return true;
}

static bool PillDrawGdiFade(HDC hdc, float itemTop, float scale, int itemH,
                            int indentPx, bool gradient, float opacity)
{
    opacity = std::clamp(opacity, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    if (opacity <= 0.0f)
        return true;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillGdiFadeCacheMutex);
    if (!PillGdiFadeCacheEnsureLocked(hdc, scale, itemH, gradient))
        return false;

    const float pillX = NAV_PILL_X_DIP * scale + (float)indentPx;
    const float halfPad = NavPillHalfPad((float)itemH, scale);
    const int dstX = (int)floorf(pillX) - 1;
    const int dstY = (int)floorf(itemTop + halfPad) - 1;
    BLENDFUNCTION blend = {
        AC_SRC_OVER, 0, (BYTE)lroundf(opacity * 255.0f), AC_SRC_ALPHA
    };
    return !!AlphaBlend(
        hdc, dstX, dstY,
        g_pillGdiFadeCache.width, g_pillGdiFadeCache.height,
        g_pillGdiFadeCache.dc, 0, 0,
        g_pillGdiFadeCache.width, g_pillGdiFadeCache.height, blend);
}

// Draw one item-owned half of the WinUI selection-indicator transition. The
// cached bitmap keeps the same antialiased shape/gradient as the resting GDI
// pill; AlphaBlend scales it vertically to the sampled outgoing/incoming
// bounds, while the item's existing paint clip prevents either half from
// escaping its own TreeView row.
static bool PillDrawGdiAnimatedPart(HDC hdc, LPCRECT itemRect, float scale,
                                    int itemH,
                                    const PillNativeMotionPart& part,
                                    bool gradient)
{
    if (!hdc || !itemRect || !part.valid || part.opacity <= 0.001f)
        return true;

    const float nominalHeight = NavPillHeight(scale);
    const float partHeight = part.bottom - part.top;
    if (nominalHeight <= 0.0f || partHeight <= 0.001f)
        return true;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillGdiFadeCacheMutex);
    if (!PillGdiFadeCacheEnsureLocked(hdc, scale, itemH, gradient))
        return false;

    const float pillX = NAV_PILL_X_DIP * scale +
        static_cast<float>(part.indentPx);
    const int dstX = static_cast<int>(floorf(pillX)) - 1;
    const int dstY = static_cast<int>(floorf(part.top)) - 1;
    const int dstHeight = (std::max)(1, static_cast<int>(lroundf(
        static_cast<float>(g_pillGdiFadeCache.height) *
        partHeight / nominalHeight)));
    const int saved = SaveDC(hdc);
    if (!saved)
        return false;
    IntersectClipRect(hdc, itemRect->left, itemRect->top,
                     itemRect->right, itemRect->bottom);

    const BLENDFUNCTION blend = {
        AC_SRC_OVER, 0,
        static_cast<BYTE>(lroundf(std::clamp(part.opacity, 0.0f, 1.0f) *
                                  255.0f)),
        AC_SRC_ALPHA
    };
    const bool drawn = !!AlphaBlend(
        hdc, dstX, dstY,
        g_pillGdiFadeCache.width, dstHeight,
        g_pillGdiFadeCache.dc, 0, 0,
        g_pillGdiFadeCache.width, g_pillGdiFadeCache.height, blend);

    RestoreDC(hdc, saved);
    return drawn;
}

// TreeView paints an unselected row in more than one themed step, so drawing
// the outgoing pill from DrawThemeBackground can be covered later in the same
// item pass. Paint it once, after the item's native/custom content is complete.
// The normal selected-row path remains unchanged and owns the incoming half.
static void PillDrawGdiOutgoingItem(
    HWND tree, HTREEITEM item, HDC hdc, LPCRECT itemRect)
{
    if (!tree || !item || !hdc || !itemRect ||
        !g_settings.NavPanePill) {
        return;
    }

    const UINT_PTR transitionId =
        g_pillTimer.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (!transitionId ||
        g_pillTreeHWND.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != tree) {
        return;
    }

    if (g_pillGdiPaintGeneration.load(std::memory_order_acquire) !=
            transitionId ||
        g_pillGdiPaintPreviousItem.load(std::memory_order_acquire) !=
            reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(item)) {
        return;
    }

    const PillTransitionSnapshot snap = PillReadTransitionSnapshot();
    if (snap.generation != transitionId || snap.useDComp ||
        snap.prevItem != reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(item) ||
        snap.prevItem == snap.curItem) {
        return;
    }

    if (itemRect->top != snap.prevTop ||
        itemRect->bottom - itemRect->top != snap.itemH) {
        return;
    }

    const DOUBLE totalDuration = PillTransitionDuration(snap);
    const DOUBLE motionElapsed = TimerGetSeconds() -
        snap.startTime - snap.holdDuration;
    const DOUBLE animT = std::clamp(
        motionElapsed / totalDuration, 0.0, 1.0);
    PillNativeMotionPart outgoing{};

    if (snap.style == 1 || snap.style == 4) {
        PillNativeMotionFrame frame{};
        const bool valid = snap.style == 1
            ? PillComputeListViewExpandFrame(snap, animT, true, &frame)
            : PillComputeNativeMotionFrame(snap, animT, true, &frame);
        if (valid)
            outgoing = frame.outgoing;
    } else if (snap.style == 2) {
        const float halfPad = NavPillHalfPad(
            static_cast<float>(snap.itemH), snap.scale);
        outgoing.valid = true;
        outgoing.top = static_cast<float>(snap.prevTop) + halfPad;
        outgoing.bottom = static_cast<float>(snap.prevTop + snap.itemH) -
            halfPad;
        outgoing.clipTop = static_cast<float>(snap.prevTop);
        outgoing.clipBottom = static_cast<float>(snap.prevTop + snap.itemH);
        outgoing.indentPx = snap.prevIndentPx;
        outgoing.opacity = 1.0f - EaseInOutCubic(animT);
    } else if (snap.style == 3) {
        int indentPx = 0;
        if (PillComputeTransitionFrame(
                snap, animT, false, &outgoing.top, &outgoing.bottom,
                &indentPx)) {
            outgoing.valid = true;
            outgoing.clipTop = static_cast<float>(snap.prevTop);
            outgoing.clipBottom = static_cast<float>(
                snap.prevTop + snap.itemH);
            outgoing.indentPx = indentPx;
            outgoing.opacity = 1.0f;
        }
    }

    if (outgoing.valid) {
        PillDrawGdiAnimatedPart(
            hdc, itemRect, snap.scale, snap.itemH, outgoing,
            snap.useGradient);
    }
}

static ID2D1DCRenderTarget* GlyphGetCachedRT(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    D2DThreadCache* cache = D2DGetThreadCache();
    if (!cache)
        return nullptr;
    if (!cache->glyphRT && g_d2dFactory)
    {
        FPUGuard fpu;
        D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_PROPERTIES rtP = D2D1::RenderTargetProperties(
            D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_TYPE_SOFTWARE,
            D2D1::PixelFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED),
            0, 0, D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_USAGE_GDI_COMPATIBLE, D2D1_FEATURE_LEVEL_DEFAULT);
        if (FAILED(g_d2dFactory->CreateDCRenderTarget(&rtP, &cache->glyphRT)))
            cache->glyphRT = nullptr;
        // Icon-font glyphs render grayscale, as in WinUI; on this
        // premultiplied target that is also what the default resolves to.
        else
            cache->glyphRT->SetTextAntialiasMode(D2D1_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_MODE_GRAYSCALE);
    }
    if (cache->glyphRT && FAILED(cache->glyphRT->BindDC(hdc, pRect))) return nullptr;
    return cache->glyphRT;
}

// ============================================================================
// DrawChevronGlyph: draws an animated expand/collapse chevron
// ============================================================================

// Defined near the other DirectWrite glyph-icon rendering machinery, far
// below this point in the file; forward-declared so the chevron paint
// functions (this one, the group-header chevron, and regedit's own TreeView
// chevron) can all reuse the same cached IDWriteTextFormat + 3-tier icon-font
// fallback (Segoe Fluent Icons -> Segoe MDL2 Assets -> Segoe UI Symbol)
// instead of standing up separate ones.
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> GlyphDWFormatEnsure(int size);

// Chevron glyphs and DIP sizes as WinUI's own templates pick them
// (microsoft-ui-xaml): TreeViewItem E76C collapsed / E70D expanded at 8
// (TreeView.idl GlyphSize) -- a touch larger here for the Win32 tree's
// taller rows; SplitButton and DropDownButton E96E at 8
// (SplitButton.xaml, DropDownButton.xaml); BreadcrumbBar E974 at 12
// (BreadcrumbBar_themeresources.xaml); ComboBox E70D at 12
// (ComboBox_themeresources.xaml) -- a touch smaller here, on a Win32
// button that is narrower than WinUI's. Group headers have no WinUI
// counterpart: the DropDownButton glyph, scaled with their larger text.
static constexpr const wchar_t* kChevronGlyphRight      = L"";
static constexpr const wchar_t* kChevronGlyphDown       = L"";
static constexpr const wchar_t* kChevronGlyphRightSmall = L"";
static constexpr const wchar_t* kChevronGlyphDownSmall  = L"";
static constexpr const wchar_t* kChevronGlyphRightMed   = L"";
static constexpr int kTreeViewChevronGlyphDip = 9;
static constexpr int kDropDownChevronGlyphDip = 8;
static constexpr int kGroupHeaderChevronGlyphDip = 10;
// Explorer's WinUI Home headers (HomeItemPresenter, read live): the
// expander is a CheckBox styled as a 16px Segoe Fluent chevron in
// TextFillColorSecondary, the name 14px SemiBold in TextFillColorPrimary,
// and the whole header content takes SubtleFillColorSecondary on hover.
static constexpr int kExplorerGroupHeaderChevronGlyphDip = 14;
static constexpr int kBreadcrumbChevronGlyphDip = 12;
static constexpr int kComboChevronGlyphDip = 10;

// One icon-font glyph rendered through DirectWrite into a premultiplied
// 32bpp DIB the size of the part and composed onto the DC with AlphaBlend
// (same reason as PaintAlphaSceneGdip: a Mica or solid pane surface keeps
// its alpha). offsetY moves the glyph within the part.
static bool DrawGlyphDWAlpha(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, D2D1_COLOR_F color,
    const wchar_t* glyph, int fontSizePx, float offsetY)
{
    if (!hdc || !glyph || !*glyph || !g_d2dFactory)
        return false;
    const int w = rc.right - rc.left;
    const int h = rc.bottom - rc.top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
        return false;
    auto fmt = GlyphDWFormatEnsure(fontSizePx);
    if (!fmt)
        return false;

    BITMAPINFO bi = {};
    bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(bi.bmiHeader);
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = w;
    bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -h;
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;
    void* bits = nullptr;
    HBITMAP dib = CreateDIBSection(nullptr, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
    if (!dib)
        return false;
    HDC mem = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
    if (!mem) {
        DeleteObject(dib);
        return false;
    }
    HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(mem, dib);
    bool drawn = false;
    {
        FPUGuard fpu;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
        const RECT full = { 0, 0, w, h };
        if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(mem, &full, g_d2dFactory, &rt))) {
            rt->BeginDraw();
            if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt.Get(), color)) {
                rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(0.f, offsetY));
                rt->DrawTextW(glyph, (UINT32)wcslen(glyph), fmt.Get(),
                    D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f, (float)w, (float)h), brush);
                rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
            }
            const HRESULT hr = rt->EndDraw();
            if (hr == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                rt.Reset();
                CachedTlsRTRecreate();
            }
            drawn = SUCCEEDED(hr);
        }
    }
    if (drawn) {
        const BLENDFUNCTION bf = { AC_SRC_OVER, 0, 255, AC_SRC_ALPHA };
        drawn = AlphaBlend(hdc, rc.left, rc.top, w, h, mem, 0, 0, w, h, bf) != FALSE;
    }
    SelectObject(mem, old);
    DeleteDC(mem);
    DeleteObject(dib);
    return drawn;
}

// Draws one icon-font glyph onto an already-BeginDraw'd render target,
// centered on (cx,cy) -- not necessarily the cell's own geometric center --
// and optionally rotated about that same point. Reuses the caller's render
// target/brush instead of standing up its own (unlike DrawGlyphDW) since
// the chevron functions already have both bound for the hover-highlight
// fill. Returns false -- nothing drawn -- if no icon font is installed at
// all; callers must fall back to a hand-drawn shape.
static bool DrawChevronGlyphOnRT(ID2D1RenderTarget* pRT, const wchar_t* glyph,
    float fw, float fh, float cx, float cy, float angleDeg,
    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush, int fontSizePx)
{
    auto fmt = GlyphDWFormatEnsure(fontSizePx);
    if (!fmt)
        return false;
    if (angleDeg != 0.f)
        pRT->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Rotation(angleDeg, D2D1::Point2F(cx, cy)));
    // Centered on (cx,cy) rather than the fixed [0,0,fw,fh]: with cx==fw/2
    // and cy==fh/2 this is identical to centering on the cell, but it also
    // lets a caller-supplied cy offset actually move the glyph, instead of
    // (cx,cy) only ever acting as a rotation pivot at rest.
    const float halfW = fw * 0.5f, halfH = fh * 0.5f;
    pRT->DrawTextW(glyph, (UINT32)wcslen(glyph), fmt.Get(),
        D2D1::RectF(cx - halfW, cy - halfH, cx + halfW, cy + halfH), brush);
    if (angleDeg != 0.f)
        pRT->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
    return true;
}

static void DrawChevronGlyph(ID2D1RenderTarget* pRT, FLOAT w, FLOAT h,
                              INT iPartId, INT iStateId, FLOAT scale, bool dark,
                              bool pressed = false)
{
    const WinUI::Color fg = pressed ? WinUI::TextFillColorSecondary(dark)
                                   : WinUI::TextFillColorPrimary(dark);
    D2D1_COLOR_F arrowColor = D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(fg.rgb) / 255.f,
        GetGValue(fg.rgb) / 255.f, GetBValue(fg.rgb) / 255.f, fg.alpha / 255.f);

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
    pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(arrowColor, &brush);

    const bool opened = (iStateId == GLPS_OPENED || iStateId == HGLPS_OPENED);

    // WinUI TreeViewItem glyphs. Callers driving the open/close animation
    // always pass the "closed" state here and rotate the render target
    // externally (see PaintTreeViewGlyph), so the fixed ChevronRight glyph
    // carried by that outer rotation reaches the interpolated angle.
    // Hand-drawn lines only if no icon font is installed at all.
    const int fontSizePx = std::max(1, (int)std::lround(kTreeViewChevronGlyphDip * scale));
    if (DrawChevronGlyphOnRT(pRT, opened ? kChevronGlyphDown : kChevronGlyphRight,
            w, h, w * 0.5f, h * 0.5f, 0.f, brush.Get(), fontSizePx))
        return;

    FLOAT cx = w / 2.f, cy = h / 2.f;
    FLOAT arrowLength = fminf(w, h) * 0.25f;
    FLOAT dx = arrowLength * 0.866f, dy = arrowLength * 0.5f;
    FLOAT strokeW = 1.6f * scale;

    D2D1_POINT_2F ptTip, ptLeft, ptRight;
    if (opened)
    {
        ptTip   = {cx, cy + dy};
        ptLeft  = {cx - dx, cy - dy};
        ptRight = {cx + dx, cy - dy};
    }
    else // closed: pointing right
    {
        ptTip   = {cx + dy, cy};
        ptLeft  = {cx - dy, cy - dx};
        ptRight = {cx - dy, cy + dx};
    }
    pRT->DrawLine(ptLeft,  ptTip, brush.Get(), strokeW);
    pRT->DrawLine(ptRight, ptTip, brush.Get(), strokeW);
}

// ============================================================================
// PaintTreeViewGlyph: animated glyph rotation
// Returns true if handled (caller should return S_OK to skip original draw).
// ============================================================================

static bool PaintTreeViewGlyphCached(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, const wchar_t* glyph,
    float angle, float scale, bool dark, bool pressed);

static bool PaintTreeViewGlyph(HDC hdc, INT iPartId, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!g_d2dFactory || (iPartId != TVP_GLYPH && iPartId != TVP_HOTGLYPH)) return false;

    FLOAT scale = (FLOAT)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    FLOAT w = (FLOAT)(pRect->right  - pRect->left);
    FLOAT h = (FLOAT)(pRect->bottom - pRect->top);

    HWND tvHwnd = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if ((!tvHwnd || !IsWindow(tvHwnd)) && g_tlsPaintHwnd)
        tvHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
    if (!tvHwnd || !IsWindow(tvHwnd)) tvHwnd = g_pillTreeHWND;

    TVHITTESTINFO ht = {};
    HTREEITEM hItem = nullptr;
    if (tvHwnd && IsWindow(tvHwnd)) {
        ht.pt = {(pRect->left + pRect->right) / 2,
                 (pRect->top + pRect->bottom) / 2};
        hItem = (HTREEITEM)SendMessage(
            tvHwnd, TVM_HITTEST, 0, (LPARAM)&ht);

        // Namespace trees can request a transient glyph while their own hit
        // test still says that no expansion button exists for this item.
        if (hItem && !(ht.flags & TVHT_ONITEMBUTTON) &&
            GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(tvHwnd))
            return true;
    }

    // The animated path rotates the closed glyph to the item's current angle.
    bool rotated = false;
    FLOAT angle = 0.f;
    bool atRest = true;
    if ((PillAnimStyle() != 0 || g_settings.AnimatedArrows) && SysAnimationsEnabled())
    {
        if (tvHwnd && IsWindow(tvHwnd))
        {
            TreeCursorTrySubclass(tvHwnd);

            GlyphTreeAnims* anims = hItem ? ChevronAnimsForTree(tvHwnd) : nullptr;
            if (anims && anims->items.size() >= kGlyphAnimMaxItems &&
                !anims->items.contains((ULONG_PTR)hItem))
            {
                const DWORD pruneNow = GetTickCount();
                std::erase_if(anims->items, [pruneNow](const auto& entry) {
                    const GlyphAnim& a = entry.second;
                    return a.current == a.target &&
                           pruneNow - a.lastSeen > kGlyphAnimStaticPruneMs;
                });
                if (anims->items.size() >= kGlyphAnimMaxItems)
                    anims = nullptr;
            }

            if (anims)
            {
                auto& anim = anims->items[(ULONG_PTR)hItem];
                anim.rect = *pRect; // always update for precise invalidation
                anim.lastSeen = GetTickCount();

                if (anim.lastState == -1)
                {
                    anim.current   = (iStateId == GLPS_OPENED) ? 90.f : 0.f;
                    anim.startAngle = anim.current;
                    anim.target    = anim.current;
                    anim.startTick = 0;
                    anim.lastState = iStateId;
                }
                else if (anim.lastState != iStateId)
                {
                    DWORD now = GetTickCount();
                    anim.current = GlyphChevronAngleAt(
                        anim.startAngle, anim.target, anim.startTick, now);
                    anim.startAngle = anim.current;
                    anim.target = (iStateId == GLPS_OPENED) ? 90.f : 0.f;
                    anim.startTick = now;
                    anim.lastState = iStateId;

                    if (anims->lastTick == 0)
                    {
                        anims->lastTick = GetTickCount();
                        SetTimer(tvHwnd, kGlyphTimerId, 16, nullptr);
                    }
                }
                rotated = true;
                angle = anim.current;
                atRest = anim.current == anim.target;
            }
        }
    }

    // The tree's own theme: an app excluded from dark mode keeps a light
    // tree under a dark system. A chevron that isn't turning is drawn from
    // the raster cache.
    const bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    const bool pressed = tvHwnd && GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(tvHwnd) &&
        RoundedSelectionVisualsEnabled() && IsTreeRowPressed(tvHwnd, pRect);
    const bool opened = !rotated && (iStateId == GLPS_OPENED || iStateId == HGLPS_OPENED);
    if (atRest && PaintTreeViewGlyphCached(hdc, *pRect,
            opened ? kChevronGlyphDown : kChevronGlyphRight, angle, scale, dark, pressed))
        return true;

    ID2D1DCRenderTarget* pRT = GlyphGetCachedRT(hdc, pRect);
    if (pRT)
    {
        pRT->BeginDraw();
        if (rotated)
        {
            // Clip to pRect so mid-angle chevron tips don't bleed outside
            FLOAT cx = w / 2.f, cy = h / 2.f;
            pRT->PushAxisAlignedClip(D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f, w, h),
                                     D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_ALIASED);
            pRT->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Rotation(
                angle, D2D1::Point2F(cx, cy)));
            DrawChevronGlyph(pRT, w, h, iPartId, GLPS_CLOSED, scale, dark, pressed);
            pRT->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
            pRT->PopAxisAlignedClip();
        }
        else
        {
            DrawChevronGlyph(pRT, w, h, iPartId, iStateId, scale, dark, pressed);
        }

        HRESULT hr = pRT->EndDraw();
        if (hr == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
            if (D2DThreadCache* cache = D2DGetThreadCache(false))
                CachedRTRecreate(cache->glyphRT);
        }
        return true;
    }

    // Fallback: direct D2D (memory DCs in file pickers)
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pFallRT;
    if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pFallRT)))
    {
        pFallRT->BeginDraw();
        DrawChevronGlyph(pFallRT.Get(), w, h, iPartId, iStateId, scale, dark, pressed);
        if (pFallRT->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
            pFallRT.Reset();
            CachedTlsRTRecreate();
        }
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}
// ============================================================================
// DrawNineGridStretch: blit a cached DIB with nine-grid corners (AlphaBlend)
// ============================================================================

static void DrawNineGridStretch(HDC hdc, HDC srcDC, LPCRECT dstRect,
                                INT left, INT top, INT right, INT bottom)
{
    HBITMAP hBmp = (HBITMAP)GetCurrentObject(srcDC, OBJ_BITMAP);
    BITMAP bmp = {};
    GetObject(hBmp, sizeof(bmp), &bmp);
    INT srcW = bmp.bmWidth, srcH = bmp.bmHeight;
    INT dstW = dstRect->right - dstRect->left, dstH = dstRect->bottom - dstRect->top;

    left   = std::min(left, dstW);
    right  = std::min(right, dstW - left);
    top    = std::min(top, dstH);
    bottom = std::min(bottom, dstH - top);
    INT centerW = dstW - left - right, centerH = dstH - top - bottom;
    INT srcCW   = srcW - left - right, srcCH   = srcH - top - bottom;

    BLENDFUNCTION blend = { AC_SRC_OVER, 0, 255, AC_SRC_ALPHA };

    if (left + right >= srcW || top + bottom >= srcH) {
        AlphaBlend(hdc, dstRect->left, dstRect->top, dstW, dstH, srcDC, 0, 0, srcW, srcH, blend);
        return;
    }
    if (centerW > 0 && centerH > 0 && srcCW > 0 && srcCH > 0)
        AlphaBlend(hdc, dstRect->left+left, dstRect->top+top, centerW, centerH, srcDC, left, top, srcCW, srcCH, blend);
    if (left > 0 && top > 0)
        AlphaBlend(hdc, dstRect->left, dstRect->top, left, top, srcDC, 0, 0, left, top, blend);
    if (centerW > 0 && top > 0 && srcCW > 0)
        AlphaBlend(hdc, dstRect->left+left, dstRect->top, centerW, top, srcDC, left, 0, srcCW, top, blend);
    if (right > 0 && top > 0)
        AlphaBlend(hdc, dstRect->right-right, dstRect->top, right, top, srcDC, srcW-right, 0, right, top, blend);
    if (left > 0 && centerH > 0 && srcCH > 0)
        AlphaBlend(hdc, dstRect->left, dstRect->top+top, left, centerH, srcDC, 0, top, left, srcCH, blend);
    if (right > 0 && centerH > 0 && srcCH > 0)
        AlphaBlend(hdc, dstRect->right-right, dstRect->top+top, right, centerH, srcDC, srcW-right, top, right, srcCH, blend);
    if (left > 0 && bottom > 0)
        AlphaBlend(hdc, dstRect->left, dstRect->bottom-bottom, left, bottom, srcDC, 0, srcH-bottom, left, bottom, blend);
    if (centerW > 0 && bottom > 0 && srcCW > 0)
        AlphaBlend(hdc, dstRect->left+left, dstRect->bottom-bottom, centerW, bottom, srcDC, left, srcH-bottom, srcCW, bottom, blend);
    if (right > 0 && bottom > 0)
        AlphaBlend(hdc, dstRect->right-right, dstRect->bottom-bottom, right, bottom, srcDC, srcW-right, srcH-bottom, right, bottom, blend);
}

// ============================================================================
// WinUI-style tab background (DrawNineGridStretch eliminates flicker)
// ============================================================================

// Fills `rect` with `color`, rounding only the top-left/top-right corners
// (radius `r`) and leaving the bottom square -- same manual-path technique
// as FillScrollbarHoverCap, since D2D's FillRoundedRectangle can't round a
// subset of corners. Used for the WinUI-style property-tab background so a
// selected tab's fill stays flush/square where it meets the pane below.
static bool FillTopRoundedRect(ID2D1Factory1* factory, ID2D1DCRenderTarget* pRT,
    D2D1_RECT_F rect, FLOAT r, D2D1_COLOR_F color)
{
    if (!factory || !pRT) return false;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> geo;
    if (FAILED(factory->CreatePathGeometry(&geo)) || !geo) return false;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GeometrySink> sink;
    if (FAILED(geo->Open(&sink)) || !sink) return false;

    D2D1_SIZE_F sz = D2D1::SizeF(r, r);
    auto arcTo = [&](D2D1_POINT_2F pt) {
        sink->AddArc(D2D1::ArcSegment(pt, sz, 0.f,
            D2D1_SWEEP_DIRECTION_CLOCKWISE, D2D1_ARC_SIZE_SMALL));
    };

    sink->BeginFigure({rect.left + r, rect.top}, D2D1_FIGURE_BEGIN_FILLED);
    sink->AddLine({rect.right - r, rect.top});
    arcTo({rect.right, rect.top + r});
    sink->AddLine({rect.right, rect.bottom});
    sink->AddLine({rect.left, rect.bottom});
    sink->AddLine({rect.left, rect.top + r});
    arcTo({rect.left + r, rect.top});
    sink->EndFigure(D2D1_FIGURE_END_CLOSED);
    if (FAILED(sink->Close())) return false;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
    if (FAILED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(color, &brush)) || !brush)
        return false;
    pRT->FillGeometry(geo.Get(), brush.Get());
    return true;
}

static bool FillJoinedTabRect(ID2D1Factory1* factory, ID2D1DCRenderTarget* pRT,
    D2D1_RECT_F rect, FLOAT r, FLOAT joinRadius, FLOAT baseInset,
    D2D1_COLOR_F color)
{
    if (!factory || !pRT) return false;

    // r (the tab's own top-corner radius) is reserved first and joinRadius
    // (the lower join curve into the pane) yields to it when both can't fit
    // side by side within halfWidth -- the reverse order silently shrank the
    // top corners below their intended radius (e.g. 4px asked for, 3px
    // rendered) any time the join curve was comparably wide, which is the
    // common case at typical DPIs. The join curve is the less prominent of
    // the two, so it's the one that should compromise.
    const FLOAT halfWidth = (rect.right - rect.left) * 0.5f;
    r = (std::max)(0.f, (std::min)(r, halfWidth - 1.f));
    joinRadius = (std::max)(
        0.f, (std::min)(joinRadius, halfWidth - r));
    baseInset = (std::max)(0.f, (std::min)(
        baseInset, rect.bottom - rect.top - r - joinRadius));
    joinRadius = (std::max)(0.f, (std::min)(
        joinRadius, rect.bottom - rect.top - r - baseInset));
    const FLOAT baseY = rect.bottom - baseInset;
    const FLOAT curveTop = baseY - joinRadius;
    constexpr FLOAT kQuarterCircle = 0.55228475f;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> geo;
    if (FAILED(factory->CreatePathGeometry(&geo)) || !geo) return false;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GeometrySink> sink;
    if (FAILED(geo->Open(&sink)) || !sink) return false;

    const D2D1_SIZE_F corner = D2D1::SizeF(r, r);
    sink->BeginFigure(
        {rect.left + joinRadius + r, rect.top}, D2D1_FIGURE_BEGIN_FILLED);
    sink->AddLine({rect.right - joinRadius - r, rect.top});
    sink->AddArc(D2D1::ArcSegment(
        {rect.right - joinRadius, rect.top + r}, corner, 0.f,
        D2D1_SWEEP_DIRECTION_CLOCKWISE, D2D1_ARC_SIZE_SMALL));
    sink->AddLine({rect.right - joinRadius, curveTop});
    sink->AddBezier(D2D1::BezierSegment(
        {rect.right - joinRadius,
            curveTop + kQuarterCircle * joinRadius},
        {rect.right - kQuarterCircle * joinRadius, baseY},
        {rect.right, baseY}));
    sink->AddLine({rect.right, rect.bottom});
    sink->AddLine({rect.left, rect.bottom});
    sink->AddLine({rect.left, baseY});
    sink->AddBezier(D2D1::BezierSegment(
        {rect.left + kQuarterCircle * joinRadius, baseY},
        {rect.left + joinRadius,
            curveTop + kQuarterCircle * joinRadius},
        {rect.left + joinRadius, curveTop}));
    sink->AddLine({rect.left + joinRadius, rect.top + r});
    sink->AddArc(D2D1::ArcSegment(
        {rect.left + joinRadius + r, rect.top}, corner, 0.f,
        D2D1_SWEEP_DIRECTION_CLOCKWISE, D2D1_ARC_SIZE_SMALL));
    sink->EndFigure(D2D1_FIGURE_END_CLOSED);
    if (FAILED(sink->Close())) return false;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
    if (FAILED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(color, &brush)) || !brush)
        return false;
    pRT->FillGeometry(geo.Get(), brush.Get());
    return true;
}

// 0=normal, 1=selected, 2=disabled, 3=hot(all corners), 4=hot(top corners),
// 5=selected single-line with inward-contained lower joins.
struct TabBgCacheEntry {
    HDC dc = nullptr;
    INT left = 0;
    INT top = 0;
    INT right = 0;
    INT bottom = 0;
};

static std::unordered_map<uint64_t, TabBgCacheEntry> g_tabBgCacheWinUI;
// DPI is the only unbounded dimension in the cache key (index/dark are fixed
// small enums) -- least-recently-used order of DPIs seen, oldest at the
// front, so a full cache is trimmed by dropping one DPI's worth of entries
// at a time instead of wiping every DPI's cached bitmaps just because one
// new DPI showed up. Callers must hold g_tabBgMutex, same as the map itself.
static std::vector<UINT> g_tabBgCacheDpiLru;

static void TabBgCacheClearWinUI()
{
    for (auto& [key, entry] : g_tabBgCacheWinUI) {
        (void)key;
        if (entry.dc) {
            HBITMAP hBmp =
                (HBITMAP)GetCurrentObject(entry.dc, OBJ_BITMAP);
            DeleteDC(entry.dc);
            if (hBmp) DeleteObject(hBmp);
        }
    }
    g_tabBgCacheWinUI.clear();
    g_tabBgCacheDpiLru.clear();
}

static void TabBgCacheTouchDpi(UINT dpi)
{
    auto it = std::find(
        g_tabBgCacheDpiLru.begin(), g_tabBgCacheDpiLru.end(), dpi);
    if (it != g_tabBgCacheDpiLru.end())
        g_tabBgCacheDpiLru.erase(it);
    g_tabBgCacheDpiLru.push_back(dpi);
}

// Drops every cached entry for the single least-recently-used DPI instead of
// TabBgCacheClearWinUI's full wipe, so a session that has painted at several
// distinct DPIs (multi-monitor, runtime DPI changes) doesn't thrash the
// whole cache every time a new one shows up.
static void TabBgCacheEvictOldestDpi()
{
    if (g_tabBgCacheDpiLru.empty())
        return;
    const UINT oldestDpi = g_tabBgCacheDpiLru.front();
    g_tabBgCacheDpiLru.erase(g_tabBgCacheDpiLru.begin());
    for (auto it = g_tabBgCacheWinUI.begin(); it != g_tabBgCacheWinUI.end();) {
        if (static_cast<UINT>(it->first & 0xFFFFFFFFull) == oldestDpi) {
            if (it->second.dc) {
                HBITMAP hBmp =
                    (HBITMAP)GetCurrentObject(it->second.dc, OBJ_BITMAP);
                DeleteDC(it->second.dc);
                if (hBmp) DeleteObject(hBmp);
            }
            it = g_tabBgCacheWinUI.erase(it);
        } else {
            ++it;
        }
    }
}

static FLOAT TabWinUiCornerRadius(HDC hdc)
{
    FLOAT scale = (FLOAT)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    return WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale; // same radius for selected/disabled and hover -- tuned live
}

// The single-line selected tab's join-curve radius (see FillJoinedTabRect).
// The ACL editor's tab row (Advanced Security Settings) has a native vertical
// gradient painted underneath it: DirectUI builds it from two system colors,
// one of which is COLOR_BTNSHADOW, which GetDarkSysColor deliberately passes
// through to the real (light) value. Natively it never shows, because native
// unselected tabs are opaque; this mod's unselected tabs are transparent, so it
// does. TabFlickerFixSubclassProc's own pre-fill (written against this same
// gradient) does not reach it: this dialog draws its tab row at dialog
// coordinates rather than through that control's client paint.
//
// Answered by walking up from the window the paint belongs to. Measured, for
// these draws: WindowFromDC is always null (the paint lands on a memory DC), so
// the BeginPaint latch is the only signal there is, and its value differs
// between passes of one paint -- an Edit at depth 3, then the DirectUIHWND at
// depth 1. That costs nothing here because the latch's identity is never
// trusted: it is only a starting point for a structural question, and both
// values sit inside the same dialog, so both answer the same. The negative
// control this was checked against is an ordinary property sheet, whose real
// SysTabControl32 answers no from the same walk.
//
// Theme-neutral, unlike IsInsideAclUiDarkDialog -- the gradient shows in both
// themes. The dialog is ATL-based, so DWLP_DLGPROC resolves to atlthunk.dll's
// generated thunk rather than into aclui.dll itself; combined with requiring
// aclui.dll to be loaded at all (it loads only when this dialog is opened),
// that is as narrow as this dialog can be identified -- any other ATL dialog
// with tabs would match too, the same coarseness IsInsideAclUiDarkDialog
// documents. Nothing is cached, so no stale answer can select a wrong variant.
static bool PaintingAclUiPropertyDialogTabs(HWND from)
{
    if (!from || !GetModuleHandleW(L"aclui.dll"))
        return false;
    HMODULE hAtlthunk = GetModuleHandleW(L"atlthunk.dll");
    if (!hAtlthunk)
        return false;

    for (int depth = 0; from && depth < 16; from = GetParent(from), ++depth) {
        if (!IsClassName(from, L"#32770"))
            continue;
        WNDPROC dlgProc = (WNDPROC)GetWindowLongPtrW(from, DWLP_DLGPROC);
        HMODULE hmod = nullptr;
        if (dlgProc &&
            GetModuleHandleExW(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS |
                                   GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
                               (LPCWSTR)dlgProc, &hmod) &&
            hmod == hAtlthunk) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

// Shared by TabBgCacheEnsureWinUI (bitmap sizing and the fill call) and
// PaintTab (which bleeds the destination rect by this same amount) -- the
// three must stay in lockstep or the bleed either under- or overshoots the
// curve it's compensating for.
static FLOAT SingleLineTabJoinRadius(UINT dpi)
{
    // Preserve the original 120-DPI calibration and floating-point rounding.
    return (WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * (120.f / 96.f)) * (dpi / 120.f);
}

// WinUI-style property-tab background. The selected tab fills solid with
// the pane color so it reads as an elevated surface against the darker/
// dimmer strip around it; unselected (index 0) stays transparent. `dark`
// picks the light/dark palette; DPI, state and palette form the bounded cache
// key so mixed-DPI windows don't reuse incompatible geometry.
//
// `opaque` bakes the same shapes over the dialog background instead of over
// transparency, for a tab row with something painted underneath that must not
// show through (see PaintingAclUiPropertyDialogTabs). It changes only the clear
// color, so the translucent hover and disabled fills composite against the real
// background and every shape stays identical to its transparent twin. It is
// part of the cache key: a variant is never reused across the two.
static const TabBgCacheEntry* TabBgCacheEnsureWinUI(
    HDC hdc, int index, bool dark, bool opaque)
{
    if (!hdc || !g_d2dFactory || index < 0 || index >= 6)
        return nullptr;

    const UINT dpi = DpiForPaintHdc(hdc);
    const uint64_t key = static_cast<uint64_t>(dpi) |
        (static_cast<uint64_t>(index) << 32) |
        (static_cast<uint64_t>(dark ? 1 : 0) << 40) |
        (static_cast<uint64_t>(opaque ? 1 : 0) << 41);
    if (auto it = g_tabBgCacheWinUI.find(key);
        it != g_tabBgCacheWinUI.end()) {
        TabBgCacheTouchDpi(dpi);
        return &it->second;
    }

    constexpr size_t kTabBgCacheMax = 96;
    while (g_tabBgCacheWinUI.size() >= kTabBgCacheMax &&
           !g_tabBgCacheDpiLru.empty()) {
        TabBgCacheEvictOldestDpi();
    }

    FLOAT cr = TabWinUiCornerRadius(hdc);
    auto scaleCacheMetric = [dpi](INT value) {
        return (std::max)(1, MulDiv(value, dpi, 120));
    };
    INT left = scaleCacheMetric(9);
    const INT top = scaleCacheMetric(9);
    INT right = scaleCacheMetric(8);
    const INT bottom = scaleCacheMetric(8);

    // Index 5's FillJoinedTabRect call below needs both the top-corner
    // radius (cr) and its own lower join-curve radius to fit side by side
    // within half the bitmap's width, or FillJoinedTabRect's own clamp
    // shrinks whichever one is asked for last (see its comment) -- widen
    // just this entry's left/right so neither has to compromise, instead of
    // touching the shared margins every other index's nine-slice stretch
    // also depends on.
    if (index == 5) {
        const FLOAT joinRadiusWanted = SingleLineTabJoinRadius(dpi);
        const INT neededHalfWidth =
            static_cast<INT>(std::ceil(cr + joinRadiusWanted)) + 1;
        const INT neededWidth = neededHalfWidth * 2;
        const INT currentWidth = left + 1 + right;
        if (neededWidth > currentWidth) {
            const INT extra = neededWidth - currentWidth;
            left += (extra + 1) / 2;
            right += extra / 2;
        }
    }

    const INT W = left + 1 + right;
    const INT H = top + 1 + bottom;

    HDC memDC = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
    if (!memDC) return nullptr;
    BITMAPINFO bmi = {};
    bmi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
    bmi.bmiHeader.biWidth = W;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -H;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;
    void* bits = nullptr;
    HBITMAP dib = CreateDIBSection(memDC, &bmi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
    if (!dib) { DeleteDC(memDC); return nullptr; }
    HGDIOBJ oldBmp = SelectObject(memDC, dib);
    if (!oldBmp || oldBmp == HGDI_ERROR) {
        DeleteObject(dib);
        DeleteDC(memDC);
        return nullptr;
    }

    auto discard = [&]() {
        SelectObject(memDC, oldBmp);
        DeleteObject(dib);
        DeleteDC(memDC);
        return static_cast<const TabBgCacheEntry*>(nullptr);
    };

    D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_PROPERTIES rtP = D2D1::RenderTargetProperties(
        D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_TYPE_SOFTWARE,
        D2D1::PixelFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED),
        0, 0, D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_USAGE_GDI_COMPATIBLE, D2D1_FEATURE_LEVEL_DEFAULT);
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
    RECT rc = {0, 0, W, H};
    if (FAILED(g_d2dFactory->CreateDCRenderTarget(&rtP, &pRT)) ||
        FAILED(pRT->BindDC(memDC, &rc))) {
        pRT.Reset();
        return discard();
    }

    D2D1_RECT_F full = D2D1::RectF(0, 0, (FLOAT)W, (FLOAT)H);
    COLORREF pane = ElevatedPaneColor(dark);
    D2D1_COLOR_F paneColor = D2D1::ColorF(
        GetRValue(pane) / 255.f, GetGValue(pane) / 255.f, GetBValue(pane) / 255.f);

    const COLORREF twinBg = dark ? Win32MainDark : RGB(255, 255, 255);
    const D2D1_COLOR_F clearColor = opaque
        ? D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(twinBg) / 255.f, GetGValue(twinBg) / 255.f,
                       GetBValue(twinBg) / 255.f, 1.f)
        : D2D1::ColorF(0, 0, 0, 0);

    pRT->BeginDraw();
    bool contentOK = true;

    if (index == 0) {
        pRT->Clear(clearColor);
    } else if (index == 1 || index == 5) {
        pRT->Clear(clearColor);
        const FLOAT dpiScale = DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 120.f;
        if (index == 5
                ? !FillJoinedTabRect(
                    g_d2dFactory, pRT.Get(), full, cr,
                    SingleLineTabJoinRadius(dpi), 2.2f * dpiScale, paneColor)
                : !FillTopRoundedRect(
                    g_d2dFactory, pRT.Get(), full, cr, paneColor)) {
            contentOK = false;
        }
    } else if (index == 2) {
        pRT->Clear(clearColor);
        D2D1_COLOR_F disabledColor = paneColor;
        disabledColor.a = 0.6f;
        if (!FillTopRoundedRect(g_d2dFactory, pRT.Get(), full, cr, disabledColor))
            contentOK = false;
    } else if (index == 3 || index == 4) {
        // Hover uses all-corners rounding, unlike the semi-rounded
        // selected/disabled shape above, except for single-line property
        // tabs where the hover also joins the pane along its bottom edge.
        pRT->Clear(clearColor);
        const D2D1_COLOR_F hoverColor =
            D2D1::ColorF(0.376f, 0.376f, 0.376f, 0.20f);
        if (index == 4) {
            contentOK = FillTopRoundedRect(
                g_d2dFactory, pRT.Get(), full, cr, hoverColor);
        } else {
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> br;
            if (FAILED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(hoverColor, &br)) || !br)
                contentOK = false;
            else
                pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                    D2D1::RoundedRect(full, cr, cr), br.Get());
        }
    }

    HRESULT endHr = pRT->EndDraw();
    pRT.Reset();
    if (!contentOK || FAILED(endHr)) {
        return discard();
    }
    auto [it, inserted] = g_tabBgCacheWinUI.emplace(
        key, TabBgCacheEntry{memDC, left, top, right, bottom});
    if (!inserted) {
        SelectObject(memDC, oldBmp);
        DeleteObject(dib);
        DeleteDC(memDC);
    } else {
        TabBgCacheTouchDpi(dpi);
    }
    return &it->second;
}

// ============================================================================
// PaintTab: WinUI-style tab background for property windows
// Returns true if handled.
// ============================================================================

// g_tlsPaintHwnd is declared earlier in the file now (see the "Travel band
// glyphs" section) -- the TravelBand click-pop trigger needs it before this
// point. Definition lives there; everything below still just uses it.
static thread_local bool g_glowEntry = false;      // DrawTextWithGlow re-entrancy guard
static thread_local bool g_inDuiPaintBg = false;    // FillRect hook: intercept white fills during DUI PaintBg
static thread_local int g_duiPaintElementType = -1;

static bool IsPropertyDirectUIScope(HWND hwnd);

// Marks the property dialog's root (#32770) once its DUI-hosted Previous
// Versions list has completed one full WM_PAINT pass. Before this prop is
// set, FillRect_hook's white-catch stays live as a safety net for the
// GetThemeColor_hook FILLCOLOR override, which can lose a race on that very
// first paint (queried during the list's initial style/layout setup,
// outside any BeginPaint bracket); once set, the catch-all steps aside and
// the theme-only fix runs standalone. Removed in PropertyDialogSubclassProc's
// WM_NCDESTROY, matching kPropertyDialogDarkModeMarker's own cleanup on the same window.
static const wchar_t* kPropDuiListPrimed = L"WH_MW_DUI_LIST_PRIMED";
static constexpr wchar_t kSingleLinePropertyTabProp[] =
    L"W32M_SINGLE_LINE_PROPERTY_TAB";
static constexpr wchar_t kWinUiTabTextOwnerProp[] =
    L"W32M_WINUI_TAB_TEXT_OWNER";

// True whenever this mod's WinUI tab styling should be active -- the single
// gate PaintTab and HandleThemeDraw's TABP_PANE fill share. Deliberately
// unconditional on dark mode -- both callers resolve their own per-window
// dark flag now.
static bool IsWinUiTabStyleActive()
{
    return g_settings.RoundedTabPane;
}

// Shared by tab text and group headers. Named instance fits LF_FACESIZE (31
// chars); "...Display Semibold" doesn't (34). Cached: FontFamilyExists
// enumerates fonts, and both repaint often.
static std::mutex g_segoeVariableFaceMutex;
static bool g_segoeVariableFaceValid = false;
static wchar_t g_segoeVariableFace[32] = {};

static LPCWSTR SegoeUiVariableFace()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_segoeVariableFaceMutex);
    if (!g_segoeVariableFaceValid) {
        if (FontFamilyExists(L"Segoe UI Variable Text Semibold"))
            wcscpy_s(g_segoeVariableFace, L"Segoe UI Variable Text Semibold");
        else
            wcscpy_s(g_segoeVariableFace, L"Segoe UI Semibold");
        g_segoeVariableFaceValid = true;
    }
    return g_segoeVariableFace;
}

// Bounded HFONT cache keyed by full LOGFONT (height/charset vary per
// dialog/DPI). Capped, oldest-evicted; each feature gets its own instance
// so one turning off doesn't invalidate another's entries.
class LogFontCache {
public:
    HFONT Ensure(const LOGFONTW& lf)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        for (const auto& entry : entries_) {
            if (memcmp(&entry.key, &lf, sizeof(LOGFONTW)) == 0)
                return entry.font;
        }

        HFONT font = CreateFontIndirectW(&lf);
        if (!font)
            return nullptr;

        if (entries_.size() >= kMaxEntries) {
            DeleteObject(entries_.front().font);
            entries_.erase(entries_.begin());
        }
        entries_.push_back({lf, font});
        return font;
    }

    void Clear()
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        for (auto& entry : entries_)
            DeleteObject(entry.font);
        entries_.clear();
    }

private:
    struct Entry {
        LOGFONTW key = {};
        HFONT font = nullptr;
    };
    static constexpr size_t kMaxEntries = 8;
    std::mutex mutex_;
    std::vector<Entry> entries_;
};

static LogFontCache g_winUiTabFontCache;
static LogFontCache g_groupHeaderFontCache;

// Creates an IDWriteTextFormat, trying each name in `names` in order (same
// contract as every font-fallback-list call site in this file). When the
// FIRST name is a "Segoe UI Variable*" face, resolves weight + optical-size
// continuously from `size` via IDWriteFactory6 instead -- the same way WinUI
// itself resolves Segoe UI Variable -- rather than a fixed named instance
// (Text/Display, Semibold or not) whose opsz is pinned wherever that
// instance happens to sit, independent of the size actually being drawn at.
// Falls back to the plain per-name CreateTextFormat loop when
// IDWriteFactory6 isn't available (older Windows) or the first name isn't a
// variable-font face (e.g. the classic "Segoe UI Semibold" fallback
// SegoeUiVariableFace() returns when the variable font isn't installed).
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> CreateSegoeVariableAwareTextFormat(
    IDWriteFactory* factory, const wchar_t* const* names, size_t nameCount,
    DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT weight, float size, UINT dpi, bool italic = false)
{
    if (!factory || !names || nameCount == 0) return {};

    // Segoe UI Variable has no italic axis -- the axis path below only
    // applies to upright text; italic falls through to the legacy loop.
    if (!italic && names[0] && wcsstr(names[0], L"Segoe UI Variable") == names[0]) {
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteFactory6> factory6;
        if (SUCCEEDED(factory->QueryInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&factory6)))) {
            // opsz is in points, a DPI-independent unit -- `size` is a
            // device-pixel value at the CURRENT monitor DPI (this file's
            // render targets are declared at a fixed 96 DPI, so DIP==pixel
            // for them, but that's a render-target convention, not a claim
            // that `size` itself is DPI-independent). Converting with a
            // hardcoded /96 only produces the true nominal point size at
            // exactly 100% DPI; at any other DPI it scales `size` by the
            // DPI factor first, so the conversion needs to divide that back
            // out again with the real, current `dpi` -- otherwise opsz comes
            // out inflated at higher DPIs (selecting a more compact optical
            // style than the nominal size actually calls for) and the same
            // font ends up a different width per character at different
            // DPIs for the same nominal size. Clamped to Segoe UI Variable's
            // own documented optical-size range (8-36pt).
            const float opsz = std::clamp(size * 72.0f / (float)(dpi ? dpi : 96), 8.0f, 36.0f);
            DWRITE_FONT_AXIS_VALUE axisValues[] = {
                { DWRITE_FONT_AXIS_TAG_WEIGHT, (float)weight },
                { DWRITE_FONT_AXIS_TAG_OPTICAL_SIZE, opsz },
            };
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat3> fmt3;
            if (SUCCEEDED(factory6->CreateTextFormat(L"Segoe UI Variable", nullptr,
                    axisValues, ARRAYSIZE(axisValues), size, L"", &fmt3)) && fmt3)
                return fmt3;
        }
    }

    const DWRITE_FONT_STYLE style = italic ? DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC : DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> fmt;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < nameCount; ++i) {
        if (names[i] && SUCCEEDED(factory->CreateTextFormat(names[i], nullptr, weight,
                style, DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, size, L"", &fmt)) && fmt)
            break;
    }
    return fmt;
}

// ── Shared DirectWrite text format cache for WinUI-styled GDI text ──────────
// Same bounded/mutex-guarded shape as LogFontCache above, keyed by the font
// identity plus alignment flags (so a cached format's alignment is fixed at
// creation and never mutated on a possibly-shared object afterward).
class DWriteTextFormatCache {
public:
    // dpi is the actual current monitor DPI for whatever hdc this format
    // will be drawn on -- needed by CreateSegoeVariableAwareTextFormat's
    // optical-size axis calculation (see its own comment), and part of the
