    // cache key since the same lf/dtFlags at a different DPI now resolves to
    // a genuinely different format (different opsz for the same nominal size).
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> Ensure(IDWriteFactory* factory,
        const LOGFONTW& lf, UINT dtFlags, UINT dpi, float sizeOverride = 0.0f)
    {
        if (!factory) return {};
        const float size = sizeOverride > 0.0f
            ? sizeOverride : static_cast<float>(std::abs(lf.lfHeight));
        if (size <= 0.f) return {};

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        for (const auto& e : entries_) {
            if (e.size == size && e.weight == lf.lfWeight &&
                e.italic == (lf.lfItalic != 0) && e.flags == dtFlags &&
                e.dpi == dpi && wcscmp(e.face, lf.lfFaceName) == 0)
                return e.fmt;
        }

        const wchar_t* names[] = { lf.lfFaceName };
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> fmt = CreateSegoeVariableAwareTextFormat(
            factory, names, 1, (DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT)lf.lfWeight, size, dpi, lf.lfItalic != 0);
        if (!fmt)
            return {};
        fmt->SetTextAlignment((dtFlags & DT_CENTER) ? DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_CENTER :
            (dtFlags & DT_RIGHT) ? DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_TRAILING : DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_LEADING);
        fmt->SetParagraphAlignment((dtFlags & DT_VCENTER) ? DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_CENTER :
            (dtFlags & DT_BOTTOM) ? DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_FAR : DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_NEAR);
        // GDI's DrawText wraps by default and only goes single-line when the
        // caller explicitly asks for it (DT_SINGLELINE) -- a hardcoded
        // NO_WRAP here forced multi-line captions (e.g. a checkbox label
        // that legitimately wraps in native GDI) onto one line instead,
        // overflowing/clipping at the right edge no matter how wide the
        // rect was grown, since the real fix is height (more lines), not
        // width.
        fmt->SetWordWrapping((dtFlags & DT_SINGLELINE)
            ? DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP : DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_WRAP);
        if (dtFlags & DT_END_ELLIPSIS) {
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteInlineObject> ellipsis;
            if (SUCCEEDED(factory->CreateEllipsisTrimmingSign(fmt.Get(), &ellipsis))) {
                DWRITE_TRIMMING trimming = { DWRITE_TRIMMING_GRANULARITY_CHARACTER, 0, 0 };
                fmt->SetTrimming(&trimming, ellipsis.Get());
            }
        }

        if (entries_.size() >= kMaxEntries)
            entries_.erase(entries_.begin());
        Entry e;
        wcsncpy_s(e.face, lf.lfFaceName, _TRUNCATE);
        e.size = size;
        e.weight = lf.lfWeight;
        e.italic = (lf.lfItalic != 0);
        e.flags = dtFlags;
        e.dpi = dpi;
        e.fmt = fmt;
        entries_.push_back(std::move(e));
        return fmt;
    }

    void Clear()
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        entries_.clear();
    }

private:
    struct Entry {
        wchar_t face[LF_FACESIZE] = {};
        float size = 0;
        LONG weight = 0;
        bool italic = false;
        UINT flags = 0;
        UINT dpi = 0;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> fmt;
    };
    static constexpr size_t kMaxEntries = 8;
    std::mutex mutex_;
    std::vector<Entry> entries_;
};

static std::mutex g_winUiTextDwMutex;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteFactory> g_winUiTextDwFactory;
static DWriteTextFormatCache g_winUiTextDwFormatCache;
static std::atomic<uint64_t> g_shellTextRasterGeneration{1};

struct DesktopTextFontMetrics {
    wchar_t family[LF_FACESIZE] = {};
    UINT16 unitsPerEm = 0;
    INT16 averageWidth = 0;
    bool attempted = false;
};

static DesktopTextFontMetrics g_desktopTextFontMetrics;

static void WinUiTextDWriteCacheClear()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_winUiTextDwMutex);
    g_winUiTextDwFactory.Reset();
    g_winUiTextDwFormatCache.Clear();

static IDWriteFactory* WinUiTextEnsureDWriteFactoryLocked()
{
    if (g_winUiTextDwFactory)
        return g_winUiTextDwFactory.Get();
    IDWriteFactory* raw = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED,
            __uuidof(IDWriteFactory), reinterpret_cast<IUnknown**>(&raw))) || !raw)
        return nullptr;
    g_winUiTextDwFactory.Attach(raw);
    return g_winUiTextDwFactory.Get();
}

// Strips Win32 DT_PREFIX-style mnemonic markers the same way GDI's
// DrawText/DrawThemeTextEx do by default ('&x' -> underline x, '&&' ->
// literal '&'), since D2D's own DrawTextW/DrawTextLayout have no concept of
// this and would otherwise show the raw '&' characters. DT_NOPREFIX skips
// processing entirely. *outAccelPos receives the accelerator character's
// index in the returned string, or SIZE_MAX if there isn't one.
static std::wstring StripMnemonicPrefix(LPCWSTR text, int cch, UINT dtFlags, size_t* outAccelPos)
{
    *outAccelPos = SIZE_MAX;
    std::wstring out;
    if (!text || cch <= 0)
        return out;
    if (dtFlags & DT_NOPREFIX) {
        out.assign(text, (size_t)cch);
        return out;
    }
    out.reserve((size_t)cch);
    bool foundAccel = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < cch; ++i) {
        if (text[i] == L'&' && i + 1 < cch) {
            if (text[i + 1] == L'&') {
                out.push_back(L'&');
                ++i;
                continue;
            }
            if (!foundAccel) {
                *outAccelPos = out.size();
                foundAccel = true;
            }
            continue;
        }
        out.push_back(text[i]);
    }
    return out;
}

// Draws `text` (already run through StripMnemonicPrefix) into `rt`,
// underlining the accelerator character if there is one and DT_HIDEPREFIX
// isn't set, and applying a horizontal-only `widthScale` (if not 1.0) so
// the substitute font's line-breaking/advance-width math -- not just its
// rendered pixels -- matches what the native font would have used without
// also shrinking its line height. Both need a real IDWriteTextLayout, so
// build one whenever either applies; otherwise use the convenience call,
// the common case. Glyph
// rendering itself is left to D2D's own default (SetTextAntialiasMode
// grayscale, no rendering-mode/grid-fit override) -- confirmed by reading
// WinUI's own source (D2DTextDrawingContext.cpp, RasterizeImageFormatGlyphRun)
// that real WinUI text draws the exact same way, via plain
// ID2D1DeviceContext::DrawGlyphRun with no DWRITE_RENDERING_MODE or
// DWRITE_GRID_FIT_MODE forced -- a custom IDWriteTextRenderer forcing
// NATURAL/NATURAL_SYMMETRIC here would be trying to replicate something
// WinUI itself doesn't do.
static void DrawMnemonicAwareText(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, IDWriteFactory* factory,
    IDWriteTextFormat* fmt, const std::wstring& text, size_t accelPos, UINT dtFlags,
    const D2D1_RECT_F& textRect, ID2D1Brush* brush, float widthScale = 1.0f,
    D2D1_DRAW_TEXT_OPTIONS drawOptions = D2D1_DRAW_TEXT_OPTIONS_CLIP)
{
    const bool needsUnderline = accelPos != SIZE_MAX && !(dtFlags & DT_HIDEPREFIX);
    const bool needsWidthScale = std::abs(widthScale - 1.0f) > 0.0001f;
    if ((needsUnderline || needsWidthScale) && factory) {
        const float physicalWidth = textRect.right - textRect.left;
        const float layoutWidth = needsWidthScale && widthScale > 0.0f
            ? physicalWidth / widthScale
            : physicalWidth;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextLayout> layout;
        if (SUCCEEDED(factory->CreateTextLayout(text.c_str(), (UINT32)text.size(), fmt,
                layoutWidth, textRect.bottom - textRect.top, &layout)) && layout) {
            if (needsUnderline) {
                DWRITE_TEXT_RANGE range = { (UINT32)accelPos, 1 };
                layout->SetUnderline(TRUE, range);
            }

            D2D1_MATRIX_3X2_F oldTransform = {};
            if (needsWidthScale) {
                rt->GetTransform(&oldTransform);
                rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Scale(
                    D2D1::SizeF(widthScale, 1.0f),
                    D2D1::Point2F(textRect.left, textRect.top)) *
                    oldTransform);
            }
            rt->DrawTextLayout(D2D1::Point2F(textRect.left, textRect.top), layout.Get(),
                brush, drawOptions);
            if (needsWidthScale)
                rt->SetTransform(oldTransform);
            return;
        }
    }
    rt->DrawTextW(text.c_str(), (UINT32)text.size(), fmt, textRect, brush,
        drawOptions);
}

// MacType's own technique for substituting a font without breaking layout
// (confirmed by reading its source: override.cpp's WidthMode setting keeps
// GetCharWidth/GetTextExtentPoint32 answering with the ORIGINAL font's
// metrics even though a different font gets rendered, and ft.cpp's
// FreeTypePrepare computes scaler.width = tmAveCharWidth * otmEMSquare /
// xAvgCharWidth -- i.e. it renders the substitute font at whatever
// horizontal size makes ITS OWN average character width match the
// ORIGINAL font's, so the substituted text keeps the same overall
// footprint the app/comctl32 already measured and sized layout around).
// This is the DirectWrite/GDI-metrics equivalent: hdc still has the
// ORIGINAL (pre-substitution) font selected at this point in every caller
// (they copy its LOGFONTW into a local `lf` and only change the copy's
// face/size before calling here), so GetTextMetricsW(hdc, ...) reads the
// original's tmAveCharWidth directly with no need to touch hdc's selection.
// Returns 1.0f (no-op) if either font's metrics aren't available, or the
// ratio would be a wild distortion -- guards a bad measurement from
// visibly squashing/stretching text instead of just leaving it unscaled.
static float ComputeWinUiWidthScale(HDC hdc, const LOGFONTW& targetLf)
{
    TEXTMETRICW tmOriginal = {};
    if (!GetTextMetricsW(hdc, &tmOriginal) || tmOriginal.tmAveCharWidth <= 0)
        return 1.0f;

    HFONT targetFont = CreateFontIndirectW(&targetLf);
    if (!targetFont)
        return 1.0f;
    HGDIOBJ oldFont = SelectObject(hdc, targetFont);
    TEXTMETRICW tmTarget = {};
    bool ok = GetTextMetricsW(hdc, &tmTarget) && tmTarget.tmAveCharWidth > 0;
    SelectObject(hdc, oldFont);
    DeleteObject(targetFont);
    if (!ok)
        return 1.0f;

    const float scale = (float)tmOriginal.tmAveCharWidth / (float)tmTarget.tmAveCharWidth;
    const float clamped = std::clamp(scale, 0.7f, 1.3f);

    // Full compensation reads as noticeably smaller than the surrounding
    // native-font text. Blend partway back toward 1.0 -- keeps most of the
    // anti-clipping correction while landing closer to the original visual
    // size. Tune this fraction to trade size vs. safety margin (1.0 = full
    // compensation, 0.0 = no compensation at all).
    constexpr float kWidthScaleStrength = 0.4f;
    return 1.0f - (1.0f - clamped) * kWidthScaleStrength;
}

static bool TryDrawNavigationTextCached(HDC hdc, const RECT& rect,
    const std::wstring& text, size_t accelPos, const LOGFONTW& font,
    COLORREF color, UINT flags, IDWriteFactory* factory, IDWriteTextFormat* format,
    float opacity);

// Draws WinUI-styled label text (tab labels, group headers) via DirectWrite
// instead of GDI, using the same LOGFONTW the GDI fallback would select.
// Grayscale AA: ClearType isn't per-font in D2D, it's a render-target-wide
// mode. CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget binds a premultiplied BGRA target to the
// real window HDC, so brush opacity remains available for translucent WinUI
// tokens such as disabled menu text while grayscale stays predictable.
static bool DrawWinUiStyledTextDWrite(HDC hdc, LPCRECT rc, LPCWSTR text, int cch,
    const LOGFONTW& lf, COLORREF color, UINT dtFlags, bool tightWidth = false,
    float sizeOverride = 0.0f, float opacity = 1.0f,
    int horizontalInkPaddingPx = 0, int verticalInkPaddingPx = 0,
    bool navigationGpu = false, int preservedVerticalInkPaddingPx = 0)
{
    if (!g_d2dFactory || !hdc || !rc || !text)
        return false;
    const int textLen = cch >= 0 ? cch : (int)wcslen(text);
    if (textLen <= 0)
        return false;

    // A positive lfHeight is the cell height, not the em size the format
    // takes: convert it the way GDI resolves that font.
    if (sizeOverride <= 0.0f && lf.lfHeight > 0) {
        if (HFONT cellFont = CreateFontIndirectW(&lf)) {
            const HGDIOBJ previous = SelectObject(hdc, cellFont);
            TEXTMETRICW tm = {};
            if (previous && GetTextMetricsW(hdc, &tm) &&
                tm.tmHeight > tm.tmInternalLeading)
                sizeOverride = static_cast<float>(tm.tmHeight - tm.tmInternalLeading);
            if (previous)
                SelectObject(hdc, previous);
            DeleteObject(cellFont);
        }
    }

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> fmt;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteFactory> dwFactory;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_winUiTextDwMutex);
        IDWriteFactory* rawFactory = WinUiTextEnsureDWriteFactoryLocked();
        if (!rawFactory)
            return false;
        dwFactory = rawFactory; // own a ref -- used below, after the lock
        fmt = g_winUiTextDwFormatCache.Ensure(
            rawFactory, lf, dtFlags, DpiForPaintHdc(hdc), sizeOverride);
    }
    if (!fmt)
        return false;

    size_t accelPos = SIZE_MAX;
    std::wstring stripped = StripMnemonicPrefix(text, textLen, dtFlags, &accelPos);

    const int horizontalInkPad = (std::max)(0, horizontalInkPaddingPx);
    const int verticalInkPad = (std::max)({0, verticalInkPaddingPx,
        preservedVerticalInkPaddingPx});
    const bool relaxHdcClip = horizontalInkPad > 0 || verticalInkPaddingPx > 0;
    if (verticalInkPad > 32 || rc->top < LONG_MIN + verticalInkPad ||
        rc->bottom > LONG_MAX - verticalInkPad)
        return false;

    // Only the two navigation-label routes opt in. Every other caller keeps
    // the existing software target, clipping, opacity and mnemonic handling.
    if (navigationGpu && !tightWidth && !relaxHdcClip && !verticalInkPad &&
        TryDrawNavigationTextCached(hdc, *rc, stripped, accelPos, lf, color,
            dtFlags, dwFactory.Get(), fmt.Get(), opacity))
        return true;

    // BindDC observes the HDC clip. Only popup-menu callers that explicitly
    // request extra ink padding may relax a narrower text clip; tabs and every
    // other zero-padding caller retain the native control/update-region clip.
    int saved = 0;
    if (relaxHdcClip) {
        saved = SaveDC(hdc);
        if (!saved)
            return false;
        if (SelectClipRgn(hdc, nullptr) == ERROR) {
            RestoreDC(hdc, saved);
            return false;
        }
    }

    RECT bindRect = *rc;
    bindRect.left -= horizontalInkPad;
    bindRect.top -= verticalInkPad;
    bindRect.right += horizontalInkPad;
    bindRect.bottom += verticalInkPad;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &bindRect, g_d2dFactory, &rt)) || !rt) {
        if (saved)
            RestoreDC(hdc, saved);
        return false;
    }

    D2D1_COLOR_F d2dColor = {};
    d2dColor.r = GetRValue(color) / 255.0f;
    d2dColor.g = GetGValue(color) / 255.0f;
    d2dColor.b = GetBValue(color) / 255.0f;
    d2dColor.a = std::clamp(opacity, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt.Get(), d2dColor);
    if (!brush) {
        if (saved)
            RestoreDC(hdc, saved);
        return false;
    }

    const D2D1_RECT_F textRect = D2D1::RectF(
        (float)horizontalInkPad, (float)verticalInkPad,
        (float)(horizontalInkPad + rc->right - rc->left),
        (float)(verticalInkPad + rc->bottom - rc->top));

    // Substitute glyphs render wider on average than the native font
    // comctl32/the app already measured and wrapped/sized layout around.
    // Only worth compensating for callers whose rect can't just grow to
    // absorb the difference (wrap text sized tightly against sibling
    // controls in a dialog template, or Tab captions sized to the native
    // button width via `tightWidth`) -- every other caller already grows
    // its rect via GrowRectForWinUiText and stays untouched here.
    //
    // Tight single-line captions use exact per-string measurements: only
    // compensate when native GDI says the caption fits (including its
    // one-pixel exclusive-edge tolerance) but DirectWrite says it doesn't.
    // Wrapped labels retain their existing average-font compensation, gated
    // by an actual extra-line overflow. Both avoid shrinking text that
    // already fits instead of guessing from DPI alone.
    const bool wrapText = !(dtFlags & DT_SINGLELINE);
    float widthScale = 1.0f;
    if (tightWidth && !wrapText) {
        const float availableWidth = textRect.right - textRect.left;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextLayout> probeLayout;
        if (availableWidth > 0.0f &&
            SUCCEEDED(dwFactory->CreateTextLayout(stripped.c_str(),
                (UINT32)stripped.size(), fmt.Get(), 100000.0f,
                textRect.bottom - textRect.top, &probeLayout)) &&
            probeLayout) {
            DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS metrics = {};
            if (SUCCEEDED(probeLayout->GetMetrics(&metrics))) {
                const float naturalWidth =
                    metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace;
                SIZE nativeExtent = {};
                if (naturalWidth > availableWidth &&
                    GetTextExtentPoint32W(hdc, stripped.c_str(),
                        static_cast<int>(stripped.size()), &nativeExtent) &&
                    nativeExtent.cx > 0 &&
                    nativeExtent.cx <= static_cast<LONG>(
                        std::floor(availableWidth)) + 1) {
                    const float fittedWidth = std::min(
                        static_cast<float>(nativeExtent.cx),
                        std::max(0.75f, availableWidth - 0.25f));
                    const float exactScale = fittedWidth / naturalWidth;
                    // A larger mismatch indicates a genuinely incompatible
                    // metric/font contract; preserve native ellipsis rather
                    // than visibly crushing the caption.
                    if (exactScale >= 0.75f && exactScale < 1.0f)
                        widthScale = exactScale;
                }
            }
        }
    } else if (wrapText) {
        bool needsCompensation = true;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextLayout> probeLayout;
        if (SUCCEEDED(dwFactory->CreateTextLayout(stripped.c_str(), (UINT32)stripped.size(),
                fmt.Get(), textRect.right - textRect.left, 100000.0f,
                &probeLayout)) && probeLayout) {
            DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS metrics = {};
            if (SUCCEEDED(probeLayout->GetMetrics(&metrics)))
                needsCompensation =
                    metrics.height > (textRect.bottom - textRect.top) + 0.5f;
        }
        if (needsCompensation)
            widthScale = std::min(1.0f, ComputeWinUiWidthScale(hdc, lf));
    }

    FPUGuard fpu;
    const D2D1_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_MODE oldTextAntialiasMode =
        rt->GetTextAntialiasMode();
    rt->SetTextAntialiasMode(D2D1_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_MODE_GRAYSCALE);
    rt->BeginDraw();
    DrawMnemonicAwareText(rt.Get(), dwFactory.Get(), fmt.Get(), stripped, accelPos, dtFlags,
        textRect, brush, widthScale,
        (relaxHdcClip || verticalInkPad > 0)
            ? D2D1_DRAW_TEXT_OPTIONS_NONE
            : D2D1_DRAW_TEXT_OPTIONS_CLIP);
    rt->SetTextAntialiasMode(oldTextAntialiasMode);
    const HRESULT hr = rt->EndDraw();
    if (hr == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET)
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();

    if (saved)
        RestoreDC(hdc, saved);
    return SUCCEEDED(hr);
}

static bool ResolveDesktopTextFontMetricsLocked(IDWriteFactory* factory)
{
    if (g_desktopTextFontMetrics.attempted)
        return g_desktopTextFontMetrics.unitsPerEm != 0;
    g_desktopTextFontMetrics.attempted = true;
    if (!factory)
        return false;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteFontCollection> collection;
    if (FAILED(factory->GetSystemFontCollection(&collection)) || !collection)
        return false;

    constexpr LPCWSTR families[] = {L"Segoe UI Variable Text", L"Segoe UI"};
    for (LPCWSTR familyName : families) {
        UINT32 familyIndex = 0;
        BOOL familyExists = FALSE;
        if (FAILED(collection->FindFamilyName(
                familyName, &familyIndex, &familyExists)) || !familyExists)
            continue;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteFontFamily> family;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteFont> font;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteFontFace> face;
        if (FAILED(collection->GetFontFamily(familyIndex, &family)) || !family ||
            FAILED(family->GetFirstMatchingFont(DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL,
                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL, &font)) || !font ||
            FAILED(font->CreateFontFace(&face)) || !face)
            continue;

        const void* tableData = nullptr;
        UINT32 tableSize = 0;
        void* tableContext = nullptr;
        BOOL tableExists = FALSE;
        HRESULT hr = face->TryGetFontTable(
            DWRITE_MAKE_OPENTYPE_TAG('O', 'S', '/', '2'), &tableData,
            &tableSize, &tableContext, &tableExists);
        if (FAILED(hr) || !tableExists || !tableData)
            continue;

        DWRITE_FONT_METRICS metrics = {};
        face->GetMetrics(&metrics);
        INT16 averageWidth = 0;
        if (tableSize >= 4) {
            const auto* bytes = static_cast<const BYTE*>(tableData);
            averageWidth = static_cast<INT16>(
                (static_cast<UINT16>(bytes[2]) << 8) | bytes[3]);
        }
        face->ReleaseFontTable(tableContext);
        if (!metrics.designUnitsPerEm || averageWidth <= 0)
            continue;

        wcscpy_s(g_desktopTextFontMetrics.family, familyName);
        g_desktopTextFontMetrics.unitsPerEm = metrics.designUnitsPerEm;
        g_desktopTextFontMetrics.averageWidth = averageWidth;
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

static bool GetCurrent32BppDib(HDC hdc, DIBSECTION* dib)
{
    if (!dib)
        return false;

    HBITMAP bitmap = static_cast<HBITMAP>(GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_BITMAP));
    *dib = {};
    return bitmap && GetObjectW(bitmap, sizeof(*dib), dib) == sizeof(*dib) &&
        dib->dsBm.bmBits && dib->dsBm.bmBitsPixel == 32 &&
        dib->dsBm.bmWidth > 0 && std::abs(dib->dsBm.bmHeight) > 0 &&
        dib->dsBm.bmWidthBytes >= dib->dsBm.bmWidth * 4;
}

static void PrepareCurrentDibShadowMask(HDC hdc, BYTE opacity)
{
    DIBSECTION dib = {};
    if (!GetCurrent32BppDib(hdc, &dib))
        return;

    const LONG width = dib.dsBm.bmWidth;
    const LONG height = std::abs(dib.dsBm.bmHeight);
    auto* row = static_cast<BYTE*>(dib.dsBm.bmBits);
    for (LONG y = 0; y < height; ++y) {
        auto* pixels = reinterpret_cast<UINT32*>(row);
        for (LONG x = 0; x < width; ++x) {
            const UINT32 pixel = pixels[x];
            const UINT32 b = ((pixel & 0xFFu) * opacity + 127u) / 255u;
            const UINT32 g = (((pixel >> 8) & 0xFFu) * opacity + 127u) / 255u;
            const UINT32 r = (((pixel >> 16) & 0xFFu) * opacity + 127u) / 255u;
            pixels[x] = b | (g << 8) | (r << 16);
        }
        row += dib.dsBm.bmWidthBytes;
    }
}

static void LegacyRebarTextBeginPaint(HWND hwnd, LPCWSTR windowClass)
{
    const bool enabled = (g_settings.RoundedButtons || (g_settings.ExplorerSection &&
        (g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite || g_settings.DialogTextDirectWrite))) &&
        !IsTextPipelineDisabled();
    if (!enabled && !g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth && !g_ribbonDirectTextDC)
        return;
    auto kind = enabled ? ClassifyLegacyRebarText(hwnd, windowClass)
        : LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    if (!LegacyRebarTextKindEnabled(kind))
        kind = LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    if (kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::Ribbon) {
        if (g_ribbonTextHost != hwnd)
            g_ribbonDrawTextCaller = nullptr;
        g_ribbonTextHost = hwnd;
    }
    if (!g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth && !g_ribbonDirectTextDC &&
        kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::None)
        return;
    const unsigned depth = g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth++;
    if (depth < ARRAYSIZE(g_legacyRebarTextPaints)) {
        g_legacyRebarTextPaints[depth] = {hwnd, kind};
    }
}

        kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::None)

        g_legacyRebarTextPaints[depth] = {hwnd, kind};
}

static void LegacyRebarTextEndPaint(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth)
        return;
    if (g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth > ARRAYSIZE(g_legacyRebarTextPaints)) {
        --g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth;
        return;
    }
    // EndPaint must match the active paint; an unexpected order fails closed.
    if (g_legacyRebarTextPaints[g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth - 1].hwnd != hwnd) {
        static thread_local unsigned mismatches = 0;
        if (mismatches < 4) {
            ++mismatches;
            Wh_Log(L"Explorer text: paint scope mismatch end=%p expected=%p depth=%u",
                hwnd, g_legacyRebarTextPaints[g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth - 1].hwnd,
                g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth);
        }
        g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth = 0;
        return;
    }
    g_legacyRebarTextPaints[--g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth] = {};
}

static LegacyRebarTextPaint LegacyRebarTextForDc(HDC hdc)
{
    const unsigned depth = g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth;
    if (!hdc || depth > ARRAYSIZE(g_legacyRebarTextPaints) ||
        g_legacyRebarTextNative || g_glowEntry ||
        IsTextPipelineDisabled())
        return {};
    if (!depth)
        return hdc == g_ribbonDirectTextDC && g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite
            ? g_ribbonDirectTextPaint
            : LegacyRebarTextPaint{};
    const auto paint = g_legacyRebarTextPaints[depth - 1];
    if (paint.kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::None || !LegacyRebarTextKindEnabled(paint.kind))
        return {};
    if (paint.kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogDirectUi && hdc != g_dialogDuiTextDC)
        return {};
    const HWND dcWindow = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    return !dcWindow || dcWindow == paint.hwnd ? paint : LegacyRebarTextPaint{};
}

// Finished label rasters shared by Explorer's UI threads. A key holds every
// input its drawing path derives the pixels from, so it is built before any
// text layout and a hit skips both the layout and the raster. Destination DCs
// and the copy into a thread's DIB never leave the painting thread.
struct ShellTextRasterKey {
    std::wstring_view text, face;
    std::array<uint32_t, 28> values = {};
    COLORREF color = 0;
    uint64_t generation = 0;
    uint32_t rendererKind = 0;
    uint64_t Hash() const
    {
        uint64_t hash = std::hash<std::wstring_view>{}(text);
        auto combine = [&](uint64_t value) {
            hash ^= value + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL + (hash << 6) + (hash >> 2);
        };
        combine(std::hash<std::wstring_view>{}(face));
        for (uint32_t value : values) combine(value);
        combine(color);
        combine(generation);
        combine(rendererKind);
        return hash;
    }
};
static uint32_t ShellTextFloatBits(float value)
{
    uint32_t result;
    memcpy(&result, &value, sizeof(result));
    return result;
}

class ShellTextRasterCache {
public:
    static constexpr size_t kMaxEntries = 512;
    static constexpr size_t kMaxBytes = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
    static constexpr size_t kMaxEntryBytes = 256 * 1024;
    struct Entry {
        std::wstring text, face;
        std::array<uint32_t, 28> values;
        COLORREF color;
        uint32_t rendererKind;
        int result;
        std::vector<BYTE> pixels;
        size_t bytes;
        std::list<uint64_t>::iterator recent;
    };
    void Clear()
    {
        entries_.clear();
        recent_.clear();
        bytes_ = 0;
    }
    void SyncGeneration(uint64_t generation)
    {
        if (generation_ != generation) {
            Clear();
            generation_ = generation;
        }
    }
    bool Eligible(const ShellTextRasterKey& key, size_t pixelBytes) const
    {
        return key.generation == generation_ && key.text.size() <= 1024 &&
            pixelBytes <= kMaxEntryBytes;
    }
    const Entry* Find(const ShellTextRasterKey& key, uint64_t hash)
    {
        auto found = entries_.find(hash);
        if (found == entries_.end()) return nullptr;
        auto& entry = found->second;
        // Hash collisions never reuse another label's image.
        if (entry.values != key.values || entry.color != key.color ||
            entry.rendererKind != key.rendererKind ||
            entry.text != key.text || entry.face != key.face) return nullptr;
        recent_.splice(recent_.begin(), recent_, entry.recent);
        return &entry;
    }
    bool Store(const ShellTextRasterKey& key, uint64_t hash,
        const ShellTextRaster& source, UINT width, UINT height, int result)
    {
        try {
            Entry entry;
            entry.text = key.text;
            entry.face = key.face;
            entry.values = key.values;
            entry.color = key.color;
            entry.rendererKind = key.rendererKind;
            entry.result = result;
            const size_t rowBytes = static_cast<size_t>(width) * 4;
            entry.pixels.resize(rowBytes * height);
            for (UINT y = 0; y < height; ++y)
                memcpy(entry.pixels.data() + y * rowBytes,
                    source.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * source.width * 4, rowBytes);
            entry.bytes = sizeof(Entry) + 6 * sizeof(void*) + entry.pixels.capacity() +
                (entry.text.capacity() + entry.face.capacity() + 2) * sizeof(wchar_t);
            auto erase = [&](auto found) {
                bytes_ -= found->second.bytes;
                recent_.erase(found->second.recent);
                entries_.erase(found);
            };
            if (auto found = entries_.find(hash); found != entries_.end()) erase(found);
            while (!recent_.empty() && (entries_.size() >= kMaxEntries || bytes_ + entry.bytes > kMaxBytes))
                erase(entries_.find(recent_.back()));
            recent_.push_front(hash);
            entry.recent = recent_.begin();
            const size_t bytes = entry.bytes;
            try {
                entries_.emplace(hash, std::move(entry));
            } catch (...) {
                recent_.pop_front();
                throw;
            }
            bytes_ += bytes;
            return true;
        } catch (const std::bad_alloc&) {
            return false;
        }
    }
private:
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, Entry> entries_;
    std::list<uint64_t> recent_;
    size_t bytes_ = 0;
    uint64_t generation_ = 0;
};

static void ShellTextRasterLogError(LPCWSTR stage, HRESULT error)
{
    const unsigned index = g_shellTextRasterErrorLogs.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (index < 8)
        Wh_Log(L"[SHELLTEXT] error stage=%s hr=0x%08lX fallback=software-DirectWrite",
            stage, static_cast<unsigned long>(error));
    else if (index == 8)
        Wh_Log(L"[SHELLTEXT] further errors suppressed");
}
