// Size and device-transform limits of the cached raster, which is blended at
// device coordinates.
static bool ShellTextRasterUsable(HDC hdc, LONG width, LONG height)
{
    if (!g_settings.ShellTextRasterCache ||
        g_shellTextRasterUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        width <= 0 || height <= 0 || width > 2048 || height > 512 ||
        static_cast<size_t>(width) * height * 4 > ShellTextRasterCache::kMaxEntryBytes ||
        (GetLayout(hdc) & LAYOUT_RTL))
        return false;
    XFORM world = {};
    return GetGraphicsMode(hdc) != GM_ADVANCED ||
        (GetWorldTransform(hdc, &world) && world.eM11 == 1 && world.eM22 == 1 &&
            world.eM12 == 0 && world.eM21 == 0 && world.eDx == 0 && world.eDy == 0);
}
static bool ShellTextRasterBlend(HDC hdc, const RECT& rect, ShellTextRaster& raster)
{
    const BLENDFUNCTION function = {AC_SRC_OVER, 0, 255, AC_SRC_ALPHA};
    if (AlphaBlend(hdc, rect.left, rect.top, rect.right - rect.left,
            rect.bottom - rect.top, raster.dc, 0, 0, rect.right - rect.left,
            rect.bottom - rect.top, function))
        return true;
    const DWORD error = GetLastError();
    ShellTextRasterLogError(L"AlphaBlend", error ? HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(error) : E_FAIL);
    return false;
}
// A hit: copies the cached pixels to (0,0) of this thread's DIB.
static ShellTextRaster* ShellTextRasterLoad(UINT width, UINT height,
    const ShellTextRasterKey& key, uint64_t hash, int* result)
{
    D2DThreadCache* thread = D2DGetThreadCache();
    if (!thread)
        return nullptr;
    auto& raster = thread->shellTextRaster;
    GdiFlush(); // Finish reads of the previous DIB before overwriting its pixels.
    if (FAILED(raster.EnsureDib(width, height)))
        return nullptr;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_shellTextRasterMutex);
    auto& cache = g_shellTextRasterCache;
    cache.SyncGeneration(ShellTextRasterGeneration());
    const auto* entry = cache.Find(key, hash);
    if (!entry)
        return nullptr;
    const size_t rowBytes = static_cast<size_t>(width) * 4;
    for (UINT y = 0; y < height; ++y)
        memcpy(raster.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * raster.width * 4,
            entry->pixels.data() + y * rowBytes, rowBytes);
    if (result)
        *result = entry->result;
    return &raster;
}
static bool ShellTextRasterDrawCached(HDC hdc, const RECT& rect,
    const ShellTextRasterKey& key, uint64_t hash, int* result)
{
    ShellTextRaster* raster = ShellTextRasterLoad(rect.right - rect.left,
        rect.bottom - rect.top, key, hash, result);
    return raster && ShellTextRasterBlend(hdc, rect, *raster);
}
// A miss: `draw` renders with `color` on this thread's CPU target; the pixels
// land at (0,0) of its DIB and in the cache. A `draw` that returns false
// caches nothing.
template <typename Draw>
static ShellTextRaster* ShellTextRasterRender(UINT width, UINT height,
    COLORREF color, const ShellTextRasterKey& key, uint64_t hash, int result,
    Draw&& draw, bool cacheResult = true)
{
    D2DThreadCache* thread = D2DGetThreadCache();
    if (!thread)
        return nullptr;
    auto& raster = thread->shellTextRaster;
    GdiFlush();
    FPUGuard fpu;
    HRESULT hr = raster.EnsureTarget(g_d2dFactory, width, height);
    if (FAILED(hr)) {
        ShellTextRasterLogError(L"raster-target", hr);
        return nullptr;
    }
    hr = raster.EnsureDib(width, height);
    if (FAILED(hr)) {
        ShellTextRasterLogError(L"raster-DIB", hr);
        return nullptr;
    }

    auto* target = raster.target.Get();
    raster.brush->SetColor(D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(color) / 255.0f,
        GetGValue(color) / 255.0f, GetBValue(color) / 255.0f, 1.0f));
    target->BeginDraw();
    target->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
    target->PushAxisAlignedClip(D2D1::RectF(0, 0, width, height),
        D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_ALIASED);
    target->Clear(D2D1::ColorF(0, 0.0f));
    const bool drawn = draw(target, raster.brush.Get());
    target->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
    target->PopAxisAlignedClip();
    hr = target->EndDraw();
    if (FAILED(hr)) {
        raster.ResetTarget();
        ShellTextRasterLogError(L"EndDraw", hr);
        return nullptr;
    }
    if (!drawn)
        return nullptr;

    const WICRect lockRect = {0, 0, static_cast<INT>(width), static_cast<INT>(height)};
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IWICBitmapLock> bitmapLock;
    UINT stride = 0, size = 0;
    BYTE* data = nullptr;
    hr = raster.wicBitmap->Lock(&lockRect, WICBitmapLockRead, &bitmapLock);
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) hr = bitmapLock->GetStride(&stride);
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) hr = bitmapLock->GetDataPointer(&size, &data);
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && (!data || stride < width * 4))
        hr = E_UNEXPECTED;
    if (FAILED(hr)) {
        ShellTextRasterLogError(L"raster-lock", hr);
        return nullptr;
    }
    for (UINT y = 0; y < height; ++y)
        memcpy(raster.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * raster.width * 4,
            data + static_cast<size_t>(y) * stride, static_cast<size_t>(width) * 4);
    bitmapLock.Reset();

    if (cacheResult) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_shellTextRasterMutex);
        auto& cache = g_shellTextRasterCache;
        cache.SyncGeneration(ShellTextRasterGeneration());
        if (cache.Eligible(key, static_cast<size_t>(width) * height * 4))
            cache.Store(key, hash, raster, width, height, result);
    }
    return &raster;
}
static bool ShellTextRasterDrawLayout(HDC hdc, const RECT& rect,
    IDWriteTextLayout* layout, D2D1_POINT_2F origin, float scale, COLORREF color,
    const ShellTextRasterKey& key, uint64_t hash, int result, float opacity = 1.f,
    D2D1_DRAW_TEXT_OPTIONS options = D2D1_DRAW_TEXT_OPTIONS_CLIP)
{
    if (!layout)
        return false;
    ShellTextRaster* raster = ShellTextRasterRender(rect.right - rect.left,
        rect.bottom - rect.top, color, key, hash, result,
        [&](ID2D1RenderTarget* target, ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush) {
            target->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Scale(scale, 1.0f));
            brush->SetOpacity(opacity);
            target->DrawTextLayout(origin, layout, brush, options);
            brush->SetOpacity(1.f);
            return true;
        });
    return raster && ShellTextRasterBlend(hdc, rect, *raster);
}

// Resting SVG glyphs (DrawSvgGeom) share the cache: the fill is kept as
// premultiplied pixels per glyph, size, fit scale and color.
static ShellTextRasterKey ShellTextMakeGlyphKey(const wchar_t* glyph,
    bool filled, LONG width, LONG height, float scale, COLORREF color,
    uint64_t generation)
{
    ShellTextRasterKey key;
    key.text = std::wstring_view(glyph, 1);
    key.face = L"svg";
    key.values = {filled ? 1u : 0u, static_cast<uint32_t>(width),
        static_cast<uint32_t>(height), ShellTextFloatBits(scale)};
    key.color = color;
    key.generation = generation;
    key.rendererKind = 2;
    return key;
}

// A tree expand chevron that isn't turning, as DrawChevronGlyphOnRT draws it:
// the icon-font glyph in TextFillColorPrimary, centered in the cell and
// rotated by the animation's resting angle.
static bool DrawChevronGlyphCached(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, const wchar_t* glyph,
    float angle, int fontSizePx, bool dark, bool pressed = false,
    const WinUI::Color* foreground = nullptr)
{
    const LONG width = rc.right - rc.left, height = rc.bottom - rc.top;
    if (GetMapMode(hdc) != MM_TEXT || !ShellTextRasterUsable(hdc, width, height))
        return false;
    const WinUI::Color fg = foreground ? *foreground
        : pressed ? WinUI::TextFillColorSecondary(dark)
                  : WinUI::TextFillColorPrimary(dark);
    ShellTextRasterKey key;
    key.text = std::wstring_view(glyph, 1);
    key.face = L"chevron";
    key.values = {static_cast<uint32_t>(fontSizePx), static_cast<uint32_t>(width),
        static_cast<uint32_t>(height), ShellTextFloatBits(angle), fg.alpha};
    key.color = fg.rgb;
    key.generation = ShellTextRasterGeneration();
    key.rendererKind = 3;
    const uint64_t hash = key.Hash();
    ShellTextRaster* raster = ShellTextRasterLoad(width, height, key, hash, nullptr);
    if (!raster) {
        auto format = GlyphDWFormatEnsure(fontSizePx);
        if (!format)
            return false;
        raster = ShellTextRasterRender(width, height, fg.rgb, key, hash, 0,
            [&](ID2D1RenderTarget* target, ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush) {
                const float w = static_cast<float>(width), h = static_cast<float>(height);
                if (angle != 0.f)
                    target->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Rotation(angle,
                        D2D1::Point2F(w * 0.5f, h * 0.5f)));
                brush->SetOpacity(fg.alpha / 255.f);
                target->DrawTextW(glyph, 1, format.Get(), D2D1::RectF(0, 0, w, h), brush);
                brush->SetOpacity(1.f);
                return true;
            });
    }
    return raster && ShellTextRasterBlend(hdc, rc, *raster);
}
static bool PaintTreeViewGlyphCached(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, const wchar_t* glyph,
    float angle, float scale, bool dark, bool pressed)
{
    return DrawChevronGlyphCached(hdc, rc, glyph, angle,
        std::max(1, (int)std::lround(kTreeViewChevronGlyphDip * scale)),
        dark, pressed);
}

static bool TryDrawNavigationTextCached(HDC hdc, const RECT& rect,
    const std::wstring& text, size_t accelPos, const LOGFONTW& font,
    COLORREF color, UINT flags, IDWriteFactory* factory, IDWriteTextFormat* format,
    float opacity)
{
    const LONG width = rect.right - rect.left, height = rect.bottom - rect.top;
    if (!factory || !format || text.empty() || GetMapMode(hdc) != MM_TEXT ||
        !(flags & DT_SINGLELINE) || (flags & (DT_CALCRECT | DT_MODIFYSTRING)) ||
        (accelPos != SIZE_MAX && !(flags & DT_HIDEPREFIX)) ||
        !ShellTextRasterUsable(hdc, width, height)) {
        return false;
    }

    auto key = ShellTextMakeNavigationKey(text, font, DpiForPaintHdc(hdc),
        flags, width, height, color, ShellTextRasterGeneration());
    key.values[12] = ShellTextFloatBits(opacity);
    const uint64_t hash = key.Hash();
    if (ShellTextRasterDrawCached(hdc, rect, key, hash, nullptr))
        return true;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextLayout> layout;
    if (FAILED(factory->CreateTextLayout(text.c_str(),
            static_cast<UINT32>(text.size()), format, static_cast<float>(width),
            static_cast<float>(height), &layout)) || !layout)
        return false;
    return ShellTextRasterDrawLayout(hdc, rect, layout.Get(),
        D2D1::Point2F(0, 0), 1.0f, color, key, hash, 0, opacity);
}

static bool NavTV_DrawTextDWrite(HWND tree, HDC hdc, const RECT& rect,
    LPCWSTR text, int length, const LOGFONTW& font, COLORREF color, UINT flags)
{
    const bool cached = g_settings.ShellTextRasterCache &&
        ShellTextIsExplorerNavigationHost(tree);
    const bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    const WinUI::Color foreground = NavigationItemForegroundColor(dark,
        g_settings.NeutralSelection, color, IsTreeRowPressed(tree, &rect));
    return DrawWinUiStyledTextDWrite(hdc, &rect, text, length,
        font, foreground.rgb, flags, false, 0.0f,
        foreground.alpha / 255.f, 0, 0, cached);
}

static bool ShellTextNoClipBounds(const RECT& rect,
    const DWRITE_OVERHANG_METRICS& ink, float widthScale,
    RECT* bounds, D2D1_POINT_2F* origin)
{
    if (!bounds || !origin || !std::isfinite(widthScale) || widthScale <= 0.0f ||
        rect.right <= rect.left || rect.bottom <= rect.top)
        return false;
    const float overhangs[] = {
        ink.left * widthScale, ink.top, ink.right * widthScale, ink.bottom};
    LONG padding[4] = {};
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < ARRAYSIZE(padding); ++i) {
        if (!std::isfinite(overhangs[i]) || overhangs[i] > 2048.0f)
            return false;
        // Pixel snapping can extend the measured ink by a pixel.
        padding[i] = static_cast<LONG>(std::ceil(std::max(0.0f, overhangs[i]))) + 1;
    }
    const int64_t left = static_cast<int64_t>(rect.left) - padding[0];
    const int64_t top = static_cast<int64_t>(rect.top) - padding[1];
    const int64_t right = static_cast<int64_t>(rect.right) + padding[2];
    const int64_t bottom = static_cast<int64_t>(rect.bottom) + padding[3];
    if (left < LONG_MIN || top < LONG_MIN || right > LONG_MAX ||
        bottom > LONG_MAX || right - left > 2048 || bottom - top > 512)
        return false;
    *bounds = {static_cast<LONG>(left), static_cast<LONG>(top),
        static_cast<LONG>(right), static_cast<LONG>(bottom)};
    *origin = D2D1::Point2F(padding[0] / widthScale, static_cast<float>(padding[1]));
    return true;
}

static bool DrawShellItemTextDWrite(HDC hdc, LPCWSTR text, int cch,
    LPCRECT rc, UINT dtFlags, unsigned pass, INT* result,
    LONG weightBoost = 50, float heightReduction = 0.5f,
    const ShellTextExtPlacement* extPlacement = nullptr,
    bool allowRasterCache = false, bool noLayoutClip = false,
    bool preserveNativeAdvance = false, bool nativeDialogLayout = false,
    int preservedVerticalInkPaddingPx = 0)
{
    if (!g_d2dFactory || !hdc || !text || !rc || !result ||
        GetMapMode(hdc) != MM_TEXT || (dtFlags & (DT_CALCRECT | DT_MODIFYSTRING)))
        return false;

    const int textLen = cch >= 0 ? cch : static_cast<int>(wcslen(text));
    const LONG width = rc->right - rc->left;
    const LONG height = rc->bottom - rc->top;
    if (textLen <= 0 || width <= 0 || height <= 0)
        return false;
    // Extend only the ink surface. Layout, horizontal clipping and the HDC's
    // control/update/selection clip remain native, unlike popup-menu padding.
    const int verticalInkPad = noLayoutClip ? 0 : preservedVerticalInkPaddingPx;
    if (verticalInkPad < 0 || verticalInkPad > 32 ||
        rc->top < LONG_MIN + verticalInkPad ||
        rc->bottom > LONG_MAX - verticalInkPad ||
        height > LONG_MAX - verticalInkPad * 2)
        return false;
    RECT bindRect = *rc;
    bindRect.top -= verticalInkPad;
    bindRect.bottom += verticalInkPad;
    if (preserveNativeAdvance &&
        (!(dtFlags & DT_SINGLELINE) ||
         (dtFlags & (DT_END_ELLIPSIS | DT_WORD_ELLIPSIS | DT_PATH_ELLIPSIS))))
        return false;
    if (noLayoutClip && (extPlacement || !(dtFlags & DT_NOCLIP) ||
        (!nativeDialogLayout &&
            (!(dtFlags & DT_SINGLELINE) || !(dtFlags & DT_NOPREFIX))) ||
        GetGraphicsMode(hdc) != GM_COMPATIBLE || GetLayout(hdc) != 0 ||
        GetTextCharacterExtra(hdc) != 0))
        return false;

    LOGFONTW targetFont = {};
    TEXTMETRICW originalMetrics = {};
    HFONT selectedFont = static_cast<HFONT>(GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT));
    if (!selectedFont ||
        GetObjectW(selectedFont, sizeof(targetFont), &targetFont) != sizeof(targetFont) ||
        !GetTextMetricsW(hdc, &originalMetrics))
        return false;
    const LOGFONTW sourceFont = targetFont;
    if (noLayoutClip && (sourceFont.lfEscapement || sourceFont.lfOrientation))
        return false;

    const LONG emHeight = targetFont.lfHeight < 0
        ? -targetFont.lfHeight
        : originalMetrics.tmHeight - originalMetrics.tmInternalLeading;
    if (emHeight <= 0)
        return false;
    const float targetEmHeight = std::max(
        1.0f, static_cast<float>(emHeight) - heightReduction);
    const UINT dpi = DpiForPaintHdc(hdc);

    // Foreground desktop/folder labels and verified legacy-bar captions use
    // the raster cache; desktop shadow masks keep their native compositor and
    // the software alpha repair below. Everything after this point depends
    // only on the key's inputs, so a hit returns before any text layout.
    const COLORREF textColor = GetTextColor(hdc);
    const bool rasterCached = !noLayoutClip && pass == 2 && textColor != CLR_INVALID &&
        (allowRasterCache || (!g_duiExplorerTextPaintElement && !g_desktopDragImageTextHwnd &&
                g_desktopTextPaintHwnd && IsDesktopIconListView(g_desktopTextPaintHwnd)) ||
            (g_duiExplorerTextPaintElement && g_duiExplorerTextRasterDC &&
                (g_duiExplorerTextRasterDC == hdc ||
                    ShellTextIsExplorerFolderHost(ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc))))) &&
        ShellTextRasterUsable(hdc, width, height + verticalInkPad * 2);
    ShellTextRasterKey rasterKey;
    uint64_t rasterHash = 0;
    if (rasterCached) {
        rasterKey = ShellTextMakeItemKey(text, textLen, sourceFont,
            originalMetrics, dpi, dtFlags, width, height, weightBoost,
            heightReduction, extPlacement, *rc, textColor,
            ShellTextRasterGeneration());
        if (preserveNativeAdvance)
            rasterKey.rendererKind = 4;
        else if (nativeDialogLayout)
            rasterKey.rendererKind = 5;
        // Item keys use slots 0..25; reserve the next slot for ink padding.
        rasterKey.values[26] = static_cast<uint32_t>(verticalInkPad);
        rasterHash = rasterKey.Hash();
        if (ShellTextRasterDrawCached(hdc, bindRect, rasterKey, rasterHash, result))
            return true;
    }

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteFactory> dwFactory;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> format;
    float widthScale = 1.0f;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_winUiTextDwMutex);
        IDWriteFactory* rawFactory = WinUiTextEnsureDWriteFactoryLocked();
        if (!rawFactory || !ResolveDesktopTextFontMetricsLocked(rawFactory))
            return false;

        wcscpy_s(targetFont.lfFaceName, g_desktopTextFontMetrics.family);
        targetFont.lfHeight = -emHeight;
        targetFont.lfWidth = 0;
        targetFont.lfWeight = std::clamp<LONG>(
            targetFont.lfWeight + weightBoost, 1, 999);
        dwFactory = rawFactory;
        format = g_winUiTextDwFormatCache.Ensure(
            rawFactory, targetFont, dtFlags, dpi, targetEmHeight);

        const float targetAverageWidth = targetEmHeight *
            g_desktopTextFontMetrics.averageWidth /
            g_desktopTextFontMetrics.unitsPerEm;
        if (!preserveNativeAdvance && !nativeDialogLayout &&
            originalMetrics.tmAveCharWidth > 0 && targetAverageWidth > 0.0f) {
            widthScale = std::clamp(
                originalMetrics.tmAveCharWidth / targetAverageWidth, 0.75f, 1.25f);
        }
    }
    if (!format)
        return false;

    const bool nativeMultilineLayout = nativeDialogLayout && !extPlacement &&
        !preserveNativeAdvance && !(dtFlags & DT_SINGLELINE);
    const bool nativeExplicitLines = nativeMultilineLayout &&
        std::wstring_view(text, textLen).find_first_of(L"\r\n") != std::wstring_view::npos;
    const LONG nativeLineHeight = originalMetrics.tmHeight +
        ((dtFlags & DT_EXTERNALLEADING) ? originalMetrics.tmExternalLeading : 0);
    const float layoutWidth = extPlacement
        ? 32768.0f : static_cast<float>(width) / widthScale;
    const float layoutHeight = extPlacement
        ? std::max(static_cast<float>(height), targetEmHeight * 4.0f)
        : static_cast<float>(height);
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextLayout> layout;
    if (FAILED(dwFactory->CreateTextLayout(text, static_cast<UINT32>(textLen),
            format.Get(), layoutWidth, layoutHeight, &layout)) || !layout)
        return false;
    if ((dtFlags & DT_WORDBREAK) && !(dtFlags & DT_SINGLELINE)) {
        if (FAILED(layout->SetWordWrapping(
                DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_EMERGENCY_BREAK)))
            return false;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextLayout2> layout2;
        if (SUCCEEDED(layout.As(&layout2)) && layout2 &&
            FAILED(layout2->SetLastLineWrapping(TRUE)))
            return false;
    }
    if ((dtFlags & DT_RTLREADING) && FAILED(layout->SetReadingDirection(
            DWRITE_READING_DIRECTION_RIGHT_TO_LEFT)))
        return false;
    if (nativeMultilineLayout) {
        // The dialog sized its multiline block with GDI. DT_VCENTER/BOTTOM
        // apply only to single-line text, not this already-positioned block.
        if (nativeLineHeight <= 0 || originalMetrics.tmAscent <= 0 ||
            FAILED(layout->SetParagraphAlignment(DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_NEAR)) ||
            FAILED(layout->SetLineSpacing(DWRITE_LINE_SPACING_METHOD_UNIFORM,
                static_cast<float>(nativeLineHeight), static_cast<float>(originalMetrics.tmAscent))))
            return false;
    }
    if (preserveNativeAdvance) {
        // SysLink already splits and positions each line/link using GDI.
        // Match this run's advance, not the font's average character width.
        SIZE native = {};
        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS natural = {};
        if (!GetTextExtentPoint32W(hdc, text, textLen, &native) || native.cx <= 0 ||
            FAILED(layout->GetMetrics(&natural)) ||
            natural.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace <= 0.0f)
            return false;
        const float exactScale = native.cx / natural.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace;
        if (!std::isfinite(exactScale) || exactScale < 0.9f || exactScale > 1.1f)
            return false;
        widthScale = exactScale;
        if (FAILED(layout->SetMaxWidth(static_cast<float>(width) / widthScale)))
            return false;
    }
    if ((dtFlags & DT_WORD_ELLIPSIS) && !(dtFlags & DT_END_ELLIPSIS)) {
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteInlineObject> ellipsis;
        if (SUCCEEDED(dwFactory->CreateEllipsisTrimmingSign(
                format.Get(), &ellipsis)) && ellipsis) {
            DWRITE_TRIMMING trimming = {
                DWRITE_TRIMMING_GRANULARITY_WORD, 0, 0};
            if (FAILED(layout->SetTrimming(&trimming, ellipsis.Get())))
                return false;
        }
    }

    // The average-width compensation above preserves the footprint of the
    // original GDI font well, but a particular word can still end up a
    // fraction wider in Segoe UI Variable. Explorer often gives a label an
    // exact, pre-measured rect, so that per-word differences can make even a
    // short name such as "Pastas" trim. Only pay for exact measurements after
    // the already-created layout confirms that it really trimmed such a
    // name. GDI tolerates its integer extent ending one pixel beyond this
    // exclusive-edge rect; accept the same one-pixel near-fit and compress
    // only that word enough to stay inside Direct2D's strict clip. The render
    // target remains bound to the original rect, and genuine overflow keeps
    // its normal ellipsis.
    bool singleWord = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < textLen; ++i) {
        const wchar_t ch = text[i];
        if (ch == L' ' || ch == L'\t' || ch == L'\r' || ch == L'\n') {
            singleWord = false;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (!extPlacement && (!noLayoutClip || nativeDialogLayout) &&
        !preserveNativeAdvance && singleWord &&
        (dtFlags & (DT_END_ELLIPSIS | DT_WORD_ELLIPSIS))) {
        DWRITE_LINE_METRICS lineMetrics[4] = {};
        UINT32 lineCount = 0;
        if (SUCCEEDED(layout->GetLineMetrics(
                lineMetrics, ARRAYSIZE(lineMetrics), &lineCount))) {
            bool isTrimmed = false;
            for (UINT32 i = 0; i < lineCount; ++i)
                isTrimmed = isTrimmed || lineMetrics[i].isTrimmed;

            if (isTrimmed) {
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextLayout> probeLayout;
                const float probeHeight = std::max(
                    layoutHeight, targetEmHeight * 4.0f);
                if (SUCCEEDED(dwFactory->CreateTextLayout(text,
                        static_cast<UINT32>(textLen), format.Get(), 32768.0f,
                        probeHeight, &probeLayout)) && probeLayout) {
                    DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS probeMetrics = {};
                    if (SUCCEEDED(probeLayout->GetMetrics(&probeMetrics))) {
                        const float naturalWidth =
                            probeMetrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace;
                        const float physicalWidth = naturalWidth * widthScale;
                        SIZE gdiExtent = {};
                        if (naturalWidth > 0.0f &&
                            GetTextExtentPoint32W(
                                hdc, text, textLen, &gdiExtent) &&
                            gdiExtent.cx > 0 && gdiExtent.cx <= width + 1 &&
                            physicalWidth > static_cast<float>(width) &&
                            physicalWidth <= static_cast<float>(width) + 1.0f) {
                            const float oldMaxWidth = layout->GetMaxWidth();
                            const float fittedPhysicalWidth = std::min(
                                static_cast<float>(gdiExtent.cx),
                                std::max(0.75f,
                                    static_cast<float>(width) - 0.25f));
                            const float fittedScale =
                                std::max(0.01f,
                                    fittedPhysicalWidth / naturalWidth);
                            if (fittedScale < widthScale &&
                                SUCCEEDED(layout->SetMaxWidth(
                                    static_cast<float>(width) / fittedScale))) {
                                DWRITE_LINE_METRICS fittedLines[4] = {};
                                UINT32 fittedLineCount = 0;
                                bool stillTrimmed = true;
                                if (SUCCEEDED(layout->GetLineMetrics(fittedLines,
                                        ARRAYSIZE(fittedLines),
                                        &fittedLineCount))) {
                                    stillTrimmed = false;
                                    for (UINT32 i = 0; i < fittedLineCount; ++i)
                                        stillTrimmed = stillTrimmed ||
                                            fittedLines[i].isTrimmed;
                                }
                                if (!stillTrimmed)
                                    widthScale = fittedScale;
                                else
                                    layout->SetMaxWidth(oldMaxWidth);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // DirectUI sizes a label's rect with the GDI font. The layout above lets
    // DirectWrite break lines on its own, so a text a few pixels wider in
    // Segoe UI Variable wraps early and loses its last line to the rect
    // ("System and" for "System and Security" in Control Panel). Where GDI
    // fits the text, its line breaks are kept instead: the same lines,
    // without automatic wrapping, compressed just enough for the widest one
    // to fit. Beyond kMaxFitCompression the native GDI text is used.
    if (!extPlacement && (!noLayoutClip || nativeDialogLayout) && !preserveNativeAdvance) {
        constexpr float kMaxFitCompression = 0.94f;
        bool plainText = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < textLen && plainText; ++i) {
            const wchar_t ch = text[i];
            plainText = ch != L'\t' &&
                (nativeExplicitLines || (ch != L'\r' && ch != L'\n'));
        }
        // Only a layout that wraps, trims or overflows can differ from GDI;
        // a single fitting line (most labels) skips the GDI measuring.
        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS dwMetrics = {};
        DWRITE_LINE_METRICS dwLines[8] = {};
        UINT32 dwLineCount = 0;
        bool dwSuspect = false;
        if (plainText && SUCCEEDED(layout->GetMetrics(&dwMetrics))) {
            const HRESULT lineHr = layout->GetLineMetrics(
                dwLines, ARRAYSIZE(dwLines), &dwLineCount);
            // More lines than the buffer holds (dwLineCount then is the
            // real count): the native text.
            if (FAILED(lineHr))
                return false;
            dwSuspect = dwLineCount != 1 ||
                dwMetrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace * widthScale >
                    static_cast<float>(width);
            for (UINT32 i = 0; !dwSuspect && i < dwLineCount; ++i)
                dwSuspect = dwLines[i].isTrimmed;
        }
        std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> gdiLines;   // start, length
        bool gdiFits = dwSuspect;
        auto gdiWidth = [&](int start, int length) -> LONG {
            SIZE extent = {};
            return GetTextExtentPoint32W(hdc, text + start, length, &extent)
                ? extent.cx : LONG_MAX;
        };
        if (gdiFits) {
            if (!nativeExplicitLines &&
                ((dtFlags & DT_SINGLELINE) || !(dtFlags & DT_WORDBREAK))) {
                gdiFits = gdiWidth(0, textLen) <= width + 1;
                gdiLines.emplace_back(0, textLen);
            } else {
                // DrawTextW's greedy word wrap: as many words per line as fit,
                // the breaking space dropped. A word wider than the rect is
                // broken between characters with DT_EDITCONTROL (Explorer's
                // item labels, e.g. a long file name) and doesn't fit
                // without it.
                int start = 0;
                while (gdiFits && start < textLen) {
                    int paragraphEnd = textLen;
                    if (nativeExplicitLines) {
                        paragraphEnd = start;
                        while (paragraphEnd < textLen &&
                            text[paragraphEnd] != L'\r' && text[paragraphEnd] != L'\n')
                            ++paragraphEnd;
                    }
                    int lineEnd = -1;
                    int scan = start;
                    if (paragraphEnd == start)
                        lineEnd = start; // Preserve an explicit empty line.
                    else if (!(dtFlags & DT_WORDBREAK)) {
                        gdiFits = gdiWidth(start, paragraphEnd - start) <= width + 1;
                        lineEnd = paragraphEnd;
                    }
                    while ((dtFlags & DT_WORDBREAK) && scan < paragraphEnd) {
                        int wordEnd = scan;
                        while (wordEnd < paragraphEnd && text[wordEnd] != L' ')
                            ++wordEnd;
                        if (gdiWidth(start, wordEnd - start) > width + 1)
                            break;
                        lineEnd = wordEnd;
                        scan = wordEnd;
                        while (scan < paragraphEnd && text[scan] == L' ')
                            ++scan;
                    }
                    if (lineEnd < 0) {
                        int wordEnd = start;
                        while (wordEnd < paragraphEnd && text[wordEnd] != L' ')
                            ++wordEnd;
                        INT fit = 0;
                        SIZE extent = {};
                        if (!(dtFlags & DT_EDITCONTROL) ||
                            !GetTextExtentExPointW(hdc, text + start,
                                wordEnd - start, width + 1, &fit, nullptr,
                                &extent) || fit <= 0) {
                            gdiFits = false;   // a word wider than the rect
                            break;
                        }
                        lineEnd = start + fit;
                    }
                    gdiLines.emplace_back(start, lineEnd - start);
                    start = lineEnd;
                    while (start < paragraphEnd && text[start] == L' ')
                        ++start;
                    if (nativeExplicitLines && start == paragraphEnd && start < textLen) {
                        const wchar_t separator = text[start++];
                        if (separator == L'\r' && start < textLen && text[start] == L'\n')
                            ++start;
                    }
                }
                // More lines than the rect holds (rounded, as a rect a few
                // pixels short of a line still shows it): GDI trims too, and
                // so does the DirectWrite layout, with its ellipsis.
                const LONG lineHeight = nativeMultilineLayout
                    ? nativeLineHeight : originalMetrics.tmHeight;
                if (gdiFits && lineHeight > 0 &&
                    static_cast<LONG>(gdiLines.size()) > std::max<LONG>(1,
                        (height + lineHeight / 2) / lineHeight))
                    gdiFits = false;
            }
        }

        bool dwDiffers = false;
        if (gdiFits && !gdiLines.empty()) {
            dwDiffers = dwLineCount != gdiLines.size() ||
                dwMetrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace * widthScale >
                    static_cast<float>(width);
            for (UINT32 i = 0; !dwDiffers && i < dwLineCount; ++i) {
                dwDiffers = dwLines[i].isTrimmed;
                if (nativeExplicitLines) {
                    int nativeLength = gdiLines[i].second;
                    while (nativeLength > 0 &&
                        text[gdiLines[i].first + nativeLength - 1] == L' ')
                        --nativeLength;
                    dwDiffers = dwDiffers || dwLines[i].length -
                        dwLines[i].trailingWhitespaceLength !=
                            static_cast<UINT32>(nativeLength);
                }
            }
        }

        if (dwDiffers) {
            std::wstring broken;
            broken.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(textLen) + gdiLines.size());
            for (size_t i = 0; i < gdiLines.size(); ++i) {
                if (i)
                    broken.push_back(L'\n');
                broken.append(text + gdiLines[i].first, gdiLines[i].second);
            }
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextLayout> fixed;
            DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS fixedMetrics = {};
            if (FAILED(dwFactory->CreateTextLayout(broken.c_str(),
                    static_cast<UINT32>(broken.size()), format.Get(),
                    layoutWidth, std::max(layoutHeight,
                        targetEmHeight * 2.0f * gdiLines.size()), &fixed)) ||
                !fixed ||
                FAILED(fixed->SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP)) ||
                ((dtFlags & DT_RTLREADING) && FAILED(fixed->SetReadingDirection(
                    DWRITE_READING_DIRECTION_RIGHT_TO_LEFT))) ||
                FAILED(fixed->GetMetrics(&fixedMetrics))) {
                return false;
            }
            if (nativeMultilineLayout) {
                if (FAILED(fixed->SetParagraphAlignment(DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_NEAR)) ||
                    FAILED(fixed->SetLineSpacing(DWRITE_LINE_SPACING_METHOD_UNIFORM,
                        static_cast<float>(nativeLineHeight), static_cast<float>(originalMetrics.tmAscent))))
                    return false;
            }
            const float widest = fixedMetrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace;
            if (widest * widthScale > static_cast<float>(width) && widest > 0.0f) {
                const float fitted = std::max(0.25f,
                    static_cast<float>(width) - 0.25f) / widest;
                if (fitted < widthScale * kMaxFitCompression)
                    return false;
                widthScale = fitted;
            }
            if (FAILED(fixed->SetMaxWidth(static_cast<float>(width) / widthScale)) ||
                FAILED(fixed->SetMaxHeight(layoutHeight)))
                return false;
            layout = fixed;
        }
    }

    DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS metrics = {};
    if (FAILED(layout->GetMetrics(&metrics)))
        return false;

    D2D1_POINT_2F drawOrigin = D2D1::Point2F(0.0f,
        static_cast<float>(verticalInkPad));
    if (noLayoutClip) {
        // Ribbon's DT_NOCLIP removes only the layout-box clip, not the HDC
        // update region. Bind enough pixels for the ink without moving the
        // layout/alignment box or clearing the control's native clip.
        DWRITE_OVERHANG_METRICS ink = {};
        if (FAILED(layout->GetOverhangMetrics(&ink)) ||
            !ShellTextNoClipBounds(*rc, ink, widthScale, &bindRect, &drawOrigin))
            return false;
    }
    if (extPlacement) {
        const float naturalLayoutWidth = std::max(
            1.0f, std::ceil(metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace) + 1.0f);
        if (FAILED(layout->SetMaxWidth(naturalLayoutWidth)) ||
            FAILED(layout->GetMetrics(&metrics))) {
            return false;
        }

        const float textWidth = metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace * widthScale;
        const float textHeight = metrics.height;
        float originX = static_cast<float>(extPlacement->x);
        if ((extPlacement->textAlign & TA_CENTER) == TA_CENTER)
            originX -= textWidth * 0.5f;
        else if ((extPlacement->textAlign & TA_RIGHT) == TA_RIGHT)
            originX -= textWidth;

        float originY = static_cast<float>(extPlacement->y);
        if ((extPlacement->textAlign & TA_BASELINE) == TA_BASELINE) {
            DWRITE_LINE_METRICS lineMetrics = {};
            UINT32 lineCount = 0;
            if (FAILED(layout->GetLineMetrics(&lineMetrics, 1, &lineCount)) ||
                lineCount == 0) {
                return false;
            }
            originY -= lineMetrics.baseline;
        } else if ((extPlacement->textAlign & TA_BOTTOM) == TA_BOTTOM) {
            originY -= textHeight;
        }

        drawOrigin.x = (originX - bindRect.left) / widthScale;
        drawOrigin.y = originY - bindRect.top;
    }

    if (rasterCached) {
        const int drawnResult = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(std::ceil(metrics.height)));
        if (ShellTextRasterDrawLayout(hdc, bindRect, layout.Get(), drawOrigin,
                widthScale, textColor, rasterKey, rasterHash, drawnResult, 1.f,
                verticalInkPad ? D2D1_DRAW_TEXT_OPTIONS_NONE
                               : D2D1_DRAW_TEXT_OPTIONS_CLIP)) {
            *result = drawnResult;
            return true;
        }
    }
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(
            hdc, &bindRect, g_d2dFactory, &rt)) || !rt)
        return false;

    COLORREF color = GetTextColor(hdc);
    if (color == CLR_INVALID)
        return false;
    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt.Get(),
        D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(color) / 255.0f, GetGValue(color) / 255.0f,
            GetBValue(color) / 255.0f, 1.0f));
    if (!brush)
        return false;

    FPUGuard fpu;
    D2D1_MATRIX_3X2_F oldTransform = {};
    rt->GetTransform(&oldTransform);
    const D2D1_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_MODE oldTextAntialiasMode =
        rt->GetTextAntialiasMode();
    rt->SetTextAntialiasMode(D2D1_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_MODE_GRAYSCALE);
    rt->BeginDraw();
    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Scale(widthScale, 1.0f));
    rt->DrawTextLayout(drawOrigin, layout.Get(), brush,
        (noLayoutClip || verticalInkPad) ? D2D1_DRAW_TEXT_OPTIONS_NONE
                                       : D2D1_DRAW_TEXT_OPTIONS_CLIP);
    rt->SetTransform(oldTransform);
    rt->SetTextAntialiasMode(oldTextAntialiasMode);
    const HRESULT hr = rt->EndDraw();
    if (hr == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET)
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    if (FAILED(hr))
        return false;

    *result = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(std::ceil(metrics.height)));
    if (pass == 1 && g_desktopShadowTextContext)
        PrepareCurrentDibShadowMask(hdc,
            g_desktopShadowTextContext->shadowMaskOpacity);
    return true;
}

static COLORREF FixDarkTextColor(COLORREF color);

static bool LegacyRebarAllowsNoClip(LegacyRebarTextKind kind, UINT flags)
{
    if ((ExplorerDialogTextKind(kind) && kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogLink &&
         kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogReadOnly) || kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::ModernCombo) {
        constexpr UINT supported = DT_NOCLIP | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_NOPREFIX |
            DT_CENTER | DT_RIGHT | DT_VCENTER | DT_BOTTOM | DT_RTLREADING |
            DT_WORDBREAK | DT_EDITCONTROL | DT_END_ELLIPSIS | DT_WORD_ELLIPSIS |
            DT_PATH_ELLIPSIS | DT_HIDEPREFIX | DT_EXTERNALLEADING;
        return (flags & DT_NOCLIP) && !(flags & ~supported);
    }
    constexpr UINT supported = DT_NOCLIP | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_NOPREFIX |
        DT_CENTER | DT_RIGHT | DT_VCENTER | DT_BOTTOM | DT_RTLREADING;
    return kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::Ribbon &&
        (flags & (DT_NOCLIP | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_NOPREFIX)) ==
            (DT_NOCLIP | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_NOPREFIX) && !(flags & ~supported);
}

static void LegacyRibbonObserveDrawTextCaller(HDC hdc, UINT flags, void* caller)
{
    if (!caller || g_ribbonDrawTextCaller ||
        !g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth ||
        !LegacyRebarAllowsNoClip(LegacyRebarTextKind::Ribbon, flags) ||
        LegacyRebarTextForDc(hdc).kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::Ribbon)
        return;
    HMODULE module = nullptr;
    if (GetModuleHandleExW(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS |
            GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
            reinterpret_cast<LPCWSTR>(caller), &module) &&
        module == GetModuleHandleW(L"UIRibbon.dll"))
        g_ribbonDrawTextCaller = caller;
}

static HWND LegacyRibbonDirectTextHost(HDC hdc, UINT flags, void* caller)
{
    if (!g_ribbonTextHost || g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth || g_ribbonDirectTextDC ||
        g_legacyRebarTextNative || g_glowEntry || !hdc || !caller ||
        caller != g_ribbonDrawTextCaller ||
        !g_settings.ExplorerSection || !g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite ||
        IsTextPipelineDisabled() ||
        !LegacyRebarAllowsNoClip(LegacyRebarTextKind::Ribbon, flags) ||
        GetObjectType(hdc) != OBJ_MEMDC || WindowFromDC(hdc) ||
        GetTextAlign(hdc) != (TA_LEFT | TA_TOP | TA_NOUPDATECP))
        return nullptr;
    HMODULE module = nullptr;
    if (!GetModuleHandleExW(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS |
            GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
            reinterpret_cast<LPCWSTR>(caller), &module) ||
        module != GetModuleHandleW(L"UIRibbon.dll"))
        return nullptr;
    const HWND host = g_ribbonTextHost;
    DWORD processId = 0;
    if (GetWindowThreadProcessId(host, &processId) != GetCurrentThreadId() ||
        processId != GetCurrentProcessId() || !IsClassName(host, L"NetUIHWND") ||
        ClassifyLegacyRebarText(host, L"NetUIHWND") != LegacyRebarTextKind::Ribbon)
        return nullptr;
    return host;
}

struct LegacyRibbonDirectTextScope {
    HDC previousDC = g_ribbonDirectTextDC;
    LegacyRebarTextPaint previousPaint = g_ribbonDirectTextPaint;
    LegacyRibbonDirectTextScope(HDC hdc, HWND host) {
        g_ribbonDirectTextDC = hdc;
        g_ribbonDirectTextPaint = {host, LegacyRebarTextKind::Ribbon};
    }
    ~LegacyRibbonDirectTextScope() {
        g_ribbonDirectTextDC = previousDC;
        g_ribbonDirectTextPaint = previousPaint;
    }
    LegacyRibbonDirectTextScope(const LegacyRibbonDirectTextScope&) = delete;
    LegacyRibbonDirectTextScope& operator=(const LegacyRibbonDirectTextScope&) = delete;
};

static bool LegacyNormalizeLinkRun(HDC hdc, LPCWSTR text, int count,
    LPCRECT rect, UINT flags, std::wstring& normalized)
{
    // SysLink has already placed this single-line run. Ignore only controls
    // that DrawText also ignores, not new layout or expanded tab stops.
    if (!(flags & DT_SINGLELINE) || (flags & (DT_EXPANDTABS | DT_TABSTOP)) || count > 8192)
        return false;
    normalized.reserve(count);
    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        if (text[i] != L'\t' && text[i] != L'\r' && text[i] != L'\n')
            normalized.push_back(text[i]);
    }
    if (normalized.empty())
        return false;
    RECT originalRect = *rect, normalizedRect = *rect;
    const bool previousNative = g_legacyRebarTextNative;
    g_legacyRebarTextNative = true;
    const INT originalHeight = DrawTextW(hdc, text, count, &originalRect, flags | DT_CALCRECT);
    const INT normalizedHeight = DrawTextW(hdc, normalized.c_str(),
        static_cast<int>(normalized.size()), &normalizedRect, flags | DT_CALCRECT);
    g_legacyRebarTextNative = previousNative;
    if (originalHeight <= 0 || originalHeight != normalizedHeight ||
        !EqualRect(&originalRect, &normalizedRect))
        return false;
    return true;
}

// Dialog DirectUI uses GM_ADVANCED even for an identity/integer translation.
// Move only that translation into the viewport for the existing text renderer;
// the device-space clip and the host's original DC state remain unchanged.
struct LegacyDialogTextDcScope {
    HDC hdc;
    int saved = 0;
    bool ready = true;
    LegacyDialogTextDcScope(HDC dc, LegacyRebarTextKind kind,
        bool nativeGlyphs = false) : hdc(dc) {
        if ((kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogDirectUi &&
             !LegacyEditableTextKind(kind) && !nativeGlyphs) ||
            GetGraphicsMode(hdc) == GM_COMPATIBLE)
            return;
        ready = false;
        XFORM world = {};
        POINT viewport = {};
        if (GetGraphicsMode(hdc) != GM_ADVANCED || GetMapMode(hdc) != MM_TEXT ||
            GetLayout(hdc) != 0 || !GetWorldTransform(hdc, &world) ||
            world.eM11 != 1 || world.eM22 != 1 || world.eM12 != 0 || world.eM21 != 0 ||
            !std::isfinite(world.eDx) || !std::isfinite(world.eDy) ||
            std::trunc(world.eDx) != world.eDx || std::trunc(world.eDy) != world.eDy ||
            !GetViewportOrgEx(hdc, &viewport))
            return;
        const double x = static_cast<double>(viewport.x) + world.eDx;
        const double y = static_cast<double>(viewport.y) + world.eDy;
        if (x < LONG_MIN || x > LONG_MAX || y < LONG_MIN || y > LONG_MAX)
            return;
        saved = SaveDC(hdc);
        if (!saved)
            return;
        const XFORM identity = {1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0};
        ready = SetWorldTransform(hdc, &identity) &&
            SetGraphicsMode(hdc, GM_COMPATIBLE) &&
            SetViewportOrgEx(hdc, static_cast<int>(x), static_cast<int>(y), nullptr);
    }
    ~LegacyDialogTextDcScope() {
        if (saved) RestoreDC(hdc, saved);
    }
    LegacyDialogTextDcScope(const LegacyDialogTextDcScope&) = delete;
    LegacyDialogTextDcScope& operator=(const LegacyDialogTextDcScope&) = delete;
};

static bool TryDrawLegacyRebarMutableText(HDC hdc, LPCWSTR text, INT count,
    LPRECT rect, UINT flags, INT* result);

static bool TryDrawLegacyRebarText(HDC hdc, LPCWSTR text, int count,
    LPCRECT rect, UINT flags, INT* result,
    const ShellTextExtPlacement* placement = nullptr,
    COLORREF themedColor = CLR_INVALID, bool nativeRectClip = false)
{
    // DirectWrite trims only at the end or at a word. A path is shortened in
    // its middle by native DrawText first, into a copy.
    if (flags & DT_PATH_ELLIPSIS) {
        if (placement || themedColor != CLR_INVALID || nativeRectClip ||
            !text || !rect || !result || (flags & DT_MODIFYSTRING))
            return false;
        const size_t length = count >= 0 ? static_cast<size_t>(count)
            : wcsnlen(text, 32769);
        if (!length || length > 32768)
            return false;
        // DT_MODIFYSTRING may write up to four more characters.
        std::wstring copy(text, length);
        copy.resize(length + 5);
        RECT layout = *rect;
        return TryDrawLegacyRebarMutableText(hdc, copy.data(),
            static_cast<INT>(length), &layout, flags | DT_MODIFYSTRING, result);
    }
    const auto paint = LegacyRebarTextForDc(hdc);
    LegacyDialogTextDcScope dcScope(hdc, paint.kind);
    if (!dcScope.ready)
        return false;
    const bool controlText = ExplorerDialogTextKind(paint.kind) ||
        paint.kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::ModernCombo;
    const bool nativeDialogLayout = controlText &&
        paint.kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogLink &&
        paint.kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogReadOnly;
    const bool expandCaptionTabs = nativeDialogLayout && (flags & DT_EXPANDTABS) &&
        !(flags & DT_TABSTOP);
    if (expandCaptionTabs)
        flags &= ~DT_EXPANDTABS;
    const bool noLayoutClip = (flags & DT_NOCLIP) &&
        LegacyRebarAllowsNoClip(paint.kind, flags);
    if (paint.kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::None || LegacyEditableTextKind(paint.kind) ||
        !text || !rect ||
        (flags & (DT_CALCRECT | DT_MODIFYSTRING | DT_PREFIXONLY |
            DT_EXPANDTABS | DT_TABSTOP | DT_INTERNAL)) ||
        ((flags & DT_NOCLIP) && !noLayoutClip))
        return false;
    int length = count >= 0 ? count : static_cast<int>(wcslen(text));
    if (length <= 0)
        return false;
    LOGFONTW font = {};
    if (GetObjectW(GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT), sizeof(font), &font) != sizeof(font) ||
        font.lfCharSet == SYMBOL_CHARSET ||
        wcsstr(font.lfFaceName, L"MDL2") || wcsstr(font.lfFaceName, L"Fluent Icons") ||
        !_wcsicmp(font.lfFaceName, L"Marlett") ||
        !_wcsicmp(font.lfFaceName, L"Wingdings") ||
        !_wcsicmp(font.lfFaceName, L"Webdings"))
        return false;
    if (controlText) {
        if (font.lfEscapement || font.lfOrientation)
            return false;
        if (GetGraphicsMode(hdc) != GM_COMPATIBLE)
            return false;
        if (GetLayout(hdc) != 0)
            return false;
        if (GetTextCharacterExtra(hdc) != 0)
            return false;
    }
    bool mnemonic = false;
    const bool preserveNativeAdvance = paint.kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogLink ||
        paint.kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogReadOnly || (controlText && placement);
    if (preserveNativeAdvance && !(flags & DT_SINGLELINE))
        return false;
    bool normalizeLinkRun = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < length; ++i) {
        if (text[i] >= 0xE000 && text[i] <= 0xF8FF)
            return false;
        if ((nativeDialogLayout && text[i] == L'\t') ||
            ((preserveNativeAdvance || (noLayoutClip && !nativeDialogLayout)) &&
             (text[i] == L'\t' || text[i] == L'\r' || text[i] == L'\n'))) {
            if (paint.kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogLink)
                return false;
            normalizeLinkRun = true;
        }
        mnemonic |= text[i] == L'&' && !(flags & DT_NOPREFIX);
    }
    std::wstring normalizedRun;
    if (normalizeLinkRun) {
        if (!LegacyNormalizeLinkRun(hdc, text, length, rect, flags, normalizedRun))
            return false;
        text = normalizedRun.c_str();
        length = static_cast<int>(normalizedRun.size());
    }
    if (mnemonic && ((paint.kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::Dropdown &&
                     paint.kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::Ribbon &&
                     !controlText) || placement))
        return false;
    // Visible underlines need the mnemonic renderer; it still has a layout
    // clip, so no-clip calls outside dialog controls stay native.
    if (mnemonic && noLayoutClip && !(flags & DT_HIDEPREFIX) && !controlText)
        return false;
    std::wstring caption;
    int drawLength = length;
    if (mnemonic && (noLayoutClip || (controlText &&
        LegacyControlTextBaseKind(paint.kind) != LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogStatic)) &&
        (flags & DT_HIDEPREFIX)) {
        size_t accelerator = SIZE_MAX;
        caption = StripMnemonicPrefix(text, length, flags, &accelerator);
        if (caption.empty())
            return false;
        text = caption.c_str();
        drawLength = static_cast<int>(caption.size());
        mnemonic = false;
        flags |= DT_NOPREFIX;
    }
    const COLORREF originalColor = GetTextColor(hdc);
    const COLORREF color = themedColor != CLR_INVALID ? themedColor :
        (paint.kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::Search ||
         paint.kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::Ribbon || controlText)
            ? originalColor : FixDarkTextColor(originalColor);
    if (color == CLR_INVALID || !EnsureD2DFactory())
        return false;
    // ETO_CLIPPED is an explicit native rectangle, not just a glyph cell.
    const int verticalInkPad = controlText && !nativeRectClip
        ? (std::max)(1, static_cast<int>(std::floor(
            1.5f * DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI)))
        : 0;
    const bool previousNative = g_legacyRebarTextNative;
    g_legacyRebarTextNative = true;
    if (color != originalColor)
        SetTextColor(hdc, color);
    bool drawn = false;
    if (mnemonic) {
        // Popup/Ribbon mnemonics keep native measurement and underline semantics;
        // the plain-label raster cache intentionally accepts no prefix work.
        RECT measure = *rect;
        const INT nativeHeight = DrawTextW(hdc, text, drawLength, &measure,
            flags | DT_CALCRECT);
        // Without a native clip, the layout box may only bound text that fits it.
        const bool overflows = noLayoutClip &&
            (measure.right - measure.left > rect->right - rect->left ||
             nativeHeight > rect->bottom - rect->top);
        if (nativeHeight > 0 && !overflows) {
            wcsncpy_s(font.lfFaceName, SegoeUiVariableFace(), _TRUNCATE);
            drawn = DrawWinUiStyledTextDWrite(hdc, rect, text, length,
                font, color, flags, /*tightWidth=*/true, 0.f, 1.f,
                0, 0, false, verticalInkPad);
            if (drawn)
                *result = nativeHeight;
        }
    } else if (noLayoutClip) {
        RECT measure = *rect;
        const INT nativeHeight = DrawTextW(hdc, text, drawLength, &measure,
            flags | DT_CALCRECT);
        if (nativeHeight > 0) {
            INT drawnHeight = 0;
            drawn = DrawShellItemTextDWrite(hdc, text, drawLength, rect,
                flags, 2, &drawnHeight, 0, 0.0f, nullptr, false, true,
                preserveNativeAdvance, nativeDialogLayout);
            if (drawn)
                *result = nativeHeight;
        }
    } else {
        drawn = DrawShellItemTextDWrite(hdc, text, drawLength, rect,
            flags, 2, result, 0, 0.0f, placement, true, false,
            preserveNativeAdvance, nativeDialogLayout, verticalInkPad);
    }
    if (color != originalColor)
        SetTextColor(hdc, originalColor);
    g_legacyRebarTextNative = previousNative;
    return drawn;
}

static bool TryDrawLegacyRibbonDirectText(HDC hdc, LPCWSTR text, int count,
    LPCRECT rect, UINT flags, void* caller, INT* result)
{
    // File's pressed/menu-open caption is redrawn outside BeginPaint. Borrow
    // eligibility only for this direct UIRibbon call and its exact memory DC.
    const HWND host = LegacyRibbonDirectTextHost(hdc, flags, caller);
    if (!host || !text || !rect || !result)
        return false;
    LegacyRibbonDirectTextScope scope(hdc, host);
    const bool drawn = TryDrawLegacyRebarText(hdc, text, count, rect,
        flags, result);
    return drawn;
}

static bool TryDrawLegacyRebarThemeText(HTHEME theme, HDC hdc,
    int part, int state, LPCWSTR text, int count, LPCRECT rect,
    DWORD flags, const DTTOPTS* options)
{
    const auto paint = LegacyRebarTextForDc(hdc);
    // DirectWrite has no path ellipsis.
    if (paint.kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::None ||
        (flags & (DT_CALCRECT | DT_MODIFYSTRING | DT_PREFIXONLY |
            DT_EXPANDTABS | DT_TABSTOP | DT_INTERNAL | DT_PATH_ELLIPSIS)) ||
        ((flags & DT_NOCLIP) && !LegacyRebarAllowsNoClip(paint.kind, flags)) ||
        (options && (options->dwSize != sizeof(DTTOPTS) ||
            (options->dwFlags & ~(DTT_TEXTCOLOR | DTT_COMPOSITED | DTT_FONTPROP)) ||
            ((options->dwFlags & DTT_FONTPROP) &&
                LegacyControlTextBaseKind(paint.kind) != LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogCommand))))
        return false;
    COLORREF color = CLR_INVALID;
    if (options && (options->dwFlags & DTT_TEXTCOLOR))
        color = options->crText;
    else {
        const HRESULT hr = GetThemeColor(theme, part, state, TMT_TEXTCOLOR, &color);
        if (FAILED(hr)) {
            // Native control themes can omit a state's TextColor and retain
            // the font/color already selected by WM_CTLCOLOR on this DC.
            if (hr != HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_NOT_FOUND) ||
                (!ExplorerDialogTextKind(paint.kind) &&
                 paint.kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::ModernCombo))
                return false;
            color = GetTextColor(hdc);
        }
    }
    LOGFONTW font = {};
    const bool systemFont = options && (options->dwFlags & DTT_FONTPROP);
    const HRESULT fontHr = systemFont
        ? GetThemeSysFont(theme, options->iFontPropId, &font)
        : GetThemeFont(theme, hdc, part, state, TMT_FONT, &font);
    if (FAILED(fontHr)) {
        // A missing theme font means DrawThemeText uses the DC's own font.
        if (!systemFont && fontHr == HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_NOT_FOUND)) {
            INT result = 0;
            return TryDrawLegacyRebarText(hdc, text, count, rect, flags,
                &result, nullptr, color);
        }
        return false;
    }
    LOGFONTW selectedFont = {};
    INT result = 0;
    if (GetObjectW(GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT), sizeof(selectedFont),
            &selectedFont) == sizeof(selectedFont) &&
        memcmp(&font, &selectedFont, sizeof(font)) == 0) {
        return TryDrawLegacyRebarText(hdc, text, count, rect, flags,
            &result, nullptr, color);
    }
    HFONT themedFont = CreateFontIndirectW(&font);
    if (!themedFont)
        return false;
    HGDIOBJ previousFont = SelectObject(hdc, themedFont);
    const bool drawn = previousFont && previousFont != HGDI_ERROR &&
        TryDrawLegacyRebarText(hdc, text, count, rect, flags,
            &result, nullptr, color);
    if (previousFont && previousFont != HGDI_ERROR)
        SelectObject(hdc, previousFont);
    DeleteObject(themedFont);
    return drawn;
}

static bool LegacyRebarIsExplorerCallback(const DTTOPTS* options)
{
    if (!options || options->dwSize != sizeof(DTTOPTS) ||
        (options->dwFlags & (DTT_CALLBACK | DTT_COMPOSITED)) !=
            (DTT_CALLBACK | DTT_COMPOSITED) ||
        (options->dwFlags & ~(DTT_CALLBACK | DTT_COMPOSITED | DTT_TEXTCOLOR)) ||
        !options->pfnDrawTextCallback)
        return false;
    HMODULE module = nullptr;
    return GetModuleHandleExW(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS |
            GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
            reinterpret_cast<LPCWSTR>(options->pfnDrawTextCallback), &module) &&
        module == GetModuleHandleW(L"ExplorerFrame.dll");
}

static bool TryDrawLegacyRebarCallback(HTHEME theme, HDC hdc,
    int part, int state, LPCWSTR text, int count, LPCRECT rect,
    DWORD flags, const DTTOPTS* options)
{
    if (g_legacyRebarCallbackPaint || !rect || count != 0 ||
        (flags & (DT_CALCRECT | DT_MODIFYSTRING | DT_NOCLIP)) ||
        LegacyRebarTextForDc(hdc).kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::Search ||
        !LegacyRebarIsExplorerCallback(options))
        return false;
    COLORREF color = CLR_INVALID;
    if (options->dwFlags & DTT_TEXTCOLOR)
        color = options->crText;
    else if (FAILED(GetThemeColor(theme, part, state, TMT_TEXTCOLOR, &color)))
        return false;
    BLENDFUNCTION blend = {AC_SRC_OVER, 0, 255, AC_SRC_ALPHA};
    BP_PAINTPARAMS params = {sizeof(params)};
    params.dwFlags = BPPF_ERASE;
    params.pBlendFunction = &blend;
    HDC bufferDc = nullptr;
    HPAINTBUFFER buffer = BeginBufferedPaint(hdc, rect, BPBF_TOPDOWNDIB,
        &params, &bufferDc);
    if (!buffer || !bufferDc) {
        if (buffer)
            EndBufferedPaint(buffer, FALSE);
        return false;
    }
    const HGDIOBJ previousFont = SelectObject(bufferDc, GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT));
    if (!previousFont || previousFont == HGDI_ERROR) {
        EndBufferedPaint(buffer, FALSE);
        return false;
    }
    SetBkMode(bufferDc, TRANSPARENT);
    SetTextColor(bufferDc, color);
    SetTextAlign(bufferDc, GetTextAlign(hdc));
    SetTextCharacterExtra(bufferDc, GetTextCharacterExtra(hdc));
    POINT previousOrigin = {};
    if (!SetWindowOrgEx(bufferDc, 0, 0, &previousOrigin)) {
        SelectObject(bufferDc, previousFont);
        EndBufferedPaint(buffer, FALSE);
        return false;
    }
    RECT drawRect = {0, 0, rect->right - rect->left, rect->bottom - rect->top};
    LegacyRebarCallbackPaint callback = {bufferDc};
    g_legacyRebarCallbackPaint = &callback;
    // Explorer's callback supplies the real text and selects its own font.
    // Keep its native local coordinates, but use an alpha buffer instead of
    // UxTheme's GDI coverage mask.
    options->pfnDrawTextCallback(bufferDc, const_cast<LPWSTR>(text), count,
        &drawRect, flags, options->lParam);
    g_legacyRebarCallbackPaint = nullptr;
    SetWindowOrgEx(bufferDc, previousOrigin.x, previousOrigin.y, nullptr);
    SelectObject(bufferDc, previousFont);
    const bool accepted = callback.drawn && !callback.failed;
    const HRESULT hr = EndBufferedPaint(buffer, accepted);
    return accepted && SUCCEEDED(hr);
}

using DesktopDrawShadowTextEx_t = int (WINAPI*)(HDC, LPCWSTR, UINT, RECT*,
    DWORD, COLORREF, COLORREF, int, int, DWORD, BOOL);
static DesktopDrawShadowTextEx_t g_desktopDrawShadowTextExOrig = nullptr;

static int WINAPI DesktopDrawShadowTextEx_hook(HDC hdc, LPCWSTR text,
    UINT count, RECT* rc, DWORD flags, COLORREF textColor,
    COLORREF shadowColor, int offsetX, int offsetY, DWORD shadowOptions,
    BOOL reserved)
{
    HWND desktopTextHwnd = g_desktopTextPaintHwnd
        ? g_desktopTextPaintHwnd : g_desktopDragImageTextHwnd;
    if (!g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite || IsTextPipelineDisabled() ||
        !desktopTextHwnd || !IsDesktopIconListView(desktopTextHwnd)) {
        return g_desktopDrawShadowTextExOrig(hdc, text, count, rc, flags,
            textColor, shadowColor, offsetX, offsetY, shadowOptions, reserved);
    }

    DesktopShadowTextContext context = {};
    context.shadowMaskOpacity = 204;
    DesktopShadowTextContext* previous = g_desktopShadowTextContext;
    g_desktopShadowTextContext = &context;
    int result = g_desktopDrawShadowTextExOrig(hdc, text, count, rc, flags,
        textColor, shadowColor, offsetX, offsetY, shadowOptions, reserved);
    g_desktopShadowTextContext = previous;
    return result;
}

// ── Private symbols, one lookup per module ─────────────────────────────────
// Windhawk caches the result of a HookSymbols call per module, and a later
// call for the same module with a different list replaces that cache, so the
// next process start resolves everything again. Each module's full list is
// therefore resolved in a single call, addresses only (a null hook), and each
// feature hooks the addresses it needs with SetResolvedSymbolHook. The
// resolvers are defined near the end of the file, after the calling-
// convention macros their symbol strings use.
struct Comctl32Symbols {
    void* drawShadowTextEx = nullptr;
    void* ccDrawInsertMark = nullptr;
    void* tvExpand = nullptr;
    void* markupPaint = nullptr;
};
struct ExplorerFrameSymbols {
    void* canApplyOwnerDrawToMenu = nullptr;
    void* nscTreeDrawDivider = nullptr;
    void* marqueeStart = nullptr;
    void* marqueeEnd = nullptr;
};
struct Shell32Symbols {
    void* canApplyOwnerDrawToMenu = nullptr;
    void* drawPie = nullptr;
    void* drvPrshtDrawItem = nullptr;
};
struct WindowsStorageSymbols {
    void* imageRendererDraw = nullptr;
    void* imageRendererGetOverlayIndex = nullptr;
};
static Comctl32Symbols Comctl32ResolveSymbols(HMODULE module);
static ExplorerFrameSymbols ExplorerFrameResolveSymbols(HMODULE module);
static Shell32Symbols Shell32ResolveSymbols(HMODULE module);
static WindowsStorageSymbols WindowsStorageResolveSymbols(HMODULE module);

template <typename Prototype>
static bool SetResolvedSymbolHook(void* address,
    std::type_identity_t<Prototype>* hook, Prototype** original)
{
    return address && WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(
        reinterpret_cast<Prototype*>(address), hook, original);
}

// dui70 exports its DirectUI methods by decorated name, so those need no
// symbol lookup at all.
static void* DuiExport(HMODULE dui70, const char* name64, const char* name32)
{
    if (!dui70)
        return nullptr;
#ifdef _WIN64
    static_cast<void>(name32);
    return reinterpret_cast<void*>(GetProcAddress(dui70, name64));
#else
    static_cast<void>(name64);
    return reinterpret_cast<void*>(GetProcAddress(dui70, name32));
#endif
}

static void DesktopTextInstallShadowHook()
{
    if (!IsCurrentProcessExplorer() || g_desktopDrawShadowTextExOrig)
        return;

    HANDLE snapshot = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(
        TH32CS_SNAPMODULE | TH32CS_SNAPMODULE32, GetCurrentProcessId());
    if (snapshot == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        Wh_Log(L"Desktop text: failed to enumerate comctl32 modules, error=%lu",
            GetLastError());
        return;
    }

    MODULEENTRY32W module = {};
    module.dwSize = sizeof(module);
    if (Module32FirstW(snapshot, &module)) {
        do {
            if (_wcsicmp(module.szModule, L"comctl32.dll") != 0)
                continue;
            SetResolvedSymbolHook(
                Comctl32ResolveSymbols(module.hModule).drawShadowTextEx,
                DesktopDrawShadowTextEx_hook, &g_desktopDrawShadowTextExOrig);
        } while (!g_desktopDrawShadowTextExOrig && Module32NextW(snapshot, &module));
    }
    CloseHandle(snapshot);

    if (!g_desktopDrawShadowTextExOrig)
        Wh_Log(L"Desktop text: DrawShadowTextEx symbol unavailable; using native labels");
}
