// Measures `text` the way DrawWinUiStyledTextDWrite will actually draw it --
// same cached IDWriteTextFormat (so pass the exact dtFlags the draw call
// will use, or this ends up populating a second cache entry alongside it),
// same mnemonic-prefix stripping -- instead of a GDI HFONT create/select/
// GetTextExtentPoint32W/deselect/delete round trip against a different
// rasterizer's metrics on every call.
static bool MeasureWinUiStyledTextDWrite(LPCWSTR text, int cch,
    const LOGFONTW& lf, UINT dtFlags, UINT dpi, SIZE* outExtent,
    float maxWidth = 100000.0f)
{
    if (!text || !outExtent) return false;
    const int textLen = cch >= 0 ? cch : (int)wcslen(text);
    if (textLen <= 0) return false;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> fmt;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteFactory> dwFactory;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_winUiTextDwMutex);
        IDWriteFactory* rawFactory = WinUiTextEnsureDWriteFactoryLocked();
        if (!rawFactory) return false;
        dwFactory = rawFactory;
        fmt = g_winUiTextDwFormatCache.Ensure(rawFactory, lf, dtFlags, dpi);
    }
    if (!fmt) return false;

    size_t accelPos = SIZE_MAX;
    std::wstring stripped = StripMnemonicPrefix(text, textLen, dtFlags, &accelPos);
    if (stripped.empty()) return false;

    // maxWidth defaults to unbounded -- wrapping is already off on the
    // cached format, so this just keeps the layout from reporting a clipped
    // width. Callers measuring a wrap-constrained CALCRECT (e.g. a tooltip
    // sizing itself to a fixed max width) pass the real constraint instead,
    // so the reported height reflects wrapping at that width.
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextLayout> layout;
    if (FAILED(dwFactory->CreateTextLayout(stripped.c_str(), (UINT32)stripped.size(),
            fmt.Get(), maxWidth, 100000.0f, &layout)) || !layout)
        return false;

    DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS metrics = {};
    if (FAILED(layout->GetMetrics(&metrics)))
        return false;

    outExtent->cx = (LONG)std::ceil(metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace);
    outExtent->cy = (LONG)std::ceil(metrics.height);
    return true;
}

// Grows *rc (grow-only -- left untouched if it already fits) so DirectWrite
// text isn't clipped by a rect a caller sized against its own, narrower
// native-font metrics -- the rect it's handed was always sized for whatever
// native font the control/theme originally measured with, not for Segoe UI
// Variable's own (wider) axis-resolved glyphs. Every DrawWinUiStyledTextDWrite
// call site needs this same compensation.
static void GrowRectForWinUiText(HDC hdc, RECT* rc, LPCWSTR text, int cch,
    const LOGFONTW& lf, UINT dtFlags)
{
    if (!(dtFlags & DT_SINGLELINE)) {
        // Multi-line/wrap text (e.g. a checkbox label wrapping to 2+ lines).
        // Scoped to non-singleline only: single-line callers (tooltips,
        // buttons, combobox items, menu items, the nav pane) don't have
        // this problem, and the same margin there only adds unwanted empty
        // space.
        //
        // A small pixel margin isn't reliable here: word-wrap breaks at
        // whole-word boundaries, so a width mismatch between DirectWrite and
        // native doesn't shave a few pixels off the last line -- it can push
        // an entire trailing word onto a new line native never allocated
        // room for, clipping that whole line instead of a sliver of one.
        // Rather than compute the exact minimal width that avoids the extra
        // wrap, measure one line's real height in the font actually being
        // drawn and guarantee room for a whole extra line, so an unplanned
        // wrap still has somewhere to go instead of being clipped off
        // entirely.
        const UINT dpi = DpiForPaintHdc(hdc);
        SIZE lineExtent = {};
        LONG lineHeight = 0;
        if (MeasureWinUiStyledTextDWrite(L"Ag", 2, lf, dtFlags | DT_SINGLELINE,
                dpi, &lineExtent) && lineExtent.cy > 0) {
            lineHeight = lineExtent.cy;
        } else {
            lineHeight = (LONG)std::lround(std::abs(lf.lfHeight) * 1.3f);
        }
        // Width: still grow a little, proportional to the rect's own width
        // (which already reflects the current DPI) rather than a flat
        // constant -- reduces how often the extra-line case above is even
        // needed, without trying to eliminate it outright.
        const LONG hPad = (LONG)std::lround(
            (std::max)(4.0f, (float)(rc->right - rc->left) * 0.04f));
        if (dtFlags & DT_VCENTER) {
            rc->top -= lineHeight / 2;
            rc->bottom += lineHeight - lineHeight / 2;
        } else if (dtFlags & DT_BOTTOM) {
            rc->top -= lineHeight;
        } else {
            rc->bottom += lineHeight;
        }
        if (dtFlags & DT_CENTER) {
            rc->left -= hPad / 2;
            rc->right += hPad - hPad / 2;
        } else if (dtFlags & DT_RIGHT) {
            rc->left -= hPad;
        } else {
            rc->right += hPad;
        }
        return;
    }
    SIZE extent = {};
    if (!MeasureWinUiStyledTextDWrite(text, cch, lf, dtFlags, DpiForPaintHdc(hdc), &extent))
        return;
    // Growth direction follows horizontal alignment so the anchored edge
    // doesn't shift: DT_RIGHT grows left, DT_CENTER grows both sides evenly,
    // anything else (DT_LEFT/default) grows right. The 1.05x pad is much
    // smaller than the 1.08x used elsewhere for the older, cross-rasterizer
    // GDI-vs-DirectWrite gap, since this measurement already comes from
    // DirectWrite itself -- it only needs to cover per-character rounding/
    // hinting slack between this measurement and the final draw, which is
    // why a flat pad alone isn't enough for longer strings.
    const LONG hPad = (LONG)std::lround(3.0f * (DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.0f));
    const LONG needed = (LONG)std::lround(extent.cx * 1.05f) + hPad;
    const LONG have = rc->right - rc->left;
    if (needed <= have)
        return;
    const LONG grow = needed - have;
    if (dtFlags & DT_CENTER) {
        rc->left -= grow / 2;
        rc->right += grow - grow / 2;
    } else if (dtFlags & DT_RIGHT) {
        rc->left -= grow;
    } else {
        rc->right += grow;
    }
}

// Same as DrawWinUiStyledTextDWrite, but draws into a render target the
// caller already has BeginDraw'd -- no BindDC/BeginDraw/EndDraw of its own.
// For callers that keep one D2D session open across several draws per
// paint (e.g. regedit's TreeView NM_CUSTOMDRAW), so adding a text draw
// doesn't add a whole extra session on top of what's already open.
static bool DrawWinUiStyledTextDWriteInSession(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, LPCRECT rc,
    LPCWSTR text, int cch, const LOGFONTW& lf, COLORREF color, UINT dtFlags, UINT dpi,
    float opacity = 1.f)
{
    if (!rt || !rc || !text)
        return false;
    const int textLen = cch >= 0 ? cch : (int)wcslen(text);
    if (textLen <= 0)
        return false;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> fmt;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteFactory> dwFactory;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_winUiTextDwMutex);
        IDWriteFactory* rawFactory = WinUiTextEnsureDWriteFactoryLocked();
        if (!rawFactory)
            return false;
        dwFactory = rawFactory; // own a ref -- used below, after the lock
        fmt = g_winUiTextDwFormatCache.Ensure(rawFactory, lf, dtFlags, dpi);
    }
    if (!fmt)
        return false;

    size_t accelPos = SIZE_MAX;
    std::wstring stripped = StripMnemonicPrefix(text, textLen, dtFlags, &accelPos);

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
    if (FAILED(rt->CreateSolidColorBrush(
            D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(color) / 255.f, GetGValue(color) / 255.f,
                GetBValue(color) / 255.f, opacity), &brush)) || !brush)
        return false;

    const D2D1_RECT_F textRect = D2D1::RectF((float)rc->left, (float)rc->top,
        (float)rc->right, (float)rc->bottom);
    rt->SetTextAntialiasMode(D2D1_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_MODE_GRAYSCALE);
    DrawMnemonicAwareText(rt, dwFactory.Get(), fmt.Get(), stripped, accelPos, dtFlags,
        textRect, brush.Get());
    return true;
}

// Forward declaration -- defined in the PaintCheckBox section below. PaintTab
// now needs its own per-window dark/light answer (see IsWinUiTabStyleActive's
// comment), earlier than the file's other forward declaration of this same
// function further down.
static bool IsWindowDarkMode(HDC hdc);

static void PaintSingleLineTabSeparator(
    HDC hdc, HWND tab, LPCRECT paintRect, bool dark)
{
    if (!hdc || !tab || !paintRect) {
        return;
    }

    const int itemCount = TabCtrl_GetItemCount(tab);
    if (itemCount <= 1)
        return;

    RECT lastItemRect = {};
    const POINT paintCenter = {
        (paintRect->left + paintRect->right) / 2,
        (paintRect->top + paintRect->bottom) / 2,
    };
    if (!TabCtrl_GetItemRect(tab, itemCount - 1, &lastItemRect) ||
        PtInRect(&lastItemRect, paintCenter)) {
        return;
    }

    const UINT dpi = DpiForPaintHdc(hdc);
    const LONG width = (std::max)(
        1L, static_cast<LONG>(MulDiv(1, dpi, USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI)));
    const LONG availableHeight = paintRect->bottom - paintRect->top;
    const LONG height = (std::min)(
        availableHeight - 2,
        static_cast<LONG>(MulDiv(10, dpi, USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI)));
    if (height <= 0)
        return;

    // 1px further out past the tab boundary than a flush right edge.
    const LONG right = paintRect->right + 1;
    const LONG topOffset = (std::max)(
        1L, static_cast<LONG>(MulDiv(2, dpi, USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI)));
    const LONG top =
        paintRect->top + (availableHeight - height) / 2 - topOffset;
    RECT separatorRect = {right - width, top, right, top + height};

    const COLORREF base = dark
        ? DarkBgForPaint(tab)
        : GetSysColor(COLOR_WINDOW);
    const COLORREF overlay = dark ? RGB(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF) : RGB(0, 0, 0);
    const float alpha = dark ? 0.10f : 0.20f;
    auto blend = [alpha](BYTE from, BYTE to) {
        return static_cast<BYTE>(
            from + (to - from) * alpha + 0.5f);
    };
    const COLORREF color = RGB(
        blend(GetRValue(base), GetRValue(overlay)),
        blend(GetGValue(base), GetGValue(overlay)),
        blend(GetBValue(base), GetBValue(overlay)));

    HBRUSH brush = static_cast<HBRUSH>(GetStockObject(DC_BRUSH));
    const COLORREF previousColor = SetDCBrushColor(hdc, color);
    if (brush && FillRect_orig)
        FillRect_orig(hdc, &separatorRect, brush);
    if (previousColor != CLR_INVALID)
        SetDCBrushColor(hdc, previousColor);
}

static bool PaintTab(HDC hdc, INT iPartId, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (iPartId == TABP_PANE || !g_d2dFactory || !IsWinUiTabStyleActive() ||
        g_tabFeaturesUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return false;
    }

    int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
    int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return false;

    bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);

    BOOL isSelected = (iStateId == TIS_SELECTED || iStateId == TIS_FOCUSED);
    BOOL isHot      = (iStateId == TIS_HOT);
    HWND tab = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
    const bool singleLine = tab && g_settings.SingleLinePropertyTabs &&
        GetPropW(tab, kSingleLinePropertyTabProp);
    // GetCapture() == tab, not just the global VK_LBUTTON state: comctl32's
    // tab control captures the mouse for the duration of a real press on one
    // of its items. Without this check, an unrelated left-button drag
    // elsewhere (resizing a splitter, a drag-and-drop operation) that merely
    // passes its cursor over this tab would also read as "pressed" here.
    BOOL isPressed = FALSE;
    if (!isSelected && !isHot && tab && GetCapture() == tab &&
        GetKeyState(VK_LBUTTON) < 0) {
        POINT cursor = {};
        if (GetCursorPos(&cursor) && ScreenToClient(tab, &cursor) &&
            PtInRect(pRect, cursor)) {
            isPressed = TRUE;
        }
    }

    // All tab backgrounds via cached bitmap (DrawNineGridStretch = no flicker)
    INT bgIndex;
    if (isSelected)                    bgIndex = singleLine ? 5 : 1;
    else if (isHot)                    bgIndex = singleLine ? 4 : 3;
    else if (iStateId == TIS_DISABLED) bgIndex = 2;
    else                               bgIndex = 0;

    const bool opaqueBg = PaintingAclUiPropertyDialogTabs(tab);

    {
        // Keep the cache protected through the stretch because cleanup can
        // release the backing DC as soon as the lock is dropped.
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> tabBgLock(g_tabBgMutex);
        if (const TabBgCacheEntry* background =
                TabBgCacheEnsureWinUI(hdc, bgIndex, dark, opaqueBg)) {
            RECT brc = {pRect->left, pRect->top, pRect->right, pRect->bottom};
            if (singleLine && isHot) {
                const UINT dpi = DpiForPaintHdc(hdc);
                brc.top -= (std::max)(
                    1L, static_cast<LONG>(MulDiv(3, dpi, 120)));
                brc.bottom -= (std::max)(
                    1L, static_cast<LONG>(MulDiv(2, dpi, 120)));
            }
            if (bgIndex == 5) {
                // FillJoinedTabRect insets the selected pill's straight sides
                // by this same join radius for most of its height (see its
                // own comment) -- bleeding the destination rect outward
                // cancels that inset back out, so the body reads closer to
                // hover/pRect's own width while the curve into the pane at
                // the very bottom is unchanged. Safe to bleed into
                // neighboring tabs' nominal rects: comctl32's
                // WM_PRINTCLIENT-driven repaint of this control is fully
                // double-buffered per TabFlickerFixSubclassProc (redraws the
                // whole client rect every time, not incrementally), so any
                // overlap is repainted correctly on every single frame.
                //
                // kSingleLineTabBleedFactor < 1 -- tuned live: the full join
                // radius overshot hover's own width.
                constexpr FLOAT kSingleLineTabBleedFactor = 0.5f;
                const UINT dpi = DpiForPaintHdc(hdc);
                const LONG bleed = static_cast<LONG>(std::lround(
                    SingleLineTabJoinRadius(dpi) * kSingleLineTabBleedFactor));
                brc.left -= bleed;
                brc.right += bleed;
            }
            DrawNineGridStretch(hdc, background->dc, &brc,
                background->left, background->top,
                background->right, background->bottom);
        }
    }
    if (singleLine && !isSelected && !isHot && !isPressed)
        PaintSingleLineTabSeparator(hdc, tab, pRect, dark);
    return true;
}


// Forward declaration — defined in the PaintCheckBox section below
static bool IsWindowDarkMode(HDC hdc);

// ============================================================================
// Sample background color for D2D control corners.
// Default: GetPixel (perfect blending with actual parent background).
// Overload for callers that already have a reliable dark/light flag of their
// own (e.g. a global mode flag, not derived from this hdc) and want to skip
// IsWindowDarkMode's own hdc-based resolution. That resolution falls back to
// WindowFromDC, then g_tlsPaintHwnd when the hdc is a buffered/memory DC --
// on a paint whose real owning window can't be recovered from the hdc at all
// (e.g. a scrollbar's native NC repaint), g_tlsPaintHwnd may still hold a
// stale hwnd left over from an unrelated control's earlier paint, so this
// overload lets such callers use their own already-correct answer instead.
static COLORREF SampleBackground(HDC hdc, int x, int y, int sysColor, bool dark)
{
    // Dark property windows: return fixed color instead of GetPixel.
    // GetPixel can capture transient white during repaints, causing
    // white artifacts around rounded borders that persist until redraw.
    if (dark)
        return (sysColor == COLOR_WINDOW) ? kElevatedPaneDark : Win32MainDark;
    COLORREF px = GetPixel(hdc, x, y);
    if (px == CLR_INVALID) return GetSysColor(sysColor);
    // Black in light mode is almost certainly an uninitialized DC or DWM black
    if (px == RGB(0, 0, 0)) return GetSysColor(sysColor);
    return px;
}

// PaintRadioButton: accent-colored radio button (BP_RADIOBUTTON)
// ============================================================================

// Checkbox and radio surfaces go through GDI+ when the paint belongs to a
// Button window: comctl32 flattens that buffer's alpha afterwards
// (BufferedPaintSetAlpha(255)), so the destination alpha GDI+ drops does
// not matter, and a paint costs ~15 us instead of the DC render target's
// ~300 us BindDC/EndDraw. DirectUI hosts (Explorer's item checkboxes on a
// Mica surface) keep the render target, which writes real alpha.
static bool PaintOnButtonWindow(HDC hdc)
{
    HWND hwnd = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (!hwnd) hwnd = t_currentCheckHWND;
    if (!hwnd) hwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
    return hwnd && IsClassName(hwnd, L"Button");
}

// GDI+ Graphics on the DC, translated so shapes use the part's own
// coordinates like the bound render target does.
static bool BeginPartGraphicsGdip(Gdiplus::Graphics& graphics, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (graphics.GetLastStatus() != Gdiplus::Ok ||
        graphics.SetSmoothingMode(Gdiplus::SmoothingModeAntiAlias) != Gdiplus::Ok ||
        graphics.SetPixelOffsetMode(Gdiplus::PixelOffsetModeHalf) != Gdiplus::Ok)
        return false;
    return graphics.TranslateTransform(static_cast<float>(pRect->left),
        static_cast<float>(pRect->top)) == Gdiplus::Ok;
}

static D2D1_COLOR_F WinUiColorF(const WinUI::Color& c)
{
    return D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(c.rgb) / 255.f, GetGValue(c.rgb) / 255.f,
        GetBValue(c.rgb) / 255.f, c.alpha / 255.f);
}

// WinUI RadioButton (RadioButton_themeresources.xaml): 20px OuterEllipse,
// stroke 1, CheckGlyph 12 (14 on PointerOver, 10 pressed). One step
// smaller here, same 2/20 steps between states: the Win32 circle is
// 13-16px, where the nominal ratio reads heavy.
static constexpr float kRadioDotRatio = 10.f / 20.f;
static constexpr float kRadioDotHotRatio = 12.f / 20.f;
static constexpr float kRadioDotPressedRatio = 8.f / 20.f;

static bool PaintRadioButton(HDC hdc, INT iPartId, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (iPartId != BP_RADIOBUTTON || !pRect) return false;
    int w = pRect->right - pRect->left, h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return false;

    bool checked  = (iStateId >= RBS_CHECKEDNORMAL);
    bool disabled = (iStateId == RBS_UNCHECKEDDISABLED || iStateId == RBS_CHECKEDDISABLED);
    bool hot      = (iStateId == RBS_UNCHECKEDHOT      || iStateId == RBS_CHECKEDHOT);
    bool pressed  = (iStateId == RBS_UNCHECKEDPRESSED  || iStateId == RBS_CHECKEDPRESSED);
    bool dark     = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);

    float scale  = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / (float)USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    float fw = (float)w, fh = (float)h;
    float dim    = std::min(fw, fh);
    float cx     = fw / 2.f, cy = fh / 2.f;
    float rOuter = dim / 2.f - 0.5f;
    float rDot   = rOuter * (pressed ? kRadioDotPressedRatio
                           : hot ? kRadioDotHotRatio : kRadioDotRatio);
    if (rOuter < 2.f) return false;

    // The square corners around the circle are left as they were on the DC,
    // so a selection pill or outline behind a radio button shows through;
    // every fill below is WinUI's own translucent value.
    // RadioButtonOuterEllipseStroke*: ControlStrongStrokeColorDefault,
    // Disabled while pressed/disabled. RadioButtonOuterEllipseFill*:
    // ControlAltFillColor Secondary / Tertiary / Quarternary / Disabled.
    const D2D1_COLOR_F bordClr = WinUiColorF(
        (pressed || disabled)
            ? WinUI::ControlStrongStrokeColorDisabled(dark)
            : WinUI::ControlStrongStrokeColorDefault(dark));
    const D2D1_COLOR_F hlClr = WinUiColorF(
        disabled ? WinUI::ControlAltFillColorDisabled(dark)
        : pressed ? WinUI::ControlAltFillColorQuarternary(dark)
        : hot     ? WinUI::ControlAltFillColorTertiary(dark)
                  : WinUI::ControlAltFillColorSecondary(dark));
    // RadioButtonOuterEllipseCheckedFill*: AccentFillColorDefault, then the
    // same color at 90 % (Secondary) / 80 % (Tertiary), AccentFillColorDisabled.
    D2D1_COLOR_F accentClr;
    if (disabled) {
        accentClr = WinUiColorF(WinUI::AccentFillColorDisabled(dark));
    } else {
        // Per-window like the checkbox.
        const COLORREF accent = GetAccentFillDefault(dark);
        accentClr = D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(accent) / 255.f, GetGValue(accent) / 255.f,
            GetBValue(accent) / 255.f, pressed ? 0.8f : hot ? 0.9f : 1.f);
    }
    // RadioButtonCheckGlyphFill: TextOnAccentFillColorPrimary in every state.
    const D2D1_COLOR_F dotClr = WinUiColorF(WinUI::TextOnAccentFillColorPrimary(dark));
    const float borderW = std::max(1.f, scale);

    if (PaintOnButtonWindow(hdc)) {
        RoundedHdcGdipDrawLock gdipLock;
        if (!gdipLock)
            return false;
        Gdiplus::Graphics graphics(hdc);
        if (!BeginPartGraphicsGdip(graphics, pRect))
            return false;
        auto circle = [&](float r) {
            return Gdiplus::RectF(cx - r, cy - r, 2.f * r, 2.f * r);
        };
        if (checked) {
            Gdiplus::SolidBrush accent(GdipColor(accentClr));
            graphics.FillEllipse(&accent, circle(rOuter));
            Gdiplus::SolidBrush dot(GdipColor(dotClr));
            graphics.FillEllipse(&dot, circle(rDot));
        } else {
            if (hlClr.a > 0.f) {
                Gdiplus::SolidBrush hl(GdipColor(hlClr));
                graphics.FillEllipse(&hl, circle(rOuter));
            }
            Gdiplus::Pen border(GdipColor(bordClr), borderW);
            graphics.DrawEllipse(&border, circle(rOuter));
            // Pressed: WinUI's PressedCheckGlyph, in the check glyph's color.
            if (pressed) {
                Gdiplus::SolidBrush dot(GdipColor(dotClr));
                graphics.FillEllipse(&dot, circle(rDot));
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (!g_d2dFactory) return false;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
    if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
        return false;
    D2D1_ELLIPSE outerE = D2D1::Ellipse(D2D1::Point2F(cx, cy), rOuter, rOuter);
    D2D1_ELLIPSE dotE   = D2D1::Ellipse(D2D1::Point2F(cx, cy), rDot,   rDot);

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> bordBr, accentBr, hlBr, dotBr;
    pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(bordClr,   &bordBr);
    pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(accentClr, &accentBr);
    pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(hlClr,     &hlBr);
    pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(dotClr,    &dotBr);
    // A null brush is a required (non-optional) parameter to FillEllipse/
    // DrawEllipse below -- Direct2D's documented error-handling policy is
    // that a null required parameter is dereferenced and crashes, unlike
    // some other "tolerated" null-resource cases.
    if (!bordBr || !accentBr || !hlBr || !dotBr) return false;

    pRT->BeginDraw();
    if (checked)
    {
        pRT->FillEllipse(outerE,  accentBr.Get());
        pRT->FillEllipse(dotE,    dotBr.Get());
    }
    else
    {
        if (hlClr.a > 0.f)
            pRT->FillEllipse(outerE, hlBr.Get());
        pRT->DrawEllipse(outerE, bordBr.Get(), borderW);
        if (pressed)
            pRT->FillEllipse(dotE, dotBr.Get());
    }
    // pRT comes from the shared cache -- same device-loss handling as every
    // other paint function using CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget.
    if (pRT->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        pRT.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
    return true;
}

// PaintCheckBox: D2D checkbox rendering with animated checkmark
// Returns true if handled.
// ============================================================================

// ── Per-window dark mode detection ────────────────────────────────────────────
// IsWindowDarkMode(hdc) resolution order (see its definition below):
//  1. WindowFromDC(hdc)       — works for BeginPaint DCs
//  2. t_currentCheckHWND      — checkbox-specific: only meaningful while a
//                               thread is nested inside CheckBoxSubclassProc's
//                               own CallWindowProcW for one particular
//                               checkbox HWND (see its declaration). Callers
//                               other than checkbox painting (radio buttons,
//                               etc.) fall through this tier harmlessly when
//                               it's null, which it is outside that nesting.
//  3. g_tlsPaintHwnd          — general: WM_PAINT-tracked HWND (set by the
//                               BeginPaint hook), works when hdc is a
//                               BufferedPaint memory DC and WindowFromDC fails
//  4. g_cachedIsDark fallback — only for off-screen DCs with no HWND context
//
// Walks to the first non-WS_CHILD ancestor and reads
// DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE. On DwmGetWindowAttribute failure we return
// FALSE (light mode) — safer than dark since dark-on-light is invisible.
// Thread-local HWND captured by BeginPaint hook — used by IsWindowDarkMode
// and PaintPushButton for reliable per-window dark mode detection.

// Walk to top-level ancestor and check DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE.
// Returns false if hwnd is NULL or no top-level found.
static bool IsHwndDarkModeUncached(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd) return false;

    wchar_t selfCls[64] = {};
    if (GetClassNameW(hwnd, selfCls, ARRAYSIZE(selfCls))) {
        if (_wcsicmp(selfCls, L"SysListView32") == 0) {
            COLORREF bk = ListView_GetBkColor(hwnd);
            if (bk != CLR_NONE) {
                int luma = (GetRValue(bk) * 54 +
                            GetGValue(bk) * 183 +
                            GetBValue(bk) * 19) >> 8;
                if (luma < 96)
                    return true;
            }
        }
        if (GetPropW(hwnd, L"UseImmersiveDarkModeColors"))
            return true;
    }

    HWND p = hwnd;
    while (p) {
        if (GetPropW(p, L"UseImmersiveDarkModeColors"))
            return true;

        if (!(GetWindowLongW(p, GWL_STYLE) & WS_CHILD)) {
            // AeroWizard windows have UseImmersiveDarkModeColors removed (see
            // HandleThemeDraw), so use kPropAeroWizardCaption as the dark-mode
            // signal instead for their real Win32 controls (checkbox, etc).
            if (GetPropW(p, kPropAeroWizardCaption))
                return g_darkModeActive;

            BOOL dark = FALSE;
            DwmGetWindowAttribute(p, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE,
                                  &dark, sizeof(dark));
            if (dark) return true;
            // Shell host windows never set the attr but are dark when system is
            WCHAR cls[32] = {};
            GetClassNameW(p, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls));
            if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"Progman") == 0 ||
                _wcsicmp(cls, L"WorkerW") == 0 ||
                _wcsicmp(cls, L"SHELLDLL_DefView") == 0) {
                if (g_accentCacheDirty.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
                    RefreshAccentCache();
                return g_cachedIsDark.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
            }
            return false;
        }
        HWND next = GetParent(p);
        if (!next) break;
        p = next;
    }
    return false;
}

// Direct-mapped per-thread cache in front of the uncached walk, which costs
// several syscalls (GetClassName, GetProp per ancestor, DwmGetWindowAttribute)
// and is asked about the same window hundreds of times per paint.
struct HwndDarkCacheEntry { HWND hwnd; uint32_t generation; bool dark; };
static thread_local HwndDarkCacheEntry g_hwndDarkCache[64];

static bool IsHwndDarkMode(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd) return false;
    const uint32_t generation = g_hwndDarkGeneration.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    HwndDarkCacheEntry& slot =
        g_hwndDarkCache[(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(hwnd) >> 3) & 63];
    if (slot.hwnd == hwnd && slot.generation == generation)
        return slot.dark;
    const bool dark = IsHwndDarkModeUncached(hwnd);
    slot = { hwnd, generation, dark };
    return dark;
}

static bool IsWindowDarkMode(HDC hdc)
{
    HWND hwnd = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (!hwnd) hwnd = t_currentCheckHWND;
    if (!hwnd) hwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
    if (hwnd) return IsHwndDarkMode(hwnd);

    // Fallback: system-wide flag — only for off-screen/unassociated DCs.
    if (g_accentCacheDirty.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) RefreshAccentCache();
    return g_cachedIsDark.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

// progressOverride >= 0 supplies the checkmark reveal for checkboxes without
// their own window (DirectUI items, see ShellCheckAnim).
static bool PaintCheckBox(HDC hdc, INT iPartId, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect,
    float progressOverride = -1.f)
{
    if (iPartId != BP_CHECKBOX || !pRect) return false;
    int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
    int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return false;

    FLOAT scale        = (FLOAT)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    FLOAT fw = (FLOAT)w, fh = (FLOAT)h;
    // The theme's box is smaller than WinUI's, so keep WinUI's radius-to-side ratio.
    FLOAT cornerRadius = (std::min)(fw, fh) *
        (WinUI::ControlCornerRadius / WinUI::CheckBoxSize);

    // Map states to fill/border colors
    D2D1_COLOR_F fillColor = {}, borderColor = {};
    // Per-window dark mode: checks the host window's DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE
    // so light-mode apps (e.g. Properties dialog) get light checkbox styling
    // even when the system is in dark mode.
    bool _dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    // Per-window _dark, so light-mode dialogs keep Dark1 under a dark system.
    COLORREF l2 = GetAccentFillDefault(_dark);
    D2D1_COLOR_F ac2 = D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(l2)/255.f, GetGValue(l2)/255.f, GetBValue(l2)/255.f);

    // CheckBox_themeresources.xaml. Unchecked: stroke
    // ControlStrongStrokeColorDefault (Disabled while pressed/disabled), fill
    // ControlAltFillColor Secondary / Tertiary / Quarternary / Disabled.
    // Checked and indeterminate: AccentFillColorDefault, the same color at
    // 90 % (Secondary) / 80 % (Tertiary), AccentFillColorDisabled with a
    // ControlStrongStrokeColorDisabled stroke.
    const WinUI::Color strongDefault = WinUI::ControlStrongStrokeColorDefault(_dark);
    const WinUI::Color strongDisabled = WinUI::ControlStrongStrokeColorDisabled(_dark);
    switch (iStateId)
    {
        case CBS_UNCHECKEDNORMAL:
            borderColor = WinUiColorF(strongDefault);
            fillColor = WinUiColorF(WinUI::ControlAltFillColorSecondary(_dark));
            break;
        case CBS_UNCHECKEDHOT:
            borderColor = WinUiColorF(strongDefault);
            fillColor = WinUiColorF(WinUI::ControlAltFillColorTertiary(_dark));
            break;
        case CBS_UNCHECKEDPRESSED:
            borderColor = WinUiColorF(strongDisabled);
            fillColor = WinUiColorF(WinUI::ControlAltFillColorQuarternary(_dark));
            break;
        case CBS_UNCHECKEDDISABLED:
            borderColor = WinUiColorF(strongDisabled);
            fillColor = WinUiColorF(WinUI::ControlAltFillColorDisabled(_dark));
            break;
        case CBS_CHECKEDNORMAL: case CBS_MIXEDNORMAL:
        case CBS_IMPLICITNORMAL: case CBS_EXCLUDEDNORMAL:
            fillColor = borderColor = ac2;
            break;
        case CBS_CHECKEDHOT: case CBS_MIXEDHOT:
        case CBS_IMPLICITHOT: case CBS_EXCLUDEDHOT:
            fillColor = borderColor = D2D1::ColorF(ac2.r, ac2.g, ac2.b, 0.9f);
            break;
        case CBS_CHECKEDPRESSED: case CBS_MIXEDPRESSED:
        case CBS_IMPLICITPRESSED: case CBS_EXCLUDEDPRESSED:
            fillColor = borderColor = D2D1::ColorF(ac2.r, ac2.g, ac2.b, 0.8f);
            break;
        case CBS_CHECKEDDISABLED: case CBS_MIXEDDISABLED:
        case CBS_IMPLICITDISABLED: case CBS_EXCLUDEDDISABLED:
            fillColor = WinUiColorF(WinUI::AccentFillColorDisabled(_dark));
            borderColor = WinUiColorF(strongDisabled);
            break;
        default:
            return false;
    }

    // Animation progress for checkmark reveal. Same hwnd-resolution cascade
    // as IsWindowDarkMode above: prefer the real window this hdc is bound
    // to over t_currentCheckHWND alone, which is only meaningful while
    // still nested inside CheckBoxSubclassProc's own call stack -- trusting
    // it unconditionally can leak one checkbox's progress into a different,
    // not-yet-subclassed checkbox's first paint if that paint is triggered
    // from within the first checkbox's own message handling (e.g. a
    // "check this to enable that" dependent-control pattern).
    bool isCheckedState = (iStateId > CBS_UNCHECKEDDISABLED);
    float progress = 1.f;
    if (progressOverride >= 0.f)
    {
        progress = (std::min)(progressOverride, 1.f);
    }
    else if (isCheckedState && SysAnimationsEnabled())
    {
        HWND checkHwnd = WindowFromDC(hdc);
        if (!checkHwnd) checkHwnd = t_currentCheckHWND;
        if (!checkHwnd) checkHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
        if (checkHwnd)
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_checkAnimsMutex);
            auto it = g_checkAnims.find((ULONG_PTR)checkHwnd);
            if (it != g_checkAnims.end())
                progress = it->second.progress;
        }
    }
    // The reveal's TrimEnd easing in AnimatedAcceptVisualSource.
    const float ep = PillCubicBezierEase(progress, 0.55f, 0.f, 0.f, 1.f);

    const bool unchecked = iStateId >= CBS_UNCHECKEDNORMAL && iStateId <= CBS_UNCHECKEDDISABLED;
    // The disabled checked/mixed boxes keep their ControlStrongStrokeColorDisabled
    // stroke too (CheckBoxCheckBackgroundStroke*Disabled).
    const bool stroked = unchecked ||
        iStateId == CBS_CHECKEDDISABLED || iStateId == CBS_MIXEDDISABLED ||
        iStateId == CBS_IMPLICITDISABLED || iStateId == CBS_EXCLUDEDDISABLED;
    const bool checkmark =
        (iStateId >= CBS_CHECKEDNORMAL  && iStateId <= CBS_CHECKEDDISABLED) ||
        (iStateId >= CBS_IMPLICITNORMAL && iStateId <= CBS_IMPLICITDISABLED);
    const bool exclude = iStateId >= CBS_EXCLUDEDNORMAL && iStateId <= CBS_EXCLUDEDDISABLED;
    const bool mixed = iStateId >= CBS_MIXEDNORMAL && iStateId <= CBS_MIXEDDISABLED;
    // CheckBoxCheckGlyphForeground*: TextOnAccentFillColorPrimary, Secondary
    // while pressed, Disabled when disabled.
    const bool glyphPressed = iStateId == CBS_CHECKEDPRESSED || iStateId == CBS_MIXEDPRESSED ||
        iStateId == CBS_IMPLICITPRESSED || iStateId == CBS_EXCLUDEDPRESSED;
    const bool glyphDisabled = iStateId == CBS_CHECKEDDISABLED || iStateId == CBS_MIXEDDISABLED ||
        iStateId == CBS_IMPLICITDISABLED || iStateId == CBS_EXCLUDEDDISABLED;
    const WinUI::Color onAccent = glyphDisabled
        ? WinUI::TextOnAccentFillColorDisabled(_dark)
        : glyphPressed
        ? WinUI::TextOnAccentFillColorSecondary(_dark)
        : WinUI::TextOnAccentFillColorPrimary(_dark);
    const D2D1_COLOR_F glyphColor = D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(onAccent.rgb) / 255.f,
        GetGValue(onAccent.rgb) / 255.f, GetBValue(onAccent.rgb) / 255.f, onAccent.alpha / 255.f);

    // Glyphs from AnimatedAcceptVisualSource, the AnimatedIcon WinUI's
    // CheckBox uses (E73E/E9AE are only its down-level FontIcon): 48x48
    // Lottie strokes shown in the 20 DIP box one DIP lower (Margin 0,1,0,-1),
    // as fractions of the box, all 1.225 DIP thick with round caps. The
    // checkmark's reveal runs along its length.
    const D2D1_POINT_2F ptLeft  = D2D1::Point2F(fw * 0.2677f, fh * 0.5284f);
    const D2D1_POINT_2F ptTip   = D2D1::Point2F(fw * 0.4234f, fh * 0.6841f);
    const D2D1_POINT_2F ptRight = D2D1::Point2F(fw * 0.7349f, fh * 0.3698f);
    const FLOAT strokeW  = (std::max)((std::min)(fw, fh) * (1.225f / WinUI::CheckBoxSize), 1.f);
    // In boxes smaller than WinUI's (the native Win32 size) the checkmark
    // keeps WinUI's absolute thickness so it doesn't read faint.
    const FLOAT checkW   = (std::max)(strokeW, 1.225f * scale);
    const FLOAT lenLeft  = hypotf(ptTip.x - ptLeft.x, ptTip.y - ptLeft.y);
    const FLOAT lenRight = hypotf(ptRight.x - ptTip.x, ptRight.y - ptTip.y);
    const FLOAT drawn    = ep * (lenLeft + lenRight);
    // The reveal's end point: on the left segment while drawn <= lenLeft,
    // otherwise on the right one.
    const bool onLeft = drawn <= lenLeft;
    const FLOAT t2 = onLeft ? drawn / lenLeft : (drawn - lenLeft) / lenRight;
    const D2D1_POINT_2F mid = onLeft
        ? D2D1::Point2F(ptLeft.x + (ptTip.x - ptLeft.x) * t2, ptLeft.y + (ptTip.y - ptLeft.y) * t2)
        : D2D1::Point2F(ptTip.x + (ptRight.x - ptTip.x) * t2, ptTip.y + (ptRight.y - ptTip.y) * t2);
    // Indeterminate: the Lottie's horizontal stroke. Excluded has no WinUI
    // counterpart and keeps its X in the same stroke.
    const D2D1_POINT_2F dashFrom = D2D1::Point2F(fw * 0.3201f, fh * 0.5481f);
    const D2D1_POINT_2F dashTo   = D2D1::Point2F(fw * 0.6818f, fh * 0.5481f);

    if (PaintOnButtonWindow(hdc)) {
        RoundedHdcGdipDrawLock gdipLock;
        if (!gdipLock)
            return false;
        Gdiplus::Graphics graphics(hdc);
        if (!BeginPartGraphicsGdip(graphics, pRect))
            return false;
        Gdiplus::GraphicsPath box;
        if (!RoundedHdcAddPath(box, Gdiplus::RectF(0.f, 0.f, fw, fh), cornerRadius,
                true, true, true, true))
            return false;
        Gdiplus::SolidBrush fill(GdipColor(fillColor));
        graphics.FillPath(&fill, &box);
        if (stroked) {
            Gdiplus::GraphicsPath edge;
            if (RoundedHdcAddPath(edge, Gdiplus::RectF(.5f, .5f, fw - 1.f, fh - 1.f),
                    cornerRadius, true, true, true, true)) {
                Gdiplus::Pen pen(GdipColor(borderColor), scale);
                graphics.DrawPath(&pen, &edge);
            }
        }
        Gdiplus::Pen pen(GdipColor(glyphColor), strokeW);
        pen.SetStartCap(Gdiplus::LineCapRound);
        pen.SetEndCap(Gdiplus::LineCapRound);
        pen.SetLineJoin(Gdiplus::LineJoinRound);
        // One polyline, so a translucent glyph color doesn't double at the corner.
        if (checkmark && drawn > 0.f) {
            pen.SetWidth(checkW);
            const Gdiplus::PointF points[] = {
                {ptLeft.x, ptLeft.y},
                onLeft ? Gdiplus::PointF(mid.x, mid.y) : Gdiplus::PointF(ptTip.x, ptTip.y),
                {mid.x, mid.y}};
            graphics.DrawLines(&pen, points, onLeft ? 2 : 3);
            pen.SetWidth(strokeW);
        }
        if (mixed)
            graphics.DrawLine(&pen, dashFrom.x, dashFrom.y, dashTo.x, dashTo.y);
        if (exclude) {
            Gdiplus::GraphicsPath cross;
            cross.AddLine(fw*.3f, fh/3.f, fw*.7f, fh/1.5f);
            cross.StartFigure();
            cross.AddLine(fw*.3f, fh/1.5f, fw*.7f, fh/3.f);
            graphics.DrawPath(&pen, &cross);
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (!g_d2dFactory) return false;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
    if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
        return false; // fallback: let system draw

    D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT rr = D2D1::RoundedRect(D2D1::RectF(0,0,fw,fh), cornerRadius, cornerRadius);
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
    pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(fillColor, &brush);
    if (!brush) return false; // fallback: let system draw
    pRT->BeginDraw();

    // Fill box — accent color appears instantly (WinUI behavior)
    pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(&rr, brush.Get());

    // Border for unchecked and disabled states
    if (stroked)
    {
        brush->SetColor(borderColor);
        pRT->DrawRoundedRectangle(
            D2D1::RoundedRect(D2D1::RectF(.5f,.5f,fw-.5f,fh-.5f), cornerRadius, cornerRadius),
            brush.Get(), scale);
    }

    if (iStateId > CBS_UNCHECKEDDISABLED)
    {
        brush->SetColor(glyphColor);
        // Round-cap, round-join stroke style: created once, eagerly, in
        // Wh_ModInit (see the D2D factory setup) -- PaintCheckBox runs on
        // however many threads have their own WH_CBT hook, so a lazy
        // check-then-create here would race.
        ID2D1StrokeStyle* const strokeStyle = g_checkStrokeStyle.Get();
        if (checkmark && drawn > 0.f)
        {
            // The factory is multithreaded, so the path is built per paint.
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> path;
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GeometrySink> sink;
            if (SUCCEEDED(g_d2dFactory->CreatePathGeometry(&path)) &&
                SUCCEEDED(path->Open(&sink)))
            {
                sink->BeginFigure(ptLeft, D2D1_FIGURE_BEGIN_HOLLOW);
                if (!onLeft)
                    sink->AddLine(ptTip);
                sink->AddLine(mid);
                sink->EndFigure(D2D1_FIGURE_END_OPEN);
                if (SUCCEEDED(sink->Close()))
                    pRT->DrawGeometry(path.Get(), brush.Get(), checkW, strokeStyle);
            }
        }
        // Indeterminate and excluded: no animation, they appear instantly.
        if (mixed)
            pRT->DrawLine(dashFrom, dashTo, brush.Get(), strokeW, strokeStyle);
        if (exclude)
        {
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> path;
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GeometrySink> sink;
            if (SUCCEEDED(g_d2dFactory->CreatePathGeometry(&path)) &&
                SUCCEEDED(path->Open(&sink)))
            {
                sink->BeginFigure(D2D1::Point2F(fw*.3f, fh/3.f), D2D1_FIGURE_BEGIN_HOLLOW);
                sink->AddLine(D2D1::Point2F(fw*.7f, fh/1.5f));
                sink->EndFigure(D2D1_FIGURE_END_OPEN);
                sink->BeginFigure(D2D1::Point2F(fw*.3f, fh/1.5f), D2D1_FIGURE_BEGIN_HOLLOW);
                sink->AddLine(D2D1::Point2F(fw*.7f, fh/3.f));
                sink->EndFigure(D2D1_FIGURE_END_OPEN);
                if (SUCCEEDED(sink->Close()))
                    pRT->DrawGeometry(path.Get(), brush.Get(), strokeW, strokeStyle);
            }
        }
    }

    if (pRT->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        pRT.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
    return true;
}

static ATOM g_cbdAtomComboBox    = 0;

static CbdTargetClass CbdGetTargetClass(HWND hwnd)
{
    ATOM cls = (ATOM)GetClassLongW(hwnd, GCW_ATOM);
    if (!cls) return CbdTargetClass::None;
    if (g_cbdAtomComboLBox   && cls == g_cbdAtomComboLBox)   return CbdTargetClass::ComboLBox;
    if (g_cbdAtomComboBox    && cls == g_cbdAtomComboBox)    return CbdTargetClass::ComboBox;
    if (g_cbdAtomAutoSuggest && cls == g_cbdAtomAutoSuggest) return CbdTargetClass::AutoSuggest;
    WCHAR name[32] = {};
    GetClassNameW(hwnd, name, ARRAYSIZE(name));
    if (_wcsicmp(name, L"ComboLBox")          == 0) { g_cbdAtomComboLBox   = cls; return CbdTargetClass::ComboLBox;   }
    if (_wcsicmp(name, L"ComboBox")           == 0) { g_cbdAtomComboBox    = cls; return CbdTargetClass::ComboBox;    }
    if (_wcsicmp(name, L"Auto-Suggest Dropdown") == 0) { g_cbdAtomAutoSuggest = cls; return CbdTargetClass::AutoSuggest; }
    return CbdTargetClass::None;
}

static bool CbdIsResizable(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (GetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE) & WS_THICKFRAME) return true;
    HWND par = GetParent(hwnd);
    if (!par) return false;
    ATOM a = (ATOM)GetClassLongW(par, GCW_ATOM);
    bool isCombo = (g_cbdAtomComboBox && a == g_cbdAtomComboBox);
    if (!isCombo) {
        WCHAR n[32] = {}; GetClassNameW(par, n, ARRAYSIZE(n));
        isCombo = (_wcsicmp(n, L"ComboBox") == 0);
    }
    return isCombo && (GetWindowLongW(par, GWL_STYLE) & WS_THICKFRAME);
}

static SetPreferredAppMode_t g_setAppMode     = nullptr;

// Reverting the process app-mode preference to Default is correct everywhere
// this mod raised it to ForceDark -- measured: every non-Explorer process
// reports Default as the value in place before the mod's own call.
//
// Explorer is the exception, and not because Default is the wrong original:
// it is the original there too. SHELL32 establishes AllowDark for Explorer
// shortly after startup and ExplorerFrame reasserts it on later events, so by
// the time a dark->light switch reverts, AllowDark is *their* value, not
// ours. Writing Default over it leaves nav-pane TreeViews resolving their
// DarkMode_Explorer:: sub-app against a light desktop, which renders hover
// text white until the control reopens its theme (measured differentially
// against a run with the mod off).
//
// The mod's own AllowDark call in Explorer stays: in a fresh process it lands
// before SHELL32's and is doing real work. Declining to write Default back is
// not an unreverted change -- the process converges to AllowDark with or
// without this mod.
static void RevertPreferredAppMode()
{
    if (!g_setAppMode || IsCurrentProcessExplorer())
        return;
    g_setAppMode(0); // Default
}

static HWND ListRenameFindAncestor(HWND hwnd, LPCWSTR className)
{
    for (HWND current = GetParent(hwnd); current;
         current = GetParent(current)) {
        if (IsClassName(current, className))
            return current;
    }
    return nullptr;
}

static ListRenameKind ListRenameGetKind(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!IsClassName(hwnd, L"Edit"))
        return ListRenameKind::None;

    HWND parent = GetParent(hwnd);
    if (IsCurrentProcessRegedit() &&
        (IsClassName(parent, L"SysTreeView32") ||
         IsClassName(parent, L"SysListView32")) &&
        IsClassName(GetAncestor(parent, GA_ROOT), L"RegEdit_RegEdit")) {
        return ListRenameKind::RegistryControl;
    }
    if (IsClassName(parent, L"SysListView32"))
        return IsDesktopIconListView(parent)
            ? ListRenameKind::ClassicListView
            : ListRenameKind::None;
    if (IsClassName(parent, L"SysTreeView32") &&
        IsClassName(GetParent(parent), L"NamespaceTreeControl")) {
        return ListRenameKind::NavigationTree;
    }

    bool sawDirectUi = false;
    for (HWND current = GetParent(hwnd); current;
         current = GetParent(current)) {
        if (IsClassName(current, L"DirectUIHWND"))
            sawDirectUi = true;
        else if (IsClassName(current, L"SHELLDLL_DefView"))
            return sawDirectUi ? ListRenameKind::DirectUiDefView
                               : ListRenameKind::None;
    }
    return ListRenameKind::None;
}

static bool ListRenameIsCandidate(HWND hwnd)
{
    return ListRenameGetKind(hwnd) != ListRenameKind::None;
}

static HWND ListRenameCurrentClassicEdit(HWND edit)
{
    HWND owner = edit ? GetParent(edit) : nullptr;
    if (!IsClassName(owner, L"SysListView32"))
        return nullptr;

    auto send = SendMessageW_orig ? SendMessageW_orig : SendMessageW;
    return reinterpret_cast<HWND>(
        send(owner, LVM_GETEDITCONTROL, 0, 0));
}

static HWND ListRenameCurrentTreeEdit(HWND edit)
{
    HWND tree = edit ? GetParent(edit) : nullptr;
    if (!IsClassName(tree, L"SysTreeView32"))
        return nullptr;

    auto send = SendMessageW_orig ? SendMessageW_orig : SendMessageW;
    return reinterpret_cast<HWND>(
        send(tree, TVM_GETEDITCONTROL, 0, 0));
}

static bool ListRenameIsClassicKind(ListRenameKind kind)
{

}

static bool ListRenameIsNativeControlKind(ListRenameKind kind)
{

static bool ListRenameIsMicaDirectUiEdit(HWND edit)
{
    if (ListRenameGetKind(edit) != ListRenameKind::DirectUiDefView ||
        !ExplorerMicaActive()) {
        return false;
    }

    if (IsInsideExplorer(edit))
        return true;

    HWND directUiHost = ListRenameFindAncestor(edit, L"DirectUIHWND");
    return FilePickerMicaActive() &&
        IsFilePickerListHost(directUiHost);
}

static bool ListRenameIsMicaNativeControlEdit(HWND edit)
{
    const ListRenameKind kind = ListRenameGetKind(edit);
    if (kind == ListRenameKind::RegistryControl)
        return RgMicaActive();
    if (kind != ListRenameKind::NavigationTree || !ExplorerMicaActive()) {
        return false;
    }

    HWND tree = GetParent(edit);
    return IsInsideExplorer(tree) ||
        (FilePickerMicaActive() && IsFilePickerNavPaneTree(tree));
}

static bool ListRenameIsExactEdit(HWND hwnd)
{
    switch (ListRenameGetKind(hwnd)) {
    case ListRenameKind::ClassicListView:
        return ListRenameCurrentClassicEdit(hwnd) == hwnd;
    case ListRenameKind::DirectUiDefView:
        return IsWindowVisible(hwnd) || GetFocus() == hwnd;
    case ListRenameKind::NavigationTree:
        return ListRenameCurrentTreeEdit(hwnd) == hwnd;
    case ListRenameKind::RegistryControl:
        return (IsClassName(GetParent(hwnd), L"SysTreeView32")
                    ? ListRenameCurrentTreeEdit(hwnd)
                    : ListRenameCurrentClassicEdit(hwnd)) == hwnd;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

static HWND ListRenameVisualHost(HWND edit)
{
    if (ListRenameGetKind(edit) == ListRenameKind::DirectUiDefView) {
        HWND parent = GetParent(edit);
        if (IsClassName(parent, L"CtrlNotifySink"))
            return parent;
    }
    return edit;
}

    HWND edit, HWND visualHost, int width, int height);

static bool ListRenameDirectUiReady()
{
    return g_listRenameDuiHookUsable.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
        ListRenameHwndHostPaint_orig && g_listRenameHwndHostGetHwnd &&
        g_d2dFactory;
}

static bool ListRenameSizeIsReady(
    HWND edit, HWND visualHost, int width, int height)
{
    if (!ListRenameIsExactEdit(edit) || !IsWindowVisible(edit) ||
        !visualHost || width <= 0 || height <= 0) {
        return false;
    }

    HWND host = ListRenameFindAncestor(edit, L"SHELLDLL_DefView");
    if (!host)
        host = GetParent(edit);
    RECT hostRect = {};
    if (!host || !GetClientRect(host, &hostRect))
        return false;

    UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(edit);
    if (!dpi)
        dpi = USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const int tolerance = MulDiv(16, dpi, USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI);
    return width <= hostRect.right - hostRect.left + tolerance &&
        height <= hostRect.bottom - hostRect.top + tolerance;
}

static void ListRenameSetActive(HWND hwnd, bool active)
{
    const bool wasActive = GetPropW(hwnd, kListRenameActiveProp) != nullptr;
    if (active == wasActive)
        return;

    if (active) {
        if (!ListRenameFeatureEnabled() || !ListRenameIsExactEdit(hwnd) ||
            !SetPropW(hwnd, kListRenameActiveProp, reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(1))) {
            return;
        }
        g_listRenameActiveCount.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        return;
    }

    if (!RemovePropW(hwnd, kListRenameActiveProp))
        return;

    unsigned count = g_listRenameActiveCount.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    while (count && !g_listRenameActiveCount.compare_exchange_weak(
        count, count - 1, std::memory_order_acq_rel,
        std::memory_order_acquire)) {
    }
}

static COLORREF ListRenameBackground(HWND hwnd)
{
    const ULONG_PTR stored = reinterpret_cast<ULONG_PTR>(
        GetPropW(hwnd, kListRenameBackgroundProp));
    return stored ? static_cast<COLORREF>(stored - 1)
                  : GetSysColor(COLOR_WINDOW);
}

static void ListRenameCaptureBackground(HWND edit, HDC hdc)
{
    if (!hdc || !ListRenameFeatureEnabled() ||
        !ListRenameIsCandidate(edit)) {
        return;
    }

    const COLORREF color = GetBkColor(hdc);
    if (color != CLR_INVALID) {
        SetPropW(edit, kListRenameBackgroundProp,
            reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(
                static_cast<ULONG_PTR>(color) + 1));
    }
}

static void ListRenameClearVisualState(HWND hwnd)
{
    HWND visualHost = ListRenameVisualHost(hwnd);
    const bool hostOutlivesEdit = visualHost && visualHost != hwnd;

    ListRenameSetActive(hwnd, false);
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kListRenameBackgroundProp);
    if (hostOutlivesEdit &&
        reinterpret_cast<HWND>(GetPropW(
            visualHost, kListRenameOwnerProp)) == hwnd) {
        RemovePropW(visualHost, kListRenameOwnerProp);
    }
}

static D2D1_COLOR_F ListRenameColor(COLORREF color)
{
    return D2D1::ColorF(
        GetRValue(color) / 255.0f,
        GetGValue(color) / 255.0f,
        GetBValue(color) / 255.0f);
}

struct ListRenameRenderState {
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> renderTarget;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
    D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT fillRect = {};
    D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT borderRect = {};
    float scale = 1.0f;
    float radius = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius;
    float stroke = 1.0f;
    int width = 0;
    int height = 0;
};

static bool ListRenamePrepareRender(
    HWND edit, HDC hdc, const RECT& paintRect,
    ListRenameRenderState* state)
{
    if (!state || !g_d2dFactory)
        return false;

    state->width = paintRect.right - paintRect.left;
    state->height = paintRect.bottom - paintRect.top;
    if (!hdc || state->width <= 0 || state->height <= 0 || !GdiFlush())
        return false;

    FPUGuard fpu;
    const D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_PROPERTIES properties =
        D2D1::RenderTargetProperties(
            D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_TYPE_DEFAULT,
            D2D1::PixelFormat(
                DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_IGNORE));
    if (FAILED(g_d2dFactory->CreateDCRenderTarget(
            &properties, state->renderTarget.GetAddressOf())) ||
        FAILED(state->renderTarget->BindDC(hdc, &paintRect))) {
        return false;
    }

    UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(edit);
    if (!dpi)
        dpi = USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    state->scale = static_cast<float>(dpi) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    state->stroke = state->scale;
    state->radius = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * state->scale;
    const float inset = state->stroke * 0.5f;
    state->fillRect = D2D1::RoundedRect(
        D2D1::RectF(0.0f, 0.0f,
            static_cast<float>(state->width),
            static_cast<float>(state->height)),
        state->radius, state->radius);
    state->borderRect = D2D1::RoundedRect(
        D2D1::RectF(inset, inset,
            state->width - inset, state->height - inset),
        state->radius, state->radius);

    return SUCCEEDED(state->renderTarget->CreateSolidColorBrush(
        ListRenameColor(ListRenameBackground(edit)),
        state->brush.GetAddressOf()));
}

static bool ListRenameDrawBase(
    HWND edit, ListRenameRenderState* state)
{
    if (!state || !state->renderTarget || !state->brush)
        return false;

    state->brush->SetColor(ListRenameColor(ListRenameBackground(edit)));
    state->renderTarget->BeginDraw();
    state->renderTarget->SetAntialiasMode(
        D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_PER_PRIMITIVE);
    state->renderTarget->FillRoundedRectangle(
        &state->fillRect, state->brush.Get());
    return SUCCEEDED(state->renderTarget->EndDraw());
}

static bool ListRenameFillBackgroundD2D(
    HDC hdc, const RECT& rect, COLORREF color)
{
    const float width = static_cast<float>(rect.right - rect.left);
    const float height = static_cast<float>(rect.bottom - rect.top);
    if (!hdc || width <= 0.0f || height <= 0.0f || !g_d2dFactory)
        return false;

    FPUGuard fpu;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> renderTarget;
    if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(
            hdc, &rect, g_d2dFactory, &renderTarget)) || !renderTarget) {
        return false;
    }

    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(
        renderTarget.Get(), ListRenameColor(color));
    if (!brush)
        return false;

    D2D1_MATRIX_3X2_F oldTransform = {};
    renderTarget->GetTransform(&oldTransform);
    renderTarget->BeginDraw();
    renderTarget->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
    renderTarget->FillRectangle(
        D2D1::RectF(0.0f, 0.0f, width, height), brush);
    renderTarget->SetTransform(oldTransform);
    const HRESULT drawResult = renderTarget->EndDraw();
    if (drawResult == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        renderTarget.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
    return SUCCEEDED(drawResult);
}

static bool ListRenameDrawBorder(
    HWND edit, ListRenameRenderState* state)
{
    if (!state || !state->renderTarget || !state->brush || !GdiFlush())
        return false;

    const COLORREF background = ListRenameBackground(edit);
    const int luma = (GetRValue(background) * 54 +
        GetGValue(background) * 183 + GetBValue(background) * 19) >> 8;
    state->brush->SetColor(luma < 128
        ? D2D1::ColorF(0.35f, 0.35f, 0.35f)
        : D2D1::ColorF(0.65f, 0.65f, 0.65f));

    state->renderTarget->BeginDraw();
    state->renderTarget->SetAntialiasMode(
        D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_PER_PRIMITIVE);
    state->renderTarget->DrawRoundedRectangle(
        &state->borderRect, state->brush.Get(), state->stroke);

    if (GetFocus() == edit) {
        state->brush->SetColor(ListRenameColor(GetAccentIndicator()));
        const float accentStroke = 2.0f * state->scale;
        const float y = state->height - accentStroke * 0.5f;
        const float sideInset = state->radius * 0.5f;
        state->renderTarget->DrawLine(
            D2D1::Point2F(sideInset, y),
            D2D1::Point2F(
                state->width - sideInset, y),
            state->brush.Get(), accentStroke);
    }

    return SUCCEEDED(state->renderTarget->EndDraw());
}

static bool ListRenameDrawClassicParentBackground(
    HWND edit, HDC hdc, const RECT& clientRect)
{
    RECT backgroundRect = clientRect;
    if (SUCCEEDED(DrawThemeParentBackground(edit, hdc, &backgroundRect)))
        return true;

    HWND parent = GetParent(edit);
    if (!parent)
        return false;

    POINT source = {clientRect.left, clientRect.top};
    SetLastError(ERROR_SUCCESS);
    if (!MapWindowPoints(edit, parent, &source, 1) &&
        GetLastError() != ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        return false;
    }

    HDC parentDc = GetDC(parent);
    if (!parentDc)
        return false;
    const BOOL copied = BitBlt(
        hdc, clientRect.left, clientRect.top,
        clientRect.right - clientRect.left,
        clientRect.bottom - clientRect.top,
        parentDc, source.x, source.y, SRCCOPY);
    ReleaseDC(parent, parentDc);
    return copied != FALSE;
}

static bool ListRenameBeginClassicPaint(HWND edit, HDC hdc)
{
    if (!hdc || g_listRenameClassicClip.edit)
        return false;

    RECT clientRect = {};
    if (!GetClientRect(edit, &clientRect) ||
        clientRect.right <= clientRect.left ||
        clientRect.bottom <= clientRect.top ||
        !ListRenameDrawClassicParentBackground(edit, hdc, clientRect)) {
        return false;
    }

    ListRenameRenderState renderState;
    if (!ListRenamePrepareRender(
            edit, hdc, clientRect, &renderState) ||
        !ListRenameDrawBase(edit, &renderState)) {
        return false;
    }

    UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(edit);
    if (!dpi)
        dpi = USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    int clipInset = std::max(
        1, static_cast<int>((dpi + USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI - 1) /
            USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI));
    const int width = clientRect.right - clientRect.left;
    const int height = clientRect.bottom - clientRect.top;
    if (width <= clipInset * 2 || height <= clipInset * 2)
        clipInset = 0;
    const int radius = std::max(
        1, MulDiv(static_cast<int>(WinUI::ControlCornerRadius), dpi, USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI));
    const int clipRadius = std::max(1, radius - clipInset);

    const int savedDc = SaveDC(hdc);
    HRGN clip = CreateRoundRectRgn(
        clientRect.left + clipInset, clientRect.top + clipInset,
        clientRect.right + 1 - clipInset,
        clientRect.bottom + 1 - clipInset,
        clipRadius * 2, clipRadius * 2);
    if (savedDc <= 0 || !clip ||
        ExtSelectClipRgn(hdc, clip, RGN_AND) == ERROR) {
        if (savedDc > 0)
            RestoreDC(hdc, savedDc);
        if (clip)
            DeleteObject(clip);
        return false;
    }

    g_listRenameClassicClip = {edit, hdc, savedDc, clip};
    return true;
}

static void ListRenameEndClassicPaint(HWND edit, HDC hdc)
{
    if (g_listRenameClassicClip.edit != edit ||
        g_listRenameClassicClip.hdc != hdc) {
        return;
    }

    RestoreDC(hdc, g_listRenameClassicClip.savedDc);
    DeleteObject(g_listRenameClassicClip.clip);
    g_listRenameClassicClip = {};
}

static void ListRenameDrawClassicBorder(HWND edit, HDC suppliedHdc = nullptr)
{
    if (!ListRenameFeatureEnabled())
        return;

    RECT clientRect = {};
    if (!GetClientRect(edit, &clientRect))
        return;
    const int width = clientRect.right - clientRect.left;
    const int height = clientRect.bottom - clientRect.top;
    if (!ListRenameSizeIsReady(edit, edit, width, height))
        return;

    HDC hdc = suppliedHdc ? suppliedHdc : GetDC(edit);
    if (!hdc)
        return;

    ListRenameRenderState state;
    if (ListRenamePrepareRender(
            edit, hdc, clientRect, &state)) {
        ListRenameDrawBorder(edit, &state);
    }

    if (!suppliedHdc)
        ReleaseDC(edit, hdc);
}

static bool ListRenameRectSizeMatches(
    const RECT& rect, int width, int height, int tolerance)
{
    const int widthDelta = rect.right - rect.left - width;
    const int heightDelta = rect.bottom - rect.top - height;
    return widthDelta >= -tolerance && widthDelta <= tolerance &&
        heightDelta >= -tolerance && heightDelta <= tolerance;
}

static bool ListRenameResolveHwndHostPaintRect(HWND edit, HDC hdc,
    const RECT* updateRect, const RECT* clipRect,
    const RECT* contentRect, const RECT* childrenRect, RECT* result)
{
    HWND visualHost = ListRenameVisualHost(edit);
    RECT visualScreenRect = {};
    if (!visualHost || !GetWindowRect(visualHost, &visualScreenRect))
        return false;

    const int width = visualScreenRect.right - visualScreenRect.left;
    const int height = visualScreenRect.bottom - visualScreenRect.top;
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
        return false;

    if (HWND dcWindow = WindowFromDC(hdc)) {
        POINT points[] = {
            {visualScreenRect.left, visualScreenRect.top},
            {visualScreenRect.right, visualScreenRect.bottom},
        };
        SetLastError(ERROR_SUCCESS);
        if (!MapWindowPoints(
                HWND_DESKTOP, dcWindow, points, ARRAYSIZE(points)) &&
            GetLastError() != ERROR_SUCCESS) {
            return false;
        }

        POINT viewportOrigin = {};
        POINT windowOrigin = {};
        GetViewportOrgEx(hdc, &viewportOrigin);
        GetWindowOrgEx(hdc, &windowOrigin);
        result->left = points[0].x - viewportOrigin.x + windowOrigin.x;
        result->top = points[0].y - viewportOrigin.y + windowOrigin.y;
        result->right = points[1].x - viewportOrigin.x + windowOrigin.x;
        result->bottom = points[1].y - viewportOrigin.y + windowOrigin.y;
        return true;
    }

    UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(edit);
    if (!dpi)
        dpi = USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const int tolerance = std::max(
        2, MulDiv(4, dpi, USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI));
    const RECT* candidates[] = {
        contentRect, childrenRect, updateRect, clipRect,
    };
    for (const RECT* candidate : candidates) {
        if (candidate && ListRenameRectSizeMatches(
                *candidate, width, height, tolerance)) {
            *result = *candidate;
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static HWND ListRenameFromHwndHost(void* hwndHost)
{
    if (!hwndHost || !ListRenameDirectUiReady())
        return nullptr;

    HWND hostedWindow = g_listRenameHwndHostGetHwnd(hwndHost);
    if (ListRenameGetKind(hostedWindow) ==
            ListRenameKind::DirectUiDefView &&
        GetPropW(hostedWindow, kListRenameActiveProp) &&
        ListRenameIsExactEdit(hostedWindow)) {
        return hostedWindow;
    }

    HWND edit = reinterpret_cast<HWND>(
        GetPropW(hostedWindow, kListRenameOwnerProp));
    return ListRenameGetKind(edit) == ListRenameKind::DirectUiDefView &&
            GetPropW(edit, kListRenameActiveProp) &&
            ListRenameIsExactEdit(edit)
        ? edit
        : nullptr;
}

static void LIST_RENAME_DUI_CALL ListRenameHwndHostPaint_hook(
    void* hwndHost, HDC hdc, const RECT* updateRect, const RECT* clipRect,
    RECT* contentRect, RECT* childrenRect)
{
    if (!ListRenameHasActiveEdit() || !ListRenameFeatureEnabled() ||
        g_listRenameInHwndHostPaint) {
        ListRenameHwndHostPaint_orig(
            hwndHost, hdc, updateRect, clipRect, contentRect, childrenRect);
        return;
    }

    HWND edit = ListRenameFromHwndHost(hwndHost);
    RECT paintRect = {};
    if (!edit || !ListRenameResolveHwndHostPaintRect(
            edit, hdc, updateRect, clipRect,
            contentRect, childrenRect, &paintRect) ||
        g_darkModeActive || !ListRenameIsMicaDirectUiEdit(edit)) {
        ListRenameHwndHostPaint_orig(
            hwndHost, hdc, updateRect, clipRect, contentRect, childrenRect);
        return;
    }

    g_listRenameInHwndHostPaint = true;
    const BufferedPaintScope bufferedPaintScope;
    BP_PAINTPARAMS paintParams = {sizeof(BP_PAINTPARAMS)};
    paintParams.dwFlags = BPPF_ERASE | BPPF_NOCLIP;
    HDC paintHdc = nullptr;
    HPAINTBUFFER paintBuffer = BeginBufferedPaint(
        hdc, &paintRect, BPBF_TOPDOWNDIB,
        &paintParams, &paintHdc);
    if (!paintBuffer || !paintHdc ||
        !ListRenameFillBackgroundD2D(
            paintHdc, paintRect, GetSysColor(COLOR_WINDOW))) {
        if (paintBuffer)
            EndBufferedPaint(paintBuffer, FALSE);
        g_listRenameInHwndHostPaint = false;
        ListRenameHwndHostPaint_orig(
            hwndHost, hdc, updateRect, clipRect,
            contentRect, childrenRect);
        return;
    }

    HWND previousPaintEdit = g_listRenamePaintEdit;
    g_listRenamePaintEdit = edit;
    ListRenameHwndHostPaint_orig(
        hwndHost, paintHdc, updateRect, clipRect, contentRect, childrenRect);
    g_listRenamePaintEdit = previousPaintEdit;

    // GDI writes the native RGB correctly but clears alpha again while
    // painting the Edit. Repair the completed buffer, after all native text,
    // selection, caret and border work, without changing any color channel.
    RGBQUAD* pixels = nullptr;
    int rowWidth = 0;
    bool alphaRepaired = GdiFlush() &&
        SUCCEEDED(GetBufferedPaintBits(
            paintBuffer, &pixels, &rowWidth)) &&
        pixels && rowWidth > 0;
    if (alphaRepaired) {
        const int width = paintRect.right - paintRect.left;
        const int height = paintRect.bottom - paintRect.top;
        for (int y = 0; y < height; ++y) {
            RGBQUAD* row = pixels +
                static_cast<size_t>(y) * rowWidth;
            for (int x = 0; x < width; ++x)
                row[x].rgbReserved = 255;
        }
    }

    if (!alphaRepaired) {
        EndBufferedPaint(paintBuffer, FALSE);
        g_listRenameInHwndHostPaint = false;
        ListRenameHwndHostPaint_orig(
            hwndHost, hdc, updateRect, clipRect,
            contentRect, childrenRect);
        return;
    }

    const HRESULT commitResult = EndBufferedPaint(paintBuffer, TRUE);
    g_listRenameInHwndHostPaint = false;
    if (FAILED(commitResult)) {
        ListRenameHwndHostPaint_orig(
            hwndHost, hdc, updateRect, clipRect,
            contentRect, childrenRect);
    }
}

static void ListRenameDrawNativeFrame(
    HWND edit, HDC suppliedHdc = nullptr)
{
    if (!edit || g_darkModeActive ||
        !ListRenameIsNativeControlKind(ListRenameGetKind(edit)) ||
        !GetPropW(edit, kListRenameActiveProp) ||
        !ListRenameIsMicaNativeControlEdit(edit) ||
        !ListRenameIsExactEdit(edit)) {
        return;
    }

    RECT clientRect = {};
    if (!GetClientRect(edit, &clientRect))
        return;
    const int width = clientRect.right - clientRect.left;
    const int height = clientRect.bottom - clientRect.top;
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
        return;

    HDC outputHdc = suppliedHdc ? suppliedHdc : GetDC(edit);
    if (!outputHdc)
        return;

    BITMAPINFO bitmapInfo = {};
    bitmapInfo.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(bitmapInfo.bmiHeader);
    bitmapInfo.bmiHeader.biWidth = width;
    bitmapInfo.bmiHeader.biHeight = -height;
    bitmapInfo.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bitmapInfo.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bitmapInfo.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;
    void* bits = nullptr;
    HBITMAP bitmap = CreateDIBSection(
        outputHdc, &bitmapInfo, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
    HDC memoryDc = bitmap && bits ? CreateCompatibleDC(outputHdc) : nullptr;
    if (memoryDc) {
        HGDIOBJ previous = SelectObject(memoryDc, bitmap);
        if (previous && previous != HGDI_ERROR) {
            RECT bufferRect = {0, 0, width, height};
            if (HBRUSH brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(GetSysColor(COLOR_WINDOW))) {
                (FillRect_orig ? FillRect_orig : FillRect)(
                    memoryDc, &bufferRect, brush);

                const bool previousPrint =
                    g_listRenameInNativePrint;
                g_listRenameInNativePrint = true;
                SendMessageW(edit, WM_PRINTCLIENT,
                    reinterpret_cast<WPARAM>(memoryDc), PRF_CLIENT);
                g_listRenameInNativePrint = previousPrint;

                if (GdiFlush()) {
                    DWORD* pixels = static_cast<DWORD*>(bits);
                    const size_t pixelCount =
                        static_cast<size_t>(width) * height;
                    for (size_t i = 0; i < pixelCount; ++i)
                        pixels[i] |= 0xFF000000u;

                    UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(edit);
                    if (!dpi)
                        dpi = USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
                    const int inset = std::min(
                        std::max(1, MulDiv(4, dpi, USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI)),
                        std::min(width, height) / 2);
                    HRGN outer = CreateRectRgn(0, 0, width, height);
                    HRGN inner = CreateRectRgn(
                        inset, inset, width - inset, height - inset);
                    HRGN frame = CreateRectRgn(0, 0, 0, 0);
                    if (outer && inner && frame &&
                        CombineRgn(frame, outer, inner, RGN_DIFF) != ERROR) {
                        const int savedDc = SaveDC(outputHdc);
                        if (savedDc > 0 &&
                            ExtSelectClipRgn(
                                outputHdc, frame, RGN_AND) != ERROR) {
                            BitBlt(outputHdc, 0, 0, width, height,
                                memoryDc, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
                        }
                        if (savedDc > 0)
                            RestoreDC(outputHdc, savedDc);
                    }
                    if (frame)
                        DeleteObject(frame);
                    if (inner)
                        DeleteObject(inner);
                    if (outer)
                        DeleteObject(outer);
                }
            }
            SelectObject(memoryDc, previous);
        }
        DeleteDC(memoryDc);
    }
    if (bitmap)
        DeleteObject(bitmap);
    if (!suppliedHdc)
        ReleaseDC(edit, outputHdc);
}

static void ListRenameRepairNativeAlpha(
    HWND edit, HDC suppliedHdc = nullptr)
{
    if (!edit || g_darkModeActive ||
        ListRenameGetKind(edit) != ListRenameKind::DirectUiDefView ||
        !GetPropW(edit, kListRenameActiveProp) ||
        !ListRenameIsMicaDirectUiEdit(edit) ||
        !ListRenameIsExactEdit(edit)) {
        return;
    }

    RECT clientRect = {};
    if (!GetClientRect(edit, &clientRect) ||
        clientRect.right <= clientRect.left ||
        clientRect.bottom <= clientRect.top) {
        return;
    }

    HDC hdc = suppliedHdc ? suppliedHdc : GetDC(edit);
    if (!hdc)
        return;
    RepairOpaqueHdcAlpha(hdc, clientRect);
    if (!suppliedHdc)
        ReleaseDC(edit, hdc);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK ListRenameSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        ListRenameClearVisualState(hwnd);
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_listRenameWindowsMutex);
            g_listRenameWindows.erase(hwnd);
        }
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, ListRenameSubclassProc);
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    }

    if (g_listRenameInNativePrint && msg == WM_PRINTCLIENT)
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);

    if (!ListRenameFeatureEnabled()) {
        ListRenameClearVisualState(hwnd);
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    }

    if (msg == WM_SETFOCUS) {
        ListRenameSetActive(hwnd, true);
        const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        ListRenameRepairNativeAlpha(hwnd);
        ListRenameDrawNativeFrame(hwnd);
        return result;
    }
    if (msg == WM_KILLFOCUS) {
        const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        ListRenameRepairNativeAlpha(hwnd);
        ListRenameDrawNativeFrame(hwnd);
        ListRenameSetActive(hwnd, false);
        return result;
    }
    if (msg == WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGED) {
        const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        const bool active =
            IsWindowVisible(hwnd) && ListRenameIsExactEdit(hwnd);
        ListRenameSetActive(hwnd, active);
        if (active &&
            ListRenameGetKind(hwnd) == ListRenameKind::DirectUiDefView) {
            HWND visualHost = ListRenameVisualHost(hwnd);
            RedrawWindow(visualHost ? visualHost : hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
                RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME |
                    RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
        } else if (active &&
                   ListRenameIsNativeControlKind(ListRenameGetKind(hwnd))) {
            ListRenameDrawNativeFrame(hwnd);
        }
        return result;
    }
    if (msg == WM_LBUTTONDOWN || msg == WM_LBUTTONUP ||
        msg == WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK || msg == WM_KEYDOWN ||
        msg == WM_KEYUP || msg == WM_CHAR ||
        msg == WM_CUT || msg == WM_COPY || msg == WM_PASTE ||
        msg == WM_CLEAR || msg == WM_UNDO ||
        msg == WM_IME_COMPOSITION) {
        const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        ListRenameRepairNativeAlpha(hwnd);
        return result;
    }
    if (msg == WM_MOUSEMOVE && GetCapture() == hwnd &&
        (wp & MK_LBUTTON)) {
        const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        ListRenameRepairNativeAlpha(hwnd);
        return result;
    }
    if (msg == WM_PAINT) {
        const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        const ListRenameKind kind = ListRenameGetKind(hwnd);
        if (ListRenameIsClassicKind(kind))
            ListRenameDrawClassicBorder(hwnd);
        else if (kind == ListRenameKind::DirectUiDefView)
            ListRenameRepairNativeAlpha(hwnd);
        else if (ListRenameIsNativeControlKind(kind))
            ListRenameDrawNativeFrame(hwnd);
        return result;
    }
    if (msg == WM_PRINTCLIENT) {
        const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        const ListRenameKind kind = ListRenameGetKind(hwnd);
        if (ListRenameIsClassicKind(kind)) {
            ListRenameDrawClassicBorder(hwnd, reinterpret_cast<HDC>(wp));
        } else if (kind == ListRenameKind::DirectUiDefView) {
            ListRenameRepairNativeAlpha(
                hwnd, reinterpret_cast<HDC>(wp));
        } else if (ListRenameIsNativeControlKind(kind)) {
            ListRenameDrawNativeFrame(
                hwnd, reinterpret_cast<HDC>(wp));
        }
        return result;
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

static void ListRenameTryTrack(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (g_listRenameUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !IsClassName(hwnd, L"Edit")) {
        return;
    }

    const ListRenameKind kind = ListRenameGetKind(hwnd);
    if (kind == ListRenameKind::None ||
        g_listRenameHighContrast.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return;
    }
    if (kind == ListRenameKind::ClassicListView &&
        !GetSettings()->EditFocusLine) {
        return;
    }
    if (kind == ListRenameKind::DirectUiDefView) {
        if (g_darkModeActive || !ListRenameIsMicaDirectUiEdit(hwnd) ||
            !EnsureD2DFactory()) {
            return;
        }
        if (!ListRenameDirectUiReady()) {
            if (!g_listRenameDuiHookAttempted.load(
                    std::memory_order_acquire)) {
                DirectUiRequestRenameSymbols(hwnd);
            }
            return;
        }
    } else if (ListRenameIsNativeControlKind(kind) &&
               (g_darkModeActive ||
                !ListRenameIsMicaNativeControlEdit(hwnd))) {
        return;
    }

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_listRenameWindowsMutex);
        if (g_listRenameWindows.contains(hwnd))
            return;
        // Reserve before the cross-thread subclass call. If destruction races
        // the install, WM_NCDESTROY can still erase the entry.
        g_listRenameWindows.insert(hwnd);
    }

    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, ListRenameSubclassProc, 0)) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_listRenameWindowsMutex);
        g_listRenameWindows.erase(hwnd);
        return;
    }

    HWND visualHost = ListRenameVisualHost(hwnd);
    if (visualHost != hwnd) {
        if (!SetPropW(visualHost, kListRenameOwnerProp, hwnd)) {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_listRenameWindowsMutex);
            g_listRenameWindows.erase(hwnd);
            WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                hwnd, ListRenameSubclassProc);
            return;
        }
    }

    ListRenameSetActive(hwnd,
