        IsWindowVisible(hwnd) && ListRenameIsExactEdit(hwnd));
}

static void ListRenameCleanupAll(bool redraw)
{
    std::vector<HWND> windows;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_listRenameWindowsMutex);
        windows.assign(
            g_listRenameWindows.begin(), g_listRenameWindows.end());
        g_listRenameWindows.clear();
    }
    for (HWND hwnd : windows) {
        if (!IsWindow(hwnd))
            continue;
        ListRenameClearVisualState(hwnd);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, ListRenameSubclassProc);
        if (redraw) {
            RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
                RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME);
        }
    }
    g_listRenameActiveCount.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
}

static BOOL CALLBACK ListRenameTrackChildEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    ListRenameTryTrack(hwnd);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK ListRenameTrackTopEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId())
        return TRUE;

    ListRenameTryTrack(hwnd);
    EnumChildWindows(hwnd, ListRenameTrackChildEnum, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

static bool ListRenameQueueDuiHook(HMODULE dui70, bool* queued)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_listRenameHookMutex);
    if (ListRenameHwndHostPaint_orig) {
        if (queued && !g_listRenameDuiHookUsable.load(
                std::memory_order_acquire)) {
            *queued = true;
        }
        return true;
    }
    if (g_listRenameDuiHookAttempted.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !dui70) {
        return false;
    }

    g_listRenameDuiHookAttempted.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
#ifdef _WIN64
    constexpr const char* getHwndSymbol =
        "?GetHWND@HWNDHost@DirectUI@@UEAAPEAUHWND__@@XZ";
#else
    constexpr const char* getHwndSymbol =
        "?GetHWND@HWNDHost@DirectUI@@UAEPAUHWND__@@XZ";
#endif
    g_listRenameHwndHostGetHwnd =
        reinterpret_cast<ListRenameHwndHostGetHwnd_t>(
            GetProcAddress(dui70, getHwndSymbol));
    if (!g_listRenameHwndHostGetHwnd) {
        Wh_Log(L"Rename edit: HWNDHost::GetHWND unavailable; "
               L"light-Mica alpha repair disabled");
        return false;
    }

    const bool success = SetResolvedSymbolHook(
        DuiExport(dui70,
            "?Paint@HWNDHost@DirectUI@@UEAAXPEAUHDC__@@PEBUtagRECT@@1PEAU4@2@Z",
            "?Paint@HWNDHost@DirectUI@@UAEXPAUHDC__@@PBUtagRECT@@1PAU4@2@Z"),
        ListRenameHwndHostPaint_hook, &ListRenameHwndHostPaint_orig);
    if (success && ListRenameHwndHostPaint_orig) {
        if (queued)
            *queued = true;
        else
            g_listRenameDuiHookUsable.store(
                true, std::memory_order_release);
        return true;
    }

    g_listRenameHwndHostGetHwnd = nullptr;
    Wh_Log(L"Rename edit: HWNDHost::Paint unavailable; "
           L"light-Mica alpha repair disabled");
    return false;
}

static void CbdLoadAPIs()
{
    // Both modules are direct imports; borrow their handles without adding refs.
    HMODULE hDwm  = GetModuleHandleW(L"dwmapi.dll");
    HMODULE hUx   = GetModuleHandleW(L"uxtheme.dll");
    if (hDwm) {
        g_cbdDwmSetAttr = (CbdDwmSetAttr_t)GetProcAddress(hDwm, "DwmSetWindowAttribute");
    }
    HMODULE hUser32 = GetModuleHandleW(L"user32.dll");
    if (hUser32) {
        g_pSWCA = (SetWindowCompositionAttribute_t)
            GetProcAddress(hUser32, "SetWindowCompositionAttribute");
    }
    if (hUx) {
        g_cbdAllowDarkRaw    = (CbdAllowDark_t)GetProcAddress(hUx, MAKEINTRESOURCEA(133));
        g_cbdAllowDark       = g_cbdAllowDarkRaw ? CbdAllowDarkTracked : nullptr;
        g_setAppMode         = (SetPreferredAppMode_t)GetProcAddress(hUx, MAKEINTRESOURCEA(135));
        g_flushMenuThemes    = (FlushMenuThemes_t)GetProcAddress(hUx, MAKEINTRESOURCEA(136));
        g_pDrawTextWithGlow  = (DrawTextWithGlow_t)GetProcAddress(hUx, MAKEINTRESOURCEA(126));
        g_refreshColorPolicy = (RefreshImmersiveColorPolicyState_t)GetProcAddress(hUx, MAKEINTRESOURCEA(104));
    }
}

static void ResetExcludedProcessDarkModeHints()
{
    // Excluded processes should not inherit the mod's process-wide ForceDark
    // state. This only resets hints that are owned by this process; it doesn't
    // touch per-window app-native dark mode.
    if (g_setAppMode) {
        RevertPreferredAppMode();
        if (g_flushMenuThemes)
            g_flushMenuThemes();
        if (g_refreshColorPolicy)
            g_refreshColorPolicy();
    }
}

// ── Acrylic context menus (#32768 popups) ─────────────────────────────────
// Subclass menu windows in WM_CREATE, refresh SWCA acrylic on MN_SIZEWINDOW,
// and route Menu theme background/border/gutter fills through the acrylic
// black-backdrop path or opaque dark fallback.
constexpr UINT MN_SIZEWINDOW = 0x01E2;
static const wchar_t MENUPOPUP_CLASS[] = L"#32768";
static constexpr DWORD kDwmwaBorderColor = 34; // DWMWA_BORDER_COLOR
static constexpr DWORD kDwmwaUseHostBackdropBrush = 17; // DWMWA_USE_HOSTBACKDROPBRUSH
static constexpr int kDwmsbtMainWindow = 2; // DWMSBT_MAINWINDOW (Mica)

static bool IsLegacyShellDropdownRoot(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd)
        return false;

    HWND root = GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT);
    if (!root)
        root = hwnd;

    wchar_t cls[32] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(root, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)))
        return false;

    return _wcsicmp(cls, L"DropDown") == 0 ||
           _wcsicmp(cls, L"ViewControlClass") == 0;
}

static COLORREF MenuAcrylicDwmBorderColor(bool dark)
{
    // DWMWA_BORDER_COLOR takes a plain opaque COLORREF, and only that:
    // measured that any non-zero top byte makes DWM discard the value and
    // draw its own default border instead, while the same color with a zero
    // top byte lands exactly. So the token is flattened here rather than
    // passed with its alpha. A translucent window border does exist, but only
    // from inside dwm.exe, where CWindowBorder::SetBorderParameters takes a
    // float RGBA -- out of reach from a process-side hook.
    //
    if (dark)
        return WinUiFloatingSurfaceStroke(true);

    // MenuFlyoutPresenter binds its outline to SurfaceStrokeColorFlyout.
    // Flattening the light token over SolidBackgroundFillColorBase gives the
    // #E5E5E5 shown by WinUI Gallery. SurfaceStrokeColorDefault is the stronger
    // generic surface outline (~#C1C1C1 there), not the flyout hairline.
    return WinUI::FlattenOver(WinUI::Light::SurfaceStrokeColorFlyout,
                              WinUI::Light::SolidBackgroundFillColorBase.rgb);
}

// Created eagerly in Wh_ModInit (single-threaded, before any hook is live) --
// MenuAcrylicSubclassProc runs on whatever thread owns the #32768 popup being
// painted, and a process with more than one UI thread can paint two different
// popups concurrently, so a lazy check-then-create here would race (same bug
// class as the checkbox subsystem's g_checkStrokeStyle, fixed earlier).
static HBRUSH g_acrylicMenuBorderBrush = nullptr;
static HBRUSH g_acrylicMenuBorderBrushLight = nullptr;

static HBRUSH MenuAcrylicDwmBorderBrush(bool dark)
{
    HBRUSH brush = dark ? g_acrylicMenuBorderBrush
                        : g_acrylicMenuBorderBrushLight;
    return brush ? brush : static_cast<HBRUSH>(GetStockObject(BLACK_BRUSH));
}

// Set first thing in Wh_ModUninit, before the (multi-second) thread joins
// that precede the EnumWindows(MenuRemoveSubclassEnum) sweep -- otherwise a
// #32768/DropDown/ViewControlClass popup created and subclassed during that
// window is never reached by the sweep, and its subclass calls into freed
// code after the DLL actually unloads. Checked at the top of
// MenuTryInstallAcrylic, the single choke point all install paths funnel
// through. Same pattern as the pre-existing g_navDividerUnloading.
static std::atomic<bool> g_menuAcrylicUnloading{ false };

static bool MenuUseTransparentBackdrop()
{
    return IsSystemTransparencyEnabled() && g_pSWCA;
}

static DWORD MenuAcrylicTintColor(bool dark)
{
    // ACCENT_POLICY::GradientColor uses 0xAABBGGRR, not COLORREF/RGB. Only
    // the color comes from WinUI; the opacity is this mod's own, and the two
    // themes do not take the same one. Light ink is legible over a thin tint
    // of almost anything, dark ink is not, so the light surface keeps more of
    // itself -- the same reason the tooltip pair is not symmetric either.
    // These two are the tuning knobs for how translucent a menu reads.
    constexpr DWORD kDarkTintAlpha = 0x80;   // an even 50%
    constexpr DWORD kLightTintAlpha = 0xCC;  // 80%
    const COLORREF solid = WinUiFloatingSurfaceColor(dark);
    const DWORD alpha = dark ? kDarkTintAlpha : kLightTintAlpha;
    return (alpha << 24) | (GetBValue(solid) << 16) | (GetGValue(solid) << 8) |
           GetRValue(solid);
}

static DWORD TooltipAcrylicTintColor(bool dark)
{
    // ACCENT_POLICY::GradientColor uses 0xAABBGGRR. Both variants stay
    // nearly opaque so acrylic contributes only subtle blur and noise, and
    // the opacity is this mod's own -- only the color comes from WinUI.
    //
    // The surface color shared with menus and the drag label; see
    // WinUiFloatingSurfaceColor. Gray, so the byte order does not matter.
    const COLORREF solid = WinUiFloatingSurfaceColor(dark);
    const DWORD alpha = dark ? 0xD9u : 0xE6u;
    return (alpha << 24) | (GetBValue(solid) << 16) | (GetGValue(solid) << 8) |
           GetRValue(solid);
}

// ToolTip binds ToolTipBorderBrush to SurfaceStrokeColorFlyoutBrush. DWM's
// border attribute takes an opaque color, so the token is flattened over
// SolidBackgroundFillColorBase -- the shade it is defined against, and the
// one the shell's own flyout borders match (the WinUI Gallery presents it as
// #E5E5E5 in light). Flattening it over the tooltip's near-white tint instead
// would wash it out to #EDEDED.
static COLORREF TooltipDwmBorderColor(bool dark)
{
    return WinUI::FlattenOver(WinUI::SurfaceStrokeColorFlyout(dark),
                              WinUI::SolidBackgroundFillColorBase(dark).rgb);
}

static constexpr wchar_t kTooltipAcrylicActiveProp[] =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.TooltipAcrylicActive";
static constexpr wchar_t kTooltipCornerLowProp[] =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.TooltipCornerLow";
static constexpr wchar_t kTooltipCornerHighProp[] =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.TooltipCornerHigh";
static constexpr wchar_t kTooltipBorderLowProp[] =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.TooltipBorderLow";
static constexpr wchar_t kTooltipBorderHighProp[] =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.TooltipBorderHigh";
static std::atomic<bool> g_tooltipEffectsUnloading{ false };
static std::atomic<bool> g_tooltipTextUnloading{ false };

static bool TooltipTextIsWindow(HWND hwnd)
{
    return hwnd && IsClassName(hwnd, L"tooltips_class32");
}

static bool TooltipTextIsEnabled()
{
    return !g_isXamlProcess && g_settings.ModernTooltips &&
           !IsTextPipelineDisabled() &&
           !g_tooltipTextUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

static bool TooltipLoadSavedDword(HWND hwnd, PCWSTR lowProp, PCWSTR highProp,
    DWORD* value)
{
    if (!hwnd || !value)
        return false;

    HANDLE low = GetPropW(hwnd, lowProp);
    HANDLE high = GetPropW(hwnd, highProp);
    if (!low || !high)
        return false;

    const DWORD lowWord = static_cast<DWORD>(
        reinterpret_cast<ULONG_PTR>(low) - 1u);
    const DWORD highWord = static_cast<DWORD>(
        reinterpret_cast<ULONG_PTR>(high) - 1u);
    *value = MAKELONG(lowWord, highWord);
    return true;
}

static bool TooltipSaveDword(HWND hwnd, PCWSTR lowProp, PCWSTR highProp,
    DWORD value)
{
    (void)RemovePropW(hwnd, lowProp);
    (void)RemovePropW(hwnd, highProp);

    HANDLE low = reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(
        static_cast<ULONG_PTR>(LOWORD(value)) + 1u);
    HANDLE high = reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(
        static_cast<ULONG_PTR>(HIWORD(value)) + 1u);
    if (!SetPropW(hwnd, lowProp, low))
        return false;
    if (SetPropW(hwnd, highProp, high))
        return true;

    (void)RemovePropW(hwnd, lowProp);
    return false;
}

static void TooltipApplyTrackedDwmAttribute(HWND hwnd, DWORD attribute,
    DWORD value, PCWSTR lowProp, PCWSTR highProp)
{
    if (!hwnd || !g_cbdDwmSetAttr)
        return;

    // DWMWA_BORDER_COLOR is write-only: DwmGetWindowAttribute answers
    // E_INVALIDARG for it (measured; the corner preference beside it reads
    // back fine). Bailing out on that failure meant the tooltip border color
    // was never applied at all, leaving the system's own. DWMWA_COLOR_DEFAULT
    // is the documented way to hand the attribute back, so it stands in as
    // the saved original and the write goes ahead.
    DWORD original = 0;
    if (!TooltipLoadSavedDword(hwnd, lowProp, highProp, &original)) {
        if (FAILED(DwmGetWindowAttribute(
                hwnd, attribute, &original, sizeof(original)))) {
            original = DWMWA_COLOR_DEFAULT;
        }
        if (!TooltipSaveDword(hwnd, lowProp, highProp, original))
            return;
    }

    (void)g_cbdDwmSetAttr(hwnd, attribute, &value, sizeof(value));
}

static void TooltipRestoreDwmAttribute(HWND hwnd, DWORD attribute,
    PCWSTR lowProp, PCWSTR highProp)
{
    DWORD original = 0;
    if (!hwnd || !g_cbdDwmSetAttr ||
        !TooltipLoadSavedDword(hwnd, lowProp, highProp, &original)) {
        return;
    }

    if (SUCCEEDED(g_cbdDwmSetAttr(
            hwnd, attribute, &original, sizeof(original)))) {
        (void)RemovePropW(hwnd, lowProp);
        (void)RemovePropW(hwnd, highProp);
    }
}

static void TooltipDisableAcrylic(HWND hwnd, bool force = false)
{
    if (!hwnd)
        return;

    const bool owned = GetPropW(hwnd, kTooltipAcrylicActiveProp) != nullptr;
    if (!owned && !force)
        return;

    bool disabled = true;
    if (g_pSWCA) {
        ACCENT_POLICY accent{};
        accent.AccentState = ACCENT_DISABLED;
        WINCOMPATTRDATA attr{};
        attr.Attrib = WCA_ACCENT_POLICY;
        attr.pvData = &accent;
        attr.cbData = sizeof(accent);
        disabled = g_pSWCA(hwnd, &attr) != FALSE;
    }
    if (disabled)
        (void)RemovePropW(hwnd, kTooltipAcrylicActiveProp);
}

static void TooltipRestoreEffects(HWND hwnd)
{
    TooltipDisableAcrylic(hwnd);
    TooltipRestoreDwmAttribute(hwnd, DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE,
        kTooltipCornerLowProp, kTooltipCornerHighProp);
    TooltipRestoreDwmAttribute(hwnd, kDwmwaBorderColor,
        kTooltipBorderLowProp, kTooltipBorderHighProp);
}

// The prop also records the tint's theme (1 light, 2 dark): the text drawn
// over it has to read on that material, which the DC can't show (its pixels
// there are the black acrylic placeholder).
static bool TooltipEnableAcrylic(HWND hwnd, bool dark)
{
    if (!hwnd || !g_pSWCA)
        return false;

    ACCENT_POLICY accent{};
    accent.AccentState = ACCENT_ENABLE_ACRYLICBLURBEHIND;
    accent.GradientColor = TooltipAcrylicTintColor(dark);
    WINCOMPATTRDATA attr{};
    attr.Attrib = WCA_ACCENT_POLICY;
    attr.pvData = &accent;
    attr.cbData = sizeof(accent);
    const bool applied = g_pSWCA(hwnd, &attr) != FALSE;
    if (applied && SetPropW(hwnd, kTooltipAcrylicActiveProp,
            reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(static_cast<UINT_PTR>(dark ? 2 : 1)))) {
        return true;
    }

    // Roll back an effect that was applied but couldn't be marked as ours.
    TooltipDisableAcrylic(hwnd, applied);
    return false;
}

#define MN_GETHMENU 0x01E1

static constexpr wchar_t kMenuSurfaceOwnedProp[] =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.MenuSurfaceOwned";

extern thread_local HWND g_tlsPaintHwnd;

// A popup whose pixels the application supplies itself: MIM_BACKGROUND hands
// user32 a brush to fill the background with, MFT_OWNERDRAW hands the item to
// the owner's WM_DRAWITEM. Both paint with plain GDI, which leaves alpha at
// zero, and over a transparent backdrop those pixels land ADDED to the
// material instead of covering it. Native immersive menus no longer reach
// this test while ModernContextMenus is active: the symbol hooks below make
// user32 build their classic, acrylic-compatible representation first.
static bool MenuPopupSelfPaints(HWND hwnd)
{
    HMENU menu = reinterpret_cast<HMENU>(
        SendMessageW(hwnd, MN_GETHMENU, 0, 0));
    if (!menu)
        return false;

    MENUINFO info{ sizeof(info) };
    info.fMask = MIM_BACKGROUND;
    if (GetMenuInfo(menu, &info) && info.hbrBack)
        return true;

    // Only this popup's own items -- a submenu opens as its own popup and is
    // asked separately.
    const int count = GetMenuItemCount(menu);
    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        MENUITEMINFOW item{ sizeof(item) };
        item.fMask = MIIM_FTYPE;
        if (GetMenuItemInfoW(menu, i, TRUE, &item) &&
            (item.fType & MFT_OWNERDRAW)) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

// Set while a popup's own subclass is handling a message, which is the only
// source that holds for a theme query carrying neither a DC nor a paint
// bracket -- GetThemeColor's fill color, asked once per popup, is exactly
// that. Saved and restored rather than assigned, since a submenu opens while
// its parent is still on the stack.
static thread_local HWND g_tlsMenuPopup = nullptr;

struct MenuPaintScope {
    HWND previous;
    explicit MenuPaintScope(HWND hwnd) : previous(g_tlsMenuPopup) {
        g_tlsMenuPopup = hwnd;
    }
    ~MenuPaintScope() { g_tlsMenuPopup = previous; }
    MenuPaintScope(const MenuPaintScope&) = delete;
    MenuPaintScope& operator=(const MenuPaintScope&) = delete;
};

// The color a menu surface collapses to with system transparency off, which
// is the palette's own solid in both themes -- #2C2C2C and #F9F9F9. Dark used
// to fall back to Win32MainDark instead, far darker than the shade Windows
// itself shows there, which also put the border on a different base than the
// one its token is measured against.
static COLORREF MenuSurfaceSolidColor(bool dark)
{
    return WinUiFloatingSurfaceColor(dark);
}

// True while this mod owns the popup's surface. The theme-part fills are only
// correct together with the backdrop applied alongside them, so a popup that
// never got one -- or that is genuinely drawn by its application -- keeps
// the system's own surface.
//
// `answerWhenUnnamed` is what a paint whose popup could not be identified
// gets. Dark mode has taken over every popup since long before this gate and
// answers yes, so an unnamed paint stays where it was; light mode answers no,
// because taking over a surface that never got a backdrop would fill it
// transparent over nothing and paint the menu black.
static bool MenuSurfaceIsOwned(HWND hwnd, bool answerWhenUnnamed)
{
    return hwnd ? (GetPropW(hwnd, kMenuSurfaceOwnedProp) != nullptr)
                : answerWhenUnnamed;
}

// The popup a menu paint belongs to, or null when it cannot be named. Both
// sources can be pointing somewhere else -- the paint-hwnd TLS holds whatever
// BeginPaint bracket the thread is in, which during a menu paint may still be
// the owner window -- so an answer only counts when it really is a popup.
// What an unnamed paint then counts as is the caller's to say; see
// MenuSurfaceIsOwned.
static HWND MenuPopupBeingPainted(HDC hdc)
{
    if (g_tlsMenuPopup)
        return g_tlsMenuPopup;

    HWND fromDc = hdc ? WindowFromDC(hdc) : nullptr;
    if (fromDc && IsClassName(fromDc, MENUPOPUP_CLASS))
        return fromDc;

    HWND painting = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
    return (painting && IsClassName(painting, MENUPOPUP_CLASS)) ? painting
                                                                : nullptr;
}

static void MenuReleaseSurface(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!GetPropW(hwnd, kMenuSurfaceOwnedProp))
        return;

    if (g_pSWCA) {
        ACCENT_POLICY accent{};
        accent.AccentState = ACCENT_DISABLED;
        WINCOMPATTRDATA attr{};
        attr.Attrib = WCA_ACCENT_POLICY;
        attr.pvData = &accent;
        attr.cbData = sizeof(accent);
        g_pSWCA(hwnd, &attr);
    }
    (void)RemovePropW(hwnd, kMenuSurfaceOwnedProp);
}

// The DWM-managed frame, in both themes. Native menu code can set both the
// border color and corner preference again after the popup is created.
static bool MenuShouldOverrideDwmFrame(HWND hwnd)
{
    return g_settings.ModernContextMenus &&
           IsClassName(hwnd, MENUPOPUP_CLASS) &&
           !IsLegacyShellDropdownRoot(hwnd);
}

struct MenuPopupVerticalInsets {
    int top = 0;
    int bottom = 0;
};

struct MenuPopupLayoutState {
    MenuPopupVerticalInsets insets;
    int outerHeight = 0;
};

static constexpr wchar_t kMenuPopupLayoutStateProp[] =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.MenuPopupLayoutState";

static MenuPopupLayoutState* MenuPopupGetLayoutState(HWND hwnd, bool create)
{
    auto* state = reinterpret_cast<MenuPopupLayoutState*>(
        GetPropW(hwnd, kMenuPopupLayoutStateProp));
    if (state || !create)
        return state;

    auto pending = std::make_unique<MenuPopupLayoutState>();
    if (!SetPropW(hwnd, kMenuPopupLayoutStateProp, pending.get()))
        return nullptr;
    return pending.release();
}

static void MenuPopupClearLayoutState(HWND hwnd)
{
    delete reinterpret_cast<MenuPopupLayoutState*>(
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kMenuPopupLayoutStateProp));
}

static MenuPopupVerticalInsets MenuPopupExtraVerticalInsets(HWND hwnd)
{
    // The native #32768 frame isn't part of the visible acrylic surface. Keep
    // the full five-DIP WinUI-style gap in our own NC area instead of counting
    // the system frame toward it; doing so left only three visible DIPs.
    constexpr int kOuterMarginDip = 5;
    UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);
    if (!dpi)
        dpi = USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const int target = MulDiv(kOuterMarginDip, dpi,
                              USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI);
    return { target, target };
}

static thread_local HWND g_tlsMenuPopupSizing = nullptr;

class MenuPopupSizingScope {
public:
    explicit MenuPopupSizingScope(HWND hwnd)
        : previous_(g_tlsMenuPopupSizing)
    {
        g_tlsMenuPopupSizing = hwnd;
    }

    ~MenuPopupSizingScope()
    {
        g_tlsMenuPopupSizing = previous_;
    }

    MenuPopupSizingScope(const MenuPopupSizingScope&) = delete;
    MenuPopupSizingScope& operator=(const MenuPopupSizingScope&) = delete;

private:
    HWND previous_;
};

// The surface behind that edge. Asking about ownership rather than the theme
// also keeps the non-client blackout off a genuinely application-drawn popup,
// which has no backdrop for those transparent pixels to reveal.
static bool MenuShouldPaintAcrylicFrame(HWND hwnd)
{
    return MenuShouldOverrideDwmFrame(hwnd) &&
           MenuSurfaceIsOwned(hwnd, /*answerWhenUnnamed=*/false);
}

// What the window's own code last asked DWM for on a window the mod put Mica
// on, so turning Mica off restores that instead of DWM's defaults. One entry
// per such window; entries of destroyed windows are pruned on insert.
struct MicaNativeFrame {
    bool haveMargins = false;
    MARGINS margins = {};
    bool haveBackdrop = false;
    DWORD backdrop = 0;
    bool haveHostBrush = false;
    BOOL hostBrush = FALSE;
};
static std::mutex g_micaNativeMutex;
static std::unordered_map<HWND, MicaNativeFrame> g_micaNativeFrames;

template <typename Update>
static void MicaNativeRecord(HWND hwnd, Update&& update)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_micaNativeMutex);
    auto it = g_micaNativeFrames.find(hwnd);
    if (it == g_micaNativeFrames.end()) {
        std::erase_if(g_micaNativeFrames,
            [](const auto& entry) { return !IsWindow(entry.first); });
        it = g_micaNativeFrames.emplace(hwnd, MicaNativeFrame{}).first;
    }
    update(it->second);
}

static HRESULT WINAPI DwmSetWindowAttribute_hook(
    HWND hWnd, DWORD dwAttribute, LPCVOID pvAttribute, DWORD cbAttribute)
{
    HRESULT hr;
    if (dwAttribute == DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE &&
        MenuShouldOverrideDwmFrame(hWnd))
    {
        const DWORD corner = static_cast<DWORD>(
            g_settings.MenuCornerStyle);
        hr = DwmSetWindowAttribute_orig(
            hWnd, dwAttribute, &corner, sizeof(corner));
    }
    else if (dwAttribute == kDwmwaBorderColor &&
             MenuShouldOverrideDwmFrame(hWnd))
    {
        const COLORREF borderClr = MenuAcrylicDwmBorderColor(g_darkModeActive);
        hr = DwmSetWindowAttribute_orig(
            hWnd, dwAttribute, &borderClr, sizeof(borderClr));
    }
    else if (ExplorerMicaActive() &&
             !g_darkModeUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
             (dwAttribute == DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE ||
              dwAttribute == kDwmwaUseHostBackdropBrush) &&
             (IsClassName(hWnd, L"CabinetWClass") ||
              IsClassName(hWnd, L"ExploreWClass") ||
              (FilePickerMicaActive() && FilePickerRoot(hWnd) == hWnd)))
    {
        // Reactive, not one-shot: confirmed via a throwaway test mod that
        // Explorer itself natively calls this with
        // DWMWA_USE_HOSTBACKDROPBRUSH on its own CabinetWClass window
        // (likely tied to its own WinUI titlebar setup) -- a value only
        // pushed once from outside can get silently stomped by that later
        // call. Redirect whichever of the two attributes Explorer tried to
        // set to a real DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE Mica every time.
        MicaNativeRecord(hWnd, [&](MicaNativeFrame& frame) {
            if (!pvAttribute || cbAttribute < sizeof(DWORD))
                return;
            if (dwAttribute == DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE) {
                frame.haveBackdrop = true;
                frame.backdrop = *static_cast<const DWORD*>(pvAttribute);
            } else {
                frame.haveHostBrush = true;
                frame.hostBrush = *static_cast<const BOOL*>(pvAttribute);
            }
        });
        hr = DwmSetWindowAttribute_orig(hWnd, DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE,
                                        &kDwmsbtMainWindow,
                                        sizeof(kDwmsbtMainWindow));
    }
    else
    {
        hr = DwmSetWindowAttribute_orig(
            hWnd, dwAttribute, pvAttribute, cbAttribute);
    }

    if (dwAttribute == DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE ||
        dwAttribute == 19 /* pre-20H1 DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE */)
        HwndDarkCacheInvalidate();

    // Some hosts' COMDLG32 reverts classic Open/Save dialogs back to light
    // DWM dark-mode state shortly after ApplyPropertyDialogDarkMode. Counter-apply only
    // on windows already tagged by us, and at most once per window, to avoid
    // unbounded synchronous write/revert ping-pong with DWM.
    if (dwAttribute == DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE &&
        pvAttribute && cbAttribute >= sizeof(BOOL) &&
        *reinterpret_cast<const BOOL*>(pvAttribute) == FALSE &&
        GetPropW(hWnd, kPropertyDialogDarkModeMarker) && IsSystemDarkMode() &&
        IsCustomDarkModeAllowed() &&
        !GetPropW(hWnd, L"_PropDkCounterApplied"))
    {
        SetPropW(hWnd, L"_PropDkCounterApplied", (HANDLE)1);
        const BOOL darkAttr = TRUE;
        DwmSetWindowAttribute_orig(hWnd, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE, &darkAttr, sizeof(darkAttr));
    }

    return hr;
}

static decltype(&DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea) DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea_orig = nullptr;

// The picker's SHELLDLL_DefView (its CtrlNotifySink under the view host's
// DirectUIHWND), or null before it exists.
static HWND FilePickerDefView(HWND root)
{
    HWND viewHost = FindWindowExW(root, nullptr, L"DUIViewWndClassName", nullptr);
    HWND duiHost = viewHost
        ? FindWindowExW(viewHost, nullptr, L"DirectUIHWND", nullptr) : nullptr;
    for (HWND sink = duiHost ? FindWindowExW(duiHost, nullptr, L"CtrlNotifySink", nullptr) : nullptr;
         sink; sink = FindWindowExW(duiHost, sink, L"CtrlNotifySink", nullptr)) {
        if (FindWindowExW(sink, nullptr, L"SHELLDLL_DefView", nullptr))
            return sink;
    }
    return nullptr;
}

// Mica on the picker: unlike Explorer's window, the frame is extended only
// down to the file list's bottom (the row the file-name rule goes on), so
// the file-name area below stays a plain client surface and its GDI
// controls need no alpha treatment. Called from the seed and from the view
// host's paints, re-extending only when that edge moved. cyTopHeight is
// measured from the top of the client area, below the DWM caption (logged
// live: a margin taken from the window's top overshot by the caption).
static void FilePickerApplyBackdrop(HWND root)
{
    if (!root || g_darkModeUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return;
    POINT clientOrigin = { 0, 0 };
    if (!ClientToScreen(root, &clientOrigin))
        return;
    RECT view;
    int top = -1;
    HWND edge = FilePickerDefView(root);
    if (!edge || !IsWindowVisible(edge))
        edge = FindWindowExW(root, nullptr, L"DUIViewWndClassName", nullptr);
    if (edge && IsWindowVisible(edge) && GetWindowRect(edge, &view))
        top = std::max<int>(0, view.bottom - clientOrigin.y);
    if (top < 0)
        return;
    const int previous = static_cast<int>(reinterpret_cast<INT_PTR>(
        GetPropW(root, kFilePickerMicaTopMarker))) - 1;
    if (previous == top)
        return;
    SetPropW(root, kFilePickerMicaTopMarker,
        reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(top) + 1));
    MicaNativeRecord(root, [](MicaNativeFrame&) {});
    const MARGINS margins = { 0, 0, top, 0 };
    DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea_orig(root, &margins);
    if (previous < 0)
        DwmSetWindowAttribute_orig(root, DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE,
                                   &kDwmsbtMainWindow, sizeof(kDwmsbtMainWindow));
}

static HRESULT WINAPI DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea_hook(
    HWND hWnd, const MARGINS* pMarInset)
{
    const bool unloading = g_darkModeUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    const bool pickerRoot = !unloading && FilePickerMicaActive() &&
        FilePickerRoot(hWnd) == hWnd;
    const bool explorerRoot = !unloading && !pickerRoot && ExplorerMicaActive() &&
        (IsClassName(hWnd, L"CabinetWClass") ||
         IsClassName(hWnd, L"ExploreWClass"));
    if ((pickerRoot || explorerRoot) && pMarInset) {
        MicaNativeRecord(hWnd, [&](MicaNativeFrame& frame) {
            frame.haveMargins = true;
            frame.margins = *pMarInset;
        });
    }
    if (pickerRoot) {
        RemovePropW(hWnd, kFilePickerMicaTopMarker);
        FilePickerApplyBackdrop(hWnd);
        return S_OK;
    }
    if (explorerRoot)
    {
        // Whatever margin Explorer itself asks for on its own root window,
        // widen it to cover the whole client area -- confirmed via a
        // throwaway test mod that a partial (titlebar-only) margin leaves
        // the nav pane/file list/status bar backgrounds we clear to black
        // showing solid black instead of the Mica material behind them.
        static const MARGINS kFullMargins = {-1, -1, -1, -1};
        return DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea_orig(hWnd, &kFullMargins);
    }
    return DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea_orig(hWnd, pMarInset);
}

// Initial push for a window Explorer doesn't happen to (re-)touch on its own
// via DwmSetWindowAttribute/DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea -- the reactive
// hooks above are the primary mechanism (they keep the backdrop correct
// against whatever Explorer itself does later), this just seeds it. For a
// window DWM already composited before this runs (alreadyOpen), also nudges
// DWM to re-evaluate immediately rather than waiting for the next organic
// resize/move/redraw -- confirmed necessary via a throwaway test mod and
// matches windows-11-file-explorer-styler's own TriggerWindowCompositionUpdate.
static void KickExplorerMicaBackdrop(HWND hwnd, bool alreadyOpen)
{
    if (g_darkModeUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return;
    static const MARGINS kFullMargins = {-1, -1, -1, -1};
    MicaNativeRecord(hwnd, [](MicaNativeFrame&) {});
    DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea_orig(hwnd, &kFullMargins);
    DwmSetWindowAttribute_orig(hwnd, DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE,
                               &kDwmsbtMainWindow, sizeof(kDwmsbtMainWindow));
    if (alreadyOpen) {
        WINDOWPOS windowPos = {};
        windowPos.hwnd = hwnd;
        windowPos.flags = SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE;
        SendMessageW(hwnd, WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGED, 0, (LPARAM)&windowPos);
        SendMessageW(hwnd, WM_DWMCOMPOSITIONCHANGED, 0, 0);
    }
}

// Back to the frame the window's own code asked for; DWM's defaults (no
// extended frame, DWMSBT_AUTO) for what it never set.
static void MicaRevertWindow(HWND hwnd, const MicaNativeFrame& frame)
{
    if (!IsWindow(hwnd))
        return;
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kFilePickerMicaTopMarker);
    const MARGINS margins = frame.haveMargins ? frame.margins : MARGINS{};
    DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea_orig(hwnd, &margins);
    const DWORD backdrop = frame.haveBackdrop ? frame.backdrop : 0; // DWMSBT_AUTO
    DwmSetWindowAttribute_orig(hwnd, DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE,
                               &backdrop, sizeof(backdrop));
    if (frame.haveHostBrush) {
        DwmSetWindowAttribute_orig(hwnd, kDwmwaUseHostBackdropBrush,
                                   &frame.hostBrush, sizeof(frame.hostBrush));
    }
    RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
                 RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
}

// On unload, and when ExplorerMicaBackdrop leaves the Mica modes.
static void MicaRevertAll()
{
    if (!DwmSetWindowAttribute_orig || !DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea_orig)
        return;
    std::unordered_map<HWND, MicaNativeFrame> frames;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_micaNativeMutex);
        frames.swap(g_micaNativeFrames);
    }
    for (const auto& [hwnd, frame] : frames)
        MicaRevertWindow(hwnd, frame);
}

static BOOL CALLBACK PaneScrollBarInstallChildEnum(HWND child, LPARAM)
{
    if (IsClassName(child, L"ScrollBar") && IsInsideShellFolderView(child))
        PaneScrollBarSubclassInstall(child);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK ExplorerMicaBackdropApplyEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId()) return TRUE;
    if (IsClassName(hwnd, L"CabinetWClass") ||
        IsClassName(hwnd, L"ExploreWClass")) {
        if (ExplorerMicaPaneMode())
            EnumChildWindows(hwnd, PaneScrollBarInstallChildEnum, 0);
        if (ExplorerMicaActive())
            KickExplorerMicaBackdrop(hwnd, /*alreadyOpen=*/true);
        RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
                     RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME |
                         RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
    }
    return TRUE;
}

static void MenuApplyDwmBorderColor(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!g_cbdDwmSetAttr || !MenuShouldOverrideDwmFrame(hwnd))
        return;

    // Called once from HCBT_CREATEWND, where DWM does not know the window
    // yet and answers E_HANDLE, and again from MN_SIZEWINDOW, which is the
    // one that lands -- before the popup's first paint either way.
    const COLORREF borderClr = MenuAcrylicDwmBorderColor(g_darkModeActive);
    g_cbdDwmSetAttr(hwnd, kDwmwaBorderColor, &borderClr, sizeof(borderClr));
}

static bool IsLegacyShellDropdownDark(HWND hwnd)
{
    return g_darkModeActive || (hwnd && IsHwndDarkMode(hwnd));
}

static COLORREF LegacyShellDropdownBgColor(HWND hwnd)
{
    return IsLegacyShellDropdownDark(hwnd) ? Win32MainDark : GetSysColor(COLOR_WINDOW);
}

// The popup's own window edge, written as opaque pixels rather than filled.
// Over the backdrop a GDI frame lands ADDED to the material instead of
// covering it, and #EAEAEA added to anything saturates: the light edge came
// out pure white. Alpha 255 because this edge is meant to cover, not tint --
// the separator takes the same treatment with its token's own alpha.
static void MenuStrokeWindowEdge(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, bool dark)
{
    if (!hdc || rc.right <= rc.left || rc.bottom <= rc.top)
        return;

    if (!MenuUseTransparentBackdrop()) {
        FrameRect(hdc, &rc, MenuAcrylicDwmBorderBrush(dark));
        return;
    }

    const COLORREF edge = MenuAcrylicDwmBorderColor(dark);
    const DWORD opaque = 0xFF000000u | (GetRValue(edge) << 16) |
                         (GetGValue(edge) << 8) | GetBValue(edge);
    const RECT sides[] = {
        { rc.left,      rc.top,        rc.right,    rc.top + 1 },
        { rc.left,      rc.bottom - 1, rc.right,    rc.bottom  },
        { rc.left,      rc.top,        rc.left + 1, rc.bottom  },
        { rc.right - 1, rc.top,        rc.right,    rc.bottom  },
    };
    for (const RECT& side : sides)
        WriteExplorerMicaPixels(hdc, side, opaque);
}

static decltype(&BitBlt) MenuBitBlt_orig = nullptr;
static decltype(&StretchBlt) MenuStretchBlt_orig = nullptr;

static void FillAcrylicMenuTransparentRect(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!hdc || !pRect)
        return;

    if (MenuUseTransparentBackdrop()) {
        FillRect(hdc, pRect, (HBRUSH)GetStockObject(BLACK_BRUSH));
    } else if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(
                   MenuSurfaceSolidColor(g_darkModeActive))) {
        FillRect(hdc, pRect, br);
    }
}

// Apply acrylic + rounded corners + dark mode to a popup menu window.
// Called from MN_SIZEWINDOW (every resize) so the effect survives submenu
// expansion and animation re-layouts.
static void MenuApplyAcrylicEffects(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!g_cbdDwmSetAttr) return;
    const bool dark = g_darkModeActive;
    const bool transparentBackdrop = MenuUseTransparentBackdrop();

    // Light mode only takes the surface when there is a backdrop to put under
    // it. Dark has always taken it either way, falling back to an opaque
    // shade, and keeps doing so; claiming every light popup just to repaint
    // it in a near-identical solid would be a change with nothing behind it.
    const bool ownSurface = !MenuPopupSelfPaints(hwnd) &&
                            (dark || transparentBackdrop);

    if (ownSurface) {
        if (dark) {
            BOOL darkAttr = TRUE;
            g_cbdDwmSetAttr(hwnd, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE, &darkAttr,
                sizeof(darkAttr));
            if (g_cbdAllowDark) g_cbdAllowDark(hwnd, true);
        }

        if (transparentBackdrop) {
            ACCENT_POLICY accent{};
            accent.AccentState = ACCENT_ENABLE_ACRYLICBLURBEHIND;
            accent.GradientColor = MenuAcrylicTintColor(dark);
            WINCOMPATTRDATA attr{};
            attr.Attrib = WCA_ACCENT_POLICY;
            attr.pvData = &accent;
            attr.cbData = sizeof(accent);
            g_pSWCA(hwnd, &attr);
        }

        // The hook below keeps this color from being overwritten by later
        // system DWMWA_BORDER_COLOR calls on #32768 popup menus.
        MenuApplyDwmBorderColor(hwnd);
        (void)SetPropW(hwnd, kMenuSurfaceOwnedProp,
                       reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(1));
    } else {
        // The window edge and nothing else -- the system draws the surface.
        // A popup genuinely painted by its application is handed back this
        // way too, including one that was empty when it was created and only
        // named its items later.
        MenuReleaseSurface(hwnd);
        MenuApplyDwmBorderColor(hwnd);
    }
    // Both modes: DWM rounded corners, per the user's configured style (was
    // hardcoded to DWMWCP_ROUNDSMALL here, silently ignoring MenuCornerStyle
    // for every popup while dark mode is active -- the light-mode branch and
    // the DropDown/ViewControlClass path below already used the setting).
    g_cbdDwmSetAttr(hwnd, DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE,
        &g_settings.MenuCornerStyle, sizeof(g_settings.MenuCornerStyle));
}

// Subclass for #32768 popup menus. Owns lifecycle (removes itself on
// WM_NCDESTROY), re-applies acrylic on every MN_SIZEWINDOW (because that
// message is delivered before the popup paints its content, so we get
// the new layout right the first time), and clears the NC area so the
// classic drop-shadow doesn't draw over our acrylic or opaque fallback.
static LRESULT CALLBACK MenuAcrylicSubclassProc(
    HWND hWnd, UINT uMsg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam, DWORD_PTR /*ref*/)
{
    MenuPaintScope scope(hWnd);

    switch (uMsg)
    {
    case MN_SIZEWINDOW:
        MenuApplyAcrylicEffects(hWnd);
        if (g_settings.MenuWinUiMetrics) {
            // user32 sizes and positions #32768 synchronously while handling
            // MN_SIZEWINDOW. Mark that nested SetWindowPos so the popup can
            // gain real outer padding without changing any item rectangle.
            MenuPopupSizingScope sizingScope(hWnd);
            return DefSubclassProc(hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam);
        }
        break;

    case WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGING:
        if (lParam) {
            auto* windowPos = reinterpret_cast<WINDOWPOS*>(lParam);
            if (!(windowPos->flags & SWP_NOSIZE)) {
                MenuPopupLayoutState* state =
                    MenuPopupGetLayoutState(hWnd, false);
                const bool nativeSizing = g_settings.MenuWinUiMetrics &&
                    g_tlsMenuPopupSizing == hWnd;

                if (!nativeSizing) {
                    // An unrelated SetWindowPos must not inherit NC insets
                    // whose matching outer growth belonged to an earlier
                    // MN_SIZEWINDOW transaction.
                    MenuPopupClearLayoutState(hWnd);
                } else {
                    if (!state)
                        state = MenuPopupGetLayoutState(hWnd, true);
                    if (!state)
                        break;

                    // user32 can repeat the same SetWindowPos while handling
                    // one popup layout. If it already carries our expanded
                    // height, preserve it instead of adding the margins again.
                    if (state->outerHeight <= 0 ||
                        windowPos->cy != state->outerHeight) {
                        const MenuPopupVerticalInsets desired =
                            MenuPopupExtraVerticalInsets(hWnd);
                        int availableExtra = desired.top + desired.bottom;

                        RECT nativeRect{
                            windowPos->x,
                            windowPos->y,
                            windowPos->x + windowPos->cx,
                            windowPos->y + windowPos->cy,
                        };
                        HMONITOR monitor = MonitorFromRect(
                            &nativeRect, MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST);
                        MONITORINFO monitorInfo{ sizeof(monitorInfo) };
                        if (monitor && GetMonitorInfoW(monitor, &monitorInfo)) {
                            const int workHeight =
                                monitorInfo.rcWork.bottom - monitorInfo.rcWork.top;
                            availableExtra = std::clamp(
                                workHeight - windowPos->cy, 0, availableExtra);
                        }

                        // Keep the visible gap symmetric. If user32 already
                        // consumed the monitor's full work height, no extra NC
                        // band is added and the native scrollable menu remains
                        // completely reachable.
                        const int perEdge = availableExtra / 2;
                        state->insets.top = std::min(desired.top, perEdge);
                        state->insets.bottom = std::min(desired.bottom, perEdge);
                        const int extra =
                            state->insets.top + state->insets.bottom;
                        windowPos->cy += extra;
                        state->outerHeight = windowPos->cy;
                    }

                    RECT proposed{
                        windowPos->x,
                        windowPos->y,
                        windowPos->x + windowPos->cx,
                        windowPos->y + windowPos->cy,
                    };
                    HMONITOR monitor = MonitorFromRect(
                        &proposed, MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST);
                    MONITORINFO monitorInfo{ sizeof(monitorInfo) };
                    if (monitor && GetMonitorInfoW(monitor, &monitorInfo)) {
                        const int maxY = monitorInfo.rcWork.bottom - windowPos->cy;
                        const int clampedY = std::clamp(
                            windowPos->y,
                            static_cast<int>(monitorInfo.rcWork.top),
                            std::max(static_cast<int>(monitorInfo.rcWork.top), maxY));
                        if (clampedY != windowPos->y) {
                            windowPos->y = clampedY;
                            windowPos->flags &= ~SWP_NOMOVE;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        break;

    case WM_NCCALCSIZE:
        if (g_settings.MenuWinUiMetrics && lParam) {
            LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam);
            const MenuPopupLayoutState* state =
                MenuPopupGetLayoutState(hWnd, false);
            if (state) {
                RECT* client = wParam
                    ? &reinterpret_cast<NCCALCSIZE_PARAMS*>(lParam)->rgrc[0]
                    : reinterpret_cast<RECT*>(lParam);
                const int insetHeight =
                    state->insets.top + state->insets.bottom;
                if (insetHeight > 0 &&
                    client->bottom - client->top > insetHeight) {
                    client->top += state->insets.top;
                    client->bottom -= state->insets.bottom;
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
        break;

    case WM_PRINT:
    {
        if (!MenuShouldPaintAcrylicFrame(hWnd))
            break;

        // Let the system/theme draw first, then reapply our visible DWM edge.
        LRESULT res = DefSubclassProc(hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam);
        HDC hdc = reinterpret_cast<HDC>(wParam);
        if (hdc) {
            RECT paintRect{};
            GetWindowRect(hWnd, &paintRect);
            OffsetRect(&paintRect, -paintRect.left, -paintRect.top);
            FrameRect(hdc, &paintRect,
                      MenuAcrylicDwmBorderBrush(g_darkModeActive));
        }
        return res;
    }

    case WM_NCPAINT:
    {
        if (!MenuShouldPaintAcrylicFrame(hWnd))
            break;

        // Clear NC frame with transparency black, or with the opaque dark
        // fallback when Windows transparency effects are disabled.
        HDC hdc = GetWindowDC(hWnd);
        if (hdc)
        {
            RECT rcWin{};
            GetWindowRect(hWnd, &rcWin);

            // Respect the update region passed in wParam (if any). NULLREGION
            // (==1) and ERROR (==0) are sentinels meaning "no region" — only
            // a real HRGN ( > 1) is a region. It arrives in screen
            // coordinates and the window DC's are the window's own, so a
            // copy is moved over before clipping (the original belongs to
            // the system).
            if (wParam != 0 && wParam != 1) {
                if (HRGN clip = CreateRectRgn(0, 0, 0, 0)) {
                    if (CombineRgn(clip, reinterpret_cast<HRGN>(wParam), nullptr,
                                   RGN_COPY) != ERROR) {
                        OffsetRgn(clip, -rcWin.left, -rcWin.top);
                        SelectClipRgn(hdc, clip);
                    }
                    DeleteObject(clip);
                }
            }
            const int w = rcWin.right  - rcWin.left;
            const int h = rcWin.bottom - rcWin.top;

            // Exclude the client area so we only black-out the NC border;
            // the client area gets its own theme paint via DrawThemeBackground.
            MENUBARINFO mbi{ sizeof(MENUBARINFO) };
            if (GetMenuBarInfo(hWnd, OBJID_CLIENT, 0, &mbi))
            {
                const int left   = mbi.rcBar.left  - rcWin.left;
                const int top    = mbi.rcBar.top   - rcWin.top;
                const int right  = mbi.rcBar.right - rcWin.left;
                const int bottom = mbi.rcBar.bottom - rcWin.top;
                if (right > left && bottom > top)
                    ExcludeClipRect(hdc, left, top, right, bottom);
            }
            if (MenuUseTransparentBackdrop()) {
                PatBlt(hdc, 0, 0, w, h, BLACKNESS);
            } else {
                RECT fillRect{ 0, 0, w, h };
                if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(
                        MenuSurfaceSolidColor(g_darkModeActive)))
                    FillRect_orig(hdc, &fillRect, br);
            }
            RECT paintRect{ 0, 0, w, h };
            MenuStrokeWindowEdge(hdc, paintRect, g_darkModeActive);
            ReleaseDC(hWnd, hdc);
        }
        return 0;
    }

    case WM_NCDESTROY:
        (void)RemovePropW(hWnd, kMenuSurfaceOwnedProp);
        MenuPopupClearLayoutState(hWnd);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hWnd, MenuAcrylicSubclassProc);
        break;
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam);
}

// Called from CbtProc on HCBT_CREATEWND of #32768 popups. Idempotent —
// SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread is a no-op if the subclass is already
// installed with the same ID.
static void MenuTryInstallAcrylic(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!g_settings.ModernContextMenus) return;
    if (g_menuAcrylicUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return;
    if (!g_cbdDwmSetAttr) return;
    if (IsLegacyShellDropdownRoot(hwnd)) {
        if (g_darkModeActive) {
            BOOL useDark = TRUE;
            g_cbdDwmSetAttr(hwnd, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE,
                &useDark, sizeof(useDark));
        }
        g_cbdDwmSetAttr(hwnd, DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE,
            &g_settings.MenuCornerStyle, sizeof(g_settings.MenuCornerStyle));
        return;
    }

    // Both themes get the subclass now. Light mode needs it for the same
    // reasons dark always did -- MN_SIZEWINDOW reapplies the backdrop after
    // every relayout, WM_NCPAINT clears the frame the rounded corners cut
    // through -- and for MenuPaintScope, without which the fill color, asked
    // through GetThemeColor with no DC, could not tell which popup it is for.
    MenuApplyAcrylicEffects(hwnd);
    WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
        hwnd, MenuAcrylicSubclassProc, 0);
}

// user32 blits a menu item's bitmap with SRCCOPY instead of AlphaBlend when
// that bitmap carries no alpha channel -- measured live on the NVIDIA shell
// extension's two entries, while every other icon in the same menu arrived
// through AlphaBlend with AC_SRC_ALPHA and composed correctly. SRCCOPY copies
// the empty channel along with the color, so the icon lands at alpha 0, and
// over the backdrop that is ADDED to the material instead of covering it.
//
// The color is right; only the channel user32 never filled is missing, so it
// is filled in here and nothing else. Deliberately no color keying: a first
// attempt keyed out the corner color to drop what looked like an unfilled
// background, which on the NVIDIA icons erased the dark square their artwork
// actually has -- the same square their taskbar icon carries. Opaque over the
// whole rect is what the native menu draws.
static void MenuRepairIconAlpha(HDC hdc, int x, int y, int w, int h)
{
    BITMAPINFO bi = {};
    bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(bi.bmiHeader);
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = w;
    bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -h;
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

    void* bits = nullptr;
    HBITMAP dib = CreateDIBSection(nullptr, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits,
                                   nullptr, 0);
    if (!dib)
        return;

    if (HDC mem = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc)) {
        HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(mem, dib);
        if (MenuBitBlt_orig(mem, 0, 0, w, h, hdc, x, y, SRCCOPY) && bits) {
            GdiFlush();
            DWORD* px = static_cast<DWORD*>(bits);
            for (int i = 0; i < w * h; ++i)
                px[i] |= 0xFF000000u;
            GdiFlush();
            SetDIBitsToDevice(hdc, x, y, w, h, 0, 0, 0, h, bits, &bi,
                              DIB_RGB_COLORS);
        }
        SelectObject(mem, old);
        DeleteDC(mem);
    }
    DeleteObject(dib);
}

// Only an icon-sized copy into the popup's own DC qualifies. The size bound
// is what keeps this off everything this mod draws itself: the window edge,
// the separator, the hover and the text all blit wider or taller than any
// menu glyph, and forcing alpha over one of those would turn a translucent
// overlay into an opaque plate.
static bool MenuBlitNeedsAlphaRepair(HDC dst, int w, int h, DWORD rop)
{
    if (rop != SRCCOPY || w <= 0 || h <= 0 || w > 64 || h > 64)
        return false;

    HWND popup = g_tlsMenuPopup;
    return popup && MenuUseTransparentBackdrop() &&
           MenuSurfaceIsOwned(popup, /*answerWhenUnnamed=*/false) &&
           WindowFromDC(dst) == popup;
}

static BOOL WINAPI MenuBitBlt_hook(HDC dst, int x, int y, int w, int h,
    HDC src, int sx, int sy, DWORD rop)
{
    const BOOL ok = MenuBitBlt_orig(dst, x, y, w, h, src, sx, sy, rop);
    if (ok && MenuBlitNeedsAlphaRepair(dst, w, h, rop))
        MenuRepairIconAlpha(dst, x, y, w, h);
    return ok;
}

static BOOL WINAPI MenuStretchBlt_hook(HDC dst, int x, int y, int w, int h,
    HDC src, int sx, int sy, int sw, int sh, DWORD rop)
{
    const BOOL ok = MenuStretchBlt_orig(dst, x, y, w, h, src, sx, sy, sw, sh,
                                        rop);
    if (ok && MenuBlitNeedsAlphaRepair(dst, w, h, rop))
        MenuRepairIconAlpha(dst, x, y, w, h);
    return ok;
}

// applyTheme is false when reconciling from inside the tooltip's own paint:
// SetWindowTheme sends WM_THEMECHANGED, SWCA and the DWM attributes don't.
static void TooltipApplyAcrylicEffects(HWND hwnd, HWND owner, bool applyTheme = true)
{
    if (!g_settings.ModernTooltips || !hwnd ||
        g_tooltipEffectsUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return;
    }

    // No owner yet (comctl32 often creates tooltips before binding one) --
    // fall back to our own gated state instead of the raw OS setting, so an
    // excluded process's tooltip doesn't go dark on its own.
    const bool ownerDark = owner ? IsHwndDarkMode(owner) : IsCustomDarkModeAllowed();

    constexpr DWORD smallRound = CBD_DWMWCP_ROUNDSMALL;
    TooltipApplyTrackedDwmAttribute(hwnd, DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE,
        smallRound, kTooltipCornerLowProp, kTooltipCornerHighProp);

    if (g_cbdDwmSetAttr) {
        if (ownerDark) {
            BOOL darkAttr = TRUE;
            g_cbdDwmSetAttr(hwnd, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE,
                &darkAttr, sizeof(darkAttr));
        }

        const COLORREF borderClr = TooltipDwmBorderColor(ownerDark);
        TooltipApplyTrackedDwmAttribute(hwnd, kDwmwaBorderColor,
            borderClr, kTooltipBorderLowProp, kTooltipBorderHighProp);
    }

    if (ownerDark && g_cbdAllowDark)
        g_cbdAllowDark(hwnd, true);

    if (applyTheme && ownerDark && IsCurrentProcessExplorer())
        SetWindowTheme(hwnd, L"DarkMode_Explorer", nullptr);

    const bool lightTextReady = ownerDark || TooltipTextIsEnabled();
    if (!MenuUseTransparentBackdrop() || (!ownerDark && !lightTextReady))
        TooltipDisableAcrylic(hwnd);
    else
        TooltipEnableAcrylic(hwnd, ownerDark);
}

static BOOL CALLBACK TooltipAcrylicEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM forceDisable)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId() ||
        !IsClassName(hwnd, L"tooltips_class32")) {
        return TRUE;
    }

    if (!forceDisable && g_settings.ModernTooltips) {
        TooltipApplyAcrylicEffects(hwnd, GetWindow(hwnd, GW_OWNER));
    } else {
        TooltipRestoreEffects(hwnd);
    }
    if (!forceDisable) {
        RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
            RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME);
    }
    return TRUE;
}

// EnumWindows callback used by Wh_ModUninit to remove menu subclasses
// from any currently-visible #32768 popups. Most menus are torn down
// when their owner releases focus, so this is mostly defensive — but
// if a menu is mid-animation when the mod unloads we must still detach
// the subclass to avoid calling into freed code.
static BOOL CALLBACK MenuRemoveSubclassEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId()) return TRUE;
    wchar_t cls[32] = {};
    GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls));
    if (_wcsicmp(cls, MENUPOPUP_CLASS) == 0
        || _wcsicmp(cls, L"DropDown") == 0
        || _wcsicmp(cls, L"ViewControlClass") == 0) {
        MenuReleaseSurface(hwnd);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, MenuAcrylicSubclassProc);
    }
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK MenuReapplyCornerEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId()) return TRUE;

    wchar_t cls[32] = {};
    GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls));
    if (_wcsicmp(cls, MENUPOPUP_CLASS) == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"DropDown") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"ViewControlClass") == 0) {
        MenuTryInstallAcrylic(hwnd);
    }
    return TRUE;
}

// ── UAH Dark Menu Bar ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Menu bars are NOT rendered via DrawThemeBackground. The system uses
// undocumented UAH messages (WM_UAHDRAWMENU=0x91, WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM=0x92)
// processed inside DefWindowProc. To customize menu bar appearance, we hook
// DefWindowProc and intercept these messages.
// Based on: win32-darkmode (adzm), notepad++, dark-menus-fork (Mgg Sk)

#define WM_UAHDRAWMENU     0x91
#define WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM 0x92
#define WM_UAHINITMENU     0x93
#define WM_UAHMEASUREMENUITEM 0x94
#define MFISPOPUP           0x01

struct UAHMENU { HMENU hMenu; HDC hdc; DWORD dwFlags; };
union UAHMENUITEMMETRICS {
    struct { DWORD cx, cy; } rgsizeBar[2];
    struct { DWORD cx, cy; } rgsizePopup[4];
};
struct UAHMENUPOPUPMETRICS { DWORD rgcx[4]; DWORD fUpdateMaxWidths : 2; };
struct UAHMENUITEM { int iPosition; UAHMENUITEMMETRICS umim; UAHMENUPOPUPMETRICS umpm; };
struct UAHDRAWMENUITEM { DRAWITEMSTRUCT dis; UAHMENU um; UAHMENUITEM umi; };
struct UAHMEASUREMENUITEM {
    MEASUREITEMSTRUCT measureItem;
    UAHMENU um;
    UAHMENUITEM umi;
};

static constexpr int kMenuWinUiItemHeightDip = 28;
static constexpr float kMenuWinUiTextSizeDip = 12.8f;

static void MenuAdjustUahPopupItemHeight(HWND hwnd, LPARAM lParam)
{
    if (!g_settings.ModernContextMenus || !g_settings.MenuWinUiMetrics)
        return;

    auto* item = reinterpret_cast<UAHMEASUREMENUITEM*>(lParam);
    if (!item || !(item->um.dwFlags & MFISPOPUP))
        return;

    MENUITEMINFOW info{ sizeof(info) };
    info.fMask = MIIM_FTYPE;
    if (GetMenuItemInfoW(item->um.hMenu, item->umi.iPosition, TRUE, &info) &&
        (info.fType & MFT_SEPARATOR)) {
        return;
    }

    UINT dpi = hwnd ? GetDpiForWindow(hwnd) : USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    if (!dpi)
        dpi = USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const int targetHeight = MulDiv(
        kMenuWinUiItemHeightDip, dpi, USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI);
    if (targetHeight > 0 &&
        item->measureItem.itemHeight < static_cast<UINT>(targetHeight)) {
        item->measureItem.itemHeight = static_cast<UINT>(targetHeight);
    }
}

// The string form stays defined for the rest of the file: the windhawk-mods
// symbol extractor expands a SYMBOL_HOOK string with the macros as they
// stand at the end of the file.
#ifdef _WIN64
#define MENU_IMMERSIVE_CALL __cdecl
#define MENU_IMMERSIVE_SCALL L"__cdecl"
#else
#define MENU_IMMERSIVE_CALL __stdcall
#define MENU_IMMERSIVE_SCALL L"__stdcall"
#endif

using MenuCanApplyOwnerDraw_t =
    bool(MENU_IMMERSIVE_CALL*)(HMENU, HWND);

struct MenuImmersiveHookState {
    HMODULE moduleReference = nullptr;
    std::atomic<bool> attempted{ false };
};

static std::mutex g_menuImmersiveHookMutex;
static std::atomic<bool> g_menuImmersiveUnloading{ false };

#define DECLARE_MENU_IMMERSIVE_HOOK(name)                                    \
    static MenuCanApplyOwnerDraw_t name##_orig = nullptr;                    \
    static MenuImmersiveHookState name##_state;                              \
    static bool MENU_IMMERSIVE_CALL name##_hook(HMENU menu, HWND owner)      \
    {                                                                         \
        if (!g_menuImmersiveUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&      \
            g_settings.ModernContextMenus) {                                  \
            return false;                                                     \
        }                                                                     \
        return name##_orig ? name##_orig(menu, owner) : false;                \
    }

DECLARE_MENU_IMMERSIVE_HOOK(MenuImmersiveExplorerFrame)
DECLARE_MENU_IMMERSIVE_HOOK(MenuImmersiveShell32)
DECLARE_MENU_IMMERSIVE_HOOK(MenuImmersiveExplorer)
DECLARE_MENU_IMMERSIVE_HOOK(MenuImmersiveTwinui)
DECLARE_MENU_IMMERSIVE_HOOK(MenuImmersiveTwinuiPcShell)
DECLARE_MENU_IMMERSIVE_HOOK(MenuImmersivePnidui)
DECLARE_MENU_IMMERSIVE_HOOK(MenuImmersiveSndVolSso)
DECLARE_MENU_IMMERSIVE_HOOK(MenuImmersiveMoNotificationUx)
DECLARE_MENU_IMMERSIVE_HOOK(MenuImmersiveMuseUxDocked)
DECLARE_MENU_IMMERSIVE_HOOK(MenuImmersiveMusNotifyIcon)
DECLARE_MENU_IMMERSIVE_HOOK(MenuImmersiveUsoApi)

DECLARE_MENU_IMMERSIVE_HOOK(MenuImmersiveSecurityHealthSsoUdk)

#undef DECLARE_MENU_IMMERSIVE_HOOK

static bool MenuInstallImmersiveHook(
    PCWSTR moduleName, bool currentExecutable,
    MenuCanApplyOwnerDraw_t* original, MenuCanApplyOwnerDraw_t hook,
    MenuImmersiveHookState* state)
{
    if (!original || !hook || !state ||
        state->attempted.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return false;
    }

    HMODULE module = nullptr;
    if (currentExecutable) {
        module = GetModuleHandleW(nullptr);
    } else {
        // Retain a module that its host already loaded, but never introduce a
        // Shell DLL into an unrelated process just to probe one private symbol.
        if (!GetModuleHandleExW(0, moduleName, &module))
            return false;
        state->moduleReference = module;
    }

    state->attempted.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    // explorer.exe, ExplorerFrame.dll, MoNotificationUx.exe, museuxdocked.dll, MusNotifyIcon.exe, Narrator.exe, pnidui.dll, SecurityHealthSSO.dll, SecurityHealthSsoUdk.dll, SecurityHealthSystray.exe, shell32.dll, SndVolSSO.dll, Taskmgr.exe, twinui.dll, twinui.pcshell.dll, usoapi.dll
    WindhawkUtils::SYMBOL_HOOK immersive_menu_module_hooks[] = {{
        {L"bool " MENU_IMMERSIVE_SCALL
         L" ImmersiveContextMenuHelper::CanApplyOwnerDrawToMenu("
         L"struct HMENU__ *,struct HWND__ *)"},
        original, hook, true
    }};
    // ExplorerFrame and shell32 have other private symbols too; theirs come
    // from the one lookup of that module.
    if (!currentExecutable && _wcsicmp(moduleName, L"ExplorerFrame.dll") == 0) {
        SetResolvedSymbolHook(
            ExplorerFrameResolveSymbols(module).canApplyOwnerDrawToMenu,
            hook, original);
    } else if (!currentExecutable && _wcsicmp(moduleName, L"shell32.dll") == 0) {
        SetResolvedSymbolHook(
            Shell32ResolveSymbols(module).canApplyOwnerDrawToMenu,
            hook, original);
    } else {
        WindhawkUtils::HookSymbols(module, immersive_menu_module_hooks,
            ARRAYSIZE(immersive_menu_module_hooks));
    }
    if (!*original) {
        // The private helper legitimately moves between these modules across
        // Windows builds. A miss in one target is therefore an expected
        // optional fallback, not a runtime error. Balance the reference taken
        // only for this probe immediately; an already-loaded module retains
        // its pre-existing references.
        if (state->moduleReference) {
            FreeLibrary(state->moduleReference);
            state->moduleReference = nullptr;
        }
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool MenuImmersiveProcessExcluded(PCWSTR processName)
{
    static constexpr PCWSTR kExcludedProcesses[] = {
        L"consent.exe",
        L"dwm.exe",
        L"SearchIndexer.exe",
        L"ShellExperienceHost.exe",
        L"svchost.exe",
        L"windhawk.exe",
        L"wlanext.exe",
    };
    for (PCWSTR excluded : kExcludedProcesses) {
        if (_wcsicmp(processName, excluded) == 0)
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static PCWSTR MenuImmersiveCurrentProcessName(
    wchar_t (&processPath)[MAX_PATH])
{
    GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, processPath, ARRAYSIZE(processPath));
    const wchar_t* processName = wcsrchr(processPath, L'\\');
    return processName ? processName + 1 : processPath;
}

static bool MenuEnsureImmersiveHooks(bool applyHooks)
{
    if (!g_settings.ModernContextMenus || !IsCurrentProcessInteractive() ||
        g_menuImmersiveUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return false;
    }

    wchar_t processPath[MAX_PATH] = {};
    const wchar_t* processName =
        MenuImmersiveCurrentProcessName(processPath);
    const auto processIs = [processName](PCWSTR expected) {
        return _wcsicmp(processName, expected) == 0;
    };

    if (MenuImmersiveProcessExcluded(processName))
        return false;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_menuImmersiveHookMutex);
    bool hooksQueued = false;
    auto install = [&](PCWSTR moduleName, bool currentExecutable,
                       MenuCanApplyOwnerDraw_t* original,
                       MenuCanApplyOwnerDraw_t hook,
                       MenuImmersiveHookState* state) {
        hooksQueued = MenuInstallImmersiveHook(moduleName, currentExecutable,
            original, hook, state) || hooksQueued;
    };

    // Probe every known location that is already present in this process. The
    // helper moves between these modules across Windows builds, and observing
    // loaded modules is both broader and safer than force-loading a process-
    // specific dependency graph here.
    install(L"ExplorerFrame.dll", false,
        &MenuImmersiveExplorerFrame_orig,
        MenuImmersiveExplorerFrame_hook,
        &MenuImmersiveExplorerFrame_state);
    install(L"shell32.dll", false,
        &MenuImmersiveShell32_orig, MenuImmersiveShell32_hook,
        &MenuImmersiveShell32_state);
    install(L"pnidui.dll", false, &MenuImmersivePnidui_orig,
        MenuImmersivePnidui_hook, &MenuImmersivePnidui_state);
    install(L"SndVolSSO.dll", false, &MenuImmersiveSndVolSso_orig,
        MenuImmersiveSndVolSso_hook, &MenuImmersiveSndVolSso_state);
    install(L"twinui.dll", false, &MenuImmersiveTwinui_orig,
        MenuImmersiveTwinui_hook, &MenuImmersiveTwinui_state);
    install(L"twinui.pcshell.dll", false,
        &MenuImmersiveTwinuiPcShell_orig,
        MenuImmersiveTwinuiPcShell_hook,
        &MenuImmersiveTwinuiPcShell_state);
    install(L"museuxdocked.dll", false,
        &MenuImmersiveMuseUxDocked_orig,
        MenuImmersiveMuseUxDocked_hook,
        &MenuImmersiveMuseUxDocked_state);
    install(L"usoapi.dll", false, &MenuImmersiveUsoApi_orig,
        MenuImmersiveUsoApi_hook, &MenuImmersiveUsoApi_state);
    install(L"SecurityHealthSSO.dll", false,
        &MenuImmersiveSecurityHealthSso_orig,
        MenuImmersiveSecurityHealthSso_hook,
        &MenuImmersiveSecurityHealthSso_state);
    install(L"SecurityHealthSsoUdk.dll", false,
        &MenuImmersiveSecurityHealthSsoUdk_orig,
        MenuImmersiveSecurityHealthSsoUdk_hook,
        &MenuImmersiveSecurityHealthSsoUdk_state);

    if (processIs(L"explorer.exe")) {
        install(nullptr, true, &MenuImmersiveExplorer_orig,
            MenuImmersiveExplorer_hook, &MenuImmersiveExplorer_state);
    } else if (processIs(L"MoNotificationUx.exe")) {
        install(nullptr, true, &MenuImmersiveMoNotificationUx_orig,
            MenuImmersiveMoNotificationUx_hook,
            &MenuImmersiveMoNotificationUx_state);
    } else if (processIs(L"MusNotifyIcon.exe")) {
        install(nullptr, true, &MenuImmersiveMusNotifyIcon_orig,
            MenuImmersiveMusNotifyIcon_hook,
            &MenuImmersiveMusNotifyIcon_state);
    } else if (processIs(L"Narrator.exe")) {
        install(nullptr, true, &MenuImmersiveNarrator_orig,
            MenuImmersiveNarrator_hook, &MenuImmersiveNarrator_state);
    } else if (processIs(L"SecurityHealthSystray.exe")) {
        install(nullptr, true,
            &MenuImmersiveSecurityHealthSystray_orig,
            MenuImmersiveSecurityHealthSystray_hook,
            &MenuImmersiveSecurityHealthSystray_state);
    } else if (processIs(L"Taskmgr.exe")) {
        install(nullptr, true, &MenuImmersiveTaskmgr_orig,
            MenuImmersiveTaskmgr_hook, &MenuImmersiveTaskmgr_state);
    }

    if (applyHooks && hooksQueued && !Wh_ApplyHookOperations())
        Wh_Log(L"Context menu: failed to apply immersive-menu hooks");
    return hooksQueued;
}

static bool MenuImmersiveHasLoadedPendingModule()
{
    if (!g_settings.ModernContextMenus || !IsCurrentProcessInteractive() ||
        g_menuImmersiveUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return false;
    }

    wchar_t processPath[MAX_PATH] = {};
    const wchar_t* processName =
        MenuImmersiveCurrentProcessName(processPath);
    if (MenuImmersiveProcessExcluded(processName))
        return false;

    struct Candidate {
        PCWSTR moduleName;
        MenuImmersiveHookState* state;
    };
    const Candidate candidates[] = {
        { L"ExplorerFrame.dll", &MenuImmersiveExplorerFrame_state },
        { L"shell32.dll", &MenuImmersiveShell32_state },
        { L"pnidui.dll", &MenuImmersivePnidui_state },
        { L"SndVolSSO.dll", &MenuImmersiveSndVolSso_state },
        { L"twinui.dll", &MenuImmersiveTwinui_state },
        { L"twinui.pcshell.dll", &MenuImmersiveTwinuiPcShell_state },
        { L"museuxdocked.dll", &MenuImmersiveMuseUxDocked_state },
        { L"usoapi.dll", &MenuImmersiveUsoApi_state },
        { L"SecurityHealthSSO.dll", &MenuImmersiveSecurityHealthSso_state },
        { L"SecurityHealthSsoUdk.dll", &MenuImmersiveSecurityHealthSsoUdk_state },
    };
    for (const Candidate& candidate : candidates) {
        if (!candidate.state->attempted.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
            GetModuleHandleW(candidate.moduleName)) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    const auto currentPending = [](MenuImmersiveHookState& state) {
        return !state.attempted.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    };
    if (_wcsicmp(processName, L"explorer.exe") == 0)
        return currentPending(MenuImmersiveExplorer_state);
    if (_wcsicmp(processName, L"MoNotificationUx.exe") == 0)
        return currentPending(MenuImmersiveMoNotificationUx_state);
    if (_wcsicmp(processName, L"MusNotifyIcon.exe") == 0)
        return currentPending(MenuImmersiveMusNotifyIcon_state);
    if (_wcsicmp(processName, L"Narrator.exe") == 0)
        return currentPending(MenuImmersiveNarrator_state);
    if (_wcsicmp(processName, L"SecurityHealthSystray.exe") == 0)
        return currentPending(MenuImmersiveSecurityHealthSystray_state);
    if (_wcsicmp(processName, L"Taskmgr.exe") == 0)
        return currentPending(MenuImmersiveTaskmgr_state);
    return false;
}
