// Detect popup menu initialization via DefWindowProc. WM_UAHINITMENU is sent
// to the menu OWNER window whenever a popup menu is about to be displayed.
// We enumerate #32768 windows to find the popup HWND matching the HMENU from
// lParam, then apply acrylic. Same pattern as the WinUI Context Menu Animation mod.
static void MenuDetectPopupFromUAH(LPARAM lParam)
{
    if (!g_settings.ModernContextMenus) return;
    if (g_menuAcrylicUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return;
    const auto* pMenu = (const UAHMENU*)lParam;
    if (!(pMenu->dwFlags & MFISPOPUP)) return;

    // FindWindowExW(nullptr, ...) enumerates every top-level window on the
    // desktop across ALL processes, not just this one -- filter by PID
    // before the SendMessageW below, same as MenuRemoveSubclassEnum /
    // MenuReapplyCornerEnum already do. Without this, a #32768 belonging to
    // some other, unrelated process (possibly hung, not pumping messages)
    // can make this thread block indefinitely on a cross-process
    // SendMessageW every time a menu bar opens in THIS process.
    const DWORD myPid = GetCurrentProcessId();
    HWND hwndMenu = nullptr;
    while ((hwndMenu = FindWindowExW(nullptr, hwndMenu, MENUPOPUP_CLASS, nullptr)) != nullptr)
    {
        DWORD pid = 0;
        GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwndMenu, &pid);
        if (pid != myPid) continue;
        HMENU hm = (HMENU)SendMessageW(hwndMenu, MN_GETHMENU, 0, 0);
        if (hm == pMenu->hMenu)
        {
            MenuTryInstallAcrylic(hwndMenu);
            return;
        }
    }
}

static void DrawUAHMenuNCBottomLine(HWND hWnd) {
    MENUBARINFO mbi{ sizeof(mbi) };
    if (!GetMenuBarInfo(hWnd, OBJID_MENU, 0, &mbi)) return;
    RECT rcClient; GetClientRect(hWnd, &rcClient);
    MapWindowPoints(hWnd, nullptr, (LPPOINT)&rcClient, 2);
    RECT rcWin; GetWindowRect(hWnd, &rcWin);
    OffsetRect(&rcClient, -rcWin.left, -rcWin.top);
    RECT rcLine = rcClient;
    rcLine.bottom = rcLine.top;
    rcLine.top--;
    HDC hdc = GetWindowDC(hWnd);
    if (HBRUSH lineBr = GetCachedSolidBrush(Win32MainDark))
        FillRect_orig(hdc, &rcLine, lineBr);
    ReleaseDC(hWnd, hdc);
}

static bool UAHWndProc(HWND hWnd, UINT uMsg, WPARAM, LPARAM lParam) {
    if (uMsg == WM_THEMECHANGED || uMsg == WM_DESTROY)
        return false;
    // Only the UAH paint messages need the colors. Probing dark mode for every
    // DefWindowProc call is also a recursion trap: IsHwndDarkMode sends
    // LVM_GETBKCOLOR to SysListView32, and a list view whose CListView is
    // already detached (WM_NCDESTROY) forwards that to DefWindowProc -- back
    // into this hook -- until the stack overflows.
    if (uMsg != WM_UAHDRAWMENU && uMsg != WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM)
        return false;
    const bool dark = IsHwndDarkMode(hWnd);
    const COLORREF barBg = dark ? Win32MainDark : GetSysColor(COLOR_MENUBAR);

    if (uMsg == WM_UAHDRAWMENU) {
        const auto* pMenu = (UAHMENU*)lParam;
        if (!pMenu || !pMenu->hdc) return false;
        MENUBARINFO mbi{ sizeof(mbi) };
        if (!GetMenuBarInfo(hWnd, OBJID_MENU, 0, &mbi)) return false;
        RECT rcWin; if (!GetWindowRect(hWnd, &rcWin)) return false;
        RECT rcMenu = mbi.rcBar;
        OffsetRect(&rcMenu, -rcWin.left, -rcWin.top);
        // Use the resolved barBg directly instead of a cached system brush:
        // popup menus can intentionally drive COLOR_MENUBAR differently from
        // regular opaque menu bars.
        if (HBRUSH bgBr = GetCachedSolidBrush(barBg))
            FillRect_orig(pMenu->hdc, &rcMenu, bgBr);
        return true;
    }
    if (uMsg == WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM) {
        auto* pItem = (UAHDRAWMENUITEM*)lParam;
        if (!pItem || !pItem->um.hdc) return false;
        bool isDisabled = (pItem->dis.itemState & (ODS_GRAYED | ODS_DISABLED)) != 0;
        bool isHot      = (pItem->dis.itemState & ODS_HOTLIGHT) != 0;
        bool isSelected = (pItem->dis.itemState & ODS_SELECTED) != 0;
        bool isInactive = (GetForegroundWindow() != hWnd);

        // Background — erase the native hover before our rounded overlay.
        if (HBRUSH bgBr = GetCachedSolidBrush(barBg))
            FillRect_orig(pItem->um.hdc, &pItem->dis.rcItem, bgBr);

        // D2D rounded hover overlay for hot/pressed items
        if ((isHot || isSelected) && !isDisabled && g_d2dFactory)
        {
            const RECT* rc = &pItem->dis.rcItem;
            int w = rc->right  - rc->left;
            int h = rc->bottom - rc->top;
            if (w > 0 && h > 0) {
                const float scale = (float)DpiForPaint(hWnd) / (float)USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
                const float cr = ModernizerCornerRadius * scale;
                const float inset = 2.f * scale;

                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
                if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(pItem->um.hdc, rc,
                        g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
                {
                    // MenuBarItemBackground: SubtleFillColorSecondary on
                    // hover, Tertiary when pressed or open (MenuBar_themeresources.xaml).
                    const D2D1_COLOR_F hoverClr = WinUiColorF(isSelected
                        ? WinUI::SubtleFillColorTertiary(dark)
                        : WinUI::SubtleFillColorSecondary(dark));
                    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
                    pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(hoverClr, &brush);
                    if (brush) {
                        pRT->BeginDraw();
                        pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                            D2D1::RoundedRect(
                                D2D1::RectF(inset, inset, (float)w - inset, (float)h - inset),
                                cr, cr),
                            brush.Get());
                        if (pRT->EndDraw() == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                            pRT.Reset();
                            CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Text
        wchar_t menuStr[256]{};
        MENUITEMINFO mii{ sizeof(mii), MIIM_STRING };
        mii.dwTypeData = menuStr; mii.cch = 255;
        if (!GetMenuItemInfoW(pItem->um.hMenu, pItem->umi.iPosition, TRUE, &mii))
            return false;
        DTTOPTS dtto = { sizeof(dtto) };
        dtto.dwFlags = DTT_TEXTCOLOR;
        dtto.crText = (isDisabled || isInactive)
            ? (dark ? RGB(0xAA, 0xAA, 0xAA) : RGB(0x66, 0x66, 0x66))
            : (dark ? RGB(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF) : RGB(0x00, 0x00, 0x00));
        DWORD dtFlags = DT_CENTER | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_VCENTER;
        if (pItem->dis.itemState & ODS_NOACCEL) dtFlags |= DT_HIDEPREFIX;

        bool drawnViaD2D = false;
        {
            HFONT srcFont = (HFONT)GetCurrentObject(pItem->um.hdc, OBJ_FONT);
            LOGFONTW lf = {};
            if (srcFont && GetObjectW(srcFont, sizeof(lf), &lf)) {
                wcsncpy_s(lf.lfFaceName, L"Segoe UI Variable Text", _TRUNCATE);
                drawnViaD2D = DrawWinUiStyledTextDWrite(pItem->um.hdc, &pItem->dis.rcItem,
                    menuStr, mii.cch, lf, dtto.crText, dtFlags);
            }
        }
        if (!drawnViaD2D) {
            // Opened for this draw only: a thread's cached handle would stay
            // open past unload.
            if (HTHEME menuTheme = OpenThemeData(hWnd, L"Menu")) {
                g_glowEntry = true;
                DrawThemeTextEx(menuTheme, pItem->um.hdc, MENU_BARITEM,
                    MBI_NORMAL, menuStr, mii.cch, dtFlags, &pItem->dis.rcItem, &dtto);
                g_glowEntry = false;
                CloseThemeData(menuTheme);
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// DefWindowProc hooks — intercept UAH menu messages
static decltype(&DefWindowProcW) DefWindowProcW_orig = nullptr;
static LRESULT CALLBACK DefWindowProcW_hook(HWND hWnd, UINT uMsg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp) {
    if (GlyphOrColorIconsActive() && uMsg == WM_DEVICECHANGE
        && wp == DBT_DEVICEARRIVAL && IsCurrentProcessExplorer())
        GlyphRefreshDriveArrival(lp);
    if ((g_darkModeActive || g_settings.ModernContextMenus) &&
        GetMenu(hWnd) && UAHWndProc(hWnd, uMsg, wp, lp))
        return 0;
    // Popup menu detection via WM_UAHINITMENU — fires BEFORE DefWindowProc
    // processes the message, so the #32768 already exists at this point.
    if (uMsg == WM_UAHINITMENU && lp)
        MenuDetectPopupFromUAH(lp);
    if (uMsg == WM_ERASEBKGND && g_darkModeExcluded &&
        ExcludedEraseSessionBtnFace(hWnd, reinterpret_cast<HDC>(wp)))
        return 1;
    LRESULT lr;
    {
        ScrollBarOwnerScope ownerScope(hWnd);
        lr = DefWindowProcW_orig(hWnd, uMsg, wp, lp);
    }
    if (g_darkModeExcluded)
        lr = ExcludedFixCtlColorResult(uMsg, wp, lp, lr);
    if (uMsg == WM_UAHMEASUREMENUITEM)
        MenuAdjustUahPopupItemHeight(hWnd, lp);
    if (g_darkModeActive && GetMenu(hWnd) && (uMsg == WM_ACTIVATE || uMsg == WM_NCPAINT))
        DrawUAHMenuNCBottomLine(hWnd);
    return lr;
}

static void CbdApplyRoundedRgn(HWND hwnd, DWORD style)
{
    if (style == CBD_DWMWCP_DONOTROUND) { SetWindowRgn(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE); return; }
    RECT rc; GetWindowRect(hwnd, &rc);
    int w = rc.right - rc.left, h = rc.bottom - rc.top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;
    int r = (style == CBD_DWMWCP_ROUND) ? 10 : 6;
    HRGN hRgn = CreateRoundRectRgn(0, 0, w+1, h+1, r*2, r*2);
    if (hRgn) SetWindowRgn(hwnd, hRgn, TRUE);
}

// Reuse the menu SWCA acrylic path; callers keep the opaque hooked dark fill
// when transparency/SWCA is unavailable.
static bool CbdShouldUseAcrylic()
{
    return g_settings.ModernContextMenus && g_darkModeActive && MenuUseTransparentBackdrop();
}

// Dark acrylic tint: ComboLBox keeps its normal hooked fill, while DWM adds
// a visible acrylic layer behind it without taking over text/highlight colors.
static DWORD ComboAcrylicTintColor()
{
    return 0x90191919;
}

// Deliberately independent of CbdApplyDWM's AllowDarkModeForWindow/
// DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE avoidance below -- SWCA blur-behind and the
// border color are plain DWM/composition attributes, unrelated to the
// system dark theme renderer that causes the FFFFFF highlight bug. Only the
// blur is new; text/highlight colors keep coming from the existing
// SetSysColors + GetSysColor hooks untouched.
static void CbdApplyAcrylic(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!g_pSWCA || !g_cbdDwmSetAttr || !CbdShouldUseAcrylic())
        return;

    ACCENT_POLICY accent{};
    accent.AccentState = ACCENT_ENABLE_ACRYLICBLURBEHIND;
    accent.GradientColor = ComboAcrylicTintColor();
    WINCOMPATTRDATA attr{};
    attr.Attrib = WCA_ACCENT_POLICY;
    attr.pvData = &accent;
    attr.cbData = sizeof(accent);
    g_pSWCA(hwnd, &attr);

    const COLORREF borderClr = MenuAcrylicDwmBorderColor(g_darkModeActive);
    g_cbdDwmSetAttr(hwnd, kDwmwaBorderColor, &borderClr, sizeof(borderClr));
}

static void CbdApplyDWM(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!g_cbdDwmSetAttr || !g_settings.ModernContextMenus) return;
    const bool resizable = CbdIsResizable(hwnd);

    // Corners
    if (resizable) {
        CbdApplyRoundedRgn(hwnd, g_settings.CbCornerStyle);
    } else {
        g_cbdDwmSetAttr(hwnd, DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE,
                        &g_settings.CbCornerStyle, sizeof(DWORD));
    }

    // Dark mode: deliberately do NOT set DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE or
    // AllowDarkModeForWindow on ComboLBox. Setting it activates the system's
    // dark theme renderer which uses an internal highlight color (FFFFFF)
    // that ignores GetSysColor(COLOR_HIGHLIGHT). Without it, the light-mode
    // renderer reads COLOR_HIGHLIGHT from our hooks (accent) correctly.
    // The scrollbar gets dark from SetPreferredAppMode (process-wide).
    // The background/text get dark from SetSysColors + GetSysColor hooks.
    // See CbdApplyAcrylic for the (independent) acrylic blur-behind.

}

// Subclass: parent ComboBox — cleanup only
static LRESULT CALLBACK CbdComboParentSubclass(
    HWND hWnd, UINT uMsg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (uMsg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hWnd, CbdComboParentSubclass);
        RemovePropW(hWnd, PROP_CBD_CB);
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam);
}

// Subclass: ComboLBox / Auto-Suggest — re-apply DWM on resize/show, suppress GDI erase
static LRESULT CALLBACK CbdComboLBoxSubclass(
    HWND hWnd, UINT uMsg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam, DWORD_PTR)
{
    switch (uMsg) {
    case WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGED: {
        LRESULT res = DefSubclassProc(hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam);
        const WINDOWPOS* wp = reinterpret_cast<const WINDOWPOS*>(lParam);
        bool sizeChanged = !(wp->flags & SWP_NOSIZE);
        bool firstShow   =  (wp->flags & SWP_SHOWWINDOW) != 0;
        if (sizeChanged || firstShow) {
            if (CbdIsResizable(hWnd)) CbdApplyRoundedRgn(hWnd, g_settings.CbCornerStyle);
            else                      CbdApplyDWM(hWnd);
            CbdApplyAcrylic(hWnd); // independent of the resizable/corner branch above
        }
        return res;
    }
    case WM_NCDESTROY:
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hWnd, CbdComboLBoxSubclass);
        RemovePropW(hWnd, PROP_CBD_LB);
        break;
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam);
}

static void CbdInstallWindow(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd) || !g_settings.ModernContextMenus ||
        IsInsideExcludedFilePicker(hwnd))
        return;

    const CbdTargetClass target = CbdGetTargetClass(hwnd);
    if (target == CbdTargetClass::ComboLBox ||
        target == CbdTargetClass::AutoSuggest) {
        CbdApplyDWM(hwnd);
        CbdApplyAcrylic(hwnd);
        if (!GetPropW(hwnd, PROP_CBD_LB) &&
            WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                hwnd, CbdComboLBoxSubclass, 0)) {
            SetPropW(hwnd, PROP_CBD_LB, (HANDLE)1);
        }
        if (target == CbdTargetClass::ComboLBox) {
            HWND parent = GetParent(hwnd);
            if (parent && !GetPropW(parent, PROP_CBD_CB) &&
                WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                    parent, CbdComboParentSubclass, 0)) {
                SetPropW(parent, PROP_CBD_CB, (HANDLE)1);
            }
        }

               WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                   hwnd, CbdComboParentSubclass, 0)) {

    }
}

static void CbdResetWindowEffects(HWND hwnd)

// Unified GetSysColor/GetSysColorBrush hook — handles DarkMode AND AccentMarquee/Colorize.
// DarkMode overrides ALL colors; accent only overrides HIGHLIGHT/HOTLIGHT.
static decltype(&GetSysColor) GetSysColor_orig = nullptr;

static COLORREF GetDarkSysColor(int nIndex)
{
    switch (nIndex) {
    // Black only when SWCA acrylic is active: black pixels become
    // transparent for acrylic popup menus. Without acrylic, use the real
    // dark background so native menu fills don't become a flat black
    // rectangle.
    case COLOR_MENU:
        return (g_settings.ModernContextMenus && MenuUseTransparentBackdrop())
            ? RGB(0, 0, 0)
            : Win32MainDark;
    case COLOR_WINDOW:
    case COLOR_BTNFACE:
        return Win32MainDark;
    case COLOR_WINDOWTEXT:    return RGB(0xE6, 0xE6, 0xE6);
    case COLOR_MENUTEXT:
    case COLOR_BTNTEXT:
    case COLOR_HIGHLIGHTTEXT:
        return WinUI::Dark::TextFillColorPrimary;
    case COLOR_GRAYTEXT:      return RGB(0x80, 0x80, 0x80);
    case COLOR_HIGHLIGHT:     case COLOR_MENUHILIGHT:
    case COLOR_HOTLIGHT:
        return GetSystemAccentColor();
    // Every other index (captions, 3D bevel, borders, workspace, tooltip,
    // scrollbar, menu bar, ...) has no consumer in this mod's own paint code
    // -- forcing them dark only affects native, unsupported third-party
    // rendering, which doesn't add up to a coherent dark look on its own and
    // risks the same kind of breakage that requires Office et al. to be
    // hardcoded into the exclusion list. Fall through to the real color.
    default: return GetSysColor_orig ? GetSysColor_orig(nIndex) : 0;
    }
}

// Excluded processes: return hardcoded Windows light theme defaults.
// GetSysColor_orig would return dark (SetSysColors already applied at kernel level).
static COLORREF GetDefaultLightSysColor(int nIndex) {
    switch (nIndex) {
    case COLOR_SCROLLBAR:       return RGB(200, 200, 200);
    case COLOR_BACKGROUND:      return RGB(0, 0, 0);
    case COLOR_ACTIVECAPTION:   return RGB(153, 180, 209);
    case COLOR_INACTIVECAPTION: return RGB(191, 205, 219);
    case COLOR_MENU:            return RGB(240, 240, 240);
    case COLOR_WINDOW:          return RGB(255, 255, 255);
    case COLOR_WINDOWFRAME:     return RGB(100, 100, 100);
    case COLOR_MENUTEXT:        return RGB(0, 0, 0);
    case COLOR_WINDOWTEXT:      return RGB(0, 0, 0);
    case COLOR_CAPTIONTEXT:     return RGB(0, 0, 0);
    case COLOR_ACTIVEBORDER:    return RGB(180, 180, 180);
    case COLOR_INACTIVEBORDER:  return RGB(244, 247, 252);
    case COLOR_APPWORKSPACE:    return RGB(171, 171, 171);
    case COLOR_HIGHLIGHT:       return RGB(0, 120, 212);
    case COLOR_HIGHLIGHTTEXT:   return RGB(255, 255, 255);
    case COLOR_BTNFACE:         return RGB(240, 240, 240);
    case COLOR_BTNSHADOW:       return RGB(160, 160, 160);
    case COLOR_GRAYTEXT:        return RGB(109, 109, 109);
    case COLOR_BTNTEXT:         return RGB(0, 0, 0);
    case COLOR_INACTIVECAPTIONTEXT: return RGB(0, 0, 0);
    case COLOR_BTNHIGHLIGHT:    return RGB(255, 255, 255);
    case COLOR_3DDKSHADOW:      return RGB(105, 105, 105);
    case COLOR_3DLIGHT:         return RGB(227, 227, 227);
    case COLOR_INFOTEXT:        return RGB(0, 0, 0);
    case COLOR_INFOBK:          return RGB(255, 255, 255);
    case COLOR_HOTLIGHT:        return RGB(0, 102, 204);
    case COLOR_GRADIENTACTIVECAPTION:   return RGB(185, 209, 234);
    case COLOR_GRADIENTINACTIVECAPTION: return RGB(215, 228, 242);
    case COLOR_MENUHILIGHT:     return RGB(0, 120, 212);
    case COLOR_MENUBAR:         return RGB(240, 240, 240);
    default:                    return GetSysColor_orig(nIndex);
    }
}

// Cached brushes for excluded processes (light defaults)
static HBRUSH g_excludedBrushCache[31] = {};

static HBRUSH BrushCacheGetOrCreate(HBRUSH (&cache)[31], int index, COLORREF color)
{
    if (index < 0 || index >= 31)
        return nullptr;

    auto slot = reinterpret_cast<PVOID volatile*>(&cache[index]);
    HBRUSH cached = reinterpret_cast<HBRUSH>(
        InterlockedCompareExchangePointer(slot, nullptr, nullptr));
    if (cached)
        return cached;

    HBRUSH created = CreateSolidBrush(color);
    if (!created)
        return nullptr;

    PVOID previous = InterlockedCompareExchangePointer(slot, created, nullptr);
    if (previous) {
        DeleteObject(created);
        return reinterpret_cast<HBRUSH>(previous);
    }
    return created;
}

static void BrushCacheClear(HBRUSH (&cache)[31])
{
    for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) {
        HBRUSH brush = reinterpret_cast<HBRUSH>(
            InterlockedExchangePointer(
                reinterpret_cast<PVOID volatile*>(&cache[i]), nullptr));
        if (brush)
            DeleteObject(brush);
    }
}

static void ExcludedBrushCacheClear() {
    BrushCacheClear(g_excludedBrushCache);
}

static HBRUSH ExcludedSysColorBrush(int nIndex)
{
    return BrushCacheGetOrCreate(g_excludedBrushCache, nIndex,
        GetDefaultLightSysColor(nIndex));
}

// ── SysLink text (comctl32 v6 CMarkup::Paint) ────────────────────────────
// CMarkup::Paint, SysLink's markup renderer, asks GetSysColor(COLOR_HOTLIGHT)
// for the link color on every paint. While it runs, that index answers
// AccentTextFillColorPrimary, like the themed links; everywhere else
// COLOR_HOTLIGHT keeps serving the marquee border and hot-tracking.
// x86: a plain member function (__thiscall, ret 0Ch in SysWOW64's v6).
#ifdef _WIN64
#define CMARKUP_CALL __cdecl
#define CMARKUP_CALL_TEXT L"__cdecl"
#else
#define CMARKUP_CALL __thiscall
#define CMARKUP_CALL_TEXT L"__thiscall"
#endif
using CMarkupPaint_t = void(CMARKUP_CALL*)(void*, HDC, const RECT*, int);
static CMarkupPaint_t CMarkupPaint_orig = nullptr;
static thread_local int t_markupPaintDepth = 0;
static thread_local HDC t_markupPaintHdc = nullptr;
// Set by the first SysLink window; holds the comctl32 that owns its class.
static std::atomic<bool> g_sysLinkContextSeen{false};
static std::atomic<HMODULE> g_sysLinkComctl32{nullptr};

static void CMARKUP_CALL CMarkupPaint_hook(void* self, HDC hdc, const RECT* rc, int flags)
{
    const HDC previousHdc = t_markupPaintHdc;
    ++t_markupPaintDepth;
    t_markupPaintHdc = hdc;
    CMarkupPaint_orig(self, hdc, rc, flags);
    t_markupPaintHdc = previousHdc;
    --t_markupPaintDepth;
}

static bool SysLinkTextColorWanted()
{
    return g_settings.EnableDarkMode || g_settings.AccentColorize;
}

// AccentTextFillColorPrimary: Light3 dark, Dark2 light.
static COLORREF SysLinkTextColor()
{
    const bool dark = t_markupPaintHdc ? IsWindowDarkMode(t_markupPaintHdc)
                                       : g_darkModeActive.load();
    return GetAccentFromPalette(dark ? 0 : 20);
}

// Windows' theme engine saves and reapplies the legacy color scheme
// (Control Panel\Colors) from SystemSettings through these modules, reading
// it with GetSysColor. A dark answer there persists: Windows restores that
// scheme when a contrast theme is turned off, leaving COLOR_WINDOW and
// COLOR_WINDOWTEXT dark session-wide (measured: themeui.dll and
// SettingsHandlers_nt.dll read both). They get the real table. The loader
// reports both modules' loads and unloads (ThemeEngineWatchStart), so the
// hook only compares two address ranges.
struct ThemeEngineRange {
    std::atomic<uintptr_t> lo{0};
    std::atomic<uintptr_t> hi{0};
};
static ThemeEngineRange g_themeEngineRanges[2];
static constexpr const wchar_t* kThemeEngineModules[2] = {
    L"themeui.dll", L"SettingsHandlers_nt.dll"};
static void* g_themeEngineNotifyCookie = nullptr;

static bool IsThemeEngineCaller(const void* returnAddress)
{
    const auto address = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(returnAddress);
    for (const auto& range : g_themeEngineRanges) {
        const uintptr_t lo = range.lo.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        if (lo && address >= lo && address < range.hi.load(std::memory_order_relaxed))
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static void ThemeEngineSetRange(int which, const void* base, ULONG size)
{
    const auto lo = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(base);
    g_themeEngineRanges[which].hi.store(base ? lo + size : 0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    g_themeEngineRanges[which].lo.store(lo, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

static int ThemeEngineModuleIndex(const wchar_t* name, size_t length)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        if (wcslen(kThemeEngineModules[i]) == length &&
            _wcsnicmp(name, kThemeEngineModules[i], length) == 0)
            return i;
    }
    return -1;
}

// LDR_DLL_NOTIFICATION_DATA (loaded and unloaded share the layout).
struct ThemeEngineUnicodeString {
    USHORT length;
    USHORT maximumLength;
    const wchar_t* buffer;
};
struct ThemeEngineDllNotification {
    ULONG flags;
    const ThemeEngineUnicodeString* fullName;
    const ThemeEngineUnicodeString* baseName;
    void* base;
    ULONG size;
};

static VOID NTAPI ThemeEngineDllNotify(ULONG reason,
    const ThemeEngineDllNotification* data, PVOID)
{
    if (!data || !data->baseName || !data->baseName->buffer)
        return;
    const int which = ThemeEngineModuleIndex(data->baseName->buffer,
        data->baseName->length / sizeof(wchar_t));
    if (which < 0)
        return;
    if (reason == 1 /*LDR_DLL_NOTIFICATION_REASON_LOADED*/)
        ThemeEngineSetRange(which, data->base, data->size);
    else if (g_themeEngineRanges[which].lo.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) ==
             reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(data->base))
        ThemeEngineSetRange(which, nullptr, 0);
}

static void ThemeEngineWatchStart()
{
    using Register_t = LONG(NTAPI*)(ULONG, decltype(&ThemeEngineDllNotify), PVOID, PVOID*);
    HMODULE ntdll = GetModuleHandleW(L"ntdll.dll");
    const auto registerFn = ntdll ? reinterpret_cast<Register_t>(
        GetProcAddress(ntdll, "LdrRegisterDllNotification")) : nullptr;
    if (!registerFn || registerFn(0, ThemeEngineDllNotify, nullptr,
            &g_themeEngineNotifyCookie) < 0) {
        g_themeEngineNotifyCookie = nullptr;
        Wh_Log(L"Theme engine: LdrRegisterDllNotification unavailable");
    }
    // Modules loaded before the registration.
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        if (HMODULE module = GetModuleHandleW(kThemeEngineModules[i])) {
            const auto base = reinterpret_cast<const BYTE*>(module);
            const auto nt = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS*>(
                base + reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER*>(base)->e_lfanew);
            ThemeEngineSetRange(i, base, nt->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage);
        }
    }
}

static void ThemeEngineWatchStop()
{
    if (!g_themeEngineNotifyCookie)
        return;
    using Unregister_t = LONG(NTAPI*)(PVOID);
    HMODULE ntdll = GetModuleHandleW(L"ntdll.dll");
    if (const auto unregisterFn = ntdll ? reinterpret_cast<Unregister_t>(
            GetProcAddress(ntdll, "LdrUnregisterDllNotification")) : nullptr)
        unregisterFn(g_themeEngineNotifyCookie);
    g_themeEngineNotifyCookie = nullptr;
}

static DWORD WINAPI GetSysColor_hook(int nIndex)
{
    if (IsThemeEngineCaller(__builtin_return_address(0)))
        [[clang::musttail]] return GetSysColor_orig(nIndex);
    // Excluded processes: return light defaults to undo SetSysColors, with
    // no exception -- an excluded process's file pickers stay fully native
    // too (see IsInsideExcludedFilePicker).
    if (g_darkModeExcluded) {
        return GetDefaultLightSysColor(nIndex);
    }
    if (nIndex == COLOR_HOTLIGHT && t_markupPaintDepth > 0 &&
        (g_darkModeActive || g_settings.AccentColorize)) {
        return SysLinkTextColor();
    }
    if (g_darkModeActive) {
        return GetDarkSysColor(nIndex);
    }
    if (nIndex == COLOR_HIGHLIGHT || nIndex == COLOR_MENUHILIGHT) {
        if (g_settings.AccentColorize || g_settings.AccentMarquee)
            return GetSystemAccentColor();
    } else if (nIndex == COLOR_HOTLIGHT) {
        if (g_settings.AccentMarquee)
            return GetSystemAccentColor();
    }
    [[clang::musttail]] return GetSysColor_orig(nIndex);
}

// GetSysColorBrush_orig itself is forward-declared earlier, above SendMessageW_hook
// (static-duration pointers are zero-initialized by default, no initializer needed here).
static HBRUSH g_accentBrushCache[31] = {};
static HBRUSH g_darkBrushCache[31]   = {};

// Brushes GetSysColorBrush_hook hands out. Callers keep a system-color brush
// as permanent (a class background, a WM_CTLCOLOR answer), so none is deleted
// before unload: a theme change only repoints the index caches above, and a
// color seen before gets its existing brush back. Bounded by the distinct
// colors the session uses.
static SRWLOCK g_sysColorBrushLock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static std::unordered_map<COLORREF, HBRUSH> g_sysColorBrushes;

static HBRUSH SysColorBrushForColor(COLORREF color)
{
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_sysColorBrushLock);
    auto it = g_sysColorBrushes.find(color);
    HBRUSH brush = it != g_sysColorBrushes.end() ? it->second : nullptr;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_sysColorBrushLock);
    if (brush)
        return brush;

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_sysColorBrushLock);
    auto& slot = g_sysColorBrushes[color];
    if (!slot)
        slot = CreateSolidBrush(color);
    brush = slot;
    if (!brush)
        g_sysColorBrushes.erase(color);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_sysColorBrushLock);
    return brush;
}

static HBRUSH SysColorBrushCacheGet(HBRUSH (&cache)[31], int index, COLORREF color)
{
    if (index < 0 || index >= 31)
        return nullptr;
    auto slot = reinterpret_cast<PVOID volatile*>(&cache[index]);
    if (HBRUSH cached = reinterpret_cast<HBRUSH>(
            InterlockedCompareExchangePointer(slot, nullptr, nullptr)))
        return cached;
    HBRUSH brush = SysColorBrushForColor(color);
    if (brush)
        InterlockedCompareExchangePointer(slot, brush, nullptr);
    return brush;
}

// Theme change: the next request resolves the new colors. Nothing is deleted.
static void AccentBrushCacheClear()
{
    for (HBRUSH (*cache)[31] : { &g_accentBrushCache, &g_darkBrushCache }) {
        for (HBRUSH& slot : *cache) {
            InterlockedExchangePointer(
                reinterpret_cast<PVOID volatile*>(&slot), nullptr);
        }
    }
}

// Unload only.
static void SysColorBrushesRelease()
{
    AccentBrushCacheClear();
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_sysColorBrushLock);
    for (const auto& [color, brush] : g_sysColorBrushes)
        DeleteObject(brush);
    g_sysColorBrushes.clear();
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_sysColorBrushLock);
}

HBRUSH WINAPI GetSysColorBrush_hook(int nIndex)
{
    if (nIndex < 0 || nIndex >= 31)
        return GetSysColorBrush_orig(nIndex);
    // Excluded processes: return cached light brushes, with no exception --
    // an excluded process's file pickers stay fully native too (see
    // IsInsideExcludedFilePicker).
    if (g_darkModeExcluded) {
        if (nIndex >= 0 && nIndex < 31) {
            if (HBRUSH br = ExcludedSysColorBrush(nIndex))
                return br;
            return GetSysColorBrush_orig(nIndex);
        }
        return GetSysColorBrush_orig(nIndex);
    }
    if (g_darkModeActive) {
        if (HBRUSH br = SysColorBrushCacheGet(g_darkBrushCache, nIndex,
                GetDarkSysColor(nIndex)))
            return br;
        return GetSysColorBrush_orig(nIndex);
    }
    bool ovr = false;
    if ((nIndex == COLOR_HIGHLIGHT || nIndex == COLOR_MENUHILIGHT) &&
        (g_settings.AccentColorize || g_settings.AccentMarquee)) ovr = true;
    else if (nIndex == COLOR_HOTLIGHT && g_settings.AccentMarquee) ovr = true;
    if (ovr) {
        if (HBRUSH br = SysColorBrushCacheGet(g_accentBrushCache, nIndex,
                GetSystemAccentColor()))
            return br;
        return GetSysColorBrush_orig(nIndex);
    }
    [[clang::musttail]] return GetSysColorBrush_orig(nIndex);
}

static const INT g_accentElems[] = {
    COLOR_ACTIVECAPTION, COLOR_GRADIENTACTIVECAPTION
    // COLOR_HIGHLIGHT / COLOR_MENUHILIGHT intentionally excluded from
    // SetSysColors: leaking to the system scope makes the classic Win32
    // scrollbar (used inside ComboLBox popups that aren't fully themed)
    // pick up the accent color for its UPPER/LOWER track dither — track
    // ends up tinted accent in light mode. The GetSysColor / GetSysColorBrush
    // hooks below still translate these indices to the accent color for
    // in-process callers, so ListBox item-hover painting that goes through
    // GetSysColorBrush(COLOR_HIGHLIGHT) keeps showing the accent.
    // COLOR_HOTLIGHT intentionally excluded: Win32 uses it to draw
    // separator lines in toolbars/status bars, causing them to appear
    // in the accent color (green/pink) when AccentColorize is active.
};
static const int g_nAccentElems = 2; // update manually when array changes
static COLORREF  g_origAccentCols[5] = {};
static bool      g_accentSaved = false;

// ── Accent color application ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

// The theme's own value (SysMetrics), not the live table: after an Explorer
// restart the live table still holds the accent this mod wrote, and saving
// that as the original would "restore" the accent on unload.
static COLORREF AccentBaselineSysColor(int index);

static void ApplyAccentColorize()
{
    if (g_settings.AccentColorize)
    {
        if (!g_accentSaved)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < g_nAccentElems; i++)
                g_origAccentCols[i] = AccentBaselineSysColor(g_accentElems[i]);
            g_accentSaved = true;
        }
        COLORREF accent = GetSystemAccentColor();
        COLORREF newCols[5];
        for (int i = 0; i < g_nAccentElems; i++)
            newCols[i] = accent;
        SetSysColors(g_nAccentElems, g_accentElems, newCols);
    }
    else if (g_accentSaved)
    {
        SetSysColors(g_nAccentElems, g_accentElems, g_origAccentCols);
        g_accentSaved = false;
    }
}

static void ApplyAccentMarquee()
{
    // Off while AccentColorize is on, which takes precedence; a marquee
    // applied before that is restored like any other disable.
    if (g_settings.AccentMarquee && !g_settings.AccentColorize)
    {
        if (!g_hotlightSaved)
        {
            g_origHotlight  = AccentBaselineSysColor(COLOR_HOTLIGHT);
            g_origHighlight = AccentBaselineSysColor(COLOR_HIGHLIGHT);
            g_hotlightSaved = true;
        }
        COLORREF accent = GetSystemAccentColor();
        INT      elems[2]  = { COLOR_HOTLIGHT, COLOR_HIGHLIGHT };
        COLORREF cols[2]   = { accent, accent };
        SetSysColors(2, elems, cols);
    }
    else if (g_hotlightSaved)
    {
        INT      elems[2]  = { COLOR_HOTLIGHT, COLOR_HIGHLIGHT };
        COLORREF cols[2]   = { g_origHotlight, g_origHighlight };
        SetSysColors(2, elems, cols);
        g_hotlightSaved = false;
    }
}

// Forward declarations for UpdateThemeColors

static bool IsInsideExplorer(HWND hFrom)
{
    HWND root = GetAncestor(hFrom, GA_ROOT);
    if (!root) return false;
    wchar_t cls[64] = {};
    GetClassNameW(root, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls));
    return (_wcsicmp(cls, L"CabinetWClass") == 0 ||
            _wcsicmp(cls, L"ExploreWClass") == 0);
}

// The explicit option remains global. Real Explorer Mica also enables this
// renderer automatically, but only within an Explorer window.
static bool ModernScrollbarEnabledForWindow(HWND hwnd)
{
    return g_settings.ModernScrollbars ||
           (ExplorerBackdropMode() && IsInsideExplorer(hwnd));
}

// The shade of the size box between a control's two non-client scrollbars.
static COLORREF ScrollBarSizeBoxColor(HWND hwnd, HDC hdc, bool dark)
{
    const bool inExplorer = IsInsideExplorer(hwnd);
    if (ExplorerOpaqueMode() && inExplorer)
        return ExplorerMicaPaneSolidColor(dark);
    if (!inExplorer) {
        const COLORREF ownerBg = ScrollBarOwnerBackground(hwnd, hdc);
        if (ownerBg != CLR_INVALID)
            return ownerBg;
    }
    const bool micaBlack = ExplorerMicaActive() && inExplorer;
    if (dark)
        return micaBlack ? RGB(0, 0, 0) : Win32MainDark;
    return micaBlack ? RGB(0, 0, 0) : RGB(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF);
}

// user32 fills that size box itself with the theme's fill color (never a
// SBP_SIZEBOX draw), on the owner's window DC inside its DefWindowProc.
// Matches that fill by its exact rectangle so it takes our shade.
static bool ScrollBarNativeSizeBoxFill(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF& color)
{
    HWND owner = ScrollBarOwnerFromDc(hdc);
    if (!owner)
        return false;
    const DWORD style = GetWindowLongW(owner, GWL_STYLE);
    if ((style & (WS_VSCROLL | WS_HSCROLL)) != (WS_VSCROLL | WS_HSCROLL))
        return false;
    if (SysHighContrastEnabled())
        return false;
    const bool dark = IsHwndDarkMode(owner);
    // Dark mode alone no longer implies this renderer -- with the option
    // off the native scrollbar draws, and it paints its own size box.
    if (!ModernScrollbarEnabledForWindow(owner))
        return false;
    RECT win, client;
    if (!GetWindowRect(owner, &win) || !GetClientRect(owner, &client))
        return false;
    MapWindowPoints(owner, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(&client), 2);
    OffsetRect(&client, -win.left, -win.top);
    const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(owner);
    const int cx = GetSystemMetricsForDpi(SM_CXVSCROLL, dpi);
    const int cy = GetSystemMetricsForDpi(SM_CYHSCROLL, dpi);
    const bool leftScrollbar =
        (GetWindowLongW(owner, GWL_EXSTYLE) & (WS_EX_LEFTSCROLLBAR | WS_EX_LAYOUTRTL)) != 0;
    const RECT sizeBox = leftScrollbar
        ? RECT{client.left - cx, client.bottom, client.left, client.bottom + cy}
        : RECT{client.right, client.bottom, client.right + cx, client.bottom + cy};
    if (!EqualRect(&rc, &sizeBox))
        return false;
    color = ScrollBarSizeBoxColor(owner, hdc, dark);
    return true;
}

static bool IsExplorerMicaScrollbarTheme(HTHEME hTheme, HWND paintHwnd)
{
    if (!ExplorerBackdropMode() || !IsCurrentProcessExplorer())
        return false;

    const ThemeOpenerInfo themeInfo = GetThemeOpenerInfo(hTheme);
    bool explorerScrollbar;
    if (paintHwnd && IsWindow(paintHwnd)) {
        explorerScrollbar = IsInsideExplorer(paintHwnd);
    } else if (themeInfo.hwnd && IsWindow(themeInfo.hwnd)) {
        explorerScrollbar = IsInsideExplorer(themeInfo.hwnd);
    } else if (g_tlsPaintHwnd && IsWindow(g_tlsPaintHwnd)) {
        explorerScrollbar = IsInsideExplorer(g_tlsPaintHwnd);
    } else {
        explorerScrollbar = themeInfo.explorerScrollbar ||
            g_tlsPaintWasInsideExplorer;
    }
    if (explorerScrollbar && !themeInfo.explorerScrollbar)
        MarkThemeAsExplorerScrollbar(hTheme);
    return explorerScrollbar;
}

// Deliberately separate from IsInsideExplorer, not folded into it: several
// call sites gate behavior that must stay real-Explorer-only and would
// incorrectly leak onto the desktop if that check's own root list grew to
// include Progman/WorkerW. Root-level check only (WorkerW is also used by
// unrelated helper windows in many other processes for reasons that have
// nothing to do with the desktop -- callers needing certainty should
// confirm a real SHELLDLL_DefView/SysListView32 descendant too).
static bool IsInsideDesktop(HWND hFrom)
{
    HWND root = GetAncestor(hFrom, GA_ROOT);
    if (!root) return false;
    wchar_t cls[64] = {};
    GetClassNameW(root, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls));
    return (_wcsicmp(cls, L"Progman") == 0 ||
            _wcsicmp(cls, L"WorkerW") == 0);
}

// IsInsideExplorer only covers CabinetWClass/ExploreWClass -- common Open/Save
// file-picker dialogs (root class #32770) have their own NamespaceTreeControl
// nav pane and need the same protection. cacheNegative=false: this can run
// before the picker's nav pane finishes constructing, same reasoning as
// IsInsideExcludedFilePicker.
static bool IsInsidePickerNamespaceTree(HWND hwnd)
{
    HWND root = GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT);
    if (!root) return false;
    wchar_t rootCls[64] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(root, rootCls, ARRAYSIZE(rootCls)) ||
        _wcsicmp(rootCls, L"#32770") != 0)
        return false;
    return NavDividerRootContainsNamespaceTree(hwnd, /*cacheNegative=*/false);
}

// True if hwnd sits inside a real shell folder view (SHELLDLL_DefView) hosted
// either by Explorer itself or by a common Open/Save file picker running in
// another process. Generic dialog/NativeHWNDHost roots additionally need the
// picker's NamespaceTreeControl so unrelated embedded shell views stay native.
static bool IsInsideShellFolderView(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd))
        return false;

    bool inDefView = false;
    for (HWND p = GetParent(hwnd); p; p = GetParent(p)) {
        wchar_t pc[64] = {};
        if (GetClassNameW(p, pc, ARRAYSIZE(pc)) &&
            _wcsicmp(pc, L"SHELLDLL_DefView") == 0) {
            inDefView = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!inDefView)
        return false;

    HWND root = GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT);
    wchar_t rootCls[64] = {};
    if (!root || !GetClassNameW(root, rootCls, ARRAYSIZE(rootCls)))
        return false;

    if (_wcsicmp(rootCls, L"CabinetWClass") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(rootCls, L"ExploreWClass") == 0) {
        return true;
    }

    if (_wcsicmp(rootCls, L"#32770") != 0 &&
        _wcsicmp(rootCls, L"NativeHWNDHost") != 0) {
        return false;
    }

    // Both root classes are generic and can host unrelated UI. A real modern
    // shell file picker also owns a NamespaceTreeControl; do not cache an
    // early miss because DirectUI can paint before that tree finishes loading.
    return NavDividerRootContainsNamespaceTree(
        root, /*cacheNegative=*/false);
}

// True if hwnd is the DirectUIHWND hosting modern Explorer's own status
// bar -- like the file list, it's DirectUI-hosted, not a classic
// msctls_statusbar32, but under a different parent chain than the content
// view's SHELLDLL_DefView: ShellTabWindowClass > DUIViewWndClassName >
// DirectUIHWND. Confirmed via inspection, not guessed.
static bool IsInsideExplorerStatusBarHost(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd))
        return false;

    HWND parent = GetParent(hwnd);
    wchar_t parentCls[64] = {};
    if (!parent || !GetClassNameW(parent, parentCls, ARRAYSIZE(parentCls)) ||
        _wcsicmp(parentCls, L"DUIViewWndClassName") != 0)
        return false;

    HWND grandparent = GetParent(parent);
    wchar_t gpCls[64] = {};
    if (!grandparent || !GetClassNameW(grandparent, gpCls, ARRAYSIZE(gpCls)) ||
        _wcsicmp(gpCls, L"ShellTabWindowClass") != 0)
        return false;

    HWND root = GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT);
    wchar_t rootCls[64] = {};
    if (!root || !GetClassNameW(root, rootCls, ARRAYSIZE(rootCls)))
        return false;

    return _wcsicmp(rootCls, L"CabinetWClass") == 0 ||
           _wcsicmp(rootCls, L"ExploreWClass") == 0;
}

static void UpdateThemeColors()
{
    g_tabTextMetricGeneration.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);

    // Clear theme class cache — new theme handles are incompatible with old ones
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_themeClassCacheMutex);
      g_themeClassCache.clear(); }
    ThemeClassCacheBump();

    // Invalidate accent caches
    AccentPaletteInvalidate();
    HwndDarkCacheInvalidate();
    g_accentCacheDirty.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    g_accentBaseCacheDirty.store(true, std::memory_order_release);

    // Invalidate DComp pill brush cache (accent color may have changed).
    // Every other g_pillDC touch holds g_pillDCMutex -- this one must too.
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillDCMutex);
      g_pillDC.brushDirty = true; }

    // Invalidate ListView item cache (accent/dark may have changed)
    LvCacheInvalidate();

    // Drag/drop badge cache is keyed by dark/light theme and DPI.
    DragDropBadgeCacheClear();

    // Shell SVG rasterizations are keyed by theme/accent and must not outlive
    // a palette change even when the setting itself stays enabled.
    ShellIconClearCache();

    // Same reasoning -- the content-area pin icons are keyed by dark/accent too.
    PinContentIconClearCache();

    // Regedit's TreeView glyph icons are keyed by dark/accent as well.
    RgGlyphIconClearCache();

    // Module-identity caches (keyed by raw HMODULE base address) can't
    // detect a module unloading and a different one loading at the same
    // address -- low-likelihood in practice (shell32/comctl32/dui70 are
    // essentially never unloaded from a live process), but clearing them on
    // every theme change bounds the staleness window instead of leaving it
    // open for the rest of the process's life, at no extra cost since this
    // path already runs infrequently.
    ShellIconClearModuleCaches();

    // Invalidate cached accent brushes (GetSysColorBrush hook)
    AccentBrushCacheClear();

    // Keyed on the dialog's own font, which a theme change can shift.
    g_winUiTabFontCache.Clear();
    g_groupHeaderFontCache.Clear();
    WinUiTextDWriteCacheClear();

    // Explorer-only: re-apply SetSysColors operations
    if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer())
    {
        ApplyAccentColorize();
        ApplyAccentMarquee();
    }
}
// Mode switch: invalidate children for repaint
static BOOL CALLBACK ModeSwitchChildProc(HWND ch, LPARAM) {
    wchar_t cls[64] = {};
    GetClassNameW(ch, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls));
    // Nested #32770 dialogs (property-sheet/wizard pages) get their own
    // ApplyPropertyDialogDarkMode subclass, but this enumeration is the only sweep
    // that runs on a live dark<->excluded switch -- without it, a page
    // created while dark mode was allowed keeps its dark styling after
    // exclusion until recreated. Both callees already no-op on any
    // non-#32770 WS_CHILD window, so this is safe unconditionally.
    if (IsCustomDarkModeAllowed())
        ApplyCustomDarkModeToExistingWindow(ch);
    else
        RemoveCustomDarkModeFromWindow(ch);
    // Real Explorer manages dark mode for its own window tree natively --
    // never actively re-theme it (SetWindowTheme/WM_THEMECHANGED here were
    // found to coincide with the modern grouped ListView's group-header
    // font-height bug). Passive recoloring elsewhere is unaffected. The
    // desktop (Progman/WorkerW) needs the exact same exclusion -- confirmed
    // via live logging that its own SysListView32 (the desktop icon view)
    // was falling through to the generic ListView_SetBkColor(CLR_DEFAULT)
    // branch below meant for third-party apps' list views, which replaces
    // its normally-transparent background with an opaque one and hides the
    // wallpaper behind it until something else forces a full repaint.
    // IsInsideDesktop is deliberately its own separate helper rather than
    // folded into IsInsideExplorer -- several other call sites gate
    // behavior that must stay real-Explorer-only and would incorrectly
    // leak onto the desktop if that check's own root list grew to include
    // Progman/WorkerW.
    const bool cabinetRooted = IsInsideExplorer(ch);
    const bool desktopRooted = IsInsideDesktop(ch);
    const bool ownsNativeTheming = cabinetRooted || desktopRooted;
    const bool dark = IsCustomDarkModeAllowed();
    if (!ownsNativeTheming && _wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboLBox") != 0 && g_cbdAllowDark)
        g_cbdAllowDark(ch, dark);
    if (!dark)
        RemovePropW(ch, L"UseImmersiveDarkModeColors");
    HwndDarkCacheInvalidate();
    // Apply dark/light theme to common controls
    const bool isListOrTree =
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysListView32") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTreeView32") == 0;
    // SetExplorerFamilyTheme resolves to "Explorer" (not nullptr) for
    // non-Explorer processes -- the same theme string the creation-time
    // path (NtUserCreateWindowEx_hook) already applies to ListView/TreeView
    // unconditionally, confirmed safe (doesn't trigger the MFC/ProfUIS
    // WM_THEMECHANGED deadlock the way "DarkMode_Explorer" does). Safe here
    // too.
    if (isListOrTree && !ownsNativeTheming) {
        SetExplorerFamilyTheme(ch);
        if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTreeView32") == 0) {
            TreeView_SetBkColor(ch, dark ? Win32MainDark : CLR_DEFAULT);
            TreeView_SetTextColor(ch, dark ? WinUI::Dark::TextFillColorPrimary : CLR_DEFAULT);
        } else {
            ListView_SetBkColor(ch, dark ? Win32MainDark : CLR_DEFAULT);
            ListView_SetTextBkColor(ch, dark ? Win32MainDark : CLR_DEFAULT);
            ListView_SetTextColor(ch, dark ? WinUI::Dark::TextFillColorPrimary : CLR_DEFAULT);
        }
        SendMessageW(ch, WM_THEMECHANGED, 0, 0);
    } else if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"SysHeader32") == 0) {
        // SetItemsViewOrDefaultTheme/SetDarkExplorerOrDefaultTheme still call
        // SetWindowTheme(hwnd, NULL, NULL) for real the first time even in
        // non-Explorer processes -- that's the actual call that deadlocked
        // MFC/ProfUIS-skinned third-party apps (Revo Uninstaller Pro), same
        // bug as the creation-time path. Keep these Explorer-only.
        if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer() && !ownsNativeTheming) {
            SetItemsViewOrDefaultTheme(ch);
            SendMessageW(ch, WM_THEMECHANGED, 0, 0);
        }
    } else if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"Button") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"ScrollBar") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"msctls_trackbar32") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"msctls_statusbar32") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"ToolbarWindow32") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"ReBarWindow32") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"ListBox") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"CHECKLIST_ACLUI") == 0 ||
        wcsstr(cls, L"SysTabCtl") != nullptr) {
        if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer() && !ownsNativeTheming) {
            SetDarkExplorerOrDefaultTheme(ch);
            SendMessageW(ch, WM_THEMECHANGED, 0, 0);
        }
    }
    // Reuse the mode-switch sweep for an Edit opened before light-Mica
    // rename repair became available; no separate window scan is needed.
    if (!dark && (ExplorerMicaActive() || RgMicaActive()) &&
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"Edit") == 0) {
        ListRenameTryTrack(ch);
    }
    RedrawWindow(ch, nullptr, nullptr,
        RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
    return TRUE;
}
// ModeSwitchEnumProc's lParam at unload: its cross-thread sends skip a hung
// window instead of stalling the unload on it, and nothing new is applied.
static constexpr LPARAM kModeSwitchUnloading = 1;

static BOOL CALLBACK ModeSwitchEnumProc(HWND hw, LPARAM lParam) {
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hw, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId()) return TRUE;
    const bool unloading = lParam == kModeSwitchUnloading;
    if (unloading && IsHungAppWindow(hw)) return TRUE;
    wchar_t c[64] = {};
    GetClassNameW(hw, c, ARRAYSIZE(c));
    if (IsCustomDarkModeAllowed())
        ApplyCustomDarkModeToExistingWindow(hw);
    else
        RemoveCustomDarkModeFromWindow(hw);
    if (_wcsicmp(c, L"tooltips_class32") == 0) {
        SetDarkExplorerOrDefaultTheme(hw);
        if (g_settings.ModernTooltips && !unloading)
            TooltipApplyAcrylicEffects(hw, GetWindow(hw, GW_OWNER));
        else
            TooltipRestoreEffects(hw);
    }
    // Force full redraw including non-client scrollbars
    RedrawWindow(hw, nullptr, nullptr, RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
    EnumChildWindows(hw, ModeSwitchChildProc, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

// Forward declarations for mode switch
static void ApplyDarkSysColors();
static void RestoreDarkSysColors();

static LRESULT CALLBACK ThemeMsgWndProc(HWND hWnd, UINT uMsg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (g_msgWndUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
        uMsg != WM_CLOSE && uMsg != WM_NCDESTROY) {
        return DefSubclassProc(hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam);
    }
    if (uMsg == WM_CLOSE) {
        DestroyWindow(hWnd);
        return 0;
    }
    // Re-read on the next SysAnimationsEnabled() call -- covers the
    // Accessibility "Play animations" toggle (SPI_SETCLIENTAREAANIMATION),
    // which broadcasts WM_SETTINGCHANGE without a matching lParam string.
    if (uMsg == WM_SETTINGCHANGE) {
        g_animEnabled = -1;
        const bool highContrast = SysHighContrastEnabled();
        const bool previousRoundedHighContrast =
            g_roundedSelectionHighContrast.exchange(
                highContrast, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        if (!previousRoundedHighContrast && highContrast)
            ListSelectFadeCleanup();
        if (GetSettings()->EditFocusLine || ExplorerMicaActive() ||
            RgMicaActive()) {
            const bool previousHighContrast =
                g_listRenameHighContrast.exchange(
                    highContrast, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            if (previousHighContrast != highContrast) {
                if (highContrast) {
                    ListRenameCleanupAll(true);
                } else if (!g_isXamlProcess) {
                    EnumWindows(ListRenameTrackTopEnum, 0);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // A contrast theme toggle (SPI_SETHIGHCONTRAST) switches dark mode too.
    if (uMsg == WM_SETTINGCHANGE &&
        (wParam == SPI_SETHIGHCONTRAST ||
         (lParam && wcscmp((LPCWSTR)lParam, L"ImmersiveColorSet") == 0)))
    {
        bool systemDark = ReadSystemDarkModeFromRegistry();
        bool systemModeChanged =
            g_lastSeenSystemDarkValid && g_lastSeenSystemDark != systemDark;
        g_lastSeenSystemDark = systemDark;
        g_lastSeenSystemDarkValid = true;
        // IsSystemDarkMode() answers from this cache, and the dark-mode
        // recompute below must already see the new mode.
        g_cachedIsDark.store(systemDark, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        g_accentCacheDirty.store(true, std::memory_order_release);

        // Auto dark mode switch: custom dark mode follows the system app theme.
        bool wasDark = g_darkModeActive.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        bool nowDark = RecomputeCustomDarkModeActive();
        // Restore the real palette before applying light-mode accent settings;
        // otherwise RestoreDarkSysColors would overwrite those changes.
        if (!g_isXamlProcess && wasDark && !nowDark)
            RestoreDarkSysColors();
        // g_themeClassCache and all palette-dependent caches are cleared here.
        UpdateThemeColors();
        ShortcutOverlayScheduleRefresh();
        if (!g_isXamlProcess && !nowDark &&
            (wasDark || systemModeChanged) &&
            (ExplorerMicaActive() || RgMicaActive())) {
            NavTreeUniscribeInit(true);
        }
        if (!g_isXamlProcess && nowDark)
            ApplyDarkSysColors();
        if (g_settings.FluentPinIcon)
            EnumWindows(PinSettingsEnumProc, 0);

        if (!g_isXamlProcess && wasDark != nowDark) {
            if (nowDark) {
                if (g_setAppMode) {
                    int mode = IsCurrentProcessExplorer() ? 1 : 2;
                    g_setAppMode(mode);
                    if (g_refreshColorPolicy) g_refreshColorPolicy();
                }
            } else {
                RevertPreferredAppMode();
            }
            if (g_flushMenuThemes) g_flushMenuThemes();
            if (g_refreshColorPolicy) g_refreshColorPolicy();
            LvCacheInvalidate();
            // g_tabBgCacheWinUI is theme-independent (see UpdateThemeColors
            // above) -- nothing to invalidate here.

            if (nowDark && !g_win32MainDarkBrush)
                g_win32MainDarkBrush = CreateSolidBrush(Win32MainDark);
            SetPropertyDialogClassBrush(nowDark);

            // Invalidate all windows and reset themes
            EnumWindows(ModeSwitchEnumProc, 0);
        } else if (!g_isXamlProcess && systemModeChanged) {
            if (g_flushMenuThemes) g_flushMenuThemes();
            if (g_refreshColorPolicy) g_refreshColorPolicy();
            EnumWindows(ModeSwitchEnumProc, 0);
        }
    }
    else if (uMsg == WM_DWMCOLORIZATIONCOLORCHANGED)
    {
        // This notification can precede ImmersiveColorSet. Only invalidate
        // the accent inputs here; the later immersive-color notification owns
        // the mod-wide theme transition.
        AccentPaletteInvalidate();
        g_accentCacheDirty.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        g_accentBaseCacheDirty.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        ShortcutOverlayScheduleRefresh();
    }
    else if (uMsg == WM_THEMECHANGED)
    {
        UpdateThemeColors();
        ShortcutOverlayScheduleRefresh();
        if (!g_isXamlProcess && IsCustomDarkModeAllowed())
            ApplyDarkSysColors();
        if (g_settings.FluentPinIcon)
            EnumWindows(PinSettingsEnumProc, 0);
    }
    else if (uMsg == WM_SYSCOLORCHANGE)
    {
        // Catches the live sys-color table drifting back to light from an
        // external SetSysColors call. Same guard as WM_THEMECHANGED below --
        // only re-asserts when dark mode should actually be active.
        if (!g_isXamlProcess && IsCustomDarkModeAllowed())
            ApplyDarkSysColors();
    }
    if (uMsg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hWnd, ThemeMsgWndProc);
        HWND expected = hWnd;
        g_msgWnd.compare_exchange_strong(
            expected, nullptr, std::memory_order_acq_rel,
            std::memory_order_acquire);
        PostQuitMessage(0);
    }

    // Posted by NavDividerTrackAndGetHwnd -- see kNavDividerApplyHooksMessage.
    // Re-checked here (not just relying on the g_msgWndUnloading guard at the
    // top of this function) because g_navDividerUnloading is set well before
    // DestroyMsgWindow gets around to setting g_msgWndUnloading, so a message
    // posted just before Wh_ModUninit began could otherwise still be
    // dispatched during that window.
    if (uMsg == kNavDividerApplyHooksMessage) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_navDividerHookMutex);
        if (!g_navDividerUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            Wh_ApplyHookOperations();
        return 0;
    }

    if (uMsg == kShortcutOverlayActivateMessage) {
        if (!g_shortcutOverlayUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            ShortcutOverlayEnable();
        return 0;
    }

    if (const UINT syncMsg = g_winEventHooksSyncMsg.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        syncMsg && uMsg == syncMsg) {
        WinEventHooksSync(false);
        return 0;
    }

    if (uMsg == kDirectUiApplyHooksMessage) {
        DirectUiEnsureSymbolsForLoadedModule(true);
        return 0;
    }

    if (uMsg == kDirectUiRetryRenameMessage) {
        DirectUiEnsureSymbolsForLoadedModule(true);
        HWND edit = reinterpret_cast<HWND>(lParam);
        if (IsWindow(edit))
            ListRenameTryTrack(edit);
        return 0;
    }

    if (uMsg == kExplorerFrameApplyHooksMessage) {
        ExplorerFrameEnsureSymbolsForLoadedModule(true);
        return 0;
    }

    if (uMsg == kLazyFeatureApplyHooksMessage) {
        LazyFeatureEnsureHooks(true);
        return 0;
    }

    if (uMsg == kMenuImmersiveApplyHooksMessage) {
        MenuEnsureImmersiveHooks(true);
        g_menuImmersiveApplyPosted.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        return 0;
    }

    if (uMsg == WM_TIMER &&
        wParam == kShortcutOverlayRefreshTimerId) {
        KillTimer(hWnd, kShortcutOverlayRefreshTimerId);
        if (!g_shortcutOverlayUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            ShortcutOverlayRefresh();
        return 0;
    }

    return DefSubclassProc(hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam);
}

// Keep the executable-scoped class independent of the mod: its class proc is
// the system DefWindowProcW, while ThemeMsgWndProc is attached only to the
// dedicated thread's live window and removed before that thread exits.
static bool RegisterMsgWndClass()
{
    WNDCLASSEXW wc = {};
    wc.cbSize        = sizeof(wc);
    wc.lpfnWndProc   = DefWindowProcW;
    wc.hInstance     = (HINSTANCE)GetModuleHandleW(nullptr);
    wc.lpszClassName = MSG_WND_CLS;
    if (RegisterClassExW(&wc) != 0)
        return true;
    if (GetLastError() != ERROR_CLASS_ALREADY_EXISTS)
        return false;

    // The executable-scoped system-procedure class intentionally remains
    // registered after its dedicated window is destroyed, so reuse it.
    WNDCLASSEXW existing = {};
    existing.cbSize = sizeof(existing);
    return GetClassInfoExW(wc.hInstance, MSG_WND_CLS, &existing) &&
           existing.lpfnWndProc == DefWindowProcW;
}

static DWORD WINAPI MsgWindowThreadProc(LPVOID)
{
    g_msgWndThreadId.store(GetCurrentThreadId(), std::memory_order_release);
    HWND hwnd = nullptr;
    if (RegisterMsgWndClass()) {
        // Must be a real top-level window (WS_POPUP, parent=nullptr) so it
        // receives HWND_BROADCAST messages. HWND_MESSAGE is excluded.
        hwnd = CreateWindowExW(0, MSG_WND_CLS, nullptr, WS_POPUP,
            0, 0, 0, 0, nullptr, nullptr,
            (HINSTANCE)GetModuleHandleW(nullptr), nullptr);
        if (hwnd && !WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                hwnd, ThemeMsgWndProc, 0)) {
            DestroyWindow(hwnd);
            hwnd = nullptr;
        }
    }
    g_msgWnd.store(hwnd, std::memory_order_release);
    if (g_msgWndReadyEvent)
        SetEvent(g_msgWndReadyEvent);

    if (hwnd) {
        MSG msg = {};
        while (GetMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0) > 0) {
            TranslateMessage(&msg);
            DispatchMessageW(&msg);
        }
        if (IsWindow(hwnd)) {
            WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                hwnd, ThemeMsgWndProc);
            DestroyWindow(hwnd);
        }
    }

    // The WinEvent hooks belong to this thread: remove them before it exits.
    WinEventHooksSync(true);
    g_msgWnd.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
    g_msgWndThreadId.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    return 0;
}

static void CreateMsgWindow()
{
    if (g_msgWndThread)
        return;
    g_winEventHooksSyncMsg.store(
        RegisterWindowMessageW(L"Win32UIModernizer.WinEventHooksSync"),
        std::memory_order_release);
    g_msgWndReadyEvent = CreateEventW(nullptr, TRUE, FALSE, nullptr);
    if (!g_msgWndReadyEvent)
        return;
    g_msgWndThread = CreateThread(
        nullptr, 0, MsgWindowThreadProc, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
    if (!g_msgWndThread) {
        CloseHandle(g_msgWndReadyEvent);
        g_msgWndReadyEvent = nullptr;
        return;
    }
    WaitForSingleObject(g_msgWndReadyEvent, INFINITE);
}

static void DestroyMsgWindow()
{
    g_msgWndUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    HANDLE thread = g_msgWndThread;
    if (!thread)
        return;

    HWND hwnd = g_msgWnd.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    bool stopPosted = hwnd && IsWindow(hwnd) && PostMessageW(hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
    DWORD threadId = g_msgWndThreadId.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (!stopPosted && threadId)
        PostThreadMessageW(threadId, WM_QUIT, 0, 0);

    WaitForSingleObject(thread, INFINITE);
    CloseHandle(thread);
    g_msgWndThread = nullptr;
    if (g_msgWndReadyEvent) {
        CloseHandle(g_msgWndReadyEvent);
        g_msgWndReadyEvent = nullptr;
    }
    g_msgWnd.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
    g_msgWndThreadId.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    // Deliberately no UnregisterClassW -- the class proc is DefWindowProcW,
    // always safe to leave registered. See RegisterMsgWndClass's reuse path.
}
