// Full takeover of the chart: computes its own geometry and draws from
// scratch, same technique as the reference "Disk Pie Chart" mod, so there's
// no native pie/hole geometry to match up against.
struct DiskPieRingGdipRuntime {
    ULONG_PTR token = 0;
    bool startupAttempted = false;
    bool ready = false;
};
static DiskPieRingGdipRuntime g_diskPieRingGdip;
static std::mutex g_diskPieRingGdipMutex;

static bool DiskPieRingEnsureGdipLocked()
{
    if (!g_settings.DiskChartAccentColor)
        return false;
    if (g_diskPieRingGdip.ready)
        return true;
    if (g_diskPieRingGdip.startupAttempted ||
        g_gdipUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return false;

    g_diskPieRingGdip.startupAttempted = true;
    Gdiplus::GdiplusStartupInput input;
    if (Gdiplus::GdiplusStartup(&g_diskPieRingGdip.token, &input, nullptr) !=
        Gdiplus::Ok) {
        g_diskPieRingGdip.token = 0;
        return false;
    }
    g_diskPieRingGdip.ready = true;
    return true;
}

static void DiskPieRingGdipShutdown()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_diskPieRingGdipMutex);
    if (g_diskPieRingGdip.token) {
        Gdiplus::GdiplusShutdown(g_diskPieRingGdip.token);
        g_diskPieRingGdip.token = 0;
    }
    g_diskPieRingGdip.ready = false;
    g_diskPieRingGdip.startupAttempted = false;
}

// The custom chart owns its full circular surface. Keep that surface stable
// across repaints instead of sampling pixels that may be stale while moving.
static COLORREF DiskPieRingBackgroundColor(bool dark)
{
    return ElevatedPaneColor(dark);
}

// No official threshold exists for this chart; critical mirrors Windows'
// own low-disk-space cue (~10-15% free), warning set a bit earlier.
static constexpr DWORD kDiskPieWarningThreshold  = 800;  // 80% used
static constexpr DWORD kDiskPieCriticalThreshold = 900;  // 90% used
static constexpr COLORREF kDiskPieWarningColor  = RGB(0xFF, 0xB9, 0x00); // Fluent Amber
static constexpr COLORREF kDiskPieCriticalColor = RGB(0xE8, 0x11, 0x23); // Fluent Red

static COLORREF DiskPieLighten(COLORREF c, float amount)
{
    amount = std::clamp(amount, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    auto mix = [amount](BYTE v) {
        return static_cast<BYTE>(std::lround(v + (255 - v) * amount));
    };
    return RGB(mix(GetRValue(c)), mix(GetGValue(c)), mix(GetBValue(c)));
}

static COLORREF DiskPieAccentBaseColor(DWORD usagePer1000, bool dark)
{
    if (usagePer1000 >= kDiskPieCriticalThreshold)
        return kDiskPieCriticalColor;
    if (usagePer1000 >= kDiskPieWarningThreshold)
        return kDiskPieWarningColor;
    return GetAccentFillDefault(dark);
}

static constexpr UINT kDiskPieAnimationIntervalMs = 33;
static constexpr ULONGLONG kDiskPieAnimationDurationMs = 2800;
static constexpr float kDiskPieAnimationLightenAmount = 0.40f;
static int g_diskPieAnimationTimerTag;
static std::atomic_bool g_diskPieAnimationUnloading = false;

struct DiskPieAnimationState {
    std::mutex mutex;
    HWND page = nullptr;
    HWND root = nullptr;
    RECT chartRect = {};
    DWORD usagePer1000 = 0;
    ULONGLONG startTick = 0;
    double pausedPhase = 0.0;
    bool timerActive = false;
    bool highContrast = false;
    std::atomic_bool cleanupStarted = false;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteFactory> dwFactory;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> textFormat;
    float textFormatSize = 0.0f;
    bool textFormatAttempted = false;
};

static std::mutex g_diskPieAnimationMutex;
static std::unordered_map<HWND, std::shared_ptr<DiskPieAnimationState>>
    g_diskPieAnimationStates;
static std::unordered_set<HWND> g_diskPieAnimationRoots;

static bool DiskPieDrawRoundedRing(HDC hdc, const RECT& chartRect,
    DWORD usagePer1000,
    const std::shared_ptr<DiskPieAnimationState>& animationState);
static bool DiskPieDrawRoundedRingBuffered(HDC hdc, const RECT& chartRect,
    DWORD usagePer1000,
    const std::shared_ptr<DiskPieAnimationState>& animationState);

static UINT_PTR DiskPieAnimationTimerId()
{
    return reinterpret_cast<UINT_PTR>(&g_diskPieAnimationTimerTag);
}

static std::shared_ptr<DiskPieAnimationState> DiskPieAnimationFind(HWND page)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_diskPieAnimationMutex);
    auto it = g_diskPieAnimationStates.find(page);
    return it != g_diskPieAnimationStates.end() ? it->second : nullptr;
}

static std::vector<std::shared_ptr<DiskPieAnimationState>>
DiskPieAnimationFindForRoot(HWND root)
{
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<DiskPieAnimationState>> states;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_diskPieAnimationMutex);
    for (const auto& [page, state] : g_diskPieAnimationStates) {
        (void)page;
        if (state && state->root == root)
            states.push_back(state);
    }
    return states;
}

// Requires state.mutex. Mutable timer and render-cache fields are shared by
// the page thread and Windhawk's settings/unload thread.
static double DiskPieAnimationPhaseLocked(
    const DiskPieAnimationState& state)
{
    if (!state.timerActive || !state.startTick)
        return state.pausedPhase;
    const ULONGLONG elapsed = GetTickCount64() - state.startTick;
    return std::fmod(
        static_cast<double>(elapsed) / kDiskPieAnimationDurationMs, 1.0);
}

static void DiskPieAnimationStopLocked(DiskPieAnimationState& state)
{
    if (!state.timerActive)
        return;
    state.pausedPhase = DiskPieAnimationPhaseLocked(state);
    (void)KillTimer(state.page, DiskPieAnimationTimerId());
    state.timerActive = false;
    state.startTick = 0;
}

static void DiskPieAnimationStop(
    const std::shared_ptr<DiskPieAnimationState>& state)
{
    if (!state)
        return;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state->mutex);
    DiskPieAnimationStopLocked(*state);
}

static bool DiskPieAnimationCanRunLocked(
    const DiskPieAnimationState& state)
{
    if (state.cleanupStarted.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return false;
    if (g_diskPieAnimationUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return false;
    if (!g_settings.DiskChartAccentColor)
        return false;
    if (!SysAnimationsEnabled())
        return false;
    if (state.highContrast)
        return false;
    if (!state.page || !state.root ||
        !IsWindow(state.page) || !IsWindow(state.root))
        return false;
    if (!IsWindowVisible(state.page))
        return false;
    if (IsIconic(state.root))
        return false;
    if (GetForegroundWindow() != state.root)
        return false;
    if (state.chartRect.right <= state.chartRect.left ||
        state.chartRect.bottom <= state.chartRect.top)
        return false;
    return true;
}

static void DiskPieAnimationStartLocked(DiskPieAnimationState& state)
{
    if (state.timerActive || !DiskPieAnimationCanRunLocked(state))
        return;
    const ULONGLONG phaseOffset = static_cast<ULONGLONG>(std::lround(
        std::clamp(state.pausedPhase, 0.0, 1.0) *
        kDiskPieAnimationDurationMs));
    state.startTick = GetTickCount64() - phaseOffset;
    if (SetTimer(state.page, DiskPieAnimationTimerId(),
            kDiskPieAnimationIntervalMs, nullptr)) {
        state.timerActive = true;
    } else {
        state.startTick = 0;
    }
}

static void DiskPieAnimationStart(
    const std::shared_ptr<DiskPieAnimationState>& state)
{
    if (!state)
        return;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state->mutex);
    DiskPieAnimationStartLocked(*state);
}

static void DiskPieAnimationRefresh(
    const std::shared_ptr<DiskPieAnimationState>& state)
{
    if (!state)
        return;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state->mutex);
    if (DiskPieAnimationCanRunLocked(*state))
        DiskPieAnimationStartLocked(*state);
    else
        DiskPieAnimationStopLocked(*state);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK DiskPieAnimationSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR);

static void DiskPieAnimationCleanup(
    const std::shared_ptr<DiskPieAnimationState>& state)
{
    if (!state || state->cleanupStarted.exchange(
            true, std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
        return;
    }

    DiskPieAnimationStop(state);
    bool removeRootSubclass = false;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_diskPieAnimationMutex);
        auto it = g_diskPieAnimationStates.find(state->page);
        if (it != g_diskPieAnimationStates.end() && it->second == state)
            g_diskPieAnimationStates.erase(it);

        bool rootStillUsed = false;
        for (const auto& [page, other] : g_diskPieAnimationStates) {
            (void)page;
            if (other && other->root == state->root) {
                rootStillUsed = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!rootStillUsed)
            removeRootSubclass = g_diskPieAnimationRoots.erase(state->root) != 0;
    }

    if (state->page && IsWindow(state->page)) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            state->page, DiskPieAnimationSubclassProc);
    }
    if (removeRootSubclass && state->root != state->page &&
        state->root && IsWindow(state->root)) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            state->root, DiskPieAnimationSubclassProc);
    }
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK DiskPieAnimationSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_TIMER && wp == DiskPieAnimationTimerId()) {
        auto state = DiskPieAnimationFind(hwnd);
        if (!state)
            return 0;
        RECT chartRect = {};
        DWORD usagePer1000 = 0;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state->mutex);
            if (!DiskPieAnimationCanRunLocked(*state)) {
                DiskPieAnimationStopLocked(*state);
                return 0;
            }
            chartRect = state->chartRect;
            usagePer1000 = state->usagePer1000;
        }
        HDC hdc = GetDC(hwnd);
        if (hdc) {
            const bool drawn = DiskPieDrawRoundedRingBuffered(
                hdc, chartRect, usagePer1000, state);
            ReleaseDC(hwnd, hdc);
            if (!drawn)
                InvalidateRect(hwnd, &chartRect, FALSE);
        }
        return 0;
    }

    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        if (auto pageState = DiskPieAnimationFind(hwnd)) {
            DiskPieAnimationCleanup(pageState);
        } else {
            auto rootStates = DiskPieAnimationFindForRoot(hwnd);
            for (const auto& state : rootStates)
                DiskPieAnimationCleanup(state);
        }
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    }

    const bool refreshPage =
        msg == WM_SHOWWINDOW || msg == WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGED;
    const bool refreshRoot = msg == WM_ACTIVATE || msg == WM_SIZE ||
        msg == WM_SETTINGCHANGE;
    LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);

    if (refreshPage) {
        if (auto state = DiskPieAnimationFind(hwnd))
            DiskPieAnimationRefresh(state);
    }
    if (refreshRoot) {
        if (msg == WM_SETTINGCHANGE)
            g_animEnabled.store(-1, std::memory_order_release);
        auto states = DiskPieAnimationFindForRoot(hwnd);
        const bool highContrast = msg == WM_SETTINGCHANGE
            ? SysHighContrastEnabled() : false;
        for (const auto& state : states)
        {
            if (msg == WM_SETTINGCHANGE) {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state->mutex);
                state->highContrast = highContrast;
            }
            DiskPieAnimationRefresh(state);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

static std::shared_ptr<DiskPieAnimationState> DiskPieAnimationEnsure(
    HWND page, const RECT& chartRect, DWORD usagePer1000)
{
    if (!page || !IsWindow(page) ||
        g_diskPieAnimationUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !g_settings.DiskChartAccentColor ||
        !SysAnimationsEnabled()) {
        return nullptr;
    }

    if (auto state = DiskPieAnimationFind(page)) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state->mutex);
        if (state->cleanupStarted.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            return nullptr;
        state->chartRect = chartRect;
        state->usagePer1000 = usagePer1000;
        if (state->highContrast) {
            DiskPieAnimationStopLocked(*state);
            return nullptr;
        }
        return state;
    }

    const bool highContrast = SysHighContrastEnabled();
    if (highContrast)
        return nullptr;

    HWND root = GetAncestor(page, GA_ROOT);
    if (!root)
        return nullptr;

    auto state = std::make_shared<DiskPieAnimationState>();
    state->page = page;
    state->root = root;
    state->chartRect = chartRect;
    state->usagePer1000 = usagePer1000;
    state->highContrast = false;

    bool rootAlreadyInstalled = false;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_diskPieAnimationMutex);
        rootAlreadyInstalled = g_diskPieAnimationRoots.count(root) != 0;
    }
    if (!rootAlreadyInstalled &&
        !WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            root, DiskPieAnimationSubclassProc, 0)) {
        return nullptr;
    }
    if (page != root &&
        !WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            page, DiskPieAnimationSubclassProc, 0)) {
        if (!rootAlreadyInstalled) {
            WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                root, DiskPieAnimationSubclassProc);
        }
        return nullptr;
    }

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_diskPieAnimationMutex);
        g_diskPieAnimationStates[page] = state;
        g_diskPieAnimationRoots.insert(root);
    }
    return state;
}

static void DiskPieAnimationCleanupAll()
{
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<DiskPieAnimationState>> states;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_diskPieAnimationMutex);
        for (const auto& [page, state] : g_diskPieAnimationStates) {
            (void)page;
            if (state)
                states.push_back(state);
        }
    }
    for (const auto& state : states)
        DiskPieAnimationCleanup(state);
}

// WinUI ring: background fill (the hole), track circle, then accent arc.
// DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION: GDI+ not D2D -- flat opaque fills/strokes need no
// BindDC/BeginDraw/EndDraw bracket; percentage text below still uses D2D.
static bool DiskPieDrawRoundedRing(HDC hdc, const RECT& chartRect,
    DWORD usagePer1000,
    const std::shared_ptr<DiskPieAnimationState>& animationState)
{
    const float width = (float)(chartRect.right - chartRect.left);
    const float height = (float)(chartRect.bottom - chartRect.top);
    if (width <= 0.0f || height <= 0.0f)
        return false;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_diskPieRingGdipMutex);
    if (!DiskPieRingEnsureGdipLocked())
        return false;

    HWND pieHwnd = animationState && IsWindow(animationState->page)
        ? animationState->page
        : (g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc));
    const bool dark = pieHwnd ? IsHwndDarkMode(pieHwnd)
                              : IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    const UINT dpi = DpiForPaintHdc(hdc);

    // Small inset so anti-aliasing at the ring's outer edge doesn't bleed
    // past the HDC's actual paintable area at chartRect's own boundary.
    const float safetyMargin = 1.5f * (dpi / 96.0f);
    const float diameter = (std::min)(width, height) - safetyMargin * 2.0f;
    const float centerX = chartRect.left + width * 0.5f;
    const float centerY = chartRect.top + height * 0.5f;

    // Ring thickness as a fraction of the diameter, floored so it doesn't
    // vanish on a tiny chart -- tuned to read close to the native donut's
    // own band width.
    const float thickness = (std::max)(
        2.0f * (dpi / 96.0f), diameter * 0.16f);
    const float midDiameter = diameter - thickness;
    const Gdiplus::RectF midBounds(
        centerX - midDiameter * 0.5f, centerY - midDiameter * 0.5f,
        midDiameter, midDiameter);

    const COLORREF backgroundColor = DiskPieRingBackgroundColor(dark);
    const COLORREF trackColor = dark ? kDiskPieFreeColorDark : kDiskPieFreeColorLight;
    const COLORREF accentColor = DiskPieAccentBaseColor(usagePer1000, dark);
    bool animateGradient = false;
    double animationPhase = 0.0;
    if (animationState) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> stateLock(animationState->mutex);
        animateGradient =
            !animationState->cleanupStarted.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
            SysAnimationsEnabled() && !animationState->highContrast;
        if (animateGradient)
            animationPhase = DiskPieAnimationPhaseLocked(*animationState);
    }
    const COLORREF accentLightColor = DiskPieLighten(
        accentColor, animateGradient
            ? kDiskPieAnimationLightenAmount : 0.35f);

    // Scoped so the GDI+ Graphics object (and its GDI-level state on hdc)
    // is fully torn down before the DirectWrite/D2D text pass below binds
    // its own render target to the same hdc.
    {
    Gdiplus::Graphics graphics(hdc);
    if (graphics.GetLastStatus() != Gdiplus::Ok ||
        graphics.SetSmoothingMode(Gdiplus::SmoothingModeAntiAlias) != Gdiplus::Ok) {
        return false;
    }

    Gdiplus::SolidBrush backgroundBrush(Gdiplus::Color(255,
        GetRValue(backgroundColor), GetGValue(backgroundColor), GetBValue(backgroundColor)));
    graphics.FillEllipse(&backgroundBrush,
        centerX - diameter * 0.5f, centerY - diameter * 0.5f, diameter, diameter);

    Gdiplus::Pen trackPen(Gdiplus::Color(255,
        GetRValue(trackColor), GetGValue(trackColor), GetBValue(trackColor)), thickness);
    graphics.DrawEllipse(&trackPen, midBounds);

    const float usageFraction =
        (std::min)(static_cast<DWORD>(1000), usagePer1000) / 1000.0f;
    if (usageFraction > 0.0f) {
        // 9 o'clock start, sweeping clockwise -- matches native Draw3dPie's
        // own cut-point convention (free wedge starts at rcItem.left,cy).
        constexpr float kStartAngleDeg = 180.0f;
        const float sweepDeg = usageFraction * 360.0f;

        const Gdiplus::Color lightColor(255, GetRValue(accentLightColor),
            GetGValue(accentLightColor), GetBValue(accentLightColor));
        const Gdiplus::Color baseColor(255, GetRValue(accentColor),
            GetGValue(accentColor), GetBValue(accentColor));

        const float midRadius = midDiameter * 0.5f;
        auto pointOnRing = [&](float angleDeg) {
            const float rad = angleDeg * (3.14159265f / 180.0f);
            return Gdiplus::PointF(
                centerX + midRadius * std::cos(rad),
                centerY + midRadius * std::sin(rad));
        };
        bool gradientDrawn = false;
        if (animateGradient) {
            // Rotate an asymmetric highlight field through 360 degrees.
            // The first and last phase are mathematically identical, so the
            // 2.8-second loop has no reset frame or visible discontinuity.
            const float phase = static_cast<float>(animationPhase);
            const float phaseAngle = phase * 360.0f;
            const Gdiplus::PointF gradientStart =
                pointOnRing(phaseAngle + 180.0f);
            const Gdiplus::PointF gradientEnd = pointOnRing(phaseAngle);
            const COLORREF accentSoftColor =
                DiskPieLighten(accentColor, 0.15f);
            const Gdiplus::Color softColor(255,
                GetRValue(accentSoftColor), GetGValue(accentSoftColor),
                GetBValue(accentSoftColor));
            Gdiplus::LinearGradientBrush accentBrush(
                gradientStart, gradientEnd, baseColor, baseColor);
            const Gdiplus::Color colors[] = {
                baseColor, softColor, lightColor, baseColor,
            };
            const Gdiplus::REAL positions[] = {0.0f, 0.18f, 0.42f, 1.0f};
            if (accentBrush.GetLastStatus() == Gdiplus::Ok &&
                accentBrush.SetInterpolationColors(
                    colors, positions, ARRAYSIZE(colors)) == Gdiplus::Ok) {
                Gdiplus::Pen accentPen(&accentBrush, thickness);
                accentPen.SetStartCap(Gdiplus::LineCapRound);
                accentPen.SetEndCap(Gdiplus::LineCapRound);
                gradientDrawn = graphics.DrawArc(
                    &accentPen, midBounds, kStartAngleDeg, sweepDeg) ==
                    Gdiplus::Ok;
            }
        }

        if (!gradientDrawn) {
            // Static path and animation fallback: anchor the original
            // light-to-base gradient to the visible arc's own endpoints.
            const Gdiplus::PointF gradientStart =
                pointOnRing(kStartAngleDeg);
            const Gdiplus::PointF gradientEnd =
                pointOnRing(kStartAngleDeg + sweepDeg);
            const float dx = gradientEnd.X - gradientStart.X;
            const float dy = gradientEnd.Y - gradientStart.Y;
            if (dx * dx + dy * dy >= 4.0f) {
                Gdiplus::LinearGradientBrush accentBrush(
                    gradientStart, gradientEnd, lightColor, baseColor);
                accentBrush.SetWrapMode(Gdiplus::WrapModeTileFlipXY);
                Gdiplus::Pen accentPen(&accentBrush, thickness);
                accentPen.SetStartCap(Gdiplus::LineCapRound);
                accentPen.SetEndCap(Gdiplus::LineCapRound);
                graphics.DrawArc(
                    &accentPen, midBounds, kStartAngleDeg, sweepDeg);
            } else {
            // Too short an arc to define a gradient direction (near 0% or
            // 100%) -- a flat base-color stroke reads better than a
            // near-zero-length one.
                Gdiplus::Pen accentPen(baseColor, thickness);
                accentPen.SetStartCap(Gdiplus::LineCapRound);
                accentPen.SetEndCap(Gdiplus::LineCapRound);
                graphics.DrawArc(
                    &accentPen, midBounds, kStartAngleDeg, sweepDeg);
            }
        }
    }
    } // end GDI+ Graphics scope

    // Rounds like the reference "Disk Usage Bar" mod: 995-999/1000 round to
    // 99%, not 100%, so "100%" only shows for a genuinely full disk.
    DWORD usagePercent = ((std::min)(static_cast<DWORD>(1000), usagePer1000) + 5) / 10;
    usagePercent = (std::min)(usagePercent, static_cast<DWORD>(100));
    if (usagePercent == 100 && usagePer1000 < 1000)
        usagePercent = 99;

    // DirectWrite/D2D, not GDI+, to reach the real "Segoe UI Variable
    // Display Semibold" family (falls back to "Segoe UI Semibold"). The
    // animated path caches factory/format per page and recreates only when
    // DPI changes the computed font size.
    const float holeDiameter = (std::max)(0.0f, midDiameter - thickness);
    if (holeDiameter > 4.0f && g_d2dFactory) {
        const float fontSizePx = (std::max)(6.0f, holeDiameter * 0.24f);

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteFactory> localFactory;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> localFormat;
        IDWriteFactory* dwFactory = nullptr;
        IDWriteTextFormat* fmt = nullptr;

        if (animationState) {
            {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> stateLock(animationState->mutex);
                if (!animationState->dwFactory) {
                    IDWriteFactory* rawFactory = nullptr;
                    if (SUCCEEDED(DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED,
                            __uuidof(IDWriteFactory),
                            reinterpret_cast<IUnknown**>(&rawFactory))) && rawFactory) {
                        animationState->dwFactory.Attach(rawFactory);
                    }
                }
                dwFactory = animationState->dwFactory.Get();
                if (std::fabs(animationState->textFormatSize - fontSizePx) > 0.01f) {
                    animationState->textFormat.Reset();
                    animationState->textFormatSize = fontSizePx;
                    animationState->textFormatAttempted = false;
                }
                if (dwFactory && !animationState->textFormatAttempted) {
                    animationState->textFormatAttempted = true;
                    const wchar_t* fontNames[] = {
                        L"Segoe UI Variable Display Semibold",
                        L"Segoe UI Semibold",
                    };
                    animationState->textFormat = CreateSegoeVariableAwareTextFormat(
                        dwFactory, fontNames, ARRAYSIZE(fontNames),
                        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_SEMI_BOLD, fontSizePx, dpi);
                }
                localFactory = animationState->dwFactory;
                localFormat = animationState->textFormat;
            }
            dwFactory = localFactory.Get();
            fmt = localFormat.Get();
        } else {
            IDWriteFactory* rawFactory = nullptr;
            if (SUCCEEDED(DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED,
                    __uuidof(IDWriteFactory),
                    reinterpret_cast<IUnknown**>(&rawFactory))) && rawFactory) {
                localFactory.Attach(rawFactory);
                dwFactory = localFactory.Get();
                const wchar_t* fontNames[] = {
                    L"Segoe UI Variable Display Semibold",
                    L"Segoe UI Semibold",
                };
                localFormat = CreateSegoeVariableAwareTextFormat(
                    dwFactory, fontNames, ARRAYSIZE(fontNames),
                    DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_SEMI_BOLD, fontSizePx, dpi);
                fmt = localFormat.Get();
            }
        }

        if (fmt) {
            fmt->SetTextAlignment(DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_CENTER);
            fmt->SetParagraphAlignment(DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_CENTER);

            const RECT holeRectPx = {
                    static_cast<LONG>(std::lround(centerX - holeDiameter * 0.5f)),
                    static_cast<LONG>(std::lround(centerY - holeDiameter * 0.5f)),
                    static_cast<LONG>(std::lround(centerX + holeDiameter * 0.5f)),
                    static_cast<LONG>(std::lround(centerY + holeDiameter * 0.5f)),
            };
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
            if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(
                    hdc, &holeRectPx, g_d2dFactory, &pRT))) {
                const COLORREF textColor =
                    dark ? WinUI::Dark::TextFillColorPrimary : GetSysColor(COLOR_WINDOWTEXT);
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> textBrush;
                if (SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(
                        D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(textColor) / 255.f,
                            GetGValue(textColor) / 255.f,
                            GetBValue(textColor) / 255.f),
                        &textBrush))) {
                    wchar_t percentText[8];
                    swprintf_s(percentText, L"%u%%", usagePercent);
                    pRT->BeginDraw();
                    pRT->SetTextAntialiasMode(D2D1_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_MODE_GRAYSCALE);
                    pRT->DrawTextW(percentText,
                        static_cast<UINT32>(wcslen(percentText)), fmt,
                        D2D1::RectF(0, 0, holeDiameter, holeDiameter),
                        textBrush.Get());
                    const HRESULT hr = pRT->EndDraw();
                    if (hr == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET)
                        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return true;
}

static bool DiskPieDrawRoundedRingBuffered(HDC hdc, const RECT& chartRect,
    DWORD usagePer1000,
    const std::shared_ptr<DiskPieAnimationState>& animationState)
{
    BP_PAINTPARAMS params = {sizeof(params)};
    HDC bufferDc = nullptr;
    HPAINTBUFFER buffer = BeginBufferedPaint(
        hdc, &chartRect, BPBF_TOPDOWNDIB, &params, &bufferDc);
    if (!buffer || !bufferDc) {
        return DiskPieDrawRoundedRing(
            hdc, chartRect, usagePer1000, animationState);
    }

    HWND pieHwnd = animationState && IsWindow(animationState->page)
        ? animationState->page
        : (g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc));
    const bool dark = pieHwnd ? IsHwndDarkMode(pieHwnd)
                              : IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    HBRUSH backgroundBrush = static_cast<HBRUSH>(GetStockObject(DC_BRUSH));
    const COLORREF previousDcBrush = SetDCBrushColor(
        bufferDc, DiskPieRingBackgroundColor(dark));
    const bool backgroundFilled = backgroundBrush && FillRect_orig &&
        previousDcBrush != CLR_INVALID &&
        FillRect_orig(bufferDc, &chartRect, backgroundBrush);
    if (previousDcBrush != CLR_INVALID)
        SetDCBrushColor(bufferDc, previousDcBrush);
    if (!backgroundFilled) {
        EndBufferedPaint(buffer, FALSE);
        return DiskPieDrawRoundedRing(
            hdc, chartRect, usagePer1000, animationState);
    }

    const bool drawn = DiskPieDrawRoundedRing(
        bufferDc, chartRect, usagePer1000, animationState);
    const HRESULT hr = EndBufferedPaint(buffer, drawn);
    return drawn && SUCCEEDED(hr);
}

// Local drives: shell32.dll's DrawPie is the call site reached from the
// drive properties page.
//
// __fastcall, not the __stdcall the 32-bit symbols are decorated with
// (_DrawPie@20, _DrvPrshtDrawItem): the 32-bit shell32 build passes the
// first two arguments in ECX/EDX and pops only the rest (DrawPie ends in
// ret 0Ch, and _DrvGeneralDlgProc loads ECX/EDX before calling
// _DrvPrshtDrawItem), checked by disassembly on build 26100. A __stdcall
// hook read them from the stack and crashed the page. No effect on x64.
// As with CCDrawInsertMark, that is a compiler choice that can change
// between Windows builds, so these hooks are only installed in 64-bit
// processes; the typed hooks stay for that build's convention.
using DiskPieShell32DrawPie_t = int(__fastcall*)(HDC, LPRECT, DWORD, DWORD, const DWORD*);
static DiskPieShell32DrawPie_t g_pDiskPieShell32DrawPie_Orig;
[[maybe_unused]] static int __fastcall DiskPieShell32DrawPie_Hook(
    HDC hdc, LPRECT prcChart, DWORD dwUsagePer1000, DWORD dwCachePer1000, const DWORD* lpColors)
{
    g_diskPieState.active = g_settings.DiskChartAccentColor;
    g_diskPieState.hdc = hdc;
    g_diskPieState.usagePer1000 = dwUsagePer1000;

    // Warning/critical tiers are resolved inside DiskPieDrawRoundedRing
    // itself (DiskPieAccentBaseColor); this only bails to native drawing if
    // the redraw fails outright (e.g. GDI+ didn't come up).
    if (g_diskPieState.active && prcChart) {
        HWND page = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
        auto animationState = DiskPieAnimationEnsure(
            page, *prcChart, dwUsagePer1000);
        if (DiskPieDrawRoundedRingBuffered(
                hdc, *prcChart, dwUsagePer1000, animationState)) {
            if (animationState)
                DiskPieAnimationStart(animationState);
            g_diskPieState.active = false;
            return 0;
        }
        if (animationState)
            DiskPieAnimationCleanup(animationState);
    }

    int result = g_pDiskPieShell32DrawPie_Orig(hdc, prcChart, dwUsagePer1000, dwCachePer1000, lpColors);
    g_diskPieState.active = false;
    return result;
}

// Portable devices: wpdshext.dll's _DrawPie is the call site for the
// portable-device storage properties page.
// __fastcall like shell32's DrawPie: the 32-bit wpdshext _DrawPie also
// reads ECX/EDX and ends in ret 0Ch (disassembled at its Symbol Helper RVA).
using DiskPieWpdShExtDrawPie_t = void(__fastcall*)(HDC, LPCRECT, DWORD, DWORD, const DWORD*);
static DiskPieWpdShExtDrawPie_t g_pDiskPieWpdShExtDrawPie_Orig;
static void __fastcall DiskPieWpdShExtDrawPie_Hook(
    HDC hdc, LPCRECT prcChart, DWORD dwUsagePer1000, DWORD dwCachePer1000, const DWORD* lpColors)
{
    g_diskPieState.active = g_settings.DiskChartAccentColor;
    g_diskPieState.hdc = hdc;
    g_diskPieState.usagePer1000 = dwUsagePer1000;

    if (g_diskPieState.active && prcChart) {
        HWND page = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
        auto animationState = DiskPieAnimationEnsure(
            page, *prcChart, dwUsagePer1000);
        if (DiskPieDrawRoundedRingBuffered(
                hdc, *prcChart, dwUsagePer1000, animationState)) {
            if (animationState)
                DiskPieAnimationStart(animationState);
            g_diskPieState.active = false;
            return;
        }
        if (animationState)
            DiskPieAnimationCleanup(animationState);
    }

    g_pDiskPieWpdShExtDrawPie_Orig(hdc, prcChart, dwUsagePer1000, dwCachePer1000, lpColors);
    g_diskPieState.active = false;
}

// Legend swatch: full takeover for the three swatch control IDs, mirroring
// the "Disk Pie Chart" mod's proven technique of intercepting these exact
// control IDs. Rounded corners need anti-aliasing to not look jagged at
// this size, so this draws via this mod's existing D2D DC-render-target
// cache (CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget) rather than GDI FillRect/SetWindowRgn.
static void DiskPieDrawRoundedSwatch(HDC hdc, const RECT& rcItem, COLORREF color)
{
    float width = (float)(rcItem.right - rcItem.left);
    float height = (float)(rcItem.bottom - rcItem.top);
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
    {
        return;
    }

    bool drewWithD2D = false;
    if (g_d2dFactory)
    {
        FPUGuard fpu;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
        if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcItem, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
        {
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
            if (SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(ColorFAlpha(color), &brush)))
            {
                // Subtle 1px outline so the swatch reads as a distinct shape
                // against its own fill, not just a flat color blob.
                bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
                D2D1_COLOR_F borderColor = dark
                    ? D2D1::ColorF(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 0.10f)
                    : D2D1::ColorF(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.10f);

                float radius = (std::min)(3.0f, (std::min)(width, height) / 2.0f);
                D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT roundedRect = D2D1::RoundedRect(
                    D2D1::RectF(0.0f, 0.0f, width, height), radius, radius);

                pRT->BeginDraw();
                pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(roundedRect, brush.Get());
                brush->SetColor(borderColor);
                pRT->DrawRoundedRectangle(roundedRect, brush.Get(), 1.0f);
                HRESULT hr = pRT->EndDraw();
                if (hr == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET)
                {
                    CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                }
                drewWithD2D = SUCCEEDED(hr);
            }
        }
    }

    if (!drewWithD2D)
    {
        // Fallback: square corners, but never fails to paint at all.
        HBRUSH hbr = CreateSolidBrush(color);
        FillRect(hdc, &rcItem, hbr);
        DeleteObject(hbr);
    }
}

// The "free"/"cache" swatches must keep their existing color exactly — that
// color is intentionally not hardcoded or guessed here. Instead, the real
// original handler is asked to draw once into an offscreen bitmap, and the
// resulting pixel is sampled, so the value is always correct for the
// current Windows build and theme without this mod needing to know it.
static COLORREF DiskPieSampleOriginalSwatchColor(void* lpps, LPDRAWITEMSTRUCT lpdi,
    void (__fastcall *original)(void*, LPDRAWITEMSTRUCT))
{
    int width = lpdi->rcItem.right - lpdi->rcItem.left;
    int height = lpdi->rcItem.bottom - lpdi->rcItem.top;
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
    {
        return RGB(0xAC, 0xAC, 0xAC); // Never used unless rcItem is degenerate.
    }

    HDC hMemDC = CreateCompatibleDC(lpdi->hDC);
    HBITMAP hBmp = CreateCompatibleBitmap(lpdi->hDC, width, height);
    HBITMAP hOldBmp = (HBITMAP)SelectObject(hMemDC, hBmp);

    DRAWITEMSTRUCT diCopy = *lpdi;
    diCopy.hDC = hMemDC;
    diCopy.rcItem = RECT{ 0, 0, width, height };
    original(lpps, &diCopy);

    COLORREF color = GetPixel(hMemDC, width / 2, height / 2);

    SelectObject(hMemDC, hOldBmp);
    DeleteObject(hBmp);
    DeleteDC(hMemDC);

    return color;
}

// __fastcall: see DiskPieShell32DrawPie_t.
static void (__fastcall *g_pDiskPieDrvPrshtDrawItem_Orig)(void*, LPDRAWITEMSTRUCT);
[[maybe_unused]] static void __fastcall DiskPieDrvPrshtDrawItem_Hook(void* lpps, LPDRAWITEMSTRUCT lpdi)
{
    if (!g_settings.DiskChartAccentColor)
    {
        g_pDiskPieDrvPrshtDrawItem_Orig(lpps, lpdi);
        return;
    }

    if (lpdi->CtlID == IDC_DRV_USEDCOLOR)
    {
        // Mirrors DiskPieResolveColor's full-disk bypass: keep the legend
        // consistent with whatever warning color the chart itself is
        // showing instead of forcing the accent color over it.
        COLORREF fillColor;
        if (DiskPieIsFull())
        {
            fillColor = DiskPieSampleOriginalSwatchColor(lpps, lpdi, g_pDiskPieDrvPrshtDrawItem_Orig);
        }
        else
        {
            bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(lpdi->hDC);
            fillColor = GetAccentFillDefault(dark);
        }
        DiskPieDrawRoundedSwatch(lpdi->hDC, lpdi->rcItem, fillColor);
        return;
    }

    if (lpdi->CtlID == IDC_DRV_FREECOLOR || lpdi->CtlID == IDC_DRV_CACHECOLOR)
    {
        COLORREF original = DiskPieSampleOriginalSwatchColor(lpps, lpdi, g_pDiskPieDrvPrshtDrawItem_Orig);
        COLORREF fillColor = IsWindowDarkMode(lpdi->hDC) ? kDiskPieFreeColorDark : original;
        DiskPieDrawRoundedSwatch(lpdi->hDC, lpdi->rcItem, fillColor);
        return;
    }

    g_pDiskPieDrvPrshtDrawItem_Orig(lpps, lpdi);
}

static std::mutex g_lazyFeatureModuleMutex;
static HMODULE g_lazyFeatureShell32Module = nullptr;
static HMODULE g_lazyFeatureWpdShExtModule = nullptr;
static HMODULE g_lazyFeatureGdiplusModule = nullptr;
static HMODULE g_lazyFeatureUsp10Module = nullptr;

static HMODULE LazyFeatureAcquireSystemModule(
    HMODULE& module, LPCWSTR moduleName)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_lazyFeatureModuleMutex);
    if (!module &&
        !g_lazyFeatureHooksUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        module = LoadLibraryExW(
            moduleName, nullptr, LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32);
    }
    return module;
}

static void LazyFeatureReleaseModules();

static std::atomic<bool> g_diskPieContextSeen{false};
static std::atomic<bool> g_fileOpContextSeen{false};
static std::atomic<bool> g_navTreeContextSeen{false};
static std::atomic<bool> g_dialogReadOnlyContextSeen{false};
static std::atomic<bool> g_modernComboTextContextSeen{false};
static void LazyFeatureRequestHooks();
static std::atomic<bool> g_insertMarkContextSeen{false};
static std::atomic<bool> g_lazyFeatureApplyPosted{false};

static std::mutex g_diskPieHookMutex;
[[maybe_unused]] static bool g_diskPieShell32HooksAttempted = false;
[[maybe_unused]] static bool g_diskPieWpdShExtHooksAttempted = false;
static bool g_diskPieGdipHooksAttempted = false;

// Registers private Shell symbols only for the disk chart, while the shared
// GDI+ fill hooks are also useful to AccentColorize's file-operation chart.
// Returns true only when this call staged at least one new hook.
static bool DiskPieInit()
{
    const bool diskPieContext =
        g_diskPieContextSeen.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    const bool fileOpContext =
        g_fileOpContextSeen.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    const bool diskPieNeeded =
        g_settings.DiskChartAccentColor && diskPieContext;
    const bool fileOpNeeded =
        g_settings.AccentColorize && fileOpContext;
    if (g_lazyFeatureHooksUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        (!diskPieNeeded && !fileOpNeeded)) {
        return false;
    }

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_diskPieHookMutex);
    bool hooksQueued = false;

#ifdef _WIN64
    // 64-bit only: see DiskPieShell32DrawPie_t.
    if (g_settings.DiskChartAccentColor && diskPieContext &&
        !g_diskPieShell32HooksAttempted) {
        HMODULE hShell32 = LazyFeatureAcquireSystemModule(
            g_lazyFeatureShell32Module, L"shell32.dll");
        if (hShell32) {
            g_diskPieShell32HooksAttempted = true;
            const Shell32Symbols shellSymbols =
                Shell32ResolveSymbols(hShell32);
            SetResolvedSymbolHook(shellSymbols.drawPie,
                DiskPieShell32DrawPie_Hook, &g_pDiskPieShell32DrawPie_Orig);
            SetResolvedSymbolHook(shellSymbols.drvPrshtDrawItem,
                DiskPieDrvPrshtDrawItem_Hook,
                &g_pDiskPieDrvPrshtDrawItem_Orig);
            hooksQueued = g_pDiskPieShell32DrawPie_Orig ||
                g_pDiskPieDrvPrshtDrawItem_Orig || hooksQueued;
            if (!g_pDiskPieShell32DrawPie_Orig &&
                !g_pDiskPieDrvPrshtDrawItem_Orig) {
                Wh_Log(L"Disk chart: shell32 symbols unavailable");
            }
        }
    }

    if (g_settings.DiskChartAccentColor && diskPieContext &&
        !g_diskPieWpdShExtHooksAttempted) {
        // Portable-device charts are secondary; failure leaves local-drive
        // properties functional and native.
        HMODULE hWpdShExt = LazyFeatureAcquireSystemModule(
            g_lazyFeatureWpdShExtModule, L"wpdshext.dll");
        if (hWpdShExt) {
            g_diskPieWpdShExtHooksAttempted = true;
            WindhawkUtils::HookSymbols(
                hWpdShExt, wpdshextDllHooks,
                ARRAYSIZE(wpdshextDllHooks));
            hooksQueued = g_pDiskPieWpdShExtDrawPie_Orig || hooksQueued;
            if (!g_pDiskPieWpdShExtDrawPie_Orig)
                Wh_Log(L"Disk chart: wpdshext symbol unavailable");
        }
    }
#endif

    if (g_diskPieGdipHooksAttempted)
        return hooksQueued;
    HMODULE hGdiplus = LazyFeatureAcquireSystemModule(
        g_lazyFeatureGdiplusModule, L"gdiplus.dll");
    if (!hGdiplus)
        return hooksQueued;
    g_diskPieGdipHooksAttempted = true;

    g_pDiskPieGdipGetBrushType =
        (DiskPieGdipGetBrushType_t)GetProcAddress(hGdiplus, "GdipGetBrushType");
    g_pDiskPieGdipGetSolidFillColor =
        (DiskPieGdipGetSolidFillColor_t)GetProcAddress(hGdiplus, "GdipGetSolidFillColor");
    g_pDiskPieGdipDeleteBrush =
        (DiskPieGdipDeleteBrush_t)GetProcAddress(hGdiplus, "GdipDeleteBrush");
    g_pDiskPieGdipCreateSolidFill =
        (DiskPieGdipCreateSolidFill_t)GetProcAddress(hGdiplus, "GdipCreateSolidFill");

    struct { const char* name; void* hookFn; void** originalFn; } gdiplusHooks[] = {
        { "GdipFillPath",     (void*)DiskPieGdipFillPath_Hook,     (void**)&g_pDiskPieGdipFillPath_Orig },
        { "GdipFillRegion",   (void*)DiskPieGdipFillRegion_Hook,   (void**)&g_pDiskPieGdipFillRegion_Orig },
        { "GdipFillPie",      (void*)DiskPieGdipFillPie_Hook,      (void**)&g_pDiskPieGdipFillPie_Orig },
        { "GdipFillPieI",     (void*)DiskPieGdipFillPieI_Hook,     (void**)&g_pDiskPieGdipFillPieI_Orig },
        { "GdipFillEllipse",  (void*)DiskPieGdipFillEllipse_Hook,  (void**)&g_pDiskPieGdipFillEllipse_Orig },
        { "GdipFillEllipseI", (void*)DiskPieGdipFillEllipseI_Hook, (void**)&g_pDiskPieGdipFillEllipseI_Orig },
    };
    for (const auto& h : gdiplusHooks) {
        FARPROC proc = GetProcAddress(hGdiplus, h.name);
        if (proc && Wh_SetFunctionHook((void*)proc, h.hookFn, h.originalFn))
            hooksQueued = true;
    }
    return hooksQueued;
}

static bool IsExplorerAddressCompositedPart(HDC hdc, LPCWSTR className)
{
    HWND hwnd = WindowFromDC(hdc);

    if (!theme)

static bool ExplorerAddressFieldHasFocus(HDC hdc)
{
    HWND hwnd = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (!hwnd)
        hwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd;

    HWND focus = GetFocus();
    if (!hwnd || !focus)
        return false;

    if (focus == hwnd || IsChild(hwnd, focus))
        return true;

    if (GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT) != GetAncestor(focus, GA_ROOT))
        return false;

    auto isFocusBoundary = [](HWND h) -> bool {
        wchar_t cls[64] = {};
        if (!h || !GetClassNameW(h, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)))
            return true;
        return _wcsicmp(cls, L"ReBarWindow32") == 0 ||
               _wcsicmp(cls, L"CabinetWClass") == 0 ||
               _wcsicmp(cls, L"ExploreWClass") == 0 ||
               _wcsicmp(cls, L"#32770") == 0 ||
               _wcsicmp(cls, L"NativeHWNDHost") == 0;
    };

    for (HWND owner = hwnd; owner && !isFocusBoundary(owner); owner = GetParent(owner)) {
        if (focus == owner || IsChild(owner, focus))
            return true;
    }

    return false;
}

static bool PaintExplorerAddressBand(HDC hdc, INT iPartId, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!g_settings.ExplorerSection || !g_settings.LegacyRebarControls ||
        !g_d2dFactory || !pRect || iPartId != 1)
        return false;

    const int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
    const int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
        return false;

    const bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    const float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.f;
    // ControlCornerRadius, like every other text field.
    const float cr = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale;
    const bool focused = (iStateId == 4);
    const bool hot = (iStateId == 2);

    D2D1_COLOR_F fill = focused
        ? ColorFAlpha(ExplorerAddressEditFillColor(hdc, true), 1.f)
        : dark
            ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, hot ? 0.075f : 0.055f)
            : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, hot ? 0.040f : 0.030f);
    D2D1_COLOR_F border = dark
        ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, focused ? 0.16f : 0.10f)
        : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, focused ? 0.18f : 0.12f);

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
    FPUGuard fpu;
    if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
        return false;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
    pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(fill, &brush);

    const float fw = (float)w;
    const float fh = (float)h;
    D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT rr = D2D1::RoundedRect(
        D2D1::RectF(0.5f, 0.5f, fw - 0.5f, fh - 0.5f), cr, cr);

    // Focus line masked by the box's own rounded rect, so its ends follow
    // the corners, as PaintControlBorder does for edits and the Registry
    // Editor's search bar: WinUI's 2 DIP focused bottom border. The layer
    // is the thread's cached one, bound to this render target.
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1RoundedRectangleGeometry> lineClipGeom;
    D2DThreadCache* lineCache = focused ? D2DGetThreadCache() : nullptr;
    if (focused) {
        g_d2dFactory->CreateRoundedRectangleGeometry(rr, &lineClipGeom);
        if (lineClipGeom && lineCache &&
            (!lineCache->editBorderLineLayer ||
             lineCache->editBorderLineLayerRT != pRT.Get())) {
            if (lineCache->editBorderLineLayer) {
                lineCache->editBorderLineLayer->Release();
                lineCache->editBorderLineLayer = nullptr;
            }
            ID2D1Layer* rawLayer = nullptr;
            pRT->CreateLayer(nullptr, &rawLayer);
            if (rawLayer) {
                lineCache->editBorderLineLayer = rawLayer;
                lineCache->editBorderLineLayerRT = pRT.Get();
            }
        }
    }
    const bool pushLineLayer =
        lineClipGeom && lineCache && lineCache->editBorderLineLayer;

    pRT->BeginDraw();
    pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(&rr, brush.Get());
    brush->SetColor(border);
    pRT->DrawRoundedRectangle(&rr, brush.Get(), scale);

    if (focused) {
        brush->SetColor(ColorFAlpha(GetAccentFillDefault(dark), 1.f));
        const float lineH = 2.f * scale;
        if (pushLineLayer) {
            pRT->PushLayer(D2D1::LayerParameters(
                D2D1::InfiniteRect(), lineClipGeom.Get()),
                lineCache->editBorderLineLayer);
            pRT->FillRectangle(
                D2D1::RectF(0.f, fh - lineH, fw, fh), brush.Get());
            pRT->PopLayer();
        } else {
            const float inset = cr * 0.5f;
            pRT->DrawLine(
                D2D1::Point2F(inset, fh - 1.5f * scale),
                D2D1::Point2F(fw - inset, fh - 1.5f * scale),
                brush.Get(), lineH);
        }
    }

    HRESULT hr = pRT->EndDraw();
    if (hr == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        pRT.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
        return false;
    }
    return SUCCEEDED(hr);
}

static constexpr UINT_PTR kComboChevronPopCommand = 0x5C02;

static HWND ResolveComboBoxAnimationHwnd(HDC hdc)
{
    HWND hwnd = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (!hwnd || !IsClassName(hwnd, L"ComboBox"))
        hwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
    return IsClassName(hwnd, L"ComboBox") ? hwnd : nullptr;
}

// Same click-release spring used by split-button chevrons. HWND tracking is
// animation-only; colors and chrome never depend on resolving the control.
static bool DrawAnimatedComboChevron(
    HDC hdc, LPCRECT rect, HWND hwnd, D2D1_COLOR_F color,
    COLORREF fallbackBg, bool pressed, float dx, float dy,
    float stroke, float centerYOffset)
{
    if (!hdc || !rect)
        return false;

    const int w = rect->right - rect->left;
    const int h = rect->bottom - rect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
        return false;

    bool animationPressed = pressed;
    if (!animationPressed && hwnd && GetKeyState(VK_LBUTTON) < 0) {
        COMBOBOXINFO info = {};
        info.cbSize = sizeof(info);
        animationPressed = GetComboBoxInfo(hwnd, &info) &&
            (info.stateButton & STATE_SYSTEM_PRESSED) != 0;
    }

    DOUBLE animElapsed = -1.0;
    const bool chevronAnimate = hwnd != nullptr && SysAnimationsEnabled();
    if (chevronAnimate) {
        animElapsed = ButtonPopTrigger(
            hwnd, kComboChevronPopCommand, animationPressed,
            CHEVRON_FULL_DUR, rect, true, true);
    }

    // Composed through an alpha scene: the chevron also sits on the
    // address band, a Mica surface in Explorer. Hand-drawn lines only
    // without an icon font.
    {
        float lift = 0.f;
        if (animElapsed >= 0.0) {
            const DOUBLE t =
                std::clamp(animElapsed / CHEVRON_FULL_DUR, 0.0, 1.0);
            lift = ChevronFullOffset(t) * std::min((float)w, (float)h);
        }
        const int fontSizePx = std::max(1, (int)std::lround(
            kComboChevronGlyphDip * (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI));
        if (DrawGlyphDWAlpha(hdc, *rect, color, kChevronGlyphDown, fontSizePx,
                centerYOffset + lift))
            return true;
    }

    const float alpha = std::clamp(color.a, 0.f, 1.f);
    auto blend = [alpha](float channel, BYTE bg) -> BYTE {
        return (BYTE)lroundf(
            channel * 255.f * alpha + bg * (1.f - alpha));
    };
    const COLORREF gdiColor = RGB(
        blend(color.r, GetRValue(fallbackBg)),
        blend(color.g, GetGValue(fallbackBg)),
        blend(color.b, GetBValue(fallbackBg)));
    HPEN pen = CreatePen(
        PS_SOLID, (int)std::max(1.f, stroke), gdiColor);
    if (!pen)
        return false;

    const int cx = (rect->left + rect->right) / 2;
    const int cy = (rect->top + rect->bottom) / 2 +
        (int)lroundf(centerYOffset);
    HGDIOBJ oldPen = SelectObject(hdc, pen);
    MoveToEx(hdc, (int)lroundf(cx - dx), (int)lroundf(cy - dy), nullptr);
    LineTo(hdc, cx, (int)lroundf(cy + dy));
    LineTo(hdc, (int)lroundf(cx + dx), (int)lroundf(cy - dy));
    SelectObject(hdc, oldPen);
    DeleteObject(pen);
    return true;
}

static bool PaintExplorerAddressDropDownArrow(
    HDC hdc, INT iPartId, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect, bool addressPart)
{
    if (!g_settings.ExplorerSection || !g_settings.LegacyRebarControls ||
        !g_d2dFactory || !pRect ||
        (iPartId != CP_DROPDOWNBUTTON &&
         iPartId != CP_DROPDOWNBUTTONRIGHT &&
         iPartId != CP_DROPDOWNBUTTONLEFT))
        return false;

    const int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
    const int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
        return false;

    const bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    const bool disabled = (iStateId == CBXS_DISABLED);
    const bool pressed = (iStateId == CBXS_PRESSED);
    const bool hot = (iStateId == CBXS_HOT);

    D2D1_COLOR_F arrow = disabled
        ? (dark ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.25f) : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.25f))
        : pressed
            ? (dark ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.62f) : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.62f))
            : hot
                ? (dark ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.95f) : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.85f))
                : (dark ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.72f) : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.62f));

    const float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.f;
    const float fw = (float)w;
    const float fh = (float)h;
    const float len = std::min(fw, fh) * (addressPart ? 0.15f : 0.24f);
    const float dx = len * 0.866f;
    const float dy = len * 0.5f;
    const COLORREF fallbackBg = dark
        ? Win32MainDark : RGB(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF);
    return DrawAnimatedComboChevron(
        hdc, pRect, ResolveComboBoxAnimationHwnd(hdc), arrow,
        fallbackBg, pressed, dx, dy, 1.25f * scale, fh * 0.02f);
}

static bool PaintExplorerNavigationButton(HDC hdc, INT iPartId, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!g_settings.ExplorerSection || !g_settings.LegacyRebarControls ||
        !g_d2dFactory || !pRect)
        return false;

    if (!IsExplorerShellHost(hdc))
        return false;

    if (iPartId != NAV_BACKBUTTON &&
        iPartId != NAV_FORWARDBUTTON &&
        iPartId != NAV_MENUBUTTON)
        return false;

    const int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
    const int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
        return false;

    const bool dark = IsDarkForExcludedAwarePaintHdc(hdc);
    const bool hot = (iStateId == NAV_BB_HOT);
    const bool pressed = (iStateId == NAV_BB_PRESSED);
    const bool disabled = (iStateId == NAV_BB_DISABLED);
    const float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / (float)USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;

    D2D1_COLOR_F fill = D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f);
    if (hot)
        fill = dark ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.085f)
                    : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.060f);
    else if (pressed)
        fill = dark ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.050f)
                    : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.040f);

    D2D1_COLOR_F glyph = disabled
        ? (dark ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.24f)
                : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.24f))
        : pressed
            ? (dark ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.62f)
                    : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.58f))
            : hot
                ? (dark ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.92f)
                        : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.82f))
                : (dark ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.70f)
                        : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.62f));

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
    FPUGuard fpu;
    if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
        return false;

    const float fw = (float)w;
    const float fh = (float)h;
    const float cr = 5.5f * scale;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
    pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(fill, &brush);
    if (!brush)
        return false;

    pRT->BeginDraw();
    pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
        D2D1::RoundedRect(D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f, fw, fh), cr, cr),
        brush.Get());

    brush->SetColor(glyph);
    // Same glyphs and size ratio as the travel band's buttons (WinUI's
    // NavigationView back button is E72B at 16 in a 40-wide button).
    {
        const wchar_t* navGlyph = iPartId == NAV_BACKBUTTON ? GLYPH_NAV_BACK
                                : iPartId == NAV_FORWARDBUTTON ? GLYPH_NAV_FORWARD
                                : GLYPH_NAV_RECENT;
        const int fontSize = std::max(8, (int)(std::min(fw, fh) * 0.46f + 0.5f));
        if (auto fmt = TravelBandEnsureDWFormat(fontSize)) {
            pRT->DrawTextW(navGlyph, 1, fmt.Get(), D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f, fw, fh), brush.Get());
            HRESULT hr = pRT->EndDraw();
            if (hr == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                pRT.Reset();
                CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                return false;
            }
            return SUCCEEDED(hr);
        }
    }
    const float stroke = std::max(1.f, 1.45f * scale);
    if (iPartId == NAV_BACKBUTTON || iPartId == NAV_FORWARDBUTTON) {
        const float cy = fh * 0.5f;
        const float tail = std::min(fw, fh) * 0.34f;
        const float wing = tail * 0.62f;
        if (iPartId == NAV_BACKBUTTON) {
            const float tipX = fw * 0.34f;
            const float endX = fw * 0.68f;
            pRT->DrawLine(D2D1::Point2F(endX, cy),
                          D2D1::Point2F(tipX, cy),
                          brush.Get(), stroke);
            pRT->DrawLine(D2D1::Point2F(tipX + wing, cy - wing),
                          D2D1::Point2F(tipX, cy),
                          brush.Get(), stroke);
            pRT->DrawLine(D2D1::Point2F(tipX + wing, cy + wing),
                          D2D1::Point2F(tipX, cy),
                          brush.Get(), stroke);
        } else {
            const float tipX = fw * 0.66f;
            const float endX = fw * 0.32f;
            pRT->DrawLine(D2D1::Point2F(endX, cy),
                          D2D1::Point2F(tipX, cy),
                          brush.Get(), stroke);
            pRT->DrawLine(D2D1::Point2F(tipX - wing, cy - wing),
                          D2D1::Point2F(tipX, cy),
                          brush.Get(), stroke);
            pRT->DrawLine(D2D1::Point2F(tipX - wing, cy + wing),
                          D2D1::Point2F(tipX, cy),
                          brush.Get(), stroke);
        }
    } else {
        const float cx = fw * 0.5f;
        const float cy = fh * 0.53f;
        const float len = std::min(fw, fh) * 0.18f;
        const float dx = len * 0.866f;
        const float dy = len * 0.5f;
        pRT->DrawLine(D2D1::Point2F(cx - dx, cy - dy),
                      D2D1::Point2F(cx, cy + dy),
                      brush.Get(), stroke);
        pRT->DrawLine(D2D1::Point2F(cx + dx, cy - dy),
                      D2D1::Point2F(cx, cy + dy),
                      brush.Get(), stroke);
    }

    HRESULT hr = pRT->EndDraw();
    if (hr == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        pRT.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
        return false;
    }
    return SUCCEEDED(hr);
}

static bool SuppressTravelBandRecentMenuHover(HDC hdc, INT iPartId, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!pRect || iPartId != 9 /*MENU_POPUPBACKGROUND*/ || iStateId != 1)
        return false;

    HWND toolbar = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (!toolbar || !IsClassName(toolbar, L"ToolbarWindow32"))
        return false;

    HWND parent = GetParent(toolbar);

        return false;

    POINT pt = {
        (pRect->left + pRect->right) / 2,
        (pRect->top + pRect->bottom) / 2
    };
    int hit = (int)SendMessageW(toolbar, TB_HITTEST, 0, (LPARAM)&pt);
    if (hit < 0)
        return false;

    TBBUTTON tb = {};
    if (!SendMessageW(toolbar, TB_GETBUTTON, (WPARAM)hit, (LPARAM)&tb) ||
        tb.idCommand != 258)
        return false;

    HBRUSH br = CreateSolidBrush(TravelBandEraseColor(
        g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc)));
    if (br) {
        FillRect(hdc, pRect, br);
        DeleteObject(br);
    }
    return true;
}

static bool PaintExplorerAddressEdit(HTHEME, HDC hdc, INT iPartId, INT, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    constexpr INT EP_BACKGROUNDWITHBORDER_W32M = 5;
    if (!g_settings.ExplorerSection || !g_settings.LegacyRebarControls || !pRect)
        return false;

    const bool active = ExplorerAddressFieldHasFocus(hdc);
    auto fillAddressEdit = [&]() -> bool {
        return FillExplorerAddressEditRect(hdc, pRect, active);
    };

    if (iPartId == EP_BACKGROUND &&
        IsExplorerAddressCompositedPart(hdc, L"AddressComposited::Edit")) {
        fillAddressEdit();
        return true;
    }

    if (iPartId == EP_BACKGROUNDWITHBORDER_W32M &&
        IsExplorerAddressEditBackground(hdc, iPartId)) {
        RECT rc = { pRect->left - 1, pRect->top - 1,
                    pRect->right + 3, pRect->bottom + 1 };
        COLORREF bg = ExplorerAddressEditFillColor(hdc, active);
        HBRUSH br = CreateSolidBrush(bg);
        if (br) {
            FillRect(hdc, &rc, br);
            DeleteObject(br);
        }
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

static bool LegacyRebarTextIsShellRoot(HWND root)
{
    if ((IsClassName(root, L"CabinetWClass") ||
         IsClassName(root, L"ExploreWClass")) && IsCurrentProcessExplorer())
        return true;
    return (IsClassName(root, L"#32770") || IsClassName(root, L"NativeHWNDHost")) &&
        NavDividerRootContainsNamespaceTree(root, false);
}

static bool LegacyRebarTextDropdownOwner(HWND popup)
{
    HWND owner = GetWindow(popup, GW_OWNER);
    HWND root = owner ? GetAncestor(owner, GA_ROOT) : nullptr;
    if (!root || !LegacyRebarTextIsShellRoot(root))
        return false;
    DWORD popupPid = 0, ownerPid = 0;
    const DWORD popupThread = GetWindowThreadProcessId(popup, &popupPid);
    const DWORD ownerThread = GetWindowThreadProcessId(root, &ownerPid);
    if (!popupThread || popupThread != ownerThread || popupPid != ownerPid ||
        popupPid != GetCurrentProcessId())
        return false;
    // The dropdown owns a separate top-level window. Verify its owner has
    // the same WorkerW/ReBar structure, without enumerating the whole dialog.
    HWND worker = nullptr;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
        worker = FindWindowExW(root, worker, L"WorkerW", nullptr);
        if (!worker)
            return false;
        if (FindWindowExW(worker, nullptr, L"ReBarWindow32", nullptr))
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static LegacyRebarTextKind ClassifyLegacyRebarText(HWND hwnd, LPCWSTR windowClass)
{
    if (!_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"ComboBox") || !_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"ComboLBox")) {
        if (!GetPropW(hwnd, kExplorerDialogTextProp))
            ExplorerDialogTextObserve(hwnd, windowClass);
        return LegacyRebarTextKindEnabled(LegacyRebarTextKind::ModernCombo)
            ? ModernComboTextControlKind(hwnd, windowClass) : LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    }
    if (!g_settings.ExplorerSection ||
        (!g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite && !g_settings.DialogTextDirectWrite))
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    if (!_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"Static") || !_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"SysLink") ||
        !_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"Edit") || !_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"Button") ||
        !_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"SysTreeView32") || !_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"NativeFontCtl") ||
        !_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"CHECKLIST_ACLUI") || !_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"msctls_hotkey32"))
        return ExplorerDialogTextClassify(hwnd, windowClass);
    if (!_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"DirectUIHWND")) {
        const auto dialog = ExplorerDialogTextClassify(hwnd, windowClass);
        if (dialog != LegacyRebarTextKind::None)
            return dialog;
    }
    // Shell dropdown lists retain the earlier, owner-validated route.
    if (!_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"SysListView32") || !_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"SysHeader32")) {
        const auto dialog = ExplorerDialogTextClassify(hwnd, windowClass);
        if (dialog != LegacyRebarTextKind::None)
            return dialog;
    }
    if (!_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"NetUIHWND")) {
        // Explorer's Windows Ribbon Framework, not arbitrary NetUI controls.
        // Its glyphs, measurements and unsupported text contracts stay native.
        return !g_roundedSelectionHighContrast.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
            IsClassName(GetParent(hwnd), L"NUIPane") &&
            ShellTextIsExplorerFrameHost(hwnd)
                ? LegacyRebarTextKind::Ribbon : LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    }
    LegacyRebarTextKind kind = LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    if (!_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"ReBarWindow32"))
        kind = LegacyRebarTextKind::Rebar;
    else if (!_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"ToolbarWindow32"))
        kind = LegacyRebarTextKind::Toolbar;
    else if (!_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"DirectUIHWND") &&
        IsClassName(GetParent(hwnd), L"SearchEditBoxWrapperClass"))
        kind = LegacyRebarTextKind::Search;
    const bool dropdownClass = !_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"DropDown") ||
        !_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"ViewControlClass") ||
        !_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"ListviewPopup") ||
        !_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"SysListView32") ||
        !_wcsicmp(windowClass, L"SysHeader32") ||
        kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::Toolbar;
    if (kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::None && !dropdownClass)
        return kind;
    if (g_roundedSelectionHighContrast.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    if (dropdownClass) {
        HWND popup = GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT);
        if (IsClassName(popup, L"DropDown") ||
            IsClassName(popup, L"ViewControlClass")) {
            return LegacyRebarTextDropdownOwner(popup)
                ? LegacyRebarTextKind::Dropdown : LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
        }
    }
    if (kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::None ||
        !hwnd)
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;

    HWND rebar = hwnd;
    for (unsigned depth = 0; rebar && depth < 16; ++depth) {
        if (IsClassName(rebar, L"ReBarWindow32"))
            break;
        rebar = GetParent(rebar);
    }
    if (!rebar || !IsClassName(rebar, L"ReBarWindow32") ||
        !IsClassName(GetParent(rebar), L"WorkerW"))
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    HWND root = GetAncestor(rebar, GA_ROOT);
    // Generic dialog classes alone are not proof of a Shell file picker.
    // Reuse the positive NamespaceTreeControl cache, without caching early misses.
    if (LegacyRebarTextIsShellRoot(root))
        return kind;
    return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
}

// Explorer dialog and file-picker captions: cache eligibility on the control and
// revalidate style/root at paint boundaries, not per text run.

static LegacyRebarTextKind ModernComboTextControlKind(HWND hwnd, LPCWSTR cls)
{
    const bool popup = !_wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboLBox");
    if (popup) {
        // Native ComboLBox popups can have the desktop as parent and no
        // owner. Their built-in class and list styles are sufficient.
        return (GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE) &
            (LBS_OWNERDRAWFIXED | LBS_OWNERDRAWVARIABLE))
            ? LegacyRebarTextKind::None : LegacyRebarTextKind::ModernCombo;
    } else if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboBox")) {
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    }
    const LONG_PTR style = GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE);
    // Editable fields and application-owned item painting remain native.
    if (!(style & WS_CHILD) || (style & (CBS_OWNERDRAWFIXED | CBS_OWNERDRAWVARIABLE)) ||
        (style & 3) != CBS_DROPDOWNLIST)
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    return LegacyRebarTextKind::ModernCombo;
}

static LegacyRebarTextKind ExplorerDialogTextControlKind(HWND hwnd, LPCWSTR cls)
{
    const LONG_PTR style = GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE);
    if (!(style & WS_CHILD))
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    if (!_wcsicmp(cls, L"DirectUIHWND")) {
        // Keep folder/status text and the legacy search field on their own
        // pipelines. Only dialog Element text, not hosted HWNDs, is replaced.
        return !IsInsideShellFolderView(hwnd) && !IsInsideExplorerStatusBarHost(hwnd) &&
            !IsClassName(GetParent(hwnd), L"SearchEditBoxWrapperClass")
                ? LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogDirectUi : LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    } else if (!_wcsicmp(cls, L"Static")) {
        const auto type = style & SS_TYPEMASK;
        if (type == SS_LEFT || type == SS_CENTER || type == SS_RIGHT ||
            type == SS_SIMPLE || type == SS_LEFTNOWORDWRAP)
            return LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogStatic;
    } else if (!_wcsicmp(cls, L"SysLink")) {
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogLink;
    } else if (!_wcsicmp(cls, L"SysListView32") && !(style & LVS_OWNERDRAWFIXED)) {
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogList;
    } else if (!_wcsicmp(cls, L"SysHeader32")) {
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogHeader;
    } else if (!_wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTreeView32") && !GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(hwnd)) {
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogTree;
    } else if (!_wcsicmp(cls, L"NativeFontCtl") || !_wcsicmp(cls, L"CHECKLIST_ACLUI")) {
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogCustom;
    } else if (!_wcsicmp(cls, L"msctls_hotkey32")) {
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogHotkey;
    } else if (!_wcsicmp(cls, L"Edit") && !(style & ES_PASSWORD)) {
        // Renaming keeps its independently validated native/Mica repair.
        if (ListRenameIsCandidate(hwnd) || IsClassName(GetParent(hwnd), L"SysTreeView32") ||
            IsClassName(GetParent(hwnd), L"SysListView32"))
            return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
        return (style & ES_READONLY) ? LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogReadOnly
                                    : LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogEditable;
    } else if (!_wcsicmp(cls, L"Button") &&
        !(style & (BS_ICON | BS_BITMAP | BS_PUSHLIKE))) {
        // Only native captions: never take over push/owner-drawn buttons or
        // their glyphs, state painting, focus rectangles and hit testing.
        switch (style & BS_TYPEMASK) {
        case BS_CHECKBOX:
        case BS_AUTOCHECKBOX:
        case BS_3STATE:
        case BS_AUTO3STATE:
        case BS_RADIOBUTTON:
        case BS_AUTORADIOBUTTON:
        case BS_GROUPBOX:
            return LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogButton;
        case BS_COMMANDLINK:
        case BS_DEFCOMMANDLINK:
            return LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogCommand;
        }
    }
    return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
}

static LegacyRebarTextKind ExplorerDialogTextTargetKind(HWND hwnd, LPCWSTR cls, HWND root)
{
    if (!g_settings.ExplorerSection)
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    const bool dialogRoot = IsClassName(root, L"#32770");
    if (g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite && !_wcsicmp(cls, L"Edit") &&
        (dialogRoot || IsClassName(root, L"NativeHWNDHost") ||
         (IsCurrentProcessExplorer() &&
          (IsClassName(root, L"CabinetWClass") || IsClassName(root, L"ExploreWClass")))) &&
        ExplorerDialogTextControlKind(hwnd, cls) == LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogEditable) {
        // Validate at paint boundaries, never for each glyph run. A generic
        // WorkerW or an owned dialog alone is not evidence of Shell UI.
        HWND parent = GetParent(hwnd);
        for (unsigned depth = 0; parent && parent != root && depth < 32;
             ++depth, parent = GetParent(parent)) {
            if (IsClassName(parent, L"ReBarWindow32")) {
                if (IsClassName(GetParent(parent), L"WorkerW") &&
                    LegacyRebarTextIsShellRoot(root))
                    return LegacyRebarTextKind::ShellEditable;
                break;
            }
            if (IsClassName(parent, L"SearchEditBoxWrapperClass") &&
                LegacyRebarTextIsShellRoot(root))
                return LegacyRebarTextKind::ShellEditable;
        }
    }
    if (!dialogRoot)
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    if (g_settings.DialogTextDirectWrite && IsCurrentProcessExplorer())
        return ExplorerDialogTextControlKind(hwnd, cls);
    if (!g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite ||
        (_wcsicmp(cls, L"Static") && _wcsicmp(cls, L"Button") && _wcsicmp(cls, L"Edit")))
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    const auto kind = ExplorerDialogTextControlKind(hwnd, cls);
    if (kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogStatic &&
        kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogButton && kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogCommand &&
        kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogEditable)
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    // The same positive, late-built Shell identity as picker Mica. Do not
    // enumerate per text run, cache early misses or include owned dialogs.
    if (FilePickerDialogRoot(hwnd) != root)
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    switch (kind) {
    case LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogStatic: return LegacyRebarTextKind::FilePickerStatic;
    case LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogButton: return LegacyRebarTextKind::FilePickerButton;
    case LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogCommand: return LegacyRebarTextKind::FilePickerCommand;
    case LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogEditable: return LegacyRebarTextKind::FilePickerEditable;
    default: return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    }
}


static LRESULT CALLBACK ExplorerDialogTextSubclassProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg,
    WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kExplorerDialogTextProp);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, ExplorerDialogTextSubclassProc);
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    }
    // Native controls also draw synchronously while changing state/selection,
    // without BeginPaint. Scope only messages that can update their visuals.
    const bool visualUpdate = msg == WM_PAINT || msg == WM_PRINTCLIENT || msg == WM_PRINT ||
        msg == WM_ERASEBKGND || msg == WM_SIZE || msg == WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGED ||
        msg == WM_MOUSEMOVE || msg == WM_MOUSELEAVE ||
        msg == WM_LBUTTONDOWN || msg == WM_LBUTTONUP || msg == WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK ||
        msg == WM_KEYDOWN || msg == WM_KEYUP || msg == WM_CHAR ||
        msg == WM_SYSKEYDOWN || msg == WM_SYSKEYUP ||
        msg == WM_SETFOCUS || msg == WM_KILLFOCUS || msg == WM_ENABLE ||
        msg == WM_SETTEXT || msg == WM_SETFONT || msg == WM_UPDATEUISTATE ||
        msg == WM_CHANGEUISTATE || msg == WM_TIMER || msg == WM_CAPTURECHANGED ||
        msg == WM_CANCELMODE || msg == BM_SETCHECK || msg == BM_SETSTATE ||
        msg == EM_SETSEL || msg == LB_SETCURSEL || msg == LB_SETSEL ||
        msg == LB_SETTOPINDEX || msg == CB_SETCURSEL || msg == CB_SHOWDROPDOWN ||
        msg == WM_VSCROLL || msg == WM_HSCROLL || msg == WM_MOUSEWHEEL ||
        msg == WM_PASTE || msg == WM_CUT || msg == WM_CLEAR || msg == WM_UNDO ||
        msg == EM_REPLACESEL || msg == EM_UNDO || msg == EM_SCROLL || msg == EM_LINESCROLL ||
        msg == EM_SCROLLCARET || msg == EM_SETPASSWORDCHAR ||
        msg == WM_UNICHAR || msg == WM_IME_STARTCOMPOSITION ||
        msg == WM_IME_COMPOSITION || msg == WM_IME_ENDCOMPOSITION || msg == WM_IME_CHAR;
    if (visualUpdate &&
        (g_settings.DialogTextDirectWrite || g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite || g_settings.RoundedButtons) &&
        !g_explorerDialogTextUnloading.load(
            std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        // Paints and layout, text or style changes classify the control
        // again; input and timer messages reuse the kind that stored.
        const bool revalidate = msg == WM_PAINT || msg == WM_PRINTCLIENT ||
            msg == WM_PRINT || msg == WM_ERASEBKGND || msg == WM_SIZE ||
            msg == WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGED || msg == WM_SETTEXT || msg == WM_SETFONT ||
            msg == WM_ENABLE;
        const unsigned previousDepth = g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth;
        if (revalidate) {
            wchar_t cls[16] = {};
            GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls));
            LegacyRebarTextBeginPaint(hwnd, cls);
        } else {
            LegacyRebarTextBeginPaintKnown(hwnd, static_cast<LegacyRebarTextKind>(
                reinterpret_cast<UINT_PTR>(GetPropW(hwnd, kExplorerDialogTextProp))));
        }
        const bool pushed = g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth == previousDepth + 1;
        if (msg == WM_PAINT && LegacyDialogCheckboxOwnsTransition(BP_CHECKBOX))
            BufferedPaintStopAllAnimations(hwnd);
        const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        if (pushed)
            LegacyRebarTextEndPaint(hwnd);
        return result;
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

static void ExplorerDialogTextRemove(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (GetPropW(hwnd, kExplorerDialogTextProp)) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, ExplorerDialogTextSubclassProc);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kExplorerDialogTextProp);
    }
}

static void ExplorerDialogTextObserve(HWND hwnd, LPCWSTR cls)
{
    const bool combo = !_wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboBox") || !_wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboLBox");
    if ((!combo && (!g_settings.ExplorerSection ||
            !(g_settings.DialogTextDirectWrite || g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite))) ||
        (combo && !g_settings.RoundedButtons) ||
        IsTextPipelineDisabled() || g_explorerDialogTextUnloading.load(
            std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        ExplorerDialogTextRemove(hwnd);
        return;
    }
    DWORD processId = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &processId);
    const HWND root = GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT);
    if (processId != GetCurrentProcessId())
        return;
    const auto kind = combo ? ModernComboTextControlKind(hwnd, cls)
        : ExplorerDialogTextTargetKind(hwnd, cls, root);
    if (kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::None) {
        ExplorerDialogTextRemove(hwnd);
        return;
    }
    const auto marker = reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(static_cast<UINT_PTR>(kind));
    if (GetPropW(hwnd, kExplorerDialogTextProp) == marker)
        return;
    ExplorerDialogTextRemove(hwnd);
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, ExplorerDialogTextSubclassProc, 0))
        return;
    if (g_explorerDialogTextUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !SetPropW(hwnd, kExplorerDialogTextProp, marker)) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, ExplorerDialogTextSubclassProc);
        return;
    }
    if (g_explorerDialogTextUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        ExplorerDialogTextRemove(hwnd);
    else if (LegacyControlUniscribeKind(kind)) {
        const bool first = kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::ModernCombo
            ? !g_modernComboTextContextSeen.exchange(true, std::memory_order_acq_rel)
            : !g_dialogReadOnlyContextSeen.exchange(true, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        if (first)
            LazyFeatureRequestHooks();
    }
}

static LegacyRebarTextKind ExplorerDialogTextClassify(HWND hwnd, LPCWSTR cls)
{
    if ((!g_settings.DialogTextDirectWrite && !g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite) ||
