        g_explorerDialogTextUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        g_roundedSelectionHighContrast.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    DWORD processId = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &processId);
    if (processId != GetCurrentProcessId())
        return LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
    const HWND root = GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT);
    const auto targetKind = ExplorerDialogTextTargetKind(hwnd, cls, root);
    auto marker = GetPropW(hwnd, kExplorerDialogTextProp);
    if (static_cast<LegacyRebarTextKind>(reinterpret_cast<UINT_PTR>(marker)) != targetKind) {
        ExplorerDialogTextObserve(hwnd, cls);
        marker = GetPropW(hwnd, kExplorerDialogTextProp);
    }
    const auto kind = static_cast<LegacyRebarTextKind>(reinterpret_cast<UINT_PTR>(marker));
    // Read-only/style and reparenting changes must not inherit old eligibility.
    return ExplorerDialogTextKind(kind) && kind == targetKind
            ? kind : LegacyRebarTextKind::None;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK ExplorerDialogTextApplyChild(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    const bool wasTracked = GetPropW(hwnd, kExplorerDialogTextProp) != nullptr;
    wchar_t cls[32] = {};
    if (GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)))
        ExplorerDialogTextObserve(hwnd, cls);
    if (wasTracked || GetPropW(hwnd, kExplorerDialogTextProp))
        InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK ExplorerDialogTextApplyTop(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD processId = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &processId);
    // Apply also when disabling the options, so tracked controls are removed
    // and invalidated immediately rather than waiting for a later paint.
    if (processId == GetCurrentProcessId() &&
        (IsClassName(hwnd, L"#32770") || IsClassName(hwnd, L"CabinetWClass") ||
         IsClassName(hwnd, L"ExploreWClass") || IsClassName(hwnd, L"NativeHWNDHost")))
        EnumChildWindows(hwnd, ExplorerDialogTextApplyChild, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK ModernComboTextApplyChild(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    wchar_t cls[16] = {};
    if (GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)) &&
        (!_wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboBox") || !_wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboLBox"))) {
        const bool tracked = GetPropW(hwnd, kExplorerDialogTextProp) != nullptr;
        ExplorerDialogTextObserve(hwnd, cls);
        if (tracked || GetPropW(hwnd, kExplorerDialogTextProp))
            InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
    }
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK ModernComboTextApplyTop(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD processId = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &processId);
    if (processId == GetCurrentProcessId()) {
        ModernComboTextApplyChild(hwnd, 0);
        EnumChildWindows(hwnd, ModernComboTextApplyChild, 0);
    }
    return TRUE;
}

static bool IsExplorerRebarHost(HDC hdc)
{
    HWND hwnd = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (!hwnd)
        hwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
    if (!hwnd)
        return false;

    bool inRebar = false;
    for (HWND p = hwnd; p; p = GetParent(p)) {
        wchar_t cls[64] = {};
        if (GetClassNameW(p, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)) &&
            _wcsicmp(cls, L"ReBarWindow32") == 0) {
            inRebar = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!inRebar)
        return false;

    HWND root = GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT);
    if (!root)
        return false;

    wchar_t cls[64] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(root, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)))
        return false;

    return _wcsicmp(cls, L"CabinetWClass") == 0 ||
           _wcsicmp(cls, L"ExploreWClass") == 0 ||
           _wcsicmp(cls, L"#32770") == 0 ||
           _wcsicmp(cls, L"NativeHWNDHost") == 0;
}

static void SyncComboEditButtonState(HDC hdc, INT buttonState)
{
    // Consumed by the WM_CTLCOLOREDIT answer in both themes and by
    // FillRect_hook/SetBkColor_hook in dark mode.
    if (!g_darkModeActive && !g_settings.RoundedButtons)
        return;

    HWND combo = ResolveComboBoxAnimationHwnd(hdc);
    if (!combo || IsExplorerRebarHost(hdc))
        return;

    HANDLE value = (HANDLE)(INT_PTR)(buttonState + 1);
    if (GetPropW(combo, kPropComboButtonState) == value)
        return;
    if (!SetPropW(combo, kPropComboButtonState, value))
        return;

    HWND edit = FindWindowExW(combo, nullptr, L"Edit", nullptr);
    if (!edit && IsClassName(GetParent(combo), L"ComboBoxEx32")) {
        edit = FindWindowExW(GetParent(combo), nullptr, L"Edit", nullptr);
    }
    if (edit)
        InvalidateRect(edit, nullptr, FALSE);
}

static bool IsComboBoxEditFocused(HWND combo)
{
    if (!combo)
        return false;

    HWND edit = nullptr;
    COMBOBOXINFO info = {sizeof(info)};
    if (GetComboBoxInfo(combo, &info))
        edit = info.hwndItem;

    if (!edit && IsClassName(GetParent(combo), L"ComboBoxEx32"))
        edit = FindWindowExW(GetParent(combo), nullptr, L"Edit", nullptr);

    const HWND focus = GetFocus();
    return edit && focus && (focus == edit || IsChild(edit, focus));
}

static HWND RebarWindowFromPaintHdc(HDC hdc)
{
    HWND hwnd = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (!hwnd)
        hwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
    for (HWND p = hwnd; p; p = GetParent(p))
        if (IsClassName(p, L"ReBarWindow32"))
            return p;
    return nullptr;
}

// WinUI's DividerStrokeColorDefault along the rebar's bottom row: the rule
// against the content below, the same as the file picker's dividers. Only
// for a part reaching the rebar's own bottom: comctl32 paints each band
// twice (probed: 62 then 65 rows tall in a 65-row rebar), and the shorter
// pass would leave a second rule floating above the edge.
static void DrawRebarBottomRule(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect, bool dark)
{
    RECT client;
    HWND rebar = RebarWindowFromPaintHdc(hdc);
    if (rebar && GetClientRect(rebar, &client) && pRect->bottom < client.bottom)
        return;
    const int lineW = std::max(1, (int)std::lround(
        (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI));
    RECT line = { pRect->left, std::max(pRect->top, pRect->bottom - lineW),
                  pRect->right, pRect->bottom };
    BlendPremultipliedPixels(hdc, line, dark ? 0x15151515u : 0x0F000000u);
}

// Explorer's legacy frame (Control Panel's): a CabinetWClass without the
// tabbed Explorer's WinUI island, a direct child of the frame.
static bool IsLegacyExplorerFrame(HWND hwnd)
{
    HWND root = hwnd ? GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT) : nullptr;
    return root && IsClassName(root, L"CabinetWClass") &&
        !FindWindowExW(root, nullptr,
            L"Microsoft.UI.Content.DesktopChildSiteBridge", nullptr);
}

// Control Panel page text recolors (title, view button, "View by" label).
// Light: part of the Explorer section. Dark: only with the custom dark mode,
// without which the page stays white under light text.
static bool ControlPanelTextRecolorActive(bool dark)
{
    return IsCurrentProcessExplorer() &&
        (dark ? g_darkModeActive.load() : g_settings.ExplorerSection != FALSE);
}

static bool IsLegacyExplorerFrameRebar(HDC hdc)
{
    HWND rebar = RebarWindowFromPaintHdc(hdc);
    return rebar && IsLegacyExplorerFrame(rebar);
}

static bool PaintExplorerRebarMicaTintRect(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!pRect)
        return false;

    // Two reasons to be here: the opt-in accent-tinted look (RebarMicaTint),
    // or plain custom dark mode with no tint -- the rebar's native
    // DarkMode_Explorer background needs no help from us there, but it also
    // draws no divider against the content below it, so this still runs
    // just for the DrawLine a few lines down. Skip entirely if neither
    // applies (light mode, tint off) -- checked before IsExplorerRebarHost's
    // parent-chain walk below, so the common case (tint off, light mode)
    // bails on a couple of cheap flag reads instead of paying that walk on
    // every rebar repaint.
    const bool tintActive = g_settings.RebarMicaTint && IsSystemTransparencyEnabled();
    const bool dark = IsDarkForExcludedAwarePaintHdc(hdc);
    // Light Explorer legacy frame under Mica (outside the Control Panel
    // host): the native band paints nothing over the frame's black reveal, so the
    // rebar gets the white the file picker's has; RepairOpaqueChromeAlpha
    // keeps it and its text opaque after the paint.
    const bool lightMicaFrame = !tintActive && !dark && ExplorerMicaActive() &&
        IsCurrentProcessExplorer() && IsLegacyExplorerFrameRebar(hdc);
    if (!tintActive && !dark && !lightMicaFrame)
        return false;

    if (!IsExplorerRebarHost(hdc))
        return false;

    const int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
    const int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
        return false;

    // Plain dark (no tint): the shell shade this area natively paints, the
    // same one TravelBandEraseColor uses.
    const COLORREF mixed = tintActive ? GetExplorerFakeMicaColor(dark)
        : lightMicaFrame ? RGB(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF) : ExplorerDarkColor;
    // Light keeps the rule to HandlePostDraw's ModernSeparators pass, as over
    // the native light band.
    const bool drawRule = !lightMicaFrame;

    if (!g_d2dFactory) {
        HBRUSH br = CreateSolidBrush(mixed);
        if (br) {
            FillRect(hdc, pRect, br);
            DeleteObject(br);
        }
        if (drawRule)
            DrawRebarBottomRule(hdc, pRect, dark);
        return true;
    }

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
    FPUGuard fpu;
    if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
        return false;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
    pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(ColorFAlpha(mixed, 1.f), &brush);
    pRT->BeginDraw();
    pRT->FillRectangle(D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f, (float)w, (float)h), brush.Get());

    HRESULT hr = pRT->EndDraw();
    if (hr == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        pRT.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
        return false;
    }
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && drawRule)
        DrawRebarBottomRule(hdc, pRect, dark);
    return SUCCEEDED(hr);
}

static bool PaintExplorerRebarMicaTint(HDC hdc, INT iPartId, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (iStateId != 0 || (iPartId != RP_BAND && iPartId != RP_BACKGROUND))
        return false;

    return PaintExplorerRebarMicaTintRect(hdc, pRect);
}

static bool PaintLegacyShellDropdownToolbar(HDC hdc, INT iPartId, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!pRect)
        return false;

    HWND hwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (!IsLegacyShellDropdownRoot(hwnd))
        return false;

    const bool dark = IsLegacyShellDropdownDark(hwnd);
    const COLORREF bgColor = LegacyShellDropdownBgColor(hwnd);

    if (iPartId == 0 /*COMMONPROPS*/) {
        if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(bgColor))
            FillRect(hdc, pRect, br);
        return true;
    }

    const bool isToolbarButton =
        iPartId == TP_BUTTON || iPartId == TP_DROPDOWNBUTTON || iPartId == TP_SPLITBUTTON;
    if (!isToolbarButton)
        return false;

    if (iStateId == TS_NORMAL || iStateId == TS_DISABLED || iStateId == TS_NEARHOT)
        return true;

    const int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
    const int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
        return true;

    if (!g_d2dFactory) {
        if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(bgColor))
            FillRect(hdc, pRect, br);
        return true;
    }

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
    FPUGuard fpu;
    if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
        return true;

    if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(bgColor))
        FillRect(hdc, pRect, br);

    const bool selected = (iStateId == TS_PRESSED ||
                           iStateId == TS_CHECKED ||
                           iStateId == TS_HOTCHECKED);
    float aR, aG, aB;
    if (g_settings.NeutralSelection) {
        aR = aG = aB = dark ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    } else {
        const COLORREF ac = GetAccentIndicator();
        aR = GetRValue(ac) / 255.f;
        aG = GetGValue(ac) / 255.f;
        aB = GetBValue(ac) / 255.f;
    }
    const float alpha = selected
        ? (dark ? 0.14f : 0.12f)
        : (dark ? 0.08f : 0.06f);

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
    pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(D2D1::ColorF(aR, aG, aB, alpha), &brush);
    if (!brush)
        return true;

    const float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.f;
    pRT->BeginDraw();
    pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
        D2D1::RoundedRect(
            D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f, (float)w, (float)h),
            ModernizerCornerRadius * scale, ModernizerCornerRadius * scale),
        brush.Get());
    HRESULT hr = pRT->EndDraw();
    if (hr == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        pRT.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
    return hr != (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET;
}

static decltype(&DrawFocusRect) DrawFocusRect_orig = nullptr;

struct FocusRectGdipCache {
    ULONG_PTR token = 0;
    bool startupAttempted = false;
    bool ready = false;
};
static FocusRectGdipCache g_focusRectGdip;
static std::mutex g_focusRectGdipMutex;

static bool FocusRectEnsureGdipLocked()
{
    if (g_focusRectGdip.ready)
        return true;
    if (g_focusRectGdip.startupAttempted ||
        g_gdipUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return false;
    g_focusRectGdip.startupAttempted = true;
    Gdiplus::GdiplusStartupInput input;
    if (Gdiplus::GdiplusStartup(&g_focusRectGdip.token, &input, nullptr) !=
        Gdiplus::Ok) {
        g_focusRectGdip.token = 0;
        return false;
    }
    g_focusRectGdip.ready = true;
    return true;
}

static void FocusRectGdipShutdown()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_focusRectGdipMutex);
    if (g_focusRectGdip.token) {
        Gdiplus::GdiplusShutdown(g_focusRectGdip.token);
        g_focusRectGdip.token = 0;
    }
    g_focusRectGdip.ready = false;
    g_focusRectGdip.startupAttempted = false;
}

static void FocusRectAddRoundedPath(Gdiplus::GraphicsPath& path,
    const Gdiplus::RectF& rect, float radius)
{
    const float diameter = radius * 2.0f;
    if (diameter <= 0.0f) {
        path.AddRectangle(rect);
        return;
    }
    path.AddArc(rect.X, rect.Y, diameter, diameter, 180.0f, 90.0f);
    path.AddArc(rect.GetRight() - diameter, rect.Y, diameter, diameter,
        270.0f, 90.0f);
    path.AddArc(rect.GetRight() - diameter, rect.GetBottom() - diameter,
        diameter, diameter, 0.0f, 90.0f);
    path.AddArc(rect.X, rect.GetBottom() - diameter, diameter, diameter,
        90.0f, 90.0f);
    path.CloseFigure();
}

// DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION: a tiny one-shot rounded outline drawn directly on the
// caller's HDC, invoked from many unrelated controls' own paint cycles. GDI+
// needs no persistent/cached render target the way the D2D DC-render-target
// path used elsewhere in this file does -- Graphics(hdc) is stateless per
// call, which avoids a whole class of stale-binding issues here.
static BOOL DrawModernFocusRect(HDC hdc, const RECT* rect)
{
    if (!hdc || !rect)
        return FALSE;
    const int w = rect->right - rect->left;
    const int h = rect->bottom - rect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
        return FALSE;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_focusRectGdipMutex);
    if (!FocusRectEnsureGdipLocked())
        return FALSE;

    const int dpi = std::max(GetDeviceCaps(hdc, LOGPIXELSX),
                              USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI);
    const float scale = (float)dpi / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const float strokeW = std::max(1.5f, 1.5f * scale);
    const float radius = 2.8f * scale;
    const float half = strokeW * 0.5f;

    // Inset within the given rect (never outside it), matching the button/
    // combo border convention -- DrawFocusRect is commonly called more than
    // once per paint (XOR erase-then-redraw idiom; see DrawFocusRect_hook),
    // and this hook draws opaque with no erase. A ring extending outside the
    // rect sits partly beyond whatever area the control's own repaint
    // naturally covers, so double-composited pixels there can accumulate
    // instead of being washed clean by the next normal repaint -- most
    // visible at the corners, which bulge outward in two dimensions versus
    // a straight edge's one.
    Gdiplus::RectF rc(
        (float)rect->left + half,
        (float)rect->top + half,
        (float)w - strokeW,
        (float)h - strokeW);
    if (rc.Width <= 0.0f || rc.Height <= 0.0f)
        return FALSE;

    const bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    Gdiplus::Color color = dark
        ? Gdiplus::Color(255, 255, 255, 255)
        : Gdiplus::Color(255, 0, 0, 0);
    Gdiplus::Pen pen(color, strokeW);
    if (pen.GetLastStatus() != Gdiplus::Ok)
        return FALSE;

    Gdiplus::GraphicsPath path;
    FocusRectAddRoundedPath(path, rc, radius);

    Gdiplus::Graphics graphics(hdc);
    graphics.SetSmoothingMode(Gdiplus::SmoothingModeAntiAlias);
    graphics.SetPixelOffsetMode(Gdiplus::PixelOffsetModeHalf);
    return graphics.DrawPath(&pen, &path) == Gdiplus::Ok;
}

static bool ShouldDrawSelectionBorder(HWND hwnd, bool isTreeView); // defined later in the file

BOOL WINAPI DrawFocusRect_hook(HDC hdc, CONST RECT* lprc)
{
    // GeneralSection off: mod fully inactive for this feature -- native
    // dotted rect behaves exactly as on an unmodified system.
    if (g_settings.ModernFocusRect < 0)
        [[clang::musttail]] return DrawFocusRect_orig(hdc, lprc);

    HWND hwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (hwnd) {
        wchar_t cls[48] = {};
        GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls));

        if (RoundedSelectionVisualsEnabled() &&
            _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTreeView32") == 0)
            return TRUE; // handled independently via NM_CUSTOMDRAW/CDIS_FOCUS

        // Items with an existing accent ring get it recolored white/black on
        // focus instead. Items with no ring (Explorer's own pill) get none --
        // Explorer's file list never calls this API for its custom items, so
        // a fallthrough here is unreachable for them. Suppress unconditionally
        // either way, same as the TreeView branch above.
        if (RoundedSelectionVisualsEnabled() &&
            _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysListView32") == 0)
            return TRUE;

        // The WinUI background already conveys selection on its own -- but
        // only when PaintTab is actually going to draw it (IsWinUiTabStyleActive);
        // otherwise this tab is falling through to fully native rendering,
        // and native rendering needs its own native focus rect.
        if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTabControl32") == 0 && IsWinUiTabStyleActive())
            return TRUE;

        // Pushbuttons show focus via their own border color (PaintPushButton)
        // -- skip the separate ring so the two don't stack. Checkboxes/
        // radios/groupboxes ("Button" class, other BS_* styles) are
        // untouched and keep the ring.
        if (g_settings.RoundedButtons && _wcsicmp(cls, L"Button") == 0) {
            const LONG bs = GetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE) & BS_TYPEMASK;
            if (bs == BS_PUSHBUTTON || bs == BS_DEFPUSHBUTTON)
                return TRUE;
        }
    }

    // Modern focus indication is enabled (dropdown = modern or hidden) --
    // the dotted rect never shows past this point, either replaced with the
    // rounded outline or intentionally left invisible.
    if (g_settings.ModernFocusRect == 1 /* hidden */)
        return TRUE;

    if (DrawModernFocusRect(hdc, lprc))
        return TRUE;
    [[clang::musttail]] return DrawFocusRect_orig(hdc, lprc);
}

// Background behind a 3D edge, from the same source the control erases
// with (WM_CTLCOLORSTATIC/BTN to the parent, the client bg for edits and
// lists) rather than a window-DC GetPixel (~200 us). Controls this can't
// answer for -- toolbars, non-themed headers, third-party DirectUI hosts --
// keep the readback: a guessed color there shows as a square.
static COLORREF DrawEdgeBackgroundColor(HWND hw, HDC hdc, const RECT& rc,
    int sysColor, bool darkFixed)
{
    if (hw && !darkFixed) {
        wchar_t cls[32] = {};
        GetClassNameW(hw, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls));
        HWND parent = GetParent(hw);
        UINT msg = 0;
        if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"Static") == 0)
            msg = WM_CTLCOLORSTATIC;
        else if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"Button") == 0)
            msg = WM_CTLCOLORBTN;
        if (msg && parent) {
            const COLORREF savedBk = GetBkColor(hdc);
            const COLORREF savedText = GetTextColor(hdc);
            HBRUSH br = (HBRUSH)SendMessageUnhooked(parent, msg, (WPARAM)hdc, (LPARAM)hw);
            const COLORREF parentBk = GetBkColor(hdc);
            SetBkColor(hdc, savedBk);
            SetTextColor(hdc, savedText);
            LOGBRUSH lb = {};
            if (br && GetObject(br, sizeof(lb), &lb) && lb.lbStyle == BS_SOLID)
                return lb.lbColor;
            if (br && parentBk != CLR_INVALID)
                return parentBk;
        } else if (parent && (_wcsicmp(cls, L"Edit") == 0 ||
                              _wcsicmp(cls, L"ListBox") == 0 ||
                              _wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboLBox") == 0 ||
                              _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysListView32") == 0)) {
            return ControlClientBgColor(hw, hdc, sysColor);
        }
    }
    return SampleBackground(hdc, rc.left + 1, rc.top + 1, sysColor, darkFixed);
}

// DrawEdge hook — replace 3D embossed separators with 1px semi-transparent line
static decltype(&DrawEdge) DrawEdge_orig = nullptr;
BOOL WINAPI DrawEdge_hook(HDC hdc, LPRECT qrc, UINT edge, UINT grfFlags)
{
    if (!g_settings.ModernSeparators || !qrc)
        return DrawEdge_orig(hdc, qrc, edge, grfFlags);

    // Never replace edges on ScrollBar controls — our 1px line replacement
    // makes arrow button areas look unpainted. Let the system render normally.
    HWND hw = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (!hw) hw = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
    {
        if (hw) {
            wchar_t sc[32] = {};
            GetClassNameW(hw, sc, ARRAYSIZE(sc));
            if (_wcsicmp(sc, L"ScrollBar") == 0)
                return DrawEdge_orig(hdc, qrc, edge, grfFlags);
            // Status bar: suppress native 3D separators; the subclass redraws
            // modern separators after paint in both light and dark mode.
            if (_wcsicmp(sc, L"msctls_statusbar32") == 0) {
                if (grfFlags & BF_ADJUST) {
                    // BF_ADJUST: caller wants the rect adjusted — still update it
                    if (edge & (BDR_RAISEDOUTER | BDR_SUNKENOUTER)) {
                        if (grfFlags & BF_LEFT)   qrc->left++;
                        if (grfFlags & BF_TOP)    qrc->top++;
                        if (grfFlags & BF_RIGHT)  qrc->right--;
                        if (grfFlags & BF_BOTTOM) qrc->bottom--;
                    }
                }
                return TRUE; // suppress separator drawing
            }

        }
    }

    // Intercept ANY 3D edge — check if any BDR_* bit is set.
    // This catches all combinations: EDGE_SUNKEN, EDGE_RAISED, EDGE_ETCHED,
    // EDGE_BUMP, and unusual single/mixed BDR_* combos that the old checks missed.
    const UINT edgeBits = edge & (BDR_RAISEDOUTER | BDR_SUNKENOUTER
                                | BDR_RAISEDINNER | BDR_SUNKENINNER);
    if (!edgeBits)
        return DrawEdge_orig(hdc, qrc, edge, grfFlags);

    const bool dark = hw ? IsHwndDarkMode(hw) : IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    HPEN hPen = GetDrawEdgePen(dark);
    if (!hPen) return DrawEdge_orig(hdc, qrc, edge, grfFlags);
    // Own fills go straight to the real FillRect: FillRect_hook's restyle
    // checks are for the host's fills, not ours.
    const auto fillRect = FillRect_orig ? FillRect_orig : FillRect;

    HPEN oldPen = (HPEN)SelectObject(hdc, hPen);

    // If no edge flags specified, draw all four sides (full rect border)
    UINT sides = grfFlags & (BF_TOP | BF_BOTTOM | BF_LEFT | BF_RIGHT);
    if (!sides) sides = BF_TOP | BF_BOTTOM | BF_LEFT | BF_RIGHT;

    // Fill the border area with background to erase old 3D pixels
    COLORREF bgClr = DrawEdgeBackgroundColor(hw, hdc, *qrc,
        dark ? COLOR_WINDOWFRAME : COLOR_WINDOW, g_darkModeActive && dark);
    HBRUSH hBgBr = CreateSolidBrush(bgClr);

    if (hBgBr) {
        // Fill 2px strips on each active edge to clear old 3D rendering
        if (sides & BF_TOP) {
            RECT r = { qrc->left, qrc->top, qrc->right, qrc->top + 2 };
            fillRect(hdc, &r, hBgBr);
        }
        if (sides & BF_BOTTOM) {
            RECT r = { qrc->left, qrc->bottom - 2, qrc->right, qrc->bottom };
            fillRect(hdc, &r, hBgBr);
        }
        if (sides & BF_LEFT) {
            RECT r = { qrc->left, qrc->top, qrc->left + 2, qrc->bottom };
            fillRect(hdc, &r, hBgBr);
        }
        if (sides & BF_RIGHT) {
            RECT r = { qrc->right - 2, qrc->top, qrc->right, qrc->bottom };
            fillRect(hdc, &r, hBgBr);
        }
        DeleteObject(hBgBr);
    }

    // Draw 1px line on each active edge
    if (sides & BF_TOP) {
        MoveToEx(hdc, qrc->left, qrc->top, nullptr);
        LineTo(hdc, qrc->right, qrc->top);
    }
    if (sides & BF_BOTTOM) {
        MoveToEx(hdc, qrc->left, qrc->bottom - 1, nullptr);
        LineTo(hdc, qrc->right, qrc->bottom - 1);
    }
    if (sides & BF_LEFT) {
        MoveToEx(hdc, qrc->left, qrc->top, nullptr);
        LineTo(hdc, qrc->left, qrc->bottom);
    }
    if (sides & BF_RIGHT) {
        MoveToEx(hdc, qrc->right - 1, qrc->top, nullptr);
        LineTo(hdc, qrc->right - 1, qrc->bottom);
    }

    // BF_ADJUST: shrink rect by the original edge width.
    // Compound edges (2 BDR_* bits = inner+outer) are 2px; single BDR_* = 1px.
    if (grfFlags & BF_ADJUST) {
        const bool hasInner = (edgeBits & (BDR_RAISEDINNER | BDR_SUNKENINNER)) != 0;
        const bool hasOuter = (edgeBits & (BDR_RAISEDOUTER | BDR_SUNKENOUTER)) != 0;
        int adj = (hasInner && hasOuter) ? 2 : 1;
        if (sides & BF_TOP)    qrc->top    += adj;
        if (sides & BF_BOTTOM) qrc->bottom -= adj;
        if (sides & BF_LEFT)   qrc->left   += adj;
        if (sides & BF_RIGHT)  qrc->right  -= adj;
    }

    SelectObject(hdc, oldPen);
    return TRUE;
}

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ROUNDED SELECTION BACKGROUNDS
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── ListView/TreeView item bitmap cache ──────────────────────────────────
// Pre-renders rounded rects into small DIBs. DrawNineGridStretch preserves
// corner radius while stretching middle — no blur/distortion.
// Explorer's WinUI Home tile selection (FileExplorerExtensions
// HomeItemPresenter: ContentGrid fill + SelectionAndHoverVisual 2px ring):
// SubtleFillColorSecondary for hot and selected, SubtleFillColorTertiary
// when hovered while selected -- white in dark, black in light.
static D2D1_COLOR_F GetWinUiItemFillColor(bool dark, INT state)
{
    const BYTE a = dark ? (state == 6 ? 0x0A : 0x0F) : (state == 6 ? 0x06 : 0x09);
    const float ch = dark ? 1.f : 0.f;
    return D2D1::ColorF(ch, ch, ch, a / 255.f);
}

// The keyboard focus visual's inner line (FocusVisualSecondaryBrush, 1px
// inside the 2px primary ring).
static D2D1_COLOR_F GetFocusVisualInnerColor(bool dark)
{
    return dark ? D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0xB3 / 255.f)
                : D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0xB3 / 255.f);
}

static constexpr int LV_CACHE_SZ = 24; // must be > 2*corner_radius
static constexpr int LV_CACHE_MARGIN = 8; // 9-grid margin (>= largest corner radius at 100%)
static constexpr float LV_SHADOW_BAND_H = 2.f; // selected-item bottom shadow height (must be <= LV_CACHE_MARGIN)
static constexpr int LV_CACHE_BLOCK = 12; // slots needed for one fill-only 9-grid variant (5 states x 2 controls, some spare)
static constexpr int LV_TREE_PRESSED_CACHE_INDEX = LV_CACHE_BLOCK - 1;
static constexpr int LV_BORDER_CACHE_BASE = LV_CACHE_BLOCK; // outside-context bordered-pill variant starts here
static constexpr int LV_FOCUS_BORDER_CACHE_BASE = LV_CACHE_BLOCK * 2; // same, ring recolored white/black on keyboard focus
static constexpr int LV_CACHE_SLOTS = LV_CACHE_BLOCK * 3;
static constexpr size_t LV_CACHE_MAX_PER_THREAD = 64;
static std::atomic<uint32_t> g_lvCacheGen{0};

static uint32_t PackRoundedSelectionColor(const D2D1_COLOR_F& color)
{
    auto toByte = [](float value) -> uint32_t {
        return static_cast<uint32_t>(std::lround(
            std::clamp(value, 0.f, 1.f) * 255.f));
    };
    return toByte(color.r) | (toByte(color.g) << 8) |
        (toByte(color.b) << 16) | (toByte(color.a) << 24);
}

static D2DThreadCache* LvCacheGetThreadCache()
{
    D2DThreadCache* cache = D2DGetThreadCache();
    if (!cache)
        return nullptr;

    const uint32_t generation =
        g_lvCacheGen.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (cache->roundedSelectionGeneration != generation) {
        cache->ResetRoundedSelectionTiles();
        cache->roundedSelectionGeneration = generation;
    }
    return cache;
}

static RoundedSelectionTile* LvCacheFind(
    D2DThreadCache* cache, const RoundedSelectionTileKey& key)
{
    if (!cache)
        return nullptr;
    auto it = cache->roundedSelectionTiles.find(key);
    if (it == cache->roundedSelectionTiles.end())
        return nullptr;
    it->second.lastUse = ++cache->roundedSelectionUseCounter;
    return &it->second;
}

static RoundedSelectionTile* LvCachePublish(
    D2DThreadCache* cache, const RoundedSelectionTileKey& key,
    RoundedSelectionTile&& tile)
{
    if (!cache)
        return nullptr;

    if (cache->roundedSelectionTiles.size() >= LV_CACHE_MAX_PER_THREAD) {
        auto oldest = cache->roundedSelectionTiles.begin();
        for (auto it = std::next(oldest);
             it != cache->roundedSelectionTiles.end(); ++it) {
            if (it->second.lastUse < oldest->second.lastUse)
                oldest = it;
        }
        cache->roundedSelectionTiles.erase(oldest);
    }

    tile.lastUse = ++cache->roundedSelectionUseCounter;
    auto result = cache->roundedSelectionTiles.emplace(key, std::move(tile));
    return &result.first->second;
}

static void LvCacheInvalidate()
{
    g_lvCacheGen.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
}

static void LvCacheDestroy()
{
    LvCacheInvalidate();
    if (D2DThreadCache* cache = D2DGetThreadCache(false))
        cache->ResetRoundedSelectionTiles();
}

static HRESULT CreateRoundedSelectionTileRenderTarget(
    HDC hdc, LPCRECT rect, ID2D1DCRenderTarget** target)
{
    if (!g_d2dFactory || !hdc || !rect || !target)
        return E_INVALIDARG;
    *target = nullptr;

    FPUGuard fpu;
    const D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_PROPERTIES props =
        D2D1::RenderTargetProperties(
            D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_TYPE_SOFTWARE,
            D2D1::PixelFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM,
                D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED),
            96.f, 96.f, D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_USAGE_GDI_COMPATIBLE,
            D2D1_FEATURE_LEVEL_DEFAULT);
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> local;
    HRESULT hr = g_d2dFactory->CreateDCRenderTarget(&props, &local);
    if (FAILED(hr))
        return hr;
    hr = local->BindDC(hdc, rect);
    if (FAILED(hr))
        return hr;
    *target = local.Detach();
    return S_OK;
}

// `shadowAlpha` (0 = none): darkens the bottom LV_CACHE_MARGIN-tall band of
// the tile at that alpha, clipped to the same rounded-rect geometry so the
// corners stay correct. That band maps 1:1 (unstretched) to the destination's
// bottom edge in the 9-grid draw, so it always renders as a fixed-height
// inner shadow regardless of item size. Baked into the same cached tile as
// the fill itself (rather than drawn separately below pRect) so it can never
// outlive the item's own repaint -- a shadow drawn outside pRect stops
// getting erased once the item deselects, since ListView only repaints
// pRect on state change. Needs a higher alpha in dark mode: the shadow is
// composited over the window's actual dark background (e.g. #191919), not
// black, so a light-mode alpha reads as nearly invisible there.
static RoundedSelectionTile* LvCacheEnsure(
    HDC hdc, int idx, D2D1_COLOR_F fill, float shadowAlpha, UINT dpi)
{
    if (!g_d2dFactory || idx < 0 || idx >= LV_CACHE_SLOTS)
        return nullptr;

    D2DThreadCache* cache = LvCacheGetThreadCache();
    if (!cache)
        return nullptr;
    const uint64_t variant = PackRoundedSelectionColor(fill) |
        (static_cast<uint64_t>(std::lround(
            std::clamp(shadowAlpha, 0.f, 1.f) * 255.f)) << 32);
    const RoundedSelectionTileKey key{
        static_cast<UINT>(idx), dpi, variant};
    if (RoundedSelectionTile* tile = LvCacheFind(cache, key))
        return tile;

    const float scale = static_cast<float>(dpi) / 96.f;
    const float radius = ModernizerCornerRadius * scale;
    const int cacheMargin = (std::max)(LV_CACHE_MARGIN,
        static_cast<int>(std::ceil(radius)));
    const int cacheSize = (std::max)(LV_CACHE_SZ, cacheMargin * 2 + 8);

    RoundedSelectionTile pending;
    pending.dc = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
    if (!pending.dc)
        return nullptr;
    BITMAPINFO bi = {}; bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = cacheSize; bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -cacheSize;
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1; bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    void* bits = nullptr;
    pending.bitmap = CreateDIBSection(
        pending.dc, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
    if (!pending.bitmap || !bits)
        return nullptr;
    HGDIOBJ oldBitmap = SelectObject(pending.dc, pending.bitmap);
    if (!oldBitmap || oldBitmap == HGDI_ERROR)
        return nullptr;
    memset(bits, 0, static_cast<size_t>(cacheSize) * cacheSize * 4);
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
    RECT brc = {0, 0, cacheSize, cacheSize};
    if (FAILED(CreateRoundedSelectionTileRenderTarget(
            pending.dc, &brc, &pRT)))
        return nullptr;
    D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT rr = D2D1::RoundedRect(
        D2D1::RectF(0, 0, static_cast<float>(cacheSize),
            static_cast<float>(cacheSize)), radius, radius);
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> br;
    if (FAILED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(fill, &br)) || !br)
        return nullptr;

    float bandTop = 0.f;
    float bandBottom = 0.f;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1LinearGradientBrush> shadowBrush;
    if (shadowAlpha > 0.f) {
        // DC render targets have no blur effect (no ID2D1DeviceContext), so
        // the "blur" is faked with a linear gradient: transparent at the top
        // of the band, peaking only at the very last pixel -- reads as a
        // thin, soft-edged line rather than a flat band.
        bandTop = static_cast<float>(cacheSize) - LV_SHADOW_BAND_H * scale;
        bandBottom = static_cast<float>(cacheSize);
        D2D1_GRADIENT_STOP stops[2] = {
            { 0.f, D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f) },
            { 1.f, D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, shadowAlpha) },
        };
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GradientStopCollection> sc;
        if (FAILED(pRT->CreateGradientStopCollection(stops, 2, &sc)) || !sc ||
            FAILED(pRT->CreateLinearGradientBrush(
                D2D1::LinearGradientBrushProperties(
                    D2D1::Point2F(0, bandTop),
                    D2D1::Point2F(0, bandBottom)),
                sc.Get(), &shadowBrush)) || !shadowBrush)
            return nullptr;
    }

    pRT->BeginDraw();
    pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(rr, br.Get());
    if (shadowBrush) {
        D2D1_RECT_F bandClip = D2D1::RectF(
            0, bandTop, static_cast<float>(cacheSize), bandBottom);
        pRT->PushAxisAlignedClip(
            bandClip, D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_PER_PRIMITIVE);
        pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(rr, shadowBrush.Get());
        pRT->PopAxisAlignedClip();
    }
    const HRESULT drawHr = pRT->EndDraw();
    if (FAILED(drawHr))
        return nullptr;

    pending.size = cacheSize;
    pending.margin = cacheMargin;
    return LvCachePublish(cache, key, std::move(pending));
}

// Resolves the ring's stroke color: the accent color normally, or solid
// white/black when the item is the keyboard-focused one (see
// IsKeyboardFocusedItemRect) -- mirrors the white/black modern focus outline
// used everywhere else (buttons, combos, TreeView, tabs) instead of layering
// a second, differently-colored indicator on top of the existing ring.
static D2D1_COLOR_F GetSelectionRingColor(bool dark, bool focusedRing)
{
    // FocusVisualPrimaryBrush: white in dark, #E4000000 in light.
    if (focusedRing)
        return dark ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f) : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0xE4 / 255.f);
    const COLORREF ac = GetAccentIndicator();
    return D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(ac) / 255.f, GetGValue(ac) / 255.f, GetBValue(ac) / 255.f, 1.f);
}

// Bakes outside-shell-context fill + ring into a per-thread, DPI-keyed
// 9-grid tile. Ring tiles grow at 200% DPI, when the scaled 4.5-DIP corner
// no longer fits the compact default tile margin.
static RoundedSelectionTile* LvBorderCacheEnsure(
    HDC hdc, int idx, D2D1_COLOR_F fill, D2D1_COLOR_F ringColor,
    bool isTreeView, UINT dpi)
{
    if (!g_d2dFactory || idx < 0 || idx >= LV_CACHE_SLOTS)
        return nullptr;

    D2DThreadCache* cache = LvCacheGetThreadCache();
    if (!cache)
        return nullptr;
    const uint64_t variant = PackRoundedSelectionColor(fill) |
        (static_cast<uint64_t>(PackRoundedSelectionColor(ringColor)) << 32);
    const RoundedSelectionTileKey key{
        static_cast<UINT>(idx), dpi, variant};
    if (RoundedSelectionTile* tile = LvCacheFind(cache, key))
        return tile;

    const float scale = (float)dpi / 96.f;
    const float outerRadius = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale;
    const int cacheMargin = (std::max)(LV_CACHE_MARGIN,
        static_cast<int>(std::ceil(outerRadius)));
    const int cacheSize = (std::max)(LV_CACHE_SZ, cacheMargin * 2 + 8);
    RoundedSelectionTile pending;
    pending.dc = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
    if (!pending.dc)
        return nullptr;
    BITMAPINFO bi = {}; bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = cacheSize; bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -cacheSize;
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1; bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    void* bits = nullptr;
    pending.bitmap = CreateDIBSection(
        pending.dc, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
    if (!pending.bitmap || !bits)
        return nullptr;
    HGDIOBJ oldBitmap = SelectObject(pending.dc, pending.bitmap);
    if (!oldBitmap || oldBitmap == HGDI_ERROR)
        return nullptr;
    memset(bits, 0, static_cast<size_t>(cacheSize) * cacheSize * 4);
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
    RECT brc = {0, 0, cacheSize, cacheSize};
    if (FAILED(CreateRoundedSelectionTileRenderTarget(
            pending.dc, &brc, &pRT)))
        return nullptr;

    // Whole device pixels, like XAML's layout rounding of the 2-DIP border.
    const float stroke     = (std::max)(1.f, std::round(2.f * scale));
    const float ringInset  = stroke * 0.5f;
    const float ringRadius = (outerRadius > ringInset) ? (outerRadius - ringInset) : 1.f;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> fillBr;
    if (FAILED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(fill, &fillBr)) || !fillBr)
        return nullptr;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> ringBr;
    if (FAILED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(ringColor, &ringBr)) || !ringBr)
        return nullptr;

    // Ringed items use the same 4-DIP silhouette for fill and outline.
    // Account for the destination expansion baked into the cached bordered
    // variant so the fill still lands on pRect.
    const float fillPadX = isTreeView
        ? (float)((std::max)(1, MulDiv(2, (int)dpi, 96)) + 1)
        : 0.f;
    const float fillPadY = isTreeView ? 0.f : static_cast<float>(dpi) / 192.f;
    const D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT fillRr = D2D1::RoundedRect(
        D2D1::RectF(fillPadX, fillPadY,
            (float)cacheSize - fillPadX,
            (float)cacheSize - fillPadY),
        outerRadius, outerRadius);

    pRT->BeginDraw();
    pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(fillRr, fillBr.Get());

    if (ringColor.a > 0.f) {
        pRT->DrawRoundedRectangle(
            D2D1::RoundedRect(
                D2D1::RectF(ringInset, ringInset, (float)cacheSize - ringInset, (float)cacheSize - ringInset),
                ringRadius, ringRadius),
            ringBr.Get(), stroke);
    }
    // Keyboard-focus slots carry the focus visual's 1px inner line; the
    // opaque white ring is the dark theme's, black the light theme's.
    if (idx >= LV_FOCUS_BORDER_CACHE_BASE) {
        const float innerStroke = (std::max)(1.f, std::round(scale));
        const float innerInset = stroke + innerStroke * 0.5f;
        const float innerRadius = (outerRadius > innerInset) ? (outerRadius - innerInset) : 1.f;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> innerBr;
        if (SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(
                GetFocusVisualInnerColor(ringColor.r > 0.5f), &innerBr)) && innerBr) {
            pRT->DrawRoundedRectangle(
                D2D1::RoundedRect(
                    D2D1::RectF(innerInset, innerInset, (float)cacheSize - innerInset, (float)cacheSize - innerInset),
                    innerRadius, innerRadius),
                innerBr.Get(), innerStroke);
        }
    }
    const HRESULT drawHr = pRT->EndDraw();
    if (FAILED(drawHr))
        return nullptr;

    pending.size = cacheSize;
    pending.margin = cacheMargin;
    return LvCachePublish(cache, key, std::move(pending));
}

// 9-grid stretch with alpha — corners preserved, middle stretched
static void LvCacheDraw(
    HDC hdc, LPCRECT dst, const RoundedSelectionTile& tile,
    BYTE opacity = 255)
{
    if (!hdc || !dst || !tile.dc || !opacity)
        return;

    int dw = dst->right - dst->left, dh = dst->bottom - dst->top;
    if (dw <= 0 || dh <= 0)
        return;
    int m = tile.margin;
    int S = tile.size;
    if (m <= 0 || S <= m * 2)
        return;
    BLENDFUNCTION bf = {AC_SRC_OVER, 0, opacity, AC_SRC_ALPHA};
    if (dw < m * 2 || dh < m * 2) {
        AlphaBlend(hdc, dst->left, dst->top, dw, dh,
            tile.dc, 0, 0, S, S, bf);
        return;
    }
    AlphaBlend(hdc, dst->left, dst->top, m, m, tile.dc, 0, 0, m, m, bf);
    AlphaBlend(hdc, dst->right - m, dst->top, m, m, tile.dc, S - m, 0, m, m, bf);
    AlphaBlend(hdc, dst->left, dst->bottom - m, m, m, tile.dc, 0, S - m, m, m, bf);
    AlphaBlend(hdc, dst->right - m, dst->bottom - m, m, m, tile.dc, S - m, S - m, m, m, bf);
    AlphaBlend(hdc, dst->left + m, dst->top, dw - 2*m, m, tile.dc, m, 0, S - 2*m, m, bf);
    AlphaBlend(hdc, dst->left + m, dst->bottom - m, dw - 2*m, m, tile.dc, m, S - m, S - 2*m, m, bf);
    AlphaBlend(hdc, dst->left, dst->top + m, m, dh - 2*m, tile.dc, 0, m, m, S - 2*m, bf);
    AlphaBlend(hdc, dst->right - m, dst->top + m, m, dh - 2*m, tile.dc, S - m, m, m, S - 2*m, bf);
    AlphaBlend(hdc, dst->left + m, dst->top + m, dw - 2*m, dh - 2*m,
               tile.dc, m, m, S - 2*m, S - 2*m, bf);
}

static HWND GetPaintHwndFromDC(HDC hdc)
{
    HWND hwnd = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (!hwnd)
        hwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
    return hwnd;
}

// Bordered-pill selection style used for controls living outside their
// native shell context: a nav-pane-style TreeView not hosted in Explorer's
// own namespace tree, or a ListView not hosted in a real shell folder view
// (Explorer or a common file picker). Third-party apps get the accent
// border instead of Explorer's plain filled selection.
static bool ShouldDrawSelectionBorder(HWND hwnd, bool isTreeView)
{
    if (!hwnd) return false;
    return isTreeView ? !GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(hwnd) : !IsInsideShellFolderView(hwnd);
}

// Details/list/small-icon rows as opposed to icon and tile items: judged by
// height, since tiles are as wide as rows.
static bool IsCompactListItemRect(LPCRECT rect, UINT dpi)
{
    if (!rect)
        return false;
    const int height = rect->bottom - rect->top;
    return height > 0 && height < MulDiv(40, (int)dpi, 96);
}

// True when *pRect exactly matches the control's own keyboard-focused item
// (TVGN_CARET / LVNI_FOCUSED) and focus indicators are currently visible
// (NavFocusCuesVisible) -- i.e. reached via Tab/arrow-key navigation, not a
// mouse click. Used to recolor an already-drawn accent ring on focus instead
// of layering a second outline on top of it (see DrawFocusRect_hook).
// Defined later in the file, alongside the LVM_GETNEXTITEM_/LVNI_FOCUSED_
// constants it needs.
static bool IsKeyboardFocusedItemRect(HWND hwnd, LPCRECT pRect, bool isTreeView);

static int GetSelectionBorderOuterPaddingX(HWND hwnd)
{
    const UINT dpi = DpiForPaint(hwnd);
    const int padding = MulDiv(2, dpi, 96);
    return padding > 1 ? padding : 1;
}

// ListView items sit right next to their horizontal clip boundary (see the
// clip setup in DrawRoundedItemBg), so this must stay small enough that the
// border stroke's outer edge doesn't fall outside the clipped region -- the
// TreeView padding above (2dpi units) is wide enough to clip into the border
// itself, cutting it off on the sides.
static int GetListSelectionBorderOuterPaddingX(HWND hwnd)
{
    const UINT dpi = DpiForPaint(hwnd);
    const int padding = MulDiv(1, dpi, 96);
    return padding > 1 ? padding : 1;
}

static int GetSelectionBorderOuterPaddingY(HWND hwnd)
{
    const UINT dpi = DpiForPaint(hwnd);
    const int padding = MulDiv(1, dpi, 96);
    return padding > 1 ? padding : 1;
}

// Half of GetSelectionBorderOuterPaddingY's coefficient. Uses plain
// truncating division (not MulDiv's round-half-up) so the 0.5 reduction is
// real at 100% DPI instead of rounding straight back up to the same value.
static int GetListSelectionBorderOuterPaddingY(HWND hwnd)
{
    const UINT dpi = DpiForPaint(hwnd);
    return (int)(dpi / 192);
}

static float GetBorderedSelectionFillAlpha(bool dark, bool neutral, bool outsideExplorerPicker)
{
    if (neutral)
        return outsideExplorerPicker ? (dark ? 0.07f : 0.05f) : (dark ? 0.05f : 0.035f);

    return outsideExplorerPicker ? (dark ? 0.11f : 0.075f) : (dark ? 0.08f : 0.055f);
}

static void DrawSelectionBorder(ID2D1RenderTarget* pRT, FLOAT w, FLOAT h, FLOAT padX, HWND hwnd,
    D2D1_COLOR_F ringColor, bool focusVisual, bool dark)
{
    if (!pRT || w <= 0.f || h <= 0.f || ringColor.a <= 0.f)
        return;

    const UINT dpi = DpiForPaint(hwnd);
    const FLOAT scale = (FLOAT)dpi / 96.f;
    const FLOAT stroke = (std::max)(1.f, std::round(2.f * scale));
    const FLOAT inset = stroke * 0.5f;
    const FLOAT outerRadius = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale;
    const FLOAT radius = (outerRadius > inset) ? (outerRadius - inset) : 1.f;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> borderBr;
    if (FAILED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(ringColor, &borderBr))) {
        return;
    }

    pRT->DrawRoundedRectangle(
        D2D1::RoundedRect(
            D2D1::RectF(padX + inset, inset, w - padX - inset, h - inset),
            radius, radius),
        borderBr.Get(), stroke);
    if (focusVisual) {
        const FLOAT innerStroke = (std::max)(1.f, std::round(scale));
        const FLOAT innerInset = stroke + innerStroke * 0.5f;
        const FLOAT innerRadius = (outerRadius > innerInset) ? (outerRadius - innerInset) : 1.f;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> innerBr;
        if (SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(GetFocusVisualInnerColor(dark), &innerBr))) {
            pRT->DrawRoundedRectangle(
                D2D1::RoundedRect(
                    D2D1::RectF(padX + innerInset, innerInset, w - padX - innerInset, h - innerInset),
                    innerRadius, innerRadius),
                innerBr.Get(), innerStroke);
        }
    }
}

// GetCursorPos/ScreenToClient cached per (hwnd, tick) -- this is called once
// per visible row via DrawRoundedItemBg, so a ~30-item nav pane repainting
// while the left button is held (drag, press-and-hold) would otherwise redo
// the same cursor query ~30 times per frame. GetTickCount()'s ~10-16ms
// resolution means every item painted within one repaint sees the same tick
// and reuses a single cached query; a tick advancing or a different
// window's items starting to paint invalidates it.
//
// GetKeyState(VK_LBUTTON) below is deliberately NOT part of this cache and
// always read fresh, unlike the position: it's effectively free (no real
// syscall, just a read of the thread's already-attached input state), and
// caching it caused a real regression -- an unrelated repaint (e.g. a hover
// fade tick) landing in the same ~15ms tick window as the actual
// WM_LBUTTONDOWN-triggered repaint could populate the cache with a stale
// "not pressed" reading moments before the press, which then got reused for
// the real press's own paint instead of re-checking the button, making the
// pressed state silently fail to activate.
struct TreeItemPressedCache {
    DWORD tick = 0;
    HWND hwnd = nullptr;
    POINT clientPt = {};
    bool havePt = false;
};
static thread_local TreeItemPressedCache s_treeItemPressedCache;

// Keep the pressed visual visible briefly after mouse-up, matching the more
// legible WinUI feedback without delaying TreeView selection or activation.
// A mouse can only press one HWND at a time on a UI thread, so thread-local
// state is sufficient and makes the idle paint path a single null check.
// The timer is one-shot in practice: it exists only during the post-release
// hold and is killed when the state is cleared.
struct TreePressedHoldState {
    HWND hwnd = nullptr;
    HTREEITEM item = nullptr;
    POINT clientPt = {};
    RECT invalidateRect = {};
    ULONGLONG holdUntil = 0;
    bool trackingPress = false;
    bool holding = false;
    bool selectedAtPress = false;
};

static thread_local TreePressedHoldState s_treePressedHoldState;
static constexpr UINT kTreePressedHoldDurationMs = 84;
static int g_treePressedHoldTimerTag;

static UINT_PTR TreePressedHoldTimerId()
{
    return reinterpret_cast<UINT_PTR>(&g_treePressedHoldTimerTag);
}

static bool TreePressedHoldHitTest(HWND hwnd, LPARAM lParam,
                                  HTREEITEM* item, POINT* clientPt,
                                  RECT* invalidateRect)
{
    if (!hwnd || !item || !clientPt || !invalidateRect)
        return false;

    TVHITTESTINFO hit = {};
    hit.pt.x = static_cast<SHORT>(LOWORD(lParam));
    hit.pt.y = static_cast<SHORT>(HIWORD(lParam));
    const HTREEITEM hitItem = TreeView_HitTest(hwnd, &hit);
    if (!hitItem || (hit.flags & TVHT_NOWHERE))
        return false;

    RECT rect = {};
    if (!TreeView_GetItemRect(hwnd, hitItem, &rect, FALSE))
        return false;

    *item = hitItem;
    *clientPt = hit.pt;
    *invalidateRect = rect;
    return true;
}

static void TreePressedHoldReset(HWND hwnd, bool invalidate)
{
    TreePressedHoldState& state = s_treePressedHoldState;
    if (!state.hwnd || (hwnd && state.hwnd != hwnd))
        return;

    KillTimer(state.hwnd, TreePressedHoldTimerId());
    if (invalidate && IsWindow(state.hwnd) &&
        !IsRectEmpty(&state.invalidateRect)) {
        InvalidateRect(state.hwnd, &state.invalidateRect, FALSE);
    }
    state = {};
}

static void TreePressedHoldCancelVisible(HWND hwnd, bool invalidate)
{
    const TreePressedHoldState& state = s_treePressedHoldState;
    if (state.hwnd != hwnd || !state.holding)
        return;
    // EnsureVisible and layout messages also arrive after clicking the
    // current selection. Cancel only if the held row really moved/disappeared.
    RECT currentRect = {};
    if (!TreeView_GetItemRect(hwnd, state.item, &currentRect, FALSE) ||
        !EqualRect(&state.invalidateRect, &currentRect)) {
        TreePressedHoldReset(hwnd, invalidate);
    }
}

static void TreePressedHoldBegin(HWND hwnd, LPARAM lParam)
{
    TreePressedHoldReset(nullptr, true);

    HTREEITEM item = nullptr;
    POINT point = {};
    RECT rect = {};
    if (!TreePressedHoldHitTest(hwnd, lParam, &item, &point, &rect)) {
        return;
    }

    s_treePressedHoldState.hwnd = hwnd;
    s_treePressedHoldState.item = item;
    s_treePressedHoldState.clientPt = point;
    s_treePressedHoldState.invalidateRect = rect;
    s_treePressedHoldState.selectedAtPress =
        (TreeView_GetItemState(hwnd, item, TVIS_SELECTED) & TVIS_SELECTED) != 0;
    s_treePressedHoldState.trackingPress = true;
}

static void TreePressedHoldCommit(HWND hwnd, LPARAM lParam)
{
    TreePressedHoldState& state = s_treePressedHoldState;
    if (state.hwnd != hwnd || !state.trackingPress) {
        return;
    }

    HTREEITEM item = nullptr;
    POINT point = {};
    RECT rect = {};
    if (!TreePressedHoldHitTest(hwnd, lParam, &item, &point, &rect) ||
        item != state.item) {
        TreePressedHoldReset(hwnd, true);
        return;
    }

    state.clientPt = point;
    state.invalidateRect = rect;
    state.trackingPress = false;
    state.holding = true;
    state.holdUntil = GetTickCount64() + kTreePressedHoldDurationMs;
    if (!SetTimer(hwnd, TreePressedHoldTimerId(),
                  kTreePressedHoldDurationMs, nullptr)) {
        TreePressedHoldReset(hwnd, true);
        return;
    }
    InvalidateRect(hwnd, &state.invalidateRect, FALSE);
}

static void TreePressedHoldCommitFromCursor(HWND hwnd)
{
    POINT point = {};
    if (!GetCursorPos(&point) || !ScreenToClient(hwnd, &point)) {
        TreePressedHoldReset(hwnd, true);
        return;
    }

    TreePressedHoldCommit(
        hwnd,
        MAKELPARAM(static_cast<WORD>(static_cast<SHORT>(point.x)),
                   static_cast<WORD>(static_cast<SHORT>(point.y))));
}

static void TreePressedHoldInvalidateItem(HWND hwnd, HTREEITEM item)
{
    const TreePressedHoldState& state = s_treePressedHoldState;
    if (state.hwnd == hwnd && state.item == item)
        TreePressedHoldReset(hwnd, true);
}

static void TreePressedHoldTimerTick(HWND hwnd)
{
    TreePressedHoldState& state = s_treePressedHoldState;
    if (state.hwnd != hwnd || !state.holding) {
        KillTimer(hwnd, TreePressedHoldTimerId());
        return;
    }

    const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
    if (now < state.holdUntil) {
        const UINT remaining = static_cast<UINT>(state.holdUntil - now);
        SetTimer(hwnd, TreePressedHoldTimerId(), (std::max)(1u, remaining), nullptr);
        return;
    }
    TreePressedHoldReset(hwnd, true);
}

static bool IsTreeItemPressed(HWND hwnd, LPCRECT itemRect)
{
    if (!hwnd || !itemRect)
        return false;

    if (!(GetKeyState(VK_LBUTTON) & 0x8000)) {
        TreePressedHoldState& hold = s_treePressedHoldState;
        if (hold.hwnd != hwnd ||
            (!hold.trackingPress && !hold.holding)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Explorer's TreeView consumes button-up inside its modal
        // WM_LBUTTONDOWN tracking loop and repaints selection before that
        // outer message returns. Keep the original item pressed across this
        // intermediate repaint so selected never flashes between the native
        // pressed frame and the post-release hold.
        const bool paintsHeldRow =
            itemRect->bottom > hold.invalidateRect.top &&
            itemRect->top < hold.invalidateRect.bottom;
        return paintsHeldRow &&
            PtInRect(&hold.invalidateRect, hold.clientPt) &&
            (hold.trackingPress || GetTickCount64() < hold.holdUntil);
    }

    const DWORD now = GetTickCount();
    TreeItemPressedCache& c = s_treeItemPressedCache;
    if (c.tick != now || c.hwnd != hwnd) {
        c.tick = now;
        c.hwnd = hwnd;
        POINT cursor = {};
        c.havePt = GetCursorPos(&cursor) && ScreenToClient(hwnd, &cursor);
        c.clientPt = cursor;
    }
    if (!c.havePt)
        return false;

    const TreePressedHoldState& tracked = s_treePressedHoldState;
    if (tracked.hwnd == hwnd && tracked.trackingPress) {
        // The themed background rect can omit a few pixels of the row's
        // horizontal margins/indentation even though TreeView_HitTest treats
        // that point as part of the item. Match the paint rect to the tracked
        // row vertically, but test the cursor against the full item rect that
        // came from TVM_GETITEMRECT(FALSE), so edge/icon clicks get the same
        // pressed feedback as clicks over the label.
        const bool paintsTrackedRow =
            itemRect->bottom > tracked.invalidateRect.top &&
            itemRect->top < tracked.invalidateRect.bottom;
        return paintsTrackedRow &&
               PtInRect(&tracked.invalidateRect, c.clientPt);
    }

    return PtInRect(itemRect, c.clientPt);
}

static bool IsTreeRowPressed(HWND hwnd, LPCRECT itemRect)
{
    const TreePressedHoldState& tracked = s_treePressedHoldState;
    if (!itemRect || tracked.hwnd != hwnd ||
        (!tracked.trackingPress && !tracked.holding))
        return false;
    // Label/icon/chevron rects are narrower than the clickable row. The
    // existing tracker still validates the mouse against its full item rect.
    RECT row = *itemRect;
    row.left = LONG_MIN;
    row.right = LONG_MAX;
    return IsTreeItemPressed(hwnd, &row);
}

static bool TreePressedFillSelected(HWND hwnd, LPCRECT itemRect,
    bool selected, bool pressed)
{
    const TreePressedHoldState& hold = s_treePressedHoldState;
    if (!pressed || !itemRect || hold.hwnd != hwnd ||
        (!hold.trackingPress && !hold.holding) ||
        itemRect->bottom <= hold.invalidateRect.top ||
        itemRect->top >= hold.invalidateRect.bottom) {
        return selected;
    }
    // Selection commits during the native release loop. Keep the original
    // pressed fill across that commit/hold, then use the live selected+hover
    // fill on release. Otherwise Pressed -> PressedSelected -> PointerOverSelected
    // flashes the normal selected fill even though hover never left the row.
    return hold.selectedAtPress;
}

static void ScaleRectAroundCenter(RECT* rect, float scale)
{
    if (!rect || scale >= 1.f)
        return;

    const int width = rect->right - rect->left;
    const int height = rect->bottom - rect->top;
    const int insetX = std::max(
        0, static_cast<int>(std::lround(width * (1.f - scale) * 0.5f)));
    const int insetY = std::max(
        0, static_cast<int>(std::lround(height * (1.f - scale) * 0.5f)));
    if (width > insetX * 2) {
        rect->left += insetX;
        rect->right -= insetX;
    }
    if (height > insetY * 2) {
        rect->top += insetY;
        rect->bottom -= insetY;
    }
}

// Alpha-fade-in for the outside-context bordered-pill selection style (see
// ShouldDrawSelectionBorder) -- same smoothstep-progress/16ms-timer strategy
// as NavHoverFadeState, but single-shot (0->1 only, no reverse). Shared
// between ListView (keyed by the item's real LVM_HITTEST index -- a rect key
// breaks on scroll, since the same item gets a new key at its shifted
// position and wrongly restarts) and TreeView (keyed by the stable HTREEITEM
// directly, no hit-test involved -- see the TreeView branch in
// DrawRoundedItemBg's reader block). A finished entry is left parked at
// progress 1 (same as the chevron animation map) instead of erased, since the
// item stays selected across many repaints -- erasing on completion would
// make the very next repaint see no entry and restart the fade from 0,
// blinking forever. Real deselection is only ever observed via
// LVN_ITEMCHANGED (ListView) or TVN_SELCHANGEDW/A and TVN_DELETEITEM
// (TreeView) -- see ListSelectFadeInvalidateItem/ListSelectFadeResyncWindow
// -- never through the paint path itself.
struct ListSelectFadeState {
    DOUBLE startTime = 0.0;
    HWND paintHwnd = nullptr;
    HWND timerHwnd = nullptr;
    RECT rect = {};
    // Whether this entry is still counted in g_lvSelectFadeActiveCount --
    // cleared exactly once, the first time the timer tick observes its
    // progress reach 1, so the counter never double-decrements.
    bool activeCounted = false;
};

static constexpr UINT kListSelectFadeTimerId = 0x5E1EC7;
static constexpr UINT kListSelectFadeTimerIntervalMs = 16;
static constexpr DOUBLE kListSelectFadeDurationSeconds = 0.14;
static constexpr UINT kListSelectFadeHitTestMsg = 0x1000 + 18; // LVM_HITTEST
// Explorer runs one UI thread per browser window (and dialogs commonly get
// their own thread too), so although each *window's* own messages are always
// serialized on its own thread, these containers are process-global -- two
// list/tree views on different threads can still insert into/rehash the same
// unordered_map concurrently. g_lvSelectFadeMutex guards every access to the
// globals below. Never hold it across a cross-thread
// SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread/RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread call --
// same deadlock shape documented on g_checkAnimsMutex/CheckAnims_Cleanup.
static std::recursive_mutex g_lvSelectFadeMutex;
static std::unordered_map<ULONG_PTR, ListSelectFadeState> g_lvSelectFadeAnims;
// Reverse index (which keys belong to which window) so a per-window
// operation -- LVN_DELETEITEM's wipe, ResyncWindow's prune -- doesn't have
// to scan every entry in the process, just this window's own.
static std::unordered_map<HWND, std::unordered_set<ULONG_PTR>> g_lvSelectFadeKeysByWindow;
// Separate reverse index for each root timer host. A timer tick can therefore
// touch only its own window's fades instead of scanning every process entry.
static std::unordered_map<HWND, std::unordered_set<ULONG_PTR>>
    g_lvSelectFadeKeysByTimerHost;
// One independent timer/subclass host per root window that has ever needed
// one -- NOT a single global slot retargeted between windows. Retargeting
// meant releasing the *previous* host's subclass from whichever thread was
// installing the new one: a blocking cross-thread
// RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread call made synchronously from inside
// SendMessageW_hook's LVN_ITEMCHANGED handling, which could freeze window
// B's click on window A's thread for as long as A's thread was busy. Each
// host now manages its own timer independently and self-removes on its own
// WM_NCDESTROY; only Wh_ModUninit tears every host down explicitly, with
// the copy-then-release shape used elsewhere in the file.
static std::unordered_set<HWND> g_lvSelectFadeTimerHosts;
// Count of entries still actively fading (progress < 1). DrawRoundedItemBg
// gates its whole per-paint lookup behind this being nonzero -- the ListView
// LVM_HITTEST call and the TreeView map lookup alike -- once every fade has
// settled it's back to 0, so a selected item just sitting there (the common
// case, including a first/last item during an unrelated later scroll) costs
// zero SendMessage calls per paint, not one per repaint forever.
static int g_lvSelectFadeActiveCount = 0;

// Callers below already hold g_lvSelectFadeMutex.
static void ListSelectFadeMarkComplete(ListSelectFadeState& state)
{
    if (!state.activeCounted)
        return;
    state.activeCounted = false;
    if (g_lvSelectFadeActiveCount > 0)
        --g_lvSelectFadeActiveCount;
}

// Callers below already hold g_lvSelectFadeMutex.
static void ListSelectFadeTrackKey(
    const ListSelectFadeState& state, ULONG_PTR key)
{
    g_lvSelectFadeKeysByWindow[state.paintHwnd].insert(key);
    g_lvSelectFadeKeysByTimerHost[state.timerHwnd].insert(key);
}

static void ListSelectFadeUntrackKey(
    const ListSelectFadeState& state, ULONG_PTR key)
{
    auto winIt = g_lvSelectFadeKeysByWindow.find(state.paintHwnd);
    if (winIt != g_lvSelectFadeKeysByWindow.end()) {
        winIt->second.erase(key);
        if (winIt->second.empty())
            g_lvSelectFadeKeysByWindow.erase(winIt);
    }

    auto hostIt = g_lvSelectFadeKeysByTimerHost.find(state.timerHwnd);
    if (hostIt != g_lvSelectFadeKeysByTimerHost.end()) {
        hostIt->second.erase(key);
        if (hostIt->second.empty())
            g_lvSelectFadeKeysByTimerHost.erase(hostIt);
    }
}

// itemId is a ListView index (cast through (UINT) at the call site) or a
// TreeView HTREEITEM's raw pointer value -- either way just opaque bits to
// hash, disambiguated by hwnd since the two controls never share a map entry.
static ULONG_PTR ListSelectFadeKey(HWND hwnd, ULONG_PTR itemId)
{
    return ((ULONG_PTR)hwnd) ^ ((itemId + 1) * 2654435761ull);
}

// Resolves the real item index under pRect's center the same way the OS
// itself would hit-test it -- pRect is already the exact bounding rect
// DrawThemeBackground handed us for this item, so its center reliably lands
// inside that item's own cell regardless of view mode (report/list/icon).
static int ListSelectFadeHitTestItem(HWND hwnd, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!hwnd || !pRect)
        return -1;

    LVHITTESTINFO ht = {};
    ht.pt.x = (pRect->left + pRect->right) / 2;
    ht.pt.y = (pRect->top + pRect->bottom) / 2;
    return (int)SendMessageW(hwnd, kListSelectFadeHitTestMsg, 0, (LPARAM)&ht);
}

static float ListSelectFadeProgress(const ListSelectFadeState& state, DOUBLE now)
{
    if (state.startTime <= 0.0)
        return 1.f;

    const DOUBLE elapsed = now - state.startTime;
    if (elapsed <= 0.0)
        return 0.f;
    if (elapsed >= kListSelectFadeDurationSeconds)
        return 1.f;

    float t = static_cast<float>(elapsed / kListSelectFadeDurationSeconds);
    return t * t * (3.f - 2.f * t);
}

// When this thread's fade timer last ran, and when a paint last stood in for
// it (ListSelectFadeKickFromPaint).
static thread_local DOUBLE t_listSelectFadeLastTick = 0.0;
static thread_local DOUBLE t_listSelectFadeLastKick = 0.0;

static LRESULT CALLBACK ListSelectFadeSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_TIMER && wp == kListSelectFadeTimerId) {
        DOUBLE now = TimerGetSeconds();
        t_listSelectFadeLastTick = now;

        // Rects to invalidate are collected under the lock and fired off
        // after releasing it -- InvalidateRect itself doesn't need the
        // lock, and keeping the critical section short matters here since
        // this runs on every timer tick while any selection is fading.
        struct PendingInvalidate { HWND hwnd; RECT rect; };
        std::vector<PendingInvalidate> pending;
        bool anyFading = false;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_lvSelectFadeMutex);
            auto hostIt = g_lvSelectFadeKeysByTimerHost.find(hwnd);
            std::vector<ULONG_PTR> keys;
            if (hostIt != g_lvSelectFadeKeysByTimerHost.end())
                keys.assign(hostIt->second.begin(), hostIt->second.end());

            for (ULONG_PTR key : keys) {
                auto it = g_lvSelectFadeAnims.find(key);
                if (it == g_lvSelectFadeAnims.end())
                    continue;
                auto& state = it->second;
                if (!state.paintHwnd || !IsWindow(state.paintHwnd)) {
                    ListSelectFadeMarkComplete(state);
                    ListSelectFadeUntrackKey(state, key);
                    g_lvSelectFadeAnims.erase(it);
                    continue;
                }

                const float progress = ListSelectFadeProgress(state, now);
                if (progress >= 1.f) {
                    // WM_TIMER only comes with an empty queue, so a marquee
                    // drag can starve every tick of a fade, and the parts of
                    // the item it repaints carry whatever opacity the fade
                    // had then. Repaint the whole item once at its final one.
                    if (state.activeCounted && state.rect.right > state.rect.left) {
                        RECT inv = state.rect;
                        const int margin = GetSelectionBorderOuterPaddingX(state.paintHwnd);
                        InflateRect(&inv, margin, margin);
                        pending.push_back({state.paintHwnd, inv});
                    }
                    ListSelectFadeMarkComplete(state);
                } else {
                    anyFading = true;
                    // state.rect is kept fresh by DrawRoundedItemBg on every
                    // real paint during this active window (the InvalidateRect
                    // below is what drives those paints), so it doesn't need a
                    // live re-fetch here. It IS inflated by a safety margin
                    // before invalidating, though: the border draw expands its
                    // destination rect outward past pRect for the cross-axis
                    // bleed effect (extraX for TreeView, extraY for ListView),
                    // but InvalidateRect also sets the clip region for the next
                    // paint -- invalidating the raw, un-inflated rect would
                    // permanently clip that bleed off every repaint this timer
                    // drives, cutting the border's edges. GetSelectionBorderOuterPaddingX
                    // is the larger of the two axis paddings, so using it on all
                    // four sides is a safe, generous margin regardless of which
                    // control type/axis actually needs it.
                    if (state.rect.right > state.rect.left) {
                        RECT inv = state.rect;
                        const int margin = GetSelectionBorderOuterPaddingX(state.paintHwnd);
                        InflateRect(&inv, margin, margin);
                        pending.push_back({state.paintHwnd, inv});
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (const auto& p : pending)
            InvalidateRect(p.hwnd, &p.rect, FALSE);

        if (!anyFading)
            KillTimer(hwnd, kListSelectFadeTimerId);
        return 0;
    }

    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_lvSelectFadeMutex);
            auto hostIt = g_lvSelectFadeKeysByTimerHost.find(hwnd);
            std::vector<ULONG_PTR> keys;
            if (hostIt != g_lvSelectFadeKeysByTimerHost.end())
                keys.assign(hostIt->second.begin(), hostIt->second.end());
            for (ULONG_PTR key : keys) {
                auto it = g_lvSelectFadeAnims.find(key);
                if (it != g_lvSelectFadeAnims.end()) {
                    ListSelectFadeMarkComplete(it->second);
                    ListSelectFadeUntrackKey(it->second, key);
                    g_lvSelectFadeAnims.erase(it);
                }
            }
            g_lvSelectFadeKeysByTimerHost.erase(hwnd);
            g_lvSelectFadeTimerHosts.erase(hwnd);
        }
        KillTimer(hwnd, kListSelectFadeTimerId);
        // No manual RemoveWindowSubclass here: this proc is installed via
        // WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread, whose
        // SubclassProcWrapper already removes itself on WM_NCDESTROY before
        // forwarding the message to us.
    }

    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

static HWND ListSelectFadeTimerHwnd(HWND paintHwnd)
{
    if (!paintHwnd || !IsWindow(paintHwnd))
        return nullptr;

    HWND root = GetAncestor(paintHwnd, GA_ROOT);
    return (root && IsWindow(root)) ? root : paintHwnd;
}

static bool ListSelectFadeEnsureTimer(HWND timerHwnd)
{
    if (!timerHwnd || !IsWindow(timerHwnd))
        return false;

    // timerHwnd is GetAncestor(hwndFrom, GA_ROOT), always on hwndFrom's own
    // thread, so the subclass install below always takes
    // SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread's same-thread fast path -- no blocking
    // cross-thread SendMessage. Each host is independent (see
    // g_lvSelectFadeTimerHosts): there's no *other* window's subclass to
    // release here, unlike the old single-global-slot design.
    bool needSubclass;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_lvSelectFadeMutex);
        needSubclass = !g_lvSelectFadeTimerHosts.count(timerHwnd);
    }

    bool installedSubclass = false;
    if (needSubclass) {
        if (!WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                timerHwnd, ListSelectFadeSubclassProc, 0))
            return false;
        installedSubclass = true;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_lvSelectFadeMutex);
            g_lvSelectFadeTimerHosts.insert(timerHwnd);
        }
    }

    // SetTimer on an already-running timer with the same ID just re-arms
    // it -- harmless, and this is only reached once per new fade (a real
    // selection change), not once per paint, so the redundant call some of
    // the time isn't worth tracking a separate "is armed" flag for.
    if (SetTimer(timerHwnd, kListSelectFadeTimerId,
            kListSelectFadeTimerIntervalMs, nullptr))
        return true;

    if (installedSubclass) {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_lvSelectFadeMutex);
            g_lvSelectFadeTimerHosts.erase(timerHwnd);
        }
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            timerHwnd, ListSelectFadeSubclassProc);
    }
    return false;
}

// WM_TIMER only comes with an empty queue, and a marquee drag keeps it full
// while repainting the list on every mouse move. A paint that draws a fade
// frame while the timer is behind asks for the next frame of every fading
// item of its window, at most once per frame interval, so the drag's own
// repaints carry the animation and an idle queue still leaves the timer room
// to take over. A fade already over gets its final frame here instead.
static void ListSelectFadeKickFromPaint(HWND hwnd, DOUBLE now)
{
    constexpr DOUBLE kFrameSeconds = 1.0 / 60.0;
    if (!hwnd || now - t_listSelectFadeLastTick < kFrameSeconds ||
        now - t_listSelectFadeLastKick < kFrameSeconds)
        return;
    t_listSelectFadeLastKick = now;

    std::vector<RECT> rects;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_lvSelectFadeMutex);
        auto winIt = g_lvSelectFadeKeysByWindow.find(hwnd);
        if (winIt == g_lvSelectFadeKeysByWindow.end())
            return;
        for (ULONG_PTR key : winIt->second) {
            auto it = g_lvSelectFadeAnims.find(key);
            if (it == g_lvSelectFadeAnims.end() || !it->second.activeCounted ||
                it->second.rect.right <= it->second.rect.left)
                continue;
            rects.push_back(it->second.rect);
            if (ListSelectFadeProgress(it->second, now) >= 1.f)
                ListSelectFadeMarkComplete(it->second);
        }
    }
    const int margin = GetSelectionBorderOuterPaddingX(hwnd);
    for (RECT& rect : rects) {
        InflateRect(&rect, margin, margin);
        InvalidateRect(hwnd, &rect, FALSE);
    }
}

// Called from SendMessageW_hook's LVN_ITEMCHANGED interception for a clean
// per-item selection (iItem >= 0, LVIS_SELECTED actually gained) -- the sole
// place a ListSelectFade entry is created. Paint (DrawRoundedItemBg) only
// ever reads an existing entry's progress; it never creates one, since that
// would mean an LVM_HITTEST lookup on every single paint of a selected item
// (not just while it's actively fading) -- see g_lvSelectFadeActiveCount.
// Inserts the fade entry and arms the timer for an item the caller has
// already confirmed eligible (SysAnimationsEnabled + ShouldDrawSelectionBorder).
// Used directly by ListSelectFadeResyncWindow, which validates both once for
// the whole batch instead of paying ShouldDrawSelectionBorder's ancestor walk
// again per selected item.
static void ListSelectFadeStartItemUnchecked(HWND hwndFrom, ULONG_PTR itemId)
{
    const HWND timerHwnd = ListSelectFadeTimerHwnd(hwndFrom);
    if (!timerHwnd)
        return;
    const ULONG_PTR key = ListSelectFadeKey(hwndFrom, itemId);
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_lvSelectFadeMutex);
        if (g_lvSelectFadeAnims.find(key) != g_lvSelectFadeAnims.end())
            return;

        ListSelectFadeState st;
        st.startTime = TimerGetSeconds();
        st.paintHwnd = hwndFrom;
        st.timerHwnd = timerHwnd;
        st.activeCounted = true;
        auto [it, inserted] = g_lvSelectFadeAnims.emplace(key, st);
        if (!inserted)
            return;
        ListSelectFadeTrackKey(it->second, key);
        ++g_lvSelectFadeActiveCount;
    }
    if (!ListSelectFadeEnsureTimer(timerHwnd)) {
        // Timer failed to install (e.g. SetWindowSubclass exhausted) --
        // nothing will ever advance or complete this entry, so undo the
        // insert instead of leaking an active-but-frozen fade forever.
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_lvSelectFadeMutex);
        auto it = g_lvSelectFadeAnims.find(key);
        if (it != g_lvSelectFadeAnims.end()) {
            ListSelectFadeMarkComplete(it->second);
            ListSelectFadeUntrackKey(it->second, key);
            g_lvSelectFadeAnims.erase(it);
        }
    }
}

static void ListSelectFadeStartItem(HWND hwndFrom, ULONG_PTR itemId, bool isTreeView)
{
    if (!hwndFrom || !RoundedSelectionVisualsEnabled() ||
        !SysAnimationsEnabled() ||
        !ShouldDrawSelectionBorder(hwndFrom, isTreeView))
        return;
    ListSelectFadeStartItemUnchecked(hwndFrom, itemId);
}

static void ListSelectFadeCleanup()
{
    std::vector<HWND> hosts;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_lvSelectFadeMutex);
        g_lvSelectFadeActiveCount = 0;
        hosts.assign(g_lvSelectFadeTimerHosts.begin(), g_lvSelectFadeTimerHosts.end());
        g_lvSelectFadeTimerHosts.clear();
        g_lvSelectFadeAnims.clear();
        g_lvSelectFadeKeysByWindow.clear();
        g_lvSelectFadeKeysByTimerHost.clear();
    }
    for (HWND h : hosts) {
        if (IsWindow(h)) {
            KillTimer(h, kListSelectFadeTimerId);
            WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                h, ListSelectFadeSubclassProc);
        }
    }
}

static bool DrawRoundedItemBg(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect, INT iStateId, bool isTreeView,
    float progressOverride)
{
    if (!pRect)
        return false;
