    int itemW = pRect->right - pRect->left, itemH = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (itemW <= 0 || itemH <= 0)
        return false;

    HWND itemHwnd = GetPaintHwndFromDC(hdc);
    NavHoverFadeState* hoverFadeState =
        isTreeView && itemHwnd
            ? NavHoverFadeGetState(itemHwnd)
            : nullptr;
    const bool isNavPaneTree = isTreeView && itemHwnd &&
        (hoverFadeState || GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(itemHwnd));
    const bool hoverFade = hoverFadeState != nullptr;
    // Only meaningful for the native hotItem call (progressOverride < 0):
    // "pressed" means the mouse is physically down inside pRect right now,
    // which only has anything to do with hotItem -- outItem is, by
    // definition, an item the cursor already left, so its own overlay call
    // (progressOverride >= 0) skips this entirely. Without that guard, a
    // still-held button from the click that triggered outItem's own leave
    // (e.g. clicking a chevron to expand, which doesn't move that row) kept
    // re-matching outItem's rect on every one of its repaints, zeroing
    // hotItem's unrelated startTime and killing the one shared timer both
    // slots depend on -- outItem's fade-out would then never resolve on its
    // own again, stuck until something else (like re-hovering it) happened
    // to overwrite the state by other means.
    const bool pressed = isNavPaneTree && progressOverride < 0.f &&
        IsTreeItemPressed(itemHwnd, pRect);
    if (pressed && hoverFadeState) {
        hoverFadeState->startTime = 0.0;
        // Only actually stop the shared timer if outItem isn't still using
        // it -- this fires for hotItem's own native call (a click landing
        // on the item it's hovering), which has nothing to do with whether
        // some *other* item is mid-fade-out via outItem.
        if (hoverFadeState->outStartTime <= 0.0)
            NavHoverFadeStopTimer(itemHwnd, hoverFadeState);
    }
    float hoverProgress = 1.f;
    if (iStateId == 2 && hoverFade) {
        hoverProgress = progressOverride >= 0.f
            ? progressOverride
            : NavHoverFadeProgressForWindow(itemHwnd);
        if (hoverProgress <= 0.001f)
            return true;
    }
    const float hoverScale =
        kNavHoverFadeInitialScale +
        (1.f - kNavHoverFadeInitialScale) * hoverProgress;

    EnsureD2DFactory();
    if (!g_d2dFactory)
        return false;

    bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    // Every list item and every TreeView item outside the nav pane gets the
    // Explorer Home tile style (GetWinUiItemFillColor): fill + 2px ring, the
    // ring accent when selected. Compact rows keep hover to the fill alone;
    // icon/tile items also get the tile's subtle hover ring.
    const bool drawBorder = itemHwnd && !isNavPaneTree;
    const bool compactItem = isTreeView ||
        IsCompactListItemRect(pRect, itemHwnd ? GetDpiForWindow(itemHwnd) : DpiForPaintHdc(hdc));
    // Keyboard-focused item (Tab/arrow nav, not mouse click) gets the focus
    // visual in place of the accent ring: white/black ring plus the 1px
    // inner line -- see IsKeyboardFocusedItemRect and DrawFocusRect_hook.
    bool focusedRing = drawBorder && g_settings.ModernFocusRect == 0 &&
        IsKeyboardFocusedItemRect(itemHwnd, pRect, isTreeView);
    D2D1_COLOR_F ringColor;
    if (focusedRing)
        ringColor = GetSelectionRingColor(dark, true);
    else if (iStateId != 2)
        ringColor = GetSelectionRingColor(dark, false);
    else if (compactItem)
        ringColor = D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f);
    else
        ringColor = GetWinUiItemFillColor(dark, 2);

    // Fade the bordered-pill in on selection (see ListSelectFade* above) --
    // the hover state is already excluded from drawBorder, so this only ever
    // triggers on a genuine selection transition. Entries are created only by
    // LVN_ITEMCHANGED/TVN_SELCHANGEDW/A (ListSelectFadeStartItem), never here:
    // this block is purely a reader, gated behind g_lvSelectFadeActiveCount so
    // a settled selection costs nothing extra per repaint.
    float selectFadeProgress = 1.f;
    if (drawBorder && iStateId != 2 && SysAnimationsEnabled()) {
        if (isTreeView) {
            // TreeView is single-select and keyed by the stable HTREEITEM
            // rather than a hit-testable index (TVM_HITTEST proved
            // unreliable here in an earlier attempt -- see the blinking bug
            // it caused). Any Selected-family iStateId paint for this window
            // during an active fade can only be for the one selected item,
            // so the sole tracked entry (if any) is read directly, no
            // hit-test needed.
            std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_lvSelectFadeMutex);
            if (g_lvSelectFadeActiveCount > 0) {
                auto winIt = g_lvSelectFadeKeysByWindow.find(itemHwnd);
                if (winIt != g_lvSelectFadeKeysByWindow.end() && !winIt->second.empty()) {
                    auto fadeIt = g_lvSelectFadeAnims.find(*winIt->second.begin());
                    if (fadeIt != g_lvSelectFadeAnims.end()) {
                        fadeIt->second.rect = *pRect;
                        selectFadeProgress = ListSelectFadeProgress(fadeIt->second, TimerGetSeconds());
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            // Only worth an LVM_HITTEST round-trip while some window has an
            // active fade -- check the (lock-protected) counter first, same
            // early-exit this block always relied on.
            bool anyActive;
            {
                std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_lvSelectFadeMutex);
                anyActive = g_lvSelectFadeActiveCount > 0;
            }
            if (anyActive) {
                const int fadeItem = ListSelectFadeHitTestItem(itemHwnd, pRect);
                const DOUBLE now = TimerGetSeconds();
                bool fading = false;
                if (fadeItem >= 0) {
                    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_lvSelectFadeMutex);
                    auto fadeIt = g_lvSelectFadeAnims.find(
                        ListSelectFadeKey(itemHwnd, (ULONG_PTR)(UINT)fadeItem));
                    if (fadeIt != g_lvSelectFadeAnims.end()) {
                        fadeIt->second.rect = *pRect;
                        selectFadeProgress = ListSelectFadeProgress(fadeIt->second, now);
                        fading = selectFadeProgress < 1.f;
                    }
                }
                if (fading)
                    ListSelectFadeKickFromPaint(itemHwnd, now);
            }
        }
    }

    float aR, aG, aB;
    if (g_settings.NeutralSelection) {
        aR = aG = aB = dark ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    } else {
        const COLORREF ac = GetAccentIndicator();
        aR = GetRValue(ac) / 255.f;
        aG = GetGValue(ac) / 255.f;
        aB = GetBValue(ac) / 255.f;
    }

    D2D1_COLOR_F fill;
    switch (iStateId) {
    case 2: case 3: case 5: case 6:
        if (drawBorder) {
            fill = GetWinUiItemFillColor(dark, iStateId);
        } else if (isNavPaneTree) {
            const bool selected = iStateId != 2;
            const bool trackedHot = hoverFadeState && hoverFadeState->hotItem &&
                pRect->bottom > hoverFadeState->rect.top &&
                pRect->top < hoverFadeState->rect.bottom;
            const bool hot = iStateId == 2 ||
                NavigationSelectedItemIsHot(iStateId,
                    hoverFadeState || NavHoverTrackingEnabled(), trackedHot);
            const WinUI::Color itemFill = NavigationItemFillColor(dark,
                g_settings.NeutralSelection, GetAccentIndicator(),
                TreePressedFillSelected(itemHwnd, pRect, selected, pressed), hot, pressed);
            fill = D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(itemFill.rgb) / 255.f,
                GetGValue(itemFill.rgb) / 255.f, GetBValue(itemFill.rgb) / 255.f,
                itemFill.alpha / 255.f);
        } else if (iStateId == 2 || iStateId == 5) {
            fill = D2D1::ColorF(aR, aG, aB, dark ? 0.08f : 0.06f);
        } else {
            fill = D2D1::ColorF(aR, aG, aB, dark ? (iStateId==6 ? 0.20f : 0.14f) : (iStateId==6 ? 0.16f : 0.12f));
        }
        break;
    default: return false;
    }
    // Drop shadow: plain (non-bordered) ListView selection only -- bordered-
    // pill and TreeView selection use the accent border instead. Alpha
    // values follow LvCacheEnsure's shadowAlpha rationale (dark mode
    // composites over ~#191919, not black).
    bool  wantsShadow  = !isTreeView && !drawBorder && (iStateId == 3 || iStateId == 6);
    float shadowAlpha  = wantsShadow ? (dark ? 0.38f : 0.12f) : 0.f;

    int cacheIdx = pressed
        ? LV_TREE_PRESSED_CACHE_INDEX
        : (iStateId >= 2 && iStateId <= 6 ? iStateId - 2 : 0) +
            (isTreeView ? 6 : 0);
    if (cacheIdx >= LV_CACHE_BLOCK) cacheIdx = 0;
    UINT itemDpi = itemHwnd ? GetDpiForWindow(itemHwnd) : DpiForPaintHdc(hdc);
    if (!itemDpi)
        itemDpi = USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    FLOAT padX = isTreeView ? 1.f : 0.f;
    int px = (int)padX;

    if (drawBorder) {
        // Border case: fill + ring are baked into a small tile (same 9-grid
        // scheme as the plain-fill cache below). No D2D clip is needed here
        // (the ring's fixed inset-from-tile-edge already lands at the right
        // spot once stretched), but the outer padding from the old
        // direct-D2D fallback still needs reproducing: there, the padding on
        // the item-stacking axis (vertical for TreeView, horizontal for
        // ListView) was always clipped straight back to the real rect --
        // zero net effect -- while the padding on the *cross* axis was never
        // clipped and bled visibly past the item's own edges. Reproduce just
        // that net-visible bleed directly in the destination rect.
        int borderIdx = (focusedRing ? LV_FOCUS_BORDER_CACHE_BASE : LV_BORDER_CACHE_BASE) + cacheIdx;
        HWND borderHwnd = itemHwnd;
        if (RoundedSelectionTile* tile = LvBorderCacheEnsure(
                hdc, borderIdx, fill, ringColor, isTreeView, itemDpi)) {
            RECT dst = *pRect;
            if (isTreeView) {
                const int extraX = GetSelectionBorderOuterPaddingX(borderHwnd);
                dst.left -= extraX;
                dst.right += extraX;
            } else {
                const int extraY = GetListSelectionBorderOuterPaddingY(borderHwnd);
                dst.top -= extraY;
                dst.bottom += extraY;
            }
            const BYTE borderOpacity = static_cast<BYTE>(
                std::lround(std::clamp(selectFadeProgress, 0.f, 1.f) * 255.f));
            LvCacheDraw(hdc, &dst, *tile, borderOpacity);
            return true;
        }
    } else if (RoundedSelectionTile* tile = LvCacheEnsure(
                   hdc, cacheIdx, fill, shadowAlpha, itemDpi)) {
        RECT dst = {pRect->left + px, pRect->top, pRect->right - px, pRect->bottom};
        if (iStateId == 2 && hoverFade)
            ScaleRectAroundCenter(&dst, hoverScale);
        const BYTE opacity = static_cast<BYTE>(
            std::lround(std::clamp(hoverProgress, 0.f, 1.f) * 255.f));
        LvCacheDraw(hdc, &dst, *tile, opacity);
        return true;
    }

    // Fallback: direct D2D (cache alloc failure, e.g. GDI object exhaustion)
    HWND paintHwnd = drawBorder ? itemHwnd : nullptr;
    RECT paintRect = *pRect;
    int extraX = 0;
    int extraY = 0;
    if (drawBorder) {
        extraX = isTreeView ? GetSelectionBorderOuterPaddingX(paintHwnd)
                            : GetListSelectionBorderOuterPaddingX(paintHwnd);
        extraY = isTreeView ? GetSelectionBorderOuterPaddingY(paintHwnd)
                            : GetListSelectionBorderOuterPaddingY(paintHwnd);
        paintRect.left -= extraX;
        paintRect.right += extraX;
        paintRect.top -= extraY;
        paintRect.bottom += extraY;
    }
    if (iStateId == 2 && hoverFade)
        ScaleRectAroundCenter(&paintRect, hoverScale);
    int w = paintRect.right - paintRect.left, h = paintRect.bottom - paintRect.top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return false;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
    if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &paintRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT))) return false;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> br;
    D2D1_COLOR_F fallbackFill = fill;
    fallbackFill.a *= hoverProgress * selectFadeProgress;
    if (FAILED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(fallbackFill, &br)))
        return false;
    D2D1_COLOR_F fallbackRingColor = ringColor;
    fallbackRingColor.a *= selectFadeProgress;
    const FLOAT fillOffsetX = drawBorder ? (FLOAT)extraX + padX : padX;
    const FLOAT fillOffsetY = drawBorder ? (FLOAT)extraY : 0.f;
    const FLOAT fillRadius = drawBorder
        ? WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * (static_cast<FLOAT>(itemDpi) / 96.f)
        : ModernizerCornerRadius * (static_cast<FLOAT>(itemDpi) / 96.f);
    const D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT rr = D2D1::RoundedRect(
        D2D1::RectF(fillOffsetX, fillOffsetY,
            (FLOAT)w - fillOffsetX, (FLOAT)h - fillOffsetY),
        fillRadius, fillRadius);
    pRT->BeginDraw();
    if (drawBorder) {
        // Clip the outer-padding expansion back to the item's real bounds on
        // whichever axis neighboring items sit: TreeView rows stack
        // vertically (clip top/bottom, full width), ListView items sit
        // side-by-side in a row/grid (clip left/right, full height).
        D2D1_RECT_F clipRc;
        if (isTreeView) {
            const FLOAT clipTop = (FLOAT)(pRect->top - paintRect.top);
            const FLOAT clipBottom = (FLOAT)(pRect->bottom - paintRect.top);
            clipRc = D2D1::RectF(0.f, clipTop, (FLOAT)w, clipBottom);
        } else {
            const FLOAT clipLeft = (FLOAT)(pRect->left - paintRect.left);
            const FLOAT clipRight = (FLOAT)(pRect->right - paintRect.left);
            clipRc = D2D1::RectF(clipLeft, 0.f, clipRight, (FLOAT)h);
        }
        pRT->PushAxisAlignedClip(clipRc, D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_PER_PRIMITIVE);
    }
    pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(rr, br.Get());
    if (shadowAlpha > 0.f) {
        float bandTop = (FLOAT)h - LV_SHADOW_BAND_H;
        float bandBottom = (FLOAT)h;
        D2D1_GRADIENT_STOP stops[2] = {
            { 0.f, D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f) },
            { 1.f, D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, shadowAlpha) },
        };
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GradientStopCollection> sc;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1LinearGradientBrush> gb;
        if (SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateGradientStopCollection(stops, 2, &sc)) &&
            SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateLinearGradientBrush(
                D2D1::LinearGradientBrushProperties(
                    D2D1::Point2F(0, bandTop), D2D1::Point2F(0, bandBottom)),
                sc.Get(), &gb))) {
            D2D1_RECT_F bandClip = D2D1::RectF(padX, bandTop, (FLOAT)w - padX, bandBottom);
            pRT->PushAxisAlignedClip(bandClip, D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_PER_PRIMITIVE);
            pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(rr, gb.Get());
            pRT->PopAxisAlignedClip();
        }
    }
    if (drawBorder)
        DrawSelectionBorder(pRT.Get(), (FLOAT)w, (FLOAT)h, padX, paintHwnd,
            fallbackRingColor, focusedRing, dark);
    if (drawBorder)
        pRT->PopAxisAlignedClip();
    if (pRT->EndDraw() == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        pRT.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
    return true;
}

static bool IsSplitButtonChevronCandidate(HWND hwnd);

static bool IsListViewThemeClass(const std::wstring& cls)
{
    return cls == L"ItemsView" || cls == L"ListView" ||
           cls == L"Explorer::ListView" || cls == L"ItemsView::ListView";
}

static bool IsDuiGroupHeaderPaintElement();

static bool IsLikelyGroupHeaderOverlayRect(LPCRECT rc)
{
    if (!rc)
        return false;
    const int w = rc->right - rc->left;
    const int h = rc->bottom - rc->top;
    return rc->left <= 1 && w >= 160 && h >= 16 && h <= 48;
}

// Scale applied to the group header's own selected font (see
// DrawThemeTextEx_hook's LVP_GROUPHEADER branch and TryDrawGroupHeaderText
// below) and, inside real Explorer windows, to the accompanying chevron so
// the two stay proportional.
static constexpr float kGroupHeaderFontScale = 1.25f;
// WinUI header name color: TextFillColorPrimary, the light value flattened
// over the list surface (no alpha through the GDI/DirectWrite text paths).
static COLORREF GroupHeaderTextColor(bool dark)
{
    return dark ? (COLORREF)WinUI::Dark::TextFillColorPrimary
                : WinUI::FlattenOver(WinUI::Light::TextFillColorPrimary, kExplorerListLight);
}

// The header content fill: SubtleFillColorSecondary for the hot states,
// Tertiary for the selected/pressed ones, ControlCornerRadius corners,
// stopping short of the row's edges on both sides.
static constexpr float kGroupHeaderFillInsetPx = 3.f;
static void PaintGroupHeaderFill(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect, bool dark, bool pressed)
{
    const WinUI::Color fill = pressed ? WinUI::SubtleFillColorTertiary(dark)
                                      : WinUI::SubtleFillColorSecondary(dark);
    const float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const float cr = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale;
    const float inset = kGroupHeaderFillInsetPx * scale;
    const float w = (float)(pRect->right - pRect->left) - inset * 2.f;
    if (w <= 0.f)
        return;
    FillRoundedRectGdip(hdc,
        Gdiplus::RectF((float)pRect->left + inset, (float)pRect->top,
            w, (float)(pRect->bottom - pRect->top)),
        cr, GdipColor(fill.rgb, fill.alpha));
}
// Extra gap between the chevron and the enlarged header text in Explorer,
// at 96 DPI. Only the drawn rect moves: the measurement DirectUI lays the
// row (and its hover background) out with stays native.
static constexpr float kGroupHeaderTextLeftPadPx = 8.f;
// WinUI header name size. DirectUI's own header font is ~15 DIP (logged:
// lfHeight -19 at 120 DPI), so the Explorer path sets the size outright
// instead of scaling it; classic comctl32 headers keep the scale.
static constexpr int kExplorerGroupHeaderFontDip = 14;

// kGroupHeaderChevronGlyphDip/kChevronGlyphRightSmall/kChevronGlyphDownSmall/
// DrawChevronGlyphOnRT (and kTreeViewChevronGlyphDip) are declared
// earlier in the file, near DrawChevronGlyph, so the nav-pane/TreeView-family
// chevrons can use them too.
static constexpr float kChevronGlyphNonExplorerScale = 1.1f; // cosmetic-only
    // size bump outside real Explorer windows (no header-text-matching
    // reason there, just reads a bit small at 1x).
static constexpr float kChevronExplorerYOffsetPx = 1.f; // downward nudge
    // inside real Explorer only, at 96 DPI -- scaled by the caller's own
    // per-paint DPI factor.
static constexpr float kChevronExplorerXOffsetPx = 2.f; // rightward nudge,
    // same scope: the DUI cell hugs the row's left edge.

static bool PaintListViewGroupChevron(HDC hdc, INT iPartId, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!pRect || (iPartId != LVP_EXPANDBUTTON && iPartId != LVP_COLLAPSEBUTTON))
        return false;

    const int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
    const int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
        return true;

    const bool dark = IsDarkForExcludedAwarePaintHdc(hdc);
    if (!g_d2dFactory)
        return false;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
    FPUGuard fpu;
    if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
        return false;

    const float fw = (float)w;
    const float fh = (float)h;
    const float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / (float)USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const bool hot = (iStateId == 2 || iStateId == 3);
    const bool pressed = (iStateId == 3);
    // Inside real Explorer the header's own fill (GROUPHEADER part) covers
    // the chevron and the glyph itself carries the hover; a cell pill of
    // its own sits off the nudged glyph. Classic ListViews keep the pill.
    HWND chevronHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
    const bool insideExplorer = IsInsideExplorer(chevronHwnd);
    const float hoverAlpha = insideExplorer ? 0.f : pressed ? 0.10f : hot ? 0.075f : 0.f;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
    pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(
        dark ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, hoverAlpha)
             : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, hoverAlpha),
        &brush);
    if (!brush)
        return false;

    pRT->BeginDraw();
    if (hoverAlpha > 0.f) {
        const float cr = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale;
        pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
            D2D1::RoundedRect(D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f, fw, fh), cr, cr),
            brush.Get());
    }

    const float chevronScale = insideExplorer ? 1.f : kChevronGlyphNonExplorerScale;

    const float cx = fw * 0.50f + (insideExplorer ? kChevronExplorerXOffsetPx * scale : 0.f);
    // Nudged down a bit inside Explorer only -- purely a visual alignment
    // tweak against the real Explorer row layout, not tied to font scale.
    const float cy = fh * 0.52f + (insideExplorer ? kChevronExplorerYOffsetPx * scale : 0.f);
    const float len = std::min(fw, fh) * 0.205f * chevronScale;
    const float stroke = std::max(1.f, 1.45f * scale * chevronScale);
    // Explorer: the Home header's ChevronExpanderToggleButtonStyle
    // (resources.pri string table + live tree): TextFillColorPrimary at
    // rest, Secondary on PointerOver, Tertiary pressed (pressed inferred
    // from the same file's other buttons). Classic ListViews: the fixed
    // nav pane chevron color.
    if (insideExplorer) {
        const WinUI::Color fg = pressed
            ? WinUI::TextFillColorTertiary(dark)
            : hot
            ? WinUI::TextFillColorSecondary(dark)
            : WinUI::TextFillColorPrimary(dark);
        brush->SetColor(D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(fg.rgb) / 255.f,
            GetGValue(fg.rgb) / 255.f, GetBValue(fg.rgb) / 255.f, fg.alpha / 255.f));
    } else {
        brush->SetColor(dark
            ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f)
            : D2D1::ColorF(30.f / 255.f, 30.f / 255.f, 30.f / 255.f));
    }

    // Real Fluent glyph first; hand-drawn lines only if no icon font is
    // installed at all.
    const int fontSizePx = std::max(1, (int)std::lround(
        (insideExplorer ? kExplorerGroupHeaderChevronGlyphDip : kGroupHeaderChevronGlyphDip)
            * scale * chevronScale));
    const wchar_t* glyph = insideExplorer
        ? (iPartId == LVP_EXPANDBUTTON ? kChevronGlyphRight : kChevronGlyphDown)
        : (iPartId == LVP_EXPANDBUTTON ? kChevronGlyphRightSmall : kChevronGlyphDownSmall);
    if (!DrawChevronGlyphOnRT(pRT.Get(), glyph, fw, fh, cx, cy, 0.f, brush.Get(), fontSizePx)) {
        if (iPartId == LVP_EXPANDBUTTON) {
            pRT->DrawLine(D2D1::Point2F(cx - len * 0.35f, cy - len),
                          D2D1::Point2F(cx + len * 0.45f, cy),
                          brush.Get(), stroke);
            pRT->DrawLine(D2D1::Point2F(cx - len * 0.35f, cy + len),
                          D2D1::Point2F(cx + len * 0.45f, cy),
                          brush.Get(), stroke);
        } else {
            pRT->DrawLine(D2D1::Point2F(cx - len, cy - len * 0.35f),
                          D2D1::Point2F(cx, cy + len * 0.45f),
                          brush.Get(), stroke);
            pRT->DrawLine(D2D1::Point2F(cx + len, cy - len * 0.35f),
                          D2D1::Point2F(cx, cy + len * 0.45f),
                          brush.Get(), stroke);
        }
    }

    HRESULT hr = pRT->EndDraw();
    if (hr == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        pRT.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// The group-header expand/collapse chevron used to have its own
// timer-driven rotation animation (ListViewGroupChevronAnim et al.,
// mirroring the nav-pane TreeView glyph's), but comctl32 almost never
// actually painted an intermediate state for this control long enough
// for it to be seen -- removed rather than kept around (and made to
// fight the same cross-thread/unbounded-growth bugs the nav-pane
// version had) for a transition nobody was really watching.
// PaintListViewGroupChevron below renders the resting state directly.


static bool PaintGroupHeaderOverlayPill(HDC hdc, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!pRect)
        return true;

    const int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
    const int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
        return true;

    // The FOCUSRECT the DUI lays over a clicked header: WinUI shows the
    // pressed (Tertiary) fill there, nothing for the focus outline itself.
    if (iStateId == 1)
        return true;
    PaintGroupHeaderFill(hdc, pRect, IsDarkForExcludedAwarePaintHdc(hdc), /*pressed=*/true);
    return true;
}

// Explorer's column header corners (the full Mica strip, the hot/pressed
// item, the end beside a scrollbar): between WinUI's ControlCornerRadius (4)
// and OverlayCornerRadius (8).

static bool PaintRoundedHeaderItem(HDC hdc, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!pRect)
        return false;

    const int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
    const int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
        return false;

    const bool isHot = (iStateId == HIS_HOT || iStateId == 5 || iStateId == 8);
    const bool isPressed = (iStateId == HIS_PRESSED || iStateId == 6 || iStateId == 9);
    if (!isHot && !isPressed)
        return false;

    if (g_accentCacheDirty.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        RefreshAccentCache();

    const bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    COLORREF acClr = GetAccentFromPalette(dark ? (isPressed ? 4 : 8)
                                               : (isPressed ? 16 : 12));
    const float alpha = dark ? (isPressed ? 180.f / 255.f : 80.f / 255.f)
                             : (isPressed ?  60.f / 255.f : 25.f / 255.f);

    const float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.f;
    const float inset = 1.4f * scale;
    const float fw = (float)w - 2.f * inset;
    const float fh = (float)h - 2.f * inset;
    FillRoundedRectGdip(hdc,
        Gdiplus::RectF(pRect->left + inset, pRect->top + inset, fw, fh),
        std::min(ModernizerCornerRadius * scale, fh * 0.5f),
        GdipColor(acClr, (BYTE)std::lround(alpha * 255.f)));
    return true;
}

static void DrawDuiHeaderItemDivider(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect);

static bool IsExplorerMicaHeaderPaint(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc)
{
    const bool filePickerSurface =
        FilePickerMicaActive() || ExplorerOpaqueMode();
    if (!ExplorerBackdropMode() ||
        !(IsCurrentProcessExplorer() || filePickerSurface))
        return false;

    HWND hwnd = ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc);
    if (!hwnd)
        hwnd = GetThemeOpenerHwnd(hTheme);
    // Unresolvable only counts inside explorer.exe; elsewhere a header is
    // the picker's only when its window says so.
    if (!hwnd)
        return IsCurrentProcessExplorer();

    HWND root = GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT);
    wchar_t rootClass[32] = {};
    if (root && GetClassNameW(root, rootClass, ARRAYSIZE(rootClass)) &&
        _wcsicmp(rootClass, L"#32770") == 0) {
        return filePickerSurface && FilePickerRoot(hwnd) != nullptr;
    }

    return IsInsideExplorer(hwnd);
}

static BOOL CALLBACK HeaderVerticalScrollBarEnumProc(HWND child, LPARAM lp)
{
    if (IsClassName(child, L"ScrollBar") &&
        (GetWindowLongW(child, GWL_STYLE) & SBS_VERT) &&
        IsWindowVisible(child)) {
        *reinterpret_cast<bool*>(lp) = true;
        return FALSE;
    }
    return TRUE;
}

// The file list's vertical ScrollBar window takes the column beside the
// header whenever it shows, so the header ends short of the list's edge.
// LTR only: a mirrored list puts that column on the left.
static bool HeaderHostHasVerticalScrollBar(HDC hdc)
{
    HWND host = ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc);
    if (!host || (GetWindowLongW(host, GWL_EXSTYLE) & WS_EX_LAYOUTRTL))
        return false;
    bool found = false;
    EnumChildWindows(host, HeaderVerticalScrollBarEnumProc,
        reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&found));
    return found;
}

// Paints the content-pane header strip through `paint(dc, rect)`, then
// gives it a rounded bottom-right corner, its bottom rule following the
// arc: every pixel of the corner square is rebuilt as pane / strip / rule
// weighted by the arc's coverage (4x4 samples). Nothing is read back from
// `hdc`, whose clip can leave the square partly unpainted (DirectUI
// repaints a few rows of the header while the thumb is dragged): the strip
// and rule come from `paint` run again on a private square, and
// `panePixel` is the list pane's own pixel (BGRA, as its fill writes it).
template <typename Paint>
static void PaintHeaderWithRoundedEnd(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, int radius,
    int lineW, DWORD panePixel, Paint&& paint)
{
    const int r = std::min({ radius, static_cast<int>(rc.right - rc.left),
                             static_cast<int>(rc.bottom - rc.top) });
    if (r <= lineW + 1) {
        paint(hdc, rc);
        return;
    }
    const int sqX = rc.right - r;
    const int sqY = rc.bottom - r;

    BITMAPINFO bi = {};
    bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(bi.bmiHeader);
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = r;
    bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -r;
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;
    void* rawBits = nullptr;
    HBITMAP dib = CreateDIBSection(nullptr, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &rawBits, nullptr, 0);
    HDC mem = dib ? CreateCompatibleDC(hdc) : nullptr;
    HGDIOBJ oldBmp = mem ? SelectObject(mem, dib) : nullptr;
    BYTE* bits = static_cast<BYTE*>(rawBits);
    const bool ready = mem && oldBmp && oldBmp != HGDI_ERROR && bits;
    BYTE pane[4];
    memcpy(pane, &panePixel, 4);

    paint(hdc, rc);

    if (ready) {
        // The header shifted so its corner square lands on the DIB; the
        // flat strip and flat rule are then the square's left column.
        const RECT local = { rc.left - sqX, rc.top - sqY, r, r };
        paint(mem, local);
        GdiFlush();
        BYTE strip[4], rule[4];
        memcpy(strip, bits, 4);
        memcpy(rule, bits + static_cast<size_t>(r - 1) * r * 4, 4);
        const float outer = static_cast<float>(r);
        const float inner = outer - static_cast<float>(lineW);
        for (int y = 0; y < r; ++y) {
            for (int x = 0; x < r; ++x) {
                int inFill = 0, inRule = 0;
                for (int sy = 0; sy < 4; ++sy) {
                    for (int sx = 0; sx < 4; ++sx) {
                        const float px = x + (sx + 0.5f) * 0.25f;
                        const float py = y + (sy + 0.5f) * 0.25f;
                        const float d = std::sqrt(px * px + py * py);
                        if (d <= outer) {
                            ++inFill;
                            if (d >= inner)
                                ++inRule;
                        }
                    }
                }
                const float cf = inFill / 16.f;
                const float cr = inRule / 16.f;
                BYTE* out = bits + (static_cast<size_t>(y) * r + x) * 4;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    const float v = pane[k] * (1.f - cf) +
                        strip[k] * (cf - cr) + rule[k] * cr;
                    out[k] = static_cast<BYTE>(std::clamp(
                        std::lround(v), 0L, 255L));
                }
            }
        }
        BitBlt(hdc, sqX, sqY, r, r, mem, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
    }

    if (mem) {
        if (oldBmp && oldBmp != HGDI_ERROR)
            SelectObject(mem, oldBmp);
        DeleteDC(mem);
    }
    if (dib)
        DeleteObject(dib);
}

static bool PaintExplorerMicaHeaderBackground(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!pRect)
        return false;

    const int width = pRect->right - pRect->left;
    const int height = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
        return false;

    const bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    const BYTE overlayAlpha =
        ExplorerMicaSecondaryRevealLevel(dark);

    // Content-pane modes: a flat strip in the same translucent shade with
    // a CardStroke rule along its bottom edge, like the pane edge and the
    // status bar's top rule. Both are single premultiplied pixel values
    // over the backdrop, so they are written directly.
    if (ExplorerMicaPaneMode()) {
        const UINT dpi = DpiForPaintHdc(hdc);
        const int lineW = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(std::lround(
            static_cast<float>(dpi) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI)));
        auto paintStrip = [&](HDC dc, const RECT& rc) {
            if (ExplorerOpaqueMode()) {
                // The header belongs to the lifted list surface.
                if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(ExplorerMicaPaneSolidColor(dark)))
                    FillRect_orig(dc, &rc, br);
            } else {
                const DWORD a = overlayAlpha;
                WriteExplorerMicaPixels(dc, rc,
                    dark ? (a << 24) | (a << 16) | (a << 8) | a : a << 24);
            }
            const RECT rule = { rc.left, std::max(rc.top, rc.bottom - lineW),
                                rc.right, rc.bottom };
            PaintExplorerPaneRule(dc, rule);
        };
        // A vertical scrollbar cuts the header short of the list's edge:
        // end it in the header's corner rather than a hard cut.
        if (HeaderHostHasVerticalScrollBar(hdc)) {
            // The pane under the header, as its fill writes it: the Mica
            // reveal through GDI (alpha 0, added to the backdrop), or the
            // solid pane written opaque (over Mica and on the opaque surface).
            const COLORREF pane = ExplorerMicaPaneRevealColor(dark);
            const DWORD paneAlpha = ExplorerMicaSolidPaneMode() ? 0xFFu : 0u;
            const DWORD panePixel = (paneAlpha << 24) |
                (static_cast<DWORD>(GetRValue(pane)) << 16) |
                (static_cast<DWORD>(GetGValue(pane)) << 8) | GetBValue(pane);
            PaintHeaderWithRoundedEnd(hdc, *pRect,
                static_cast<int>(std::lround(ModernizerCornerRadius * dpi / 96.f)),
                lineW, panePixel, paintStrip);
        } else {
            paintStrip(hdc, *pRect);
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (FillRect_orig)
        FillRect_orig(hdc, pRect, static_cast<HBRUSH>(GetStockObject(BLACK_BRUSH)));

    const UINT dpi = DpiForPaintHdc(hdc);
    const float scale = static_cast<float>(dpi) / 96.f;
    const float radius = std::min(
        ModernizerCornerRadius * scale,
        std::min(width, height) * 0.5f);

    if (g_d2dFactory) {
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> renderTarget;
        FPUGuard fpu;
        if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(
                hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &renderTarget))) {
            const D2D1_COLOR_F color = dark
                ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, overlayAlpha / 255.f)
                : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, overlayAlpha / 255.f);
            ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush =
                GetCachedSolidBrush(renderTarget.Get(), color);
            if (brush) {
                const float w = static_cast<float>(width);
                const float h = static_cast<float>(height);
                const float borderStrokeWidth = std::max(
                    1.f, static_cast<float>(dpi) / 120.f);
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> geometry;
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GeometrySink> sink;
                if (SUCCEEDED(g_d2dFactory->CreatePathGeometry(&geometry)) &&
                    SUCCEEDED(geometry->Open(&sink))) {
                    const D2D1_SIZE_F arc = D2D1::SizeF(radius, radius);
                    sink->BeginFigure(
                        D2D1::Point2F(0.f, 0.f), D2D1_FIGURE_BEGIN_FILLED);
                    sink->AddLine(D2D1::Point2F(w, 0.f));
                    sink->AddLine(D2D1::Point2F(w, h - radius));
                    sink->AddArc(D2D1::ArcSegment(
                        D2D1::Point2F(w - radius, h), arc, 0.f,
                        D2D1_SWEEP_DIRECTION_CLOCKWISE,
                        D2D1_ARC_SIZE_SMALL));
                    sink->AddLine(D2D1::Point2F(radius, h));
                    sink->AddArc(D2D1::ArcSegment(
                        D2D1::Point2F(0.f, h - radius), arc, 0.f,
                        D2D1_SWEEP_DIRECTION_CLOCKWISE,
                        D2D1_ARC_SIZE_SMALL));
                    sink->EndFigure(D2D1_FIGURE_END_CLOSED);
                    if (SUCCEEDED(sink->Close())) {
                        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> borderGeometry;
                        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GeometrySink> borderSink;
                        if (SUCCEEDED(g_d2dFactory->CreatePathGeometry(
                                &borderGeometry)) &&
                            SUCCEEDED(borderGeometry->Open(&borderSink))) {
                            const float halfStroke = borderStrokeWidth * 0.5f;
                            const float requestedEdgeInset =
                                std::max(borderStrokeWidth, scale) + halfStroke;
                            const float edgeInset = std::min(
                                requestedEdgeInset,
                                std::max(halfStroke, radius - 0.5f));
                            const float borderRadius = std::max(
                                0.5f, radius - edgeInset);
                            const D2D1_SIZE_F borderArc =
                                D2D1::SizeF(borderRadius, borderRadius);
                            borderSink->BeginFigure(
                                D2D1::Point2F(
                                    w - edgeInset, h - radius),
                                D2D1_FIGURE_BEGIN_HOLLOW);
                            borderSink->AddArc(D2D1::ArcSegment(
                                D2D1::Point2F(w - radius, h - edgeInset),
                                borderArc, 0.f,
                                D2D1_SWEEP_DIRECTION_CLOCKWISE,
                                D2D1_ARC_SIZE_SMALL));
                            borderSink->AddLine(
                                D2D1::Point2F(radius, h - edgeInset));
                            borderSink->AddArc(D2D1::ArcSegment(
                                D2D1::Point2F(edgeInset, h - radius),
                                borderArc, 0.f,
                                D2D1_SWEEP_DIRECTION_CLOCKWISE,
                                D2D1_ARC_SIZE_SMALL));
                            borderSink->EndFigure(D2D1_FIGURE_END_OPEN);
                            if (FAILED(borderSink->Close()))
                                borderGeometry.Reset();
                        }

                        renderTarget->BeginDraw();
                        renderTarget->FillGeometry(geometry.Get(), brush);
                        if (borderGeometry) {
                            brush->SetColor(dark
                                ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.04f)
                                : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.05f));
                            renderTarget->DrawGeometry(
                                borderGeometry.Get(), brush,
                                borderStrokeWidth);
                        }
                        const HRESULT hr = renderTarget->EndDraw();
                        if (hr == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                            renderTarget.Reset();
                            CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                        } else if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Black keeps the real DWM backdrop visible if D2D is unavailable.
    return true;
}

static bool PaintExplorerMicaHeader(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, INT iPartId,
                                    INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!IsExplorerMicaHeaderPaint(hTheme, hdc))
        return false;

    if (iPartId == 0 /*COMMONPROPS*/)
        return PaintExplorerMicaHeaderBackground(hdc, pRect);

    if (iPartId != HP_HEADERITEM)
        return false;

    if (g_settings.AccentColorize)
        PaintRoundedHeaderItem(hdc, iStateId, pRect);
    DrawDuiHeaderItemDivider(hdc, pRect);
    return true;
}

// WinUI's DividerStrokeColorDefault (#15FFFFFF dark / #0F000000 light)
// as premultiplied pixels over the backdrop. Written with SRCCOPY like the
// CardStroke rules: a D2D DC render target costs ~0.7 ms per line in
// BindDC/EndDraw, this ~20 us.
static bool PaintExplorerMicaStatusBarRule(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect, bool dark)
{
    if (!hdc || !pRect)
        return false;
    const DWORD stroke = dark ? 0x15151515u : 0x0F000000u;
    if (ExplorerOpaqueMode())
        BlendPremultipliedPixels(hdc, *pRect, stroke);
    else
        WriteExplorerMicaPixels(hdc, *pRect, stroke);
    return true;
}

// msctls_statusbar32 through its theme parts (classes Status /
// DarkMode_DarkTheme::Status). comctl32 v6 draws part 0 (background) from
// WM_ERASEBKGND over the whole client, SP_PANE/SP_GRIPPERPANE per pane from
// DrawStatusTextEx (the pane image carries the separator) and SP_GRIPPER
// for the sizing grip. Flat background, a 1px separator on the pane's right
// edge, no grip (WinUI has none; resizing still works through hit-testing).
static bool PaintStatusBarThemePart(HDC hdc, INT iPartId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!hdc || !pRect)
        return false;
    HWND hwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
    const bool dark = g_darkModeActive &&
        (hwnd ? IsHwndDarkMode(hwnd) : IsWindowDarkMode(hdc));
    const auto fill = FillRect_orig ? FillRect_orig : FillRect;

    switch (iPartId) {
    case 0: {
        const COLORREF bg = dark ? DarkBgForPaint(hwnd)
                                 : GetSysColor(COLOR_BTNFACE);
        if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(bg))
            fill(hdc, pRect, br);
        return true;
    }
    case 1: // SP_PANE
    case 2: { // SP_GRIPPERPANE
        RECT client = {};
        if (hwnd && GetClientRect(hwnd, &client) &&
            pRect->right >= client.right - 1)
            return true; // last pane: no separator against the edge
        const UINT dpi = hwnd ? GetDpiForWindow(hwnd) : DpiForPaintHdc(hdc);
        const int padY = MulDiv(4, dpi, 96);
        const int x = pRect->right - 1;
        RECT line = { x, pRect->top + padY, x + 1, pRect->bottom - padY };
        if (line.bottom > line.top) {
            if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(
                    dark ? RGB(88, 88, 88) : RGB(190, 190, 190)))
                fill(hdc, &line, br);
        }
        return true;
    }
    case 3: // SP_GRIPPER
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static bool PaintExplorerMicaStatusBarSeparator(
    HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!ExplorerBackdropMode() || !IsCurrentProcessExplorer() ||
        !hdc || !pRect) {
        return false;
    }

    HWND hwnd = ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc);
    if (!hwnd)
        hwnd = GetThemeOpenerHwnd(hTheme);
    if (!hwnd || !IsInsideExplorerStatusBarHost(hwnd))
        return false;

    const bool dark = DarkModeActiveForPaint(hwnd);

    const int width = pRect->right - pRect->left;
    const int height = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
        return true;

    // Shell32 UIFILE 34/69 defines FieldSeparatorInner as a Separator whose
    // background is dtb(ShellStatusBarSeparator, 1, 0). Replace that themed
    // GDI strip with the translucent WinUI status-bar separator.
    const int xPixel = std::max(0, (width - 1) / 2);
    RECT lineRect = {
        pRect->left + xPixel,
        pRect->top,
        pRect->left + xPixel + 1,
        pRect->bottom,
    };
    return PaintExplorerMicaStatusBarRule(hdc, &lineRect, dark);
}

static bool IsSplitButtonHwnd(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd)) return false;
    wchar_t cls[32] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)) ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"Button") != 0)
        return false;

    LONG_PTR style = GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE);
    LONG_PTR type = style & BS_TYPEMASK;
    return type == BS_SPLITBUTTON || type == BS_DEFSPLITBUTTON;
}

static bool IsSplitButtonChevronCandidate(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (IsSplitButtonHwnd(hwnd)) return true;
    if (!hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd)) return false;

    wchar_t cls[32] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)) ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"Button") != 0)
        return false;

    wchar_t text[8] = {};
    GetWindowTextW(hwnd, text, ARRAYSIZE(text));
    if (text[0] != L'\0') return false;

    RECT rc = {};
    if (!GetWindowRect(hwnd, &rc)) return false;
    UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);
    int maxW = MulDiv(34, (int)dpi, 96);
    int minH = MulDiv(18, (int)dpi, 96);
    if ((rc.right - rc.left) > maxW || (rc.bottom - rc.top) < minH)
        return false;

    HWND parent = GetParent(hwnd);
    if (!parent) return false;
    for (HWND ch = GetWindow(parent, GW_CHILD); ch; ch = GetWindow(ch, GW_HWNDNEXT)) {
        if (ch == hwnd) continue;
        wchar_t ccls[32] = {};
        if (!GetClassNameW(ch, ccls, ARRAYSIZE(ccls)) ||
            _wcsicmp(ccls, L"Button") != 0)
            continue;
        LONG_PTR st = GetWindowLongPtrW(ch, GWL_STYLE);
        LONG_PTR type = st & BS_TYPEMASK;
        if (type == BS_DEFPUSHBUTTON || type == BS_DEFSPLITBUTTON)
            return true;
        if (GetDlgCtrlID(ch) == IDOK)
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static constexpr LPCWSTR kSplitButtonChevronSubclassProp =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.SplitChevronSubclass";

static INT GetSplitButtonPaintState(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!IsWindowEnabled(hwnd)) return PBS_DISABLED;

    LRESULT state = SendMessageW(hwnd, BM_GETSTATE, 0, 0);
    if (state & (BST_PUSHED | BST_DROPDOWNPUSHED)) return PBS_PRESSED;
    if (state & BST_HOT) return PBS_HOT;

    LONG_PTR type = GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE) & BS_TYPEMASK;
    if (type == BS_DEFSPLITBUTTON) return PBS_DEFAULTED;
    return PBS_NORMAL;
}

// SplitButton's chevron (SplitButton_themeresources.xaml): ForegroundSecondary
// = TextFillColorSecondary, Tertiary when pressed, Disabled when disabled.
// The accent button's chevron keeps TextOnAccentFillColor. The GDI fallback
// below has no alpha and draws the token's opaque color.
static WinUI::Color GetSplitButtonChevronColor(HWND hwnd, INT state)
{
    const bool dark = IsDarkForExcludedAwarePaint(hwnd);
    const bool disabled = (state == PBS_DISABLED);
    bool isAccent = false;
    if (hwnd) {
        INT ctrlId = GetDlgCtrlID(hwnd);
        isAccent = (ctrlId == IDOK || ctrlId == IDYES);
    }

    if (isAccent)
        return disabled ? WinUI::TextOnAccentFillColorDisabled(dark)
                        : WinUI::TextOnAccentFillColorPrimary(dark);
    if (disabled)
        return WinUI::TextFillColorDisabled(dark);
    return state == PBS_PRESSED ? WinUI::TextFillColorTertiary(dark)
                                : WinUI::TextFillColorSecondary(dark);
}

static bool IsNativeSplitButtonChevronText(HWND hwnd, LPCWSTR text,
    INT cchText, LPCRECT rc, UINT format)
{
    if (!g_settings.RoundedButtons || !hwnd || !text || !rc)
        return false;
    // The text tests are free; the window-class lookup comes last.
    if (!(format & DT_SINGLELINE))
        return false;
    if (cchText == 0 || text[0] != L'6')
        return false;
    if (cchText > 1 || (cchText < 0 && text[1] != L'\0'))
        return false;
    if (!IsSplitButtonChevronCandidate(hwnd))
        return false;

    RECT client = {};
    if (!GetClientRect(hwnd, &client))
        return false;

    UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);
    const int rightSlack = MulDiv(5, (int)dpi, 96);
    const int maxGlyphW = MulDiv(34, (int)dpi, 96);
    const int minGlyphH = MulDiv(12, (int)dpi, 96);

    int w = rc->right - rc->left;
    int h = rc->bottom - rc->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h < minGlyphH || w > maxGlyphW)
        return false;

    if (rc->right < client.right - rightSlack ||
        rc->left < client.right - maxGlyphW - rightSlack)
        return false;

    return true;
}

static bool DrawSplitButtonChevronGlyph(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect, HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hdc || !pRect || !hwnd)
        return false;

    int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
    int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
        return false;

    float scale = (float)GetDpiForWindow(hwnd) / 96.f;
    INT state = GetSplitButtonPaintState(hwnd);
    const WinUI::Color chevron = GetSplitButtonChevronColor(hwnd, state);
    const COLORREF clr = chevron.rgb;

    // Same click-pop bob as TravelBand's Recent-locations chevron: a
    // hot/pressed->released edge starts the shared spring-translateY
    // animation, keyed by this button's own HWND (command slot 0, since
    // each split button only ever has the one chevron).
    DOUBLE animElapsed = -1.0;
    if (SysAnimationsEnabled()) {
        animElapsed = ButtonPopTrigger(
            hwnd, 0, state == PBS_PRESSED, CHEVRON_FULL_DUR, pRect,
            /*lazyUntilPressed=*/false, /*triggerOnPress=*/true);
    }

    if (g_d2dFactory) {
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
        if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT))) {
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> br;
            if (SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(
                    D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(clr) / 255.f,
                                  GetGValue(clr) / 255.f,
                                  GetBValue(clr) / 255.f,
                                  chevron.alpha / 255.f),
                    &br)) && br) {
                float cx = w * 0.5f;
                float cy = h * 0.5f + 0.5f * scale;
                float dx = 3.7f * scale;
                float dy = 1.9f * scale;
                float stroke = std::max(1.05f, 1.35f * scale);

                pRT->BeginDraw();
                pRT->SetAntialiasMode(D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_PER_PRIMITIVE);

                if (animElapsed >= 0.0) {
                    const DOUBLE t =
                        std::clamp(animElapsed / CHEVRON_FULL_DUR, 0.0, 1.0);
                    pRT->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(
                        0.f, ChevronFullOffset(t) * std::min((float)w, (float)h)));
                }

                // WinUI SplitButton: ChevronDownSmall at 8. Lines only
                // without an icon font.
                if (!DrawChevronGlyphOnRT(pRT.Get(), kChevronGlyphDownSmall,
                        (float)w, (float)h, cx, cy, 0.f, br.Get(),
                        std::max(1, (int)std::lround(kDropDownChevronGlyphDip * scale)))) {
                    pRT->DrawLine(D2D1::Point2F(cx - dx, cy - dy),
                                  D2D1::Point2F(cx, cy + dy),
                                  br.Get(), stroke);
                    pRT->DrawLine(D2D1::Point2F(cx + dx, cy - dy),
                                  D2D1::Point2F(cx, cy + dy),
                                  br.Get(), stroke);
                }

                if (animElapsed >= 0.0)
                    pRT->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());

                HRESULT hr = pRT->EndDraw();
                if (SUCCEEDED(hr))
                    return true;
                if (hr == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                    pRT.Reset();
                    CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    HPEN pen = CreatePen(PS_SOLID, (int)std::max(1.f, 1.35f * scale), clr);
    if (!pen)
        return false;

    int cx = (pRect->left + pRect->right) / 2;
    int cy = (pRect->top + pRect->bottom) / 2;
    HPEN oldPen = (HPEN)SelectObject(hdc, pen);
    MoveToEx(hdc, (int)(cx - 3.7f * scale), (int)(cy - 1.7f * scale), nullptr);
    LineTo(hdc, cx, (int)(cy + 2.3f * scale));
    LineTo(hdc, (int)(cx + 3.7f * scale), (int)(cy - 1.7f * scale));
    SelectObject(hdc, oldPen);
    DeleteObject(pen);
    return true;
}

static bool DrawCommandModuleChevronGlyph(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect, bool useAccent)
{
    if (!hdc || !pRect)
        return false;

    int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
    int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
        return false;

    float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.f;

    // Non-accent callers (Organize, the split-button pair) don't trust
    // GetTextColor(hdc) at all here -- for this specific CommandModule part
    // it comes back a plain, non-CLR_INVALID black regardless of dark/light
    // mode, so a CLR_INVALID-only fallback never actually overrides it.
    // Always compute the neutral color directly instead.
    bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    COLORREF clr;
    if (useAccent) {
        clr = GetTextColor(hdc);
        if (clr == CLR_INVALID || clr == RGB(0, 0, 0) || clr == RGB(255, 255, 255)) {
            clr = GetAccentFillDefault(dark);
        }
    } else {
        clr = dark ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0);
    }

    if (g_d2dFactory) {
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
        if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT))) {
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> br;
            if (SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(
                    D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(clr) / 255.f,
                                  GetGValue(clr) / 255.f,
                                  GetBValue(clr) / 255.f,
                                  1.f),
                    &br)) && br) {
                float cx = w * 0.5f;
                float cy = h * 0.5f + 0.4f * scale;
                float dx = std::min(3.6f * scale, w * 0.34f);
                float dy = std::min(1.9f * scale, h * 0.30f);
                float stroke = std::max(1.05f, 1.30f * scale);

                pRT->BeginDraw();
                pRT->SetAntialiasMode(D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_PER_PRIMITIVE);
                // WinUI DropDownButton: ChevronDownSmall at 8.
                if (!DrawChevronGlyphOnRT(pRT.Get(), kChevronGlyphDownSmall,
                        (float)w, (float)h, cx, cy, 0.f, br.Get(),
                        std::max(1, (int)std::lround(kDropDownChevronGlyphDip * scale)))) {
                    pRT->DrawLine(D2D1::Point2F(cx - dx, cy - dy),
                                  D2D1::Point2F(cx, cy + dy),
                                  br.Get(), stroke);
                    pRT->DrawLine(D2D1::Point2F(cx + dx, cy - dy),
                                  D2D1::Point2F(cx, cy + dy),
                                  br.Get(), stroke);
                }
                HRESULT hr = pRT->EndDraw();
                if (SUCCEEDED(hr))
                    return true;
                if (hr == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                    pRT.Reset();
                    CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    HPEN pen = CreatePen(PS_SOLID, (int)std::max(1.f, 1.30f * scale), clr);
    if (!pen)
        return false;

    int cx = (pRect->left + pRect->right) / 2;
    int cy = (pRect->top + pRect->bottom) / 2;
    HPEN oldPen = (HPEN)SelectObject(hdc, pen);
    MoveToEx(hdc, (int)(cx - 3.6f * scale), (int)(cy - 1.7f * scale), nullptr);
    LineTo(hdc, cx, (int)(cy + 2.3f * scale));
    LineTo(hdc, (int)(cx + 3.6f * scale), (int)(cy - 1.7f * scale));
    SelectObject(hdc, oldPen);
    DeleteObject(pen);
    return true;
}

static void InvalidateSplitButtonChevron(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd))
        return;

    RECT rc = {};
    if (!GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc))
        return;

    UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);
    int glyphW = MulDiv(28, (int)dpi, 96);
    rc.left = std::max(rc.left, rc.right - glyphW);
    RedrawWindow(hwnd, &rc, nullptr,
        RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_NOERASE | RDW_NOCHILDREN | RDW_UPDATENOW);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK SplitButtonChevronSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kSplitButtonChevronSubclassProp);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, SplitButtonChevronSubclassProc);
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    }

    LRESULT ret = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);

    if (msg == WM_ENABLE || msg == WM_STYLECHANGED ||
        msg == BM_SETSTYLE || msg == WM_UPDATEUISTATE) {
        if (g_settings.RoundedButtons && IsSplitButtonChevronCandidate(hwnd))
            InvalidateSplitButtonChevron(hwnd);
    }

    return ret;
}

static void TryInstallSplitButtonChevronSubclass(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!g_settings.RoundedButtons || !IsSplitButtonChevronCandidate(hwnd))
        return;

    if (!GetPropW(hwnd, kSplitButtonChevronSubclassProp)) {
        if (WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                hwnd, SplitButtonChevronSubclassProc, 0))
            SetPropW(hwnd, kSplitButtonChevronSubclassProp, (HANDLE)1);
    }

}

static void SplitButtonChevronRemoveFromWindow(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (GetPropW(hwnd, kSplitButtonChevronSubclassProp)) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, SplitButtonChevronSubclassProc);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kSplitButtonChevronSubclassProp);
    }
}

static BOOL CALLBACK SplitButtonChevronRemoveChildEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    SplitButtonChevronRemoveFromWindow(hwnd);
    return TRUE;
}

// Sweeps every top-level window of this process when RoundedButtons is
// toggled off live, so the subclass doesn't outlive the setting.
static BOOL CALLBACK SplitButtonChevronRemoveEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId())
        return TRUE;
    SplitButtonChevronRemoveFromWindow(hwnd);
    EnumChildWindows(hwnd, SplitButtonChevronRemoveChildEnum, 0);
    return TRUE;
}
// ============================================================================
// Progress bars: thin track + rounded accent fill, no gradient, in GDI+.
// comctl32 v6 paints the control into a BeginBufferedPaint DIB that comes
// zeroed (probed: black under the track whatever the parent's color) and
// PP_BAR is opaque in the theme, so nothing draws the parent behind it --
// the track background is filled here with the parent's own erase color.
// Inside list items and DirectUI hosts the bar stays transparent.
// ============================================================================

static bool ProgressBarInTransparentHost(HDC hdc)
{
    HWND hw = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
    if (!hw) hw = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (!hw) return false;
    wchar_t pc[64] = {};
    GetClassNameW(hw, pc, ARRAYSIZE(pc));
    return _wcsicmp(pc, L"SysListView32") == 0 ||
           wcsstr(pc, L"ListView") != nullptr ||
           _wcsicmp(pc, L"DirectUIHWND") == 0;
}

// The parent's own erase color in either theme: dialogs the mod darkens
// answer WM_CTLCOLORDLG with their dark brush (PropertyDialogSubclassProc and the
// DefWindowProc-level handler), everything else with the brush it really
// paints with.
static void FillProgressTrackBackground(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    HWND hwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
    const COLORREF bg = ParentBackgroundColor(hwnd, hdc, false, COLOR_BTNFACE);
    if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(bg))
        (FillRect_orig ? FillRect_orig : FillRect)(hdc, pRect, br);
}

// The marquee pill slides past the control's edges and comctl32 never
// clips it, so it is clamped to the client along the bar's axis: two
// capsules of one radius on the same band intersect as a capsule, which is
// what a geometric mask would have produced.
static bool PaintProgressCapsule(HDC hdc, Gdiplus::RectF bar, float radius,
    COLORREF color, bool vertical, HWND clampTo, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (clampTo && pRect) {
        RECT client = {};
        if (GetClientRect(clampTo, &client)) {
            // pRect and the client share the control's coordinate space.
            if (vertical) {
                const float top = std::max(bar.Y, static_cast<float>(client.top));
                const float bottom = std::min(bar.Y + bar.Height, static_cast<float>(client.bottom));
                bar.Y = top; bar.Height = bottom - top;
            } else {
                const float left = std::max(bar.X, static_cast<float>(client.left));
                const float right = std::min(bar.X + bar.Width, static_cast<float>(client.right));
                bar.X = left; bar.Width = right - left;
            }
        }
    }
    if (bar.Width <= 0.f || bar.Height <= 0.f)
        return true;
    radius = std::min(radius, std::min(bar.Width, bar.Height) * 0.5f);
    return FillRoundedRectGdip(hdc, bar, radius, GdipColor(color));
}

// ProgressBarBackground, pixel-snapped. Kept a hard-edged fill rather
// than a capsule: ProgressBarTrackCornerRadius is half the track's own
// height, which at these thicknesses only has room to fade the end
// pixels, and the crisp edge is what reads right against the indicator.
static bool PaintProgressTrackLine(HDC hdc, const Gdiplus::RectF& line, bool dark)
{
    RoundedHdcGdipDrawLock gdipLock;
    if (!gdipLock)
        return false;
    Gdiplus::Graphics graphics(hdc);
    if (graphics.GetLastStatus() != Gdiplus::Ok ||
        graphics.SetSmoothingMode(Gdiplus::SmoothingModeNone) != Gdiplus::Ok ||
        graphics.SetPixelOffsetMode(Gdiplus::PixelOffsetModeHalf) != Gdiplus::Ok)
        return false;
    // ProgressBarBackground: ControlStrongStrokeColorDefault, alpha and
    // all -- GDI+ composes it over whatever the track sits on.
    const WinUI::Color track = WinUI::ControlStrongStrokeColorDefault(dark);
    Gdiplus::SolidBrush brush(Gdiplus::Color(track.alpha,
        GetRValue(track.rgb), GetGValue(track.rgb), GetBValue(track.rgb)));
    return graphics.FillRectangle(&brush, line) == Gdiplus::Ok;
}

// Only PP_MOVEOVERLAY (the moving pill) is rendered; the other parts just
// get the track background.
static bool PaintIndeterminateProgressBar(HDC hdc, INT iPartId, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!hdc || !pRect) return false;
    if (iPartId != PP_MOVEOVERLAY && iPartId != PP_MOVEOVERLAYVERT) {
        const bool isTransparentTrack =
            iPartId == PP_TRANSPARENTBAR || iPartId == PP_TRANSPARENTBARVERT;
        if (!(isTransparentTrack && ProgressBarInTransparentHost(hdc)))
            FillProgressTrackBackground(hdc, pRect);
        return true;
    }

    const float w = static_cast<float>(pRect->right - pRect->left);
    const float h = static_cast<float>(pRect->bottom - pRect->top);
    if (w <= 0.f || h <= 0.f) return false;

    const float scale = static_cast<float>(DpiForPaintHdc(hdc)) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const bool isVert = (iPartId == PP_MOVEOVERLAYVERT);
    const float pillH = 4.f * scale;
    const Gdiplus::RectF pill = isVert
        ? Gdiplus::RectF(pRect->left + (w - pillH) * 0.5f, static_cast<float>(pRect->top), pillH, h)
        : Gdiplus::RectF(static_cast<float>(pRect->left), pRect->top + (h - pillH) * 0.5f, w, pillH);
    HWND paintHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
    return PaintProgressCapsule(hdc, pill, pillH * 0.5f,
        GetAccentFillDefault(IsWindowDarkMode(hdc)), isVert, paintHwnd, pRect);
}

// Track: 1px centered neutral line. Fill: 4px centered accent capsule.
static bool PaintProgressBar(HDC hdc, INT iPartId, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!hdc || !pRect) return false;

    // Overlay animations (marquee/pulse) are not reproducible at the right speed.
    if (iPartId == PP_PULSEOVERLAY    || iPartId == PP_MOVEOVERLAY ||
        iPartId == PP_PULSEOVERLAYVERT || iPartId == PP_MOVEOVERLAYVERT)
        return true;

    const float w = static_cast<float>(pRect->right - pRect->left);
    const float h = static_cast<float>(pRect->bottom - pRect->top);
    if (w <= 0.f || h <= 0.f)
        return false;

    const bool isVertical = (iPartId == PP_FILLVERT   || iPartId == PP_BARVERT ||
                             iPartId == PP_TRANSPARENTBARVERT || iPartId == PP_CHUNKVERT);
    const bool isTrack    = (iPartId == PP_BAR          || iPartId == PP_BARVERT ||
                             iPartId == PP_TRANSPARENTBAR || iPartId == PP_TRANSPARENTBARVERT);
    const bool isFill     = (iPartId == PP_CHUNK  || iPartId == PP_FILL ||
                             iPartId == PP_CHUNKVERT || iPartId == PP_FILLVERT);
    if (!isTrack && !isFill)
        return false;

    const bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);

    // In list items the bar must stay transparent (hover changes the bg);
    // the track's verdict carries over to the fill parts that follow it.
    static thread_local bool t_transparentProgress = false;
    if (isTrack) {
        const bool isTransparentTrack =
            iPartId == PP_TRANSPARENTBAR || iPartId == PP_TRANSPARENTBARVERT;
        t_transparentProgress = isTransparentTrack && ProgressBarInTransparentHost(hdc);
        if (!t_transparentProgress)
            FillProgressTrackBackground(hdc, pRect);
    }

    if (isTrack) {
        // ProgressBarTrackHeight, scaled and then rounded to whole pixels
        // the way XAML lays a DIP out. This was one device pixel at any
        // DPI, so the track stayed a hairline while the indicator above it
        // scaled: 8:1 at 200 %, where the template holds them at 3:1.
        const float trackThickness = std::max(1.f,
            floorf(static_cast<float>(DpiForPaintHdc(hdc)) /
                   USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI + 0.5f));
        Gdiplus::RectF line;
        if (isVertical) {
            const float pad = floorf((w - trackThickness) / 2.f + 0.5f);
            line = Gdiplus::RectF(pRect->left + pad,
                static_cast<float>(pRect->top), trackThickness, h);
        } else {
            const float pad = floorf((h - trackThickness) / 2.f + 0.5f);
            line = Gdiplus::RectF(static_cast<float>(pRect->left),
                pRect->top + pad, w, trackThickness);
        }
        return PaintProgressTrackLine(hdc, line, dark);
    }

    const float thickness = 4.f * (static_cast<float>(DpiForPaintHdc(hdc)) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI);
    Gdiplus::RectF bar = isVertical
        ? Gdiplus::RectF(pRect->left + (w - thickness) / 2.f, static_cast<float>(pRect->top), thickness, h)
        : Gdiplus::RectF(static_cast<float>(pRect->left), pRect->top + (h - thickness) / 2.f, w, thickness);

    // ProgressBarForeground is AccentFillColorDefault, resolved per window:
    // an excluded process keeps a light window while the system is dark,
    // and the indicator cache answers for the system.
    const COLORREF accent = GetAccentFillDefault(dark);
    COLORREF color;
    if (iPartId == PP_CHUNK || iPartId == PP_CHUNKVERT ||
        iStateId == PBFS_NORMAL || iStateId == PBFS_PARTIAL)
        color = accent;
    else if (iStateId == PBFS_ERROR)
        color = WinUI::SystemFillColorCritical(dark);
    else if (iStateId == PBFS_PAUSED)
        color = WinUI::SystemFillColorCaution(dark);
    else
        color = accent;

    return PaintProgressCapsule(hdc, bar, thickness / 2.f, color, isVertical, nullptr, nullptr);
}
