constexpr INT TVP_TREEITEM_ = 1;
constexpr INT LVP_LISTITEM_ = 1;
constexpr UINT   TVM_GETNEXTITEM_  = 0x110A;
constexpr WPARAM TVGN_PARENT_      = 0x0003;
constexpr WPARAM TVGN_DROPHILITE_  = 0x0008;
constexpr WPARAM TVGN_CARET_       = 0x0009;
constexpr UINT   LVM_GETNEXTITEM_       = 0x1000 + 12;
constexpr UINT   LVM_GETITEMRECT_       = 0x1000 + 14;
constexpr UINT   LVM_GETSELECTEDCOUNT_  = 0x1000 + 50;
constexpr WPARAM LVNI_FOCUSED_          = 0x0001;
constexpr WPARAM LVNI_SELECTED_         = 0x0002;
constexpr INT    LVIR_BOUNDS_           = 0;
// A bulk selection (Ctrl+A and the like) has no meaningful per-item fade to
// show, so ListSelectFadeResyncWindow skips starting fades entirely above
// this count instead of paying one ancestor-walk-gated map insert per row.
constexpr int    kListSelectFadeMaxBulkSelection = 32;

// True when *pRect matches the keyboard-focused item (Tab/arrow-key nav, not
// a mouse click) and focus cues are visible. Used to recolor an already-drawn
// accent ring instead of layering a second outline (DrawFocusRect_hook,
// DrawRoundedItemBg).
static bool IsKeyboardFocusedItemRect(HWND hwnd, LPCRECT pRect, bool isTreeView)
{
    // GetFocus() is cheap (no IPC) -- check first to skip the SendMessage
    // round-trips below for the common case. Also more correct than
    // NavFocusCuesVisible alone, which can still read "show focus cues"
    // after a mouse click moved focus elsewhere.
    if (!hwnd || !pRect || GetFocus() != hwnd || !NavFocusCuesVisible(hwnd))
        return false;

    RECT fr;
    if (isTreeView) {
        HTREEITEM caret = (HTREEITEM)SendMessageW(hwnd, TVM_GETNEXTITEM_, TVGN_CARET_, 0);
        if (!caret || !TreeView_GetItemRect(hwnd, caret, &fr, FALSE))
            return false;
    } else {
        int idx = (int)(INT_PTR)SendMessageW(hwnd, LVM_GETNEXTITEM_, (WPARAM)-1, MAKELPARAM(LVNI_FOCUSED_, 0));
        if (idx < 0)
            return false;
        fr.left = LVIR_BOUNDS_;
        if (!SendMessageW(hwnd, LVM_GETITEMRECT_, (WPARAM)idx, (LPARAM)&fr))
            return false;
    }
    return EqualRect(&fr, pRect) != FALSE;
}

static bool TreeItemVerticalCenter(HWND hwnd, HTREEITEM item, LONG* centerY)
{
    if (!hwnd || !item || !centerY)
        return false;

    RECT itemRect = {};
    *reinterpret_cast<HTREEITEM*>(&itemRect) = item;
    if (!SendMessageW(hwnd, TVM_GETITEMRECT_, TRUE, (LPARAM)&itemRect) ||
        itemRect.bottom <= itemRect.top)
        return false;

    *centerY = itemRect.top + (itemRect.bottom - itemRect.top) / 2;
    return true;
}

// Called from SendMessageW_hook's LVN_ITEMCHANGED (ListView, iItem >= 0) and
// TVN_SELCHANGEDW/A / TVN_DELETEITEM (TreeView, HTREEITEM) interceptions for
// a clean deselection or a deleted item. Erases the matching ListSelectFade
// entry so a later reselection of the same item starts fresh instead of
// reusing the finished progress=1 state from before.
static void ListSelectFadeInvalidateItem(HWND hwndFrom, ULONG_PTR itemId, bool isTreeView)
{
    if (!hwndFrom || !ShouldDrawSelectionBorder(hwndFrom, isTreeView))
        return;

    const ULONG_PTR key = ListSelectFadeKey(hwndFrom, itemId);
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_lvSelectFadeMutex);
    auto it = g_lvSelectFadeAnims.find(key);
    if (it == g_lvSelectFadeAnims.end())
        return;
    ListSelectFadeMarkComplete(it->second);
    ListSelectFadeUntrackKey(it->second, key);
    g_lvSelectFadeAnims.erase(it);
}

// Called from SendMessageW_hook's LVN_ITEMCHANGED interception for a bulk
// state change (iItem == -1) -- comctl32 reports both "deselect everything"
// (e.g. clicking empty space) and "deselect the old item while selecting a
// new one" this way, so uOldState/uNewState aren't meaningful per item here.
// Re-derives the real selection set directly (SendMessageW_orig -- this runs
// inside the SendMessageW hook, so a plain SendMessageW would re-enter it):
// starts a fresh fade for any currently-selected item that has no entry yet
// (a real new selection can arrive this way too, not just deselection), and
// prunes any tracked entry that fell out of the selection, leaving entries
// for items that stayed selected untouched.
static void ListSelectFadeResyncWindow(HWND hwndFrom)
{
    if (!hwndFrom || !RoundedSelectionVisualsEnabled() ||
        !SysAnimationsEnabled() || !ShouldDrawSelectionBorder(hwndFrom, false))
        return;

    // A bulk selection (Ctrl+A and the like) also arrives as iItem==-1, and
    // has no meaningful per-item fade to show -- counting first avoids
    // thousands of LVM_GETNEXTITEM round-trips and map inserts for a
    // selection this large. Any previously tracked entries for this window
    // are dropped outright rather than left parked in g_lvSelectFadeAnims
    // until the next selection change.
    const int selCount = (int)SendMessageUnhooked(hwndFrom, LVM_GETSELECTEDCOUNT_, 0, 0);
    if (selCount > kListSelectFadeMaxBulkSelection) {
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_lvSelectFadeMutex);
        auto winIt = g_lvSelectFadeKeysByWindow.find(hwndFrom);
        if (winIt == g_lvSelectFadeKeysByWindow.end())
            return;
        std::vector<ULONG_PTR> trackedKeys(
            winIt->second.begin(), winIt->second.end());
        for (ULONG_PTR key : trackedKeys) {
            auto animIt = g_lvSelectFadeAnims.find(key);
            if (animIt != g_lvSelectFadeAnims.end()) {
                ListSelectFadeMarkComplete(animIt->second);
                ListSelectFadeUntrackKey(animIt->second, key);
                g_lvSelectFadeAnims.erase(animIt);
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    std::unordered_set<ULONG_PTR> stillSelected;
    int idx = -1;
    for (;;) {
        idx = (int)SendMessageUnhooked(hwndFrom, LVM_GETNEXTITEM_,
            (WPARAM)idx, MAKELPARAM(LVNI_SELECTED_, 0));
        if (idx < 0)
            break;
        const ULONG_PTR key = ListSelectFadeKey(hwndFrom, (ULONG_PTR)(UINT)idx);
        stillSelected.insert(key);
        bool alreadyTracked;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_lvSelectFadeMutex);
            alreadyTracked = g_lvSelectFadeAnims.find(key) != g_lvSelectFadeAnims.end();
        }
        // Unchecked: ShouldDrawSelectionBorder was already validated once
        // above for the whole batch, so a per-item ancestor walk here would
        // just repeat the same answer at the cost of one extra call per row.
        if (!alreadyTracked)
            ListSelectFadeStartItemUnchecked(hwndFrom, (ULONG_PTR)(UINT)idx);
    }

    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_lvSelectFadeMutex);
    auto winIt = g_lvSelectFadeKeysByWindow.find(hwndFrom);
    if (winIt == g_lvSelectFadeKeysByWindow.end())
        return;

    // Copy first: erasing from winIt->second (via ListSelectFadeUntrackKey)
    // while iterating it directly would invalidate the iterator.
    std::vector<ULONG_PTR> trackedKeys(winIt->second.begin(), winIt->second.end());
    for (ULONG_PTR key : trackedKeys) {
        if (stillSelected.count(key))
            continue;
        auto animIt = g_lvSelectFadeAnims.find(key);
        if (animIt != g_lvSelectFadeAnims.end()) {
            ListSelectFadeMarkComplete(animIt->second);
            ListSelectFadeUntrackKey(animIt->second, key);
            g_lvSelectFadeAnims.erase(animIt);
        }
    }
}

// Called from SendMessageW_hook's LVN_DELETEITEM interception. Deleting an
// item shifts every later index down by one, so any ListSelectFade entry
// tracked for this window could now be keyed at the wrong (shifted) item --
// there's no cheap per-item fix-up without a stable non-index item identity
// (unlike TreeView's HTREEITEM), so this drops the window's entire tracked
// set instead of trying to reindex individual keys. Harmless for an item
// that stays selected across the delete: it just reads as untracked (full
// opacity, matching its already-finished fade) on its next repaint instead
// of finding a parked entry -- same visual result, one extra hit-test.
static void ListSelectFadeInvalidateWindowItems(HWND hwndFrom)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_lvSelectFadeMutex);
    auto winIt = g_lvSelectFadeKeysByWindow.find(hwndFrom);
    if (winIt == g_lvSelectFadeKeysByWindow.end())
        return;

    std::vector<ULONG_PTR> trackedKeys(
        winIt->second.begin(), winIt->second.end());
    for (ULONG_PTR key : trackedKeys) {
        auto animIt = g_lvSelectFadeAnims.find(key);
        if (animIt != g_lvSelectFadeAnims.end()) {
            ListSelectFadeMarkComplete(animIt->second);
            ListSelectFadeUntrackKey(animIt->second, key);
            g_lvSelectFadeAnims.erase(animIt);
        }
    }
}

// Visual tree nesting depth of 'item' (0 = top-level row) and its real
// horizontal indent, measured via TVM_GETITEMRECT rather than assumed --
// the per-level pixel step depends on whether items show a chevron or just
// an icon. Explorer's nav pane has a hidden root (Desktop) above every
// visually top-level item, so a plain "has a parent" check climbs one level
// too far; a null grandparent is the real stop condition. Cached per (tree,
// item): TVM_GETITEMRECT fails for an item scrolled out of view, which would
// otherwise wrongly report 0 inset during that transition instead of falling
// back to the last known-good value.
static HWND      s_pillNestLastHwnd     = nullptr;
static HTREEITEM s_pillNestLastItem     = nullptr;
static int       s_pillNestLastIndentPx = 0;

static void PillItemNestInfo(HWND tv, HTREEITEM item, int* outDepth, int* outIndentPx)
{
    *outDepth = 0;
    *outIndentPx = 0;
    if (!tv || !item) return;

    HTREEITEM top = item;
    int depth = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < PILL_NEST_WALK_SAFETY_CAP; i++)
    {
        HTREEITEM parent = (HTREEITEM)SendMessageW(tv, TVM_GETNEXTITEM_, TVGN_PARENT_, (LPARAM)top);
        HTREEITEM grandparent = parent ? (HTREEITEM)SendMessageW(tv, TVM_GETNEXTITEM_, TVGN_PARENT_, (LPARAM)parent) : nullptr;
        if (!grandparent) break; // 'top' is already visually top-level
        top = parent;
        depth++;
    }
    *outDepth = depth;
    if (top == item) return;

    RECT rcItem = {}; *reinterpret_cast<HTREEITEM*>(&rcItem) = item;
    RECT rcTop  = {}; *reinterpret_cast<HTREEITEM*>(&rcTop)  = top;
    if (!SendMessageW(tv, TVM_GETITEMRECT, TRUE, (LPARAM)&rcItem) ||
        !SendMessageW(tv, TVM_GETITEMRECT, TRUE, (LPARAM)&rcTop))
    {
        if (tv == s_pillNestLastHwnd && item == s_pillNestLastItem)
            *outIndentPx = s_pillNestLastIndentPx;
        return;
    }

    int delta = rcItem.left - rcTop.left;
    if (delta < 0) delta = 0;
    if (delta > (int)PILL_NESTED_MAX_INDENT) delta = (int)PILL_NESTED_MAX_INDENT;
    *outIndentPx = delta;

    s_pillNestLastHwnd     = tv;
    s_pillNestLastItem     = item;
    s_pillNestLastIndentPx = delta;
}

// A successful TVM_GETITEMRECT only proves that the row still participates in
// layout. Require vertical client intersection as well so an off-screen item
// can never provide the origin for a visible DComp transition.
static bool PillItemGetVisibleRect(HWND tv, HTREEITEM item, RECT* outRect)
{
    if (!tv || !item) return false;
    RECT rc = {}; *reinterpret_cast<HTREEITEM*>(&rc) = item;
    const LRESULT gotRect = SendMessageW_orig
        ? SendMessageUnhooked(tv, TVM_GETITEMRECT, FALSE, (LPARAM)&rc)
        : SendMessageW(tv, TVM_GETITEMRECT, FALSE, (LPARAM)&rc);
    if (!gotRect)
        return false;

    RECT client = {};
    if (!GetClientRect(tv, &client) ||
        rc.bottom <= client.top || rc.top >= client.bottom) {
        return false;
    }

    if (outRect)
        *outRect = rc;
    return true;
}

static void PillInvalidateGdiItems(
    HWND tree, const PillTransitionSnapshot& snap)
{
    if (!tree || !IsWindow(tree))
        return;

    const LONG pillRight = static_cast<LONG>(ceilf(
        (NAV_PILL_X_DIP + NAV_PILL_WIDTH_DIP) * snap.scale)) +
        static_cast<LONG>(PILL_NESTED_MAX_INDENT) + 2;
    auto invalidateItem = [&](LPARAM item) {
        RECT itemRect = {};
        if (!item || !PillItemGetVisibleRect(
                         tree, reinterpret_cast<HTREEITEM>(item),
                         &itemRect)) {
            return;
        }
        itemRect.left = 0;
        itemRect.right = (std::min)(itemRect.right, pillRight);
        if (itemRect.right > itemRect.left)
            InvalidateRect(tree, &itemRect, FALSE);
    };

    invalidateItem(snap.prevItem);
    if (snap.curItem != snap.prevItem)
        invalidateItem(snap.curItem);
}

static bool PillItemIsVisible(HWND tv, HTREEITEM item)
{
    return PillItemGetVisibleRect(tv, item, nullptr);
}

struct ShellDuiListItemDrawContext
{
    HWND hwnd = nullptr;
    RECT rc = {};
    DWORD tick = 0;
    // The DirectUI element that painted the item. Only compared against the
    // live ancestors of a painting checkbox, never dereferenced on its own.
    void* element = nullptr;
};

static thread_local ShellDuiListItemDrawContext g_shellDuiListItemCtx[24];
static thread_local UINT g_shellDuiListItemCtxNext = 0;
// Defined with ShellCheckAnim, after the DirectUI declarations.
static void* ShellCheckAnimPaintElement();
static float ShellCheckAnimOnPaint(HDC hdc, INT state, LPCRECT native, LPCRECT target,
    void* itemElement);
// Details view's select-all checkbox lives in a column header, not an item.
static thread_local ShellDuiListItemDrawContext g_shellDuiHeaderItemCtx[8];
static thread_local UINT g_shellDuiHeaderItemCtxNext = 0;

// Last checkbox placement per view: every item of a view has the same size,
// so checkbox paints without a recent item paint reuse it.
struct ShellDuiCheckboxPlacement
{
    HWND hwnd = nullptr;
    UINT dpi = 0;
    int nativeW = 0;
    int nativeH = 0;
    int dx = 0;
    int dy = 0;
    int size = 0;
};

static thread_local ShellDuiCheckboxPlacement g_shellDuiCheckboxPlacements[8];
static thread_local UINT g_shellDuiCheckboxPlacementNext = 0;

static bool IsShellDefViewDirectUI(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd))
        return false;

    wchar_t cls[64] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)) ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"DirectUIHWND") != 0)
        return false;

    return IsInsideShellFolderView(hwnd);
}

static void TrackShellDuiListItemForCheckbox(
    HDC hdc, const std::wstring& cls, INT part, INT state, LPCRECT rc)
{
    const bool header = cls == L"Header" && part == HP_HEADERITEM;
    if (!g_settings.ExplorerSection || !g_settings.RoundedButtons || !rc ||
        (!header && (cls != L"ListView" || part != LVP_LISTITEM_)) ||
        rc->right <= rc->left || rc->bottom <= rc->top)
        return;

    HWND hwnd = GetPaintHwndFromDC(hdc);
    if (!IsShellDefViewDirectUI(hwnd))
        return;

    ShellDuiListItemDrawContext& ctx = header
        ? g_shellDuiHeaderItemCtx[g_shellDuiHeaderItemCtxNext++ %
            ARRAYSIZE(g_shellDuiHeaderItemCtx)]
        : g_shellDuiListItemCtx[g_shellDuiListItemCtxNext++ %
            ARRAYSIZE(g_shellDuiListItemCtx)];
    ctx.hwnd = hwnd;
    ctx.rc = *rc;
    ctx.tick = GetTickCount();
    ctx.element = header ? nullptr : ShellCheckAnimPaintElement();
}

// Item checkboxes sit inside the selection ring with WinUI's 2-DIP inner
// margin. Icon items get a fixed size (16 DIP medium, 20 DIP large, as
// WinUI's CheckBoxSize); rows and tiles keep the native box and position.
static bool ComputeShellDuiCheckboxPlacement(LPCRECT item, LPCRECT rc, UINT dpi,
    ShellDuiCheckboxPlacement* placement)
{
    const int itemW = item->right - item->left;
    const int itemH = item->bottom - item->top;
    const int nativeW = rc->right - rc->left;
    const int nativeH = rc->bottom - rc->top;
    if (itemW <= 0 || itemH <= 0 || nativeW <= 0 || nativeH <= 0)
        return false;

    const float scale = static_cast<float>(dpi) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const int ring = (std::max)(1, static_cast<int>(std::lround(2.f * scale)));
    const int inset = ring + MulDiv(2, static_cast<int>(dpi), USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI);
    const int nativeSize = (std::max)(nativeW, nativeH);
    RECT target = *rc;
    if (static_cast<float>(itemW) / static_cast<float>(itemH) >= 2.5f) {
        target.left = (std::max)(rc->left, static_cast<LONG>(item->left + inset));
        target.right = target.left + nativeW;
    } else {
        const int extent = MulDiv((std::max)(itemW, itemH), USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI,
            static_cast<int>(dpi));
        const int size = (std::max)(nativeSize,
            MulDiv(extent < 96 ? 16 : 20, static_cast<int>(dpi), USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI));
        // ListView rings start dpi/192 px above the item (DrawRoundedItemBg).
        const int ringTop = item->top - static_cast<int>(dpi / 192);
        target = {item->left + inset, ringTop + inset,
            item->left + inset + size, ringTop + inset + size};
    }
    placement->dpi = dpi;
    placement->nativeW = nativeW;
    placement->nativeH = nativeH;
    placement->dx = target.left - rc->left;
    placement->dy = target.top - rc->top;
    placement->size = target.right - target.left;
    return true;
}

static bool GetShellDuiCheckboxRect(HDC hdc, LPCRECT rc, RECT* target, void** itemElement)
{
    *itemElement = nullptr;
    if (!g_settings.ExplorerSection || !g_settings.RoundedButtons || !rc || !target)
        return false;

    HWND hwnd = GetPaintHwndFromDC(hdc);
    if (!IsShellDefViewDirectUI(hwnd))
        return false;

    const DWORD now = GetTickCount();
    const auto contains = [rc](const RECT& outer) {
        return rc->left >= outer.left && rc->right <= outer.right &&
            rc->top >= outer.top && rc->bottom <= outer.bottom;
    };
    for (const ShellDuiListItemDrawContext& ctx : g_shellDuiHeaderItemCtx) {
        if (ctx.hwnd == hwnd && now - ctx.tick <= 5000 && contains(ctx.rc))
            return false;
    }

    const UINT dpi = DpiForPaint(hwnd);
    ShellDuiListItemDrawContext* best = nullptr;
    for (ShellDuiListItemDrawContext& ctx : g_shellDuiListItemCtx) {
        if (ctx.hwnd == hwnd && now - ctx.tick <= 5000 && contains(ctx.rc) &&
            (!best || ctx.tick >= best->tick))
            best = &ctx;
    }

    ShellDuiCheckboxPlacement* stored = nullptr;
    for (ShellDuiCheckboxPlacement& entry : g_shellDuiCheckboxPlacements) {
        if (entry.hwnd == hwnd) {
            stored = &entry;
            break;
        }
    }

    ShellDuiCheckboxPlacement placement;
    if (best && ComputeShellDuiCheckboxPlacement(&best->rc, rc, dpi, &placement)) {
        if (!stored) {
            stored = &g_shellDuiCheckboxPlacements[
                g_shellDuiCheckboxPlacementNext++ % ARRAYSIZE(g_shellDuiCheckboxPlacements)];
        }
        placement.hwnd = hwnd;
        *stored = placement;
        *itemElement = best->element;
    } else if (stored && stored->dpi == dpi &&
               stored->nativeW == rc->right - rc->left &&
               stored->nativeH == rc->bottom - rc->top) {
        placement = *stored;
    } else {
        return false;
    }

    target->left = rc->left + placement.dx;
    target->top = rc->top + placement.dy;
    target->right = target->left + placement.size;
    target->bottom = target->top + placement.size;
    return true;
}

static bool PaintShiftedShellDuiCheckbox(HDC hdc, INT part, INT state, LPCRECT rc)
{
    if (!g_settings.ExplorerSection || !g_settings.RoundedButtons ||
        part != BP_CHECKBOX || !rc)
        return false;

    RECT target = {};
    void* itemElement = nullptr;
    if (!GetShellDuiCheckboxRect(hdc, rc, &target, &itemElement))
        return false;
    const float progress = ShellCheckAnimOnPaint(hdc, state, rc, &target, itemElement);
    return PaintCheckBox(hdc, part, state, &target, progress);
}

// ============================================================================
// Check box and radio images built off screen
// ============================================================================
// comctl32 (list and tree view check boxes) and shell32 (Folder Options'
// advanced settings tree) build check box and radio images by drawing the
// Button parts into a blank 32bpp bitmap and storing it with ImageList_Add
// or ImageList_AddMasked, which take the colors as straight alpha. D2D
// leaves them premultiplied, which darkens the antialiased edge over
// whatever the image is later drawn on. Only such a bake is converted: a
// memory DC with no window, outside any paint, over pixels that were fully
// transparent. Paint buffers keep their premultiplied pixels.
namespace OffscreenBake {
// The box of the 32bpp bitmap selected into hdc, top-down.
static bool ReadBox(HDC hdc, const RECT& box, std::vector<DWORD>* pixels, RECT* device)
{
    GdiFlush();
    HBITMAP bitmap = static_cast<HBITMAP>(GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_BITMAP));
    BITMAP bm = {};
    if (!bitmap || !GetObjectW(bitmap, sizeof(bm), &bm) || bm.bmBitsPixel != 32)
        return false;
    const int width = bm.bmWidth;
    const int height = std::abs(bm.bmHeight);
    RECT d = box;
    LPtoDP(hdc, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(&d), 2);
    *device = {std::clamp<LONG>(d.left, 0, width), std::clamp<LONG>(d.top, 0, height),
        std::clamp<LONG>(d.right, 0, width), std::clamp<LONG>(d.bottom, 0, height)};
    const int boxW = device->right - device->left;
    const int boxH = device->bottom - device->top;
    if (boxW <= 0 || boxH <= 0)
        return false;

    // Only the box's scan lines. They are numbered from the bottom, so the
    // rows come back bottom-up.
    BITMAPINFO bmi = {};
    bmi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(bmi.bmiHeader);
    bmi.bmiHeader.biWidth = width;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biHeight = height;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;
    std::vector<DWORD> rows(static_cast<size_t>(width) * boxH);
    if (GetDIBits(hdc, bitmap, static_cast<UINT>(height - device->bottom),
            static_cast<UINT>(boxH), rows.data(), &bmi, DIB_RGB_COLORS) != boxH)
        return false;
    pixels->resize(static_cast<size_t>(boxW) * boxH);
    for (int y = 0; y < boxH; ++y)
        memcpy(&(*pixels)[static_cast<size_t>(y) * boxW],
            &rows[static_cast<size_t>(boxH - 1 - y) * width + device->left],
            boxW * sizeof(DWORD));
    return true;
}

// Before the draw: whether this one builds an image.
static bool Begin(HDC hdc, INT part, LPCRECT rc)
{
    if ((part != BP_CHECKBOX && part != BP_RADIOBUTTON) || !rc || t_paintDepth > 0 ||
        GetObjectType(hdc) != OBJ_MEMDC || WindowFromDC(hdc))
        return false;
    std::vector<DWORD> pixels;
    RECT device = {};
    return ReadBox(hdc, *rc, &pixels, &device) &&
        std::all_of(pixels.begin(), pixels.end(), [](DWORD p) { return p == 0; });
}

// After it: the drawn box is read back, converted and written over itself
// (SetDIBitsToDevice keeps alpha).
static void Finish(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc)
{
    std::vector<DWORD> pixels;
    RECT device = {};
    if (!ReadBox(hdc, rc, &pixels, &device))
        return;
    const int boxW = device.right - device.left;
    const int boxH = device.bottom - device.top;
    ConvertPremultipliedDibToStraightAlpha(pixels.data(), boxW, boxH);
    BITMAPINFO bmi = {};
    bmi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(bmi.bmiHeader);
    bmi.bmiHeader.biWidth = boxW;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -boxH;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;
    POINT origin = {device.left, device.top};
    DPtoLP(hdc, &origin, 1);
    SetDIBitsToDevice(hdc, origin.x, origin.y, boxW, boxH, 0, 0, 0, boxH,
        pixels.data(), &bmi, DIB_RGB_COLORS);
}
}

// ============================================================================
// Desktop item check boxes
// ============================================================================
// comctl32 bakes the desktop list view's check boxes once into a state image
// list sized by GetThemePartSize(Button, BP_CHECKBOX, CBS_UNCHECKEDNORMAL,
// TS_DRAW), drawing only the unchecked and checked normal states. The image
// is anchored at the icon's left edge and the item's top: a bigger cell only
// grows right and down, the item layout stays put, and the whole cell is
// the clickable box (measured by Log Desktop Item Checkboxes). While the
// desktop list view handles a message, the cell is answered at a 16 DIP box
// plus the drop that clears the selection ring's top edge, and the box is
// drawn at the cell's bottom.
namespace DesktopCheckbox {
static std::atomic<HWND> g_listView{nullptr};
static std::atomic<bool> g_unloading{false};
static std::atomic<bool> g_recheckPending{false};
static UINT g_recheckMessage;
// The desktop list view's thread only.
static thread_local int t_depth = 0;
static thread_local HWND t_listView = nullptr;
static thread_local int t_drawDy = 0;
static thread_local int t_drawSize = 0;
// The re-bake at unload: the theme draw hook leaves check boxes native, so
// no image drawn by this mod outlives it.
static thread_local bool t_nativeBake = false;
static SIZE g_customCell = {};

static bool Enabled()
{
    return g_settings.ExplorerSection && g_settings.RoundedButtons &&
        !g_unloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

// One 16 DIP box in every desktop view (Explorer's medium item size). The
// ring is the ListView tile's (DrawRoundedItemBg), starting dpi/192 px above
// the item.
static SIZE WantedCell(HWND lv, int* dy, int* size)
{
    UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(lv);
    if (!dpi)
        dpi = USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const float scale = static_cast<float>(dpi) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const int ring = (std::max)(1, static_cast<int>(std::lround(2.f * scale)));
    const int inset = ring + MulDiv(2, static_cast<int>(dpi), USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI);
    *dy = inset - static_cast<int>(dpi / 192);
    *size = MulDiv(16, static_cast<int>(dpi), USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI);
    return {*size, *dy + *size};
}

// From GetThemePartSize while the desktop list view handles a message.
static void OnPartSize(HTHEME theme, int part, int state, THEMESIZE eSize, SIZE* size)
{
    if (!t_listView || part != BP_CHECKBOX || state != CBS_UNCHECKEDNORMAL ||
        eSize != TS_DRAW || GetCachedThemeClass(theme) != L"Button")
        return;
    if (!Enabled()) {
        g_customCell = {};
        t_drawSize = 0;
        return;
    }
    *size = WantedCell(t_listView, &t_drawDy, &t_drawSize);
    g_customCell = *size;
}

// The bake's draws of the cell answered above: the box goes to its bottom.
static bool PaintCell(HDC hdc, INT part, INT state, LPCRECT rc)
{
    if (t_depth <= 0 || t_drawSize <= 0 || part != BP_CHECKBOX || !rc ||
        rc->right - rc->left != t_drawSize ||
        rc->bottom - rc->top != t_drawDy + t_drawSize)
        return false;
    const RECT box = {rc->left, rc->top + t_drawDy,
        rc->left + t_drawSize, rc->top + t_drawDy + t_drawSize};
    return PaintCheckBox(hdc, part, state, &box, 1.f);
}

// Turning LVS_EX_CHECKBOXES off and on makes comctl32 bake again; that resets
// every item's state image, so the check states are put back.
static void Rebake(HWND lv)
{
    const int count = static_cast<int>(DefSubclassProc(lv, LVM_GETITEMCOUNT, 0, 0));
    std::vector<UINT> states(static_cast<size_t>((std::max)(count, 0)));
    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        states[i] = static_cast<UINT>(DefSubclassProc(lv, LVM_GETITEMSTATE, i,
            LVIS_STATEIMAGEMASK));
    t_nativeBake = g_unloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    DefSubclassProc(lv, LVM_SETEXTENDEDLISTVIEWSTYLE, LVS_EX_CHECKBOXES, 0);
    DefSubclassProc(lv, LVM_SETEXTENDEDLISTVIEWSTYLE, LVS_EX_CHECKBOXES,
        LVS_EX_CHECKBOXES);
    t_nativeBake = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        const UINT now = static_cast<UINT>(DefSubclassProc(lv, LVM_GETITEMSTATE, i,
            LVIS_STATEIMAGEMASK));
        if (now == states[i])
            continue;
        LVITEMW item = {};
        item.stateMask = LVIS_STATEIMAGEMASK;
        item.state = states[i];
        DefSubclassProc(lv, LVM_SETITEMSTATE, i, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&item));
    }
    InvalidateRect(lv, nullptr, TRUE);
}

// Bakes again when the cell in use isn't the one wanted now: DPI or the
// settings changed, or comctl32 baked before the hook saw it.
static void Recheck(HWND lv)
{
    g_recheckPending.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    const DWORD exStyle = static_cast<DWORD>(
        DefSubclassProc(lv, LVM_GETEXTENDEDLISTVIEWSTYLE, 0, 0));
    if (!(exStyle & LVS_EX_CHECKBOXES))
        return;
    SIZE current = {};
    if (HIMAGELIST stateList = reinterpret_cast<HIMAGELIST>(
            DefSubclassProc(lv, LVM_GETIMAGELIST, LVSIL_STATE, 0))) {
        int cx = 0, cy = 0;
        if (ImageList_GetIconSize(stateList, &cx, &cy))
            current = {cx, cy};
    }
    bool rebake;
    if (Enabled()) {
        int dy = 0, size = 0;
        const SIZE wanted = WantedCell(lv, &dy, &size);
        rebake = current.cx != wanted.cx || current.cy != wanted.cy;
    } else {
        rebake = g_customCell.cx && current.cx == g_customCell.cx &&
            current.cy == g_customCell.cy;
    }
    if (rebake)
        Rebake(lv);
}

static void QueueRecheck(HWND lv)
{
    if (!g_recheckPending.exchange(true, std::memory_order_acq_rel) &&
        !PostMessageW(lv, g_recheckMessage, 0, 0))
        g_recheckPending.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK ListViewSubclass(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp,
    DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        // comctl32 drops the subclass itself. A recheck still queued dies
        // with the window.
        HWND expected = hwnd;
        if (g_listView.compare_exchange_strong(expected, nullptr))
            g_recheckPending.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    }
    const HWND outerListView = t_listView;
    t_listView = hwnd;
    ++t_depth;
    LRESULT result = 0;
    if (msg == g_recheckMessage && g_recheckMessage)
        Recheck(hwnd);
    else
        result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    if (--t_depth == 0)
        t_drawSize = 0;
    t_listView = outerListView;

    if ((msg == WM_THEMECHANGED || msg == WM_DPICHANGED_AFTERPARENT) &&
        (Enabled() || g_customCell.cx))
        QueueRecheck(hwnd);
    return result;
}

// BeforeUninit raises g_unloading before it reads g_listView: either it sees
// this view and removes the subclass, or this sees the flag and does.
static bool Install(HWND lv)
{
    HWND expected = nullptr;
    if (!g_listView.compare_exchange_strong(expected, lv, std::memory_order_seq_cst))
        return false;
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(lv, ListViewSubclass, 0)) {
        g_listView.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
        return false;
    }
    if (g_unloading.load(std::memory_order_seq_cst)) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(lv, ListViewSubclass);
        g_listView.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// From the desktop list view's paint, on its thread.
static void Attach(HWND lv)
{
    if (!lv || !g_recheckMessage || !Enabled() ||
        g_listView.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == lv)
        return;
    if (Install(lv))
        QueueRecheck(lv);
}

static void Init()
{
    g_recheckMessage = RegisterWindowMessageW(L"Win32UIModernizer.DesktopCheckboxRecheck");
}

static BOOL CALLBACK FindListViewEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM lParam)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId())
        return TRUE;
    HWND defView = FindWindowExW(hwnd, nullptr, L"SHELLDLL_DefView", nullptr);
    HWND lv = defView ? FindWindowExW(defView, nullptr, L"SysListView32", nullptr)
                      : nullptr;
    if (lv && IsDesktopIconListView(lv)) {
        *reinterpret_cast<HWND*>(lParam) = lv;
        return FALSE;
    }
    return TRUE;
}

// A switch on attaches now; any switch makes the attached view check its cell.
static void SettingsChanged()
{
    HWND lv = g_listView.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (lv) {
        QueueRecheck(lv);
        return;
    }
    if (!Enabled())
        return;
    EnumWindows(FindListViewEnum, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&lv));
    if (lv && Install(lv))
        QueueRecheck(lv);
}

// Puts the native check boxes back while the subclass still runs.
static void BeforeUninit()
{
    g_unloading.store(true, std::memory_order_seq_cst);
    HWND lv = g_listView.load(std::memory_order_seq_cst);
    if (!lv || !IsWindow(lv))
        return;
    DWORD_PTR ignored = 0;
    SendMessageTimeoutW(lv, g_recheckMessage, 0, 0, SMTO_ABORTIFHUNG | SMTO_BLOCK,
        5000, &ignored);
    WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(lv, ListViewSubclass);
    g_listView.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
}
}

// hwnd resolved from hdc (not a parameter -- DrawTheme* hooks feeding this
// pipeline don't always carry one) mirrors the WindowFromDC/g_tlsPaintHwnd
// fallback used elsewhere in the file. For an excluded process, this drag
// image is real app content dragged from/into that process's own window --
// same category as the file-picker exception, narrowed the same way:
// still dark only inside IsInsideExcludedFilePicker's scope.
static bool DragDropDarkMode(HDC hdc)
{
    bool sysDark = IsSystemDarkMode();
    if (!g_darkModeExcluded) return sysDark;
    HWND hw = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (!hw) hw = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
    return IsInsideExcludedFilePicker(hw) && sysDark;
}

static bool ShouldModernizeDragDrop()
{
    return g_settings.NormalizeDragDrop || IsCustomDarkModeAllowed();
}

// Intercepts DrawThemeBackground for DragDrop/DD_IMAGEBG and draws
// a rounded rectangle directly at the pRect size the OS requested.
// Unlike SetBitmapBits approach, no scaling is involved so corners stay crisp.
// Color: semi-transparent dark in dark mode, semi-transparent light in light mode.
static bool PaintDragDrop(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!pRect || !g_d2dFactory) return false;

    // The drag image is process/system themed rather than tied to the HDC window.
    bool dark = DragDropDarkMode(hdc);
    if (g_accentCacheDirty.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) RefreshAccentCache();

    // Fill: blend with text glow (system draws dark shadow behind text).
    // Kept visibly non-zero (not just a subtle tint) since Windows sometimes
    // fails to generate the dragged item's own image and shows only this
    // background -- it needs to still read as a fallback drag indicator.
    D2D1_COLOR_F fill = dark
        ? D2D1::ColorF(0.93f, 0.93f, 0.93f, 0.14f)  // light on dark
        : D2D1::ColorF(0.10f, 0.10f, 0.10f, 0.11f);  // dark on light

    // Scale corner radius by DPI
    float cr = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * (DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / (float)USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI);
    float w  = (float)(pRect->right  - pRect->left);
    float h  = (float)(pRect->bottom - pRect->top);

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
    if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
        return false;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
    pRT->BeginDraw();
    pRT->Clear(D2D1::ColorF(0, 0, 0, 0));
    if (SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(fill, &brush)))
        pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
            D2D1::RoundedRect(D2D1::RectF(0, 0, w, h), cr, cr),
            brush.Get());
    HRESULT hr = pRT->EndDraw();
    if (hr == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        pRT.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
        return false;
    }
    return SUCCEEDED(hr);
}

static COLORREF DragDropBadgeTextColor(HDC hdc)
{
    return DragDropDarkMode(hdc) ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0);
}

// DragDrop parts 1-6 (DD_COPY, DD_MOVE, DD_UPDATEMETADATA, DD_CREATELINK,
// DD_WARNING, DD_NONE per vsstyle.h) each show a small action badge; 7/8
// (DD_IMAGEBG/DD_TEXTBG) are backgrounds, handled separately above. Maps
// each to a Segoe Fluent Icons codepoint, with an optional rotation for
// parts that reuse another part's glyph at a different angle instead of a
// dedicated one.
static const wchar_t* DragDropBadgeGlyphForPart(int part, float* outRotationDegrees)
{
    *outRotationDegrees = 0.0f;
    switch (part) {
    case 1: return L""; // DD_COPY
    case 2: return L""; // DD_MOVE
    case 3: return L""; // DD_UPDATEMETADATA
    case 4:
        // DD_CREATELINK: the Move arrow rotated to the classic diagonal
        // shortcut-badge angle, instead of a dedicated link glyph.
        *outRotationDegrees = -45.0f;
        return L"";
    case 5: return L""; // DD_WARNING
    case 6: return L""; // DD_NONE
    default: return nullptr;
    }
}

static void DragDropDWriteCacheClearLocked()

static void DragDropBadgeBitmapDeleteLocked()
{
    if (g_dragDropBadgeCache.hdc && g_dragDropBadgeCache.oldBmp)
        SelectObject(g_dragDropBadgeCache.hdc, g_dragDropBadgeCache.oldBmp);
    if (g_dragDropBadgeCache.bmp)
        DeleteObject(g_dragDropBadgeCache.bmp);
    if (g_dragDropBadgeCache.hdc)
        DeleteDC(g_dragDropBadgeCache.hdc);
    g_dragDropBadgeCache = {};
}

static void DragDropBadgeCacheClear()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_dragDropBadgeCacheMutex);
    DragDropBadgeBitmapDeleteLocked();
    if (g_dragDropBadgeFont) {
        DeleteObject(g_dragDropBadgeFont);
        g_dragDropBadgeFont = nullptr;
    }
    g_dragDropBadgeFontKey = {};
    g_dragDropBadgeFontKeyValid = false;
    g_dragDropBadgeFace[0] = L'\0';
    g_dragDropBadgeFaceValid = false;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> gdipLock(g_dragDropGdipMutex);
    delete g_dragDropGdip.fillBrush;
    delete g_dragDropGdip.borderPen;
    g_dragDropGdip.fillBrush = nullptr;
    g_dragDropGdip.borderPen = nullptr;
    g_dragDropGdip.paletteValid = false;
    if (g_dragDropGdip.token) {
        Gdiplus::GdiplusShutdown(g_dragDropGdip.token);
        g_dragDropGdip.token = 0;
    }
    g_dragDropGdip.ready = false;
    g_dragDropGdip.startupAttempted = false;

    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> dwLock(g_dragDropDwMutex);
    DragDropDWriteCacheClearLocked();
}

static LPCWSTR GetDragDropBadgeFaceLocked()
{
    if (g_dragDropBadgeFaceValid)
        return g_dragDropBadgeFace;

    if (FontFamilyExists(L"Segoe UI Variable Text Semibold"))
        wcscpy_s(g_dragDropBadgeFace, L"Segoe UI Variable Text Semibold");
    else
        wcscpy_s(g_dragDropBadgeFace, L"Segoe UI Semibold");

    g_dragDropBadgeFaceValid = true;
    return g_dragDropBadgeFace;
}

static bool GetDragDropBadgeLogFont(HDC hdc, HTHEME hTheme, int part, int state, LOGFONTW* out)
{
    if (!out)
        return false;

    LOGFONTW lf = {};
    if (FAILED(GetThemeFont(hTheme, hdc, part, state, TMT_FONT, &lf))) {
        HFONT current = (HFONT)GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT);
        if (!current || !GetObjectW(current, sizeof(lf), &lf))
            return false;
    }

    constexpr LONG kBadgeSemiboldWeight = FW_SEMIBOLD;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_dragDropBadgeCacheMutex);
        wcscpy_s(lf.lfFaceName, GetDragDropBadgeFaceLocked());
    }
    lf.lfWeight = kBadgeSemiboldWeight;
    *out = lf;
    return true;
}

static HFONT GetDragDropBadgeFont(HDC hdc, HTHEME hTheme, int part, int state)
{
    LOGFONTW lf = {};
    if (!GetDragDropBadgeLogFont(hdc, hTheme, part, state, &lf))
        return nullptr;

    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_dragDropBadgeCacheMutex);
    if (g_dragDropBadgeFont && g_dragDropBadgeFontKeyValid &&
        memcmp(&g_dragDropBadgeFontKey, &lf, sizeof(lf)) == 0)
        return g_dragDropBadgeFont;

    if (g_dragDropBadgeFont) {
        DeleteObject(g_dragDropBadgeFont);
        g_dragDropBadgeFont = nullptr;
    }

    HFONT font = CreateFontIndirectW(&lf);
    if (!font) {
        wcscpy_s(lf.lfFaceName, L"Segoe UI Semibold");
        font = CreateFontIndirectW(&lf);
    }
    if (!font) {
        g_dragDropBadgeFontKey = {};
        g_dragDropBadgeFontKeyValid = false;
        return nullptr;
    }

    g_dragDropBadgeFont = font;
    g_dragDropBadgeFontKey = lf;
    g_dragDropBadgeFontKeyValid = true;
    return g_dragDropBadgeFont;
}

static bool DragDropBadgeBitmapEnsureLocked(HDC hdc, int side, UINT dpi, bool dark)
{
    if (g_dragDropBadgeCache.hdc && g_dragDropBadgeCache.bmp &&
        g_dragDropBadgeCache.side == side &&
        g_dragDropBadgeCache.dpi == dpi &&
        g_dragDropBadgeCache.dark == dark)
        return true;

    DragDropBadgeBitmapDeleteLocked();

    HDC memDC = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
    if (!memDC)
        return false;

    BITMAPINFO bi = {};
    bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(bi.bmiHeader);
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = side;
    bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -side;
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

    void* bits = nullptr;
    HBITMAP bmp = CreateDIBSection(memDC, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
    if (!bmp || !bits) {
        if (bmp) DeleteObject(bmp);
        DeleteDC(memDC);
        return false;
    }

    HGDIOBJ oldBmp = SelectObject(memDC, bmp);
    memset(bits, 0, side * side * 4);

    const float scale = dpi / (float)USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> gdipLock(g_dragDropGdipMutex);
        if (!DragDropEnsureGdipLocked(dark)) {
            SelectObject(memDC, oldBmp);
            DeleteObject(bmp);
            DeleteDC(memDC);
            return false;
        }

        Gdiplus::Graphics graphics(memDC);
        graphics.SetSmoothingMode(Gdiplus::SmoothingModeAntiAlias);
        graphics.SetPixelOffsetMode(Gdiplus::PixelOffsetModeHalf);
        Gdiplus::RectF rect(0.5f, 0.5f, (Gdiplus::REAL)side - 1.0f,
            (Gdiplus::REAL)side - 1.0f);
        Gdiplus::GraphicsPath path;
        DragDropAddRoundedRect(path, rect, WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale);
        graphics.FillPath(g_dragDropGdip.fillBrush, &path);
        graphics.DrawPath(g_dragDropGdip.borderPen, &path);
        if (graphics.GetLastStatus() != Gdiplus::Ok) {
            SelectObject(memDC, oldBmp);
            DeleteObject(bmp);
            DeleteDC(memDC);
            return false;
        }
    }

    GdiFlush();
    g_dragDropBadgeCache.hdc = memDC;
    g_dragDropBadgeCache.bmp = bmp;
    g_dragDropBadgeCache.oldBmp = oldBmp;
    g_dragDropBadgeCache.side = side;
    g_dragDropBadgeCache.dpi = dpi;
    g_dragDropBadgeCache.dark = dark;
    return true;
}

// A label arrives in up to three calls -- the text before the destination
// with state 1, the destination with state 2, the text after it with state 1
// again -- and the background has to cover whichever of them exist. Only one
// fragment is ever held: the piece drawn before the one that completes it.
// Which piece that is depends on the language, so the held fragment records
// whether it is waiting for a destination or is one.
struct DragDropPendingLabel {
    bool valid = false;
    bool isDestination = false;  // held a state-2 fragment, awaiting a suffix
    int part = 0;
    RECT rect = {};
    wchar_t text[128] = {};
};

static thread_local DragDropPendingLabel g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel;

static bool DragDropCopyText(wchar_t* dst, size_t dstCount, LPCWSTR text, int cchText)
{
    if (!dst || dstCount == 0)
        return false;

    dst[0] = L'\0';
    if (!text)
        return false;

    size_t n = cchText >= 0
        ? (std::min<size_t>)((size_t)cchText, dstCount - 1)
        : wcsnlen(text, dstCount - 1);
    if (n > 0)
        wmemcpy(dst, text, n);
    dst[n] = L'\0';
    return n > 0;
}

static LONG DragDropAbsLong(LONG value)
{
    return value < 0 ? -value : value;
}

static int DragDropDpiFromHdc(HDC hdc, int index)
{
    int dpi = hdc ? GetDeviceCaps(hdc, index) : USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    return dpi > 0 ? dpi : USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
}

static LONG DragDropScaleDpi(LONG value, int dpi)
{
    return MulDiv(value, dpi > 0 ? dpi : USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI,
        USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI);
}

static LONG DragDropScaleMargin(LONG value, int dpi)
{
    if (dpi <= USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI)
        return value;

    return value + MulDiv(value, dpi - USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI,
        USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI * 2);
}

static bool DragDropIsIconNearText(HDC hdc, const RECT& iconRc,
    const RECT& textRc)
{
    const LONG gapTolerance = DragDropScaleMargin(4,
        DragDropDpiFromHdc(hdc, LOGPIXELSX));
    return DragDropAbsLong(iconRc.right - textRc.left) <= gapTolerance &&
        iconRc.bottom > textRc.top &&
        iconRc.top < textRc.bottom + DragDropScaleMargin(8,
            DragDropDpiFromHdc(hdc, LOGPIXELSY));
}

static bool DragDropTryObservedDpi(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, const RECT& textRc,
    int* dpiX, int* dpiY)
{
    if (!dpiX || !dpiY || !g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.valid ||
        g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.theme != hTheme ||
        !DragDropIsIconNearText(hdc, g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.rect, textRc)) {
        return false;
    }

    const LONG w = g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.rect.right -
        g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.rect.left;
    const LONG h = g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.rect.bottom -
        g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.rect.top;
    *dpiX = w > 0 ? MulDiv(w, USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI, 24) :
        USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    *dpiY = h > 0 ? MulDiv(h, USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI, 30) :
        USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    return true;
}

static int DragDropEffectiveDpiX(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, const RECT& textRc)
{
    int dpiX = USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    int dpiY = USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    if (DragDropTryObservedDpi(hTheme, hdc, textRc, &dpiX, &dpiY))
        return dpiX;

    return DragDropDpiFromHdc(hdc, LOGPIXELSX);
}

static int DragDropEffectiveDpiY(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, const RECT& textRc)
{
    int dpiX = USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    int dpiY = USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    if (DragDropTryObservedDpi(hTheme, hdc, textRc, &dpiX, &dpiY))
        return dpiY;

    return DragDropDpiFromHdc(hdc, LOGPIXELSY);
}

static RECT DragDropIconRectForText(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, const RECT& textRc)
{
    if (g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.valid &&
        g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.theme == hTheme &&
        DragDropIsIconNearText(hdc, g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.rect, textRc)) {
        return g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.rect;
    }

    const int dpiX = DragDropEffectiveDpiX(hTheme, hdc, textRc);
    const int dpiY = DragDropEffectiveDpiY(hTheme, hdc, textRc);
    const LONG iconW = DragDropScaleDpi(24, dpiX);
    const LONG iconH = DragDropScaleDpi(30, dpiY);
    RECT iconRc = {};
    iconRc.left = textRc.left - iconW;
    iconRc.top = textRc.top + DragDropScaleDpi(-2, dpiY);
    iconRc.right = iconRc.left + iconW;
    iconRc.bottom = iconRc.top + iconH;
    return iconRc;
}

static RECT DragDropUnionRects(RECT a, const RECT& b)
{
    a.left = (std::min)(a.left, b.left);
    a.top = (std::min)(a.top, b.top);
    a.right = (std::max)(a.right, b.right);
    a.bottom = (std::max)(a.bottom, b.bottom);
    return a;
}

static RECT DragDropBackgroundRectForText(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc,
    const RECT& firstTextRc, const RECT* secondTextRc)
{
    const int dpiX = DragDropEffectiveDpiX(hTheme, hdc, firstTextRc);
    const int dpiY = DragDropEffectiveDpiY(hTheme, hdc, firstTextRc);
    RECT bg = DragDropUnionRects(DragDropIconRectForText(hTheme, hdc,
        firstTextRc), firstTextRc);
    if (secondTextRc)
        bg = DragDropUnionRects(bg, *secondTextRc);

    bg.left -= DragDropScaleMargin(5, dpiX);
    bg.top -= DragDropScaleMargin(3, dpiY);
    bg.right += DragDropScaleMargin(10, dpiX);
    bg.bottom -= DragDropScaleMargin(2, dpiY);
    if (bg.bottom <= bg.top)
        bg.bottom = bg.top + 1;
    return bg;
}

static Gdiplus::Color DragDropGdipColor(BYTE r, BYTE g, BYTE b)
{
    return Gdiplus::Color(255, r, g, b);
}

static void DragDropAddRoundedRect(Gdiplus::GraphicsPath& path,
    const Gdiplus::RectF& rect, float radius)
{
    const float diameter = radius * 2.0f;
    if (diameter <= 0.0f) {
        path.AddRectangle(rect);
        return;
    }

    path.AddArc(rect.X, rect.Y, diameter, diameter, 180.0f, 90.0f);
    path.AddArc(rect.GetRight() - diameter, rect.Y, diameter, diameter,
        270.0f, 90.0f);
    path.AddArc(rect.GetRight() - diameter, rect.GetBottom() - diameter,
        diameter, diameter, 0.0f, 90.0f);
    path.AddArc(rect.X, rect.GetBottom() - diameter, diameter, diameter,
        90.0f, 90.0f);
    path.CloseFigure();
}

static bool DragDropEnsureGdipLocked(bool dark)
{
    if (!g_dragDropGdip.ready) {
        if (g_dragDropGdip.startupAttempted ||
            g_gdipUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            return false;

        g_dragDropGdip.startupAttempted = true;
        Gdiplus::GdiplusStartupInput input;
        if (Gdiplus::GdiplusStartup(&g_dragDropGdip.token, &input, nullptr) !=
            Gdiplus::Ok) {
            g_dragDropGdip.token = 0;
            return false;
        }
        g_dragDropGdip.ready = true;
    }

    if (g_dragDropGdip.paletteValid && g_dragDropGdip.dark == dark &&
        g_dragDropGdip.fillBrush && g_dragDropGdip.borderPen) {
        return true;
    }

    delete g_dragDropGdip.fillBrush;
    delete g_dragDropGdip.borderPen;
    g_dragDropGdip.fillBrush = nullptr;
    g_dragDropGdip.borderPen = nullptr;

    // WinUI's surface colors, instead of the values this once carried by eye.
    // The stroke token is translucent in XAML and is flattened over the fill,
    // because half of a 1px pen lands outside the shape, where the backdrop
    // is whatever the app underneath happens to show.
    const COLORREF fillRgb = WinUiFloatingSurfaceColor(dark);
    // Flat, not the Secondary->Default gradient WinUI maps onto a control's
    // border: this chip's outline is uniform, and it is the same hairline the
    // tooltip and menu windows carry.
    const COLORREF borderRgb = WinUiFloatingSurfaceStroke(dark);
    const Gdiplus::Color fill = DragDropGdipColor(
        GetRValue(fillRgb), GetGValue(fillRgb), GetBValue(fillRgb));
    const Gdiplus::Color border = DragDropGdipColor(
        GetRValue(borderRgb), GetGValue(borderRgb), GetBValue(borderRgb));
    g_dragDropGdip.fillBrush = new Gdiplus::SolidBrush(fill);
    g_dragDropGdip.borderPen = new Gdiplus::Pen(border, 1.0f);
    g_dragDropGdip.dark = dark;
    g_dragDropGdip.paletteValid = g_dragDropGdip.fillBrush &&
        g_dragDropGdip.fillBrush->GetLastStatus() == Gdiplus::Ok &&
        g_dragDropGdip.borderPen &&
        g_dragDropGdip.borderPen->GetLastStatus() == Gdiplus::Ok;
    return g_dragDropGdip.paletteValid;
}

// Several of this overlay's pixel constants (corner radius, badge cover
// padding) were tuned by eye at 125% (120 DPI) rather than 100% (96 DPI) --
// scale proportionally from that reference point so they hold the same
// visual proportion at any DPI, instead of DragDropScaleDpi's 96-DPI-base
// assumption compounding an extra ~1.25x on top of the DPI they were
// already tuned at.
static float DragDropScaleFromReferenceDpi(float valueAtReference, int dpi)
{
    constexpr float kReferenceDpi = 120.0f; // 125% scaling
    return valueAtReference * (dpi / kReferenceDpi);
}

// Shared by the label pill and the badge cover chip so their corners always
// match. WinUI's ControlCornerRadius is 4, and ToolTip -- the closest thing
// the toolkit has to this surface -- rounds with it, so this is 4 DIP rather
// than the 120-DPI tuning the badge padding above keeps.
static float DragDropChipCornerRadius(HDC hdc)
{
    return WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * (DragDropDpiFromHdc(hdc, LOGPIXELSX) /
                   (float)USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI);
}

static bool PaintDragDropLabelBackground(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc,
    const RECT& firstTextRc, const RECT* secondTextRc)
{
    if (!hdc)
        return false;

    RECT bg = DragDropBackgroundRectForText(hTheme, hdc, firstTextRc,
        secondTextRc);

    // This paints into a small offscreen bitmap sized tightly to the native
    // content, not the full window -- WindowFromDC(hdc) returns null here,
    // so there's no window rect to check. Clamp to the HDC's actual
    // selected bitmap so a long destination name's +10 right margin never
    // lands past the real edge of the surface (confirmed live: without
    // this, the rounded corner there hard-clips square instead of curving).
    HGDIOBJ selectedBmp = GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_BITMAP);
    BITMAP bmInfo = {};
    if (selectedBmp && GetObjectW(selectedBmp, sizeof(bmInfo), &bmInfo) &&
        bmInfo.bmWidth > 0 && bmInfo.bmHeight > 0) {
        bg.left = (std::max)(bg.left, 0L);
        bg.top = (std::max)(bg.top, 0L);
        bg.right = (std::min)(bg.right, (LONG)bmInfo.bmWidth);
        bg.bottom = (std::min)(bg.bottom, (LONG)bmInfo.bmHeight);
    }

    if (bg.right <= bg.left || bg.bottom <= bg.top)
        return false;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_dragDropGdipMutex);
    if (!DragDropEnsureGdipLocked(DragDropDarkMode(hdc)))
        return false;

    // DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION: this DragDrop overlay is a tiny hot-path rounded
    // rectangle over an existing HDC. GDI+ gives anti-aliased corners with less
    // setup than a one-off D2D DC render target here.
    Gdiplus::Graphics graphics(hdc);
    graphics.SetSmoothingMode(Gdiplus::SmoothingModeAntiAlias);
    graphics.SetPixelOffsetMode(Gdiplus::PixelOffsetModeHalf);

    Gdiplus::RectF rect(
        (Gdiplus::REAL)bg.left + 0.5f,
        (Gdiplus::REAL)bg.top + 0.5f,
        (Gdiplus::REAL)(bg.right - bg.left - 1),
        (Gdiplus::REAL)(bg.bottom - bg.top - 1));
    Gdiplus::GraphicsPath path;
    const float cornerRadius = DragDropChipCornerRadius(hdc);
    DragDropAddRoundedRect(path, rect, cornerRadius);
    graphics.FillPath(g_dragDropGdip.fillBrush, &path);
    graphics.DrawPath(g_dragDropGdip.borderPen, &path);
    return true;
}

static void DragDropRepaintLastIconIfNeeded(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc,
    const RECT& firstTextRc, const RECT* secondTextRc)
{
    if (!DrawThemeBackground_orig || !g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.valid ||
        g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.theme != hTheme) {
        return;
    }

    const RECT bg = DragDropBackgroundRectForText(hTheme, hdc, firstTextRc,
        secondTextRc);
    RECT intersection = {};
    if (!IntersectRect(&intersection, &g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.rect, &bg))
        return;

    DrawThemeBackground_orig(hTheme, hdc, g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.part,
        g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.state, &g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.rect, nullptr);
}

// The shell builds a drop label from a DROPDESCRIPTION message carrying a
// %1 where the destination goes, and draws the halves as separate calls: the
// text before %1 with state 1, the destination itself with state 2. What
// marks that first half is where it ends -- on the space the destination is
// appended after -- not the phrase, which comes from whichever app supplied
// the description ("Open with X", "Add to X") and is localized on top of
// that. Matching the phrase only ever recognized the handful that were
// listed, in the one language they were written in; everything else was
// treated as a whole label and got a background sized to the prefix alone,
// with the destination drawn outside it.
static bool DragDropTextIsPrefix(LPCWSTR text)
{
    if (!text || !*text)
        return false;
    return text[wcslen(text) - 1] == L' ';
}

static bool DragDropShouldPaintSingleLabel(int part, int state, LPCWSTR text)
{
    if (state != 1 || !text || !*text)
        return false;

    return part == 1 || part == 2 || part == 4 || part == 6;
}

static bool DragDropIsIconPart(int part, int state)
{
    return state == 0 && (part == 1 || part == 2 || part == 4 || part == 6);
}

static bool DragDropIsLikelyIconRect(HDC hdc, LPCRECT rc)
{
    if (!rc)
        return false;

    const LONG w = rc->right - rc->left;
    const LONG h = rc->bottom - rc->top;
    constexpr LONG kBaseW = 24;
    constexpr LONG kBaseH = 30;
    const LONG scaledW = DragDropScaleDpi(kBaseW, DragDropDpiFromHdc(hdc,
        LOGPIXELSX));
    const LONG scaledH = DragDropScaleDpi(kBaseH, DragDropDpiFromHdc(hdc,
        LOGPIXELSY));
    const LONG tolX = (std::max<LONG>)(1, DragDropScaleDpi(2,
        DragDropDpiFromHdc(hdc, LOGPIXELSX)));
    const LONG tolY = (std::max<LONG>)(1, DragDropScaleDpi(2,
        DragDropDpiFromHdc(hdc, LOGPIXELSY)));

    return (DragDropAbsLong(w - kBaseW) <= 1 &&
               DragDropAbsLong(h - kBaseH) <= 1) ||
        (DragDropAbsLong(w - scaledW) <= tolX &&
            DragDropAbsLong(h - scaledH) <= tolY);
}

// DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION: GDI+, not D2D -- see PaintDragDropLabelBackground's
// exception above for the base rationale (same overlay, matching opaque
// fill so the two chips read as one visual). Also sidesteps a D2D-specific
// bug found here: Clear(0,0,0,0) left this rect's rounded corners reading
// back as solid black on this surface; GDI+ FillPath just leaves those
// pixels alone.
//
// Purpose: something paints the OS's own badge bitmap into this same rect
// before this call runs -- confirmed live it's none of DrawThemeIcon/
// GetThemeColor/GetThemeBitmap/ImageList_Draw(Indirect)/AlphaBlend, and it
// shows up underneath our glyph rather than as a separately-composited
// cursor layer (a cursor would render on top instead). Covering the whole
// rect first hides it regardless of what actually wrote it. No border
// stroke, unlike the label pill -- this chip should disappear into the
// surrounding chrome, not read as its own shape.
static void PaintDragDropBadgeCover(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!pRect || !hdc) return;
    RECT rc = *pRect;
    if (rc.right <= rc.left || rc.bottom <= rc.top) return;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_dragDropGdipMutex);
    if (!DragDropEnsureGdipLocked(DragDropDarkMode(hdc)))
        return;

    Gdiplus::Graphics graphics(hdc);
    graphics.SetSmoothingMode(Gdiplus::SmoothingModeAntiAlias);
    graphics.SetPixelOffsetMode(Gdiplus::PixelOffsetModeHalf);

    Gdiplus::RectF rect(
        (Gdiplus::REAL)rc.left + 0.5f,
        (Gdiplus::REAL)rc.top + 0.5f,
        (Gdiplus::REAL)(rc.right - rc.left - 1),
        (Gdiplus::REAL)(rc.bottom - rc.top - 1));
    Gdiplus::GraphicsPath path;
    const float cornerRadius = DragDropChipCornerRadius(hdc);
    DragDropAddRoundedRect(path, rect, cornerRadius);
    graphics.FillPath(g_dragDropGdip.fillBrush, &path);
}

// Draws a badge glyph over the native DragDrop icon part, in the same
// color as the badge label text so both stay consistent in light/dark mode.
static bool PaintDragDropBadgeIcon(HDC hdc, int iPartId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!pRect) return false;
    float rotationDegrees = 0.0f;
    const wchar_t* glyph = DragDropBadgeGlyphForPart(iPartId, &rotationDegrees);
    if (!glyph) return false;

    // Raise the bottom edge and widen the left edge a little so the chip
    // reads closer to square instead of a tall narrow strip. Left only --
    // the icon rect sits immediately against the text label's own left edge
    // (DragDropIconRectForText), so widening right would creep straight
    // into the label text itself (PaintDragDropLabelBackground). The cover
    // and the glyph's centering both use this same adjusted rect, so
    // nothing native is left exposed at the trimmed/widened edges.
    RECT rc = *pRect;
    const int dpiX = DragDropDpiFromHdc(hdc, LOGPIXELSX);
    const int dpiY = DragDropDpiFromHdc(hdc, LOGPIXELSY);
    rc.bottom -= (LONG)std::lround(DragDropScaleFromReferenceDpi(2.0f, dpiY));
    rc.left -= (LONG)std::lround(DragDropScaleFromReferenceDpi(2.0f, dpiX));
    if (rc.bottom <= rc.top || rc.right <= rc.left) return false;

    const int w = rc.right - rc.left;
    const int h = rc.bottom - rc.top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return false;
    PaintDragDropBadgeCover(hdc, &rc);

    // Glyph size shrinks independently of the cover above -- the cover just
    // grew a little, so keeping the old 0.85 multiplier would now crowd its
    // edges.
    const int fontSize = (int)std::lround((std::min)(w, h) * 0.65f);
    if (fontSize <= 0) return false;
    return DrawGlyphDW(hdc, rc, DragDropBadgeTextColor(hdc), glyph, fontSize,
        1.0f, rotationDegrees);
}

// Shared by every call site that can render a DragDrop badge part (1-6):
// Windows draws some of them via DrawThemeBackground(Ex) (a dedicated theme
// bitmap) and others -- confirmed live for DD_CREATELINK/DD_NONE, which
// reuse common system icons -- via DrawThemeIcon instead. Both need the
// same rect-cache update (for the label-background positioning elsewhere)
// and the same glyph draw, so one place owns both instead of drifting.
static bool DragDropHandleBadgeIcon(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, int iPartId,
    int iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!pRect || iPartId < 1 || iPartId > 6) return false;
    if (DragDropIsIconPart(iPartId, iStateId) &&
        DragDropIsLikelyIconRect(hdc, pRect)) {
        g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.valid = true;
        g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.theme = hTheme;
        g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.part = iPartId;
        g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.state = iStateId;
        g_tlsDragDropLastIcon.rect = *pRect;
    }
    PaintDragDropBadgeIcon(hdc, iPartId, pRect);
    return true;
}

static bool DrawDragDropLabelText(HDC hdc, HTHEME hTheme, int part, int state,
    LPCWSTR text, LPCRECT rc, DWORD flags)
{
    if (!hdc || !text || !rc)
        return false;

    LOGFONTW lf = {};
    HFONT font = nullptr;
    if (SUCCEEDED(GetThemeFont(hTheme, hdc, part, state, TMT_FONT, &lf)))
        font = CreateFontIndirectW(&lf);

    HGDIOBJ oldFont = font ? SelectObject(hdc, font) : nullptr;
    const bool preserveTextColor = !DragDropDarkMode(hdc) && state == 1 &&
        part != kDragDropTextBgPart;
    COLORREF oldText = CLR_INVALID;
    if (!preserveTextColor)
        oldText = SetTextColor(hdc, DragDropBadgeTextColor(hdc));
    int oldBkMode = SetBkMode(hdc, TRANSPARENT);
    RECT textRc = *rc;
    bool oldDragTextPaint = g_tlsDragDropTextPaint;
    bool oldPreserveTextColor = g_tlsDragDropPreserveTextColor;
    g_tlsDragDropTextPaint = true;
    g_tlsDragDropPreserveTextColor = preserveTextColor;
    DrawTextW(hdc, text, -1, &textRc, flags ? flags : (DT_LEFT | DT_TOP | DT_SINGLELINE));
    g_tlsDragDropTextPaint = oldDragTextPaint;
    g_tlsDragDropPreserveTextColor = oldPreserveTextColor;
    if (oldBkMode)
        SetBkMode(hdc, oldBkMode);
    if (!preserveTextColor)
        SetTextColor(hdc, oldText);
    if (oldFont)
        SelectObject(hdc, oldFont);
    if (font)
        DeleteObject(font);
    return true;
}

static DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT DragDropDWriteWeight(LONG weight)
{
    if (weight <= 0)
        return DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL;
    if (weight <= 100)
        return DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_THIN;
    if (weight <= 200)
        return DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_EXTRA_LIGHT;
    if (weight <= 300)
        return DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_LIGHT;
    if (weight <= 350)
        return DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_SEMI_LIGHT;
    if (weight <= 400)
        return DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL;
    if (weight <= 500)
        return DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_MEDIUM;
    if (weight <= 600)
        return DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_SEMI_BOLD;
    if (weight <= 700)
        return DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD;
    if (weight <= 800)
        return DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_EXTRA_BOLD;
    return DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BLACK;
}

static IDWriteFactory* DragDropEnsureDWriteFactoryLocked()
{
    if (g_dragDropDwCache.factory)
        return g_dragDropDwCache.factory;

    IDWriteFactory* raw = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED,
            __uuidof(IDWriteFactory), reinterpret_cast<IUnknown**>(&raw))) ||
        !raw) {
        return nullptr;
    }

    g_dragDropDwCache.factory = raw;
    return g_dragDropDwCache.factory;
}

static bool DragDropGetTextLogFont(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, int part,
    int state, LOGFONTW* lf)
{
    if (!lf)
        return false;

    if (part == kDragDropTextBgPart)
        return GetDragDropBadgeLogFont(hdc, hTheme, part, state, lf);

    if (SUCCEEDED(GetThemeFont(hTheme, hdc, part, state, TMT_FONT, lf)))
        return true;

    HFONT current = (HFONT)GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT);
    return current && GetObjectW(current, sizeof(*lf), lf);
}

static IDWriteTextFormat* DragDropEnsureDWriteFormatLocked(
    const LOGFONTW& lf, DWORD flags, UINT dpi)
{
    IDWriteFactory* dw = DragDropEnsureDWriteFactoryLocked();
    if (!dw)
        return nullptr;

    if (g_dragDropDwCache.format && g_dragDropDwCache.formatKeyValid &&
        g_dragDropDwCache.formatFlags == flags &&
        g_dragDropDwCache.formatDpi == dpi &&
        memcmp(&g_dragDropDwCache.formatKey, &lf, sizeof(lf)) == 0) {
        g_dragDropDwCache.format->AddRef();
        return g_dragDropDwCache.format;
    }

    if (g_dragDropDwCache.format) {
        g_dragDropDwCache.format->Release();
        g_dragDropDwCache.format = nullptr;
    }
    g_dragDropDwCache.formatKey = {};
    g_dragDropDwCache.formatFlags = 0;
    g_dragDropDwCache.formatDpi = 0;
    g_dragDropDwCache.formatKeyValid = false;

    const float fontSize = (float)(lf.lfHeight < 0 ? -lf.lfHeight :
        lf.lfHeight);
    if (fontSize <= 0.0f)
        return nullptr;

    const wchar_t* faceName = lf.lfFaceName[0] ? lf.lfFaceName : L"Segoe UI";
    const wchar_t* fallbackFace = lf.lfWeight >= FW_SEMIBOLD
        ? L"Segoe UI Semibold" : L"Segoe UI Semilight";
    const wchar_t* names[2] = { faceName, fallbackFace };
    const size_t nameCount = wcscmp(faceName, fallbackFace) != 0 ? 2 : 1;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> fmtPtr = CreateSegoeVariableAwareTextFormat(
        dw, names, nameCount, DragDropDWriteWeight(lf.lfWeight), fontSize, dpi,
        lf.lfItalic != 0);
    IDWriteTextFormat* format = fmtPtr.Detach();
    if (!format)
        return nullptr;

    format->SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP);
    format->SetTextAlignment((flags & DT_RIGHT) ?
        DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_TRAILING : (flags & DT_CENTER) ?
        DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_CENTER : DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_LEADING);
    format->SetParagraphAlignment((flags & DT_BOTTOM) ?
        DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_FAR : (flags & DT_VCENTER) ?
        DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_CENTER : DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_NEAR);

    // Only activates when a caller's layout rect is narrower than the
    // text's natural width -- a long destination name that overflows its
    // native rect ends in an ellipsis instead of a raw mid-glyph cut.
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteInlineObject> ellipsisSign;
    if (SUCCEEDED(dw->CreateEllipsisTrimmingSign(format, &ellipsisSign))) {
        DWRITE_TRIMMING trimming = { DWRITE_TRIMMING_GRANULARITY_CHARACTER, 0, 0 };
        format->SetTrimming(&trimming, ellipsisSign.Get());
    }

    g_dragDropDwCache.formatDpi = dpi;
    g_dragDropDwCache.format = format;
    g_dragDropDwCache.formatKey = lf;
    g_dragDropDwCache.formatFlags = flags;
    g_dragDropDwCache.formatKeyValid = true;
    g_dragDropDwCache.format->AddRef();
    return g_dragDropDwCache.format;
}

static bool DrawDragDropLabelTextDWrite(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, int part,
    int state, LPCWSTR text, int cchText, LPCRECT rc, DWORD flags)
{
    if (!g_d2dFactory || !hdc || !text || !rc)
        return false;

    LOGFONTW lf = {};
    if (!DragDropGetTextLogFont(hTheme, hdc, part, state, &lf))
        return false;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> fmt;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_dragDropDwMutex);
        IDWriteTextFormat* rawFmt = DragDropEnsureDWriteFormatLocked(
            lf, flags, DpiForPaintHdc(hdc));
        if (!rawFmt)
            return false;
        fmt.Attach(rawFmt);
    }

    const int textLen = cchText >= 0 ? cchText : (int)wcslen(text);
    if (textLen <= 0)
        return false;

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, rc, g_d2dFactory,
            &rt)) || !rt) {
        return false;
    }

    D2D1_COLOR_F color = {};
    const COLORREF textColor = DragDropBadgeTextColor(hdc);
    color.r = GetRValue(textColor) / 255.0f;
    color.g = GetGValue(textColor) / 255.0f;
    color.b = GetBValue(textColor) / 255.0f;
    color.a = 1.0f;

    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt.Get(), color);
    if (!brush)
        return false;

    const D2D1_RECT_F textRect = D2D1::RectF(0.0f, 0.0f,
        (float)(rc->right - rc->left), (float)(rc->bottom - rc->top));

    FPUGuard fpu;
    rt->BeginDraw();
    rt->SetTextAntialiasMode(D2D1_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_MODE_GRAYSCALE);
    rt->DrawTextW(text, (UINT32)textLen, fmt.Get(), textRect, brush,
        D2D1_DRAW_TEXT_OPTIONS_CLIP);
    HRESULT hr = rt->EndDraw();
    if (hr == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET)
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    return SUCCEEDED(hr);
}

static bool DrawDragDropLabelTextBestEffort(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, int part,
    int state, LPCWSTR text, LPCRECT rc, DWORD flags)
{
    if (DrawDragDropLabelTextDWrite(hTheme, hdc, part, state, text, -1, rc,
            flags)) {
        return true;
    }

    return DrawDragDropLabelText(hdc, hTheme, part, state, text, rc, flags);
}

static HRESULT DrawDragDropThemeTextTransparent(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, int part,
    int state, LPCWSTR text, int cchText, DWORD flags, LPRECT rc)
{
    if (!hdc || !text || !rc)
        return E_INVALIDARG;

    if (DrawDragDropLabelTextDWrite(hTheme, hdc, part, state, text, cchText,
            rc, flags)) {
        return S_OK;
    }

    HFONT font = nullptr;
    bool fontOwned = false;
    std::unique_lock<std::recursive_mutex> fontCacheLock;
    if (part == kDragDropTextBgPart) {
        fontCacheLock = std::unique_lock<std::recursive_mutex>(g_dragDropBadgeCacheMutex);
        font = GetDragDropBadgeFont(hdc, hTheme, part, state);
    } else {
        LOGFONTW lf = {};
        if (SUCCEEDED(GetThemeFont(hTheme, hdc, part, state, TMT_FONT, &lf))) {
            font = CreateFontIndirectW(&lf);
            fontOwned = font != nullptr;
        }
    }

    HGDIOBJ oldFont = font ? SelectObject(hdc, font) : nullptr;
    const bool preserveTextColor = !DragDropDarkMode(hdc) && state == 1 &&
        part != kDragDropTextBgPart;
    COLORREF oldText = CLR_INVALID;
    if (!preserveTextColor)
        oldText = SetTextColor(hdc, DragDropBadgeTextColor(hdc));
    int oldBkMode = SetBkMode(hdc, TRANSPARENT);
    bool oldDragTextPaint = g_tlsDragDropTextPaint;
    bool oldPreserveTextColor = g_tlsDragDropPreserveTextColor;
    g_tlsDragDropTextPaint = true;
    g_tlsDragDropPreserveTextColor = preserveTextColor;

    RECT textRc = *rc;
    UINT drawFlags = flags ? flags : (DT_LEFT | DT_TOP | DT_SINGLELINE);
    INT ret = DrawTextW(hdc, text, cchText, &textRc, drawFlags);

    g_tlsDragDropTextPaint = oldDragTextPaint;
    g_tlsDragDropPreserveTextColor = oldPreserveTextColor;
    if (oldBkMode)
        SetBkMode(hdc, oldBkMode);
    if (!preserveTextColor)
        SetTextColor(hdc, oldText);
    if (oldFont)
        SelectObject(hdc, oldFont);
    if (fontOwned)
        DeleteObject(font);

    return ret ? S_OK : E_FAIL;
}

// DirectWrite's rendering of the same native font can measure a few pixels
// wider than the native (GDI) metrics that sized this rect -- previously
// that just clipped an imperceptible sliver off the last glyph, but now
// that trimming is on, that same small overflow triggers a visible ellipsis
// on text that clearly fits (e.g. "Imagens", "Documentos"). A small safety
// pad, well inside the pill's own +10 right margin, absorbs that slop
// without the text visibly overflowing the pill.
static RECT DragDropWidenTextRectForSubstituteFont(RECT rc, HDC hdc)
{
    rc.right += DragDropScaleDpi(4, DragDropDpiFromHdc(hdc, LOGPIXELSX));
    return rc;
}

// Paints a deferred prefix on its own, for the case where the destination
// never arrived. Without it, a text held back by DragDropTextIsPrefix and
// then abandoned would never be drawn at all -- the worst case of the rule
// has to stay "a background sized to the prefix", which is what unrecognized
// labels already got, and never a label missing its text.
static void DragDropFlushPendingLabel(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, DWORD flags)
{
    if (!g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.valid)
        return;

    wchar_t pendingText[ARRAYSIZE(g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.text)] = {};
    wcscpy_s(pendingText, g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.text);
    const RECT pendingRc = g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.rect;
    const int pendingPart = g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.part;
    const int pendingState = g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.isDestination ? 2 : 1;
    g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.valid = false;

    PaintDragDropLabelBackground(hTheme, hdc, pendingRc, nullptr);
    DragDropRepaintLastIconIfNeeded(hTheme, hdc, pendingRc, nullptr);
    const RECT widenedRc = DragDropWidenTextRectForSubstituteFont(pendingRc, hdc);
    DrawDragDropLabelTextBestEffort(hTheme, hdc, pendingPart, pendingState,
        pendingText, &widenedRc, flags);
}

static HRESULT TryDrawDragDropCombinedLabel(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, int part,
    int state, LPCWSTR text, int cchText, DWORD flags, LPCRECT rc)
{
    if (!hdc || !rc)
        return E_NOTIMPL;

    if (state == 1) {
        wchar_t labelText[128] = {};
        const bool haveText = DragDropCopyText(labelText, ARRAYSIZE(labelText),
                                               text, cchText) && labelText[0];

        // A destination is waiting and this is the text that follows it:
        // the pair is drawn together, over one background, the mirror of the
        // prefix case below. Languages that put the destination first read
        // this way round.
        if (haveText && g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.valid &&
            g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.isDestination &&
            g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.part == part) {
            const RECT destRc = g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.rect;
            wchar_t destText[ARRAYSIZE(g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.text)] = {};
            wcscpy_s(destText, g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.text);
            g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.valid = false;

            PaintDragDropLabelBackground(hTheme, hdc, destRc, rc);
            DragDropRepaintLastIconIfNeeded(hTheme, hdc, destRc, rc);
            const RECT widenedDestRc =
                DragDropWidenTextRectForSubstituteFont(destRc, hdc);
            const RECT widenedSuffixRc =
                DragDropWidenTextRectForSubstituteFont(*rc, hdc);
            DrawDragDropLabelTextBestEffort(hTheme, hdc, part, 2, destText,
                &widenedDestRc, flags);
            DrawDragDropLabelTextBestEffort(hTheme, hdc, part, state,
                labelText, &widenedSuffixRc, flags);
            return S_OK;
        }

        // Anything still pending here belongs to a label whose other half
        // never came; it goes down now, before this one takes its place.
        DragDropFlushPendingLabel(hTheme, hdc, flags);

        if (!haveText) {
            g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.valid = false;
            return E_NOTIMPL;
        }

        if (DragDropTextIsPrefix(labelText)) {
            g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.valid = true;
            g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.isDestination = false;
            g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.part = part;
            g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.rect = *rc;
            wcscpy_s(g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.text, labelText);
            return S_OK;
        }

        g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.valid = false;
        if (DragDropShouldPaintSingleLabel(part, state, labelText)) {
            PaintDragDropLabelBackground(hTheme, hdc, *rc, nullptr);
            DragDropRepaintLastIconIfNeeded(hTheme, hdc, *rc, nullptr);
            const RECT widenedRc = DragDropWidenTextRectForSubstituteFont(*rc, hdc);
            DrawDragDropLabelTextBestEffort(hTheme, hdc, part, state,
                labelText, &widenedRc, flags);
            return S_OK;
        }

        return E_NOTIMPL;
    }

    if (state != 2)
        return E_NOTIMPL;

    if (!g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.valid ||
        g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.isDestination ||
        g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.part != part) {
        wchar_t destOnly[ARRAYSIZE(g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.text)] = {};
        if (!DragDropCopyText(destOnly, ARRAYSIZE(destOnly), text, cchText) ||
            !destOnly[0]) {
            return E_NOTIMPL;
        }

        // A destination held on the previous pass and never completed means
        // this label has no second half. Holding it again would draw every
        // frame one frame late, and the label follows the cursor, so the
        // stale hold is dropped and this one is drawn where it belongs.
        if (g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.valid &&
            g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.isDestination &&
            g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.part == part) {
            g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.valid = false;
            PaintDragDropLabelBackground(hTheme, hdc, *rc, nullptr);
            DragDropRepaintLastIconIfNeeded(hTheme, hdc, *rc, nullptr);
            const RECT widenedRc =
                DragDropWidenTextRectForSubstituteFont(*rc, hdc);
            DrawDragDropLabelTextBestEffort(hTheme, hdc, part, state, destOnly,
                &widenedRc, flags);
            return S_OK;
        }

        // Otherwise this destination may be the one that comes first, with its
        // text still to follow. Hold it: the next state-1 fragment either
        // completes the pair above or, failing that, the branch just above
        // settles it on the pass after.
        DragDropFlushPendingLabel(hTheme, hdc, flags);
        g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.valid = true;
        g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.isDestination = true;
        g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.part = part;
        g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.rect = *rc;
        wcscpy_s(g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.text, destOnly);
        return S_OK;
    }

    wchar_t destText[160] = {};
