    DragDropCopyText(destText, ARRAYSIZE(destText), text, cchText);

    PaintDragDropLabelBackground(hTheme, hdc, g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.rect,
        rc);
    DragDropRepaintLastIconIfNeeded(hTheme, hdc, g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.rect,
        rc);
    const RECT widenedPrefixRc = DragDropWidenTextRectForSubstituteFont(
        g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.rect, hdc);
    const RECT widenedDestRc = DragDropWidenTextRectForSubstituteFont(*rc, hdc);
    DrawDragDropLabelTextBestEffort(hTheme, hdc, part, 1,
        g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.text, &widenedPrefixRc, flags);
    DrawDragDropLabelTextBestEffort(hTheme, hdc, part, state, destText,
        &widenedDestRc, flags);
    g_tlsDragDropPendingLabel.valid = false;
    return S_OK;
}

static bool PaintDragDropTextBg(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!pRect || !g_d2dFactory) return false;

    const int wPx = pRect->right - pRect->left;
    const int hPx = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (wPx <= 0 || hPx <= 0) return false;
    if (wPx > hPx * 2)
        return true;

    const bool dark = DragDropDarkMode(hdc);
    const UINT dpi = DpiForPaintHdc(hdc);
    const float scale = dpi / (float)USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const int pad = std::max(4, (int)(5.f * scale + 0.5f));
    const int side = std::max(wPx, hPx) + pad * 2;
    const int cx = (pRect->left + pRect->right) / 2;
    const int cy = (pRect->top + pRect->bottom) / 2;
    RECT drawRc = {
        cx - side / 2,
        cy - side / 2,
        cx - side / 2 + side,
        cy - side / 2 + side
    };

    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_dragDropBadgeCacheMutex);
    if (!DragDropBadgeBitmapEnsureLocked(hdc, side, dpi, dark))
        return false;

    BLENDFUNCTION bf = { AC_SRC_OVER, 0, 255, AC_SRC_ALPHA };
    return !!AlphaBlend(hdc, drawRc.left, drawRc.top, side, side,
        g_dragDropBadgeCache.hdc, 0, 0, side, side, bf);
}

// Forward-declared: real definition is further down, near the file-op
// GDI+ recoloring block.
static bool IsFileOpProgressWindow(HWND hwnd);

// Themed push buttons normally cross-fade between states via uxtheme's
// buffered-transition system. That blend never reliably reached the screen
// for our custom-drawn buttons (push buttons here, Pause/CopyClose below),
// leaving the pre-transition state visible until an unrelated repaint
// bypassed it. Forcing duration to 0 skips the capture/blend.
static decltype(&GetThemeTransitionDuration) GetThemeTransitionDuration_orig = nullptr;
HRESULT WINAPI GetThemeTransitionDuration_hook(HTHEME hTheme, int iPartId,
    int iStateIdFrom, int iStateIdTo, int iPropId, DWORD* pdwDuration)
{
    if (pdwDuration && iPropId == TMT_TRANSITIONDURATIONS &&
        LegacyDialogCheckboxOwnsTransition(iPartId) &&
        GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme) == L"Button") {
        // PaintCheckBox animates the glyph. A second native transition would
        // capture/blend the entire caption and bypass fresh text paints.
        *pdwDuration = 0;
        return S_OK;
    }
    {
        // Only while this mod paints these controls (the gates of their
        // HandleThemeDraw branches); otherwise the native transition stays.
        const std::wstring& cls = GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme);
        const bool isComboBox =
            cls.find(L"ComboBox") != std::wstring::npos ||
            cls.find(L"Combobox") != std::wstring::npos;
        const bool isEdit = cls.find(L"Edit") != std::wstring::npos;
        const bool paintsComboBox = isComboBox &&
            (IsCustomDarkModeAllowed() || g_settings.RoundedButtons ||
             g_settings.ExplorerSection);
        const bool paintsEdit = isEdit &&
            (g_settings.EditFocusLine || g_settings.ExplorerSection);
        if (paintsComboBox || paintsEdit) {
            if (pdwDuration)
                *pdwDuration = 0;
            return S_OK;
        }
    }
    if (g_settings.RoundedButtons) {
        const std::wstring& cls = GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme);
        // Push and command-link buttons crossfade their own fill
        // (ButtonFillFadeStep); the native buffered-paint transition is off.
        if (cls == L"Button" &&
            (iPartId == BP_PUSHBUTTON || iPartId == BP_COMMANDLINK ||
             iPartId == 7 /*BP_COMMANDLINKGLYPH*/)) {
            if (pdwDuration) *pdwDuration = 0;
            return S_OK;
        }
        if (cls == L"Spin" && iPartId >= 1 && iPartId <= 4) {
            if (pdwDuration) *pdwDuration = 0;
            return S_OK;
        }
        if ((cls == L"Pause" || cls == L"CopyClose") &&
            IsFileOpProgressWindow(g_tlsPaintHwnd)) {
            if (pdwDuration) *pdwDuration = 0;
            return S_OK;
        }
    }
    if (g_settings.ExplorerSection && g_settings.LegacyRebarControls) {
        const std::wstring& cls = GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme);
        const bool isBreadcrumbButton =
            iPartId == TP_BUTTON || iPartId == TP_DROPDOWNBUTTON ||
            iPartId == TP_SPLITBUTTON ||
            iPartId == TP_SPLITBUTTONDROPDOWN;
        if (cls == L"Toolbar" && isBreadcrumbButton &&
            (IsExplorerRebarHost(nullptr) || IsCurrentProcessMMC())) {
            if (pdwDuration)
                *pdwDuration = 0;
            return S_OK;
        }
        // The classic Open/Save dialog's toolbars are custom-drawn per item
        // (PaintClassicDlgToolbarItem / PaintClassicPlacesBarItem).
        if (cls == L"Toolbar" && isBreadcrumbButton &&
            (IsClassicDialogTopToolbar(g_tlsPaintHwnd) ||
             IsClassicPlacesBarToolbarAnyMode(g_tlsPaintHwnd))) {
            if (pdwDuration)
                *pdwDuration = 0;
            return S_OK;
        }
    }
    if (g_settings.ModernContextMenus) {
        const std::wstring& cls = GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme);
        const bool isToolbarButton =
            iPartId == TP_BUTTON || iPartId == TP_DROPDOWNBUTTON || iPartId == TP_SPLITBUTTON;
        if (cls == L"Toolbar" && isToolbarButton &&
            IsLegacyShellDropdownRoot(g_tlsPaintHwnd)) {
            if (pdwDuration) *pdwDuration = 0;
            return S_OK;
        }
    }
    // A picker follows the Explorer surface from whatever process hosts
    // it, so this can no longer key off IsCurrentProcessExplorer alone --
    // that is what left its bars on the system transition once dark mode
    // stopped forcing the renderer on.
    const bool filePickerSurface =
        FilePickerMicaActive() || ExplorerOpaqueMode();
    const bool scrollbarRendererMayBeActive = g_settings.ModernScrollbars ||
        filePickerSurface ||
        (ExplorerBackdropMode() && IsCurrentProcessExplorer());
    if (scrollbarRendererMayBeActive) {
        const std::wstring& cls = GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme);
        const bool animatedPart =
            iPartId == SBP_ARROWBTN ||
            iPartId == SBP_THUMBBTNVERT || iPartId == SBP_THUMBBTNHORZ ||
            iPartId == SBP_UPPERTRACKVERT || iPartId == SBP_LOWERTRACKVERT ||
            iPartId == SBP_UPPERTRACKHORZ || iPartId == SBP_LOWERTRACKHORZ;
        if (cls == L"ScrollBar" && animatedPart) {
            const bool pickerScrollbar = filePickerSurface &&
                (t_filePickerListScrollBarDepth > 0 ||
                 t_filePickerNavTreeDepth > 0);
            const bool modernScrollbar = g_settings.ModernScrollbars ||
                IsExplorerMicaScrollbarTheme(hTheme, nullptr) ||
                pickerScrollbar;
            if (modernScrollbar) {
                // Keep the short native theme transition used by the stable
                // renderer; it approximates WinUI motion without adding
                // timers or per-window animation state.
                if (pdwDuration) *pdwDuration = 200;
                return S_OK;
            }
        }
    }
    return GetThemeTransitionDuration_orig(hTheme, iPartId, iStateIdFrom, iStateIdTo, iPropId, pdwDuration);
}

// ── Rounded push buttons — D2D ──────────────────────────────────────────────
// Accent detection: IDOK (1) and IDYES (6) by control ID — stable, doesn't
// jump between buttons as focus moves (unlike BS_DEFPUSHBUTTON style).
// Uses GetAccentIndicator() for accent color consistency with the rest of the mod.
static thread_local bool g_tlsIsAccentButton = false;

// PaintPushButton's own `dark` (DarkModeActiveForPaint, resolved via a
// robust hwnd fallback) mirrored here for GetThemeColor_hook's text-color
// query -- GetThemeColor takes no HDC/HWND at all, and can fire for this
// same button's TMT_TEXTCOLOR property with only g_tlsPaintHwnd (no
// WindowFromDC fallback possible) to go on, which is less reliable than
// what PaintPushButton already resolved moments earlier for the same paint.
static thread_local bool g_tlsButtonDark = false;

// Caption color PaintPushButton resolved for the current state (composited
// over the fill it drew); CLR_INVALID outside a push-button paint.
static thread_local COLORREF g_tlsButtonTextColor = CLR_INVALID;

// Marked by PaintPushButton (Winver backdrop-hole context only) so the GDI
// text hooks below can skip a button's follow-up DrawText call for a
// caption already painted via D2D/DirectWrite. Keyed by HWND, not a single
// flag, since Winver's two buttons can both paint in one cycle. Fixed-size
// array, not a dynamic container -- each slot self-clears on consumption.
static thread_local HWND g_tlsWinverTextDrawnHwnds[4] = {};

static void WinverMarkButtonTextDrawn(HWND hBtn)
{
    if (!hBtn) return;
    for (HWND& slot : g_tlsWinverTextDrawnHwnds) {
        if (!slot) { slot = hBtn; return; }
    }
    // All slots full (shouldn't happen -- far fewer buttons than this in
    // Winver) -- overwrite the first rather than silently dropping the mark.
    g_tlsWinverTextDrawnHwnds[0] = hBtn;
}

// Empty outside Winver: lets the text hooks skip resolving the window.
static bool WinverTextMarksPending()
{
    for (HWND slot : g_tlsWinverTextDrawnHwnds) {
        if (slot)
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static bool WinverConsumeButtonTextDrawn(HWND hBtn)
{
    // Null must never match -- slots default-init to nullptr, so a
    // null-context draw (memory/off-screen DCs, e.g. buffered/D2D-composited
    // painting) would otherwise match that "empty" slot and get suppressed
    // in every process this mod touches, not just Winver's own buttons.
    if (!hBtn) return false;
    for (HWND& slot : g_tlsWinverTextDrawnHwnds) {
        if (slot == hBtn) { slot = nullptr; return true; }
    }
    return false;
}

static bool WinverUsesBackdropHole();
static bool WinverIsDarkVisualMode();
static bool WinverStyledDialogActive();
static bool PaintPushButton(HDC hdc, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect);

// WinUI's Fluent button colors (generic.xaml: ControlFillColor*,
// ControlStrokeColor*, AccentFillColor*, TextFillColor*, the OnAccent
// variants). The XAML fills are translucent; here they are composited over
// the parent's erase color so every surface stays opaque.
static COLORREF BlendOverColor(COLORREF bg, COLORREF fg, float alpha)
{
    alpha = std::clamp(alpha, 0.f, 1.f);
    auto ch = [alpha](BYTE f, BYTE b) {
        return (BYTE)std::lround(f * alpha + b * (1.f - alpha));
    };
    return RGB(ch(GetRValue(fg), GetRValue(bg)),
               ch(GetGValue(fg), GetGValue(bg)),
               ch(GetBValue(fg), GetBValue(bg)));
}

// Erase color under a button or combo: what the parent paints there.
static COLORREF ButtonParentBackground(HWND hwnd, HDC hdc, bool dark)
{
    return dark ? DarkBgForPaint(hwnd)
                : ParentBackgroundColor(hwnd, hdc, false, COLOR_BTNFACE);
}

// ControlFillColor Default / Secondary (hot) / Tertiary (pressed) / Disabled.
static COLORREF WinUiControlFillColor(bool dark, INT state, COLORREF bg)
{
    if (dark) {
        const BYTE a = (state == PBS_HOT)      ? 0x15 :
                       (state == PBS_PRESSED)  ? 0x08 :
                       (state == PBS_DISABLED) ? 0x0B : 0x0F;
        return BlendOverColor(bg, RGB(255, 255, 255), a / 255.f);
    }
    if (state == PBS_HOT || state == PBS_PRESSED || state == PBS_DISABLED) {
        const BYTE a = (state == PBS_HOT) ? 0x80 : 0x4D;
        return BlendOverColor(bg, RGB(0xF9, 0xF9, 0xF9), a / 255.f);
    }
    return BlendOverColor(bg, RGB(255, 255, 255), 0xB3 / 255.f);
}

// AccentFillColor Default / Secondary / Tertiary: the accent shade at
// 100/90/80 % over the parent; Disabled is a neutral gray, not the accent.
static COLORREF WinUiAccentFillColor(bool dark, INT state, COLORREF bg)
{
    if (state == PBS_DISABLED) {
        return dark ? BlendOverColor(bg, RGB(255, 255, 255), 0x28 / 255.f)
                    : BlendOverColor(bg, RGB(0, 0, 0), 0x37 / 255.f);
    }
    const COLORREF accent = GetAccentFillDefault(dark);
    const float a = (state == PBS_HOT) ? 0.9f : (state == PBS_PRESSED) ? 0.8f : 1.f;
    return BlendOverColor(bg, accent, a);
}

// TextFillColor Primary / Secondary (pressed) / Disabled over the fill.
static COLORREF WinUiControlTextColor(bool dark, INT state, COLORREF fill)
{
    const BYTE a = (state == PBS_PRESSED)  ? (dark ? 0xC5 : 0x9E) :
                   (state == PBS_DISABLED) ? (dark ? 0x5D : 0x5C) :
                                             (dark ? 0xFF : 0xE4);
    return BlendOverColor(fill, dark ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0), a / 255.f);
}

// TextOnAccentFillColor Primary / Secondary (pressed) / Disabled.
static COLORREF WinUiAccentTextColor(bool dark, INT state, COLORREF fill)
{
    if (state == PBS_DISABLED) {
        return dark ? BlendOverColor(fill, RGB(255, 255, 255), 0x87 / 255.f)
                    : RGB(255, 255, 255);
    }
    const BYTE a = (state == PBS_PRESSED) ? (dark ? 0x80 : 0xB3) : 0xFF;
    return BlendOverColor(fill, dark ? RGB(0, 0, 0) : RGB(255, 255, 255), a / 255.f);
}

// A 1px ring with one differently shaded edge row: WinUI's elevation border
// brushes map a Secondary->Default gradient onto 3 absolute pixels from
// the top (dark neutral: lit edge) or the bottom (light neutral and accent:
// shadowed edge). Alpha 0 in ring = no border, in edge = flat ring.
struct ButtonBorder {
    D2D1_COLOR_F ring;
    D2D1_COLOR_F edge;
    bool edgeAtTop;
};

// ControlElevationBorderBrush; pressed and disabled use the flat
// ControlStrokeColorDefault ring.
static ButtonBorder WinUiControlBorder(bool dark, INT state)
{
    ButtonBorder b = {};
    b.ring = dark ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0x12 / 255.f)
                  : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0x0F / 255.f);
    if (state != PBS_PRESSED && state != PBS_DISABLED) {
        b.edge = dark ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0x18 / 255.f)
                      : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0x29 / 255.f);
    }
    b.edgeAtTop = dark;
    return b;
}

// AccentControlElevationBorderBrush; pressed and disabled have no border.
static ButtonBorder WinUiAccentBorder(bool dark, INT state)
{
    ButtonBorder b = {};
    if (state == PBS_PRESSED || state == PBS_DISABLED)
        return b;
    b.ring = D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0x14 / 255.f);
    b.edge = D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, (dark ? 0x23 : 0x66) / 255.f);
    b.edgeAtTop = false;
    return b;
}

// Rounded push-button surface (fill + border) drawn by GDI+; the fill is
// opaque, the border strokes composite over it and over the parent at the
// corners. comctl32 flattens the buffer's alpha afterwards
// (CCompositedDraw::EndDoubleBuffer -> BufferedPaintSetAlpha(255)).
// gradientTop/Bottom replace the flat fill; focused draws the 2px focus
// border instead of the WinUI one.
static bool PaintRoundedButtonGdip(HDC hdc, const RECT& rect, float scale,
    float cornerRadius, COLORREF fill, const ButtonBorder& border, bool dark,
    bool focused, const COLORREF* gradientTop, const COLORREF* gradientBottom)
{
    const float fW = (float)(rect.right - rect.left);
    const float fH = (float)(rect.bottom - rect.top);
    if (fW <= 1.f || fH <= 1.f)
        return false;

    RoundedHdcGdipDrawLock gdipLock;
    if (!gdipLock)
        return false;

    Gdiplus::Graphics graphics(hdc);
    if (graphics.GetLastStatus() != Gdiplus::Ok ||
        graphics.SetSmoothingMode(Gdiplus::SmoothingModeAntiAlias) != Gdiplus::Ok ||
        graphics.SetPixelOffsetMode(Gdiplus::PixelOffsetModeHalf) != Gdiplus::Ok)
        return false;

    // Half-pixel inset keeps the 1px border centered on pixel rows.
    const Gdiplus::RectF bounds(rect.left + 0.5f, rect.top + 0.5f, fW - 1.f, fH - 1.f);
    Gdiplus::GraphicsPath path;
    if (!RoundedHdcAddPath(path, bounds, cornerRadius, true, true, true, true))
        return false;

    bool filled = false;
    if (gradientTop && gradientBottom) {
        Gdiplus::LinearGradientBrush gradient(
            Gdiplus::RectF((float)rect.left, (float)rect.top, fW, fH),
            GdipColor(*gradientTop), GdipColor(*gradientBottom),
            Gdiplus::LinearGradientModeVertical);
        gradient.SetWrapMode(Gdiplus::WrapModeTileFlipXY);
        filled = gradient.GetLastStatus() == Gdiplus::Ok &&
                 graphics.FillPath(&gradient, &path) == Gdiplus::Ok;
    }
    if (!filled) {
        Gdiplus::SolidBrush flat(GdipColor(fill));
        if (graphics.FillPath(&flat, &path) != Gdiplus::Ok)
            return false;
    }

    if (focused) {
        // Solid white/black 2px focus border on its own inset geometry so
        // the stroke stays centered instead of clipping against the fill.
        const float stroke = 2.f * scale;
        const Gdiplus::RectF focusBounds(
            rect.left + stroke * 0.5f, rect.top + stroke * 0.5f,
            fW - stroke, fH - stroke);
        Gdiplus::GraphicsPath focusPath;
        if (focusBounds.Width > 0.f && focusBounds.Height > 0.f &&
            RoundedHdcAddPath(focusPath, focusBounds, cornerRadius, true, true, true, true)) {
            Gdiplus::Pen pen(dark ? Gdiplus::Color(255, 255, 255, 255)
                                  : Gdiplus::Color(255, 0, 0, 0), stroke);
            graphics.DrawPath(&pen, &focusPath);
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (border.ring.a <= 0.f)
        return true;

    const float band = 3.f * scale;
    if (border.edge.a > 0.f && fH > band * 2.f) {
        // WinUI's stops (0.33 Secondary, 1.0 Default over 3px) mapped onto
        // the ring's full height, so one stroke draws the whole ring.
        const float f = band / fH;
        const Gdiplus::Color edge = GdipColor(border.edge);
        const Gdiplus::Color ring = GdipColor(border.ring);
        Gdiplus::Color stops[4];
        Gdiplus::REAL positions[4];
        if (border.edgeAtTop) {
            stops[0] = edge; stops[1] = edge; stops[2] = ring; stops[3] = ring;
            positions[0] = 0.f; positions[1] = 0.33f * f; positions[2] = f; positions[3] = 1.f;
        } else {
            stops[0] = ring; stops[1] = ring; stops[2] = edge; stops[3] = edge;
            positions[0] = 0.f; positions[1] = 1.f - f; positions[2] = 1.f - 0.33f * f; positions[3] = 1.f;
        }
        Gdiplus::LinearGradientBrush borderGradient(
            Gdiplus::RectF((float)rect.left, (float)rect.top, fW, fH),
            stops[0], stops[3], Gdiplus::LinearGradientModeVertical);
        borderGradient.SetWrapMode(Gdiplus::WrapModeTileFlipXY);
        borderGradient.SetInterpolationColors(stops, positions, 4);
        Gdiplus::Pen pen(&borderGradient, scale);
        if (pen.GetLastStatus() == Gdiplus::Ok &&
            graphics.DrawPath(&pen, &path) == Gdiplus::Ok)
            return true;
    }
    Gdiplus::Pen solid(GdipColor(border.ring), scale);
    graphics.DrawPath(&solid, &path);
    return true;
}

// Opaque neutral fill for the Edit child of a restyled dark combo, over the
// same erase color the combo's own chrome composites on.
static COLORREF GetNeutralPushButtonFillColor(HWND hwnd, bool dark, INT state)
{
    const COLORREF bg = dark ? DarkBgForPaint(hwnd) : RGB(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF);
    return WinUiControlFillColor(dark, state, bg);
}

// Mirrors the GDI font already selected in the button's DC so the D2D-drawn
// caption matches the dialog's font. Cached by facename/size/weight/italic.
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteFactory>    g_winverBtnDwFactory;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> g_winverBtnDwFmt;
static wchar_t g_winverBtnDwFmtFace[LF_FACESIZE] = {};
static float   g_winverBtnDwFmtSize   = 0.f;
static LONG    g_winverBtnDwFmtWeight = 0;
static bool    g_winverBtnDwFmtItalic = false;
static UINT    g_winverBtnDwFmtDpi    = 0;
static std::mutex g_winverBtnDwMutex;

struct WinverStaticTextFormatEntry {
    wchar_t face[LF_FACESIZE] = {};
    float size = 0.f;
    LONG weight = 0;
    bool italic = false;
    UINT dpi = 0;
    DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT textAlignment = DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_LEADING;
    DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT paragraphAlignment = DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_NEAR;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> format;
};
static std::vector<WinverStaticTextFormatEntry> g_winverStaticDwFormats;

static bool WinverEnsureDWriteFactoryLocked()
{
    if (g_winverBtnDwFactory)
        return true;

    IDWriteFactory* raw = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, __uuidof(IDWriteFactory),
            reinterpret_cast<IUnknown**>(&raw))) || !raw)
        return false;
    g_winverBtnDwFactory.Attach(raw);
    return true;
}

static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteFactory> WinverGetDWriteFactory()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_winverBtnDwMutex);
    if (!WinverEnsureDWriteFactoryLocked())
        return {};
    return g_winverBtnDwFactory;
}

static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> WinverEnsureButtonTextFormat(HDC hdc)
{
    LOGFONTW lf = {};
    HFONT hFont = (HFONT)GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT);
    if (!hFont || !GetObjectW(hFont, sizeof(lf), &lf))
        return {};
    // Segoe UI Variable, not whatever the dialog's own GDI font resolved to
    // (keeps the button's own weight, unlike SegoeUiVariableFace() which is
    // hardcoded Semibold for the tab/header modernization it was written for).
    wcsncpy_s(lf.lfFaceName, L"Segoe UI Variable Text", _TRUNCATE);
    float size = (float)std::abs(lf.lfHeight);
    if (size <= 0.f)
        return {};
    const UINT dpi = DpiForPaintHdc(hdc);

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_winverBtnDwMutex);
    if (g_winverBtnDwFmt &&
        g_winverBtnDwFmtSize == size &&
        g_winverBtnDwFmtWeight == lf.lfWeight &&
        g_winverBtnDwFmtItalic == (lf.lfItalic != 0) &&
        g_winverBtnDwFmtDpi == dpi &&
        wcscmp(g_winverBtnDwFmtFace, lf.lfFaceName) == 0)
        return g_winverBtnDwFmt;

    if (!WinverEnsureDWriteFactoryLocked())
        return {};

    const wchar_t* names[] = { lf.lfFaceName, L"Segoe UI" };
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> fmt = CreateSegoeVariableAwareTextFormat(
        g_winverBtnDwFactory.Get(), names, ARRAYSIZE(names),
        (DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT)lf.lfWeight, size, dpi, lf.lfItalic != 0);
    if (!fmt)
        return {};
    fmt->SetTextAlignment(DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_CENTER);
    fmt->SetParagraphAlignment(DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_CENTER);

    g_winverBtnDwFmt = fmt;
    wcsncpy_s(g_winverBtnDwFmtFace, lf.lfFaceName, _TRUNCATE);
    g_winverBtnDwFmtSize   = size;
    g_winverBtnDwFmtWeight = lf.lfWeight;
    g_winverBtnDwFmtItalic = (lf.lfItalic != 0);
    g_winverBtnDwFmtDpi    = dpi;
    return fmt;
}

static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> WinverEnsureStaticTextFormat(
    HDC hdc, DWORD style)
{
    LOGFONTW lf = {};
    HFONT hFont = (HFONT)GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT);
    if (!hFont || !GetObjectW(hFont, sizeof(lf), &lf))
        return {};
    wcsncpy_s(lf.lfFaceName, L"Segoe UI Variable Text", _TRUNCATE);
    const float size = (float)std::abs(lf.lfHeight);
    if (size <= 0.f)
        return {};

    DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT textAlignment = DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_LEADING;
    switch (style & SS_TYPEMASK) {
    case SS_CENTER:
        textAlignment = DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_CENTER;
        break;
    case SS_RIGHT:
        textAlignment = DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_TRAILING;
        break;
    }
    const DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT paragraphAlignment =
        (style & SS_CENTERIMAGE) ? DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
                                 : DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_NEAR;
    const UINT dpi = DpiForPaintHdc(hdc);

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_winverBtnDwMutex);
    for (const auto& entry : g_winverStaticDwFormats) {
        if (entry.size == size && entry.weight == lf.lfWeight &&
            entry.italic == (lf.lfItalic != 0) &&
            entry.textAlignment == textAlignment &&
            entry.paragraphAlignment == paragraphAlignment &&
            entry.dpi == dpi &&
            wcscmp(entry.face, lf.lfFaceName) == 0)
            return entry.format;
    }

    if (!WinverEnsureDWriteFactoryLocked())
        return {};

    const wchar_t* names[] = { lf.lfFaceName, L"Segoe UI" };
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat> format = CreateSegoeVariableAwareTextFormat(
        g_winverBtnDwFactory.Get(), names, ARRAYSIZE(names),
        (DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT)lf.lfWeight, size, dpi, lf.lfItalic != 0);
    if (!format)
        return {};
    if (FAILED(format->SetTextAlignment(textAlignment)) ||
        FAILED(format->SetParagraphAlignment(paragraphAlignment)))
        return {};

    WinverStaticTextFormatEntry entry;
    wcsncpy_s(entry.face, lf.lfFaceName, _TRUNCATE);
    entry.size = size;
    entry.weight = lf.lfWeight;
    entry.italic = lf.lfItalic != 0;
    entry.dpi = dpi;
    entry.textAlignment = textAlignment;
    entry.paragraphAlignment = paragraphAlignment;
    entry.format = format;
    if (g_winverStaticDwFormats.size() >= 16)
        g_winverStaticDwFormats.clear();
    g_winverStaticDwFormats.emplace_back(std::move(entry));
    return format;
}

static void WinverDWriteCacheClear()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_winverBtnDwMutex);
    g_winverBtnDwFmt.Reset();
    g_winverStaticDwFormats.clear();
    g_winverBtnDwFactory.Reset();
    g_winverBtnDwFmtFace[0] = L'\0';
    g_winverBtnDwFmtSize = 0.f;
    g_winverBtnDwFmtWeight = 0;
    g_winverBtnDwFmtItalic = false;
    g_winverBtnDwFmtDpi = 0;
}

static bool PaintPushButton(HDC hdc, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!g_d2dFactory || !pRect) return false;

    const int w = pRect->right  - pRect->left;
    const int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return false;

    // Reads the control ID (stable across hot/pressed/disabled) instead of
    // iStateId's PBS_DEFAULTED, which Windows stops reporting the instant
    // the button goes hot/pressed -- checking that would flicker the accent
    // off on hover.
    // The button being painted: the DC's own window; on a memory DC, the
    // button handling a message on this thread (a repaint on a state change,
    // as when it is enabled) if it is a button of the painted size -- the
    // thread's paint window can be the edit just typed in, or another
    // button -- else, as before, the window that began painting.
    HWND hBtn = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (!hBtn) {
        auto paintedButton = [&](HWND candidate) {
            RECT client;
            return candidate && IsClassName(candidate, L"Button") &&
                GetClientRect(candidate, &client) &&
                client.right == w && client.bottom == h;
        };
        if (paintedButton(t_buttonMessageHwnd))
            hBtn = t_buttonMessageHwnd;
        else
            hBtn = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
    }
    if (g_settings.RoundedButtons && hBtn && IsClassName(hBtn, L"Button"))
        ButtonPopTrackButton(hBtn);
    bool isAccent = false;
    if (hBtn) {
        INT ctrlId = GetDlgCtrlID(hBtn);
        isAccent = (ctrlId == IDOK || ctrlId == IDYES);
    }
    g_tlsIsAccentButton = isAccent;

    // PBS_* has no focused state in the theme model -- pushbuttons signal
    // focus only via a separate native DrawFocusRect call. Check directly
    // so the border itself can become the focus cue instead.
    const bool focused = g_settings.ModernFocusRect == 0 && hBtn &&
        GetFocus() == hBtn && NavFocusCuesVisible(hBtn);

    // Winver backdrop modes have their own visual policy. All other
    // dialogs keep the process-wide mode, avoiding per-paint DWM queries.
    const bool winverBlackVisual =
        WinverStyledDialogActive() && WinverUsesBackdropHole();
    const bool dark = winverBlackVisual ? WinverIsDarkVisualMode()
                                        : DarkModeActiveForPaint(hBtn);
    g_tlsButtonDark = dark;
    const float scale = (float)DpiForPaint(hBtn) / (float)USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const float cr = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale;

    // Winver's backdrop modes erase under the button themselves (below); the
    // surface composites as if over the mod's dark or a white dialog.
    const COLORREF bg = winverBlackVisual
        ? (dark ? Win32MainDark : RGB(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF))
        : ButtonParentBackground(hBtn, hdc, dark);
    const COLORREF fill = isAccent ? WinUiAccentFillColor(dark, iStateId, bg)
                                   : WinUiControlFillColor(dark, iStateId, bg);
    const ButtonBorder border = isAccent ? WinUiAccentBorder(dark, iStateId)
                                         : WinUiControlBorder(dark, iStateId);

    // Winver backdrop modes: the corners must be exact RGB(0,0,0),
    // which DWM's colorkey turns into a hole onto the backdrop -- the
    // dialog's own erase never reaches under the button, so paint it here.
    const bool winverBlackCorner = winverBlackVisual;
    if (winverBlackCorner) {
        if (HBRUSH black = GetCachedSolidBrush(RGB(0, 0, 0)))
            (FillRect_orig ? FillRect_orig : FillRect)(hdc, pRect, black);
    }
    const float fW = (float)w, fH = (float)h;

    COLORREF topC = 0, botC = 0;
    const bool gradient =
        isAccent && g_settings.AccentGradients && iStateId != PBS_DISABLED;
    if (gradient) {
        // Vertical gradient on accent buttons — wider spread for visibility
        topC = GetAccentFromPalette(dark ?  0 :  8);  // Light3 / Light1
        botC = GetAccentFromPalette(dark ?  8 : 20);  // Light1 / Dark2
        if (iStateId == PBS_PRESSED) {
            topC = GetAccentFillDefault(dark);
            botC = GetAccentFromPalette(dark ? 12 : 24); // Base / Dark3
        } else if (iStateId == PBS_HOT) {
            topC = GetAccentFromPalette(dark ?  0 :  4);  // Light3 / Light2
            botC = GetAccentFillDefault(dark);
        }
    }
    // Focused applies even to accent (OK/Yes) buttons, overriding their
    // subtle translucent border. Only the fill crossfades between states.
    const COLORREF frameFill = gradient ? fill : ButtonFillFadeStep(hBtn, fill);
    if (!PaintRoundedButtonGdip(hdc, *pRect, scale, cr, frameFill, border, dark,
            focused, gradient ? &topC : nullptr, gradient ? &botC : nullptr))
        return false;

    // Force text color on the DC — the button control calls DrawText after
    // DrawThemeBackground. SetTextColor ensures correct contrast regardless
    // of whether GetThemeColor is consulted by DrawThemeText.
    COLORREF textClr = isAccent ? WinUiAccentTextColor(dark, iStateId, fill)
                                : WinUiControlTextColor(dark, iStateId, fill);
    g_tlsButtonTextColor = textClr;

    // Winver backdrop modes: draw the caption via DirectWrite here and mark
    // it so DrawTextW_hook/DrawTextExW_hook/ExtTextOutW_hook skip the
    // button's own GDI DrawText call -- that path runs "Button" captions
    // through FixDarkTextColor, which force-corrects near-black text to white.
    if (winverBlackCorner) {
        wchar_t caption[128] = {};
        GetWindowTextW(hBtn, caption, ARRAYSIZE(caption));
        auto fmt = caption[0] ? WinverEnsureButtonTextFormat(hdc) :
                               Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat>{};
        if (fmt) {
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT2;
            if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT2))) {
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> textBrush;
                if (SUCCEEDED(pRT2->CreateSolidColorBrush(
                        D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(textClr) / 255.f, GetGValue(textClr) / 255.f,
                                     GetBValue(textClr) / 255.f, 1.f), &textBrush))) {
                    pRT2->BeginDraw();
                    pRT2->SetTextAntialiasMode(D2D1_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_MODE_GRAYSCALE);
                    pRT2->DrawTextW(caption, (UINT32)wcslen(caption), fmt.Get(),
                        D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f, fW, fH), textBrush.Get());
                    const HRESULT hr = pRT2->EndDraw();
                    if (hr == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET)
                        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                    if (SUCCEEDED(hr))
                        WinverMarkButtonTextDrawn(hBtn);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Fallback for every other app's buttons and in case the D2D draw above
    // failed. DWM's colorkey (WinverBackdropSetup's extended frame, backdrop
    // modes only) treats exact RGB(0,0,0) as a hole into the backdrop, so
    // nudge pure black by one unit to avoid matching it unintentionally.
    if (textClr == RGB(0, 0, 0) && WinverUsesBackdropHole() && WinverStyledDialogActive())
        textClr = RGB(1, 1, 1);
    SetTextColor(hdc, textClr);

    return true;
}

// ── Rounded control borders — D2D ───────────────────────────────────────────
// Replaces the default flat/3D border on Edit, ListBox, and ListView controls
// with a rounded rectangle. Draws a 2px accent line at the bottom when focused.
// Reused for all controls with client-edge themed borders.
static HWND GetSpinBuddyForPaint(HWND spin)
{
    if (!spin)
        return nullptr;

    if (GetWindowThreadProcessId(spin, nullptr) == GetCurrentThreadId()) {
        return reinterpret_cast<HWND>(
            SendMessageW(spin, UDM_GETBUDDY, 0, 0));
    }

    DWORD_PTR result = 0;
    if (!SendMessageTimeoutW(
            spin, UDM_GETBUDDY, 0, 0,
            SMTO_ABORTIFHUNG | SMTO_BLOCK, 20, &result)) {
        return nullptr;
    }
    return reinterpret_cast<HWND>(result);
}

static int ValidateConnectedSpin(HWND spin, HWND edit)
{
    if (!spin || !IsWindow(spin) ||
        !IsClassName(spin, L"msctls_updown32") ||
        GetParent(spin) != GetParent(edit)) {
        return 0;
    }

    const LONG_PTR style = GetWindowLongPtrW(spin, GWL_STYLE);
    const bool alignRight = (style & UDS_ALIGNRIGHT) != 0;
    const bool alignLeft = (style & UDS_ALIGNLEFT) != 0;
    if (alignRight == alignLeft || GetSpinBuddyForPaint(spin) != edit)
        return 0;
    return alignRight ? 1 : -1;
}

static void EditSpinBuddyCacheClear()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_editSpinBuddyCacheMutex);
    g_editSpinBuddyCache.clear();
}

static int EditConnectedSpinEdge(HWND edit, HWND* connectedSpin = nullptr)
{
    if (connectedSpin)
        *connectedSpin = nullptr;
    if (!edit || !IsClassName(edit, L"Edit"))
        return 0;

    HWND parent = GetParent(edit);
    if (!parent)
        return 0;

    HWND cachedSpin = nullptr;
    bool cached = false;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_editSpinBuddyCacheMutex);
        auto it = g_editSpinBuddyCache.find(edit);
        if (it != g_editSpinBuddyCache.end()) {
            cachedSpin = it->second.spin;
            cached = true;
        }
    }
    if (cachedSpin) {
        const int edge = ValidateConnectedSpin(cachedSpin, edit);
        if (edge) {
            if (connectedSpin)
                *connectedSpin = cachedSpin;
            return edge;
        }
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_editSpinBuddyCacheMutex);
        auto it = g_editSpinBuddyCache.find(edit);
        if (it != g_editSpinBuddyCache.end() && it->second.spin == cachedSpin)
            g_editSpinBuddyCache.erase(it);
    } else if (cached) {
        // Confirmed no buddy on a previous paint. Spin-buddy pairing is
        // established once at dialog-creation time and effectively never
        // changes afterward, so trusting this indefinitely -- same as the
        // positive case, bounded by the same cache -- avoids re-walking
        // FindWindowExW/SendMessageTimeoutW for every plain Edit control on
        // every single repaint. An app that attaches a spinner dynamically
        // after this edit already painted once won't get the merged border
        // until EditSpinBuddyCacheClear runs (settings change) or this
        // entry is evicted.
        return 0;
    }

    for (HWND spin = FindWindowExW(
             parent, nullptr, L"msctls_updown32", nullptr);
         spin;
         spin = FindWindowExW(
             parent, spin, L"msctls_updown32", nullptr)) {
        const int edge = ValidateConnectedSpin(spin, edit);
        if (edge) {
            {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_editSpinBuddyCacheMutex);
                if (g_editSpinBuddyCache.size() >= kEditSpinBuddyCacheMax)
                    g_editSpinBuddyCache.clear();
                g_editSpinBuddyCache[edit] = {spin};
            }
            if (connectedSpin)
                *connectedSpin = spin;
            return edge;
        }
    }

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_editSpinBuddyCacheMutex);
        if (g_editSpinBuddyCache.size() >= kEditSpinBuddyCacheMax)
            g_editSpinBuddyCache.clear();
        g_editSpinBuddyCache[edit] = {nullptr};
    }
    return 0;
}

static bool PaintControlBorder(HDC hdc, INT iPartId, INT iStateId,
    LPCRECT pRect, bool fillBackground = true, int connectedEdge = 0)
{
    if (!g_d2dFactory || !pRect) return false;

    const int w = pRect->right  - pRect->left;
    const int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return false;

    const bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    HWND dcHwnd = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    HWND dpiHwnd = dcHwnd;
    if (!dpiHwnd)
        dpiHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
    UINT dpi = dpiHwnd ? GetDpiForWindow(dpiHwnd) : 0;
    if (!dpi) {
        const int dcDpi = GetDeviceCaps(hdc, LOGPIXELSX);
        dpi = dcDpi > 0 ? (UINT)dcDpi : g_Dpi;
    }
    const float scale = (float)dpi / (float)USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const float cr = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale;

    // EP_EDITBORDER_NOSCROLL/HSCROLL/VSCROLL/HVSCROLL (6-9): the accent line
    // is the text field's primary focus cue, not a supplementary keyboard-
    // navigation ring, so unlike ListBox/ListView below it isn't gated
    // behind NavFocusCuesVisible -- uxtheme reports state 3 (EBNS_FOCUSED)
    // for any real input focus, mouse or Tab alike.
    //
    // The bypass only covers state 3, not the whole cluster: Edit's state
    // enum doesn't overlap with ListBox's -- state 2 there is EBNS_HOT (mere
    // hover), unlike the ListBox cluster's LBPSH_FOCUSED(2) it coincides
    // with only numerically. Bypassing the whole cluster would make hovering
    // an unfocused edit show the line too.
    const bool isEditBorder = (iPartId >= 6 && iPartId <= 9);
    HWND connectedEditHwnd = nullptr;
    HWND connectedSpinHwnd = nullptr;
    // Gated by RoundedButtons: this merges the Edit's border into its spin
    // buddy's, matching the buddy's own rounded look -- but the buddy itself
    // (Spin's paint block, GetThemeTransitionDuration_hook) only gets that
    // rounded look when RoundedButtons is on. Without this gate, an
    // EditFocusLine-only user (the default) would get an asymmetric merged
    // border on any spin-connected Edit while the spin stays fully native.
    if (!connectedEdge && isEditBorder && g_settings.RoundedButtons) {
        HWND editHwnd = t_currentEditPaintHwnd;
        if (!editHwnd || !IsClassName(editHwnd, L"Edit"))
            editHwnd = dcHwnd;
        connectedEdge = EditConnectedSpinEdge(editHwnd, &connectedSpinHwnd);
        if (connectedEdge)
            connectedEditHwnd = editHwnd;
    }

    // Focused = ETS_SELECTED(3) / ETS_FOCUSED(5) / LBPSH_FOCUSED(2)
    const bool focused = isEditBorder
        ? (iStateId == 3)
        : ((iStateId == 2 || iStateId == 3 || iStateId == 5) &&
           (!dpiHwnd || NavFocusCuesVisible(dpiHwnd)));
    const bool hot     = (iStateId == 2 && !focused) || iStateId == 6; // ETS_HOT or LBPSH_HOT(3)
    const bool disabled = (iStateId == 4);

    const auto toD2D = [](COLORREF c) {
        return D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(c) / 255.f, GetGValue(c) / 255.f, GetBValue(c) / 255.f);
    };
    // Edit borders follow WinUI's TextBox
    // (microsoft-ui-xaml controls/dev/CommonStyles/TextBox_themeresources.xaml):
    // TextControlElevationBorderBrush, ControlStrokeColorDefault around and
    // ControlStrongStrokeColorDefault along the bottom, the same in every
    // state but disabled (TextControlBorderBrushDisabled, no bottom stroke).
    // The field's own fill stays the app's, so the strokes are flattened over
    // the TextBox fill (ControlFillColorDefault/Disabled) on the base
    // background, as WinUI renders them.
    const COLORREF editField = WinUI::FlattenOver(
        disabled ? WinUI::ControlFillColorDisabled(dark) : WinUI::ControlFillColorDefault(dark),
        WinUI::SolidBackgroundFillColorBase(dark));
    D2D1_COLOR_F borderClr;
    if (isEditBorder) {
        borderClr = toD2D(WinUI::FlattenOver(WinUI::ControlStrokeColorDefault(dark), editField));
    } else if (dark) {
        borderClr = disabled ? D2D1::ColorF(0.25f, 0.25f, 0.25f, 0.4f) :
                    hot      ? D2D1::ColorF(0.45f, 0.45f, 0.45f) :
                               D2D1::ColorF(0.35f, 0.35f, 0.35f);
    } else {
        borderClr = disabled ? D2D1::ColorF(0.80f, 0.80f, 0.80f, 0.6f) :
                    hot      ? D2D1::ColorF(0.50f, 0.50f, 0.50f) :
                               D2D1::ColorF(0.65f, 0.65f, 0.65f);
    }

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
    if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
        return false;

    const float fW = (float)w, fH = (float)h;
    const float borderInset = connectedEdge
        ? std::max(0.5f, scale * 0.5f)
        : 0.5f;
    float borderLeft = borderInset;
    float borderRight = fW - borderInset;
    if (connectedEdge < 0)
        borderLeft -= cr;
    else if (connectedEdge > 0)
        borderRight += cr;
    D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT rr = D2D1::RoundedRect(
        D2D1::RectF(
            borderLeft, borderInset, borderRight, fH - borderInset),
        cr, cr);

    D2D1_RECT_F drawClip = D2D1::RectF(0.0f, 0.0f, fW, fH);
    bool clipConnectedEdit = false;
    if (connectedEditHwnd && connectedSpinHwnd) {
        POINT editOrigin = { pRect->left, pRect->top };
        RECT spinClientRect = {};
        if (ClientToScreen(connectedEditHwnd, &editOrigin) &&
            GetClientRect(connectedSpinHwnd, &spinClientRect)) {
            MapWindowPoints(
                connectedSpinHwnd, HWND_DESKTOP,
                reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(&spinClientRect), 2);
            const float seam = connectedEdge > 0
                ? (float)spinClientRect.left - editOrigin.x
                : (float)spinClientRect.right - editOrigin.x;
            if (seam > 0.0f && seam < fW) {
                const float seamOverlap = ceilf(scale);
                if (connectedEdge > 0)
                    drawClip.right = std::min(fW, seam + seamOverlap);
                else
                    drawClip.left = std::max(0.0f, seam - seamOverlap);
                clipConnectedEdit = true;
            }
        }
    }

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
    if (FAILED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(borderClr, &brush))) return false;

    // Only replace the native background after D2D setup has succeeded.
    // NC-border callers leave the client untouched and only draw the outline.
    if (fillBackground) {
        EraseWithParentBackground(dcHwnd ? dcHwnd : g_tlsPaintHwnd, hdc, *pRect,
            g_darkModeActive && dark, COLOR_WINDOW);
    }

    // Bottom line clipped to the border's rounded rect (rr) so its ends
    // follow the corner curve. Needs an explicit ID2D1Layer, cached in
    // D2DThreadCache -- ID2D1DCRenderTarget lacks PushLayer(nullptr).
    const bool wantEditLine = focused || (isEditBorder && !disabled);
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1RoundedRectangleGeometry> lineClipGeom;
    D2DThreadCache* lineCache = wantEditLine ? D2DGetThreadCache() : nullptr;
    if (wantEditLine) {
        // An Edit's bottom stroke replaces the border's bottom edge, so it is
        // clipped to the outer edge of the border rather than its centerline.
        const D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT outer = D2D1::RoundedRect(
            D2D1::RectF(rr.rect.left - borderInset, 0.0f, rr.rect.right + borderInset, fH),
            cr, cr);
        g_d2dFactory->CreateRoundedRectangleGeometry(isEditBorder ? outer : rr, &lineClipGeom);
        if (lineClipGeom && lineCache &&
            (!lineCache->editBorderLineLayer || lineCache->editBorderLineLayerRT != pRT.Get())) {
            if (lineCache->editBorderLineLayer) {
                lineCache->editBorderLineLayer->Release();
                lineCache->editBorderLineLayer = nullptr;
            }
            ID2D1Layer* rawLayer = nullptr;
            pRT->CreateLayer(nullptr, &rawLayer);
            if (rawLayer) {
                lineCache->editBorderLineLayer = rawLayer;
                lineCache->editBorderLineLayerRT = pRT.Get();
            }
        }
    }
    const bool pushEditLineLayer =
        lineClipGeom && lineCache && lineCache->editBorderLineLayer;

    pRT->BeginDraw();
    // No Clear() — GDI background is already opaque
    if (clipConnectedEdit)
        pRT->PushAxisAlignedClip(drawClip, D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_PER_PRIMITIVE);
    pRT->DrawRoundedRectangle(&rr, brush.Get(), scale);

    // Focus accent line (focused) / WinUI rest-state underline (idle)
    if (wantEditLine) {
        if (pushEditLineLayer)
            pRT->PushLayer(D2D1::LayerParameters(D2D1::InfiniteRect(), lineClipGeom.Get()),
                lineCache->editBorderLineLayer);
        const float lineY = fH - 0.5f * scale;
        if (isEditBorder) {
            // TextControlBorderThemeThickness(Focused): the bottom edge is
            // 1 px at rest and 2 px of accent when focused.
            const D2D1_RECT_F lineRect = D2D1::RectF(
                0.f, fH - (focused ? 2.f : 1.f) * scale, fW, fH);
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GradientStopCollection> sc;
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1LinearGradientBrush> gb;
            if (focused && g_settings.AccentGradients) {
                D2D1_GRADIENT_STOP stops[2] = {
                    { 0.f, toD2D(GetAccentFromPalette(12)) },
                    { 1.f, toD2D(GetAccentFillDefault(dark)) }
                };
                if (SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateGradientStopCollection(stops, 2, &sc)))
                    pRT->CreateLinearGradientBrush(
                        D2D1::LinearGradientBrushProperties(
                            D2D1::Point2F(0.f, lineY), D2D1::Point2F(fW, lineY)),
                        sc.Get(), &gb);
            }
            if (gb) {
                pRT->FillRectangle(lineRect, gb.Get());
            } else {
                brush->SetColor(toD2D(focused
                    ? GetAccentFillDefault(dark)
                    : WinUI::FlattenOver(WinUI::ControlStrongStrokeColorDefault(dark), editField)));
                pRT->FillRectangle(lineRect, brush.Get());
            }
        } else if (focused) {
            if (g_settings.AccentGradients) {
                COLORREF baseC = GetAccentFromPalette(12);
                COLORREF indC  = GetAccentFillDefault(dark);
                D2D1_GRADIENT_STOP stops[2] = {
                    { 0.f, D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(baseC)/255.f, GetGValue(baseC)/255.f, GetBValue(baseC)/255.f) },
                    { 1.f, D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(indC)/255.f, GetGValue(indC)/255.f, GetBValue(indC)/255.f) }
                };
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GradientStopCollection> sc;
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1LinearGradientBrush> gb;
                if (SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateGradientStopCollection(stops, 2, &sc))
                 && SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateLinearGradientBrush(
                        D2D1::LinearGradientBrushProperties(
                            D2D1::Point2F(0.f, lineY),
                            D2D1::Point2F(fW, lineY)),
                        sc.Get(), &gb)))
                    pRT->DrawLine(
                        D2D1::Point2F(0.f, lineY),
                        D2D1::Point2F(fW, lineY),
                        gb.Get(), 3.f * scale);
            } else {
                const COLORREF ac = GetAccentFillDefault(dark);
                brush->SetColor(D2D1::ColorF(
                    GetRValue(ac) / 255.f, GetGValue(ac) / 255.f, GetBValue(ac) / 255.f));
                pRT->DrawLine(
                    D2D1::Point2F(0.f, lineY),
                    D2D1::Point2F(fW, lineY),
                    brush.Get(), 3.f * scale);
            }
        }
        if (pushEditLineLayer)
            pRT->PopLayer();
    }
    if (clipConnectedEdit)
        pRT->PopAxisAlignedClip();

    HRESULT hr = pRT->EndDraw();
    if (hr == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        pRT.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
        return false;
    }
    return SUCCEEDED(hr);
}


// ── Modern border subclass ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Paints over the 3D NC border (WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE / WS_BORDER) after
// DefSubclassProc renders the original. Uses GetWindowDC for NC access.
static constexpr LPCWSTR kPropModernBorderHot =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.ModernBorderHot";
static constexpr LPCWSTR kPropModernBorderKind =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.ModernBorderKind";

static LRESULT CALLBACK ModernBorderSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR dwRefData);

static bool ModernBorderGetKind(HWND hwnd, DWORD_PTR* kind = nullptr)
{
    const ULONG_PTR value = (ULONG_PTR)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropModernBorderKind);
    if (!value)
        return false;
    if (kind)
        *kind = value - 1;
    return true;
}

static bool ModernBorderInstall(HWND hwnd, DWORD_PTR kind)
{
    DWORD_PTR currentKind = 0;
    if (ModernBorderGetKind(hwnd, &currentKind) && currentKind == kind)
        return true;

    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, ModernBorderSubclassProc, kind)) {
        return false;
    }

    if (!SetPropW(hwnd, kPropModernBorderKind,
            (HANDLE)(ULONG_PTR)(kind + 1))) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, ModernBorderSubclassProc);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool ModernBorderUninstall(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!ModernBorderGetKind(hwnd))
        return false;
    WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
        hwnd, ModernBorderSubclassProc);
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropModernBorderKind);
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropModernBorderHot);
    return true;
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK ModernBorderSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR dwRefData)
{
    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropModernBorderHot);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropModernBorderKind);
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    }

    if (dwRefData == 3 && msg == WM_NCPAINT &&
        (!g_settings.EditFocusLine || SysHighContrastEnabled())) {
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    }

    if (msg == WM_NCPAINT) {
        LRESULT res = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);

        HDC hdc = GetWindowDC(hwnd);
        if (!hdc) return res;

        RECT rcWin;
        GetWindowRect(hwnd, &rcWin);
        const int winW = rcWin.right - rcWin.left;
        const int winH = rcWin.bottom - rcWin.top;

        RECT rcClient;
        GetClientRect(hwnd, &rcClient);
        MapWindowPoints(hwnd, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(&rcClient), 2);
        OffsetRect(&rcClient, -rcWin.left, -rcWin.top);

        const int ncL = rcClient.left;
        const int ncT = rcClient.top;
        const int ncR = winW - rcClient.right;
        const int ncB = winH - rcClient.bottom;

        if (ncL > 0 || ncT > 0 || ncR > 0 || ncB > 0) {
            const bool dark = IsHwndDarkMode(hwnd);
            const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);

            const COLORREF bgClr = (g_darkModeActive && dark)
                    ? kElevatedPaneDark
                    : ControlClientBgColor(hwnd, hdc, COLOR_WINDOW);
            HBRUSH hBgBr = CreateSolidBrush(bgClr);
            const bool canReplaceNative = hBgBr != nullptr;

            // GetClientRect excludes non-client scrollbars. Separate their
            // channels from the actual frame so erasing the native square
            // border doesn't cover a scrollbar until its next repaint.
            const DWORD style = GetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE);
            const DWORD exStyle = GetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE);
            const bool hasVert = (style & WS_VSCROLL) != 0;
            const bool hasHorz = (style & WS_HSCROLL) != 0;
            // WS_EX_LAYOUTRTL mirrors the whole window (including where the
            // vertical scrollbar sits) independently of WS_EX_LEFTSCROLLBAR
            // -- either one alone can put it on the left.
            const bool leftScrollbar = hasVert &&
                ((exStyle & (WS_EX_LEFTSCROLLBAR | WS_EX_LAYOUTRTL)) != 0);
            int frameL = ncL;
            int frameR = ncR;
            int frameB = ncB;
            if (hasVert) {
                const int scrollW = GetSystemMetricsForDpi(SM_CXVSCROLL, dpi);
                int& scrollbarSide = leftScrollbar ? frameL : frameR;
                if (scrollW > 0 && scrollbarSide >= scrollW)
                    scrollbarSide -= scrollW;
            }
            if (hasHorz) {
                const int scrollH = GetSystemMetricsForDpi(SM_CYHSCROLL, dpi);
                if (scrollH > 0 && frameB >= scrollH)
                    frameB -= scrollH;
            }

            // Erase 3D NC border
            if (hBgBr) {
                if (ncT > 0) { RECT r = {0, 0, winW, ncT}; FillRect_orig(hdc, &r, hBgBr); }
                if (frameB > 0) { RECT r = {0, winH-frameB, winW, winH}; FillRect_orig(hdc, &r, hBgBr); }
                if (frameL > 0) { RECT r = {0, ncT, frameL, winH-frameB}; FillRect_orig(hdc, &r, hBgBr); }
                if (frameR > 0) { RECT r = {winW-frameR, ncT, winW, winH-frameB}; FillRect_orig(hdc, &r, hBgBr); }
                DeleteObject(hBgBr);
            }

            const bool modernSizeBox = ModernScrollbarEnabledForWindow(hwnd);
            if (modernSizeBox && hasVert && hasHorz &&
                !SysHighContrastEnabled()) {
                HBRUSH sizeBoxBr = CreateSolidBrush(ScrollBarSizeBoxColor(hwnd, hdc, dark));
                if (sizeBoxBr) {
                    RECT sizeBox = leftScrollbar
                        ? RECT{frameL, rcClient.bottom,
                               rcClient.left, winH - frameB}
                        : RECT{rcClient.right, rcClient.bottom,
                               winW - frameR, winH - frameB};
                    if (sizeBox.right > sizeBox.left &&
                        sizeBox.bottom > sizeBox.top) {
                        FillRect_orig(hdc, &sizeBox, sizeBoxBr);
                    }
                    DeleteObject(sizeBoxBr);
                }
            }

            // dwRefData: 1 = Edit (DrawThemeBackground handles visual)
            //            2 = Static separator line (thin sunken-edge static,
            //                shape-detected once at creation size — see the
            //                WS_EX_STATICEDGE install site below)
            //            3 = Hotkey control (Edit-style border + focus line)
            //            0 = box (GroupBox-style rounded border)
            if (dwRefData == 3) {
                bool painted = false;
                if (canReplaceNative) {
                    const bool disabled = !IsWindowEnabled(hwnd);
                    const bool focused = GetFocus() == hwnd;
                    const bool hot = GetPropW(hwnd, kPropModernBorderHot) != nullptr;
                    const INT state = disabled ? 4 : focused ? 5 : hot ? 6 : 1;
                    RECT borderRect = { 0, 0, winW, winH };
                    painted = PaintControlBorder(
                        hdc, 0, state, &borderRect, /*fillBackground=*/false);
                }
                if (!painted) {
                    ReleaseDC(hwnd, hdc);
                    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
                }
            }
            else if (dwRefData == 2) {
                // Same 1px line technique as DrawEdge_hook's separator
                // replacement, just oriented to whichever side is longer.
                const COLORREF lineClr = dark ? RGB(48, 48, 48) : RGB(224, 224, 224);
                HPEN hPen = CreatePen(PS_SOLID, 1, lineClr);
                if (hPen) {
                    HPEN oldPen = (HPEN)SelectObject(hdc, hPen);
                    if (winW >= winH) {
                        const int midY = winH / 2;
                        MoveToEx(hdc, 0, midY, nullptr);
                        LineTo(hdc, winW, midY);
                    } else {
                        const int midX = winW / 2;
                        MoveToEx(hdc, midX, 0, nullptr);
                        LineTo(hdc, midX, winH);
                    }
                    SelectObject(hdc, oldPen);
                    DeleteObject(hPen);
                }
            }
            else if (dwRefData == 0) {
                // The modern GroupBox's outline: 4 DIP corners, a 1 DIP
                // antialiased line in white/black at 8% over the surface.
                // The client area isn't clipped to the curve, so the radius
                // stays where the arc still clears the thinnest frame side
                // (r - r/sqrt(2) <= frame).
                const float scale = static_cast<float>(dpi) / 96.f;
                int frameMin = INT_MAX;
                for (int side : { ncT, frameL, frameR, frameB }) {
                    if (side > 0)
                        frameMin = (std::min)(frameMin, side);
                }
                if (frameMin == INT_MAX)
                    frameMin = 1;
                const float radius = (std::min)(WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale,
                    static_cast<float>(frameMin) / (1.f - 0.70710678f));
                const float lineW = scale;
                const COLORREF lineClr = BlendOverColor(bgClr,
                    dark ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0), 0.08f);
                const Gdiplus::RectF bounds(lineW * 0.5f, lineW * 0.5f,
                    static_cast<float>(winW) - lineW,
                    static_cast<float>(winH) - lineW);
                if (!StrokeRoundedRectGdip(hdc, bounds, radius, lineW,
                        Gdiplus::Color(255, GetRValue(lineClr),
                            GetGValue(lineClr), GetBValue(lineClr)))) {
                    HPEN hPen = CreatePen(PS_SOLID, 1, lineClr);
                    if (hPen) {
                        HBRUSH hNull = static_cast<HBRUSH>(GetStockObject(NULL_BRUSH));
                        HPEN oldPen = static_cast<HPEN>(SelectObject(hdc, hPen));
                        HBRUSH oldBr = static_cast<HBRUSH>(SelectObject(hdc, hNull));
                        const int d = static_cast<int>(std::lround(radius * 2.f));
                        RoundRect(hdc, 0, 0, winW, winH, d, d);
                        SelectObject(hdc, oldBr);
                        SelectObject(hdc, oldPen);
                        DeleteObject(hPen);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        ReleaseDC(hwnd, hdc);
        return res;
    }

    if (dwRefData == 3 && msg == WM_MOUSEMOVE &&
        g_settings.EditFocusLine) {
        if (!GetPropW(hwnd, kPropModernBorderHot) &&
            !SysHighContrastEnabled()) {
            SetPropW(hwnd, kPropModernBorderHot, (HANDLE)1);
            TRACKMOUSEEVENT tme = {
                sizeof(tme), TME_LEAVE, hwnd, HOVER_DEFAULT
            };
            TrackMouseEvent(&tme);
            RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
                RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_NOERASE);
        }
    } else if (dwRefData == 3 && msg == WM_MOUSELEAVE) {
        if (RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropModernBorderHot)) {
            RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
                RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_NOERASE);
        }
    }

    // Redraw NC on focus changes
    if (msg == WM_SETFOCUS || msg == WM_KILLFOCUS || msg == WM_ENABLE) {
        LRESULT res = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        SendMessage(hwnd, WM_NCPAINT, 0, 0);
        return res;
    }

    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

// ── DirectUI folder-view border in property dialogs ─────────────────────────
// SHELLDLL_DefView adds WS_BORDER after creation. Keep its layout border, clip
// the content, suppress the square NC paint, and draw the replacement outside.
static constexpr LPCWSTR kPropDefViewBorderSubclass =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.DefViewBorderSubclass";
static constexpr LPCWSTR kPropDefViewBorderRegionInstalled =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.DefViewBorderRegionInstalled";
static constexpr LPCWSTR kPropDefViewBorderOriginalRegion =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.DefViewBorderOriginalRegion";
static constexpr LPCWSTR kPropDefViewBorderApplyingRegion =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.DefViewBorderApplyingRegion";
static constexpr LPCWSTR kPropDefViewBorderParentSubclass =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.DefViewBorderParentSubclass";
static constexpr LPCWSTR kPropDefViewBorderParentChild =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.DefViewBorderParentChild";
static constexpr LPCWSTR kPropDefViewBorderParentPaintPending =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.DefViewBorderParentPaintPending";

static std::atomic<bool> g_defViewBorderUnloading{false};
static std::atomic<UINT> g_defViewBorderPaintMessage{0};

static LRESULT CALLBACK DefViewBorderSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR);
static LRESULT CALLBACK DefViewBorderParentSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR);

static HWND DefViewBorderFindDirectUiChild(HWND hwnd)
{
    return FindWindowExW(hwnd, nullptr, L"DirectUIHWND", nullptr);
}

static bool DefViewBorderIsPropertyScope(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!IsClassName(hwnd, L"SHELLDLL_DefView"))
        return false;

    HWND page = GetParent(hwnd);
    if (!IsClassName(page, L"#32770") ||
        !IsInTabbedPropertyPane(page)) {
        return false;
    }

    HWND root = GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT);
    return IsClassName(root, L"#32770");
}

static bool DefViewBorderIsEligible(HWND hwnd)
{
    return g_settings.ModernSeparators &&
        !SysHighContrastEnabled() &&
        DefViewBorderIsPropertyScope(hwnd) &&
        (GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE) & WS_BORDER) &&
        DefViewBorderFindDirectUiChild(hwnd);
}

static UINT DefViewBorderDpi(HWND hwnd)
{
    UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);
    return dpi ? dpi : USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
}

static int DefViewBorderCornerDiameter(HWND hwnd)
{
    return (std::max)(
        1, MulDiv(static_cast<int>(WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * 2.f), DefViewBorderDpi(hwnd), USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI));
}

static int DefViewBorderOutsideInset(HWND hwnd)
{
    return (std::max)(
        1, MulDiv(1, DefViewBorderDpi(hwnd), USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI));
}

static void DefViewBorderDiscardSavedRegion(HWND hwnd)
{
    HRGN original = reinterpret_cast<HRGN>(
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderOriginalRegion));
    if (original)
        DeleteObject(original);
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderRegionInstalled);
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderApplyingRegion);
}

static void DefViewBorderRestoreRegion(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderRegionInstalled))
        return;

    HRGN original = reinterpret_cast<HRGN>(
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderOriginalRegion));
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderApplyingRegion);
    if (!SetWindowRgn(hwnd, original, TRUE) && original)
        DeleteObject(original);
}

static bool DefViewBorderApplyRegion(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (GetPropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderApplyingRegion))
        return true;

    RECT rect = {};
    if (!GetWindowRect(hwnd, &rect))
        return false;
    const int width = rect.right - rect.left;
    const int height = rect.bottom - rect.top;
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
        return false;

    const bool firstInstall =
        !GetPropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderRegionInstalled);
    if (firstInstall) {
        HRGN original = CreateRectRgn(0, 0, 0, 0);
        if (!original)
            return false;
        if (GetWindowRgn(hwnd, original) == ERROR) {
            DeleteObject(original);
            original = nullptr;
        } else if (!SetPropW(
                       hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderOriginalRegion, original)) {
            DeleteObject(original);
            return false;
        }

        if (!SetPropW(
                hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderRegionInstalled,
                reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(1))) {
            if (original) {
                RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderOriginalRegion);
                DeleteObject(original);
            }
            return false;
        }
    }

    const int diameter = DefViewBorderCornerDiameter(hwnd);
    HRGN rounded = CreateRoundRectRgn(
        0, 0, width + 1, height + 1, diameter, diameter);
    if (!rounded) {
        if (firstInstall)
            DefViewBorderDiscardSavedRegion(hwnd);
        return false;
    }

    if (!SetPropW(
            hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderApplyingRegion,
            reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(1))) {
        DeleteObject(rounded);
        if (firstInstall)
            DefViewBorderDiscardSavedRegion(hwnd);
        return false;
    }

    const bool applied = SetWindowRgn(hwnd, rounded, TRUE) != FALSE;
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderApplyingRegion);
    if (!applied) {
        DeleteObject(rounded);
        if (firstInstall)
            DefViewBorderDiscardSavedRegion(hwnd);
    }
    return applied;
}

static bool DefViewBorderEraseNative(HWND hwnd, bool dark)
{
    HDC hdc = GetWindowDC(hwnd);
    if (!hdc)
        return false;

    RECT windowRect = {};
    RECT clientRect = {};
    if (!GetWindowRect(hwnd, &windowRect) ||
        !GetClientRect(hwnd, &clientRect)) {
        ReleaseDC(hwnd, hdc);
        return false;
    }
    MapWindowPoints(
        hwnd, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(&clientRect), 2);
    OffsetRect(
        &clientRect, -windowRect.left, -windowRect.top);

    const int width = windowRect.right - windowRect.left;
    const int height = windowRect.bottom - windowRect.top;
    const int ncLeft = clientRect.left;
    const int ncTop = clientRect.top;
    const int ncRight = width - clientRect.right;
    const int ncBottom = height - clientRect.bottom;
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0 ||
        (ncLeft <= 0 && ncTop <= 0 && ncRight <= 0 && ncBottom <= 0)) {
        ReleaseDC(hwnd, hdc);
        return false;
    }

    HBRUSH brush = CreateSolidBrush(
        dark ? Win32MainDark : GetSysColor(COLOR_WINDOW));
    if (!brush) {
        ReleaseDC(hwnd, hdc);
        return false;
    }

    bool erased = true;
    if (ncTop > 0) {
        RECT rect = {0, 0, width, ncTop};
        erased = FillRect_orig(hdc, &rect, brush) != FALSE && erased;
    }
    if (ncBottom > 0) {
        RECT rect = {0, height - ncBottom, width, height};
        erased = FillRect_orig(hdc, &rect, brush) != FALSE && erased;
    }
    if (ncLeft > 0) {
        RECT rect = {0, ncTop, ncLeft, height - ncBottom};
        erased = FillRect_orig(hdc, &rect, brush) != FALSE && erased;
    }
    if (ncRight > 0) {
        RECT rect = {
            width - ncRight, ncTop, width, height - ncBottom};
        erased = FillRect_orig(hdc, &rect, brush) != FALSE && erased;
    }

    DeleteObject(brush);
    ReleaseDC(hwnd, hdc);
    return erased;
}

static bool DefViewBorderGetOuterRect(
    HWND hwnd, HWND* parentOut, RECT* borderRectOut)
{
    HWND parent = GetParent(hwnd);
    if (!parent || !borderRectOut || !IsClassName(parent, L"#32770"))
        return false;

    RECT windowRect = {};
    if (!GetWindowRect(hwnd, &windowRect))
        return false;
    POINT points[2] = {
        {windowRect.left, windowRect.top},
        {windowRect.right, windowRect.bottom},
    };
    MapWindowPoints(nullptr, parent, points, ARRAYSIZE(points));

    const int outsideInset = DefViewBorderOutsideInset(hwnd);
    *borderRectOut = {
        points[0].x - outsideInset,
        points[0].y - outsideInset,
        points[1].x + outsideInset,
        points[1].y + outsideInset,
    };
    if (parentOut)
        *parentOut = parent;
    return true;
}

static void DefViewBorderInvalidateOuter(HWND hwnd)
{
    HWND parent = nullptr;
    RECT borderRect = {};
    if (DefViewBorderGetOuterRect(hwnd, &parent, &borderRect)) {
        RedrawWindow(
            parent, &borderRect, nullptr,
            RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE);
    }
}

static bool DefViewBorderPaintOuter(HWND hwnd, bool dark)
{
    HWND parent = nullptr;
    RECT borderRect = {};
    if (!IsWindowVisible(hwnd) ||
        !DefViewBorderGetOuterRect(hwnd, &parent, &borderRect) ||
        !IsWindowVisible(parent)) {
        return false;
    }

    RECT parentClient = {};
    if (!GetClientRect(parent, &parentClient) ||
        borderRect.left < parentClient.left ||
        borderRect.top < parentClient.top ||
        borderRect.right > parentClient.right ||
        borderRect.bottom > parentClient.bottom) {
        return false;
    }

    HDC parentDc = GetDC(parent);
    if (!parentDc)
        return false;

    BP_PAINTPARAMS params = {};
    params.cbSize = sizeof(params);
    HDC bufferDc = nullptr;
    HPAINTBUFFER buffer = BeginBufferedPaint(
        parentDc, &borderRect, BPBF_COMPATIBLEBITMAP, &params, &bufferDc);
    if (!buffer || !bufferDc) {
        ReleaseDC(parent, parentDc);
        return false;
    }

    const int width = borderRect.right - borderRect.left;
    const int height = borderRect.bottom - borderRect.top;
    bool painted = BitBlt(
        bufferDc, borderRect.left, borderRect.top, width, height,
        parentDc, borderRect.left, borderRect.top, SRCCOPY) != FALSE;

    const COLORREF line =
        dark ? RGB(0x30, 0x30, 0x30) : RGB(0xE0, 0xE0, 0xE0);
    const int penWidth = DefViewBorderOutsideInset(hwnd);
    HPEN pen = painted ? CreatePen(PS_SOLID, penWidth, line) : nullptr;
    HBRUSH nullBrush =
        static_cast<HBRUSH>(GetStockObject(NULL_BRUSH));
    if (!pen || !nullBrush) {
        painted = false;
    } else {
        HPEN oldPen =
            static_cast<HPEN>(SelectObject(bufferDc, pen));
        HBRUSH oldBrush =
            static_cast<HBRUSH>(SelectObject(bufferDc, nullBrush));
        const int penInset = penWidth / 2;
        const int outsideInset = DefViewBorderOutsideInset(hwnd);
        const int diameter =
            DefViewBorderCornerDiameter(hwnd) + 2 * outsideInset;
        painted = RoundRect(
            bufferDc,
            borderRect.left + penInset, borderRect.top + penInset,
            borderRect.right - penInset, borderRect.bottom - penInset,
            diameter, diameter) != FALSE;
        SelectObject(bufferDc, oldBrush);
        SelectObject(bufferDc, oldPen);
    }

    if (pen)
        DeleteObject(pen);
    const HRESULT endHr = EndBufferedPaint(buffer, painted);
    ReleaseDC(parent, parentDc);
    return painted && SUCCEEDED(endHr);
}

static void DefViewBorderScheduleParentPaint(HWND parent)
{
    if (!parent ||
        GetPropW(parent, kPropDefViewBorderParentPaintPending)) {
        return;
    }

    const UINT paintMessage =
        g_defViewBorderPaintMessage.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (!paintMessage) {
        HWND child = reinterpret_cast<HWND>(
            GetPropW(parent, kPropDefViewBorderParentChild));
        if (DefViewBorderIsEligible(child))
            DefViewBorderPaintOuter(child, IsHwndDarkMode(child));
        return;
    }

    if (!SetPropW(
            parent, kPropDefViewBorderParentPaintPending,
            reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(1))) {
        return;
    }
    if (!PostMessageW(parent, paintMessage, 0, 0)) {
        RemovePropW(parent, kPropDefViewBorderParentPaintPending);
    }
}

static bool DefViewBorderAttachParent(HWND hwnd)
{
    HWND parent = GetParent(hwnd);
    if (!parent || !IsClassName(parent, L"#32770"))
        return false;

    HWND previous = reinterpret_cast<HWND>(
        GetPropW(parent, kPropDefViewBorderParentChild));
    if (previous && previous != hwnd && IsWindow(previous))
        return false;

    if (!SetPropW(parent, kPropDefViewBorderParentChild, hwnd))
        return false;

    if (GetPropW(parent, kPropDefViewBorderParentSubclass))
        return true;

    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            parent, DefViewBorderParentSubclassProc, 0)) {
        RemovePropW(parent, kPropDefViewBorderParentChild);
        return false;
    }
    if (!SetPropW(
            parent, kPropDefViewBorderParentSubclass,
            reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(1))) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            parent, DefViewBorderParentSubclassProc);
        RemovePropW(parent, kPropDefViewBorderParentChild);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static void DefViewBorderDetachParent(HWND hwnd)
{
    HWND parent = GetParent(hwnd);
    if (!parent ||
        reinterpret_cast<HWND>(
            GetPropW(parent, kPropDefViewBorderParentChild)) != hwnd) {
        return;
    }

    RemovePropW(parent, kPropDefViewBorderParentPaintPending);
    RemovePropW(parent, kPropDefViewBorderParentChild);
    if (RemovePropW(parent, kPropDefViewBorderParentSubclass)) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            parent, DefViewBorderParentSubclassProc);
    }
}

static void DefViewBorderDeactivate(HWND hwnd)
{
    HWND parent = nullptr;
    RECT borderRect = {};
    const bool hadOuterRect =
        DefViewBorderGetOuterRect(hwnd, &parent, &borderRect);
    DefViewBorderDetachParent(hwnd);
    DefViewBorderRestoreRegion(hwnd);
    if (hadOuterRect && parent) {
        RedrawWindow(
            parent, &borderRect, nullptr,
            RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE);
    }
}

static bool DefViewBorderActivate(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!DefViewBorderIsEligible(hwnd))
        return false;

    ModernBorderUninstall(hwnd);
    if (!DefViewBorderApplyRegion(hwnd) ||
        !DefViewBorderAttachParent(hwnd)) {
        DefViewBorderDeactivate(hwnd);
        return false;
    }

    RedrawWindow(
        hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
        RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_NOERASE);
    return true;
}

static void DefViewBorderUpdate(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (DefViewBorderIsEligible(hwnd))
        DefViewBorderActivate(hwnd);
    else
        DefViewBorderDeactivate(hwnd);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK DefViewBorderParentSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderParentPaintPending);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderParentChild);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderParentSubclass);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, DefViewBorderParentSubclassProc);
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    }

    if (g_defViewBorderUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);

    if (const UINT paintMessage =
            g_defViewBorderPaintMessage.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        paintMessage && msg == paintMessage) {
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderParentPaintPending);
        HWND child = reinterpret_cast<HWND>(
            GetPropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderParentChild));
        if (DefViewBorderIsEligible(child))
            DefViewBorderPaintOuter(child, IsHwndDarkMode(child));
        return 0;
    }

    if (msg == WM_PAINT || msg == WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGED) {
        LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        DefViewBorderScheduleParentPaint(hwnd);
        return result;
    }

    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK DefViewBorderSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        HWND parent = nullptr;
        RECT borderRect = {};
        const bool hadOuterRect =
            DefViewBorderGetOuterRect(hwnd, &parent, &borderRect);
        DefViewBorderDetachParent(hwnd);
        DefViewBorderDiscardSavedRegion(hwnd);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderSubclass);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, DefViewBorderSubclassProc);
        LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        if (hadOuterRect && IsWindow(parent)) {
            RedrawWindow(
                parent, &borderRect, nullptr,
                RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE);
        }
        return result;
    }

    if (g_defViewBorderUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !g_settings.ModernSeparators) {
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    }

    if (msg == WM_STYLECHANGED &&
        static_cast<int>(wp) == GWL_STYLE) {
        LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        DefViewBorderUpdate(hwnd);
        return result;
    }

    if (msg == WM_SIZE || msg == WM_DPICHANGED) {
        LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        DefViewBorderUpdate(hwnd);
        return result;
    }

    if (msg == WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGED) {
        LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        if (DefViewBorderIsEligible(hwnd))
            DefViewBorderScheduleParentPaint(GetParent(hwnd));
        return result;
    }
