    if (msg == WM_SHOWWINDOW) {
        LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        if (wp && DefViewBorderIsEligible(hwnd))
            DefViewBorderScheduleParentPaint(GetParent(hwnd));
        else
            DefViewBorderInvalidateOuter(hwnd);
        return result;
    }

    if (msg == WM_THEMECHANGED || msg == WM_SETTINGCHANGE) {
        LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        DefViewBorderUpdate(hwnd);
        if (DefViewBorderIsEligible(hwnd)) {
            DefViewBorderScheduleParentPaint(GetParent(hwnd));
        }
        return result;
    }

    if (msg == WM_NCPAINT && DefViewBorderIsEligible(hwnd)) {
        const bool dark = IsHwndDarkMode(hwnd);
        const bool erased = DefViewBorderEraseNative(hwnd, dark);
        const bool outerPainted =
            erased && DefViewBorderPaintOuter(hwnd, dark);
        if (erased && outerPainted)
            return 0;
    }

    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

static void DefViewBorderTryInstall(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (g_defViewBorderUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !g_settings.ModernSeparators ||
        !DefViewBorderIsPropertyScope(hwnd) ||
        !DefViewBorderFindDirectUiChild(hwnd)) {
        return;
    }

    if (!GetPropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderSubclass)) {
        if (!WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                hwnd, DefViewBorderSubclassProc, 0)) {
            return;
        }
        if (!SetPropW(
                hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderSubclass,
                reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(1))) {
            WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                hwnd, DefViewBorderSubclassProc);
            return;
        }
    }

    DefViewBorderUpdate(hwnd);
}

static void DefViewBorderConsiderWindow(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!IsClassName(hwnd, L"DirectUIHWND"))
        return;

    HWND defView = GetParent(hwnd);
    if (DefViewBorderIsPropertyScope(defView))
        DefViewBorderTryInstall(defView);
}

static void DefViewBorderUninstall(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (GetPropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderSubclass)) {
        DefViewBorderDeactivate(hwnd);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, DefViewBorderSubclassProc);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderSubclass);
    }

    if (GetPropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderParentSubclass)) {
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderParentPaintPending);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderParentChild);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, DefViewBorderParentSubclassProc);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropDefViewBorderParentSubclass);
    }
}

static BOOL CALLBACK DefViewBorderApplyChildEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DefViewBorderConsiderWindow(hwnd);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK DefViewBorderApplyEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId())
        return TRUE;
    DefViewBorderConsiderWindow(hwnd);
    EnumChildWindows(hwnd, DefViewBorderApplyChildEnum, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK DefViewBorderRemoveChildEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DefViewBorderUninstall(hwnd);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK DefViewBorderRemoveEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId())
        return TRUE;
    DefViewBorderUninstall(hwnd);
    EnumChildWindows(hwnd, DefViewBorderRemoveChildEnum, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

// WinUI-style scrollbar hover background: one continuous pill running the
// length of the whole bar, built from three independently-painted theme
// parts (top/left arrow, track + thumb body, bottom/right arrow). Each part
// only sees its own rect, so the illusion relies on every part sharing the
// exact same cross-width (inset on the side away from where the thumb sits
// — left for vertical bars, top for horizontal — not trimmed on the other
// side) so the edges line up: square corners on parts that are flush
// against a neighbor, and the rounding only on the two outer corners of
// the arrow parts that cap each end of the bar.
static D2D1_RECT_F ScrollbarHoverStripRect(bool isVert, FLOAT fw, FLOAT fh, FLOAT scale)
{
    // Near side (away from the thumb) trims the empty margin without
    // shrinking to the thumb's own width; far side gets a smaller trim too,
    // since the thumb itself never reaches the true edge. Insets are a
    // fraction of the control's own measured cross-width/height, not a fixed
    // scale-derived pixel count -- some windows (certain native file-picker
    // dialogs) aren't fully per-monitor-v2 aware and render the scrollbar
    // narrower than the DPI standard this was tuned against, and a fixed
    // pixel inset would undershoot there. `scale` only sets the floor so a
    // near-zero rect can't collapse the inset.
    FLOAT crossDim  = isVert ? fw : fh;
    FLOAT nearInset = std::max(crossDim * (4.f / 17.f), 1.f * scale);
    FLOAT farInset  = std::max(crossDim * (1.f / 17.f), 0.5f * scale);
    return isVert
        ? D2D1::RectF(nearInset, 0.f, fw - farInset, fh)
        : D2D1::RectF(0.f, nearInset, fw, fh - farInset);
}

// Flat fill, no rounding: the square middle joining the two arrow caps.
static bool FillScrollbarHoverStrip(Gdiplus::Graphics& graphics, bool isVert,
    FLOAT fw, FLOAT fh, FLOAT scale, COLORREF color)
{
    const D2D1_RECT_F rect = ScrollbarHoverStripRect(isVert, fw, fh, scale);
    Gdiplus::SolidBrush brush(GdipColor(color));
    return brush.GetLastStatus() == Gdiplus::Ok &&
        graphics.FillRectangle(&brush, Gdiplus::RectF(
            rect.left, rect.top, rect.right - rect.left,
            rect.bottom - rect.top)) == Gdiplus::Ok;
}

enum class ScrollbarCapEdge { Top, Bottom, Left, Right };

// Makes a themed part atomic: its erase, background, border, and glyph are
// committed together. UxTheme owns the temporary surface, so this adds no
// cache or HWND lifecycle.
class AtomicThemePaintBuffer
{
public:
    AtomicThemePaintBuffer(HDC target, LPCRECT rect, bool enabled)
        : m_paint(target)
    {
        if (!enabled || !target || !rect)
            return;
        BP_PAINTPARAMS params = {sizeof(params)};
        m_buffer = BeginBufferedPaint(
            target, rect, BPBF_TOPDOWNDIB, &params, &m_paint);
        if (!m_buffer || !m_paint) {
            m_buffer = nullptr;
            m_paint = target;
        }
    }

    ~AtomicThemePaintBuffer()
    {
        if (m_buffer)
            EndBufferedPaint(m_buffer, m_commit);
    }

    AtomicThemePaintBuffer(const AtomicThemePaintBuffer&) = delete;
    AtomicThemePaintBuffer& operator=(const AtomicThemePaintBuffer&) = delete;

    HDC GetDC() const { return m_paint; }
    void Commit() { m_commit = TRUE; }

private:
    HDC m_paint = nullptr;
    HPAINTBUFFER m_buffer = nullptr;
    BOOL m_commit = FALSE;
};

static bool FillScrollbarRoundedRect(Gdiplus::Graphics& graphics,
    const Gdiplus::RectF& bounds, FLOAT radius, COLORREF color)
{
    Gdiplus::GraphicsPath path;
    if (!RoundedHdcAddPath(path, bounds, radius, true, true, true, true))
        return false;
    Gdiplus::SolidBrush brush(GdipColor(color));
    return brush.GetLastStatus() == Gdiplus::Ok &&
        graphics.FillPath(&brush, &path) == Gdiplus::Ok;
}

// Same strip rect as FillScrollbarHoverStrip, rounding only the outer end.
static bool FillScrollbarHoverCap(Gdiplus::Graphics& graphics, bool isVert,
    FLOAT fw, FLOAT fh, FLOAT scale, ScrollbarCapEdge cap, COLORREF color)
{
    D2D1_RECT_F rect = ScrollbarHoverStripRect(isVert, fw, fh, scale);

    // Extra inset on just the outer/rounded edge — pulls the cap in from
    // the control's true edge so the curve sits closer to the arrow glyph
    // instead of reaching all the way out. Doesn't touch the cross-width
    // (left/right for vertical caps, top/bottom for horizontal), so the
    // radius below is unaffected.
    FLOAT capInset = 1.f * scale;
    switch (cap) {
    case ScrollbarCapEdge::Top:    rect.top    += capInset; break;
    case ScrollbarCapEdge::Bottom: rect.bottom -= capInset; break;
    case ScrollbarCapEdge::Left:   rect.left   += capInset; break;
    case ScrollbarCapEdge::Right:  rect.right  -= capInset; break;
    }

    FLOAT r = isVert ? (rect.right - rect.left) / 2.f : (rect.bottom - rect.top) / 2.f;
    if (r <= 0.f) return false;

    const bool top = cap == ScrollbarCapEdge::Top;
    const bool bottom = cap == ScrollbarCapEdge::Bottom;
    const bool left = cap == ScrollbarCapEdge::Left;
    const bool right = cap == ScrollbarCapEdge::Right;
    Gdiplus::GraphicsPath path;
    if (!RoundedHdcAddPath(path, Gdiplus::RectF(
            rect.left, rect.top, rect.right - rect.left,
            rect.bottom - rect.top), r,
            top || left, top || right, bottom || right, bottom || left))
        return false;
    Gdiplus::SolidBrush brush(GdipColor(color));
    return brush.GetLastStatus() == Gdiplus::Ok &&
        graphics.FillPath(&brush, &path) == Gdiplus::Ok;
}

static bool PaintScrollbarArrowFallbackGdip(Gdiplus::Graphics& graphics,
    ScrollbarCapEdge edge, FLOAT cx, FLOAT cy, FLOAT scale,
    bool pressed, COLORREF color)
{
    const FLOAT pressScale = pressed ? 0.875f : 1.0f;
    const FLOAT halfW = 3.0f * scale * pressScale;
    const FLOAT halfH = 2.0f * scale * pressScale;
    Gdiplus::PointF points[3] = {};
    switch (edge) {
    case ScrollbarCapEdge::Top:
        points[0] = {cx - halfW, cy + halfH};
        points[1] = {cx, cy - halfH};
        points[2] = {cx + halfW, cy + halfH};
        break;
    case ScrollbarCapEdge::Bottom:
        points[0] = {cx - halfW, cy - halfH};
        points[1] = {cx, cy + halfH};
        points[2] = {cx + halfW, cy - halfH};
        break;
    case ScrollbarCapEdge::Left:
        points[0] = {cx + halfH, cy - halfW};
        points[1] = {cx - halfH, cy};
        points[2] = {cx + halfH, cy + halfW};
        break;
    case ScrollbarCapEdge::Right:
        points[0] = {cx - halfH, cy - halfW};
        points[1] = {cx + halfH, cy};
        points[2] = {cx - halfH, cy + halfW};
        break;
    }
    Gdiplus::Pen pen(GdipColor(color), std::max(1.0f, 1.35f * scale));
    if (pen.GetLastStatus() != Gdiplus::Ok)
        return false;
    pen.SetLineJoin(Gdiplus::LineJoinRound);
    pen.SetStartCap(Gdiplus::LineCapRound);
    pen.SetEndCap(Gdiplus::LineCapRound);
    return graphics.DrawLines(&pen, points, ARRAYSIZE(points)) == Gdiplus::Ok;
}

// ============================================================================
// WinUI-style nav divider hover reveal (ExplorerSection.NavDividerHoverReveal)
// ============================================================================
// The divider theme part repaints only on position changes, so hover tracking
// uses SetCursor(IDC_SIZEWE) instead of subclassing DirectUIHWND. More than
// one divider can be painted by the same DirectUI host (navigation and preview
// panes), therefore the tracked client-x identifies the divider that is
// actually hot; a theme paint must never replace it with another divider's x.
static const wchar_t* kPropNavDividerX    = L"WH_MW_NAVDIV_X";    // client-x of the active divider
static const wchar_t* kPropNavDividerHot  = L"WH_MW_NAVDIV_HOT";  // present = mouse currently over the divider (fade target)
static const wchar_t* kPropNavDividerFade = L"WH_MW_NAVDIV_FADE"; // current fade level, 0-100 (absent == 0)
static const wchar_t* kPropNavDividerNamespaceTree = L"WH_MW_NAVDIV_NAMESPACE_TREE";

// Arbitrary, deliberately unusual timer ID -- timer IDs are scoped per-HWND,
// but this avoids any chance of colliding with one of DirectUI's own
// internal timers on the same window.
static constexpr UINT_PTR kNavDividerFadeTimerId = 0x4E444956; // "NDIV"
static constexpr int      kNavDividerFadeStep     = 20;        // per 16ms tick -> ~80ms full fade
static constexpr UINT     kNavDividerFadeTimerMs  = 16;

static std::atomic<HWND> g_navDividerHotHwnd{nullptr};

// g_navDividerUnloading is declared near g_msgWndUnloading, because
// ThemeMsgWndProc uses it too.

static void NavDividerInvalidateStrip(HWND hWnd, int centerX, int marginMul)
{
    float scale  = (float)DpiForPaint(hWnd) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    int   margin = std::max(2, (int)(4.f * scale)) * marginMul;
    RECT rc; GetClientRect(hWnd, &rc);
    RECT inval = { centerX - margin, rc.top, centerX + margin, rc.bottom };
    InvalidateRect(hWnd, &inval, FALSE);
}

static int NavDividerHitMargin(HWND hwnd)
{
    const float scale = (float)DpiForPaint(hwnd) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    return std::max(2, (int)(4.f * scale));
}

// Window properties use nullptr to mean "not present". Bias the ordinary
// signed client-coordinate range so zero (and small negative coordinates
// while a captured drag leaves the client) remain valid tracked values.
static constexpr INT_PTR kNavDividerXPropertyBias = 0x10000;

static void NavDividerSetTrackedX(HWND hwnd, int x)
{
    SetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerX,
        reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(
            static_cast<INT_PTR>(x) + kNavDividerXPropertyBias));
}

static bool NavDividerTryGetTrackedX(HWND hwnd, int* x)
{
    HANDLE value = hwnd ? GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerX) : nullptr;
    if (!value)
        return false;

    if (x) {
        *x = static_cast<int>(reinterpret_cast<INT_PTR>(value) -
            kNavDividerXPropertyBias);
    }
    return true;
}

static bool NavDividerRectMatchesTrackedX(HWND hwnd, LPCRECT rect)
{
    if (!hwnd || !rect)
        return false;

    int x = 0;
    if (!NavDividerTryGetTrackedX(hwnd, &x))
        return false;

    const int margin = NavDividerHitMargin(hwnd);
    return x >= rect->left - margin && x <= rect->right + margin;
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK NavDividerHotSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam, DWORD_PTR);

// One fade step, from NavDividerHotSubclassProc's WM_TIMER. The timer has
// no TIMERPROC, so one that outlives the subclass (a mod unload) reaches the
// native window proc and is ignored instead of calling into a freed DLL.
// Once the fade has reached a divider that is no longer hot, the subclass
// removes itself: an idle divider owns no timer and no subclass.
static void NavDividerFadeTick(HWND hwnd)
{
    bool hot = GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerHot) != nullptr;
    int  x = 0;
    const bool haveX = NavDividerTryGetTrackedX(hwnd, &x);

    int target = hot ? 100 : 0;
    int fade   = (int)(INT_PTR)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerFade);
    if (!SysAnimationsEnabled() && fade != target) {
        // No OS/mod animation: jump straight to the final state instead of
        // ramping kNavDividerFadeStep per tick.
        fade = target;
        if (fade == 0) RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerFade);
        else           SetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerFade, (HANDLE)(INT_PTR)fade);
        if (haveX) NavDividerInvalidateStrip(hwnd, x, 3);
    }
    if (fade == target) {
        KillTimer(hwnd, kNavDividerFadeTimerId);
        if (!hot)
            WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, NavDividerHotSubclassProc);
        return;
    }

    fade += (target > fade) ? kNavDividerFadeStep : -kNavDividerFadeStep;
    fade = std::clamp(fade, 0, 100);
    if (fade == 0) RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerFade);
    else           SetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerFade, (HANDLE)(INT_PTR)fade);

    if (haveX) NavDividerInvalidateStrip(hwnd, x, 3);
}

// Registered: starts a fade-out on the divider window's own thread, where
// its timer has to be set.
static UINT NavDividerFadeOutMessage()
{
    static const UINT message =
        RegisterWindowMessageW(L"Win32UIModernizer.NavDividerFadeOut");
    return message;
}

static decltype(&SetCursor) NavDividerSetCursor_orig = nullptr;

static bool NavDividerHasState(HWND hwnd)
{
    return GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerHot) ||
           GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerFade) ||
           GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerX) ||
           GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerNamespaceTree);
}

static void NavDividerClearWindow(HWND hwnd)
{
    // Only windows the divider tracked: the subclass removal below is a
    // blocking cross-thread SendMessage, which must not reach every window
    // of the process (a hung thread's IME window would hang the unload).
    if (!hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd) || !NavDividerHasState(hwnd))
        return;
    int x = 0;
    const bool haveX = NavDividerTryGetTrackedX(hwnd, &x);
    // A no-op from another thread; a timer left behind has no TIMERPROC.
    KillTimer(hwnd, kNavDividerFadeTimerId);
    WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, NavDividerHotSubclassProc);
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerHot);
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerFade);
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerX);
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerNamespaceTree);
    HWND expected = hwnd;
    g_navDividerHotHwnd.compare_exchange_strong(
        expected, nullptr, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
    if (haveX)
        NavDividerInvalidateStrip(hwnd, x, 3);
}

static BOOL CALLBACK NavDividerClearChild(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    NavDividerClearWindow(hwnd);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK NavDividerClearEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId()) return TRUE;
    NavDividerClearWindow(hwnd);
    EnumChildWindows(hwnd, NavDividerClearChild, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

static void NavDividerClearAll()
{
    EnumWindows(NavDividerClearEnum, 0);
    g_navDividerHotHwnd.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
}

// On the divider window's own thread: the hot state ends, and the subclass
// runs the fade out on its WM_TIMER.
static void NavDividerBeginFadeOutLocal(HWND hwnd)
{
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerHot);
    SetTimer(hwnd, kNavDividerFadeTimerId, kNavDividerFadeTimerMs, nullptr);
}

static void NavDividerStartFadeOut(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd) ||
        g_navDividerHotHwnd.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == hwnd)
        return;
    // Another Explorer window's divider belongs to another thread, which
    // SetTimer can't reach: ask that thread's subclass instead.
    if (GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, nullptr) == GetCurrentThreadId())
        NavDividerBeginFadeOutLocal(hwnd);
    else if (const UINT message = NavDividerFadeOutMessage())
        PostMessageW(hwnd, message, 0, 0);
}

// Installed on hot entry and kept until the fade out has finished, so an
// idle divider owns no timer and no subclass. Moving off the divider inside
// the same DirectUIHWND produces no fresh SetCursor call, only WM_MOUSEMOVE;
// leaving the window entirely arrives as WM_MOUSELEAVE (TME_LEAVE, armed
// on hot entry). A drag keeps the hot state and updates kPropNavDividerX from
// WM_MOUSEMOVE, independently of whichever divider DirectUI paints next.
static LRESULT CALLBACK NavDividerHotSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, NavDividerHotSubclassProc);
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
    }
    if (g_navDividerUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        KillTimer(hwnd, kNavDividerFadeTimerId);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, NavDividerHotSubclassProc);
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
    }
    if (msg == WM_TIMER && wParam == kNavDividerFadeTimerId) {
        NavDividerFadeTick(hwnd);
        return 0;
    }
    if (const UINT fadeOutMsg = NavDividerFadeOutMessage();
        fadeOutMsg && msg == fadeOutMsg) {
        if (g_navDividerHotHwnd.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != hwnd)
            NavDividerBeginFadeOutLocal(hwnd);
        return 0;
    }
    if (msg != WM_MOUSEMOVE && msg != WM_MOUSELEAVE)
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam);

    // Fading out: the mouse no longer matters, only the timer does.
    if (!GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavDividerHot))
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam);

    bool left = msg == WM_MOUSELEAVE;
    if (msg == WM_MOUSEMOVE && ((wParam & MK_LBUTTON) || GetCapture() == hwnd)) {
        const int x = (int)(short)LOWORD(lParam);
        int oldX = 0;
        const bool haveOldX = NavDividerTryGetTrackedX(hwnd, &oldX);
        if (!haveOldX || oldX != x) {
            NavDividerSetTrackedX(hwnd, x);
            if (haveOldX)
                NavDividerInvalidateStrip(hwnd, oldX, 3);
            NavDividerInvalidateStrip(hwnd, x, 3);
        }
    } else if (msg == WM_MOUSEMOVE) {
        int trackedX = 0;
        const bool haveX = NavDividerTryGetTrackedX(hwnd, &trackedX);
        const int x = (int)(short)LOWORD(lParam);
        const int margin = NavDividerHitMargin(hwnd);
        left = !haveX || std::abs(x - trackedX) > margin;
    }
    if (left) {
        HWND expected = hwnd;
        g_navDividerHotHwnd.compare_exchange_strong(
            expected, nullptr, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        NavDividerStartFadeOut(hwnd);
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
}

static bool NavDividerIsNamespaceTreeClass(HWND hwnd)
{
    wchar_t cls[64] = {};
    return GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)) &&
        wcsstr(cls, L"NamespaceTreeControl");
}

static BOOL CALLBACK NavDividerFindNamespaceTreeChild(HWND hwnd, LPARAM lParam)
{
    if (!NavDividerIsNamespaceTreeClass(hwnd))
        return TRUE;

    *reinterpret_cast<HWND*>(lParam) = hwnd;
    return FALSE;
}

// Never a real HWND -- marks "checked, no namespace tree under this root"
// so a root without one doesn't pay a fresh EnumChildWindows walk on every
// call. This runs from a global SetCursor hook, so an uncached negative
// means every WM_SETCURSOR with an IDC_SIZEWE-style splitter re-walks its
// whole child tree.
static HWND kNavDividerNoTreeSentinel = reinterpret_cast<HWND>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(-1));

// cacheNegative=true is only safe once the caller's trigger can't fire
// before the dialog finishes building its children -- true for WM_SETCURSOR,
// but not for a paint-hot-path caller like IsInsideExcludedFilePicker, which
// can run while the NamespaceTreeControl nav pane is still under
// construction. Such a caller must pass cacheNegative=false, or a too-early
// miss gets baked in permanently since nothing else invalidates it.
static bool NavDividerRootContainsNamespaceTree(HWND hwnd, bool cacheNegative)
{
    HWND root = hwnd ? GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT) : nullptr;
    if (!root)
        return false;

    HWND cached = reinterpret_cast<HWND>(
        GetPropW(root, kPropNavDividerNamespaceTree));
    if (cached == kNavDividerNoTreeSentinel)
        return false;
    if (cached && IsWindow(cached) && NavDividerIsNamespaceTreeClass(cached))
        return true;

    if (cached)
        RemovePropW(root, kPropNavDividerNamespaceTree);

    HWND namespaceTree = NavDividerIsNamespaceTreeClass(root) ? root : nullptr;
    if (!namespaceTree)
        EnumChildWindows(root, NavDividerFindNamespaceTreeChild,
            reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&namespaceTree));

    if (!namespaceTree) {
        if (cacheNegative)
            SetPropW(root, kPropNavDividerNamespaceTree, kNavDividerNoTreeSentinel);
        return false;
    }

    SetPropW(root, kPropNavDividerNamespaceTree, namespaceTree);
    return true;
}

// SetCursor is the authoritative first-hover signal. DirectUI can paint the
// divider through a memory DC owned by a different internal HWND, so requiring
// a prior theme-paint marker would make the reveal depend on a later resize.
HCURSOR WINAPI NavDividerSetCursor_hook(HCURSOR hCursor)
{
    if (!g_settings.NavDividerHoverReveal)
        return NavDividerSetCursor_orig(hCursor);

    static HCURSOR sizeWECursor = LoadCursorW(nullptr, IDC_SIZEWE);

    if (hCursor == sizeWECursor) {
        POINT pt; GetCursorPos(&pt);
        HWND hUnder = WindowFromPoint(pt);
        // Only this thread's own window: during a captured drag the point can
        // sit over another thread's (or process's) window, whose timer and
        // subclass this thread can't own.
        if (hUnder &&
            GetWindowThreadProcessId(hUnder, nullptr) == GetCurrentThreadId() &&
            NavDividerRootContainsNamespaceTree(hUnder)) {
            HWND previous = g_navDividerHotHwnd.exchange(
                hUnder, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            if (previous != hUnder)
                NavDividerStartFadeOut(previous);

            POINT clientPt = pt;
            const bool haveClientPoint = ScreenToClient(hUnder, &clientPt);
            int oldX = 0;
            const bool haveOldX = NavDividerTryGetTrackedX(hUnder, &oldX);
            const bool dragging = GetCapture() == hUnder ||
                GetKeyState(VK_LBUTTON) < 0;
            const bool changedDivider = !dragging && haveClientPoint && haveOldX &&
                std::abs(clientPt.x - oldX) > NavDividerHitMargin(hUnder);

            if (changedDivider) {
                NavDividerInvalidateStrip(hUnder, oldX, 3);
                // A second divider inside the same DirectUI host is a new
                // hover, not a continuation of the first divider's fade.
                RemovePropW(hUnder, kPropNavDividerFade);
            }
            if (haveClientPoint) {
                NavDividerSetTrackedX(hUnder, clientPt.x);
                if (changedDivider)
                    NavDividerInvalidateStrip(hUnder, clientPt.x, 3);
            }

            if (!GetPropW(hUnder, kPropNavDividerHot)) {
                SetPropW(hUnder, kPropNavDividerHot, (HANDLE)1);
                // The subclass drives the fade; without it there is none.
                if (WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                        hUnder, NavDividerHotSubclassProc, 0)) {
                    TRACKMOUSEEVENT tme = { sizeof(tme), TME_LEAVE, hUnder, 0 };
                    TrackMouseEvent(&tme);
                    SetTimer(hUnder, kNavDividerFadeTimerId,
                        kNavDividerFadeTimerMs, nullptr);
                }
            } else if (changedDivider) {
                SetTimer(hUnder, kNavDividerFadeTimerId,
                    kNavDividerFadeTimerMs, nullptr);
            }
            return NavDividerSetCursor_orig(hCursor);
        }
    }

    HWND previous = g_navDividerHotHwnd.exchange(
        nullptr, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
    NavDividerStartFadeOut(previous);
    return NavDividerSetCursor_orig(hCursor);
}

// Guards SetFunctionHook below: ensures it's queued exactly once even if
// multiple UI threads hit NavDividerTrackAndGetHwnd concurrently right as
// the first divider(s) appear. (g_navDividerUnloading, used right below
// too, is declared earlier in the file -- see its own comment there for
// why.)
static std::atomic<bool> g_navDividerHookInstallTriggered{false};
// Separate from the flag above: g_msgWnd is only created in Wh_ModAfterInit,
// so a divider paint in the gap between hooks going live and that window
// existing (or any CreateMsgWindow failure) would otherwise queue the hook
// and never actually apply it -- Wh_ApplyHookOperations can't run from this
// paint callback, only from ThemeMsgWndProc once the post lands. Tracked
// independently so a later divider paint keeps retrying the post (cheap:
// one atomic load) until it succeeds once, instead of giving up forever.
static std::atomic<bool> g_navDividerApplyPosted{false};

// Resolves the HWND owning this divider paint. Hover detection and the active
// divider coordinate are handled by NavDividerSetCursor_hook and, while a
// drag owns capture, NavDividerHotSubclassProc. Keeping paint read-only is
// important because one DirectUI host can paint multiple independent dividers.
//
// WindowFromDC(hdc) is tried first, not g_tlsPaintHwnd, since the latter is
// last-set by whichever BeginPaint ran most recently on this UI thread and
// can be stale by the time this call happens. WindowFromDC only succeeds
// for a real window-associated DC, so it's authoritative when it works;
// g_tlsPaintHwnd is kept as the fallback for memory/double-buffered DCs.
static HWND NavDividerTrackAndGetHwnd(HDC hdc)
{
    HWND hDiv = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (!hDiv) hDiv = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
    if (!hDiv) return nullptr;

    // SetFunctionHook only queues the hook, so it's safe to call directly
    // from this callback. Only Wh_ApplyHookOperations (which actually
    // patches the target) can't run from here -- deferred to ThemeMsgWndProc
    // via a posted message, reusing the thread g_msgWnd already runs on.
    // Installing lazily (not in Wh_ModInit) keeps SetCursor unhooked in the
    // many processes that never show a real nav-pane divider.
    if (!g_navDividerHookInstallTriggered.exchange(true, std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_navDividerHookMutex);
        if (!g_navDividerUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(SetCursor, NavDividerSetCursor_hook, &NavDividerSetCursor_orig);
    }

    if (!g_navDividerApplyPosted.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        HWND msgWnd = g_msgWnd.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (msgWnd && PostMessageW(msgWnd, kNavDividerApplyHooksMessage, 0, 0))
            g_navDividerApplyPosted.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    }

    return hDiv;
}

// Explorer uses stable navigation backgrounds. Its own Mica backdrop needs
// black in both themes; callers scope micaBlack to the actual pane host.
static COLORREF NavDividerBackgroundColor(bool dark, bool micaBlack)
{
    if (micaBlack)
        return RGB(0, 0, 0);
    // GetSysColor_orig, not GetSysColor, for the light branch: callers pass
    // `dark` from IsSystemDarkMode(), which can disagree with the *global*
    // g_darkModeActive the hooked GetSysColor branches on -- using the real
    // native color here keeps the light-mode divider matching the actual
    // window background (including under High Contrast / a customized
    // classic window color) regardless of that mismatch.
    return dark ? ExplorerDarkColor : GetSysColor_orig(COLOR_WINDOW);
}

// Paints the WinUI-style hover indicator on top of the already-erased
// background, scaled by fadeFrac (0..1): a thin rounded line spanning 90%
// of the divider's height (same white/black-with-opacity values as the
// scrollbar thumb's hot state), plus a wider accent-filled pill bulge with
// a 2px outline so it stays legible against whatever's behind it.
//
// Painted per fade frame on the outer DirectUI host, a Mica surface, so
// the GDI+ scene goes through PaintAlphaSceneGdip.
static void PaintNavDividerHoverPill(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect, float fadeFrac, bool dark)
{
    if (fadeFrac <= 0.f) return;

    const float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const float w  = (float)(pRect->right - pRect->left);
    const float h  = (float)(pRect->bottom - pRect->top);
    const float cx = w / 2.f;

    const D2D1_COLOR_F lineColor = dark
        ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, (45.f / 255.f) * fadeFrac)
        : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, (55.f / 255.f) * fadeFrac);
    const float lineHalfW = std::max(1.f, 1.f * scale);
    const float lineH     = h * 0.9f;
    const float lineTop   = (h - lineH) / 2.f;

    const float pillHalfW = std::max(3.f, 3.f * scale);
    const float pillHalfH = std::min(14.f * scale, h * 0.5f); // never taller than the divider itself
    const float pillCy = h / 2.f;
    const D2D1_COLOR_F pillFill = ColorFAlpha(GetAccentFillDefault(dark), fadeFrac);
    const float strokeW = std::max(1.f, 2.f * scale);
    const D2D1_COLOR_F outlineColor = ColorFAlpha(dark ? ExplorerDarkColor : RGB(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF), fadeFrac);

    PaintAlphaSceneGdip(hdc, pRect, [&](Gdiplus::Graphics& graphics) {
        Gdiplus::GraphicsPath line;
        if (RoundedHdcAddPath(line,
                Gdiplus::RectF(cx - lineHalfW, lineTop, 2.f * lineHalfW, lineH),
                lineHalfW, true, true, true, true)) {
            Gdiplus::SolidBrush brush(GdipColor(lineColor));
            graphics.FillPath(&brush, &line);
        }
        Gdiplus::GraphicsPath pill;
        if (RoundedHdcAddPath(pill,
                Gdiplus::RectF(cx - pillHalfW, pillCy - pillHalfH, 2.f * pillHalfW, 2.f * pillHalfH),
                pillHalfW, true, true, true, true)) {
            Gdiplus::SolidBrush fill(GdipColor(pillFill));
            graphics.FillPath(&fill, &pill);
            Gdiplus::Pen outline(GdipColor(outlineColor), strokeW);
            graphics.DrawPath(&outline, &pill);
        }
    });
}

// Cached brush for the menu hover overlay (context menu / menu bar item
// highlight) used below in HandleThemeDraw's Menu handling. The handful of
// colors used there are static literals (white/black at a few fixed alphas)
// recomputed via CreateSolidColorBrush on every mouse-move repaint of any
// open menu -- SetColor on a reused brush is a cheap field write instead of
// a fresh COM allocation. Kept in the thread's D2D cache, which releases it
// with the render target and on unload.

// A menu item's hover is SubtleFillColorSecondary, WinUI's pointer-over
// fill. It stays translucent rather than flattened, because it lands on the
// acrylic and has to let the material through; over the solid surface that
// same token reads as #383838 dark and #F0F0F0 light, which is what a color
// picker finds on the shell's own menus.
static D2D1_COLOR_F MenuItemHoverFill(bool dark)
{
    const WinUI::Color token = WinUI::SubtleFillColorSecondary(dark);
    const float channel = dark ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    return D2D1::ColorF(channel, channel, channel, token.alpha / 255.0f);
}

static ID2D1SolidColorBrush* GetMenuHoverBrush(ID2D1DCRenderTarget* pRT, D2D1_COLOR_F color)
{
    D2DThreadCache* cache = D2DGetThreadCache();
    if (!cache || !pRT)
        return nullptr;
    if (cache->menuHoverBrushRT != pRT) {
        if (cache->menuHoverBrush) {
            cache->menuHoverBrush->Release();
            cache->menuHoverBrush = nullptr;
        }
        cache->menuHoverBrushRT = pRT;
    }
    if (cache->menuHoverBrush)
        cache->menuHoverBrush->SetColor(color);
    else if (FAILED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(color, &cache->menuHoverBrush)))
        cache->menuHoverBrush = nullptr;
    return cache->menuHoverBrush;
}

static bool PaintLegacyShellDropdownHover(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect, HWND hwnd, bool selected = false)
{
    if (!hdc || !pRect)
        return false;

    if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(LegacyShellDropdownBgColor(hwnd)))
        FillRect(hdc, pRect, br);

    if (!g_d2dFactory)
        return true;

    int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
    int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
        return true;

    UINT dpi = DpiForPaint(hwnd);
    float scale = (float)dpi / (float)USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    float cr = g_settings.MenuHoverRadius * scale;
    float inset = 1.f * scale;
    bool dropdownDark = IsLegacyShellDropdownDark(hwnd);
    float alpha = selected ? 0.12f : (dropdownDark ? 0.09f : 0.06f);
    D2D1_COLOR_F hoverColor = dropdownDark
        ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, alpha)
        : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, alpha);

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
    if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT))) {
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* hover = GetMenuHoverBrush(pRT.Get(), hoverColor)) {
            pRT->BeginDraw();
            pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                D2D1::RoundedRect(
                    D2D1::RectF(inset, inset, (float)w - inset, (float)h - inset),
                    cr, cr),
                hover);
            if (pRT->EndDraw() == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                pRT.Reset();
                CachedTlsRTRecreate();
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}

static const wchar_t kSearchIconGlyph[] = L"\uE721"; // Segoe Fluent/MDL2 "Search"

// Same prop this file uses elsewhere (PropertySheetLightPaneSubclassProc's own
// declaration, defined much later) to mark a root dialog as carrying the
// light-mode edge extension -- redeclared here since TabPaneCornerColor
// needs it earlier in the file than that section.
static constexpr LPCWSTR kPropTabPaneMeasuredTop = L"WH_TABPANE_MEASURED_TOP";
static constexpr INT_PTR kTabPaneMeasuredTopBias = 0x10000;

static bool ReadMeasuredTabPaneTop(HWND tabHwnd, LONG* paneTop)
{
    if (!tabHwnd || !paneTop)
        return false;

    HANDLE encoded = GetPropW(tabHwnd, kPropTabPaneMeasuredTop);
    if (!encoded)
        return false;

    const INT_PTR decoded = reinterpret_cast<INT_PTR>(encoded) -
        kTabPaneMeasuredTopBias;
    if (decoded < -0x7FFF || decoded > 0x7FFF)
        return false;

    *paneTop = static_cast<LONG>(decoded);
    return true;
}

static void CacheMeasuredTabPaneTop(HWND tabHwnd, LONG paneTop)
{
    if (g_tabFeaturesUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) || !tabHwnd ||
        !GetPropW(tabHwnd, kWinUiTabTextOwnerProp) ||
        paneTop < -0x7FFF || paneTop > 0x7FFF) {
        return;
    }

    const HANDLE encoded = reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(
        static_cast<INT_PTR>(paneTop) + kTabPaneMeasuredTopBias);
    if (GetPropW(tabHwnd, kPropTabPaneMeasuredTop) == encoded ||
        !SetPropW(tabHwnd, kPropTabPaneMeasuredTop, encoded)) {
        return;
    }

    if (g_tabFeaturesUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        RemovePropW(tabHwnd, kPropTabPaneMeasuredTop);
        return;
    }

    // The root may already have erased using the documented fallback. Repaint
    // its children too because some dialogs don't clip them during erase.
    if (HWND root = GetAncestor(tabHwnd, GA_ROOT)) {
        RedrawWindow(root, nullptr, nullptr,
            RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
    }
}

static bool GetExtendedTabPaneRect(
    HWND root, HWND tabHwnd, const RECT& rootClient, RECT* paneRect)
{
    if (!root || !tabHwnd || !paneRect ||
        !GetClientRect(tabHwnd, paneRect)) {
        return false;
    }

    TabCtrl_AdjustRect(tabHwnd, FALSE, paneRect);
    const float scale = DpiForPaint(root) / 96.f;
    LONG measuredTop = 0;
    if (ReadMeasuredTabPaneTop(tabHwnd, &measuredTop)) {
        // Match HandleThemeDraw's one-pixel upward extension from the real
        // TABP_PANE rectangle supplied by the theme renderer.
        paneRect->top = measuredTop -
            static_cast<LONG>(lroundf(1.f * scale));
    } else {
        // First-paint fallback until TABP_PANE supplies its exact rectangle.
        paneRect->top -= static_cast<LONG>(lroundf(3.f * scale));
    }
    paneRect->bottom += static_cast<LONG>(lroundf(5.f * scale));
    MapWindowPoints(tabHwnd, root,
        reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(paneRect), 2);
    paneRect->left = rootClient.left;
    paneRect->right = rootClient.right;
    return paneRect->right > paneRect->left &&
        paneRect->bottom > paneRect->top;
}

// True when the color that should show through the TABP_PANE rounded-corner
// cutouts is actually known -- the root is a real property-sheet dialog that
// our own edge-extension subclass (PropertyDialogSubclassProc/
// PropertySheetLightPaneSubclassProc) has already painted with kElevatedPaneDark/
// WinUI::Light::SolidBackgroundFillColorTertiary. Without that confirmation there's no way to know what
// really surrounds the pane (a plain #32770, an AeroWizard page, a custom-
// colored dialog), so callers must preserve the existing corner pixels
// instead of clearing the cutouts to a guessed color.
static bool TabPaneCornerColorConfirmed(HWND tabHwnd, bool dark)
{
    if (!tabHwnd || !g_settings.RoundedTabPane)
        return false;
    HWND root = GetAncestor(tabHwnd, GA_ROOT);
    const wchar_t* extensionMarker = dark ? kPropertyDialogDarkModeMarker : kPropertySheetLightPaneSubclassMarker;
    wchar_t rootCls[32] = {};
    return root && GetClassNameW(root, rootCls, ARRAYSIZE(rootCls)) &&
        _wcsicmp(rootCls, L"#32770") == 0 && GetPropW(root, extensionMarker);
}

// The color that should show through the TABP_PANE rounded-corner cutouts,
// once TabPaneCornerColorConfirmed() has already established it's known. A
// DC render target bound via BindDC discards alpha on its final blit, so
// Clear()-ing to transparent just blits the Clear color's own RGB, not the
// real destination pixels -- and GetPixel is unsafe too, since the strip
// above the pane may not be repainted yet at this point. Same as
// SampleBackground's own dark-mode branch, the fix is a fixed color by
// context instead of sampling.
static COLORREF TabPaneCornerColor(bool dark)
{
    return ElevatedPaneColor(dark);
}

static bool RoundedHdcEnsureGdipLocked()
{
    if (g_roundedHdcGdip.ready)
        return true;
    if (g_roundedHdcGdip.startupAttempted ||
        g_gdipUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return false;

    g_roundedHdcGdip.startupAttempted = true;
    Gdiplus::GdiplusStartupInput input;
    if (Gdiplus::GdiplusStartup(&g_roundedHdcGdip.token, &input, nullptr) !=
        Gdiplus::Ok) {
        g_roundedHdcGdip.token = 0;
        return false;
    }
    g_roundedHdcGdip.ready = true;
    return true;
}

static void RoundedHdcGdipShutdown()
{
    std::unique_lock<std::shared_mutex> lock(g_roundedHdcGdipMutex);
    if (g_roundedHdcGdip.token) {
        Gdiplus::GdiplusShutdown(g_roundedHdcGdip.token);
        g_roundedHdcGdip.token = 0;
    }
    g_roundedHdcGdip.ready = false;
    g_roundedHdcGdip.startupAttempted = false;
}

static bool RoundedHdcAddPath(Gdiplus::GraphicsPath& path,
    const Gdiplus::RectF& bounds, float radius,
    bool roundTopLeft = true, bool roundTopRight = true,
    bool roundBottomRight = true, bool roundBottomLeft = true)
{
    radius = std::min(radius, std::min(bounds.Width, bounds.Height) * 0.5f);
    if (radius <= 0.0f ||
        !(roundTopLeft || roundTopRight || roundBottomRight || roundBottomLeft)) {
        path.AddRectangle(bounds);
        return path.GetLastStatus() == Gdiplus::Ok;
    }

    const float left = bounds.X, top = bounds.Y;
    const float right = bounds.GetRight(), bottom = bounds.GetBottom();
    const float tl = roundTopLeft ? radius : 0.0f;
    const float tr = roundTopRight ? radius : 0.0f;
    const float br = roundBottomRight ? radius : 0.0f;
    const float bl = roundBottomLeft ? radius : 0.0f;

    path.AddLine(left + tl, top, right - tr, top);
    if (tr > 0.0f)
        path.AddArc(right - tr * 2, top, tr * 2, tr * 2, 270.0f, 90.0f);

    path.AddLine(right, top + tr, right, bottom - br);
    if (br > 0.0f)
        path.AddArc(right - br * 2, bottom - br * 2, br * 2, br * 2, 0.0f, 90.0f);

    path.AddLine(right - br, bottom, left + bl, bottom);
    if (bl > 0.0f)
        path.AddArc(left, bottom - bl * 2, bl * 2, bl * 2, 90.0f, 90.0f);

    path.AddLine(left, bottom - bl, left, top + tl);
    if (tl > 0.0f)
        path.AddArc(left, top, tl * 2, tl * 2, 180.0f, 90.0f);

    path.CloseFigure();
    return path.GetLastStatus() == Gdiplus::Ok;
}

static bool PaintUnextendedRoundedTabPane(HDC hdc, const RECT& rect,
    COLORREF paneColor)
{
    const int width = rect.right - rect.left;
    const int height = rect.bottom - rect.top;
    if (!hdc || width <= 0 || height <= 0)
        return false;

    RoundedHdcGdipDrawLock gdipLock;
    if (!gdipLock)
        return false;

    const Gdiplus::RectF bounds(
        (float)rect.left, (float)rect.top, (float)width, (float)height);

    Gdiplus::GraphicsPath path;
    if (!RoundedHdcAddPath(path, bounds, TabWinUiCornerRadius(hdc)))
        return false;

    Gdiplus::SolidBrush brush(Gdiplus::Color(
        255, GetRValue(paneColor), GetGValue(paneColor), GetBValue(paneColor)));
    if (brush.GetLastStatus() != Gdiplus::Ok)
        return false;

    // Paint only the rounded geometry. The untouched corner pixels keep the
    // parent/control background without sampling an unready or custom color.
    Gdiplus::Graphics graphics(hdc);
    if (graphics.GetLastStatus() != Gdiplus::Ok ||
        graphics.SetSmoothingMode(Gdiplus::SmoothingModeAntiAlias) != Gdiplus::Ok ||
        graphics.SetPixelOffsetMode(Gdiplus::PixelOffsetModeHalf) != Gdiplus::Ok) {
        return false;
    }
    return graphics.FillPath(&brush, &path) == Gdiplus::Ok;
}

static bool PaintSpinButtonGdip(HDC hdc, const RECT& rect, COLORREF fillColor,
    bool dark, float radius, float strokeWidth,
    const RECT* controlRect = nullptr, float controlRadius = 0.0f,
    int connectedEdge = 0,
    bool roundTopLeft = true, bool roundTopRight = true,
    bool roundBottomRight = true, bool roundBottomLeft = true,
    int seamEdge = -1)
{
    const float width = (float)(rect.right - rect.left);
    const float height = (float)(rect.bottom - rect.top);
    if (!hdc || width <= 0.0f || height <= 0.0f || strokeWidth <= 0.0f)
        return false;

    RoundedHdcGdipDrawLock gdipLock;
    if (!gdipLock)
        return false;

    const float halfStroke = strokeWidth * 0.5f;
    const Gdiplus::RectF bounds(
        rect.left + halfStroke, rect.top + halfStroke,
        width - strokeWidth, height - strokeWidth);
    if (bounds.Width <= 0.0f || bounds.Height <= 0.0f)
        return false;

    Gdiplus::GraphicsPath path;
    if (!RoundedHdcAddPath(path, bounds, radius,
            roundTopLeft, roundTopRight, roundBottomRight, roundBottomLeft))
        return false;

    Gdiplus::GraphicsPath controlClipPath;
    const bool clipToControl = controlRect && connectedEdge;
    if (clipToControl) {
        const float clipInset = strokeWidth;
        float clipLeft = controlRect->left + clipInset;
        float clipRight = controlRect->right - clipInset;
        const float clipTop = controlRect->top + clipInset;
        const float clipBottom = controlRect->bottom - clipInset;
        const float clipRadius = std::max(0.5f, controlRadius - clipInset);
        if (connectedEdge < 0)
            clipLeft -= clipRadius + clipInset;
        else
            clipRight += clipRadius + clipInset;
        const Gdiplus::RectF clipBounds(
            clipLeft, clipTop, clipRight - clipLeft, clipBottom - clipTop);
        if (clipBounds.Width <= 0.0f || clipBounds.Height <= 0.0f ||
            !RoundedHdcAddPath(controlClipPath, clipBounds, clipRadius)) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    Gdiplus::SolidBrush fillBrush(Gdiplus::Color(
        255, GetRValue(fillColor), GetGValue(fillColor), GetBValue(fillColor)));
    if (fillBrush.GetLastStatus() != Gdiplus::Ok) {
        return false;
    }

    Gdiplus::Graphics graphics(hdc);
    if (graphics.GetLastStatus() != Gdiplus::Ok ||
        graphics.SetSmoothingMode(Gdiplus::SmoothingModeAntiAlias) != Gdiplus::Ok ||
        graphics.SetPixelOffsetMode(Gdiplus::PixelOffsetModeHalf) != Gdiplus::Ok) {
        return false;
    }
    if (clipToControl &&
        graphics.SetClip(
            &controlClipPath, Gdiplus::CombineModeIntersect) != Gdiplus::Ok) {
        return false;
    }
    if (clipToControl) {
        const Gdiplus::RectF fillRect(
            (float)rect.left, (float)rect.top, width, height);
        return graphics.FillRectangle(&fillBrush, fillRect) == Gdiplus::Ok;
    }

    const BYTE borderAlpha = dark ? 23 : 15;
    const Gdiplus::Color borderColor(borderAlpha,
        dark ? 255 : 0, dark ? 255 : 0, dark ? 255 : 0);
    Gdiplus::Pen borderPen(borderColor, strokeWidth);
    if (borderPen.GetLastStatus() != Gdiplus::Ok)
        return false;
    if (graphics.FillPath(&fillBrush, &path) != Gdiplus::Ok)
        return false;
    if (seamEdge < 0)
        return graphics.DrawPath(&borderPen, &path) == Gdiplus::Ok;

    float borderTop = bounds.Y, borderLeft = bounds.X;
    float borderRight = bounds.GetRight(), borderBottom = bounds.GetBottom();
    switch (seamEdge) {
        case 0: borderTop = (float)rect.top; break;
        case 1: borderRight = (float)rect.right; break;
        case 2: borderBottom = (float)rect.bottom; break;
        case 3: borderLeft = (float)rect.left; break;
    }
    const Gdiplus::RectF borderBounds(
        borderLeft, borderTop, borderRight - borderLeft, borderBottom - borderTop);
    Gdiplus::GraphicsPath borderPath;
    if (!RoundedHdcAddPath(borderPath, borderBounds, radius,
            roundTopLeft, roundTopRight, roundBottomRight, roundBottomLeft)) {
        return false;
    }
    return graphics.DrawPath(&borderPen, &borderPath) == Gdiplus::Ok;
}

static bool FillSpinBaseInsideBorder(HDC hdc, HWND spin, LPCRECT paintRect,
    COLORREF fillColor, float radius, float strokeWidth, int connectedEdge)
{
    if (!hdc || !spin || !paintRect || !FillRect_orig)
        return false;

    RECT innerRect = {};
    if (!GetClientRect(spin, &innerRect))
        return false;

    const int inset = std::max(1, (int)ceilf(strokeWidth));
    InflateRect(&innerRect, -inset, -inset);
    if (innerRect.right <= innerRect.left ||
        innerRect.bottom <= innerRect.top) {
        return false;
    }

    const int cornerRadius = std::max(
        1, (int)lroundf(std::max(0.5f, radius - inset)));
    const int diameter = cornerRadius * 2;
    if (connectedEdge < 0)
        innerRect.left -= cornerRadius + inset;
    else if (connectedEdge > 0)
        innerRect.right += cornerRadius + inset;
    HBRUSH brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(fillColor);
    if (!brush)
        return false;

    const int saved = SaveDC(hdc);
    bool filled = false;
    if (saved) {
        if (BeginPath(hdc) &&
            RoundRect(
                hdc, innerRect.left, innerRect.top,
                innerRect.right + 1, innerRect.bottom + 1,
                diameter, diameter) &&
            EndPath(hdc) &&
            SelectClipPath(hdc, RGN_AND)) {
            filled = FillRect_orig(hdc, paintRect, brush) != FALSE;
        } else {
            AbortPath(hdc);
        }
        RestoreDC(hdc, saved);
    }
    return filled;
}

static bool PaintAlignedSpinBuddyBorder(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc,
    INT iPartId, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    const bool supportedState =
        iStateId == ETS_NORMAL || iStateId == ETS_DISABLED;
    if (!g_settings.RoundedButtons || !g_d2dFactory || !hTheme || !hdc ||
        !pRect || iPartId != EP_EDITTEXT || !supportedState) {
        return false;
    }

    HWND spin = t_currentSpinPaintHwnd;
    if (!spin || !IsWindow(spin) ||
        !IsClassName(spin, L"msctls_updown32")) {
        return false;
    }

    HWND dcHwnd = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (dcHwnd && dcHwnd != spin)
        return false;

    const LONG_PTR style = GetWindowLongPtrW(spin, GWL_STYLE);
    const bool alignRight = (style & UDS_ALIGNRIGHT) != 0;
    const bool alignLeft = (style & UDS_ALIGNLEFT) != 0;
    if (alignRight == alignLeft)
        return false;

    HWND buddy = GetSpinBuddyForPaint(spin);
    if (!buddy || !IsWindow(buddy) || !IsClassName(buddy, L"Edit") ||
        GetWindowTheme(buddy) != hTheme) {
        return false;
    }

    RECT clientRect = {};
    RECT visibleRect = {};
    if (!GetClientRect(spin, &clientRect) ||
        !IntersectRect(&visibleRect, pRect, &clientRect)) {
        return false;
    }

    AtomicThemePaintBuffer paintBuffer(hdc, pRect, true);
    HDC paintDC = paintBuffer.GetDC();
    const bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    const COLORREF background = dark
        ? DarkBgForPaint(spin)
        : SampleBackground(
            hdc, pRect->left, pRect->top, COLOR_WINDOW, false);
    HBRUSH backgroundBrush = GetCachedSolidBrush(background);
    if (!backgroundBrush || !FillRect_orig ||
        !FillRect_orig(paintDC, &visibleRect, backgroundBrush)) {
        return false;
    }

    INT borderState = ETS_NORMAL;
    if (!IsWindowEnabled(spin) || !IsWindowEnabled(buddy)) {
        borderState = ETS_DISABLED;
    } else {
        HWND focus = GetFocus();
        if (focus == buddy || focus == spin) {
            borderState = ETS_SELECTED;
        } else {
            POINT cursor = {};
            RECT buddyRect = {};
            if (GetCursorPos(&cursor) && GetWindowRect(buddy, &buddyRect) &&
                PtInRect(&buddyRect, cursor)) {
                borderState = ETS_HOT;
            }
        }
    }

    const int connectedEdge = alignRight ? -1 : 1;
    if (!PaintControlBorder(
            paintDC, EP_EDITBORDER_NOSCROLL, borderState, pRect, false,
            connectedEdge)) {
        return false;
    }

    paintBuffer.Commit();
    return true;
}

// Undoes HandleThemeDraw's AeroWizard caption (below): back to DWM's default
// backdrop and a light frame. A wizard still eligible gets it again, in the
// current mode, on its next paint.
static BOOL CALLBACK AeroWizardCaptionRevertEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId() || !RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropAeroWizardCaption))
        return TRUE;
    const BOOL dark = FALSE;
    DwmSetWindowAttribute(hwnd, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE, &dark, sizeof(dark));
    const DWORD backdrop = 0; // DWMSBT_AUTO
    DwmSetWindowAttribute(hwnd, DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE, &backdrop, sizeof(backdrop));
    HwndDarkCacheInvalidate();
    RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
                 RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
    return TRUE;
}

// The Explorer InfoBar's close button (infobarstyle: a Button whose 9 rp
// content draws the tooltip close part, padded 4 rp above and below) as
// WinUI InfoBar's (InfoBar.xaml, InfoBar_themeresources.xaml): an
// AppBarButton-style square, transparent at rest, SubtleFillColorSecondary
// hovered and SubtleFillColorTertiary pressed, with ControlCornerRadius
// corners, holding the Cancel glyph (E711) at WinUI's 16 of 38 in
// TextFillColorPrimary, TextFillColorSecondary pressed. The square is the
// button's own height, so it never outgrows what the button repaints.
static bool PaintExplorerInfoBarClose(HDC hdc, INT state, LPCRECT glyphRect)
{
    const ExplorerInfoBarPaint& bar = t_explorerInfoBarPaint;
    if (!hdc || !glyphRect || bar.hdc != hdc)
        return false;
    const POINT center = {(glyphRect->left + glyphRect->right) / 2,
                          (glyphRect->top + glyphRect->bottom) / 2};
    if (!PtInRect(&bar.rect, center))
        return false;

    const float scale = static_cast<float>(DpiForPaintHdc(hdc)) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const int side = (glyphRect->bottom - glyphRect->top) +
                     2 * static_cast<int>(std::lround(4.f * scale));
    RECT button = {center.x - side / 2, center.y - side / 2,
                   center.x - side / 2 + side, center.y - side / 2 + side};
    if (!IntersectRect(&button, &button, &bar.rect))
        return true;

    const bool dark = bar.dark;
    const bool pressed = state == TTCS_PRESSED;
    if (pressed || state == TTCS_HOT) {
        const COLORREF fill = WinUI::FlattenOver(pressed
            ? WinUI::SubtleFillColorTertiary(dark)
            : WinUI::SubtleFillColorSecondary(dark), bar.background);
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* rt = nullptr;
        if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &button, g_d2dFactory, &rt)) && rt) {
            const float radius = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale;
            const D2D1_COLOR_F color = {GetRValue(fill) / 255.f, GetGValue(fill) / 255.f,
                                        GetBValue(fill) / 255.f, 1.f};
            rt->BeginDraw();
            if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, color)) {
                rt->FillRoundedRectangle(D2D1::RoundedRect(D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f,
                    static_cast<float>(button.right - button.left),
                    static_cast<float>(button.bottom - button.top)), radius, radius), brush);
            }
            if (rt->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET)
                CachedTlsRTRecreate();
            rt->Release();
        }
    }
    const COLORREF glyph = WinUI::FlattenOver(pressed
        ? WinUI::TextFillColorSecondary(dark)
        : WinUI::TextFillColorPrimary(dark), bar.background);
    const int glyphSize = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(std::lround(side * 16.f / 38.f)));
    DrawGlyphDW(hdc, button, glyph, L"\uE711", glyphSize);
    return true;
}

static bool HandleThemeDraw(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, INT iPartId, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!pRect) return false;
    // Reset accent button flag — prevents leak from a previous PaintPushButton
    // call affecting unrelated controls (tabs, lists) on the same thread.
    g_tlsIsAccentButton = false;
    g_tlsButtonDark = false;
    g_tlsButtonTextColor = CLR_INVALID;
    EnsureD2DFactory();

    const std::wstring& cls = GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme);
    if (cls.find(L"Edit") != std::wstring::npos &&
        PaintAlignedSpinBuddyBorder(
            hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect)) {
        return true;
    }
    TrackShellDuiListItemForCheckbox(hdc, cls, iPartId, iStateId, pRect);

    if (cls == L"Header" &&
        PaintExplorerMicaHeader(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect)) {
        return true;
    }

    if (cls == L"ShellStatusBarSeparator" && iPartId == 1 &&
        PaintExplorerMicaStatusBarSeparator(hTheme, hdc, pRect)) {
        return true;
    }

    if (g_settings.ModernSeparators &&
        (cls == L"Status" || cls == L"DarkMode_DarkTheme::Status") &&
        PaintStatusBarThemePart(hdc, iPartId, pRect)) {
        return true;
    }

    if (g_settings.AccentColorize && cls == L"Header" &&
        iPartId == HP_HEADERITEM && PaintRoundedHeaderItem(hdc, iStateId, pRect))
    {
        return true;
    }

    // The legacy rebar search box's magnifying-glass icon is theme class
    // "SearchBox" part 3, a fixed 22x22 icon-sized part within the search
    // box's part-1 background. This is a cosmetic modernization (like the
    // travel-band buttons), not a dark-mode-only fix, so it runs in both
    // themes whenever legacy rebar controls are modernized -- color picked
    // per-window rather than hardcoded white, since light mode needs a dark
    // glyph. Falls back to the native draw if no icon font is installed.
    if (g_settings.LegacyRebarControls && cls == L"SearchBox" && iPartId == 3) {
        int w = pRect->right - pRect->left, h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
        if (w > 0 && h > 0) {
            int fontSize = std::max(8, (int)(std::min(w, h) * 0.82f + 0.5f));
            HWND searchCtxHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
            COLORREF glyphClr = IsDarkForExcludedAwarePaint(searchCtxHwnd) ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(25, 26, 26);
            if (DrawGlyphDW(hdc, *pRect, glyphClr, kSearchIconGlyph, fontSize))
                return true;
        }
    }

    // AeroWizard back button ("Navigation" class, part=1) paints a hardcoded
    // solid-black glyph regardless of theme, invisible against a dark
    // caption. PaintExplorerNavigationButton doesn't apply (it requires
    // IsExplorerShellHost). Substitute our own icon-font glyph instead.
    if (g_darkModeActive && cls == L"Navigation" && iPartId == 1) {
        HWND navRoot = GetAncestor(WindowFromDC(hdc), GA_ROOT);
        if (navRoot && GetPropW(navRoot, kPropAeroWizardCaption)) {
            int w = pRect->right - pRect->left, h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
            if (w > 0 && h > 0) {
                int fontSize = std::max(8, (int)(std::min(w, h) * 0.38f + 0.5f));
                if (DrawGlyphDW(hdc, *pRect, RGB(255, 255, 255), GLYPH_NAV_BACK, fontSize))
                    return true;
            }
        }
    }

    // AeroWizard title bar: the top <44px strip is DWM's own non-client
    // caption, never drawn via uxtheme, so give it a Mica backdrop applied
    // once per window. AllowDarkModeForWindow stays off here -- it changes
    // uxtheme's internal rendering branch and broke this legacy control's
    // own text rendering; DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE is unrelated and
    // only controls Mica's tint. No SWP_FRAMECHANGED -- it forces
    // WM_NCCALCSIZE, which conflicts with this control's own NC layout.
    // Always applied in dark mode (a light caption on a dark wizard body
    // looks broken); in light mode it's purely cosmetic, so it rides on
    // RoundedButtons instead of getting its own dedicated setting.
    if (cls == L"AeroWizard" && (g_darkModeActive || g_settings.RoundedButtons) &&
        !g_darkModeUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        HWND root = GetAncestor(WindowFromDC(hdc), GA_ROOT);
        if (root && !GetPropW(root, kPropAeroWizardCaption)) {
            if (g_darkModeActive) {
                if (g_cbdAllowDark) g_cbdAllowDark(root, false);
                RemovePropW(root, L"UseImmersiveDarkModeColors");
            }

            BOOL micaDark = g_darkModeActive ? TRUE : FALSE;
            DwmSetWindowAttribute(root, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE, &micaDark, sizeof(micaDark));
            COLORREF defColor = DWMWA_COLOR_DEFAULT;
            DwmSetWindowAttribute(root, DWMWA_CAPTION_COLOR, &defColor, sizeof(defColor));
            int backdrop = 2 /*DWMSBT_MAINWINDOW*/;
            DwmSetWindowAttribute(root, DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE, &backdrop, sizeof(backdrop));

            SetPropW(root, kPropAeroWizardCaption, (HANDLE)1);
            HwndDarkCacheInvalidate();
        }
    }

    if (cls == L"Menu" &&
        SuppressTravelBandRecentMenuHover(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect))
        return true;

    // MENU_POPUPSEPARATOR (part 15) in a Dropdown/ViewControlClass popup is
    // rendered by uxtheme's own internal DarkMode_Explorer path, bypassing
    // GetThemeColor/FillRect -- stays native near-white in dark mode.
    // Independent of ModernContextMenus. Replace with our own dark fill +
    // centered line (RGB(0x40,0x40,0x40)).
    if (g_darkModeActive && cls == L"Menu" && iPartId == 15 /*MENU_POPUPSEPARATOR*/) {
        HWND _hSep = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
        if (!_hSep) _hSep = WindowFromDC(hdc);
        if (IsLegacyShellDropdownRoot(_hSep)) {
            if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(Win32MainDark))
                FillRect(hdc, pRect, br);
            int yMid = pRect->top + (pRect->bottom - pRect->top) / 2;
            if (HPEN linePen = CreatePen(PS_SOLID, 1, RGB(0x40, 0x40, 0x40))) {
                HPEN oldPen = (HPEN)SelectObject(hdc, linePen);
                MoveToEx(hdc, pRect->left, yMid, nullptr);
                LineTo(hdc, pRect->right, yMid);
                SelectObject(hdc, oldPen);
                DeleteObject(linePen);
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    // ── Acrylic context menus: fill Menu theme popup parts ────────────────
    // On a popup whose surface this mod owns, every Menu theme part the OS
    // would normally paint with the popup background goes through
    // FillAcrylicMenuTransparentRect(). With system transparency enabled,
    // black pixels reveal the DWM backdrop; with transparency disabled, the
    // same path falls back to an opaque shade of the surface color.
    //
    // Part IDs (from vsstyle.h Menu class):
    //   MENU_POPUPBACKGROUND  = 9
    //   MENU_POPUPBORDERS     = 10
    //   MENU_POPUPCHECK       = 11  (kept themed -- the glyph carries alpha)
    //   MENU_POPUPCHECKBACKGROUND = 12  (suppressed, see below)
    //   MENU_POPUPGUTTER      = 13
    //   MENU_POPUPITEM        = 14
    //   MENU_POPUPSEPARATOR   = 15  (kept themed — the separator is meant to be visible)
    //   MENU_BARBACKGROUND    = 7
    //   MENU_BARITEM          = 8
    //   Part 27 is an undocumented popup-item variant used by some shells.
    if (g_settings.ModernContextMenus && cls == L"Menu")
    {
        const bool dark          = g_darkModeActive;
        const bool isPopupBg     = (iPartId == 9 || iPartId == 10 || iPartId == 13);
        const bool isPopupItem   = (iPartId == 14 || iPartId == 27);
        const bool isPopupSep    = (iPartId == 15);
        const bool isBarBg       = (iPartId == 7);
        const bool isBarItem     = (iPartId == 8);
        const bool itemIsHot     = (isPopupItem && iStateId == 2);

        // Legacy Explorer dropdowns are menu-themed, but the visible items are
        // painted by their SysListView32 child. Intercepting Menu item parts
        // here can suppress the first item paint, leaving an empty dropdown
        // until hover invalidates a row. Let the theme pass through and darken
        // the ListView child at creation time instead.
        HWND popup = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
        if (!popup) popup = WindowFromDC(hdc);
        if (IsLegacyShellDropdownRoot(popup)) {
            if (itemIsHot) {
                return PaintLegacyShellDropdownHover(hdc, pRect, popup);
            }
            return false;
        }

        // ── Menu BAR parts ───────────────────────────────────────────────
        // Only intercept in dark mode (for custom bg) or for hot items
        // (for D2D hover overlay). In light mode with no dark, let the
        // system handle normal bar rendering completely.
        if (dark && isBarBg) {
            if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(Win32MainDark))
                FillRect(hdc, pRect, br);
            return true;
        }
        if (isBarItem) {
            bool barHot = (iStateId == 2 || iStateId == 3 || iStateId == 5);
            if (dark) {
                // Dark mode: fill with dark bg + D2D hover
                if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(Win32MainDark))
                    FillRect(hdc, pRect, br);
            }
            if (barHot && g_d2dFactory) {
                // D2D hover overlay (works in both modes)
                if (!dark) {
                    // Light mode: suppress the native full-rect hover, then
                    // paint only our smaller rounded hover below.
                    if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(GetSysColor(COLOR_MENUBAR)))
                        FillRect(hdc, pRect, br);
                }
                int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
                int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
                if (w > 0 && h > 0) {
                    float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / (float)USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
                    float cr = ModernizerCornerRadius * scale;
                    float inset = 2.f * scale;
                    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
                    if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT))) {
                        // Same MenuBarItemBackground tokens as the UAH path.
                        const D2D1_COLOR_F hc = WinUiColorF((iStateId == 3 || iStateId == 5)
                            ? WinUI::SubtleFillColorTertiary(dark)
                            : WinUI::SubtleFillColorSecondary(dark));
                        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* hb = GetMenuHoverBrush(pRT.Get(), hc)) {
                            pRT->BeginDraw();
                            pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                                D2D1::RoundedRect(
                                    D2D1::RectF(inset, inset, (float)w - inset, (float)h - inset),
                                    cr, cr),
                                hb);
                            if (pRT->EndDraw() == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                                pRT.Reset();
                                CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                return true;
            }
            if (dark) return true;
            // Light mode, not hot: fall through to original
        }

        // ── Owned surface: full acrylic popup rendering ──────────────────
        if (MenuSurfaceIsOwned(MenuPopupBeingPainted(hdc),
                               /*answerWhenUnnamed=*/dark)) {
            // MENU_POPUPCHECKBACKGROUND is a solid plate behind the check
            // glyph, and it fills its whole rect opaque (measured). Filling
            // it transparent instead would punch through the hover it is
            // drawn over, so it is suppressed and whatever is already there
            // survives -- which is also what a WinUI menu shows: the glyph
            // alone, no plate.
            if (iPartId == 12 /*MENU_POPUPCHECKBACKGROUND*/)
                return true;

            if ((isPopupBg || (isPopupItem && !itemIsHot))) {
                FillAcrylicMenuTransparentRect(hdc, pRect);
                return true;
            }
            if (itemIsHot) {
                const int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
                const int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
                if (w > 0 && h > 0) {
                    // GDI+ rather than Direct2D, because this sits in the gap
                    // between erasing the item and the text landing on it: a
                    // DC render target's BindDC/EndDraw was measured at 709us
                    // against 5.8us for the same capsule in GDI+, and the
                    // whole gap is what the compositor can catch mid-way and
                    // show as a blink. Same swap the insertion mark took.
                    FillAcrylicMenuTransparentRect(hdc, pRect);
                    const float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) /
                                        (float)USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
                    const float cr = g_settings.MenuHoverRadius * scale;
                    const float inset = 1.f * scale;
                    const Gdiplus::Color pill = GdipColor(MenuItemHoverFill(dark));
                    PaintAlphaSceneGdip(hdc, pRect,
                        [&](Gdiplus::Graphics& graphics) {
                            Gdiplus::GraphicsPath path;
                            if (RoundedHdcAddPath(path,
                                    Gdiplus::RectF(inset, 0.f,
                                        (float)w - 2.f * inset,
                                        (float)h),
                                    cr, true, true, true, true)) {
                                Gdiplus::SolidBrush brush(pill);
                                graphics.FillPath(&brush, &path);
                            }
                        });
                }
                return true;
            }
            if (isPopupSep) {
                FillAcrylicMenuTransparentRect(hdc, pRect);
                int cy = (pRect->top + pRect->bottom) / 2;
                // WinUI's flyout divider spans its whole available row. This
                // theme-part rect can itself be inset, so prefer the tracked
                // popup's complete client width. File pickers often render it
                // through a buffered DC for which WindowFromDC isn't #32768;
                // DPtoLP still maps the client pixel edges into that DC. The
                // DWM-owned frame remains outside the client area.
                RECT lineRc = {pRect->left, cy, pRect->right, cy + 1};
                HWND popup = MenuPopupBeingPainted(hdc);
                if (popup) {
                    RECT client = {};
                    if (GetClientRect(popup, &client)) {
                        POINT edges[] = {
                            {client.left, 0},
                            {client.right, 0},
                        };
                        if (DPtoLP(hdc, edges, ARRAYSIZE(edges))) {
                            lineRc.left = edges[0].x;
                            lineRc.right = edges[1].x;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (lineRc.right <= lineRc.left)
                    return true;
                // DividerStrokeColorDefault, written premultiplied rather
                // than filled: over the acrylic region a GDI fill lands
                // ADDED to the material instead of replacing it, so an
                // opaque line reads far heavier than the shell's own. Same
                // treatment the winver separator gets over Mica, and the
                // same token -- only the composition differs.
                const WinUI::Color stroke = WinUI::DividerStrokeColorDefault(dark);
                const DWORD a = stroke.alpha;
                const DWORD premultiplied = (a << 24) |
                    ((GetRValue(stroke.rgb) * a / 255) << 16) |
                    ((GetGValue(stroke.rgb) * a / 255) << 8) |
                    (GetBValue(stroke.rgb) * a / 255);
                if (MenuUseTransparentBackdrop())
                    WriteExplorerMicaPixels(hdc, lineRc, premultiplied);
                else
                    BlendPremultipliedPixels(hdc, lineRc, premultiplied);
                return true;
            }
        }

        // ── Light popups this mod does not own ──────────────────────────
        // System transparency is off, or the popup is genuinely application-
        // drawn: the system draws backgrounds, separators and normal items,
        // and only HOT items are intercepted to carry the rounded hover.
        if (!dark && itemIsHot && g_d2dFactory) {
            int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
            int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
            if (w > 0 && h > 0) {
                // Cover the item with the surface color rather than letting
                // the native full-rect highlight through: the overlay below
                // can only darken what is already there, so the hover would
                // sit on top of the system's highlight instead of replacing
                // it, and never reach the shade the shell's own menus show.
                if (HBRUSH surface = GetCachedSolidBrush(
                        WinUiFloatingSurfaceColor(/*dark=*/false))) {
                    FillRect(hdc, pRect, surface);
                }
                // Then overlay with a subtle D2D rounded rect
                float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / (float)USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
                float cr = g_settings.MenuHoverRadius * scale;
                float inset = 1.f * scale;
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
                if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT))) {
                    if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetMenuHoverBrush(
                            pRT.Get(), MenuItemHoverFill(/*dark=*/false))) {
                        pRT->BeginDraw();
                        pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                            D2D1::RoundedRect(
                                D2D1::RectF(inset, 0.f,
                                    (float)w - inset, (float)h),
                                cr, cr),
                            brush);
                        if (pRT->EndDraw() == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                            pRT.Reset();
                            CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    // DragDrop overlay — crisp anti-aliased rounded rectangles at exact draw size
    if (ShouldModernizeDragDrop() && cls == L"DragDrop") {
        if (iPartId == kDragDropImageBgPart)
            return PaintDragDrop(hdc, pRect);
        if (iPartId == kDragDropTextBgPart)
            return PaintDragDropTextBg(hdc, pRect);
        // DD_COPY/MOVE/UPDATEMETADATA/CREATELINK/WARNING/NONE (parts 1-6):
        // fully own these parts instead of drawing over the theme's own
        // bitmap afterward -- D2D's DrawTextW only composites the glyph's
        // own pixels, so the native icon drawn underneath would still show
        // through around/behind it.
        if (DragDropHandleBadgeIcon(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect))
            return true;
    }

    if (cls == L"Tooltip" && iPartId == TTP_CLOSE &&
        PaintExplorerInfoBarClose(hdc, iStateId, pRect))
        return true;

    // A successfully applied SWCA backdrop uses black as its composition
    // surface. Otherwise retain the opaque light/dark fallback.
    if (g_settings.ModernTooltips && cls == L"Tooltip"
        && (iPartId == TTP_STANDARD || iPartId == TTP_BALLOON)) {
        HWND hTT = WindowFromDC(hdc);
        if (!hTT) hTT = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
        HWND owner = hTT ? GetWindow(hTT, GW_OWNER) : nullptr;
        const bool dark = owner ? IsHwndDarkMode(owner) : IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
        UINT_PTR acrylicTint = hTT
            ? reinterpret_cast<UINT_PTR>(GetPropW(hTT, kTooltipAcrylicActiveProp)) : 0;
        // The tint is chosen when the tooltip is created, which can be before
        // its owner turns dark (a tree view creates its tooltip inside the
        // main window's WM_CREATE), so it's reconciled with the owner here.
        if (acrylicTint && owner && (acrylicTint == 2) != dark) {
            TooltipApplyAcrylicEffects(hTT, owner, false);
            acrylicTint = reinterpret_cast<UINT_PTR>(GetPropW(hTT, kTooltipAcrylicActiveProp));
        }
        const bool acrylicActive = acrylicTint != 0;
        const COLORREF bg = acrylicActive
            ? RGB(0x00, 0x00, 0x00)
            : WinUiFloatingSurfaceColor(dark);
        if (HBRUSH hBr = GetCachedSolidBrush(bg))
            FillRect(hdc, pRect, hBr);
        return true;
    }

    // Rounded push buttons — D2D anti-aliased with accent fill for IDOK/IDYES
    if (g_settings.RoundedButtons && cls == L"Button" && iPartId == BP_PUSHBUTTON)
        return PaintPushButton(hdc, iStateId, pRect);

    // Command link buttons — rounded bg like push buttons
    if (g_settings.RoundedButtons && cls == L"Button" &&
        (iPartId == BP_COMMANDLINK || iPartId == 7 /*BP_COMMANDLINKGLYPH*/)) {
        if (iPartId == 7) return true; // suppress glyph (system draws arrow separately)
        int w = pRect->right - pRect->left, h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
        if (w > 0 && h > 0) {
            bool dark = IsDarkForExcludedAwarePaintHdc(hdc);
            float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.f;
            bool isHot = (iStateId == 2 /*HOT*/);
            bool isPressed = (iStateId == 3 /*PRESSED*/);
            bool isDefault = (iStateId == 5 /*DEFAULTED*/);
