            // Subtle tint over the parent, kept opaque.
            const float tint = (isDefault || isHot) ? (dark ? 0.08f : 0.04f)
                             : isPressed            ? (dark ? 0.04f : 0.02f)
                                                    : (dark ? 0.035f : 0.02f);
            HWND hBtn = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
            const COLORREF fill = BlendOverColor(
                ButtonParentBackground(hBtn, hdc, dark),
                dark ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0), tint);
            ButtonBorder border = {};
            border.ring = dark ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.06f)
                               : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.04f);
            PaintRoundedButtonGdip(hdc, *pRect, scale, WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale,
                ButtonFillFadeStep(hBtn, fill), border, dark, false, nullptr, nullptr);
            return true;
        }
    }

    // ListBox border — accent on focus, neutral otherwise. Part of the
    // EditFocusLine control borders; in dark mode also without it, since the
    // native border and fill stay light.
    if ((cls == L"Listbox" || cls == L"ListBox") &&
        (g_settings.EditFocusLine || IsWindowDarkMode(hdc))) {
        if (iPartId == 0 /*COMMONPROPS*/) {
            bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
            if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(
                    dark ? RGB(0x2E, 0x2E, 0x2E) : GetSysColor(COLOR_WINDOW)))
                FillRect(hdc, pRect, br);
            return true;
        }
        if (iPartId == 1 /*LBCP_BORDER_NOSCROLL or similar*/) {
            int w = pRect->right - pRect->left, h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
            if (w > 0 && h > 0 && g_d2dFactory) {
                bool dark = IsDarkForExcludedAwarePaintHdc(hdc);
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
                if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
                {
                    float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.f;
                    float fw = (float)w, fh = (float)h, cr = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale;
                    // Fill bg
                    D2D1_COLOR_F bgFill = dark
                        ? D2D1::ColorF(0.18f, 0.18f, 0.18f)
                        : D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f);
                    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> br;
                    pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(bgFill, &br);
                    pRT->BeginDraw();
                    pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                        D2D1::RoundedRect(D2D1::RectF(0, 0, fw, fh), cr, cr), br.Get());
                    // Border: accent on hot/focused
                    D2D1_COLOR_F borderClr;
                    if (iStateId == 2 /*HOT*/ || iStateId == 3 /*FOCUSED*/) {
                        COLORREF ac = GetAccentIndicator();
                        borderClr = D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(ac)/255.f, GetGValue(ac)/255.f,
                                                  GetBValue(ac)/255.f);
                    } else {
                        borderClr = dark ? D2D1::ColorF(0.4f, 0.4f, 0.4f)
                                         : D2D1::ColorF(0.6f, 0.6f, 0.6f);
                    }
                    br->SetColor(borderClr);
                    pRT->DrawRoundedRectangle(
                        D2D1::RoundedRect(D2D1::RectF(0.5f, 0.5f, fw-0.5f, fh-0.5f), cr, cr),
                        br.Get(), 1.f);
                    if (pRT->EndDraw() == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                        pRT.Reset();
                        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                    }
                }
                return true;
            }
        }
    }

    // CommandModule buttons — rounded hover/pressed for Explorer command bar
    if (g_settings.ExplorerSection && cls == L"CommandModule") {
        // Part 6: DirectUI command/dropdown chevron nested inside part 3
        // (Organize) or part 5 (the split-button pair's dropdown zone) —
        // confirmed via a discovery mod, same 13x10 glyph rect in both
        // cases. Part 8: same glyph, Control Panel "View by".
        if (iPartId == 6 || iPartId == 8)
            return DrawCommandModuleChevronGlyph(hdc, pRect, /*useAccent=*/iPartId == 8);

        // Part 3: task button (Organize, New folder)
        // Parts 4/5: split button pair
        // Part 9: location button
        bool isModBtn = (iPartId == 3 || iPartId == 4 || iPartId == 5 || iPartId == 9);
        if (isModBtn) {
            // State 1 (NORMAL), 6 (DISABLED): suppress → transparent bg
            if (iStateId == 1 || iStateId == 6) return true;
            int w = pRect->right - pRect->left, h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
            if (w > 0 && h > 0 && g_d2dFactory) {
                bool dark = IsDarkForExcludedAwarePaintHdc(hdc);
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
                if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
                {
                    float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.f;
                    float fw = (float)w, fh = (float)h, cr = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale;
                    bool isPressed = (iStateId == 3 /*PRESSED*/);
                    float alpha = isPressed ? (dark ? 0.04f : 0.03f) : (dark ? 0.08f : 0.06f);
                    D2D1_COLOR_F fill = dark
                        ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, alpha)
                        : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, alpha);
                    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> br;
                    pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(fill, &br);
                    pRT->BeginDraw();
                    pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                        D2D1::RoundedRect(D2D1::RectF(0, 0, fw, fh), cr, cr), br.Get());
                    if (pRT->EndDraw() == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                        pRT.Reset();
                        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                    }
                }
                return true;
            }
        }
    }

    // TABP_PANE (9) / TABP_BODY (10) — tab content area background
    if (cls == L"Tab" && (iPartId == 9 || iPartId == 10)) {
        // Not widened here: this hdc belongs to the tab control itself, and
        // a child window's DC is clipped to its own bounds regardless of
        // what rect we hand FillRect. Reaching the real dialog edges needs
        // an unclipped DC, so that's drawn separately from the root
        // dialog's own WM_ERASEBKGND (PropertyDialogSubclassProc/
        // PropertySheetLightPaneSubclassProc), which only happens in a real
        // property-sheet root dialog -- elsewhere there's no matching
        // root-level fill to clear into, so the GDI+ fallback preserves the
        // real pixels already present around the rounded geometry.
        //
        // All 4 corners rounded, no border. Confirmed property-sheet roots
        // use D2D with TabPaneCornerColor(...); other contexts use GDI+ and
        // leave the corner pixels untouched. Runs in both themes, gated on
        // IsWinUiTabStyleActive like PaintTab.
        if (IsWinUiTabStyleActive()) {
            if (SysHighContrastEnabled())
                return false;

            const bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
            RECT rcExp = *pRect;
            // GetExtendedTabPaneRect mirrors this one-pixel extension after
            // caching the real TABP_PANE top supplied here.
            const float paneScale = DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.f;
            rcExp.top -= (LONG)lroundf(1.f * paneScale);

            COLORREF pane = ElevatedPaneColor(dark);
            HWND tabHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
            bool drewRounded = false;
            const bool cornerColorConfirmed =
                TabPaneCornerColorConfirmed(tabHwnd, dark);
            if (iPartId == TABP_PANE && cornerColorConfirmed)
                CacheMeasuredTabPaneTop(tabHwnd, pRect->top);
            // Property-sheet roots have a known matching surround, so keep
            // their existing D2D clear-and-fill path. Elsewhere GDI+ fills
            // only the rounded geometry and preserves the real corner
            // pixels, avoiding both sampling and a guessed clear color.
            if (g_d2dFactory && cornerColorConfirmed) {
                COLORREF corner = TabPaneCornerColor(dark);
                ID2D1DCRenderTarget* rawRT = nullptr;
                if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcExp, g_d2dFactory, &rawRT)) && rawRT) {
                    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
                    pRT.Attach(rawRT);
                    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> br;
                    D2D1_COLOR_F paneColor = D2D1::ColorF(
                        GetRValue(pane) / 255.f, GetGValue(pane) / 255.f, GetBValue(pane) / 255.f);
                    if (SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(paneColor, &br)) && br) {
                        FLOAT w = (FLOAT)(rcExp.right - rcExp.left);
                        FLOAT h = (FLOAT)(rcExp.bottom - rcExp.top);
                        FLOAT cr = TabWinUiCornerRadius(hdc);
                        pRT->BeginDraw();
                        pRT->Clear(D2D1::ColorF(
                            GetRValue(corner) / 255.f, GetGValue(corner) / 255.f, GetBValue(corner) / 255.f));
                        pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                            D2D1::RoundedRect(D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f, w, h), cr, cr), br.Get());
                        HRESULT endHr = pRT->EndDraw();
                        drewRounded = SUCCEEDED(endHr);
                        if (endHr == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                            pRT.Reset();
                            CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!drewRounded && !cornerColorConfirmed)
                drewRounded = PaintUnextendedRoundedTabPane(hdc, rcExp, pane);
            if (!drewRounded) {
                // Native-compatible fallback if either rendering path fails.
                if (HBRUSH hBr = GetCachedSolidBrush(pane))
                    FillRect(hdc, &rcExp, hBr);
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    // Modern GroupBox — replace 3D border with subtle rounded border
    // BP_GROUPBOX = 4; border-only (no fill) to avoid background mismatch
    // with child controls that paint with the dialog's background color.
    if (g_settings.ModernSeparators && cls == L"Button" && iPartId == BP_GROUPBOX) {
        if (!g_d2dFactory) return false;
        const int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
        const int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return false;

        const bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
        // Per-window DPI (not cached g_Dpi) for multi-monitor support
        HWND hw = WindowFromDC(hdc);
        const float scale = hw ? (float)GetDpiForWindow(hw) / 96.f : (float)g_Dpi / 96.f;
        const float cr = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale;

        D2D1_COLOR_F borderClr = dark
            ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.08f)
            : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.08f);

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
        FPUGuard fpu;
        if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
            return false;

        // Draw from (0.5, 0.5) — no topOff. The system's clip rect (pClipRect
        // in DrawThemeBackground) already excludes the label area. Starting
        // from the full rect avoids a "box looks smaller" bug.
        const float fW = (float)w, fH = (float)h;
        D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT rr = D2D1::RoundedRect(
            D2D1::RectF(0.5f, 0.5f, fW - 0.5f, fH - 0.5f), cr, cr);

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
        if (FAILED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(borderClr, &brush))) return false;

        pRT->BeginDraw();
        pRT->DrawRoundedRectangle(&rr, brush.Get(), scale);
        HRESULT hr = pRT->EndDraw();
        if (hr == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
            pRT.Reset();
            CachedTlsRTRecreate();
            return false;
        }
        return SUCCEEDED(hr);
    }

    // Rounded control borders (Edit, ListBox, ListView) — D2D with focus accent
    // Edit: EP_EDITBORDER_NOSCROLL=6..9; ListBox: LBCP_BORDER_*=1..4
    if (g_settings.EditFocusLine) {
        if ((cls == L"Edit" || cls.find(L"Edit") != std::wstring::npos)
            && iPartId >= 6 && iPartId <= 9 &&
            !IsInsideExcludedFilePicker(g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc)))
            return PaintControlBorder(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect);

        if (cls == L"ListBox" && iPartId >= 1 && iPartId <= 4)
            return PaintControlBorder(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect);

        if (cls == L"ListView" && iPartId == 0 && iStateId == 0)
            return PaintControlBorder(hdc, iPartId, 1 /*normal*/, pRect);
    }

    if (cls == L"ComboBox") {
        if (SanitizeExplorerAddressCombo(hdc, iPartId, pRect))
            return true;
        if (PaintExplorerAddressDropDownArrow(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect, true))
            return true;
    }

    if (cls == L"Edit" && PaintExplorerAddressEdit(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect))
        return true;

    if (cls == L"Combobox" &&
        PaintExplorerAddressDropDownArrow(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect, false))
        return true;

    // ComboBox — not gated by EditFocusLine (gating it there made the
    // dropdown button lose dark mode and client-edge rounding whenever
    // EditFocusLine was toggled off). WinUI 3 style: dark bg fill, rounded
    // border, Fluent chevron. Always active in dark mode for the same
    // reason (native chrome has no dark colors of its own); in light mode
    // it's purely cosmetic, so it respects RoundedButtons.
    if (cls == L"Combobox" &&
        (IsWindowDarkMode(hdc) || g_settings.RoundedButtons) &&
        !IsInsideExcludedFilePicker(g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc))) {
            bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
            int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
            int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
            if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return false;

            // CP_BORDER=4, CP_READONLY=5 — full push-button chrome.
            if (iPartId == 4 || iPartId == 5) {
                const bool disabled = (iStateId == 4);
                const bool hot = (iStateId == 2);
                const bool pressed = (iPartId == 5 && iStateId == 3);
                // CBB_FOCUSED: same numeric state as CP_READONLY's CBRO_PRESSED
                // but only meaningful on CP_BORDER (editable combo).
                const bool focused = (iPartId == 4 && iStateId == 3) &&
                    NavFocusCuesVisible(ResolveComboBoxAnimationHwnd(hdc));
                const INT buttonState = disabled ? PBS_DISABLED :
                    pressed ? PBS_PRESSED : hot ? PBS_HOT : PBS_NORMAL;
                SyncComboEditButtonState(hdc, buttonState);
                const float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.f;
                const float cr = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale;

                HWND combo = ResolveComboBoxAnimationHwnd(hdc);
                const COLORREF fill = WinUiControlFillColor(dark, buttonState,
                    ButtonParentBackground(combo, hdc, dark));
                PaintRoundedButtonGdip(hdc, *pRect, scale, cr, fill,
                    WinUiControlBorder(dark, buttonState), dark,
                    focused && g_settings.ModernFocusRect == 0, nullptr, nullptr);
                return true;
            }

            // CP_DROPDOWNBUTTON=1, CP_DROPDOWNBUTTONRIGHT=6 — Fluent chevron
            if (iPartId == 1 || iPartId == 6) {
                const bool disabled = (iStateId == 4);
                const bool pressed = (iStateId == 3);
                const bool hot = (iStateId == 2);
                const INT buttonState = disabled ? PBS_DISABLED :
                    pressed ? PBS_PRESSED : hot ? PBS_HOT : PBS_NORMAL;
                const FLOAT scale = (FLOAT)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.f;

                HWND combo = ResolveComboBoxAnimationHwnd(hdc);
                const COLORREF fill = WinUiControlFillColor(dark, buttonState,
                    ButtonParentBackground(combo, hdc, dark));
                // A read-only combo is one surface in WinUI, its chrome part
                // already carries the state. The editable one has a
                // DropDownOverlay button (4px margin, 4px radius). WinUI
                // uses SubtleFillColorSecondary/Tertiary while unfocused,
                // but ControlAltFillColorQuarternary for a focused edit's
                // pressed overlay.
                const bool editable = combo &&
                    (GetWindowLongPtrW(combo, GWL_STYLE) & 3) != CBS_DROPDOWNLIST;
                if (editable && (hot || pressed)) {
                    const float margin = 4.f * scale;
                    const Gdiplus::RectF overlay(
                        pRect->left + margin, pRect->top + margin,
                        (float)(pRect->right - pRect->left) - margin * 2.f,
                        (float)(pRect->bottom - pRect->top) - margin * 2.f);
                    const bool focusedPressed =
                        pressed && IsComboBoxEditFocused(combo);
                    const BYTE a = focusedPressed ? (dark ? 0x12 : 0x18)
                        : dark ? (pressed ? 0x0A : 0x0F)
                               : (pressed ? 0x06 : 0x09);
                    FillRoundedRectGdip(hdc, overlay, WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale,
                        GdipColor(dark ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0), a));
                }

                // ComboBoxDropDownGlyphForeground: TextFillColorSecondary,
                // TextFillColorDisabled -- opaque over the fill.
                const BYTE glyphAlpha = disabled ? (dark ? 0x5D : 0x5C)
                                                 : (dark ? 0xC5 : 0x9E);
                const COLORREF chevronClr = BlendOverColor(fill,
                    dark ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0), glyphAlpha / 255.f);
                DrawAnimatedComboChevron(
                    hdc, pRect, combo,
                    ColorFAlpha(chevronClr, 1.f), fill, pressed,
                    3.5f * scale, 1.75f * scale,
                    std::max(1.f, 1.25f * scale), 0.25f * scale);
                return true;
            }
        }

    // Sizebox (corner between vertical and horizontal scrollbars) — mode aware
    // Gripper pattern on scrollbar thumb — suppress entirely (WinUI has no grip lines)
    bool explorerMicaScrollbar = false;
    bool explorerMicaPaneScrollbar = false;
    if (cls == L"ScrollBar" && ExplorerBackdropMode() &&
        IsCurrentProcessExplorer()) {
        const HWND scrollbarDcHwnd = hdc ? WindowFromDC(hdc) : nullptr;
        explorerMicaScrollbar =
            IsExplorerMicaScrollbarTheme(hTheme, scrollbarDcHwnd);
        // Content pane mode: the file list's scrollbars are real ScrollBar
        // windows under SHELLDLL_DefView and sit on the pane; the nav pane
        // tree draws its own bars and stays on the backdrop. Only the
        // subclass bracket decides (see t_paneScrollBarDepth): the tree's
        // bar paints on a memory DC outside any BeginPaint, where the stale
        // g_tlsPaintHwnd can still be a content ScrollBar.
        explorerMicaPaneScrollbar = explorerMicaScrollbar &&
            ExplorerMicaPaneMode() && t_paneScrollBarDepth > 0;
    }
    // Solid content pane: the list's own ScrollBar windows sit on the pane
    // and are written opaque over the GDI (alpha 0) background fill.
    const bool pickerSolidScrollbar = cls == L"ScrollBar" &&
        t_filePickerListScrollBarDepth > 0 && ExplorerMicaSolidPaneMode();
    auto paintSolidScrollbarBg = [&](HDC dc) {
        if ((explorerMicaPaneScrollbar || pickerSolidScrollbar) &&
            ExplorerMicaSolidPaneMode() && pRect)
            WriteExplorerMicaSolidPixels(dc, *pRect, g_darkModeActive);
    };
    // The bar's own background under a part's hover strip, arrow or thumb.
    auto paintPartBackdrop = [&](HDC dc) {
        paintSolidScrollbarBg(dc);
        if (pRect && IsCurrentProcessRegedit())
            RgPaintScrollbarHeaderBand(ScrollBarOwnerFromDc(hdc), dc, *pRect);
    };
    // The file picker's size grip sits on the chrome shade in both themes
    // (no grip glyph, as in WinUI), whatever the scrollbar settings.
    if (cls == L"ScrollBar" && iPartId == SBP_SIZEBOX && pRect &&
        FilePickerChromeRoot(ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc))) {
        if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(FilePickerControlBackground(g_darkModeActive)))
            FillRect(hdc, pRect, br);
        return true;
    }
    // The list bracket wins when both are open: selecting a tree item
    // navigates the view synchronously inside the tree's message, and the
    // list's ScrollBars then redraw from their own SBM_SETSCROLLINFO.
    bool pickerListScrollbar = cls == L"ScrollBar" &&
        t_filePickerListScrollBarDepth > 0 && FilePickerListShaded();
    bool pickerNavScrollbar = cls == L"ScrollBar" &&
        t_filePickerNavTreeDepth > 0 && t_filePickerListScrollBarDepth == 0;
    // A picker bar painted outside both brackets (the nav tree's bar paints
    // on a memory DC outside any BeginPaint) is told by its resolved window,
    // the nav pane shade the fallback, in every mode the picker is styled:
    // under Mica the generic default would add to the backdrop, and without
    // it that default is the content's color, flashing over the pane.
    if (cls == L"ScrollBar" && !pickerListScrollbar && !pickerNavScrollbar &&
        FilePickerChromeEnabled()) {
        HWND owner = ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc);
        if (FilePickerRoot(owner)) {
            const bool listWindow = IsFilePickerListWindow(owner);
            pickerListScrollbar = listWindow && FilePickerListShaded();
            pickerNavScrollbar = !listWindow;
        }
    }
    // Custom dark mode no longer forces this renderer: OpenNcThemeData_hook
    // redirects the class to Explorer::ScrollBar whenever dark mode is on,
    // so turning the option off leaves a native scrollbar that is still
    // dark -- the fixed width and grab area some apps and users want back.
    // Both picker panes, not just the nav one: the picker follows the
    // Explorer surface, and inside Explorer explorerMicaScrollbar covers
    // the file list as well. Leaving the list out left it native while
    // the tree beside it was ours.
    const bool modernScrollbar = g_settings.ModernScrollbars ||
        explorerMicaScrollbar || pickerNavScrollbar || pickerListScrollbar;
    if (cls == L"ScrollBar" && modernScrollbar) {
        // An excluded process's picker is natively dark under a dark system.
        const bool darkScrollbar =
            DarkModeActiveForPaint(ScrollBarOwnerFromDc(hdc));
        // Keep Explorer Mica and picker pane shades separate from the
        // ordinary owner background. Mica uses black in either theme.
        COLORREF ownerBg = CLR_INVALID;
        if (!pickerNavScrollbar && !pickerListScrollbar && !explorerMicaScrollbar)
            ownerBg = ScrollBarOwnerBackground(ScrollBarOwnerFromDc(hdc), hdc);
        auto scrollbarBg = [&]() -> COLORREF {
            if (pickerNavScrollbar)
                return FilePickerPaneColor(darkScrollbar);
            if (pickerListScrollbar)
                return FilePickerListColor(darkScrollbar);
            if (explorerMicaPaneScrollbar)
                return ExplorerMicaPaneRevealColor(darkScrollbar);
            if (explorerMicaScrollbar && ExplorerOpaqueMode())
                return FilePickerPaneColor(darkScrollbar);
            if (ownerBg != CLR_INVALID)
                return ownerBg;
            if (!darkScrollbar)
                return explorerMicaScrollbar
                           ? RGB(0, 0, 0)
                           : RGB(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF);
            return explorerMicaScrollbar
                       ? RGB(0, 0, 0)
                       : Win32MainDark;
        };
        // Opaque equivalents of WinUI's current scrollbar resources. WinUI
        // overlays translucent brushes; Win32 scrollbars consume layout, so
        // using their resolved solid colors avoids exposing the host surface.
        const COLORREF scrollbarForeground = darkScrollbar
            ? RGB(0x9D, 0x9D, 0x9D)  // SystemFillColorSolidNeutral
            : RGB(0x8A, 0x8A, 0x8A);
        const COLORREF scrollbarHover = darkScrollbar
            ? RGB(0x2E, 0x2E, 0x2E)  // solid AcrylicInApp approximation
            : RGB(0xF7, 0xF7, 0xF7);
        const COLORREF scrollbarActiveArrow = darkScrollbar
            ? RGB(0xCF, 0xCF, 0xCF)  // TextFillColorSecondary over hover
            : RGB(0x5E, 0x5E, 0x5E);
        const COLORREF scrollbarDisabled = darkScrollbar
            ? RGB(0x57, 0x57, 0x57)  // ControlStrongFillColorDisabled
            : RGB(0xAE, 0xAE, 0xAE);

        if (iPartId == SBP_GRIPPERVERT || iPartId == SBP_GRIPPERHORZ)
            return true;

        if (iPartId == SBP_SIZEBOX) {
            HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(scrollbarBg());
            if (!br) return false;
            FillRect(hdc, pRect, br);
            paintSolidScrollbarBg(hdc);
            return true;
        }

        // Custom scrollbar when dark mode is active or light mode opts in.
        // Replaces the classic dithered scrollbar (which uses COLOR_HIGHLIGHT
        // for the track, showing accent red) with a clean modern scrollbar.
        {
            int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
            int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
            if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return true;

            // Track: adaptive in dark mode, pure white in light mode. Whole-
            // bar hover (SCRBS_HOT, sent here too even though the cursor is
            // over an arrow/thumb elsewhere) draws a #2E2E2E pill in the same
            // column the thumb occupies, so the track highlights together
            // with the rest of the bar without a flat full-width rectangle.
            if (iPartId == SBP_UPPERTRACKVERT || iPartId == SBP_LOWERTRACKVERT
             || iPartId == SBP_UPPERTRACKHORZ || iPartId == SBP_LOWERTRACKHORZ) {
                bool isHot = (iStateId != SCRBS_NORMAL && iStateId != SCRBS_DISABLED);
                AtomicThemePaintBuffer paintBuffer(hdc, pRect, isHot);
                HDC paintDC = paintBuffer.GetDC();
                HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(scrollbarBg());
                if (!br) return false;
                FillRect_orig(paintDC, pRect, br);
                paintPartBackdrop(paintDC);

                if (isHot) {
                    const bool isVert = iPartId == SBP_UPPERTRACKVERT ||
                        iPartId == SBP_LOWERTRACKVERT;
                    const FLOAT scale = (FLOAT)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) /
                        USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
                    RoundedHdcGdipDrawLock gdipLock;
                    if (!gdipLock)
                        return false;
                    Gdiplus::Graphics graphics(paintDC);
                    if (!BeginPartGraphicsGdip(graphics, pRect) ||
                        !FillScrollbarHoverStrip(graphics, isVert,
                            (FLOAT)w, (FLOAT)h, scale, scrollbarHover))
                        return false;
                }
                paintBuffer.Commit();
                return true;
            }

            // Thumb: GDI+ rounded pill. The visible 2/6-DIP widths are what
            // WinUI's 8/12-DIP thumb produces after its transparent stroke.
            if (iPartId == SBP_THUMBBTNVERT || iPartId == SBP_THUMBBTNHORZ) {
                const bool isDisabled = iStateId == SCRBS_DISABLED;
                const bool isHot = iStateId != SCRBS_NORMAL && !isDisabled;
                AtomicThemePaintBuffer paintBuffer(hdc, pRect, isHot);
                HDC paintDC = paintBuffer.GetDC();
                HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(scrollbarBg());
                if (!br) return false;
                FillRect_orig(paintDC, pRect, br);
                paintPartBackdrop(paintDC);
                const bool isVert = iPartId == SBP_THUMBBTNVERT;
                const FLOAT scale = (FLOAT)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) /
                    USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
                const FLOAT thumbW = (isHot ? 6.f : 2.f) * scale;
                const COLORREF color = isDisabled ? scrollbarDisabled :
                    (isHot
                        ? BlendOverColor(scrollbarHover,
                            darkScrollbar ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0),
                            darkScrollbar ? 0x8B / 255.f : 0x72 / 255.f)
                        : scrollbarForeground);

                const FLOAT fw = (FLOAT)w;
                const FLOAT fh = (FLOAT)h;
                const FLOAT pad = 2.f * scale;
                const FLOAT edgeGap = 4.f * scale;
                const Gdiplus::RectF thumbRect = isVert
                    ? Gdiplus::RectF(fw - thumbW - edgeGap, pad,
                        thumbW, fh - 2.f * pad)
                    : Gdiplus::RectF(pad, fh - thumbW - edgeGap,
                        fw - 2.f * pad, thumbW);

                RoundedHdcGdipDrawLock gdipLock;
                if (!gdipLock)
                    return false;
                Gdiplus::Graphics graphics(paintDC);
                if (!BeginPartGraphicsGdip(graphics, pRect))
                    return false;
                const bool contentOK =
                    (!isHot || FillScrollbarHoverStrip(graphics, isVert,
                        fw, fh, scale, scrollbarHover)) &&
                    FillScrollbarRoundedRect(
                        graphics, thumbRect, thumbW * 0.5f, color);
                if (!contentOK)
                    return false;
                paintBuffer.Commit();
                return true;
            }

            // Arrows: invisible in normal/disabled, chevron on hover/pressed.
            // States 17-20 are undocumented Windows 11 extras: the whole
            // scrollbar widens and reveals arrows together when the cursor
            // is anywhere over it, not just over a specific arrow button —
            // these are the "hot because the bar is hovered" variants of
            // ABS_*HOT, sent to arrows the cursor isn't directly over.
            if (iPartId == SBP_ARROWBTN) {
                // Direct hover brightens the glyph; the undocumented bar-hot
                // states reveal it with the normal foreground color.
                const bool isDirectHot =
                    iStateId == ABS_UPHOT || iStateId == ABS_DOWNHOT ||
                    iStateId == ABS_LEFTHOT || iStateId == ABS_RIGHTHOT;
                const bool isInactive =
                    iStateId == ABS_UPNORMAL || iStateId == ABS_DOWNNORMAL ||
                    iStateId == ABS_LEFTNORMAL || iStateId == ABS_RIGHTNORMAL ||
                    iStateId == ABS_UPDISABLED || iStateId == ABS_DOWNDISABLED ||
                    iStateId == ABS_LEFTDISABLED || iStateId == ABS_RIGHTDISABLED;
                AtomicThemePaintBuffer paintBuffer(hdc, pRect, !isInactive);
                HDC paintDC = paintBuffer.GetDC();
                HBRUSH bgBr = GetCachedSolidBrush(scrollbarBg());
                if (!bgBr) return false;
                FillRect_orig(paintDC, pRect, bgBr);
                paintPartBackdrop(paintDC);

                // Normal/disabled: no chevron, only the solid host background.
                if (isInactive)
                    return true;

                const FLOAT scale = (FLOAT)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) /
                    USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
                const FLOAT fw = (FLOAT)w;
                const FLOAT fh = (FLOAT)h;
                const FLOAT hotThumbW = 6.f * scale;
                const FLOAT edgeGap = 4.f * scale;
                const bool isVertDir =
                    (iStateId >= ABS_UPNORMAL &&
                        iStateId <= ABS_DOWNDISABLED) ||
                    iStateId == 17 || iStateId == 18;
                // +0.5px at the 125% DPI baseline (0.4px logical), scaled by
                // DPI -- measured in Photoshop against the thumb's actual
                // position; without this the chevron sits slightly left of
                // where it should be.
                const FLOAT cx = isVertDir
                    ? fw - hotThumbW / 2.f - edgeGap + 0.4f * scale
                    : fw / 2.f;
                const FLOAT cy = isVertDir
                    ? fh / 2.f
                    : fh - hotThumbW / 2.f - edgeGap;

                const bool isPressed =
                    iStateId == ABS_UPPRESSED ||
                    iStateId == ABS_DOWNPRESSED ||
                    iStateId == ABS_LEFTPRESSED ||
                    iStateId == ABS_RIGHTPRESSED;
                ScrollbarCapEdge capEdge;
                if ((iStateId >= ABS_UPNORMAL && iStateId <= ABS_UPDISABLED) || iStateId == 17) {
                    capEdge = ScrollbarCapEdge::Top;
                } else if ((iStateId >= ABS_DOWNNORMAL && iStateId <= ABS_DOWNDISABLED) || iStateId == 18) {
                    capEdge = ScrollbarCapEdge::Bottom;
                } else if ((iStateId >= ABS_LEFTNORMAL && iStateId <= ABS_LEFTDISABLED) || iStateId == 19) {
                    capEdge = ScrollbarCapEdge::Left;
                } else {
                    capEdge = ScrollbarCapEdge::Right;
                }

                // The cap remains at its hover color while pressed; only the
                // glyph changes, matching WinUI's arrow-button feedback.
                const COLORREF capColor = scrollbarHover;
                const COLORREF arrowClr = isPressed
                    ? BlendOverColor(capColor,
                        darkScrollbar ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0),
                        darkScrollbar ? 0xC5 / 255.f : 0x9E / 255.f)
                    : (isDirectHot
                        ? scrollbarActiveArrow : scrollbarForeground);

                {
                    RoundedHdcGdipDrawLock gdipLock;
                    if (!gdipLock)
                        return false;
                    Gdiplus::Graphics graphics(paintDC);
                    if (!BeginPartGraphicsGdip(graphics, pRect) ||
                        !FillScrollbarHoverCap(graphics, isVertDir,
                            fw, fh, scale, capEdge, capColor))
                        return false;
                }

                const wchar_t* glyph = nullptr;
                switch (capEdge) {
                case ScrollbarCapEdge::Top: glyph = L"\uEDDB"; break;
                case ScrollbarCapEdge::Bottom: glyph = L"\uEDDC"; break;
                case ScrollbarCapEdge::Left: glyph = L"\uEDD9"; break;
                case ScrollbarCapEdge::Right: glyph = L"\uEDDA"; break;
                }
                RECT glyphRect = *pRect;
                OffsetRect(&glyphRect,
                    (int)std::lround(cx - fw * 0.5f),
                    (int)std::lround(cy - fh * 0.5f));
                const int glyphSize = std::max(
                    1, (int)std::lround(8.f * scale));
                if (!DrawGlyphDW(paintDC, glyphRect, arrowClr, glyph,
                        glyphSize, isPressed ? 0.875f : 1.f, 0.f)) {
                    RoundedHdcGdipDrawLock gdipLock;
                    if (!gdipLock)
                        return false;
                    Gdiplus::Graphics graphics(paintDC);
                    if (!BeginPartGraphicsGdip(graphics, pRect) ||
                        !PaintScrollbarArrowFallbackGdip(graphics, capEdge,
                            cx, cy, scale, isPressed, arrowClr))
                        return false;
                }
                paintBuffer.Commit();
                return true;
            }
        }
    }

    if (g_settings.ModernContextMenus && cls == L"Toolbar" &&
        PaintLegacyShellDropdownToolbar(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect))
        return true;

    // ── Trackbar (Slider) — WinUI 3 style ────────────────────────────────
    // TKP_TRACK=1/TRACKVERT=2: rounded gray rail
    // TKP_THUMB=3/THUMBVERT=6: rounded rect thumb (accent on hover/pressed)
    // TKP_THUMBBOTTOM=4/TOP=5/LEFT=7/RIGHT=8: pointed thumb variants
    // TKP_TICS=9/TICSVERT=10: suppressed (WinUI has no tick marks)
    if (g_settings.RoundedButtons && _wcsicmp(cls.c_str(), L"Trackbar") == 0) {
        int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
        int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return false;

        // Suppress tick marks (WinUI Slider has none)
        if (iPartId == 9 || iPartId == 10) return true;

        // Track/rail: uniform gray pill
        if (iPartId == 1 /*TKP_TRACK*/ || iPartId == 2 /*TKP_TRACKVERT*/) {
            if (!g_d2dFactory) return false;

            bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
            FLOAT fw = (FLOAT)w, fh = (FLOAT)h;
            FLOAT cr = std::min(fw, fh) * 0.5f;

            HWND tb = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
            if (tb && !IsClassName(tb, L"msctls_trackbar32"))
                tb = nullptr;
            const bool trackEnabled = !tb || IsWindowEnabled(tb);

            // SliderTrackFill: ControlStrongFillColorDefault, unchanged on
            // hover and press; Disabled has its own token.
            D2D1_COLOR_F trackClr = WinUiColorF(trackEnabled
                ? WinUI::ControlStrongFillColorDefault(dark)
                : WinUI::ControlStrongFillColorDisabled(dark));

            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
            FPUGuard fpu;
            if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
                return false;

            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
            pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(trackClr, &brush);
            pRT->BeginDraw();
            pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                D2D1::RoundedRect(D2D1::RectF(0, 0, fw, fh), cr, cr), brush.Get());

            // WinUI fills the track up to the thumb's center
            // (HorizontalDecreaseRect). comctl32 has no theme part for that
            // side, so the length is asked of the control itself. Safe to
            // paint only because TrackbarSubclassProc recomposes the whole
            // client on every WM_PAINT: a length that moved since the last
            // frame cannot leave a strip of the old one behind, the way it
            // would if this followed comctl32's partial invalidation.
            RECT thumbRc = {};
            if (tb) {
                SendMessageUnhooked(tb, TBM_GETTHUMBRECT, 0,
                                    reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&thumbRc));
            }
            if (thumbRc.right > thumbRc.left && thumbRc.bottom > thumbRc.top) {
                // Both rects are in client space, and so is the bound DC.
                const bool vert = (iPartId == 2);
                // Halved as a float: the center of an even-sized thumb
                // falls on a half pixel, and D2D can draw there.
                const FLOAT center = vert
                    ? (FLOAT)(thumbRc.top + thumbRc.bottom) * 0.5f -
                          (FLOAT)pRect->top
                    : (FLOAT)(thumbRc.left + thumbRc.right) * 0.5f -
                          (FLOAT)pRect->left;
                const FLOAT len = std::clamp(center, 0.f, vert ? fh : fw);
                if (len > 0.f) {
                    const COLORREF acc = GetAccentFillDefault(dark);
                    // AccentFillColorDisabled is translucent by design: it
                    // composes over the track just drawn, like the XAML brush.
                    const D2D1_COLOR_F valueClr = trackEnabled
                        ? D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(acc) / 255.f,
                            GetGValue(acc) / 255.f, GetBValue(acc) / 255.f)
                        : WinUiColorF(WinUI::AccentFillColorDisabled(dark));
                    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> valueBrush;
                    if (SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(valueClr,
                            &valueBrush))) {
                        const D2D1_RECT_F valueRect = vert
                            ? D2D1::RectF(0, 0, fw, len)
                            : D2D1::RectF(0, 0, len, fh);
                        pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                            D2D1::RoundedRect(valueRect, cr, cr),
                            valueBrush.Get());
                    }
                }
            }
            if (pRT->EndDraw() == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                pRT.Reset();
                CachedTlsRTRecreate();
            }
            return true;
        }

        // Thumb: WinUI Slider style — grows on hover, shrinks on press
        bool isThumb = (iPartId >= 3 && iPartId <= 8);
        if (isThumb && g_d2dFactory) {
            INT st = iStateId;
            if (st == 4) st = 1; // FOCUSED→NORMAL
            if (st == 2 && (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_LBUTTON) & 0x8000))
                st = 3;

            FLOAT scale = (FLOAT)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.f;
            FLOAT innerPad = (st == 2) ? 1.0f * scale :  // HOT: accent grows
                             (st == 3) ? 3.5f * scale :  // PRESSED: accent shrinks
                             (st == 5) ? 2.5f * scale :  // DISABLED
                                         2.5f * scale;   // NORMAL

            bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
            COLORREF ac = GetAccentFillDefault(dark);

            FLOAT fw = (FLOAT)w, fh = (FLOAT)h;
            bool isVert = (iPartId == 6 || iPartId == 7 || iPartId == 8);

            FLOAT barW = 8.f * scale;
            FLOAT barH = fh;
            if (isVert) { barW = fw; barH = 8.f * scale; }
            barW = std::min(barW, fw);
            barH = std::min(barH, fh);
            FLOAT cr = std::min(barW, barH) * 0.5f;

            FLOAT cx = fw * 0.5f, cy = fh * 0.5f;
            D2D1_RECT_F outerRect = isVert
                ? D2D1::RectF(cx - barW*0.5f, cy - barH*0.5f, cx + barW*0.5f, cy + barH*0.5f)
                : D2D1::RectF(cx - barW*0.5f, 1.f * scale, cx + barW*0.5f, fh - 1.f * scale);
            D2D1_RECT_F innerRect = D2D1::RectF(
                outerRect.left + innerPad, outerRect.top + innerPad,
                outerRect.right - innerPad, outerRect.bottom - innerPad);
            FLOAT innerCr = std::max(0.f, cr - innerPad);

            // SliderOuterThumbBackground: ControlSolidFillColorDefault in
            // every state -- WinUI's Thumb template never restates the
            // Border's background, only the inner shape's.
            D2D1_COLOR_F outerClr =
                WinUiColorF(WinUI::ControlSolidFillColorDefault(dark));
            // SliderThumbBackground: AccentFillColor Default, then the same
            // color at 90 % (Secondary) and 80 % (Tertiary) over the outer
            // shape; Disabled is a neutral token, not the accent.
            D2D1_COLOR_F innerClr = (st == 5)
                ? WinUiColorF(WinUI::AccentFillColorDisabled(dark))
                : D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(ac)/255.f, GetGValue(ac)/255.f,
                    GetBValue(ac)/255.f,
                    (st == 3) ? 0.8f : (st == 2) ? 0.9f : 1.f);

            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
            FPUGuard fpu;
            if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
                return false;

            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> outBr, inBr;
            pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(outerClr, &outBr);
            pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(innerClr, &inBr);
            pRT->BeginDraw();
            pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(D2D1::RoundedRect(outerRect, cr, cr), outBr.Get());
            // SliderThumbBorderBrush: ControlElevationBorderBrush, a 1px
            // ring whose 3 pixels nearest one end carry the lit (dark) or
            // shadowed (light) shade. Without it the light thumb, now solid
            // white, has nothing separating it from the dialog behind.
            const ButtonBorder tbBorder = WinUiControlBorder(dark,
                (st == 3) ? PBS_PRESSED : (st == 5) ? PBS_DISABLED : PBS_NORMAL);
            const FLOAT strokeW = std::max(1.f, scale);
            const FLOAT outerH = outerRect.bottom - outerRect.top;
            if (tbBorder.ring.a > 0.f && outerH > strokeW * 2.f) {
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GradientStopCollection> stops;
                const FLOAT edgeSpan =
                    std::min(3.f * scale / outerH, 0.5f);
                // An edge with alpha 0 is this helper's way of saying
                // "flat ring" (pressed and disabled), not "fade out".
                const D2D1_COLOR_F edgeClr = (tbBorder.edge.a > 0.f)
                    ? tbBorder.edge : tbBorder.ring;
                D2D1_GRADIENT_STOP gs[3] = {};
                if (tbBorder.edgeAtTop) {
                    gs[0] = { 0.f, edgeClr };
                    gs[1] = { edgeSpan, tbBorder.ring };
                    gs[2] = { 1.f, tbBorder.ring };
                } else {
                    gs[0] = { 0.f, tbBorder.ring };
                    gs[1] = { 1.f - edgeSpan, tbBorder.ring };
                    gs[2] = { 1.f, edgeClr };
                }
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1LinearGradientBrush> ringBr;
                if (SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateGradientStopCollection(gs, 3, &stops)) &&
                    SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateLinearGradientBrush(
                        D2D1::LinearGradientBrushProperties(
                            D2D1::Point2F(0.f, outerRect.top),
                            D2D1::Point2F(0.f, outerRect.bottom)),
                        stops.Get(), &ringBr))) {
                    const FLOAT half = strokeW * 0.5f;
                    pRT->DrawRoundedRectangle(
                        D2D1::RoundedRect(D2D1::RectF(
                            outerRect.left + half, outerRect.top + half,
                            outerRect.right - half, outerRect.bottom - half),
                            std::max(0.f, cr - half), std::max(0.f, cr - half)),
                        ringBr.Get(), strokeW);
                }
            }
            pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(D2D1::RoundedRect(innerRect, innerCr, innerCr), inBr.Get());
            if (pRT->EndDraw() == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                pRT.Reset();
                CachedTlsRTRecreate();
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    // Spin button (msctls_updown32) — modern style with Fluent chevrons
    // SPNP_UP=1, SPNP_DOWN=2, SPNP_UPHORZ=3, SPNP_DOWNHORZ=4
    if (g_settings.RoundedButtons && cls == L"Spin") {
        if (iPartId >= 1 && iPartId <= 4) {
        int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
        int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return false;

        AtomicThemePaintBuffer paintBuffer(hdc, pRect, true);
        HDC paintDC = paintBuffer.GetDC();

        bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
        bool isHot     = (iStateId == 2);
        bool isPressed = (iStateId == 3);
        bool disabled  = (iStateId == 4);
        const bool isUp = (iPartId == 1 || iPartId == 3);
        const bool isHorz = (iPartId >= 3);

        // Background: rounded fill matching Edit control
        FLOAT scale = (FLOAT)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.f;
        FLOAT cr = 3.5f * scale;

        HWND spinHwnd = t_currentSpinPaintHwnd;
        if (!spinHwnd)
            spinHwnd = WindowFromDC(hdc);
        RECT spinClientRect = {};
        int connectedEdge = 0;
        if (spinHwnd && GetClientRect(spinHwnd, &spinClientRect)) {
            const LONG_PTR style = GetWindowLongPtrW(spinHwnd, GWL_STYLE);
            const bool alignRight = (style & UDS_ALIGNRIGHT) != 0;
            const bool alignLeft = (style & UDS_ALIGNLEFT) != 0;
            HWND buddy = GetSpinBuddyForPaint(spinHwnd);
            if (alignRight != alignLeft && buddy && IsClassName(buddy, L"Edit"))
                connectedEdge = alignRight ? -1 : 1;
        }
        // Sample the outer rounded corner, never the shared square seam.
        const int sampleX = isHorz && isUp ? pRect->right - 1 : pRect->left;
        const int sampleY = !isHorz && !isUp ? pRect->bottom - 1 : pRect->top;
        const COLORREF baseBg = dark
            ? DarkBgForPaint(spinHwnd)
            : SampleBackground(
                hdc, sampleX, sampleY, COLOR_WINDOW, false);
        COLORREF bg = baseBg;
        if (isHot)     bg = dark ? RGB(0x38, 0x38, 0x38) : RGB(0xE8, 0xE8, 0xE8);
        if (isPressed) bg = dark ? RGB(0x2A, 0x2A, 0x2A) : RGB(0xDD, 0xDD, 0xDD);

        // Reset the state paint without touching the full-control outline.
        // The inner rounded clip prevents a square erase from covering its
        // antialiased outer corners while still avoiding edge accumulation.
        const float strokeWidth = std::max(1.0f, scale);
        bool baseReset = false;
        if (connectedEdge) {
            baseReset = FillSpinBaseInsideBorder(
                paintDC, spinHwnd, pRect, baseBg, WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale, strokeWidth,
                connectedEdge);
        } else if (HBRUSH baseBrush = GetCachedSolidBrush(baseBg)) {
            // A standalone Spin owns its complete outline, so every state
            // starts from an opaque surface to prevent antialias accumulation.
            baseReset = FillRect_orig &&
                FillRect_orig(paintDC, pRect, baseBrush) != FALSE;
        }
        if (!baseReset) {
            if (HBRUSH baseBrush = GetCachedSolidBrush(baseBg))
                FillRect(paintDC, pRect, baseBrush);
        }

        const bool roundTopLeft = isHorz ? !isUp : isUp;
        const bool roundTopRight = isHorz ? isUp : isUp;
        const bool roundBottomRight = isHorz ? isUp : !isUp;
        const bool roundBottomLeft = isHorz ? !isUp : !isUp;
        const int seamEdge = isHorz ? (isUp ? 3 : 1) : (isUp ? 2 : 0);

        // Both halves center their border on the shared edge, producing one line.
        bool backgroundDrawn = PaintSpinButtonGdip(
            paintDC, *pRect, bg, dark, cr, strokeWidth,
            connectedEdge ? &spinClientRect : nullptr, WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale,
            connectedEdge, roundTopLeft, roundTopRight, roundBottomRight,
            roundBottomLeft, seamEdge);
        if (!backgroundDrawn) {
            // GDI+/path failure: keep the control usable and avoid restoring
            // the old sampled-black corner path. The flat fill is deliberate;
            // D2D still supplies the normal rounded border when available.
            if (HBRUSH fallbackBrush = GetCachedSolidBrush(bg))
                FillRect(paintDC, pRect, fallbackBrush);
        }

        if (!backgroundDrawn && g_d2dFactory) {
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
            FPUGuard fpu;
            if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(paintDC, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT))) {
                FLOAT fw = (FLOAT)w, fh = (FLOAT)h;
                D2D1_COLOR_F fillClr = D2D1::ColorF(
                    GetRValue(bg)/255.f, GetGValue(bg)/255.f, GetBValue(bg)/255.f);
                D2D1_COLOR_F borderClr = dark
                    ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.09f)
                    : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.06f);
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> fillBr, borderBr;
                if (SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(fillClr, &fillBr)) && fillBr &&
                    SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(borderClr, &borderBr)) && borderBr) {
                    pRT->BeginDraw();
                    D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT rr = D2D1::RoundedRect(
                        D2D1::RectF(0.5f, 0.5f, fw - 0.5f, fh - 0.5f), cr, cr);
                    pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(&rr, fillBr.Get());
                    pRT->DrawRoundedRectangle(&rr, borderBr.Get(), scale);
                    if (pRT->EndDraw() == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                        pRT.Reset();
                        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Chevron via Segoe Fluent Icons
        const wchar_t* glyph = isHorz
            ? (isUp ? L"\uF08F" : L"\uF08D")    // ChevronRight / ChevronLeft
            : (isUp ? L"\uF090" : L"\uF08E");   // ChevronUp / ChevronDown

        int fontSize = std::max(7, (int)lroundf(9.f * scale));
        COLORREF chevClr = dark
            ? (disabled ? RGB(0x55, 0x55, 0x55) : RGB(0xCC, 0xCC, 0xCC))
            : (disabled ? RGB(0xAA, 0xAA, 0xAA) : RGB(0x33, 0x33, 0x33));
        bool glyphDrawn = DrawGlyphDW(
            paintDC, *pRect, chevClr, glyph, fontSize, 1.0f, 0.0f);
        if (!glyphDrawn)
            glyphDrawn = DrawGlyphGdiFallback(
                paintDC, *pRect, chevClr, glyph, fontSize);
        if (!glyphDrawn) {
            HPEN pen = CreatePen(PS_SOLID, (int)std::max(1.f, 1.20f * scale), chevClr);
            if (pen) {
                int cx = (pRect->left + pRect->right) / 2;
                int cy = (pRect->top + pRect->bottom) / 2;
                int sx = isHorz ? (isUp ? 1 : -1) : 0;
                int sy = isHorz ? 0 : (isUp ? -1 : 1);
                HPEN oldPen = (HPEN)SelectObject(paintDC, pen);
                if (isHorz) {
                    MoveToEx(paintDC, (int)(cx - sx * 1.5f * scale), (int)(cy - 3.5f * scale), nullptr);
                    LineTo(paintDC, (int)(cx + sx * 2.0f * scale), cy);
                    LineTo(paintDC, (int)(cx - sx * 1.5f * scale), (int)(cy + 3.5f * scale));
                } else {
                    MoveToEx(paintDC, (int)(cx - 3.5f * scale), (int)(cy - sy * 1.5f * scale), nullptr);
                    LineTo(paintDC, cx, (int)(cy + sy * 2.0f * scale));
                    LineTo(paintDC, (int)(cx + 3.5f * scale), (int)(cy - sy * 1.5f * scale));
                }
                SelectObject(paintDC, oldPen);
                DeleteObject(pen);
            }
        }
        paintBuffer.Commit();
        return true;
    } // end iPartId 1-4
    } // end Spin

    // Pause/CopyClose glyph buttons: native art doesn't match this mod's
    // Fluent icon-font glyphs used elsewhere (Spin chevrons above, pin,
    // search). Redesign, not a dark-mode-only fix, so gated by
    // RoundedButtons like Spin rather than g_darkModeActive.
    //
    // iStateId mapping (Pause 1-8, CopyClose 1-5): Pause 1-3 = Pause icon
    // Normal/Hot/Pressed, 4 = Play Normal, 5 = Pause Disabled, 6 = Play
    // Disabled, 7-8 = Play Hot/Pressed.
    if (g_settings.RoundedButtons && (cls == L"Pause" || cls == L"CopyClose")) {
        HWND fileOpHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
        if (IsFileOpProgressWindow(fileOpHwnd)) {
            int w = pRect->right - pRect->left;
            int h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
            if (w > 0 && h > 0) {
                bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
                bool isPlay = false, isHot = false, isPressed = false, isDisabled = false;
                if (cls == L"Pause") {
                    switch (iStateId) {
                        case 2: isHot = true; break;
                        case 3: isPressed = true; break;
                        case 4: isPlay = true; break;
                        case 5: isDisabled = true; break;
                        case 6: isPlay = true; isDisabled = true; break;
                        case 7: isPlay = true; isHot = true; break;
                        case 8: isPlay = true; isPressed = true; break;
                        default: break; // 1 = Pause Normal
                    }
                } else { // CopyClose
                    switch (iStateId) {
                        case 2: isHot = true; break;
                        case 3: isPressed = true; break;
                        case 4: isDisabled = true; break;
                        default: if (iStateId != 1) isDisabled = true; break; // rare state 5
                    }
                }

                // Erase whatever the native draw (or the previous hover
                // pill) left behind. The DUI dialog paints this part on its
                // own memory DC, so the corner pixel is a cheap and exact
                // read of its background.
                FLOAT scale = (FLOAT)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.f;
                COLORREF cornerBg = GetPixel(hdc, pRect->left, pRect->top);
                if (cornerBg == CLR_INVALID)
                    cornerBg = dark ? Win32MainDark : GetSysColor_orig(COLOR_BTNFACE);
                if (HBRUSH hCBr = GetCachedSolidBrush(cornerBg))
                    (FillRect_orig ? FillRect_orig : FillRect)(hdc, pRect, hCBr);

                // Transparent at rest; accent-with-opacity (or neutral b/w
                // when NeutralSelection is on) on hover/press, matching
                // other rounded-pill hover treatments in this file.
                if (!isDisabled && (isHot || isPressed)) {
                    FLOAT cr = 3.5f * scale;
                    COLORREF accentClr = g_settings.NeutralSelection
                        ? (dark ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0))
                        : GetAccentIndicator();
                    float baseAlpha = GetBorderedSelectionFillAlpha(dark, g_settings.NeutralSelection, false);
                    float alpha = isPressed ? baseAlpha * 2.f : baseAlpha;
                    FillRoundedRectGdip(hdc,
                        Gdiplus::RectF(pRect->left + 0.5f, pRect->top + 0.5f, (float)w - 1.f, (float)h - 1.f),
                        cr, GdipColor(accentClr, (BYTE)std::lround(std::clamp(alpha, 0.f, 1.f) * 255.f)));
                }

                const wchar_t* glyph = (cls == L"CopyClose")
                    ? L""                    // Cancel
                    : (isPlay ? L"" : L""); // Play : Pause
                bool isCancel = (cls == L"CopyClose");
                int fontSize = (int)(std::min(w, h) * (isCancel ? 0.55f : 0.50f));
                COLORREF glyphClr = dark
                    ? (isDisabled ? RGB(0x55, 0x55, 0x55) : RGB(0xCC, 0xCC, 0xCC))
                    : (isDisabled ? RGB(0xAA, 0xAA, 0xAA) : RGB(0x33, 0x33, 0x33));
                if (!DrawGlyphDW(hdc, *pRect, glyphClr, glyph, fontSize)) {
                    // No icon font installed -- hand-drawn shapes, matching
                    // the Spin chevron's fallback above.
                    int cx = (pRect->left + pRect->right) / 2;
                    int cy = (pRect->top + pRect->bottom) / 2;
                    if (isCancel) {
                        HPEN pen = CreatePen(PS_SOLID, (int)std::max(1.f, 1.4f * scale), glyphClr);
                        if (pen) {
                            HPEN oldPen = (HPEN)SelectObject(hdc, pen);
                            float r = 3.5f * scale;
                            MoveToEx(hdc, (int)(cx - r), (int)(cy - r), nullptr);
                            LineTo(hdc, (int)(cx + r + 1), (int)(cy + r + 1));
                            MoveToEx(hdc, (int)(cx + r), (int)(cy - r), nullptr);
                            LineTo(hdc, (int)(cx - r - 1), (int)(cy + r + 1));
                            SelectObject(hdc, oldPen);
                            DeleteObject(pen);
                        }
                    } else if (isPlay) {
                        HBRUSH br = CreateSolidBrush(glyphClr);
                        if (br) {
                            HGDIOBJ oldBr = SelectObject(hdc, br);
                            HGDIOBJ oldPen = SelectObject(hdc, GetStockObject(NULL_PEN));
                            POINT tri[3] = {
                                { (int)(cx - 2.5f * scale), (int)(cy - 4.5f * scale) },
                                { (int)(cx - 2.5f * scale), (int)(cy + 4.5f * scale) },
                                { (int)(cx + 4.f * scale),  cy },
                            };
                            Polygon(hdc, tri, 3);
                            SelectObject(hdc, oldPen);
                            SelectObject(hdc, oldBr);
                            DeleteObject(br);
                        }
                    } else {
                        HBRUSH br = CreateSolidBrush(glyphClr);
                        if (br) {
                            int barW = (int)std::max(1.f, 1.6f * scale);
                            int barH = (int)(8.f * scale);
                            int gap = (int)(1.5f * scale);
                            RECT bar1 = { cx - gap - barW, cy - barH / 2, cx - gap, cy + barH / 2 };
                            RECT bar2 = { cx + gap, cy - barH / 2, cx + gap + barW, cy + barH / 2 };
                            FillRect(hdc, &bar1, br);
                            FillRect(hdc, &bar2, br);
                            DeleteObject(br);
                        }
                    }
                }
                return true;
            }
        }
    }

    if (DesktopCheckbox::t_nativeBake && cls == L"Button")
        return false;

    // Button class — radio button + checkbox animation
    const bool offscreenBake = g_settings.RoundedButtons && cls == L"Button" &&
        OffscreenBake::Begin(hdc, iPartId, pRect);
    if (cls == L"Button")
    {
        if (g_settings.RoundedButtons && PaintRadioButton(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect)) {
            if (offscreenBake)
                OffscreenBake::Finish(hdc, *pRect);
            return true;
        }
    }
    if (g_settings.RoundedButtons && cls == L"Button")
    {
        // Install WH_CBT lazily on threads that draw Buttons.
        // This avoids installing on D3D/WebView2 render threads (which
        // never draw Buttons but would otherwise get the hook via
        // NtUserCreateWindowEx_hook, breaking their message loop).
        InstallCbtHookForThread();
        if (DesktopCheckbox::PaintCell(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect)) {
            if (offscreenBake)
                OffscreenBake::Finish(hdc, *pRect);
            return true;
        }
        if (PaintShiftedShellDuiCheckbox(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect))
            return true;
        if (PaintCheckBox(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect))
        {
            if (offscreenBake)
                OffscreenBake::Finish(hdc, *pRect);
            // Lazy fallback for windows already existing before mod load.
            // g_tlsPaintHwnd first: WindowFromDC returns NULL on the memory
            // DCs used by buffered-paint animation frames (see the
            // BufferedPaintStopAllAnimations call in CheckBoxSubclassProc).
            HWND hwndCB = (iPartId == BP_CHECKBOX && !g_checkBoxAnimUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
                ? (g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc)) : nullptr;
            bool alreadyTracked = true;
            if (hwndCB && IsWindow(hwndCB)) {
                std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_checkAnimsMutex);
                alreadyTracked = g_checkAnims.find((ULONG_PTR)hwndCB) != g_checkAnims.end();
            }
            if (hwndCB && IsWindow(hwndCB) && !alreadyTracked)
            {
                wchar_t clsBuf[16] = {};
                GetClassNameW(hwndCB, clsBuf, ARRAYSIZE(clsBuf));
                // Same BS_CHECKBOX-family style guard as the CbtProc
                // install path -- without it, any Button that merely calls
                // DrawThemeBackground(BP_CHECKBOX, ...) to render a
                // checkbox-style glyph (a custom tri-state control, say)
                // would get silently subclassed too.
                LONG style = GetWindowLongW(hwndCB, GWL_STYLE) & 0xFL;
                bool isChk = (style == BS_CHECKBOX   || style == BS_AUTOCHECKBOX ||
                              style == BS_3STATE      || style == BS_AUTO3STATE);
                if (isChk && _wcsicmp(clsBuf, L"Button") == 0)
                {
                    CheckAnim ca;
                    ca.fromState = (int)SendMessageW(hwndCB, BM_GETCHECK, 0, 0);
                    ca.progress  = 1.f;
                    ca.lastTick  = GetTickCount();
                    if (WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                            hwndCB, CheckBoxSubclassProc, 0))
                    {
                        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g_checkAnimsMutex);
                        g_checkAnims[(ULONG_PTR)hwndCB] = ca;
                    }
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    // Tab class -- WinUI-style tab backgrounds. PaintTab itself checks
    // IsWinUiTabStyleActive and no-ops when it isn't, so no setting gate is
    // needed here.
    if (cls == L"Tab")
    {
        if (PaintTab(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect))
            return true;
    }

    // TreeView glyph -- animated arrows
    if (g_settings.AnimatedArrows &&
        (cls == L"TreeView" || cls == L"Explorer::TreeView"))
    {
        if (PaintTreeViewGlyph(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect))
            return true;
    }

    // Progress bars (all processes)
    if (g_settings.ProgressBars)
    {
        if (cls == L"Progress" || cls.find(L"Progress") != std::wstring::npos)
        {
            bool isIndet = false;
            AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_indeterminateThemesLock);
            isIndet = g_indeterminateThemes.count(hTheme) > 0;
            ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_indeterminateThemesLock);
            if (isIndet) { if (PaintIndeterminateProgressBar(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect)) return true; }
            else         { if (PaintProgressBar(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect)) return true; }
        }
    }

    // Explorer-only features
    if (!g_settings.ExplorerSection) return false;

    if (_wcsicmp(cls.c_str(), L"Rebar") == 0 &&
        PaintExplorerRebarMicaTint(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect))
        return true;

    if (g_settings.RebarMicaTint && iPartId == 0 /*COMMONPROPS*/ &&
        (cls == L"Toolbar" || cls == L"Navigation" ||
         cls == L"AddressBand" || cls == L"SearchBox") &&
        PaintExplorerRebarMicaTintRect(hdc, pRect))
        return true;

    if (cls == L"Navigation" &&
        PaintExplorerNavigationButton(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect))
        return true;

    if (cls == L"Toolbar" &&
        PaintTravelBandDropDownGlyph(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect))
        return true;

    // Legacy Explorer/Control Panel address bar and search box surfaces.
    if ((cls == L"AddressBand" || cls == L"SearchBox") &&
        PaintExplorerAddressBand(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect))
        return true;

    // Nav divider removal / WinUI-style hover reveal
    if ((g_settings.RemoveNavDivider || g_settings.NavDividerHoverReveal) &&
        (iPartId == 3 || iPartId == 4))
    {
        if (cls == L"PreviewPane" || cls == L"NavPane")
        {
            if (g_settings.NavDividerHoverReveal)
            {
                HWND hDiv = NavDividerTrackAndGetHwnd(hdc);
                int fade = hDiv ? (int)(INT_PTR)GetPropW(hDiv, kPropNavDividerFade) : 0;

                const bool dark = IsSystemDarkMode();
                const HWND divHost = ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc);
                const bool inExplorer = IsInsideExplorer(divHost);
                const bool micaBlack = ExplorerMicaActive() && inExplorer;

                RECT rc = *pRect;
                rc.left--;
                rc.right++;
                // The divider sits on the nav pane: its shade in the opaque
                // Explorer mode and in the restyled picker (black reveal
                // under Mica there, where an opaque fill would light up).
                COLORREF bg = (ExplorerOpaqueMode() && inExplorer) || FilePickerRoot(divHost)
                    ? FilePickerPaneColor(dark)
                    : NavDividerBackgroundColor(dark, micaBlack);
                if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(bg))
                    FillRect(hdc, &rc, br);

                if (fade > 0 && NavDividerRectMatchesTrackedX(hDiv, pRect))
                    PaintNavDividerHoverPill(hdc, pRect, fade / 100.f, dark);

                return true;
            }

            {
                const bool dark = IsSystemDarkMode();
                const HWND divHost = ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc);
                const bool inExplorer = IsInsideExplorer(divHost);
                const bool micaBlack = ExplorerMicaActive() && inExplorer;
                RECT rc = *pRect;
                rc.left--;
                rc.right++;
                COLORREF bg = (ExplorerOpaqueMode() && inExplorer) || FilePickerRoot(divHost)
                    ? FilePickerPaneColor(dark)
                    : NavDividerBackgroundColor(dark, micaBlack);
                if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(bg))
                    FillRect(hdc, &rc, br);
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    // Legacy shell dropdowns sometimes paint hot rows as ListView items
    // instead of Menu popup items in light mode. Catch that path too so the
    // native blue square hover doesn't leak through. Gated the same as its
    // Menu-class sibling above.
    if (g_settings.ModernContextMenus && cls == L"ListView" &&
        iPartId == LVP_LISTITEM_ && iStateId == 2) {
        HWND hwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
        if (IsLegacyShellDropdownRoot(hwnd))
            return PaintLegacyShellDropdownHover(hdc, pRect, hwnd);
    }

    // Rounded selection backgrounds
    if (RoundedSelectionVisualsEnabled())
    {
        if (iPartId == TVP_TREEITEM_ &&
            (cls == L"TreeView" || cls == L"Explorer::TreeView"))
        {
            if (iStateId == 1)
                return true;
            if (iStateId >= 2 && iStateId <= 6)
                return DrawRoundedItemBg(hdc, pRect, iStateId, true);
        }
        if (iPartId == 0 &&
            (cls == L"TreeView" || cls == L"Explorer::TreeView"))
            return true;

        bool isLV = IsListViewThemeClass(cls);
        if (isLV && iPartId == LVP_LISTITEM_) {
            if (iStateId == 1)
                return true; // suppress native focus border, same as the TreeView/ItemsView call sites
            if (iStateId >= 2 && iStateId <= 6) {
                return DrawRoundedItemBg(hdc, pRect, iStateId, false);
            }
        }

        // iPartId == 3 in ItemsView = overlay drawn on top of the item background.
        // State 1 = focus border (suppress). Other states = hover/selection overlays
        // routed through DrawRoundedItemBg for visual consistency with iPartId==1 backgrounds.
        bool isItemsView = (cls == L"ItemsView" || cls == L"ItemsView::ListView");
        if (isItemsView && iPartId == 3)
        {
            if (g_settings.RoundedButtons &&
                (IsDuiGroupHeaderPaintElement() || IsLikelyGroupHeaderOverlayRect(pRect))) {
                return PaintGroupHeaderOverlayPill(hdc, iStateId, pRect);
            }
            if (iStateId == 1) {
                return true; // suppress focus border
            }
            if (iStateId >= 2 && iStateId <= 6) {
                return DrawRoundedItemBg(hdc, pRect, iStateId, false);
            }
            return true; // suppress unknown states
        }
    }

    // File-conflict picker rows inside OperationStatusWindow. ItemsView
    // part=4 is private to this picker (not LVP_LISTITEM_=1 or the
    // group-header overlay part=3 above); state 11 = hover, 12 = pressed.
    // Part of the rounded-buttons config like Pause/Play/Cancel above --
    // works in both light and dark mode, scoped to the file-op window.
    if (g_settings.RoundedButtons && cls == L"ItemsView" && iPartId == 4 &&
        (iStateId == 11 || iStateId == 12)) {
        HWND conflictHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
        if (IsFileOpProgressWindow(conflictHwnd)) {
            int w = pRect->right - pRect->left, h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
            if (w > 0 && h > 0 && g_d2dFactory) {
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
                if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT))) {
                    const COLORREF ac = GetAccentIndicator();
                    float aR = GetRValue(ac) / 255.f, aG = GetGValue(ac) / 255.f, aB = GetBValue(ac) / 255.f;
                    float alpha = (iStateId == 12) ? 0.16f : 0.08f; // pressed / hover
                    float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.f;
                    float fw = (float)w, fh = (float)h, cr = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale;
                    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> br;
                    if (SUCCEEDED(pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(D2D1::ColorF(aR, aG, aB, alpha), &br))) {
                        pRT->BeginDraw();
                        pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                            D2D1::RoundedRect(D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f, fw, fh), cr, cr), br.Get());
                        if (pRT->EndDraw() == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                            pRT.Reset();
                            CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    // Toolbar buttons: rounded hover/pressed (Explorer breadcrumb area, view
    // mode, MMC consoles). Extended to MMC specifically, not to any
    // non-Explorer host -- MMC support is experimental (see README), so
    // fixes for it stay scoped to that one process until more of them get
    // real testing. Unlike SetWindowTheme's native-theme redirect elsewhere
    // in this file (Explorer-only because of a real WM_THEMECHANGED
    // reentrancy hang in third-party MFC apps), this path never touches
    // SetWindowTheme -- it's a stateless per-part/state D2D fill -- so that
    // risk doesn't apply here.
    if (g_settings.ExplorerSection && g_settings.LegacyRebarControls &&
        cls == L"Toolbar" && (IsExplorerShellHost(hdc) || IsCurrentProcessMMC())) {
        bool isTbBtn = (iPartId == TP_BUTTON || iPartId == TP_DROPDOWNBUTTON ||
                        iPartId == TP_SPLITBUTTON);
        if (isTbBtn) {
            // Normal/Disabled/NearHot: suppress (transparent bg, icons drawn separately)
            if (iStateId == TS_NORMAL || iStateId == TS_DISABLED || iStateId == TS_NEARHOT)
                return true;
            // Hot/Pressed/Checked: rounded pill bg
            int w = pRect->right - pRect->left, h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
            if (w > 0 && h > 0 && g_d2dFactory) {
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
                if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
                {
                    bool dark = IsDarkForExcludedAwarePaintHdc(hdc);
                    float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.f;
                    float fw = (float)w, fh = (float)h;
                    float cr = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale;
                    // AppBarButton: SubtleFillColorSecondary on hover,
                    // Tertiary pressed. Checked stays a neutral fill, not
                    // AppBarToggleButton's accent: accent behind the
                    // toolbar's bitmap icons clashes with them.
                    float alpha;
                    switch (iStateId) {
                    case TS_PRESSED:
                        alpha = WinUI::SubtleFillColorTertiary(dark).alpha / 255.f; break;
                    case TS_CHECKED: case TS_HOTCHECKED:
                        alpha = dark ? 0.12f : 0.10f; break;
                    default:
                        alpha = WinUI::SubtleFillColorSecondary(dark).alpha / 255.f; break;
                    }
                    D2D1_COLOR_F fill = dark
                        ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, alpha)
                        : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, alpha);
                    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> br;
                    pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(fill, &br);
                    pRT->BeginDraw();
                    pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                        D2D1::RoundedRect(D2D1::RectF(0, 0, fw, fh), cr, cr), br.Get());
                    if (pRT->EndDraw() == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                        pRT.Reset();
                        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                    }
                }
                return true;
            }
        }
        // TP_SPLITBUTTONDROPDOWN — chevron: > normal, V pressed
        if (iPartId == TP_SPLITBUTTONDROPDOWN) {
            if (iStateId == TS_DISABLED) return true;
            int w = pRect->right - pRect->left, h = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
            if (w > 0 && h > 0 && g_d2dFactory) {
                bool dark = IsDarkForExcludedAwarePaintHdc(hdc);
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
                if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, pRect, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
                {
                    float scale = (float)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.f;
                    float fw = (float)w, fh = (float)h, cr = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale;
                    float bgAlpha = 0.f;
                    bool isPressed = (iStateId == TS_PRESSED);
                    if (iStateId == TS_HOT || iStateId == TS_OTHERSIDEHOT || iStateId == TS_HOTCHECKED)
                        bgAlpha = WinUI::SubtleFillColorSecondary(dark).alpha / 255.f;
                    else if (isPressed)
                        bgAlpha = WinUI::SubtleFillColorTertiary(dark).alpha / 255.f;
                    else if (iStateId == TS_CHECKED)
                        bgAlpha = dark ? 0.12f : 0.10f;
                    pRT->BeginDraw();
                    if (bgAlpha > 0.f) {
                        D2D1_COLOR_F fill = dark
                            ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, bgAlpha)
                            : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, bgAlpha);
                        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> bgBr;
                        pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(fill, &bgBr);
                        pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                            D2D1::RoundedRect(D2D1::RectF(1.f, 0, fw, fh), cr, cr), bgBr.Get());
                    }
