                    // Chevron: rotate > into V with the same 160 ms
                    // EaseOutCubic transition used by TreeView. WinUI
                    // BreadcrumbBar: ChevronRightMed at 12.
                    float cx = fw / 2.f, cy = fh / 2.f;
                    float al = std::min(fw, fh) * 0.2f;
                    D2D1_COLOR_F ac = WinUiColorF(isPressed
                        ? WinUI::TextFillColorTertiary(dark)
                        : WinUI::TextFillColorSecondary(dark));
                    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> aBr;
                    pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(ac, &aBr);
                    pRT->SetAntialiasMode(D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_PER_PRIMITIVE);
                    HWND toolbar = g_tlsPaintHwnd
                        ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
                    if (!IsClassName(toolbar, L"ToolbarWindow32"))
                        toolbar = nullptr;
                    UINT_PTR animationKey =
                        ((UINT_PTR)(UINT)pRect->left << 16) ^
                        (UINT_PTR)(UINT)pRect->right;
                    if (toolbar) {
                        POINT hitPoint = {
                            (pRect->left + pRect->right) / 2,
                            (pRect->top + pRect->bottom) / 2
                        };
                        int index = (int)SendMessageUnhooked(toolbar,
                            TB_HITTEST, 0,
                            reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&hitPoint));
                        TBBUTTON button = {};
                        if (index >= 0 && SendMessageUnhooked(toolbar,
                                TB_GETBUTTON, index,
                                reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&button)))
                            animationKey = (UINT_PTR)button.idCommand;
                    }
                    const float angle = BreadcrumbChevronAngle(
                        toolbar, animationKey, isPressed, pRect);
                    pRT->PushAxisAlignedClip(
                        D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f, fw, fh),
                        D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_ALIASED);
                    if (!DrawChevronGlyphOnRT(pRT.Get(), kChevronGlyphRightMed,
                            fw, fh, cx, cy, angle, aBr.Get(),
                            std::max(1, (int)std::lround(kBreadcrumbChevronGlyphDip * scale)))) {
                        pRT->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Rotation(
                            angle, D2D1::Point2F(cx, cy)));
                        pRT->DrawLine(
                            D2D1::Point2F(cx - al * 0.5f, cy - al),
                            D2D1::Point2F(cx + al * 0.5f, cy),
                            aBr.Get(), scale * 1.2f);
                        pRT->DrawLine(
                            D2D1::Point2F(cx - al * 0.5f, cy + al),
                            D2D1::Point2F(cx + al * 0.5f, cy),
                            aBr.Get(), scale * 1.2f);
                        pRT->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
                    }
                    pRT->PopAxisAlignedClip();
                    if (pRT->EndDraw() == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                        pRT.Reset();
                        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                    }
                }
                return true;
            }
        }
    }

    // Rounded group headers
    // Pure class-name check (IsListViewThemeClass), not HWND-scoped, so
    // this also engages for the DUI-hosted Previous Versions tab's
    // date-group headers/chevrons -- intentional, same restyle every
    // other ListView group header already gets.
    if (g_settings.RoundedButtons)
    {
        bool isLV = IsListViewThemeClass(cls);
        if (isLV && (iPartId == LVP_EXPANDBUTTON || iPartId == LVP_COLLAPSEBUTTON))
        {
            return PaintListViewGroupChevron(hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect);
        }
        // GROUPHEADER states (ItemsView::ListView in the theme dump): the
        // even ones are the HOT variants the theme paints directly, the odd
        // ones above OPEN/CLOSE are the selected variants; OPEN (1) and
        // CLOSE (9) themselves draw nothing.
        if (isLV && iPartId == 6)
        {
            if (pRect->bottom > pRect->top && pRect->right > pRect->left &&
                iStateId != 1 && iStateId != 9) {
                // Per-window dark mode so headers match the host app's
                // light/dark theme, not just the system-wide flag --
                // except inside an excluded process's own file picker,
                // where the picker's native frame follows the real
                // system setting directly and this plain child control
                // never got its own per-control dark-mode opt-in.
                const bool dark = IsDarkForExcludedAwarePaintHdc(hdc);
                PaintGroupHeaderFill(hdc, pRect, dark, /*pressed=*/(iStateId % 2) != 0);
            }
            return true;
        }
        // Current Explorer and WinUI's header style draw no line beside the
        // header text, so the classic line is suppressed in every host.
        if (isLV && iPartId == 7 /*LVP_GROUPHEADERLINE*/)
            return true;
    }

    if (cls == L"ListView" && iPartId == LVP_LISTITEM && iStateId == 0) {
        HWND hwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
        if (IsLegacyShellDropdownRoot(hwnd)) {
            if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(LegacyShellDropdownBgColor(hwnd)))
                FillRect(hdc, pRect, br);
            return true;
        }
    }

    if (cls == L"ListView" && iPartId == LVP_COLUMNDETAIL) {
        HWND hwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
        if (IsLegacyShellDropdownRoot(hwnd)) {
            if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(LegacyShellDropdownBgColor(hwnd)))
                FillRect(hdc, pRect, br);
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}
// ============================================================================
// HandlePostDraw — post-draw: DComp nav-pane pill tracking + ListView pill
// ============================================================================

static void HandlePostDraw(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, INT iPartId, INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!pRect) return;

    EnsureD2DFactory();

    const std::wstring& cls = GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme);

    if (!g_settings.ExplorerSection) return;

    // ReadingPane's background and divider are separate UIFILE elements:
    // ReadingPane owns the surface, while its sibling ReadingPaneSizer draws
    // through PreviewPane/READINGPANESIZER. Mirror the nav pane separator on
    // the content-facing (left) edge of that right-side sizer.
    if ((ExplorerMicaActive() || ExplorerOpaqueMode()) && iPartId == 4 &&
        (cls == L"PreviewPane" || cls.ends_with(L"::PreviewPane")) &&
        IsExplorerMicaHeaderPaint(hTheme, hdc)) {
        const int lineW = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(std::lround(
            static_cast<float>(DpiForPaintHdc(hdc)) /
            USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI)));
        RECT line = {
            pRect->left,
            pRect->top,
            std::min(pRect->right, pRect->left + lineW),
            pRect->bottom,
        };
        PaintExplorerPaneRule(hdc, line);
    }

    // Light rebar without the tint: the native band paint stays, the rule
    // against the content below is added (dark and tinted rebars draw it
    // in PaintExplorerRebarMicaTintRect over their own fill).
    if (g_settings.ModernSeparators && iStateId == 0 &&
        (iPartId == RP_BAND || iPartId == RP_BACKGROUND) && cls == L"Rebar" &&
        !(g_settings.RebarMicaTint && IsSystemTransparencyEnabled()) &&
        !IsDarkForExcludedAwarePaintHdc(hdc) && IsExplorerRebarHost(hdc))
        DrawRebarBottomRule(hdc, pRect, false);

    // ── Nav pane DComp pill ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (g_settings.NavPanePill &&
        iPartId == TVP_TREEITEM_ &&
        (cls == L"TreeView" || cls == L"Explorer::TreeView"))
    {
        // Only track selected states; normalize HOTSELECTED -> SELECTED
        INT state = iStateId;
        if (state == TREIS_HOTSELECTED) state = TREIS_SELECTED;
        bool isSelected = (state == TREIS_SELECTED || state == TREIS_SELECTEDNOTFOCUS);

        if (isSelected)
        {
            if (g_pillUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
                return;

            INT   animStyle   = PillAnimStyle();
            FLOAT scale       = (FLOAT)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
            int   itemH       = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;

            bool isDCompStyle =
                (animStyle == 4 || animStyle == 3 || animStyle == 2 || animStyle == 1);

            // ── Track which TreeView we are rendering in ──────────────────
            HWND currentTree = WindowFromDC(hdc);
            if (!currentTree || !IsWindow(currentTree))
                currentTree = PillFindTreeView();
            const int currentTreeContext =
                PillTreeContextCached(currentTree);
            isDCompStyle = isDCompStyle && currentTreeContext == 1;

            const HWND dropTree =
                g_dropPillActiveTree.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
            const HTREEITEM dropItem = (HTREEITEM)
                g_dropPillActiveItem.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
            const bool dropStateOverridden = dropTree == currentTree;
            const bool dropDCompActive =
                dropStateOverridden && dropItem != nullptr;
            // Reuse the native drop-hilite CDDS_PREPAINT already fetched once
            // per whole-tree paint pass (s_glyphDropPaint, populated in
            // SendMessageW_hook) instead of re-querying TVM_GETNEXTITEM here.
            // This block runs on every repaint of the selected item -- exactly
            // the pill's own GDI-fallback animation hot loop -- so the extra
            // synchronous SendMessageW round trip (re-entering the whole hook
            // chain) on every single frame was stalling the UI thread badly
            // enough to look frozen. Falls back to the original per-call query
            // only when the cache doesn't match this tree (e.g. glyph
            // tracking disabled), so correctness is unchanged either way.
            const bool haveCachedDrop = !dropStateOverridden &&
                s_glyphDropPaint.tree == currentTree;
            const HTREEITEM visualDropItem = dropStateOverridden
                ? dropItem
                : haveCachedDrop
                    ? s_glyphDropPaint.dropItem
                    : (HTREEITEM)SendMessageW(
                        currentTree, TVM_GETNEXTITEM_, TVGN_DROPHILITE_, 0);
            bool paintIsDropTarget = false;
            if (visualDropItem) {
                const HTREEITEM selectedItem = haveCachedDrop
                    ? s_glyphDropPaint.selectedItem
                    : (HTREEITEM)SendMessageW(
                        currentTree, TVM_GETNEXTITEM_, TVGN_CARET_, 0);
                if (visualDropItem != selectedItem) {
                    LONG dropCenter = 0;
                    if (TreeItemVerticalCenter(currentTree, visualDropItem,
                                               &dropCenter)) {
                        const LONG paintCenter = pRect->top +
                            (pRect->bottom - pRect->top) / 2;
                        LONG selectedCenter = 0;
                        paintIsDropTarget =
                            !TreeItemVerticalCenter(currentTree, selectedItem,
                                                    &selectedCenter) ||
                            std::abs(dropCenter - paintCenter) <
                                std::abs(selectedCenter - paintCenter);
                    }
                }
            }
            const bool suppressDropStatic =
                dropDCompActive && paintIsDropTarget;
            const bool useStaticDropColor =
                paintIsDropTarget && !dropDCompActive;

            // A second Explorer/picker window's tree can repaint its own
            // selected row (hover, an unrelated redraw, a blinking caret) while
            // a different tree still owns the single shared g_pillTreeHWND/
            // g_pillDC/g_pillTimer state -- switching that state on every such
            // repaint tore down the owner's animation just from moving the
            // mouse between windows. Only let a tree touch the shared state
            // if it's foreground, already owns it, or nothing owns it yet.
            HWND ownerTop = GetAncestor(currentTree, GA_ROOT);
            bool currentIsForeground = (ownerTop && ownerTop == GetForegroundWindow());
            bool noTreeTrackedYet = (!g_pillTreeHWND || !IsWindow(g_pillTreeHWND));
            bool ownsSharedState = (currentTree == g_pillTreeHWND) || currentIsForeground || noTreeTrackedYet;

            if (!PillIsUsableTreeItemRect(currentTree, pRect))
            {
                if (ownsSharedState && isDCompStyle)
                    PillCancelForGeometryChange(currentTree);
                return;
            }

            // g_pillItemH is shared state too -- a non-owning tree's own row
            // height must not clobber the value the actual owner's animation
            // math depends on (usually identical across trees in the same
            // process, but not guaranteed across monitors/DPI).
            if (ownsSharedState && itemH > 0) g_pillItemH = itemH;

            if (ownsSharedState && currentTree != g_pillTreeHWND)
            {
                // Tree changed: remove old subclass, reset state
                PillTreeSubclassRemove();
                g_pillTreeHWND  = currentTree;
                g_pillCurTop    = -99999;
                g_pillCurItem   = 0;
                g_pillLastValid = false;

                TreeCursorTrySubclass(currentTree);

                // Install subclass for DComp pill animation and scroll tracking
                if ((isDCompStyle || animStyle != 0) && currentTree)
                    PillTreeSubclassInstall(currentTree, currentTreeContext);

                // One-time retroactive pin swap — TVM_SETIMAGELIST may have
                // arrived before SendMessageW_hook could intercept.
                if (g_settings.FluentPinIcon && g_settings.ExplorerSection
                    && GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(currentTree)
                    && !PinIsDisabledDragDropTreeView(currentTree)) {
                    HIMAGELIST hState = reinterpret_cast<HIMAGELIST>(
                        SendMessageUnhooked(currentTree, TVM_GETIMAGELIST, TVSIL_STATE, 0));
                    HIMAGELIST ours = (HIMAGELIST)GetPropW(currentTree, kPropPinList);
                    if (hState && hState != ours)
                        PinInstallCustomList(currentTree, hState);
                }
            }

            bool treeRepainted = ownsSharedState && isDCompStyle && g_pillTreeRepainted.exchange(false);

            // ── Detect position change ─────────────────────────────────────
            if (ownsSharedState &&
                (pRect->top != g_pillCurTop ||
                 (treeRepainted && pRect->top == g_pillCurTop)))
            {
                // Reuse visualDropItem (computed above for this same tree)
                // instead of a third redundant TVM_GETNEXTITEM query per
                // paint -- ownsSharedState guarantees g_pillTreeHWND ==
                // currentTree by this point.
                bool isDragging = g_pillTreeHWND && visualDropItem != nullptr;

                if (!isDragging)
                {
                    bool isFirstEver = (g_pillCurTop == -99999);
                    // One-shot: consumed here regardless of what happens
                    // below, so a scroll with nothing selected afterward
                    // doesn't leave this armed for some unrelated later trigger.
                    bool justScrolled   = g_pillJustScrolled;
                    bool justScrolledUp = g_pillJustScrolledUp;
                    g_pillJustScrolled = false;

                    LPARAM curItem = g_pillTreeHWND
                        ? (LPARAM)SendMessageW(g_pillTreeHWND, TVM_GETNEXTITEM_, TVGN_CARET_, 0)
                        : 0;
                    bool isSameItem = (!isFirstEver && curItem != 0 && curItem == g_pillCurItem);
                    // Captured before g_pillCurItem is overwritten below --
                    // needed to detect an entering/exiting parent/child move.
                    LPARAM prevItemForBoundary = g_pillCurItem;
                    RECT previousSourceRect = {};
                    const bool previousSourceVisible = !isFirstEver &&
                        prevItemForBoundary && PillItemGetVisibleRect(
                            g_pillTreeHWND, (HTREEITEM)prevItemForBoundary,
                            &previousSourceRect);
                    // DComp owns a viewport-independent overlay, so a scroll
                    // invalidates its remembered origin. The GDI fallback is
                    // clipped and repainted by each TreeView row; when the old
                    // row is still visible, its fresh rect is a safe elastic
                    // origin and doesn't need an open-only blind.
                    const bool sourcePositionInvalid =
                        (justScrolled && isDCompStyle) ||
                        (!isFirstEver && !previousSourceVisible);
                    const bool useFreshGdiSource = justScrolled &&
                        !isDCompStyle && previousSourceVisible;
                    if (sourcePositionInvalid && !justScrolled && !isFirstEver)
                        justScrolledUp = pRect->top > g_pillCurTop;

                    const DOUBLE pillAnimStart = TimerGetSeconds();
                    float outgoingScale = 1.0f;
                    float outgoingOpacity = 1.0f;
                    float incomingScale = 0.0f;
                    float incomingOpacity = 0.0f;
                    const UINT_PTR activeGeneration =
                        g_pillTimer.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
                    if (animStyle == 1 && activeGeneration &&
                        !sourcePositionInvalid) {
                        const PillTransitionSnapshot activeSnap =
                            PillReadTransitionSnapshot();
                        if (activeSnap.generation == activeGeneration &&
                            activeSnap.style == 1) {
                            const DOUBLE motionElapsed = pillAnimStart -
                                activeSnap.startTime - activeSnap.holdDuration;
                            const PillListViewIndicatorState activeState =
                                PillSampleListViewIndicator(
                                    activeSnap, motionElapsed);
                            auto sampleItem = [&activeSnap, &activeState](
                                LPARAM item, float defaultScale,
                                float defaultOpacity, float* itemScale,
                                float* itemOpacity) {
                                *itemScale = defaultScale;
                                *itemOpacity = defaultOpacity;
                                if (item == activeSnap.curItem) {
                                    *itemScale = activeState.incomingScale;
                                    *itemOpacity = activeState.incomingOpacity;
                                } else if (item == activeSnap.prevItem) {
                                    *itemScale = activeState.outgoingScale;
                                    *itemOpacity = activeState.outgoingOpacity;
                                }
                            };
                            sampleItem(prevItemForBoundary, 1.0f, 1.0f,
                                &outgoingScale, &outgoingOpacity);
                            sampleItem(curItem, 0.0f, 0.0f,
                                &incomingScale, &incomingOpacity);
                        }
                    }

                    // Stop any running animation immediately. The GDI path
                    // must also kill its timer and invalidate the old snapshot:
                    // merely replacing the generation can strand a partially
                    // painted A row during a rapid A -> B -> C transition.
                    if (g_pillTimer)
                        PillCancelForGeometryChange(currentTree);

                    // Scroll (either axis) while DComp post-animation counter is
                    // active: clear DComp immediately to avoid a stale pill at
                    // the wrong position. Single load covers both checks since
                    // either one changing calls for the exact same response.
                    if (isDCompStyle && g_pillDCClearPending.load() > 0 &&
                        (pRect->top != g_pillCurTop || pRect->left != g_pillCurLeft))
                        PillCancelForGeometryChange(currentTree);

                    g_pillPrevTop =
                        (isFirstEver || isSameItem || sourcePositionInvalid)
                            ? pRect->top
                            : useFreshGdiSource
                                ? previousSourceRect.top
                                : g_pillCurTop;
                    g_pillCurTop  = pRect->top;
                    g_pillCurLeft = pRect->left;
                    // Guard curItem != 0: caret is transiently 0 during expand/collapse
                    if (curItem != 0) g_pillCurItem = curItem;

                    // Start animation for genuine item-to-item navigation. A
                    // DComp scroll or an off-screen previous item makes its
                    // remembered top unsuitable as an origin. winui_top then
                    // uses a directional open-only blind; visible GDI rows use
                    // the freshly queried source rect above.
                    if (animStyle && !isSameItem && curItem != 0 &&
                        (sourcePositionInvalid
                            ? (animStyle == 4) : !isFirstEver))
                    {
                        int ctx = currentTreeContext;
                        if (ctx > 0)
                        {
                            PillTransitionSnapshot snap;
                            snap.generation = g_pillNextTransitionId.fetch_add(
                                1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
                            if (!snap.generation)
                                snap.generation = g_pillNextTransitionId.fetch_add(
                                    1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
                            snap.startTime = pillAnimStart;
                            snap.prevItem = prevItemForBoundary;
                            snap.curItem = curItem;
                            snap.prevTop = g_pillPrevTop;
                            snap.curTop = g_pillCurTop;
                            snap.itemH = g_pillItemH;
                            snap.style = animStyle;
                            snap.scale = scale;
                            snap.useGradient = g_settings.AccentGradients;
                            snap.noClip = g_settings.NavPillNoClip;
                            // Contexts are intentionally disjoint: Explorer
                            // animates only through DirectComposition; common
                            // file pickers animate only through the GDI timer.
                            snap.useDComp = ctx == 1 && isDCompStyle;
                            snap.outgoingScale = outgoingScale;
                            snap.outgoingStartOpacity = outgoingOpacity;
                            snap.incomingStartScale = incomingScale;
                            snap.incomingStartOpacity = incomingOpacity;

                            // Detect a nested-section boundary crossing (winui_top
                            // style only) to drive NavigationView's simultaneous
                            // outgoing/incoming blinds instead of its stretch. Based
                            // on relative nesting depth rather than exact parent
                            // identity or a fixed level, so it also fires coming
                            // from/going to any OTHER item at a shallower/deeper
                            // level -- not just the section's own immediate parent.
                            snap.blindKind = 0;
                            snap.prevIndentPx = 0;
                            snap.curIndentPx = 0;
                            if (animStyle == 4 && g_pillTreeHWND && curItem)
                            {
                                HTREEITEM newItem = (HTREEITEM)curItem;
                                if (isFirstEver || sourcePositionInvalid)
                                {
                                    // isFirstEver: no "from" item exists at all.
                                    // sourcePositionInvalid: the remembered top
                                    // predates a layout move or belongs to an
                                    // item outside the viewport. Both cases skip
                                    // straight to an open-only pop-in.
                                    // Anchor follows scroll direction: scrolled
                                    // up -> bottom-anchored (blindKind 3, same as
                                    // "arriving after a collapse"); scrolled down
                                    // -> top-anchored (blindKind 4); no scroll
                                    // (genuine first paint) defaults to blindKind
                                    // 3 via g_pillJustScrolledUp's default.
                                    int newDepth = 0, newIndentPx = 0;
                                    PillItemNestInfo(g_pillTreeHWND, newItem, &newDepth, &newIndentPx);
                                    snap.curIndentPx = newIndentPx;
                                    snap.blindKind = justScrolledUp ? 3 : 4;
                                }
                                else if (prevItemForBoundary)
                                {
                                    HTREEITEM oldItem = (HTREEITEM)prevItemForBoundary;
                                    int oldDepth = 0, oldIndentPx = 0;
                                    int newDepth = 0, newIndentPx = 0;
                                    PillItemNestInfo(g_pillTreeHWND, oldItem, &oldDepth, &oldIndentPx);
                                    PillItemNestInfo(g_pillTreeHWND, newItem, &newDepth, &newIndentPx);
                                    snap.prevIndentPx = oldIndentPx;
                                    snap.curIndentPx = newIndentPx;
                                    if (newDepth != oldDepth)
                                    {
                                        // If oldItem is no longer visible, this exit
                                        // was a section collapse, not a plain
                                        // navigation -- its old row now shows
                                        // different content, so animating a close
                                        // phase there would look wrong. blindKind 3
                                        // skips to a single expand-only phase.
                                        if (newDepth < oldDepth &&
                                            !PillItemIsVisible(g_pillTreeHWND, oldItem))
                                        {
                                            snap.blindKind = 3;
                                        }
                                        else if (snap.curTop != snap.prevTop)
                                        {
                                            // Depth detects the section boundary;
                                            // screen order determines the blind's
                                            // direction across different branches.
                                            snap.blindKind =
                                                snap.curTop > snap.prevTop ? 1 : 2;
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            // Stable fallback for an unusual
                                            // same-row layout transition.
                                            snap.blindKind =
                                                newDepth > oldDepth ? 1 : 2;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            if (ctx == 1 &&
                                (animStyle == 4 || animStyle == 1)) {
                                // The hold protects the GDI/DComp handoff and
                                // consumes the beginning of the total duration.
                                snap.holdDuration =
                                    animStyle == 4 && snap.blindKind != 0
                                        ? PILL_BLIND_HOLD_DUR
                                        : PILL_ELASTIC_HOLD_DUR;
                            }
                            if (snap.useDComp) {
                                g_pillSleepMs = PillComputeSleepMs(
                                    g_pillTreeHWND);
                                // Width column covers pill + small margin,
                                // plus nested-indent headroom for the DComp
                                // surface.
                                g_pillColumnRight = (int)ceilf(
                                    (NAV_PILL_X_DIP + NAV_PILL_WIDTH_DIP) *
                                    scale) +
                                    (int)PILL_NESTED_MAX_INDENT + 2;
                            }
                            bool dcompReady = !snap.useDComp;
                            if (snap.useDComp && g_pillDCMutex.try_lock())
                            {
                                if (g_pillUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
                                    g_pillDCMutex.unlock();
                                    return;
                                }
                                PillDCompConsumeClearRequestLocked(currentTree);
                                bool preRendered = false;
                                if (!g_pillDC.valid)
                                {
                                    PillDCompInit_Locked(g_pillTreeHWND);
                                    g_pillLastValid = false;
                                }
                                dcompReady = g_pillDC.valid;
                                if (g_pillDC.valid && snap.style == 2 &&
                                    PillDCompEnsureFadeVisual_Locked())
                                {
                                    float preTop = 0.0f, preBottom = 0.0f;
                                    int preIndentPx = 0;
                                    HRESULT fadeHr =
                                        g_pillDC.pFadeOpacityEffect->SetOpacity(1.0f);
                                    if (SUCCEEDED(fadeHr) &&
                                        PillComputeTransitionFrame(snap, 0.0, false,
                                            &preTop, &preBottom, &preIndentPx) &&
                                        preBottom > preTop)
                                    {
                                        preRendered = PillDCompDrawFrame_Locked(
                                            preTop, preBottom,
                                            g_pillLastVTop, g_pillLastVBot,
                                            g_pillLastValid, snap.scale, 0.0f,
                                            false, false, preIndentPx,
                                            snap, snap.useGradient, false);
                                        if (preRendered) {
                                            g_pillLastVTop = preTop;
                                            g_pillLastVBot = preBottom;
                                            g_pillLastValid = true;
                                            g_pillDC.fadePhase = 0;
                                            g_pillDC.fadeOpacity = 1.0f;
                                        }
                                    }
                                    dcompReady = preRendered;
                                }
                                else if (g_pillDC.valid &&
                                         (snap.style == 3 || snap.style == 4))
                                {
                                    DOUBLE preT =
                                        (snap.blindKind == 3 ||
                                         snap.blindKind == 4) ? 0.001 : 0.0;
                                    float preTop = 0.0f, preBottom = 0.0f;
                                    int preIndentPx = 0;
                                    if (PillComputeTransitionFrame(snap, preT, false,
                                            &preTop, &preBottom, &preIndentPx) &&
                                        preBottom > preTop)
                                    {
                                        preRendered = PillDCompDrawFrame_Locked(preTop, preBottom,
                                            g_pillLastVTop, g_pillLastVBot, g_pillLastValid,
                                            snap.scale, (float)preT, false, !snap.noClip, preIndentPx,
                                            snap, snap.useGradient, false);
                                        if (preRendered) {
                                            g_pillLastVTop = preTop;
                                            g_pillLastVBot = preBottom;
                                            g_pillLastValid = true;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                else if (g_pillDC.valid && snap.style == 1)
                                {
                                    // Keep the outgoing indicator's exact
                                    // interrupted state visible during the
                                    // structural hold. The incoming indicator
                                    // starts only when the motion phase begins.
                                    PillDCompEnsureFadeVisual_Locked();
                                    HRESULT resetHr = g_pillDC.pFadeOpacityEffect
                                        ? g_pillDC.pFadeOpacityEffect->SetOpacity(1.0f)
                                        : S_OK;
                                    PillTransitionSnapshot holdSnap = snap;
                                    holdSnap.incomingStartOpacity = 0.0f;
                                    float preTop = 0.0f;
                                    float preBottom = 0.0f;
                                    int preIndentPx = 0;
                                    if (SUCCEEDED(resetHr) &&
                                        PillComputeTransitionFrame(
                                            holdSnap, 0.0, false, &preTop,
                                            &preBottom, &preIndentPx) &&
                                        preBottom > preTop) {
                                        preRendered = PillDCompDrawFrame_Locked(
                                            preTop, preBottom,
                                            g_pillLastVTop, g_pillLastVBot,
                                            g_pillLastValid, snap.scale, 0.0f,
                                            false, false, preIndentPx,
                                            holdSnap,
                                            snap.useGradient, false);
                                        if (preRendered) {
                                            g_pillLastVTop = preTop;
                                            g_pillLastVBot = preBottom;
                                            // Force the first native ListView
                                            // cross-fade frame to clear the held
                                            // source before drawing both parts.
                                            g_pillLastValid = false;
                                        }
                                    }
                                    dcompReady = preRendered;
                                }
                                if (!preRendered && !isFirstEver &&
                                    g_pillDC.valid && g_pillDC.contentAttached && g_pillDC.pDComp)
                                {
                                    g_pillDC.pDComp->Commit();
                                }
                                // The tree's current WM_PAINT removes the old
                                // static GDI pill when it returns. For a held
                                // transition, wait until the committed DComp
                                // copy reaches DWM first, making the handoff
                                // atomic. DwmFlush can block unboundedly, so it
                                // must run after the unlock below so it can't
                                // block the animation thread's try_lock on this
                                // same mutex -- the commit it waits for already
                                // happened under the lock, so this only changes
                                // who it can block, not what it waits for.
                                bool needDwmFlush = preRendered && snap.holdDuration > 0.0;
                                g_pillDCMutex.unlock();
                                if (needDwmFlush)
                                    DwmFlush();
                            }
                            else if (snap.useDComp)
                            {
                                // The worker already retries this mutex without
                                // blocking the UI thread. Preserve the new
                                // generation and let it commit t=0 before the
                                // structural hold instead of dropping the
                                // transition when an older frame owns the lock.
                                snap.deferDCompPreparation =
                                    snap.holdDuration > 0.0;
                                dcompReady = true;
                            }
                            if (dcompReady) {
                                if (snap.holdDuration > 0.0)
                                    snap.startTime = TimerGetSeconds();
                                PillPublishTransitionSnapshot(snap);
                                bool activated = false;
                                if (snap.useDComp) {
                                    PillEnsureThreadStarted();
                                    activated = PillActivateTransition(
                                        snap.generation);
                                } else {
                                    activated = PillActivateGdiTransition(
                                        currentTree, snap.generation);
                                }
                                if (!activated) {
                                    if (snap.useDComp) {
                                        PillCancelForGeometryChange(currentTree);
                                        return;
                                    }
                                    // PillActivateGdiTransition already erased
                                    // the failed snapshot. Fall through so this
                                    // paint produces the resting static pill.
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // ── Draw static GDI pill slice ────────────────────────────────
            // Skip the GDI slice only while a DComp overlay is actively
            // rendering the pill (g_pillTimer > 0); GDI is the permanent
            // renderer otherwise. Both gated on ownsSharedState: g_pillTimer/
            // g_pillDC* belong to whichever tree currently owns the shared
            // state, so a non-owning tree always takes the plain resting
            // path instead of reading them as its own animation.
            bool dcompAnimating = ownsSharedState && isDCompStyle && g_pillTimer &&
                                    g_pillDCValid.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
                                    g_pillDCContentAttached.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
            if (currentTreeContext > 0 && !dcompAnimating &&
                !suppressDropStatic)
            {
                // g_pillItemH is the owner's row height (see above); a
                // non-owning tree uses its own freshly-measured row instead.
                float h2 = ownsSharedState ? (float)g_pillItemH : (float)itemH;
                float halfPad = NavPillHalfPad(h2, scale);
                float vTop, vBottom;
                // File-picker GDI animation: recalculate the selected item's
                // incoming indicator from the UI-thread timer snapshot. The
                // outgoing item is added in TreeView item post-paint.
                bool isGDIAnimating = ownsSharedState &&
                    (animStyle != 0 && g_pillTimer && !dcompAnimating);
                int  gdiIndentPx = 0;
                float gdiFadeOpacity = 1.0f;
                float gdiPillOpacity = 1.0f;
                PillTransitionSnapshot gdiSnap;
                if (isGDIAnimating)
                {
                    gdiSnap = PillReadTransitionSnapshot();
                    DOUBLE totalDur2 = PillTransitionDuration(gdiSnap);
                    DOUBLE motionElapsed2 =
                        TimerGetSeconds() - gdiSnap.startTime -
                        gdiSnap.holdDuration;
                    DOUBLE animT2 = motionElapsed2 / totalDur2;
                    if (animT2 < 0.0) animT2 = 0.0;
                    if (animT2 > 1.0) animT2 = 1.0;
                    if (gdiSnap.style == 1 || gdiSnap.style == 4) {
                        PillNativeMotionFrame nativeFrame{};
                        bool frameValid = gdiSnap.style == 1
                            ? PillComputeListViewExpandFrame(
                                gdiSnap, animT2, true, &nativeFrame)
                            : PillComputeNativeMotionFrame(
                                gdiSnap, animT2, true, &nativeFrame);
                        if (frameValid &&
                            nativeFrame.incoming.valid)
                        {
                            vTop = nativeFrame.incoming.top;
                            vBottom = nativeFrame.incoming.bottom;
                            gdiIndentPx = nativeFrame.incoming.indentPx;
                            gdiPillOpacity = nativeFrame.incoming.opacity;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            // At t=0 the native incoming indicator is still
                            // collapsed. Keep this item-scoped fallback empty
                            // instead of flashing the final resting pill.
                            vTop = (float)pRect->top;
                            vBottom = vTop;
                            gdiIndentPx = gdiSnap.curIndentPx;
                        }
                    }
                    else if (!PillComputeTransitionFrame(
                                 gdiSnap, animT2, false,
                                 &vTop, &vBottom, &gdiIndentPx))
                    {
                        vTop = (float)pRect->top + halfPad;
                        vBottom = (float)pRect->top + h2 - halfPad;
                        gdiIndentPx = 0;
                    }
                    if (gdiSnap.style == 2) {
                        vTop = (float)pRect->top + halfPad;
                        vBottom = (float)pRect->top + h2 - halfPad;
                        gdiIndentPx = 0;
                        gdiFadeOpacity = EaseInOutCubic(animT2);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    // pRect->top rather than g_pillCurTop: for the owning tree
                    // they're always equal here (see "Detect position change"
                    // above), and pRect->top is also the only one that's
                    // correct when this is a different, non-owning tree's own
                    // selected-item paint (g_pillCurTop then belongs to
                    // whichever tree does own the shared state).
                    vTop    = (float)pRect->top + halfPad;
                    vBottom = (float)pRect->top + h2 - halfPad;
                }

                bool gdiFadeHandled = false;
                if (isGDIAnimating && animStyle == 2) {
                    gdiFadeHandled = PillDrawGdiFade(
                        hdc, (float)pRect->top, scale, gdiSnap.itemH,
                        gdiIndentPx, gdiSnap.useGradient, gdiFadeOpacity);
                    if (!gdiFadeHandled) {
                        vTop = (float)pRect->top + halfPad;
                        vBottom = (float)pRect->top + h2 - halfPad;
                    }
                }

                if (!gdiFadeHandled) {
                float iTop    = (float)pRect->top;
                float iBottom = (float)pRect->bottom;
                float clipTop    = vTop    < iTop    ? iTop    : vTop;
                float clipBottom = vBottom > iBottom ? iBottom : vBottom;

                if (clipBottom - clipTop >= 0.5f)
                {
                    float localTop    = clipTop    - iTop;
                    float localBottom = clipBottom - iTop;

                    ID2D1DCRenderTarget* pRT = PillGetCachedRT(hdc, pRect);
                    D2DThreadCache* pillCache = pRT ? D2DGetThreadCache(false) : nullptr;
                    if (pRT && pillCache)
                    {
                        float pillW = NavPillWidth(scale);
                        // Horizontal inset for nested items (winui_top style
                        // only): gdiIndentPx while the picker GDI animation is
                        // animating, or a fresh measurement otherwise. Resting
                        // lookup cached by (tree, item, scale, item count) since
                        // this runs on every idle repaint of the selected row.
                        // Item count is included because comctl32 can reuse an
                        // HTREEITEM's pointer value after a tree rebuild (e.g.
                        // F5) -- without it, a same-looking key would keep
                        // returning a stale indent indefinitely.
                        static HWND      s_pillNestCacheHwnd     = nullptr;
                        static HTREEITEM s_pillNestCacheItem     = nullptr;
                        static float     s_pillNestCacheScale    = 0.0f;
                        static int       s_pillNestCacheCount    = -1;
                        static int       s_pillNestCacheIndentPx = 0;
                        int indentPx = 0;
                        if (isGDIAnimating)
                        {
                            indentPx = gdiIndentPx;
                        }
                        else if (ownsSharedState && PillAnimStyle() == 4)
                        {
                            // g_pillCurItem belongs to the owning tree -- a
                            // non-owning tree has no business reading it, so
                            // it just gets indentPx=0 (a plain, non-inset
                            // pill) rather than a computation from someone
                            // else's current selection.
                            HTREEITEM curHItem = (HTREEITEM)g_pillCurItem;
                            if (curHItem)
                            {
                                int curCount = (int)SendMessageW(g_pillTreeHWND, TVM_GETCOUNT, 0, 0);
                                if (g_pillTreeHWND == s_pillNestCacheHwnd &&
                                    curHItem == s_pillNestCacheItem &&
                                    scale == s_pillNestCacheScale &&
                                    curCount == s_pillNestCacheCount)
                                {
                                    indentPx = s_pillNestCacheIndentPx;
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    int unusedDepth = 0;
                                    PillItemNestInfo(g_pillTreeHWND, curHItem, &unusedDepth, &indentPx);
                                    s_pillNestCacheHwnd     = g_pillTreeHWND;
                                    s_pillNestCacheItem     = curHItem;
                                    s_pillNestCacheScale    = scale;
                                    s_pillNestCacheCount    = curCount;
                                    s_pillNestCacheIndentPx = indentPx;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        float pillX = NAV_PILL_X_DIP * scale +
                            (float)indentPx;

                        D2D1_COLOR_F pillColor = GetAccentIndicatorD2D();
                        if (useStaticDropColor) {
                            pillColor = IsHwndDarkMode(currentTree)
                                ? D2D1::ColorF(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 0.38f)
                                : D2D1::ColorF(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.30f);
                        }

                        if (g_settings.AccentGradients && !useStaticDropColor)
                        {
                            // Inline gradient: AccentBase at bottom, accent at top.
                            // Cached brush/stops (avoid recreating both per frame);
                            // GetCachedAccentBase/GetAccentIndicator avoid a
                            // registry read per frame too. Position still moves
                            // every frame via SetStartPoint/SetEndPoint.
                            COLORREF baseC = GetCachedAccentBase();
                            COLORREF indC  = GetAccentIndicator();
                            bool gradColorsChanged = (pillCache->pillSliceGradBaseClr != baseC ||
                                                       pillCache->pillSliceGradIndClr  != indC);
                            if (!pillCache->pillSliceGradBrush || pillCache->pillSliceGradRT != pRT || gradColorsChanged)
                            {
                                if (pillCache->pillSliceGradBrush) { pillCache->pillSliceGradBrush->Release(); pillCache->pillSliceGradBrush = nullptr; }
                                if (pillCache->pillSliceGradStops) { pillCache->pillSliceGradStops->Release(); pillCache->pillSliceGradStops = nullptr; }
                                D2D1_GRADIENT_STOP stops[2] = {
                                    { 0.0f, D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(baseC)/255.f, GetGValue(baseC)/255.f, GetBValue(baseC)/255.f) },
                                    { 1.0f, D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(indC)/255.f, GetGValue(indC)/255.f, GetBValue(indC)/255.f) }
                                };
                                pRT->CreateGradientStopCollection(stops, 2, &pillCache->pillSliceGradStops);
                                if (pillCache->pillSliceGradStops) {
                                    pRT->CreateLinearGradientBrush(
                                        D2D1::LinearGradientBrushProperties(
                                            D2D1::Point2F(pillX, localBottom),
                                            D2D1::Point2F(pillX, localTop)),
                                        pillCache->pillSliceGradStops, &pillCache->pillSliceGradBrush);
                                }
                                pillCache->pillSliceGradRT      = pRT;
                                pillCache->pillSliceGradBaseClr = baseC;
                                pillCache->pillSliceGradIndClr  = indC;
                            }
                            else if (pillCache->pillSliceGradBrush)
                            {
                                pillCache->pillSliceGradBrush->SetStartPoint(D2D1::Point2F(pillX, localBottom));
                                pillCache->pillSliceGradBrush->SetEndPoint(D2D1::Point2F(pillX, localTop));
                            }
                            if (pillCache->pillSliceGradBrush)
                            {
                                pillCache->pillSliceGradBrush->SetOpacity(gdiPillOpacity);
                                const D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE previousAntialias =
                                    pRT->GetAntialiasMode();
                                pRT->BeginDraw();
                                pRT->SetAntialiasMode(
                                    D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_PER_PRIMITIVE);
                                pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                                    D2D1::RoundedRect(
                                        D2D1::RectF(pillX, localTop, pillX+pillW, localBottom),
                                        NavPillRadius(scale, pillW),
                                        NavPillRadius(scale, pillW)),
                                    pillCache->pillSliceGradBrush);
                                pRT->SetAntialiasMode(previousAntialias);
                                HRESULT hr = pRT->EndDraw();
                                pillCache->pillSliceGradBrush->SetOpacity(1.0f);
                                if (hr == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET)
                                {
                                    if (pillCache->pillSliceGradBrush) { pillCache->pillSliceGradBrush->Release(); pillCache->pillSliceGradBrush = nullptr; }
                                    if (pillCache->pillSliceGradStops) { pillCache->pillSliceGradStops->Release(); pillCache->pillSliceGradStops = nullptr; }
                                    pillCache->pillSliceGradRT = nullptr;
                                    CachedRTRecreate(pillCache->pillRT);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            // Solid — use cached brush (avoid recreate per frame)
                            ID2D1SolidColorBrush*& solidBrush = useStaticDropColor
                                ? pillCache->pillSliceDropBrush : pillCache->pillSliceBrush;
                            ID2D1DCRenderTarget*& solidBrushRT = useStaticDropColor
                                ? pillCache->pillSliceDropBrushRT : pillCache->pillSliceBrushRT;
                            D2D1_COLOR_F& solidBrushColor = useStaticDropColor
                                ? pillCache->pillSliceDropBrushClr : pillCache->pillSliceBrushClr;
                            bool clrChanged =
                                solidBrushColor.r != pillColor.r ||
                                solidBrushColor.g != pillColor.g ||
                                solidBrushColor.b != pillColor.b ||
                                solidBrushColor.a != pillColor.a;
                            if (!solidBrush || solidBrushRT != pRT || clrChanged)
                            {
                                if (solidBrush) {
                                    solidBrush->Release();
                                    solidBrush = nullptr;
                                }
                                pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(pillColor, &solidBrush);
                                solidBrushRT = pRT;
                                solidBrushColor = pillColor;
                            }
                            if (solidBrush)
                            {
                                solidBrush->SetOpacity(gdiPillOpacity);
                                const D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE previousAntialias =
                                    pRT->GetAntialiasMode();
                                pRT->BeginDraw();
                                pRT->SetAntialiasMode(
                                    D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_PER_PRIMITIVE);
                                pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                                    D2D1::RoundedRect(
                                        D2D1::RectF(pillX, localTop, pillX+pillW, localBottom),
                                        NavPillRadius(scale, pillW),
                                        NavPillRadius(scale, pillW)),
                                    solidBrush);
                                pRT->SetAntialiasMode(previousAntialias);
                                HRESULT hr = pRT->EndDraw();
                                solidBrush->SetOpacity(1.0f);
                                if (hr == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET)
                                {
                                    if (solidBrush) {
                                        solidBrush->Release();
                                        solidBrush = nullptr;
                                        solidBrushRT = nullptr;
                                    }
                                    CachedRTRecreate(pillCache->pillRT);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                }
            }

            // ── 4-frame GDI/DComp handoff countdown ───────────────────────
            // After animation ends, DComp overlay is still visible for up to
            // N GDI frames before being cleared. Decrement the counter each
            // frame GDI draws the pill; clear DComp when counter hits 0.
            if (isDCompStyle && !g_pillTimer)
            {
                int cnt = g_pillDCClearPending.load();
                if (cnt > 0)
                {
                    if (g_pillDCClearPending.fetch_sub(1) == 1) // last decrement
                    {
                        if (g_pillDCMutex.try_lock())
                        {
                            PillDCompHide_Locked();
                            g_pillDCMutex.unlock();
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            // Retry next frame
                            g_pillDCClearPending.store(1);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

}
// ============================================================================
// SetWindowTheme hook — early exit + redirect for ListView/TreeView
// ============================================================================
// Prevents the system or other code from overriding our dark theme on
// ListView/TreeView controls. When dark mode is active, redirects to
// DarkMode_Explorer (Explorer) or Explorer (non-Explorer). Repeated requests
// for known system themes are ignored when the HWND already has that theme.
// Adapted from Reabstraction's "Fix Darkmode ListViews and TreeViews".

static decltype(&SetWindowTheme) SetWindowTheme_orig = nullptr;

static constexpr LPCWSTR kAppliedThemeProp = L"Win32UIModernizer.AppliedTheme";

static int GetKnownThemeId(LPCWSTR pszSubAppName)
{
    if (!pszSubAppName) return 1;
    if (pszSubAppName[0] == L'\0') return 2;
    if (_wcsicmp(pszSubAppName, L"Explorer") == 0) return 3;
    if (_wcsicmp(pszSubAppName, L"DarkMode_Explorer") == 0) return 4;
    if (_wcsicmp(pszSubAppName, L"DarkMode_CFD") == 0) return 5;
    if (_wcsicmp(pszSubAppName, L"DarkMode_ItemsView") == 0) return 6;
    return 0;
}

static int GetKnownSubId(LPCWSTR pszSubIdList)
{
    if (!pszSubIdList) return 1;
    if (pszSubIdList[0] == L'\0') return 2;
    return 0;
}

static UINT_PTR GetKnownThemeSignature(LPCWSTR pszSubAppName, LPCWSTR pszSubIdList)
{
    int themeId = GetKnownThemeId(pszSubAppName);
    int subId = GetKnownSubId(pszSubIdList);
    if (!themeId || !subId) return 0;
    return ((UINT_PTR)themeId << 8) | (UINT_PTR)subId;
}

static bool IsKnownWindowThemeApplied(HWND hwnd, LPCWSTR pszSubAppName, LPCWSTR pszSubIdList)
{
    if (!hwnd) return false;
    UINT_PTR sig = GetKnownThemeSignature(pszSubAppName, pszSubIdList);
    return sig && (UINT_PTR)GetPropW(hwnd, kAppliedThemeProp) == sig;
}

static HRESULT SetKnownWindowThemeOnce(HWND hwnd, LPCWSTR pszSubAppName, LPCWSTR pszSubIdList)
{
    UINT_PTR sig = GetKnownThemeSignature(pszSubAppName, pszSubIdList);
    if (!hwnd)
        return SetWindowTheme_orig(hwnd, pszSubAppName, pszSubIdList);

    if (IsKnownWindowThemeApplied(hwnd, pszSubAppName, pszSubIdList))
        return S_OK;

    HRESULT hr = SetWindowTheme_orig(hwnd, pszSubAppName, pszSubIdList);
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) {
        if (sig)
            SetPropW(hwnd, kAppliedThemeProp, (HANDLE)sig);
        else
            RemovePropW(hwnd, kAppliedThemeProp);
    }
    return hr;
}

static HRESULT SetExplorerFamilyTheme(HWND hwnd, LPCWSTR pszSubIdList)
{
    // Outside Explorer we don't own this window's theming -- GetWindowTheme
    // returns non-NULL only once SetWindowTheme has actually been called on
    // it (by us or by the app itself; a control that simply renders with
    // ambient manifest visual styles but never had SetWindowTheme called on
    // it still reports NULL here). If the app's own skinning engine already
    // asserted a theme, leave it alone instead of overriding it.
    if (!IsCurrentProcessExplorer() && hwnd && GetWindowTheme(hwnd) != nullptr)
        return S_FALSE;

    return SetKnownWindowThemeOnce(
        hwnd,
        (g_darkModeActive && IsCurrentProcessExplorer()) ? L"DarkMode_Explorer" : L"Explorer",
        pszSubIdList);
}

static HRESULT SetDarkExplorerOrDefaultTheme(HWND hwnd)
{
    return SetKnownWindowThemeOnce(
        hwnd,
        (g_darkModeActive && IsCurrentProcessExplorer()) ? L"DarkMode_Explorer" : nullptr,
        nullptr);
}

static HRESULT SetItemsViewOrDefaultTheme(HWND hwnd)
{
    return SetKnownWindowThemeOnce(
        hwnd,
        (g_darkModeActive && IsCurrentProcessExplorer()) ? L"DarkMode_ItemsView" : nullptr,
        nullptr);
}

HRESULT WINAPI SetWindowTheme_hook(HWND hwnd, LPCWSTR pszSubAppName, LPCWSTR pszSubIdList)
{
    // Early exit for themes we apply repeatedly from several paths. Skipping
    // identical SetWindowTheme calls avoids duplicate WM_THEMECHANGED cascades
    // while leaving DrawTheme/custom-draw hooks untouched.
    if (GetKnownThemeSignature(pszSubAppName, pszSubIdList)) {
        return SetKnownWindowThemeOnce(hwnd, pszSubAppName, pszSubIdList);
    }

    // Redirect ListView/TreeView to Explorer-family themes. In light mode the
    // plain Explorer theme gives the modern hover/selection metrics without
    // changing colors; in dark Explorer we keep DarkMode_Explorer. Scoped to
    // IsCurrentProcessExplorer() only -- forcing this on a third-party
    // process's own ListView/TreeView (e.g. Revo Uninstaller Pro) caused a
    // SetWindowTheme/WM_THEMECHANGED reentrancy hang there.
    if (hwnd && !g_darkModeExcluded && IsCurrentProcessExplorer()) {
        wchar_t cls[64] = {};
        GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, 64);
        if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"SysListView32") == 0 ||
            _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTreeView32") == 0) {
            return SetExplorerFamilyTheme(hwnd, pszSubIdList);
        }
    }

    HRESULT hr = SetWindowTheme_orig(hwnd, pszSubAppName, pszSubIdList);
    if (hwnd && SUCCEEDED(hr))
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kAppliedThemeProp);
    return hr;
}

// ============================================================================
// DrawThemeBackground hooks
// ============================================================================

static decltype(&DrawThemeBackgroundEx) DrawThemeBackgroundEx_orig = nullptr;

// DUI Header column separator — an opaque #929292 pixel column in light mode; the
// established dark GDI line remains unchanged.
// Our own flat FillRect below replaces the native bitmap art (baked
// BGTYPE=IMAGEFILE, no FILLCOLOR to recolor instead), which erases the
// native column dividers along with it — redraw one by hand per
// HP_HEADERITEM column so the boundaries stay visible.
static void DrawDuiHeaderItemDivider(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!hdc || !pRect)
        return;

    const int width = pRect->right - pRect->left;
    const int height = pRect->bottom - pRect->top;
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
        return;

    int top = 0;
    int bottom = height;
    if (IsExplorerShellHost(hdc)) {
        const int margin = height / 4;
        top += margin;
        bottom -= margin;
    }

    const bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    if (!dark) {
        // Opaque pixels: a GDI pen leaves alpha 0, which DWM adds to the
        // backdrop and washes the gray out over Mica.
        const int x = std::max(pRect->left, pRect->right - 2);
        const RECT line = { x, pRect->top + top, x + 1, pRect->top + bottom };
        WriteExplorerMicaPixels(hdc, line, 0xFF929292u);
        return;
    }

    const COLORREF color = RGB(55, 55, 55);
    HPEN hPen = CreatePen(PS_SOLID, 1, color);
    if (!hPen) return;
    HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(hdc, hPen);
    // Explorer, dialogs it opens, and file-picker windows keep the short,
    // vertically-centered line; everywhere else (MMC consoles, other
    // third-party DirectUI hosts) it spans the header's full height instead.
    // Both variants sit 1px further left than before (right - 2, not - 1).
    const int x = pRect->right - 2;
    MoveToEx(hdc, x, pRect->top + top, nullptr);
    LineTo(hdc, x, pRect->top + bottom);
    SelectObject(hdc, old);
    DeleteObject(hPen);
}

// Replaces the RBS_BANDBORDERS style stripped from MMC's rebar at window-
// creation time (see NtUserCreateWindowEx_hook) with a single modern
// hairline, same color convention as DrawEdge_hook's own separator
// replacement, instead of comctl32's thicker native top+bottom band border.
// (Explorer's own rebar divider is unrelated -- see the bottom DrawLine in
// PaintExplorerRebarMicaTintRect instead.)
static void DrawRebarBandLine(HDC hdc, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    HPEN hPen = CreatePen(PS_SOLID, 1, RGB(48, 48, 48));
    if (!hPen) return;
    HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(hdc, hPen);
    MoveToEx(hdc, pRect->left, pRect->bottom - 1, nullptr);
    LineTo(hdc, pRect->right, pRect->bottom - 1);
    SelectObject(hdc, old);
    DeleteObject(hPen);
}

// TaskDialog panels laid out like WinUI's ContentDialog (ContentDialog.xaml /
// _themeresources.xaml): the content on ContentDialogTopOverlay
// (LayerFillColorAlt over the base), the command band on
// ContentDialogBackground (SolidBackgroundFillColorBase), and a one-DIP
// ContentDialogSeparatorBorderBrush (CardStrokeColorDefault) at the
// content's bottom edge. The separator composes over the band's background
// (the content grid's InnerBorderEdge sizing), so it is drawn as the band's
// first row. WinUI has no footnote area; it continues the band. Light
// leaves the content to the theme, which is already white.
static bool PaintTaskDialogPanel(HDC hdc, int partId, LPCRECT rc, bool dark)
{
    const COLORREF base = WinUI::SolidBackgroundFillColorBase(dark);
    COLORREF fill;
    switch (partId) {
    case TDLG_PRIMARYPANEL:
    case TDLG_CONTENTPANE:
        if (!dark)
            return false;
        fill = WinUI::FlattenOver(WinUI::Dark::LayerFillColorAlt, base);
        break;
    case TDLG_SECONDARYPANEL:
    case TDLG_FOOTNOTEPANE:
    case TDLG_FOOTNOTESEPARATOR:
        fill = base;
        break;
    default:
        return false;
    }
    HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(fill);
    if (!br || !rc)
        return false;
    FillRect_orig(hdc, rc, br);
    // The band starts where the content ends: the bottom of a content part or
    // the top of a band part. The Run / Create new task dialog paints
    // TDLG_CONTENTPANE over TDLG_FOOTNOTEPANE, not the primary/secondary pair.
    const bool contentPart =
        partId == TDLG_PRIMARYPANEL || partId == TDLG_CONTENTPANE;
    const bool bandPart =
        partId == TDLG_SECONDARYPANEL || partId == TDLG_FOOTNOTEPANE;
    if (dark && (contentPart || bandPart)) {
        // Only on a dialog this mod darkened; a real TaskDialog paints its
        // panels into its DirectUI child and draws its own text on them.
        HWND dialog = WindowFromDC(hdc);
        if (!dialog)
            dialog = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
        if (dialog && GetPropW(dialog, kPropertyDialogDarkModeMarker) &&
            IsClassName(dialog, L"#32770")) {
            const LONG bandTop = contentPart ? rc->bottom : rc->top;
            SetPropW(dialog, kPropTaskDialogBandTop,
                reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(bandTop) + 1));
        }
    }
    if (partId == TDLG_SECONDARYPANEL) {
        const int lineH = std::max(1, MulDiv(1, (int)DpiForPaintHdc(hdc), 96));
        const RECT line = { rc->left, rc->top, rc->right,
                            std::min(rc->bottom, rc->top + lineH) };
        if (HBRUSH lineBr = GetCachedSolidBrush(WinUI::FlattenOver(
                WinUI::CardStrokeColorDefault(dark), base)))
            FillRect_orig(hdc, &line, lineBr);
    }
    return true;
}

// Light TaskDialogs under Modern controls; a dialog that is dark on its own
// (an excluded app's) keeps its theme.
static bool PaintLightTaskDialogPanel(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, int partId,
    LPCRECT rc)
{
    // Only the band parts change in light; test the part before the class.
    return !g_darkModeActive && g_settings.RoundedButtons && rc &&
        (partId == TDLG_SECONDARYPANEL || partId == TDLG_FOOTNOTEPANE ||
         partId == TDLG_FOOTNOTESEPARATOR) &&
        GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme) == L"TaskDialog" &&
        !IsWindowDarkMode(hdc) &&
        PaintTaskDialogPanel(hdc, partId, rc, false);
}

// A column header's dark fill continues its list: a ListView's own
// background, else the host's dark surface (the shell shade in Explorer's
// views and Task Manager's DirectUI pages, the main dark shade elsewhere).
static COLORREF HeaderDarkBackground(HDC hdc)
{
    HWND hwnd = ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc);
    if (hwnd && IsClassName(hwnd, WC_HEADERW)) {
        HWND list = GetParent(hwnd);
        if (list && IsClassName(list, WC_LISTVIEWW)) {
            const COLORREF bk = static_cast<COLORREF>(
                SendMessageUnhooked(list, LVM_GETBKCOLOR, 0, 0));
            if (bk != CLR_NONE)
                return bk;
        }
    }
    return DarkBgForPaint(hwnd);
}

// The surfaces of a Control Panel page (content, banner, command areas).
static bool IsControlPanelSurfacePart(HTHEME hTheme, int iPartId)
{
    return (iPartId == CPANEL_CONTENTPANE || iPartId == CPANEL_CONTENTPANELINE ||
            iPartId == CPANEL_BANNERAREA ||
            iPartId == 5 /*CPANEL_LARGECOMMANDAREA*/ ||
            iPartId == 6 /*CPANEL_SMALLCOMMANDAREA*/) &&
        GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme) == L"ControlPanel";
}

// The line between a Control Panel page's header and its content
// (CommandModule part 10, a light gradient natively). Off the Mica backdrop
// (always in the Control Panel host) it is drawn as the WinUI divider stroke
// blended over the page, in place of the native one, with custom dark mode
// or modern controls; under Mica the post-draw CardStroke rule takes it. The
// page is dark only with custom dark mode.
static bool PaintControlPanelHeaderRule(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc,
    int iPartId, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    if (!pRect || iPartId != 10 || !IsCurrentProcessExplorer() ||
        ExplorerMicaActive())
        return false;
    const bool dark = IsCustomDarkModeAllowed();
    if ((!dark && !g_settings.RoundedButtons) ||
        GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme) != L"CommandModule")
        return false;
    BlendPremultipliedPixels(hdc, *pRect, dark ? 0x15151515u : 0x0F000000u);
    return true;
}

HRESULT WINAPI DrawThemeBackground_hook(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, INT iPartId,
    INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect, LPCRECT pClipRect)
{

    if (HandleThemeDraw(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect))
    {
        HandlePostDraw(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect);
        return S_OK;
    }
    HRESULT hr;
    {
        ThemeDrawHwndScope themeDrawScope(ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc));
        hr = DrawThemeBackground_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect, pClipRect);
    }

    // Legacy shell dropdowns (breadcrumb '>' and ViewControlClass) need the
    // native Menu part to draw first, then we cover the background/item
    // rect. Filling before the original can leave the popup visually empty
    // until hover invalidates individual rows.
    // The part and class tests come first: the window lookup behind them
    // would otherwise run on every themed draw in the process.
    const bool isPopupBg = (iPartId == 9 || iPartId == 10 || iPartId == 13);
    const bool isPopupItemNormal = ((iPartId == 14 || iPartId == 27) && iStateId != 2);
    if (pRect && (isPopupBg || isPopupItemNormal) &&
        GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme) == L"Menu") {
        HWND paintHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
        if (IsLegacyShellDropdownRoot(paintHwnd)) {
            RECT clipRect = *pRect;
            if (pClipRect)
                IntersectRect(&clipRect, pRect, pClipRect);

            if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(LegacyShellDropdownBgColor(paintHwnd)))
                FillRect(hdc, &clipRect, br);
            return S_OK;
        }
    }

    // Acrylic menu parts are handled in HandleThemeDraw above (early return
    // with FillRect BLACK before the original is ever called). No further
    // post-processing needed here for regular menus.

    if (PaintLightTaskDialogPanel(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, pRect))
        return S_OK;

    // ── Dark mode post-processing ───────────────────────────────────────
    if (g_darkModeActive && pRect) {
        const std::wstring& pcls = GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme);
        HBRUSH darkBr = GetCachedSolidBrush(GetSysColor(COLOR_WINDOW));

        // Header, TaskDialog, Status — backgrounds dark
        // NOTE: Rebar removed — breadcrumbs manage own dark mode via DarkMode_Explorer.
        // Our FillRect was covering composited breadcrumb text in file picker dialogs.
        //
        // AeroWizard (parts 2/3/4) mirrors DrawThemeBackgroundEx_hook's own
        // case below -- AeroWizard calls both the Ex and non-Ex APIs for its
        // AW_HEADERAREA/AW_CONTENTAREA/AW_COMMANDAREA depending on the code
        // path, and only the Ex twin had this case, so the non-Ex one fell
        // through to the theme's own FillColor (255,255,255) with no dark
        // override.
        if (pcls == L"TaskDialog" &&
            PaintTaskDialogPanel(hdc, iPartId, pRect, true)) {
            return S_OK;
        }
        if ((pcls == L"Header" && (iPartId == 0 /*COMMONPROPS*/ ||
                iPartId == HP_HEADERITEM))
            || (pcls == L"Status" && iPartId == 0 && iStateId == 0)
            || (pcls == L"Rebar" && (iPartId == RP_BAND || iPartId == RP_BACKGROUND) &&
                iStateId == 0 && IsCurrentProcessMMC())
            || (pcls == L"AeroWizard" && (iPartId == 2 /*AW_HEADERAREA*/ ||
                iPartId == 3 /*AW_CONTENTAREA*/ || iPartId == 4 /*AW_COMMANDAREA*/)))
        {
            if (pcls == L"Header") {
                if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(HeaderDarkBackground(hdc)))
                    FillRect(hdc, pRect, br);
            } else if (darkBr) {
                FillRect(hdc, pRect, darkBr);
            }
            if (pcls == L"Header" && iPartId == HP_HEADERITEM)
                DrawDuiHeaderItemDivider(hdc, pRect);
            if (pcls == L"Rebar")
                DrawRebarBandLine(hdc, pRect);
            return S_OK;
        }
    }

    HandlePostDraw(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect);
    return hr;
}

HRESULT WINAPI DrawThemeBackgroundEx_hook(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, INT iPartId,
    INT iStateId, LPCRECT pRect, const DTBGOPTS* pOptions)
{

    if (HandleThemeDraw(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect))
    {
        HandlePostDraw(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect);
        return S_OK;
    }
    if (PaintControlPanelHeaderRule(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, pRect))
        return S_OK;
    HRESULT hr;
    {
        ThemeDrawHwndScope themeDrawScope(ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc));
        hr = DrawThemeBackgroundEx_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect, pOptions);
    }

    // Acrylic menu parts handled in HandleThemeDraw above — no post step here.

    // Header hot/pressed → semi-transparent accent color (AccentColorize, both modes)
    if (g_settings.AccentColorize && pRect) {
        const std::wstring& hcls = GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme);
        if (hcls == L"Header" && iPartId == HP_HEADERITEM) {
            bool isHot = (iStateId == HIS_HOT || iStateId == 5 || iStateId == 8);
            bool isPressed = (iStateId == HIS_PRESSED || iStateId == 6 || iStateId == 9);
            if (isHot || isPressed) {
                if (g_accentCacheDirty.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) RefreshAccentCache();
                bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
                COLORREF acClr = GetAccentFromPalette(dark ? (isPressed ? 4 : 8) : (isPressed ? 16 : 12));
                BYTE alpha = dark ? (isPressed ? 180 : 80)
                                 : (isPressed ? 60 : 25);
                if (dark) FillRect(hdc, pRect, GetSysColorBrush(COLOR_BTNFACE));
                BITMAPINFO bmi = {};
                bmi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
                bmi.bmiHeader.biWidth = 1; bmi.bmiHeader.biHeight = 1;
                bmi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1; bmi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
                void* bits = nullptr;
                HDC memDC = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
                HBITMAP dib = CreateDIBSection(memDC, &bmi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
                if (dib && bits) {
                    HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(memDC, dib);
                    BYTE* px = (BYTE*)bits;
