// What started a layout transaction: a TV_Expand call, a host
// WM_SETREDRAW(FALSE)..(TRUE) batch, or item inserts/deletes (which use the
// add/delete motion). Only an expansion overrides a pending item change.
enum class TransactionKind { Expand, HostBatch, ItemChange };

struct AnimState {
    TreeCapture b;
    TreeCapture a;
    Dib frame;
    LayoutDiff d;
    std::uint32_t background = 0;
    bool expand = true;   // inserted rows outnumber removed rows
    bool slide = true;
    bool fadeIn = false;  // inserted rows fade in
    bool fadeOut = false; // removed rows fade out
    float scaleFrom = 1.0f;  // row size at the start/end of the fade (1 = no scaling)
    int dirtyTop = 0;
    float pushMs = 0.0f;
    float pushDelayMs = 0.0f;
    float fadeMs = 0.0f;
    float fadeDelayMs = 0.0f;
    CubicBezier pushEase = kPushEase;
    LARGE_INTEGER start{};
    LARGE_INTEGER frequency{};
    float lastRefreshMs = -1000.0f;  // last live re-render of the anchor row
    float refreshPeriodMs = 16.0f;   // one display frame, at most ~75 Hz
    float frameElapsedMs = 0.0f;     // timeline position the next paint composes
    bool refreshDue = false;         // re-render the anchor row on the next paint
    bool composedOnce = false;       // rows above dirtyTop are final after frame 0
    bool tickPaint = false;          // the paint comes from AnimTick's own repaint
};

// Per-tree bookkeeping: the running animation, a capture waiting for the end
// of a WM_SETREDRAW(FALSE)..(TRUE) bracket, and the bracket nesting depth.
struct TreeState {
    AnimState* anim = nullptr;
    std::unique_ptr<TreeCapture> pending;
    std::uint32_t pendingBackground = 0;
    TransactionKind pendingKind = TransactionKind::Expand;
    bool pendingMerged = false;  // pending started from the running animation
    ULONGLONG pendingSince = 0;  // GetTickCount64 when `pending` was taken
    WPARAM pendingSerial = 0;    // identifies `pending` to a posted end-of-batch
    int bracketDepth = 0;
    int itemChangeDepth = 0;     // inside TVM_INSERTITEM/TVM_DELETEITEM processing
    // A capture in progress: the next WM_PAINT renders the tree into
    // `captureTarget` and shows `captureDisplay` (or the capture) on screen.
    Dib* captureTarget = nullptr;
    const Dib* captureDisplay = nullptr;
    bool captured = false;
};

// Other mods identify the painting window from BeginPaint (thread-local
// "current paint hwnd"), so captures go through a real WM_PAINT: the subclass
// renders the tree into the DIB inside BeginPaint/EndPaint and puts
// `display` (or the fresh capture) back on screen, so nothing visibly changes.
static bool CaptureTree(HWND tree, TreeState& ts, std::uint32_t background, Dib& out,
                        const Dib* display) {
    ts.captureTarget = &out;
    ts.captureDisplay = display;
    ts.captured = false;
    RedrawWindow(tree, nullptr, nullptr,
                 RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_NOERASE | RDW_NOCHILDREN | RDW_UPDATENOW);
    ts.captureTarget = nullptr;
    ts.captureDisplay = nullptr;
    if (ts.captured) return out.Valid();
    // No paint arrived (e.g. the window isn't visible): render directly.
    return RenderTreeInto(tree, background, out);
}

// Keeps the screen unchanged while a transaction is pending for at most this
// long; after that a lost end-of-batch message must not freeze the tree.
static constexpr ULONGLONG kPendingFreezeMs = 1000;

static std::mutex g_treesMutex;
static std::unordered_set<HWND> g_trackedTrees;  // trees carrying TreeSubclassProc + TreeState
static thread_local unsigned g_expandDepth = 0;
static thread_local int g_ownRedraw = 0;  // WM_SETREDRAW sent by this mod

static TreeState* GetTreeState(HWND tree) {
    return reinterpret_cast<TreeState*>(GetPropW(tree, kStateProp));
}

// ─── Frame pacing worker ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// One thread paces every running animation: while any is active it wakes on
// each compositor clock tick (Windows 11, Explorer only, like the rest of
// dcomp), or else at ~75% of the monitor frame period, and posts
// FrameMessage() to the tree, which composes and paints on its own thread; a
// frame is only posted once the previous one was consumed, so the queue never
// backs up. Idle, it blocks on the wake event. Held as a pointer: a value-type
// global thread would abort the host at process exit, where Wh_ModUninit never
// runs.

struct ActiveAnim {
    DWORD sleepMs = 4;
    bool framePosted = false;
};

static std::mutex g_workerMutex;
static std::unordered_map<HWND, ActiveAnim> g_activeAnims;
static std::thread* g_workerThread = nullptr;
static HANDLE g_workerWake = nullptr;
static std::atomic<bool> g_workerStop{false};

static DWORD FrameSleepMsForWindow(HWND hwnd) {
    HMONITOR monitor = MonitorFromWindow(hwnd, MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST);
    MONITORINFOEXW mi{};
    mi.cbSize = sizeof(mi);
    if (monitor && GetMonitorInfoW(monitor, &mi)) {
        DEVMODEW dm{};
        dm.dmSize = sizeof(dm);
        if (EnumDisplaySettingsW(mi.szDevice, ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS, &dm) &&
            dm.dmDisplayFrequency >= 24) {
            return std::max<DWORD>(2, static_cast<DWORD>(750.0 / dm.dmDisplayFrequency));
        }
    }
    return 4;
}

static void FrameWorker() {
    const bool clock = CompositorClockAvailable();
    bool resolutionRaised = false;
    for (;;) {
        DWORD sleepMs = INFINITE;
        std::vector<HWND> toPost;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_workerMutex);
            if (g_workerStop.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) break;
            for (auto& [hwnd, active] : g_activeAnims) {
                sleepMs = std::min(sleepMs, active.sleepMs);
                if (!active.framePosted) {
                    active.framePosted = true;
                    toPost.push_back(hwnd);
                }
            }
        }
        const bool busy = sleepMs != INFINITE;
        if (busy && !clock && !resolutionRaised)
            resolutionRaised = timeBeginPeriod(1) == TIMERR_NOERROR;
        if (!busy && resolutionRaised) {
            timeEndPeriod(1);
            resolutionRaised = false;
        }
        for (HWND hwnd : toPost) {
            if (!PostMessageW(hwnd, FrameMessage(), 0, 0)) {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_workerMutex);
                g_activeAnims.erase(hwnd);
            }
        }
        if (busy && WaitForCompositorFrame(g_workerWake, 100))
            continue;
        WaitForSingleObject(g_workerWake, sleepMs);
    }
    if (resolutionRaised) timeEndPeriod(1);
}

static bool StartFramePacing(HWND tree) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_workerMutex);
    if (g_workerStop.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return false;
    if (!g_workerWake) {
        g_workerWake = CreateEventW(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr);
        if (!g_workerWake) return false;
    }
    if (!g_workerThread) {
        try {
            g_workerThread = new std::thread(FrameWorker);
        } catch (...) {
            g_workerThread = nullptr;
            return false;
        }
    }
    g_activeAnims[tree] = ActiveAnim{FrameSleepMsForWindow(tree), false};
    SetEvent(g_workerWake);
    return true;
}

static void StopFramePacing(HWND tree) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_workerMutex);
    g_activeAnims.erase(tree);
    if (g_workerWake) SetEvent(g_workerWake);
}

// Called on the tree's thread once a posted frame message arrives.
static void FrameConsumed(HWND tree) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_workerMutex);
    auto it = g_activeAnims.find(tree);
    if (it != g_activeAnims.end()) it->second.framePosted = false;
}

static void ShutdownFrameWorker() {
    std::thread* worker = nullptr;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_workerMutex);
        g_workerStop.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        g_activeAnims.clear();
        worker = g_workerThread;
        g_workerThread = nullptr;
        if (g_workerWake) SetEvent(g_workerWake);
    }
    if (worker) {
        if (worker->joinable()) worker->join();
        delete worker;
    }
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_workerMutex);
    if (g_workerWake) {
        CloseHandle(g_workerWake);
        g_workerWake = nullptr;
    }
}

// Drops the running animation without repainting.
static void DiscardAnim(HWND tree, TreeState& ts) {
    if (!ts.anim) return;
    StopFramePacing(tree);
    delete ts.anim;
    ts.anim = nullptr;
}

// Ends the running animation: the control repaints its real state.
static void FinishAnim(HWND tree, TreeState& ts) {
    if (!ts.anim) return;
    const int top = ts.anim->dirtyTop;
    DiscardAnim(tree, ts);
    if (IsWindow(tree)) {
        RECT rc{};
        GetClientRect(tree, &rc);
        rc.top = top;
        InvalidateRect(tree, &rc, FALSE);
    }
}

// ─── Frame composition ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Copies `count` full-width rows from src (starting at srcY) to dst (dstY),
// clipping to both bitmaps. Columns the source doesn't cover get `bg`.
static void CopyRows(Dib& dst, int dstY, const Dib& src, int srcY, int count,
                     std::uint32_t bg, int clipTop = 0) {
    if (count <= 0) return;
    if (srcY < 0) { dstY -= srcY; count += srcY; srcY = 0; }
    if (srcY + count > src.height) count = src.height - srcY;
    clipTop = std::max(clipTop, 0);
    if (dstY < clipTop) { srcY += clipTop - dstY; count -= clipTop - dstY; dstY = clipTop; }
    if (dstY + count > dst.height) count = dst.height - dstY;
    if (count <= 0) return;

    const int copyW = std::min(dst.width, src.width);
    const size_t copyBytes = static_cast<size_t>(copyW) * 4;
    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        std::uint32_t* d = dst.Row(dstY + i);
        std::memcpy(d, src.Row(srcY + i), copyBytes);
        if (copyW < dst.width) std::fill(d + copyW, d + dst.width, bg);
    }
}

static void FillRows(Dib& dst, int y0, int y1, std::uint32_t bg) {
    y0 = std::max(y0, 0);
    y1 = std::min(y1, dst.height);
    if (y1 <= y0) return;
    std::fill(dst.Row(y0), dst.Row(y1), bg);
}

// Blends `count` rows of src over whatever dst already holds, channel by
// channel (alpha included) so premultiplied/translucent captures interpolate
// correctly. Only rows inside [clipTop, clipBottom) are touched.
static void BlendRowsOver(Dib& dst, int dstY, const Dib& src, int srcY, int count,
                          int alpha, int clipTop, int clipBottom) {
    if (count <= 0 || alpha <= 0) return;
    if (srcY < 0) { dstY -= srcY; count += srcY; srcY = 0; }
    if (srcY + count > src.height) count = src.height - srcY;
    const int lo = std::max({dstY, clipTop, 0});
    const int hi = std::min({dstY + count, clipBottom, dst.height});
    if (hi <= lo) return;
    srcY += lo - dstY;
    count = hi - lo;
    dstY = lo;

    const int copyW = std::min(dst.width, src.width);
    if (alpha >= 255) {
        const size_t copyBytes = static_cast<size_t>(copyW) * 4;
        for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) std::memcpy(dst.Row(dstY + i), src.Row(srcY + i), copyBytes);
        return;
    }
    const int inv = 255 - alpha;
    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        std::uint32_t* d = dst.Row(dstY + i);
        const std::uint32_t* s = src.Row(srcY + i);
        for (int x = 0; x < copyW; ++x) {
            const std::uint32_t p = s[x], q = d[x];
            const int c0 = ((p & 0xFF) * alpha + (q & 0xFF) * inv + 127) / 255;
            const int c1 = (((p >> 8) & 0xFF) * alpha + ((q >> 8) & 0xFF) * inv + 127) / 255;
            const int c2 = (((p >> 16) & 0xFF) * alpha + ((q >> 16) & 0xFF) * inv + 127) / 255;
            const int c3 = ((p >> 24) * alpha + (q >> 24) * inv + 127) / 255;
            d[x] = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(c0 | (c1 << 8) | (c2 << 16) | (c3 << 24));
        }
    }
}

// Like BlendRowsOver, but every row listed in `rows` that lies inside the
// source range is drawn scaled by `scale` about its own centre (bilinear,
// all four channels). Pixels that map outside the row keep the destination.
static void BlendScaledRowsOver(Dib& dst, int dstY, const Dib& src, int srcY, int count,
                                const std::vector<RowInfo>& rows, int alpha, float scale,
                                int clipTop, int clipBottom) {
    if (scale >= 0.999f) {
        BlendRowsOver(dst, dstY, src, srcY, count, alpha, clipTop, clipBottom);
        return;
    }
    if (count <= 0 || alpha <= 0 || scale <= 0.05f) return;
    const int copyW = std::min(dst.width, src.width);
    const float inv = 1.0f / scale;
    const float cx = (copyW - 1) * 0.5f;

    // The horizontal mapping is the same for every row: source column pair
    // and 8-bit weight per destination column, -1 where nothing maps.
    using Column = BlendScaleColumn;
    std::vector<Column> localColumns;
    D2DThreadCache* threadCache = D2DGetThreadCache();
    std::vector<Column>& columns =
        threadCache ? threadCache->blendScaleColumns : localColumns;
    columns.resize(copyW);
    int xFirst = copyW, xLast = -1;
    for (int x = 0; x < copyW; ++x) {
        const float fx = cx + (x - cx) * inv;
        const int x0 = static_cast<int>(std::floor(fx));
        if (x0 < -1 || x0 >= copyW) {
            columns[x] = {-1, -1, 0};
            continue;
        }
        columns[x] = {std::clamp(x0, 0, copyW - 1), std::clamp(x0 + 1, 0, copyW - 1),
                      static_cast<int>((fx - x0) * 256.0f + 0.5f)};
        xFirst = std::min(xFirst, x);
        xLast = x;
    }
    if (xLast < 0) return;
    const int inv255 = 255 - alpha;

    // Bilinear sample of one channel with 8-bit weights.
    const auto channel = [](std::uint32_t p00, std::uint32_t p10, std::uint32_t p01, std::uint32_t p11,
                            int sh, int wx, int wy) -> int {
        const int top = (((p00 >> sh) & 0xFF) * (256 - wx) + ((p10 >> sh) & 0xFF) * wx) >> 8;
        const int bottom = (((p01 >> sh) & 0xFF) * (256 - wx) + ((p11 >> sh) & 0xFF) * wx) >> 8;
        return (top * (256 - wy) + bottom * wy) >> 8;
    };

    for (const RowInfo& row : rows) {
        const int rowTop = std::max(row.top, srcY);
        const int rowBottom = std::min({row.bottom, srcY + count, src.height});
        if (rowBottom <= rowTop) continue;
        const float cy = (row.top + row.bottom - 1) * 0.5f;
        for (int sy = rowTop; sy < rowBottom; ++sy) {
            const int dy = dstY + (sy - srcY);
            if (dy < clipTop || dy >= clipBottom || dy < 0 || dy >= dst.height) continue;
            const float fy = cy + (sy - cy) * inv;
            const int y0 = static_cast<int>(std::floor(fy));
            if (y0 < rowTop - 1 || y0 >= rowBottom) continue;
            const int wy = static_cast<int>((fy - y0) * 256.0f + 0.5f);
            const std::uint32_t* r0 = src.Row(std::clamp(y0, rowTop, rowBottom - 1));
            const std::uint32_t* r1 = src.Row(std::clamp(y0 + 1, rowTop, rowBottom - 1));
            std::uint32_t* d = dst.Row(dy);
            for (int x = xFirst; x <= xLast; ++x) {
                const Column& c = columns[x];
                if (c.xa < 0) continue;
                const std::uint32_t p00 = r0[c.xa], p10 = r0[c.xb], p01 = r1[c.xa], p11 = r1[c.xb];
                const std::uint32_t q = d[x];
                std::uint32_t out = 0;
                for (int sh = 0; sh < 32; sh += 8) {
                    const int v = channel(p00, p10, p01, p11, sh, c.wx, wy);
                    const int blended = (v * alpha + ((q >> sh) & 0xFF) * inv255 + 127) / 255;
                    out |= static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::clamp(blended, 0, 255)) << sh;
                }
                d[x] = out;
            }
        }
    }
}

// Composes one frame. `push` is the eased layout progress (0 = B, 1 = A);
// `alphaIn`/`alphaOut` are the opacities of the inserted / removed rows.
static void ComposeFrame(AnimState& s, float push, int alphaIn, int alphaOut,
                         float scaleIn, float scaleOut) {
    Dib& f = s.frame;
    const std::uint32_t bg = s.background;
    const LayoutDiff& d = s.d;
    const Dib& B = s.b.pixels;
    const Dib& A = s.a.pixels;

    const int shiftTop = d.topEndA - d.topEndB;
    const int dyTop = static_cast<int>(std::lround(shiftTop * push));

    // Everything above dirtyTop is identical in every frame, so after the
    // first composition only the rows from there down are rebuilt.
    const int top = s.composedOnce ? s.dirtyTop : 0;
    s.composedOnce = true;

    // Rows that exist in both layouts are drawn from A: it has the final
    // client width (a scrollbar may have appeared or gone with the change)
    // and the anchor's live glyph. Only rows B alone still shows come from B.
    FillRows(f, top, f.height, bg);
    CopyRows(f, dyTop, B, 0, d.firstTopB, bg, top);  // scrolled out above in A
    CopyRows(f, d.firstTopB + dyTop, A, d.firstTopA, d.topEndA - d.firstTopA, bg, top);
    const int aboveA = d.firstTopA;  // rows that scrolled in above
    if (aboveA > 0) CopyRows(f, d.firstTopB + dyTop - aboveA, A, 0, aboveA, bg, top);

    // Band between the anchor and the resume row: removed rows shrink/fade
    // out while inserted rows grow/fade in.
    const int bandTop = d.topEndB + dyTop;
    const int bandH = static_cast<int>(std::lround(d.bandB + (d.bandA - d.bandB) * push));
    const int bandBottom = bandTop + bandH;
    if (bandH > 0) {
        FillRows(f, bandTop, bandBottom, bg);
        // The drawer slide only spans the rows the capture holds; a band that
        // runs past the viewport keeps its captured rows attached to the top.
        if (d.bandB > 0 && alphaOut > 0) {
            const int content = std::min(d.bandB, s.b.height - d.topEndB);
            const int hidden = std::max(content - bandH, 0);
            const int y = bandTop - (s.slide ? hidden : 0);
            BlendScaledRowsOver(f, y, B, d.topEndB, content, s.b.rows, alphaOut, scaleOut,
                                bandTop, bandBottom);
        }
        if (d.bandA > 0 && alphaIn > 0) {
            const int content = std::min(d.bandA, s.a.height - d.topEndA);
            const int hidden = std::max(content - bandH, 0);
            const int y = bandTop - (s.slide ? hidden : 0);
            BlendScaledRowsOver(f, y, A, d.topEndA, content, s.a.rows, alphaIn, scaleIn,
                                bandTop, bandBottom);
        }
    }

    // Rows after the band: A's pixels wherever A still shows them, B's for
    // the rows that only B had in view (they slide out early in an expand).
    const int belowH_B = s.b.height - d.belowB;
    const int belowH_A = s.a.height - d.belowA;
    if (belowH_B > belowH_A) CopyRows(f, bandBottom, B, d.belowB, belowH_B, bg);
    if (belowH_A > 0) CopyRows(f, bandBottom, A, d.belowA, belowH_A, bg);
}

// ─── Painting / timer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

static void PaintDib(const Dib& dib, HDC hdc, const RECT& rc) {
    if (!dib.Valid()) return;
    HDC mem = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
    if (!mem) return;
    HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(mem, dib.bitmap);
    BitBlt(hdc, rc.left, rc.top, rc.right - rc.left, rc.bottom - rc.top,
           mem, rc.left, rc.top, SRCCOPY);
    SelectObject(mem, old);
    DeleteDC(mem);
}

static float ElapsedMs(const AnimState& s) {
    LARGE_INTEGER now{};
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
    return static_cast<float>(now.QuadPart - s.start.QuadPart) * 1000.0f /
           static_cast<float>(s.frequency.QuadPart);
}

static float Progress(float elapsed, float delay, float duration) {
    if (duration <= 0.0f) return 1.0f;
    return std::clamp((elapsed - delay) / duration, 0.0f, 1.0f);
}

static float TotalMs(const AnimState& s) {
    return std::max(s.pushDelayMs + s.pushMs, s.fadeDelayMs + s.fadeMs);
}

static void ComposeAt(AnimState& s, float elapsed) {
    const float pushP = Progress(elapsed, s.pushDelayMs, s.pushMs);
    const float fadeP = Progress(elapsed, s.fadeDelayMs, s.fadeMs);
    const float push = s.pushEase.Eval(pushP);
    const float fade = kFadeEase.Eval(fadeP);
    const int alphaIn = s.fadeIn ? static_cast<int>(std::lround(255.0f * fade)) : 255;
    const int alphaOut = s.fadeOut ? static_cast<int>(std::lround(255.0f * (1.0f - fade))) : 255;
    // Scale follows the fade timeline: rows grow in with the fade-in and
    // shrink away with the fade-out (WinUI AddDelete: 0.85 -> 1 with opacity).
    const float scaleIn = s.fadeIn ? s.scaleFrom + (1.0f - s.scaleFrom) * fade : 1.0f;
    const float scaleOut = s.fadeOut ? 1.0f - (1.0f - s.scaleFrom) * fade : 1.0f;
    ComposeFrame(s, push, alphaIn, alphaOut, scaleIn, scaleOut);
}

// Composes and blits the current frame from inside WM_PAINT. The anchor row
// keeps being painted by the control (its expand glyph may still be
// mid-transition), so it is re-rendered from the live layout here — inside
// BeginPaint, where other mods' paint tracking already points at this tree —
// once per display frame (without the compositor clock, the pacing thread
// wakes a little more often).
static void PaintAnimFrame(HWND tree, AnimState& s, HDC hdc, const RECT& rc) {
    // Paints between ticks (chevron and hover timers) show the frame already
    // composed for this timeline position; only a tick advances it.
    if (!s.tickPaint && s.composedOnce) {
        PaintDib(s.frame, hdc, rc);
        return;
    }
    if (s.refreshDue) {
        RefreshCapturedRows(tree, s.a.pixels, s.d.anchorTopA, s.d.anchorTopA + s.d.anchorH);
        s.lastRefreshMs = s.frameElapsedMs;
        s.refreshDue = false;
    }
    ComposeAt(s, s.frameElapsedMs);
    PaintDib(s.frame, hdc, rc);
}

static void AnimTick(HWND tree, TreeState& ts) {
    AnimState& s = *ts.anim;
    const float elapsed = ElapsedMs(s);
    s.frameElapsedMs = elapsed;
    s.refreshDue = elapsed - s.lastRefreshMs >= s.refreshPeriodMs * 0.9f;
    RECT rc{0, s.dirtyTop, s.frame.width, s.frame.height};
    s.tickPaint = true;
    RedrawWindow(tree, &rc, nullptr, RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_NOERASE | RDW_UPDATENOW);
    s.tickPaint = false;
    if (elapsed >= TotalMs(s)) FinishAnim(tree, ts);
}

// ─── Transactions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

static bool ShouldAnimateTree(HWND tree) {
    if (!g_settings.NavPaneExpandAnimation || !g_settings.ExplorerSection) return false;
    if (!tree || !IsWindow(tree) || !IsWindowVisible(tree)) return false;
    if (g_unloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return false;
    if (!SysAnimationsEnabled()) return false;
    return GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(tree);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK TreeSubclassProc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM, DWORD_PTR);

static TreeState* EnsureTreeState(HWND tree) {
    if (TreeState* ts = GetTreeState(tree)) return ts;
    auto ts = new (std::nothrow) TreeState();
    if (!ts) return nullptr;
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(tree, TreeSubclassProc, 0)) {
        delete ts;
        return nullptr;
    }
    SetPropW(tree, kStateProp, ts);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_treesMutex);
    g_trackedTrees.insert(tree);
    return ts;
}

static void ReleaseTreeState(HWND tree, TreeState* ts, bool repaint) {
    if (!ts) return;
    DiscardAnim(tree, *ts);
    RemovePropW(tree, kStateProp);
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_treesMutex);
        g_trackedTrees.erase(tree);
    }
    WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(tree, TreeSubclassProc);
    delete ts;
    if (repaint && IsWindow(tree)) InvalidateRect(tree, nullptr, FALSE);
}

// Reusing the running animation's "before" state when a layout transaction
// starts this soon after it keeps the two changes looking like one motion
// (Explorer expands with a placeholder child first, then swaps in the real
// children ~1 ms later).
static constexpr float kMergeWindowMs = 120.0f;

// Records the current layout as the start of a change.
static void BeginTransaction(HWND tree, TreeState& ts, TransactionKind kind) {
    if (ts.pending) {
        // An expansion inside a pending item-change batch decides the motion.
        if (kind == TransactionKind::Expand) ts.pendingKind = kind;
        return;
    }
    ts.pendingKind = kind;
    ts.pendingMerged = false;
    if (ts.anim && ElapsedMs(*ts.anim) < kMergeWindowMs) {
        // Keep the animation running; EndTransaction either continues it
        // (same change, fresh pixels) or restarts from its start state.
        auto keep = std::make_unique<TreeCapture>();
        if (CloneCapture(ts.anim->b, *keep)) {
            ts.pendingBackground = ts.anim->background;
            ts.pending = std::move(keep);
            ts.pendingMerged = true;
            ts.pendingSince = GetTickCount64();
            ++ts.pendingSerial;
            return;
        }
    }
    FinishAnim(tree, ts);
    auto capture = std::make_unique<TreeCapture>();
    const std::uint32_t background = TreeBackgroundPixel(tree);
    ts.pendingBackground = background;
    if (!CaptureState(tree, ts, background, *capture, nullptr)) return;
    ts.pending = std::move(capture);
    ts.pendingSince = GetTickCount64();
    ++ts.pendingSerial;
}

// Compares the current layout with the recorded one and animates the change.
static void EndTransaction(HWND tree, TreeState& ts) {
    std::unique_ptr<TreeCapture> before = std::move(ts.pending);
    const bool merged = ts.pendingMerged;
    ts.pendingMerged = false;
    if (!before || !IsWindow(tree) || g_unloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return;

    auto state = new (std::nothrow) AnimState();
    if (!state) return;
    state->background = ts.pendingBackground;
    // The screen keeps showing the start state while the end state is captured.
    const Dib* display = merged && ts.anim ? &ts.anim->frame : &before->pixels;
    if (!CaptureState(tree, ts, state->background, state->a, display) ||
        state->a.height != before->height) {
        delete state;
        if (merged) FinishAnim(tree, ts);
        return;
    }
    state->b = std::move(*before);
    if (!DiffLayouts(tree, state->b, state->a, state->d) ||
        !state->frame.Create(state->a.width, state->a.height)) {
        delete state;
        // A merged batch that changed nothing leaves the running animation alone.
        return;
    }
    if (merged && ts.anim) {
        if (ts.anim->d == state->d) {
            // Same change re-applied (Explorer re-syncs after edits): keep the
            // motion going with the fresh final pixels instead of restarting.
            ts.anim->a = std::move(state->a);
            ts.anim->composedOnce = false;  // rebuild the static rows from the new pixels
            delete state;
            return;
        }
        DiscardAnim(tree, ts);
    }

    const LayoutDiff& d = state->d;
    state->expand = d.bandA >= d.bandB;
    state->slide = kSlideChildren;
    if (ts.pendingKind == TransactionKind::ItemChange) {
        // Rows inserted/removed outside an expansion: WinUI add/delete motion.
        state->slide = false;
        state->fadeIn = d.bandA > 0;
        state->fadeOut = d.bandB > 0;
        state->fadeMs = kAddDeleteFadeMs;
        state->fadeDelayMs = (d.bandA > 0 && d.bandB == 0) ? kAddFadeDelayMs : 0.0f;
        state->scaleFrom = kAddDeleteScale;
        state->pushMs = kAddDeleteMoveMs;
        state->pushDelayMs = (d.bandB > 0 && d.bandA == 0) ? kDeleteMoveDelayMs : 0.0f;
        state->pushEase = kAddDeleteEase;
    } else {
        state->fadeIn = d.bandA > 0;
        state->fadeOut = d.bandB > 0 && (d.bandA > 0 || kCollapseFade);
        state->fadeMs = (state->fadeIn || state->fadeOut) ? kFadeMs : 0.0f;
        state->scaleFrom = kItemScale;
        state->pushMs = state->expand ? kExpandMs : kCollapseMs;
    }
    const int shiftTop = d.topEndA - d.topEndB;
    state->dirtyTop = shiftTop != 0 ? 0 : std::max(std::min(d.topEndB, d.topEndA) - d.anchorH, 0);
    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&state->frequency);
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&state->start);

    // The anchor row's live content (the chevron's 16 ms timer) changes at
    // most ~64 Hz, so on faster displays it is re-rendered every other frame.
    state->refreshPeriodMs = std::max(FrameSleepMsForWindow(tree) / 0.75f, 1000.0f / 75.0f);
    ts.anim = state;
    if (!StartFramePacing(tree)) {
        DiscardAnim(tree, ts);
        return;
    }

    // Consume the pending invalidation with the first frame so the final
    // layout never flashes before the animation starts.
    RedrawWindow(tree, nullptr, nullptr, RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_NOERASE | RDW_UPDATENOW);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK TreeSubclassProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam,
                                         LPARAM lParam, DWORD_PTR /*refData*/) {
    TreeState* ts = GetTreeState(hwnd);
    if (!ts) return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
    AnimState* anim = ts->anim;

    if (msg == FrameMessage()) {
        FrameConsumed(hwnd);
        if (anim) AnimTick(hwnd, *ts);
        return 0;
    }
    if (msg == FinishMessage()) {
        FinishAnim(hwnd, *ts);
        return 0;
    }
    if (msg == ReleaseMessage()) {
        ReleaseTreeState(hwnd, ts, true);
        return 0;
    }
    if (msg == EndItemChangeMessage()) {
        // Only closes the batch it was posted for; a host bracket may have
        // consumed that one and a newer batch may be pending now.
        if (ts->bracketDepth == 0 && ts->pending && wParam == ts->pendingSerial) {
            EndTransaction(hwnd, *ts);
        }
        return 0;
    }

    switch (msg) {
        case WM_PAINT:
            if (ts->captureTarget) {
                PAINTSTRUCT ps{};
                if (HDC hdc = BeginPaint(hwnd, &ps)) {
                    ts->captured = RenderTreeInto(hwnd, ts->pendingBackground, *ts->captureTarget);
                    const Dib* show = ts->captureDisplay ? ts->captureDisplay : ts->captureTarget;
                    if (show->Valid()) PaintDib(*show, hdc, ps.rcPaint);
                    EndPaint(hwnd, &ps);
                }
                return 0;
            }
            if (anim) {
                PAINTSTRUCT ps{};
                if (HDC hdc = BeginPaint(hwnd, &ps)) {
                    PaintAnimFrame(hwnd, *anim, hdc, ps.rcPaint);
                    EndPaint(hwnd, &ps);
                }
                return 0;
            }
            if (ts->pending && GetTickCount64() - ts->pendingSince < kPendingFreezeMs) {
                // Hosts may paint synchronously between a change and the end
                // of its batch; keep showing the start state until then.
                PAINTSTRUCT ps{};
                if (HDC hdc = BeginPaint(hwnd, &ps)) {
                    PaintDib(ts->pending->pixels, hdc, ps.rcPaint);
                    EndPaint(hwnd, &ps);
                }
                return 0;
            }
            break;

        case WM_ERASEBKGND:
            if (anim || ts->captureTarget || ts->pending) return 1;
            break;

        // Hosts batch layout changes inside WM_SETREDRAW(FALSE)..(TRUE)
        // (Explorer's CNscTree::_EnumBackgroundDone swaps the placeholder
        // child for the real subfolders this way); animate the whole batch.
        case WM_SETREDRAW:
            if (g_ownRedraw > 0) break;
            if (!wParam) {
                if (ts->bracketDepth++ == 0 && ShouldAnimateTree(hwnd)) {
                    BeginTransaction(hwnd, *ts, TransactionKind::HostBatch);
                }
                break;
            } else {
                const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
                if (ts->bracketDepth > 0 && --ts->bracketDepth == 0) EndTransaction(hwnd, *ts);
                return result;
            }

        // Rows inserted or removed outside a host batch (shell change
        // notifications, drives appearing): start a transaction on the first
        // one and close it once the current burst of messages has been
        // processed, so a loop of inserts animates as one change.
        case TVM_INSERTITEMA:
        case TVM_INSERTITEMW:
        case TVM_DELETEITEM: {
            if (ts->bracketDepth == 0 && !ts->pending && ShouldAnimateTree(hwnd)) {
                BeginTransaction(hwnd, *ts, TransactionKind::ItemChange);
                if (ts->pending) PostMessageW(hwnd, EndItemChangeMessage(), ts->pendingSerial, 0);
            }
            // comctl32 may call TV_Expand while deleting (collapsing a parent
            // that lost its last child); the hook must not end the batch then.
            ++ts->itemChangeDepth;
            const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
            if (GetTreeState(hwnd) == ts) --ts->itemChangeDepth;
            return result;
        }

        // These only invalidate the frames if they actually scroll the tree.
        case TVM_ENSUREVISIBLE:
        case TVM_SELECTITEM:
            if (anim && ts->bracketDepth == 0) {
                const HTREEITEM firstBefore = TreeView_GetFirstVisible(hwnd);
                const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
                if (GetTreeState(hwnd) == ts && ts->anim == anim &&
                    TreeView_GetFirstVisible(hwnd) != firstBefore) {
                    FinishAnim(hwnd, *ts);
                }
                return result;
            }
            break;

        // Layout changes we can't follow: snap to the real state. Item
        // attribute updates (TVM_SETITEM: Explorer swaps the "expanding"
        // icon, states) don't move rows and are deliberately not here.
        case WM_VSCROLL:
        case WM_HSCROLL:
        case WM_MOUSEWHEEL:
        case WM_MOUSEHWHEEL:
        case WM_SIZE:
        case WM_KEYDOWN:
        case WM_SETFONT:
        case TVM_SORTCHILDREN:
        case TVM_SORTCHILDRENCB:
        case TVM_SETITEMHEIGHT:
        case TVM_SETINDENT:
            if (anim && ts->bracketDepth == 0) FinishAnim(hwnd, *ts);
            break;

        case WM_DESTROY:
            FinishAnim(hwnd, *ts);
            break;

        case WM_NCDESTROY:
            ReleaseTreeState(hwnd, ts, false);
            break;
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
}

struct ExpandContext {
    HWND tree = nullptr;
    TreeState* ts = nullptr;
};

// Wraps one comctl32 expansion in a transaction. The expansion runs with the
// tree's redraw flag off: TV_ScrollBelow/TV_SmoothSetTopItem otherwise scroll
// the window pixels synchronously (the scroll position is still updated), and
// the first painted frame must be ours.
static bool AnimBeforeExpand(HWND tree, HTREEITEM item, ExpandContext& ctx) {
    if (!item || !ShouldAnimateTree(tree)) return false;
    TreeState* ts = EnsureTreeState(tree);
    if (!ts || ts->bracketDepth > 0 || ts->itemChangeDepth > 0) return false;  // inside a host change
    BeginTransaction(tree, *ts, TransactionKind::Expand);
    if (!ts->pending) return false;
    ctx.tree = tree;
    ctx.ts = ts;
    ++g_ownRedraw;
    SendMessageW(tree, WM_SETREDRAW, FALSE, 0);
    --g_ownRedraw;
    return true;
}

static void AnimAfterExpand(ExpandContext& ctx, int /*result*/) {
    if (!ctx.tree || !IsWindow(ctx.tree)) return;
    ++g_ownRedraw;
    SendMessageW(ctx.tree, WM_SETREDRAW, TRUE, 0);
    --g_ownRedraw;
    if (TreeState* ts = GetTreeState(ctx.tree)) EndTransaction(ctx.tree, *ts);
}


static void FinishAllAnimations() {
    std::unordered_set<HWND> trees;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_treesMutex);
        trees = g_trackedTrees;
    }
    for (HWND tree : trees) {
        if (!IsWindow(tree)) continue;
        DWORD_PTR ignored = 0;
        SendMessageTimeoutW(tree, FinishMessage(), 0, 0, SMTO_ABORTIFHUNG | SMTO_BLOCK,
                            2000, &ignored);
    }
}


// ─── comctl32!TV_Expand ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

using TV_Expand_t = int(__cdecl*)(void* tree, UINT_PTR action, void* item, int notify);
static TV_Expand_t TV_Expand_Original = nullptr;

static int __cdecl TV_Expand_Hook(void* treeObject, UINT_PTR action, void* itemObject, int notify) {
    if (g_unloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) || !treeObject ||
        !g_settings.NavPaneExpandAnimation) {
        return TV_Expand_Original(treeObject, action, itemObject, notify);
    }

    // `_TREE` starts with the control's HWND.
    HWND tree = *static_cast<HWND*>(treeObject);
    ExpandContext ctx;
    bool tracked = false;
    if (++g_expandDepth == 1) {
        tracked = AnimBeforeExpand(tree, static_cast<HTREEITEM>(itemObject), ctx);
    }

    const int result = TV_Expand_Original(treeObject, action, itemObject, notify);

    if (tracked) AnimAfterExpand(ctx, result);
    --g_expandDepth;
    return result;
}

static std::mutex g_hookMutex;
static bool g_hooksAttempted = false;

// Resolves the comctl32 symbol only in processes that showed a navigation
// pane (LazyFeatureObserveWindow -> LazyFeatureEnsureHooks), like the other
// lazy feature hooks.
static void Init(bool applyHooks)
{
    if (g_lazyFeatureHooksUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !g_settings.NavPaneExpandAnimation || !g_settings.ExplorerSection ||
        !g_navTreeContextSeen.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return;
    }

    // Held through the apply: Wh_ModBeforeUninit sets the unloading flag
    // under this lock, so no hook operation starts after it returns.
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_hookMutex);
    if (g_hooksAttempted ||
        g_lazyFeatureHooksUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return;
    HMODULE comctl32 = GetModuleHandleW(L"comctl32.dll");
    if (!comctl32)
        return;
    g_hooksAttempted = true;

    SetResolvedSymbolHook(Comctl32ResolveSymbols(comctl32).tvExpand,
                          TV_Expand_Hook, &TV_Expand_Original);
    const bool queued = TV_Expand_Original != nullptr;
    if (!queued)
        Wh_Log(L"Navigation pane animation: TV_Expand symbol unavailable");
    if (applyHooks && queued && !Wh_ApplyHookOperations())
        Wh_Log(L"Navigation pane animation: failed to apply the TV_Expand hook");
}

static void BeforeUninit()
{
    g_unloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    FinishAllAnimations();
}

static void Uninit()
{
    FinishAllAnimations();
    ShutdownFrameWorker();
    // Subclasses are normally removed on WM_NCDESTROY; sweep the survivors so
    // nothing stays attached to live trees.
    std::unordered_set<HWND> trees;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_treesMutex);
        trees = g_trackedTrees;
    }
    for (HWND tree : trees) {
        if (!IsWindow(tree)) continue;
        // Release on the tree's own thread so it can't race the subclass;
        // a hung thread gets the cross-thread fallback.
        DWORD_PTR ignored = 0;
        if (!SendMessageTimeoutW(tree, ReleaseMessage(), 0, 0, SMTO_ABORTIFHUNG | SMTO_BLOCK,
                                 2000, &ignored)) {
            ReleaseTreeState(tree, GetTreeState(tree), true);
        }
    }
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_treesMutex);
    g_trackedTrees.clear();
}

{

// Resolved only once a SysLink exists in the process (LazyFeatureObserveWindow),
// from the comctl32 that owns its class. SysLinks painted before the hook
// are repainted with the link color.
static void SysLinkTextEnsureHook(bool applyHooks)
{
    static std::atomic<bool> attempted{false};
    if (attempted.load(std::memory_order_acquire) || CMarkupPaint_orig ||
        !SysLinkTextColorWanted() ||
        !g_sysLinkContextSeen.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return;
    }
    const HMODULE comctl32 = g_sysLinkComctl32.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_lazyControlHookMutex);
    if (!comctl32 || g_lazyFeatureHooksUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        attempted.exchange(true, std::memory_order_acq_rel))
        return;
    SetResolvedSymbolHook(Comctl32ResolveSymbols(comctl32).markupPaint,
                          CMarkupPaint_hook, &CMarkupPaint_orig);
    if (!CMarkupPaint_orig) {
        Wh_Log(L"SysLink text: CMarkup::Paint symbol unavailable");
        return;
    }
    if (applyHooks && !Wh_ApplyHookOperations()) {
        Wh_Log(L"SysLink text: Wh_ApplyHookOperations failed");
        return;
    }
    if (applyHooks)
        EnumWindows(SysLinkInvalidateTopProc, 0);
}

static void LazyFeatureRequestHooks()
{

}

static void LazyFeatureObserveWindow(HWND hwnd, LPCWSTR className)
{
    if (!hwnd || !className ||
        g_lazyFeatureHooksUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return;
    }

    if (g_settings.DialogTextDirectWrite ||
        (g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite &&
         (!_wcsicmp(className, L"Static") || !_wcsicmp(className, L"Button") ||
          !_wcsicmp(className, L"Edit"))) ||
        (g_settings.RoundedButtons &&
        (_wcsicmp(className, L"ComboBox") == 0 || _wcsicmp(className, L"ComboLBox") == 0)))
        ExplorerDialogTextObserve(hwnd, className);

    bool requestHooks = false;
    const bool shellUiWindow =
        _wcsicmp(className, L"DirectUIHWND") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(className, L"SHELLDLL_DefView") == 0;
    if (shellUiWindow || GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT) == hwnd)
        MenuImmersiveRequestPendingHooks();
    if (wcsstr(className, L"NamespaceTreeControl")) {
        const bool newlyRelevant = !g_navTreeContextSeen.exchange(
            true, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        requestHooks = requestHooks ||
            (newlyRelevant && (g_settings.RoundedButtons ||
                               g_settings.NavPaneExpandAnimation ||
                               (ExplorerMicaActive() &&
                                !g_darkModeActive)));
    }
    if (_wcsicmp(className, L"SysTabControl32") == 0) {
        HWND root = GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT);
        if (root && IsClassName(root, L"#32770")) {
            const bool newlyRelevant = !g_diskPieContextSeen.exchange(
                true, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            requestHooks = requestHooks ||
                (newlyRelevant && g_settings.DiskChartAccentColor);
        }
    }
    if (_wcsicmp(className, L"OperationStatusWindow") == 0) {
        const bool newlyRelevant = !g_fileOpContextSeen.exchange(
            true, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        requestHooks = requestHooks ||
            (newlyRelevant && g_settings.AccentColorize);
    }
    // comctl32 is loaded in nearly every process, so its symbols are only
    // ever resolved once a list view actually turns up -- the control whose
    // marks the helper has to draw. Tree views are served by their own
    // subclass and never need it.
    if (_wcsicmp(className, L"SysListView32") == 0) {
        const bool newlyRelevant = !g_insertMarkContextSeen.exchange(
            true, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        requestHooks = requestHooks ||
            (newlyRelevant && g_settings.ModernInsert && !CCDrawInsertMark_orig);
    }
    // SysLink exists only in comctl32 v6, so the class's own procedure
    // names the module to resolve CMarkup::Paint in. Recorded even while the
    // link color is off: turning it on later installs the hook from
    // Wh_ModSettingsChanged.
    if (_wcsicmp(className, WC_LINK) == 0 &&
        !g_sysLinkContextSeen.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        HMODULE comctl32 = nullptr;
        const auto classProc = reinterpret_cast<LPCWSTR>(
            GetClassLongPtrW(hwnd, GCLP_WNDPROC));
        if (classProc && GetModuleHandleExW(
                GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS |
                GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
                classProc, &comctl32) && comctl32) {
            g_sysLinkComctl32.store(comctl32, std::memory_order_release);
            const bool first =
                !g_sysLinkContextSeen.exchange(true, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            requestHooks = requestHooks || (first && SysLinkTextColorWanted());
        }
    }

    if (requestHooks)
        LazyFeatureRequestHooks();
}

static void LazyFeatureReleaseModules()
{
    HMODULE modules[4] = {};
    {
        // Initializers acquire their feature mutex before the shared module
        // mutex. Follow that order so no in-flight GetProcAddress can race
        // the final FreeLibrary calls during mod teardown.
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> diskLock(g_diskPieHookMutex);
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> fileOpLock(g_fileOpAccentGdipHookMutex);
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> navLock(g_navTreeUniscribeHookMutex);
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> moduleLock(g_lazyFeatureModuleMutex);
        modules[0] = g_lazyFeatureUsp10Module;
        modules[1] = g_lazyFeatureGdiplusModule;
        modules[2] = g_lazyFeatureWpdShExtModule;
        modules[3] = g_lazyFeatureShell32Module;
        g_lazyFeatureUsp10Module = nullptr;
        g_lazyFeatureGdiplusModule = nullptr;
        g_lazyFeatureWpdShExtModule = nullptr;
        g_lazyFeatureShell32Module = nullptr;
    }
    for (HMODULE module : modules) {
        if (module)
            FreeLibrary(module);
    }
}

// ── Combo/ListBox family helper ───────────────────────────────────────────
// Returns true for ComboBox, ComboLBox, ListBox, ComboBoxEx32, and Edit
// controls whose immediate parent is a combo family window.
static bool IsComboFamilyWindow(HWND hw)
{
    if (!hw) return false;
    wchar_t cls[64] = {};
    GetClassNameW(hw, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls));
    if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboBox")    == 0 || _wcsicmp(cls, L"Combobox")    == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboLBox")   == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"ListBox")     == 0 || _wcsicmp(cls, L"Listbox")     == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboBoxEx32") == 0)
        return true;
    if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"Edit") == 0) {
        HWND parent = GetParent(hw);
        if (parent) {
            wchar_t pcls[64] = {};
            GetClassNameW(parent, pcls, ARRAYSIZE(pcls));
            if (_wcsicmp(pcls, L"ComboBox")     == 0 || _wcsicmp(pcls, L"Combobox")     == 0 ||
                _wcsicmp(pcls, L"ComboBoxEx32") == 0)
                return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static bool IsComboEditWindow(HWND hw)
{
    if (!hw || !IsClassName(hw, L"Edit"))
        return false;

    HWND parent = GetParent(hw);
    return parent &&
        (IsClassName(parent, L"ComboBox") ||
         IsClassName(parent, L"ComboBoxEx32"));
}

// hw is the combo's Edit child or the ComboBox itself.
static INT GetRestyledComboEditButtonState(HWND hw, HDC hdc)
{
    if (!hw || IsExplorerRebarHost(hdc))
        return -1;

    HWND host, combo;
    if (IsComboEditWindow(hw)) {
        host = GetParent(hw);
        combo = host;
        if (IsClassName(host, L"ComboBoxEx32")) {
            HWND child = (HWND)SendMessageUnhooked(
                host, CBEM_GETCOMBOCONTROL, 0, 0);
            if (IsClassName(child, L"ComboBox"))
                combo = child;
        }
    } else if (IsClassName(hw, L"ComboBox")) {
        combo = hw;
        HWND parent = GetParent(hw);
        host = IsClassName(parent, L"ComboBoxEx32") ? parent : hw;
    } else {
        return -1;
    }

    if (!IsWindowEnabled(host) || !IsWindowEnabled(combo))
        return PBS_DISABLED;

    COMBOBOXINFO info = { sizeof(info) };
    if ((GetComboBoxInfo(combo, &info) &&
         (info.stateButton & STATE_SYSTEM_PRESSED)) ||
        SendMessageUnhooked(combo, CB_GETDROPPEDSTATE, 0, 0)) {
        return PBS_NORMAL;
    }

    HANDLE value = GetPropW(combo, kPropComboButtonState);
    const INT buttonState = (INT)(INT_PTR)value - 1;
    if (buttonState == PBS_PRESSED)
        return PBS_NORMAL;
    if (buttonState >= PBS_NORMAL && buttonState <= PBS_DISABLED)
        return buttonState;

    return PBS_NORMAL;
}

// The chrome fill a restyled combo's edit area sits in, composited over the
// same erase color the chrome itself uses (ctl: the Edit or the ComboBox).
static COLORREF RestyledComboFillColor(HWND ctl, HDC hdc, bool dark, INT state)
{
    HWND combo = ctl;
    if (IsComboEditWindow(ctl)) {
        combo = GetParent(ctl);
        if (IsClassName(combo, L"ComboBoxEx32")) {
            HWND child = (HWND)SendMessageUnhooked(
                combo, CBEM_GETCOMBOCONTROL, 0, 0);
            if (IsClassName(child, L"ComboBox"))
                combo = child;
        }
    }
    return WinUiControlFillColor(dark, state, ButtonParentBackground(combo, hdc, dark));
}

// ── FillRect hook: intercept white fills during DirectUI PaintBg ─────────
// DirectUI calls FillRect with a white brush (stock or cached) for backgrounds.
// During PaintBg (g_inDuiPaintBg=true), replace white brushes with dark.
// FillRect_orig itself is declared much earlier (next to g_tlsPaintHwnd /
// t_currentEditPaintHwnd) -- see that declaration's comment for why.

static constexpr COLORREF kModernLtEditBk = RGB(0xF4, 0xF4, 0xF4);
static HBRUSH g_modernLtEditBkBrush = nullptr;

static bool EditParentHasTabControlSibling(HWND edit)
{
    HWND parent = GetParent(edit);
    if (!parent)
        return false;

    HWND container = GetParent(parent);
    if (!container)
        return false;

    for (HWND ch = GetWindow(container, GW_CHILD); ch; ch = GetWindow(ch, GW_HWNDNEXT)) {
        if (ch == parent)
            continue;

        wchar_t cls[64] = {};
        if (GetClassNameW(ch, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)) &&
            (_wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTabControl32") == 0 ||
             wcsstr(cls, L"SysTabCtl") != nullptr)) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static bool IsModernLightEditDc(HDC hdc)
{
    if (!g_settings.EditFocusLine || !hdc)
        return false;

    // Every white fill and white bk color in the process lands here: the
    // class test comes before the window's dark-mode lookup.
    HWND hwnd = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (!hwnd)
        hwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
    if (!hwnd)
        return false;

    wchar_t cls[64] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)) ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"Edit") != 0) {
        return false;
    }

    return !IsWindowDarkMode(hdc) && EditParentHasTabControlSibling(hwnd);
}

static HBRUSH GetModernLightEditBrush()
{
    if (!g_modernLtEditBkBrush)
        g_modernLtEditBkBrush = CreateSolidBrush(kModernLtEditBk);
    return g_modernLtEditBkBrush;
}

static HBRUSH GetDirectUIDarkBackgroundBrush()
{
    if (!g_win32MainDarkBrush)
        g_win32MainDarkBrush = CreateSolidBrush(Win32MainDark);
    return g_win32MainDarkBrush ? g_win32MainDarkBrush : GetSysColorBrush(COLOR_BTNFACE);
}

// Walks up the ancestor chain looking for a #32770 dialog ApplyPropertyDialogDarkMode
// already tagged dark (kPropertyDialogDarkModeMarker) whose DLGPROC lives in atlthunk.dll.
// Classic dialogs (#32770) all share the same WNDPROC (USER32's
// DefDlgProc), so GWLP_WNDPROC can't tell dialogs apart; the app-supplied
// callback lives at DWLP_DLGPROC instead. The Advanced Security Settings /
// ACL editor dialog is ATL-based, so DWLP_DLGPROC doesn't point directly
// into aclui.dll -- ATL installs a small generated thunk (_stdcallthunk) in
// atlthunk.dll that jumps to the real handler, so the resolved module is
// always atlthunk.dll regardless of which ATL-based component owns the
// dialog. Combined with requiring aclui.dll to be loaded in the process at
// all (a coarse but cheap pre-filter -- it only loads when this specific
// dialog is opened), this is meaningfully narrower than "any #32770 we've
// darkened" even though it can't pin down aclui.dll directly the way a
// non-ATL dialog's DLGPROC would allow.
static bool IsInsideAclUiDarkDialog(HWND hwnd)
{
    // Not cached: aclui.dll loads on-demand when the user opens the dialog,
    // well after FillRect_hook's first call in the process's lifetime --
    // caching the lookup once would permanently freeze it at "not loaded".
    // GetModuleHandleW is a handle-table lookup, not a load, so this is cheap.
    if (!GetModuleHandleW(L"aclui.dll")) return false;

    HMODULE hAtlthunk = GetModuleHandleW(L"atlthunk.dll");
    if (!hAtlthunk) return false;

    for (HWND p = hwnd; p; p = GetParent(p)) {
        if (!GetPropW(p, kPropertyDialogDarkModeMarker))
            continue;
        WNDPROC dlgProc = (WNDPROC)GetWindowLongPtrW(p, DWLP_DLGPROC);
        HMODULE hmod = nullptr;
        if (dlgProc && GetModuleHandleExW(
                GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS |
                GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
                (LPCWSTR)dlgProc, &hmod) && hmod == hAtlthunk) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

// The ReBar's search box (Windows 11 "SearchEditBoxWrapperClass") already
// renders dark mode correctly on its own; our general text-color remap
// conflicts with its near-transparent placeholder text. Direct parent
// only, not a full walk -- called on nearly every text draw in the
// process, and the placeholder's DirectUIHWND is always an immediate child.
static bool IsInsideSearchEditBoxWrapper(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd) return false;
    HWND parent = GetParent(hwnd);
    if (!parent) return false;
    wchar_t cls[64] = {};
    return GetClassNameW(parent, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)) &&
           _wcsicmp(cls, L"SearchEditBoxWrapperClass") == 0;
}

int WINAPI FillRect_hook(HDC hdc, const RECT* lprc, HBRUSH hbr)
{
    // One brush query serves every check below, and only they read it.
    LOGBRUSH lb = {};
    const bool gotColor = hbr &&
        (t_scrollBarOwnerWindow || g_settings.EditFocusLine || g_darkModeActive) &&
        GetObject(hbr, sizeof(lb), &lb) && lb.lbStyle == BS_SOLID;

    if (gotColor && lprc && t_scrollBarOwnerWindow) {
        COLORREF sizeBoxColor;
        if (ScrollBarNativeSizeBoxFill(hdc, *lprc, sizeBoxColor) &&
            sizeBoxColor != lb.lbColor) {
            if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(sizeBoxColor))
                return FillRect_orig(hdc, lprc, br);
        }
    }

    if (hbr && g_settings.EditFocusLine &&
        ((gotColor && lb.lbColor == RGB(255, 255, 255)) ||
         hbr == (HBRUSH)GetStockObject(WHITE_BRUSH)) &&
        IsModernLightEditDc(hdc)) {
        if (HBRUSH br = GetModernLightEditBrush())
            return FillRect_orig(hdc, lprc, br);
    }

    // The Advanced Security Settings dialog (aclui.dll's ACL editor, a
    // #32770 dialog we mark dark via ApplyPropertyDialogDarkMode) hosts its content
    // in a DirectUIHWND that clears its own double-buffer to black
    // (FillRect + BitBlt SRCCOPY) before painting real content on top --
    // bypassing our WM_ERASEBKGND-based subclass, which this internal
    // paint mechanism never goes through. Replace with our dark background.
    if (g_darkModeActive && hbr) {
        if (gotColor && lb.lbColor == RGB(0, 0, 0)) {
            HWND hwAcl = WindowFromDC(hdc);
            if (!hwAcl) hwAcl = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
            wchar_t clsAcl[64] = {};
            if (hwAcl && GetClassNameW(hwAcl, clsAcl, ARRAYSIZE(clsAcl)) &&
                _wcsicmp(clsAcl, L"DirectUIHWND") == 0 &&
                IsInsideAclUiDarkDialog(hwAcl)) {
                if (HBRUSH darkBrAcl = GetCachedSolidBrush(Win32MainDark))
                    return FillRect_orig(hdc, lprc, darkBrAcl);
            }
        }
    }

    if (g_darkModeActive && hbr) {
        // ComboBox Edits can receive either DarkMode_Explorer's #383838 or
        // a regular dark surface (the mod's, or the shell shade the address
        // bar theme carries). Match them to the neutral push-button fill,
        // except for Explorer/file-picker address bars inside a ReBar.
        if (gotColor &&
            (lb.lbColor == RGB(0x38, 0x38, 0x38) ||
             lb.lbColor == Win32MainDark ||
             lb.lbColor == ExplorerDarkColor)) {
            // WindowFromDC first, then t_currentEditPaintHwnd -- NOT
            // g_tlsPaintHwnd. That general fallback can still point at a
            // real (but different) ComboBox edit left over from earlier
            // activity on this thread; since IsComboEditWindow() would then
            // correctly confirm THAT window really is a combo edit, this
            // per-DC identity check can't tell it apart from the current,
            // unrelated FillRect call -- so an unrelated control's own
            // dark-surface fill (e.g. a scrollbar) gets its color stolen for a
            // stale ComboBox's button state. t_currentEditPaintHwnd is
            // narrower: it's only ever an Edit still inside its own
            // BeginPaint/EndPaint bracket, cleared the instant that ends.
            HWND hw = WindowFromDC(hdc);
            if (!hw) hw = t_currentEditPaintHwnd;
            const INT buttonState =
                GetRestyledComboEditButtonState(hw, hdc);
            if (buttonState >= 0) {
                const COLORREF pushFill =
                    GetNeutralPushButtonFillColor(hw, true, buttonState);
                if (HBRUSH pushBr = GetCachedSolidBrush(pushFill))
                    return FillRect_orig(hdc, lprc, pushBr);
            }
            if (lb.lbColor == RGB(0x38, 0x38, 0x38) &&
                IsComboFamilyWindow(hw)) {
                if (HBRUSH darkBr = GetCachedSolidBrush(Win32MainDark))
                    return FillRect_orig(hdc, lprc, darkBr);
            }
        }

        if (g_inDuiPaintBg) {
            // Native FILLCOLOR handles property-list fills after the first paint.
            // Keep the white-fill fallback until primed; other DUI roots retain it.
            bool skipPrimedPropertyList = false;
            HWND hwDui = WindowFromDC(hdc);
            if (!hwDui) hwDui = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
            if (IsPropertyDirectUIScope(hwDui)) {
                HWND root = GetAncestor(hwDui, GA_ROOT);
                skipPrimedPropertyList = root && GetPropW(root, kPropDuiListPrimed) != nullptr;
            }
            if (!skipPrimedPropertyList) {
                if (gotColor) {
                    BYTE r = GetRValue(lb.lbColor), g = GetGValue(lb.lbColor), b = GetBValue(lb.lbColor);
                    if (r > 200 && g > 200 && b > 200) {
                        // White brush → replace with dark
                        return FillRect_orig(hdc, lprc, GetDirectUIDarkBackgroundBrush());
                    }
                }
                // Also check stock WHITE_BRUSH
                if (hbr == (HBRUSH)GetStockObject(WHITE_BRUSH)) {
                    return FillRect_orig(hdc, lprc, GetDirectUIDarkBackgroundBrush());
                }
            }
        }
    }
    [[clang::musttail]] return FillRect_orig(hdc, lprc, hbr);
}

// ── SetBkColor hook: fix Edit background color for opaque text rendering ──
// ComboBox Edits can set #383838 or a dark surface before ExtTextOut. Keep the text
// background synchronized with the restyled button fill, except in ReBars.
static decltype(&SetBkColor) SetBkColor_orig = nullptr;
COLORREF WINAPI SetBkColor_hook(HDC hdc, COLORREF color)
{
    if (color == RGB(255, 255, 255) && IsModernLightEditDc(hdc)) {
        [[clang::musttail]] return SetBkColor_orig(hdc, kModernLtEditBk);
    }

    if (g_darkModeActive &&
        (color == RGB(0x38, 0x38, 0x38) || color == Win32MainDark ||
         color == ExplorerDarkColor)) {
        // WindowFromDC first, then t_currentEditPaintHwnd -- see the
        // matching comment in FillRect_hook. The combo's own buffered
        // paint (edit-area ExtTextOut background) resolves through
        // t_currentComboPaintHwnd.
        HWND hw = WindowFromDC(hdc);
        if (!hw) hw = t_currentEditPaintHwnd;
        if (!hw) hw = t_currentComboPaintHwnd;
        const INT buttonState = GetRestyledComboEditButtonState(hw, hdc);
        if (buttonState >= 0) {
            [[clang::musttail]] return SetBkColor_orig(
                hdc, GetNeutralPushButtonFillColor(hw, true, buttonState));
        }
        if (color == RGB(0x38, 0x38, 0x38) && IsComboFamilyWindow(hw))
            [[clang::musttail]] return SetBkColor_orig(hdc, Win32MainDark);
    }
    [[clang::musttail]] return SetBkColor_orig(hdc, color);
}

// ── DrawThemeIcon → DragDrop badge glyphs ─────────────────────────────────
// Some DD_COPY/MOVE/UPDATEMETADATA/CREATELINK/WARNING/NONE badges (parts
// 1-6) draw through DrawThemeIcon instead of DrawThemeBackground(Ex) --
// confirmed live for DD_CREATELINK/DD_NONE, which reuse common system
// icons. Same badge-cover-and-glyph handling as the HandleThemeDraw call
// site, so both paths stay in sync.
HRESULT WINAPI DrawThemeIcon_hook(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, int iPartId,
    int iStateId, LPCRECT pRect, HIMAGELIST himl, int iImageIndex)
{
    if (ShouldModernizeDragDrop() && pRect &&
        GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme) == L"DragDrop" &&
        DragDropHandleBadgeIcon(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect))
        return S_OK;
    return DrawThemeIcon_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pRect, himl,
        iImageIndex);
}

// ── DrawThemeText → redirect to DrawThemeTextEx ──────────────────────────
HRESULT WINAPI DrawThemeText_hook(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, int iPartId,
    int iStateId, LPCWSTR pszText, int cchText, DWORD dwTextFlags,
    DWORD dwTextFlags2, LPCRECT pRect)
{
    const bool dialogDrawn = !dwTextFlags2 && TryDrawLegacyRebarThemeText(hTheme, hdc,
            iPartId, iStateId, pszText, cchText, pRect, dwTextFlags,
            nullptr);
    if (dialogDrawn)
        return S_OK;
    LegacyRebarNativeTextScope rebarNative(
        LegacyRebarTextForDc(hdc).kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::None);
    if (t_desktopIconPaintHwnd) {
        return DrawThemeText_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pszText,
            cchText, dwTextFlags, dwTextFlags2, pRect);
    }

    RECT adjustedTabRect = {};
    if (CenterWinUiTabTextRect(
            hTheme, hdc, iPartId, &dwTextFlags,
            pRect, &adjustedTabRect)) {
        pRect = &adjustedTabRect;
    }

    // Must run before the g_darkModeActive gate below or this silently
    // never fires in light mode. Draws straight on hdc, no BufferedPaint --
    // matching the "Tab, Status, Combobox" branch further down, whose
    // DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION is that those controls' DCs interfere with
    // BeginBufferedPaint. The DirectWrite attempt below binds directly to
    // hdc too (no BufferedPaint), so it's unaffected by that same exception;
    // GDI DTT_TEXTCOLOR stays as the fallback.
    if (pRect && IsWinUiTabStyleActive() &&
        GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme) == L"Tab") {
        // TCS_MULTILINE allows multiple rows of tab items, not wrapped text
        // inside an individual item. Some theme paths still supply
        // DT_WORDBREAK; normalize the caption contract before both the
        // DirectWrite path and its native GDI fallback see the flags.
        dwTextFlags = (dwTextFlags & ~DT_WORDBREAK) | DT_SINGLELINE;
        DTTOPTS opts = { sizeof(DTTOPTS) };
        opts.dwFlags = DTT_TEXTCOLOR;
        GetThemeColor(hTheme, iPartId, iStateId, TMT_TEXTCOLOR, &opts.crText);
        RECT rc = *pRect;

        HFONT srcFont = (HFONT)GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT);
        LOGFONTW lf = {};
        if (srcFont && GetObjectW(srcFont, sizeof(lf), &lf)) {
            wcsncpy_s(lf.lfFaceName, SegoeUiVariableFace(), _TRUNCATE);
            lf.lfWeight = FW_SEMIBOLD;
            const float tabFontSizePx = std::max(
                1.0f, std::abs(static_cast<float>(lf.lfHeight)) * 1.02f);
            lf.lfHeight = lf.lfHeight < 0
                ? -static_cast<LONG>(std::lround(tabFontSizePx))
                : static_cast<LONG>(std::lround(tabFontSizePx));

            if (DrawWinUiStyledTextDWrite(hdc, &rc, pszText, cchText, lf,
                    opts.crText, dwTextFlags, /*tightWidth=*/true,
                    tabFontSizePx)) {
                return S_OK;
            }

            // GDI fallback if DirectWrite is unavailable/fails. ClearType,
            // not grayscale AA -- at this near-1:1 scale (1.02f) grayscale's
            // coarser GDI smoothing reads as pixelated.
            lf.lfQuality = CLEARTYPE_QUALITY;
            if (HFONT tabFont = g_winUiTabFontCache.Ensure(lf)) {
                HGDIOBJ oldFont = SelectObject(hdc, tabFont);
                HRESULT hr = DrawThemeTextEx_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
                    pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, &rc, &opts);
                SelectObject(hdc, oldFont);
                return hr;
            }
        }
        return DrawThemeTextEx_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
            pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, &rc, &opts);
    }

    // Accent button text: force color in BOTH dark and light modes.
    // Must be before g_darkModeActive check because light mode needs it too.
    //
    // IsTextPipelineDisabled() is too broad a veto here on its own: it's
    // also true for any window of an excluded process, but this specific
    // override is color-only (no glow/decorative rendering) and needs to
    // keep running inside an excluded process's file picker, whose native
    // frame is genuinely dark regardless of the host's own exclusion (see
    // IsInsideExcludedFilePicker).
    const bool accentTextAllowed = !g_darkModeExcluded ||
        IsInsideExcludedFilePicker(ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc));
    if (accentTextAllowed && g_settings.RoundedButtons && pRect) {
        const std::wstring& c = GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme);
        if (c == L"Button" && iPartId == BP_PUSHBUTTON && iStateId != PBS_DISABLED) {
            // This block (not DrawTextW_hook's Button-class case, which push
            // buttons never reach) is the one real path a push-button caption
            // paints through, in Explorer and inside Winver alike -- Winver's
            // own bespoke D2D caption draw (PaintPushButton's winverBlackCorner
            // branch) runs first, during DrawThemeBackground. Consuming the
            // flag here skips this block entirely when Winver already painted
            // the caption, instead of drawing it a second time.
            HWND hBtn = ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc);
            if (WinverConsumeButtonTextDrawn(hBtn))
                return S_OK;

            const bool isAccent = g_tlsIsAccentButton;
            const bool dark = g_tlsButtonDark;
            // PaintPushButton's own color for this state -- no GetThemeColor
            // query needed (and none wanted: it fails outright for some
            // part/state combos, the same bug class already fixed for Tab).
            const COLORREF textClr = g_tlsButtonTextColor != CLR_INVALID
                ? g_tlsButtonTextColor
                : isAccent ? (dark ? RGB(0, 0, 0) : RGB(255, 255, 255))
                           : (dark ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0));
            RECT rc = *pRect;

            // DirectWrite attempt, same pattern as every other substitution
            // in this file -- also covers the normal-button/light-mode case
            // this block used to skip entirely (isAccent||dark was false, so
            // it fell through to fully untouched native rendering).
            HFONT srcFont = (HFONT)GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT);
            LOGFONTW lf = {};
            if (srcFont && GetObjectW(srcFont, sizeof(lf), &lf)) {
                wcsncpy_s(lf.lfFaceName, L"Segoe UI Variable Text", _TRUNCATE);
                GrowRectForWinUiText(hdc, &rc, pszText, cchText, lf, dwTextFlags);
                if (DrawWinUiStyledTextDWrite(hdc, &rc, pszText, cchText, lf,
                        textClr, dwTextFlags)) {
                    return S_OK;
                }
            }

            // GDI fallback: forced DTT_TEXTCOLOR through a nested
            // (glow-guarded) DrawThemeTextEx call.
            DTTOPTS opts = { sizeof(DTTOPTS) };
            opts.dwFlags = DTT_TEXTCOLOR;
            opts.crText = textClr;
            // Composited DCs need DTT_COMPOSITED for correct alpha
            if (isAccent && !dark)
                opts.dwFlags |= DTT_COMPOSITED;
            g_glowEntry = true;
            HRESULT hr = DrawThemeTextEx(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
                pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, &rc, &opts);
            g_glowEntry = false;
            return hr;
        }
    }

    if (ShouldModernizeDragDrop() && pRect &&
        GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme) == L"DragDrop") {
        RECT rc = *pRect;
        HRESULT combinedLabelHr = TryDrawDragDropCombinedLabel(hTheme, hdc, iPartId,
            iStateId, pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, &rc);
        if (combinedLabelHr != E_NOTIMPL)
            return combinedLabelHr;
        return DrawDragDropThemeTextTransparent(hTheme, hdc, iPartId,
            iStateId, pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, &rc);
    }

    // Tab/Status DirectWrite attempt -- must run before the g_darkModeActive
    // gate below (same reason as the WinUI tab/accent button blocks above:
    // light mode needs the same rendering quality, not just dark mode's
    // color fixes). Only the DirectWrite attempt moves up here; the
    // DTT_TEXTCOLOR-forcing GDI path below stays exactly as it was (dark-
    // mode-only, its original color-fix purpose) -- if DirectWrite fails,
    // control falls through unchanged into it.
    if (!IsTextPipelineDisabled() && pRect && !IsAeroWizardRawWindow(WindowFromDC(hdc))) {
        const std::wstring& earlyCls = GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme);
        if (earlyCls == L"Tab" || earlyCls == L"Status") {
            // GetThemeColor fails outright for some part/state combos here
            // (confirmed for Tab's TABP_TOPTABITEM(_*EDGE), hr=0x80070490 --
            // same "no TMT_TEXTCOLOR declared" case GetThemeColor_hook already
            // special-cases for cls=="Tab"). Status isn't covered by that
            // special case and can hit the same failure, and an unchecked
            // HRESULT here left textClr at its zero-initialized value --
            // black text regardless of theme/dark mode. Falling
            // back to the DC's own current text color (already set correctly
            // by the control's own state handling) instead of leaving it at 0.
            COLORREF textClr = GetTextColor(hdc);
            if (FAILED(GetThemeColor(hTheme, iPartId, iStateId, TMT_TEXTCOLOR, &textClr)))
                textClr = FixDarkTextColor(GetTextColor(hdc));
            HFONT srcFont = (HFONT)GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT);
            LOGFONTW lf = {};
            if (srcFont && GetObjectW(srcFont, sizeof(lf), &lf)) {
                wcsncpy_s(lf.lfFaceName, L"Segoe UI Variable Text", _TRUNCATE);
                RECT rc = *pRect;
                GrowRectForWinUiText(hdc, &rc, pszText, cchText, lf, dwTextFlags);
                if (DrawWinUiStyledTextDWrite(hdc, &rc, pszText, cchText, lf,
                        textClr, dwTextFlags)) {
                    return S_OK;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Menu text on a popup whose surface this mod owns, in light mode. Over
    // an acrylic backdrop a pixel with no alpha is ADDED to the material
    // rather than covering it, which loses dark ink completely -- the same
    // trap the light tooltip hit, where the answer was to give native text an
    // alpha mask. Here the answer is the DirectWrite path, which writes real
    // alpha (measured). Dark mode already reaches it through the redirect at
    // the end of this function; light mode returns to the original before
    // getting there, so it is sent on explicitly.
    if (pRect && !g_darkModeActive && !IsTextPipelineDisabled() &&
        GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme) == L"Menu" &&
        MenuSurfaceIsOwned(MenuPopupBeingPainted(hdc),
                           /*answerWhenUnnamed=*/false)) {
        DTTOPTS menuOpts = { sizeof(DTTOPTS) };
        menuOpts.dwFlags = DTT_TEXTCOLOR;
        GetThemeColor(hTheme, iPartId, iStateId, TMT_TEXTCOLOR,
                      &menuOpts.crText);
        RECT menuRc = *pRect;
        return DrawThemeTextEx(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
            pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, &menuRc, &menuOpts);
    }

    if (IsTextPipelineDisabled() || !g_darkModeActive || !pRect ||
        IsAeroWizardRawWindow(WindowFromDC(hdc)) ||
        IsTaskbarThumbnailWindow(ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc)))
        return DrawThemeText_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
            pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, dwTextFlags2, pRect);

    const std::wstring& cls = GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme);

    // Tab, Status, Combobox, Button (non-push): DTT_TEXTCOLOR direct —
    // bypass BufferedPaint pipeline. These controls use non-composited or
    // DTT_COMPOSITED DCs where BeginBufferedPaint interferes. Direct
    // DTT_TEXTCOLOR works correctly. Predates the DirectWrite work above
    // (Tab/Status get a DirectWrite attempt first; Combobox/Button don't, so
    // this is the only path they take here) -- must stay separate from the
    // generic DrawThemeTextEx-redirect path further below, which routes
    // through our own DrawThemeTextEx_hook's BufferedPaint pipeline instead
    // and doesn't correctly resolve TMT_TEXTCOLOR for these classes in dark
    // mode (GetThemeColor legitimately has no color declared for several of
    // their part/state combos, and that path doesn't fall back the way this
    // one's caller-side handling below does).
    if (cls == L"Tab" || cls == L"Status" || cls == L"Combobox"
        || (cls == L"Button" && iPartId != BP_PUSHBUTTON)) {
        DTTOPTS opts = { sizeof(DTTOPTS) };
        opts.dwFlags = DTT_TEXTCOLOR;
        GetThemeColor(hTheme, iPartId, iStateId, TMT_TEXTCOLOR, &opts.crText);
        RECT rc = *pRect;
        // cls == L"Tab" with IsWinUiTabStyleActive() is handled earlier,
        // before the g_darkModeActive gate above (see that block's comment
        // for why) -- never reached with that combination here. Tab/Status
        // also get a DirectWrite attempt above, before this same gate --
        // reaching here with those two means it failed.
        return DrawThemeTextEx_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
            pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, &rc, &opts);
    }

    // All other classes: redirect to DrawThemeTextEx (goes through our hook)
    DTTOPTS opts = { sizeof(DTTOPTS) };
    opts.dwFlags = DTT_TEXTCOLOR;
    GetThemeColor(hTheme, iPartId, iStateId, TMT_TEXTCOLOR, &opts.crText);
    RECT rc = *pRect;
    return DrawThemeTextEx(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
        pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, &rc, &opts);
}

// ── DrawThemeTextEx → BeginBufferedPaint + DrawTextWithGlow (GLOBAL) ─────
// ALL themed text goes through BufferedPaint for correct alpha.
// No class-specific branching — one pipeline for everything.
HRESULT WINAPI DrawThemeTextEx_hook(HTHEME hTheme, HDC hdc, int iPartId,
    int iStateId, LPCWSTR pszText, int cchText, DWORD dwTextFlags,
    LPRECT pRect, const DTTOPTS* pOptions)
{
    const bool dialogDrawn = TryDrawLegacyRebarThemeText(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
            pszText, cchText, pRect, dwTextFlags, pOptions);
    if (dialogDrawn)
        return S_OK;
    if (TryDrawLegacyRebarCallback(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
            pszText, cchText, pRect, dwTextFlags, pOptions))
        return S_OK;
    LegacyRebarNativeTextScope rebarNative(
        LegacyRebarTextForDc(hdc).kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::None);
    if (t_desktopIconPaintHwnd) {
        return DrawThemeTextEx_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, pszText,
            cchText, dwTextFlags, pRect, pOptions);
    }

    // Classic comctl32-backed group headers (e.g. a common-dialog file
    // picker). pRect/iPartId/iStateId are direct arguments here -- no
    // correlation with another hook needed, so this applies to every real
    // paint, independent of hover/interaction state. Measurement calls must
    // stay native: DirectWrite would otherwise paint into their probe rect.
    // GetThemeFont itself returns a layout metric (e.g. row height), separate from what
    // DrawThemeTextEx_orig actually selects onto the DC to draw the glyphs
    // with, so the font actually has to be scaled here, at draw time.
    const bool groupHeaderMeasure = (dwTextFlags & DT_CALCRECT) ||
        (pOptions && (pOptions->dwFlags & DTT_CALCRECT));
    const bool modernGroupHeader = g_settings.RoundedButtons &&
        iPartId == LVP_GROUPHEADER &&
        IsListViewThemeClass(GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme));
    if (modernGroupHeader && groupHeaderMeasure) {
        return DrawThemeTextEx_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
            pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, pRect, pOptions);
    }
    if (modernGroupHeader) {
        LOGFONTW lf = {};
        HFONT bigFont = nullptr;
        if (SUCCEEDED(GetThemeFont(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, TMT_FONT, &lf))) {
            lf.lfHeight = (LONG)std::lround(lf.lfHeight * kGroupHeaderFontScale);
            // Same Semibold family/fallback as the single-line tab text.
            wcsncpy_s(lf.lfFaceName, SegoeUiVariableFace(), _TRUNCATE);
            lf.lfWeight = FW_SEMIBOLD;
            lf.lfQuality = ANTIALIASED_QUALITY;
            bigFont = g_groupHeaderFontCache.Ensure(lf);
        }
        HGDIOBJ oldFont = bigFont ? SelectObject(hdc, bigFont) : nullptr;

        // Local copy, both edges -- growing only the bottom shifts the
        // centered text instead of just adding descender clearance.
        RECT rc = *pRect;
        const LONG vMargin = (LONG)std::lround(2.0f * (DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.0f));
        rc.top -= vMargin;
        rc.bottom += vMargin;

        DTTOPTS textOpts = pOptions
            ? *pOptions
            : DTTOPTS{sizeof(DTTOPTS)};
        textOpts.dwFlags |= DTT_TEXTCOLOR;
        textOpts.crText = GroupHeaderTextColor(IsWindowDarkMode(hdc));

        if (bigFont && DrawWinUiStyledTextDWrite(hdc, &rc, pszText, cchText, lf,
                textOpts.crText, dwTextFlags)) {
            if (oldFont) SelectObject(hdc, oldFont);
            return S_OK;
        }

        HRESULT hr = DrawThemeTextEx_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
            pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, &rc, &textOpts);
        if (oldFont) SelectObject(hdc, oldFont);
        return hr;
    }

    // ExplorerMicaBackdrop: new, separate redirect to the existing
