    // BeginBufferedPaint+DrawTextWithGlow primitive, for LIGHT-mode Explorer
    // text specifically. Deliberately NOT threaded through the
    // g_darkModeActive gate further below (that pipeline is carefully tuned
    // for dark mode already; widening its gate risks breaking assumptions
    // downstream of it that were never exercised in light mode). Needed
    // because ExplorerMicaBackdrop forces these same theme classes' fills to
    // black (see GetThemeColor_hook) so the real Mica backdrop shows
    // through, and plain GDI text drawn straight onto that DWM-composited
    // surface leaves alpha at 0 -- same problem BeginBufferedPaint+
    // DrawTextWithGlow already solves for dark mode, just needed here in
    // light mode too. The black fill is a GDI-level placeholder, not the final
    // pixel -- DWM's own compositing replaces it with the real Mica material,
    // which in light mode renders light (confirmed ~#f3f3f3, not black).
    // Colors remain native except for
    // ExplorerStatusBar, whose WinUI opacity is flattened in GetThemeColor_hook.
    // Scoped to the same classes the black fill applies to, so nothing outside
    // those regions (e.g. the toolbar/address bar) is touched.
    if ((ExplorerMicaActive() || RgMicaActive()) && !g_darkModeActive &&
        !g_glowEntry && !IsTextPipelineDisabled() && pRect &&
        g_pDrawTextWithGlow &&
        !(pOptions && (pOptions->dwFlags & DTT_CALCRECT))) {
        const std::wstring& micaCls = GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme);
        const bool regeditMica = RgMicaActive();
        const bool shellMicaText =
            micaCls.find(L"ProperTree") != std::wstring::npos ||
            micaCls.find(L"ItemsView") != std::wstring::npos ||
            micaCls.find(L"ExplorerNavPane") != std::wstring::npos ||
            micaCls.find(L"ExplorerStatusBar") != std::wstring::npos;
        const HWND micaTextHwnd = (regeditMica || shellMicaText)
            ? ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc) : nullptr;
        if ((regeditMica && MicaLightTextNeedsGlow(micaTextHwnd)) ||
            (shellMicaText &&
             (IsInsideExplorer(micaTextHwnd) ||
              (FilePickerMicaActive() &&
                FilePickerRoot(micaTextHwnd) != nullptr)))) {
            COLORREF micaTextClr = pOptions ? pOptions->crText : RGB(0, 0, 0);
            GetThemeColor(hTheme, iPartId, iStateId, TMT_TEXTCOLOR, &micaTextClr);

            BLENDFUNCTION micaBf = { AC_SRC_OVER, 0, 255, AC_SRC_ALPHA };
            BP_PAINTPARAMS micaBpParam = { sizeof(BP_PAINTPARAMS) };
            micaBpParam.dwFlags = BPPF_ERASE;
            micaBpParam.pBlendFunction = &micaBf;
            HDC micaHdc = nullptr;
            HPAINTBUFFER micaPbuf = BeginBufferedPaint(
                hdc, pRect, BPBF_TOPDOWNDIB, &micaBpParam, &micaHdc);
            if (micaPbuf && micaHdc) {
                g_glowEntry = true;
                HFONT micaSrcFont = (HFONT)GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT);
                SelectObject(micaHdc, micaSrcFont);
                SetBkMode(micaHdc, GetBkMode(hdc));
                SetBkColor(micaHdc, GetBkColor(hdc));
                SetTextAlign(micaHdc, GetTextAlign(hdc));
                SetTextCharacterExtra(micaHdc, GetTextCharacterExtra(hdc));
                HRESULT micaHr = g_pDrawTextWithGlow(
                    micaHdc, pszText, cchText, pRect, dwTextFlags, micaTextClr,
                    0, 0, 0, FALSE, GlowDrawTextCallback, 0);
                EndBufferedPaint(micaPbuf, TRUE);
                g_glowEntry = false;
                if (SUCCEEDED(micaHr))
                    return S_OK;
            }
            // Falls through to the normal native/pipeline path below on any
            // failure above.
        }
    }

    // Classic places bar: comctl32 builds this control's DTTOPTS.crText
    // internally as black, bypassing both the WM_NOTIFY-stage SetTextColor
    // and the GetThemeColor fixup below. Override unconditionally, even when
    // the text pipeline is off -- this is a contrast fix for comctl32's own
    // color, not part of the mod's general text pipeline.
    if (IsClassicPlacesBarToolbar(g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc))) {
        DTTOPTS fixedOpts = pOptions ? *pOptions : DTTOPTS{ sizeof(DTTOPTS) };
        fixedOpts.dwFlags |= DTT_TEXTCOLOR;
        fixedOpts.crText = WinUI::Dark::TextFillColorPrimary;
        return DrawThemeTextEx_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
            pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, pRect, &fixedOpts);
    }

    if (ShouldModernizeDragDrop() && pRect && !(pOptions && (pOptions->dwFlags & DTT_CALCRECT))) {
        const std::wstring& cls = GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme);
        if (cls == L"DragDrop") {
            HRESULT combinedLabelHr = TryDrawDragDropCombinedLabel(hTheme, hdc, iPartId,
                iStateId, pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, pRect);
            if (combinedLabelHr != E_NOTIMPL)
                return combinedLabelHr;
            return DrawDragDropThemeTextTransparent(hTheme, hdc, iPartId,
                iStateId, pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, pRect);
        }
    }

    // Popup menu items (MENU_POPUPITEM etc.) DirectWrite attempt -- must run
    // before the g_darkModeActive gate below so light mode gets it too (same
    // reasoning as the LVP_GROUPHEADER/DragDrop blocks above). Still honors
    // g_glowEntry (reentrancy guard -- MENU_BARITEM's own DrawThemeTextEx
    // call already tried DirectWrite itself before falling back into this
    // same hook) and DTT_CALCRECT (measurement only, no real draw). Segoe UI
    // Variable Text, own weight kept as-is. The optional 12.8-DIP metric is
    // restricted to popup-item parts: menu bars retain their native font
    // size. Falls back to the BufferedPaint pipeline below (which correctly
    // handles composited/Mica popup backdrops) on any DirectWrite failure.
    if (pRect && !g_glowEntry && !IsTextPipelineDisabled() &&
        !(pOptions && (pOptions->dwFlags & DTT_CALCRECT)) &&
        GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme) == L"Menu") {
        DTTOPTS menuOpts = pOptions ? *pOptions : DTTOPTS{ sizeof(DTTOPTS) };
        menuOpts.dwFlags |= DTT_TEXTCOLOR;
        GetThemeColor(hTheme, iPartId, iStateId, TMT_TEXTCOLOR, &menuOpts.crText);
        HFONT srcFont = (HFONT)GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT);
        LOGFONTW lf = {};
        if (srcFont && GetObjectW(srcFont, sizeof(lf), &lf)) {
            wcsncpy_s(lf.lfFaceName, L"Segoe UI Variable Text", _TRUNCATE);
            const bool popupItem =
                iPartId == MENU_POPUPITEM || iPartId == 27;
            float menuTextOpacity = 1.0f;
            if (g_settings.ModernContextMenus && popupItem &&
                (iStateId == 3 /*MPI_DISABLED*/ ||
                 iStateId == 4 /*MPI_DISABLEDHOT*/) &&
                !SysHighContrastEnabled()) {
                const WinUI::Color disabled =
                    WinUI::TextFillColorDisabled(g_darkModeActive);
                menuOpts.crText = disabled.rgb;
                menuTextOpacity = disabled.alpha / 255.0f;
            }
            float menuTextSizePx = 0.0f;
            const UINT menuDpi = DpiForPaintHdc(hdc);
            if (g_settings.ModernContextMenus &&
                g_settings.MenuWinUiMetrics && popupItem) {
                menuTextSizePx = kMenuWinUiTextSizeDip *
                    static_cast<float>(menuDpi) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
                lf.lfHeight = -static_cast<LONG>(
                    std::lround(menuTextSizePx));
            }
            // MacType's ClipBoxFix reserves roughly 1.5 scaled pixels in the
            // glyph black box so descenders aren't shaved by a GDI-sized text
            // cell. DirectWrite cannot alter those GDI glyph metrics, so give
            // popup items the equivalent vertical allowance plus a smaller
            // horizontal allowance for the substituted/larger font's ink.
            const int menuVerticalInkPadPx = popupItem
                ? (std::max)(1, static_cast<int>(std::floor(
                    1.5f * menuDpi / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI)))
                : 0;
            const int menuHorizontalInkPadPx = popupItem
                ? (std::max)(1, static_cast<int>(std::lround(
                    1.0f * menuDpi / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI)))
                : 0;
            RECT rc = *pRect;
            GrowRectForWinUiText(hdc, &rc, pszText, cchText, lf, dwTextFlags);
            if (DrawWinUiStyledTextDWrite(hdc, &rc, pszText, cchText, lf,
                    menuOpts.crText, dwTextFlags, /*tightWidth=*/false,
                    menuTextSizePx, menuTextOpacity,
                    menuHorizontalInkPadPx, menuVerticalInkPadPx)) {
                return S_OK;
            }
        }
    }

    // Nav-pane TreeView item text, dark mode only (see NavTV_ScriptStringOut_
    // hook's own banner for light mode, handled separately there). In dark
    // mode, this hook's own BeginBufferedPaint+DrawTextWithGlow branch below
    // is what ends up producing the actual pixels, and DrawTextWithGlow calls
    // Uniscribe internally to do it -- substituting DirectWrite at that inner
    // Uniscribe call doesn't work, since BeginBufferedPaint's buffer is a
    // per-pixel-alpha surface DrawTextWithGlow knows how to composite
    // correctly, but DrawWinUiStyledTextDWrite's render target is built for a
    // real, opaque HDC and would leave the drawn pixels at alpha=0.
    // Substituting here instead, before BeginBufferedPaint ever runs, draws
    // straight onto the real, opaque hdc and skips DrawTextWithGlow (and its
    // internal Uniscribe call) entirely for this item.
    if (RoundedSelectionVisualsEnabled() && g_darkModeActive &&
        pRect && !g_glowEntry &&
        !IsTextPipelineDisabled() &&
        !(pOptions && (pOptions->dwFlags & DTT_CALCRECT)) &&
        GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme) == L"TreeView") {
        HWND tvHwnd = WindowFromDC(hdc);
        if (!tvHwnd) tvHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
        if (tvHwnd && GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(tvHwnd)) {
            DTTOPTS tvOpts = pOptions ? *pOptions : DTTOPTS{ sizeof(DTTOPTS) };
            tvOpts.dwFlags |= DTT_TEXTCOLOR;
            GetThemeColor(hTheme, iPartId, iStateId, TMT_TEXTCOLOR, &tvOpts.crText);
            tvOpts.crText = FixDarkTextColor(tvOpts.crText);
            HFONT srcFont = (HFONT)GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT);
            LOGFONTW lf = {};
            if (srcFont && GetObjectW(srcFont, sizeof(lf), &lf)) {
                wcsncpy_s(lf.lfFaceName, L"Segoe UI Variable Text", _TRUNCATE);
                // Same effective-pixels/13.2px reasoning as
                // NavTV_ScriptStringOut_hook.
                if (g_settings.NavPaneWinUIMetrics)
                    lf.lfHeight = -(LONG)std::lround(13.2f * DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.0f);

                // Same DirectWrite-native measurement as the Uniscribe path
                // (same cached IDWriteTextFormat/flags the draw call below
                // uses), falling back to the GDI measurement only if that
                // fails.
                const int textLen = cchText >= 0 ? cchText : (int)wcslen(pszText);
                const UINT drawFlags = (dwTextFlags & ~(DT_TOP | DT_BOTTOM)) |
                    DT_VCENTER | DT_SINGLELINE;
                SIZE extent = {};
                if (!MeasureWinUiStyledTextDWrite(pszText, textLen, lf, drawFlags,
                        DpiForPaintHdc(hdc), &extent)) {
                    if (HFONT measureFont = CreateFontIndirectW(&lf)) {
                        HGDIOBJ oldFont = SelectObject(hdc, measureFont);
                        GetTextExtentPoint32W(hdc, pszText, textLen, &extent);
                        SelectObject(hdc, oldFont);
                        DeleteObject(measureFont);
                    }
                }
                const LONG hPad = (LONG)std::lround(3.0f * (DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.0f));
                const LONG width = extent.cx + hPad;

                // Prefer comctl32's own real label rect (see t_navTvItemLabelRect's
                // banner) over pRect for the vertical bounds -- pRect alone
                // isn't the label's true vertical bounds.
                RECT rc = t_navTvItemLabelRectValid ? t_navTvItemLabelRect : *pRect;
                rc.right = rc.left + width;

                // Force DT_VCENTER since DirectWrite's line metrics for Segoe
                // UI Variable don't match whatever vertical position native
                // assumed.
                if (NavTV_DrawTextDWrite(tvHwnd, hdc, rc, pszText, cchText, lf,
                        tvOpts.crText, drawFlags)) {
                    return S_OK;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (IsTextPipelineDisabled() || !g_darkModeActive || !pRect || g_glowEntry || !g_pDrawTextWithGlow ||
        IsAeroWizardRawWindow(WindowFromDC(hdc)) ||
        IsTaskbarThumbnailWindow(ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc))) {
        return DrawThemeTextEx_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
            pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, pRect, pOptions);
    }

    if (pOptions && (pOptions->dwFlags & DTT_CALCRECT))
        return DrawThemeTextEx_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
            pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, pRect, pOptions);

    // DTT_COMPOSITED non-Menu: system handles alpha, but we still fix color
    if (pOptions && (pOptions->dwFlags & DTT_COMPOSITED)) {
        const std::wstring& cls = GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme);
        if (cls != L"Menu") {
            DTTOPTS fixedOpts = *pOptions;
            fixedOpts.dwFlags |= DTT_TEXTCOLOR;
            GetThemeColor(hTheme, iPartId, iStateId, TMT_TEXTCOLOR, &fixedOpts.crText);
            // uxtheme draws the composited text as a black DrawTextW mask;
            // the text hooks must leave that mask alone.
            const bool previousGlowEntry = g_glowEntry;
            g_glowEntry = true;
            const HRESULT hr = DrawThemeTextEx_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
                pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, pRect, &fixedOpts);
            g_glowEntry = previousGlowEntry;
            return hr;
        }
        // cls == L"Menu": the DirectWrite attempt above already ran before
        // this gate -- reaching here means it failed. Falls through to the
        // BufferedPaint pipeline below like before.
    }

    // BeginBufferedPaint + DrawTextWithGlow
    BLENDFUNCTION bf = { AC_SRC_OVER, 0, 255, AC_SRC_ALPHA };
    BP_PAINTPARAMS bpParam = { sizeof(BP_PAINTPARAMS) };
    bpParam.dwFlags = BPPF_ERASE;
    bpParam.prcExclude = nullptr;
    bpParam.pBlendFunction = &bf;

    HDC hDC = nullptr;
    HPAINTBUFFER pbuf = BeginBufferedPaint(hdc, pRect, BPBF_TOPDOWNDIB, &bpParam, &hDC);
    if (pbuf && hDC) {
        g_glowEntry = true;
        // Copy font. Fallback to theme font if DC has system default.
        HFONT srcFont = (HFONT)GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT);
        HFONT themeFont = nullptr;
        LOGFONTW lf = {};
        if (srcFont && GetObjectW(srcFont, sizeof(lf), &lf)) {
            if (_wcsicmp(lf.lfFaceName, L"System") == 0 || lf.lfFaceName[0] == 0) {
                LOGFONTW tlf = {};
                if (SUCCEEDED(GetThemeFont(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, TMT_FONT, &tlf)))
                    themeFont = CreateFontIndirectW(&tlf);
            }
        }
        SelectObject(hDC, themeFont ? themeFont : srcFont);
        SetBkMode(hDC, GetBkMode(hdc));
        SetBkColor(hDC, GetBkColor(hdc));
        SetTextAlign(hDC, GetTextAlign(hdc));
        SetTextCharacterExtra(hDC, GetTextCharacterExtra(hdc));

        COLORREF textClr = pOptions ? pOptions->crText : RGB(255, 255, 255);
        GetThemeColor(hTheme, iPartId, iStateId, TMT_TEXTCOLOR, &textClr);

        // DragDrop text: accent color when AccentColorize is active
        const std::wstring& dteCls = GetCachedThemeClass(hTheme);
        if (dteCls == L"DragDrop" && g_settings.AccentColorize) {
            if (g_accentCacheDirty.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) RefreshAccentCache();
            bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
            textClr = GetAccentFromPalette(dark ? 8 : 4);
        }
        // DragDrop: use _orig with DTT_TEXTCOLOR (system handles compositing)
        if (dteCls == L"DragDrop") {
            // Apply theme font to original DC if system default
            HFONT dragFont = nullptr;
            HGDIOBJ oldDragFont = nullptr;
            HFONT sf = (HFONT)GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT);
            LOGFONTW dlf = {};
            if (sf && GetObjectW(sf, sizeof(dlf), &dlf)) {
                if (_wcsicmp(dlf.lfFaceName, L"System") == 0 || dlf.lfFaceName[0] == 0) {
                    LOGFONTW tlf = {};
                    if (SUCCEEDED(GetThemeFont(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId, TMT_FONT, &tlf)))
                        dragFont = CreateFontIndirectW(&tlf);
                }
            }
            if (dragFont) oldDragFont = SelectObject(hdc, dragFont);
            if (themeFont) DeleteObject(themeFont);
            g_glowEntry = false;
            EndBufferedPaint(pbuf, FALSE);
            DTTOPTS dteOpts = pOptions ? *pOptions : DTTOPTS{ sizeof(DTTOPTS) };
            dteOpts.dwFlags |= DTT_TEXTCOLOR;
            dteOpts.crText = textClr;
            HRESULT hr = DrawThemeTextEx_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
                pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, pRect, &dteOpts);
            if (oldDragFont) SelectObject(hdc, oldDragFont);
            if (dragFont) DeleteObject(dragFont);
            return hr;
        }

        HRESULT hr = g_pDrawTextWithGlow(hDC, pszText, cchText, pRect, dwTextFlags,
            textClr, 0, 0, 0, FALSE, GlowDrawTextCallback, 0);

        if (themeFont) DeleteObject(themeFont);
        EndBufferedPaint(pbuf, TRUE);
        g_glowEntry = false;
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr))
            return S_OK;

        hr = DrawThemeTextEx_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
            pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, pRect, pOptions);
        return hr;
    }
    // Fallback if BeginBufferedPaint fails: DTT_TEXTCOLOR
    DTTOPTS fixedOpts = pOptions ? *pOptions : DTTOPTS{ sizeof(DTTOPTS) };
    fixedOpts.dwFlags |= DTT_TEXTCOLOR;
    GetThemeColor(hTheme, iPartId, iStateId, TMT_TEXTCOLOR, &fixedOpts.crText);
    return DrawThemeTextEx_orig(hTheme, hdc, iPartId, iStateId,
        pszText, cchText, dwTextFlags, pRect, &fixedOpts);
}

// Modern ItemsView group headers ("Today"/"Yesterday" etc.) draw via a raw
// DrawTextW call, not DrawThemeTextEx -- comctl32's GROUPHEADER font-scale
// branch above doesn't apply here. Defined near the DUI Element::Paint/
// GetParent/GetClass hooks further down; forward-declared so DrawTextW_hook
// can call it.
static bool TryDrawGroupHeaderText(HDC hdc, LPCWSTR text, INT cch,
    LPRECT lprc, UINT format, INT* outResult);

static void PrepareTooltipNativeTextFallback(
    HWND tooltip, HDC hdc, LPCRECT rect)
{
    if (!tooltip || !GetPropW(tooltip, kTooltipAcrylicActiveProp))
        return;

    HWND owner = GetWindow(tooltip, GW_OWNER);
    const bool ownerDark = owner
        ? IsHwndDarkMode(owner) : IsCustomDarkModeAllowed();
    TooltipDisableAcrylic(tooltip);

    // The current HDC still belongs to the acrylic paint pass. Give light
    // native text an opaque surface now; the queued repaint restores the
    // complete tooltip after the compositor effect is removed.
    if (!ownerDark && hdc && rect && FillRect_orig) {
        if (HBRUSH brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(WinUI::Light::SolidBackgroundFillColorTertiary))
            (void)FillRect_orig(hdc, rect, brush);
    }

    (void)RedrawWindow(tooltip, nullptr, nullptr,
        RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME);
}

struct TooltipCompositedTextContext {
    bool drawTextEx;
    bool hasParams;
    DRAWTEXTPARAMS params;
    INT nativeResult = 0;
    bool callbackDrawn = false;
};

static int WINAPI TooltipCompositedTextCallback(HDC hdc, LPWSTR text,
    int count, LPRECT rect, UINT format, LPARAM data)
{
    auto& context = *reinterpret_cast<TooltipCompositedTextContext*>(data);
    DRAWTEXTPARAMS params = context.params;
    const INT result = context.drawTextEx
        ? DrawTextExW_orig(hdc, text, count, rect, format,
            context.hasParams ? &params : nullptr)
        : DrawTextW_orig(hdc, text, count, rect, format);
    if (!(format & DT_CALCRECT)) {
        context.nativeResult = result;
        context.callbackDrawn = true;
        context.params.uiLengthDrawn = params.uiLengthDrawn;
    }
    return result;
}

// Keep native measurement/callback contracts; UxTheme owns alpha generation.
static bool DrawTooltipTextComposited(HDC hdc, LPCWSTR text, INT count,
    LPRECT rect, UINT format, bool drawTextEx, LPDRAWTEXTPARAMS params,
    INT* result)
{
    if (!hdc || !text || !rect || !result ||
        !DrawThemeTextEx_orig || !DrawTextW_orig || !DrawTextExW_orig ||
        (format & (DT_CALCRECT | DT_MODIFYSTRING)) ||
        GetMapMode(hdc) != MM_TEXT) {
        return false;
    }
    const INT length = count < 0 ? lstrlenW(text) : count;
    const LONG width = rect->right - rect->left;
    const LONG height = rect->bottom - rect->top;
    if (length < 0 || length > 32768 ||
        width <= 0 || height <= 0 || width > 4096 || height > 4096 ||
        static_cast<unsigned long long>(width) * height > 16ull * 1024 * 1024) {
        return false;
    }

    const HWND tooltip = ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc);
    // Borrow the control's theme, or open a paint-local one for unthemed tooltips.
    // A null HWND leaves the control's own visual style unchanged.
    struct PaintTheme {
        HTHEME owned = nullptr;
        ~PaintTheme() { if (owned) CloseThemeData_orig(owned); }
    } paintTheme;
    HTHEME theme = tooltip ? GetWindowTheme(tooltip) : nullptr;
    HFONT font = static_cast<HFONT>(GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT));
    if (!theme && font && OpenThemeData_orig && CloseThemeData_orig) {
        paintTheme.owned = OpenThemeData_orig(nullptr, L"TOOLTIP");
        theme = paintTheme.owned;
    }
    TooltipCompositedTextContext context{ drawTextEx, params != nullptr,
        params ? *params : DRAWTEXTPARAMS{ sizeof(DRAWTEXTPARAMS) } };
    const UINT_PTR acrylicTint = tooltip
        ? reinterpret_cast<UINT_PTR>(GetPropW(tooltip, kTooltipAcrylicActiveProp)) : 0;
    const bool dark = acrylicTint ? acrylicTint == 2
        : g_darkModeActive.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (!theme || !font) {
        return false;
    }

    BITMAPINFO bitmapInfo = {};
    bitmapInfo.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
    bitmapInfo.bmiHeader.biWidth = width;
    bitmapInfo.bmiHeader.biHeight = -height;
    bitmapInfo.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bitmapInfo.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bitmapInfo.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;
    void* bits = nullptr;
    HBITMAP bitmap = CreateDIBSection(hdc, &bitmapInfo,
        DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
    HDC memoryDc = bitmap ? CreateCompatibleDC(hdc) : nullptr;
    if (!bitmap || !bits || !memoryDc) {
        if (memoryDc) DeleteDC(memoryDc);
        if (bitmap) DeleteObject(bitmap);
        return false;
    }
    HGDIOBJ previousBitmap = SelectObject(memoryDc, bitmap);
    HGDIOBJ previousFont = SelectObject(memoryDc, font);
    if (!previousBitmap || previousBitmap == HGDI_ERROR ||
        !previousFont || previousFont == HGDI_ERROR) {
        if (previousFont && previousFont != HGDI_ERROR) SelectObject(memoryDc, previousFont);
        if (previousBitmap && previousBitmap != HGDI_ERROR) SelectObject(memoryDc, previousBitmap);
        DeleteDC(memoryDc);
        DeleteObject(bitmap);
        return false;
    }

    const COLORREF originalColor = GetTextColor(hdc);
    COLORREF textColor = FixDarkTextColor(originalColor);
    if (acrylicTint) {
        textColor = ReadableTextColorOn(textColor, originalColor,
            WinUiFloatingSurfaceColor(dark));
    } else if (g_darkModeActive &&
        BitBlt(memoryDc, 0, 0, width, height, hdc, rect->left, rect->top, SRCCOPY) &&
        GdiFlush()) {
        COLORREF background;
        if (CornerBackgroundFromBits(static_cast<const RGBQUAD*>(bits), width, height, &background))
            textColor = ReadableTextColorOn(textColor, originalColor, background);
    }
    if (textColor != CLR_INVALID && GetRValue(textColor) < 16 &&
        GetGValue(textColor) < 16 && GetBValue(textColor) < 16) {
        textColor = WinUI::FlattenOver(WinUI::TextFillColorPrimary(false),
            WinUiFloatingSurfaceColor(false));
    }
    std::memset(bits, 0, static_cast<size_t>(width) * height * sizeof(RGBQUAD));
    const DWORD layout = GetLayout(hdc);
    if (layout != GDI_ERROR) SetLayout(memoryDc, layout);
    SetTextAlign(memoryDc, GetTextAlign(hdc));
    const int characterExtra = GetTextCharacterExtra(hdc);
    if (characterExtra != static_cast<int>(0x80000000u))
        SetTextCharacterExtra(memoryDc, characterExtra);
    SetBkMode(memoryDc, TRANSPARENT);
    SetBkColor(memoryDc, RGB(0, 0, 0));
    SetTextColor(memoryDc, textColor);

    RECT localRect{ 0, 0, width, height };
    DTTOPTS options{ sizeof(DTTOPTS) };
    options.dwFlags = DTT_COMPOSITED | DTT_TEXTCOLOR | DTT_CALLBACK;
    options.crText = textColor;
    options.pfnDrawTextCallback = TooltipCompositedTextCallback;
    options.lParam = reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&context);
    const bool previousGlowEntry = g_glowEntry;
    g_glowEntry = true;
    const HRESULT hr = textColor == CLR_INVALID ? E_INVALIDARG
        : DrawThemeTextEx_orig(theme, memoryDc, 0, 0, text, count,
            format, &localRect, &options);
    g_glowEntry = previousGlowEntry;
    if (layout != GDI_ERROR) SetLayout(memoryDc, 0);
    const bool pixelsReady = GdiFlush() != FALSE;
    const BLENDFUNCTION blend{ AC_SRC_OVER, 0, 255, AC_SRC_ALPHA };
    const bool blended = SUCCEEDED(hr) && pixelsReady && context.callbackDrawn &&
        (context.nativeResult != 0 || length == 0) &&
        AlphaBlend(hdc, rect->left, rect->top, width, height,
            memoryDc, 0, 0, width, height, blend) != FALSE;
    if (blended) {
        *result = context.nativeResult;
        if (params) params->uiLengthDrawn = context.params.uiLengthDrawn;
    }
    SelectObject(memoryDc, previousFont);
    SelectObject(memoryDc, previousBitmap);
    DeleteDC(memoryDc);
    DeleteObject(bitmap);
    return blended;
}

// Explorer SysLink hover/pressed pill: while armed (only for the duration
// of one WM_PAINT on the specific hovered/pressed SysLink -- see
// ExplorerSysLinkSubclassProc), captures the real per-line rect(s) from
// DrawTextW's real (non-CALCRECT) draw calls for the active link's text.
// SysLink lays itself out through plain DrawTextW alone (never DrawTextExW),
// one call per run/line with a real *lprc each time -- reading that rect
// directly is exact, no separate measurement or calibration needed.
// Fixed storage, so a thread alive at unload holds nothing on the heap: a
// longer link text isn't captured, and a link wraps to at most 8 lines.
struct SysLinkPillCapture {
    bool active = false;
    HWND targetHwnd = nullptr;
    wchar_t targetText[256] = {}; // the active link's own plain-text substring
    size_t targetLength = 0;
    RECT rects[8] = {};
    int rectCount = 0;
};
static thread_local SysLinkPillCapture g_sysLinkPillCapture;

// Shared by DrawTextW_hook's dark-mode "all other controls" path and its
// ExplorerMicaBackdrop light-mode counterpart below: BeginBufferedPaint +
// DrawTextWithGlow, the alpha-mask pipeline composited/DWM surfaces need
// (plain SetTextColor leaves alpha at 0 there -- see the comment on
// DrawTextW_hook itself). Returns false when the buffer or the glow call
// isn't usable, so the caller can fall back to SetTextColor+DrawTextW_orig.
static bool DrawTextGlowBuffered(HDC hdc, LPCWSTR lpchText, INT cchText,
    LPRECT lprc, UINT format, COLORREF textClr, INT* outResult)
{
    if (!g_pDrawTextWithGlow) return false;

    BLENDFUNCTION bf = { AC_SRC_OVER, 0, 255, AC_SRC_ALPHA };
    BP_PAINTPARAMS bpParam = { sizeof(BP_PAINTPARAMS) };
    bpParam.dwFlags = BPPF_ERASE;
    bpParam.prcExclude = nullptr;
    bpParam.pBlendFunction = &bf;

    HDC hDC = nullptr;
    HPAINTBUFFER pbuf = BeginBufferedPaint(hdc, lprc, BPBF_TOPDOWNDIB, &bpParam, &hDC);
    if (!pbuf || !hDC) return false;

    g_glowEntry = true;
    SelectObject(hDC, GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT));
    SetBkMode(hDC, GetBkMode(hdc));
    SetBkColor(hDC, GetBkColor(hdc));
    SetTextAlign(hDC, GetTextAlign(hdc));
    SetTextCharacterExtra(hDC, GetTextCharacterExtra(hdc));
    SetMapMode(hDC, GetMapMode(hdc));

    const INT previousCallbackResult = g_glowCallbackResult;
    g_glowCallbackResult = 0;
    HRESULT hr = g_pDrawTextWithGlow(hDC, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format,
        textClr, 0, 0, 0, FALSE, GlowDrawTextCallback, 0);
    INT drawnResult = g_glowCallbackResult;
    g_glowCallbackResult = previousCallbackResult;

    EndBufferedPaint(pbuf, TRUE);
    g_glowEntry = false;
    *outResult = 0;
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) {
        // Callers stack lines with DrawText's result. The callback's own
        // DrawTextW already returned it; measuring again (a whole layout
        // pass, ~45% of a wrapped paragraph's cost) only when it didn't run.
        if (drawnResult <= 0) {
            RECT measured = *lprc;
            drawnResult = DrawTextW_orig(
                hdc, lpchText, cchText, &measured, format | DT_CALCRECT);
        }
        *outResult = drawnResult > 0 ? drawnResult : TRUE;
    }
    return SUCCEEDED(hr);
}

// DrawTextW once its color is decided against a background ExtTextOutW_hook
// won't see: an OPAQUE one (Uniscribe hands the glyphs over with the bk mode
// switched to transparent) or a transparent window's pixels. Its glyphs must
// not be recolored again without it.
static INT DrawTextOwningColor(HDC hdc, LPCWSTR text, INT count, LPRECT rect,
    UINT format, bool fromWindowPixels = false)
{
    if (GetBkMode(hdc) != OPAQUE && !fromWindowPixels)
        return DrawTextW_orig(hdc, text, count, rect, format);
    const bool previousGlowEntry = g_glowEntry;
    g_glowEntry = true;
    const INT result = DrawTextW_orig(hdc, text, count, rect, format);
    g_glowEntry = previousGlowEntry;
    return result;
}

static bool ControlPanelViewByLabelColor(HDC hdc, COLORREF* color);
static bool RgListTextDWrite(HDC hdc, LPCWSTR text, INT count, LPRECT rect,
    UINT format, INT* result);
static INT WINAPI DrawTextW_hook_impl(HDC hdc, LPCWSTR lpchText, INT cchText,
    LPRECT lprc, UINT format);

static bool TryDrawLegacyRebarMutableText(HDC hdc, LPCWSTR text, INT count,
    LPRECT rect, UINT flags, INT* result)
{
    const auto kind = LegacyRebarTextForDc(hdc).kind;
    const bool control = ExplorerDialogTextKind(kind) || kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::ModernCombo;
    const UINT supported = DT_MODIFYSTRING | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_NOPREFIX |
        DT_END_ELLIPSIS | DT_PATH_ELLIPSIS | DT_CENTER | DT_RIGHT |
        DT_VCENTER | DT_BOTTOM | DT_RTLREADING | DT_EXTERNALLEADING |
        (control ? DT_WORD_ELLIPSIS | DT_WORDBREAK | DT_EDITCONTROL : 0);
    if (!(flags & DT_MODIFYSTRING) ||
        (kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::Dropdown && !control) ||
        !text || !rect || !result || !DrawTextW_orig || count < -1 ||
        (flags & ~supported) || !(flags & DT_SINGLELINE) ||
        !(flags & DT_NOPREFIX) ||
        !(flags & (DT_END_ELLIPSIS | DT_PATH_ELLIPSIS | DT_WORD_ELLIPSIS)) ||
        rect->right <= rect->left || rect->bottom <= rect->top ||
        GetMapMode(hdc) != MM_TEXT || GetGraphicsMode(hdc) != GM_COMPATIBLE ||
        GetLayout(hdc) != 0 || GetTextCharacterExtra(hdc) != 0 ||
        (GetTextAlign(hdc) & (TA_UPDATECP | TA_CENTER | TA_BASELINE)))
        return false;
    const size_t length = count >= 0 ? static_cast<size_t>(count)
        : wcsnlen(text, 32769);
    if (!length || length > 32768)
        return false;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < length; ++i) {
        if (!text[i] || text[i] == L'\t' || text[i] == L'\r' || text[i] == L'\n')
            return false;
    }

    // DrawText owns ellipsis and caller-buffer mutation. Its default 1x1
    // memory bitmap is sufficient for formatting; no native pixels reach hdc.
    struct FormatDc {
        HDC dc = nullptr;
        HGDIOBJ oldFont = nullptr;
        ~FormatDc() {
            if (dc) {
                if (oldFont && oldFont != HGDI_ERROR) SelectObject(dc, oldFont);
                DeleteDC(dc);
            }
        }
    } memory{CreateCompatibleDC(hdc)};
    if (!memory.dc)
        return false;
    memory.oldFont = SelectObject(memory.dc, GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT));
    if (!memory.oldFont || memory.oldFont == HGDI_ERROR ||
        SetTextAlign(memory.dc, GetTextAlign(hdc)) == GDI_ERROR)
        return false;
    std::wstring formatted(length + 5, L'\0');
    memcpy(formatted.data(), text, length * sizeof(wchar_t));
    RECT nativeRect = *rect;
    INT nativeResult = 0;
    {
        LegacyRebarNativeTextScope native(true);
        const bool previousGlow = g_glowEntry;
        g_glowEntry = true;
        nativeResult = DrawTextW_orig(memory.dc, formatted.data(), count,
            &nativeRect, flags);
        g_glowEntry = previousGlow;
    }
    if (nativeResult <= 0)
        return false;
    const size_t visibleLength = wcsnlen(formatted.data(), formatted.size());
    if (!visibleLength || visibleLength >= formatted.size())
        return false;
    INT drawnResult = 0;
    const UINT drawFlags = flags &
        ~(DT_MODIFYSTRING | DT_END_ELLIPSIS | DT_PATH_ELLIPSIS | DT_WORD_ELLIPSIS);
    if (!TryDrawLegacyRebarText(hdc, formatted.data(), static_cast<INT>(visibleLength),
            rect, drawFlags, &drawnResult))
        return false;
    const bool modified = visibleLength != length ||
        memcmp(text, formatted.data(), length * sizeof(wchar_t)) != 0;
    if (modified) {
        memcpy(const_cast<LPWSTR>(text), formatted.data(),
            (visibleLength + 1) * sizeof(wchar_t));
    }
    *result = nativeResult;
    return true;
}

// Recolors Control Panel's "View by" label around the real hook (which
// tail-calls, so it can't restore the DC itself).
INT WINAPI DrawTextW_hook(HDC hdc, LPCWSTR lpchText, INT cchText, LPRECT lprc, UINT format)
{
    if (g_ribbonTextHost)
        LegacyRibbonObserveDrawTextCaller(hdc, format, __builtin_return_address(0));
    INT ribbonResult = 0;
    if (g_ribbonTextHost && TryDrawLegacyRibbonDirectText(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc,
            format, __builtin_return_address(0), &ribbonResult))
        return ribbonResult;
    COLORREF labelColor;
    // Explorer InfoBar text: its color, and its rect starting after the
    // severity icon (layout measurements keep the native rect).
    if (!(format & DT_CALCRECT) && lprc && !t_explorerInfoBarTextShifted &&
        ExplorerInfoBarTextColor(hdc,
            {(lprc->left + lprc->right) / 2, (lprc->top + lprc->bottom) / 2},
            &labelColor)) {
        RECT shifted = *lprc;
        if (t_explorerInfoBarPaint.textLeft < shifted.right)
            shifted.left = std::max(shifted.left, t_explorerInfoBarPaint.textLeft);
        const COLORREF previous = SetTextColor(hdc, labelColor);
        t_explorerInfoBarTextShifted = true;
        const INT result = DrawTextW_hook_impl(hdc, lpchText, cchText, &shifted, format);
        t_explorerInfoBarTextShifted = false;
        SetTextColor(hdc, previous);
        return result;
    }
    if (!(format & DT_CALCRECT) && ControlPanelViewByLabelColor(hdc, &labelColor)) {
        const COLORREF previous = SetTextColor(hdc, labelColor);
        const INT result = DrawTextW_hook_impl(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format);
        SetTextColor(hdc, previous);
        return result;
    }
    [[clang::musttail]] return DrawTextW_hook_impl(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format);
}

// ── DrawTextW → BeginBufferedPaint + DrawTextWithGlow (GLOBAL) ───────────
// ALL DrawTextW calls go through BufferedPaint. No class checks.
// Even white text needs BufferedPaint to fix alpha on composited DCs.
static INT WINAPI DrawTextW_hook_impl(HDC hdc, LPCWSTR lpchText, INT cchText,
    LPRECT lprc, UINT format)
{
    // Capture SysLink geometry even when the caption is replaced below.
    if (g_sysLinkPillCapture.active && !g_legacyRebarTextNative && lprc && lpchText &&
        !(format & DT_CALCRECT) &&
        (g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc)) == g_sysLinkPillCapture.targetHwnd) {
        const size_t len = cchText >= 0 ? (size_t)cchText : wcslen(lpchText);
        auto& capture = g_sysLinkPillCapture;
        if (len > 0 &&
            capture.rectCount < static_cast<int>(ARRAYSIZE(capture.rects)) &&
            std::wstring_view(capture.targetText, capture.targetLength).find(
                std::wstring_view(lpchText, len)) != std::wstring_view::npos) {
            capture.rects[capture.rectCount++] = *lprc;
        }
    }
    INT rebarResult = 0;
    const bool rebarDrawn = (format & DT_MODIFYSTRING)
        ? TryDrawLegacyRebarMutableText(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc,
            format, &rebarResult)
        : TryDrawLegacyRebarText(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc,
            format, &rebarResult);
    LegacyRebarCallbackRecord(hdc, format, rebarDrawn);
    if (rebarDrawn)
        return rebarResult;
    if (LegacyRebarTextForDc(hdc).kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::None) {
        LegacyRebarNativeTextScope rebarNative(true);
        return DrawTextW_hook_impl(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format);
    }
    // Both desktop paths are required for artifact-free labels: the shadow
    // context repairs shadowed items, while the direct path handles labels
    // for which comctl32 bypasses DrawShadowTextEx. Neither is optional.
    if (g_desktopShadowTextContext) {
        const unsigned pass = ++g_desktopShadowTextContext->drawTextPass;
        INT result = 0;
        if (pass <= 2 && DrawShellItemTextDWrite(
                hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format, pass, &result))
            return result;
    } else if (g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite &&
               !IsTextPipelineDisabled() &&
               (g_desktopTextPaintHwnd || g_desktopDragImageTextHwnd)) {
        // Without this path, the original GDI surface leaves opaque/black
        // artifacts around labels drawn with icon shadows disabled.
        HWND desktopTextHwnd = g_desktopTextPaintHwnd
            ? g_desktopTextPaintHwnd : g_desktopDragImageTextHwnd;
        INT result = 0;
        if (IsDesktopIconListView(desktopTextHwnd) &&
            DrawShellItemTextDWrite(
                hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format, 2, &result)) {
            return result;
        }
    }

    // Desktop icon labels: DirectWrite above, otherwise native.
    if (t_desktopIconPaintHwnd)
        return DrawTextW_orig(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format);

    if (!(format & DT_CALCRECT) && lprc && !g_glowEntry &&
        !IsTextPipelineDisabled()) {
        INT result = 0;
        if (RgListTextDWrite(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format, &result))
            return result;
    }

    HWND splitChevronHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
    HWND paintHwnd = splitChevronHwnd;

    // Group header font: unconditional, before any dark-mode/pipeline gate
    // below, same reasoning as the DrawThemeTextEx_hook GROUPHEADER branch --
    // applies regardless of hover/interaction state or light/dark mode.
    {
        INT groupHeaderResult = 0;
        if (TryDrawGroupHeaderText(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format, &groupHeaderResult))
            return groupHeaderResult;
    }

    if (g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite &&
        !IsTextPipelineDisabled() && g_duiExplorerTextPaintElement) {
        INT result = 0;
        if (DrawShellItemTextDWrite(
                hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format, 2, &result,
                g_duiExplorerTextWeightBoost, 0.0f)) {
            return result;
        }
    }

    // Skip the GDI draw of a caption PaintPushButton already drew via D2D
    // (see WinverMarkButtonTextDrawn). DT_CALCRECT is measurement only --
    // don't consume the mark there, or the real paint call after it would
    // go through unsuppressed.
    if (!(format & DT_CALCRECT) && WinverConsumeButtonTextDrawn(paintHwnd))
        return lprc ? std::max(1L, lprc->bottom - lprc->top) : 1;

    if (g_tlsDragDropTextPaint && hdc && lprc && !(format & DT_CALCRECT)) {
        COLORREF oldText = CLR_INVALID;
        if (!g_tlsDragDropPreserveTextColor)
            oldText = SetTextColor(hdc, DragDropBadgeTextColor(hdc));
        int oldBkMode = SetBkMode(hdc, TRANSPARENT);
        INT ret = DrawTextW_orig(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format);
        if (oldBkMode) SetBkMode(hdc, oldBkMode);
        if (!g_tlsDragDropPreserveTextColor)
            SetTextColor(hdc, oldText);
        return ret;
    }

    // File operation progress dialog: recolor the source/destination folder
    // name link text to the accent color. Checked before the dark-mode gate
    // below since this applies in light mode too — it's a fixed-blue/accent
    // swap, not a structural dark-mode change.
    if (!(format & DT_CALCRECT) && g_settings.AccentColorize &&
        IsFileOpProgressWindow(paintHwnd)) {
        COLORREF origClr = GetTextColor(hdc);
        if (FileOpColorCloseTo(origClr, kFileOpLinkTextColor, 10)) {
            bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
            COLORREF accent = GetAccentFillDefault(dark);
            SetTextColor(hdc, accent);
            INT ret = DrawTextW_orig(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format);
            SetTextColor(hdc, origClr);
            return ret;
        }
    }

    if (!(format & DT_CALCRECT) && !g_glowEntry && lprc &&
        IsNativeSplitButtonChevronText(splitChevronHwnd, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format)) {
        // A disabled button embosses the glyph: a lighter pass one pixel down
        // and right, then the COLOR_BTNSHADOW pass in place. Only the latter
        // gets the chevron.
        if (!IsWindowEnabled(splitChevronHwnd) &&
            GetTextColor(hdc) != GetSysColor(COLOR_BTNSHADOW))
            return std::max(1L, lprc->bottom - lprc->top);
        if (DrawSplitButtonChevronGlyph(hdc, lprc, splitChevronHwnd))
            return std::max(1L, lprc->bottom - lprc->top);

        return std::max(1L, lprc->bottom - lprc->top);
    }

    // Keep comctl32 authoritative for CALCRECT, wrapping and tooltip sizing.
    // The visible pass uses the native layout through UxTheme's alpha callback.
    if (!g_glowEntry && TooltipTextIsEnabled()) {
        HWND tooltip = ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc);
        if (TooltipTextIsWindow(tooltip)) {
            if (format & DT_CALCRECT)
                return DrawTextW_orig(
                    hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format);

            INT result = 0;
            if (lprc && DrawTooltipTextComposited(hdc, lpchText, cchText,
                    lprc, format, false, nullptr, &result)) {
                return result;
            }

            PrepareTooltipNativeTextFallback(tooltip, hdc, lprc);
            COLORREF originalColor = GetTextColor(hdc);
            COLORREF textColor = lprc
                ? FixDarkTextColorOverDc(hdc, *lprc, originalColor)
                : FixDarkTextColor(originalColor);
            if (textColor != originalColor)
                SetTextColor(hdc, textColor);
            result = DrawTextW_orig(
                hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format);
            if (textColor != originalColor)
                SetTextColor(hdc, originalColor);
            return result;
        }
    }

    // ExplorerMicaBackdrop: LIGHT-mode counterpart to the g_darkModeActive
    // gate right below (same reasoning as the matching block in
    // DrawThemeTextEx_hook -- a separate carve-out rather than widening
    // that gate, since this function's own contract is that ALL DrawTextW
    // calls reaching the glow pipeline get it unconditionally, with no
    // per-call color-unchanged bailout to narrow scope back down the way
    // ExtTextOutW_hook has). MicaLightTextNeedsGlow's own comment
    // has the full reasoning: the content view/nav-pane/status-bar sit
    // over a genuinely DWM-composited surface here, so plain GDI text
    // needs this alpha-safe pipeline to render at all. This path preserves the
    // HDC's current color; ExplorerStatusBar can already carry the WinUI shade
    // supplied by GetThemeColor_hook, while the other classes remain native.
    if ((ExplorerMicaActive() || RgMicaActive()) && !g_darkModeActive &&
        !g_glowEntry && !(format & DT_CALCRECT) && lprc &&
        !IsTextPipelineDisabled() &&
        MicaLightTextNeedsGlow(splitChevronHwnd)) {
        INT glowResult = 0;
        if (DrawTextGlowBuffered(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format,
                GetTextColor(hdc), &glowResult))
            return glowResult;
        // Buffer/glow unavailable -- fall through to the native path below,
        // same (unchanged) color, just without the alpha-safe compositing.
    }

    // ReBar search box placeholder text: see the matching gate in
    // ExtTextOutW_hook for why this can't be remapped to a dark-mode color.
    if ((format & DT_CALCRECT) || g_glowEntry || IsTextPipelineDisabled() ||
        !g_darkModeActive || !lprc ||
        IsAeroWizardRawWindow(splitChevronHwnd) ||
        IsTaskbarThumbnailWindow(splitChevronHwnd) ||
        IsInsideSearchEditBoxWrapper(splitChevronHwnd))
        [[clang::musttail]] return DrawTextW_orig(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format);

    // Win11 context menus draw their chevron/check/radio glyphs as a single
    // Segoe Fluent Icons char via DrawTextW (shell32's s_DrawGlyph) -- force
    // its color so it can't render invisible against a dark menu.
    if (cchText == 1 &&
        (lpchText[0] == 0xE974 /* ChevronRightMed */ ||
         lpchText[0] == 0xE973 /* ChevronLeftMed   */ ||
         lpchText[0] == 0xF78C /* AcceptMedium     */ ||
         lpchText[0] == 0xE915 /* RadioBullet      */)) {
        COLORREF origClr = GetTextColor(hdc);
        SetTextColor(hdc, RGB(255, 255, 255));
        INT ret = DrawTextW_orig(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format);
        SetTextColor(hdc, origClr);
        return ret;
    }

    // Known non-composited controls: simple SetTextColor (old method, proven).
    paintHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
    if (!paintHwnd) paintHwnd = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (paintHwnd) {
        wchar_t wc[64] = {};
        GetClassNameW(paintHwnd, wc, ARRAYSIZE(wc));
        bool simpleSafe = (_wcsicmp(wc, L"msctls_statusbar32") == 0 ||
                           _wcsicmp(wc, L"Static") == 0 ||
                           _wcsicmp(wc, L"Button") == 0 ||
                           _wcsicmp(wc, L"ComboBox") == 0 ||
                           _wcsicmp(wc, L"#32770") == 0 ||
                           _wcsicmp(wc, L"SysListView32") == 0 ||
                           _wcsicmp(wc, L"SysTreeView32") == 0 ||
                           _wcsicmp(wc, L"SysHeader32") == 0 ||
                           wcsstr(wc, L"SysTabCtl") != nullptr);
        if (simpleSafe) {
            COLORREF origClr = GetTextColor(hdc);
            bool fromWindowPixels = false;
            COLORREF fixedClr = FixDarkTextColorForDc(hdc, origClr, lprc,
                &fromWindowPixels);
            if (fixedClr != origClr) {
                SetTextColor(hdc, fixedClr);
                INT ret = DrawTextOwningColor(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format,
                    fromWindowPixels);
                SetTextColor(hdc, origClr);
                return ret;
            }
            return DrawTextW_orig(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format);
        }

        // Modern tooltip text already returned through the composited path.
        // Reaching here means that feature is disabled.
    }

    // All other controls: BeginBufferedPaint + DrawTextWithGlow. Not for the
    // OPAQUE bk mode: the glow buffer only carries the text, so the cell
    // background the app asked for would be lost; the native path below
    // paints it.
    if (GetBkMode(hdc) != OPAQUE) {
        COLORREF textClr = FixDarkTextColorForDc(hdc, GetTextColor(hdc), lprc);
        INT glowResult = 0;
        if (DrawTextGlowBuffered(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format,
                textClr, &glowResult))
            return glowResult;
    }
    // Buffer or glow unavailable -- use SetTextColor (works on non-composited DCs)
    {
        COLORREF origClr = GetTextColor(hdc);
        bool fromWindowPixels = false;
        COLORREF fixedClr = FixDarkTextColorForDc(hdc, origClr, lprc,
            &fromWindowPixels);
        if (fixedClr != origClr) SetTextColor(hdc, fixedClr);
        INT ret = DrawTextOwningColor(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format,
            fromWindowPixels);
        if (fixedClr != origClr) SetTextColor(hdc, origClr);
        return ret;
    }
}

// ── DrawTextExW → redirect to DrawTextW ──────────────────────────────────
BOOL WINAPI DrawTextExW_hook(HDC hdc, LPWSTR lpchText, INT cchText,
    LPRECT lprc, UINT format, LPDRAWTEXTPARAMS lpdtp)
{
    INT rebarResult = 0;
    const bool rebarDrawn = !lpdtp && TryDrawLegacyRebarText(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc,
        format, &rebarResult);
    LegacyRebarCallbackRecord(hdc, format, rebarDrawn);
    if (rebarDrawn)
        return rebarResult;
    LegacyRebarNativeTextScope rebarNative(
        lpdtp && LegacyRebarTextForDc(hdc).kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::None);
    // Desktop icon labels: only the DirectWrite option, reached through
    // DrawTextW exactly when the delegation at the end of this hook would.
    if (t_desktopIconPaintHwnd) {
        if (!IsTextPipelineDisabled() && g_darkModeActive && !g_glowEntry &&
            !lpdtp && !(format & DT_CALCRECT) && lpchText) {
            return (BOOL)DrawTextW_hook(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format);
        }
        return DrawTextExW_orig(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format, lpdtp);
    }
    // Same suppression as DrawTextW_hook -- needed here too since the
    // delegation below only fires when lpdtp is null, and buttons commonly
    // pass a real DRAWTEXTPARAMS (mnemonic prefix handling).
    if (!(format & DT_CALCRECT) && WinverTextMarksPending()) {
        HWND paintHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
        if (WinverConsumeButtonTextDrawn(paintHwnd)) {
            // DrawTextExW's real contract returns the text height in logical
            // units, not a plain success flag -- a caller doing layout math
            // on the result would get it wrong with a synthesized TRUE (1).
            // DT_CALCRECT measures without drawing, so this still suppresses
            // the actual native paint (already drawn by our own logic).
            // Measure into a local copy -- the caller issued a drawing call
            // and doesn't expect DT_CALCRECT to write the measured box back
            // into its own *lprc.
            RECT tmp = *lprc;
            return DrawTextExW_orig(hdc, lpchText, cchText, &tmp,
                format | DT_CALCRECT, lpdtp);
        }
    }

    if (!g_glowEntry && TooltipTextIsEnabled()) {
        HWND tooltip = ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc);
        if (TooltipTextIsWindow(tooltip)) {
            if (format & DT_CALCRECT) {
                return DrawTextExW_orig(hdc, lpchText, cchText,
                    lprc, format, lpdtp);
            }

            INT result = 0;
            if (lprc && DrawTooltipTextComposited(hdc, lpchText, cchText,
                    lprc, format, true, lpdtp, &result)) {
                return result;
            }

            PrepareTooltipNativeTextFallback(tooltip, hdc, lprc);
            COLORREF originalColor = GetTextColor(hdc);
            COLORREF textColor = lprc
                ? FixDarkTextColorOverDc(hdc, *lprc, originalColor)
                : FixDarkTextColor(originalColor);
            if (textColor != originalColor)
                SetTextColor(hdc, textColor);
            result = DrawTextExW_orig(
                hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format, lpdtp);
            if (textColor != originalColor)
                SetTextColor(hdc, originalColor);
            return result;
        }
    }

    if (!IsTextPipelineDisabled() && g_darkModeActive && !g_glowEntry &&
        !lpdtp && !(format & DT_CALCRECT) && lpchText) {
        return (BOOL)DrawTextW_hook(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format);
    }
    return DrawTextExW_orig(hdc, lpchText, cchText, lprc, format, lpdtp);
}

// Gamma-corrects mask luminance before it's used as alpha, so anti-aliased
// edge pixels don't read thinner here than DrawTextW_hook's composited path.
static const std::array<BYTE, 256>& TextAlphaGammaLUT()
{
    static const std::array<BYTE, 256> lut = [] {
        std::array<BYTE, 256> t{};
        for (int i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
            float a = i * (1.0f / 255.0f);
            float g = std::pow(a, 1.0f / 1.4f);
            t[i] = (BYTE)(g * 255.0f + 0.5f);
        }
        return t;
    }();
    return lut;
}

// Where an ExtTextOutW call without a rectangle draws, for the mask below:
// the run's advance placed by the DC's text alignment, padded for glyph
// overhangs and limited to the clip box. The inner call ExtTextOutW makes
// through Uniscribe (ETO_IGNORELANGUAGE) is the common case; sizing it by
// the clip box masked the whole window on every text draw (4.6 ms at
// 1582x953, against ~25 us native). Rotated fonts, mapping modes, world
// transforms, mirrored DCs and per-glyph vertical or backward offsets keep
// the clip box. False when nothing would be visible or the size is unknown.
// Unpadded, it's the text cell alone, whose corners lie on the text's own
// background (MemoryDcTextBackground) rather than beside it.
static bool ExtTextOutTextBounds(HDC hdc, int x, int y, UINT options,
    LPCWSTR text, UINT count, const INT* dx, RECT* bounds, bool padded = true)
{
    RECT clip = {};
    const int clipKind = GetClipBox(hdc, &clip);
    if (clipKind == ERROR || clipKind == NULLREGION || !text || !count)
        return false;

    LOGFONTW font = {};
    TEXTMETRICW metrics = {};
    if ((options & ETO_PDY) || GetMapMode(hdc) != MM_TEXT ||
        GetGraphicsMode(hdc) == GM_ADVANCED ||
        (GetLayout(hdc) & LAYOUT_RTL) ||
        !GetObjectW(GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT), sizeof(font), &font) ||
        font.lfEscapement != 0 || !GetTextMetricsW(hdc, &metrics)) {
        *bounds = clip;
        return true;
    }

    LONG advance = 0;
    if (dx) {
        for (UINT i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            if (dx[i] < 0) {
                *bounds = clip;
                return true;
            }
            advance += dx[i];
        }
    } else {
        SIZE size = {};
        const BOOL measured = (options & ETO_GLYPH_INDEX)
            ? GetTextExtentPointI(hdc, const_cast<LPWORD>(
                  reinterpret_cast<const WORD*>(text)), count, &size)
            : GetTextExtentPoint32W(hdc, text, count, &size);
        if (!measured)
            return false;
        advance = size.cx;
    }

    const UINT align = GetTextAlign(hdc);
    if (align & TA_UPDATECP) {
        POINT current = {};
        if (GetCurrentPositionEx(hdc, &current)) {
            x = current.x;
            y = current.y;
        }
    }
    LONG left = x;
    if ((align & TA_CENTER) == TA_CENTER)
        left = x - advance / 2;
    else if (align & TA_RIGHT)
        left = x - advance;
    LONG top = y;
    if ((align & TA_BASELINE) == TA_BASELINE)
        top = y - metrics.tmAscent;
    else if (align & TA_BOTTOM)
        top = y - metrics.tmHeight;

    // Italic and ClearType glyphs reach past the advance, accents past the
    // cell.
    const LONG padX = padded ? metrics.tmAveCharWidth + metrics.tmOverhang : 0;
    const LONG padY = padded ? metrics.tmHeight / 2 : 0;
    const RECT textBounds = {
        left - padX, top - padY,
        left + advance + padX, top + metrics.tmHeight + padY };
    return IntersectRect(bounds, &textBounds, &clip) != FALSE;
}

// ── ExtTextOutW → DIB + AlphaBlend (GLOBAL) ─────────────────────────────
// ExtTextOutW can't use DrawTextWithGlow because it supports glyph indices
// and opaque backgrounds. Manual DIB compositing handles all cases.
static bool DrawEditableGlyphTextDWrite(HDC hdc, int x, int y, UINT options,
    const RECT* clip, LPCWSTR glyphs, UINT count, const INT* advances)
{
    // Uniscribe/GDI remains the layout authority. Glyph IDs belong to the
    // physical HFONT, not our substituted caption font; caret/IME stay native.
    constexpr UINT supported = ETO_GLYPH_INDEX | ETO_CLIPPED | ETO_OPAQUE |
        ETO_PDY | ETO_RTLREADING;
    if (!hdc || !(options & ETO_GLYPH_INDEX) || !count || count > 8192 ||
        !glyphs || !advances || (options & ~supported) ||
        ((options & (ETO_CLIPPED | ETO_OPAQUE)) && !clip) ||
        GetMapMode(hdc) != MM_TEXT || GetGraphicsMode(hdc) != GM_COMPATIBLE ||
        GetLayout(hdc) != 0 || GetTextCharacterExtra(hdc) != 0)
        return false;
    const UINT align = GetTextAlign(hdc);
    if (align == GDI_ERROR || (align & TA_UPDATECP))
        return false;
    LOGFONTW font = {};
    TEXTMETRICW metrics = {};
    if (GetObjectW(GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT), sizeof(font), &font) != sizeof(font) ||
        !GetTextMetricsW(hdc, &metrics) || font.lfEscapement || font.lfOrientation ||
        font.lfWidth || font.lfUnderline || font.lfStrikeOut ||
        !(metrics.tmPitchAndFamily & TMPF_TRUETYPE) ||
        metrics.tmHeight <= metrics.tmInternalLeading)
        return false;
    RECT bounds = {};
    const int complexity = GetClipBox(hdc, &bounds);
    if (complexity == ERROR)
        return false;
    if (complexity == NULLREGION)
        return true;
    if ((options & ETO_CLIPPED) && !IntersectRect(&bounds, &bounds, clip))
        return true;
    const int64_t width = int64_t(bounds.right) - bounds.left;
    const int64_t height = int64_t(bounds.bottom) - bounds.top;
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0 || width > 4096 || height > 4096 ||
        width * height > 1024 * 1024)
        return false;
    const COLORREF color = GetTextColor(hdc);
    const int backgroundMode = GetBkMode(hdc);
    if (color == CLR_INVALID || (backgroundMode != OPAQUE && backgroundMode != TRANSPARENT))
        return false;
    D2DThreadCache* thread = D2DGetThreadCache();
    if (!thread || !EnsureD2DFactory())
        return false;
    auto& scratch = thread->shellTextRaster;
    if (!scratch.editInterop) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_winUiTextDwMutex);
        auto* factory = WinUiTextEnsureDWriteFactoryLocked();
        if (!factory)
            return false;
        const HRESULT hr = factory->GetGdiInterop(&scratch.editInterop);
        if (FAILED(hr)) {
            ShellTextRasterLogError(L"edit-GDI-interop", hr);
            return false;
        }
    }
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteFontFace> face;
    const HRESULT faceHr = scratch.editInterop->CreateFontFaceFromHdc(hdc, &face);
    if (FAILED(faceHr)) {
        ShellTextRasterLogError(L"edit-font-face", faceHr);
        return false;
    }
    try {
        scratch.editAdvances.resize(count);
        scratch.editOffsets.resize(count);
    } catch (const std::bad_alloc&) {
        return false;
    }
    int64_t total = 0, vertical = 0;
    for (UINT i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        const int advance = advances[(options & ETO_PDY) ? 2 * i : i];
        if (std::abs(int64_t(advance)) > 65536 || std::abs(vertical) > 65536)
            return false;
        scratch.editAdvances[i] = static_cast<float>(advance);
        scratch.editOffsets[i] = {0.f, static_cast<float>(-vertical)};
        total += advance;
        if (options & ETO_PDY) {
            const int dy = advances[2 * i + 1];
            // Opaque per-glyph vertical cells need the native renderer.
            if (backgroundMode == OPAQUE && dy)
                return false;
            vertical += dy;
        }
    }
    if (std::abs(total) > 65536)
        return false;
    if (backgroundMode == OPAQUE && total < 0)
        return false;
    FPUGuard fpu;
    float originX = static_cast<float>(x), baseline = static_cast<float>(y);
    if ((align & TA_CENTER) == TA_CENTER)
        originX -= static_cast<float>(total) / 2.f;
    else if (align & TA_RIGHT)
        originX -= static_cast<float>(total);
    if ((align & TA_BASELINE) != TA_BASELINE)
        baseline += (align & TA_BOTTOM) ? -metrics.tmDescent : metrics.tmAscent;
    if (double(originX) < LONG_MIN || double(originX) > LONG_MAX ||
        double(originX) + total < LONG_MIN || double(originX) + total > LONG_MAX ||
        double(baseline) - metrics.tmAscent < LONG_MIN ||
        double(baseline) + metrics.tmDescent > LONG_MAX)
        return false;
    const DWRITE_GLYPH_RUN run = {face.Get(),
        static_cast<float>(metrics.tmHeight - metrics.tmInternalLeading), count,
        reinterpret_cast<const UINT16*>(glyphs), scratch.editAdvances.data(),
        scratch.editOffsets.data(), FALSE, 0};
    // Reuse thread-owned surfaces, but don't cache typed/password text or
    // hold glyph IDs after the call. No overlay or delayed presentation.
    ShellTextRaster* raster = ShellTextRasterRender(static_cast<UINT>(width),
        static_cast<UINT>(height), color, {}, 0, 0,
        [&](ID2D1RenderTarget* target, ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush) {
            target->SetTextAntialiasMode(D2D1_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_MODE_GRAYSCALE);
            brush->SetOpacity(1.f);
            target->DrawGlyphRun(D2D1::Point2F(originX - bounds.left,
                baseline - bounds.top), &run, brush, DWRITE_MEASURING_MODE_GDI_CLASSIC);
            return true;
        }, false);
    if (!raster)
        return false;
    const int saved = SaveDC(hdc);
    if (!saved)
        return false;
    bool drawn = !(options & ETO_CLIPPED) ||
        IntersectClipRect(hdc, clip->left, clip->top, clip->right, clip->bottom) != ERROR;
    if (drawn && (options & ETO_OPAQUE))
        drawn = ExtTextOutW_orig && ExtTextOutW_orig(hdc, 0, 0, ETO_OPAQUE,
            clip, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
    if (drawn && backgroundMode == OPAQUE) {
        const RECT cell = {static_cast<LONG>(originX),
            static_cast<LONG>(baseline - metrics.tmAscent),
            static_cast<LONG>(originX + total),
            static_cast<LONG>(baseline + metrics.tmDescent)};
        drawn = ExtTextOutW_orig && ExtTextOutW_orig(hdc, 0, 0, ETO_OPAQUE,
            &cell, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
    }
    if (drawn)
        drawn = ShellTextRasterBlend(hdc, bounds, *raster);
    RestoreDC(hdc, saved);
    return drawn;
}

static bool DrawSearchEditTextDWrite(HDC hdc, int x, int y, UINT options,
    const RECT* clip, LPCWSTR text, UINT count, const INT* advances)
{
    if (options & ETO_GLYPH_INDEX)
        return DrawEditableGlyphTextDWrite(hdc, x, y, options, clip, text, count, advances);
    // MsftEdit can emit simple Unicode with per-character native advances,
    // without re-entering ExtTextOutW with glyph indices. Only one-to-one LTR
    // runs can reuse those advances; shaping and font fallback stay native.
    constexpr UINT supported = ETO_CLIPPED | ETO_OPAQUE | ETO_PDY;
    if (!hdc || !text || !count || count > 8192 || !advances ||
        (options & ~supported) || (GetTextAlign(hdc) & TA_RTLREADING) ||
        ScriptIsComplex(text, static_cast<int>(count), SIC_COMPLEX) != S_FALSE)
        return false;
    bool hasDigits = false;
    for (UINT i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        const WCHAR ch = text[i];
        if (ch < 0x20 || (ch >= 0xD800 && ch <= 0xF8FF) ||
            (ch >= 0x200B && ch <= 0x206F))
            return false;
        hasDigits |= ch >= L'0' && ch <= L'9';
    }
    if (hasDigits) {
        SCRIPT_DIGITSUBSTITUTE digits = {};
        if (ScriptRecordDigitSubstitution(LOCALE_USER_DEFAULT, &digits) != S_OK ||
            digits.DigitSubstitute != SCRIPT_DIGITSUBSTITUTE_NONE)
            return false;
    }
    std::vector<WORD> glyphs;
    try {
        glyphs.resize(count);
    } catch (const std::bad_alloc&) {
        return false;
    }
    if (GetGlyphIndicesW(hdc, text, static_cast<int>(count), glyphs.data(),
            GGI_MARK_NONEXISTING_GLYPHS) != count ||
        std::find(glyphs.begin(), glyphs.end(), WORD{0xFFFF}) != glyphs.end())
        return false;
    return DrawEditableGlyphTextDWrite(hdc, x, y, options | ETO_GLYPH_INDEX,
        clip, reinterpret_cast<LPCWSTR>(glyphs.data()), count, advances);
}

// msctls_hotkey32 draws its key name with TextOutW: simple Unicode without
// advances. GDI measures them, so the caret it places still matches.
static bool DrawHotkeyTextDWrite(HDC hdc, int x, int y, UINT options,
    const RECT* clip, LPCWSTR text, UINT count, const INT* advances)
{
    options &= ~ETO_IGNORELANGUAGE;
    if (advances || (options & ETO_GLYPH_INDEX))
        return DrawSearchEditTextDWrite(hdc, x, y, options, clip, text, count, advances);
    if (!hdc || !text || !count || count > 256)
        return false;
    INT extents[256];
    SIZE size = {};
    if (!GetTextExtentExPointW(hdc, text, static_cast<int>(count), 0, nullptr,
            extents, &size))
        return false;
    for (UINT i = count; i-- > 1;)
        extents[i] -= extents[i - 1];
    return DrawSearchEditTextDWrite(hdc, x, y, options, clip, text, count, extents);
}

static bool TryDrawLegacyRebarExtText(HDC hdc, int x, int y, UINT options,
    const RECT* clip, LPCWSTR text, UINT count, const INT* dx)
{
    const auto paint = g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth
        ? LegacyRebarTextForDc(hdc) : LegacyRebarTextPaint{};
    if (LegacyEditableTextKind(paint.kind))
        return false;
    LegacyDialogTextDcScope dcScope(hdc, paint.kind);
    if (!dcScope.ready)
        return false;
    const bool dialogText = ExplorerDialogTextKind(paint.kind) ||
        paint.kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::ModernCombo;
    const bool opaqueControl = dialogText && GetBkMode(hdc) == OPAQUE;
    const UINT supportedOptions = ETO_CLIPPED | ETO_RTLREADING |
        (dialogText ? ETO_IGNORELANGUAGE | ETO_OPAQUE : 0);
    if (paint.kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::None || !text || !count || count > INT_MAX ||
        dx || (options & ~supportedOptions) || (GetTextAlign(hdc) & TA_UPDATECP) ||
        (!(clip && (options & ETO_CLIPPED)) && !dialogText) ||
        (dialogText && !opaqueControl && GetBkMode(hdc) != TRANSPARENT) ||
        ((options & ETO_CLIPPED) && !clip))
        return false;
    const UINT align = GetTextAlign(hdc);
    UINT format = DT_SINGLELINE | DT_TOP | DT_LEFT | DT_NOPREFIX;
    if ((options & ETO_RTLREADING) || (align & TA_RTLREADING))
        format |= DT_RTLREADING;
    const ShellTextExtPlacement placement = {x, y, align};
    RECT bounds = {};
    const RECT* nativeRect = clip;
    if (dialogText && !(options & ETO_CLIPPED))
        clip = ExtTextOutTextBounds(hdc, x, y, options, text, count, nullptr, &bounds)
            ? &bounds : nullptr;
    if ((options & ETO_OPAQUE) && nativeRect &&
        (!ExtTextOutW_orig || !ExtTextOutW_orig(hdc, 0, 0, ETO_OPAQUE,
            nativeRect, nullptr, 0, nullptr)))
        return false;
    if (opaqueControl) {
        RECT background = {};
        if (!clip || !ExtTextOutW_orig || !ExtTextOutTextBounds(hdc, x, y,
                options, text, count, nullptr, &background, false))
            return false;
        if ((options & ETO_CLIPPED) && !IntersectRect(&background, &background, clip))
            return false;
        // Preserve the control's own solid/selected cell color; do not paint
        // glyphs or change its item selection. Native fallback remains valid.
        if (!ExtTextOutW_orig(hdc, 0, 0, ETO_OPAQUE, &background, nullptr, 0, nullptr))
            return false;
    }
    INT result = 0;
    const COLORREF color = paint.kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::ModernCombo
        ? FixDarkTextColorForDc(hdc, GetTextColor(hdc), clip) : CLR_INVALID;
    return TryDrawLegacyRebarText(hdc, text, static_cast<int>(count),
        clip, format, &result, &placement, color, (options & ETO_CLIPPED) != 0);
}

static bool ExplorerDialogGetSelectionSpans(void* analysis, int first, int last,
    std::vector<ExplorerDialogSelectionSpan>& spans)
{
    if (!analysis || !g_dialogTextCPtoX || first < 0 || first >= last || last > 8192)
        return false;
    spans.clear();
    spans.reserve(last - first);
    for (int cp = first; cp < last; ++cp) {
        int leading = 0, trailing = 0;
        if (g_dialogTextCPtoX(analysis, cp, FALSE, &leading) != S_OK ||
            g_dialogTextCPtoX(analysis, cp, TRUE, &trailing) != S_OK)
            return false;
        spans.push_back({std::min(leading, trailing), std::max(leading, trailing)});
    }
    const auto byLeft = [](const auto& a, const auto& b) { return a.left < b.left; };
    if (!std::is_sorted(spans.begin(), spans.end(), byLeft))
        std::sort(spans.begin(), spans.end(), byLeft);
    size_t merged = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < spans.size(); ++i) {
        const auto span = spans[i];
        if (merged && span.left <= spans[merged - 1].right)
            spans[merged - 1].right = std::max(spans[merged - 1].right, span.right);
        else
            spans[merged++] = span;
    }
    spans.resize(merged);
    // Native ETO_CLIPPED highlighting includes the trailing boundary pixel,
    // even for a zero-width direction control. Keep native UTF-16 indices.
    for (auto& span : spans) {
        if (span.right == INT_MAX)
            return false;
        ++span.right;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool TryDrawExplorerDialogSelectedText(HDC hdc, HWND edit, void* analysis,
    LPCWSTR text, int count, int x, int y, UINT options, const RECT* clip,
    int minSelection, int maxSelection, bool rtl, bool disabled)
{
    const auto paint = LegacyRebarTextForDc(hdc);
    if (paint.kind != LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogReadOnly || paint.hwnd != edit)
        return false;
    if (!g_dialogTextCPtoX || !ExtTextOutW_orig || !text || count <= 0 || count > 8192)
        return false;
    if ((GetTextAlign(hdc) & ~TA_RTLREADING) != (TA_LEFT | TA_TOP) ||
        GetMapMode(hdc) != MM_TEXT || GetGraphicsMode(hdc) != GM_COMPATIBLE ||
        GetLayout(hdc) != 0 || GetTextCharacterExtra(hdc) != 0 ||
        (options & ~(ETO_CLIPPED | ETO_OPAQUE)) ||
        !(options & ETO_CLIPPED) || !clip)
        return false;
    const int first = std::clamp(minSelection, 0, count);
    const int last = std::clamp(maxSelection, 0, count);
    if (first >= last)
        return false;
    std::vector<ExplorerDialogSelectionSpan> spans;
    if (!ExplorerDialogGetSelectionSpans(analysis, first, last, spans))
        return false;
    std::vector<RECT> rectangles;
    rectangles.reserve(spans.size());
    for (const auto& span : spans) {
        const int64_t left = static_cast<int64_t>(x) + span.left;
        const int64_t right = static_cast<int64_t>(x) + span.right;
        if (left < LONG_MIN || left > LONG_MAX || right < LONG_MIN || right > LONG_MAX)
            return false;
        RECT band = {static_cast<LONG>(left), clip->top,
            static_cast<LONG>(right), clip->bottom};
        if (IntersectRect(&band, &band, clip))
            rectangles.push_back(band);
    }
    struct SelectionRegion {
        HRGN value = nullptr;
        ~SelectionRegion() { if (value) DeleteObject(value); }
    } selection;
    if (rectangles.size() > 1) {
        std::vector<RECT> deviceRectangles = rectangles;
        if (!LPtoDP(hdc, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(deviceRectangles.data()),
                static_cast<int>(deviceRectangles.size() * 2)))
            return false;
        const size_t bytes = sizeof(RGNDATAHEADER) + deviceRectangles.size() * sizeof(RECT);
        std::vector<DWORD> regionData((bytes + sizeof(DWORD) - 1) / sizeof(DWORD));
        const RECT bounds = {deviceRectangles.front().left, deviceRectangles.front().top,
            deviceRectangles.back().right, deviceRectangles.front().bottom};
        const RGNDATAHEADER header = {sizeof(RGNDATAHEADER), RDH_RECTANGLES,
            static_cast<DWORD>(deviceRectangles.size()),
            static_cast<DWORD>(deviceRectangles.size() * sizeof(RECT)), bounds};
        memcpy(regionData.data(), &header, sizeof(header));
        memcpy(reinterpret_cast<BYTE*>(regionData.data()) + sizeof(header),
            deviceRectangles.data(), deviceRectangles.size() * sizeof(RECT));
        selection.value = ExtCreateRegion(nullptr, static_cast<DWORD>(bytes),
            reinterpret_cast<const RGNDATA*>(regionData.data()));
        if (!selection.value)
            return false;
    }
    struct SelectionDcScope {
        HDC dc;
        int saved;
        ~SelectionDcScope() { if (saved) RestoreDC(dc, saved); }
        bool Finish(bool drawn) {
            const bool restored = RestoreDC(dc, saved) != FALSE;
            saved = 0;
            return restored && drawn;
        }
    } scope{hdc, SaveDC(hdc)};
    if (!scope.saved)
        return false;
    const UINT drawOptions = options | (rtl ? ETO_RTLREADING : 0);
    if (!TryDrawLegacyRebarExtText(hdc, x, y, drawOptions, clip, text, count, nullptr))
        return false;
    if (rectangles.empty())
        return scope.Finish(true);
    if (IntersectClipRect(hdc, clip->left, clip->top, clip->right, clip->bottom) == ERROR)
        return false;
    const RECT& band = rectangles.front();
    const int region = selection.value ? ExtSelectClipRgn(hdc, selection.value, RGN_AND)
        : IntersectClipRect(hdc, band.left, band.top, band.right, band.bottom);
    if (region == ERROR)
        return false;
    if (region == NULLREGION)
        return scope.Finish(true);
    if (SetBkColor(hdc, GetSysColor(COLOR_HIGHLIGHT)) == CLR_INVALID ||
        !SetBkMode(hdc, TRANSPARENT) ||
        (!disabled && SetTextColor(hdc, GetSysColor(COLOR_HIGHLIGHTTEXT)) == CLR_INVALID))
        return false;
    const bool drawn = ExtTextOutW_orig(hdc, 0, 0, ETO_OPAQUE, clip, nullptr, 0, nullptr) &&
        TryDrawLegacyRebarExtText(hdc, x, y, drawOptions & ~ETO_OPAQUE,
            clip, text, count, nullptr);
    return scope.Finish(drawn);
}

static bool TryDrawExplorerDialogReadOnlyText(HDC hdc, HWND edit,
    LPCWSTR text, int count, int x, int y, UINT options, const RECT* clip,
    int minSelection, int maxSelection, bool rtl)
{
    const auto paint = LegacyRebarTextForDc(hdc);
    if (!LegacyControlUniscribeKind(paint.kind) || paint.hwnd != edit ||
        minSelection < maxSelection || (options & ~ETO_CLIPPED))
        return false;
    // ScriptStringOut is intercepted before ExtTextOutW changes characters
    // into glyph IDs; never reinterpret ETO_GLYPH_INDEX as Unicode.
    return TryDrawLegacyRebarExtText(hdc, x, y,
        options | (rtl ? ETO_RTLREADING : 0), clip, text, count, nullptr);
}

static BOOL WINAPI ExtTextOutW_hook_impl(HDC hdc, int x, int y, UINT options,
    const RECT* lprect, LPCWSTR lpString, UINT c, const INT* lpDx);

// Explorer InfoBar text gets its color here, around the whole pipeline,
// and starts after the severity icon unless the DrawTextW it comes from
// already moved it.
BOOL WINAPI ExtTextOutW_hook(HDC hdc, int x, int y, UINT options,
    const RECT* lprect, LPCWSTR lpString, UINT c, const INT* lpDx)
{
    COLORREF infoBarColor;
    if (c && t_explorerInfoBarPaint.hdc == hdc &&
        ExplorerInfoBarTextColor(hdc, {x, y}, &infoBarColor)) {
        RECT shiftedRect = {};
        const LONG textLeft = t_explorerInfoBarPaint.textLeft;
        if (!t_explorerInfoBarTextShifted && x < textLeft &&
            !(GetTextAlign(hdc) & (TA_CENTER | TA_RIGHT | TA_UPDATECP))) {
            x = textLeft;
            if (lprect) {
                shiftedRect = *lprect;
                shiftedRect.left = std::max(shiftedRect.left, textLeft);
                lprect = &shiftedRect;
            }
        }
        const COLORREF previous = SetTextColor(hdc, infoBarColor);
        const BOOL result = ExtTextOutW_hook_impl(
            hdc, x, y, options, lprect, lpString, c, lpDx);
        SetTextColor(hdc, previous);
        return result;
    }
    [[clang::musttail]] return ExtTextOutW_hook_impl(
        hdc, x, y, options, lprect, lpString, c, lpDx);
}

static BOOL WINAPI ExtTextOutW_hook_impl(HDC hdc, int x, int y, UINT options,
    const RECT* lprect, LPCWSTR lpString, UINT c, const INT* lpDx)
{
    // Desktop icon labels keep the native pipeline (see t_desktopIconPaintHwnd).
    if (t_desktopIconPaintHwnd)
        return ExtTextOutW_orig(hdc, x, y, options, lprect, lpString, c, lpDx);

    // Same suppression as DrawTextW_hook, checked before the
    // g_tlsIsAccentButton bypass below (which would otherwise let an
    // unsuppressed draw of this text through unmodified).
    if (WinverTextMarksPending()) {
        HWND wvHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
        if (WinverConsumeButtonTextDrawn(wvHwnd))
            return TRUE;
    }

    if (g_tlsDragDropTextPaint && hdc && lpString) {
        COLORREF oldText = CLR_INVALID;
        if (!g_tlsDragDropPreserveTextColor)
            oldText = SetTextColor(hdc, DragDropBadgeTextColor(hdc));
        int oldBkMode = SetBkMode(hdc, TRANSPARENT);
        BOOL ret = ExtTextOutW_orig(hdc, x, y, options & ~ETO_OPAQUE,
            lprect, lpString, c, lpDx);
        if (oldBkMode) SetBkMode(hdc, oldBkMode);
        if (!g_tlsDragDropPreserveTextColor)
            SetTextColor(hdc, oldText);
        return ret;
    }

    // Typed text borrows only the exact active control/Search paint scope,
    // never g_tlsPaintHwnd's stale host or a process-wide font substitution.
    if (g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth &&
        g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth <= ARRAYSIZE(g_legacyRebarTextPaints) &&
        (LegacyEditableTextKind(g_legacyRebarTextPaints[g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth - 1].kind) ||
         g_legacyRebarTextPaints[g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth - 1].kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::Search)) {
        const auto editPaint = LegacyRebarTextForDc(hdc);
        const bool search = editPaint.kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::Search &&
            !g_explorerDialogTextUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
            !g_roundedSelectionHighContrast.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (LegacyEditableTextKind(editPaint.kind) || search) {
            bool drawn = false;
