// Mica behind the whole window, the frame extended over the client so the
// black tree and menu bar reveal it; reverted when the mode goes away.
static constexpr wchar_t kRgMicaAppliedProp[] = L"Win32UIModernizer.RgMica";

static void RgApplyBackdrop(HWND main, bool mica)
{
    if (!main || !IsWindow(main))
        return;
    if (mica) {
        const BOOL darkAttr = RgIsDarkMode() ? TRUE : FALSE;
        DwmSetWindowAttribute(main, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE,
            &darkAttr, sizeof(darkAttr));
        static const MARGINS kFullMargins = { -1, -1, -1, -1 };
        DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea_orig(main, &kFullMargins);
        DwmSetWindowAttribute_orig(main, DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE,
            &kDwmsbtMainWindow, sizeof(kDwmsbtMainWindow));
        SetPropW(main, kRgMicaAppliedProp, reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(1));
    } else if (RemovePropW(main, kRgMicaAppliedProp)) {
        static const MARGINS kNoMargins = { 0, 0, 0, 0 };
        DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea_orig(main, &kNoMargins);
        const int autoBackdrop = 0; // DWMSBT_AUTO
        DwmSetWindowAttribute_orig(main, DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE,
            &autoBackdrop, sizeof(autoBackdrop));
    }
}

// Hairline width of the Mica card stroke and header rules.
static int RgMicaStrokeWidth(UINT dpi)
{
    return std::max(1, MulDiv(1, (int)dpi, 96));
}

static HBRUSH RgHeaderBrush(bool dark)
{
    if (!dark && !rg_hdrLtBkBrush)
        rg_hdrLtBkBrush = CreateSolidBrush(RGB(0xF9, 0xF9, 0xF9));
    return dark ? rg_lvBkBrush : rg_hdrLtBkBrush;
}

// A header rule (bottom edge, item dividers). Mica: the CardStroke rule
// Explorer's content-pane header uses, written with alpha over the
// backdrop. Opaque: DividerStroke blended on the header's own fill, like
// Explorer's opaque surface mode.
static void RgWriteHeaderRule(HDC hdc, const RECT& line, bool dark)
{
    if (RgMicaActive())
        WriteExplorerMicaPixels(hdc, line, static_cast<DWORD>(dark ? 0x19 : 0x0F) << 24);
    else
        BlendPremultipliedPixels(hdc, line, dark ? 0x15151515u : 0x0F000000u);
}

// The header's strip with its bottom rule: under Mica the translucent
// strip Explorer's content-pane header uses, else the header's own fill.
static bool RgPaintHeaderStrip(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, bool dark, int lineW)
{
    if (RgMicaActive()) {
        const DWORD a = ExplorerMicaSecondaryRevealLevel(dark);
        WriteExplorerMicaPixels(hdc, rc,
            dark ? (a << 24) | (a << 16) | (a << 8) | a : a << 24);
    } else if (HBRUSH br = RgHeaderBrush(dark)) {
        FillRect(hdc, &rc, br);
    } else {
        return false;
    }
    const RECT rule = { rc.left, std::max(rc.top, rc.bottom - lineW),
                        rc.right, rc.bottom };
    RgWriteHeaderRule(hdc, rule, dark);
    return true;
}

// The value list's vertical scrollbar runs beside the header, in the
// list's non-client area; its top, as tall as the header, continues the
// header strip so the header reads edge to edge, the bar's hover strip,
// arrow and thumb drawn over it. Part rects are in the list window's
// coordinates (user32 paints the bar on its window DC, or on a buffer
// mapped onto it); a part that does not lie inside the bar's own rect
// there is left alone.
static void RgPaintScrollbarHeaderBand(HWND owner, HDC dc, const RECT& part)
{
    const HWND lv = rg_hwndLV.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    const HWND hdr = rg_hwndHdr.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (!lv || owner != lv || !hdr || !IsWindowVisible(hdr) ||
        (GetWindowLongW(lv, GWL_EXSTYLE) & WS_EX_LAYOUTRTL))
        return;
    SCROLLBARINFO sbi = { sizeof(sbi) };
    RECT wr, hr;
    if (!GetScrollBarInfo(lv, OBJID_VSCROLL, &sbi) ||
        (sbi.rgstate[0] & (STATE_SYSTEM_INVISIBLE | STATE_SYSTEM_OFFSCREEN)) ||
        !GetWindowRect(lv, &wr) || !GetWindowRect(hdr, &hr))
        return;
    RECT bar = sbi.rcScrollBar;
    OffsetRect(&bar, -wr.left, -wr.top);
    RECT inBar;
    if (!IntersectRect(&inBar, &part, &bar) || !EqualRect(&inBar, &part))
        return;
    const RECT band = { bar.left, bar.top, bar.right,
                        std::min<LONG>(bar.bottom, hr.bottom - wr.top) };
    RECT area;
    if (!IntersectRect(&area, &band, &part))
        return;
    const int saved = SaveDC(dc);
    if (!saved)
        return;
    IntersectClipRect(dc, area.left, area.top, area.right, area.bottom);
    RgPaintHeaderStrip(dc, band, RgIsDarkMode(),
        RgMicaStrokeWidth(GetDpiForWindow(lv)));
    RestoreDC(dc, saved);
}

// The value list's outline, in the gap it keeps from the tree and the
// address bar: a line down its left side, the arc of its rounded corner and
// a line along its top. Under Mica WinUI's CardStrokeColorDefault is written
// with alpha over the revealed backdrop; on the opaque surface
// DividerStrokeColorDefault is blended, like Explorer's pane rule in both.
static void RgPaintCardStroke(HWND main, HDC hdc)
{
    const HWND lv = rg_hwndLV.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    RECT rc;
    if (!lv || !IsWindowVisible(lv) || !GetWindowRect(lv, &rc))
        return;
    MapWindowPoints(nullptr, main, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(&rc), 2);
    const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(main);
    const int r = MulDiv(static_cast<int>(WinUI::OverlayCornerRadius), (int)dpi, 96);
    const int w = RgMicaStrokeWidth(dpi);
    const bool dark = RgIsDarkMode();
    const bool mica = RgMicaActive();
    // Mica: black CardStroke. Opaque: DividerStroke, white 0x15 in dark.
    const BYTE alpha = mica ? (dark ? 0x19 : 0x0F) : (dark ? 0x15 : 0x0F);
    const BYTE level = (!mica && dark) ? 0xFF : 0x00;
    const DWORD stroke = (static_cast<DWORD>(alpha) << 24) |
        (level ? (static_cast<DWORD>(alpha) << 16) |
                 (static_cast<DWORD>(alpha) << 8) | alpha : 0);
    const auto writeLine = [&](const RECT& line) {
        if (mica)
            WriteExplorerMicaPixels(hdc, line, stroke);
        else
            BlendPremultipliedPixels(hdc, line, stroke);
    };

    const RECT left = { rc.left - w, rc.top + r, rc.left, rc.bottom };
    const RECT top = { rc.left + r, rc.top - w, rc.right, rc.top };
    if (left.bottom > left.top)
        writeLine(left);
    if (top.right > top.left)
        writeLine(top);

    const RECT corner = { rc.left - w, rc.top - w, rc.left + r, rc.top + r };
    PaintAlphaSceneGdip(hdc, &corner, [&](Gdiplus::Graphics& graphics) {
        const float fw = static_cast<float>(w);
        Gdiplus::Pen pen(Gdiplus::Color(alpha, level, level, level), fw);
        const float d = 2.f * static_cast<float>(r) + fw;
        graphics.DrawArc(&pen, fw * 0.5f, fw * 0.5f, d, d, 180.f, 90.f);
    });
}

// The strips RgPaintCardStroke writes for a list at `rc` (parent client
// coordinates).
static void RgInvalidateCardStroke(HWND main, const RECT& rc)
{
    const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(main);
    const int r = MulDiv(static_cast<int>(WinUI::OverlayCornerRadius), (int)dpi, 96);
    const int w = RgMicaStrokeWidth(dpi);
    const RECT left = { rc.left - w, rc.top - w, rc.left + r, rc.bottom };
    const RECT top = { rc.left - w, rc.top - w, rc.right, rc.top + r };
    InvalidateRect(main, &left, TRUE);
    InvalidateRect(main, &top, TRUE);
}

// Replacing existing handles must happen on Regedit's UI thread. The initial
// call from RgInitResources is also safe because no control can reference the
// resources yet.
static bool RgRefreshColorResources()
{
    const bool dark = RgIsDarkMode();
    const bool mica = g_settings.RgMicaBackdrop;
    if (rg_lvBkBrush && rg_tvBkBrush && rg_searchBkBrush && rg_searchHotBrush &&
        rg_searchFocusBrush && rg_menuBkBrush &&
        rg_colorResourcesDark == dark &&
        rg_colorResourcesMica == mica) {
        return true;
    }

    HBRUSH newLv = CreateSolidBrush(RgListBackground(dark));
    HBRUSH newTv = CreateSolidBrush(
        mica ? RGB(0, 0, 0) : (dark ? kRgDkTVBk : kRgLtTVBk));
    HBRUSH newSearch = CreateSolidBrush(RgSearchFill(dark, kRgSearchRest));
    HBRUSH newSearchHot = CreateSolidBrush(RgSearchFill(dark, kRgSearchHot));
    HBRUSH newSearchFocus = CreateSolidBrush(RgSearchFill(dark, kRgSearchFocused));
    HBRUSH newMenu = CreateSolidBrush(kRgDkMenuBk);
    if (!newLv || !newTv || !newSearch || !newSearchHot || !newSearchFocus || !newMenu) {
        if (newLv) DeleteObject(newLv);
        if (newTv) DeleteObject(newTv);
        if (newSearch) DeleteObject(newSearch);
        if (newSearchHot) DeleteObject(newSearchHot);
        if (newSearchFocus) DeleteObject(newSearchFocus);
        if (newMenu) DeleteObject(newMenu);
        return false;
    }

    HBRUSH oldLv = rg_lvBkBrush;
    HBRUSH oldTv = rg_tvBkBrush;
    HBRUSH oldSearch = rg_searchBkBrush;
    HBRUSH oldSearchHot = rg_searchHotBrush;
    HBRUSH oldSearchFocus = rg_searchFocusBrush;
    HBRUSH oldMenu = rg_menuBkBrush;
    rg_searchHotBrush = newSearchHot;
    rg_searchFocusBrush = newSearchFocus;
    rg_lvBkBrush = newLv;
    rg_tvBkBrush = newTv;
    rg_searchBkBrush = newSearch;
    rg_menuBkBrush = newMenu;
    rg_colorResourcesDark = dark;
    rg_colorResourcesMica = mica;

    RgApplyBackdrop(rg_hwndMain.load(std::memory_order_acquire), mica);

    const HWND tv = rg_hwndTV.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (tv && IsWindow(tv)) {
        TreeView_SetBkColor(tv,
            mica ? RGB(0, 0, 0) : (dark ? kRgDkTVBk : kRgLtTVBk));
        TreeView_SetTextColor(tv, dark ? kRgDkTVText : kRgLtTVText);
        InvalidateRect(tv, nullptr, TRUE);
    }

    const HWND lv = rg_hwndLV.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (lv && IsWindow(lv)) {
        const COLORREF lvBk = RgListBackground(dark);
        ListView_SetBkColor(lv, lvBk);
        ListView_SetTextBkColor(lv, lvBk);
        ListView_SetTextColor(lv, dark ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0));
        InvalidateRect(lv, nullptr, TRUE);
    }

    const HWND search = rg_hwndSearch.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (search && IsWindow(search))
        InvalidateRect(search, nullptr, TRUE);

    if (oldLv) DeleteObject(oldLv);
    if (oldTv) DeleteObject(oldTv);
    if (oldSearch) DeleteObject(oldSearch);
    if (oldSearchHot) DeleteObject(oldSearchHot);
    if (oldSearchFocus) DeleteObject(oldSearchFocus);
    if (oldMenu) DeleteObject(oldMenu);
    return true;
}

static void RgAddRoundedRect(Gdiplus::GraphicsPath& path,
    const Gdiplus::RectF& rect, float radius)
{
    const float diameter = radius * 2.0f;
    if (diameter <= 0.0f) {
        path.AddRectangle(rect);
        return;
    }

    path.AddArc(rect.X, rect.Y, diameter, diameter, 180.0f, 90.0f);
    path.AddArc(rect.GetRight() - diameter, rect.Y, diameter, diameter,
        270.0f, 90.0f);
    path.AddArc(rect.GetRight() - diameter, rect.GetBottom() - diameter,
        diameter, diameter, 0.0f, 90.0f);
    path.AddArc(rect.X, rect.GetBottom() - diameter, diameter, diameter,
        90.0f, 90.0f);
    path.CloseFigure();
}

// SetMenuInfo hook — dark context menu backgrounds (regedit only)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
static WINBOOL WINAPI RgSetMenuInfo_Hook(HMENU hMenu, LPCMENUINFO lpInfo)
{
    // Only intercept in regedit when section is enabled
    if (!g_settings.RegeditSection || !IsCurrentProcessRegedit())
        return rg_SetMenuInfo_orig(hMenu, lpInfo);

    const bool dark = RgIsDarkMode();
    if (!dark)
        return rg_SetMenuInfo_orig(hMenu, lpInfo);

    // Override background brush
    if (!(lpInfo->fMask & MIM_BACKGROUND) || lpInfo->cbSize > 256)
        return rg_SetMenuInfo_orig(hMenu, lpInfo);

    alignas(MENUINFO) BYTE buffer[256];
    memcpy(buffer, lpInfo, lpInfo->cbSize);
    auto* infoCopy = reinterpret_cast<LPMENUINFO>(buffer);
    infoCopy->hbrBack = rg_menuBkBrush ? rg_menuBkBrush : (HBRUSH)GetStockObject(BLACK_BRUSH);
    return rg_SetMenuInfo_orig(hMenu, infoCopy);
}

// Marks the drag as ending so the next PATINVERT PatBlt (regedit's own
// final erase of its ghost-line) is treated as a pure erase instead of
// being replaced with one more accent line draw.
static bool RgIsMainCapture(HWND main, HWND capture)
{
    return main && capture &&
        (capture == main || IsChild(main, capture));
}

static WINBOOL WINAPI RgReleaseCapture_Hook()
{
    {
        RgDividerStateGuard stateGuard;
        const DWORD activeThread =
            rg_dividerActiveThread.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (g_settings.RegeditSection && IsCurrentProcessRegedit() &&
            activeThread == GetCurrentThreadId() &&
            rg_dividerActiveMain.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
            rg_dividerDragEnding.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        }
    }
    return rg_ReleaseCapture_orig();
}

// Pixel-level backup for the accent line, so it can be removed by restoring
// exactly what was under it -- not by asking the window to repaint itself.
// RedrawWindow-based erasing was tried first and rejected: without
// RDW_ALLCHILDREN it doesn't reach the ListView child at all, and the
// ListView's own top-left-corner window region (see RgUpdateListViewRegion)
// depends on the parent's background showing through a carved-out notch --
// forcing WM_ERASEBKGND on the parent there visibly corrupted that notch.
// A raw BitBlt never touches window paint machinery, so neither problem
// applies: it works over any child, and it can't corrupt a sibling's region.
//
// rop's rect is NOT a fixed-width line -- confirmed live by logging ~900
// consecutive calls during one drag: at rest it's a narrow ~5-7px sliver
// centered on the cursor, but while moving it widens to cover the *entire*
// distance traveled since the previous call (seen up to ~75px during a fast
// flick). regedit XORs that whole swept rect in one shot instead of issuing
// a separate erase-old/draw-new pair, so the backup must track the previous
// call's real (x,y,w,h), not an assumed constant -- a fixed-width backup
// only ever restored a fraction of what was actually swept, leaving the
// rest of each fast movement's path unrestored (the trail bug).
static HBITMAP rg_dividerBackupBmp = nullptr;
static int rg_dividerBackupCapW = 0, rg_dividerBackupCapH = 0; // allocated capacity

// Off-screen compose buffer for a whole call's update (old-spot erase + new
// accent draw), so the screen only ever receives one finished frame via a
// single final BitBlt -- see the comment in RgPatBlt_Hook for why separate
// direct-to-hdc calls (erase, save, draw) visibly flicker. Must be a DIB
// section (not a plain CreateCompatibleBitmap DDB): ID2D1DCRenderTarget::
// BindDC requires one, since RgPaintDividerAccent draws into it via D2D.
static HBITMAP rg_dividerFrameBmp = nullptr;
static int rg_dividerFrameCapW = 0, rg_dividerFrameCapH = 0;

static void RgDividerResetTracking()
{
    rg_dividerDragEnding.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    rg_dividerActiveThread.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    rg_dividerActiveMain.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
    rg_dividerNativeFallback.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    rg_dividerHasBackup = false;
}

static void RgDividerResetTrackingThreadSafe()
{
    RgDividerStateGuard stateGuard;
    RgDividerResetTracking();
}

static bool RgDividerRestoreBackup(HDC hdc)
{
    if (!rg_dividerHasBackup)
        return true;
    if (!rg_dividerBackupBmp)
        return false;

    POINT dcOrg{};
    if (!hdc || !GetDCOrgEx(hdc, &dcOrg))
        return false;

    HDC memDC = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
    if (!memDC)
        return false;

    HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(memDC, rg_dividerBackupBmp);
    const bool restored = old && old != HGDI_ERROR &&
        BitBlt(hdc,
            rg_dividerLastX - dcOrg.x, rg_dividerLastY - dcOrg.y,
            rg_dividerLastW, rg_dividerLastH,
            memDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
    if (old && old != HGDI_ERROR)
        SelectObject(memDC, old);
    DeleteDC(memDC);
    if (restored)
        rg_dividerHasBackup = false;
    return restored;
}

static void RgDividerResetOnMainThread(HWND main)
{
    RgDividerStateGuard stateGuard;
    if (rg_dividerHasBackup && main && IsWindow(main)) {
        HDC hdc = GetDC(main);
        const bool restored = hdc && RgDividerRestoreBackup(hdc);
        if (hdc)
            ReleaseDC(main, hdc);
        if (!restored) {
            RedrawWindow(main, nullptr, nullptr,
                RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
        }
    }
    RgDividerResetTracking();
}

static void RgDividerFreeBackup()
{
    RgDividerStateGuard stateGuard;
    if (rg_dividerBackupBmp) { DeleteObject(rg_dividerBackupBmp); rg_dividerBackupBmp = nullptr; }
    rg_dividerBackupCapW = rg_dividerBackupCapH = 0;
    if (rg_dividerFrameBmp) { DeleteObject(rg_dividerFrameBmp); rg_dividerFrameBmp = nullptr; }
    rg_dividerFrameCapW = rg_dividerFrameCapH = 0;
    RgDividerResetTracking();
}

// WinUI-style divider accent, same look as PaintNavDividerHoverPill: a thin
// line plus a wider accent-colored pill with a contrast outline, centered on
// the divider. Drawn unconditionally for the whole drag -- the drag itself
// is the trigger, so fadeFrac is fixed at 1 and centerX is passed in
// explicitly (this rect is a per-call compose buffer, not a fixed strip).
//
// The thin line is drawn via plain GDI InvertRect (not a D2D low-alpha fill,
// unlike PaintNavDividerHoverPill) because it sweeps over TreeView/ListView
// content of unknown, changing color -- inverting stays visible regardless
// of what's underneath. Pill/outline brushes live in the shared per-thread
// D2DThreadCache so Wh_ModUninit's D2DThreadCachesClear() releases them for
// every thread that painted here.

// Half-width of the accent's widest element (the pill + its outline stroke),
// with a small AA-safety margin. Used to size the backup/erase rect instead
// of regedit's own swept PatBlt rect -- we no longer draw at that rect at
// all, so there's nothing to restore there. Must track the pill/stroke
// formulas in RgPaintDividerAccent below.
static float RgDividerScale(HWND main, HDC hdc)
{
    UINT dpi = main ? GetDpiForWindow(main) : 0;
    if (!dpi && hdc)
        dpi = (UINT)std::max(GetDeviceCaps(hdc, LOGPIXELSX), 1);
    if (!dpi)
        dpi = USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    return (float)dpi / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
}

static float RgDividerAccentHalfWidth(float scale)
{
    float pillHalfW = std::max(4.5f, 4.5f * scale);
    float strokeW   = std::max(1.f, 2.f * scale);
    return pillHalfW + strokeW;
}

// Thin line's footprint in the same local coord space RgPaintDividerAccent
// draws in (centerX/top/h all relative to the compose buffer's origin) --
// shared so RgPatBlt_Hook's GDI InvertRect lands exactly where the pill's
// own geometry expects the line to be.
static RECT RgDividerLineRectLocal(
    float centerX, float top, float h, float scale)
{
    float lineHalfW = std::max(1.f, 1.f * scale);
    float lineH     = h * 0.9f;
    float lineTop   = top + (h - lineH) / 2.f;
    return RECT{
        (LONG)std::floor(centerX - lineHalfW), (LONG)std::floor(lineTop),
        (LONG)std::ceil(centerX + lineHalfW),  (LONG)std::ceil(lineTop + lineH)
    };
}

static bool RgPaintDividerAccent(
    HDC hdc, int bufW, int bufH, float centerX, float top, float h,
    bool dark, float scale)
{
    if (!g_d2dFactory || bufW <= 0 || bufH <= 0 || h <= 0.f)
        return false;
    FPUGuard fpu;
    RECT rc = {0, 0, bufW, bufH};
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
    if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rc, g_d2dFactory, &pRT)))
        return false;

    D2DThreadCache* cache = D2DGetThreadCache();
    if (!cache)
        return false;

    pRT->BeginDraw();

    float pillHalfW = std::max(4.5f, 4.5f * scale);
    float pillHalfH = std::min(14.f * scale, h * 0.5f); // never taller than the divider itself
    float pillCy = top + h / 2.f;
    float strokeW = std::max(1.f, 2.f * scale);

    // Border-as-mask: the outer shape is filled solid with the border color
    // (not stroked), then a smaller shape inset by the border's own
    // thickness is filled with the accent color on top. A centered D2D
    // stroke straddles the fill's edge (half in, half out), blending softly
    // into the accent color right at the boundary -- filling two
    // differently-sized shapes instead gives a crisp, uniform-width ring
    // with a hard edge between the two colors.
    D2D1_RECT_F outerRect = D2D1::RectF(centerX - pillHalfW, pillCy - pillHalfH, centerX + pillHalfW, pillCy + pillHalfH);
    D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT outerShape = D2D1::RoundedRect(outerRect, pillHalfW, pillHalfW);

    D2D1_COLOR_F outlineColor = ColorFAlpha(dark ? Win32MainDark : RGB(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF));
    HRESULT hr = S_OK;
    if (cache->rgDivOutlineBrush) {
        cache->rgDivOutlineBrush->SetColor(outlineColor);
    } else {
        hr = pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(
            outlineColor, &cache->rgDivOutlineBrush);
    }
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && cache->rgDivOutlineBrush)
        pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(outerShape, cache->rgDivOutlineBrush);

    float innerHalfW = std::max(0.f, pillHalfW - strokeW);
    float innerHalfH = std::max(0.f, pillHalfH - strokeW);
    D2D1_RECT_F innerRect = D2D1::RectF(centerX - innerHalfW, pillCy - innerHalfH, centerX + innerHalfW, pillCy + innerHalfH);
    D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT innerShape = D2D1::RoundedRect(innerRect, innerHalfW, innerHalfW);

    D2D1_COLOR_F pillFill = ColorFAlpha(GetAccentFillDefault(dark));
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && cache->rgDivPillBrush) {
        cache->rgDivPillBrush->SetColor(pillFill);
    } else if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) {
        hr = pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(
            pillFill, &cache->rgDivPillBrush);
    }
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && cache->rgDivPillBrush)
        pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(innerShape, cache->rgDivPillBrush);

    const HRESULT endHr = pRT->EndDraw();
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr))
        hr = endHr;
    if (hr == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        // Device loss: the shared cached RT (and our brushes, keyed against
        // its identity) are no longer valid. Same recovery as every other
        // CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget call site in this file.
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
    return SUCCEEDED(hr);
}

// PROTOTYPE: replaces regedit's dotted XOR divider-drag line with a WinUI-
// style accent (see RgPaintDividerAccent), without touching any of the drag
// mechanics that draw it (see the comment above rg_PatBlt_orig). Every call
// restores exactly the rect our own accent covered on the previous call
// before drawing (or, on the drag's last call, before *not* drawing).
static bool RgIsDividerPatBlt(HWND main, HDC hdc, int w, int h,
                              bool requireCapture)
{
    if (!main || !IsWindow(main) || !hdc || w <= 0 || h <= 0 || h <= w)
        return false;

    DWORD mainPid = 0;
    const DWORD mainThread = GetWindowThreadProcessId(main, &mainPid);
    if (mainPid != GetCurrentProcessId() || mainThread != GetCurrentThreadId())
        return false;

    if (requireCapture && !RgIsMainCapture(main, GetCapture()) &&
        GetKeyState(VK_LBUTTON) >= 0) {
        return false;
    }

    const HWND dcWindow = WindowFromDC(hdc);
    if (dcWindow && dcWindow != main && !IsChild(main, dcWindow))
        return false;

    RECT client{};
    if (!GetClientRect(main, &client))
        return false;
    const float scale = RgDividerScale(main, hdc);
    const int minHeight = std::max(
        (int)std::ceil(24.f * scale),
        (int)(client.bottom - client.top) / 3);
    return h >= minHeight;
}

static WINBOOL RgDividerFallbackToNative(
    HDC hdc, int x, int y, int w, int h, DWORD rop)
{
    const HWND main = rg_dividerActiveMain.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (!RgDividerRestoreBackup(hdc) && main) {
        RedrawWindow(main, nullptr, nullptr,
            RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
    }
    rg_dividerHasBackup = false;
    rg_dividerNativeFallback.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    return rg_PatBlt_orig(hdc, x, y, w, h, rop);
}

static WINBOOL WINAPI RgPatBlt_Hook(HDC hdc, int x, int y, int w, int h, DWORD rop)
{
    if (rop != PATINVERT || !g_settings.RegeditSection ||
        !IsCurrentProcessRegedit() || !rg_ReleaseCapture_orig) {
        return rg_PatBlt_orig(hdc, x, y, w, h, rop);
    }

    RgDividerStateGuard stateGuard;

    const DWORD threadId = GetCurrentThreadId();
    DWORD activeThread = rg_dividerActiveThread.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    HWND main = rg_hwndMain.load(std::memory_order_acquire);

    if (!activeThread) {
        if (!RgIsDividerPatBlt(main, hdc, w, h, true))
            return rg_PatBlt_orig(hdc, x, y, w, h, rop);
        rg_dividerActiveMain.store(main, std::memory_order_release);
        rg_dividerNativeFallback.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        rg_dividerDragEnding.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        rg_dividerActiveThread.store(threadId, std::memory_order_release);
        activeThread = threadId;
    }

    if (activeThread != threadId ||
        rg_dividerActiveMain.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != main)
        return rg_PatBlt_orig(hdc, x, y, w, h, rop);

    if (rg_dividerNativeFallback.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        const bool ending =
            rg_dividerDragEnding.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        const WINBOOL result = rg_PatBlt_orig(hdc, x, y, w, h, rop);
        if (ending && RgIsDividerPatBlt(main, hdc, w, h, false)) {
            rg_dividerDragEnding.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
            RgDividerResetTracking();
        }
        return result;
    }

    POINT dcOrg{};
    if (!GetDCOrgEx(hdc, &dcOrg))
        return RgDividerFallbackToNative(hdc, x, y, w, h, rop);

    const bool ending = rg_dividerDragEnding.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (ending) {
        const bool isExpectedFinalErase =
            RgIsDividerPatBlt(main, hdc, w, h, false);
        if (!isExpectedFinalErase)
            return rg_PatBlt_orig(hdc, x, y, w, h, rop);

        rg_dividerDragEnding.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        if (!RgDividerRestoreBackup(hdc)) {
            RedrawWindow(main, nullptr, nullptr,
                RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
        }
        RgDividerResetTracking();
        return TRUE;
    }

    if (!RgIsDividerPatBlt(main, hdc, w, h, true))
        return rg_PatBlt_orig(hdc, x, y, w, h, rop);

    // Tracked in screen space so a restore remains correct if regedit obtains
    // a new DC with a different origin during the modal tracking loop.
    const int oldX = rg_dividerLastX - dcOrg.x;
    const int oldY = rg_dividerLastY - dcOrg.y;
    const int oldW = rg_dividerLastW;
    const int oldH = rg_dividerLastH;
    const bool haveOld = rg_dividerHasBackup && rg_dividerBackupBmp;

    const int centerX = x + w / 2;
    const float scale = RgDividerScale(main, hdc);
    const int footHalfW =
        (int)std::ceil(RgDividerAccentHalfWidth(scale));
    const int newX = centerX - footHalfW;
    const int newW = footHalfW * 2;
    const int newY = y;
    const int newH = h;

    const int unionL = haveOld ? std::min(oldX, newX) : newX;
    const int unionT = haveOld ? std::min(oldY, newY) : newY;
    const int unionR = haveOld ? std::max(oldX + oldW, newX + newW) : newX + newW;
    const int unionB = haveOld ? std::max(oldY + oldH, newY + newH) : newY + newH;
    const int unionW = unionR - unionL;
    const int unionH = unionB - unionT;

    if (!rg_dividerFrameBmp || rg_dividerFrameCapW < unionW ||
        rg_dividerFrameCapH < unionH) {
        const int newCapW = std::max(unionW, 128);
        const int newCapH = std::max(unionH, 128);
        BITMAPINFO bi = {};
        bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
        bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = newCapW;
        bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -newCapH;
        bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
        bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
        bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;
        void* bits = nullptr;
        HBITMAP newFrame = CreateDIBSection(
            hdc, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
        if (!newFrame || !bits) {
            if (newFrame)
                DeleteObject(newFrame);
            return RgDividerFallbackToNative(hdc, x, y, w, h, rop);
        }
        if (rg_dividerFrameBmp)
            DeleteObject(rg_dividerFrameBmp);
        rg_dividerFrameBmp = newFrame;
        rg_dividerFrameCapW = newCapW;
        rg_dividerFrameCapH = newCapH;
    }

    HDC frameDC = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
    if (!frameDC)
        return RgDividerFallbackToNative(hdc, x, y, w, h, rop);

    HGDIOBJ oldFrameBmp = SelectObject(frameDC, rg_dividerFrameBmp);
    bool oldBackupStillValid = haveOld;
    bool composeOk = oldFrameBmp && oldFrameBmp != HGDI_ERROR &&
        BitBlt(frameDC, 0, 0, unionW, unionH,
            hdc, unionL, unionT, SRCCOPY);

    if (composeOk && haveOld) {
        HDC backupDC = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
        composeOk = backupDC != nullptr;
        if (backupDC) {
            HGDIOBJ oldBackup = SelectObject(backupDC, rg_dividerBackupBmp);
            composeOk = oldBackup && oldBackup != HGDI_ERROR &&
                BitBlt(frameDC, oldX - unionL, oldY - unionT,
                    oldW, oldH, backupDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
            if (oldBackup && oldBackup != HGDI_ERROR)
                SelectObject(backupDC, oldBackup);
            DeleteDC(backupDC);
        }
    }

    if (composeOk && (!rg_dividerBackupBmp ||
        rg_dividerBackupCapW < newW || rg_dividerBackupCapH != newH)) {
        const int newCapW = std::max(newW, 96);
        HBITMAP newBackup = CreateCompatibleBitmap(hdc, newCapW, newH);
        if (!newBackup) {
            composeOk = false;
        } else {
            if (rg_dividerBackupBmp)
                DeleteObject(rg_dividerBackupBmp);
            rg_dividerBackupBmp = newBackup;
            rg_dividerBackupCapW = newCapW;
            rg_dividerBackupCapH = newH;
            oldBackupStillValid = false;
        }
    }

    if (composeOk) {
        HDC backupDC = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
        composeOk = backupDC != nullptr;
        if (backupDC) {
            HGDIOBJ oldBackup = SelectObject(backupDC, rg_dividerBackupBmp);
            composeOk = oldBackup && oldBackup != HGDI_ERROR &&
                BitBlt(backupDC, 0, 0, newW, newH,
                    frameDC, newX - unionL, newY - unionT, SRCCOPY);
            if (composeOk)
                oldBackupStillValid = false;
            if (oldBackup && oldBackup != HGDI_ERROR)
                SelectObject(backupDC, oldBackup);
            DeleteDC(backupDC);
        }
    }

    if (composeOk) {
        const RECT lineRc = RgDividerLineRectLocal(
            (float)(centerX - unionL), (float)(newY - unionT),
            (float)newH, scale);
        HRGN lineRgn = CreateRoundRectRgn(
            lineRc.left, lineRc.top, lineRc.right + 1, lineRc.bottom + 1,
            lineRc.right - lineRc.left, lineRc.right - lineRc.left);
        composeOk = lineRgn && InvertRgn(frameDC, lineRgn);
        if (lineRgn)
            DeleteObject(lineRgn);
    }

    if (composeOk) {
        composeOk = RgPaintDividerAccent(
            frameDC, unionW, unionH,
            (float)(centerX - unionL), (float)(newY - unionT),
            (float)newH, g_darkModeActive, scale);
    }

    if (composeOk) {
        composeOk = !!BitBlt(hdc, unionL, unionT, unionW, unionH,
            frameDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
    }

    if (oldFrameBmp && oldFrameBmp != HGDI_ERROR)
        SelectObject(frameDC, oldFrameBmp);
    DeleteDC(frameDC);

    if (!composeOk) {
        rg_dividerHasBackup = haveOld && oldBackupStillValid;
        if (haveOld && !oldBackupStillValid) {
            RedrawWindow(main, nullptr, nullptr,
                RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
        }
        return RgDividerFallbackToNative(hdc, x, y, w, h, rop);
    }

    rg_dividerLastX = newX + dcOrg.x;
    rg_dividerLastY = newY + dcOrg.y;
    rg_dividerLastW = newW;
    rg_dividerLastH = newH;
    rg_dividerHasBackup = true;
    return TRUE;
}

// Visible pill size (see kRgSearchTextNudge/RgUpdateSearchRegion) -- the
// real client rect is taller, with the extra invisible room below clipped
// away by the window region.
static SIZE RgSearchVisibleSize(HWND hwnd)
{
    RECT rcClient;
    GetClientRect(hwnd, &rcClient);
    const int visibleH = rg_searchVisibleH.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    return { rcClient.right, visibleH > 0 ? visibleH : rcClient.bottom };
}

// Search bar overlay (border, bottom line, magnifier) drawn into paintHdc
// over the already painted field.
static void RgPaintSearchOverlay(HWND hwnd, HDC paintHdc, int w, int h, RgSearchState state)
{
    const bool dark = RgIsDarkMode();
    const bool focused = state == kRgSearchFocused;
    const COLORREF fill = RgSearchFill(dark, state);
    const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);
    const float cornerPx = (float)MulDiv(static_cast<int>(WinUI::ControlCornerRadius), (int)dpi, 96);
    const float accentLineH = (float)MulDiv(kRgAccentLineH, (int)dpi, 96);
    const float restLineH = (float)MulDiv(kRgRestLineH, (int)dpi, 96);

    // TextControlElevationBorderBrush: ControlStrokeColorDefault around,
    // ControlStrongStrokeColorDefault along the bottom edge.
    const COLORREF borderClr =
        WinUI::FlattenOver(WinUI::ControlStrokeColorDefault(dark), fill);
    bool gdipOverlayDrawn = false;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(rg_gdipMutex);
        if (RgEnsureGdipLocked()) {
            // DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION: this regedit search overlay is a tiny
            // post-paint stroke over an existing Edit HDC. GDI+ avoids the
            // aliased GDI RoundRect edge without the setup cost of a one-off
            // D2D DC render target.
            Gdiplus::Graphics graphics(paintHdc);
            graphics.SetSmoothingMode(Gdiplus::SmoothingModeAntiAlias);
            graphics.SetPixelOffsetMode(Gdiplus::PixelOffsetModeHalf);

            Gdiplus::GraphicsPath borderPath;
            RgAddRoundedRect(borderPath,
                Gdiplus::RectF(0.5f, 0.5f, (Gdiplus::REAL)w - 1.0f,
                    (Gdiplus::REAL)h - 1.0f),
                cornerPx);
            Gdiplus::Pen borderPen(RgGdipColor(borderClr), 1.0f);
            graphics.DrawPath(&borderPen, &borderPath);

            // Bottom line clipped to the border path above so its ends
            // follow the corner curve, same technique as
            // PaintControlBorder's Edit-field underline.
            graphics.SetClip(&borderPath, Gdiplus::CombineModeReplace);
            if (focused) {
                // GetAccentFromPalette(dark ? ...) directly, not
                // GetAccentIndicator() -- that cache derives dark/light
                // from IsSystemDarkMode() alone, with no exclusion
                // awareness. dark here is already RgIsDarkMode(),
                // correctly exclusion-aware.
                const COLORREF ac = GetAccentFillDefault(dark);
                const Gdiplus::RectF lineRect(
                    0.0f, (Gdiplus::REAL)h - accentLineH, (Gdiplus::REAL)w,
                    (Gdiplus::REAL)accentLineH);
                Gdiplus::SolidBrush lineBrush(RgGdipColor(ac));
                graphics.FillRectangle(&lineBrush, lineRect);
            } else {
                // The elevation border's bottom edge; replaced by the
                // thicker accent line once focused.
                const Gdiplus::RectF lineRect(
                    0.0f, (Gdiplus::REAL)h - restLineH, (Gdiplus::REAL)w,
                    (Gdiplus::REAL)restLineH);
                Gdiplus::SolidBrush lineBrush(RgGdipColor(WinUI::FlattenOver(
                    WinUI::ControlStrongStrokeColorDefault(dark), fill)));
                graphics.FillRectangle(&lineBrush, lineRect);
            }
            graphics.ResetClip();

            gdipOverlayDrawn = graphics.GetLastStatus() == Gdiplus::Ok;
        }
    }

    if (!gdipOverlayDrawn) {
        // 1px border fallback
        HPEN hPen = CreatePen(PS_SOLID, 1, borderClr);
        HBRUSH hNull = static_cast<HBRUSH>(GetStockObject(NULL_BRUSH));
        if (hPen && hNull) {
            const HPEN   hOldPen   = static_cast<HPEN>(SelectObject(paintHdc, hPen));
            const HBRUSH hOldBrush = static_cast<HBRUSH>(SelectObject(paintHdc, hNull));
            const int cornerPxInt = (int)lroundf(cornerPx);
            RoundRect(paintHdc, 0, 0, w, h, cornerPxInt * 2, cornerPxInt * 2);
            SelectObject(paintHdc, hOldPen);
            SelectObject(paintHdc, hOldBrush);
        }
        if (hPen) DeleteObject(hPen);
    }

    // Magnifying-glass icon — same glyph/icon-font as the Explorer rebar's
    // SearchBox (kSearchIconGlyph), left-aligned inside the margin reserved
    // by RgApplySearchStyle's EM_SETMARGINS. AutoSuggestBox's query glyph:
    // TextControlButtonForeground (TextFillColorSecondary).
    {
        const int  iconSize = MulDiv(kRgSearchIconSize, (int)dpi, 96);
        const int  iconX    = MulDiv(kRgSearchIconLeftPad, (int)dpi, 96);
        const RECT rcIcon = { iconX, 0, iconX + iconSize, h };
        DrawGlyphDW(paintHdc, rcIcon,
                    WinUI::FlattenOver(WinUI::TextFillColorSecondary(dark), fill),
                    kSearchIconGlyph, iconSize);
    }

    // Accent line when focused (kRgAccentLineH tall)
    if (focused && !gdipOverlayDrawn) {
        const COLORREF ac = GetAccentFillDefault(dark);
        HBRUSH hBrush = CreateSolidBrush(ac);
        if (hBrush) {
            const float insetX = cornerPx * 0.8f;
            const RECT rcLine = {
                (int)insetX, h - (int)lroundf(accentLineH),
                w - (int)insetX, h
            };
            FillRect(paintHdc, &rcLine, hBrush);
            DeleteObject(hBrush);
        }
    }
}

// The Edit's text line: inside the left margin (magnifier) and the outline,
// above the bottom line. Everything else belongs to the field's chrome.
static RECT RgSearchTextRect(HWND hwnd, int w, int visibleH)
{
    const int dpi = (int)GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);
    return { MulDiv(kRgSearchIconLeftPad + kRgSearchIconSize + kRgSearchIconGap, dpi, 96),
             MulDiv(kRgRestLineH, dpi, 96),
             w - MulDiv(kRgRestLineH, dpi, 96),
             visibleH - MulDiv(kRgAccentLineH, dpi, 96) };
}

// The chrome again over what the Edit just drew outside WM_PAINT (typing,
// selection, clicks). Everything outside the text line is cleared to the
// fill first: the antialiased outline and magnifier drawn over a previous
// copy of themselves would get darker with every redraw.
static void RgDrawSearchOverlay(HWND hwnd)
{
    const SIZE size = RgSearchVisibleSize(hwnd);
    const int w = size.cx, h = size.cy;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;

    const RgSearchState state = RgSearchCurrentState();
    HBRUSH fill = RgSearchBrush(state);
    HDC hdc = GetDC(hwnd);
    if (!hdc) return;
    HDC memDC = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
    HBITMAP memBmp = memDC ? CreateCompatibleBitmap(hdc, w, h) : nullptr;
    HGDIOBJ oldMemBmp = memBmp ? SelectObject(memDC, memBmp) : nullptr;
    if (oldMemBmp) {
        BitBlt(memDC, 0, 0, w, h, hdc, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
        if (fill) {
            const int saved = SaveDC(memDC);
            const RECT text = RgSearchTextRect(hwnd, w, h);
            ExcludeClipRect(memDC, text.left, text.top, text.right, text.bottom);
            const RECT all = {0, 0, w, h};
            FillRect(memDC, &all, fill);
            RestoreDC(memDC, saved);
        }
        RgPaintSearchOverlay(hwnd, memDC, w, h, state);
        BitBlt(hdc, 0, 0, w, h, memDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
        SelectObject(memDC, oldMemBmp);
    } else {
        RgPaintSearchOverlay(hwnd, hdc, w, h, state);
    }
    if (memBmp) DeleteObject(memBmp);
    if (memDC) DeleteDC(memDC);
    ReleaseDC(hwnd, hdc);
}

// The whole field in one off-screen pass: fill, the Edit's own text (via
// WM_PRINTCLIENT) and the overlay, then a single copy to the screen, so a
// state change never shows the fill without its border and magnifier.
// Returns false (painting nothing) when the fill brush doesn't exist yet.
static bool RgPaintSearchBuffered(HWND hwnd)
{
    RECT rc;
    GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc);
    if (rc.right <= 0 || rc.bottom <= 0) return false;
    const RgSearchState state = RgSearchCurrentState();
    HBRUSH fill = RgSearchBrush(state);
    if (!fill) return false;

    PAINTSTRUCT ps;
    HDC hdc = BeginPaint(hwnd, &ps);
    if (!hdc) return false;
    const SIZE size = RgSearchVisibleSize(hwnd);
    const auto composeInto = [&](HDC dc) {
        FillRect(dc, &rc, fill);
        DefSubclassProc(hwnd, WM_PRINTCLIENT, reinterpret_cast<WPARAM>(dc), PRF_CLIENT);
        RgPaintSearchOverlay(hwnd, dc, size.cx, size.cy, state);
    };
    HDC memDC = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
    HBITMAP memBmp = memDC ? CreateCompatibleBitmap(hdc, rc.right, rc.bottom) : nullptr;
    HGDIOBJ oldMemBmp = memBmp ? SelectObject(memDC, memBmp) : nullptr;
    // The caret is drawn on the screen; keep it out of the copy.
    const bool caret = GetFocus() == hwnd && HideCaret(hwnd);
    if (oldMemBmp) {
        composeInto(memDC);
        BitBlt(hdc, 0, 0, rc.right, rc.bottom, memDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
        SelectObject(memDC, oldMemBmp);
    } else {
        // BeginPaint already validated the area, so it is painted here.
        composeInto(hdc);
    }
    if (caret)
        ShowCaret(hwnd);
    if (memBmp) DeleteObject(memBmp);
    if (memDC) DeleteDC(memDC);
    EndPaint(hwnd, &ps);
    return true;
}

// Search bar: update rounded clip region. Skips the GDI region
// create+SetWindowRgn round-trip when the size hasn't actually changed
// since last time -- WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGED can fire for pure moves or other
// no-op-sized changes, and this control gets repositioned on every main
// window resize tick.
static void RgUpdateSearchRegion(HWND hwnd)
{
    RECT rc;
    GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc);
    if (rc.right <= 0 || rc.bottom <= 0) return;
    RECT rcWin;
    GetWindowRect(hwnd, &rcWin);
    const int w = rcWin.right - rcWin.left + 1;
    // Visible pill height, not the window's own (taller, see
    // kRgSearchTextNudge) height -- otherwise the region would extend into
    // the invisible padding and its bottom corners wouldn't land rounded.
    const int visibleH = rg_searchVisibleH.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    const int h = (visibleH > 0 ? visibleH : (rcWin.bottom - rcWin.top)) + 1;

    static HWND s_lastHwnd = nullptr;
    static int s_lastW = -1, s_lastH = -1;
    if (hwnd == s_lastHwnd && w == s_lastW && h == s_lastH) return;

    const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);
    const int dia = MulDiv(static_cast<int>(WinUI::ControlCornerRadius), (int)dpi, 96) * 2;
    HRGN hRgn = CreateRoundRectRgn(0, 0, w, h, dia, dia);
    if (hRgn) {
        SetWindowRgn(hwnd, hRgn, TRUE);
        s_lastHwnd = hwnd;
        s_lastW = w;
        s_lastH = h;
    }
}

// ListView: top-left corner rounded (WinUI 3 card)
static void RgUpdateListViewRegion(HWND hwnd)
{
    RECT rcWin;
    if (!GetWindowRect(hwnd, &rcWin)) return;
    const int w = rcWin.right  - rcWin.left + 1;
    const int h = rcWin.bottom - rcWin.top  + 1;
    if (w <= 1 || h <= 1) return;

    const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);
    const int r = MulDiv(static_cast<int>(WinUI::OverlayCornerRadius), (int)dpi, 96), d = r * 2;
    HRGN hBase = CreateRoundRectRgn(0, 0, w, h, d, d);
    if (!hBase) return;

    // Restore straight corners: TR, BR, BL (only TL stays rounded)
    HRGN hC;
    hC = CreateRectRgn(w-r-1, 0, w, r+1);
    if (hC) { CombineRgn(hBase, hBase, hC, RGN_OR); DeleteObject(hC); }
    hC = CreateRectRgn(w-r-1, h-r-1, w, h);
    if (hC) { CombineRgn(hBase, hBase, hC, RGN_OR); DeleteObject(hC); }
    hC = CreateRectRgn(0, h-r-1, r+1, h);
    if (hC) { CombineRgn(hBase, hBase, hC, RGN_OR); DeleteObject(hC); }

    SetWindowRgn(hwnd, hBase, TRUE);
}

// Search bar: compute geometry
// Assumes hwndSearch and its top-level regedit window share one DPI context
// (true here since hwndSearch is always a child of that same top-level
// window -- WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGING in RgTVSubclassProc reads DPI from
// GetParent(hwnd) for the same reason and relies on the same assumption).
static void RgComputeSearchGeometry(HWND hwndSearch, int clientW,
                                     int* outX, int* outW, int* outH)
{
    const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwndSearch);
    *outH = MulDiv(kRgSearchHeightBase, (int)dpi, 96);
    *outW = clientW * kRgSearchWidthPct / 100;
    *outX = (clientW - *outW) / 2;
}

static void RgRepositionSearch(HWND hwndMain, HWND hwndSearch)
{
    if (!hwndMain || !hwndSearch) return;
    if (!IsWindow(hwndMain) || !IsWindow(hwndSearch)) return;

    RECT rcClient;
    GetClientRect(hwndMain, &rcClient);
    if (rcClient.right <= 0) return;

    RECT rcSearch;
    GetWindowRect(hwndSearch, &rcSearch);
    MapWindowPoints(HWND_DESKTOP, hwndMain, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(&rcSearch), 2);

    int newX, newW, newH;
    RgComputeSearchGeometry(hwndSearch, rcClient.right, &newX, &newW, &newH);

    const int rowH = rcSearch.bottom - rcSearch.top;
    const int newY = rowH > newH ? rcSearch.top + (rowH - newH) / 2 : rcSearch.top;

    // Grow the actual window downward past the visible pill (see
    // kRgSearchTextNudge) -- top/visible height/width are unaffected, only
    // the true client height (which drives the native single-line edit's
    // vertical text centering) increases.
    const UINT dpi     = GetDpiForWindow(hwndSearch);
    const int  extra   = 2 * MulDiv(kRgSearchTextNudge, (int)dpi, 96);
    rg_searchVisibleH.store(newH, std::memory_order_relaxed);

    SetWindowPos(hwndSearch, nullptr, newX, newY, newW, newH + extra,
        SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_FRAMECHANGED);

    rg_searchBarBottom.store(newY + newH, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Forward declarations for subclass procs
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 5-param WH_SUBCLASSPROC form (no uIdSubclass) -- these install via
// WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread, which derives its own
// uIdSubclass from the proc pointer and never exposes it to the callback.
static LRESULT CALLBACK RgMainSubclassProc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM, DWORD_PTR);
static LRESULT CALLBACK RgTVSubclassProc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM, DWORD_PTR);
static LRESULT CALLBACK RgLVSubclassProc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM, DWORD_PTR);
static LRESULT CALLBACK RgHdrSubclassProc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM, DWORD_PTR);
static LRESULT CALLBACK RgSearchSubclassProc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM, DWORD_PTR);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Subclass: main regedit window
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
static LRESULT CALLBACK RgMainSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR /*dwRefData*/)
{
    if (const UINT refreshMsg = g_rgRefreshColorsMessage.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        refreshMsg && msg == refreshMsg) {
        RgRefreshColorResources();
        RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
            RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
        return 0;
    }
    if (const UINT resetDividerMsg = g_rgResetDividerMessage.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        resetDividerMsg && msg == resetDividerMsg) {
        RgDividerResetOnMainThread(hwnd);
        return 0;
    }

    switch (msg) {

    case WM_ERASEBKGND:
        if (rg_tvBkBrush) {
            RECT rc;
            GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc);
            FillRect_orig(reinterpret_cast<HDC>(wp), &rc, rg_tvBkBrush);
            RgPaintCardStroke(hwnd, reinterpret_cast<HDC>(wp));
            return 1;
        }
        break;

    // UAH menu bar — the UAHMENUBAR HDC is a WINDOW DC (includes NC area).
    // Coordinates are window-relative, NOT client-relative.
    // GetMenuBarInfo returns screen coords; convert via GetWindowRect offset.
    case 0x0091: // WM_UAHDRAWMENU
    {
        // Per-window, not IsSystemDarkMode -- matches UAHWndProc's own check
        // for the same message elsewhere in the file. This mod can force
        // regedit dark independent of the OS-wide setting, and the raw
        // system check disagreed with that, leaving a light menu bar in an
        // otherwise-dark regedit window (or vice versa).
        const bool dark = IsHwndDarkMode(hwnd);
        // Fixed per-window colors, not the hooked GetSysColor, which follows
        // the global mode. Light is WinUI's SolidBackgroundFillColorBase;
        // Mica: black reveals the backdrop behind the bar.
        const COLORREF barBg = RgMicaActive() ? RGB(0, 0, 0)
            : dark ? kRgDkMenuBk : WinUI::Light::SolidBackgroundFillColorBase.rgb;

        struct { HMENU hMenu; HDC hdc; DWORD dwFlags; } *pBar =
            reinterpret_cast<decltype(pBar)>(lp);
        if (!pBar || !pBar->hdc) break;

        MENUBARINFO mbi = { sizeof(mbi) };
        if (!GetMenuBarInfo(hwnd, OBJID_MENU, 0, &mbi)) break;

        // Convert screen coords to window-relative coords
        RECT rcWin;
        GetWindowRect(hwnd, &rcWin);
        const int winW = rcWin.right - rcWin.left;

        RECT rcBar;
        rcBar.left   = 0;  // full window width
        rcBar.top    = mbi.rcBar.top  - rcWin.top;
        rcBar.right  = winW;
        rcBar.bottom = mbi.rcBar.bottom - rcWin.top;

        if (HBRUSH hBr = GetCachedSolidBrush(barBg))
            FillRect_orig(pBar->hdc, &rcBar, hBr);
        return 0;
    }

    case 0x0092: // WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM
    {
        // Per-window, not IsSystemDarkMode -- see the WM_UAHDRAWMENU case above.
        const bool dark = IsHwndDarkMode(hwnd);
        // Same bar color as the WM_UAHDRAWMENU case above.
        const COLORREF barBg = RgMicaActive() ? RGB(0, 0, 0)
            : dark ? kRgDkMenuBk : WinUI::Light::SolidBackgroundFillColorBase.rgb;

        auto* pItem = reinterpret_cast<UAHDRAWMENUITEM*>(lp);
        if (!pItem || !pItem->um.hdc) break;

        const bool isDisabled = (pItem->dis.itemState & (ODS_GRAYED | ODS_DISABLED)) != 0;
        const bool isHot      = (pItem->dis.itemState & ODS_HOTLIGHT) != 0;
        const bool isSelected = (pItem->dis.itemState & ODS_SELECTED) != 0;
        const bool isInactive = (GetForegroundWindow() != hwnd);

        if (HBRUSH hBr = GetCachedSolidBrush(barBg))
            FillRect_orig(pItem->um.hdc, &pItem->dis.rcItem, hBr);

        if ((isHot || isSelected) && !isDisabled && g_d2dFactory) {
            const RECT* rc = &pItem->dis.rcItem;
            const int w = rc->right - rc->left;
            const int h = rc->bottom - rc->top;
            if (w > 0 && h > 0) {
                const float scale = (float)GetDpiForWindow(hwnd) / (float)USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
                const float cr = ModernizerCornerRadius * scale;
                const float inset = 2.f * scale;
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> pRT;
                if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(pItem->um.hdc, rc,
                        g_d2dFactory, &pRT))) {
                    const float alpha = isSelected ? 0.12f : 0.08f;
                    const D2D1_COLOR_F hoverColor = dark
                        ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, alpha)
                        : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, alpha * 0.75f);
                    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> hoverBr;
                    pRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(hoverColor, &hoverBr);
                    if (hoverBr) {
                        pRT->BeginDraw();
                        pRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                            D2D1::RoundedRect(
                                D2D1::RectF(inset, inset, (float)w - inset, (float)h - inset),
                                cr, cr),
                            hoverBr.Get());
                        if (pRT->EndDraw() == (HRESULT)D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                            pRT.Reset();
                            CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        wchar_t menuStr[256] = {};
        MENUITEMINFO mii{ sizeof(mii), MIIM_STRING };
        mii.dwTypeData = menuStr;
        mii.cch = ARRAYSIZE(menuStr) - 1;
        if (!GetMenuItemInfoW(pItem->um.hMenu, pItem->umi.iPosition, TRUE, &mii))
            return 0;

        DTTOPTS dtto = { sizeof(dtto) };
        dtto.dwFlags = DTT_TEXTCOLOR;
        dtto.crText = (isDisabled || isInactive)
            ? (dark ? RGB(0xAA, 0xAA, 0xAA) : RGB(0x66, 0x66, 0x66))
            : (dark ? RGB(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF) : RGB(0x00, 0x00, 0x00));
        DWORD dtFlags = DT_CENTER | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_VCENTER;
        if (pItem->dis.itemState & ODS_NOACCEL)
            dtFlags |= DT_HIDEPREFIX;

        bool drawnViaD2D = false;
        {
            HFONT srcFont = (HFONT)GetCurrentObject(pItem->um.hdc, OBJ_FONT);
            LOGFONTW lf = {};
            if (srcFont && GetObjectW(srcFont, sizeof(lf), &lf)) {
                wcsncpy_s(lf.lfFaceName, L"Segoe UI Variable Text", _TRUNCATE);
                drawnViaD2D = DrawWinUiStyledTextDWrite(pItem->um.hdc, &pItem->dis.rcItem,
                    menuStr, mii.cch, lf, dtto.crText, dtFlags);
            }
        }
        if (!drawnViaD2D) {
            if (HTHEME menuTheme = OpenThemeData(hwnd, L"Menu")) {
                g_glowEntry = true;
                DrawThemeTextEx(menuTheme, pItem->um.hdc, MENU_BARITEM,
                    MBI_NORMAL, menuStr, mii.cch, dtFlags, &pItem->dis.rcItem, &dtto);
                g_glowEntry = false;
                CloseThemeData(menuTheme);
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    case WM_THEMECHANGED:
    case WM_SETTINGCHANGE:
        AccentPaletteInvalidate();
        g_accentCacheDirty.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        if (const UINT refreshMsg = g_rgRefreshColorsMessage.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            PostMessageW(hwnd, refreshMsg, 0, 0);
        else {
            RgRefreshColorResources();
            RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
                RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
        }
        // Regedit has no dedicated broadcast-listener window like Explorer's
        // ThemeMsgWndProc, so re-check the animations-enabled setting here.
        if (msg == WM_SETTINGCHANGE) g_animEnabled = -1;
        break;

    // Menu bar bottom line: the system draws a 1px separator between the menu
    // bar and the client area. This is redrawn AFTER our WM_UAHDRAWMENU handler
    // by DefWindowProc during WM_NCPAINT and WM_ACTIVATE. We post-process both
    // messages to paint over it. (Technique from dark-mode-context-menus mod's
    // DrawUAHMenuNCBottomLine, based on Notepad++ dark mode implementation.)
    case WM_NCPAINT:
    case WM_ACTIVATE: {
        const LRESULT res = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        const bool mica = RgMicaActive();
        const bool dark = IsHwndDarkMode(hwnd);

        MENUBARINFO mbi2 = { sizeof(mbi2) };
        if (GetMenuBarInfo(hwnd, OBJID_MENU, 0, &mbi2)) {
            // Client rect in SCREEN coords → window-relative
            RECT rcClient;
            GetClientRect(hwnd, &rcClient);
            MapWindowPoints(hwnd, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(&rcClient), 2);
            RECT rcWin;
            GetWindowRect(hwnd, &rcWin);
            OffsetRect(&rcClient, -rcWin.left, -rcWin.top);

            // The line is 1px above the client area top
            RECT rcLine = { rcClient.left, rcClient.top - 1,
                            rcClient.right, rcClient.top };

            HDC hdcWin = GetWindowDC(hwnd);
            if (hdcWin) {
                // Use the menu bar's own color to erase the native separator.
                if (HBRUSH hBr = GetCachedSolidBrush(mica ? RGB(0, 0, 0)
                        : dark ? kRgDkMenuBk
                               : WinUI::Light::SolidBackgroundFillColorBase.rgb))
                    FillRect_orig(hdcWin, &rcLine, hBr);
                ReleaseDC(hwnd, hdcWin);
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    case WM_CTLCOLOREDIT: {
        const HWND search = rg_hwndSearch.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        const RgSearchState state = RgSearchCurrentState();
        HBRUSH brush = (HWND)lp == search ? RgSearchBrush(state) : nullptr;
        if (brush) {
            const bool dark = RgIsDarkMode();
            const COLORREF fill = RgSearchFill(dark, state);
            // TextControlForeground: TextFillColorPrimary in every state.
            SetTextColor((HDC)wp, WinUI::FlattenOver(WinUI::TextFillColorPrimary(dark), fill));
            SetBkColor((HDC)wp, fill);
            return (LRESULT)brush;
        }
        break;
    }

    case WM_NOTIFY: {
        const NMHDR* nm = reinterpret_cast<const NMHDR*>(lp);

        const HWND tv = rg_hwndTV.load(std::memory_order_acquire);

        if (!tv || nm->hwndFrom != tv) break;

        // Selection change: start pill expand animation at destination item
        if (nm->code == TVN_SELCHANGEDW || nm->code == TVN_SELCHANGEDA) {
            const NMTREEVIEW* nmt = reinterpret_cast<const NMTREEVIEW*>(lp);
            // No OS/mod animation: leave rg_pillAnimItem unset so the pill
            // paints at its full (scale==1.0) size on the very next paint
            // instead of easing in (see the `rg_pillAnimItem == hItem` check
            // in the pill paint code above).
            if (SysAnimationsEnabled()) {
                const DOUBLE now = TimerGetSeconds();
                float outgoingScale = 1.0f;
                float outgoingOpacity = 1.0f;
                float incomingScale = 0.0f;
                float incomingOpacity = 0.0f;
                if (rg_pillAnimItem) {
                    const PillListViewIndicatorState activeState =
                        RgSamplePillAnimation(now);
                    auto sampleItem = [&activeState](
                        HTREEITEM item, HTREEITEM activeIncoming,
                        HTREEITEM activeOutgoing, float defaultScale,
                        float defaultOpacity, float* itemScale,
                        float* itemOpacity) {
                        *itemScale = defaultScale;
                        *itemOpacity = defaultOpacity;
                        if (item == activeIncoming) {
                            *itemScale = activeState.incomingScale;
                            *itemOpacity = activeState.incomingOpacity;
                        } else if (item == activeOutgoing) {
                            *itemScale = activeState.outgoingScale;
                            *itemOpacity = activeState.outgoingOpacity;
                        }
                    };
                    sampleItem(nmt->itemOld.hItem, rg_pillAnimItem,
                        rg_pillAnimPrevItem, 1.0f, 1.0f,
                        &outgoingScale, &outgoingOpacity);
                    sampleItem(nmt->itemNew.hItem, rg_pillAnimItem,
                        rg_pillAnimPrevItem, 0.0f, 0.0f,
                        &incomingScale, &incomingOpacity);
                    RgInvalidatePillItems(tv);
                }
                rg_pillAnimPrevItem = nmt->itemOld.hItem;
                rg_pillAnimItem     = nmt->itemNew.hItem;
                rg_pillAnimStart = now;
                rg_pillOutgoingScale = outgoingScale;
                rg_pillOutgoingStartOpacity = outgoingOpacity;
                rg_pillIncomingStartScale = incomingScale;
                rg_pillIncomingStartOpacity = incomingOpacity;
                if (!SetTimer(hwnd, kRgPillAnimTimerId, 16, nullptr)) {
                    RgResetPillAnimationState();
                }
            } else {
                KillTimer(hwnd, kRgPillAnimTimerId);
                RgResetPillAnimationState();
            }
            RgInvalidatePillItems(tv);
            break;
        }

        // TreeView expand/collapse: start glyph rotation animation
        if (nm->code == TVN_ITEMEXPANDING) {
            if (!SysAnimationsEnabled()) break; // static angle read straight from TVIS_EXPANDED
            const NMTREEVIEW* nmt = reinterpret_cast<const NMTREEVIEW*>(lp);
            HTREEITEM hItem = nmt->itemNew.hItem;
            const bool expanding = (nmt->action & TVE_EXPAND) != 0;
            const float target = expanding ? 90.f : 0.f;
            const DWORD now = GetTickCount();

            auto it = rg_tvAnims.find(hItem);
            if (it == rg_tvAnims.end()) {
                RgTVItemAnim anim;
                anim.current = expanding ? 0.f : 90.f;
                anim.startAngle = anim.current;
                anim.target = target;
                anim.startTick = now;
                rg_tvAnims[hItem] = anim;
            } else {
                auto& anim = it->second;
                anim.current = GlyphChevronAngleAt(
                    anim.startAngle, anim.target, anim.startTick, now);
                anim.startAngle = anim.current;
                anim.target = target;
                anim.startTick = now;
            }

            if (rg_tvLastTick == 0) {
                rg_tvLastTick = now;
                SetTimer(hwnd, kRgTVAnimTimerId, 16, nullptr);
            }
            break;
        }

        // Prune deleted items from animation map
        if (nm->code == TVN_DELETEITEMW || nm->code == TVN_DELETEITEMA) {
            const NMTREEVIEW* nmt = reinterpret_cast<const NMTREEVIEW*>(lp);
            const HTREEITEM deletedItem = nmt->itemOld.hItem;
            rg_tvAnims.erase(deletedItem);
            TreePressedHoldInvalidateItem(tv, deletedItem);
            // Same dangling-HTREEITEM hazard NavHoverFadeInvalidateItem
            // guards against for the nav pane: comctl32 frees the item's
            // backing storage on delete, so rg_hoverFade must drop it
            // immediately rather than holding it across the fade's ~140ms
            // window (or the next timer tick's TreeView_GetItemRect call).
            if (rg_hoverFade.hotItem == deletedItem)
                RgHoverFadeClear(tv, false);
            if (rg_pillAnimItem == deletedItem) {
                KillTimer(hwnd, kRgPillAnimTimerId);
                RgResetPillAnimationState();
            } else if (rg_pillAnimPrevItem == deletedItem) {
                rg_pillAnimPrevItem = nullptr;
                rg_pillOutgoingStartOpacity = 0.0f;
            }
            break;
        }

        if (nm->code != NM_CUSTOMDRAW) break;

        const NMCUSTOMDRAW* cd = reinterpret_cast<const NMCUSTOMDRAW*>(lp);
        switch (cd->dwDrawStage) {
        case CDDS_PREPAINT:
            // Computed once per paint pass instead of once per visible row --
            // both are cheap individually but a tree with hundreds/thousands
            // of visible items (e.g. HKLM\SYSTEM\...\Enum) repaints them all
            // on every scroll/expand.
            s_rgTvPaintDpi  = GetDpiForWindow(tv);
            s_rgTvPaintDark = RgIsDarkMode();
            {
                const HFONT treeFont =
                    reinterpret_cast<HFONT>(SendMessage(tv, WM_GETFONT, 0, 0));
                s_rgTvPaintFontValid = treeFont &&
                    GetObjectW(treeFont, sizeof(s_rgTvPaintFont), &s_rgTvPaintFont);
                if (s_rgTvPaintFontValid)
                    wcsncpy_s(s_rgTvPaintFont.lfFaceName, L"Segoe UI Variable Text",
                        _TRUNCATE);
            }
            return CDRF_NOTIFYITEMDRAW;

        case CDDS_ITEMPREPAINT: {
            HDC       hdc   = cd->hdc;
            HTREEITEM hItem = (HTREEITEM)cd->dwItemSpec;
            const UINT dpi  = s_rgTvPaintDpi;
            const bool dark = s_rgTvPaintDark;

            const bool selected = (cd->uItemState & CDIS_SELECTED) != 0;
            // Native CDIS_HOT never arrives here -- comctl32 only computes a
            // hotItem with TVS_TRACKSELECT set, which regedit's tree
            // deliberately never gets (see ApplyTreeRuntimeSettings's
            // IsCurrentProcessRegedit exclusion). Hover is tracked
            // independently instead -- see RgHoverFade* above -- with its
            // own fade-in, same curve as NavHoverFadeState.
            const bool hot = !rg_hoverFade.fadingOut && rg_hoverFade.hotItem == hItem;
            const bool hoverFill = !selected && rg_hoverFade.hotItem == hItem;
            const float hoverProgress = hoverFill
                ? NavHoverFadeProgress(rg_hoverFade, TimerGetSeconds()) : 1.f;

            // Single TVM_GETITEM for everything this item's paint needs
            // (children/expanded/selected state, icon indices, text) --
            // was 3 separate SendMessage round-trips to the same control.
            wchar_t   itemText[512] = {};
            TVITEMEXW tvi = {};
            tvi.mask        = TVIF_CHILDREN | TVIF_STATE | TVIF_IMAGE |
                              TVIF_SELECTEDIMAGE | TVIF_TEXT;
            tvi.hItem       = hItem;
            tvi.stateMask   = TVIS_EXPANDED | TVIS_SELECTED;
            tvi.pszText     = itemText;
            tvi.cchTextMax  = ARRAYSIZE(itemText);
            SendMessage(tv, TVM_GETITEM, 0, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&tvi));
            const bool hasChildren = (tvi.cChildren != 0);

            // Text rect
            RECT rcText = {};
            *reinterpret_cast<HTREEITEM*>(&rcText) = hItem;
            SendMessage(tv, TVM_GETITEMRECT, TRUE, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&rcText));

            // Full item rect — use TVM_GETITEMRECT(FALSE) instead of cd->rc
            // because cd->rc can be stale during horizontal scroll (the TreeView
            // uses ScrollWindowEx which shifts pixels before updating cd->rc).
            RECT rcFullBuf = {};
            *reinterpret_cast<HTREEITEM*>(&rcFullBuf) = hItem;
            if (!SendMessage(tv, TVM_GETITEMRECT, FALSE, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&rcFullBuf)))
                rcFullBuf = cd->rc; // fallback
            const RECT& rcFull = rcFullBuf;

            const bool pressed = IsTreeItemPressed(tv, &rcFull);
            const bool fillSelected =
                TreePressedFillSelected(tv, &rcFull, selected, pressed);
            const WinUI::Color foreground = NavigationItemForegroundColor(dark,
                g_settings.NeutralSelection,
                dark ? kRgDkTVText : kRgLtTVText, pressed);

            // Shared geometry
            const float hMf  = (float)MulDiv(kRgTVHMargin, (int)dpi, 96);
            const float rBg  = (float)MulDiv(static_cast<int>(ModernizerCornerRadius), (int)dpi, 96);
            const float wF   = (float)(rcFull.right  - rcFull.left);
            const float hF   = (float)(rcFull.bottom - rcFull.top);
            const int   gap  = MulDiv(3, (int)dpi, 96);

            // Glyph geometry
            HIMAGELIST himl = TreeView_GetImageList(tv, TVSIL_NORMAL);
            int iconW = MulDiv(16, (int)dpi, 96);
            int iconH = iconW;
            if (himl) { ImageList_GetIconSize(himl, &iconW, &iconH); }
            const int glyphW  = MulDiv(14, (int)dpi, 96);
            const int minX    = MulDiv(kRgTVLeftInset, (int)dpi, 96);
            // Natural glyph position (scrolls with content). minX clamp only
            // when content is on-screen; when scrolled off-left, use natural
            // position so the glyph scrolls away instead of sticking at X=8.
            const int glyphXNat = (int)(rcText.left - gap - iconW - gap - glyphW);
            const int glyphX    = (glyphXNat >= 0) ? (std::max)(minX, glyphXNat) : glyphXNat;

            // Icon position -- computed early, before the icon is actually
            // drawn (GDI, further below), since the text rect drawn inside
            // the D2D session just below depends on iconXFinal.
            const int glyphXEnd = glyphX + glyphW;
            int iconX = (int)rcText.left - gap - iconW;
            int iconXFinal = (int)rcText.left;
            if (himl) {
                iconX = (std::max)(glyphXEnd + gap, iconX);
                iconXFinal = iconX + iconW + gap;
            }
            const int iconY = rcFull.top + (rcFull.bottom - rcFull.top - iconH) / 2;
            bool textDrawnViaD2D = false;

            // Rows without a tint, a pill or a turning chevron draw their
            // chevron and name from the raster cache, without a D2D session.
            bool rowCached = false;
            {
                const bool pillOutgoing = rg_pillAnimPrevItem == hItem &&
                    rg_pillAnimPrevItem != rg_pillAnimItem;
                float chevronAngle = (tvi.state & TVIS_EXPANDED) ? 90.f : 0.f;
                bool chevronTurning = false;
                if (hasChildren) {
                    auto it = rg_tvAnims.find(hItem);
                    if (it != rg_tvAnims.end()) {
                        it->second.rect = rcFull;
                        chevronAngle = it->second.current;
                        chevronTurning = it->second.current != it->second.target;
                    }
                }
                if (!selected && !hoverFill && !pressed && !pillOutgoing && !chevronTurning) {
                    const int textLeft =
                        (std::max)(iconXFinal, (int)rcText.left) - rcFull.left;
                    rowCached = RgTreeRowDrawCached(hdc, rcFull, hasChildren,
                        glyphX, glyphW, chevronAngle, textLeft,
                        (int)std::lround(wF - hMf), itemText, dark, dpi,
                        &textDrawnViaD2D);
                }
            }

            // ---- D2D phase: background tint + elastic pill + geometric chevron ----
            // Scroll artifacts are handled by WM_HSCROLL in RgTVSubclassProc
            // forcing a full RedrawWindow after every horizontal scroll.
            if (!rowCached && g_d2dFactory) {
                const bool premultiplied = RgMicaActive();
                if (rg_tvCachedRT && rg_tvCachedRTPremultiplied != premultiplied) {
                    RgReleaseTreePillBrushes();
                    rg_tvCachedRT->Release();
                    rg_tvCachedRT = nullptr;
                }
                if (!rg_tvCachedRT) {
                    const D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_PROPERTIES props = D2D1::RenderTargetProperties(
                        D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_TYPE_SOFTWARE,
                        D2D1::PixelFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM,
                            premultiplied ? D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED
                                          : D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_IGNORE),
                        0, 0, D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_USAGE_GDI_COMPATIBLE,
                        D2D1_FEATURE_LEVEL_DEFAULT);
                    HRESULT hr = g_d2dFactory->CreateDCRenderTarget(&props, &rg_tvCachedRT);
                    if (FAILED(hr)) rg_tvCachedRT = nullptr;
                    rg_tvCachedRTPremultiplied = premultiplied;
                }
                if (rg_tvCachedRT && SUCCEEDED(rg_tvCachedRT->BindDC(hdc, &rcFull))) {
                    rg_tvCachedRT->BeginDraw();

                    // Background left edge: respect item indentation.
                    // Start just before the glyph (parent items) or icon (leaf items).
                    // Same scroll pattern as glyphX: only clamp to hMf when content
                    // is on-screen; when scrolled off-left, use raw value so the
                    // background scrolls naturally with the content.
                    const float indentPad = (float)MulDiv(4, (int)dpi, 96);
                    const float contentStartClient = hasChildren
                        ? (float)glyphXNat - indentPad
                        : (float)rcText.left - (float)gap - (float)iconW - indentPad;
                    const float bgLeftRaw = contentStartClient - (float)rcFull.left;
                    // Root items have bgLeftRaw slightly negative (glyph near edge).
                    // Only allow scroll-off when far enough negative to be actual scroll,
                    // not just root-level layout. glyphW is a good threshold (~18px).
                    const float scrollThresh = -(float)glyphW;
                    const float bgLeft = (bgLeftRaw >= 0.f)
                        ? (std::max)(1.f, bgLeftRaw)   // on-screen: small margin
                        : (bgLeftRaw > scrollThresh)
                            ? 1.f                       // root near edge: clamp to 1px
                            : bgLeftRaw;                // far off: scroll naturally

                    // Fade only the unselected hover fill. Selected+hover
                    // and pressed consume their exact NavigationView tokens.
                    if (selected || hoverFill || pressed) {
                        const WinUI::Color fill = NavigationItemFillColor(dark,
                            g_settings.NeutralSelection, GetAccentFillDefault(dark),
                            fillSelected, hot || hoverFill, pressed);
                        const float opacity = fill.alpha / 255.f *
                            ((!selected && !pressed) ? hoverProgress : 1.f);
                        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
                        if (SUCCEEDED(rg_tvCachedRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(
                                RgBlendAccent(fill.rgb, opacity), &brush))) {
                            rg_tvCachedRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                                D2D1::RoundedRect(D2D1::RectF(bgLeft, 0.f, wF-hMf, hF), rBg, rBg),
                                brush.Get());
                        }
                    }

                    // Accent pill — at the indented left edge. Match WinUI's
                    // item-owned selection indicators: the old item's pill
                    // fades out while the new one fades in and expands from
                    // its vertical center.
                    const bool incomingPill = selected;
                    const bool outgoingPill =
                        rg_pillAnimPrevItem == hItem &&
                        rg_pillAnimPrevItem != rg_pillAnimItem;
                    if (incomingPill || outgoingPill) {
                        const float pillW = (float)MulDiv(3, (int)dpi, 96);
                        float scale = 1.0f;
                        float pillOpacity = 1.0f;
                        if (rg_pillAnimItem) {
                            const PillListViewIndicatorState pillState =
                                RgSamplePillAnimation(TimerGetSeconds());
                            if (outgoingPill) {
                                scale = pillState.outgoingScale;
                                pillOpacity = pillState.outgoingOpacity;
                            } else if (rg_pillAnimItem == hItem) {
                                scale = pillState.incomingScale;
                                pillOpacity = pillState.incomingOpacity;
                            }
                        }

                        const float pillHalf = (hF * PILL_H_FRAC / 2.0f) * scale;
                        const float cy = hF * 0.5f;
                        const float pTop = cy - pillHalf;
                        const float pBot = cy + pillHalf;

                        if (pillOpacity > 0.001f && pBot > pTop + 0.5f) {
                            const COLORREF ac = GetAccentFillDefault(dark);
                            const D2D1_RECT_F pillRect = D2D1::RectF(
                                bgLeft, pTop, bgLeft + pillW, pBot);
                            const COLORREF base = g_settings.AccentGradients
                                ? GetAccentFromPalette(12) : CLR_INVALID;
                            ID2D1Brush* pillBrush = RgGetTreePillBrush(
                                ac, base,
                                g_settings.AccentGradients, bgLeft, pTop,
                                pBot, pillOpacity);
                            if (pillBrush)
                                rg_tvCachedRT->FillRoundedRectangle(
                                    D2D1::RoundedRect(
                                        pillRect, pillW * 0.5f,
                                        pillW * 0.5f),
                                    pillBrush);
                        }
                    }

                    // Chevron: real Fluent glyph first (fixed "closed,
                    // pointing right" ChevronRightSmall shape, rotated by
                    // `angle` -- 0=closed, 90=open, or interpolated
                    // mid-animation -- same rotate-one-shape technique the
                    // hand-drawn lines below already used, and the same
                    // shared glyph helper Explorer's DrawChevronGlyph and
                    // the group-header chevron use). Hand-drawn lines only
                    // if no icon font is installed at all.
                    if (hasChildren) {
                        float angle = 0.f;
                        auto it = rg_tvAnims.find(hItem);
                        if (it != rg_tvAnims.end()) {
                            it->second.rect = rcFull;
                            angle = it->second.current;
                        } else {
                            angle = (tvi.state & TVIS_EXPANDED) ? 90.f : 0.f;
                        }

                        const float cellW = (float)glyphW;
                        const float cellH = hF;
                        const float arrowLen = fminf(cellW, cellH) * 0.30f;
                        const float adx = arrowLen * 0.866f;
                        const float ady = arrowLen * 0.5f;
                        const float cx  = (float)glyphX + cellW * 0.5f;
                        const float cy  = cellH * 0.5f;

                        // Same WinUI TreeViewItemForeground DrawChevronGlyph
                        // uses for the nav pane.
                        const WinUI::Color chevFg = pressed
                            ? WinUI::TextFillColorSecondary(dark)
                            : WinUI::TextFillColorPrimary(dark);
