                        const D2D1_COLOR_F chevClr = D2D1::ColorF(
                            GetRValue(chevFg.rgb) / 255.f, GetGValue(chevFg.rgb) / 255.f,
                            GetBValue(chevFg.rgb) / 255.f, chevFg.alpha / 255.f);
                        const float strokeW = 1.6f * (float)dpi / 96.f;
                        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> chevBr;
                        if (SUCCEEDED(rg_tvCachedRT->CreateSolidColorBrush(chevClr, &chevBr))) {
                            const int chevFontSizePx = std::max(1, (int)std::lround(
                                kTreeViewChevronGlyphDip * (float)dpi / 96.f));
                            if (!DrawChevronGlyphOnRT(rg_tvCachedRT, kChevronGlyphRight,
                                    cellW, cellH, cx, cy, angle, chevBr.Get(), chevFontSizePx)) {
                                if (angle != 0.f)
                                    rg_tvCachedRT->SetTransform(
                                        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Rotation(angle, D2D1::Point2F(cx, cy)));
                                D2D1_POINT_2F ptTip  = { cx + ady, cy };
                                D2D1_POINT_2F ptTop  = { cx - ady, cy - adx };
                                D2D1_POINT_2F ptBot  = { cx - ady, cy + adx };
                                rg_tvCachedRT->DrawLine(ptTop, ptTip, chevBr.Get(), strokeW);
                                rg_tvCachedRT->DrawLine(ptBot, ptTip, chevBr.Get(), strokeW);
                                if (angle != 0.f)
                                    rg_tvCachedRT->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Text -- same open D2D session as the background/pill/
                    // chevron above, so no extra BeginDraw/EndDraw per item.
                    // Icon still draws via GDI below (ImageList_Draw needs a
                    // real HDC), after this session ends.
                    if (s_rgTvPaintFontValid) {
                        const int textLeft = (std::max)(iconXFinal, (int)rcText.left);
                        RECT rcDraw = {
                            textLeft - rcFull.left, 0,
                            (LONG)std::lround(wF - hMf), (LONG)std::lround(hF)
                        };
                        textDrawnViaD2D = DrawWinUiStyledTextDWriteInSession(
                            rg_tvCachedRT, &rcDraw, itemText, -1, s_rgTvPaintFont,
                            foreground.rgb,
                            DT_LEFT | DT_VCENTER | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_END_ELLIPSIS,
                            dpi, foreground.alpha / 255.f);
                    }

                    const HRESULT hrEnd = rg_tvCachedRT->EndDraw();
                    if (hrEnd == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
                        RgReleaseTreePillBrushes();
                        rg_tvCachedRT->Release();
                        rg_tvCachedRT = nullptr;
                        textDrawnViaD2D = false;
                    }
                }
            }

            // ---- GDI phase: icon + text fallback ----

            // Icon
            if (himl) {
                const bool sel = (tvi.state & TVIS_SELECTED) != 0;
                int idx = (sel && tvi.iSelectedImage >= 0) ? tvi.iSelectedImage : tvi.iImage;

                // Monochrome glyphs consume the foreground state without
                // rebuilding the native image list. Keep its icons as fallback.
                bool drewGlyphIcon = false;
                if (g_settings.RgGlyphIcons) {
                    const wchar_t* glyph = hItem == TreeView_GetRoot(tv)
                        ? GLYPH_THISPC : GLYPH_FOLDER;
                    const COLORREF base = sel ? GetAccentFillDefault(dark)
                        : (dark ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(25, 26, 26));
                    const WinUI::Color glyphForeground = NavigationItemForegroundColor(
                        dark, g_settings.NeutralSelection, base, pressed);
                    const RECT cell = {iconX, iconY, iconX + iconW, iconY + iconH};
                    const int size = (std::max)(1, iconW * 8 / 10);
                    drewGlyphIcon = DrawChevronGlyphCached(hdc, cell, glyph,
                        0.f, size, dark, pressed, &glyphForeground);
                    if (!drewGlyphIcon) {
                        drewGlyphIcon = DrawGlyphDWAlpha(hdc, cell, D2D1::ColorF(
                            GetRValue(glyphForeground.rgb) / 255.f,
                            GetGValue(glyphForeground.rgb) / 255.f,
                            GetBValue(glyphForeground.rgb) / 255.f,
                            glyphForeground.alpha / 255.f), glyph, size, 0.f);
                    }
                }
                // The root has no selected-image slot; its existing HICON
                // cache holds the handle and locks it throughout the draw.
                if (!drewGlyphIcon && sel && g_settings.RegeditSection && g_settings.RgGlyphIcons &&
                    hItem == TreeView_GetRoot(tv)) {
                    int glyphCx = iconW, glyphCy = iconH;
                    ImageList_GetIconSize(himl, &glyphCx, &glyphCy);
                    drewGlyphIcon = RgThisPcAccentIconDraw(hdc, iconX, iconY,
                        glyphCx, glyphCy, dark, GetAccentFillDefault(dark));
                }
                if (!drewGlyphIcon && idx >= 0)
                    ImageList_Draw(himl, idx, hdc, iconX, iconY, ILD_TRANSPARENT);
            }

            // Text fallback -- only if the D2D session above couldn't draw it
            // (D2D unavailable, format/brush creation failed, device lost).
            if (!textDrawnViaD2D) {
                const HFONT hFont = reinterpret_cast<HFONT>(SendMessage(tv, WM_GETFONT, 0, 0));
                const HFONT hOld  = hFont ? static_cast<HFONT>(SelectObject(hdc, hFont)) : nullptr;

                SetTextColor(hdc, WinUI::FlattenOver(foreground,
                    dark ? kRgDkTVBk : kRgLtTVBk));
                SetBkMode(hdc, TRANSPARENT);

                const int textLeft = (std::max)(iconXFinal, (int)rcText.left);
                RECT rcDraw = {
                    textLeft, rcFull.top,
                    rcFull.right - MulDiv(kRgTVHMargin, (int)dpi, 96),
                    rcFull.bottom
                };
                g_glowEntry = true;
                DrawTextW(hdc, itemText, -1, &rcDraw,
                    DT_LEFT | DT_VCENTER | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_END_ELLIPSIS);
                g_glowEntry = false;

                if (hOld) SelectObject(hdc, hOld);
            }

            return CDRF_SKIPDEFAULT;
        }
        }
        break;
    }

    case WM_TIMER: {
        // Pill stretch animation timer
        if (wp == kRgPillAnimTimerId) {
            const HWND tvPill = rg_hwndTV.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
            if (!tvPill || !IsWindow(tvPill)) {
                KillTimer(hwnd, kRgPillAnimTimerId);
                RgResetPillAnimationState();
                break;
            }
            DOUBLE elapsed = TimerGetSeconds() - rg_pillAnimStart;
            if (elapsed >= PILL_LISTVIEW_SCALE_DUR) {
                KillTimer(hwnd, kRgPillAnimTimerId);
                RgInvalidatePillItems(tvPill);
                RgResetPillAnimationState();
                return 0;
            }
            RgInvalidatePillItems(tvPill);
            return 0;
        }

        // Menu-theme flush (one-shot, see kRgFlushMenuTimerId)
        if (wp == kRgFlushMenuTimerId) {
            KillTimer(hwnd, kRgFlushMenuTimerId);
            if (rg_FlushMenuThemes) rg_FlushMenuThemes();
            DrawMenuBar(hwnd);
            return 0;
        }

        // Chevron rotation timer
        if (wp != kRgTVAnimTimerId) break;

        const HWND tvTimer = rg_hwndTV.load(std::memory_order_acquire);

        if (!tvTimer || !IsWindow(tvTimer)) {
            KillTimer(hwnd, kRgTVAnimTimerId);
            rg_tvLastTick = 0;
            rg_tvAnims.clear();
            break;
        }

        const DWORD now = GetTickCount();
        rg_tvLastTick = now;

        bool anyMoving = false;
        RECT unionRect = {};
        bool hasRect = false;
        for (auto it = rg_tvAnims.begin(); it != rg_tvAnims.end(); ) {
            auto& anim = it->second;
            if (anim.current == anim.target) {
                it = rg_tvAnims.erase(it);
                continue;
            }
            anim.current = GlyphChevronAngleAt(
                anim.startAngle, anim.target, anim.startTick, now);
            if (anim.current == anim.target)
                anim.startTick = 0;
            if (anim.rect.right > anim.rect.left) {
                if (!hasRect) { unionRect = anim.rect; hasRect = true; }
                else          UnionRect(&unionRect, &unionRect, &anim.rect);
            }
            if (anim.current != anim.target) {
                anyMoving = true;
                ++it;
            } else {
                it = rg_tvAnims.erase(it);
            }
        }

        if (hasRect) {
            InvalidateRect(tvTimer, &unionRect, FALSE);
        } else if (!anyMoving) {
            KillTimer(hwnd, kRgTVAnimTimerId);
            rg_tvLastTick = 0;
        }
        // else: something is still moving but none of the tracked anims have
        // a resolvable rect yet (e.g. the tick right after TVN_ITEMEXPANDING,
        // before NM_CUSTOMDRAW has painted the item once and populated
        // anim.rect) -- skip invalidating this frame rather than falling
        // back to the whole HWND. The numeric state above already advanced,
        // so the next tick redraws correctly once the item's own paint
        // catches up.
        return 0;
    }

    case WM_NCDESTROY:
        KillTimer(hwnd, kRgTVAnimTimerId);
        KillTimer(hwnd, kRgPillAnimTimerId);
        KillTimer(hwnd, kRgFlushMenuTimerId);
        rg_tvAnims.clear();
        rg_tvLastTick = 0;
        RgResetPillAnimationState();
        RgDividerResetTrackingThreadSafe();
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, RgMainSubclassProc);
        rg_hwndMain.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
        rg_hwndTV.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
        rg_hwndLV.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
        rg_hwndHdr.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
        rg_hwndSearch.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
        break;
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Subclass: SysTreeView32 (regedit)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The tree keeps its client edge: without it SysTreeView32 leaves stale
// pixels along its right side when the splitter resizes it (reproduced
// natively by removing the edge). The edge ring is painted over in the
// tree's own background instead, black where a backdrop shows through.
static void RgPaintTreeEdge(HWND hwnd)
{
    RECT wr, cr;
    if (!rg_tvBkBrush || !GetWindowRect(hwnd, &wr) || !GetClientRect(hwnd, &cr))
        return;
    MapWindowPoints(hwnd, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(&cr), 2);
    const int edgeX = cr.left - wr.left;
    const int edgeY = cr.top - wr.top;
    if (edgeX <= 0 && edgeY <= 0)
        return;
    const int w = wr.right - wr.left;
    const int h = wr.bottom - wr.top;
    HDC dc = GetWindowDC(hwnd);
    if (!dc)
        return;
    ExcludeClipRect(dc, edgeX, edgeY, w - edgeX, h - edgeY);
    const RECT outer = { 0, 0, w, h };
    FillRect_orig(dc, &outer, rg_tvBkBrush);
    ReleaseDC(hwnd, dc);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK RgTVSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR /*dwRefData*/)
{
    if (const UINT resetMsg =
            g_navHoverFadeResetMessage.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        resetMsg && msg == resetMsg) {
        TreePressedHoldReset(hwnd, false);
        return 0;
    }

    switch (msg) {
    // Native first: DefWindowProc paints the scrollbars here too.
    case WM_NCPAINT: {
        const LRESULT res = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        RgPaintTreeEdge(hwnd);
        return res;
    }

    case WM_ERASEBKGND:
        if (rg_tvBkBrush) {
            RECT rc;
            GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc);
            FillRect_orig(reinterpret_cast<HDC>(wp), &rc, rg_tvBkBrush);
            return 1;
        }
        break;

    case WM_SIZE:
        // FALSE = don't erase. WM_ERASEBKGND handler fills bg separately.
        // TRUE caused full-treeview erase on every resize → visible flicker.
        InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        TreePressedHoldReset(hwnd, false);
        if (rg_hoverFade.fadingOut)
            RgHoverFadeClear(hwnd, false);
        {
            const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
            RgHoverFadeSyncCursor(hwnd, false);
            return result;
        }

    // Horizontal scroll: the TreeView uses ScrollWindowEx (BitBlt) to shift
    // existing pixels, then only repaints the newly exposed strip. Custom-drawn
    // content gets BitBlt'd to stale positions. Force a full immediate repaint
    // after every horizontal scroll to redraw all items at correct coordinates.
    case WM_HSCROLL: {
        const LRESULT res = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        TreePressedHoldCancelVisible(hwnd, true);
        if (rg_hoverFade.fadingOut)
            RgHoverFadeClear(hwnd, false);
        // RDW_ERASE removed: causes visible flash. TVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER
        // handles the double-buffered repaint; RDW_INVALIDATE is sufficient.
        RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
            RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_UPDATENOW);
        RgHoverFadeSyncCursor(hwnd, false);
        return res;
    }

    // TreeView may move already-painted pixels while scrolling or changing
    // its hierarchy. Only while a fade-out exists, erase both its old and
    // post-layout bounds so a partial frame cannot remain copied on screen.
    case TVM_EXPAND:
    case TVM_ENSUREVISIBLE:
    case WM_VSCROLL:
    case WM_MOUSEWHEEL:
    case WM_MOUSEHWHEEL:
    case WM_KEYDOWN:
        if (rg_hoverFade.hotItem ||
            (s_treePressedHoldState.hwnd == hwnd &&
             s_treePressedHoldState.holding)) {
            const LRESULT res = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
            TreePressedHoldCancelVisible(hwnd, true);
            RgHoverFadeClearAfterGeometryChange(hwnd);
            RgHoverFadeSyncCursor(hwnd, false);
            return res;
        }
        break;

    case WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGING: {
        auto* pos = reinterpret_cast<WINDOWPOS*>(lp);
        const bool moving = !(pos->flags & SWP_NOMOVE);
        const bool sizing = !(pos->flags & SWP_NOSIZE);
        if (moving || sizing) {
            const int sb = rg_searchBarBottom.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
            if (sb > 0) {
                const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(GetParent(hwnd));
                const int  gp  = MulDiv(kRgSearchBarGap, (int)dpi, 96);
                const int  top = sb + gp;
                if (moving && sizing) {
                    const int bot = pos->y + pos->cy;
                    pos->y  = top;
                    pos->cy = (bot > top) ? (bot - top) : 0;
                } else if (moving) {
                    pos->y = top;
                }
            }
        }
        break;
    }

    // Hover fade: see RgHoverFade* above. Falls through to DefSubclassProc
    // in every case below (never consumed) so the tree's own mouse handling
    // (drag, tooltips) is unaffected.
    case WM_LBUTTONDOWN:
    case WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK:
        TreePressedHoldBegin(hwnd, lp);
        {
            const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
            RgHoverFadeSyncCursor(hwnd, true);
            return result;
        }

    case WM_LBUTTONUP: {
        const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        TreePressedHoldCommit(hwnd, lp);
        RgHoverFadeSyncCursor(hwnd, true);
        return result;
    }

    case WM_MOUSEMOVE:
        RgHoverFadeHandleMouseMove(hwnd, lp);
        break;

    case WM_MOUSELEAVE:
        rg_hoverFade.trackingLeave = false;
        RgHoverFadeRetarget(hwnd, nullptr);
        break;

    case WM_TIMER:
        if (wp == kRgHoverFadeTimerId) {
            RgHoverFadeTimerTick(hwnd);
            return 0;
        }
        if (wp == TreePressedHoldTimerId()) {
            TreePressedHoldTimerTick(hwnd);
            return 0;
        }
        break;

    case WM_CANCELMODE:
    case WM_KILLFOCUS:
        TreePressedHoldReset(hwnd, true);
        break;

    case WM_CAPTURECHANGED: {
        if (lp != 0)
            TreePressedHoldReset(hwnd, true);
        const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        RgHoverFadeSyncCursor(hwnd, true);
        return result;
    }

    case WM_NCDESTROY:
        TreePressedHoldReset(hwnd, false);
        RgHoverFadeClear(hwnd, false);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, RgTVSubclassProc);
        rg_hwndTV.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
        break;
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Subclass: SysListView32 (regedit)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
static LRESULT CALLBACK RgLVSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR /*dwRefData*/)
{
    switch (msg) {
    case WM_SIZE:
        RgUpdateListViewRegion(hwnd);
        break;

    // The card stroke lives in the parent's pixels, outside the list: clear
    // it at the old bounds and draw it at the new ones.
    case WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGED:
        {
            const auto* pos = reinterpret_cast<const WINDOWPOS*>(lp);
            const HWND parent = GetParent(hwnd);
            if (parent && pos &&
                (pos->flags & (SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE)) != (SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE)) {
                static RECT s_lastRect = {};
                if (!IsRectEmpty(&s_lastRect))
                    RgInvalidateCardStroke(parent, s_lastRect);
                RECT now;
                if (GetWindowRect(hwnd, &now)) {
                    MapWindowPoints(nullptr, parent, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(&now), 2);
                    RgInvalidateCardStroke(parent, now);
                    s_lastRect = now;
                }
            }
        }
        break;

    case WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGING: {
        auto* pos = reinterpret_cast<WINDOWPOS*>(lp);
        const bool moving = !(pos->flags & SWP_NOMOVE);
        const bool sizing = !(pos->flags & SWP_NOSIZE);
        if (moving || sizing) {
            const int sb = rg_searchBarBottom.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
            if (sb > 0) {
                const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(GetParent(hwnd));
                const int  gp  = MulDiv(kRgSearchBarGap, (int)dpi, 96);
                const int  top = sb + gp;
                if (moving && sizing) {
                    const int bot = pos->y + pos->cy;
                    pos->y  = top;
                    pos->cy = (bot > top) ? (bot - top) : 0;
                } else if (moving) {
                    pos->y = top;
                }
            }
        }
        break;
    }

    case WM_NCDESTROY:
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, RgLVSubclassProc);
        rg_hwndLV.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
        break;
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Subclass: SysHeader32 (regedit) -- full custom WM_PAINT
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
static LRESULT CALLBACK RgHdrSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR /*dwRefData*/)
{
    switch (msg) {
    case WM_PAINT: {
        const bool dark = RgIsDarkMode();
        if (!RgMicaActive() && !RgHeaderBrush(dark))
            break;  // brush creation failed: default paint

        PAINTSTRUCT ps;
        HDC hdc = BeginPaint(hwnd, &ps);

        RECT rcClient;
        GetClientRect(hwnd, &rcClient);
        const int micaLineW = RgMicaStrokeWidth(GetDpiForWindow(hwnd));
        RgPaintHeaderStrip(hdc, rcClient, dark, micaLineW);

        const int   n     = Header_GetItemCount(hwnd);
        const HFONT hFont = reinterpret_cast<HFONT>(
                                SendMessage(hwnd, WM_GETFONT, 0, 0));
        const HFONT hOld  = hFont
            ? static_cast<HFONT>(SelectObject(hdc, hFont)) : nullptr;
        SetTextColor(hdc, dark ? kRgDkHdrText : kRgLtHdrText);
        SetBkMode(hdc, TRANSPARENT);

        const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);
        const int leftMargin  = MulDiv(8, (int)dpi, 96);
        const int rightMargin = MulDiv(4, (int)dpi, 96);

        // Native Header_Paint draws a 1px divider per item; skipping
        // WM_PAINT entirely drops it, so redraw it ourselves with the same
        // rule as the header's bottom edge.

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            RECT rcItem;
            if (!Header_GetItemRect(hwnd, i, &rcItem)) continue;
            wchar_t buf[256] = {};
            HDITEMW hdi = {};
            hdi.mask       = HDI_TEXT;
            hdi.pszText    = buf;
            hdi.cchTextMax = 256;
            Header_GetItem(hwnd, i, &hdi);
            RECT rcText = { rcItem.left + leftMargin, rcItem.top,
                            rcItem.right - rightMargin, rcItem.bottom };
            const UINT hdrDtFlags = DT_LEFT | DT_VCENTER | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_END_ELLIPSIS;
            bool drawnViaD2D = false;
            if (hFont) {
                LOGFONTW lf = {};
                if (GetObjectW(hFont, sizeof(lf), &lf)) {
                    wcsncpy_s(lf.lfFaceName, L"Segoe UI Variable Text", _TRUNCATE);
                    drawnViaD2D = DrawWinUiStyledTextDWrite(hdc, &rcText, buf, -1, lf,
                        dark ? kRgDkHdrText : kRgLtHdrText, hdrDtFlags);
                }
            }
            if (!drawnViaD2D) {
                g_glowEntry = true;
                DrawTextW(hdc, buf, -1, &rcText, hdrDtFlags);
                g_glowEntry = false;
            }
            // One line width further in on dark, where the edge column
            // reads as sitting past the item boundary.
            const int dividerRight = rcItem.right - (dark ? micaLineW : 0);
            const RECT divider = { dividerRight - micaLineW, rcClient.top,
                dividerRight, rcClient.bottom - micaLineW };
            if (divider.bottom > divider.top)
                RgWriteHeaderRule(hdc, divider, dark);
        }

        if (hOld) SelectObject(hdc, hOld);
        EndPaint(hwnd, &ps);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_NCDESTROY:
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, RgHdrSubclassProc);
        rg_hwndHdr.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
        break;
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Subclass: address bar Edit (regedit)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
static LRESULT CALLBACK RgSearchSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR /*dwRefData*/)
{
    auto redrawOverlayAfterDefault = [&]() -> LRESULT {
        const LRESULT res = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        RgDrawSearchOverlay(hwnd);
        return res;
    };

    switch (msg) {
    case WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGING: {
        auto* pos = reinterpret_cast<WINDOWPOS*>(lp);
        const bool moving = !(pos->flags & SWP_NOMOVE);
        const bool sizing = !(pos->flags & SWP_NOSIZE);
        if (moving || sizing) {
            const HWND parent = GetParent(hwnd);
            if (parent) {
                RECT rp;
                GetClientRect(parent, &rp);
                if (rp.right > 0) {
                    int newX, newW, newH;
                    RgComputeSearchGeometry(hwnd, rp.right, &newX, &newW, &newH);
                    rg_searchVisibleH.store(newH, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                    // Extra invisible height below the visible pill -- see
                    // kRgSearchTextNudge -- so the actual (taller) window
                    // still reports newH as pos->cy's logical row height.
                    const int extra = 2 * MulDiv(kRgSearchTextNudge, (int)GetDpiForWindow(hwnd), 96);
                    // Center vertically: shift Y down by half the height
                    // difference between the row the parent intended and our
                    // reduced height. pos->cy holds the parent's intended height
                    // (before we override it).
                    if (sizing && moving) {
                        const int rowH = pos->cy;
                        if (rowH > newH)
                            pos->y += (rowH - newH) / 2;
                        pos->cx = newW;
                        pos->cy = newH + extra;
                    } else if (sizing) {
                        pos->cx = newW;
                        pos->cy = newH + extra;
                    }
                    if (moving) { pos->x = newX; }
                }
            }
        }
        break;
    }

    case WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGED:
        RgUpdateSearchRegion(hwnd);
        break;

    case WM_ERASEBKGND:
        // WM_PAINT fills the background off-screen with everything else.
        if (RgSearchBrush(RgSearchCurrentState()))
            return 1;
        break;

    case WM_PAINT: {
        // wp is a DC only for WM_PAINT sent by another app's print path.
        if (!wp && RgPaintSearchBuffered(hwnd))
            return 0;
        const LRESULT res = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        RgDrawSearchOverlay(hwnd);
        return res;
    }

    case EM_SETSEL:
    case WM_SETTEXT:
    case WM_KEYDOWN:
    case WM_KEYUP:
    case WM_CHAR:
    case WM_LBUTTONDOWN:
    case WM_LBUTTONUP:
        return redrawOverlayAfterDefault();

    case WM_MOUSEMOVE:
        // PointerOver: the fill changes (ControlFillColorSecondary).
        if (!rg_searchHot.exchange(true, std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
            TRACKMOUSEEVENT track = { sizeof(track), TME_LEAVE, hwnd, 0 };
            TrackMouseEvent(&track);
            InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
        }
        if (wp & MK_LBUTTON)
            return redrawOverlayAfterDefault();
        break;

    case WM_MOUSELEAVE:
        rg_searchHot.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
        break;

    // The fill differs per state, so the whole background repaints.
    case WM_SETFOCUS:
        rg_searchFocused.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
        break;

    case WM_KILLFOCUS:
        rg_searchFocused.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
        break;

    case WM_NCDESTROY:
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, RgSearchSubclassProc);
        rg_hwndSearch.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
        rg_searchHot.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        break;
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Style helpers (regedit)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The edge bits RgRemoveBorderStyles took off a window, for RgUninit:
// the extended-style bits it removed, plus kRgRemovedWsBorder for WS_BORDER.
static constexpr wchar_t kPropRgRemovedBorders[] = L"Win32UIModernizer.RgRemovedBorders";
static constexpr LONG_PTR kRgRemovedWsBorder = 0x40000000;

static void RgRemoveBorderStyles(HWND hwnd)
{
    // The modern border subclass attached at creation, while the control
    // still had its edge, would keep drawing that border without it.
    ModernBorderUninstall(hwnd);

    const LONG_PTR exStyle = GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE);
    const LONG_PTR newExStyle =
        exStyle & ~(LONG_PTR)(WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE | WS_EX_STATICEDGE | WS_EX_DLGMODALFRAME);
    const LONG_PTR style = GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE);
    const LONG_PTR newStyle = style & ~(LONG_PTR)WS_BORDER;
    if (newExStyle == exStyle && newStyle == style)
        return;

    const LONG_PTR removed = (exStyle & ~newExStyle) |
        ((style & WS_BORDER) ? kRgRemovedWsBorder : 0);
    const LONG_PTR alreadyRemoved = reinterpret_cast<LONG_PTR>(
        GetPropW(hwnd, kPropRgRemovedBorders));
    SetPropW(hwnd, kPropRgRemovedBorders,
             reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(alreadyRemoved | removed));
    SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE, newExStyle);
    SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE, newStyle);
    SetWindowPos(hwnd, nullptr, 0, 0, 0, 0,
        SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_FRAMECHANGED);
    RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
        RDW_FRAME | RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_NOERASE | RDW_NOCHILDREN);
}

static void RgRestoreBorderStyles(HWND hwnd)
{
    const LONG_PTR removed = reinterpret_cast<LONG_PTR>(
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropRgRemovedBorders));
    if (!removed)
        return;
    const LONG_PTR exBits = removed & ~kRgRemovedWsBorder;
    if (exBits) {
        SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE,
                          GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE) | exBits);
    }
    if (removed & kRgRemovedWsBorder) {
        SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE,
                          GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE) | WS_BORDER);
    }
    SetWindowPos(hwnd, nullptr, 0, 0, 0, 0,
        SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_FRAMECHANGED);
}

static void RgApplyMainStyle(HWND hwnd)
{
    const bool dark = RgIsDarkMode();

    BOOL darkAttr = dark ? TRUE : FALSE;
    DwmSetWindowAttribute(hwnd, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE, &darkAttr, sizeof(darkAttr));

    if (dark) {
        COLORREF borderClr = RGB(32, 32, 32);
        DwmSetWindowAttribute(hwnd, 34 /*DWMWA_BORDER_COLOR*/, &borderClr, sizeof(borderClr));
    }

    if (dark && g_cbdAllowDark) g_cbdAllowDark(hwnd, true);

    if (dark && rg_SetPreferredAppMode) {
        rg_SetPreferredAppMode(2);
        SetTimer(hwnd, kRgFlushMenuTimerId, 1, nullptr);
    }

    if (dark) SetWindowTheme(hwnd, L"DarkMode_Explorer", nullptr);

    RgApplyBackdrop(hwnd, g_settings.RgMicaBackdrop);

    // Force NC area redraw so the menu bar picks up the dark theme immediately
    SetWindowPos(hwnd, nullptr, 0, 0, 0, 0,
        SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_FRAMECHANGED);

    WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, RgMainSubclassProc, 0);
}

// Defined later in the file, alongside their Explorer-context call sites.
static void TreeRuntimeSaveAndSetStyleBit(
    HWND hwnd, const wchar_t* prop, LONG bit, bool enabled);
static void TreeRuntimeRestoreStyleBit(HWND hwnd, const wchar_t* prop, LONG bit);

static void RgApplyTreeViewStyle(HWND hwnd)
{
    // Keeps its client edge (see RgPaintTreeEdge); the modern border drawn
    // for that edge would show instead.
    ModernBorderUninstall(hwnd);
    WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, RgTVSubclassProc, 0);

    const bool dark = RgIsDarkMode();

    // DarkMode_Explorer makes scrollbars dark. Safe because CDRF_SKIPDEFAULT
    // overrides all item painting — the theme only affects scrollbars/NC area.
    if (dark) {
        const bool themeChanged = !IsKnownWindowThemeApplied(hwnd, L"DarkMode_Explorer", nullptr);
        SetWindowTheme(hwnd, L"DarkMode_Explorer", nullptr);
        if (themeChanged) {
            SendMessage(hwnd, WM_THEMECHANGED, 0, 0);
            // Force immediate NC repaint so the gripper/scrollbar picks up
            // the dark theme before the first visible frame
            RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
                RDW_FRAME | RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_UPDATENOW);
        }
    }

    // Background color for empty areas below the last item
    COLORREF tvBk = g_settings.RgMicaBackdrop
        ? RGB(0,0,0) : (dark ? kRgDkTVBk : kRgLtTVBk);
    TreeView_SetBkColor(hwnd, tvBk);
    TreeView_SetTextColor(hwnd, dark ? kRgDkTVText : kRgLtTVText);

    // Double-buffer eliminates horizontal scroll artifacts
    TreeView_SetExtendedStyle(hwnd, TVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER, TVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER);

    // TVS_FULLROWSELECT (matching the ListView's LVS_EX_FULLROWSELECT above)
    // has no effect at all while TVS_HASLINES is set -- comctl32's own
    // TREEVIEW_IsFullRowSelect requires both -- so without clearing it here
    // our background tint paints the full row (see RgMainSubclassProc's
    // NM_CUSTOMDRAW) but only the icon/label was actually clickable/
    // selectable. Clearing TVS_HASLINES draws no native connector lines here
    // regardless, since CDRF_SKIPDEFAULT already makes TREEVIEW_DrawItem
    // return before it would ever call TREEVIEW_DrawItemLines. Unlike the
    // other one-way TVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER-style paint tweaks in this file,
    // this one DOES change visible native behavior once our own subclass
    // (which is what actually overrides the rendering) is gone -- native
    // full-row-select highlighting and missing connector lines would show
    // up if RegeditSection is toggled off live without restarting
    // regedit.exe -- so it's saved/restored the same way Explorer-context
    // trees already do via TreeRuntimeSaveAndSetStyleBit, restored in
    // RgUninit alongside this function's other TreeView_Set* reversals.
    TreeRuntimeSaveAndSetStyleBit(hwnd, PROP_RG_TV_HASLINES_ORIG, TVS_HASLINES, false);
    TreeRuntimeSaveAndSetStyleBit(hwnd, PROP_RG_TV_FULLROWSELECT_ORIG, TVS_FULLROWSELECT, true);

    const UINT dpi   = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);
    const int  itemH = MulDiv(kRgTVItemHeightBase, (int)dpi, 96);
    TreeView_SetItemHeight(hwnd, itemH);
}

static void RgApplyListViewStyle(HWND hwnd)
{
    const bool dark = RgIsDarkMode();
    RgRemoveBorderStyles(hwnd);

    const COLORREF bk = RgListBackground(dark);
    ListView_SetBkColor(hwnd, bk);
    ListView_SetTextBkColor(hwnd, bk);
    ListView_SetTextColor(hwnd, dark ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0));

    // Both modes need SetWindowTheme to get properly themed selection highlights
    // and scrollbars. Without it, light mode gets a simplified/classic look.
    const wchar_t* theme = dark ? L"DarkMode_Explorer" : L"Explorer";
    const bool themeChanged = !IsKnownWindowThemeApplied(hwnd, theme, nullptr);
    SetWindowTheme(hwnd, theme, nullptr);
    if (themeChanged)
        SendMessage(hwnd, WM_THEMECHANGED, 0, 0);

    ListView_SetExtendedListViewStyleEx(hwnd,
        LVS_EX_FULLROWSELECT | LVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER,
        LVS_EX_FULLROWSELECT | LVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER);

    WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, RgLVSubclassProc, 0);
    RgUpdateListViewRegion(hwnd);
}

static void RgApplyHeaderStyle(HWND hwnd)
{
    WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, RgHdrSubclassProc, 0);
    RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr, RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_UPDATENOW);
}

static void RgApplySearchStyle(HWND hwndMain, HWND hwnd)
{
    RgRemoveBorderStyles(hwnd);

    SetWindowTheme(hwnd, L"", L"");

    const LONG_PTR exStyle = GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE);
    SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE, exStyle | WS_EX_LAYERED);
    SetLayeredWindowAttributes(hwnd, 0, 255, LWA_ALPHA);

    const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);

    if (!rg_searchTextFont) {
        // ControlContentThemeFontSize, the TextBox's 14 px.
        const int fontPx = MulDiv(14, (int)dpi, 96);
        rg_searchTextFont = CreateFontW(
            -fontPx, 0, 0, 0, FW_NORMAL, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE,
            DEFAULT_CHARSET, OUT_DEFAULT_PRECIS, CLIP_DEFAULT_PRECIS,
            CLEARTYPE_QUALITY, DEFAULT_PITCH | FF_DONTCARE,
            L"Segoe UI Variable Text");
    }
    if (rg_searchTextFont)
        SendMessage(hwnd, WM_SETFONT, (WPARAM)rg_searchTextFont, TRUE);

    // EM_SETMARGINS MUST come after WM_SETFONT (which resets internal margins)
    // Left padding reserves room for the magnifying-glass icon drawn by
    // RgDrawSearchOverlay, so typed text starts after it instead of behind it.
    const int leftMargin = MulDiv(
        kRgSearchIconLeftPad + kRgSearchIconSize + kRgSearchIconGap, (int)dpi, 96);
    SendMessage(hwnd, EM_SETMARGINS, EC_LEFTMARGIN, MAKELPARAM(leftMargin, 0));

    WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, RgSearchSubclassProc, 0);
    RgRepositionSearch(hwndMain, hwnd);
    RgUpdateSearchRegion(hwnd);
}

// Forward declaration (needed by callback below)
static bool TryApplyToWindow_Regedit(HWND hwnd);

// Static callback for EnumChildWindows (lambdas don't convert to __stdcall WNDENUMPROC in Clang)
static BOOL CALLBACK RgEnumChildApplyProc(HWND child, LPARAM /*lParam*/)
{
    TryApplyToWindow_Regedit(child);
    return TRUE;
}

// Static callback for EnumWindows in Wh_ModAfterInit (late-attach)
static BOOL CALLBACK RgEnumWindowsAfterInitProc(HWND hwnd, LPARAM /*lParam*/)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId()) return TRUE;

    TryApplyToWindow_Regedit(hwnd);

    const HWND main = rg_hwndMain.load(std::memory_order_acquire);

    if (main && main == hwnd) {
        EnumChildWindows(hwnd, RgEnumChildApplyProc, 0);
        return FALSE;
    }
    return TRUE;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TryApplyToWindow_Regedit — called for every new window in regedit.exe
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
static bool TryApplyToWindow_Regedit(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd)) return false;
    if (rg_unloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return false;

    wchar_t cls[64] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, 64)) return false;

    // Main window detection
    if (wcscmp(cls, L"RegEdit_RegEdit") == 0) {
        bool mine = false;
        { HWND expected = nullptr; mine = rg_hwndMain.compare_exchange_strong(expected, hwnd); }
        if (mine) {
            RgApplyMainStyle(hwnd);
            EnumChildWindows(hwnd, RgEnumChildApplyProc, 0);
            RECT rc;
            GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc);
            PostMessage(hwnd, WM_SIZE, SIZE_RESTORED, MAKELPARAM(rc.right, rc.bottom));
        }
        return true;
    }

    // Children must be inside the main window
    const HWND main = rg_hwndMain.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (!main || !IsChild(main, hwnd)) return false;

    // Toolbar, Rebar, StatusBar: apply dark theme + remove borders/separators.
    // The white line below the menu bar is typically the rebar's top border
    // or the toolbar band separator drawn in light colors.
    if (wcscmp(cls, L"ReBarWindow32") == 0 ||
        wcscmp(cls, L"ToolbarWindow32") == 0 ||
        wcscmp(cls, L"msctls_statusbar32") == 0)
    {
        if (wcscmp(cls, L"ReBarWindow32") == 0) {
            HWND expected = nullptr;
            rg_hwndRebar.compare_exchange_strong(expected, hwnd);
        } else if (wcscmp(cls, L"ToolbarWindow32") == 0) {
            HWND expected = nullptr;
            rg_hwndToolbar.compare_exchange_strong(expected, hwnd);
        } else {
            HWND expected = nullptr;
            rg_hwndStatusbar.compare_exchange_strong(expected, hwnd);
        }

        const bool dark = RgIsDarkMode();
        if (dark) {
            SetWindowTheme(hwnd, L"DarkMode_Explorer", nullptr);
            // CCS_NODIVIDER removes the 1px top divider line (the separator).
            // Also strip WS_BORDER and RBS_BANDBORDERS for rebars. Saved via
            // TreeRuntimeSaveAndSetStyleBit (same helper the TreeView bits
            // below use) so RgUninit can put the original bits back -- a
            // live RegeditSection toggle-off or full mod unload would
            // otherwise leave a border-less/dividerless native control
            // behind permanently.
            TreeRuntimeSaveAndSetStyleBit(hwnd, PROP_RG_REBAR_BORDER_ORIG, WS_BORDER, false);
            TreeRuntimeSaveAndSetStyleBit(hwnd, PROP_RG_REBAR_BANDBORDERS_ORIG, RBS_BANDBORDERS, false);
            TreeRuntimeSaveAndSetStyleBit(hwnd, PROP_RG_REBAR_NODIVIDER_ORIG, CCS_NODIVIDER, true);
            SetWindowPos(hwnd, nullptr, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER |
                SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_FRAMECHANGED);
        }
        return true;
    }

    // TreeView
    if (!rg_hwndTV.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) && wcscmp(cls, L"SysTreeView32") == 0) {
        bool mine = false;
        { HWND expected = nullptr; mine = rg_hwndTV.compare_exchange_strong(expected, hwnd); }
        if (mine) RgApplyTreeViewStyle(hwnd);
        return true;
    }

    // ListView
    if (!rg_hwndLV.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) && wcscmp(cls, L"SysListView32") == 0) {
        bool mine = false;
        { HWND expected = nullptr; mine = rg_hwndLV.compare_exchange_strong(expected, hwnd); }
        if (mine) RgApplyListViewStyle(hwnd);
        return true;
    }

    // Header (child of ListView)
    if (!rg_hwndHdr.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) && wcscmp(cls, L"SysHeader32") == 0) {
        const HWND lv = rg_hwndLV.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (lv && GetParent(hwnd) == lv) {
            bool mine = false;
            { HWND expected = nullptr; mine = rg_hwndHdr.compare_exchange_strong(expected, hwnd); }
            if (mine) RgApplyHeaderStyle(hwnd);
            return true;
        }
    }

    // Search bar (Edit not inside a ComboBox)
    if (!rg_hwndSearch.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) && wcscmp(cls, L"Edit") == 0) {
        const HWND parent = GetParent(hwnd);
        wchar_t parentCls[64] = {};
        if (parent) GetClassNameW(parent, parentCls, 64);
        const bool inCombo =
            _wcsicmp(parentCls, L"ComboBox")     == 0 ||
            _wcsicmp(parentCls, L"ComboBoxEx32") == 0;
        if (!inCombo) {
            bool mine = false;
            { HWND expected = nullptr; mine = rg_hwndSearch.compare_exchange_strong(expected, hwnd); }
            if (mine) RgApplySearchStyle(main, hwnd);
            return true;
        }
    }

    // Dialogs (Find, Permissions, Select Computer, Import/Export/Load Hive
    // file pickers, etc.) are owned by `main`, not true children of it, so
    // IsChild(main, hwnd) above already routed them to `return false` before
    // reaching here -- they never hit this function at all. Their dark
    // titlebar comes from ApplyPropertyDialogDarkMode's own, unconditional #32770
    // handling elsewhere in the file, not from RegeditSection.

    return false;
}

static HRESULT WINAPI RgSHDefExtractIconW_Hook(PCWSTR pszIconFile, int iIndex,
                                               UINT uFlags, HICON* phiconLarge,
                                               HICON* phiconSmall,
                                               UINT nIconSize)
{
    UINT id = 0;
    if (RgGlyphIconShouldReplace(pszIconFile, iIndex, &id)) {
        // nIconSize packs the large-icon size in the low word, small-icon
        // size in the high word -- each output is baked at its own
        // requested size, not a single shared one.
        const int cx = LOWORD(nIconSize);
        const int cy = HIWORD(nIconSize);
        const int largeSize = std::clamp(cx > 0 ? cx : 16, 8, 256);
        const int smallSize = std::clamp(cy > 0 ? cy : (cx > 0 ? cx : 16), 8, 256);
        const bool dark = RgIsDarkMode();
        // GetAccentFromPalette(dark ? ...) directly, not GetAccentIndicator()
        // -- see the matching comment in RgDrawSearchOverlay.
        const COLORREF accent = GetAccentFillDefault(dark);

        // Only build the outputs the caller actually asked for. If either
        // requested output fails to build, fall through to the real API for
        // both rather than handing back a half-substituted pair. Index 4 is
        // the folder/key iSelectedImage slot -- accent-colored, matching the
        // nav pane's own selected-item convention (see RgGlyphIconGetForLoad).
        const bool useAccent = (id == 4);
        HICON large = phiconLarge ? RgGlyphIconGetForLoad(id, largeSize, dark, accent, useAccent) : nullptr;
        HICON small = phiconSmall ? RgGlyphIconGetForLoad(id, smallSize, dark, accent, useAccent) : nullptr;
        if (!(phiconLarge && !large) && !(phiconSmall && !small)) {
            if (phiconLarge) *phiconLarge = large;
            if (phiconSmall) *phiconSmall = small;
            return S_OK;
        }
        if (large) DestroyIcon(large);
        if (small) DestroyIcon(small);
    }
    return rg_SHDefExtractIconW_orig(pszIconFile, iIndex, uFlags, phiconLarge,
                                     phiconSmall, nIconSize);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Regedit: init GDI + uxtheme resources
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
static void RgInitResources()
{
    // Initial creation can run outside the Regedit UI thread, but there are no
    // old handles to race at that point. Later theme/settings replacements are
    // posted to RgMainSubclassProc and happen on the owning UI thread.
    if (!rg_lvBkBrush)
        RgRefreshColorResources();

    // Uxtheme dark mode APIs
    if (!rg_hUxtheme)
        rg_hUxtheme = LoadLibraryExW(L"uxtheme.dll", nullptr, LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32);
    if (rg_hUxtheme) {
        rg_SetPreferredAppMode = (RgSetPreferredAppMode_T)GetProcAddress(rg_hUxtheme, MAKEINTRESOURCEA(135));
        rg_FlushMenuThemes     = (RgFlushMenuThemes_T)GetProcAddress(rg_hUxtheme, MAKEINTRESOURCEA(136));
    }
}

static bool RgQueueRequiredHooks(bool* anyQueued = nullptr)
{
    bool queued = false;
    bool success = true;

    if (!rg_SetMenuInfo_orig) {
        if (WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(
                SetMenuInfo, RgSetMenuInfo_Hook, &rg_SetMenuInfo_orig)) {
            queued = true;
        } else {
            Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook SetMenuInfo for RegeditSection");
            success = false;
        }
    }
    if (!rg_PatBlt_orig) {
        if (WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(
                PatBlt, RgPatBlt_Hook, &rg_PatBlt_orig)) {
            queued = true;
        } else {
            Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook PatBlt for RegeditSection");
            success = false;
        }
    }
    if (!rg_ReleaseCapture_orig) {
        if (WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(
                ReleaseCapture, RgReleaseCapture_Hook,
                &rg_ReleaseCapture_orig)) {
            queued = true;
        } else {
            Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook ReleaseCapture for RegeditSection");
            success = false;
        }
    }
    if (!rg_SHDefExtractIconW_orig) {
        // Not a static import -- shell32.dll's export table is resolved by
        // hand, same as rg_SetPreferredAppMode above. regedit.exe uses other
        // shell32 APIs (common file-picker dialogs) well before it builds its
        // TreeView icons, so shell32.dll is already loaded by this point.
        HMODULE shell32 = GetModuleHandleW(L"shell32.dll");
        RgSHDefExtractIconW_t shDefExtractIconW = shell32
            ? reinterpret_cast<RgSHDefExtractIconW_t>(
                  GetProcAddress(shell32, "SHDefExtractIconW"))
            : nullptr;
        if (shDefExtractIconW &&
            WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(shDefExtractIconW,
                                           RgSHDefExtractIconW_Hook,
                                           &rg_SHDefExtractIconW_orig)) {
            queued = true;
        } else {
            Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook SHDefExtractIconW for RegeditSection");
            success = false;
        }
    }

    if (anyQueued)
        *anyQueued = queued;
    return success;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Regedit: uninit — cleanup all resources and subclasses
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Pure teardown -- does NOT touch rg_unloading. Wh_ModUninit sets that flag
// itself (first thing, before its blocking waits) since this same function
// is also reused by Wh_ModSettingsChanged for a live RegeditSection toggle-
// off, which must NOT permanently latch rg_unloading (a later toggle-on
// needs TryApplyToWindow_Regedit to work again without restarting regedit).
//
// fullUnload=true (Wh_ModUninit, mod/DLL about to unload): also frees the
// GDI/D2D/uxtheme resources.
// fullUnload=false (Wh_ModSettingsChanged, RegeditSection toggled off while
// regedit keeps running): leaves those resources allocated instead of
// deleting them -- rg_searchTextFont/the brushes are read from paint
// handlers on regedit's own UI thread, and Wh_ModSettingsChanged's thread
// isn't guaranteed to be that same thread, so deleting a GDI handle here
// could race an in-flight paint. They're a small, fixed set reused as-is
// if the setting is turned back on, and only ever actually freed once, at
// real mod unload, same as every other subsystem's teardown-vs-live-paint
// exposure in this file.
static void RgUninit(bool fullUnload)
{
    const HWND main   = rg_hwndMain.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    const HWND tv     = rg_hwndTV.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    const HWND lv     = rg_hwndLV.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    const HWND hdr    = rg_hwndHdr.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    const HWND search = rg_hwndSearch.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    const HWND rebar     = rg_hwndRebar.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    const HWND toolbar   = rg_hwndToolbar.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    const HWND statusbar = rg_hwndStatusbar.load(std::memory_order_acquire);

    if (main && IsWindow(main)) {
        const UINT resetDividerMsg =
            g_rgResetDividerMessage.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        DWORD_PTR resetIgnored = 0;
        if (!resetDividerMsg ||
            !SendMessageTimeoutW(main, resetDividerMsg, 0, 0,
                SMTO_ABORTIFHUNG | SMTO_BLOCK, 200, &resetIgnored)) {
            RgDividerResetTrackingThreadSafe();
        }
    } else {
        RgDividerResetTrackingThreadSafe();
    }

    if (search) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(search, RgSearchSubclassProc);
        if (IsWindow(search)) {
            SetWindowRgn(search, nullptr, TRUE);
            const LONG_PTR ex = GetWindowLongPtrW(search, GWL_EXSTYLE);
            SetWindowLongPtrW(search, GWL_EXSTYLE, ex & ~(LONG_PTR)WS_EX_LAYERED);
            RgRestoreBorderStyles(search);
        }
    }
    if (hdr)  WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hdr, RgHdrSubclassProc);
    // Rebar/Toolbar/StatusBar: put back whatever TryApplyToWindow_Regedit's
    // border/divider bits and theme replaced, same reversibility rationale
    // as the TreeView bits below.
    for (HWND chrome : { rebar, toolbar, statusbar }) {
        if (chrome && IsWindow(chrome)) {
            TreeRuntimeRestoreStyleBit(chrome, PROP_RG_REBAR_BORDER_ORIG, WS_BORDER);
            TreeRuntimeRestoreStyleBit(chrome, PROP_RG_REBAR_BANDBORDERS_ORIG, RBS_BANDBORDERS);
            TreeRuntimeRestoreStyleBit(chrome, PROP_RG_REBAR_NODIVIDER_ORIG, CCS_NODIVIDER);
            SetWindowTheme(chrome, nullptr, nullptr);
            SetWindowPos(chrome, nullptr, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER |
                SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_FRAMECHANGED);
        }
    }
    if (lv) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(lv, RgLVSubclassProc);
        if (IsWindow(lv)) {
            SetWindowRgn(lv, nullptr, TRUE);
            SetWindowTheme(lv, nullptr, nullptr);
            DWORD_PTR lvIgnored = 0;
            SendMessageTimeoutW(lv, WM_THEMECHANGED, 0, 0,
                SMTO_ABORTIFHUNG | SMTO_BLOCK, 200, &lvIgnored);
            ListView_SetExtendedListViewStyleEx(lv,
                LVS_EX_FULLROWSELECT | LVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER, 0);
            ListView_SetBkColor(lv, CLR_DEFAULT);
            ListView_SetTextBkColor(lv, CLR_DEFAULT);
            ListView_SetTextColor(lv, CLR_DEFAULT);
            RgRestoreBorderStyles(lv);
            InvalidateRect(lv, nullptr, TRUE);
        }
    }
    if (tv) {
        // kRgHoverFadeTimerId lives on tv itself (WM_MOUSEMOVE-driven), unlike
        // the three timers below which live on main.
        KillTimer(tv, kRgHoverFadeTimerId);
        if (const UINT resetMsg =
                g_navHoverFadeResetMessage.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
            (void)SendMessageW(tv, resetMsg, 0, 0);
        } else {
            (void)SendMessageW(tv, WM_CANCELMODE, 0, 0);
        }
        rg_hoverFade = NavHoverFadeState{};
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(tv, RgTVSubclassProc);
        if (IsWindow(tv)) {
            TreeView_SetItemHeight(tv, -1);
            TreeView_SetBkColor(tv, (COLORREF)-1);    // CLR_DEFAULT
            TreeView_SetTextColor(tv, (COLORREF)-1);
            TreeView_SetExtendedStyle(tv, TVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER, 0);
            TreeRuntimeRestoreStyleBit(tv, PROP_RG_TV_HASLINES_ORIG, TVS_HASLINES);
            TreeRuntimeRestoreStyleBit(tv, PROP_RG_TV_FULLROWSELECT_ORIG, TVS_FULLROWSELECT);
            SetWindowTheme(tv, nullptr, nullptr);
        }
    }
    if (main) {
        KillTimer(main, kRgTVAnimTimerId);
        KillTimer(main, kRgPillAnimTimerId);
        KillTimer(main, kRgFlushMenuTimerId);
        rg_tvLastTick = 0;
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(main, RgMainSubclassProc);
        if (IsWindow(main)) {
            RgApplyBackdrop(main, false);
            SetWindowTheme(main, nullptr, nullptr);
            if (g_cbdAllowDark) g_cbdAllowDark(main, false);
        }
    }

    // Restore search font before deleting it (prevents UAF in Edit control)
    if (search && IsWindow(search)) {
        DWORD_PTR searchIgnored = 0;
        SendMessageTimeoutW(search, WM_SETFONT,
            (WPARAM)GetStockObject(DEFAULT_GUI_FONT), FALSE,
            SMTO_ABORTIFHUNG | SMTO_BLOCK, 200, &searchIgnored);
        SendMessageTimeoutW(search, EM_SETMARGINS, EC_LEFTMARGIN, MAKELPARAM(0, 0),
            SMTO_ABORTIFHUNG | SMTO_BLOCK, 200, &searchIgnored);
        SetWindowTheme(search, nullptr, nullptr);
    }

    // Back to what the general dark mode wants (ForceDark while it's on,
    // as its own writer sets outside Explorer), not unconditionally to
    // Default: RegeditSection can go off while the general dark mode stays.
    if (rg_SetPreferredAppMode) {
        if (rg_FlushMenuThemes) rg_FlushMenuThemes();
        rg_SetPreferredAppMode(!fullUnload &&
            g_darkModeActive.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ? 2 : 0);
    }

    rg_tvAnims.clear();
    RgResetPillAnimationState();

    if (fullUnload) {
        // Release GDI resources
        if (rg_searchBkBrush)  { DeleteObject(rg_searchBkBrush);  rg_searchBkBrush  = nullptr; }
        if (rg_searchHotBrush) { DeleteObject(rg_searchHotBrush); rg_searchHotBrush = nullptr; }
        if (rg_searchFocusBrush) { DeleteObject(rg_searchFocusBrush); rg_searchFocusBrush = nullptr; }
        if (rg_lvBkBrush)      { DeleteObject(rg_lvBkBrush);      rg_lvBkBrush      = nullptr; }
        if (rg_tvBkBrush)      { DeleteObject(rg_tvBkBrush);      rg_tvBkBrush      = nullptr; }
        if (rg_menuBkBrush)    { DeleteObject(rg_menuBkBrush);    rg_menuBkBrush    = nullptr; }
        if (rg_hdrLtBkBrush)   { DeleteObject(rg_hdrLtBkBrush);   rg_hdrLtBkBrush   = nullptr; }
        if (rg_searchTextFont) { DeleteObject(rg_searchTextFont);  rg_searchTextFont = nullptr; }
        RgDividerFreeBackup(); // PROTOTYPE: divider drag-line pixel backup

        // D2D resources
        RgReleaseTreePillBrushes();
        if (rg_tvCachedRT) { rg_tvCachedRT->Release(); rg_tvCachedRT = nullptr; }
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> gdipLock(rg_gdipMutex);
            RgClearGdipLocked();
        }

        // Free uxtheme handle — check mitigation policy before FreeLibrary
        // (same pattern as dark-mode-context-menus mod)
        if (rg_hUxtheme) {
            PROCESS_MITIGATION_SYSTEM_CALL_DISABLE_POLICY policy{};
            const bool blocked = GetProcessMitigationPolicy(GetCurrentProcess(),
                ProcessSystemCallDisablePolicy, &policy, sizeof(policy))
                && policy.DisallowWin32kSystemCalls != 0;
            if (!blocked) FreeLibrary(rg_hUxtheme);
            rg_hUxtheme = nullptr;
        }
    }

    rg_hwndMain.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
    rg_hwndTV.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
    rg_hwndLV.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
    rg_hwndHdr.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
    rg_hwndSearch.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
    rg_hwndRebar.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
    rg_hwndToolbar.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
    rg_hwndStatusbar.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
}

// ============================================================================
// Window creation hook
// ============================================================================

// ── Dark Mode — SetSysColors approach ────────────────────────────────────────
// Shrunk from the original 30-element palette down to only 5 indices, now
// that GetSysColor_hook/GetSysColorBrush_hook/GetThemeColor_hook/
// DrawThemeBackground(Ex)_hook/the WM_CTLCOLOR* interception in
// SendMessageW_hook already cover everything else in-process, independent
// of the live table. Current entries and related decisions:
//   - COLOR_HIGHLIGHT/COLOR_HOTLIGHT/COLOR_MENUHILIGHT: proven necessary —
//     without them the kernel keeps the light-mode default, which
//     ComboLBox's popup renders as a white hover since it reads the
//     kernel-level color table directly, bypassing every hook above.
//   - COLOR_WINDOW: EXPERIMENT (this branch, active), premise now stale:
//     this was removed to test whether it's redundant once
//     AllowDarkModeForWindowWithParentFallback (uxtheme ordinal 145) was
//     wired in -- that API switches a control to native dark rendering via
//     its own theme data instead of the raw sys-color table, which may
//     already cover most of what this index used to be needed for. Ordinal
//     145 itself has since been removed entirely (it turned out to cause
//     the split-button text bug noted below, and -- separately -- was
//     apparently absent on every Windows build this experiment was actually
//     tested against, only starting to resolve non-null after a later
//     Windows update, so none of that testing exercised the code path this
//     experiment's premise assumed). Whether COLOR_WINDOW is safe to leave
//     out is therefore still an open question, not a settled result of this
//     experiment -- revisit before trusting it further. See
//     ColorWindowTestHarness.cpp: a standalone Win32 app with every common
//     COLOR_WINDOW-backed control (Edit, ListBox, ComboBox, ListView,
//     TreeView, DateTimePicker, MonthCalendar), used to check live which
//     of them still go white without this index so each can be painted
//     manually instead of leaning on the blunt session-global table. Tried
//     removing it twice before this, backed by a WM_ERASEBKGND interception
//     in SendMessageW_hook that recognizes both the (HBRUSH)(COLOR_WINDOW+1)
//     class-registration placeholder AND the real live
//     GetSysColorBrush(COLOR_WINDOW) handle -- both attempts still left
//     several general window backgrounds white. Real-world
//     precedent (the "Fix white flashes in explorer" Windhawk mod, which
//     hooks GetSysColorBrush for exactly this color) shows the standard
//     technique is hooking the exported color APIs, same as this mod
//     already does -- and that still isn't enough here, meaning
//     DefWindowProc's WM_ERASEBKGND default handling resolves COLOR_WINDOW
//     through a path that bypasses every in-process hook surface, not just
//     the class-brush cases the interception can see. The only
//     more-thorough alternative (a global WH_CALLWNDPROC hook, or
//     subclassing every window created in every injected process) is a much
//     larger, riskier surface than keeping one more index in a SetSysColors
//     call this mod already has to make for the other indices -- not a
//     good trade if this experiment doesn't pan out; expect this index to
//     go back in once retested with a build where ordinal 145 actually
//     resolved (see the open question above). The
//     WM_ERASEBKGND interception stays regardless: SetSysColors is
//     session-global and can't reach the narrow excluded-file-picker dark
//     exception (IsInsideExcludedFilePicker) the way it can.
//   - COLOR_MENU: same category again -- classic (non-owner-drawn) popup
//     menus resolve their background natively, bypassing every in-process
//     hook, so a native flash of the raw kernel color briefly shows before
//     this mod's own UAHDRAWMENU/acrylic paint takes over. Value is menuBg
//     (computed just below): solid black when ModernContextMenus' acrylic
//     backdrop is active (the blur effect needs full black underneath to
//     composite correctly), or Win32MainDark as a plain opaque fallback when
//     the acrylic backdrop isn't available (remote desktop, transparency
//     disabled, etc.). COLOR_MENUBAR (the menu *bar*, not popup menus)
//     doesn't show this flash and stays out of the array.
//   - COLOR_BTNFACE: same category as COLOR_WINDOW, confirmed the same way
//     -- a genuinely uninjected-hook-coverage third-party window whose
//     main background (not a document-style control) reduces to the
//     lazy (HBRUSH)(COLOR_BTNFACE+1) class-registration placeholder reads
//     it via DefWindowProc's native WM_ERASEBKGND handling, same bypass
//     as COLOR_WINDOW. Briefly dropped from this array during the shrink;
//     restored once a real regression showed a third-party app's window
//     background stuck light while its document controls (COLOR_WINDOW)
//     stayed correctly dark. DiskPieIsHoleColor (Cleanmgr pie chart, see
//     its own comment) already assumed this was globally remapped --
//     dropping it silently broke that assumption too.
//   - COLOR_BTNTEXT / COLOR_MENUTEXT: the text that sits on the two
//     backgrounds above. Processes without this mod's GetSysColor hooks
//     (user exclusions, hosts Windhawk can't inject) read the table
//     directly, and would otherwise draw black button and menu text
//     on the dark fills. COLOR_WINDOWTEXT stays out:
//     it is also the text of COLOR_WINDOW controls, which remain light.
// Every other former entry (the rest of the text-color family, the
// caption/3D-bevel/scrollbar-track family, etc.) is deliberately NOT sent
// to SetSysColors here.
//
// Note: a classic Toolbar "Organize"/"New Folder" split-button's text once
// rendered a fixed dark blue here -- turned out unrelated to this array
// (confirmed by restoring the full 30-entry version and seeing the bug
// persist). Real cause was AllowDarkModeForWindowWithParentFallback
// (uxtheme ordinal 145); fixed by removing that API from the mod entirely
// after it turned out to cause this and other dark-mode regressions once
// a Windows update made it actually resolve (see the COLOR_WINDOW entry
// above for the same discovery applied to that experiment).
static constexpr int kDarkSysColorCount = 7;
static const INT kDarkSysColorElems[kDarkSysColorCount] = {

    COLOR_MENU,         // popup menu bg
    COLOR_HIGHLIGHT,    // selection/hover bg — accent
    COLOR_HOTLIGHT,     // hyperlinks, hot-tracking — accent
    COLOR_MENUHILIGHT,  // menu item hover — accent

    COLOR_MENUTEXT,     // text on COLOR_MENU
};
