                                    D2D1::RoundedRect(pillRect, pillW * 0.5f, pillW * 0.5f), brush.Get());
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                const HRESULT hr = pRT->EndDraw();
                if (hr == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET)
                    CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && attemptedLabel)
                    labelDrawn = true;
            }
        }
    }

    if (label[0] && textAlpha > 0.01f && !labelDrawn) {
        const LONG textMargin = (LONG)lroundf(1.6f * scale);
        RECT labelRc = {
            rc.left + textMargin, rc.top + (LONG)textTop,
            rc.right - textMargin, rc.bottom - textMargin
        };
        int oldBkMode = SetBkMode(cd->hdc, TRANSPARENT);
        COLORREF oldTextColor = SetTextColor(cd->hdc, itemClr);
        DrawTextW(cd->hdc, label, -1, &labelRc,
            DT_CENTER | DT_WORDBREAK | DT_NOPREFIX);
        SetTextColor(cd->hdc, oldTextColor);
        SetBkMode(cd->hdc, oldBkMode);
    }

    // Pass 2: icon. DrawSvgGlyph/PlacesBarDrawWipe each bind their own
    // render target scoped to iconRc (same pattern the nav pane's own
    // per-item drawing already uses).
    const bool inCabinet = false; // real Explorer host is CabinetWClass; this is a #32770 dialog
    if (wiping) {
        PlacesBarDrawWipe(cd->hdc, iconRc, itemClr, glyphStr[0],
                          wipeElapsedSec, inCabinet);
    } else {
        DrawSvgGlyph(cd->hdc, iconRc, itemClr, glyphStr[0], filled, inCabinet, 1.0f, -1.0f);
    }

    return true;
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK ClassicDlgToolbarSubclassProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp,
    DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        TravelBandFontCachesClear();
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kClassicDlgToolbarSubclassProp);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, ClassicDlgToolbarSubclassProc);
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    }
    if (msg == WM_NOTIFY) {
        const NMHDR* nm = reinterpret_cast<const NMHDR*>(lp);
        if (nm && nm->code == NM_CUSTOMDRAW && g_settings.LegacyRebarControls) {
            const bool isTop = IsClassicDialogTopToolbar(nm->hwndFrom);
            // Places bar's own dark-mode instance (PropertyDialogSubclassProc,
            // installed later during the same window creation -> front of
            // the subclass chain) already owns and fully answers this
            // notification whenever it's active; this any-mode check is
            // what actually fires in light mode, where that instance was
            // never installed. See IsClassicPlacesBarToolbarAnyMode.
            const bool isPlaces = !isTop && IsClassicPlacesBarToolbarAnyMode(nm->hwndFrom);
            if (isTop || isPlaces) {
                NMCUSTOMDRAW* cd = reinterpret_cast<NMCUSTOMDRAW*>(lp);
                if (cd->dwDrawStage == CDDS_PREPAINT)
                    return CDRF_NOTIFYITEMDRAW;
                if (cd->dwDrawStage == CDDS_ITEMPREPAINT) {
                    if (isTop) {
                        const wchar_t* glyphStr = ClassicDialogToolbarGlyphForCommand((UINT_PTR)cd->dwItemSpec);
                        if (glyphStr) {
                            PaintClassicDlgToolbarItem(cd, glyphStr);
                            return CDRF_SKIPDEFAULT;
                        }
                        return CDRF_DODEFAULT;
                    }
                    if (PaintClassicPlacesBarItem(nm->hwndFrom, cd))
                        return CDRF_SKIPDEFAULT;
                    return CDRF_DODEFAULT;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

// ── Single-line property-sheet tabs ──────────────────────────────────────────
static std::mutex g_singleLinePropertyTabsMutex;
static std::unordered_set<HWND> g_singleLinePropertyTabs;
static std::atomic<bool> g_singleLinePropertyTabsUnloading{false};

static constexpr INT_PTR kSingleLineTabRestoreMultiline = 1;
static constexpr INT_PTR kSingleLineTabKeepSingleLine = 2;

static constexpr UINT_PTR kSingleLineTabScrollTimerId = 0x5A4E07;
static constexpr ULONGLONG kSingleLineTabScrollDurationMs = 220;

struct SingleLineTabScrollAnimation {
    HBITMAP oldBitmap = nullptr;
    HBITMAP newBitmap = nullptr;
    RECT stripRect = {};
    int displacement = 0;
    COLORREF backgroundColor = RGB(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF);
    UINT timerIntervalMs = 16;
    bool highResolutionTimer = false;
    ULONGLONG startTick = 0;
};

static std::mutex g_singleLineTabScrollMutex;
static std::unordered_map<HWND, SingleLineTabScrollAnimation>
    g_singleLineTabScrollAnimations;

static void DestroySingleLineTabScrollBitmaps(
    SingleLineTabScrollAnimation& animation)
{
    if (animation.oldBitmap) {
        DeleteObject(animation.oldBitmap);
        animation.oldBitmap = nullptr;
    }
    if (animation.newBitmap) {
        DeleteObject(animation.newBitmap);
        animation.newBitmap = nullptr;
    }
    if (animation.highResolutionTimer) {
        timeEndPeriod(1);
        animation.highResolutionTimer = false;
    }
}

static void CancelSingleLineTabScrollAnimation(HWND tab)
{
    if (tab)
        KillTimer(tab, kSingleLineTabScrollTimerId);

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_singleLineTabScrollMutex);
    auto it = g_singleLineTabScrollAnimations.find(tab);
    if (it == g_singleLineTabScrollAnimations.end())
        return;
    DestroySingleLineTabScrollBitmaps(it->second);
    g_singleLineTabScrollAnimations.erase(it);
}

static void ClearSingleLineTabScrollAnimations()
{
    std::vector<HWND> tabs;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_singleLineTabScrollMutex);
        tabs.reserve(g_singleLineTabScrollAnimations.size());
        for (const auto& [tab, animation] : g_singleLineTabScrollAnimations) {
            (void)animation;
            tabs.push_back(tab);
        }
    }
    for (HWND tab : tabs)
        CancelSingleLineTabScrollAnimation(tab);
}

static bool GetSingleLineTabStripRect(HWND tab, HWND spin, RECT* stripRect)
{
    if (!tab || !spin || !stripRect || !IsWindow(tab) || !IsWindow(spin) ||
        !IsWindowVisible(spin) || GetParent(spin) != tab ||
        !(GetWindowLongPtrW(spin, GWL_STYLE) & UDS_HORZ) ||
        // The strip/spin geometry below assumes an LTR layout (spin at the
        // right edge, strip to its left). WS_EX_LAYOUTRTL mirrors where
        // comctl32 actually places the scroll spinner, and there's no way
        // to verify a mirrored formula against a real RTL session here --
        // treat RTL tab controls as "no overflow" instead of risking wrong
        // geometry, same as any other unsupported-layout bail-out.
        (GetWindowLongPtrW(tab, GWL_EXSTYLE) & WS_EX_LAYOUTRTL)) {
        return false;
    }

    RECT client = {};
    RECT spinScreen = {};
    if (!GetClientRect(tab, &client) || !GetWindowRect(spin, &spinScreen))
        return false;

    POINT spinPoints[2] = {
        {spinScreen.left, spinScreen.top},
        {spinScreen.right, spinScreen.bottom},
    };
    MapWindowPoints(nullptr, tab, spinPoints, ARRAYSIZE(spinPoints));

    LONG stripBottom = 0;
    LONG firstItemLeft = 0;
    LONG lastItemRight = 0;
    const int itemCount = TabCtrl_GetItemCount(tab);
    for (int index = 0; index < itemCount; ++index) {
        RECT itemRect = {};
        if (!TabCtrl_GetItemRect(tab, index, &itemRect))
            return false;
        if (index == 0)
            firstItemLeft = itemRect.left;
        if (index == itemCount - 1)
            lastItemRight = itemRect.right;
        stripBottom = (std::max)(stripBottom, itemRect.bottom);
    }

    stripRect->left = client.left;
    stripRect->top = client.top;
    stripRect->right = (std::min)(client.right, spinPoints[0].x);
    stripRect->bottom = (std::min)(
        client.bottom,
        (std::max)(stripBottom, spinPoints[1].y) + 1);
    const bool hasOverflow = itemCount > 0 &&
        (firstItemLeft < stripRect->left ||
         lastItemRight > stripRect->right);
    return hasOverflow && stripRect->right > stripRect->left &&
        stripRect->bottom > stripRect->top;
}

static bool CaptureSingleLineTabItemLefts(
    HWND tab, std::vector<LONG>* itemLefts)
{
    if (!tab || !itemLefts)
        return false;

    const int itemCount = TabCtrl_GetItemCount(tab);
    if (itemCount <= 0)
        return false;

    itemLefts->clear();
    itemLefts->reserve(itemCount);
    for (int index = 0; index < itemCount; ++index) {
        RECT itemRect = {};
        if (!TabCtrl_GetItemRect(tab, index, &itemRect)) {
            itemLefts->clear();
            return false;
        }
        itemLefts->push_back(itemRect.left);
    }
    return true;
}

static bool GetSingleLineTabScrollDisplacement(
    const std::vector<LONG>& before, const std::vector<LONG>& after,
    int* displacement)
{
    if (!displacement || before.empty() || before.size() != after.size())
        return false;

    const LONG delta = after[0] - before[0];
    if (!delta)
        return false;
    for (size_t index = 1; index < before.size(); ++index) {
        if (after[index] - before[index] != delta)
            return false;
    }
    *displacement = static_cast<int>(delta);
    return true;
}

static HBITMAP CaptureSingleLineTabStripBitmap(HWND tab, const RECT& stripRect)
{
    const int width = stripRect.right - stripRect.left;
    const int height = stripRect.bottom - stripRect.top;
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
        return nullptr;

    HDC windowDC = GetDC(tab);
    if (!windowDC)
        return nullptr;

    HDC memoryDC = CreateCompatibleDC(windowDC);
    HBITMAP bitmap = memoryDC
        ? CreateCompatibleBitmap(windowDC, width, height)
        : nullptr;
    HGDIOBJ oldBitmap = bitmap ? SelectObject(memoryDC, bitmap) : nullptr;
    const bool selected = oldBitmap && oldBitmap != HGDI_ERROR;
    const bool copied = selected && BitBlt(
        memoryDC, 0, 0, width, height, windowDC,
        stripRect.left, stripRect.top, SRCCOPY);

    if (selected)
        SelectObject(memoryDC, oldBitmap);
    if (memoryDC)
        DeleteDC(memoryDC);
    ReleaseDC(tab, windowDC);

    if (!copied) {
        if (bitmap)
            DeleteObject(bitmap);
        return nullptr;
    }
    return bitmap;
}

static HBITMAP RenderSingleLineTabStripBitmap(HWND tab, const RECT& stripRect)
{
    const int width = stripRect.right - stripRect.left;
    const int height = stripRect.bottom - stripRect.top;
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
        return nullptr;

    HDC windowDC = GetDC(tab);
    HDC memoryDC = windowDC ? CreateCompatibleDC(windowDC) : nullptr;
    HBITMAP bitmap = memoryDC
        ? CreateCompatibleBitmap(windowDC, width, height)
        : nullptr;
    HGDIOBJ oldBitmap = bitmap ? SelectObject(memoryDC, bitmap) : nullptr;
    const bool ready = oldBitmap && oldBitmap != HGDI_ERROR;
    int savedDC = 0;
    if (ready) {
        savedDC = SaveDC(memoryDC);
        SetViewportOrgEx(
            memoryDC, -stripRect.left, -stripRect.top, nullptr);
        RECT client = {};
        GetClientRect(tab, &client);
        FillRect_orig(
            memoryDC, &client, GetSysColorBrush(COLOR_BTNFACE));
        const HWND previousPaintHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
        const bool previousPaintWasInsideExplorer =
            g_tlsPaintWasInsideExplorer;
        g_tlsPaintHwnd = tab;
        g_tlsPaintWasInsideExplorer =
            g_tlsExplorerMicaPaintTrackingEnabled &&
            IsInsideExplorer(tab);
        SendMessageW(tab, WM_PRINTCLIENT, reinterpret_cast<WPARAM>(memoryDC),
            PRF_CLIENT | PRF_NONCLIENT | PRF_ERASEBKGND);
        g_tlsPaintHwnd = previousPaintHwnd;
        g_tlsPaintWasInsideExplorer = previousPaintWasInsideExplorer;
        if (savedDC)
            RestoreDC(memoryDC, savedDC);
        SelectObject(memoryDC, oldBitmap);
    }
    if (memoryDC)
        DeleteDC(memoryDC);
    if (windowDC)
        ReleaseDC(tab, windowDC);

    if (!ready) {
        if (bitmap)
            DeleteObject(bitmap);
        return nullptr;
    }
    return bitmap;
}

static COLORREF SingleLineTabScrollBackground(HWND tab)
{
    if (g_darkModeActive && IsHwndDarkMode(tab))
        return DarkBgForPaint(tab);
    HDC hdc = GetDC(tab);
    const COLORREF color = ParentBackgroundColor(tab, hdc, false, COLOR_WINDOW);
    if (hdc) ReleaseDC(tab, hdc);
    return color;
}

static UINT SingleLineTabScrollTimerInterval(HWND tab)
{
    return static_cast<UINT>(std::clamp(
        IconPopComputeSleepMs(tab), static_cast<int>(USER_TIMER_MINIMUM), 16));
}

static float SingleLineTabScrollOffset(
    const SingleLineTabScrollAnimation& animation, float progress)
{
    progress = std::clamp(progress, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    const float amount = progress * progress * (3.0f - 2.0f * progress);
    return static_cast<float>(animation.displacement) * amount;
}

static bool DrawSingleLineTabScrollFrame(
    HWND tab, HDC targetDC, bool* finished)
{
    if (finished)
        *finished = false;
    if (!tab || !targetDC)
        return false;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_singleLineTabScrollMutex);
    auto it = g_singleLineTabScrollAnimations.find(tab);
    if (it == g_singleLineTabScrollAnimations.end())
        return false;

    const auto& animation = it->second;
    const int width = animation.stripRect.right - animation.stripRect.left;
    const int height = animation.stripRect.bottom - animation.stripRect.top;
    if (!animation.oldBitmap || !animation.newBitmap ||
        width <= 0 || height <= 0) {
        return false;
    }

    const ULONGLONG elapsed = GetTickCount64() - animation.startTick;
    const float progress = SysAnimationsEnabled()
        ? static_cast<float>(elapsed) /
            static_cast<float>(kSingleLineTabScrollDurationMs)
        : 1.0f;
    const int offset = static_cast<int>(std::lround(
        SingleLineTabScrollOffset(animation, progress)));

    HDC oldDC = CreateCompatibleDC(targetDC);
    HDC newDC = CreateCompatibleDC(targetDC);
    HGDIOBJ oldSelection = oldDC
        ? SelectObject(oldDC, animation.oldBitmap)
        : nullptr;
    HGDIOBJ newSelection = newDC
        ? SelectObject(newDC, animation.newBitmap)
        : nullptr;
    const bool ready = oldSelection && oldSelection != HGDI_ERROR &&
        newSelection && newSelection != HGDI_ERROR;

    int savedDC = 0;
    if (ready) {
        savedDC = SaveDC(targetDC);
        IntersectClipRect(targetDC,
            animation.stripRect.left, animation.stripRect.top,
            animation.stripRect.right, animation.stripRect.bottom);

        HBRUSH backgroundBrush = static_cast<HBRUSH>(GetStockObject(DC_BRUSH));
        const COLORREF previousBrushColor = SetDCBrushColor(
            targetDC, animation.backgroundColor);
        if (backgroundBrush)
            FillRect_orig(targetDC, &animation.stripRect, backgroundBrush);
        if (previousBrushColor != CLR_INVALID)
            SetDCBrushColor(targetDC, previousBrushColor);
        BitBlt(targetDC,
            animation.stripRect.left + offset, animation.stripRect.top,
            width, height, oldDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
        BitBlt(targetDC,
            animation.stripRect.left + offset - animation.displacement,
            animation.stripRect.top,
            width, height, newDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);

        if (savedDC)
            RestoreDC(targetDC, savedDC);
    }

    if (oldSelection && oldSelection != HGDI_ERROR)
        SelectObject(oldDC, oldSelection);
    if (newSelection && newSelection != HGDI_ERROR)
        SelectObject(newDC, newSelection);
    if (oldDC)
        DeleteDC(oldDC);
    if (newDC)
        DeleteDC(newDC);

    if (finished)
        *finished = progress >= 1.0f;
    return ready;
}

static void PaintSingleLineTabBitmap(
    HWND tab, HBITMAP bitmap, const RECT& stripRect)
{
    if (!tab || !bitmap)
        return;

    HDC windowDC = GetDC(tab);
    HDC bitmapDC = windowDC ? CreateCompatibleDC(windowDC) : nullptr;
    HGDIOBJ oldBitmap = bitmapDC ? SelectObject(bitmapDC, bitmap) : nullptr;
    if (oldBitmap && oldBitmap != HGDI_ERROR) {
        BitBlt(windowDC, stripRect.left, stripRect.top,
            stripRect.right - stripRect.left,
            stripRect.bottom - stripRect.top,
            bitmapDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
        SelectObject(bitmapDC, oldBitmap);
    }
    if (bitmapDC)
        DeleteDC(bitmapDC);
    if (windowDC)
        ReleaseDC(tab, windowDC);
}

static void RepaintSingleLinePropertyTabNative(HWND tab)
{
    if (tab && IsWindowVisible(tab)) {
        RedrawWindow(tab, nullptr, nullptr,
            RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_NOERASE |
            RDW_NOCHILDREN | RDW_UPDATENOW);
    }
}

static LRESULT AnimateSingleLinePropertyTabScroll(
    HWND tab, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp)
{
    if (g_singleLinePropertyTabsUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return DefSubclassProc(tab, msg, wp, lp);

    HWND spin = reinterpret_cast<HWND>(lp);
    RECT beforeStrip = {};
    std::vector<LONG> beforeLefts;
    if (!SysAnimationsEnabled() || SysHighContrastEnabled() ||
        LOWORD(wp) != SB_THUMBPOSITION ||
        !GetSingleLineTabStripRect(tab, spin, &beforeStrip) ||
        !CaptureSingleLineTabItemLefts(tab, &beforeLefts)) {
        return DefSubclassProc(tab, msg, wp, lp);
    }

    // A second click can arrive while the previous visual is still settling.
    // Capture that composed frame first, then retire its resources without
    // repainting so the next slide starts exactly where the user saw it.
    const COLORREF backgroundColor = SingleLineTabScrollBackground(tab);
    HBITMAP oldBitmap = CaptureSingleLineTabStripBitmap(tab, beforeStrip);
    CancelSingleLineTabScrollAnimation(tab);
    if (!oldBitmap) {
        const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(tab, msg, wp, lp);
        RepaintSingleLinePropertyTabNative(tab);
        return result;
    }

    const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(tab, msg, wp, lp);

    // Cover the strip with the pre-scroll snapshot right away -- the
    // DefSubclassProc call above just let comctl32 scroll and repaint
    // itself natively at the new position, so without this the real,
    // already-scrolled tabs are visible unmasked until the slower work
    // below (another full WM_PRINTCLIENT round-trip inside
    // RenderSingleLineTabStripBitmap) finishes. beforeStrip is used here,
    // not a freshly re-queried afterStrip, specifically to avoid doing any
    // more work before this paint; geometryReady below still requires them
    // to be EqualRect whenever the animation actually proceeds, so this is
    // never a stale rect on the path that reaches here.
    PaintSingleLineTabBitmap(tab, oldBitmap, beforeStrip);

    RECT afterStrip = {};
    std::vector<LONG> afterLefts;
    int displacement = 0;
    const bool geometryReady =
        GetSingleLineTabStripRect(tab, spin, &afterStrip) &&
        EqualRect(&beforeStrip, &afterStrip) &&
        CaptureSingleLineTabItemLefts(tab, &afterLefts) &&
        GetSingleLineTabScrollDisplacement(
            beforeLefts, afterLefts, &displacement);
    if (!geometryReady) {
        DeleteObject(oldBitmap);
        RepaintSingleLinePropertyTabNative(tab);
        return result;
    }

    HBITMAP newBitmap = RenderSingleLineTabStripBitmap(tab, afterStrip);
    if (!newBitmap) {
        DeleteObject(oldBitmap);
        RepaintSingleLinePropertyTabNative(tab);
        return result;
    }

    SingleLineTabScrollAnimation animation;
    animation.oldBitmap = oldBitmap;
    animation.newBitmap = newBitmap;
    animation.stripRect = afterStrip;
    animation.displacement = displacement;
    animation.backgroundColor = backgroundColor;
    animation.timerIntervalMs = SingleLineTabScrollTimerInterval(tab);
    if (animation.timerIntervalMs < 16)
        animation.highResolutionTimer = timeBeginPeriod(1) == TIMERR_NOERROR;
    animation.startTick = GetTickCount64();

    bool activated = false;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_singleLineTabScrollMutex);
        if (!g_singleLinePropertyTabsUnloading.load(
                std::memory_order_acquire) &&
            g_singleLineTabScrollAnimations.find(tab) ==
                g_singleLineTabScrollAnimations.end() &&
            SetTimer(tab, kSingleLineTabScrollTimerId,
                animation.timerIntervalMs, nullptr)) {
            activated = g_singleLineTabScrollAnimations.emplace(
                tab, animation).second;
            if (!activated)
                KillTimer(tab, kSingleLineTabScrollTimerId);
        }
    }
    if (!activated) {
        PaintSingleLineTabBitmap(tab, newBitmap, afterStrip);
        DestroySingleLineTabScrollBitmaps(animation);
        RepaintSingleLinePropertyTabNative(tab);
    }
    return result;
}

static HWND GetPropertySheetTabControl(HWND root)
{
    if (!root || !IsWindow(root))
        return nullptr;

    wchar_t rootClass[16] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(root, rootClass, ARRAYSIZE(rootClass)) ||
        wcscmp(rootClass, L"#32770") != 0) {
        return nullptr;
    }
    if (!FindWindowExW(root, nullptr, L"SysTabControl32", nullptr))
        return nullptr;

    DWORD processId = 0;
    const DWORD threadId = GetWindowThreadProcessId(root, &processId);
    if (!threadId || processId != GetCurrentProcessId())
        return nullptr;

    HWND tab = nullptr;
    if (threadId == GetCurrentThreadId()) {
        tab = reinterpret_cast<HWND>(
            SendMessageW(root, PSM_GETTABCONTROL, 0, 0));
    } else {
        DWORD_PTR result = 0;
        if (!SendMessageTimeoutW(
                root, PSM_GETTABCONTROL, 0, 0,
                SMTO_ABORTIFHUNG | SMTO_BLOCK, 50, &result)) {
            return nullptr;
        }
        tab = reinterpret_cast<HWND>(result);
    }

    wchar_t tabClass[32] = {};
    if (!tab || !IsWindow(tab) || GetParent(tab) != root ||
        !GetClassNameW(tab, tabClass, ARRAYSIZE(tabClass)) ||
        _wcsicmp(tabClass, L"SysTabControl32") != 0) {
        return nullptr;
    }
    return tab;
}

static void RefreshSingleLinePropertyTab(HWND tab)
{
    SetWindowPos(tab, nullptr, 0, 0, 0, 0,
        SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER |
        SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_FRAMECHANGED);
    HWND root = GetParent(tab);
    if (root) {
        RedrawWindow(root, nullptr, nullptr,
            RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
    }
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK SingleLinePropertyTabSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_HSCROLL && GetPropW(hwnd, kSingleLinePropertyTabProp) &&
        g_settings.SingleLinePropertyTabs &&
        !g_singleLinePropertyTabsUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return AnimateSingleLinePropertyTabScroll(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    }

    if (msg == WM_TIMER && wp == kSingleLineTabScrollTimerId) {
        if (g_singleLinePropertyTabsUnloading.load(
                std::memory_order_acquire)) {
            CancelSingleLineTabScrollAnimation(hwnd);
            return 0;
        }
        bool finished = false;
        bool drawn = false;
        if (IsWindowVisible(hwnd)) {
            if (HDC hdc = GetDC(hwnd)) {
                drawn = DrawSingleLineTabScrollFrame(hwnd, hdc, &finished);
                ReleaseDC(hwnd, hdc);
            }
        } else {
            finished = true;
        }
        if (!drawn || finished) {
            CancelSingleLineTabScrollAnimation(hwnd);
            RepaintSingleLinePropertyTabNative(hwnd);
        }
        return 0;
    }

    if (msg == WM_PRINTCLIENT && wp) {
        const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        DrawSingleLineTabScrollFrame(
            hwnd, reinterpret_cast<HDC>(wp), nullptr);
        return result;
    }

    if (msg == WM_PAINT && !g_settings.RoundedTabPane) {
        const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        if (HDC hdc = GetDC(hwnd)) {
            DrawSingleLineTabScrollFrame(hwnd, hdc, nullptr);
            ReleaseDC(hwnd, hdc);
        }
        return result;
    }

    if (msg == WM_SIZE || msg == WM_DPICHANGED ||
        msg == WM_DPICHANGED_BEFOREPARENT ||
        msg == WM_DPICHANGED_AFTERPARENT || msg == WM_THEMECHANGED ||
        msg == WM_DISPLAYCHANGE) {
        CancelSingleLineTabScrollAnimation(hwnd);
    }

    if (msg == WM_STYLECHANGING && static_cast<int>(wp) == GWL_STYLE &&
        GetPropW(hwnd, kSingleLinePropertyTabProp) &&
        g_settings.SingleLinePropertyTabs) {
        CancelSingleLineTabScrollAnimation(hwnd);
        auto* style = reinterpret_cast<STYLESTRUCT*>(lp);
        if (style)
            style->styleNew &= ~(LONG_PTR)TCS_MULTILINE;
    } else if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        CancelSingleLineTabScrollAnimation(hwnd);
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_singleLinePropertyTabsMutex);
            g_singleLinePropertyTabs.erase(hwnd);
        }
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kSingleLinePropertyTabProp);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, SingleLinePropertyTabSubclassProc);
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

static bool ApplySingleLinePropertyTab(HWND tab)
{
    if (!g_settings.SingleLinePropertyTabs ||
        g_singleLinePropertyTabsUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !tab || !IsWindow(tab) ||
        GetPropertySheetTabControl(GetParent(tab)) != tab) {
        return false;
    }

    if (GetPropW(tab, kSingleLinePropertyTabProp))
        return true;

    LONG_PTR style = GetWindowLongPtrW(tab, GWL_STYLE);
    const bool restoreMultiline = (style & TCS_MULTILINE) != 0;

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_singleLinePropertyTabsMutex);
        if (g_singleLinePropertyTabsUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            return false;
        g_singleLinePropertyTabs.insert(tab);
    }
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            tab, SingleLinePropertyTabSubclassProc, 0) ||
        !SetPropW(tab, kSingleLinePropertyTabProp, reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(
            restoreMultiline
                ? kSingleLineTabRestoreMultiline
                : kSingleLineTabKeepSingleLine))) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            tab, SingleLinePropertyTabSubclassProc);
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_singleLinePropertyTabsMutex);
        g_singleLinePropertyTabs.erase(tab);
        return false;
    }

    if (restoreMultiline) {
        SetLastError(ERROR_SUCCESS);
        const LONG_PTR previous = SetWindowLongPtrW(
            tab, GWL_STYLE, style & ~(LONG_PTR)TCS_MULTILINE);
        if (!previous && GetLastError() != ERROR_SUCCESS) {
            RemovePropW(tab, kSingleLinePropertyTabProp);
            WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                tab, SingleLinePropertyTabSubclassProc);
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_singleLinePropertyTabsMutex);
            g_singleLinePropertyTabs.erase(tab);
            return false;
        }
    }

    // The unload sweep (RestoreSingleLinePropertyTabs) may have already run
    // and consumed the tracked set while this cross-thread install was in
    // flight -- if so, this tab is now subclassed/marked but was never
    // reverted. Undo the install immediately instead of leaving a dangling
    // subclass proc pointer for after the DLL unloads.
    if (g_singleLinePropertyTabsUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        RemovePropW(tab, kSingleLinePropertyTabProp);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            tab, SingleLinePropertyTabSubclassProc);
        if (restoreMultiline) {
            const LONG_PTR current = GetWindowLongPtrW(tab, GWL_STYLE);
            if (!(current & TCS_MULTILINE)) {
                SetWindowLongPtrW(
                    tab, GWL_STYLE, current | (LONG_PTR)TCS_MULTILINE);
            }
        }
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_singleLinePropertyTabsMutex);
        g_singleLinePropertyTabs.erase(tab);
        return false;
    }

    RefreshSingleLinePropertyTab(tab);
    return true;
}

static void RestoreSingleLinePropertyTabs()
{
    ClearSingleLineTabScrollAnimations();

    std::vector<HWND> tabs;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_singleLinePropertyTabsMutex);
        tabs.assign(
            g_singleLinePropertyTabs.begin(), g_singleLinePropertyTabs.end());
        g_singleLinePropertyTabs.clear();
    }

    for (HWND tab : tabs) {
        HANDLE marker = IsWindow(tab)
            ? GetPropW(tab, kSingleLinePropertyTabProp)
            : nullptr;
        if (!marker)
            continue;

        const bool restoreMultiline = reinterpret_cast<INT_PTR>(marker) ==
            kSingleLineTabRestoreMultiline;
        RemovePropW(tab, kSingleLinePropertyTabProp);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            tab, SingleLinePropertyTabSubclassProc);
        const LONG_PTR style = GetWindowLongPtrW(tab, GWL_STYLE);
        if (restoreMultiline && !(style & TCS_MULTILINE)) {
            SetWindowLongPtrW(
                tab, GWL_STYLE, style | (LONG_PTR)TCS_MULTILINE);
        }
        RefreshSingleLinePropertyTab(tab);
    }
}

static void ApplySingleLinePropertyTabsForWindow(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd || !g_settings.SingleLinePropertyTabs ||
        g_singleLinePropertyTabsUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return;
    }

    wchar_t cls[32] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)))
        return;

    if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTabControl32") == 0) {
        ApplySingleLinePropertyTab(hwnd);
        return;
    }
    if (wcscmp(cls, L"#32770") != 0)
        return;

    const LONG_PTR style = GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE);
    HWND root = (style & WS_CHILD) ? GetParent(hwnd) : hwnd;
    if (HWND tab = GetPropertySheetTabControl(root))
        ApplySingleLinePropertyTab(tab);
}

static BOOL CALLBACK ApplySingleLinePropertyTabsChild(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    ApplySingleLinePropertyTabsForWindow(hwnd);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK ApplySingleLinePropertyTabsEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD processId = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &processId);
    if (processId != GetCurrentProcessId())
        return TRUE;
    ApplySingleLinePropertyTabsForWindow(hwnd);
    EnumChildWindows(hwnd, ApplySingleLinePropertyTabsChild, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

// ── Tab flicker fix ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Subclass SysTabControl32 to suppress WM_ERASEBKGND (prevents dialog-bg flash)
// and double-buffer WM_PAINT (prevents state-change flicker on hover).
static std::mutex g_tabSubclassOwnersMutex;
static std::unordered_set<HWND> g_tabSubclassOwners;

static LRESULT CALLBACK TabFlickerFixSubclassProc(HWND hWnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp,
    DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_ERASEBKGND)
        return TRUE; // suppress — our DrawThemeBackground handles tab backgrounds
    if (msg == WM_PAINT) {
        BufferedPaintStopAllAnimations(hWnd);
        // Double-buffer with regular memory DC (not BufferedPaint).
        // BufferedPaint creates a TOPDOWNDIB surface where text rendered
        // via DTT_TEXTCOLOR gets alpha=0 → invisible after EndBufferedPaint.
        // Regular CreateCompatibleDC has no alpha issues.
        PAINTSTRUCT ps;
        HDC hdc = BeginPaint(hWnd, &ps);
        if (hdc) {
            RECT rc;
            GetClientRect(hWnd, &rc);
            HDC memDC = rc.right > 0 && rc.bottom > 0
                ? CreateCompatibleDC(hdc) : nullptr;
            HBITMAP bmp = memDC
                ? CreateCompatibleBitmap(hdc, rc.right, rc.bottom) : nullptr;
            HGDIOBJ oldBmp = bmp ? SelectObject(memDC, bmp) : nullptr;
            const bool buffered = memDC && bmp && oldBmp && oldBmp != HGDI_ERROR;
            HDC target = buffered ? memDC : hdc;
            // Pre-fill with solid bg to eliminate gradient that tab control paints
            FillRect_orig(target, &rc, GetSysColorBrush(COLOR_BTNFACE));
            SendMessageW(hWnd, WM_PRINTCLIENT, (WPARAM)target,
                PRF_CLIENT | PRF_NONCLIENT | PRF_CHILDREN | PRF_ERASEBKGND);
            if (buffered)
                BitBlt(hdc, 0, 0, rc.right, rc.bottom, memDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
            if (buffered)
                SelectObject(memDC, oldBmp);
            if (bmp)
                DeleteObject(bmp);
            if (memDC)
                DeleteDC(memDC);
            EndPaint(hWnd, &ps);
        }
        return 0;
    }
    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> ownersLock(g_tabSubclassOwnersMutex);
            g_tabSubclassOwners.erase(hWnd);
        }
        RemovePropW(hWnd, kWinUiTabTextOwnerProp);
        RemovePropW(hWnd, kPropTabPaneMeasuredTop);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hWnd, TabFlickerFixSubclassProc);
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hWnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

// Gated by RoundedTabPane at both call sites (creation-time and the
// settings-changed sweep below) -- applies to every SysTabControl32 when
// on, regardless of whether IsWinUiTabStyleActive ends up drawing anything
// special on top of it.
static void TabFlickerFixInstallWindow(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (g_tabFeaturesUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd)) {
        return;
    }
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_tabSubclassOwnersMutex);
        if (g_tabFeaturesUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            return;
        g_tabSubclassOwners.insert(hwnd);
    }
    const bool installed = WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
        hwnd, TabFlickerFixSubclassProc, 0);
    if (installed) {
        if (!SetPropW(
                hwnd, kWinUiTabTextOwnerProp, reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(1))) {
            Wh_Log(L"Failed to mark WinUI tab text owner hwnd=%p", hwnd);
        }
    } else {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_tabSubclassOwnersMutex);
        g_tabSubclassOwners.erase(hwnd);
    }

    // The unload sweep may have consumed the tracked owner while the
    // cross-thread install was in flight. Remove a late install immediately.
    if (installed &&
        g_tabFeaturesUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kWinUiTabTextOwnerProp);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropTabPaneMeasuredTop);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, TabFlickerFixSubclassProc);
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_tabSubclassOwnersMutex);
        g_tabSubclassOwners.erase(hwnd);
    }
}

// Full-unload teardown -- removes every subclass this feature ever
// installed, tracked via g_tabSubclassOwners since install/WM_NCDESTROY.
static void TabFlickerFixRemoveAll()
{
    std::vector<HWND> owners;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_tabSubclassOwnersMutex);
        owners.assign(g_tabSubclassOwners.begin(), g_tabSubclassOwners.end());
        g_tabSubclassOwners.clear();
    }
    for (HWND hwnd : owners) {
        if (IsWindow(hwnd)) {
            RemovePropW(hwnd, kWinUiTabTextOwnerProp);
            RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropTabPaneMeasuredTop);
            WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                hwnd, TabFlickerFixSubclassProc);
        }
    }
}

static BOOL CALLBACK TabFlickerFixApplyChild(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    wchar_t cls[32] = {};
    GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls));
    if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTabControl32") == 0)
        TabFlickerFixInstallWindow(hwnd);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK TabFlickerFixApplyEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId()) return TRUE;
    TabFlickerFixApplyChild(hwnd, 0);
    EnumChildWindows(hwnd, TabFlickerFixApplyChild, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

static void TreeRuntimeRestoreStyleBit(HWND hwnd, const wchar_t* prop, LONG bit)
{
    HANDLE saved = GetPropW(hwnd, prop);
    if (!saved)
        return;
    LONG style = GetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE);
    if (reinterpret_cast<INT_PTR>(saved) == 2)
        style |= bit;
    else
        style &= ~bit;
    SetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE, style);
    RemovePropW(hwnd, prop);
}

static void TreeRuntimeSaveAndSetStyleBit(
    HWND hwnd, const wchar_t* prop, LONG bit, bool enabled)
{
    LONG style = GetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE);
    if (!GetPropW(hwnd, prop))
        SetPropW(hwnd, prop, reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(
            static_cast<INT_PTR>((style & bit) ? 2 : 1)));
    LONG next = enabled ? (style | bit) : (style & ~bit);
    if (next != style)
        SetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE, next);
}

// Tracks every non-regedit TreeView we've set TVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER on --
// across all three call sites that do so (this function, plus the two
// creation-time ones in NtUserCreateWindowEx_hook) -- so the bit can be
// fully cleared on mod unload. A passive style bit leaves no code/pointer
// behind, but nothing the mod changed should still be active once it's
// gone. Not tied to a live rounded-selection toggle-off: the dark-mode
// creation-time call site isn't gated by that setting at all (applies
// unconditionally under IsCustomDarkModeAllowed), so a setting-scoped
// sweep wouldn't correctly cover it anyway -- full unload only.
static std::mutex g_treeDoubleBufferMutex;
static std::unordered_set<HWND> g_treeDoubleBufferOwners;

static void TreeDoubleBufferTrack(HWND hwnd)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_treeDoubleBufferMutex);
    g_treeDoubleBufferOwners.insert(hwnd);
}

static void TreeDoubleBufferRemoveAll()
{
    std::vector<HWND> trees;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_treeDoubleBufferMutex);
        trees.assign(g_treeDoubleBufferOwners.begin(), g_treeDoubleBufferOwners.end());
        g_treeDoubleBufferOwners.clear();
    }
    for (HWND hwnd : trees) {
        if (IsWindow(hwnd))
            TreeView_SetExtendedStyle(hwnd, TVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER, 0);
    }
}

static void ApplyTreeRuntimeSettings(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd))
        return;
    wchar_t cls[32] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)) ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTreeView32") != 0)
        return;

    if (g_settings.RemoveTreeLines && !IsInsideExplorer(hwnd)) {
        TreeRuntimeSaveAndSetStyleBit(
            hwnd, PROP_TV_HASLINES_ORIG, TVS_HASLINES, false);
    } else {
        TreeRuntimeRestoreStyleBit(hwnd, PROP_TV_HASLINES_ORIG, TVS_HASLINES);
    }

    // TVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER reduces flicker from rounded selection's own D2D
    // paint (border fade, hover fade) on this tree. Unlike TVS_TRACKSELECT
    // below, this is a TVM_SETEXTENDEDSTYLE flag, not a GWL_STYLE bit -- pure
    // paint composition, no input/selection semantics to worry about, so it
    // doesn't need the narrower TVS_TRACKSELECT gate (tvExplorerThemed,
    // IsInsidePickerNamespaceTree): the same outside-Explorer scope
    // RemoveTreeLines already uses above is enough. Regedit excluded since
    // RgApplyTreeViewStyle already manages this for its own tree. Not
    // reversed on toggle-off, matching every other TVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER call
    // site in this file (e.g. NtUserCreateWindowEx_hook) -- a one-way,
    // harmless paint enhancement, not a behavior change to undo. This also
    // covers a gap those creation-time call sites have: a tree that already
    // existed before rounded selection was toggled on live never retroactively
    // got it there.
    //
    // Checked before setting -- this function re-runs on every settings-
    // changed sweep (any setting, not just this one), so an unconditional
    // TVM_SETEXTENDEDSTYLE would resend the message to every qualifying tree
    // each time. Same guard the pre-existing LVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER call site
    // already uses for ListView (LVM_GETEXTENDEDLISTVIEWSTYLE check first).
    if (g_settings.RoundedButtons && !IsInsideExplorer(hwnd) &&
        !IsCurrentProcessRegedit() &&
        !(TreeView_GetExtendedStyle(hwnd) & TVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER)) {
        TreeView_SetExtendedStyle(hwnd, TVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER, TVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER);
        TreeDoubleBufferTrack(hwnd);
    }

    // TVS_TRACKSELECT lets DrawRoundedItemBg's Hot(2) branch actually fire on
    // third-party trees -- without it comctl32 never requests that state at
    // all (confirmed via Wine/ReactOS TREEVIEW_MouseMove). Requires this
    // exact hwnd to already be tracked as Explorer/DarkMode_Explorer themed
    // (not just the ExplorerSection+RoundedButtons settings pair) before
    // touching the style bit -- sequencing it strictly after the theme has
    // actually landed avoids the SetWindowTheme/WM_THEMECHANGED reentrancy
    // class of bug already seen elsewhere in this file. Combined with
    // IsInsideExplorer/IsInsidePickerNamespaceTree, this keeps real Explorer
    // windows AND common Open/Save file-picker nav panes out (the latter
    // root at #32770, not CabinetWClass/ExploreWClass, so IsInsideExplorer
    // alone would miss them) even if the theme check ever misses an edge case.
    // IsCurrentProcessRegedit is a separate, required exclusion: regedit's
    // own RgApplyTreeViewStyle also calls plain SetWindowTheme(DarkMode_Explorer)
    // through this same hook purely for scrollbar/NC cosmetics (its own
    // NM_CUSTOMDRAW returns CDRF_SKIPDEFAULT, fully owning item painting), so
    // tvExplorerThemed alone would go true there too -- forcing native hot-
    // tracking onto RgTVSubclassProc's own pill/chevron system, which has
    // never been exercised against comctl32's hotItem/CDIS_HOT and has its
    // own history of subtle timing bugs.
    const bool tvExplorerThemed =
        IsKnownWindowThemeApplied(hwnd, L"Explorer", nullptr) ||
        IsKnownWindowThemeApplied(hwnd, L"DarkMode_Explorer", nullptr);
    if (g_settings.ExplorerSection && g_settings.RoundedButtons &&
        !IsInsideExplorer(hwnd) && !IsInsidePickerNamespaceTree(hwnd) &&
        !IsCurrentProcessRegedit() && tvExplorerThemed) {
        TreeRuntimeSaveAndSetStyleBit(
            hwnd, PROP_TV_TRACKSELECT_ORIG, TVS_TRACKSELECT, true);
        // comctl32 shows a hand cursor over any hit item once TVS_TRACKSELECT
        // is set -- restore the arrow via the lightweight subclass above.
        if (!GetPropW(hwnd, PROP_TV_TRACKSELECT_CURSOR_SUB) &&
            WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                hwnd, TvTrackSelectCursorSubclassProc, 0)) {
            SetPropW(hwnd, PROP_TV_TRACKSELECT_CURSOR_SUB, (HANDLE)1);
        }
    } else {
        TreeRuntimeRestoreStyleBit(hwnd, PROP_TV_TRACKSELECT_ORIG, TVS_TRACKSELECT);
        if (GetPropW(hwnd, PROP_TV_TRACKSELECT_CURSOR_SUB)) {
            WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                hwnd, TvTrackSelectCursorSubclassProc);
            RemovePropW(hwnd, PROP_TV_TRACKSELECT_CURSOR_SUB);
        }
    }

    if (g_settings.ModernInsert) {
        if (!GetPropW(hwnd, PROP_TV_SUB) &&
            WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                hwnd, TreeViewSubclass, 0)) {
            SetPropW(hwnd, PROP_TV_SUB, (HANDLE)1);
        }
    } else if (GetPropW(hwnd, PROP_TV_SUB)) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, TreeViewSubclass);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, PROP_TV_SUB);
        TreeInsertMarkClearProperties(hwnd);
    }

    const bool navTree = GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(hwnd);
    const bool needsTreeCursorSubclass =
        GlyphOrColorIconsActive() ||
        g_settings.RoundedButtons;
    if (navTree && g_settings.ExplorerSection &&
        needsTreeCursorSubclass) {
        TreeCursorTrySubclass(hwnd);
    }
    if (navTree &&
        !NavHoverTrackingEnabled() &&
        GetPropW(hwnd, kPropNavHoverFadeState)) {
        // See TreeCursorRemoveFromWindow for why a 0 message needs a direct
        // call instead of SendMessageW(WM_NULL).
        if (const UINT resetMsg =
                g_navHoverFadeResetMessage.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            (void)SendMessageW(hwnd, resetMsg, 0, 0);
        else
            NavHoverFadeDestroyState(
                hwnd, !g_msgWndUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
    }
    if (navTree && GlyphOrColorIconsActive()) {
        TreeRuntimeSaveAndSetStyleBit(
            hwnd, PROP_TV_NOTOOLTIPS_ORIG, TVS_NOTOOLTIPS, true);
        if (!IsCurrentProcessRegedit()) {
            {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_glyphTreeMutex);
                g_glyphTrackedTrees.insert(hwnd);
            }
            GlyphEnsureMap();
        }
    } else {
        TreeRuntimeRestoreStyleBit(
            hwnd, PROP_TV_NOTOOLTIPS_ORIG, TVS_NOTOOLTIPS);
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_glyphTreeMutex);
        g_glyphTrackedTrees.erase(hwnd);
    }

    if (navTree)
        NavMetricsUpdateTree(hwnd);
    InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK StatusBarSubclassProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp,
    LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_PAINT) {
        PAINTSTRUCT ps;
        HDC hdc = BeginPaint(hwnd, &ps);
        if (!hdc)
            return 0;

        RECT rc = {};
        GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc);
        const int w = rc.right - rc.left;
        const int h = rc.bottom - rc.top;
        if (w > 0 && h > 0) {
            HDC memDC = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
            HBITMAP bmp = memDC ? CreateCompatibleBitmap(hdc, w, h) : nullptr;
            if (memDC && bmp) {
                HGDIOBJ oldBmp = SelectObject(memDC, bmp);
                FillRect_orig(memDC, &rc, GetSysColorBrush(COLOR_BTNFACE));
                SendMessageW(hwnd, WM_PRINTCLIENT, (WPARAM)memDC,
                    PRF_CLIENT | PRF_ERASEBKGND);
                BitBlt(hdc, 0, 0, w, h, memDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
                SelectObject(memDC, oldBmp);
                DeleteObject(bmp);
            } else {
                // memDC/bmp allocation failed (GDI exhaustion) -- draw
                // unbuffered straight onto the hdc BeginPaint already
                // opened, via WM_PRINTCLIENT, instead of calling
                // DefSubclassProc(WM_PAINT) here: wp/lp for a real WM_PAINT
                // are 0/0, and the status bar's native handler takes that to
                // mean "call BeginPaint yourself" (same nested-BeginPaint
                // hazard fixed in the sibling TrackbarSubclassProc).
                if (memDC) DeleteDC(memDC);
                SendMessageW(hwnd, WM_PRINTCLIENT, (WPARAM)hdc,
                    PRF_CLIENT | PRF_ERASEBKGND);
                EndPaint(hwnd, &ps);
                return 0;
            }
            if (memDC)
                DeleteDC(memDC);
        }

        EndPaint(hwnd, &ps);
        return 0;
    }

    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_auxSubclassOwnersMutex);
            g_statusBarSubclassOwners.erase(hwnd);
        }
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, StatusBarSubclassProc);
    }

    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

// Trackbar has no TBS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER-equivalent extended style (unlike
// ListView/TreeView/Toolbar) and is well documented as one of the worst
// native flicker offenders in Win32 -- comctl32 erases and redraws the
// rail/thumb in separate steps on every WM_HSCROLL/WM_VSCROLL tick. We
// already paint a custom WinUI accent rail/thumb on top of it (RoundedButtons,
// "Trackbar" DrawThemeBackground branch), so wrap WM_PAINT the same way as
// StatusBarSubclassProc. Confirmed via Wine's trackbar.c that WM_PRINTCLIENT
// is handled identically to WM_PAINT (TRACKBAR_Paint takes the HDC straight
// from wParam, no BeginPaint), so the same memory-DC technique applies.
static LRESULT CALLBACK TrackbarSubclassProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp,
    LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_PAINT) {
        // The track's accent length follows the thumb, so the control is
        // no longer position-independent: composing the whole client
        // below is not enough on its own, because BeginPaint's DC is
        // clipped to comctl32's invalid region and the blit would land
        // the new length over part of the bar while the rest kept the
        // previous one -- the stripes seen dragging fast or across snap
        // positions. Widening the update region first makes each frame
        // land whole; BeginPaint validates it, so this cannot loop.
        InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        PAINTSTRUCT ps;
        HDC hdc = BeginPaint(hwnd, &ps);
        if (!hdc)
            return 0;

        RECT rc = {};
        GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc);
        const int w = rc.right - rc.left;
        const int h = rc.bottom - rc.top;
        if (w > 0 && h > 0) {
            HDC memDC = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
            HBITMAP bmp = memDC ? CreateCompatibleBitmap(hdc, w, h) : nullptr;
            if (memDC && bmp) {
                HGDIOBJ oldBmp = SelectObject(memDC, bmp);
                FillRect_orig(memDC, &rc, GetSysColorBrush(COLOR_BTNFACE));
                SendMessageW(hwnd, WM_PRINTCLIENT, (WPARAM)memDC,
                    PRF_CLIENT | PRF_ERASEBKGND);
                BitBlt(hdc, 0, 0, w, h, memDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
                SelectObject(memDC, oldBmp);
                DeleteObject(bmp);
            } else {
                // memDC/bmp allocation failed (GDI exhaustion) -- draw
                // unbuffered straight onto the hdc BeginPaint already
                // opened, via the same WM_PRINTCLIENT path, instead of
                // calling DefSubclassProc(WM_PAINT) here: wp/lp for a real
                // WM_PAINT are 0/0, and the trackbar's native handler takes
                // that to mean "call BeginPaint yourself" (confirmed in
                // Wine's TRACKBAR_Paint) -- a second BeginPaint/EndPaint
                // pair nested inside the one already open above.
                if (memDC) DeleteDC(memDC);
                SendMessageW(hwnd, WM_PRINTCLIENT, (WPARAM)hdc,
                    PRF_CLIENT | PRF_ERASEBKGND);
                EndPaint(hwnd, &ps);
                return 0;
            }
            if (memDC)
                DeleteDC(memDC);
        }

        EndPaint(hwnd, &ps);
        return 0;
    }

    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_auxSubclassOwnersMutex);
            g_trackbarSubclassOwners.erase(hwnd);
        }
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, TrackbarSubclassProc);
    }

    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

// Shared by WM_PAINT (hdc from BeginPaint) and WM_PRINTCLIENT (hdc from
// wParam) in HdrDarkPaintSubclassProc below -- g_win32MainDarkBrush is guaranteed
// non-null by both callers before this runs.
static void HdrDarkPaintDraw(HWND hwnd, HDC hdc)
{
    // This full-paint owner can precede the dialog text subclass, including
    // WM_PRINTCLIENT paints that never enter BeginPaint.
    const unsigned previousDepth = g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth;
    LegacyRebarTextBeginPaint(hwnd, L"SysHeader32");
    const bool pushed = g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth == previousDepth + 1;
    RECT rcClient;
    GetClientRect(hwnd, &rcClient);
    FillRect(hdc, &rcClient, g_win32MainDarkBrush);

    const int   n     = Header_GetItemCount(hwnd);
    const HFONT hFont = reinterpret_cast<HFONT>(
                            SendMessage(hwnd, WM_GETFONT, 0, 0));
    const HFONT hOld  = hFont
        ? static_cast<HFONT>(SelectObject(hdc, hFont)) : nullptr;
    SetTextColor(hdc, WinUI::Dark::TextFillColorPrimary);
    SetBkMode(hdc, TRANSPARENT);

    const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);
    const int leftMargin  = MulDiv(8, (int)dpi, 96);
    const int rightMargin = MulDiv(4, (int)dpi, 96);

    // A bit darker than regedit's RGB(70,70,70): Win32MainDark is darker
    // than regedit's kRgDkLVBk card, so the same value here would
    // read brighter/more prominent than the tuned regedit look.
    HPEN hPen = CreatePen(PS_SOLID, 1, RGB(55, 55, 55));
    HPEN hOldPen = hPen ? static_cast<HPEN>(SelectObject(hdc, hPen)) : nullptr;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        RECT rcItem;
        if (!Header_GetItemRect(hwnd, i, &rcItem)) continue;
        wchar_t buf[256] = {};
        HDITEMW hdi = {};
        hdi.mask       = HDI_TEXT | HDI_FORMAT;
        hdi.pszText    = buf;
        hdi.cchTextMax = 256;
        Header_GetItem(hwnd, i, &hdi);
        RECT rcText = { rcItem.left + leftMargin, rcItem.top,
                        rcItem.right - rightMargin, rcItem.bottom };

        // Real Explorer headers do use HDF_RIGHT/HDF_CENTER and sort arrows
        // (e.g. the "Previous Versions" list) -- match native placement:
        // the arrow always sits at the column's own right edge, and text
        // yields that space regardless of its own alignment.
        const bool sortUp   = (hdi.fmt & HDF_SORTUP)   != 0;
        const bool sortDown = (hdi.fmt & HDF_SORTDOWN) != 0;
        if (sortUp || sortDown) {
            const int arrowW = MulDiv(8, (int)dpi, 96);
            const int arrowH = MulDiv(4, (int)dpi, 96);
            const int arrowGap = MulDiv(4, (int)dpi, 96);
            rcText.right -= (arrowW + arrowGap);
            const int cx = rcItem.right - rightMargin - arrowW / 2;
            const int cy = (rcItem.top + rcItem.bottom) / 2;
            const POINT tri[3] = {
                sortUp ? POINT{cx - arrowW / 2, cy + arrowH / 2}
                       : POINT{cx - arrowW / 2, cy - arrowH / 2},
                sortUp ? POINT{cx + arrowW / 2, cy + arrowH / 2}
                       : POINT{cx + arrowW / 2, cy - arrowH / 2},
                sortUp ? POINT{cx, cy - arrowH / 2}
                       : POINT{cx, cy + arrowH / 2},
            };
            if (HBRUSH arrowBrush = CreateSolidBrush(WinUI::Dark::TextFillColorPrimary)) {
                HGDIOBJ oldArrowBrush = SelectObject(hdc, arrowBrush);
                HGDIOBJ oldArrowPen = SelectObject(hdc, GetStockObject(NULL_PEN));
                Polygon(hdc, tri, 3);
                SelectObject(hdc, oldArrowPen);
                SelectObject(hdc, oldArrowBrush);
                DeleteObject(arrowBrush);
            }
        }

        UINT dtAlign = DT_LEFT;
        switch (hdi.fmt & HDF_JUSTIFYMASK) {
        case HDF_RIGHT:  dtAlign = DT_RIGHT;  break;
        case HDF_CENTER: dtAlign = DT_CENTER; break;
        }

        const UINT textFlags = dtAlign | DT_VCENTER | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_END_ELLIPSIS;
        INT textResult = 0;
        const bool drawn = TryDrawLegacyRebarText(hdc, buf, -1, &rcText,
            textFlags, &textResult);
        if (!drawn) {
            // The fallback is already themed; preserve the caller's guard.
            const bool previousGlow = g_glowEntry;
            g_glowEntry = true;
            DrawTextW(hdc, buf, -1, &rcText, textFlags);
            g_glowEntry = previousGlow;
        }
        if (hPen) {
            MoveToEx(hdc, rcItem.right - 2, rcClient.top, nullptr);
            LineTo(hdc, rcItem.right - 2, rcClient.bottom);
        }
    }

    if (hOldPen) SelectObject(hdc, hOldPen);
    if (hPen) DeleteObject(hPen);
    if (hOld) SelectObject(hdc, hOld);
    if (pushed)
        LegacyRebarTextEndPaint(hwnd);
}

// Generic dark-mode SysHeader32 full-paint fix, same technique as regedit's
// own RgHdrSubclassProc: AllowDarkModeForWindow's internal dark renderer
// doesn't draw column divider lines, and NM_CUSTOMDRAW is unreliable for
// this control, so WM_PAINT is fully replaced instead. Installed on
// Explorer-family, non-cabinet-rooted headers once dark mode is active
// (property dialogs, Folder Options, etc. -- the same DarkMode_ItemsView
// scope SetItemsViewOrDefaultTheme always used); regedit keeps its own
// dedicated subclass to avoid stacking two full-paint owners on the same
// header. Deliberately NOT installed in third-party processes: HdrDarkPaintDraw
// only draws HDI_TEXT left-aligned and would silently discard alignment,
// sort arrows, images/owner-draw and the host's own NM_CUSTOMDRAW that
// uxtheme's native dark renderer already handles correctly there.
static LRESULT CALLBACK HdrDarkPaintSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR /*dwRefData*/)
{
    switch (msg) {
    case WM_PAINT: {
        // Light mode or a contrast theme: default paint.
        if (!IsSystemDarkMode() ||
            g_roundedSelectionHighContrast.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            break;

        if (!g_win32MainDarkBrush)
            g_win32MainDarkBrush = CreateSolidBrush(Win32MainDark);
        if (!g_win32MainDarkBrush)
            break;

        PAINTSTRUCT ps;
        HDC hdc = BeginPaint(hwnd, &ps);
        if (!hdc)
            return 0;
        HdrDarkPaintDraw(hwnd, hdc);
        EndPaint(hwnd, &ps);
        return 0;
    }
    // Some hosts repaint via WM_PRINTCLIENT instead of WM_PAINT (see
    // StatusBarSubclassProc/TrackbarSubclassProc).
    case WM_PRINTCLIENT: {
        if (!IsSystemDarkMode() ||
            g_roundedSelectionHighContrast.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            break;

        if (!g_win32MainDarkBrush)
            g_win32MainDarkBrush = CreateSolidBrush(Win32MainDark);
        if (!g_win32MainDarkBrush)
            break;

        HDC hdc = (HDC)wp;
        if (hdc)
            HdrDarkPaintDraw(hwnd, hdc);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_NCDESTROY:
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_auxSubclassOwnersMutex);
            g_hdrDarkSubclassOwners.erase(hwnd);
        }
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, HdrDarkPaintSubclassProc);
        break;
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

static void HdrDarkPaintInstall(HWND hwnd)
{
    // Blocks new installs once teardown starts -- see g_hdrDarkUnloading.
    if (g_hdrDarkUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return;

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_auxSubclassOwnersMutex);
        g_hdrDarkSubclassOwners.insert(hwnd);
    }
    bool ok = WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
        hwnd, HdrDarkPaintSubclassProc, 0);
    if (!ok) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_auxSubclassOwnersMutex);
        g_hdrDarkSubclassOwners.erase(hwnd);
    }
}

// Split out from AuxiliarySubclassCleanup so it can also run standalone if
// ever needed live -- mirrors StatusBarRemoveAllSubclasses/
// TrackbarRemoveAllSubclasses.
static void HdrDarkPaintRemoveAll()
{
    std::vector<HWND> headers;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_auxSubclassOwnersMutex);
        headers.assign(
            g_hdrDarkSubclassOwners.begin(), g_hdrDarkSubclassOwners.end());
        g_hdrDarkSubclassOwners.clear();
    }
    for (HWND hwnd : headers) {
        if (IsWindow(hwnd))
            WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                hwnd, HdrDarkPaintSubclassProc);
    }
}

static void PaintFontViewBackground(HWND hwnd, HDC hdc)
{
    if (!hwnd || !hdc || !g_darkModeActive)
        return;

    RECT rc = {};
    GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc);
    if (rc.right <= rc.left || rc.bottom <= rc.top)
        return;

    if (!g_win32MainDarkBrush)
        g_win32MainDarkBrush = CreateSolidBrush(Win32MainDark);
    if (g_win32MainDarkBrush)
        FillRect_orig(hdc, &rc, g_win32MainDarkBrush);
}

static bool IsNearBlackColor(COLORREF c)
{
    return c != CLR_INVALID &&
           GetRValue(c) < 8 && GetGValue(c) < 8 && GetBValue(c) < 8;
}

static void PaintFontViewBlackBand(HWND hwnd, HDC hdc)
{
    if (!hwnd || !hdc || !g_darkModeActive)
        return;

    RECT rc = {};
    GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc);
    const int w = rc.right - rc.left;
    const int h = rc.bottom - rc.top;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
        return;

    const int scanTop = 0;
    const int scanBottom = std::min(h, MulDiv(96, GetDpiForWindow(hwnd), 96));
    const int x1 = std::max(1, w / 4);
    const int x2 = std::min(w - 2, (w * 3) / 4);
    int bandTop = -1;
    int bandBottom = -1;

    // One BitBlt of the scanned rows, then a memory scan: GetPixel on a
    // window DC costs ~200 us per call.
    const int scanH = scanBottom - scanTop;
    if (scanH <= 0)
        return;
    BITMAPINFO bi = {};
    bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(bi.bmiHeader);
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = w;
    bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -scanH;
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    void* bits = nullptr;
    HBITMAP snapshot = CreateDIBSection(hdc, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
    HDC snapshotDC = snapshot ? CreateCompatibleDC(hdc) : nullptr;
    if (!snapshot || !snapshotDC || !bits) {
        if (snapshotDC) DeleteDC(snapshotDC);
        if (snapshot) DeleteObject(snapshot);
        return;
    }
    HGDIOBJ oldBitmap = SelectObject(snapshotDC, snapshot);
    const bool copied = BitBlt(snapshotDC, 0, 0, w, scanH, hdc, rc.left, scanTop, SRCCOPY) != FALSE;
    GdiFlush();
    if (copied) {
        const DWORD* px = static_cast<const DWORD*>(bits);
        auto pixel = [&](int x, int y) -> COLORREF {
            const DWORD v = px[(y - scanTop) * w + x];
            return RGB((v >> 16) & 0xFF, (v >> 8) & 0xFF, v & 0xFF);
        };
        for (int y = scanTop; y < scanBottom; ++y) {
            const bool blackRow = IsNearBlackColor(pixel(x1, y)) &&
                                  IsNearBlackColor(pixel(x2, y));
            if (blackRow) {
                if (bandTop < 0)
                    bandTop = y;
                bandBottom = y + 1;
            } else if (bandTop >= 0) {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    SelectObject(snapshotDC, oldBitmap);
    DeleteDC(snapshotDC);
    DeleteObject(snapshot);

    if (bandTop < 0 || bandBottom - bandTop < MulDiv(8, GetDpiForWindow(hwnd), 96))
        return;

    RECT band = { rc.left, bandTop, rc.right, bandBottom };
    if (!g_win32MainDarkBrush)
        g_win32MainDarkBrush = CreateSolidBrush(Win32MainDark);
    if (g_win32MainDarkBrush)
        FillRect_orig(hdc, &band, g_win32MainDarkBrush);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK FontViewSubclassProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp,
    LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_ERASEBKGND && g_darkModeActive) {
        PaintFontViewBackground(hwnd, (HDC)wp);
        return 1;
    }

    if (msg == WM_PAINT && g_darkModeActive) {
        LRESULT res = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        HDC hdc = GetDC(hwnd);
        if (hdc) {
            PaintFontViewBlackBand(hwnd, hdc);
            ReleaseDC(hwnd, hdc);
        }
        return res;
    }

    if (msg == WM_PRINTCLIENT && g_darkModeActive) {
        LRESULT res = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        PaintFontViewBlackBand(hwnd, (HDC)wp);
        return res;
    }

    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_auxSubclassOwnersMutex);
            g_fontViewSubclassOwners.erase(hwnd);
        }
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, FontViewSubclassProc);
    }

    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

// SetWindowSubclass is idempotent for an (proc, id) pair already installed
// (MSDN: updates the ref-data instead of stacking a second entry), so this
// is safe to call again on an already-subclassed trackbar -- lets the
// RoundedButtons live-toggle-on sweep below share this with the creation-
// time call site instead of duplicating the insert/subclass/rollback dance.
static void ApplyTrackbarDoubleBuffer(HWND hwnd)
{
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_auxSubclassOwnersMutex);
        g_trackbarSubclassOwners.insert(hwnd);
    }
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, TrackbarSubclassProc, 0)) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_auxSubclassOwnersMutex);
        g_trackbarSubclassOwners.erase(hwnd);
    }
}

// check) but never the double-buffer fix, reintroducing the exact flicker
// this feature exists to remove until the dialog is recreated. Same

{

// Same "nothing the mod changed should still be active once it's gone"
// rationale as g_treeDoubleBufferOwners -- tracks every toolbar we've set
// TBSTYLE_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER on so it can be cleared on full mod unload.
static std::mutex g_toolbarDoubleBufferMutex;
static std::unordered_set<HWND> g_toolbarDoubleBufferOwners;

// Same idempotency rationale as ApplyTrackbarDoubleBuffer -- TB_GETEXTENDEDSTYLE
// is checked before setting, so a redundant call on an already-buffered
// toolbar is a cheap no-op.
static void ApplyToolbarDoubleBuffer(HWND hwnd)
{
    DWORD tbExSt = (DWORD)SendMessageW(hwnd, TB_GETEXTENDEDSTYLE, 0, 0);
    if (!(tbExSt & TBSTYLE_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER)) {
        SendMessageW(hwnd, TB_SETEXTENDEDSTYLE, 0, tbExSt | TBSTYLE_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER);
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_toolbarDoubleBufferMutex);
        g_toolbarDoubleBufferOwners.insert(hwnd);
    }
}

static void ToolbarDoubleBufferRemoveAll()
{
    std::vector<HWND> toolbars;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_toolbarDoubleBufferMutex);
        toolbars.assign(
            g_toolbarDoubleBufferOwners.begin(), g_toolbarDoubleBufferOwners.end());
        g_toolbarDoubleBufferOwners.clear();
    }
    for (HWND hwnd : toolbars) {
        if (!IsWindow(hwnd))
            continue;
        DWORD tbExSt = (DWORD)SendMessageW(hwnd, TB_GETEXTENDEDSTYLE, 0, 0);
        if (tbExSt & TBSTYLE_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER)
            SendMessageW(hwnd, TB_SETEXTENDEDSTYLE, 0, tbExSt & ~TBSTYLE_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER);
    }
}

// MMC's window-creation-time style strips (RBS_BANDBORDERS on the rebar,
// WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE on MMCOCXViewWindow, TBSTYLE_FLAT on the toolbar -- see
// NtUserCreateWindowEx_hook) are one-way GWL_STYLE/GWL_EXSTYLE edits with no
// live toggle to undo them. Same "nothing the mod changed should still be
// active once it's gone" rationale as g_treeDoubleBufferOwners/
// g_toolbarDoubleBufferOwners above -- a tracked set instead of a per-window
// property (TreeRuntimeSaveAndSetStyleBit) because MMC can have several of
// these windows open at once, with no existing singleton HWND for
// Wh_ModUninit to reach them through.
struct MmcStyleStrip { HWND hwnd; int gwlIndex; LONG_PTR bit; };
static std::mutex g_mmcStyleStripMutex;
static std::vector<MmcStyleStrip> g_mmcStyleStripped;

static void MmcStyleStripTrack(HWND hwnd, int gwlIndex, LONG_PTR bit)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mmcStyleStripMutex);
    g_mmcStyleStripped.push_back({ hwnd, gwlIndex, bit });
}

static void MmcStyleStripRemoveAll()
{
    std::vector<MmcStyleStrip> items;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mmcStyleStripMutex);
        items.swap(g_mmcStyleStripped);
    }
    for (const auto& item : items) {
        if (!IsWindow(item.hwnd))
            continue;
        LONG_PTR style = GetWindowLongPtrW(item.hwnd, item.gwlIndex);
        if (!(style & item.bit)) {
            SetWindowLongPtrW(item.hwnd, item.gwlIndex, style | item.bit);
            SetWindowPos(item.hwnd, nullptr, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER |
                SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_FRAMECHANGED);
        }
    }
}

// ── Legacy address bar: fix breadcrumb/edit-mode repaint desync ──────────
//
// The legacy (ToolbarWindow32-based) address bar hosts several overlapping
// sibling controls under one msctls_progress32 rebar-band parent: the
// breadcrumb ToolbarWindow32 (path segments, parented by a "Breadcrumb
// Parent" window), the chevron/refresh ToolbarWindow32 buttons, and --
// revealed only after the first click into the empty/typing area -- a
// ComboBoxEx32 > ComboBox > Edit chain for typing a raw path. Leaving
// typing mode (ComboBoxEx32 hidden again) drives a genuine multi-step
// relayout (~150-240ms of separately painted frames: combo shrinks,
// breadcrumb repositioned twice, toolbar resized) that Explorer renders out
// of order -- the breadcrumb and buttons visibly repaint staggered instead
// of as one atomic frame. Root-caused with a standalone diagnostic probe
// (see project history) before porting the fix here.
//
// Fix: suppress every sibling's repaint (WM_SETREDRAW FALSE) for the whole
// leaving transition and let exactly one clean frame through once it
// settles, anchored on the ComboBox's own WM_KILLFOCUS (confirmed via the
// probe to land only ~9ms before the real WM_PAINT, i.e. after the relayout
// has already finished). The chevron ToolbarWindow32 is deliberately
// excluded from suppression -- it has its own independently driven custom-
// paint refresh (see kRefreshSpin* above), and broad suppression was found
// to swallow those calls, leaving stale button art once suppression lifted.
//
// Entering typing mode does NOT get the same treatment: applying the same
// suppression there was tried during development and reintroduced visible
// artifacts on both the edit box and the open combo box, so it stays on a
// simple one-shot RedrawWindow anchored on ComboBoxEx32's own WM_SHOWWINDOW.
//
// Suppression state is stored as a window property on the shared
// msctls_progress32 parent (not a global) so two address bars mid-
// transition at once -- e.g. two Explorer windows, or an Explorer window
// and a file-picker dialog -- can't stomp on each other.
static constexpr LPCWSTR kPropAddrBarSyncSub = L"WH_PROP_ADDRBARSYNC_SUB";
static constexpr LPCWSTR kPropAddrBarSuppressing = L"WH_PROP_ADDRBARSYNC_SUPPRESSING";

static BOOL CALLBACK AddrBarSyncSetRedrawChild(HWND hwnd, LPARAM lp)
{
    SendMessageW(hwnd, WM_SETREDRAW, (WPARAM)lp, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

static void AddrBarSyncSetRedrawRecursive(HWND root, BOOL redraw)
{
    if (!root) return;
    SendMessageW(root, WM_SETREDRAW, (WPARAM)redraw, 0);
    EnumChildWindows(root, AddrBarSyncSetRedrawChild, (LPARAM)redraw);
}

// Scoped to the combo box and breadcrumb subtrees only -- deliberately
// excludes the chevron toolbar sibling (see header comment above).
static void AddrBarSyncSetRedrawScoped(HWND comboBoxEx, HWND breadcrumbParent, BOOL redraw)
{
    AddrBarSyncSetRedrawRecursive(comboBoxEx, redraw);
    AddrBarSyncSetRedrawRecursive(breadcrumbParent, redraw);
}

// Only installed on ComboBoxEx32/ComboBox confirmed to sit under a real
// address-bar ReBarWindow32 (see the NtUserCreateWindowEx_hook call site),
// so this only ever runs the two class checks below against controls that
// are already known to be part of the address bar.
static LRESULT CALLBACK AddrBarSyncSubclassProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp,
    LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_SHOWWINDOW && IsClassName(hwnd, L"ComboBoxEx32")) {
        LRESULT res = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        HWND parent = GetParent(hwnd);
        if (parent) {
            if ((BOOL)wp) {
                // Entering: one-shot redraw, no suppression (see above).
                // Defensive: if a previous leave-transition never reached
                // its own end anchor (window torn down mid-transition),
                // don't start this cycle still suppressed.
                if (GetPropW(parent, kPropAddrBarSuppressing)) {
                    HWND breadcrumbParent =
                        FindWindowExW(parent, nullptr, L"Breadcrumb Parent", nullptr);
                    AddrBarSyncSetRedrawScoped(hwnd, breadcrumbParent, TRUE);
                    RemovePropW(parent, kPropAddrBarSuppressing);
                }
                RedrawWindow(parent, nullptr, nullptr,
                    RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_UPDATENOW | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
            } else if (!GetPropW(parent, kPropAddrBarSuppressing)) {
                HWND breadcrumbParent =
                    FindWindowExW(parent, nullptr, L"Breadcrumb Parent", nullptr);
                SetPropW(parent, kPropAddrBarSuppressing, (HANDLE)1);
                AddrBarSyncSetRedrawScoped(hwnd, breadcrumbParent, FALSE);
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    if (msg == WM_KILLFOCUS && IsClassName(hwnd, L"ComboBox")) {
        LRESULT res = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
        HWND comboBoxEx = GetParent(hwnd);
        HWND parent = comboBoxEx ? GetParent(comboBoxEx) : nullptr;
        if (parent && GetPropW(parent, kPropAddrBarSuppressing)) {
            RemovePropW(parent, kPropAddrBarSuppressing);
            HWND breadcrumbParent =
                FindWindowExW(parent, nullptr, L"Breadcrumb Parent", nullptr);
            AddrBarSyncSetRedrawScoped(comboBoxEx, breadcrumbParent, TRUE);
            RedrawWindow(parent, nullptr, nullptr,
                RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_UPDATENOW | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
        }
        return res;
    }

    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropAddrBarSyncSub);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, AddrBarSyncSubclassProc);
    }

    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

static void AddrBarSyncTryInstall(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (GetPropW(hwnd, kPropAddrBarSyncSub))
        return;
    if (WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, AddrBarSyncSubclassProc, 0))
        SetPropW(hwnd, kPropAddrBarSyncSub, (HANDLE)1);
}

// Structural confirmation that a given ComboBoxEx32/ComboBox is actually
// the address bar's, not some unrelated control that happens to share a
// class name in a third-party toolbar embedded in the same host window.
static bool AddrBarSyncUnderRebar(HWND hwnd)
{
    for (HWND p = hwnd; p; p = GetParent(p)) {
        if (IsClassName(p, L"ReBarWindow32")) return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// Per-window cleanup shared by the live ExplorerSection/LegacyRebarControls
// toggle-off sweep below and RemoveSubclassesFromWindow's full-mod-unload
// sweep -- checks both AddrBarSync props regardless of which one hwnd
// happens to hold (the subclass prop lives on ComboBoxEx32/ComboBox, the
// suppression flag lives on their msctls_progress32 parent), so a single
// EnumChildWindows walk over the address bar's rebar band always finds and
// clears whichever one is present on each window it visits.
//
// The suppression-restore branch matters even outside a mod-disable
// scenario: if this is skipped, a leave-transition caught mid-suppression
// (WM_SETREDRAW FALSE already applied, WM_KILLFOCUS anchor not yet fired)
// would leave the combo/breadcrumb subtree permanently unable to repaint
// once the subclass that was going to lift it is gone.
static BOOL CALLBACK AddrBarSyncRemoveChildEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    if (GetPropW(hwnd, kPropAddrBarSyncSub)) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, AddrBarSyncSubclassProc);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropAddrBarSyncSub);
    }
    if (GetPropW(hwnd, kPropAddrBarSuppressing)) {
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropAddrBarSuppressing);
        HWND comboBoxEx = FindWindowExW(hwnd, nullptr, L"ComboBoxEx32", nullptr);
        HWND breadcrumbParent = FindWindowExW(hwnd, nullptr, L"Breadcrumb Parent", nullptr);
        AddrBarSyncSetRedrawScoped(comboBoxEx, breadcrumbParent, TRUE);
        RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
            RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_UPDATENOW | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
    }
    return TRUE;
}

// Live-toggle-off sweep -- same "current process only" filter as the other
// EnumWindows(FooRemoveEnum, 0) sweeps in this file (e.g.
// TreeCursorRemoveEnum, SplitButtonChevronRemoveEnum).
static BOOL CALLBACK AddrBarSyncRemoveEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId()) return TRUE;
    AddrBarSyncRemoveChildEnum(hwnd, 0);
    EnumChildWindows(hwnd, AddrBarSyncRemoveChildEnum, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

// aclui.dll's CHECKLIST_ACLUI (the permission list in the Advanced
// Security Settings / ACL editor dialog) is a bare classic window
// registered with hbrBackground = (HBRUSH)(COLOR_WINDOW+1). Its
// WM_ERASEBKGND never reaches SendMessageW_hook: it's dispatched through
// an internal path that bypasses the exported SendMessageW entirely, so
// the interception above that catches every other COLOR_WINDOW-brushed
// window never sees it. Subclassing catches it regardless of dispatch
// path, since it intercepts the window's own WNDPROC call directly.
static constexpr LPCWSTR kAclChecklistSubclassProp =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.AclChecklistSubclass";

static LRESULT CALLBACK AclChecklistSubclassProc(
    HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR dwRefData)
{
    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, AclChecklistSubclassProc);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kAclChecklistSubclassProp);
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    }

    if (msg == WM_ERASEBKGND) {
        bool dark = g_darkModeExcluded
            ? (IsInsideExcludedFilePicker(hwnd) && IsSystemDarkMode())
            : g_darkModeActive.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (dark) {
            RECT rc;
            if (GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc)) {
                // Win32MainDark, not DarkBgForPaint(hwnd) -- the ACL editor is a
                // property sheet page, so DarkBgForPaint would pick the
                // lighter kElevatedPaneDark elevated shade. This list should
                // match the dark base, not the pane shade.
                if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(Win32MainDark)) {
                    FillRect_orig((HDC)wp, &rc, br);
                    return 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

static void AclChecklistInstall(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (GetPropW(hwnd, kAclChecklistSubclassProp))
        return;
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, AclChecklistSubclassProc, 0))
        return;
    SetPropW(hwnd, kAclChecklistSubclassProp, (HANDLE)1);
}

// ============================================================================
// SysLink markup parsing + hover/pressed fill geometry -- shared by the
// Explorer-wide hover pill below (native GDI text, measured only) and by
