// Winver's own SysLink handling (full DirectWrite draw), further down this
// file. Kept up here since the Explorer install site needs them and runs
// long before Winver's own section.
// ============================================================================

struct WinverParsedLinkText {
    std::wstring text;
    std::vector<DWRITE_TEXT_RANGE> linkRanges;
};

static WinverParsedLinkText WinverParseSysLinkText(const std::wstring& markup)
{
    WinverParsedLinkText parsed;
    parsed.text.reserve(markup.size());
    size_t linkStart = std::wstring::npos;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < markup.size();) {
        if (markup[i] == L'<') {
            const size_t end = markup.find(L'>', i + 1);
            if (end == std::wstring::npos) {
                parsed.text.append(markup, i, std::wstring::npos);
                break;
            }

            size_t name = i + 1;
            while (name < end && (markup[name] == L' ' || markup[name] == L'\t'))
                ++name;
            const bool closing = name < end && markup[name] == L'/';
            if (closing)
                ++name;

            const wchar_t first = name < end ? markup[name] : L'\0';
            const wchar_t second = name + 1 < end ? markup[name + 1] : L'\0';
            if ((first == L'a' || first == L'A') &&
                (second == L'\0' || second == L' ' || second == L'\t')) {
                if (closing) {
                    if (linkStart != std::wstring::npos && parsed.text.size() > linkStart) {
                        parsed.linkRanges.push_back({(UINT32)linkStart,
                            (UINT32)(parsed.text.size() - linkStart)});
                    }
                    linkStart = std::wstring::npos;
                } else {
                    linkStart = parsed.text.size();
                }
            } else if (!closing && (first == L'b' || first == L'B') &&
                       (second == L'r' || second == L'R')) {
                parsed.text.push_back(L'\n');
            }
            i = end + 1;
            continue;
        }

        if (markup[i] == L'&') {
            struct Entity {
                const wchar_t* encoded;
                wchar_t decoded;
            };
            static constexpr Entity entities[] = {
                {L"&", L'&'}, {L"<", L'<'}, {L">", L'>'},
                {L""", L'\"'}, {L"'", L'\''},
            };
            bool decoded = false;
            for (const auto& entity : entities) {
                const size_t length = wcslen(entity.encoded);
                if (markup.compare(i, length, entity.encoded) == 0) {
                    parsed.text.push_back(entity.decoded);
                    i += length;
                    decoded = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (decoded)
                continue;
        }

        parsed.text.push_back(markup[i++]);
    }

    if (linkStart != std::wstring::npos && parsed.text.size() > linkStart) {
        parsed.linkRanges.push_back({(UINT32)linkStart,
            (UINT32)(parsed.text.size() - linkStart)});
    }
    if (parsed.linkRanges.empty() && !parsed.text.empty()) {
        parsed.linkRanges.push_back({0, (UINT32)parsed.text.size()});
    }
    return parsed;
}

// Fills a rounded, padded background behind one link's glyph run(s) --
// WinUI HyperlinkButton's PointerOver/Pressed "subtle fill", neutral (not
// accent) and slightly dimmer when pressed than on hover, matching the real
// Fluent 2 recipe.
static void WinverFillSysLinkRange(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, IDWriteTextLayout* layout,
    const DWRITE_TEXT_RANGE& range, bool dark, bool pressed, UINT dpi, float progress = 1.f)
{
    if (progress <= 0.f)
        return;
    DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS metrics[4];
    UINT32 actualCount = 0;
    if (FAILED(layout->HitTestTextRange(range.startPosition, range.length,
            0.f, 0.f, metrics, ARRAYSIZE(metrics), &actualCount)) || actualCount == 0)
        return;

    const float scale = (float)dpi / 96.f;
    const float padX = 3.f * scale, padY = 1.f * scale;
    const float cr = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale;
    const D2D1_COLOR_F fillClr = dark
        ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, (pressed ? 0.06f : 0.08f) * progress)
        : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, (pressed ? 0.04f : 0.06f) * progress);

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
    if (FAILED(rt->CreateSolidColorBrush(fillClr, &brush)) || !brush)
        return;

    for (UINT32 i = 0; i < actualCount; ++i) {
        const auto& m = metrics[i];
        D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT rr = D2D1::RoundedRect(
            D2D1::RectF(m.left - padX, m.top - padY,
                m.left + m.width + padX, m.top + m.height + padY),
            cr, cr);
        rt->FillRoundedRectangle(rr, brush.Get());
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Explorer SysLink hover/pressed pill (WinUI HyperlinkButton style)
// Gated by RoundedButtons rather than its own setting. Native GDI keeps
// drawing the control's real text untouched -- the hovered/pressed link's
// per-line rect(s) come from g_sysLinkPillCapture, filled by DrawTextW_hook
// while armed around the WM_PAINT call below, then a translucent pill is
// laid over the already-drawn glyphs through a second GetDC pass. A brief
// flicker between "text appeared" and "pill appeared" is possible and
// accepted: replacing native rendering (Winver's approach further down)
// isn't worth the risk across every dialog Explorer can open, only one
// known dialog. See ExplorerSysLinkFadeState for the hover/press animation.
// ============================================================================

static constexpr wchar_t kPropExpLinkTracking[] =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.ExpLinkTrack";
static constexpr wchar_t kPropExpLinkPressIx[] =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.ExpLinkPress";
static constexpr wchar_t kPropExpLinkTextCache[] =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.ExpLinkTextCache";

// Hover fade in/out, curve borrowed from ListSelectFadeProgress (the plain
// alpha-only one regular ListView/TreeView items use, not the nav pane's
// scale+alpha NavHoverFadeProgress) but adapted to a single hot link index
// instead of a per-item map, since a SysLink only ever has one at a time.
// NavHoverFadeState/RgHoverFade fade out on leave too (see
// NavHoverFadeRetarget) -- ListSelectFadeState is the one that still settles
// instantly, since it keys off LVN_ITEMCHANGED/TVN_SELCHANGEDW rather than
// raw mouse position, and a selection border disappearing isn't naturally
// tied to a hover leaving in the first place. Pressing still settles
// instantly in either direction.
struct ExplorerSysLinkFadeState {
    int hotLinkIx = -1;      // link currently shown (fading in OR out)
    DOUBLE startTime = 0.0;  // 0 = settled at the fadingOut-implied value
    bool fadingOut = false;
    bool timerActive = false;
};

static constexpr wchar_t kPropExpLinkFadeState[] =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.ExpLinkFade";
static constexpr UINT kExpLinkFadeTimerIntervalMs = 16;
// Shorter than NavHoverFade/ListSelectFade's shared 0.14s -- still long
// enough (~5-6 ticks at 16ms) to read as a fade rather than a pop.
static constexpr DOUBLE kExpLinkFadeDurationSeconds = 0.09;
static int g_expLinkFadeTimerTag;

static UINT_PTR ExplorerSysLinkFadeTimerId()
{
    return reinterpret_cast<UINT_PTR>(&g_expLinkFadeTimerTag);
}

static float ExplorerSysLinkFadeProgress(
    const ExplorerSysLinkFadeState& state, DOUBLE now)
{
    if (state.hotLinkIx < 0)
        return 0.f;
    if (state.startTime <= 0.0)
        return state.fadingOut ? 0.f : 1.f;
    const DOUBLE elapsed = now - state.startTime;
    float t;
    if (elapsed <= 0.0) t = 0.f;
    else if (elapsed >= kExpLinkFadeDurationSeconds) t = 1.f;
    else t = (float)(elapsed / kExpLinkFadeDurationSeconds);
    t = t * t * (3.f - 2.f * t);
    return state.fadingOut ? (1.f - t) : t;
}

static ExplorerSysLinkFadeState* ExplorerSysLinkFadeGetState(HWND hwnd)
{
    return (ExplorerSysLinkFadeState*)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkFadeState);
}

static void ExplorerSysLinkFadeStopTimer(HWND hwnd, ExplorerSysLinkFadeState* state)
{
    if (!state || !state->timerActive) return;
    KillTimer(hwnd, ExplorerSysLinkFadeTimerId());
    state->timerActive = false;
}

static void ExplorerSysLinkFadeDestroyState(HWND hwnd)
{
    auto* state = (ExplorerSysLinkFadeState*)RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkFadeState);
    if (!state) return;
    ExplorerSysLinkFadeStopTimer(hwnd, state);
    delete state;
}

// Snaps the fade to fully settled-visible without changing which link is
// hot -- used on press, so the pill reads as immediately, fully visible
// rather than still catching up mid-fade (in or out).
static void ExplorerSysLinkFadeSnapToSettled(HWND hwnd)
{
    ExplorerSysLinkFadeState* state = ExplorerSysLinkFadeGetState(hwnd);
    if (!state) return;
    state->startTime = 0.0;
    state->fadingOut = false;
    ExplorerSysLinkFadeStopTimer(hwnd, state);
}

static void ExplorerSysLinkFadeRetarget(HWND hwnd, int hotLinkIx, bool pressed)
{
    ExplorerSysLinkFadeState* state = ExplorerSysLinkFadeGetState(hwnd);
    if (!state && hotLinkIx < 0)
        return;
    if (!state) {
        state = new (std::nothrow) ExplorerSysLinkFadeState{};
        if (!state) return;
        if (!SetPropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkFadeState, state)) {
            delete state;
            return;
        }
    }
    // Re-targeting the same link while it's fading out (a quick wiggle back
    // onto it) reverses into a fade-in below instead of no-op'ing -- only a
    // genuinely unchanged, already-settled target is a true no-op.
    if (state->hotLinkIx == hotLinkIx && !state->fadingOut)
        return;

    ExplorerSysLinkFadeStopTimer(hwnd, state);
    InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);

    if (hotLinkIx >= 0) {
        state->hotLinkIx = hotLinkIx;
        state->fadingOut = false;
        state->startTime = 0.0;
        if (pressed)
            return;
        state->startTime = TimerGetSeconds();
        if (SetTimer(hwnd, ExplorerSysLinkFadeTimerId(), kExpLinkFadeTimerIntervalMs, nullptr))
            state->timerActive = true;
        else
            state->startTime = 0.0;
        return;
    }

    // Leaving: keep hotLinkIx as-is (still the last link, now fading out)
    // instead of clearing it -- the timer tick below clears it for real
    // once the fade-out completes. Nothing to fade from if it was never
    // showing in the first place.
    if (state->hotLinkIx < 0)
        return;
    state->fadingOut = true;
    state->startTime = TimerGetSeconds();
    if (SetTimer(hwnd, ExplorerSysLinkFadeTimerId(), kExpLinkFadeTimerIntervalMs, nullptr))
        state->timerActive = true;
    else {
        state->hotLinkIx = -1;
        state->fadingOut = false;
        state->startTime = 0.0;
    }
}

struct ExplorerSysLinkTextCache {
    std::wstring rawText;
    WinverParsedLinkText parsed;
};

// SysLink text is set once and essentially never changes afterward, but
// WM_PAINT fires repeatedly during a hover/press session -- cache the
// parsed <a> ranges per-window instead of re-parsing on every repaint.
// Invalidated by a plain string comparison against the raw text (cheap next
// to the parse loop itself), not by a change notification -- SysLink has
// no LM_SETITEM-adjacent hook already in place to invalidate from instead.
static const WinverParsedLinkText* ExplorerSysLinkGetParsed(HWND hwnd)
{
    const int textLength = GetWindowTextLengthW(hwnd);
    if (textLength <= 0) return nullptr;
    std::wstring rawText((size_t)textLength + 1, L'\0');
    const int copied = GetWindowTextW(hwnd, rawText.data(), textLength + 1);
    if (copied <= 0) return nullptr;
    rawText.resize((size_t)copied);

    auto* cache = (ExplorerSysLinkTextCache*)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkTextCache);
    if (cache && cache->rawText == rawText)
        return &cache->parsed;

    if (!cache) {
        cache = new ExplorerSysLinkTextCache();
        if (!SetPropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkTextCache, (HANDLE)cache)) {
            delete cache;
            return nullptr;
        }
    }
    cache->rawText = rawText;
    cache->parsed = WinverParseSysLinkText(rawText);
    return &cache->parsed;
}

static std::wstring ExplorerSysLinkActiveText(HWND hwnd, int activeIx)
{
    const WinverParsedLinkText* parsed = ExplorerSysLinkGetParsed(hwnd);
    if (!parsed || (size_t)activeIx >= parsed->linkRanges.size())
        return {};
    const auto& range = parsed->linkRanges[(size_t)activeIx];
    if (range.length == 0 ||
        (size_t)range.startPosition + range.length > parsed->text.size())
        return {};
    return parsed->text.substr(range.startPosition, range.length);
}

// GDI+ over D2D here: this paint stands alone (no other D2D draw is open on
// the same HDC to interleave with, unlike Winver's pill further down, which
// shares its DirectWrite text's own BeginDraw/EndDraw for correct z-order).
// Graphics(hdc) draws straight onto the already-native-painted HDC with no
// render-target bind/flush round trip, lighter for a couple of small fills.
struct ExplorerSysLinkGdipCache {
    ULONG_PTR token = 0;
    bool startupAttempted = false;
    bool ready = false;
};
static ExplorerSysLinkGdipCache g_expLinkGdip;
static std::mutex g_expLinkGdipMutex;

static bool ExplorerSysLinkEnsureGdipLocked()
{
    if (g_expLinkGdip.ready)
        return true;
    if (g_expLinkGdip.startupAttempted ||
        g_gdipUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return false;
    g_expLinkGdip.startupAttempted = true;
    Gdiplus::GdiplusStartupInput input;
    if (Gdiplus::GdiplusStartup(&g_expLinkGdip.token, &input, nullptr) != Gdiplus::Ok) {
        g_expLinkGdip.token = 0;
        return false;
    }
    g_expLinkGdip.ready = true;
    return true;
}

static void ExplorerSysLinkGdipShutdown()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_expLinkGdipMutex);
    if (g_expLinkGdip.token) {
        Gdiplus::GdiplusShutdown(g_expLinkGdip.token);
        g_expLinkGdip.token = 0;
    }
    g_expLinkGdip.ready = false;
    g_expLinkGdip.startupAttempted = false;
}

static void ExplorerSysLinkAddRoundedPath(Gdiplus::GraphicsPath& path,
    const Gdiplus::RectF& rect, float radius)
{
    const float diameter = radius * 2.0f;
    if (diameter <= 0.0f) {
        path.AddRectangle(rect);
        return;
    }
    path.AddArc(rect.X, rect.Y, diameter, diameter, 180.0f, 90.0f);
    path.AddArc(rect.GetRight() - diameter, rect.Y, diameter, diameter,
        270.0f, 90.0f);
    path.AddArc(rect.GetRight() - diameter, rect.GetBottom() - diameter,
        diameter, diameter, 0.0f, 90.0f);
    path.AddArc(rect.X, rect.GetBottom() - diameter, diameter, diameter,
        90.0f, 90.0f);
    path.CloseFigure();
}

static void ExplorerPaintSysLinkPill(HWND hwnd, HDC hdc, bool pressed, float progress)
{
    if (g_sysLinkPillCapture.rectCount <= 0 || progress <= 0.f)
        return;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_expLinkGdipMutex);
    if (!ExplorerSysLinkEnsureGdipLocked())
        return;

    const bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    const UINT dpi = DpiForPaintHdc(hdc);
    const float scale = (float)dpi / 96.f;
    const float padX = 3.f * scale, padY = 1.f * scale;
    const float cr = WinUI::ControlCornerRadius * scale;
    const BYTE alpha = (BYTE)lroundf(255.f * progress *
        (dark ? (pressed ? 0.06f : 0.08f) : (pressed ? 0.04f : 0.06f)));
    if (alpha == 0)
        return;
    const Gdiplus::Color fillClr = dark
        ? Gdiplus::Color(alpha, 255, 255, 255)
        : Gdiplus::Color(alpha, 0, 0, 0);

    Gdiplus::Graphics graphics(hdc);
    graphics.SetSmoothingMode(Gdiplus::SmoothingModeAntiAlias);
    Gdiplus::SolidBrush brush(fillClr);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_sysLinkPillCapture.rectCount; ++i) {
        const RECT& r = g_sysLinkPillCapture.rects[i];
        Gdiplus::GraphicsPath path;
        ExplorerSysLinkAddRoundedPath(path,
            Gdiplus::RectF((float)r.left - padX, (float)r.top - padY,
                (float)(r.right - r.left) + padX * 2.f,
                (float)(r.bottom - r.top) + padY * 2.f),
            cr);
        graphics.FillPath(&brush, &path);
    }
}

// Same hover/pressed tracking shape as Winver's own SysLink subclass:
// LM_HITTEST is authoritative for "over a link"; capture guards
// WM_LBUTTONUP delivery, and its release must not depend on the prop still
// being set, or a drag off the link before release leaves capture stuck.
static LRESULT CALLBACK ExplorerSysLinkSubclassProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg,
    WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkTracking);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkPressIx);
        ExplorerSysLinkFadeDestroyState(hwnd);
        if (auto* cache = (ExplorerSysLinkTextCache*)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkTextCache)) {
            delete cache;
            RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkTextCache);
        }
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, ExplorerSysLinkSubclassProc);
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    }

    switch (msg) {
    case WM_MOUSEMOVE: {
        if (!GetPropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkTracking)) {
            SetPropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkTracking, (HANDLE)1);
            TRACKMOUSEEVENT tme = { sizeof(tme), TME_LEAVE, hwnd, HOVER_DEFAULT };
            TrackMouseEvent(&tme);
        }
        LHITTESTINFO hti = {};
        hti.pt.x = (short)LOWORD(lp);
        hti.pt.y = (short)HIWORD(lp);
        const int newIx = SendMessageW(hwnd, LM_HITTEST, 0, (LPARAM)&hti)
            ? hti.item.iLink : -1;

        const int pressIx = (int)(INT_PTR)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkPressIx) - 1;
        ExplorerSysLinkFadeRetarget(hwnd, newIx, pressIx >= 0 && pressIx == newIx);

        if (pressIx >= 0 && pressIx != newIx && RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkPressIx))
            InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
        break;
    }
    case WM_MOUSELEAVE:
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkTracking);
        ExplorerSysLinkFadeRetarget(hwnd, -1, false);
        break;
    case WM_LBUTTONDOWN: {
        LHITTESTINFO hti = {};
        hti.pt.x = (short)LOWORD(lp);
        hti.pt.y = (short)HIWORD(lp);
        if (SendMessageW(hwnd, LM_HITTEST, 0, (LPARAM)&hti)) {
            SetPropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkPressIx,
                (HANDLE)(INT_PTR)(hti.item.iLink + 1));
            SetCapture(hwnd);
            ExplorerSysLinkFadeSnapToSettled(hwnd);
            InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
        }
        break;
    }
    case WM_LBUTTONUP:
        if (GetCapture() == hwnd)
            ReleaseCapture();
        if (RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkPressIx))
            InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
        break;
    case WM_CAPTURECHANGED:
        if (RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkPressIx))
            InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
        break;
    case WM_TIMER:
        if (wp == ExplorerSysLinkFadeTimerId()) {
            if (auto* state = ExplorerSysLinkFadeGetState(hwnd)) {
                InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
                if (state->startTime <= 0.0 ||
                    TimerGetSeconds() - state->startTime >= kExpLinkFadeDurationSeconds) {
                    ExplorerSysLinkFadeStopTimer(hwnd, state);
                    if (state->fadingOut) {
                        state->hotLinkIx = -1;
                        state->fadingOut = false;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }
        break;
    case WM_PAINT: {
        const int pressIx = (int)(INT_PTR)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkPressIx) - 1;
        ExplorerSysLinkFadeState* fadeState = ExplorerSysLinkFadeGetState(hwnd);
        const int activeIx = pressIx >= 0 ? pressIx
            : (fadeState ? fadeState->hotLinkIx : -1);
        const float progress = fadeState
            ? ExplorerSysLinkFadeProgress(*fadeState, TimerGetSeconds()) : 1.f;

        std::wstring targetText;
        if (activeIx >= 0)
            targetText = ExplorerSysLinkActiveText(hwnd, activeIx);
        const bool capturing = !targetText.empty() &&
            targetText.size() < ARRAYSIZE(g_sysLinkPillCapture.targetText);
        if (capturing) {
            g_sysLinkPillCapture.active = true;
            g_sysLinkPillCapture.targetHwnd = hwnd;
            wcsncpy_s(g_sysLinkPillCapture.targetText, targetText.c_str(),
                _TRUNCATE);
            g_sysLinkPillCapture.targetLength = targetText.size();
            g_sysLinkPillCapture.rectCount = 0;
        }

        const LRESULT res = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);

        if (capturing) {
            g_sysLinkPillCapture.active = false;
            g_sysLinkPillCapture.targetHwnd = nullptr;
            if (g_sysLinkPillCapture.rectCount > 0) {
                HDC hdc = GetDC(hwnd);
                if (hdc) {
                    ExplorerPaintSysLinkPill(hwnd, hdc, pressIx >= 0, progress);
                    ReleaseDC(hwnd, hdc);
                }
            }
            g_sysLinkPillCapture.rectCount = 0;
        }
        return res;
    }
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

static constexpr wchar_t kPropExpLinkSubclassed[] =
    L"Win32UIModernizer.ExpLinkSub";

static void ExplorerSysLinkInstall(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (GetPropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkSubclassed))
        return;
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, ExplorerSysLinkSubclassProc, 0))
        return;
    SetPropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkSubclassed, (HANDLE)1);
}

// Deferred: at 1ms children exist. Property sheets have SysTabControl32.
// Per-control dark mode at creation time (same pattern as TryApplyToWindow_Regedit).
// Called from NtUserCreateWindowEx_hook for EVERY window in Explorer.
// Checks if ancestor is a dark property sheet, then themes immediately.

// Forward declarations for property window dark mode (defined later)

using NtUserCreateWindowEx_t = HWND(WINAPI*)(DWORD, VOID*, LPCWSTR, VOID*, DWORD, LONG, LONG,
    LONG, LONG, HWND, HMENU, HINSTANCE, LPVOID, DWORD, DWORD, DWORD, VOID*);
NtUserCreateWindowEx_t NtUserCreateWindowEx_orig = nullptr;

HWND WINAPI NtUserCreateWindowEx_hook(DWORD dwExStyle, VOID* pClassName, LPCWSTR lpWindowName,
    VOID* pTitleName, DWORD dwStyle, LONG X, LONG Y, LONG nWidth, LONG nHeight,
    HWND hWndParent, HMENU hMenu, HINSTANCE hInstance, LPVOID lpParam,
    DWORD dwShowCmd, DWORD dwFlags1, DWORD dwFlags2, VOID* qwFlags)
{
    HWND hwnd = NtUserCreateWindowEx_orig(dwExStyle, pClassName, lpWindowName, pTitleName,
        dwStyle, X, Y, nWidth, nHeight, hWndParent, hMenu, hInstance, lpParam,
        dwShowCmd, dwFlags1, dwFlags2, qwFlags);
    if (!hwnd) return hwnd;
    HwndDarkCacheInvalidate();

    // Registry Editor modernization: detect and style all regedit windows
    if (g_settings.RegeditSection && IsCurrentProcessRegedit())
        TryApplyToWindow_Regedit(hwnd);

    wchar_t cls[32] = {};
    GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls));
    LazyFeatureObserveWindow(hwnd, cls);

    const bool isDirectUi = _wcsicmp(cls, L"DirectUIHWND") == 0;
    const bool isShellDefView = _wcsicmp(cls, L"SHELLDLL_DefView") == 0;
    if (isShellDefView) {
        DirectUiObserveShellFolderView();
    } else if (isDirectUi) {
        DirectUiRequestPendingSymbols();
        ExplorerFrameRequestPendingSymbols();
    }

    if (g_settings.ModernShortcutOverlay &&
        isShellDefView) {
        ShortcutOverlayRequestEnableForWindow(hwnd);
    }

    // The class-name check is the creation hot-path guard. The more detailed
    // Common-control/DirectUI ancestry validation only runs for real Edits.
    if ((g_settings.EditFocusLine ||
         ((ExplorerMicaActive() || RgMicaActive()) && !g_darkModeActive)) &&
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"Edit") == 0) {
        ListRenameTryTrack(hwnd);
    }

    // SysLink hover/pressed pill, riding on RoundedButtons instead of a
    // dedicated setting. rundll32.exe covers Control Panel/shell property
    // sheets Explorer opens out-of-process; !IsInsideExplorer excludes any
    // SysLink rooted directly in the main browser chrome (CabinetWClass/
    // ExploreWClass) -- real hyperlinks live in the dialogs Explorer opens,
    // not the browser window itself.
    if (g_settings.RoundedButtons &&
        (IsCurrentProcessExplorer() || IsCurrentProcessRunDLL32()) &&
        !IsInsideExplorer(hwnd) &&
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysLink") == 0)
        ExplorerSysLinkInstall(hwnd);

    ApplySingleLinePropertyTabsForWindow(hwnd);

    // MMC's rebar (SizeableRebar, an MFC-docking-bar class name, not
    // comctl32's own ReBarWindow32) draws thick top/bottom band borders via
    // RBS_BANDBORDERS. Strip the style bit so comctl32 stops drawing them at
    // all; the thin replacement line is drawn in our own Rebar RP_BAND/
    // RP_BACKGROUND fill in DrawThemeBackground(Ex)_hook instead. No
    // SetWindowTheme call here (unlike the RegeditSection equivalent) --
    // that call is the one with a documented WM_THEMECHANGED reentrancy
    // hang in third-party MFC apps, which MMC snap-ins often are.
    if (g_darkModeActive && IsCurrentProcessMMC() &&
        (_wcsicmp(cls, L"SizeableRebar") == 0 || _wcsicmp(cls, L"ReBarWindow32") == 0)) {
        LONG_PTR style = GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE);
        if (style & RBS_BANDBORDERS) {
            SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE, style & ~(LONG_PTR)RBS_BANDBORDERS);
            SetWindowPos(hwnd, nullptr, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER |
                SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_FRAMECHANGED);
            MmcStyleStripTrack(hwnd, GWL_STYLE, RBS_BANDBORDERS);
        }
    }

    // MMCOCXViewWindow (the OCX-hosted snap-in view area) gets a classic
    // sunken WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE border, rendered with native light 3D bevel
    // colors regardless of dark mode. Strip it.
    if (g_darkModeActive && IsCurrentProcessMMC() &&
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"MMCOCXViewWindow") == 0) {
        LONG_PTR exStyle = GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE);
        if (exStyle & WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE) {
            SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE, exStyle & ~(LONG_PTR)WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE);
            SetWindowPos(hwnd, nullptr, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER |
                SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_FRAMECHANGED);
            MmcStyleStripTrack(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE, WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE);
        }
    }

    // TBSTYLE_FLAT toolbars in MMC paint their own COMMONPROPS background
    // with a native light color that our DrawThemeBackground(Ex)_hook catch-
    // all never observes (neither API gets called for it). Strip just the
    // flat bit -- not TBSTYLE_TRANSPARENT -- so it falls back to a normal,
    // opaque toolbar background instead, which the rest of this file's
    // GetSysColor(Brush)_hook already colors correctly.
    if (g_darkModeActive && IsCurrentProcessMMC() &&
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"ToolbarWindow32") == 0) {
        LONG_PTR style = GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE);
        if (style & TBSTYLE_FLAT) {
            SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE, style & ~(LONG_PTR)TBSTYLE_FLAT);
            SetWindowPos(hwnd, nullptr, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER |
                SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_FRAMECHANGED);
            MmcStyleStripTrack(hwnd, GWL_STYLE, TBSTYLE_FLAT);
        }
    }

    // The DefView itself exists before its DirectUI child and may gain
    // WS_BORDER later. Only the child-creation event has enough context to
    // distinguish a tabbed property page from Explorer's ordinary DefView.
    if (g_settings.ModernSeparators &&
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"DirectUIHWND") == 0) {
        DefViewBorderConsiderWindow(hwnd);
    }
    // Classic Open/Save dialog top toolbar icon swap: cosmetic, works in
    // light mode too, so installed unconditionally here rather than inside
    // the IsCustomDarkModeAllowed() block below (which ApplyPropertyDialogDarkMode
    // and everything else #32770-related sits in, and never runs in light
    // mode since ApplyPropertyDialogDarkMode itself bails when !IsSystemDarkMode()).
    if (g_settings.LegacyRebarControls && _wcsicmp(cls, L"#32770") == 0 &&
        WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, ClassicDlgToolbarSubclassProc, 0))
        SetPropW(hwnd, kClassicDlgToolbarSubclassProp, (HANDLE)1);

    if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"FontViewWClass") == 0) {
        if (!g_win32MainDarkBrush)
            g_win32MainDarkBrush = CreateSolidBrush(Win32MainDark);
        // Always re-applied against the current mode (not just when dark),
        // so a class-wide dark brush left over from a since-toggled-off
        // dark mode never leaks into a freshly created light-mode window.
        SetFontViewClassBrush(IsCustomDarkModeAllowed(), hwnd);
        if (IsCustomDarkModeAllowed()) {
            {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_auxSubclassOwnersMutex);
                g_fontViewSubclassOwners.insert(hwnd);
            }
            if (!WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                    hwnd, FontViewSubclassProc, 0)) {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_auxSubclassOwnersMutex);
                g_fontViewSubclassOwners.erase(hwnd);
            }
        }
    }

    if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"ScrollBar") == 0)
        ScrollBarOwnerSubclassInstall(hwnd);
    if (ExplorerMicaPaneMode() && IsCurrentProcessExplorer() &&
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"ScrollBar") == 0 && IsInsideShellFolderView(hwnd))
        PaneScrollBarSubclassInstall(hwnd);

    if ((_wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTreeView32") == 0 ||
         _wcsicmp(cls, L"NamespaceTreeControl") == 0) &&
        IsFilePickerNavPaneTree(hwnd))
        FilePickerBracketSubclassInstall(hwnd, FilePickerBracketNavTree);
    else if (FilePickerListShaded() && _wcsicmp(cls, L"ScrollBar") == 0 &&
             IsFilePickerListWindow(hwnd))
        FilePickerBracketSubclassInstall(hwnd, FilePickerBracketListScrollBar);
    else if (FilePickerListShaded() && IsFilePickerListHost(hwnd))
        FilePickerBracketSubclassInstall(hwnd, FilePickerBracketListHost);

    // Mica on the picker: the dialog's own frame never asks for a backdrop,
    // so it is seeded once its nav pane exists (root known to be a picker).
    if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"NamespaceTreeControl") == 0 && FilePickerMicaActive()) {
        if (HWND root = FilePickerRoot(hwnd))
            FilePickerApplyBackdrop(root);
    }

    if (g_settings.ModernSeparators &&
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"msctls_statusbar32") == 0)
    {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_auxSubclassOwnersMutex);
            g_statusBarSubclassOwners.insert(hwnd);
        }
        if (!WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                hwnd, StatusBarSubclassProc, 0)) {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_auxSubclassOwnersMutex);
            g_statusBarSubclassOwners.erase(hwnd);
        }
    }

    // Rides on RoundedButtons -- the setting that makes us paint the WinUI
    // accent rail/thumb on this control in the first place (see the
    // "Trackbar" DrawThemeBackground branch). No point double-buffering a
    // trackbar we never touch.
    if (g_settings.RoundedButtons && _wcsicmp(cls, L"msctls_trackbar32") == 0)
        ApplyTrackbarDoubleBuffer(hwnd);

    if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"Button") == 0)
        TryInstallSplitButtonChevronSubclass(hwnd);

    // Legacy address bar repaint-desync fix (see AddrBarSyncSubclassProc
    // above). Only the two classes it actually acts on need the subclass --
    // gated on the same two scope filters used elsewhere in this file for
    // "real Explorer or a common Open/Save file-picker dialog" (the latter
    // roots at #32770, not CabinetWClass/ExploreWClass, so IsInsideExplorer
    // alone would miss it), plus a ReBarWindow32 ancestry check so an
    // unrelated ComboBoxEx32/ComboBox elsewhere never gets touched.
    if (g_settings.ExplorerSection && g_settings.LegacyRebarControls &&
        (_wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboBoxEx32") == 0 || _wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboBox") == 0) &&
        (IsInsideExplorer(hwnd) || IsInsidePickerNamespaceTree(hwnd)) &&
        AddrBarSyncUnderRebar(hwnd)) {
        AddrBarSyncTryInstall(hwnd);
    }

    const bool isTreeView = (_wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTreeView32") == 0);
    const bool isListView = (_wcsicmp(cls, L"SysListView32") == 0);
    const bool isToolbar = (_wcsicmp(cls, L"ToolbarWindow32") == 0);

    // The Explorer theme itself is a modern visual style, not a dark-mode
    // color override. Apply it in light mode too, but leave dark colors and
    // AllowDarkModeForWindow inside the dark-mode block below (that path
    // stays unconditional -- DarkMode_Explorer is load-bearing there for
    // the dark colors to actually render, not just cosmetic).
    if ((isTreeView || isListView) && (!g_darkModeActive || g_darkModeExcluded) &&
        g_settings.ExplorerSection && g_settings.RoundedButtons &&
        !IsInsideExcludedFilePicker(hwnd)) {
        SetExplorerFamilyTheme(hwnd);
        if (isTreeView) {
            TreeView_SetExtendedStyle(hwnd, TVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER, TVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER);
            TreeDoubleBufferTrack(hwnd);
        }
    }

    // ── Per-thread WH_CBT hook for context menus ─────────────────────────
    // Install on every thread that creates a visible top-level window so
    // that future #32768 popups on that thread are caught via CbtProc.
    // Skip message-only windows (parent=HWND_MESSAGE) — their threads
    // never show context menus.
    if (g_settings.ModernContextMenus) {
        LONG_PTR sty = GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE);
        bool isTopLevel = !(sty & WS_CHILD);
        bool isMsgOnly = (hWndParent == HWND_MESSAGE);
        if (isTopLevel && !isMsgOnly) {
            InstallCbtHookForThread();
        }
    }

    // ── Legacy dropdown popups: full acrylic treatment ───────────────────
    // DropDown/ViewControlClass are menu-themed WS_POPUP roots. Their creation
    // can be missed by the per-thread CbtProc hook, so call the idempotent
    // acrylic installer directly from the creation hook.
    if (g_settings.ModernContextMenus
        && (_wcsicmp(cls, L"DropDown") == 0
            || _wcsicmp(cls, L"ViewControlClass") == 0)) {
        MenuTryInstallAcrylic(hwnd);
    }

    // ── DropDown/ViewControlClass children: SysListView32 dark mode ──────
    // SysListView32 children of legacy dropdowns don't inherit dark mode from
    // the parent's DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE attribute -- need explicit
    // AllowDarkModeForWindow + SetWindowTheme or they render with light theme
    // parts. GetAncestor(GA_ROOT) guards against intermediate containers.
    // This only covers pill/text/item rendering; the DropDown's own
    // background is handled separately via MenuTryInstallAcrylic.
    if (IsCustomDarkModeAllowed()
        && _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysListView32") == 0) {
        HWND root = GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT);
        if (root && root != hwnd) {
            wchar_t rootCls[32] = {};
            GetClassNameW(root, rootCls, 32);
            if (_wcsicmp(rootCls, L"DropDown") == 0
                || _wcsicmp(rootCls, L"ViewControlClass") == 0) {
                if (g_cbdAllowDark) g_cbdAllowDark(hwnd, true);
                SetWindowTheme(hwnd, L"DarkMode_Explorer", nullptr);
                ListView_SetBkColor(hwnd, Win32MainDark);
                ListView_SetTextBkColor(hwnd, Win32MainDark);
                ListView_SetTextColor(hwnd, WinUI::Dark::TextFillColorPrimary);
                ListView_SetExtendedListViewStyleEx(hwnd, LVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER, LVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER);
                RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
                    RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
            }
        }
    }

    // Light mode's white tab-pane edge fill -- RoundedTabPane's counterpart
    // to the dark pane extension below. Root dialogs only, same as
    // PropertyDialogSubclassProc's own extension. Gated on RoundedTabPane at
    // install time (not inside the subclass's WM_ERASEBKGND) since this
    // subclass has no other job, unlike PropertyDialogSubclassProc.
    //
    // Gated on !IsSystemDarkMode(), not !IsCustomDarkModeAllowed(): the
    // latter is also false for a dark-mode-excluded process on an otherwise-
    // dark system, which would wrongly get this white fill.
    if (g_settings.RoundedTabPane && !IsSystemDarkMode() &&
        wcscmp(cls, L"#32770") == 0 &&
        !(GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE) & WS_CHILD)) {
        if (WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                hwnd, PropertySheetLightPaneSubclassProc, kPropertySheetLightPaneSubclassId))
            SetPropW(hwnd, kPropertySheetLightPaneSubclassMarker, (HANDLE)1);
    }

    // Light file picker chrome; nested template dialogs included (see
    // FilePickerLightSubclassProc).
    if (g_settings.ModernSeparators && !IsSystemDarkMode() &&
        wcscmp(cls, L"#32770") == 0) {
        if (WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
                hwnd, FilePickerLightSubclassProc, kFilePickerLightSubclassId))
            SetPropW(hwnd, kFilePickerLightSubclassMarker, (HANDLE)1);
    }

    // Dark mode: DWM dark title bar for ALL top-level windows.
    // SetSysColors handles control colors; DWM handles title bar + border.
    if (IsCustomDarkModeAllowed()) {
        // Top-level windows: dark title bar + border + AllowDark.
        // A top-level window is any window WITHOUT WS_CHILD. This includes:
        //   - Overlapped windows (WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW) with or without owner
        //   - Popup windows (WS_POPUP)
        // Previous check (!hWndParent || WS_POPUP) missed overlapped windows
        // WITH an owner — hWndParent is the OWNER for non-child windows, but
        // CreateWindowEx uses the same parameter for both parent and owner.
        LONG_PTR style = GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE);
        bool isTopLevel = !(style & WS_CHILD);
        // Skip Explorer's CabinetWClass — it manages its own dark mode via XAML.
        // But CP/Tools CabinetWClass (comctl32.dll WndProc) DOES need AllowDark.
        bool isExplorerMain = false;
        if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"CabinetWClass") == 0 || _wcsicmp(cls, L"ExploreWClass") == 0) {
            WNDPROC wp = (WNDPROC)GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_WNDPROC);
            HMODULE hmod = nullptr;
            if (wp && GetModuleHandleExW(
                    GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS |
                    GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
                    (LPCWSTR)wp, &hmod)) {
                wchar_t path[MAX_PATH] = {};
                GetModuleFileNameW(hmod, path, MAX_PATH);
                const wchar_t* sep = wcsrchr(path, L'\\');
                // Explorer uses atlthunk.dll → skip (manages own dark mode)
                // CP/Tools uses comctl32.dll → apply AllowDark
                isExplorerMain = !(sep && _wcsicmp(sep + 1, L"comctl32.dll") == 0);
            } else {
                isExplorerMain = true; // can't determine → skip to be safe
            }
        }
        // Same reasoning as isExplorerMain, extended to child controls: real
        // Explorer (CabinetWClass/ExploreWClass) manages dark mode for its
        // entire window tree natively. The per-control
        // AllowDarkModeForWindow/SetWindowTheme calls below must skip it --
        // they were found to coincide with the modern grouped ListView's
        // group-header font-height bug.
        bool cabinetRooted = IsInsideExplorer(hwnd);
        if (isTopLevel && !isExplorerMain) {
            // Skip ComboLBox: DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE activates the
            // system's dark theme renderer which uses an internal highlight
            // color (FFFFFF) ignoring GetSysColor(COLOR_HIGHLIGHT). Without
            // it, the light renderer reads our hooked accent color correctly.
            bool isComboLBox = (_wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboLBox") == 0);
            if (isComboLBox) goto skip_dark_toplevel;
            // Apply ForceDark ONCE per process. SetPreferredAppMode is
            // process-wide — calling it on every top-level creation is
            // wasteful (FlushMenuThemes invalidates ALL menu theme caches
            // each time, ~1ms per call). Already applied at init for most
            // processes; this covers late-loading cases.
            static bool s_appModeApplied = false;
            if (!s_appModeApplied && !IsCurrentProcessExplorer() && g_setAppMode) {
                g_setAppMode(2); // ForceDark
                if (g_flushMenuThemes) g_flushMenuThemes();
                if (g_refreshColorPolicy) g_refreshColorPolicy();
                s_appModeApplied = true;
            }
            BOOL alreadyDark = FALSE;
            DwmGetWindowAttribute(hwnd, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE, &alreadyDark, sizeof(alreadyDark));
            if (!alreadyDark) {
                BOOL darkAttr = TRUE;
                DwmSetWindowAttribute(hwnd, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE, &darkAttr, sizeof(darkAttr));
                if (g_cbdAllowDark) g_cbdAllowDark(hwnd, true);
                // UseImmersiveDarkModeColors property — tells the system to
                // use dark immersive colors for this window. Covers edge cases
                // that AllowDarkModeForWindow alone doesn't (e.g. some dialog
                // backgrounds, tooltip colors). From ysc3839/win32-darkmode.
                SetPropW(hwnd, L"UseImmersiveDarkModeColors", (HANDLE)(INT_PTR)1);
                SetPropW(hwnd, kDarkWindowAppliedMarker, (HANDLE)1);
                HwndDarkCacheInvalidate();
            }
        }
        skip_dark_toplevel:

        // #32770 dialogs: add subclass for WM_CTLCOLOR + fix class brush.
        // The class brush is cached at class registration (before our hook).
        // Set it to dark to fix the FIRST WM_ERASEBKGND (during WM_INITDIALOG,
        // before SetWindowSubclass runs).
        if (wcscmp(cls, L"#32770") == 0) {
            if (!g_win32MainDarkBrush)
                g_win32MainDarkBrush = CreateSolidBrush(Win32MainDark);
            SetPropertyDialogClassBrush(true, hwnd);
            ApplyPropertyDialogDarkMode(hwnd);
        }
        // Per-control dark theming — fixes controls that cache colors at creation
        // or need explicit theme change (TreeView, ListView, ComboBox).
        //
        // (Win11), the top-level call already themed all children. Individual
        // AllowDark calls are redundant. We only need:
        //   - Explorer-only SetWindowTheme (DarkMode_Explorer/CFD/ItemsView)
        if (isTreeView) {
            if (!cabinetRooted) {
                if (g_cbdAllowDark) g_cbdAllowDark(hwnd, true);
                // DarkMode_Explorer for Explorer, plain Explorer for
                // non-Explorer. "Explorer" theme gives modern visuals
                // (rounded selection, hover) even without dark mode.
                // "DarkMode_Explorer" adds dark colors but sends
                // WM_THEMECHANGED which deadlocks MFC/ProfUIS apps.
                SetExplorerFamilyTheme(hwnd);
            }
            TreeView_SetBkColor(hwnd, Win32MainDark);
            TreeView_SetTextColor(hwnd, WinUI::Dark::TextFillColorPrimary);
            TreeView_SetExtendedStyle(hwnd, TVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER, TVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER);
            TreeDoubleBufferTrack(hwnd);
        }
        else if (isListView) {
            // Desktop icon view (Progman/WorkerW-rooted SysListView32) needs
            // the same exclusion as cabinetRooted -- forcing an opaque
            // background here hides the wallpaper behind it, same bug as
            // ModeSwitchChildProc's, just reached via window creation
            // instead of a live light<->dark mode switch.
            if (!(cabinetRooted || IsInsideDesktop(hwnd))) {
                if (g_cbdAllowDark) g_cbdAllowDark(hwnd, true);
                SetExplorerFamilyTheme(hwnd);
                ListView_SetBkColor(hwnd, Win32MainDark);
                ListView_SetTextBkColor(hwnd, Win32MainDark);
                ListView_SetTextColor(hwnd, WinUI::Dark::TextFillColorPrimary);
            }
        }
        else if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"Button") == 0) {
            if (g_cbdAllowDark) g_cbdAllowDark(hwnd, true);
            // SetDarkExplorerOrDefaultTheme still calls SetWindowTheme(hwnd,
            // NULL, NULL) the first time even in non-Explorer processes --
            // a real API call (never made before) that sends WM_THEMECHANGED
            // and deadlocked/crashed MFC/ProfUIS-skinned third-party apps
            // (Revo Uninstaller Pro). Gate the call itself to Explorer only,
            // matching the old, proven-safe behavior.
            if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer() && !cabinetRooted)
                SetDarkExplorerOrDefaultTheme(hwnd);
        }
        else if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboBox") == 0) {
            if (g_cbdAllowDark) g_cbdAllowDark(hwnd, true);
            if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer() && !cabinetRooted)
                SetWindowTheme(hwnd, L"DarkMode_CFD", nullptr);
        }
        else if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboLBox") == 0) {
            // No AllowDark — dark renderer ignores GetSysColor(COLOR_HIGHLIGHT)
        }
        else if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"Edit") == 0) {
            if (g_cbdAllowDark) g_cbdAllowDark(hwnd, true);
            if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer() && !cabinetRooted)
                SetWindowTheme(hwnd, L"DarkMode_CFD", nullptr);
        }
        else if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"Static") == 0) {
            // Static isn't one of this mod's manually-painted classes
            // either (it relies on the WM_CTLCOLORSTATIC interception above
            // for its own colors).
            if (g_cbdAllowDark)
                g_cbdAllowDark(hwnd, true);
        }
        else if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"SysHeader32") == 0) {
            if (g_cbdAllowDark) g_cbdAllowDark(hwnd, true);
            // Replaces SetItemsViewOrDefaultTheme outright -- full WM_PAINT
            // ownership makes whatever theme is set moot. Scoped the same way
            // SetItemsViewOrDefaultTheme itself always was (Explorer-family,
            // non-cabinet -- property dialogs, Folder Options, etc.): the
            // divider-line bug this fixes only exists in the DarkMode_ItemsView
            // renderer that theme applies, which SetItemsViewOrDefaultTheme
            // only ever requested inside Explorer. Dropping that check here
            // would take over WM_PAINT for every third-party app's own
            // SysHeader32 too, discarding alignment, sort arrows, images,
            // owner-draw and NM_CUSTOMDRAW that HdrDarkPaintDraw doesn't
            // know how to reproduce -- uxtheme's own dark header renderer
            // already handles all of that correctly outside Explorer.
            if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer() && !cabinetRooted && !IsCurrentProcessRegedit())
                HdrDarkPaintInstall(hwnd);
        }
        else if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"msctls_trackbar32") == 0 ||
                 _wcsicmp(cls, L"msctls_statusbar32") == 0 ||
                 _wcsicmp(cls, L"ToolbarWindow32") == 0 ||
                 _wcsicmp(cls, L"ReBarWindow32") == 0 ||
                 _wcsicmp(cls, L"ScrollBar") == 0 ||
                 _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTabControl32") == 0 ||
                 _wcsicmp(cls, L"ListBox") == 0) {
            if (g_cbdAllowDark) g_cbdAllowDark(hwnd, true);
            if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer() && !cabinetRooted)
                SetDarkExplorerOrDefaultTheme(hwnd);
        }
        else if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"CHECKLIST_ACLUI") == 0) {
            if (g_cbdAllowDark) g_cbdAllowDark(hwnd, true);
            if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer() && !cabinetRooted)
                SetDarkExplorerOrDefaultTheme(hwnd);
            // AllowDarkModeForWindow/SetWindowTheme above don't touch this
            // control's WM_ERASEBKGND class-brush fill (see
            // AclChecklistSubclassProc's own comment) -- subclass it
            // directly since that's the only path that can.
            AclChecklistInstall(hwnd);
        }

        else {
            // Catch-all: AllowDarkModeForWindow for unrecognized controls.
            // Skip known non-visual/message-only classes that never render
            // Win32 controls — AllowDark on these is pure overhead.
            static const wchar_t* kSkipClasses[] = {
                L"CicMarshalWndClass",          // Text Services Framework
                L"OleMainThreadWndClass",       // OLE/COM message pump
                L"GDI+ Hook Window Class",      // GDI+ internal
                L"IME",                         // Input Method Editor
                L"MSCTFIME UI",                 // TSF IME
                L"WorkerW",                     // Desktop shell worker
                L"tooltips_class32",            // Tooltips (handled separately)
            };
            bool skip = false;
            for (const wchar_t* sc : kSkipClasses) {
                if (_wcsicmp(cls, sc) == 0) { skip = true; break; }
            }
            // Also skip XAML-internal classes (start with Windows.UI. or XAML)
            if (!skip && (wcsncmp(cls, L"Windows.UI.", 11) == 0
                       || wcsncmp(cls, L"XAML", 4) == 0
                       || wcsncmp(cls, L"HitTest", 7) == 0)) {
                skip = true;
            }
            if (!skip) {
                if (g_cbdAllowDark)
                    g_cbdAllowDark(hwnd, true);
            }
        }
    }

    // Tab flicker fix: subclass in BOTH dark and light modes, rides on
    // RoundedTabPane (the closest existing setting, even though the fix
    // itself applies to every tab control, not just property-sheet ones).
    if (g_settings.RoundedTabPane && _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTabControl32") == 0) {
        TabFlickerFixInstallWindow(hwnd);
    }

    // Retroactive pin swap — covers TVM_SETIMAGELIST sent during creation
    // (inside NtUserCreateWindowEx, before SendMessageW_hook can intercept).
    if (g_settings.FluentPinIcon && g_settings.ExplorerSection
        && isTreeView) {
        if (GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(hwnd) && !PinIsDisabledDragDropTreeView(hwnd)) {
            HIMAGELIST hState = TreeView_GetImageList(hwnd, TVSIL_STATE);
            HIMAGELIST ours = (HIMAGELIST)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropPinList);
            if (hState && hState != ours)
                PinInstallCustomList(hwnd, hState);
        }
    }
    // Skip D3D/WebView2 render window classes — installing subclasses or
    // calling SetWindowsHookEx on their threads breaks DComp presentation.
    if (wcsncmp(cls, L"Chrome_", 7) == 0 ||
        wcsncmp(cls, L"Intermediate", 12) == 0) {
        return hwnd;
    }

    // ComboBox DWM — rounded corners + backdrop on ComboLBox / Auto-Suggest
    if (g_settings.ModernContextMenus)
        CbdInstallWindow(hwnd);

    // Modern tooltips: rounded corners + per-window dark mode
    // Adapts to the OWNER window's theme, not the system theme.
    // hWndParent is the tooltip's owner (the control that created it).

    // ── Modern border subclass for WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE / WS_STATICEDGE / WS_BORDER controls ──
    // Paints a rounded line over the 3D NC border (like GroupBox). A sunken-
    // edge Static can be a thin separator or a boxed panel, so the branch
    // below tells them apart by shape; EditFocusLine takes the accent-line
    // kind, everything else the plain rounded border.
    if ((g_settings.ModernSeparators || g_settings.EditFocusLine) &&
        (GetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE) & WS_CHILD)) {
        const DWORD exs = GetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE);
        const DWORD sty = GetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE);
        if ((exs & (WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE | WS_EX_STATICEDGE)) || (sty & WS_BORDER)) {
            if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"msctls_hotkey32") == 0 &&
                g_settings.EditFocusLine) {
                if (ModernBorderInstall(hwnd, 3)) {
                    RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
                        RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_NOERASE);
                }
            }
            // Skip Edit controls — PaintControlBorder via DrawThemeBackground
            // already handles their rounded border + accent focus line.
            else if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"Edit") == 0)
                ; // no subclass needed
            // Plain Static controls: decide line vs box by shape, once, at
            // creation size (these aren't normally resized afterward), and
            // thread the decision through dwRefData rather than re-checking
            // the class name on every WM_NCPAINT.
            else if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"Static") == 0) {
                RECT rcStatic;
                GetWindowRect(hwnd, &rcStatic);
                const int w = rcStatic.right - rcStatic.left;
                const int h = rcStatic.bottom - rcStatic.top;
                const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);
                const int lineThreshold = MulDiv(6, dpi, 96);
                const bool isLine = (h <= lineThreshold && w > h) ||
                                    (w <= lineThreshold && h > w);
                if (isLine && g_settings.ModernSeparators)
                    ModernBorderInstall(hwnd, 2);
                else if (!isLine && g_settings.ModernSeparators)
                    ModernBorderInstall(hwnd, 0);
            }
            // Other controls: subtle GroupBox-style rounded border
            else if (g_settings.ModernSeparators &&
                     (_wcsicmp(cls, L"ListBox") == 0
                  || _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysListView32") == 0
                  || _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTreeView32") == 0
                  || _wcsicmp(cls, L"RichEdit20W") == 0
                  || _wcsicmp(cls, L"RICHEDIT50W") == 0
                  || _wcsicmp(cls, L"RichEditD2DPT") == 0
                  || (sty & WS_BORDER))
                  // ComboLBox has its own popup/scrollbar painting path.
                  && _wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboLBox") != 0) {
                ModernBorderInstall(hwnd, 0);
            }
        }
    }

    if (g_settings.ModernTooltips && _wcsicmp(cls, L"tooltips_class32") == 0) {
        TooltipApplyAcrylicEffects(hwnd, hWndParent);
    }

    if (isTreeView)
        ApplyTreeRuntimeSettings(hwnd);

    // ListView — enable double-buffer (modern marquee selection)
    if (isListView) {
        DWORD exSt = (DWORD)SendMessageW(hwnd, LVM_GETEXTENDEDLISTVIEWSTYLE, 0, 0);
        if (!(exSt & LVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER))
            SendMessageW(hwnd, LVM_SETEXTENDEDLISTVIEWSTYLE, LVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER, LVS_EX_DOUBLEBUFFER);
        ApplyDiskCleanupCheckboxListViewDark(hwnd);
    }

    // Toolbar — enable double-buffer, rides on the ReBar modernization
    // toggle (same control family). Unlike TVM/LVM's mask+value
    // SETEXTENDEDSTYLE, TB_SETEXTENDEDSTYLE replaces the WHOLE value
    // (wParam unused) -- OR with the existing style instead of just
    // setting our bit, or this would wipe out MIXEDBUTTONS/DRAWDDARROWS/
    // etc. that the toolbar may already have.
    if (isToolbar && g_settings.ExplorerSection && g_settings.LegacyRebarControls)
        ApplyToolbarDoubleBuffer(hwnd);

    return hwnd;
}


// ── Resource cleanup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

static void CleanupResources()
{
    if (g_acrylicMenuBorderBrush) {
        DeleteObject(g_acrylicMenuBorderBrush);
        g_acrylicMenuBorderBrush = nullptr;
    }
    if (g_acrylicMenuBorderBrushLight) {
        DeleteObject(g_acrylicMenuBorderBrushLight);
        g_acrylicMenuBorderBrushLight = nullptr;
    }
    ShellIconReleaseSvgResources();
    // g_d2dFactory is MULTI_THREADED — safe to release from any thread
    if (g_d2dFactory) { g_d2dFactory->Release(); g_d2dFactory = nullptr; }
}

// -- Subclass removal helpers --

static BOOL CALLBACK RemoveSubclassesFromWindow(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    ExplorerDialogTextRemove(hwnd);
    RemoveCustomDarkModeFromWindow(hwnd);
    DefViewBorderUninstall(hwnd);
    ModernBorderUninstall(hwnd);
    if (GetPropW(hwnd, PROP_TV_SUB)) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, TreeViewSubclass);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, PROP_TV_SUB);
        TreeInsertMarkClearProperties(hwnd);
    }
    TreeRuntimeRestoreStyleBit(hwnd, PROP_TV_HASLINES_ORIG, TVS_HASLINES);
    TreeRuntimeRestoreStyleBit(hwnd, PROP_TV_NOTOOLTIPS_ORIG, TVS_NOTOOLTIPS);
    TreeRuntimeRestoreStyleBit(hwnd, PROP_TV_TRACKSELECT_ORIG, TVS_TRACKSELECT);
    if (GetPropW(hwnd, PROP_TV_TRACKSELECT_CURSOR_SUB)) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, TvTrackSelectCursorSubclassProc);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, PROP_TV_TRACKSELECT_CURSOR_SUB);
    }
    // These three are installed with raw SetWindowSubclass and previously
    // only removed themselves in their own WM_NCDESTROY -- if the mod is
    // disabled while such a window is still alive (e.g. Explorer's nav pane
    // is long-lived, so TreeCursorSubclassProc is essentially always
    // installed), the subclass proc stayed in comctl32's chain after the
    // DLL unloaded, and the next message dispatched into freed memory.
    TreeCursorRemoveFromWindow(hwnd);
    SplitButtonChevronRemoveFromWindow(hwnd);
    if (GetPropW(hwnd, kClassicDlgToolbarSubclassProp)) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, ClassicDlgToolbarSubclassProc);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kClassicDlgToolbarSubclassProp);
    }
    AddrBarSyncRemoveChildEnum(hwnd, 0);
    if (GetPropW(hwnd, kAclChecklistSubclassProp)) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, AclChecklistSubclassProc);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kAclChecklistSubclassProp);
    }
    if (GetPropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkSubclassed)) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, ExplorerSysLinkSubclassProc);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkSubclassed);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkTracking);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkPressIx);
        ExplorerSysLinkFadeDestroyState(hwnd);
        if (auto* cache = (ExplorerSysLinkTextCache*)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkTextCache)) {
            delete cache;
            RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropExpLinkTextCache);
        }
    }
    if (GetPropW(hwnd, kPropertySheetLightPaneSubclassMarker)) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, PropertySheetLightPaneSubclassProc);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropertySheetLightPaneSubclassMarker);
    }
    if (GetPropW(hwnd, kFilePickerLightSubclassMarker)) {
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hwnd, FilePickerLightSubclassProc);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kFilePickerLightSubclassMarker);
    }
    // GlyphSampleEraseColor sets this on whatever g_tlsPaintHwnd/WindowFromDC
    // resolves to at erase time, which is broader than the two subclasses
    // (TreeCursorSubclassProc, PlacesBarAnimSubclassProc) that remove it on
    // their own teardown -- sweep it here too so it can't outlive the mod on
    // some other window.
    RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropGlyphEraseWarm);
    return TRUE;
}

static void ModernBorderApplyHotkey(HWND hwnd)
{
    wchar_t cls[32] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)) ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"msctls_hotkey32") != 0) {
        return;
    }

    DWORD_PTR kind = 0;
    const bool installed = ModernBorderGetKind(hwnd, &kind);
    const DWORD style = GetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE);
    const DWORD exStyle = GetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE);
    const bool hasBorder = (style & WS_BORDER) != 0 ||
        (exStyle & (WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE | WS_EX_STATICEDGE)) != 0;
    // Mirrors the creation-time fallback chain (see the msctls_hotkey32
    // branch above): EditFocusLine gets the dedicated accent-line kind;
    // otherwise fall back to the plain rounded border like any other
    // bordered control, instead of dropping to the native border entirely.
    const DWORD_PTR wantKind = g_settings.EditFocusLine ? 3 : 0;
    const bool shouldInstall = hasBorder &&
        (g_settings.EditFocusLine || g_settings.ModernSeparators);

    bool changed = false;
    if (shouldInstall && (!installed || kind != wantKind))
        changed = ModernBorderInstall(hwnd, wantKind);
    else if (!shouldInstall && installed)
        changed = ModernBorderUninstall(hwnd);

    if (changed) {
        RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
            RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_NOERASE);
    }
}

static void ModernBorderReconcileGroupBox(HWND hwnd)
{
    wchar_t cls[32] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)) ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"msctls_hotkey32") == 0) {
        return;
    }

    DWORD_PTR kind = 0;
    const bool installed = ModernBorderGetKind(hwnd, &kind);
    bool shouldInstall = false;

    if (g_settings.ModernSeparators &&
        (GetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE) & WS_CHILD) &&
        !DefViewBorderIsEligible(hwnd)) {
        const DWORD style = GetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE);
        const DWORD exStyle = GetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE);
        const bool hasBorder = (style & WS_BORDER) != 0 ||
            (exStyle & (WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE | WS_EX_STATICEDGE)) != 0;

        if (hasBorder && _wcsicmp(cls, L"Edit") != 0 &&
            _wcsicmp(cls, L"ComboLBox") != 0) {
            if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"Static") == 0) {
                RECT rc = {};
                if (GetWindowRect(hwnd, &rc)) {
                    const int w = rc.right - rc.left;
                    const int h = rc.bottom - rc.top;
                    UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);
                    if (!dpi)
                        dpi = USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
                    const int lineThreshold = MulDiv(6, dpi, 96);
                    shouldInstall = !((h <= lineThreshold && w > h) ||
                                      (w <= lineThreshold && h > w));
                }
            } else {
                shouldInstall =
                    _wcsicmp(cls, L"ListBox") == 0 ||
                    _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysListView32") == 0 ||
                    _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTreeView32") == 0 ||
                    _wcsicmp(cls, L"RichEdit20W") == 0 ||
                    _wcsicmp(cls, L"RICHEDIT50W") == 0 ||
                    _wcsicmp(cls, L"RichEditD2DPT") == 0 ||
                    (style & WS_BORDER) != 0;
            }
        }
    }

    bool changed = false;
    if (shouldInstall) {
        if (!installed)
            changed = ModernBorderInstall(hwnd, 0);
    } else if (installed && kind == 0) {
        changed = ModernBorderUninstall(hwnd);
    }

    if (changed) {
        RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
            RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_NOERASE);
    }
}

static BOOL CALLBACK ModernBorderApplyGroupBoxChildEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    ModernBorderReconcileGroupBox(hwnd);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK ModernBorderApplyGroupBoxEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId())
        return TRUE;
    ModernBorderReconcileGroupBox(hwnd);
    EnumChildWindows(hwnd, ModernBorderApplyGroupBoxChildEnum, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK ModernBorderApplyHotkeyChildEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    ModernBorderApplyHotkey(hwnd);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK ModernBorderApplyHotkeyEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId())
        return TRUE;
    ModernBorderApplyHotkey(hwnd);
    EnumChildWindows(hwnd, ModernBorderApplyHotkeyChildEnum, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK EnumWindowsRemoveSubclasses(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId()) return TRUE;
    RemoveSubclassesFromWindow(hwnd, 0);
    EnumChildWindows(hwnd, RemoveSubclassesFromWindow, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

// ============================================================================
// Settings + Lifecycle
// ============================================================================

static Settings LoadSettings()
{
    Settings next{};
    next.GeneralSection   = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"GeneralSection.Enabled");
    next.ModernInsert     = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"GeneralSection.ModernInsertMark");
    {
        auto s = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(Wh_GetStringSetting(L"GeneralSection.InsertMarkColor"));
        next.InsertMarkUseAccent = _wcsicmp(s, L"accent") == 0;
        if (!next.InsertMarkUseAccent && wcslen(s) == 6) {
            DWORD v = wcstoul(s, nullptr, 16);
            next.InsertMarkClr = RGB((v>>16)&0xFF, (v>>8)&0xFF, v&0xFF);
        }
    }
    {
        // ModernFocusRect is a string enum: "modern"=0, "hidden"=1
        auto sv = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(Wh_GetStringSetting(L"GeneralSection.ModernFocusRect"));
        const wchar_t* sp = sv;
        if (wcscmp(sp, L"modern") == 0) next.ModernFocusRect = 0;
        else if (wcscmp(sp, L"hidden") == 0)    next.ModernFocusRect = 1;
        else                                     next.ModernFocusRect = 0;
    }
    next.ProgressBars     = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"GeneralSection.ProgressBars");
    next.NormalizeDragDrop = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"GeneralSection.NormalizeDragDrop");
    next.ModernTooltips    = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"GeneralSection.ModernTooltips");
    next.ModernScrollbars = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"GeneralSection.ModernScrollbars");
    {
        next.ModernContextMenus = FALSE;
        next.MenuWinUiMetrics = FALSE;
        auto mode = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(
            Wh_GetStringSetting(L"GeneralSection.ModernContextMenus"));
        if (wcscmp(mode, L"winui") == 0 || wcscmp(mode, L"native") == 0) {
            next.ModernContextMenus = TRUE;
            next.MenuWinUiMetrics = wcscmp(mode, L"winui") == 0;
        } else if (wcscmp(mode, L"off") != 0) {
            // Numeric values keep the former checkbox and its saved metrics.
            next.ModernContextMenus = wcscmp(mode, L"1") == 0 ||
                _wcsicmp(mode, L"true") == 0;
            auto metrics = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(
                Wh_GetStringSetting(L"GeneralSection.MenuItemMetrics"));
            next.MenuWinUiMetrics = wcscmp(metrics, L"native") != 0;
        }
    }
    {
        auto style = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(
            Wh_GetStringSetting(L"GeneralSection.MenuCornerStyle"));
        // One option drives both surfaces; "default" keeps the Windows 11 look
        // of round menus over small-round dropdowns.
        if      (wcscmp(style, L"round")  == 0) { next.MenuCornerStyle = 2; next.CbCornerStyle = 2; }
        else if (wcscmp(style, L"smallround") == 0) { next.MenuCornerStyle = 3; next.CbCornerStyle = 3; }
        else if (wcscmp(style, L"square") == 0) { next.MenuCornerStyle = 1; next.CbCornerStyle = 1; }
        else                                    { next.MenuCornerStyle = 2; next.CbCornerStyle = 3; }
    }
    next.MenuHoverRadius    = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"GeneralSection.MenuHoverRadius");
    next.RoundedButtons   = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"GeneralSection.RoundedButtons");
    next.AccentGradients  = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"GeneralSection.AccentGradients");
    next.ModernSeparators = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"GeneralSection.ModernSeparators");
    {
        next.RoundedTabPane = FALSE;
        auto mode = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(
            Wh_GetStringSetting(L"GeneralSection.RoundedTabPane"));
        if (wcscmp(mode, L"winui") == 0 || wcscmp(mode, L"winui_single") == 0) {
            next.RoundedTabPane = TRUE;
            next.SingleLinePropertyTabs = wcscmp(mode, L"winui_single") == 0;
        } else if (wcscmp(mode, L"native") != 0) {
            next.RoundedTabPane = wcscmp(mode, L"1") == 0 ||
                _wcsicmp(mode, L"true") == 0;
            next.SingleLinePropertyTabs = next.RoundedTabPane &&
                Wh_GetIntSetting(L"GeneralSection.SingleLinePropertyTabs");
        }
    }
    next.EnableDarkMode      = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"GeneralSection.EnableDarkMode");
    // DarkMode is automatic (follows system)
    {
        auto hex = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(Wh_GetStringSetting(L"GeneralSection.CustomAccentColor"));
        next.CustomAccentColor = 0;
        next.CustomAccentColorSet = false;
        if (hex[0] == L'#' && wcslen(hex) == 7) {
            unsigned r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
            if (swscanf(hex + 1, L"%02x%02x%02x", &r, &g, &b) == 3) {
                next.CustomAccentColor = RGB(r, g, b);
                next.CustomAccentColorSet = true;
            }
        }
    }
    next.NavPaneHoverFade = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"ExplorerSection.NavPaneHoverFade");
    next.NeutralSelection = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"ExplorerSection.NeutralSelection");

    next.ExplorerSection      = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"ExplorerSection.Enabled");
    {
        auto mode = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(
            Wh_GetStringSetting(L"ExplorerSection.AccentColorize"));
        if (wcscmp(mode, L"off") == 0 || wcscmp(mode, L"marquee") == 0 ||
            wcscmp(mode, L"interface") == 0 || wcscmp(mode, L"all") == 0) {
            next.AccentColorize = wcscmp(mode, L"interface") == 0 ||
                wcscmp(mode, L"all") == 0;
            next.AccentMarquee = wcscmp(mode, L"marquee") == 0 ||
                wcscmp(mode, L"all") == 0;
        } else {
            next.AccentColorize = wcscmp(mode, L"1") == 0 ||
                _wcsicmp(mode, L"true") == 0;
            next.AccentMarquee = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"ExplorerSection.AccentMarquee");
        }
    }
    {
        auto sv = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(
            Wh_GetStringSetting(L"ExplorerSection.NavDivider"));
        if      (wcscmp(sv, L"remove") == 0 ||
                 wcscmp(sv, L"removestrict") == 0) next.NavDividerMode = 1;
        else if (wcscmp(sv, L"hoverreveal")  == 0) next.NavDividerMode = 2;
        else                                       next.NavDividerMode = 0;
        // Stored strict removal now uses the normal pane-aware erase path.
        // Removal and hover reveal remain mutually exclusive.
        next.RemoveNavDivider      = next.NavDividerMode == 1;
        next.NavDividerHoverReveal = next.NavDividerMode == 2;
    }
    next.NavPaneWinUIMetrics  = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"ExplorerSection.NavPaneWinUIMetrics");
    // The fake-Mica tint is only reachable while ReBar styling is enabled.
    {
        auto sv = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(
            Wh_GetStringSetting(L"ExplorerSection.LegacyRebarControls"));
        next.LegacyRebarControls = wcscmp(sv, L"off") != 0;
        next.RebarMicaTint = wcscmp(sv, L"tinted") == 0;
    }
    {
        // ExplorerMicaBackdrop: "off"=0, "full"=1, "pane"=2, "solid"=3,
        // "opaque"=4; the former checkbox's stored 1/TRUE keeps meaning full.
        auto sv = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(Wh_GetStringSetting(L"ExplorerSection.ExplorerMicaBackdrop"));
        const wchar_t* sp = sv;
        if      (wcscmp(sp, L"pane") == 0) next.ExplorerMicaBackdrop = 2;
        else if (wcscmp(sp, L"solid") == 0) next.ExplorerMicaBackdrop = 3;
        else if (wcscmp(sp, L"opaque") == 0) next.ExplorerMicaBackdrop = 4;
        else if (wcscmp(sp, L"full") == 0 || wcscmp(sp, L"1") == 0 ||
                 _wcsicmp(sp, L"true") == 0) next.ExplorerMicaBackdrop = 1;
        else                               next.ExplorerMicaBackdrop = 0;
    }
    {
        auto sv = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(
            Wh_GetStringSetting(L"ExplorerSection.StatusBarWidth"));
        next.StatusBarWidth = wcscmp(sv, L"nobuttons") == 0 ? 2
                            : wcscmp(sv, L"on") == 0        ? 1
                                                            : 0;
    }
    // One option carries both "is there a pill" and "how does it move";
    // style 0 keeps its old meaning of a pill that doesn't animate.
    {
        auto sv = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(
            Wh_GetStringSetting(L"ExplorerSection.NavPanePill"));
        next.NavPanePill = wcscmp(sv, L"off") != 0;
        if      (wcscmp(sv, L"expand")     == 0) next.NavPillStyle = 1;
        else if (wcscmp(sv, L"fade")       == 0) next.NavPillStyle = 2;
        else if (wcscmp(sv, L"slide")      == 0) next.NavPillStyle = 3;
        else if (wcscmp(sv, L"winui_top")  == 0) next.NavPillStyle = 4;
        else                                     next.NavPillStyle = 0;
    }
    next.NavPaneExpandAnimation =
        Wh_GetIntSetting(L"ExplorerSection.NavPaneExpandAnimation");
    next.NavPillNoClip        = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"ExplorerSection.NavPillNoClip");
    {
        auto pinSty = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(
            Wh_GetStringSetting(L"ExplorerSection.FluentPinIcon"));
        next.FluentPinIcon = wcscmp(pinSty, L"disabled") != 0;
        next.PinIconStyle = (wcscmp(pinSty, L"filled") == 0) ? 1 : 0;
    }
    {
        auto pinClr = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(Wh_GetStringSetting(L"ExplorerSection.PinIconColor"));
        next.PinIconColor = (wcscmp(pinClr, L"gradient") == 0) ? 2
            : (wcscmp(pinClr, L"accent") == 0) ? 1 : 0;
    }
    next.PinMarginRight = std::clamp(Wh_GetIntSetting(L"ExplorerSection.PinMarginRight"), 0, 32);
    {
        auto mode = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(
            Wh_GetStringSetting(L"ExplorerSection.GlyphIcons"));
        const wchar_t* value = mode;
        if (wcscmp(value, L"static") == 0)
            next.GlyphIconMode = 1;
        else if (wcscmp(value, L"gpu") == 0)
            next.GlyphIconMode = 2;
        else if (wcscmp(value, L"native") == 0)
            next.GlyphIconMode = 3;
        else
            next.GlyphIconMode = 0;
        next.GlyphIcons = next.GlyphIconMode != 0;
        next.IconPopDirectComposition = next.GlyphIconMode == 2;
    }
    {
        auto colorMode = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(
            Wh_GetStringSetting(L"ExplorerSection.ColorNavIcons"));
        const wchar_t* cvalue = colorMode;
        if (wcscmp(cvalue, L"static") == 0)
            next.ColorNavIconMode = 1;
        else if (wcscmp(cvalue, L"animated") == 0)
            next.ColorNavIconMode = 2;
        else
            next.ColorNavIconMode = 0;
        next.ColorNavIcons = next.ColorNavIconMode != 0;
    }
    next.ModernizeShellIcons = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"ExplorerSection.ModernizeShellIcons");
    next.ModernShortcutOverlay =
        Wh_GetIntSetting(L"ExplorerSection.ModernShortcutOverlay");
    next.ShellTextDirectWrite =
        Wh_GetIntSetting(L"ExplorerSection.ShellTextDirectWrite");
    next.DialogTextDirectWrite = IsCurrentProcessExplorer() &&
        Wh_GetIntSetting(L"ExplorerSection.DialogTextDirectWrite");
    {
        auto s = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(Wh_GetStringSetting(L"ExplorerSection.GlyphColor"));
        next.GlyphColor = CLR_INVALID;
        if (s[0] == L'#' && wcslen(s) == 7) {
            unsigned r, g, b;
            if (swscanf_s(s + 1, L"%02x%02x%02x", &r, &g, &b) == 3)
                next.GlyphColor = RGB(r, g, b);
        }
    }
    next.DiskChartAccentColor = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"ExplorerSection.DiskChartAccentColor");

    // Invalidate animation-enabled cache after reload
    next.RegeditSection = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"RegeditSection.Enabled");
    {
        auto sv = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(
            Wh_GetStringSetting(L"RegeditSection.TransparentBg"));
        const wchar_t* sp = sv;
        next.RgMicaBackdrop = wcscmp(sp, L"mica") == 0;
    }
    next.RgGlyphIcons = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"RegeditSection.GlyphIcons");
    next.WinverSection = Wh_GetIntSetting(L"WinverSection.Enabled");
    {
        auto bg = WindhawkUtils::StringSetting(
            Wh_GetStringSetting(L"WinverSection.Background"));
        if      (wcscmp(bg, L"mica")    == 0) next.WinverBackground = 1;
        else if (wcscmp(bg, L"micaAlt") == 0) next.WinverBackground = 2;
        else if (wcscmp(bg, L"acrylic") == 0) next.WinverBackground = 3;
        else                                  next.WinverBackground = 0;
    }

    // Section switches produce an effective snapshot. Hooks don't need to
    // repeat parent gates, and disabling a section takes effect consistently.
    if (!next.GeneralSection) {
        next.ModernInsert = FALSE;
        next.ModernFocusRect = -1; // native passthrough, not "hidden"
        next.ProgressBars = FALSE;
        next.NormalizeDragDrop = FALSE;
        next.ModernTooltips = FALSE;
        next.ModernScrollbars = FALSE;
        next.ModernContextMenus = FALSE;
        next.RoundedButtons = FALSE;
        next.EditFocusLine = FALSE;
        next.AccentGradients = FALSE;
        next.ModernSeparators = FALSE;
        next.RoundedTabPane = FALSE;
        next.SingleLinePropertyTabs = FALSE;
        next.EnableDarkMode = FALSE;
        next.CustomAccentColor = 0;
        next.CustomAccentColorSet = false;
    }

    // Settings that ride along with a broader one. Derived after the section
    // gate so they inherit it, and before the MMC override below so that
    // override keeps its narrow meaning.
    next.EditFocusLine = next.RoundedButtons;
    next.AnimatedArrows = next.RoundedButtons;
    next.RemoveTreeLines = next.ModernSeparators;

    if (!next.ExplorerSection) {
        next.NavPaneHoverFade = FALSE;
        next.NeutralSelection = FALSE;
        next.AccentColorize = FALSE;
        next.AccentMarquee = FALSE;
        next.NavDividerMode = 0;
        next.RemoveNavDivider = FALSE;
        next.NavDividerHoverReveal = FALSE;
        next.NavPaneWinUIMetrics = FALSE;
        next.LegacyRebarControls = FALSE;
        next.RebarMicaTint = FALSE;
        next.ExplorerMicaBackdrop = 0;
        next.StatusBarWidth = 0;
        next.NavPanePill = FALSE;
        next.NavPillStyle = 0;
        next.NavPillNoClip = FALSE;
        next.FluentPinIcon = FALSE;
        next.GlyphIconMode = 0;
        next.GlyphIcons = FALSE;
        next.IconPopDirectComposition = FALSE;
        next.ColorNavIconMode = 0;
        next.ColorNavIcons = FALSE;
        next.ModernizeShellIcons = FALSE;
        next.ModernShortcutOverlay = FALSE;
        next.ShellTextDirectWrite = FALSE;
        next.DialogTextDirectWrite = FALSE;
        next.DiskChartAccentColor = FALSE;
    }
    if (!next.RegeditSection) {
        next.RgMicaBackdrop = FALSE;
