        next.RgGlyphIcons = FALSE;
    }

    // Explorer's DirectWrite label routes (folder view, desktop, navigation
    // pane) and regedit's tree keep their finished rasters; each route is
    // still enabled by its own option, and file pickers and other processes
    // draw directly.
    next.ShellTextRasterCache = IsCurrentProcessExplorer() || IsCurrentProcessRegedit();

    // Root-caused: the group box border is what crashes/mis-styles Computer
    // Management, Local Group Policy Editor, Performance Monitor, TPM
    // Management, and Hyper-V Manager -- those snap-ins are heavy with
    // property-sheet GroupBox/Static/DirectUI folder-view borders, exactly
    // what this feature touches. Force it off in MMC regardless of the
    // user's setting; every call site below reads next.ModernSeparators (or
    // the published g_settings copy of it), so this one override covers
    // all of them.
    if (IsCurrentProcessMMC()) {
        next.ModernSeparators = FALSE;
    }

    Settings previous = *GetSettings();
    auto snapshot = std::make_unique<Settings>(next);
    const Settings* published = snapshot.get();
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_settingsPublishMutex);
        g_settingsSnapshots.emplace_back(std::move(snapshot));
        g_settingsCurrent.store(published, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    g_animEnabled.store(-1, std::memory_order_release);
    return previous;
}

// x86 confirmed via a real 32-bit dui70.dll symbol dump (Windhawk Symbol
// Helper against C:\Windows\SysWOW64\dui70.dll): __thiscall, matching the
// default calling convention for a non-static C++ member function that
// isn't explicitly annotated otherwise -- not __stdcall.

using NscTreeDrawDivider_t =
    void(DUI_STDCALL*)(void*, HDC, HTREEITEM);
static NscTreeDrawDivider_t NscTreeDrawDivider_orig = nullptr;

static bool PaintNscTreeDivider(HDC hdc, HTREEITEM item, bool dark)
{
    HWND tree = ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc);
    if (!tree || !item)
        return false;

    wchar_t className[32] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(tree, className, ARRAYSIZE(className)) ||
        _wcsicmp(className, WC_TREEVIEWW) != 0) {
        return false;
    }

    RECT itemRect = {};
    if (!TreeView_GetItemRect(tree, item, &itemRect, FALSE) ||
        itemRect.right <= itemRect.left ||
        itemRect.bottom <= itemRect.top) {
        return false;
    }

    // Mirrors CNscTree::DrawDivider on the current ExplorerFrame build:
    // full item rect, 8px horizontal inset, and a line one quarter down.
    constexpr int kHorizontalInset = 8;
    const int y = itemRect.top + (itemRect.bottom - itemRect.top) / 4;
    RECT paintRect = {
        itemRect.left + kHorizontalInset,
        y,
        itemRect.right - kHorizontalInset,
        y + 1,
    };
    if (paintRect.right <= paintRect.left)
        return false;

    // WinUI DividerStrokeColorDefault (#15FFFFFF dark / #0F000000 light)
    // composed over whatever the item painted: the Mica reveal or the
    // opaque pane when the backdrop is off.
    BlendPremultipliedPixels(hdc, paintRect, dark ? 0x15151515u : 0x0F000000u);
    return true;
}

static void DUI_STDCALL NscTreeDrawDivider_hook(
    void* self, HDC hdc, HTREEITEM item)
{
    if (!g_settings.ExplorerSection || !g_settings.ModernSeparators) {
        NscTreeDrawDivider_orig(self, hdc, item);
        return;
    }

    if (!PaintNscTreeDivider(hdc, item, IsWindowDarkMode(hdc)))
        NscTreeDrawDivider_orig(self, hdc, item);
}

static bool NscTreeDividerInit(HMODULE explorerFrame)
{
    if (!explorerFrame)
        return false;

    if (!SetResolvedSymbolHook(
            ExplorerFrameResolveSymbols(explorerFrame).nscTreeDrawDivider,
            NscTreeDrawDivider_hook, &NscTreeDrawDivider_orig)) {
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook CNscTree::DrawDivider");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

enum ExplorerFrameSymbolCapability : unsigned {
    ExplorerFrameCapabilityTreeDivider = 1u << 0,
    ExplorerFrameCapabilityMarquee = 1u << 1,
};

static std::mutex g_explorerFrameSymbolsMutex;
static std::atomic<unsigned> g_explorerFrameAttemptedCapabilities{0};
static std::atomic<bool> g_explorerFrameApplyPosted{false};
static std::atomic<bool> g_explorerFrameShellHostSeen{false};

static unsigned ExplorerFrameRequiredCapabilities()
{
    if (g_isXamlProcess)
        return 0;

    unsigned capabilities = 0;
    const bool shellHost = IsCurrentProcessExplorer() ||
        g_explorerFrameShellHostSeen.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (shellHost && g_settings.ExplorerSection &&
        g_settings.ModernSeparators) {
        capabilities |= ExplorerFrameCapabilityTreeDivider;
    }
    if ((IsCurrentProcessExplorer() || (shellHost && FilePickerMicaActive())) &&
        ExplorerMicaActive()) {
        capabilities |= ExplorerFrameCapabilityMarquee;
    }
    return capabilities;
}

static bool ExplorerFrameHasPendingSymbolWork()
{
    if (g_explorerFrameUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return false;

    const unsigned required = ExplorerFrameRequiredCapabilities();
    const unsigned attempted = g_explorerFrameAttemptedCapabilities.load(
        std::memory_order_acquire);
    return (required & ~attempted) != 0;
}

static void ExplorerFrameEnsureSymbolsForLoadedModule(bool applyHooks)
{
    g_explorerFrameApplyPosted.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    if (g_explorerFrameUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        g_msgWndUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !ExplorerFrameHasPendingSymbolWork()) {
        return;
    }

    HMODULE explorerFrame = GetModuleHandleW(L"ExplorerFrame.dll");
    if (!explorerFrame)
        return;

    bool hooksQueued = false;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_explorerFrameSymbolsMutex);
        const unsigned required = ExplorerFrameRequiredCapabilities();
        const unsigned missing = required &
            ~g_explorerFrameAttemptedCapabilities.load(
                std::memory_order_relaxed);
        g_explorerFrameAttemptedCapabilities.fetch_or(
            missing, std::memory_order_release);

        if (missing & ExplorerFrameCapabilityTreeDivider)
            hooksQueued = NscTreeDividerInit(explorerFrame) || hooksQueued;
        if (missing & ExplorerFrameCapabilityMarquee)
            hooksQueued = ExplorerMarqueeInit(explorerFrame) || hooksQueued;
    }

    if (!applyHooks || !hooksQueued ||
        g_explorerFrameUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return;
    }

    if (!Wh_ApplyHookOperations())
        Wh_Log(L"ExplorerFrame: failed to apply deferred symbol hooks");
}

static void ExplorerFrameRequestPendingSymbols()
{
    if (g_explorerFrameUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !ExplorerFrameHasPendingSymbolWork() ||
        g_msgWndUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        g_explorerFrameApplyPosted.exchange(
            true, std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
        return;
    }

    HWND msgWnd = g_msgWnd.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (!msgWnd || !PostMessageW(
            msgWnd, kExplorerFrameApplyHooksMessage, 0, 0)) {
        g_explorerFrameApplyPosted.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    }
}

static void ExplorerFrameObserveShellFolderView()
{
    if (g_explorerFrameUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return;

    g_explorerFrameShellHostSeen.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    ExplorerFrameRequestPendingSymbols();
}

// Explorer item checkboxes have no window of their own. Their checkmark reveal
// and the repaint after a clipped state change run on DirectUser actions,
// DirectUI's own frame source (as DirectUI::AnimationStrip uses), and
// invalidate the item's (or the checkbox's) display node. InvalidateGadget
// does not validate its handle, so every entry is canceled from
// Element::OnDestroy before its element is freed.
namespace ShellCheckAnim {
struct GmaAction {
    DWORD cbSize;
    float flDelay;
    float flDuration;
    float flPeriod;
    int cRepeat;
    DWORD dwPause;
    void (WINAPI* pfnProc)(void*);
    void* pvData;
};
static_assert(sizeof(GmaAction) == (sizeof(void*) == 8 ? 0x28 : 0x20));
// GMA_ACTIONINFO: pvData follows the action handle; fFinished sits at
// 0x20 (x64) / 0x18 (x86).
constexpr size_t kInfoDataOffset = sizeof(void*);
constexpr size_t kInfoFinishedOffset = sizeof(void*) == 8 ? 0x20 : 0x18;
constexpr DWORD kFramePauseMs = 8;
constexpr DWORD kRepaintRepeatMs = 100;
// Reveals starting within this window share one action and its frames, so a
// multiple selection repaints its items in one pass per frame. Each item
// keeps its own start time; the action outlives the window by one duration.
constexpr DWORD kJoinWindowMs = 100;
constexpr int kGroupMembers = 32;

using CreateActionFn = HANDLE(WINAPI*)(const GmaAction*);
using InvalidateGadgetFn = BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE);
using GetDisplayNodeFn = HANDLE(DUI_STDCALL*)(void*);
using GetVisibleFn = bool(DUI_STDCALL*)(void*);

enum : int { kFree = 0, kReserved = 1, kBusy = 2 };

struct Member {
    void* item = nullptr;
    void* checkbox = nullptr;
    HANDLE node = nullptr;
    LONGLONG start = 0;
    float progress = 0.f;
    bool done = false;
};

struct Slot {
    std::atomic<int> state{kFree};
    std::atomic<DWORD> ownerThread{0};
    // A SYNCHRONIZE handle, so a reused thread ID can't pass for the owner.
    // Closed under ownerLock.
    HANDLE ownerHandle = nullptr;
    // Owner thread only: the paint, the action callback and OnDestroy all run
    // on the thread that owns the items.
    bool oneShot = false;
    bool fired = false;
    LONGLONG start = 0;
    int count = 0;
    Member members[kGroupMembers];
};

static std::once_flag resolveOnce;
static CreateActionFn createAction = nullptr;
static InvalidateGadgetFn invalidateGadget = nullptr;
static GetDisplayNodeFn getDisplayNode = nullptr;
static GetVisibleFn getVisible = nullptr;
static float durationTicks = 0.f;
static LONGLONG joinTicks = 0;
static Slot slots[16];
static std::atomic<int> busySlots{0};
static std::atomic<bool> stopping{false};
// Serializes closing a slot's owner handle with the threads that wait on it.
static SRWLOCK ownerLock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
// Last painted state per checkbox element: the reveal starts only on a real
// unchecked-to-checked change. Entries are dropped with their element. A
// hidden checkbox paints nothing, so its item's paints reset the state.
static thread_local void* t_stateKeys[64];
static thread_local void* t_stateItems[64];
static thread_local int t_stateValues[64];
static thread_local unsigned t_stateNext = 0;
static thread_local void* t_lastRepaintItem = nullptr;
static thread_local DWORD t_lastRepaintTick = 0;

static LONGLONG Now()
{
    LARGE_INTEGER now;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
    return now.QuadPart;
}

static bool Resolve()
{
    std::call_once(resolveOnce, [] {
        LARGE_INTEGER frequency = {};
        if (!QueryPerformanceFrequency(&frequency) || frequency.QuadPart <= 0)
            return;
        durationTicks = static_cast<float>(frequency.QuadPart) * kCheckAnimDuration / 1000.f;
        joinTicks = frequency.QuadPart * kJoinWindowMs / 1000;
        if (HMODULE duser = GetModuleHandleW(L"duser.dll")) {
            createAction = reinterpret_cast<CreateActionFn>(
                GetProcAddress(duser, "CreateAction"));
            invalidateGadget = reinterpret_cast<InvalidateGadgetFn>(
                GetProcAddress(duser, "InvalidateGadget"));
        }
        if (HMODULE dui = GetModuleHandleW(L"dui70.dll")) {
            getDisplayNode = reinterpret_cast<GetDisplayNodeFn>(DuiExport(dui,
                "?GetDisplayNode@Element@DirectUI@@QEAAPEAUHGADGET__@@XZ",
                "?GetDisplayNode@Element@DirectUI@@QAEPAUHGADGET__@@XZ"));
            getVisible = reinterpret_cast<GetVisibleFn>(DuiExport(dui,
                "?GetVisible@Element@DirectUI@@QEAA_NXZ",
                "?GetVisible@Element@DirectUI@@QAE_NXZ"));
        }
    });
    return createAction && invalidateGadget && getDisplayNode && durationTicks > 0.f;
}

static bool Enabled()
{
    return g_settings.ExplorerSection && g_settings.RoundedButtons &&
        !stopping.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
        g_duiElementLifetimeLive.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
        g_duserDeleteHandleLive.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
        DuiElement_GetParent_orig && Resolve();
}

// ownerLock held exclusively.
static void ReleaseLocked(Slot& slot)
{
    if (slot.ownerHandle)
        CloseHandle(slot.ownerHandle);
    slot.ownerHandle = nullptr;
    slot.count = 0;
    slot.ownerThread.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    slot.state.store(kFree, std::memory_order_seq_cst);
    busySlots.fetch_sub(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
}

// The caller holds the slot as kReserved.
static void Release(Slot& slot)
{
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&ownerLock);
    ReleaseLocked(slot);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&ownerLock);
}

// ownerLock held exclusively. A slot whose thread exited gets no more
// callbacks.
static bool ReleaseIfOwnerExited(Slot& slot)
{
    if (slot.state.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != kBusy ||
        WaitForSingleObject(slot.ownerHandle, 0) != WAIT_OBJECT_0)
        return false;
    int expected = kBusy;
    if (!slot.state.compare_exchange_strong(expected, kReserved,
            std::memory_order_seq_cst))
        return false;
    ReleaseLocked(slot);
    return true;
}

static bool ReclaimDeadOwners()
{
    bool reclaimed = false;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&ownerLock);
    for (Slot& slot : slots)
        reclaimed = ReleaseIfOwnerExited(slot) || reclaimed;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&ownerLock);
    return reclaimed;
}

// Reserves a slot for the calling thread, which becomes its owner.
static Slot* Acquire()
{
    for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass) {
        for (Slot& slot : slots) {
            int expected = kFree;
            if (!slot.state.compare_exchange_strong(expected, kReserved,
                    std::memory_order_seq_cst))
                continue;
            busySlots.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            // BeforeUninit raises stopping before it scans the slots: either
            // it sees this reservation and waits, or this sees stopping.
            slot.ownerHandle = stopping.load(std::memory_order_seq_cst)
                ? nullptr : OpenThread(SYNCHRONIZE, FALSE, GetCurrentThreadId());
            if (!slot.ownerHandle) {
                Release(slot);
                return nullptr;
            }
            slot.ownerThread.store(GetCurrentThreadId(), std::memory_order_relaxed);
            return &slot;
        }
        if (pass == 0 && !ReclaimDeadOwners())
            break;
    }
    return nullptr;
}

// DirectUser drops a destroyed context's actions without a final callback
// (MotionSC::xwPreDestroyNL), and dui70's last UnInitThread destroys the
// context through DeleteHandle with the thread still running. Without a
// context, CreateAction fails before reading its argument.
static void OnDUserHandleDeleted()
{
    if (!busySlots.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return;
    const DWORD self = GetCurrentThreadId();
    bool owned = false;
    for (Slot& slot : slots) {
        owned = owned || (slot.state.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == kBusy &&
            slot.ownerThread.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == self);
    }
    if (!owned)
        return;
    const DWORD lastError = GetLastError();
    SetLastError(ERROR_SUCCESS);
    createAction(nullptr);
    constexpr DWORD kNoContext = 0x80040014;  // DU_E_NOCONTEXT
    const bool contextGone = GetLastError() == kNoContext;
    SetLastError(lastError);
    if (!contextGone)
        return;
    for (Slot& slot : slots) {
        int expected = kBusy;
        if (slot.ownerThread.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == self &&
            slot.state.compare_exchange_strong(expected, kReserved,
                std::memory_order_seq_cst))
            Release(slot);
    }
}

static void WINAPI ActionProc(void* info)
{
    BYTE* bytes = static_cast<BYTE*>(info);
    Slot* slot = *reinterpret_cast<Slot**>(bytes + kInfoDataOffset);
    const bool finished = *reinterpret_cast<BOOL*>(bytes + kInfoFinishedOffset) != 0;
    if (!slot || slot->state.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != kBusy ||
        slot->ownerThread.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) != GetCurrentThreadId())
        return;
    const bool repaint = !stopping.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (slot->oneShot) {
        if (repaint && !slot->fired && slot->members[0].node)
            invalidateGadget(slot->members[0].node);
        slot->fired = true;
    } else {
        const LONGLONG now = Now();
        for (int i = 0; i < slot->count; ++i) {
            Member& member = slot->members[i];
            if (!member.node || member.done)
                continue;
            member.progress = finished ? 1.f :
                std::clamp((now - member.start) / durationTicks, 0.f, 1.f);
            member.done = member.progress >= 1.f;
            if (repaint)
                invalidateGadget(member.node);
        }
    }
    int expected = kBusy;
    if (finished && slot->state.compare_exchange_strong(expected, kReserved,
            std::memory_order_seq_cst))
        Release(*slot);
}

static bool Launch(Slot& slot, DWORD durationMs, DWORD pauseMs)
{
    slot.state.store(kBusy, std::memory_order_release);
    const GmaAction action = {sizeof(GmaAction), 0.f, durationMs / 1000.f, 0.f, 0,
        pauseMs, ActionProc, &slot};
    if (createAction(&action))
        return true;
    int expected = kBusy;
    if (slot.state.compare_exchange_strong(expected, kReserved, std::memory_order_acq_rel))
        Release(slot);
    return false;
}

static bool StartReveal(void* item, void* checkbox, HANDLE node)
{
    const DWORD self = GetCurrentThreadId();
    const LONGLONG now = Now();
    Slot* group = nullptr;
    if (busySlots.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        for (Slot& slot : slots) {
            if (slot.state.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == kBusy &&
                slot.ownerThread.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == self &&
                !slot.oneShot && slot.count < kGroupMembers &&
                now - slot.start <= joinTicks) {
                group = &slot;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    const bool created = !group;
    if (created) {
        group = Acquire();
        if (!group)
            return false;
        group->oneShot = false;
        group->fired = false;
        group->start = now;
        group->count = 0;
    }
    Member& member = group->members[group->count++];
    member.item = item;
    member.checkbox = checkbox;
    member.node = node;
    member.start = now;
    member.progress = 0.f;
    member.done = false;
    if (!created)
        return true;
    return Launch(*group, static_cast<DWORD>(kCheckAnimDuration) + kJoinWindowMs,
        kFramePauseMs);
}

static bool StartRepaint(void* item, HANDLE node)
{
    Slot* slot = Acquire();
    if (!slot)
        return false;
    slot->oneShot = true;
    slot->fired = false;
    slot->start = 0;
    slot->count = 1;
    slot->members[0] = {item, nullptr, node, 0, 0.f, false};
    return Launch(*slot, 0, 0);
}

// Input that selects items: a marquee drag, Ctrl/Shift clicks or Space.
static bool Selecting()
{
    const HWND paintHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd;
    return (paintHwnd && GetCapture() == paintHwnd &&
            (GetKeyState(VK_LBUTTON) & 0x8000)) ||
        (GetKeyState(VK_CONTROL) & 0x8000) || (GetKeyState(VK_SHIFT) & 0x8000) ||
        (GetKeyState(VK_SPACE) & 0x8000);
}

// The item's repaint after a selection change: a checkbox DirectUI hid is no
// longer checked, whatever it last painted.
static void OnElementPaint(void* element)
{
    if (!t_stateNext || !getVisible || stopping.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < ARRAYSIZE(t_stateKeys); ++i) {
        if (t_stateItems[i] == element && t_stateValues[i] && t_stateKeys[i] &&
            !getVisible(t_stateKeys[i]))
            t_stateValues[i] = 0;
    }
}

static void OnElementDestroyed(void* element)
{
    if (t_stateNext) {
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < ARRAYSIZE(t_stateKeys); ++i) {
            if (t_stateKeys[i] == element) {
                t_stateKeys[i] = nullptr;
                t_stateItems[i] = nullptr;
            }
            if (t_stateItems[i] == element)
                t_stateItems[i] = nullptr;
        }
    }
    if (t_lastRepaintItem == element)
        t_lastRepaintItem = nullptr;
    if (!busySlots.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return;
    const DWORD self = GetCurrentThreadId();
    for (Slot& slot : slots) {
        if (slot.state.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != kBusy ||
            slot.ownerThread.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) != self)
            continue;
        for (int i = 0; i < slot.count; ++i) {
            Member& member = slot.members[i];
            if (member.node && (member.item == element || member.checkbox == element))
                member.node = nullptr;
        }
    }
}

// Returns the checkmark progress for this paint, or -1 when not animating.
static float OnPaint(HDC hdc, INT state, LPCRECT native, LPCRECT target, void* itemElement)
{
    if (!Enabled())
        return -1.f;
    void* checkbox = g_duiPaintElement;
    if (!checkbox)
        return -1.f;
    // The recorded item is trusted only while it is a live ancestor of the
    // checkbox painting right now.
    bool itemAlive = false;
    if (itemElement) {
        void* current = DuiElement_GetParent_orig(checkbox);
        for (int depth = 0; current && depth < 4; ++depth) {
            if (current == itemElement) {
                itemAlive = true;
                break;
            }
            current = DuiElement_GetParent_orig(current);
        }
    }

    const DWORD self = GetCurrentThreadId();
    float progress = -1.f;
    bool repaintPending = false;
    if (busySlots.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        for (Slot& slot : slots) {
            if (slot.state.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != kBusy ||
                slot.ownerThread.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) != self)
                continue;
            if (slot.oneShot) {
                if (!slot.fired && slot.members[0].node && slot.members[0].item == itemElement)
                    repaintPending = true;
                continue;
            }
            for (int i = 0; progress < 0.f && i < slot.count; ++i) {
                if (slot.members[i].node && slot.members[i].checkbox == checkbox)
                    progress = slot.members[i].progress;
            }
        }
    }

    int previous = 0;
    unsigned index = ARRAYSIZE(t_stateKeys);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < ARRAYSIZE(t_stateKeys); ++i) {
        if (t_stateKeys[i] == checkbox) {
            index = i;
            previous = t_stateValues[i];
            break;
        }
    }
    if (index == ARRAYSIZE(t_stateKeys)) {
        index = t_stateNext++ % ARRAYSIZE(t_stateKeys);
        t_stateKeys[index] = checkbox;
    }
    t_stateItems[index] = itemAlive ? itemElement : nullptr;
    t_stateValues[index] = state;

    const bool checked = state >= CBS_CHECKEDNORMAL && state <= CBS_CHECKEDDISABLED;
    if (!checked)
        progress = -1.f;
    // A box first painted checked was selected now (marquee drag, Ctrl/Shift
    // or Space) rather than scrolled or restored into view.
    if (checked && progress < 0.f && itemAlive && previous != state &&
        SysAnimationsEnabled() &&
        ((previous >= CBS_UNCHECKEDNORMAL && previous <= CBS_UNCHECKEDDISABLED) ||
         (previous == 0 && Selecting()))) {
        // A checkmark inside the native box repaints with the checkbox alone;
        // a larger one needs its item.
        const bool insideNative = target->left >= native->left &&
            target->top >= native->top && target->right <= native->right &&
            target->bottom <= native->bottom;
        HANDLE node = insideNative ? getDisplayNode(checkbox) : nullptr;
        if (!node)
            node = getDisplayNode(itemElement);
        if (node && StartReveal(itemElement, checkbox, node))
            progress = 0.f;
    }

    // A state change repaints only the native box; repaint the whole item
    // right after this paint, since an invalidation inside it is dropped.
    // Scroll strips that merely cut the box are left alone.
    if (!itemAlive || repaintPending)
        return progress;
    RECT clip = {};
    const int clipType = GetClipBox(hdc, &clip);
    const bool clipped = clipType != ERROR && clipType != NULLREGION &&
        !(target->left >= clip.left && target->top >= clip.top &&
          target->right <= clip.right && target->bottom <= clip.bottom) &&
        clip.left >= native->left - 2 && clip.top >= native->top - 2 &&
        clip.right <= native->right + 2 && clip.bottom <= native->bottom + 2;
    const DWORD now = GetTickCount();
    if (clipped &&
        !(t_lastRepaintItem == itemElement && now - t_lastRepaintTick < kRepaintRepeatMs)) {
        if (HANDLE node = getDisplayNode(itemElement)) {
            t_lastRepaintItem = itemElement;
            t_lastRepaintTick = now;
            StartRepaint(itemElement, node);
        }
    }
    return progress;
}

// A busy slot's action still calls back while its thread and context live:
// with stopping set, its last frame arrives within one duration of the thread
// pumping messages again. A context destroyed meanwhile frees its slots in
// OnDUserHandleDeleted, and an exited thread's are freed here.
static void BeforeUninit()
{
    stopping.store(true, std::memory_order_seq_cst);
    for (;;) {
        bool waiting = false;
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&ownerLock);
        for (Slot& slot : slots) {
            if (slot.state.load(std::memory_order_seq_cst) != kFree &&
                !ReleaseIfOwnerExited(slot))
                waiting = true;
        }
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&ownerLock);
        if (!waiting)
            break;
        Sleep(10);
    }
}
}

// Control Panel home page's "View by" label (element TopViewPrefix): drawn in
// a color fixed in the UIFILE (#5A6779, not a system or theme color), it
// takes WinUI's TextFillColorSecondary, the color of a label beside its
// value, flattened over the header.
static bool ControlPanelViewByLabelColor(HDC hdc, COLORREF* color)
{
    // Only inside a Control Panel page's own paint (see the bracket), so
    // every other DirectUI text draw skips the id and atom lookups.
    void* element = g_duiPaintElement;
    if (!t_controlPanelDuiPaintHwnd || !element || !DuiElement_GetID_orig)
        return false;
    const ATOM id = static_cast<ATOM>(DuiElement_GetID_orig(element));
    if (!id || id != FindAtomW(L"TopViewPrefix"))
        return false;
    const bool dark = IsWindowDarkMode(hdc);
    if (!ControlPanelTextRecolorActive(dark))
        return false;
    *color = dark
        ? WinUI::FlattenOver(WinUI::Dark::TextFillColorSecondary, Win32MainDark)
        : WinUI::FlattenOver(WinUI::Light::TextFillColorSecondary, kExplorerListLight);
    return true;
}

// Up to 16 windows' rects per thread, in fixed storage: a thread alive at
// unload holds nothing on the heap. Map-like, for the paths below.
struct HwndRectSlots {
    struct Entry { HWND first; RECT second; };
    static constexpr int kCapacity = 16;
    Entry entries[kCapacity] = {};
    int count = 0;

    Entry* find(HWND hwnd)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            if (entries[i].first == hwnd)
                return &entries[i];
        }
        return nullptr;
    }
    Entry* end() { return nullptr; }
    bool contains(HWND hwnd) { return find(hwnd) != nullptr; }
    size_t size() const { return static_cast<size_t>(count); }
    void clear() { count = 0; }
    void erase(Entry* entry) { *entry = entries[--count]; }
    void EraseDestroyed()
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < count;) {
            if (!IsWindow(entries[i].first))
                erase(&entries[i]);
            else
                ++i;
        }
    }
    RECT& operator[](HWND hwnd)
    {
        if (Entry* entry = find(hwnd))
            return entry->second;
        if (count == kCapacity)
            count = 0;
        entries[count] = { hwnd, {} };
        return entries[count++].second;
    }
};
static thread_local HwndRectSlots g_explorerMicaStatusBarRects;

    for (auto& request : g_viewButtonRequests) {

    g_viewButtonRequests[g_viewButtonRequestNext++ %
                         kViewButtonRequestCapacity] = {element, visible};

bool RectEquals(const RECT& first, const RECT& second) {
    return first.left == second.left && first.top == second.top &&
           first.right == second.right && first.bottom == second.bottom;
}

bool ClassEquals(HWND hwnd, const wchar_t* expected) {
    wchar_t className[96] = {};
    return hwnd && IsWindow(hwnd) &&
           GetClassNameW(hwnd, className, ARRAYSIZE(className)) &&
           _wcsicmp(className, expected) == 0;
}

bool IsExplorerStatusHost(HWND hwnd) {
    if (!ClassEquals(hwnd, L"DirectUIHWND"))
        return false;

    HWND view = GetParent(hwnd);
    HWND tab = view ? GetParent(view) : nullptr;
    HWND root = GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT);
    return ClassEquals(view, L"DUIViewWndClassName") &&
           ClassEquals(tab, L"ShellTabWindowClass") &&
           (ClassEquals(root, L"CabinetWClass") ||
            ClassEquals(root, L"ExploreWClass"));
}

HWND StatusHostTab(HWND host) {
    if (!IsExplorerStatusHost(host))
        return nullptr;
    HWND view = GetParent(host);
    HWND tab = view ? GetParent(view) : nullptr;
    return ClassEquals(tab, L"ShellTabWindowClass") ? tab : nullptr;
}

// Confirmed Explorer chain, using direct-child hops only:
// ShellTabWindowClass -> DUIViewWndClassName -> DirectUIHWND ->
// CtrlNotifySink -> SHELLDLL_DefView.
HWND FindShellViewForTab(HWND tab) {
    if (!ClassEquals(tab, L"ShellTabWindowClass"))
        return nullptr;

    HWND view = FindWindowExW(tab, nullptr, L"DUIViewWndClassName", nullptr);
    if (!view)
        return nullptr;

    HWND directUiRoot = GetWindow(view, GW_CHILD);
    if (!ClassEquals(directUiRoot, L"DirectUIHWND"))
        return nullptr;

    HWND first = nullptr;
    for (HWND sink = GetWindow(directUiRoot, GW_CHILD); sink;
         sink = GetWindow(sink, GW_HWNDNEXT)) {
        if (!ClassEquals(sink, L"CtrlNotifySink"))
            continue;

        HWND shellView =
            FindWindowExW(sink, nullptr, L"SHELLDLL_DefView", nullptr);
        if (!shellView)
            continue;
        if (!first)
            first = shellView;
        if (IsWindowVisible(shellView))
            return shellView;
    }
    return first;
}

bool FindNavigationPaneForTab(HWND tab, HWND* navigationSink,
                              HWND* namespaceTree) {
    if (!ClassEquals(tab, L"ShellTabWindowClass"))
        return false;

    HWND view = FindWindowExW(tab, nullptr, L"DUIViewWndClassName", nullptr);
    HWND directUiRoot = view ? GetWindow(view, GW_CHILD) : nullptr;
    if (!ClassEquals(directUiRoot, L"DirectUIHWND"))
        return false;

    for (HWND sink = GetWindow(directUiRoot, GW_CHILD); sink;
         sink = GetWindow(sink, GW_HWNDNEXT)) {
        if (!ClassEquals(sink, L"CtrlNotifySink"))
            continue;

        HWND tree =
            FindWindowExW(sink, nullptr, L"NamespaceTreeControl", nullptr);
        if (!tree)
            continue;

        if (navigationSink)
            *navigationSink = sink;
        if (namespaceTree)
            *namespaceTree = tree;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool GetWindowRectInParent(HWND hwnd, RECT* rect) {
    if (!rect || !GetWindowRect(hwnd, rect))
        return false;
    HWND parent = GetParent(hwnd);
    if (parent) {
        SetLastError(ERROR_SUCCESS);
        const int result = MapWindowPoints(
            HWND_DESKTOP, parent, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(rect), 2);
        if (!result && GetLastError() != ERROR_SUCCESS)
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool IsShellViewForTab(HWND shellView, HWND tab) {
    return ClassEquals(shellView, L"SHELLDLL_DefView") && tab &&
           IsWindow(tab) && IsChild(tab, shellView);
}

bool MapShellViewToHost(HWND shellView, HWND host, RECT* mappedRect) {
    if (!mappedRect || !IsWindow(shellView) || !IsWindow(host) ||
        !GetWindowRect(shellView, mappedRect)) {
        return false;
    }

    POINT points[2] = {
        {mappedRect->left, mappedRect->top},
        {mappedRect->right, mappedRect->bottom},
    };
    SetLastError(ERROR_SUCCESS);
    const int result = MapWindowPoints(HWND_DESKTOP, host, points, 2);
    if (!result && GetLastError() != ERROR_SUCCESS)
        return false;

    mappedRect->left = points[0].x < points[1].x ? points[0].x : points[1].x;
    mappedRect->top = points[0].y < points[1].y ? points[0].y : points[1].y;
    mappedRect->right =
        points[0].x > points[1].x ? points[0].x : points[1].x;
    mappedRect->bottom =
        points[0].y > points[1].y ? points[0].y : points[1].y;
    return mappedRect->right > mappedRect->left;
}

enum class ExplorerElementKind {
    Other,
    ProperTree,
    PaneTheme,
    StatusModule,
    StatusInner,
    ViewButton,
};

ExplorerElementKind ClassifyExplorerElement(void* element) {
    if (!element || !DuiElement_GetID_orig || !g_statusPaintHost)
        return ExplorerElementKind::Other;

    const ATOM id = static_cast<ATOM>(DuiElement_GetID_orig(element));
    wchar_t idName[32] = {};
    if (!id || !GetAtomNameW(id, idName, ARRAYSIZE(idName)))
        return ExplorerElementKind::Other;

    if (_wcsicmp(idName, L"ProperTree") == 0)
        return ExplorerElementKind::ProperTree;
    if (_wcsicmp(idName, L"ProperTreeInner") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(idName, L"ProperTreeModuleInner") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(idName, L"ProperTreeHost") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(idName, L"PageSpaceControlSizer") == 0) {
        return ExplorerElementKind::PaneTheme;
    }
    if (_wcsicmp(idName, L"StatusBarModule") == 0)
        return ExplorerElementKind::StatusModule;
    if (_wcsicmp(idName, L"StatusBarModuleInner") == 0)
        return ExplorerElementKind::StatusInner;
    if (wcscmp(idName, L"ViewMode_Details") == 0 ||
        wcscmp(idName, L"ViewMode_LargeIcons") == 0) {
        return ExplorerElementKind::ViewButton;
    }
    return ExplorerElementKind::Other;
}

bool IsPaneThemeElement(ExplorerElementKind kind) {
    return kind == ExplorerElementKind::ProperTree ||
           kind == ExplorerElementKind::PaneTheme;
}

bool IsStatusElement(ExplorerElementKind kind) {
    return kind == ExplorerElementKind::StatusModule ||
           kind == ExplorerElementKind::StatusInner;
}

StatusState* FindStatusStateByHostLocked(HWND host) {
    for (auto& state : g_statusStates) {
        if (state.host == host)
            return &state;
    }
    return nullptr;
}

void UpdatePaneVisualRight(HWND host, int right) {
    RECT client = {};
    if (!host || !GetClientRect(host, &client) || right <= client.left ||
        right >= client.right) {
        return;
    }

    g_panePaintRight = right;
    g_panePaintRightValid = true;
    g_paneElementSeenHost = host;

    ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
    if (StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host)) {
        state->paneVisualRight = right;
        state->paneVisualRightValid = true;
    }
}

SubclassWindowState* FindSubclassWindowLocked(HWND hwnd) {
    for (auto& state : g_subclassWindows) {
        if (state.hwnd == hwnd)
            return &state;
    }
    return nullptr;
}

void ReadOriginalMargin(void* element, RECT* margin) {
    *margin = {};
    if (!g_elementGetMargin)
        return;

    void* value = nullptr;
    if (const RECT* current = g_elementGetMargin(element, &value))
        *margin = *current;
    if (value && g_valueRelease)
        g_valueRelease(value);
}

bool TrackStatusElement(void* element, HWND host) {
    HWND tab = StatusHostTab(host);
    if (!tab)
        return false;

    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host);
        if (state && state->element == element) {
            state->tab = tab;
            return true;
        }
    }

    RECT originalMargin = {};
    ReadOriginalMargin(element, &originalMargin);

    bool replaced = false;
    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host);
        if (!state) {
            for (auto& candidate : g_statusStates) {
                if (!candidate.host || !IsWindow(candidate.host)) {
                    state = &candidate;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!state) {
            Wh_Log(L"[Track] Status-state capacity reached; host=%p", host);
            return false;
        }

        // An existing state for this host keeps its pane state when a new
        // status element replaces a previous or destroyed one.
        replaced = state->host == host && state->element != element;
        const StatusState previous = *state;
        *state = {};
        g_anyTracked.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        state->element = element;
        state->host = host;
        state->tab = tab;
        state->originalMargin = originalMargin;
        state->originalMarginValid = true;
        if (g_statusPaintHost == host && g_panePaintRightValid) {
            state->paneVisualRight = g_panePaintRight;
            state->paneVisualRightValid = true;
        }
        if (replaced) {
            state->defView = previous.defView;
            state->navigationSink = previous.navigationSink;
            state->namespaceTree = previous.namespaceTree;
            state->navigationNativeRect = previous.navigationNativeRect;
            state->navigationNativeRectValid =
                previous.navigationNativeRectValid;
            state->navigationAppliedRect = previous.navigationAppliedRect;
            state->navigationAppliedRectValid =
                previous.navigationAppliedRectValid;
            state->navigationNativeRegionBox =
                previous.navigationNativeRegionBox;
            state->navigationNativeRegionBoxValid =
                previous.navigationNativeRegionBoxValid;
            state->navigationAppliedRegionBox =
                previous.navigationAppliedRegionBox;
            state->navigationAppliedRegionBoxValid =
                previous.navigationAppliedRegionBoxValid;
            state->namespaceTreeNativeRect =
                previous.namespaceTreeNativeRect;
            state->namespaceTreeNativeRectValid =
                previous.namespaceTreeNativeRectValid;
            state->namespaceTreeAppliedRect =
                previous.namespaceTreeAppliedRect;
            state->namespaceTreeAppliedRectValid =
                previous.namespaceTreeAppliedRectValid;
            if (!state->paneVisualRightValid) {
                state->paneVisualRight = previous.paneVisualRight;
                state->paneVisualRightValid =
                    previous.paneVisualRightValid;
            }
            state->contentBottom = previous.contentBottom;
            state->contentBottomValid = previous.contentBottomValid;
            state->updatePosted = previous.updatePosted;
        }
    }

    return true;
}

void QueueHostUpdate(HWND host) {
    if (!Active() || !host ||
        !IsWindow(host) || !g_updateMessage) {
        return;
    }

    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host);
        if (!state || state->updatePosted)
            return;
        state->updatePosted = true;
    }

    if (!PostMessageW(host, g_updateMessage, 0, 0)) {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host);
        if (state)
            state->updatePosted = false;
    }
}

void ApplyStatusHost(HWND host);

// With the option turned off, CleanupAll's restore moves the pane back, and
// the WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGED of that move must not apply the layout again.
void QueueUpdatesForWindow(HWND hwnd) {
    if (!Active())
        return;
    HWND hosts[kStatusStateCapacity] = {};
    size_t count = 0;
    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        for (const auto& state : g_statusStates) {
            if (!state.host || (state.host != hwnd && state.tab != hwnd &&
                                state.defView != hwnd &&
                                state.navigationSink != hwnd &&
                                state.namespaceTree != hwnd)) {
                continue;
            }

            bool duplicate = false;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
                if (hosts[i] == state.host) {
                    duplicate = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!duplicate && count < ARRAYSIZE(hosts))
                hosts[count++] = state.host;
        }
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        const DWORD hostThread = GetWindowThreadProcessId(hosts[i], nullptr);
        if (hostThread && hostThread == GetCurrentThreadId() &&
            !g_applyingStatusLayout) {
            // DefSubclassProc already completed, so the HWND geometry is live.
            // Updating here avoids a full message-queue turn during pane drag.
            ApplyStatusHost(hosts[i]);
        } else {
            QueueHostUpdate(hosts[i]);
        }
    }
}

void MarkWindowUnsubclassed(HWND hwnd) {
    ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
    if (SubclassWindowState* state = FindSubclassWindowLocked(hwnd))
        *state = {};
}

void HandleTrackedWindowDestroyed(HWND hwnd) {
    HWND hosts[kStatusStateCapacity] = {};
    size_t count = 0;
    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        for (auto& state : g_statusStates) {
            if (!state.host)
                continue;
            if (state.host == hwnd) {
                state = {};
                continue;
            }
            if (state.tab == hwnd)
                state.tab = nullptr;
            if (state.defView == hwnd) {
                state.defView = nullptr;
                if (count < ARRAYSIZE(hosts))
                    hosts[count++] = state.host;
            }
            if (state.navigationSink == hwnd) {
                state.paneExtensionActive = false;
                state.navigationSink = nullptr;
                state.namespaceTree = nullptr;
                state.navigationNativeRectValid = false;
                state.navigationAppliedRectValid = false;
                state.navigationNativeRegionBoxValid = false;
                state.navigationAppliedRegionBoxValid = false;
                state.namespaceTreeNativeRectValid = false;
                state.namespaceTreeAppliedRectValid = false;
                if (count < ARRAYSIZE(hosts))
                    hosts[count++] = state.host;
            } else if (state.namespaceTree == hwnd) {
                state.namespaceTree = nullptr;
                state.namespaceTreeNativeRectValid = false;
                state.namespaceTreeAppliedRectValid = false;
                if (count < ARRAYSIZE(hosts))
                    hosts[count++] = state.host;
            }
        }
        if (SubclassWindowState* state = FindSubclassWindowLocked(hwnd))
            *state = {};
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        QueueHostUpdate(hosts[i]);
}

// DirectUI destroys the status bar module while its host HWND lives on (the
// legacy frame showing Control Panel or Fonts rebuilds the tree in the same
// host), so a tracked element pointer outlived its element and the next
// layout pass called SetMargin on freed memory. Element::OnDestroy runs for
// every element of a destroyed subtree while it is still valid: the
// pointers are dropped there, and the next paint tracks the new element.
void ForgetDestroyedElement(void* element) {
    ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
    for (auto& state : g_statusStates) {
        if (!state.host)
            continue;
        if (state.element == element) {
            state.element = nullptr;
            state.originalMarginValid = false;
            state.appliedMarginValid = false;
            state.detailsButton = {};
            state.largeIconsButton = {};
            continue;
        }
        if (state.detailsButton.element == element)
            state.detailsButton = {};
        if (state.largeIconsButton.element == element)
            state.largeIconsButton = {};
    }
    for (auto& request : g_viewButtonRequests) {
        if (request.element == element)
            request = {};
    }
}

// The status bar shows its view-mode buttons again by itself
// (CStatusBarModuleInner::UpdateViewButtonsVisibility on every contents
// change, _UpdateVisibility when it lays out), which the paint-time hiding
// only caught on the bar's next paint. Its requests are kept for restoring
// and turned into hidden ones while the setting is on.
HRESULT DUI_STDCALL ElementSetVisibleHook(void* self, bool visible) {
    if (Mode() && !Unloading() && IsViewModeButton(self)) {
        {
            ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
            RecordViewButtonRequestLocked(self, visible);
        }
        if (visible && HideButtons())
            visible = false;
    }
    return g_elementSetVisibleOriginal(self, visible);
}

HRESULT SetElementMargin(void* element, const RECT& margin) {
    if (!element || !g_elementSetMargin)
        return E_POINTER;
    return g_elementSetMargin(element, margin.left, margin.top, margin.right,
                              margin.bottom);
}

ViewButtonState* SelectViewButtonState(StatusState* state, bool details) {
    return details ? &state->detailsButton : &state->largeIconsButton;
}

void ApplySingleViewButton(HWND host, void* statusElement,
                           const wchar_t* idName, bool details, bool hide) {
    if (!g_elementFindDescendent || !g_elementGetVisible ||
        (!g_elementSetVisibleOriginal && !g_elementSetVisible)) {
        return;
    }

    const ATOM id = FindAtomW(idName);
    void* button = id ? g_elementFindDescendent(statusElement, id) : nullptr;
    if (!button)
        return;

    const bool currentVisible = g_elementGetVisible(button);
    ViewButtonState snapshot = {};
    bool requested = false;
    bool requestKnown = false;
    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host);
        if (!state || state->element != statusElement)
            return;

        ViewButtonState* tracked = SelectViewButtonState(state, details);
        if (tracked->element != button) {
            *tracked = {};
            tracked->element = button;
            tracked->originalVisible = currentVisible;
            tracked->originalVisibleValid = true;
        }
        snapshot = *tracked;
        requestKnown = LookupViewButtonRequestLocked(button, &requested);
    }

    // Explorer's last request is what the button should be when not hidden;
    // ElementSetVisibleHook may have turned it into a hidden one.
    if (!hide && !snapshot.hiddenApplied &&
        !(requestKnown && requested != currentVisible)) {
        return;
    }

    const bool desiredVisible =
        hide ? false
             : requestKnown ? requested
             : snapshot.originalVisibleValid ? snapshot.originalVisible
                                             : currentVisible;
    HRESULT result = S_FALSE;
    if (currentVisible != desiredVisible)
        result = SetViewButtonVisible(button, desiredVisible);

    const bool succeeded = result == S_FALSE || SUCCEEDED(result);
    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host);
        if (state && state->element == statusElement) {
            ViewButtonState* tracked = SelectViewButtonState(state, details);
            if (tracked->element == button && succeeded) {
                if (hide)
                    tracked->hiddenApplied = true;
                else
                    *tracked = {};
            }
        }
    }

    if (!succeeded) {
        Wh_Log(L"[ViewButtons] SetVisible failed host=%p id=%s hr=0x%08X",
               host, idName, static_cast<unsigned>(result));
    }
}

void ApplyViewModeButtons(HWND host, bool restore) {
    void* statusElement = nullptr;
    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host);
        if (!state || !state->element)
            return;
        statusElement = state->element;
    }

    const bool hide =
        !restore && HideButtons();
    ApplySingleViewButton(host, statusElement, L"ViewMode_Details", true,
                          hide);
    ApplySingleViewButton(host, statusElement, L"ViewMode_LargeIcons", false,
                          hide);
}

bool SetWindowRectInParent(HWND hwnd, const RECT& rect) {
    const bool previous = g_settingPaneGeometry;
    g_settingPaneGeometry = true;
    const bool moved = SetWindowPos(hwnd, nullptr, rect.left, rect.top,
                                    rect.right - rect.left,
                                    rect.bottom - rect.top,
                                    SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE) != FALSE;
    g_settingPaneGeometry = previous;
    return moved;
}

bool SetSimpleWindowRegion(HWND hwnd, const RECT& box) {
    HRGN region = CreateRectRgn(box.left, box.top, box.right, box.bottom);
    if (!region)
        return false;

    // DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION: Explorer already assigns this native clipping
    // region; resizing its HWND alone leaves the old bottom edge in place.
    const bool previous = g_settingPaneGeometry;
    g_settingPaneGeometry = true;
    const bool applied = SetWindowRgn(hwnd, region, TRUE) != 0;
    g_settingPaneGeometry = previous;
    if (!applied) {
        DeleteObject(region);
        return false;
    }

    // After a successful SetWindowRgn, the system owns the region handle.
    return true;
}

void RestoreNavigationPane(HWND host) {
    StatusState snapshot = {};
    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host);
        if (!state)
            return;
        state->paneExtensionActive = false;
        snapshot = *state;
    }

    bool sinkRestored = !snapshot.navigationAppliedRectValid;
    if (!sinkRestored && IsWindow(snapshot.navigationSink) &&
        snapshot.navigationNativeRectValid) {
        sinkRestored = SetWindowRectInParent(
            snapshot.navigationSink, snapshot.navigationNativeRect);
    }

    bool treeRestored = !snapshot.namespaceTreeAppliedRectValid;
    if (!treeRestored && IsWindow(snapshot.namespaceTree) &&
        snapshot.namespaceTreeNativeRectValid) {
        treeRestored = SetWindowRectInParent(
            snapshot.namespaceTree, snapshot.namespaceTreeNativeRect);
    }

    bool regionRestored = !snapshot.navigationAppliedRegionBoxValid;
    if (!regionRestored && IsWindow(snapshot.navigationSink) &&
        snapshot.navigationNativeRegionBoxValid) {
        regionRestored = SetSimpleWindowRegion(
            snapshot.navigationSink, snapshot.navigationNativeRegionBox);
    }

    if (treeRestored || sinkRestored || regionRestored) {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host);
        if (state && state->element == snapshot.element) {
            if (treeRestored)
                state->namespaceTreeAppliedRectValid = false;
            if (sinkRestored)
                state->navigationAppliedRectValid = false;
            if (regionRestored)
                state->navigationAppliedRegionBoxValid = false;
        }
    }

    if ((snapshot.namespaceTreeAppliedRectValid && !treeRestored) ||
        (snapshot.navigationAppliedRectValid && !sinkRestored) ||
        (snapshot.navigationAppliedRegionBoxValid && !regionRestored)) {
        Wh_Log(L"[RestorePane] Failed host=%p sink=%p tree=%p sinkOk=%d treeOk=%d regionOk=%d",
               host, snapshot.navigationSink, snapshot.namespaceTree,
               sinkRestored, treeRestored, regionRestored);
    }
}

void RestoreStatusHost(HWND host) {
    StatusState snapshot = {};
    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host);
        if (!state) {
            return;
        }
        snapshot = *state;
    }

    ApplyViewModeButtons(host, true);

    HRESULT result = S_FALSE;
    if (snapshot.element && snapshot.originalMarginValid &&
        snapshot.appliedMarginValid) {
        result = SetElementMargin(snapshot.element, snapshot.originalMargin);
        if (SUCCEEDED(result)) {
            ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
            StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host);
            if (state && state->element == snapshot.element)
                state->appliedMarginValid = false;
        }
    }

    RestoreNavigationPane(host);

    if (snapshot.appliedMarginValid && FAILED(result)) {
        Wh_Log(L"[Restore] SetMargin failed host=%p element=%p hr=0x%08X",
               host, snapshot.element, static_cast<unsigned>(result));
    }
}

LRESULT CALLBACK LayoutSubclassProc(HWND hwnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam,
                                    LPARAM lParam, DWORD_PTR subclassData);

bool EnsureWindowSubclass(HWND hwnd) {
    if (!hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd) || !Active())
        return false;

    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        if (SubclassWindowState* existing = FindSubclassWindowLocked(hwnd))
            return existing->installed || existing->installing;

        SubclassWindowState* empty = nullptr;
        for (auto& candidate : g_subclassWindows) {
            if (!candidate.hwnd ||
                (!candidate.installing && !IsWindow(candidate.hwnd))) {
                empty = &candidate;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!empty) {
            Wh_Log(L"[Subclass] Window capacity reached; hwnd=%p", hwnd);
            return false;
        }
        *empty = {};
        empty->hwnd = hwnd;
        empty->installing = true;
    }

    // This helper can synchronously cross threads. No state lock is held.
    const bool installed = WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
        hwnd, LayoutSubclassProc, kLayoutSubclassData);

    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        SubclassWindowState* state = FindSubclassWindowLocked(hwnd);
        if (state) {
            state->installing = false;
            state->installed = installed;
            if (!installed)
                *state = {};
        }
    }

    if (!installed)
        Wh_Log(L"[Subclass] Failed for hwnd=%p", hwnd);
    return installed;
}

// With the status bar turned off the native pane already reaches the host's
// bottom and the extension is empty, so the view's own bottom (briefly past
// the host's during a layout) isn't consulted.
void ApplyNavigationPaneExtension(HWND host, HWND tab, int hostBottom) {
    StatusState snapshot = {};
    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host);
        if (!state)
            return;
        snapshot = *state;
    }

    HWND navigationSink = snapshot.navigationSink;
    HWND namespaceTree = snapshot.namespaceTree;
    const bool cachedPaneValid =
        ClassEquals(navigationSink, L"CtrlNotifySink") &&
        ClassEquals(namespaceTree, L"NamespaceTreeControl") &&
        GetParent(namespaceTree) == navigationSink &&
        IsChild(tab, navigationSink);
    // Missing or hidden only while Explorer swaps the view (or with the pane
    // turned off, when nothing of it shows). Restoring here and extending
    // again on the next pass made the pane flash its native height on
    // navigation; the next layout sync is extended by AdjustPaneWindowPos.
    if (!cachedPaneValid &&
        !FindNavigationPaneForTab(tab, &navigationSink, &namespaceTree)) {
        return;
    }
    if (!IsWindowVisible(navigationSink) || !IsWindowVisible(namespaceTree))
        return;

    RECT currentSinkRect = {};
    RECT currentTreeRect = {};
    if (!GetWindowRectInParent(navigationSink, &currentSinkRect) ||
        !GetWindowRectInParent(namespaceTree, &currentTreeRect)) {
        RestoreNavigationPane(host);
        return;
    }

    RECT nativeSinkRect = currentSinkRect;
    if (snapshot.navigationSink == navigationSink &&
        snapshot.navigationNativeRectValid &&
        snapshot.navigationAppliedRectValid &&
        RectEquals(currentSinkRect, snapshot.navigationAppliedRect)) {
        nativeSinkRect = snapshot.navigationNativeRect;
    }

    RECT nativeTreeRect = currentTreeRect;
    if (snapshot.namespaceTree == namespaceTree &&
        snapshot.namespaceTreeNativeRectValid &&
        snapshot.namespaceTreeAppliedRectValid &&
        RectEquals(currentTreeRect, snapshot.namespaceTreeAppliedRect)) {
        nativeTreeRect = snapshot.namespaceTreeNativeRect;
    }

    RECT currentRegionBox = {};
    const int currentRegionType =
        GetWindowRgnBox(navigationSink, &currentRegionBox);
    RECT nativeRegionBox = currentRegionBox;
    bool nativeRegionBoxValid = currentRegionType == SIMPLEREGION;
    if (snapshot.navigationSink == navigationSink &&
        snapshot.navigationNativeRegionBoxValid &&
        snapshot.navigationAppliedRegionBoxValid &&
        currentRegionType == SIMPLEREGION &&
        RectEquals(currentRegionBox, snapshot.navigationAppliedRegionBox)) {
        nativeRegionBox = snapshot.navigationNativeRegionBox;
        nativeRegionBoxValid = true;
    }

    HWND sinkParent = GetParent(navigationSink);
    POINT targetBottom = {0, hostBottom};
    SetLastError(ERROR_SUCCESS);
    const int mapped = MapWindowPoints(host, sinkParent, &targetBottom, 1);
    if (!mapped && GetLastError() != ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        RestoreNavigationPane(host);
        return;
    }

    // Never shorter than native.
    RECT desiredSinkRect = nativeSinkRect;
    if (targetBottom.y > desiredSinkRect.bottom)
        desiredSinkRect.bottom = targetBottom.y;

    const int nativeSinkHeight =
        nativeSinkRect.bottom - nativeSinkRect.top;
    const int desiredSinkHeight =
        desiredSinkRect.bottom - desiredSinkRect.top;
    const int treeBottomInset =
        nativeSinkHeight > nativeTreeRect.bottom
            ? nativeSinkHeight - nativeTreeRect.bottom
            : 0;
    RECT desiredTreeRect = nativeTreeRect;
    desiredTreeRect.bottom = desiredSinkHeight - treeBottomInset;
    if (desiredTreeRect.bottom < desiredTreeRect.top)
        desiredTreeRect.bottom = desiredTreeRect.top;

    RECT desiredRegionBox = nativeRegionBox;
    if (nativeRegionBoxValid) {
        desiredRegionBox.bottom += desiredSinkHeight - nativeSinkHeight;
        if (desiredRegionBox.bottom < desiredRegionBox.top)
            desiredRegionBox.bottom = desiredRegionBox.top;
    }

    const bool sinkExtended =
        !RectEquals(desiredSinkRect, nativeSinkRect);
    const bool treeExtended =
        !RectEquals(desiredTreeRect, nativeTreeRect);
    const bool regionExtended =
        nativeRegionBoxValid &&
        !RectEquals(desiredRegionBox, nativeRegionBox);
    // Their subclasses see the pane's destruction and Explorer's own moves.
    if (!EnsureWindowSubclass(navigationSink) ||
        !EnsureWindowSubclass(namespaceTree)) {
        RestoreNavigationPane(host);
        return;
    }

    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host);
        if (!state || state->element != snapshot.element)
            return;
        state->navigationSink = navigationSink;
        state->namespaceTree = namespaceTree;
        state->navigationNativeRect = nativeSinkRect;
        state->navigationNativeRectValid = true;
        state->navigationAppliedRect = desiredSinkRect;
        state->navigationAppliedRectValid = sinkExtended;
        state->navigationNativeRegionBox = nativeRegionBox;
        state->navigationNativeRegionBoxValid = nativeRegionBoxValid;
        state->navigationAppliedRegionBox = desiredRegionBox;
        state->navigationAppliedRegionBoxValid = regionExtended;
        state->namespaceTreeNativeRect = nativeTreeRect;
        state->namespaceTreeNativeRectValid = true;
        state->namespaceTreeAppliedRect = desiredTreeRect;
        state->namespaceTreeAppliedRectValid = treeExtended;
        state->paneExtensionActive = sinkExtended;
    }

    bool sinkApplied = true;
    if (!RectEquals(currentSinkRect, desiredSinkRect))
        sinkApplied = SetWindowRectInParent(navigationSink, desiredSinkRect);

    bool treeApplied = true;
    if (!RectEquals(currentTreeRect, desiredTreeRect))
        treeApplied = SetWindowRectInParent(namespaceTree, desiredTreeRect);

    bool regionApplied = !regionExtended;
    if (sinkApplied && regionExtended) {
        regionApplied = currentRegionType == SIMPLEREGION &&
                        RectEquals(currentRegionBox, desiredRegionBox);
        if (!regionApplied) {
            regionApplied =
                SetSimpleWindowRegion(navigationSink, desiredRegionBox);
        }
    }

    if (!sinkApplied || !treeApplied || !regionApplied) {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host);
        if (state && state->element == snapshot.element) {
            if (!sinkApplied)
                state->navigationAppliedRectValid = false;
            if (!treeApplied)
                state->namespaceTreeAppliedRectValid = false;
            if (!regionApplied)
                state->navigationAppliedRegionBoxValid = false;
        }
        Wh_Log(L"[Pane] Resize failed host=%p sink=%p tree=%p sinkOk=%d treeOk=%d regionOk=%d",
               host, navigationSink, namespaceTree, sinkApplied,
               treeApplied, regionApplied);
        return;
    }

}

// DirectUI's HWNDHost::SyncRect moves the navigation sink and its tree back
// to their native height on every layout sync (ApplySinkRegion then clips
// the sink to it), and extending them again afterwards discarded and
// repainted the released band: the pane flashed its native height. While
// the extension is active, Explorer's own moves are extended before they
// happen; the requested rects are recorded as the native ones.
void AdjustPaneWindowPos(HWND hwnd, WINDOWPOS* pos) {
    if (!pos || (pos->flags & SWP_NOSIZE))
        return;
    RECT current = {};
    if (!GetWindowRectInParent(hwnd, &current))
        return;
    const int x = (pos->flags & SWP_NOMOVE) ? current.left : pos->x;
    const int y = (pos->flags & SWP_NOMOVE) ? current.top : pos->y;
    const RECT requested = {x, y, x + pos->cx, y + pos->cy};

    ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
    for (auto& state : g_statusStates) {
        if (!state.host || !state.paneExtensionActive)
            continue;
        if (state.navigationSink == hwnd) {
            int bottom = state.navigationAppliedRect.bottom;
            RECT hostClient = {};
            if (GetParent(hwnd) == state.host &&
                GetClientRect(state.host, &hostClient)) {
                bottom = hostClient.bottom;
            }
            state.navigationNativeRect = requested;
            state.navigationNativeRectValid = true;
            if (requested.bottom < bottom && requested.top < bottom) {
                pos->cy = bottom - y;
                state.navigationAppliedRect = {x, y, x + pos->cx, bottom};
                state.navigationAppliedRectValid = true;
            }
            return;
        }
        if (state.namespaceTree == hwnd && state.navigationNativeRectValid) {
            const int nativeSinkHeight = state.navigationNativeRect.bottom -
                                         state.navigationNativeRect.top;
            const int sinkHeight =
                state.navigationAppliedRectValid
                    ? state.navigationAppliedRect.bottom -
                          state.navigationAppliedRect.top
                    : nativeSinkHeight;
            const int inset = nativeSinkHeight > requested.bottom
                                  ? nativeSinkHeight - requested.bottom
                                  : 0;
            const int bottom = sinkHeight - inset;
            state.namespaceTreeNativeRect = requested;
            state.namespaceTreeNativeRectValid = true;
            if (requested.bottom < bottom && requested.top < bottom) {
                pos->cy = bottom - y;
                state.namespaceTreeAppliedRect = {x, y, x + pos->cx, bottom};
                state.namespaceTreeAppliedRectValid = true;
            }
            return;
        }
    }
}

// The clip region HWNDHost::ApplySinkRegion gives the sink, extended by as
// much as the sink itself is, before it is applied. Simple regions only, as
// the rest of the pane code.
void ExtendPaneRegion(HWND hwnd, HRGN region) {
    int delta = 0;
    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        for (const auto& state : g_statusStates) {
            if (state.host && state.paneExtensionActive &&
                state.navigationSink == hwnd &&
                state.navigationNativeRectValid &&
                state.navigationAppliedRectValid) {
                delta = (state.navigationAppliedRect.bottom -
                         state.navigationAppliedRect.top) -
                        (state.navigationNativeRect.bottom -
                         state.navigationNativeRect.top);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    RECT box = {};
    if (delta <= 0 || GetRgnBox(region, &box) != SIMPLEREGION)
        return;
    const RECT extended = {box.left, box.top, box.right, box.bottom + delta};
    if (!SetRectRgn(region, extended.left, extended.top, extended.right,
                    extended.bottom)) {
        return;
    }

    ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
    for (auto& state : g_statusStates) {
        if (state.host && state.navigationSink == hwnd) {
            state.navigationNativeRegionBox = box;
            state.navigationNativeRegionBoxValid = true;
            state.navigationAppliedRegionBox = extended;
            state.navigationAppliedRegionBoxValid = true;
            break;
        }
    }
}

int WINAPI SetWindowRgnHook(HWND hwnd, HRGN region, BOOL redraw) {
    if (region && Mode() && !g_settingPaneGeometry && !Unloading()) {
        ExtendPaneRegion(hwnd, region);
    }
    return g_setWindowRgnOriginal(hwnd, region, redraw);
}

void ApplyStatusHost(HWND host) {
    if (!Active() || !IsWindow(host))
        return;
    if (g_applyingStatusLayout) {
        QueueHostUpdate(host);
        return;
    }

    struct ApplyingLayoutScope {
        ApplyingLayoutScope() {
            g_applyingStatusLayout = true;
        }
        ~ApplyingLayoutScope() {
            g_applyingStatusLayout = false;
        }
    } applyingLayoutScope;

    StatusState snapshot = {};
    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host);
        if (!state || !state->element || !state->originalMarginValid)
            return;
        snapshot = *state;
    }

    // Only the host's subclass restores the buttons, margin and pane
    // (CleanupAll), so nothing is changed without it.
    if (!EnsureWindowSubclass(host))
        return;

    ApplyViewModeButtons(host, false);

    HWND tab = StatusHostTab(host);
    if (!tab) {
        RestoreStatusHost(host);
        return;
    }

    HWND shellView = snapshot.defView;
    if (!IsShellViewForTab(shellView, tab) || !IsWindowVisible(shellView))
        shellView = FindShellViewForTab(tab);

    RECT shellRect = {};
    RECT clientRect = {};
    // No view between the old view's destruction and the new one's
    // creation, and no width while minimized: the applied layout is kept
    // until the next update instead of restored for a moment.
    if (!shellView || !GetClientRect(host, &clientRect) ||
        !MapShellViewToHost(shellView, host, &shellRect)) {
        return;
    }

    const int clientWidth = clientRect.right - clientRect.left;
    if (clientWidth <= 0)
        return;

    const bool paneBoundaryUsable =
        snapshot.paneVisualRightValid && shellRect.left > clientRect.left &&
        snapshot.paneVisualRight > clientRect.left &&
        snapshot.paneVisualRight < clientRect.right;
    const int visualLeft = paneBoundaryUsable ? snapshot.paneVisualRight
                                               : shellRect.left;
    int left = visualLeft - clientRect.left;
    // The right-side details/preview pane deliberately shares the status-bar
    // row; only the navigation pane claims space on the left.
    int right = 0;
    if (left < 0)
        left = 0;
    if (right < 0)
        right = 0;
    if (left > clientWidth)
        left = clientWidth;
    if (right > clientWidth - left)
        right = clientWidth - left;

    RECT desired = {
        left,
        snapshot.originalMargin.top,
        right,
        snapshot.originalMargin.bottom,
    };

    const bool marginAlreadyApplied =
        snapshot.appliedMarginValid &&
        RectEquals(snapshot.appliedMargin, desired) &&
        snapshot.tab == tab && snapshot.defView == shellView;
    if (!marginAlreadyApplied) {
        const HRESULT result = SetElementMargin(snapshot.element, desired);
        if (FAILED(result)) {
            Wh_Log(L"[Apply] SetMargin failed host=%p element=%p hr=0x%08X",
                   host, snapshot.element, static_cast<unsigned>(result));
            return;
        }
    }

    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host);
        if (state && state->element == snapshot.element) {
            state->tab = tab;
            state->defView = shellView;
            state->appliedMargin = desired;
            state->appliedMarginValid = true;
            state->contentBottom = shellRect.bottom;
            state->contentBottomValid = true;
            if (shellRect.left <= clientRect.left)
                state->paneVisualRightValid = false;
        }
    }

    EnsureWindowSubclass(tab);
    EnsureWindowSubclass(shellView);
    ApplyNavigationPaneExtension(host, tab, clientRect.bottom);
}

LRESULT CALLBACK LayoutSubclassProc(HWND hwnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam,
                                    LPARAM lParam, DWORD_PTR subclassData) {
    static_cast<void>(subclassData);

    if (message == g_cleanupMessage && g_cleanupMessage) {
        RestoreStatusHost(hwnd);
        MarkWindowUnsubclassed(hwnd);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, LayoutSubclassProc);
        return 0;
    }

    if (message == g_updateMessage && g_updateMessage) {
        {
            ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
            StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(hwnd);
            if (state)
                state->updatePosted = false;
        }
        ApplyStatusHost(hwnd);
        return 0;
    }

    if (message == WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGING && !g_settingPaneGeometry &&
        !Unloading()) {
        AdjustPaneWindowPos(hwnd, reinterpret_cast<WINDOWPOS*>(lParam));
    }

    if (message == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        HandleTrackedWindowDestroyed(hwnd);
        // Windhawk's wrapper removes itself before forwarding WM_NCDESTROY.
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
    }

    const LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
    if (Active()) {
        switch (message) {
            case WM_SIZE:
            case WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGED:
            case WM_SHOWWINDOW:
            case WM_PARENTNOTIFY:
            case WM_DPICHANGED:
            case WM_DPICHANGED_AFTERPARENT:
                QueueUpdatesForWindow(hwnd);
                break;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

void ActivateStatusHost(HWND host) {
    StatusState snapshot = {};
    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(host);
        if (!state)
            return;
        snapshot = *state;
    }

    EnsureWindowSubclass(host);
    EnsureWindowSubclass(snapshot.tab);
    ApplyStatusHost(host);
}

void ExtendRectBottom(RECT* rect, int bottom) {
    if (rect && bottom > rect->bottom)
        rect->bottom = bottom;
}

void ClipRectLeft(RECT* rect, int left) {
    if (!rect || left <= rect->left)
        return;
    rect->left = left < rect->right ? left : rect->right;
}

// An element of a view-mode button: the button or one of its first two
// levels of content.
bool IsInsideViewModeButton(void* element) {
    if (!DuiElement_GetParent_orig)
        return false;
    void* parent = DuiElement_GetParent_orig(element);
    for (int level = 0; parent && level < 2; ++level) {
        if (IsViewModeButton(parent))
            return true;
        parent = DuiElement_GetParent_orig(parent);
    }
    return false;
}

// The buttons are created visible by the status bar's markup, with no
// SetVisible call for ElementSetVisibleHook to see, and were drawn until the
// status bar's next paint hid them: a flash on new tabs and windows, or a
// whole first navigation. A button that should be hidden is never drawn:
// its first paint is skipped and it is hidden there for the next layout,
// with Explorer's visible state kept for restoring.
void HideViewButtonAtPaint(void* button) {
    if (!g_elementGetVisible || !g_elementGetVisible(button))
        return;
    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        bool requested = false;
        if (!LookupViewButtonRequestLocked(button, &requested))
            RecordViewButtonRequestLocked(button, true);
    }
    SetViewButtonVisible(button, false);
}


// ── Paint integration (DuiElement_Paint_hook / DuiElement_PaintBg_hook) ────

HWND PaintHost() {
    return g_statusPaintHost;
}

ExplorerElementKind ClassifyIdName(const wchar_t* idName) {
    if (!idName || !idName[0])
        return ExplorerElementKind::Other;
    if (_wcsicmp(idName, L"ProperTree") == 0)
        return ExplorerElementKind::ProperTree;
    if (_wcsicmp(idName, L"ProperTreeInner") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(idName, L"ProperTreeModuleInner") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(idName, L"ProperTreeHost") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(idName, L"PageSpaceControlSizer") == 0) {
        return ExplorerElementKind::PaneTheme;
    }
    if (_wcsicmp(idName, L"StatusBarModule") == 0)
        return ExplorerElementKind::StatusModule;
    if (_wcsicmp(idName, L"StatusBarModuleInner") == 0)
        return ExplorerElementKind::StatusInner;
    if (wcscmp(idName, L"ViewMode_Details") == 0 ||
        wcscmp(idName, L"ViewMode_LargeIcons") == 0) {
        return ExplorerElementKind::ViewButton;
    }
    return ExplorerElementKind::Other;
}

struct PaintRects {
    RECT update = {};
    RECT clip = {};
    RECT content = {};
    RECT children = {};
    HDC dc = nullptr;
    int savedDc = 0;
};

// Before Element::Paint inside the status host's paint: tracks the status
// element, keeps hidden view-mode buttons undrawn, extends the pane theme
// down through the released band and keeps the status bar right of the
// pane. False when the element must not be painted at all.
bool BeforeElementPaint(void* self, HDC hdc, const wchar_t* idName,
                        LPCRECT* updateRect, LPCRECT* clipRect,
                        LPRECT* contentRect, LPRECT* childrenRect,
                        PaintRects* rects) {
    HWND host = g_statusPaintHost;
    if (!host || Unloading())
        return true;

    const ExplorerElementKind kind = ClassifyIdName(idName);
    if (kind == ExplorerElementKind::StatusInner &&
        TrackStatusElement(self, host)) {
        g_statusElementSeenHost = host;
        ApplyViewModeButtons(host, false);
    }
    if (HideButtons()) {
        if (kind == ExplorerElementKind::ViewButton) {
            HideViewButtonAtPaint(self);
            return false;
        }
        if (kind == ExplorerElementKind::Other && IsInsideViewModeButton(self))
            return false;
    }
    if (kind == ExplorerElementKind::Other ||
        kind == ExplorerElementKind::ViewButton) {
        return true;
    }

    RECT client = {};
    if (!GetClientRect(host, &client))
        return true;

    auto adjust = [&](auto** rect, RECT* storage, bool extend) {
        if (!*rect)
            return;
        *storage = **rect;
        if (extend)
            ExtendRectBottom(storage, client.bottom);
        else
            ClipRectLeft(storage, g_panePaintRight);
        *rect = storage;
    };
    // Paint-only geometry avoids reflowing FolderLayoutContainer while still
    // covering the band released below the navigation module.
    if (IsPaneThemeElement(kind)) {
        adjust(updateRect, &rects->update, true);
        adjust(clipRect, &rects->clip, true);
        adjust(contentRect, &rects->content, true);
        adjust(childrenRect, &rects->children, true);
    } else if (IsStatusElement(kind) && g_panePaintRightValid) {
        adjust(updateRect, &rects->update, false);
        adjust(clipRect, &rects->clip, false);
        adjust(contentRect, &rects->content, false);
        adjust(childrenRect, &rects->children, false);
        // The DC clip is the final guard against fills that ignore
        // DirectUI's supplied clip rectangles during view recreation.
        if (hdc && (rects->savedDc = SaveDC(hdc)) != 0) {
            rects->dc = hdc;
