            IntersectClipRect(hdc, g_panePaintRight, client.top,
                              client.right, client.bottom);
        }
    }
    return true;
}

void AfterElementPaint(const PaintRects& rects) {
    if (rects.savedDc)
        RestoreDC(rects.dc, rects.savedDc);
}

// Before Element::PaintBackground inside the status host's paint, with the
// same geometry; ProperTree's painted right edge is where the status bar
// starts.
void BeforeElementPaintBackground(void* self, LPRECT* rect, LPRECT* clipRect,
                                  LPRECT* targetRect, RECT (&storage)[3]) {
    HWND host = g_statusPaintHost;
    if (!host || Unloading())
        return;
    const ExplorerElementKind kind = ClassifyExplorerElement(self);
    if (kind == ExplorerElementKind::Other ||
        kind == ExplorerElementKind::ViewButton) {
        return;
    }
    if (kind == ExplorerElementKind::ProperTree && *rect)
        UpdatePaneVisualRight(host, (*rect)->right);

    RECT client = {};
    if (!GetClientRect(host, &client))
        return;
    const bool extend = IsPaneThemeElement(kind);
    if (!extend && !(IsStatusElement(kind) && g_panePaintRightValid))
        return;
    LPRECT* targets[3] = {rect, clipRect, targetRect};
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        if (!*targets[i])
            continue;
        storage[i] = **targets[i];
        if (extend)
            ExtendRectBottom(&storage[i], client.bottom);
        else
            ClipRectLeft(&storage[i], g_panePaintRight);
        *targets[i] = &storage[i];
    }
}

// From BeginPaint_hook, before the real BeginPaint.
void OnBeginPaint(HWND hwnd, bool isDirectUiHost) {
    if (!isDirectUiHost || !Active() || !IsExplorerStatusHost(hwnd))
        return;
    g_statusPaintHost = hwnd;
    g_statusElementSeenHost = nullptr;
    g_paneElementSeenHost = nullptr;
    g_panePaintRight = 0;
    g_panePaintRightValid = false;

    StatusState snapshot = {};
    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        if (StatusState* state = FindStatusStateByHostLocked(hwnd))
            snapshot = *state;
    }
    if (snapshot.paneVisualRightValid) {
        g_panePaintRight = snapshot.paneVisualRight;
        g_panePaintRightValid = true;

        RECT client = {};
        if (snapshot.contentBottomValid && GetClientRect(hwnd, &client)) {
            const int top = snapshot.contentBottom > client.top
                                ? snapshot.contentBottom - 1
                                : client.top;
            RECT paneBand = {client.left, top, snapshot.paneVisualRight,
                             client.bottom};
            if (paneBand.left < paneBand.right &&
                paneBand.top < paneBand.bottom) {
                // Include one native pane row so DirectUI visits the
                // module before it extends into the released band.
                InvalidateRect(hwnd, &paneBand, FALSE);
            }
        }
    }
}

// From EndPaint_hook, before the real EndPaint: ends this host's paint
// state. True when the layout should be applied after EndPaint.
bool OnEndPaint(HWND hwnd) {
    if (g_statusPaintHost != hwnd)
        return false;
    const bool elementSeen = g_statusElementSeenHost == hwnd ||
                             g_paneElementSeenHost == hwnd;
    g_statusPaintHost = nullptr;
    g_statusElementSeenHost = nullptr;
    g_paneElementSeenHost = nullptr;
    g_panePaintRight = 0;
    g_panePaintRightValid = false;
    return elementSeen && Active();
}

void AfterEndPaint(HWND hwnd) {
    ActivateStatusHost(hwnd);
}

// ── Symbols and lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

bool SymbolsReady() {
    return DuiElement_OnDestroy_orig && g_elementGetMargin &&
           g_elementSetMargin && DuiElement_GetID_orig;
}

// The DirectUI capability: margin and visibility accessors and the SetVisible
// hook. Tracked pointers also depend on the shared OnDestroy hook, which the
// ElementLifetime capability installs. True when hooks were queued.
bool ResolveSymbols(HMODULE dui70) {
    g_elementGetMargin = reinterpret_cast<ElementGetMarginFn>(DuiExport(
        dui70,
        "?GetMargin@Element@DirectUI@@QEAAPEBUtagRECT@@PEAPEAVValue@2@@Z",
        "?GetMargin@Element@DirectUI@@QAEPBUtagRECT@@PAPAVValue@2@@Z"));
    g_elementSetMargin = reinterpret_cast<ElementSetMarginFn>(DuiExport(
        dui70, "?SetMargin@Element@DirectUI@@QEAAJHHHH@Z",
        "?SetMargin@Element@DirectUI@@QAEJHHHH@Z"));
    g_valueRelease = reinterpret_cast<ValueReleaseFn>(DuiExport(
        dui70, "?Release@Value@DirectUI@@QEAAXXZ",
        "?Release@Value@DirectUI@@QAEXXZ"));
    g_elementFindDescendent = reinterpret_cast<ElementFindDescendentFn>(
        DuiExport(dui70, "?FindDescendent@Element@DirectUI@@QEAAPEAV12@G@Z",
                  "?FindDescendent@Element@DirectUI@@QAEPAV12@G@Z"));
    g_elementGetVisible = reinterpret_cast<ElementGetVisibleFn>(DuiExport(
        dui70, "?GetVisible@Element@DirectUI@@QEAA_NXZ",
        "?GetVisible@Element@DirectUI@@QAE_NXZ"));
    g_elementSetVisible = reinterpret_cast<ElementSetVisibleFn>(DuiExport(
        dui70, "?SetVisible@Element@DirectUI@@QEAAJ_N@Z",
        "?SetVisible@Element@DirectUI@@QAEJ_N@Z"));
    if (!g_elementGetMargin || !g_elementSetMargin)
        return false;

    bool queued = false;
    if (g_elementSetVisible && !g_elementSetVisibleOriginal &&
        SetResolvedSymbolHook(reinterpret_cast<void*>(g_elementSetVisible),
                              ElementSetVisibleHook,
                              &g_elementSetVisibleOriginal)) {
        queued = true;
    }
    return queued;
}

// Once the hooks registered by ResolveSymbols are applied.
void MarkHooksLive() {
    if (SymbolsReady() && g_duiElementLifetimeLive.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        g_hooksLive.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
}

void Init() {
    g_updateMessage = RegisterWindowMessageW(
        L"Win32UIModernizer.StatusWidth.Update");
    g_cleanupMessage = RegisterWindowMessageW(
        L"Win32UIModernizer.StatusWidth.Cleanup");
}

// Restores every host on its own thread and removes every subclass. A
// blocking send: the subclass procedure must be gone before the module is.
void CleanupAll() {
    HWND hosts[kStatusStateCapacity] = {};
    size_t hostCount = 0;
    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        for (const auto& state : g_statusStates) {
            if (state.host && hostCount < ARRAYSIZE(hosts))
                hosts[hostCount++] = state.host;
        }
    }
    // Status hosts go first so their DirectUI elements are restored on the
    // owning UI thread before every callback is detached.
    for (size_t i = 0; i < hostCount; ++i) {
        if (g_cleanupMessage && IsWindow(hosts[i]))
            SendMessageW(hosts[i], g_cleanupMessage, 0, 0);
    }

    HWND windows[kSubclassWindowCapacity] = {};
    size_t windowCount = 0;
    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        for (const auto& state : g_subclassWindows) {
            if (state.hwnd && state.installed &&
                windowCount < ARRAYSIZE(windows)) {
                windows[windowCount++] = state.hwnd;
            }
        }
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < windowCount; ++i) {
        if (g_cleanupMessage && IsWindow(windows[i]))
            SendMessageW(windows[i], g_cleanupMessage, 0, 0);
    }

    ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
    for (auto& state : g_statusStates)
        state = {};
    for (auto& state : g_subclassWindows)
        state = {};
    for (auto& request : g_viewButtonRequests)
        request = {};
    g_anyTracked.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
}

bool AnyTracked() {
    return g_anyTracked.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

BOOL CALLBACK RedrawExplorerWindow(HWND hwnd, LPARAM) {
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid == GetCurrentProcessId() &&
        (IsClassName(hwnd, L"CabinetWClass") ||
         IsClassName(hwnd, L"ExploreWClass"))) {
        RedrawWindow(hwnd, nullptr, nullptr,
                     RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
    }
    return TRUE;
}

void SettingsChanged(int oldMode) {
    const int mode = Mode();
    if (mode == oldMode)
        return;
    if (!mode) {
        CleanupAll();
        return;
    }
    // Tracking starts at the status bar's next paint.
    if (!oldMode) {
        EnumWindows(RedrawExplorerWindow, 0);
        return;
    }
    HWND hosts[kStatusStateCapacity] = {};
    size_t count = 0;
    {
        ExclusiveSrwLock lock(&g_stateLock);
        for (const auto& state : g_statusStates) {
            if (state.host && count < ARRAYSIZE(hosts))
                hosts[count++] = state.host;
        }
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        QueueHostUpdate(hosts[i]);
}

void BeforeUninit() {
    g_unloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    CleanupAll();
}

}  // namespace StatusWidth

// The id name of an element painting inside one of Explorer's outer host
// paints (the status bar host, the content pane's outer host), read once per
// element for every check below; empty elsewhere, so no other DirectUI
// host's per-element paint pays the atom lookup. DirectUI releases these
// local atoms with the element tree and a later window can register the same
// name under a different value, so the live name is read, never a cached
// numeric ATOM.
static void ReadOuterHostElementIdName(void* element, wchar_t (&idName)[32])
{
    idName[0] = L'\0';
    if (!element || !DuiElement_GetID_orig ||
        (!t_explorerStatusBarDuiPaintHwnd && !t_explorerOuterDuiPaintHwnd &&
         !StatusWidth::PaintHost()))
        return;
    const ATOM id = static_cast<ATOM>(DuiElement_GetID_orig(element));
    if (!id || !GetAtomNameW(id, idName, ARRAYSIZE(idName)))
        idName[0] = L'\0';
}

static bool IsExplorerMicaStatusBarTopRuleTarget(
    const wchar_t* idName, HDC hdc, HWND* statusBarHwnd)
{
    // Only while the status bar host's own paint is open (classified once
    // per BeginPaint): the rect is consumed at that paint's EndPaint.
    HWND hwnd = t_explorerStatusBarDuiPaintHwnd;
    if (!hwnd || !hdc || !idName[0] ||
        (_wcsicmp(idName, L"StatusBarModule") != 0 &&
         _wcsicmp(idName, L"StatusBarModuleInner") != 0)) {
        return false;
    }

    if (statusBarHwnd)
        *statusBarHwnd = hwnd;
    return true;
}

static void PaintExplorerMicaStatusBarTopRule(
    HDC hdc, const ExplorerMicaStatusBarPaintState& state)
{
    RECT lineRect = {
        state.rect.left,
        state.rect.top,
        state.rect.right,
        state.rect.top + 1,
    };
    if (!IntersectRect(&lineRect, &lineRect, &state.clipRect))
        return;

    // Same CardStroke hairline as the content pane edge; vertical field
    // separators keep their own colors.
    PaintExplorerPaneRule(hdc, lineRect);
}

// Mica content pane edge: the nav pane module's DirectUI root (element id
// "ProperTree", shell32 UIFILE 52 -- ProperTree > ProperTreeInner >
// ProperTreeHost + PageSpaceControlSizer) spans from the window's left
// edge to where the view host begins, so its right edge is the column the
// CardStroke hairline goes in. Captured like the status bar's top rule:
// element identified by id in Element::Paint, bounds taken from that
// element's PaintBackground, line written on the host's own paint DC at
// EndPaint, with the column folded into every update region at BeginPaint.
struct ExplorerMicaPaneEdgePaintState {
    void* element = nullptr;
    HWND hwnd = nullptr;
    RECT rect = {};
    bool captured = false;
};

static thread_local ExplorerMicaPaneEdgePaintState*
    g_explorerMicaPaneEdgePaintState = nullptr;
static thread_local ExplorerMicaPaneEdgePaintState
    g_pendingExplorerMicaPaneEdgePaintState = {};
static thread_local HwndRectSlots g_explorerMicaPaneEdgeRects;

static bool IsExplorerMicaPaneEdgeTarget(
    const wchar_t* idName, HDC hdc, HWND* hostHwnd)
{
    // Only while the outer host's own paint is open (see the flag): the
    // rect is used at that paint's EndPaint anyway.
    HWND hwnd = t_explorerOuterDuiPaintHwnd;
    if (!hwnd || !hdc || !idName[0] || _wcsicmp(idName, L"ProperTree") != 0)
        return false;

    if (hostHwnd)
        *hostHwnd = hwnd;
    return true;
}

// The nav tree's CtrlNotifySink (the HWND ProperTree hosts) per outer
// host, searched again only once it's no longer that host's child.
struct ExplorerNavTreeSinkEntry {
    HWND host;
    HWND sink;
};
static thread_local ExplorerNavTreeSinkEntry t_explorerNavTreeSinks[4];
static thread_local unsigned t_explorerNavTreeSinkNext;

static HWND ExplorerNavTreeSink(HWND host)
{
    for (const ExplorerNavTreeSinkEntry& entry : t_explorerNavTreeSinks) {
        if (entry.host == host && GetParent(entry.sink) == host)
            return entry.sink;
    }
    for (HWND sink = FindWindowExW(host, nullptr, L"CtrlNotifySink", nullptr);
         sink; sink = FindWindowExW(host, sink, L"CtrlNotifySink", nullptr)) {
        if (!FindWindowExW(sink, nullptr, L"NamespaceTreeControl", nullptr))
            continue;
        for (ExplorerNavTreeSinkEntry& entry : t_explorerNavTreeSinks) {
            if (entry.host == host) {
                entry.sink = sink;
                return sink;
            }
        }
        t_explorerNavTreeSinks[t_explorerNavTreeSinkNext++ %
            ARRAYSIZE(t_explorerNavTreeSinks)] = {host, sink};
        return sink;
    }
    return nullptr;
}

// That sink in the outer host's client coordinates.
static bool ExplorerNavTreeSinkRect(HWND host, RECT* rect)
{
    HWND sink = ExplorerNavTreeSink(host);
    if (!sink || !IsWindowVisible(sink) || !GetWindowRect(sink, rect))
        return false;
    MapWindowPoints(nullptr, host, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(rect), 2);
    return true;
}

// The captured ProperTree rect, starting where the nav tree does now. With
// an InfoBar shown (a network folder) the InfoBar takes the top of the
// host and pushes the nav tree down, but ProperTree's painted rect still
// starts at the host's top, so the line ran over the InfoBar.
static RECT ExplorerMicaPaneEdgeModuleNow(HWND hwnd, const RECT& captured)
{
    RECT module = captured;
    RECT sink = {};
    if (ExplorerNavTreeSinkRect(hwnd, &sink))
        module.top = sink.top;
    return module;
}

static RECT ExplorerMicaPaneEdgeColumn(HWND hwnd, const RECT& navModule)
{
    const int lineW = std::max(1, (int)std::lround(
        (float)GetDpiForWindow(hwnd) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI));
    return { navModule.right - lineW, navModule.top,
             navModule.right, navModule.bottom };
}

// Solid content pane. In the list host's DirectUI tree (probed live:
// three unnamed roots > ViewerContainer > LineScroller > UICollectionHost
// > UIItemsHost > groups/items) exactly one element carries a background
// fill: the first root, spanning the whole client, whose Value is of type
// 9 (fill); every other link's Value is type 1. It paints the theme color
// with GDI (alpha 0, revealing the backdrop), so right after its
// PaintBackground the same clip is rewritten opaque in the flattened layer
// color, before any content paints.
static bool ExplorerMicaSolidPaneSpansViewer(const RECT& client, int slack,
    const RECT& rect)
{
    return rect.left <= client.left && rect.top <= client.top + slack &&
           rect.right >= client.right - slack && rect.bottom >= client.bottom;
}

static bool ExplorerMicaSolidPaneSpansViewer(HWND host, const RECT& rect)
{
    RECT client = {};
    if (!GetClientRect(host, &client))
        return false;
    const int slack = MulDiv(32, GetDpiForWindow(host), USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI);
    return ExplorerMicaSolidPaneSpansViewer(client, slack, rect);
}

// The animation's capture bitmap is content-sized: as wide as the viewer,
// but only as tall as the items when they fit without scrolling.
static bool ExplorerMicaSolidPaneSpansViewerWidth(HWND host, const RECT& rect)
{
    RECT client = {};
    if (!GetClientRect(host, &client))
        return false;
    const int slack = MulDiv(32, GetDpiForWindow(host), USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI);
    return rect.left <= client.left && rect.right >= client.right - slack;
}

// The viewer-spanning chain of each list host (roots > ViewerContainer >
// LineScroller > UICollectionHost > UIItemsHost), remembered from paints
// inside that host's BeginPaint. DirectUI also paints parts of the tree
// outside any BeginPaint: the root alone on a window DC, and -- for the
// group expand/collapse animation -- the LineScroller subtree into a
// content-sized memory bitmap that the animation frames then blit over
// the root. There only the element's identity says whose paint this is.
struct ExplorerMicaSolidPaneChainEntry { HWND host; void* element; };
static thread_local ExplorerMicaSolidPaneChainEntry t_explorerMicaSolidPaneChain[16] = {};
static thread_local unsigned t_explorerMicaSolidPaneChainNext = 0;
// The previous PaintBackground on this thread, to fill a captured bitmap
// once: at the first chain member painted into it.
static thread_local HDC t_explorerMicaSolidPaneLastBgDc = nullptr;
static thread_local bool t_explorerMicaSolidPaneLastBgCapture = false;

// The outer DUI host (the DirectUIHWND under DUIViewWndClassName; probed
// live: main > FolderLayoutContainer > ProperTree module | ... >
// ViewHostContainer > clientviewhost > listview). "main" and
// "FolderLayoutContainer" fill the whole client; "listview" is the
// HWNDElement hosting the CtrlNotifySink whose child is SHELLDLL_DefView,
// the last fill over the view region, and it also erases the sink's own
// DC when the view is recreated on navigation. An opaque rewrite after
// each keeps the backdrop from showing around, behind or before the list;
// the nav pane and status bar modules repaint their own fills afterwards.
// Resolved by id on every paint: "listview" is recreated per navigation,
// so a remembered address could be another element's the next time.
static bool IsExplorerMicaSolidOuterFill(void* element)
{
    if (!DuiElement_GetID_orig)
        return false;
    const ATOM id = static_cast<ATOM>(DuiElement_GetID_orig(element));
    wchar_t idName[32] = {};
    if (!id || !GetAtomNameW(id, idName, ARRAYSIZE(idName)))
        return false;
    return _wcsicmp(idName, L"listview") == 0 ||
           _wcsicmp(idName, L"FolderLayoutContainer") == 0 ||
           _wcsicmp(idName, L"main") == 0;
}

static void ExplorerMicaSolidPaneAfterDuiBg(void* element, HDC hdc,
    LPCRECT pRect, LPCRECT pClipRect, int valueType)
{
    if (!hdc || !pRect || !element)
        return;
    const bool afterCapture = t_explorerMicaSolidPaneLastBgDc == hdc &&
                              t_explorerMicaSolidPaneLastBgCapture;
    t_explorerMicaSolidPaneLastBgDc = hdc;
    t_explorerMicaSolidPaneLastBgCapture = false;

    const bool dark = g_darkModeActive;
    // Solid tiles, or the picker's light reveal fill (GDI, alpha 0) -- see
    // FilePickerListFillRewritten.
    const bool solid = ExplorerMicaSolidPaneMode();
    auto writeRect = [&](const RECT& fill) {
        if (solid)
            WriteExplorerMicaSolidPixels(hdc, fill, dark);
        else if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(FilePickerListColor(dark)))
            FillRect_orig(hdc, &fill, br);
    };
    auto writeClipped = [&]() {
        RECT fill = *pRect;
        if (!pClipRect || IntersectRect(&fill, &fill, pClipRect))
            writeRect(fill);
    };

    auto& chain = t_explorerMicaSolidPaneChain;
    HWND host = t_explorerListDuiPaintHwnd;
    if (host) {
        if (!ExplorerMicaSolidPaneSpansViewer(t_explorerListDuiPaintClient,
                t_explorerListDuiPaintSlack, *pRect))
            return;
        bool known = false;
        for (const auto& r : chain)
            known = known || (r.host == host && r.element == element);
        if (!known) {
            chain[t_explorerMicaSolidPaneChainNext % ARRAYSIZE(chain)] = { host, element };
            ++t_explorerMicaSolidPaneChainNext;
        }
        if (valueType == 9)
            writeClipped();
        return;
    }

    for (const auto& r : chain)
        if (r.element == element) host = r.host;
    // The picker's captures come from the list host's own messages; the
    // bracket names it even for elements the chain never saw.
    if (!host && FilePickerListFillRewritten() && t_filePickerListHostDepth > 0)
        host = t_filePickerListHostCurrent;
    if (host) {
        if (!IsWindow(host))
            return;
        const bool spans = ExplorerMicaSolidPaneSpansViewer(host, *pRect);
        if (spans && valueType == 9) {
            writeClipped();
            return;
        }
        // Animation capture: fill the whole bitmap (the clip) before content.
        // A short folder's capture is not as tall as the viewer.
        if (WindowFromDC(hdc) ||
            !(spans || ExplorerMicaSolidPaneSpansViewerWidth(host, *pRect)))
            return;
        t_explorerMicaSolidPaneLastBgCapture = true;
        if (!afterCapture)
            writeRect(pClipRect ? *pClipRect : *pRect);
        return;
    }

    if (valueType == 9 && (t_explorerOuterDuiPaintHwnd || WindowFromDC(hdc)) &&
        IsExplorerMicaSolidOuterFill(element))
        writeClipped();
}

static void ExplorerMicaPaneEdgeBeginPaint(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (g_pendingExplorerMicaPaneEdgePaintState.hwnd == hwnd)
        g_pendingExplorerMicaPaneEdgePaintState = {};

    auto rectIt = g_explorerMicaPaneEdgeRects.find(hwnd);
    if (rectIt == g_explorerMicaPaneEdgeRects.end())
        return;

    if (!ExplorerMicaPaneMode() || !IsWindow(hwnd) ||
        !IsExplorerOuterDuiHost(hwnd)) {
        g_explorerMicaPaneEdgeRects.erase(rectIt);
        return;
    }

    // Before the real BeginPaint, so the column joins this update region
    // instead of scheduling another paint cycle.
    RECT column = ExplorerMicaPaneEdgeColumn(hwnd,
        ExplorerMicaPaneEdgeModuleNow(hwnd, rectIt->second));
    InvalidateRect(hwnd, &column, FALSE);
}

static void ExplorerMicaPaneEdgeEndPaint(
    HWND hwnd, const PAINTSTRUCT* paintStruct)
{
    auto& pending = g_pendingExplorerMicaPaneEdgePaintState;
    if (pending.hwnd == hwnd && pending.captured) {
        if (g_explorerMicaPaneEdgeRects.size() >= 16 &&
            !g_explorerMicaPaneEdgeRects.contains(hwnd)) {
            g_explorerMicaPaneEdgeRects.EraseDestroyed();
            if (g_explorerMicaPaneEdgeRects.size() >= 16)
                g_explorerMicaPaneEdgeRects.clear();
        }
        g_explorerMicaPaneEdgeRects[hwnd] = pending.rect;
    }

    auto rectIt = g_explorerMicaPaneEdgeRects.find(hwnd);
    // The legacy frame showing Control Panel: the nav pane module is gone,
    // so the column is dropped instead of drawn where the pane used to be.
    if (rectIt != g_explorerMicaPaneEdgeRects.end() &&
        t_controlPanelModulePaintHwnd == hwnd) {
        g_explorerMicaPaneEdgeRects.erase(rectIt);
        rectIt = g_explorerMicaPaneEdgeRects.end();
    }
    if (rectIt != g_explorerMicaPaneEdgeRects.end() && paintStruct &&
        paintStruct->hdc && ExplorerMicaPaneMode()) {
        RECT line = ExplorerMicaPaneEdgeColumn(hwnd,
            ExplorerMicaPaneEdgeModuleNow(hwnd, rectIt->second));
        if (IntersectRect(&line, &line, &paintStruct->rcPaint))
            PaintExplorerPaneRule(paintStruct->hdc, line);
    }

    if (pending.hwnd == hwnd)
        pending = {};
}

// Common file picker separators. The picker (#32770 hosting a
// NamespaceTreeControl) lays out its toolbar band, nav pane and view in one
// DirectUIHWND (DUIViewWndClassName > DirectUIHWND) with no theme part or
// element fill marking their edges; probed: the band ends where the tree's
// CtrlNotifySink starts, the view's CtrlNotifySink starts past the 4 DIP
// splitter (PageSpaceControlSizer). Open templates normally end the outer
// host with the view; Save templates can keep their file-name controls in
// that same host below SHELLDLL_DefView. The view's actual bottom therefore
// bounds the pane/splitter and, when it is inside the host, starts the chrome
// band and its rule. WinUI's DividerStrokeColorDefault (#15FFFFFF
// dark / #0F000000 light) composed over the opaque host paint at EndPaint,
// the rows joining the update region at BeginPaint like the Mica pane edge.
// Same gate as the chrome shade (FilePickerChromeEnabled).
static bool IsFilePickerOuterDuiHost(HWND hwnd)
{
    return IsExplorerOuterDuiHost(hwnd) && FilePickerRoot(hwnd);
}

static int FilePickerSeparatorWidth(HWND hwnd)
{
    return std::max(1, (int)std::lround(
        (float)GetDpiForWindow(hwnd) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI));
}

// The band's bottom row, the splitter column next to the view and, for Save
// templates, the rule above the in-host file-name controls. All coordinates
// are relative to host. Returns the count written (0..3); contentBottom gets
// SHELLDLL_DefView's bottom, while viewSink gets its CtrlNotifySink.
static int FilePickerSeparatorLines(HWND host, RECT lines[3],
    int* bandBottom = nullptr, int* viewLeft = nullptr,
    int* contentBottom = nullptr, HWND* viewSink = nullptr)
{
    RECT client;
    if (!GetClientRect(host, &client))
        return 0;
    HWND tree = nullptr, view = nullptr, defView = nullptr;
    for (HWND sink = FindWindowExW(host, nullptr, L"CtrlNotifySink", nullptr);
         sink; sink = FindWindowExW(host, sink, L"CtrlNotifySink", nullptr)) {
        if (!tree && FindWindowExW(sink, nullptr, L"NamespaceTreeControl", nullptr))
            tree = sink;
        else if (!view &&
                 (defView = FindWindowExW(sink, nullptr, L"SHELLDLL_DefView", nullptr)))
            view = sink;
    }
    if (!tree || !IsWindowVisible(tree))
        return 0;
    RECT rcTree;
    if (!GetWindowRect(tree, &rcTree))
        return 0;
    MapWindowPoints(HWND_DESKTOP, host, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(&rcTree), 2);
    if (bandBottom)
        *bandBottom = rcTree.top;
    const int lineW = FilePickerSeparatorWidth(host);
    int n = 0;
    if (rcTree.top - lineW >= client.top)
        lines[n++] = { client.left, rcTree.top - lineW, client.right, rcTree.top };
    int viewBottom = client.bottom;
    RECT rcView;
    if (view && IsWindowVisible(view) && GetWindowRect(view, &rcView)) {
        MapWindowPoints(HWND_DESKTOP, host, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(&rcView), 2);
        if (viewLeft)
            *viewLeft = rcView.left;
        if (viewSink)
            *viewSink = view;
        RECT rcDefView;
        if (defView && IsWindowVisible(defView) && GetWindowRect(defView, &rcDefView)) {
            MapWindowPoints(HWND_DESKTOP, host,
                reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(&rcDefView), 2);
            viewBottom = std::clamp(rcDefView.bottom, rcTree.top, client.bottom);
        }
        if (contentBottom)
            *contentBottom = viewBottom;
        if (rcView.left - lineW >= rcTree.right &&
            !(FilePickerMicaActive() && ExplorerBackdropMode() == 1))
            lines[n++] = { rcView.left - lineW, rcTree.top, rcView.left, viewBottom };
        if (viewBottom < client.bottom)
            lines[n++] = { client.left, viewBottom,
                           client.right,
                           std::min<int>(client.bottom, viewBottom + lineW) };
    }
    return n;
}

// The outer picker host inside its own BeginPaint bracket, with the band
// height, host size and view edge its DirectUI fills are matched against.
static thread_local HWND t_filePickerOuterDuiPaintHwnd = nullptr;
static thread_local int t_filePickerBandBottom = 0;
static thread_local int t_filePickerHostWidth = 0;
static thread_local int t_filePickerHostHeight = 0;
static thread_local int t_filePickerViewLeft = 0;
static thread_local int t_filePickerContentBottom = 0;
// The view whose ScrollBars were last given the list bracket: the first
// folder's bars are created before the nav tree exists, so the creation
// hook can't recognize the picker yet (probed: first folder's bar on the
// default shade, stable from the next navigation on).
static thread_local HWND t_filePickerBracketedView = nullptr;

static BOOL CALLBACK FilePickerListScrollBarSweep(HWND child, LPARAM)
{
    if (IsClassName(child, L"ScrollBar"))
        FilePickerBracketSubclassInstall(child, FilePickerBracketListScrollBar);
    else if (IsClassName(child, L"DirectUIHWND") &&
             IsClassName(GetParent(child), L"SHELLDLL_DefView"))
        FilePickerBracketSubclassInstall(child, FilePickerBracketListHost);
    return TRUE;
}

static void FilePickerSeparatorsBeginPaint(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!FilePickerChromeEnabled() || !IsFilePickerOuterDuiHost(hwnd))
        return;
    t_filePickerOuterDuiPaintHwnd = hwnd;
    t_filePickerBandBottom = 0;
    t_filePickerViewLeft = 0;
    t_filePickerContentBottom = 0;
    RECT client = {};
    GetClientRect(hwnd, &client);
    t_filePickerHostWidth = client.right;
    t_filePickerHostHeight = client.bottom;
    // Before the real BeginPaint, so the rows join this update region.
    RECT lines[3];
    HWND view = nullptr;
    const int n = FilePickerSeparatorLines(hwnd, lines,
        &t_filePickerBandBottom, &t_filePickerViewLeft,
        &t_filePickerContentBottom, &view);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        InvalidateRect(hwnd, &lines[i], FALSE);
    if (t_filePickerContentBottom > t_filePickerBandBottom &&
        t_filePickerContentBottom < client.bottom) {
        RECT chrome = { client.left, t_filePickerContentBottom,
                        client.right, client.bottom };
        InvalidateRect(hwnd, &chrome, FALSE);
    }
    if (FilePickerMicaActive())
        FilePickerApplyBackdrop(GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT));
    if (FilePickerListShaded() && view && view != t_filePickerBracketedView) {
        t_filePickerBracketedView = view;
        EnumChildWindows(view, FilePickerListScrollBarSweep, 0);
    }
}

// The toolbar band's own fills (FolderBandModuleInner and its layers,
// probed: type 9 values spanning the host width from the top down to the
// nav pane's top) repainted in the chrome shade after DirectUI's fill; the
// nav pane module's (ProperTree and its layers, plus the
// PageSpaceControlSizer splitter: type 9 values in FolderLayoutContainer's
// frame ending at the view's left edge over the pane's full height) in the
// pane shade.
static void FilePickerChromeAfterDuiBg(HWND paintHwnd, HDC hdc,
    LPCRECT pRect, LPCRECT pClipRect, int elementType)
{
    if (elementType != 9 || !pRect || !hdc ||
        paintHwnd != t_filePickerOuterDuiPaintHwnd || !t_filePickerBandBottom ||
        pRect->top != 0)
        return;
    COLORREF color;
    if (pRect->left == 0 && pRect->bottom == t_filePickerBandBottom &&
        pRect->right >= t_filePickerHostWidth) {
        color = FilePickerChromeColor(g_darkModeActive);
    } else if (t_filePickerViewLeft > 0 && pRect->left >= 0 &&
               pRect->left < t_filePickerViewLeft &&
               pRect->right == t_filePickerViewLeft &&
               pRect->bottom == t_filePickerHostHeight - t_filePickerBandBottom) {
        color = FilePickerPaneColor(g_darkModeActive);
    } else {
        return;
    }
    RECT fill = *pRect;
    if (pClipRect && !IntersectRect(&fill, &fill, pClipRect))
        return;
    if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(color))
        FillRect_orig(hdc, &fill, br);
}

static void FilePickerSeparatorsEndPaint(HWND hwnd, const PAINTSTRUCT* paintStruct)
{
    if (t_filePickerOuterDuiPaintHwnd != hwnd)
        return;
    t_filePickerOuterDuiPaintHwnd = nullptr;
    if (!paintStruct || !paintStruct->hdc)
        return;
    RECT lines[3];
    int bandBottom = 0, viewLeft = 0, contentBottom = 0;
    const int n = FilePickerSeparatorLines(
        hwnd, lines, &bandBottom, &viewLeft, &contentBottom);
    // The pane's host-painted margins (the tree's 3 DIP inset and the
    // splitter column up to the rule) in the pane shade: the host clips
    // its children, so the whole pane rect can be filled. The DirectUI
    // recolor above covers the same fills when they repaint on their own.
    if (bandBottom > 0 && viewLeft > 0) {
        RECT client;
        GetClientRect(hwnd, &client);
        const int paneBottom = contentBottom > 0 ? contentBottom : client.bottom;
        RECT pane = { client.left, bandBottom,
                      viewLeft - FilePickerSeparatorWidth(hwnd), paneBottom };
        if (IntersectRect(&pane, &pane, &paintStruct->rcPaint)) {
            if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(FilePickerPaneColor(g_darkModeActive)))
                FillRect_orig(paintStruct->hdc, &pane, br);
        }
        // Save templates leave their file-name/type controls in the same
        // DirectUI host below DefView. The host clips child HWNDs, so this
        // restores only their exposed chrome background without covering
        // the controls themselves.
        if (contentBottom > bandBottom && contentBottom < client.bottom) {
            RECT chrome = { client.left, contentBottom,
                            client.right, client.bottom };
            if (IntersectRect(&chrome, &chrome, &paintStruct->rcPaint))
                FilePickerEraseChrome(paintStruct->hdc, chrome, g_darkModeActive);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        RECT line;
        if (IntersectRect(&line, &lines[i], &paintStruct->rcPaint))
            FilePickerRule(paintStruct->hdc, line,
                contentBottom <= 0 || lines[i].top < contentBottom);
    }
}

// Chrome that sits inside an extended frame but stays opaque: its GDI paints
// (native band backgrounds, breadcrumb and search text, glyphs, the ribbon's
// fill) leave alpha 0 and DWM would add them to the backdrop, so after each
// paint of such a window the painted rect's alpha is set back to 255 through
// a DIB round trip -- the RGB is already the opaque result. Covers the
// picker's rebar, and in Explorer's legacy frame the rebar
// in light -- the dark one is filled opaque by PaintExplorerRebarMicaTintRect
// and its white text survives the add -- and the ribbon (NetUIHWND) in both
// themes (blown out in light, lifted in dark).
static void RepairOpaqueChromeAlpha(HWND hwnd, const PAINTSTRUCT* paintStruct)
{
    if (!FilePickerMicaActive() || !paintStruct || !paintStruct->hdc || !hwnd)
        return;
    bool inRebar = false;
    for (HWND p = hwnd; p && !inRebar; p = GetParent(p))
        inRebar = IsClassName(p, L"ReBarWindow32");
    const bool ribbon = !inRebar && IsClassName(hwnd, L"NetUIHWND");
    if (!inRebar && !ribbon)
        return;
    bool repair = inRebar && FilePickerRoot(hwnd);
    if (!repair && IsCurrentProcessExplorer() &&
        IsLegacyExplorerFrame(hwnd))
        repair = ribbon || !IsDarkForExcludedAwarePaintHdc(paintStruct->hdc);
    if (!repair)
        return;
    RepairOpaqueHdcAlpha(paintStruct->hdc, paintStruct->rcPaint);
}

// The chrome erase (file-name area, nested template dialog, Save's in-host
// strip): the frame extension stops at the view's bottom, so this stays a
// plain opaque client surface in every mode -- the flattened shade under
// Mica, the chrome shade otherwise (FilePickerControlBackground).
static void FilePickerEraseChrome(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, bool dark)
{
    if (HBRUSH br = GetCachedSolidBrush(FilePickerControlBackground(dark)))
        FillRect_orig(hdc, &rc, br);
}

// The rule between the picker's view and the file-name controls: the
// dialog's own client row under DUIViewWndClassName, drawn after the
// dialog erase (PropertyDialogSubclassProc dark, FilePickerLightSubclassProc light).
// A manual resize erases before the view host has moved, so the row drawn
// then goes stale once it does; the previous row is invalidated whenever
// the rule lands somewhere else, which repaints it in the plain shade.
static void FilePickerBottomRule(HWND dialog, HDC hdc)
{
    if (FilePickerRoot(dialog) != dialog)
        return;
    HWND viewHost = FindWindowExW(dialog, nullptr, L"DUIViewWndClassName", nullptr);
    RECT rc, client;
    if (!viewHost || !IsWindowVisible(viewHost) || !GetWindowRect(viewHost, &rc) ||
        !GetClientRect(dialog, &client))
        return;
    MapWindowPoints(HWND_DESKTOP, dialog, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(&rc), 2);
    if (HWND duiHost = FindWindowExW(viewHost, nullptr, L"DirectUIHWND", nullptr)) {
        RECT unusedLines[3];
        int contentBottom = 0;
        FilePickerSeparatorLines(
            duiHost, unusedLines, nullptr, nullptr, &contentBottom);
        if (contentBottom > 0) {
            POINT bottom = { 0, contentBottom };
            MapWindowPoints(duiHost, dialog, &bottom, 1);
            rc.bottom = bottom.y;
        }
    }
    const int lineW = FilePickerSeparatorWidth(dialog);
    const int previous = static_cast<int>(reinterpret_cast<INT_PTR>(
        GetPropW(dialog, kFilePickerBottomRuleMarker))) - 1;
    if (previous >= 0 && previous != rc.bottom) {
        RECT stale = { client.left, previous, client.right, previous + lineW };
        InvalidateRect(dialog, &stale, TRUE);
    }
    SetPropW(dialog, kFilePickerBottomRuleMarker,
        reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(rc.bottom) + 1));
    RECT line = { rc.left, rc.bottom, rc.right, rc.bottom + lineW };
    if (IntersectRect(&line, &line, &client))
        FilePickerRule(hdc, line, false);
}

static void ExplorerMicaStatusBarBeginPaint(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (g_pendingExplorerMicaStatusBarPaintState.hwnd == hwnd)
        g_pendingExplorerMicaStatusBarPaintState = {};

    auto rectIt = g_explorerMicaStatusBarRects.find(hwnd);
    if (rectIt == g_explorerMicaStatusBarRects.end())
        return;

    if (!ExplorerBackdropMode() || !IsWindow(hwnd) ||
        !IsInsideExplorerStatusBarHost(hwnd)) {
        g_explorerMicaStatusBarRects.erase(rectIt);
        return;
    }

    RECT lineRect = {
        rectIt->second.left,
        rectIt->second.top,
        rectIt->second.right,
        rectIt->second.top + 1,
    };
    // This runs before the real BeginPaint, so the extra 1px strip is folded
    // into the same update region and doesn't schedule another paint cycle.
    InvalidateRect(hwnd, &lineRect, FALSE);
}

static void ExplorerMicaStatusBarEndPaint(
    HWND hwnd, const PAINTSTRUCT* paintStruct)
{
    auto& pending = g_pendingExplorerMicaStatusBarPaintState;
    if (pending.hwnd == hwnd && pending.captured) {
        if (ExplorerBackdropMode()) {
            if (g_explorerMicaStatusBarRects.size() >= 16 &&
                !g_explorerMicaStatusBarRects.contains(hwnd)) {
                g_explorerMicaStatusBarRects.EraseDestroyed();
                if (g_explorerMicaStatusBarRects.size() >= 16)
                    g_explorerMicaStatusBarRects.clear();
            }
            g_explorerMicaStatusBarRects[hwnd] = pending.rect;
        }
    }

    auto rectIt = g_explorerMicaStatusBarRects.find(hwnd);
    // Same for the status bar's rule while the host shows Control Panel.
    if (rectIt != g_explorerMicaStatusBarRects.end() &&
        t_controlPanelModulePaintHwnd == hwnd) {
        g_explorerMicaStatusBarRects.erase(rectIt);
        rectIt = g_explorerMicaStatusBarRects.end();
    }
    if (rectIt != g_explorerMicaStatusBarRects.end() && paintStruct &&
        paintStruct->hdc && ExplorerBackdropMode()) {
        ExplorerMicaStatusBarPaintState paintState = {};
        paintState.hwnd = hwnd;
        paintState.rect = rectIt->second;
        paintState.clipRect = paintStruct->rcPaint;
        paintState.captured = true;
        PaintExplorerMicaStatusBarTopRule(paintStruct->hdc, paintState);
    }

    if (pending.hwnd == hwnd)
        pending = {};
}

// Marks the outer host's paint when a Control Panel module draws in it,
// only inside the legacy frame's host paint (t_controlPanelDuiPaintHwnd).
static void MarkControlPanelModulePaint(const wchar_t* idName)
{
    HWND host = t_explorerStatusBarDuiPaintHwnd;
    if (host && host == t_controlPanelDuiPaintHwnd &&
        _wcsnicmp(idName, L"ControlPanel", 12) == 0)
        t_controlPanelModulePaintHwnd = host;
}

VOID DUI_STDCALL DuiElement_Paint_hook(void* self, HDC hdc,
    LPCRECT updateRect, LPCRECT clipRect, LPRECT contentRect, LPRECT childrenRect)
{
    void* previous = g_duiPaintElement;
    ExplorerMicaStatusBarPaintState* previousStatusBarState =
        g_explorerMicaStatusBarPaintState;
    ExplorerMicaStatusBarPaintState statusBarState = {};
    wchar_t idName[32];
    ReadOuterHostElementIdName(self, idName);
    StatusWidth::PaintRects statusWidthRects;
    if (!StatusWidth::BeforeElementPaint(self, hdc, idName, &updateRect,
            &clipRect, &contentRect, &childrenRect, &statusWidthRects))
        return;
    if (IsExplorerMicaStatusBarTopRuleTarget(
            idName, hdc, &statusBarState.hwnd)) {
        statusBarState.element = self;
        g_explorerMicaStatusBarPaintState = &statusBarState;
    }
    ExplorerMicaPaneEdgePaintState* previousPaneEdgeState =
        g_explorerMicaPaneEdgePaintState;
    ExplorerMicaPaneEdgePaintState paneEdgeState = {};
    if (IsExplorerMicaPaneEdgeTarget(idName, hdc, &paneEdgeState.hwnd)) {
        paneEdgeState.element = self;
        g_explorerMicaPaneEdgePaintState = &paneEdgeState;
    }
    MarkControlPanelModulePaint(idName);
    ShellCheckAnim::OnElementPaint(self);
    g_duiPaintElement = self;
    DuiElement_Paint_orig(self, hdc, updateRect, clipRect, contentRect, childrenRect);
    StatusWidth::AfterElementPaint(statusWidthRects);
    if (statusBarState.captured)
        g_pendingExplorerMicaStatusBarPaintState = statusBarState;
    if (paneEdgeState.captured)
        g_pendingExplorerMicaPaneEdgePaintState = paneEdgeState;

    g_explorerMicaPaneEdgePaintState = previousPaneEdgeState;
    g_explorerMicaStatusBarPaintState = previousStatusBarState;
    g_duiPaintElement = previous;
}

static bool IsDuiExplorerTextElement(
    void* element, HDC hdc, LONG* weightBoost, HDC* rasterDC)
{
    *rasterDC = nullptr;
    if (weightBoost)
        *weightBoost = 0;
    if (!g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite || !element || !hdc) {
        return false;
    }

    HWND hwnd = ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc);
    if (!hwnd)
        return false;
    if (IsInsideExplorerStatusBarHost(hwnd))
        return true;

    if (!IsInsideShellFolderView(hwnd))
        return false;

    if (g_settings.ShellTextRasterCache && ShellTextIsExplorerFrameHost(hwnd))
        *rasterDC = hdc;

    // Only the primary item label gets the slight weight increase. Property
    // values, metadata, loading text and column headers keep the font's
    // native weight. Resolve the live local atom because its numeric value
    // can be reused after a DirectUI tree rebuild.
    if (DuiElement_GetID_orig) {
        const ATOM elementId =
            static_cast<ATOM>(DuiElement_GetID_orig(element));
        const ATOM fileNameId = FindAtomW(L"FileName");
        if (weightBoost && fileNameId && elementId == fileNameId)
            *weightBoost = 50;
    }
    return true;
}

static VOID DUI_STDCALL DuiElement_PaintStringContent_hook(
    void* self, HDC hdc, LPCRECT rect, void* value, int flags)
{
    void* previous = g_duiExplorerTextPaintElement;
    const LONG previousWeightBoost = g_duiExplorerTextWeightBoost;
    const HDC previousRasterDC = g_duiExplorerTextRasterDC;
    const HDC previousDialogDC = g_dialogDuiTextDC;
    const unsigned depth = g_legacyRebarTextPaintDepth;
    const auto paint = depth && depth <= ARRAYSIZE(g_legacyRebarTextPaints)
        ? g_legacyRebarTextPaints[depth - 1] : LegacyRebarTextPaint{};
    const HWND dcWindow = paint.kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogDirectUi && hdc
        ? WindowFromDC(hdc) : nullptr;
    const bool dialogText = self && hdc && paint.kind == LegacyRebarTextKind::DialogDirectUi &&
        LegacyRebarTextKindEnabled(paint.kind) && (!dcWindow || dcWindow == paint.hwnd);
    g_dialogDuiTextDC = dialogText ? hdc : nullptr;
    LONG weightBoost = 0;
    g_duiExplorerTextPaintElement =
        IsDuiExplorerTextElement(self, hdc, &weightBoost,
            &g_duiExplorerTextRasterDC) ? self : nullptr;
    g_duiExplorerTextWeightBoost = weightBoost;
    DuiElement_PaintStringContent_orig(self, hdc, rect, value, flags);
    g_dialogDuiTextDC = previousDialogDC;
    g_duiExplorerTextPaintElement = previous;
    g_duiExplorerTextWeightBoost = previousWeightBoost;
    g_duiExplorerTextRasterDC = previousRasterDC;
}

// Modern ItemsView group headers ("Hoje"/"Ontem" etc.) sit 2 DUI Element
// levels below a container whose class name is "GroupExpanded" or
// "GroupCollapsed" (confirmed live -- the name itself flips with the
// group's collapsed state, so only the "Group" prefix is stable). A
// regular item's ancestry never has a "Group*" class within the first 3
// levels -- it only shows up much deeper, inside the same expanded
// group's own content subtree -- so the walk must stay bounded to 3 levels
// or it would start matching items too.
static bool IsDuiGroupHeaderElement(void* element)
{
    if (!DuiElement_GetParent_orig || !DuiElement_GetClass_orig)
        return false;
    void* current = element;
    for (int depth = 0; current && depth < 3; ++depth) {
        void* classValue = nullptr;
        const wchar_t* cls = DuiElement_GetClass_orig(current, &classValue);
        if (cls && _wcsnicmp(cls, L"Group", 5) == 0)
            return true;
        current = DuiElement_GetParent_orig(current);
    }
    return false;
}

// The DUI element painting right now is a group header (or sits inside
// one): the header's own theme parts are drawn from its Paint.
static bool IsDuiGroupHeaderPaintElement()
{
    return g_duiPaintElement && IsDuiGroupHeaderElement(g_duiPaintElement);
}

// Modern ItemsView group headers draw through a raw DrawTextW, not
// DrawThemeTextEx, so the GROUPHEADER font-scale branch further up doesn't
// apply here. Pulling a "real" bigger font from the classic ListView
// theme class's HEADING1FONT was tried first and rejected live: that face
// ("Segoe UI") has different glyph-advance metrics than what DirectUI
// actually selected here ("Segoe UI Variable Display"), so text drawn with
// it no longer fit the rect DirectUI itself had already computed for the
// original font -- same visible size, but now DT_END_ELLIPSIS truncated
// it. Scaling the SAME font already selected on hdc (mirroring the
// proven-working classic-path idiom just above) keeps the glyph metrics
// DirectUI's own layout was based on, just bigger.
static bool TryDrawGroupHeaderText(HDC hdc, LPCWSTR text, INT cch,
    LPRECT lprc, UINT format, INT* outResult)
{
    if (!g_settings.RoundedButtons || !lprc || (format & DT_CALCRECT))
        return false;

    // This DrawTextW hook fires for every text draw in the process: the free
    // check first (no DirectUI element is painting outside Explorer-style
    // DirectUI), then the window and class, and only then
    // IsDuiGroupHeaderElement's cross-DLL Element walk.
    void* textElement = g_duiExplorerTextPaintElement
        ? g_duiExplorerTextPaintElement : g_duiPaintElement;
    if (!textElement)
        return false;
    HWND hwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
    wchar_t cls[32] = {};
    if (!hwnd || !GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)) ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"DirectUIHWND") != 0 ||
        !IsInsideShellFolderView(hwnd)) {
        return false;
    }

    if (!IsDuiGroupHeaderElement(textElement))
        return false;

    HFONT dcFont = (HFONT)GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT);
    LOGFONTW lf = {};
    if (!dcFont || !GetObjectW(dcFont, sizeof(lf), &lf))
        return false;
    lf.lfHeight = -(LONG)std::lround(kExplorerGroupHeaderFontDip * (DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.0f));
    // Same Semibold family/fallback as the single-line tab text and the
    // LVP_GROUPHEADER branch in DrawThemeTextEx_hook.
    wcsncpy_s(lf.lfFaceName, SegoeUiVariableFace(), _TRUNCATE);
    lf.lfWeight = FW_SEMIBOLD;
    lf.lfQuality = ANTIALIASED_QUALITY;

    HFONT bigFont = g_groupHeaderFontCache.Ensure(lf);
    if (!bigFont)
        return false;
    HGDIOBJ oldFont = SelectObject(hdc, bigFont);
    const COLORREF textColor = GroupHeaderTextColor(IsWindowDarkMode(hdc));
    const COLORREF oldTextColor = SetTextColor(hdc, textColor);

    // Widen a local copy of the rect to fit the bigger font's actual
    // measured width -- never the caller's own *lprc (DrawTextExW_hook's
    // DT_CALCRECT branch above establishes the same rule: DirectUI doesn't
    // expect a drawing call to write back into its own rect). Grow-only:
    // if the original rect already fits, leave it untouched.
    RECT rc = *lprc;
    rc.left += (LONG)std::lround(kGroupHeaderTextLeftPadPx * (DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.0f));
    int textLen = cch < 0 ? (text ? (int)wcslen(text) : 0) : cch;
    if (textLen > 0) {
        SIZE extent = {};
        if (GetTextExtentPoint32W(hdc, text, textLen, &extent)) {
            // Padded beyond the raw GDI extent: DirectWrite's own
            // axis-resolved Segoe UI Variable glyphs (see
            // CreateSegoeVariableAwareTextFormat) measure a bit wider than
            // this GDI font's fixed instance, so a long header could
            // otherwise self-ellipsis against a rect sized from this
            // narrower GDI measurement.
            const LONG hPad = (LONG)std::lround(6.0f * (DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.0f));
            const LONG padded = (LONG)std::lround(extent.cx * 1.08f) + hPad;
            if (rc.left + padded > rc.right)
                rc.right = rc.left + padded;
        }
    }
    // Both edges -- growing only the bottom shifts the centered text.
    {
        const LONG vMargin = (LONG)std::lround(2.0f * (DpiForPaintHdc(hdc) / 96.0f));
        rc.top -= vMargin;
        rc.bottom += vMargin;
    }

    if (DrawWinUiStyledTextDWrite(hdc, &rc, text, cch, lf, textColor, format)) {
        // Still measure via GDI (DT_CALCRECT, no paint) so *outResult matches
        // the same contract DrawTextW_orig's return value would have given.
        RECT measureRc = rc;
        *outResult = DrawTextW_orig(hdc, text, cch, &measureRc, format | DT_CALCRECT);
    } else {
        *outResult = DrawTextW_orig(hdc, text, cch, &rc, format);
    }
    if (oldTextColor != CLR_INVALID)
        SetTextColor(hdc, oldTextColor);
    if (oldFont) SelectObject(hdc, oldFont);
    return true;
}

// DuiApplyDarkProc checks comctl32.dll internally — no separate probe needed.

// Apply dark mode to DirectUI and child control windows on CP/Tools threads
static BOOL CALLBACK DuiApplyDarkChildProc(HWND hw, LPARAM) {
    wchar_t cls[32];
    if (GetClassNameW(hw, cls, 32)) {
        if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"DirectUIHWND") == 0 ||
            _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysListView32") == 0 ||
            _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTreeView32") == 0 ||
            _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysHeader32") == 0) {
            if (g_cbdAllowDark) g_cbdAllowDark(hw, true);
            SetWindowTheme(hw, L"DarkMode_Explorer", nullptr);
        }
    }
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK DuiApplyDarkProc(HWND hw, LPARAM) {
    wchar_t cls[32];
    if (GetClassNameW(hw, cls, 32)) {
        if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"CabinetWClass") == 0) {
            // Only apply to CP/Tools (comctl32.dll), NOT Explorer (atlthunk.dll)
            WNDPROC wp = (WNDPROC)GetWindowLongPtrW(hw, GWLP_WNDPROC);
            HMODULE hmod = nullptr;
            bool isCPTools = false;
            if (wp && GetModuleHandleExW(
                    GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS |
                    GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
                    (LPCWSTR)wp, &hmod)) {
                wchar_t path[MAX_PATH] = {};
                GetModuleFileNameW(hmod, path, MAX_PATH);
                const wchar_t* sep = wcsrchr(path, L'\\');
                isCPTools = sep && _wcsicmp(sep + 1, L"comctl32.dll") == 0;
            }
            // A comctl32 window procedure also means any SetWindowSubclass on
            // the frame, so the tabbed Explorer
            // (the only frame with the WinUI island) is ruled out as well.
            // A frame without the island is still decided by the procedure
            // alone, as before: the classic File Explorer is unaffected.
            if (isCPTools && FindWindowExW(hw, nullptr,
                    L"Microsoft.UI.Content.DesktopChildSiteBridge", nullptr))
                isCPTools = false;
            if (!isCPTools) return TRUE; // skip Explorer windows

            if (g_cbdAllowDark) g_cbdAllowDark(hw, TRUE);
            SetWindowTheme(hw, L"DarkMode_Explorer", nullptr);
            BOOL dm = TRUE;
            DwmSetWindowAttribute(hw, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE, &dm, sizeof(dm));
            EnumChildWindows(hw, DuiApplyDarkChildProc, 0);
        }
    }
    return TRUE;
}

static void DuiApplyDarkToChildIfRelevant(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!IsCustomDarkModeAllowed() || !hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd))
        return;

    // Real Explorer manages its own dark mode for this entire window family
    // natively -- never actively re-theme it.
    if (IsInsideExplorer(hwnd))
        return;

    wchar_t cls[32] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)))
        return;

    if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"DirectUIHWND") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysListView32") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysTreeView32") == 0 ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"SysHeader32") == 0) {
        // Guards against re-issuing SetWindowTheme on the same hwnd every
        // paint -- each call fires WM_THEMECHANGED, which invalidates
        // DirectUI's font-metric cache and was the cause of the grouped
        // ListView's group-header flicker.
        if (IsKnownWindowThemeApplied(hwnd, L"DarkMode_Explorer", nullptr))
            return;
        if (g_cbdAllowDark) g_cbdAllowDark(hwnd, true);
        SetKnownWindowThemeOnce(hwnd, L"DarkMode_Explorer", nullptr);
    }
}

static void DuiApplyDarkForPaintWindow(HWND paintHwnd)
{
    if (!IsCustomDarkModeAllowed() || !paintHwnd || !IsWindow(paintHwnd) ||
        IsAeroWizardRawWindow(paintHwnd))
        return;

    DuiApplyDarkToChildIfRelevant(paintHwnd);

    HWND root = GetAncestor(paintHwnd, GA_ROOT);
    if (!root || !IsWindow(root))
        return;

    // Roots already swept on this thread, in fixed storage (restarted when
    // full): a thread alive at unload holds nothing on the heap.
    static thread_local HWND appliedRoots[32] = {};
    static thread_local int appliedRootCount = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < appliedRootCount; ++i) {
        if (appliedRoots[i] == root)
            return;
    }
    if (appliedRootCount == static_cast<int>(ARRAYSIZE(appliedRoots)))
        appliedRootCount = 0;
    appliedRoots[appliedRootCount++] = root;

    EnumThreadWindows(GetCurrentThreadId(), DuiApplyDarkProc, 0);
}


static bool IsPropertyDirectUIScope(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!g_darkModeActive || !hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd))
        return false;

    wchar_t cls[64] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)) ||
        _wcsicmp(cls, L"DirectUIHWND") != 0)
        return false;

    HWND parent = GetParent(hwnd);
    wchar_t parentCls[64] = {};
    if (!parent || !GetClassNameW(parent, parentCls, ARRAYSIZE(parentCls)) ||
        _wcsicmp(parentCls, L"SHELLDLL_DefView") != 0)
        return false;

    HWND root = GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT);
    wchar_t rootCls[64] = {};
    if (!root || !GetClassNameW(root, rootCls, ARRAYSIZE(rootCls)))
        return false;

    return _wcsicmp(rootCls, L"#32770") == 0;
}

static bool PaintExplorerMicaMarquee(
    void* element, HDC hdc, LPCRECT rect, LPCRECT clipRect)
{
    if (!ExplorerMicaActive() ||
        element != g_activeExplorerMarquee || !rect) {
        return false;
    }

    HWND hwnd = ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc);
    if (!hwnd || !IsInsideShellFolderView(hwnd)) {
        return false;
    }

    RECT visibleRect = *rect;
    if (clipRect && !IntersectRect(&visibleRect, &visibleRect, clipRect))
        return true;
    if (visibleRect.right <= visibleRect.left ||
        visibleRect.bottom <= visibleRect.top) {
        return true;
    }

    // Axis-aligned and aliased, so plain GDI does it: the translucent fill
    // is AlphaBlend'ed (source-over on color and alpha alike, so the Mica
    // or solid pane underneath composes as it did through the render
    // target) and the opaque 1px border is written along the rect's own
    // edges, each strip clipped to the visible part. Redrawn on every
    // mouse move of the drag.
    const COLORREF fillColor = GetSysColor(COLOR_HIGHLIGHT);
    const COLORREF borderColor = GetSysColor(COLOR_HOTLIGHT);
    const DWORD a = g_activeExplorerMarqueeAlpha;
    const DWORD fill = (a << 24) |
        ((GetRValue(fillColor) * a / 255) << 16) |
        ((GetGValue(fillColor) * a / 255) << 8) |
        (GetBValue(fillColor) * a / 255);
    BlendPremultipliedPixels(hdc, visibleRect, fill);

    if (rect->right - rect->left > 1 && rect->bottom - rect->top > 1) {
        const DWORD border = 0xFF000000u |
            (static_cast<DWORD>(GetRValue(borderColor)) << 16) |
            (static_cast<DWORD>(GetGValue(borderColor)) << 8) |
            GetBValue(borderColor);
        const RECT edges[4] = {
            { rect->left, rect->top, rect->right, rect->top + 1 },
            { rect->left, rect->bottom - 1, rect->right, rect->bottom },
            { rect->left, rect->top, rect->left + 1, rect->bottom },
            { rect->right - 1, rect->top, rect->right, rect->bottom },
        };
        for (const RECT& edge : edges) {
            RECT strip = {};
            if (IntersectRect(&strip, &edge, &visibleRect))
                WriteExplorerMicaPixels(hdc, strip, border);
        }
    }
    return true;
}


// Explorer's InfoBar (shellstyle.dll infobarstyle: a Button, id
// InfoBarRoot, filled with COLOR_INFOBK, highlight and hotlight) painted
// as WinUI's InfoBar with Severity Warning (InfoBar_themeresources.xaml):
// SystemFillColorCautionBackground under the SubtleFillColor hover and
// pressed layers of a button, as the bar is clickable, and a
// CardStrokeColorDefault rule along its bottom. Opaque pixels, so a Mica
// host doesn't add the backdrop to them.
static bool PaintExplorerInfoBar(void* element, HDC hdc, LPCRECT rect,
    LPCRECT clip)
{
    HWND host = t_explorerInfoBarHostPaint;
    if (!host || !hdc || !rect || !element || !DuiElement_GetID_orig)
        return false;
    const ATOM id = static_cast<ATOM>(DuiElement_GetID_orig(element));
    wchar_t idName[16] = {};
    if (!id || !GetAtomNameW(id, idName, ARRAYSIZE(idName)) ||
        wcscmp(idName, L"InfoBarRoot") != 0) {
        return false;
    }

    const bool dark = IsHwndDarkMode(host);
    COLORREF background = WinUI::SystemFillColorCautionBackground(dark);
    if (DuiButton_GetPressed_orig && DuiButton_GetPressed_orig(element)) {
        background = WinUI::FlattenOver(WinUI::SubtleFillColorTertiary(dark), background);
    } else if ((DuiElement_GetMouseFocused_orig && DuiElement_GetMouseFocused_orig(element)) ||
               (DuiElement_GetKeyFocused_orig && DuiElement_GetKeyFocused_orig(element))) {
        background = WinUI::FlattenOver(WinUI::SubtleFillColorSecondary(dark), background);
    }
    const COLORREF stroke = WinUI::FlattenOver(WinUI::CardStrokeColorDefault(dark),
        WinUI::SystemFillColorCautionBackground(dark));
    auto opaque = [](COLORREF c) {
        return 0xFF000000u | (static_cast<DWORD>(GetRValue(c)) << 16) |
               (static_cast<DWORD>(GetGValue(c)) << 8) | GetBValue(c);
    };

    const int strokeW = std::max(1, MulDiv(1, GetDpiForWindow(host),
        USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI));
    RECT fill = *rect;
    RECT rule = {rect->left, rect->bottom - strokeW, rect->right, rect->bottom};
    fill.bottom = rule.top;
    if (clip) {
        IntersectRect(&fill, &fill, clip);
        IntersectRect(&rule, &rule, clip);
    }
    if (!IsRectEmpty(&fill))
        WriteExplorerMicaPixels(hdc, fill, opaque(background));
    if (!IsRectEmpty(&rule))
        WriteExplorerMicaPixels(hdc, rule, opaque(stroke));

    // Severity icon (Warning): F136 in SystemFillColorCaution under F13C in
    // TextFillColorInverse, vertically centered above the bottom rule.
    const float scale = static_cast<float>(GetDpiForWindow(host)) / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const LONG barHeight = std::max<LONG>(0, rect->bottom - strokeW - rect->top);
    const int iconSize = std::min<int>(barHeight,
        static_cast<int>(std::lround(kExplorerInfoBarIconDip * scale)));
    const LONG iconLeft = rect->left +
        static_cast<LONG>(std::lround(kExplorerInfoBarIconLeftDip * scale));
    const LONG iconTop = rect->top + (barHeight - iconSize) / 2;
    const RECT icon = {iconLeft, iconTop, iconLeft + iconSize, iconTop + iconSize};
    RECT visibleIcon = icon;
    if (iconSize > 0 && (!clip || IntersectRect(&visibleIcon, &icon, clip))) {
        const COLORREF badge = WinUI::SystemFillColorCaution(dark);
        DrawGlyphDW(hdc, icon, badge, L"\uF136", iconSize);
        DrawGlyphDW(hdc, icon, WinUI::FlattenOver(WinUI::TextFillColorInverse(dark), badge),
            L"\uF13C", iconSize);
    }
    const LONG textLeft = icon.right +
        static_cast<LONG>(std::lround(kExplorerInfoBarIconGapDip * scale));
    t_explorerInfoBarPaint = {hdc, *rect, background, dark, textLeft};
    return true;
}

VOID DUI_STDCALL DuiElement_PaintBg_hook(
    void* This, HDC hdc, void* value,
    LPRECT pRect, LPRECT pClipRect, LPRECT pExcludeRect, LPRECT pTargetRect)
{
    RECT statusWidthRects[3];
    StatusWidth::BeforeElementPaintBackground(
        This, &pRect, &pClipRect, &pTargetRect, statusWidthRects);
    HWND paintHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
    int elementType = -1;
    unsigned elementTypeCode = 0;
    if (value) {
        elementType = (int)(*(DWORD*)value << 26) >> 26;
        if (elementType != 9) {
            // The data follows the header at pointer alignment: dui70's
            // Value::GetFill returns this+8 on x64 and this+4 on x86.
            const DWORD rawField1 = *reinterpret_cast<const DWORD*>(
                static_cast<const BYTE*>(value) + sizeof(void*));
            elementTypeCode = (unsigned)((rawField1 + 20) & 7);
        }
    }

    if (g_explorerMicaStatusBarPaintState &&
        g_explorerMicaStatusBarPaintState->element == This && pRect) {
        auto& state = *g_explorerMicaStatusBarPaintState;
        state.rect = *pRect;
        state.clipRect = pClipRect ? *pClipRect : *pRect;
        state.captured = true;
    }
    if (g_explorerMicaPaneEdgePaintState &&
        g_explorerMicaPaneEdgePaintState->element == This && pRect) {
        auto& state = *g_explorerMicaPaneEdgePaintState;
        state.rect = *pRect;
        state.captured = true;
    }
    if (PaintExplorerMicaMarquee(This, hdc, pRect, pClipRect))
        return;
    if (PaintExplorerInfoBar(This, hdc, pRect, pClipRect))
        return;

    // Apply dark mode to CP/Tools DirectUI roots. Cache broad enumeration per
    // root, while paintHwnd above covers late-created child controls.
    DuiApplyDarkForPaintWindow(paintHwnd);

    // Set flag so our FillRect hook can intercept white fills
    int prevElementType = g_duiPaintElementType;
    g_duiPaintElementType = elementType;

    bool prevInFileOpPaint = g_inFileOpPaint;
    if (IsFileOpProgressWindow(paintHwnd)) g_inFileOpPaint = true;

    g_inDuiPaintBg = true;
    DuiElement_PaintBg_orig(This, hdc, value, pRect, pClipRect, pExcludeRect, pTargetRect);
    // The picker's captures paint outside the host's BeginPaint and are
    // told by the element chain recorded during its paints, so the gate
    // can't depend on the tracked host.
    if ((ExplorerMicaSolidPaneMode() && IsCurrentProcessExplorer()) ||
        FilePickerListFillRewritten())
        ExplorerMicaSolidPaneAfterDuiBg(This, hdc, pRect, pClipRect, elementType);
    FilePickerChromeAfterDuiBg(paintHwnd, hdc, pRect, pClipRect, elementType);
    g_inDuiPaintBg = false;
    // Mark this pass complete so FillRect_hook's white-catch stands down
    // for the property dialog's DUI list from the next paint on -- see
    // kPropDuiListPrimed's own comment for why the very first pass alone
    // still needs that catch-all as a safety net.
    if (IsPropertyDirectUIScope(paintHwnd)) {
        if (HWND root = GetAncestor(paintHwnd, GA_ROOT)) {
            if (!GetPropW(root, kPropDuiListPrimed))
                SetPropW(root, kPropDuiListPrimed, (HANDLE)1);
        }
    }
    g_inFileOpPaint = prevInFileOpPaint;
    g_duiPaintElementType = prevElementType;

    // eCode=4: CP header/sidebar -- a button-face fill.
    if (IsCustomDarkModeAllowed() && value && pRect && !IsAeroWizardRawWindow(paintHwnd)) {
        if (elementType != 9) {
            if (elementTypeCode == 4) {
                FillRect_orig(hdc, pRect, GetSysColorBrush(COLOR_BTNFACE));
            }
        }
    }
}

// Once the hooks queued by the ElementLifetime capability are applied.
static void DuiElementLifetimeMarkLive()
{
    if (DuiElement_OnDestroy_orig)
        g_duiElementLifetimeLive.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    if (DUser_DeleteHandle_orig)
        g_duserDeleteHandleLive.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
}

enum DirectUiSymbolCapability : unsigned {
    DirectUiCapabilityPaintBackground = 1u << 0,
    DirectUiCapabilityMarquee = 1u << 1,
    DirectUiCapabilityPaint = 1u << 2,
    DirectUiCapabilityHierarchy = 1u << 3,
    DirectUiCapabilityText = 1u << 4,
    DirectUiCapabilityStatusWidth = 1u << 5,
    DirectUiCapabilityElementLifetime = 1u << 6,
};

static std::mutex g_directUiSymbolsMutex;
static std::atomic<unsigned> g_directUiAttemptedCapabilities{0};
static std::atomic<bool> g_directUiApplyPosted{false};
static std::atomic<bool> g_directUiShellHostSeen{false};
static std::atomic<bool> g_directUiRenameNeeded{false};

static unsigned DirectUiRequiredCapabilities()
{
    if (g_isXamlProcess)
        return 0;

    unsigned capabilities = 0;
    const bool explorerMica = IsCurrentProcessExplorer() &&
        g_settings.ExplorerMicaBackdrop;
    const bool shellHost = IsCurrentProcessExplorer() ||
        g_directUiShellHostSeen.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (g_settings.EnableDarkMode || g_settings.AccentColorize ||
        explorerMica) {
        capabilities |= DirectUiCapabilityPaintBackground;
    }
    if (explorerMica)
        capabilities |= DirectUiCapabilityPaint;
    if ((explorerMica || (shellHost && FilePickerMicaActive())) && ExplorerMicaActive())
        capabilities |= DirectUiCapabilityMarquee;
    if (shellHost && g_settings.RoundedButtons)
        capabilities |= DirectUiCapabilityPaint |
            DirectUiCapabilityHierarchy;
    // Item checkboxes keep item element pointers between messages.
    if (shellHost && g_settings.RoundedButtons && g_settings.ExplorerSection)
        capabilities |= DirectUiCapabilityElementLifetime;
    // Control Panel's "View by" label is told by the painting element.
    if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer() &&
        (g_settings.ExplorerSection || g_settings.EnableDarkMode))
        capabilities |= DirectUiCapabilityPaint;
    if ((shellHost && g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite) ||
        (IsCurrentProcessExplorer() && g_settings.ExplorerSection && g_settings.DialogTextDirectWrite))
        capabilities |= DirectUiCapabilityText;
    if (StatusWidth::Mode()) {
        capabilities |= DirectUiCapabilityPaint |
            DirectUiCapabilityPaintBackground |
            DirectUiCapabilityHierarchy | DirectUiCapabilityStatusWidth |
            DirectUiCapabilityElementLifetime;
    }
    return capabilities;
}

static bool DirectUiHasPendingSymbolWork()
{
    if (g_directUiUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return false;

    const unsigned required = DirectUiRequiredCapabilities();
    const unsigned attempted = g_directUiAttemptedCapabilities.load(
        std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (required & ~attempted)
        return true;

    return (g_settings.EditFocusLine ||
            (ExplorerMicaActive() && !g_darkModeActive)) &&
        g_directUiRenameNeeded.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
        !g_listRenameDuiHookAttempted.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

static void DirectUiEnsureSymbolsForLoadedModule(bool applyHooks)
{
    g_directUiApplyPosted.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    if (g_directUiUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        g_msgWndUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !DirectUiHasPendingSymbolWork()) {
        return;
    }

    HMODULE dui70 = GetModuleHandleW(L"dui70.dll");
    if (!dui70)
        return;

    // Held through the apply: Wh_ModBeforeUninit sets g_directUiUnloading
    // under it, so no hook operation starts after it returns.
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> applyLock(g_directUiSymbolsMutex);
    if (g_directUiUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return;

    bool hooksQueued = false;
    bool renameHookQueued = false;
    {
        const unsigned required = DirectUiRequiredCapabilities();
        const unsigned missing = required &
            ~g_directUiAttemptedCapabilities.load(
                std::memory_order_relaxed);
        g_directUiAttemptedCapabilities.fetch_or(
            missing, std::memory_order_release);

        if (missing & DirectUiCapabilityMarquee) {
#ifdef _WIN64
            DuiElement_GetAlpha_orig =
                reinterpret_cast<DuiElement_GetAlpha_t>(GetProcAddress(
                    dui70, "?GetAlpha@Element@DirectUI@@QEAAHXZ"));
#else
            DuiElement_GetAlpha_orig =
                reinterpret_cast<DuiElement_GetAlpha_t>(GetProcAddress(
                    dui70, "?GetAlpha@Element@DirectUI@@QAEHXZ"));
#endif
        }
        if (missing & (DirectUiCapabilityPaint |
                       DirectUiCapabilityText)) {
#ifdef _WIN64
            DuiElement_GetID_orig =
                reinterpret_cast<DuiElement_GetID_t>(GetProcAddress(
                    dui70, "?GetID@Element@DirectUI@@QEAAGXZ"));
#else
            DuiElement_GetID_orig =
                reinterpret_cast<DuiElement_GetID_t>(GetProcAddress(
                    dui70, "?GetID@Element@DirectUI@@QAEGXZ"));
#endif
            DuiElement_GetMouseFocused_orig =
                reinterpret_cast<DuiElement_GetState_t>(DuiExport(dui70,
                    "?GetMouseFocused@Element@DirectUI@@QEAA_NXZ",
                    "?GetMouseFocused@Element@DirectUI@@QAE_NXZ"));
            DuiElement_GetKeyFocused_orig =
                reinterpret_cast<DuiElement_GetState_t>(DuiExport(dui70,
                    "?GetKeyFocused@Element@DirectUI@@UEAA_NXZ",
                    "?GetKeyFocused@Element@DirectUI@@UAE_NXZ"));
            DuiButton_GetPressed_orig =
                reinterpret_cast<DuiElement_GetState_t>(DuiExport(dui70,
                    "?GetPressed@Button@DirectUI@@QEAA_NXZ",
                    "?GetPressed@Button@DirectUI@@QAE_NXZ"));
        }
        if (missing & DirectUiCapabilityPaintBackground) {
            SetResolvedSymbolHook(
                DuiExport(dui70,
                    "?PaintBackground@Element@DirectUI@@QEAAXPEAUHDC__@@PEAVValue@2@AEBUtagRECT@@222@Z",
                    "?PaintBackground@Element@DirectUI@@QAEXPAUHDC__@@PAVValue@2@ABUtagRECT@@222@Z"),
                DuiElement_PaintBg_hook, &DuiElement_PaintBg_orig);
            hooksQueued = hooksQueued || DuiElement_PaintBg_orig;
        }
        if (missing & DirectUiCapabilityMarquee) {
            SetResolvedSymbolHook(
                DuiExport(dui70,
                    "?PaintBorder@Element@DirectUI@@QEAAXPEAUHDC__@@PEAVValue@2@PEAUtagRECT@@AEBU5@@Z",
                    "?PaintBorder@Element@DirectUI@@QAEXPAUHDC__@@PAVValue@2@PAUtagRECT@@ABU5@@Z"),
                DuiElement_PaintBorder_hook, &DuiElement_PaintBorder_orig);
            SetResolvedSymbolHook(
                DuiExport(dui70,
                    "?_Fill@Element@DirectUI@@IEAAXPEAUHDC__@@KHHHH_N@Z",
                    "?_Fill@Element@DirectUI@@IAEXPAUHDC__@@KHHHH_N@Z"),
                DuiElement_Fill_hook, &DuiElement_Fill_orig);
            hooksQueued = hooksQueued || DuiElement_PaintBorder_orig ||
                DuiElement_Fill_orig;
        }
        if (missing & DirectUiCapabilityPaint) {
            SetResolvedSymbolHook(
                DuiExport(dui70,
                    "?Paint@Element@DirectUI@@UEAAXPEAUHDC__@@PEBUtagRECT@@1PEAU4@2@Z",
                    "?Paint@Element@DirectUI@@UAEXPAUHDC__@@PBUtagRECT@@1PAU4@2@Z"),
                DuiElement_Paint_hook, &DuiElement_Paint_orig);
            hooksQueued = hooksQueued || DuiElement_Paint_orig;
        }
        if (missing & DirectUiCapabilityHierarchy) {
            // Called directly, never hooked.
            DuiElement_GetParent_orig = reinterpret_cast<DuiElement_GetParent_t>(
                DuiExport(dui70,
                    "?GetParent@Element@DirectUI@@QEAAPEAV12@XZ",
                    "?GetParent@Element@DirectUI@@QAEPAV12@XZ"));
            DuiElement_GetClass_orig = reinterpret_cast<DuiElement_GetClass_t>(
                DuiExport(dui70,
                    "?GetClass@Element@DirectUI@@QEAAPEBGPEAPEAVValue@2@@Z",
                    "?GetClass@Element@DirectUI@@QAEPBGPAPAVValue@2@@Z"));
        }
        if (missing & DirectUiCapabilityText) {
            SetResolvedSymbolHook(
                DuiExport(dui70,
                    "?PaintStringContent@Element@DirectUI@@QEAAXPEAUHDC__@@PEBUtagRECT@@PEAVValue@2@H@Z",
                    "?PaintStringContent@Element@DirectUI@@QAEXPAUHDC__@@PBUtagRECT@@PAVValue@2@H@Z"),
                DuiElement_PaintStringContent_hook,
                &DuiElement_PaintStringContent_orig);
            hooksQueued = hooksQueued ||
                DuiElement_PaintStringContent_orig;
        }

        if ((missing & DirectUiCapabilityElementLifetime) && !DuiElement_OnDestroy_orig) {
            SetResolvedSymbolHook(
                DuiExport(dui70, "?OnDestroy@Element@DirectUI@@UEAAXXZ",
                    "?OnDestroy@Element@DirectUI@@UAEXXZ"),
                DuiElement_OnDestroy_hook, &DuiElement_OnDestroy_orig);
            hooksQueued = hooksQueued || DuiElement_OnDestroy_orig;
        }
        if ((missing & DirectUiCapabilityElementLifetime) && !DUser_DeleteHandle_orig) {
            // dui70 imports duser, so it is loaded.
            HMODULE duser = GetModuleHandleW(L"duser.dll");
            SetResolvedSymbolHook(
                duser ? reinterpret_cast<void*>(GetProcAddress(duser, "DeleteHandle"))
                      : nullptr,
                DUser_DeleteHandle_hook, &DUser_DeleteHandle_orig);
            hooksQueued = hooksQueued || DUser_DeleteHandle_orig;
        }

        if (missing & DirectUiCapabilityStatusWidth)
            hooksQueued = StatusWidth::ResolveSymbols(dui70) || hooksQueued;

        unsigned resolved = 0;
        if (DuiElement_OnDestroy_orig)
            resolved |= DirectUiCapabilityElementLifetime;
        if (StatusWidth::SymbolsReady())
            resolved |= DirectUiCapabilityStatusWidth;
        if (DuiElement_PaintBg_orig)
            resolved |= DirectUiCapabilityPaintBackground;
        if (DuiElement_PaintBorder_orig && DuiElement_Fill_orig)
            resolved |= DirectUiCapabilityMarquee;
        if (DuiElement_Paint_orig)
            resolved |= DirectUiCapabilityPaint;
        if (DuiElement_GetParent_orig && DuiElement_GetClass_orig)
            resolved |= DirectUiCapabilityHierarchy;
        if (DuiElement_PaintStringContent_orig)
            resolved |= DirectUiCapabilityText;
        const unsigned unavailable = missing & ~resolved;
        if (unavailable) {
            Wh_Log(L"DirectUI: symbol capability mask 0x%X unavailable",
                unavailable);
        }

        if ((g_settings.EditFocusLine ||
             (ExplorerMicaActive() && !g_darkModeActive)) &&
            g_directUiRenameNeeded.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
            ListRenameQueueDuiHook(
                dui70, applyHooks ? &renameHookQueued : nullptr);
        }
    }

    hooksQueued = hooksQueued || renameHookQueued;

    if (!applyHooks || !hooksQueued ||
        g_directUiUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return;
    }

    const bool applied = Wh_ApplyHookOperations();
    if (renameHookQueued) {
        g_listRenameDuiHookUsable.store(
            applied, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    if (!applied) {
        Wh_Log(L"DirectUI: failed to apply deferred symbol hooks");
        return;
    }
    DuiElementLifetimeMarkLive();
    StatusWidth::MarkHooksLive();
}

static void DirectUiRequestPendingSymbols()
{
    if (g_directUiUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !DirectUiHasPendingSymbolWork() ||
        g_msgWndUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        g_directUiApplyPosted.exchange(true, std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
        return;
    }

    HWND msgWnd = g_msgWnd.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (!msgWnd || !PostMessageW(
            msgWnd, kDirectUiApplyHooksMessage, 0, 0)) {
        g_directUiApplyPosted.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    }
}

static void DirectUiObserveShellFolderView()
{
    if (g_directUiUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return;

    g_directUiShellHostSeen.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    DirectUiRequestPendingSymbols();
    ExplorerFrameObserveShellFolderView();
}

static bool DirectUiRequestRenameSymbols(HWND edit)
{
    if (!edit ||
        g_directUiUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        g_msgWndUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        g_listRenameDuiHookAttempted.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return false;
    }

    g_directUiShellHostSeen.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    g_directUiRenameNeeded.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    HWND msgWnd = g_msgWnd.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    return msgWnd && PostMessageW(
        msgWnd, kDirectUiRetryRenameMessage, 0,
        reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(edit));
}
