// ── Shell image index to glyph map ───────────────────────────────────────
// Populated on a background thread (see GlyphBuildMapThreadProc) -- building
// this touches dozens of synchronous shell/COM calls (SHGetFileInfoW,
// SHParseDisplayName, ...) that can stall for seconds on a slow/disconnected
// network drive, a reconnecting cloud-sync provider (OneDrive/Google Drive),
// or awkward removable/optical media. g_glyphMapMutex guards these two maps
// plus g_glyphProgFilesNames/g_glyphPhoneNames below, all written by that
// background thread and read from the UI thread during per-item paint.
static std::mutex g_glyphMapMutex;
// Background shell-query workers are retained by HANDLE until they signal.
// A counter alone is insufficient because it can reach zero just before the
// thread executes its final return epilogue inside this DLL.
static std::atomic<uint64_t> g_glyphBgGeneration{1};
static std::atomic<bool> g_glyphBgUnloading{false};
static std::mutex g_glyphBgThreadsMutex;
static std::vector<HANDLE> g_glyphBgThreads;

static void GlyphBgBeginUnload()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_glyphBgThreadsMutex);
    if (!g_glyphBgUnloading.exchange(true, std::memory_order_acq_rel))
        g_glyphBgGeneration.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
}

static bool GlyphBgStartWorker(
    LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE startRoutine, void* parameter)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_glyphBgThreadsMutex);
    if (g_glyphBgUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return false;

    for (auto it = g_glyphBgThreads.begin();
         it != g_glyphBgThreads.end();) {
        if (WaitForSingleObject(*it, 0) == WAIT_OBJECT_0) {
            CloseHandle(*it);
            it = g_glyphBgThreads.erase(it);
        } else {
            ++it;
        }
    }

    HANDLE thread = CreateThread(
        nullptr, 0, startRoutine, parameter, 0, nullptr);
    if (!thread)
        return false;
    g_glyphBgThreads.push_back(thread);
    return true;
}

static void GlyphBgWaitForWorkers()
{
    std::vector<HANDLE> threads;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_glyphBgThreadsMutex);
        threads.swap(g_glyphBgThreads);
    }
    // Joined without a timeout: the DLL is freed right after unload, and a
    // worker still running mod code then crashes the host. The workers skip
    // mapped drives, the probe that can stall for long.
    for (HANDLE thread : threads) {
        if (WaitForSingleObject(thread, 2000) == WAIT_TIMEOUT) {
            Wh_Log(L"Waiting for a glyph shell-query worker to finish");
            WaitForSingleObject(thread, INFINITE);
        }
        CloseHandle(thread);
    }
}

// General SVG path parser: supports M/L/H/V/C/S/Q/T/Z (absolute + relative).
// Arcs (A/a) are approximated as a straight line to the endpoint since none
// of the currently used Fluent icon paths contain arc segments.
// SVG path data always separates decimals with '.', but strtof follows the
// CRT's LC_NUMERIC. In a host whose locale uses a comma -- regedit is one --
// "556.3152858488" reads as 556, the rest of the path derails and the
// geometry sink closes with D2DERR_WRONG_STATE, so every icon in this file
// silently loses its artwork there. Parsed by hand to keep the result
// independent of whatever locale the host process set.
static bool SvgReadNumber(const char*& p, float& out)
{
    const char* s = p;
    bool negative = false;
    if (*s == '+' || *s == '-') {
        negative = (*s == '-');
        ++s;
    }

    double mantissa = 0.0;
    int digits = 0;
    int exponent = 0;
    for (; *s >= '0' && *s <= '9'; ++s) {
        mantissa = mantissa * 10.0 + (*s - '0');
        ++digits;
    }
    if (*s == '.') {
        ++s;
        for (; *s >= '0' && *s <= '9'; ++s) {
            mantissa = mantissa * 10.0 + (*s - '0');
            --exponent;
            ++digits;
        }
    }
    if (!digits)
        return false;

    if (*s == 'e' || *s == 'E') {
        const char* e = s + 1;
        bool expNegative = false;
        if (*e == '+' || *e == '-') {
            expNegative = (*e == '-');
            ++e;
        }
        if (*e >= '0' && *e <= '9') {
            int value = 0;
            for (; *e >= '0' && *e <= '9'; ++e) {
                if (value < 10000)  // anything past this is already inf/0
                    value = value * 10 + (*e - '0');
            }
            exponent += expNegative ? -value : value;
            s = e;
        }
    }

    double value = mantissa;
    if (exponent)
        value *= std::pow(10.0, (double)exponent);
    out = (float)(negative ? -value : value);
    p = s;
    return true;
}

static bool SvgParsePathToGeometry(const char* d, ID2D1PathGeometry** ppOut) {
    if (!g_d2dFactory) return false;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> geom;
    if (FAILED(g_d2dFactory->CreatePathGeometry(&geom))) return false;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GeometrySink> sink;
    if (FAILED(geom->Open(&sink))) return false;
    sink->SetFillMode(D2D1_FILL_MODE_WINDING);
    const char* p = d;
    float cx = 0, cy = 0;
    float startX = 0, startY = 0;
    float lastCtrlX = 0, lastCtrlY = 0;
    char lastCmd = 0;
    bool figOpen = false;
    auto skipSep = [&]() { while (*p == ' ' || *p == ',' || *p == '\n' || *p == '\t' || *p == '\r') ++p; };
    auto readF = [&](float& v) -> bool {
        if (!SvgReadNumber(p, v)) return false;
        skipSep(); return true;
    };
    auto isNum = [&]() -> bool { return *p == '-' || *p == '+' || *p == '.' || (*p >= '0' && *p <= '9'); };
    auto closeIfOpen = [&](D2D1_FIGURE_END end) { if (figOpen) { sink->EndFigure(end); figOpen = false; } };
    while (*p) {
        skipSep(); if (!*p) break;
        const char* iterationStart = p;
        char cmd;
        if (isNum() && lastCmd) {
            cmd = (lastCmd == 'M') ? 'L' : (lastCmd == 'm') ? 'l' : lastCmd;
        } else {
            cmd = *p++; skipSep();
        }
        bool rel = (cmd >= 'a' && cmd <= 'z');
        switch (cmd) {
        case 'M': case 'm': {
            float x, y; if (!readF(x) || !readF(y)) { lastCmd = 0; break; }
            if (rel) { x += cx; y += cy; }
            closeIfOpen(D2D1_FIGURE_END_OPEN);
            sink->BeginFigure(D2D1::Point2F(x, y), D2D1_FIGURE_BEGIN_FILLED);
            figOpen = true; cx = x; cy = y; startX = x; startY = y;
            lastCmd = cmd; break;
        }
        case 'L': case 'l': {
            float x, y; if (!readF(x) || !readF(y)) { lastCmd = 0; break; }
            if (rel) { x += cx; y += cy; }
            sink->AddLine(D2D1::Point2F(x, y)); cx = x; cy = y;
            lastCmd = cmd; break;
        }
        case 'H': case 'h': {
            float x; if (!readF(x)) { lastCmd = 0; break; }
            if (rel) x += cx;
            sink->AddLine(D2D1::Point2F(x, cy)); cx = x;
            lastCmd = cmd; break;
        }
        case 'V': case 'v': {
            float y; if (!readF(y)) { lastCmd = 0; break; }
            if (rel) y += cy;
            sink->AddLine(D2D1::Point2F(cx, y)); cy = y;
            lastCmd = cmd; break;
        }
        case 'C': case 'c': {
            float x1, y1, x2, y2, x, y;
            bool any = false;
            while (readF(x1) && readF(y1) && readF(x2) && readF(y2) && readF(x) && readF(y)) {
                any = true;
                float ax1 = x1, ay1 = y1, ax2 = x2, ay2 = y2, ax = x, ay = y;
                if (rel) { ax1 += cx; ay1 += cy; ax2 += cx; ay2 += cy; ax += cx; ay += cy; }
                sink->AddBezier(D2D1::BezierSegment(
                    D2D1::Point2F(ax1, ay1), D2D1::Point2F(ax2, ay2), D2D1::Point2F(ax, ay)));
                lastCtrlX = ax2; lastCtrlY = ay2; cx = ax; cy = ay;
                if (!isNum()) break;
            }
            // Only keep lastCmd when a coordinate group actually advanced p
            // (matches every other case) -- otherwise a failed first read
            // leaves lastCmd == cmd with p unmoved, and the implicit-repeat
            // branch above re-enters this same case at the same position
            // forever.
            lastCmd = any ? cmd : 0;
            break;
        }
        case 'S': case 's': {
            float x2, y2, x, y;
            if (!readF(x2) || !readF(y2) || !readF(x) || !readF(y)) { lastCmd = 0; break; }
            if (rel) { x2 += cx; y2 += cy; x += cx; y += cy; }
            float x1 = (lastCmd == 'C' || lastCmd == 'c' || lastCmd == 'S' || lastCmd == 's')
                ? 2 * cx - lastCtrlX : cx;
            float y1 = (lastCmd == 'C' || lastCmd == 'c' || lastCmd == 'S' || lastCmd == 's')
                ? 2 * cy - lastCtrlY : cy;
            sink->AddBezier(D2D1::BezierSegment(
                D2D1::Point2F(x1, y1), D2D1::Point2F(x2, y2), D2D1::Point2F(x, y)));
            lastCtrlX = x2; lastCtrlY = y2; cx = x; cy = y;
            lastCmd = cmd; break;
        }
        case 'Q': case 'q': {
            float x1, y1, x, y;
            if (!readF(x1) || !readF(y1) || !readF(x) || !readF(y)) { lastCmd = 0; break; }
            if (rel) { x1 += cx; y1 += cy; x += cx; y += cy; }
            float c1x = cx + 2.0f / 3.0f * (x1 - cx);
            float c1y = cy + 2.0f / 3.0f * (y1 - cy);
            float c2x = x + 2.0f / 3.0f * (x1 - x);
            float c2y = y + 2.0f / 3.0f * (y1 - y);
            sink->AddBezier(D2D1::BezierSegment(
                D2D1::Point2F(c1x, c1y), D2D1::Point2F(c2x, c2y), D2D1::Point2F(x, y)));
            lastCtrlX = x1; lastCtrlY = y1; cx = x; cy = y;
            lastCmd = cmd; break;
        }
        case 'T': case 't': {
            float x, y;
            if (!readF(x) || !readF(y)) { lastCmd = 0; break; }
            if (rel) { x += cx; y += cy; }
            float x1 = (lastCmd == 'Q' || lastCmd == 'q' || lastCmd == 'T' || lastCmd == 't')
                ? 2 * cx - lastCtrlX : cx;
            float y1 = (lastCmd == 'Q' || lastCmd == 'q' || lastCmd == 'T' || lastCmd == 't')
                ? 2 * cy - lastCtrlY : cy;
            float c1x = cx + 2.0f / 3.0f * (x1 - cx);
            float c1y = cy + 2.0f / 3.0f * (y1 - cy);
            float c2x = x + 2.0f / 3.0f * (x1 - x);
            float c2y = y + 2.0f / 3.0f * (y1 - y);
            sink->AddBezier(D2D1::BezierSegment(
                D2D1::Point2F(c1x, c1y), D2D1::Point2F(c2x, c2y), D2D1::Point2F(x, y)));
            lastCtrlX = x1; lastCtrlY = y1; cx = x; cy = y;
            lastCmd = cmd; break;
        }
        case 'A': case 'a': {
            float rx, ry, xrot, laf, swf, x, y;
            if (!readF(rx) || !readF(ry) || !readF(xrot) || !readF(laf) || !readF(swf) ||
                !readF(x) || !readF(y)) { lastCmd = 0; break; }
            if (rel) { x += cx; y += cy; }
            sink->AddLine(D2D1::Point2F(x, y));
            cx = x; cy = y;
            lastCmd = cmd; break;
        }
        case 'Z': case 'z':
            closeIfOpen(D2D1_FIGURE_END_CLOSED);
            cx = startX; cy = startY;
            lastCmd = 0; break;
        default:
            lastCmd = 0; break;
        }

        // Forward-progress backstop. Each case above either consumes input or
        // clears lastCmd so the next pass eats the offending character, but a
        // single missed spot there is an infinite loop on malformed data (one
        // such bug in 'C' froze regedit once), and path data reaching here can
        // always be malformed.
        if (p == iterationStart) {
            ++p;
            lastCmd = 0;
        }
    }
    closeIfOpen(D2D1_FIGURE_END_OPEN);
    if (FAILED(sink->Close())) return false;
    *ppOut = geom.Detach();
    return true;
}

// The color DrawSvgGeom should Clear() its render target to before drawing
// the glyph -- the shared/cached D2D render target (CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget/
// D2DGetThreadCache) is reused across unrelated draw sites, so without this
// the glyph's own sliver of `rc` can read as a stray leftover fill from an
// earlier button/checkbox/tab paint on the same thread, causing intermittent
// black squares.
//
// GetPixel is the only way to see a live hover/selection tint, so it's used
// to sample -- but distrusted for pure black specifically: a DPI-unaware
// window's top-level buffer is virtualized by the OS, and its first-ever
// paint can genuinely read back RGB(0,0,0) for a cell that hasn't had real
// content composited into it yet (not a torn/partial value, a valid-looking
// but stale sample). Rejecting black outright would also swallow real dark
// selection tints, so instead a per-window "warm" flag (kPropGlyphEraseWarm)
// tracks the first trustworthy non-black sample; every call before that
// falls back to a fixed color, every call after trusts GetPixel normally.

static bool IsWindowDpiUnaware(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd) return false;
    DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT ctx = GetWindowDpiAwarenessContext(hwnd);
    return ctx && GetAwarenessFromDpiAwarenessContext(ctx) == DPI_AWARENESS_UNAWARE;
}

// Sample the painted hover/selection tint for DrawSvgGeom and the icon-text
// gap erase in CDDS_ITEMPOSTPAINT, rather than assuming a flat system color.
static COLORREF GlyphSampleEraseColor(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, bool dark)
{
    HWND paintHwnd = g_tlsPaintHwnd ? g_tlsPaintHwnd : WindowFromDC(hdc);
    COLORREF sampled = GetPixel(hdc, rc.left, (rc.top + rc.bottom) / 2);
    // Only pure black in dark mode needs the extra check -- pure black in
    // light mode is already rejected below regardless of DPI awareness,
    // and a cold DPI-unaware buffer reads as black, never as white, so
    // the existing white-while-dark rejection needs no equivalent guard.
    bool suspectCold = dark && sampled == RGB(0, 0, 0) &&
        IsWindowDpiUnaware(paintHwnd) &&
        !GetPropW(paintHwnd, kPropGlyphEraseWarm);
    if (sampled != CLR_INVALID && !suspectCold &&
        !(dark && sampled == RGB(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)) &&
        !(!dark && sampled == RGB(0, 0, 0))) {
        if (paintHwnd)
            SetPropW(paintHwnd, kPropGlyphEraseWarm, (HANDLE)1);
        return sampled;
    }
    return dark ? Win32MainDark : GetSysColor(COLOR_WINDOW);
}

// The cached form of DrawSvgGeom's two paths: the fill comes from the raster
// cache and is blended over the real pixels (Mica) or over the sampled erase
// color, which the D2D path clears to (opaque, written with SRCCOPY).
static bool DrawSvgGeomCached(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr,
                              wchar_t glyph, bool filled, ID2D1PathGeometry* geom,
                              const D2D1::Matrix3x2F& transform, float scale,
                              bool overBackground)
{
    const LONG width = rc.right - rc.left, height = rc.bottom - rc.top;
    if (GetMapMode(hdc) != MM_TEXT || !ShellTextRasterUsable(hdc, width, height))
        return false;
    const auto key = ShellTextMakeGlyphKey(&glyph, filled, width, height, scale,
        cr, ShellTextRasterGeneration());
    const uint64_t hash = key.Hash();
    ShellTextRaster* raster = ShellTextRasterLoad(width, height, key, hash, nullptr);
    if (!raster) {
        raster = ShellTextRasterRender(width, height, cr, key, hash, 0,
            [&](ID2D1RenderTarget* target, ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush) {
                target->SetTransform(transform);
                target->FillGeometry(geom, brush);
                return true;
            });
    }
    if (!raster)
        return false;
    if (overBackground)
        return ShellTextRasterBlend(hdc, rc, *raster);

    const COLORREF erase = GlyphSampleEraseColor(hdc, rc, IsSystemDarkMode());
    const UINT eraseB = GetBValue(erase), eraseG = GetGValue(erase),
        eraseR = GetRValue(erase);
    for (LONG y = 0; y < height; ++y) {
        BYTE* pixel = raster->pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * raster->width * 4;
        for (LONG x = 0; x < width; ++x, pixel += 4) {
            const UINT inverse = 255 - pixel[3];
            pixel[0] = static_cast<BYTE>(pixel[0] + (eraseB * inverse + 127) / 255);
            pixel[1] = static_cast<BYTE>(pixel[1] + (eraseG * inverse + 127) / 255);
            pixel[2] = static_cast<BYTE>(pixel[2] + (eraseR * inverse + 127) / 255);
            pixel[3] = 255;
        }
    }
    return BitBlt(hdc, rc.left, rc.top, width, height, raster->dc, 0, 0, SRCCOPY) != FALSE;
}

// Renders one SVG geometry into `rc` using uniform scale + center fit.
// Bounds are computed from the geometry itself via GetBounds — no hardcoded BB needed.
// A resting glyph passes `cacheGlyph` to draw from the raster cache.
static void DrawSvgGeom(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr,
                        ID2D1PathGeometry* geom, float extraScale = 1.0f,
                        float rotationDeg = 0.0f, wchar_t cacheGlyph = 0,
                        bool cacheFilled = false) {
    D2D1_RECT_F bb;
    if (FAILED(geom->GetBounds(nullptr, &bb))) return;
    const float contentW = bb.right  - bb.left;
    const float contentH = bb.bottom - bb.top;
    if (contentW <= 0 || contentH <= 0) return;
    const float targetW = float(rc.right  - rc.left);
    const float targetH = float(rc.bottom - rc.top);
    const float scale = std::min(targetW / contentW, targetH / contentH) * extraScale;
    const float offX  = (targetW - contentW * scale) / 2.0f - bb.left * scale;
    const float offY  = (targetH - contentH * scale) / 2.0f - bb.top  * scale;
    const D2D1_COLOR_F clr = {
        GetRValue(cr) / 255.f, GetGValue(cr) / 255.f, GetBValue(cr) / 255.f, 1.0f };

    // Sets the transform and fills `geom` at the scale/offset already
    // computed above. Deliberately doesn't own BeginDraw/EndDraw -- each
    // branch below needs exactly one Begin/End cycle each (with its own,
    // different erase step in between, or none), not this fill wrapped in
    // a second cycle of its own.
    auto fillGeometry = [&](ID2D1DCRenderTarget* rtRaw) {
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F transform = D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY);
        if (rotationDeg != 0.0f) {
            transform = transform * D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Rotation(rotationDeg,
                D2D1::Point2F(targetW / 2.0f, targetH / 2.0f));
        }
        rtRaw->SetTransform(transform);
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rtRaw, clr))
            rtRaw->FillGeometry(geom, brush);
        rtRaw->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
    };

    // Mica resting glyphs need a real pixel copy: clearing to a guessed color
    // erases the backdrop or highlight. Animated glyphs use their own alpha DIB.
    // File pickers need the same path, despite not being Explorer root windows.
    const HWND micaHost = ResolvePaintHwndFreshFirst(hdc);
    const bool micaBlack =
        (ExplorerMicaActive() && IsInsideExplorer(micaHost)) ||
        (FilePickerMicaActive() && FilePickerRoot(micaHost) != nullptr);
    if (cacheGlyph && rotationDeg == 0.0f &&
        DrawSvgGeomCached(hdc, rc, cr, cacheGlyph, cacheFilled, geom,
            D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY), scale, micaBlack))
        return;
    if (micaBlack) {
        const int w = rc.right - rc.left;
        const int h = rc.bottom - rc.top;
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;
        HDC memDC = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
        if (!memDC) return;
        HBITMAP bmp = CreateCompatibleBitmap(hdc, w, h);
        if (!bmp) { DeleteDC(memDC); return; }
        HBITMAP oldBmp = static_cast<HBITMAP>(SelectObject(memDC, bmp));
        BitBlt(memDC, 0, 0, w, h, hdc, rc.left, rc.top, SRCCOPY);

        RECT localRc = {0, 0, w, h};
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* raw = nullptr;
        if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(memDC, &localRc, g_d2dFactory, &raw)) && raw) {
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rtMem;
            rtMem.Attach(raw);
            // No Clear() -- memDC was just seeded with the real destination
            // pixels via the BitBlt above, so this fills straight on top of
            // them, unlike the plain path below which erases first.
            rtMem->BeginDraw();
            fillGeometry(rtMem.Get());
            if (rtMem->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET)
                CachedTlsRTRecreate();
        }

        BitBlt(hdc, rc.left, rc.top, w, h, memDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
        SelectObject(memDC, oldBmp);
        DeleteObject(bmp);
        DeleteDC(memDC);

        // The shared per-thread render target above is still bound to the
        // memDC just destroyed. Rebind it onto the real, still-live hdc
        // before returning so it's never left pointing at a freed handle --
        // no drawing happens here, just BindDC, so this has no visible
        // effect of its own.
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* rebind = nullptr;
        RECT rcCopy = rc;
        if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcCopy, g_d2dFactory, &rebind)) && rebind)
            rebind->Release();
        return;
    }

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    {
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* raw = nullptr;
        RECT rcCopy = rc;
        if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcCopy, g_d2dFactory, &raw)) || !raw) return;
        rt.Attach(raw);
    }
    rt->BeginDraw();
    const COLORREF eraseClr = GlyphSampleEraseColor(hdc, rc, IsSystemDarkMode());
    const D2D1_COLOR_F eraseD2D = {
        GetRValue(eraseClr) / 255.f, GetGValue(eraseClr) / 255.f, GetBValue(eraseClr) / 255.f, 1.0f };
    rt->Clear(eraseD2D);
    fillGeometry(rt.Get());
    if (rt->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        rt.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
}

static bool ShellIconContainsI(PCWSTR text, PCWSTR needle)
{
    if (!text || !needle || !*needle) return false;
    const size_t needleLen = wcslen(needle);
    for (PCWSTR p = text; *p; ++p)
        if (_wcsnicmp(p, needle, needleLen) == 0)
            return true;
    return false;
}

static bool ShellIconGetModulePath(HMODULE module, wchar_t* buffer, size_t cch)
{
    if (!module || !buffer || cch == 0) return false;
    DWORD len = GetModuleFileNameW(module, buffer, static_cast<DWORD>(cch));
    if (len == 0 || len >= cch) {
        buffer[0] = L'\0';
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool ShellIconIsShell32ModuleUncached(HMODULE module)
{
    wchar_t path[MAX_PATH] = {};
    return ShellIconGetModulePath(module, path, ARRAYSIZE(path)) &&
           (ShellIconContainsI(path, L"\\shell32.dll") ||
            ShellIconContainsI(path, L"\\shell32.dll.mun"));
}

static bool ShellIconIsShell32Module(HMODULE module)
{
    if (!module)
        return false;

    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_shellIconModuleCacheLock);
    for (const ShellIconModuleCacheEntry& cached : g_shellIconModuleCache) {
        if (cached.module == module) {
            bool isShell32 = cached.isShell32;
            ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_shellIconModuleCacheLock);
            return isShell32;
        }
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_shellIconModuleCacheLock);

    const bool isShell32 = ShellIconIsShell32ModuleUncached(module);

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconModuleCacheLock);
    bool exists = false;
    for (const ShellIconModuleCacheEntry& cached : g_shellIconModuleCache) {
        if (cached.module == module) {
            exists = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!exists && g_shellIconModuleCache.size() < kShellIconModuleCacheMaxEntries)
        g_shellIconModuleCache.push_back({ module, isShell32 });
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconModuleCacheLock);

    return isShell32;
}

    return reinterpret_cast<HMODULE>(mbi.AllocationBase);
}

    if (!ShellIconGetModulePath(module, path, ARRAYSIZE(path)))
        return false;

    if (ShellIconContainsI(path, L"\\comctl32.dll") ||
        ShellIconContainsI(path, L"\\dui70.dll"))
        return true;

    return IsCurrentProcessExplorer() && ShellIconContainsI(path, L"\\shell32.dll");
}

static bool ShellIconIsAllowedCaller(void* caller)
{
    HMODULE module = ShellIconGetCallerModule(caller);
    if (!module)
        return false;

    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_shellIconCallerCacheLock);
    for (const ShellIconCallerCacheEntry& cached : g_shellIconCallerCache) {
        if (cached.module == module) {
            bool allowed = cached.allowed;
            ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_shellIconCallerCacheLock);
            return allowed;
        }
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_shellIconCallerCacheLock);

    const bool allowed = ShellIconIsAllowedCallerModuleUncached(module);

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconCallerCacheLock);
    bool exists = false;
    for (const ShellIconCallerCacheEntry& cached : g_shellIconCallerCache) {
        if (cached.module == module) {
            exists = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!exists && g_shellIconCallerCache.size() < kShellIconCallerCacheMaxEntries)
        g_shellIconCallerCache.push_back({ module, allowed });
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconCallerCacheLock);

    return allowed;
}

static D2D1_COLOR_F ShellIconColorF(COLORREF cr)
{
    return D2D1::ColorF(GetRValue(cr) / 255.f,
                        GetGValue(cr) / 255.f,
                        GetBValue(cr) / 255.f,
                        1.f);
}

static COLORREF ShellIconNeutralColor(bool dark)
{
    return dark ? RGB(0xE0, 0xDF, 0xDF) : RGB(0x55, 0x55, 0x55);
}

static void ShellIconReleaseSvgResourcesLocked()
{
    if (g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext) {
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->SetTarget(nullptr);
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->Release();
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext = nullptr;
    }
    if (g_shellIconSvg.d2dDevice) {
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dDevice->Release();
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dDevice = nullptr;
    }
    if (g_shellIconSvg.dxgiDevice) {
        g_shellIconSvg.dxgiDevice->Release();
        g_shellIconSvg.dxgiDevice = nullptr;
    }
    if (g_shellIconSvg.d3dContext) {
        g_shellIconSvg.d3dContext->Release();
        g_shellIconSvg.d3dContext = nullptr;
    }
    if (g_shellIconSvg.d3dDevice) {
        g_shellIconSvg.d3dDevice->Release();
        g_shellIconSvg.d3dDevice = nullptr;
    }
}

static void ShellIconReleaseSvgResources()
{
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconSvgLock);
    ShellIconReleaseSvgResourcesLocked();
    g_shellIconSvg.tried = false;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconSvgLock);
}

static bool ShellIconEnsureSvgResourcesLocked()
{
    if (g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext)
        return true;
    if (g_shellIconSvg.tried)
        return false;

    g_shellIconSvg.tried = true;
    if (!g_d2dFactory)
        return false;

    static constexpr D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL kFeatureLevels[] = {
        D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0,
        D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_10_1,
        D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_10_0,
    };

    HRESULT hr = D3D11CreateDeviceDynamic(nullptr, D3D_DRIVER_TYPE_HARDWARE, nullptr,
        D3D11_CREATE_DEVICE_BGRA_SUPPORT, kFeatureLevels, ARRAYSIZE(kFeatureLevels),
        D3D11_SDK_VERSION, &g_shellIconSvg.d3dDevice, nullptr,
        &g_shellIconSvg.d3dContext);
    if (FAILED(hr)) {
        hr = D3D11CreateDeviceDynamic(nullptr, D3D_DRIVER_TYPE_WARP, nullptr,
            D3D11_CREATE_DEVICE_BGRA_SUPPORT, kFeatureLevels, ARRAYSIZE(kFeatureLevels),
            D3D11_SDK_VERSION, &g_shellIconSvg.d3dDevice, nullptr,
            &g_shellIconSvg.d3dContext);
    }
    if (FAILED(hr) || !g_shellIconSvg.d3dDevice || !g_shellIconSvg.d3dContext) {
        ShellIconReleaseSvgResourcesLocked();
        return false;
    }

    hr = g_shellIconSvg.d3dDevice->QueryInterface(
        __uuidof(IDXGIDevice), reinterpret_cast<void**>(&g_shellIconSvg.dxgiDevice));
    if (FAILED(hr) || !g_shellIconSvg.dxgiDevice) {
        ShellIconReleaseSvgResourcesLocked();
        return false;
    }

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1Factory2> factory2;
    hr = g_d2dFactory->QueryInterface(
        __uuidof(ID2D1Factory2), reinterpret_cast<void**>(factory2.GetAddressOf()));
    if (FAILED(hr) || !factory2) {
        ShellIconReleaseSvgResourcesLocked();
        return false;
    }

    hr = factory2->CreateDevice(g_shellIconSvg.dxgiDevice, &g_shellIconSvg.d2dDevice);
    if (FAILED(hr) || !g_shellIconSvg.d2dDevice) {
        ShellIconReleaseSvgResourcesLocked();
        return false;
    }

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DeviceContext> baseContext;
    hr = g_shellIconSvg.d2dDevice->CreateDeviceContext(
        D2D1_DEVICE_CONTEXT_OPTIONS_NONE, &baseContext);
    if (FAILED(hr) || !baseContext) {
        ShellIconReleaseSvgResourcesLocked();
        return false;
    }

    hr = baseContext->QueryInterface(
        __uuidof(ID2D1DeviceContext5),
        reinterpret_cast<void**>(&g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext));
    if (FAILED(hr) || !g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext) {
        ShellIconReleaseSvgResourcesLocked();
        return false;
    }

    return true;
}

static std::string ShellIconColorHex(COLORREF color)
{
    char buffer[8] = {};
    sprintf_s(buffer, "#%02X%02X%02X",
        GetRValue(color), GetGValue(color), GetBValue(color));
    return std::string(buffer);
}

static void ShellIconReplaceAll(std::string& text,
                                const char* from,
                                const std::string& to)
{
    if (!from || !*from)
        return;

    size_t pos = 0;
    const size_t fromLen = strlen(from);
    while ((pos = text.find(from, pos)) != std::string::npos) {
        text.replace(pos, fromLen, to);
        pos += to.length();
    }
}

static std::string ShellIconBuildSvgXml(const ShellIconEntry& entry,
                                        bool dark,
                                        COLORREF accent)
{
    std::string svg(entry.svgXml ? entry.svgXml : "");
    const std::string neutral = ShellIconColorHex(ShellIconNeutralColor(dark));
    const std::string accentHex = ShellIconColorHex(accent);
    ShellIconReplaceAll(svg, "__WH_NEUTRAL__", neutral);
    ShellIconReplaceAll(svg, "__WH_ACCENT__", accentHex);
    return svg;
}

static HICON ShellIconCreateHiconFromPixels(const void* srcBits,
                                            UINT srcPitch,
                                            int size)
{
    if (!srcBits || srcPitch < static_cast<UINT>(size) * 4)
        return nullptr;

    HDC memDC = CreateCompatibleDC(nullptr);
    if (!memDC)
        return nullptr;

    BITMAPINFO bi = {};
    bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(bi.bmiHeader);
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = size;
    bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -size;
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

    void* dstBits = nullptr;
    HBITMAP colorBmp = CreateDIBSection(memDC, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS,
        &dstBits, nullptr, 0);
    DeleteDC(memDC);
    if (!colorBmp || !dstBits) {
        if (colorBmp)
            DeleteObject(colorBmp);
        return nullptr;
    }

    const BYTE* src = static_cast<const BYTE*>(srcBits);
    BYTE* dst = static_cast<BYTE*>(dstBits);
    const UINT dstPitch = static_cast<UINT>(size) * 4;
    for (int y = 0; y < size; ++y)
        memcpy(dst + y * dstPitch, src + y * srcPitch, dstPitch);
    ConvertPremultipliedDibToStraightAlpha(dstBits, size, size);

    HICON icon = nullptr;
    HBITMAP maskBmp = CreateAlphaZeroMaskBitmap(size, size, dstBits);
    if (maskBmp) {
        ICONINFO ii = {};
        ii.fIcon = TRUE;
        ii.hbmColor = colorBmp;
        ii.hbmMask = maskBmp;
        icon = CreateIconIndirect(&ii);
        DeleteObject(maskBmp);
    }

    DeleteObject(colorBmp);
    return icon;
}

static HICON ShellIconCreateIconFromSvg(const ShellIconEntry& entry,
                                        int size,
                                        bool dark,
                                        COLORREF accent)
{
    if (!entry.svgXml || !g_d2dFactory)
        return nullptr;

    FPUGuard fpu;
    std::string svg = ShellIconBuildSvgXml(entry, dark, accent);

    HGLOBAL svgMemory = GlobalAlloc(GMEM_MOVEABLE, svg.size());
    if (!svgMemory)
        return nullptr;
    void* svgBytes = GlobalLock(svgMemory);
    if (!svgBytes) {
        GlobalFree(svgMemory);
        return nullptr;
    }
    memcpy(svgBytes, svg.data(), svg.size());
    GlobalUnlock(svgMemory);

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IStream> svgStream;
    HRESULT hr = CreateStreamOnHGlobal(svgMemory, TRUE, &svgStream);
    if (FAILED(hr) || !svgStream) {
        GlobalFree(svgMemory);
        return nullptr;
    }

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconSvgLock);
    HICON icon = nullptr;
    do {
        if (!ShellIconEnsureSvgResourcesLocked())
            break;

        const int renderSize = std::clamp(size * 4, size, 256);

        D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC texDesc = {};
        texDesc.Width = static_cast<UINT>(renderSize);
        texDesc.Height = static_cast<UINT>(renderSize);
        texDesc.MipLevels = 1;
        texDesc.ArraySize = 1;
        texDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
        texDesc.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
        texDesc.Usage = D3D11_USAGE_DEFAULT;
        texDesc.BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_RENDER_TARGET | D3D11_BIND_SHADER_RESOURCE;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D> renderTexture;
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d3dDevice->CreateTexture2D(
            &texDesc, nullptr, &renderTexture);
        if (FAILED(hr) || !renderTexture)
            break;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDXGISurface> renderSurface;
        hr = renderTexture->QueryInterface(
            __uuidof(IDXGISurface),
            reinterpret_cast<void**>(renderSurface.GetAddressOf()));
        if (FAILED(hr) || !renderSurface)
            break;

        D2D1_BITMAP_PROPERTIES1 renderBitmapProps = D2D1::BitmapProperties1(
            D2D1_BITMAP_OPTIONS_TARGET,
            D2D1::PixelFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM,
                              D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED),
            96.f, 96.f);

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1Bitmap1> renderBitmap;
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->CreateBitmapFromDxgiSurface(
            renderSurface.Get(), &renderBitmapProps, &renderBitmap);
        if (FAILED(hr) || !renderBitmap)
            break;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SvgDocument> svgDocument;
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->CreateSvgDocument(
            svgStream.Get(), D2D1::SizeF(static_cast<float>(renderSize),
                                         static_cast<float>(renderSize)),
            &svgDocument);
        if (FAILED(hr) || !svgDocument)
            break;

        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->SetTarget(renderBitmap.Get());
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->SetAntialiasMode(D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_PER_PRIMITIVE);
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->SetPrimitiveBlend(D2D1_PRIMITIVE_BLEND_SOURCE_OVER);
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->BeginDraw();
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->Clear(D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f));
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->DrawSvgDocument(svgDocument.Get());
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->EndDraw();
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->SetTarget(nullptr);
        if (FAILED(hr))
            break;

        D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC finalDesc = texDesc;
        finalDesc.Width = static_cast<UINT>(size);
        finalDesc.Height = static_cast<UINT>(size);

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D> finalTexture;
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d3dDevice->CreateTexture2D(
            &finalDesc, nullptr, &finalTexture);
        if (FAILED(hr) || !finalTexture)
            break;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDXGISurface> finalSurface;
        hr = finalTexture->QueryInterface(
            __uuidof(IDXGISurface),
            reinterpret_cast<void**>(finalSurface.GetAddressOf()));
        if (FAILED(hr) || !finalSurface)
            break;

        D2D1_BITMAP_PROPERTIES1 finalBitmapProps = D2D1::BitmapProperties1(
            D2D1_BITMAP_OPTIONS_TARGET | D2D1_BITMAP_OPTIONS_CANNOT_DRAW,
            D2D1::PixelFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM,
                              D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED),
            96.f, 96.f);

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1Bitmap1> finalBitmap;
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->CreateBitmapFromDxgiSurface(
            finalSurface.Get(), &finalBitmapProps, &finalBitmap);
        if (FAILED(hr) || !finalBitmap)
            break;

        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->SetTarget(finalBitmap.Get());
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->BeginDraw();
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->Clear(D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f));
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->DrawBitmap(
            renderBitmap.Get(),
            D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f, static_cast<float>(size), static_cast<float>(size)),
            1.f,
            D2D1_INTERPOLATION_MODE_HIGH_QUALITY_CUBIC,
            D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f, static_cast<float>(renderSize), static_cast<float>(renderSize)));
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->EndDraw();
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->SetTarget(nullptr);
        if (FAILED(hr))
            break;

        D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC stagingDesc = finalDesc;
        stagingDesc.Usage = D3D11_USAGE_STAGING;
        stagingDesc.BindFlags = 0;
        stagingDesc.CPUAccessFlags = D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_READ;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D> staging;
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d3dDevice->CreateTexture2D(
            &stagingDesc, nullptr, &staging);
        if (FAILED(hr) || !staging)
            break;

        g_shellIconSvg.d3dContext->CopyResource(staging.Get(), finalTexture.Get());

        D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE mapped = {};
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d3dContext->Map(
            staging.Get(), 0, D3D11_MAP_READ, 0, &mapped);
        if (FAILED(hr))
            break;

        icon = ShellIconCreateHiconFromPixels(
            mapped.pData, mapped.RowPitch, size);
        g_shellIconSvg.d3dContext->Unmap(staging.Get(), 0);
    } while (false);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconSvgLock);

    return icon;
}

static const char* ShortcutOverlayEmbeddedSvg(bool compact)
{
    return compact ? kShortcutSvgLight40 : kShortcutSvgLight64;
}

static void ShortcutOverlayClearCache()
{
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_shortcutOverlayCacheLock);
    for (const ShortcutOverlayCacheEntry& cached : g_shortcutOverlayCache)
        DestroyIcon(cached.icon);
    g_shortcutOverlayCache.clear();
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shortcutOverlayCacheLock);
}

static HICON ShortcutOverlayCreateIcon(int size)
{
    if (size <= 0)
        return nullptr;

    const bool dark = IsSystemDarkMode();
    const COLORREF indicator = GetAccentIndicator();
    const COLORREF base = GetCachedAccentBase();
    const COLORREF gradientStart = dark ? indicator : base;
    const COLORREF gradientEnd = dark ? base : indicator;

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_shortcutOverlayCacheLock);
    for (const ShortcutOverlayCacheEntry& cached : g_shortcutOverlayCache) {
        if (cached.size == size && cached.dark == dark &&
            cached.gradientStart == gradientStart &&
            cached.gradientEnd == gradientEnd) {
            HICON result = CopyIcon(cached.icon);
            ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shortcutOverlayCacheLock);
            return result;
        }
    }

    const bool compact = size <= 40;
    std::string svg = ShortcutOverlayEmbeddedSvg(compact);
    if (dark) {
        ShellIconReplaceAll(svg, "#eee", "#1C1C1C");
        ShellIconReplaceAll(svg, "#e5e5e5", "#424242");
    }
    ShellIconReplaceAll(svg, "#62acef", ShellIconColorHex(gradientStart));
    ShellIconReplaceAll(svg, "#3789ce", ShellIconColorHex(gradientEnd));

    // Equivalent to scaling the artwork 1.08x around its lower-left corner,
    // expressed through the SVG viewBox so the shared rasterizer remains
    // unchanged for the other shell icons.
    if (compact) {
        ShellIconReplaceAll(svg, "viewBox=\"0 0 30 30\"",
                            "viewBox=\"0 2.2222222 27.7777778 27.7777778\"");
    } else {
        ShellIconReplaceAll(svg, "viewBox=\"0 0 48 48\"",
                            "viewBox=\"0 3.5555556 44.4444444 44.4444444\"");
    }

    const ShellIconEntry entry = {
        0, compact ? 30.f : 48.f, compact ? 30.f : 48.f,
        nullptr, 0, svg.c_str()
    };
    HICON built = ShellIconCreateIconFromSvg(
        entry, std::clamp(size, 8, 256), dark, gradientStart);

    if (built) {
        if (g_shortcutOverlayCache.size() >=
            kShortcutOverlayCacheMaxEntries) {
            for (const ShortcutOverlayCacheEntry& cached :
                 g_shortcutOverlayCache) {
                DestroyIcon(cached.icon);
            }
            g_shortcutOverlayCache.clear();
        }
        g_shortcutOverlayCache.push_back(
            {size, dark, gradientStart, gradientEnd, built});
    }

    HICON result = built ? CopyIcon(built) : nullptr;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shortcutOverlayCacheLock);
    return result;
}

static bool ShortcutOverlayDrawIcon(HDC hdc, int x, int y, int size)
{
    if (!hdc || size <= 0)
        return false;

    const bool dark = IsSystemDarkMode();
    const COLORREF indicator = GetAccentIndicator();
    const COLORREF base = GetCachedAccentBase();
    const COLORREF gradientStart = dark ? indicator : base;
    const COLORREF gradientEnd = dark ? base : indicator;

    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_shortcutOverlayCacheLock);
    for (const ShortcutOverlayCacheEntry& cached :
         g_shortcutOverlayCache) {
        if (cached.size == size && cached.dark == dark &&
            cached.gradientStart == gradientStart &&
            cached.gradientEnd == gradientEnd) {
            const bool drawn = DrawIconEx(
                hdc, x, y, cached.icon, size, size, 0, nullptr,
                DI_NORMAL) != FALSE;
            ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_shortcutOverlayCacheLock);
            return drawn;
        }
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_shortcutOverlayCacheLock);

    HICON icon = ShortcutOverlayCreateIcon(size);
    if (!icon)
        return false;
    const bool drawn = DrawIconEx(
        hdc, x, y, icon, size, size, 0, nullptr, DI_NORMAL) != FALSE;
    DestroyIcon(icon);
    return drawn;
}

    0x46eb5926, 0x582e, 0x4017,
    {0x9f, 0xdf, 0xe8, 0x99, 0x8d, 0xaa, 0x09, 0x50}
};
static constexpr IID kShortcutOverlayIidImageList2 = {
    0x192b9d83, 0x50fc, 0x457b,
    {0x90, 0xa0, 0x2b, 0x82, 0xa8, 0xb5, 0xda, 0xe1}
};

static HRESULT ShortcutOverlayReplaceImageListIcon(
    IImageList* imageList, int imageIndex, HICON icon)
{
    int replacedIndex = -1;
    HRESULT hr = imageList->ReplaceIcon(imageIndex, icon, &replacedIndex);
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr))
        return hr;

    ICONINFO iconInfo = {};
    if (!GetIconInfo(icon, &iconInfo)) {
        const DWORD error = GetLastError();
        return HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(error ? error : ERROR_GEN_FAILURE);
    }

    hr = imageList->Replace(imageIndex, iconInfo.hbmColor, iconInfo.hbmMask);
    if (FAILED(hr)) {
        IImageList2* imageList2 = nullptr;
        if (SUCCEEDED(imageList->QueryInterface(
                kShortcutOverlayIidImageList2,
                reinterpret_cast<void**>(&imageList2))) && imageList2) {
            hr = imageList2->Replace2(imageIndex, iconInfo.hbmColor,
                                      iconInfo.hbmMask, nullptr, 0);
            imageList2->Release();
        }
    }

    if (iconInfo.hbmColor)
        DeleteObject(iconInfo.hbmColor);
    if (iconInfo.hbmMask)
        DeleteObject(iconInfo.hbmMask);
    return hr;
}

static bool ShortcutOverlayResolveIdentity()
{
    if (g_shortcutOverlaySlot >= 1 &&
        g_shortcutOverlayImageIndex >= 0) {
        return true;
    }

    IImageList* imageList = nullptr;
    HRESULT hr = SHGetImageList(
        SHIL_LARGE, kShortcutOverlayIidImageList,
        reinterpret_cast<void**>(&imageList));
    if (FAILED(hr) || !imageList)
        return false;

    const int slot = SHGetIconOverlayIndexW(nullptr, IDO_SHGIOI_LINK);
    int imageIndex = -1;
    if (slot >= 1)
        hr = imageList->GetOverlayImage(slot, &imageIndex);
    else
        hr = E_FAIL;
    imageList->Release();

    if (FAILED(hr) || imageIndex < 0)
        return false;
    g_shortcutOverlaySlot = slot;
    g_shortcutOverlayImageIndex = imageIndex;
    return true;
}

static int ShortcutOverlayCanvasSize(int imageSize)
{
    const UINT dpi = GetDpiForSystem();
    const int systemIcon = GetSystemMetricsForDpi(SM_CXICON, dpi);
    if (systemIcon <= 0)
        return imageSize;

    const int halfIcon = systemIcon / 2;
    const int oneAndHalfIcons = systemIcon * 3 / 2;
    if (imageSize < halfIcon)
        return -1;
    if (imageSize < systemIcon)
        return halfIcon;
    if (imageSize <= oneAndHalfIcons)
        return systemIcon;

    HDC screenDc = GetDC(nullptr);
    const int screenDpi = screenDc ? GetDeviceCaps(screenDc, LOGPIXELSX) : 96;
    if (screenDc)
        ReleaseDC(nullptr, screenDc);

    const int maximumImageSize = MulDiv(256, screenDpi, 96);
    const int range = maximumImageSize - oneAndHalfIcons;
    if (range <= 0)
        return oneAndHalfIcons;

    return systemIcon +
           MulDiv(systemIcon * 2, imageSize - oneAndHalfIcons, range);
}

static int SHORTCUT_RENDERER_CALL ShortcutRendererGetOverlayIndexHook(
    void* renderer)
{
    const ShortcutRendererGetOverlayIndexFn original =
        g_shortcutRendererGetOverlayIndexOrig;
    if (!original)
        return kShortcutOverlayNone;

    const int overlay = original(renderer);
    if (g_shortcutOverlayActive.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
        renderer == g_shortcutOverlaySuppressedRenderer &&
        overlay == g_shortcutOverlaySlot) {
        return kShortcutOverlayNone;
    }
    return overlay;
}

static HRESULT SHORTCUT_RENDERER_DRAW_CALL ShortcutRendererDrawHook(
    void* renderer, HDC hdc, const RECT* rect)
{
    const ShortcutRendererDrawFn drawOriginal =
        g_shortcutRendererDrawOrig;
    if (!drawOriginal)
        return E_UNEXPECTED;

    if (!g_shortcutOverlayActive.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !hdc || !rect) {
        return drawOriginal(renderer, hdc, rect);
    }

    const ShortcutRendererGetOverlayIndexFn getOverlayOriginal =
        g_shortcutRendererGetOverlayIndexOrig;
    if (!getOverlayOriginal)
        return drawOriginal(renderer, hdc, rect);

    const int overlay = getOverlayOriginal(renderer);
    if (overlay != g_shortcutOverlaySlot)
        return drawOriginal(renderer, hdc, rect);

    // CDefImageRenderer normally restores the HDC state it uses internally,
    // but alternate/cache-recovery paths can leave a transform, viewport or
    // clip selected on its long-lived memory DC.  DrawIconEx would inherit
    // that state and geometrically distort only our directly composed overlay
    // until Explorer recreated the renderer.  Preserve the caller's entry
    // state around the native draw so the overlay always sees the same DC
    // coordinate space as the rectangle supplied to this call.
    const int savedDc = SaveDC(hdc);
    if (savedDc == 0)
        return drawOriginal(renderer, hdc, rect);

    void* previous = g_shortcutOverlaySuppressedRenderer;
    g_shortcutOverlaySuppressedRenderer = renderer;
    const HRESULT hr = drawOriginal(renderer, hdc, rect);
    g_shortcutOverlaySuppressedRenderer = previous;
    const bool dcRestored = RestoreDC(hdc, savedDc) != FALSE;

    const int width = rect->right - rect->left;
    const int height = rect->bottom - rect->top;
    const int overlaySize =
        ShortcutOverlayCanvasSize(std::max(width, height));
    if (dcRestored && SUCCEEDED(hr) &&
        width > 0 && height > 0 && overlaySize > 0) {
        ShortcutOverlayDrawIcon(
            hdc, rect->left, rect->bottom - overlaySize, overlaySize);
    }
    return hr;
}

static bool ShortcutOverlayEnsureRendererHooks()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_shortcutOverlayHookMutex);
    if (g_shortcutOverlayHooksAttempted)
        return g_shortcutOverlayHooksInstalled;
    g_shortcutOverlayHooksAttempted = true;

    g_shortcutOverlayWindowsStorage = LoadLibraryExW(
        L"Windows.Storage.dll", nullptr, LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32);
    if (!g_shortcutOverlayWindowsStorage)
        return false;

    const WindowsStorageSymbols storageSymbols =
        WindowsStorageResolveSymbols(g_shortcutOverlayWindowsStorage);
    SetResolvedSymbolHook(storageSymbols.imageRendererDraw,
                          ShortcutRendererDrawHook,
                          &g_shortcutRendererDrawOrig);
    SetResolvedSymbolHook(storageSymbols.imageRendererGetOverlayIndex,
                          ShortcutRendererGetOverlayIndexHook,
                          &g_shortcutRendererGetOverlayIndexOrig);
    const bool anyHookQueued = g_shortcutRendererDrawOrig ||
                               g_shortcutRendererGetOverlayIndexOrig;
    if (!anyHookQueued) {
        FreeLibrary(g_shortcutOverlayWindowsStorage);
        g_shortcutOverlayWindowsStorage = nullptr;
        return false;
    }

    const bool applied = Wh_ApplyHookOperations();
    g_shortcutOverlayHooksInstalled =
        applied && g_shortcutRendererDrawOrig &&
        g_shortcutRendererGetOverlayIndexOrig;
    if (!applied) {
        Wh_Log(L"Shortcut overlay: failed to apply Windows.Storage hooks");
    } else if (!g_shortcutOverlayHooksInstalled) {
        Wh_Log(L"Shortcut overlay: incomplete Windows.Storage symbols; "
               L"Jumbo replacement disabled");
    }
    return g_shortcutOverlayHooksInstalled;
}

static void ShortcutOverlayNotifyImageChanged()
{
    if (g_shortcutOverlayImageIndex < 0)
        return;
    SHChangeNotify(
        SHCNE_UPDATEIMAGE, SHCNF_DWORD | SHCNF_FLUSH, nullptr,
        reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>(
            static_cast<ULONG_PTR>(g_shortcutOverlayImageIndex)));
}

static void ShortcutOverlayReplaceSystemLists()
{
    if (g_shortcutOverlayBackupCount != 0 ||
        !ShortcutOverlayResolveIdentity()) {
        return;
    }

    for (int listKind = SHIL_LARGE; listKind <= SHIL_SYSSMALL; ++listKind) {
        IImageList* imageList = nullptr;
        HRESULT hr = SHGetImageList(
            listKind, kShortcutOverlayIidImageList,
            reinterpret_cast<void**>(&imageList));
        if (FAILED(hr) || !imageList)
            continue;

        int imageIndex = -1;
        int cx = 0;
        int cy = 0;
        HICON originalIcon = nullptr;
        hr = imageList->GetOverlayImage(g_shortcutOverlaySlot, &imageIndex);
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr))
            hr = imageList->GetIconSize(&cx, &cy);
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr))
            hr = imageList->GetIcon(
                imageIndex, ILD_TRANSPARENT, &originalIcon);

        HICON replacement = SUCCEEDED(hr)
            ? ShortcutOverlayCreateIcon(std::max(cx, cy)) : nullptr;
        if (replacement) {
            hr = ShortcutOverlayReplaceImageListIcon(
                imageList, imageIndex, replacement);
            DestroyIcon(replacement);
        } else if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) {
            hr = E_OUTOFMEMORY;
        }

        if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && originalIcon &&
            g_shortcutOverlayBackupCount <
                ARRAYSIZE(g_shortcutOverlayBackups)) {
            g_shortcutOverlayBackups[g_shortcutOverlayBackupCount++] = {
                listKind, imageIndex, originalIcon, imageList
            };
            imageList = nullptr;
        } else if (originalIcon) {
            DestroyIcon(originalIcon);
        }

        if (imageList)
            imageList->Release();
    }
}

static void ShortcutOverlayRestoreSystemLists()
{
    for (size_t i = g_shortcutOverlayBackupCount; i-- > 0;) {
        ShortcutOverlayBackup& backup = g_shortcutOverlayBackups[i];
        if (backup.imageList) {
            const HRESULT hr = ShortcutOverlayReplaceImageListIcon(
                backup.imageList, backup.imageIndex, backup.originalIcon);
            if (FAILED(hr)) {
                Wh_Log(L"Shortcut overlay: failed to restore image list "
                       L"kind=%d hr=0x%08X",
                       backup.listKind, static_cast<unsigned int>(hr));
            }
            backup.imageList->Release();
        }
        if (backup.originalIcon)
            DestroyIcon(backup.originalIcon);
        backup = {};
    }
    g_shortcutOverlayBackupCount = 0;
}

static bool ShortcutOverlaySameImageList(IImageList* first,
                                         IImageList* second)
{
    if (first == second)
        return true;
    if (!first || !second)
        return false;

    IUnknown* firstIdentity = nullptr;
    IUnknown* secondIdentity = nullptr;
    const HRESULT firstHr = first->QueryInterface(
        IID_IUnknown, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&firstIdentity));
    const HRESULT secondHr = second->QueryInterface(
        IID_IUnknown, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&secondIdentity));
    const bool same = SUCCEEDED(firstHr) && SUCCEEDED(secondHr) &&
                      firstIdentity == secondIdentity;
    if (firstIdentity)
        firstIdentity->Release();
    if (secondIdentity)
        secondIdentity->Release();
    return same;
}

static void ShortcutOverlayRefresh()
{
    if (!g_settings.ModernShortcutOverlay ||
        !g_shortcutOverlayActive.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return;
    }

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_shortcutOverlayStateLock);
    ShortcutOverlayClearCache();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < g_shortcutOverlayBackupCount; ++i) {
        ShortcutOverlayBackup& backup =
            g_shortcutOverlayBackups[i];
        IImageList* currentList = nullptr;
        HRESULT currentHr = SHGetImageList(
            backup.listKind, kShortcutOverlayIidImageList,
            reinterpret_cast<void**>(&currentList));
        int currentIndex = -1;
        if (SUCCEEDED(currentHr) && currentList) {
            currentHr = currentList->GetOverlayImage(
                g_shortcutOverlaySlot, &currentIndex);
        }

        if (SUCCEEDED(currentHr) && currentList &&
            !ShortcutOverlaySameImageList(backup.imageList, currentList)) {
            HICON currentOriginalIcon = nullptr;
            currentHr = currentList->GetIcon(
                currentIndex, ILD_TRANSPARENT, &currentOriginalIcon);
            if (FAILED(currentHr) || !currentOriginalIcon) {
                Wh_Log(L"Shortcut overlay: failed to capture replacement "
                       L"image list kind=%d hr=0x%08X",
                       backup.listKind,
                       static_cast<unsigned int>(currentHr));
                if (currentOriginalIcon)
                    DestroyIcon(currentOriginalIcon);
                currentList->Release();
                currentList = nullptr;
            } else {
                const HRESULT restoreHr =
                    ShortcutOverlayReplaceImageListIcon(
                        backup.imageList, backup.imageIndex,
                        backup.originalIcon);
                if (FAILED(restoreHr)) {
                    Wh_Log(L"Shortcut overlay: failed to restore superseded "
                           L"image list kind=%d hr=0x%08X",
                           backup.listKind,
                           static_cast<unsigned int>(restoreHr));
                }
                backup.imageList->Release();
                DestroyIcon(backup.originalIcon);
                backup.imageList = currentList;
                backup.imageIndex = currentIndex;
                backup.originalIcon = currentOriginalIcon;
                currentList = nullptr;
            }
        }
        if (currentList)
            currentList->Release();

        int cx = 0;
        int cy = 0;
        HRESULT hr = backup.imageList
            ? backup.imageList->GetIconSize(&cx, &cy) : E_POINTER;
        HICON replacement = SUCCEEDED(hr)
            ? ShortcutOverlayCreateIcon(std::max(cx, cy)) : nullptr;
        if (replacement) {
            hr = ShortcutOverlayReplaceImageListIcon(
                backup.imageList, backup.imageIndex, replacement);
            DestroyIcon(replacement);
        }
        if (FAILED(hr)) {
            Wh_Log(L"Shortcut overlay: failed to refresh image list "
                   L"kind=%d hr=0x%08X",
                   backup.listKind, static_cast<unsigned int>(hr));
        }
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shortcutOverlayStateLock);
    ShortcutOverlayNotifyImageChanged();
}

static void ShortcutOverlayScheduleRefresh()
{
    if (!g_settings.ModernShortcutOverlay ||
        !g_shortcutOverlayActive.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        g_msgWndUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return;
    }

    if (HWND hwnd = g_msgWnd.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        hwnd && IsWindow(hwnd)) {
        SetTimer(hwnd, kShortcutOverlayRefreshTimerId, 150, nullptr);
    }
}

static void ShortcutOverlayEnable()
{
    if (!g_settings.ModernShortcutOverlay ||
        g_shortcutOverlayActive.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return;
    }

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_shortcutOverlayStateLock);
    if (!g_shortcutOverlayActive.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) &&
        ShortcutOverlayResolveIdentity()) {
        // Jumbo composition is optional; the four replaceable system lists
        // remain useful on builds where these private symbols differ.
        // Jumbo is rendered by Windows.Storage only in the Explorer/desktop
        // host. File pickers use the standard Shell image lists below, so do
        // not load and hook this private implementation in every application.
        if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer())
            ShortcutOverlayEnsureRendererHooks();
        ShortcutOverlayReplaceSystemLists();
        g_shortcutOverlayActive.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shortcutOverlayStateLock);
    ShortcutOverlayNotifyImageChanged();
}

static BOOL CALLBACK ShortcutOverlayFindDefViewChild(HWND hwnd,
                                                     LPARAM lParam)
{
    bool* found = reinterpret_cast<bool*>(lParam);
    wchar_t className[32] = {};
    if (GetClassNameW(hwnd, className, ARRAYSIZE(className)) &&
        _wcsicmp(className, L"SHELLDLL_DefView") == 0) {
        *found = true;
        return FALSE;
    }
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK ShortcutOverlayFindDefViewTop(HWND hwnd, LPARAM lParam)
{
    DWORD processId = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &processId);
    if (processId != GetCurrentProcessId())
        return TRUE;

    bool* found = reinterpret_cast<bool*>(lParam);
    ShortcutOverlayFindDefViewChild(hwnd, lParam);
    if (!*found)
        EnumChildWindows(hwnd, ShortcutOverlayFindDefViewChild, lParam);
    return *found ? FALSE : TRUE;
}

static void ShortcutOverlayEnableForCurrentProcess()
{
    if (!g_settings.ModernShortcutOverlay ||
        g_shortcutOverlayActive.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return;
    }

    if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer()) {
        ShortcutOverlayEnable();
        return;
    }

    bool foundDefView = false;
    EnumWindows(ShortcutOverlayFindDefViewTop,
                reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&foundDefView));
    if (foundDefView)
        ShortcutOverlayEnable();
}

static void ShortcutOverlayRequestEnableForWindow(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd || !g_settings.ModernShortcutOverlay ||
        g_shortcutOverlayActive.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return;
    }

    HWND messageWindow = g_msgWnd.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (messageWindow && IsWindow(messageWindow)) {
        PostMessageW(messageWindow, kShortcutOverlayActivateMessage, 0, 0);
    }
}

static void ShortcutOverlayDisable()
{
    g_shortcutOverlayActive.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    if (HWND hwnd = g_msgWnd.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        hwnd && IsWindow(hwnd)) {
        KillTimer(hwnd, kShortcutOverlayRefreshTimerId);
    }
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_shortcutOverlayStateLock);
    const bool restoredSystemLists = g_shortcutOverlayBackupCount != 0;
    ShortcutOverlayRestoreSystemLists();
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shortcutOverlayStateLock);
    ShortcutOverlayClearCache();
    ShortcutOverlayNotifyImageChanged();
    if (restoredSystemLists && IsCurrentProcessExplorer()) {
        // Existing views can retain a copied overlay after the list entry is
        // restored. This infrequent flush is required only when disabling or
        // unloading the explicitly enabled feature. The notification is
        // session-wide, so Explorer sends the one flush for every process.
        SHChangeNotify(SHCNE_ASSOCCHANGED, SHCNF_IDLIST | SHCNF_FLUSH,
                       nullptr, nullptr);
    }
}

static void ShortcutOverlayUninit()
{
    ShortcutOverlayDisable();
    if (g_shortcutOverlayWindowsStorage) {
        FreeLibrary(g_shortcutOverlayWindowsStorage);
        g_shortcutOverlayWindowsStorage = nullptr;
    }
}

#undef SHORTCUT_RENDERER_CALL
#undef SHORTCUT_RENDERER_DRAW_CALL
// SHORTCUT_RENDERER_CALL_TEXT and SHORTCUT_RENDERER_DRAW_CALL_TEXT stay
// defined: the windhawk-mods symbol extractor expands SYMBOL_HOOK strings
// with the macros as they stand at the end of the file.

static bool ShellIconDrawPart(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt,
                              const ShellIconPart& part,
                              ID2D1SolidColorBrush* neutralBrush,
                              ID2D1SolidColorBrush* accentBrush)
{
    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush =
        (part.role == SHELL_ICON_ACCENT) ? accentBrush : neutralBrush;
    if (!brush)
        return false;

    if (part.kind == SHELL_ICON_ROUNDED_RECT) {
        D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT rr = D2D1::RoundedRect(
            D2D1::RectF(part.x, part.y, part.x + part.w, part.y + part.h),
            part.rx, part.ry);
        rt->FillRoundedRectangle(rr, brush);
        return true;
    }

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> geom;
    ID2D1PathGeometry* rawGeom = nullptr;
    if (!part.path || !SvgParsePathToGeometry(part.path, &rawGeom) || !rawGeom)
        return false;
    geom.Attach(rawGeom);

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1TransformedGeometry> transformed;
    ID2D1Geometry* drawGeom = geom.Get();
    if (part.rotate180) {
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F svgTransform =
            D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Rotation(-180.0f) *
            D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(part.tx, part.ty);
        if (FAILED(g_d2dFactory->CreateTransformedGeometry(
                geom.Get(), svgTransform, &transformed)) || !transformed)
            return false;
        drawGeom = transformed.Get();
    }

    rt->FillGeometry(drawGeom, brush);
    return true;
}

static HICON ShellIconCreateIcon(const ShellIconEntry& entry, int size,
                                 bool dark, COLORREF accent)
{
    if (HICON svgIcon = ShellIconCreateIconFromSvg(entry, size, dark, accent))
        return svgIcon;

    if (!entry.parts || entry.partCount == 0)
        return nullptr;

    if (!g_d2dFactory)
        return nullptr;
    size = std::clamp(size, 8, 256);

    HDC screenDC = GetDC(nullptr);
    HDC memDC = CreateCompatibleDC(screenDC);
    if (screenDC)
        ReleaseDC(nullptr, screenDC);
    if (!memDC)
        return nullptr;

    BITMAPINFO bi = {};
    bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(bi.bmiHeader);
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = size;
    bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -size;
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

    void* bits = nullptr;
    HBITMAP colorBmp = CreateDIBSection(memDC, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS,
        &bits, nullptr, 0);
    if (!colorBmp || !bits) {
        if (colorBmp) DeleteObject(colorBmp);
        DeleteDC(memDC);
        return nullptr;
    }

    HGDIOBJ oldBmp = SelectObject(memDC, colorBmp);
    ZeroMemory(bits, static_cast<SIZE_T>(size) * size * 4);

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    RECT rc = { 0, 0, size, size };
    ID2D1DCRenderTarget* rawRt = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(memDC, &rc, g_d2dFactory, &rawRt)) || !rawRt) {
        SelectObject(memDC, oldBmp);
        DeleteObject(colorBmp);
        DeleteDC(memDC);
        return nullptr;
    }
    rt.Attach(rawRt);

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> neutralBrush;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> accentBrush;
    if (FAILED(rt->CreateSolidColorBrush(ShellIconColorF(ShellIconNeutralColor(dark)), &neutralBrush)) ||
        FAILED(rt->CreateSolidColorBrush(ShellIconColorF(accent), &accentBrush))) {
        SelectObject(memDC, oldBmp);
        DeleteObject(colorBmp);
        DeleteDC(memDC);
        return nullptr;
    }

    const float targetW = static_cast<float>(size);
    const float targetH = static_cast<float>(size);
    const float scale = std::min(targetW / entry.viewW, targetH / entry.viewH);
    const float offX = (targetW - entry.viewW * scale) * 0.5f;
    const float offY = (targetH - entry.viewH * scale) * 0.5f;

    bool ok = true;
    rt->BeginDraw();
    rt->Clear(D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f));
    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY));
    for (UINT i = 0; i < entry.partCount; ++i) {
        if (!ShellIconDrawPart(rt.Get(), entry.parts[i],
                               neutralBrush.Get(), accentBrush.Get())) {
            ok = false;
            break;
        }
    }
    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
    HRESULT hr = rt->EndDraw();
    if (hr == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET)
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    if (FAILED(hr))
        ok = false;

    HICON icon = nullptr;
    if (ok) {
        DWORD maskStride = ((static_cast<DWORD>(size) + 15) / 16) * 2;
        std::vector<BYTE> maskBits(maskStride * static_cast<DWORD>(size), 0);
        HBITMAP maskBmp = CreateBitmap(size, size, 1, 1, maskBits.data());
        if (maskBmp) {
            ICONINFO ii = {};
            ii.fIcon = TRUE;
            ii.hbmColor = colorBmp;
            ii.hbmMask = maskBmp;
            icon = CreateIconIndirect(&ii);
            DeleteObject(maskBmp);
        }
    }

    SelectObject(memDC, oldBmp);
    DeleteObject(colorBmp);
    DeleteDC(memDC);
    return icon;
}

// Caller holds g_shellIconCacheLock exclusively.
static void ShellIconPurgePrivateEntriesLocked()
{
    for (auto it = g_shellIconCache.begin();
         it != g_shellIconCache.end();) {
        if (it->sharedPublished) {
            ++it;
            continue;
        }
        if (it->icon)
            DestroyIcon(it->icon);
        it = g_shellIconCache.erase(it);
    }
}

static HICON ShellIconGetForLoad(const ShellIconEntry& entry, int size,
                                 bool dark, COLORREF accent, bool shared)
{
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconCacheLock);
    for (ShellIconCacheEntry& cached : g_shellIconCache) {
        if (cached.id == entry.id && cached.size == size &&
            cached.dark == dark && cached.accent == accent) {
            HICON result = nullptr;
            if (shared) {
                cached.sharedPublished = true;
                result = cached.icon;
            } else {
                result = CopyIcon(cached.icon);
            }
            ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconCacheLock);
            return result;
        }
    }
    if (g_shellIconCache.size() >= kShellIconCacheMaxEntries)
        ShellIconPurgePrivateEntriesLocked();
    if (g_shellIconCache.size() >= kShellIconCacheMaxEntries) {
        // Every bounded slot is an LR_SHARED handle that must stay valid for
        // the process lifetime. Skip SVG rasterization and use the native icon.
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconCacheLock);
        return nullptr;
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconCacheLock);

    HICON icon = ShellIconCreateIcon(entry, size, dark, accent);
    if (!icon)
        return nullptr;

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconCacheLock);
    for (ShellIconCacheEntry& cached : g_shellIconCache) {
        if (cached.id == entry.id && cached.size == size &&
            cached.dark == dark && cached.accent == accent) {
            HICON result = nullptr;
            if (shared) {
                cached.sharedPublished = true;
                result = cached.icon;
            } else {
                result = CopyIcon(cached.icon);
            }
            ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconCacheLock);
            DestroyIcon(icon);
            return result;
        }
    }
    if (icon) {
        if (g_shellIconCache.size() >= kShellIconCacheMaxEntries)
            ShellIconPurgePrivateEntriesLocked();
        if (g_shellIconCache.size() >= kShellIconCacheMaxEntries) {
            // Another thread filled the final slot while this icon rasterized.
            ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconCacheLock);
            DestroyIcon(icon);
            return nullptr;
        }
        g_shellIconCache.push_back({ entry.id, size, dark, accent, icon, shared });
    }
    HICON result = shared ? icon : CopyIcon(icon);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconCacheLock);
    return result;
}

static void ShellIconClearCache()
{
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconCacheLock);
    ShellIconPurgePrivateEntriesLocked();
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconCacheLock);
}

static void ShellIconClearModuleCaches()
{
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconModuleCacheLock);
    g_shellIconModuleCache.clear();
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconModuleCacheLock);

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconCallerCacheLock);
    g_shellIconCallerCache.clear();
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconCallerCacheLock);
}

static double ColorIconGetCompensationScale(wchar_t glyphCh)
{
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_HOME[0])          return 1.10;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_ONEDRIVE[0])      return 0.97;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_DOWNLOADS[0])     return 0.98;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_DOCUMENTS[0])     return 1.10;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_PICTURES[0])      return 0.93;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_MUSIC[0])         return 0.98;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_VIDEOS[0])        return 1.09;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_PHONE[0])         return 1.10;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_NETWORK[0])       return 1.08;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_CDROM[0])         return 0.97;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_GOOGLEDRIVE[0])   return 0.97;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_SCREENSHOT[0])    return 0.98;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_PROGFILES[0])     return 1.09;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_FAVORITES[0] || glyphCh == GLYPH_FAVORITES_FILLED[0])
        return 1.09;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_LINKS[0])         return 1.03;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_LIBRARY[0])       return 1.03;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_USER[0] || glyphCh == GLYPH_USER_FILLED[0])
        return 1.09;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_CONTACTS[0])      return 1.09;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_SEARCH[0])        return 0.97;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_GAME[0])          return 0.97;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_CAMERA[0])        return 1.11;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_LINUX[0])         return 1.00;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_GALLERY[0])       return 0.93;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_RECYCLE[0])       return 0.97;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_RECYCLE_FULL[0])  return 0.97;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_THISPC[0])        return 0.97;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_FOLDER[0])        return 0.97;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_DRIVE[0])         return 0.97;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_CTRLPANEL[0])     return 0.97;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_ZIPARCHIVE[0])    return 0.97;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_FONT[0])          return 0.97;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_3DOBJECTS[0])     return 0.97;
    // Desktop is the remaining reference size (no compensation).
    return 1.00;
}

    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_DOCUMENTS[0])     return kColorSvgDocuments;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_PICTURES[0])      return kColorSvgPictures;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_MUSIC[0])         return kColorSvgMusic;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_VIDEOS[0])        return kColorSvgVideos;

    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_GOOGLEDRIVE[0])   return kColorSvgGoogleDrive;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_SCREENSHOT[0])    return kColorSvgScreenshot;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_PROGFILES[0])     return kColorSvgProgFiles;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_FAVORITES[0] || glyphCh == GLYPH_FAVORITES_FILLED[0])
        return kColorSvgFavorites; // fixed-palette art, no separate filled rendition needed
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_LINKS[0])         return kColorSvgLinks;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_LIBRARY[0])       return kColorSvgLibrary;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_USER[0] || glyphCh == GLYPH_USER_FILLED[0])
        return kColorSvgUser;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_CONTACTS[0])      return kColorSvgContacts;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_SEARCH[0])        return kColorSvgSearch;

    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_CAMERA[0])        return kColorSvgCamera;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_LINUX[0])         return kColorSvgLinux;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_GALLERY[0])       return kColorSvgGallery;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_RECYCLE[0])       return kColorSvgRecycleEmpty;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_RECYCLE_FULL[0])  return kColorSvgRecycleFull;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_THISPC[0])        return kColorSvgThisPC;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_FOLDER[0])        return kColorSvgFolder;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_DRIVE[0])         return kColorSvgDrive;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_CTRLPANEL[0])     return kColorSvgCtrlPanel;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_ZIPARCHIVE[0])    return kColorSvgZipArchive;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_FONT[0])          return kColorSvgFonts;
    if (glyphCh == GLYPH_3DOBJECTS[0])     return kColorSvgObjects3D;
