}

// Mirrors ShellIconCreateIconFromSvg's proven recipe (reusing the same
// g_shellIconSvg D3D11/D2D device and ShellIconCreateHiconFromPixels tail),
// minus the dark/accent recoloring step -- these color icons use their own
// fixed palette, unlike the shell-icon feature's per-theme recolored SVGs.
static HICON ColorIconRenderSvgToIcon(const char* svgText, int size)
{
    if (!svgText || !*svgText || !g_d2dFactory || size <= 0)
        return nullptr;

    FPUGuard fpu;
    const size_t svgLen = strlen(svgText);
    HGLOBAL svgMemory = GlobalAlloc(GMEM_MOVEABLE, svgLen);
    if (!svgMemory)
        return nullptr;
    void* svgBytes = GlobalLock(svgMemory);
    if (!svgBytes) {
        GlobalFree(svgMemory);
        return nullptr;
    }
    memcpy(svgBytes, svgText, svgLen);
    GlobalUnlock(svgMemory);

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IStream> svgStream;
    HRESULT hr = CreateStreamOnHGlobal(svgMemory, TRUE, &svgStream);
    if (FAILED(hr) || !svgStream) {
        GlobalFree(svgMemory);
        return nullptr;
    }

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconSvgLock);
    HICON icon = nullptr;
    do {
        if (!ShellIconEnsureSvgResourcesLocked())
            break;

        const int renderSize = std::clamp(size * 4, size, 256);

        D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC texDesc = {};
        texDesc.Width = static_cast<UINT>(renderSize);
        texDesc.Height = static_cast<UINT>(renderSize);
        texDesc.MipLevels = 1;
        texDesc.ArraySize = 1;
        texDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
        texDesc.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
        texDesc.Usage = D3D11_USAGE_DEFAULT;
        texDesc.BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_RENDER_TARGET | D3D11_BIND_SHADER_RESOURCE;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D> renderTexture;
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d3dDevice->CreateTexture2D(
            &texDesc, nullptr, &renderTexture);
        if (FAILED(hr) || !renderTexture)
            break;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDXGISurface> renderSurface;
        hr = renderTexture->QueryInterface(
            __uuidof(IDXGISurface),
            reinterpret_cast<void**>(renderSurface.GetAddressOf()));
        if (FAILED(hr) || !renderSurface)
            break;

        D2D1_BITMAP_PROPERTIES1 renderBitmapProps = D2D1::BitmapProperties1(
            D2D1_BITMAP_OPTIONS_TARGET,
            D2D1::PixelFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM,
                              D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED),
            96.f, 96.f);

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1Bitmap1> renderBitmap;
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->CreateBitmapFromDxgiSurface(
            renderSurface.Get(), &renderBitmapProps, &renderBitmap);
        if (FAILED(hr) || !renderBitmap)
            break;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SvgDocument> svgDocument;
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->CreateSvgDocument(
            svgStream.Get(), D2D1::SizeF(static_cast<float>(renderSize),
                                         static_cast<float>(renderSize)),
            &svgDocument);
        if (FAILED(hr) || !svgDocument)
            break;

        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->SetTarget(renderBitmap.Get());
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->SetAntialiasMode(D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_PER_PRIMITIVE);
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->SetPrimitiveBlend(D2D1_PRIMITIVE_BLEND_SOURCE_OVER);
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->BeginDraw();
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->Clear(D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f));
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->DrawSvgDocument(svgDocument.Get());
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->EndDraw();
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->SetTarget(nullptr);
        if (FAILED(hr))
            break;

        D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC finalDesc = texDesc;
        finalDesc.Width = static_cast<UINT>(size);
        finalDesc.Height = static_cast<UINT>(size);

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D> finalTexture;
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d3dDevice->CreateTexture2D(
            &finalDesc, nullptr, &finalTexture);
        if (FAILED(hr) || !finalTexture)
            break;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDXGISurface> finalSurface;
        hr = finalTexture->QueryInterface(
            __uuidof(IDXGISurface),
            reinterpret_cast<void**>(finalSurface.GetAddressOf()));
        if (FAILED(hr) || !finalSurface)
            break;

        D2D1_BITMAP_PROPERTIES1 finalBitmapProps = D2D1::BitmapProperties1(
            D2D1_BITMAP_OPTIONS_TARGET | D2D1_BITMAP_OPTIONS_CANNOT_DRAW,
            D2D1::PixelFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM,
                              D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED),
            96.f, 96.f);

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1Bitmap1> finalBitmap;
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->CreateBitmapFromDxgiSurface(
            finalSurface.Get(), &finalBitmapProps, &finalBitmap);
        if (FAILED(hr) || !finalBitmap)
            break;

        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->SetTarget(finalBitmap.Get());
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->BeginDraw();
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->Clear(D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f));
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->DrawBitmap(
            renderBitmap.Get(),
            D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f, static_cast<float>(size), static_cast<float>(size)),
            1.f,
            D2D1_INTERPOLATION_MODE_HIGH_QUALITY_CUBIC,
            D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f, static_cast<float>(renderSize), static_cast<float>(renderSize)));
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->EndDraw();
        g_shellIconSvg.d2dContext->SetTarget(nullptr);
        if (FAILED(hr))
            break;

        D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC stagingDesc = finalDesc;
        stagingDesc.Usage = D3D11_USAGE_STAGING;
        stagingDesc.BindFlags = 0;
        stagingDesc.CPUAccessFlags = D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_READ;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D> staging;
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d3dDevice->CreateTexture2D(
            &stagingDesc, nullptr, &staging);
        if (FAILED(hr) || !staging)
            break;

        g_shellIconSvg.d3dContext->CopyResource(staging.Get(), finalTexture.Get());

        D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE mapped = {};
        hr = g_shellIconSvg.d3dContext->Map(
            staging.Get(), 0, D3D11_MAP_READ, 0, &mapped);
        if (FAILED(hr))
            break;

        icon = ShellIconCreateHiconFromPixels(
            mapped.pData, mapped.RowPitch, size);
        g_shellIconSvg.d3dContext->Unmap(staging.Get(), 0);
    } while (false);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_shellIconSvgLock);

    return icon;
}

// Cache-owned HICONs keyed by (glyph identity, pixel size) -- a small,
// inherently bounded key space (~24 glyphs x a handful of realistic
// DPI-driven sizes), unlike the shell-icon cache's per-item-identity keying.
// Unlike the shell-icon caches (which hand icons to the shell and must
// defensively CopyIcon), the only consumer here is a local DrawIconEx call,
// which doesn't take ownership -- returning the raw cached HICON directly
// avoids a CopyIcon/DestroyIcon pair on every repaint.
struct ColorIconCacheEntry {
    wchar_t glyphCh;
    int size;
    HICON icon;
};
static SRWLOCK g_colorIconCacheLock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static constexpr size_t kColorIconCacheMaxEntries = 128;
static std::vector<ColorIconCacheEntry> g_colorIconCache;

static void ColorIconClearCacheLocked()
{
    for (ColorIconCacheEntry& cached : g_colorIconCache)
        if (cached.icon) DestroyIcon(cached.icon);
    g_colorIconCache.clear();
}

static void ColorIconClearCache()
{
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_colorIconCacheLock);
    ColorIconClearCacheLocked();
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_colorIconCacheLock);
}

// Returns a cache-owned HICON at size x size for glyphCh's color SVG, or
// nullptr if unmapped or rendering fails. Caller must NOT DestroyIcon it --
// it stays valid until eviction, ColorIconClearCache(), or mod unload.
static HICON ColorIconGetOrBuild(wchar_t glyphCh, int size)
{
    if (size <= 0)
        return nullptr;
    const char* svgText = ColorIconGetSvgForGlyph(glyphCh);
    if (!svgText)
        return nullptr;

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_colorIconCacheLock);
    for (ColorIconCacheEntry& cached : g_colorIconCache) {
        if (cached.glyphCh == glyphCh && cached.size == size) {
            HICON result = cached.icon;
            ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_colorIconCacheLock);
            return result;
        }
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_colorIconCacheLock);

    HICON icon = ColorIconRenderSvgToIcon(svgText, size);
    if (!icon)
        return nullptr;

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_colorIconCacheLock);
    for (ColorIconCacheEntry& cached : g_colorIconCache) {
        // Another thread may have built and cached the same entry while we
        // were rendering -- use its result and drop ours instead of
        // duplicating the cache entry.
        if (cached.glyphCh == glyphCh && cached.size == size) {
            HICON result = cached.icon;
            ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_colorIconCacheLock);
            DestroyIcon(icon);
            return result;
        }
    }
    if (g_colorIconCache.size() >= kColorIconCacheMaxEntries)
        ColorIconClearCacheLocked();
    g_colorIconCache.push_back({ glyphCh, size, icon });
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_colorIconCacheLock);
    return icon;
}

// ── Fluent pin icons outside the nav pane (imageres.dll #5100/#5101) ──────
// Windows' classic common-dialog "Pin to Quick access" toolbar button (and
// any other content-area surface reusing the same two icons) loads them via
// LoadImageW(hImageres, MAKEINTRESOURCE(5100 or 5101), IMAGE_ICON, ...),
// with shell32.dll itself as the caller -- confirmed against a live probe
// log. This reuses PinRenderGlyphCell (same glyph/colors/opacity as the
// nav-pane FluentPinIcon feature) to build a standalone HICON instead, so
// both surfaces render pixel-identical pins. Deliberately a separate cache
// from g_shellIconCache: that one is keyed to shell32.dll-sourced SVG/parts
// entries in kShellIcons, whereas this is font-glyph-based and sourced from
// imageres.dll specifically.
struct PinContentIconCacheEntry {
    UINT id;
    int size;
    bool dark;
    COLORREF accent;
    HICON icon;
    bool sharedPublished;
};
static SRWLOCK g_pinContentIconCacheLock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static constexpr size_t kPinContentIconCacheMaxEntries = 64;
static std::vector<PinContentIconCacheEntry> g_pinContentIconCache;

struct PinContentIconModuleCacheEntry {
    HMODULE module;
    bool isImageres;
};
static SRWLOCK g_pinContentIconModuleCacheLock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static constexpr size_t kPinContentIconModuleCacheMaxEntries = 32;
static std::vector<PinContentIconModuleCacheEntry> g_pinContentIconModuleCache;

// Caller holds g_pinContentIconCacheLock exclusively.
static void PinContentIconPurgePrivateEntriesLocked()
{
    for (auto it = g_pinContentIconCache.begin();
         it != g_pinContentIconCache.end();) {
        if (it->sharedPublished) {
            ++it;
            continue;
        }
        if (it->icon)
            DestroyIcon(it->icon);
        it = g_pinContentIconCache.erase(it);
    }
}

static void PinContentIconClearCache()
{
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_pinContentIconCacheLock);
    PinContentIconPurgePrivateEntriesLocked();
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_pinContentIconCacheLock);

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_pinContentIconModuleCacheLock);
    g_pinContentIconModuleCache.clear();
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_pinContentIconModuleCacheLock);
}

static bool PinContentIconIsImageresModuleUncached(HMODULE module)
{
    // imageres.dll is a pure-resource DLL, loaded via
    // LOAD_LIBRARY_AS_DATAFILE/LOAD_LIBRARY_AS_IMAGE_RESOURCE, which maps it
    // as a section rather than a real loaded module -- GetModuleHandleW and
    // GetModuleFileNameW-based lookups both fail to find it.
    // K32GetMappedFileNameW resolves the file behind any mapped address
    // regardless of how it was mapped, returning an NT device path (not a
    // drive letter), but the substring check below doesn't care about the
    // prefix.
    wchar_t path[MAX_PATH] = {};
    DWORD len = K32GetMappedFileNameW(GetCurrentProcess(), module, path, ARRAYSIZE(path));
    if (len == 0 || len >= ARRAYSIZE(path))
        return false;
    return ShellIconContainsI(path, L"\\imageres.dll");
}

static bool PinContentIconIsImageresModule(HMODULE module)
{
    if (!module)
        return false;

    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_pinContentIconModuleCacheLock);
    for (const PinContentIconModuleCacheEntry& cached : g_pinContentIconModuleCache) {
        if (cached.module == module) {
            bool isImageres = cached.isImageres;
            ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_pinContentIconModuleCacheLock);
            return isImageres;
        }
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_pinContentIconModuleCacheLock);

    const bool isImageres = PinContentIconIsImageresModuleUncached(module);

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_pinContentIconModuleCacheLock);
    bool exists = false;
    for (const PinContentIconModuleCacheEntry& cached : g_pinContentIconModuleCache) {
        if (cached.module == module) {
            exists = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!exists && g_pinContentIconModuleCache.size() < kPinContentIconModuleCacheMaxEntries)
        g_pinContentIconModuleCache.push_back({ module, isImageres });
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_pinContentIconModuleCacheLock);

    return isImageres;
}

// Builds a standalone HICON for the current Fluent pin glyph at the given
// size. filled mirrors g_settings.PinIconStyle, passed explicitly so this
// stays a pure function of its arguments like PinContentIconCreate's
// ShellIcon-side counterparts.
static HICON PinContentIconCreate(int size, bool filled)
{
    if (size <= 0) return nullptr;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> fontLock(g_pinFontMutex);
    const int fontSize = (size * 7) / 10;
    if (!g_pinFont || g_pinFontH != fontSize) {
        if (g_pinFont) DeleteObject(g_pinFont);
        g_pinFont = CreateIconFontWithFallback(fontSize, FW_NORMAL, ANTIALIASED_QUALITY);
        g_pinFontH = fontSize;
    }
    if (!g_pinFont) return nullptr;

    HDC hScreen = GetDC(nullptr);
    if (!hScreen) return nullptr;
    HDC hDC = CreateCompatibleDC(hScreen);
    if (!hDC) { ReleaseDC(nullptr, hScreen); return nullptr; }

    BITMAPINFO bmi = {};
    bmi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
    bmi.bmiHeader.biWidth = size;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -size;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

    void* bits = nullptr;
    HBITMAP hBmp = CreateDIBSection(hDC, &bmi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
    if (!hBmp) {
        DeleteDC(hDC);
        ReleaseDC(nullptr, hScreen);
        return nullptr;
    }
    HBITMAP hPrev = static_cast<HBITMAP>(SelectObject(hDC, hBmp));
    ZeroMemory(bits, static_cast<SIZE_T>(size) * size * 4);

    PinRenderGlyphCell(hDC, bits, size, size, size, filled);
    ConvertPremultipliedDibToStraightAlpha(bits, size, size);
    HBITMAP hMask = CreateAlphaZeroMaskBitmap(size, size, bits);

    SelectObject(hDC, hPrev);

    HICON icon = nullptr;
    if (hMask) {
        ICONINFO ii = {};
        ii.fIcon = TRUE;
        ii.hbmColor = hBmp;
        ii.hbmMask = hMask;
        icon = CreateIconIndirect(&ii);
        DeleteObject(hMask);
    }
    DeleteObject(hBmp);
    DeleteDC(hDC);
    ReleaseDC(nullptr, hScreen);
    return icon;
}

static HICON PinContentIconGetForLoad(UINT id, int size, bool dark,
                                      COLORREF accent, bool shared)
{
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_pinContentIconCacheLock);
    for (PinContentIconCacheEntry& cached : g_pinContentIconCache) {
        if (cached.id == id && cached.size == size &&
            cached.dark == dark && cached.accent == accent) {
            HICON result = nullptr;
            if (shared) {
                cached.sharedPublished = true;
                result = cached.icon;
            } else {
                result = CopyIcon(cached.icon);
            }
            ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_pinContentIconCacheLock);
            return result;
        }
    }
    if (g_pinContentIconCache.size() >= kPinContentIconCacheMaxEntries)
        PinContentIconPurgePrivateEntriesLocked();
    if (g_pinContentIconCache.size() >= kPinContentIconCacheMaxEntries) {
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_pinContentIconCacheLock);
        return nullptr;
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_pinContentIconCacheLock);

    const bool filled = g_settings.PinIconStyle == 1;
    HICON icon = PinContentIconCreate(size, filled);
    if (!icon)
        return nullptr;

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_pinContentIconCacheLock);
    for (PinContentIconCacheEntry& cached : g_pinContentIconCache) {
        if (cached.id == id && cached.size == size &&
            cached.dark == dark && cached.accent == accent) {
            HICON result = nullptr;
            if (shared) {
                cached.sharedPublished = true;
                result = cached.icon;
            } else {
                result = CopyIcon(cached.icon);
            }
            ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_pinContentIconCacheLock);
            DestroyIcon(icon);
            return result;
        }
    }
    if (g_pinContentIconCache.size() >= kPinContentIconCacheMaxEntries)
        PinContentIconPurgePrivateEntriesLocked();
    if (g_pinContentIconCache.size() >= kPinContentIconCacheMaxEntries) {
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_pinContentIconCacheLock);
        DestroyIcon(icon);
        return nullptr;
    }
    g_pinContentIconCache.push_back({ id, size, dark, accent, icon, shared });
    HICON result = shared ? icon : CopyIcon(icon);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_pinContentIconCacheLock);
    return result;
}

static bool PinContentIconShouldReplace(HINSTANCE hInst, LPCWSTR name,
                                        UINT type, int cx, int cy, UINT* outId)
{
    if (!g_settings.ExplorerSection || !g_settings.FluentPinIcon ||
        type != IMAGE_ICON || !name || !IS_INTRESOURCE(name))
        return false;

    const UINT id = LOWORD(reinterpret_cast<ULONG_PTR>(name));
    if (id != 5100 && id != 5101)
        return false;

    if (cx > 0 && cy > 0 && cx != cy)
        return false;
    const int requestedSize = cx > 0 ? cx : (cy > 0 ? cy : 20);
    if (requestedSize < 16 || requestedSize > 64)
        return false;

    if (!PinContentIconIsImageresModule(hInst))
        return false;

    *outId = id;
    return true;
}

static const ShellIconEntry* ShellIconShouldReplace(HINSTANCE hInst,
                                                    LPCWSTR name,
                                                    UINT type,
                                                    int cx,
                                                    int cy,
                                                    void* caller)
{
    if (!g_settings.ExplorerSection || !g_settings.ModernizeShellIcons ||
        type != IMAGE_ICON || !name || !IS_INTRESOURCE(name))
        return nullptr;

    const ShellIconEntry* entry = ShellIconFindEntry(
        LOWORD(reinterpret_cast<ULONG_PTR>(name)));
    if (!entry)
        return nullptr;

    if (cx > 0 && cy > 0 && cx != cy)
        return nullptr;
    const int requestedSize = cx > 0 ? cx : (cy > 0 ? cy : 20);
    if (requestedSize < 16 || requestedSize > 64)
        return nullptr;

    if (!ShellIconIsShell32Module(hInst))
        return nullptr;

    if (!ShellIconIsAllowedCaller(caller))
        return nullptr;

    return entry;
}

static HANDLE WINAPI LoadImageW_hook(HINSTANCE hInst, LPCWSTR name, UINT type,
                                     int cx, int cy, UINT fuLoad)
{
    void* caller = __builtin_return_address(0);
    if (const ShellIconEntry* entry =
            ShellIconShouldReplace(hInst, name, type, cx, cy, caller)) {
        const int size = std::clamp(cx > 0 ? cx : (cy > 0 ? cy : 20), 8, 256);
        const bool dark = IsSystemDarkMode();
        const COLORREF accent = GetAccentIndicator();
        if (HICON icon = ShellIconGetForLoad(
                *entry, size, dark, accent, (fuLoad & LR_SHARED) != 0))
            return icon;
    }
    UINT pinId = 0;
    if (PinContentIconShouldReplace(hInst, name, type, cx, cy, &pinId)) {
        const int size = std::clamp(cx > 0 ? cx : (cy > 0 ? cy : 20), 8, 256);
        const bool dark = IsSystemDarkMode();
        const COLORREF accent = GetAccentIndicator();
        if (HICON icon = PinContentIconGetForLoad(
                pinId, size, dark, accent, (fuLoad & LR_SHARED) != 0))
            return icon;
    }
    return LoadImageW_orig(hInst, name, type, cx, cy, fuLoad);
}

// ── winver "About Windows" logo overlay ──────────────────────────────────
// The banner is not exposed through a hookable GDI/resource path, so subclass
// the main dialog and draw after DefSubclassProc on every WM_PAINT. The stable
// Separator control (0x3327) gives a DPI-correct banner bottom edge.
static constexpr int kWinverSeparatorCtrlId = 0x3327;
// winver.exe and regedit's Help > About both show the same shell32 dialog
// (template #14352, reached through ShellAboutW), so the treatment keys off
// these three controls of that template instead of the host process. The
// host's own icon (12297) and license link (13586) come with it.
static constexpr int kShellAboutIconCtrlId = 12297;
static constexpr int kShellAboutLicenseLinkId = 13586;

static bool IsShellAboutDialog(HWND hDlg)
{
    if (!hDlg || !IsWindow(hDlg) || !IsClassName(hDlg, L"#32770"))
        return false;
    // The template lives in shell32, so the dialog manager stamps shell32's
    // module on the window. A host's own dialog -- however similar -- carries
    // the host's instance instead, which is what keeps this from matching a
    // lookalike; the control ids alone would only be a strong hint.
    if (reinterpret_cast<HMODULE>(GetWindowLongPtrW(hDlg, GWLP_HINSTANCE)) !=
        GetModuleHandleW(L"shell32.dll")) {
        return false;
    }
    HWND icon = GetDlgItem(hDlg, kShellAboutIconCtrlId);
    HWND link = GetDlgItem(hDlg, kShellAboutLicenseLinkId);
    return GetDlgItem(hDlg, kWinverSeparatorCtrlId) && icon && link &&
           IsClassName(icon, L"Static") && IsClassName(link, L"SysLink");
}

static bool WinverComputeBannerRect(HWND hDlg, RECT& outRect)
{
    HWND hSep = GetDlgItem(hDlg, kWinverSeparatorCtrlId);
    if (!hSep) return false;

    RECT sepRect{};
    if (!GetWindowRect(hSep, &sepRect)) return false;
    MapWindowPoints(HWND_DESKTOP, hDlg, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(&sepRect), 2);

    RECT clientRect{};
    GetClientRect(hDlg, &clientRect);

    // The band is exactly the client above the separator now. The overlay
    // used to bleed past it on three edges to make sure the native graphic
    // couldn't peek out around a slightly-too-small cover; the branding
    // bitmap is blanked at its source (WinverBlankBrandingBitmap), so there
    // is nothing left to hide and the logo can sit centered in the real band.
    outRect.left = 0;
    outRect.top = 0;
    outRect.right = clientRect.right;
    // No bleed on the bottom -- WinverPaintNow now paints directly (see its
    // comment) instead of going through a real WM_PAINT, so nothing ever
    // repaints the Separator control back on top of an overlap here anymore
    // the way DefSubclassProc used to on every animation-timer-triggered
    // WM_PAINT; overlapping it now would stay overlapped for good.
    outRect.bottom = (LONG)sepRect.top;
    return true;
}

// Background color for the plain GDI cover in WinverPaintNow's normal
// (non-Mica) mode -- WinverDrawBanner no longer draws a background geometry
// of its own, so this GDI fill IS the banner's actual background now, not
// just a placeholder ahead of a matching D2D redraw.
//
// A host that answers WM_CTLCOLORDLG with its own solid brush keeps it:
// winver.exe has none (the constants below are the dialog's real background
// there), but the same dialog in another process may be painted by someone
// else, and a banner in a different shade would read as a seam.
static COLORREF WinverBgColor(HWND hDlg, HDC hdc, bool dark)
{
    if (hDlg && hdc) {
        const COLORREF own = AppOwnedDialogColor(hDlg, hdc);
        if (own != CLR_INVALID)
            return own;
    }
    return dark ? Win32MainDark : GetDefaultLightSysColor(COLOR_BTNFACE);
}

// Draws just the logo, gradient-filled, fit to `rc` using the SOURCE SVG's
// own full-canvas viewBox dimensions (matching kSvgWinverBannerLogo's own
// coordinate space) rather than the logo geometry's own (smaller) bounding
// box -- fitting against its own bounds alone would blow the logo up to
// fill the whole target rect instead of reading at the size/position it
// was authored at relative to that viewBox. No separate background
// geometry/fill here: the caller (WinverPaintNow) already covers `rc`'s
// background pixels first, either with a flat GDI FillRect (normal mode)
// or the whole-dialog backdrop hole (opt-in, see WinverBackdropSetup).
static constexpr float kWinverViewBoxW = 1282.4272460938f;
static constexpr float kWinverViewBoxH = 204.4983520508f;
// Registered lazily in winver.exe only when its section and system animations
// are enabled. A registered message avoids fixed WM_APP+N collisions.
static std::atomic<UINT> g_winverStartLogoAnimMsg{0};
static constexpr UINT_PTR kWinverLogoAnimTimerId = 0x5A2;
static constexpr DWORD kWinverLogoAnimDurationMs = 520;
static constexpr float kWinverLogoAnimMinScale = 0.94f;
static constexpr UINT kWinverGradientAnimIntervalMs = 33;
static constexpr ULONGLONG kWinverGradientAnimDurationMs = 2800;
static constexpr float kWinverGradientAnimLightenAmount = 0.40f;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_winverLogoGeom;
static std::atomic<DWORD> g_winverLogoAnimStart{0};
static std::atomic<bool> g_winverLogoAnimating{false};
static std::atomic<bool> g_winverLogoAnimPending{false};
static std::atomic<ULONGLONG> g_winverGradientAnimStart{0};
static std::atomic<ULONGLONG> g_winverGradientAnimPausedMs{0};
static std::atomic<bool> g_winverGradientAnimating{false};
static std::atomic<bool> g_winverGradientHighContrast{false};
static std::atomic<UINT> g_winverAnimTimerInterval{0};
static std::atomic_bool g_winverUnloading{false};
// Registered message carrying a WinEvent to the About dialog's own thread
// (see WinverWinEventProc).
static std::atomic<UINT> g_winverDialogEventMsg{0};
static void WinverHandleDialogEvent(HWND hWnd, DWORD event, bool justSubclassed);
static void WinEventHooksRequestSync();

static void WinverEnsureStartLogoAnimMessage()
{
    if (g_winverStartLogoAnimMsg.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return;

    const UINT message =
        RegisterWindowMessageW(L"Win32UIModernizer.WinverStartLogoAnim");
    if (message) {
        g_winverStartLogoAnimMsg.store(message, std::memory_order_release);
    } else {
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to register winver logo-animation-start message");
    }
}

static float WinverLogoAnimProgress()
{
    if (!g_settings.WinverSection ||
        g_winverUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return 1.0f;
    }
    if (g_winverLogoAnimPending.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return 0.0f;
    if (!g_winverLogoAnimating.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return 1.0f;

    const DWORD elapsed = GetTickCount() -
        g_winverLogoAnimStart.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    const float t = std::min(1.0f,
        float(elapsed) / float(kWinverLogoAnimDurationMs));
    return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6.0f - 15.0f) + 10.0f);
}

static float WinverGradientAnimPhase()
{
    if (!g_settings.WinverSection ||
        g_winverUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !SysAnimationsEnabled() ||
        g_winverGradientHighContrast.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return -1.0f;
    }

    ULONGLONG elapsed =
        g_winverGradientAnimPausedMs.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (g_winverGradientAnimating.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        const ULONGLONG start =
            g_winverGradientAnimStart.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        if (start)
            elapsed = GetTickCount64() - start;
    }
    return static_cast<float>(std::fmod(
        static_cast<double>(elapsed) / kWinverGradientAnimDurationMs, 1.0));
}

// Half the top bleed the band used to carry above the client origin: the
// logo was tuned centered against that taller rect, so without it the fit
// lands this much lower.
static constexpr float kWinverLogoRiseDip = 12.f;

static void WinverDrawBanner(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, float animT = 1.0f,
    float gradientPhase = -1.0f, const bool* darkOverride = nullptr,
    UINT dpi = 0)
{
    if (!EnsureD2DFactory()) return;

    if (!g_winverLogoGeom) {
        ID2D1PathGeometry* rawLogo = nullptr;
        if (!SvgParsePathToGeometry(kSvgWinverBannerLogo, &rawLogo) || !rawLogo)
            return;
        g_winverLogoGeom.Attach(rawLogo);
    }

    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    {
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* rawRt = nullptr;
        RECT rcCopy = rc;
        if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcCopy, g_d2dFactory, &rawRt)) || !rawRt) return;
        rt.Attach(rawRt);
    }

    const float targetW = float(rc.right - rc.left);
    const float targetH = float(rc.bottom - rc.top);
    // Slightly larger than a strict uniform fit -- matches how the logo
    // read back when it was fit alongside the (now-removed) full-viewBox
    // background rectangle.
    constexpr float kExtraScale = 1.12f;
    const float baseScale = std::min(targetW / kWinverViewBoxW, targetH / kWinverViewBoxH) * kExtraScale;
    const float scale = baseScale * (kWinverLogoAnimMinScale +
        (1.0f - kWinverLogoAnimMinScale) * animT);
    const float offX = (targetW - kWinverViewBoxW * scale) / 2.0f;
    const float dpiScale = (float)(dpi ? dpi : DpiForPaintHdc(hdc)) /
                           (float)USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;
    const float offY = (targetH - kWinverViewBoxH * scale) / 2.0f -
                       kWinverLogoRiseDip * dpiScale;

    const bool dark = darkOverride ? *darkOverride : WinverIsDarkVisualMode();

    // Same accent-palette technique as the nav pill's accent gradient.
    // The static fallback remains lighter-top/darker-bottom; the animated
    // path rotates a highlight within that same lightness family.
    const COLORREF gradTop = GetAccentFromPalette(dark ? 0 : 16);
    const COLORREF gradBottom = GetAccentFromPalette(dark ? 8 : 24);
    const D2D1_COLOR_F fgTop = D2D1::ColorF(
        GetRValue(gradTop) / 255.f, GetGValue(gradTop) / 255.f, GetBValue(gradTop) / 255.f, animT);
    const D2D1_COLOR_F fgBottom = D2D1::ColorF(
        GetRValue(gradBottom) / 255.f, GetGValue(gradBottom) / 255.f, GetBValue(gradBottom) / 255.f, animT);

    rt->BeginDraw();
    // The thread-local render target is reused across D2D draw calls -- set
    // our own transform before the very first draw call,
    // since whatever transform the previous caller left set (e.g. a scaled
    // icon draw moments earlier) would otherwise apply here.
    // Small downward nudge -- the flag+wordmark reads slightly high within
    // the viewBox's own vertical centering. Proportional to the scaled
    // viewBox height rather than a flat pixel count, so it stays consistent
    // across DPI/dialog sizes instead of needing its own separate scaling.
    const float yNudge = kWinverViewBoxH * scale * 0.12f;
    const float kExtraDownPx = 2.0f * scale;
    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY + yNudge + kExtraDownPx));

    D2D1_RECT_F logoBB{};
    g_winverLogoGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &logoBB);
    // Extend the gradient line past the logo's own corners on both ends --
    // a line ending exactly at the shape's bounding box concentrates each
    // pure stop color right at those corners; stretching it out means the
    // shape only samples the gentler middle portion of the ramp, spreading
    // the light-to-dark transition more gradually across it.
    constexpr float kGradSpread = 0.4f;
    const float gradDX = (logoBB.right - logoBB.left) * kGradSpread;
    const float gradDY = (logoBB.bottom - logoBB.top) * kGradSpread;
    D2D1_POINT_2F gradStart = D2D1::Point2F(
        logoBB.left - gradDX, logoBB.top - gradDY);
    D2D1_POINT_2F gradEnd = D2D1::Point2F(
        logoBB.right + gradDX, logoBB.bottom + gradDY);
    D2D1_GRADIENT_STOP fgStops[4] = {
        { 0.f, fgTop },
        { 1.f, fgBottom },
    };
    UINT fgStopCount = 2;
    if (gradientPhase >= 0.0f) {
        // Same seamless rotating highlight field as the disk-usage chart.
        // A complete turn makes phase 0 and phase 1 identical, avoiding a
        // reset frame while keeping the original accent family underneath.
        constexpr float kTwoPi = 6.28318530718f;
        const float bbW = logoBB.right - logoBB.left;
        const float bbH = logoBB.bottom - logoBB.top;
        const float centerX = (logoBB.left + logoBB.right) * 0.5f;
        const float centerY = (logoBB.top + logoBB.bottom) * 0.5f;
        const float radius = std::hypot(bbW, bbH) * (0.5f + kGradSpread);
        const float baseAngle = std::atan2(bbH, bbW);
        const float angle = baseAngle + gradientPhase * kTwoPi;
        const float vx = std::cos(angle) * radius;
        const float vy = std::sin(angle) * radius;
        gradStart = D2D1::Point2F(centerX - vx, centerY - vy);
        gradEnd = D2D1::Point2F(centerX + vx, centerY + vy);

        const COLORREF gradHighlight = DiskPieLighten(
            gradTop, kWinverGradientAnimLightenAmount);
        const D2D1_COLOR_F fgHighlight = D2D1::ColorF(
            GetRValue(gradHighlight) / 255.f,
            GetGValue(gradHighlight) / 255.f,
            GetBValue(gradHighlight) / 255.f, animT);
        fgStops[0] = {0.0f, fgBottom};
        fgStops[1] = {0.18f, fgTop};
        fgStops[2] = {0.42f, fgHighlight};
        fgStops[3] = {1.0f, fgBottom};
        fgStopCount = ARRAYSIZE(fgStops);
    }
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GradientStopCollection> fgStopColl;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1LinearGradientBrush> fgGradBrush;
    ID2D1Brush* fgBrush = nullptr;
    if (SUCCEEDED(rt->CreateGradientStopCollection(
            fgStops, fgStopCount, &fgStopColl)) &&
        SUCCEEDED(rt->CreateLinearGradientBrush(
            D2D1::LinearGradientBrushProperties(gradStart, gradEnd),
            fgStopColl.Get(), &fgGradBrush))) {
        fgBrush = fgGradBrush.Get();
    }
    // Fallback flat brush if the gradient failed to create for any reason
    // (transient D2D resource hiccup) -- seen intermittently during the
    // animation, only ever affecting the logo (recreated with a new
    // gradient brush every single animation frame). Drawing flat for one
    // frame instead of not drawing at all means the logo never visibly
    // disappears/flickers even when this happens.
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> fgFallbackBrush;
    if (!fgBrush && SUCCEEDED(rt->CreateSolidColorBrush(fgTop, &fgFallbackBrush)))
        fgBrush = fgFallbackBrush.Get();

    if (fgBrush)
        rt->FillGeometry(g_winverLogoGeom.Get(), fgBrush);

    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());

    if (rt->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        rt.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
}

static bool WinverUsesBackdropHole()
{
    return g_settings.WinverBackground >= 1 && g_settings.WinverBackground <= 3;
}

static bool WinverIsDarkVisualMode()
{
    if (g_accentCacheDirty.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        RefreshAccentCache();
    return g_cachedIsDark.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

static int WinverBackdropType()
{
    switch (g_settings.WinverBackground) {
    case 1: return 2; // DWMSBT_MAINWINDOW (Mica)
    case 2: return 4; // DWMSBT_TABBEDWINDOW (Mica Alt)
    case 3: return 3; // DWMSBT_TRANSIENTWINDOW (Acrylic)
    default: return 0; // DWMSBT_AUTO / disabled fallback
    }
}

// Backdrop modes extend the frame across the ENTIRE client area (MARGINS of
// -1 on all four sides is the documented "sheet of glass" special case) so
// DWM's black-colorkey path treats pure black GDI content anywhere in the
// dialog as a hole showing the selected material. A cyTopHeight-only margin
// leaves material visible in only a thin strip near the Separator, since that
// margin value and the banner's actual rendered extent don't quite agree.
// WinverPaintNow / WM_CTLCOLORSTATIC below decide which pixels go black.
static void WinverBackdropSetup(HWND hDlg)
{
    const BOOL dark = WinverIsDarkVisualMode() ? TRUE : FALSE;
    DwmSetWindowAttribute(hDlg, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE, &dark, sizeof(dark));

    int backdrop = WinverBackdropType();
    if (!backdrop)
        return;
    DwmSetWindowAttribute(hDlg, DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE, &backdrop, sizeof(backdrop));

    MARGINS margins{-1, -1, -1, -1};
    DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea(hDlg, &margins);
}

static void WinverInstallTextSubclasses(HWND hDlg);
static void WinverRemoveTextSubclasses(HWND hDlg);

static void WinverBackdropReset(HWND hDlg)
{
    const BOOL dark = FALSE;
    const int backdrop = 0;
    const MARGINS margins{};
    DwmSetWindowAttribute(hDlg, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE, &dark, sizeof(dark));
    DwmSetWindowAttribute(hDlg, DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE,
        &backdrop, sizeof(backdrop));
    DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea(hDlg, &margins);
}

static void WinverApplyCurrentBackground(HWND hDlg)
{
    // Text subclasses stay installed either way now: WinverTextSubclassProc
    // needs to run in native mode too, for the SysLink hover/pressed pill
    // (it just passes everything else through unchanged there).
    WinverInstallTextSubclasses(hDlg);
    if (WinverUsesBackdropHole())
        WinverBackdropSetup(hDlg);
    else
        WinverBackdropReset(hDlg);
}

// Dialog-client Y position for the custom-drawn separator line below (0 =
// not resolved yet). The native Separator control's own SS_ETCHEDHORZ
// rendering can't be squeezed down to a clean single device-pixel line
// without artifacts (its bevel needs at least a couple of pixels to read as
// an edge at all), so WinverFixSeparator (below) hides it and this is
// drawn instead -- same 1px-line idea as the mod's general DrawEdge_hook
// (ModernSeparators), reusing its exact line color for consistency, just
// applied directly since winver's dialog isn't reachable through that
// hook's own control-class checks.
static int g_winverSeparatorY = 0;

// Draws the actual 1px separator line (see g_winverSeparatorY above), the
// same way the Explorer and file picker rules draw theirs.
//
// A backdrop mode extends the frame across the whole client, and in a
// DWM-extended region a plain GDI line lands with alpha 0 and gets ADDED to
// the material: #303030 reads as a faint lift in dark, and #E0E0E0 blows out
// to near-white in light. The rule there has to be written as premultiplied
// pixels so DWM composes it instead, exactly like the pane edge.
static void WinverDrawSeparatorLine(HDC hdc, HWND hWnd)
{
    if (g_winverSeparatorY <= 0) return;

    RECT clientRect{};
    GetClientRect(hWnd, &clientRect);
    if (clientRect.right <= 0) return;

    const RECT line{0, g_winverSeparatorY, clientRect.right,
                    g_winverSeparatorY + 1};
    const bool dark = WinverIsDarkVisualMode();

    // WinUI's DividerStrokeColorDefault: white at 15 % in dark, black at 6 %
    // in light. Taken from the token in both branches on purpose -- writing
    // the CardStroke convention (RGB 0 plus alpha) into the backdrop hole is
    // what made this line read almost black over dark Mica.
    const WinUI::Color stroke = WinUI::DividerStrokeColorDefault(dark);
    const DWORD a = stroke.alpha;
    const DWORD premultiplied =
        (a << 24) |
        ((GetRValue(stroke.rgb) * a / 255) << 16) |
        ((GetGValue(stroke.rgb) * a / 255) << 8) |
        (GetBValue(stroke.rgb) * a / 255);

    if (WinverUsesBackdropHole()) {
        // Written, not blended: in the extended region DWM composes the
        // alpha itself, and a GDI blend there would be added to the material.
        WriteExplorerMicaPixels(hdc, line, premultiplied);
        return;
    }
    BlendPremultipliedPixels(hdc, line, premultiplied);
}

// Fast GDI cover + the real D2D draw, in one shot. Called from WM_PAINT
// after DefSubclassProc.
static void WinverPaintNow(HWND hWnd)
{
    const float logoAnimT = WinverLogoAnimProgress();
    const float gradientPhase = WinverGradientAnimPhase();
    if (WinverUsesBackdropHole()) {
        // Whole client rect, not just the banner, clipped to the gaps
        // between child controls: the dialog has no WS_CLIPCHILDREN, and a
        // partial repaint only repaints the children it exposed. The
        // controls keep their own background (static text labels via
        // WM_CTLCOLORSTATIC in WinverDialogSubclassProc, buttons via
        // PaintPushButton's winverMicaCorner branch).
        RECT full{};
        GetClientRect(hWnd, &full);
        HDC hdcFull = GetDCEx(hWnd, nullptr, DCX_CACHE | DCX_CLIPCHILDREN);
        if (!hdcFull) return;
        if (HBRUSH br = CreateSolidBrush(RGB(0, 0, 0))) {
            FillRect(hdcFull, &full, br);
            DeleteObject(br);
        }
        RECT bannerRc;
        if (WinverComputeBannerRect(hWnd, bannerRc)) {
            WinverDrawBanner(hdcFull, bannerRc, logoAnimT, gradientPhase,
                             nullptr, GetDpiForWindow(hWnd));
        }
        WinverDrawSeparatorLine(hdcFull, hWnd);
        ReleaseDC(hWnd, hdcFull);
        return;
    }

    RECT rc;
    if (!WinverComputeBannerRect(hWnd, rc)) return;
    HDC hdc = GetDC(hWnd);
    if (!hdc) return;
    // D2D has real first-use latency (factory/render-target creation) --
    // on a slow first frame the real banner (which renders through some
    // other, already-warmed-up mechanism) can win the race and flash
    // briefly before our D2D draw finishes. A plain GDI FillRect has no
    // comparable startup cost, so cover the area with it immediately
    // first; the full D2D draw (gradient + logo) replaces it a moment
    // later, same color underneath either way.
    if (HBRUSH br = CreateSolidBrush(
            WinverBgColor(hWnd, hdc, WinverIsDarkVisualMode()))) {
        FillRect_orig(hdc, &rc, br);
        DeleteObject(br);
    }
    WinverDrawBanner(hdc, rc, logoAnimT, gradientPhase, nullptr,
                     GetDpiForWindow(hWnd));
    WinverDrawSeparatorLine(hdc, hWnd);
    ReleaseDC(hWnd, hdc);
}

static void WinverPaintBannerAnimFrame(HWND hWnd)
{
    RECT rc{};
    if (!WinverComputeBannerRect(hWnd, rc)) return;
    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(hWnd, &client);
    RECT visibleRc{};
    if (!IntersectRect(&visibleRc, &rc, &client)) return;

    HDC hdc = GetDC(hWnd);
    if (!hdc) return;

    const bool dark = WinverIsDarkVisualMode();
    const float logoAnimT = WinverLogoAnimProgress();
    const float gradientPhase = WinverGradientAnimPhase();
    const COLORREF bg = WinverUsesBackdropHole()
        ? RGB(0, 0, 0)
        : WinverBgColor(hWnd, hdc, dark);

    const int fullW = rc.right - rc.left;
    const int fullH = rc.bottom - rc.top;
    HDC memDC = fullW > 0 && fullH > 0 ? CreateCompatibleDC(hdc) : nullptr;
    HBITMAP memBmp = memDC ? CreateCompatibleBitmap(hdc, fullW, fullH) : nullptr;
    HGDIOBJ oldBmp = nullptr;
    if (memDC && memBmp)
        oldBmp = SelectObject(memDC, memBmp);

    if (memDC && oldBmp) {
        RECT localRc{0, 0, fullW, fullH};
        if (HBRUSH br = CreateSolidBrush(bg)) {
            FillRect_orig(memDC, &localRc, br);
            DeleteObject(br);
        }

        WinverDrawBanner(memDC, localRc, logoAnimT, gradientPhase, &dark,
                         GetDpiForWindow(hWnd));

        const int sepY = g_winverSeparatorY - rc.top;
        if (sepY >= 0 && sepY < fullH) {
            const COLORREF lineClr = dark ? RGB(48, 48, 48) : RGB(224, 224, 224);
            HPEN hPen = CreatePen(PS_SOLID, 1, lineClr);
            if (hPen) {
                HPEN oldPen = (HPEN)SelectObject(memDC, hPen);
                MoveToEx(memDC, 0, sepY, nullptr);
                LineTo(memDC, fullW, sepY);
                SelectObject(memDC, oldPen);
                DeleteObject(hPen);
            }
        }

        BitBlt(hdc, visibleRc.left, visibleRc.top,
            visibleRc.right - visibleRc.left, visibleRc.bottom - visibleRc.top,
            memDC, visibleRc.left - rc.left, visibleRc.top - rc.top, SRCCOPY);
    } else {
        if (HBRUSH br = CreateSolidBrush(bg)) {
            FillRect_orig(hdc, &rc, br);
            DeleteObject(br);
        }
        WinverDrawBanner(hdc, rc, logoAnimT, gradientPhase, &dark,
                         GetDpiForWindow(hWnd));
        WinverDrawSeparatorLine(hdc, hWnd);
    }

    if (oldBmp)
        SelectObject(memDC, oldBmp);
    if (memBmp)
        DeleteObject(memBmp);
    if (memDC)
        DeleteDC(memDC);
    ReleaseDC(hWnd, hdc);
}

// "Open Settings" button -- links to the modern Settings app's own About
// page (ms-settings:about), next to winver's classic OK button. IDOK (1) is
// a standard dialog control ID, not something reverse-engineered like the
// Separator ID -- works on any standard dialog.
static constexpr int kWinverSettingsBtnId = 0xDA53;
static HWND g_winverSettingsBtn = nullptr;
static HWND g_winverLayoutDlg = nullptr;
static HWND g_winverSubclassedDlg = nullptr;

// Processes whose About dialog the mod takes over. winver.exe is one of
// them; the Registry Editor's Help > About opens the same shell32 dialog
// through ShellAboutW, so it gets the same treatment from the same setting.
static bool WinverHostProcess()
{
    return IsCurrentProcessWinver() || IsCurrentProcessRegedit() ||
           IsCurrentProcessMMC();
}

// shell32 creates this dialog per-monitor aware even inside a process that
// isn't (MMC is DPI-unaware), and in that mixed state every coordinate API
// answers in the space of the CALLING thread: measured in MMC at 120 dpi,
// the dialog's own WM_PAINT read a 573x482 client while the WinEvent
// callback -- which runs in the process default -- read 458x385, the same
// rect virtualized by 1.25. Laying the dialog out from there produced a
// button scaled up by that factor and anchored off the wrong edge. Anything
// touching the dialog from outside its own messages adopts its context.
struct WinverDpiScope {
    DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT previous = nullptr;

    explicit WinverDpiScope(HWND hwnd)
    {
        if (!hwnd || !IsWindow(hwnd))
            return;
        if (DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT context = GetWindowDpiAwarenessContext(hwnd))
            previous = SetThreadDpiAwarenessContext(context);
    }

    ~WinverDpiScope()
    {
        if (previous)
            SetThreadDpiAwarenessContext(previous);
    }

    WinverDpiScope(const WinverDpiScope&) = delete;
    WinverDpiScope& operator=(const WinverDpiScope&) = delete;
};

// The Windows logo the dialog paints in the banner band: winbrand resolves
// it internally (basebrd carries no RT_BITMAP), so BrandingLoadImage is the
// only place it can be reached.
static constexpr UINT kBrandingWindowsLogoId = 121;

// shell32 draws that bitmap with GdiTransparentBlt keyed on white, measured
// on this dialog: colorKey=FFFFFF, 1:1, over a #F0F0F0 field. An all-white
// bitmap therefore paints nothing at all, which leaves the band to the logo
// this mod animates -- no native graphic to cover, and no first-frame race
// with it. The caller keeps owning the bitmap; only its pixels change, and
// each dialog loads its own.
static void WinverBlankBrandingBitmap(HBITMAP bitmap)
{
    BITMAP info = {};
    if (GetObjectW(bitmap, sizeof(info), &info) != sizeof(info) ||
        info.bmWidth <= 0 || info.bmHeight <= 0) {
        return;
    }

    HDC dc = CreateCompatibleDC(nullptr);
    if (!dc)
        return;

    BITMAPINFO bmi = {};
    bmi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
    bmi.bmiHeader.biWidth = info.bmWidth;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biHeight = info.bmHeight;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

    const size_t pixels = (size_t)info.bmWidth * (size_t)info.bmHeight;
    std::vector<DWORD> white(pixels, 0x00FFFFFF);
    SetDIBits(dc, bitmap, 0, (UINT)info.bmHeight, white.data(), &bmi,
              DIB_RGB_COLORS);
    DeleteDC(dc);
}

// The Alt+F4 "Shut Down Windows" dialog (ShutdownUX.dll) hands this same
// Basebrd #121 bitmap to an SS_BITMAP static, which blits it opaquely --
// the asset's own #F0F0F0 field is why that band stays light in dark mode.
// Redrawing the DIB in place keeps the caller's ownership and size, and
// makes the band's background ours along with the logo.
static void WinverBakeBrandingBitmap(HBITMAP bitmap)
{
    BITMAP info = {};
    if (GetObjectW(bitmap, sizeof(info), &info) != sizeof(info) ||
        info.bmWidth <= 0 || info.bmHeight <= 0) {
        return;
    }

    HDC dc = CreateCompatibleDC(nullptr);
    if (!dc)
        return;
    HGDIOBJ prevBitmap = SelectObject(dc, bitmap);

    const bool dark = g_darkModeActive.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    const RECT rc{ 0, 0, info.bmWidth, info.bmHeight };
    if (HBRUSH bg = CreateSolidBrush(
            dark ? Win32MainDark : GetDefaultLightSysColor(COLOR_BTNFACE))) {
        FillRect(dc, &rc, bg);
        DeleteObject(bg);
    }
    // The asset is authored at 96 dpi and the static never scales it, so
    // the logo is laid out in that same space whatever the dialog's DPI.
    WinverDrawBanner(dc, rc, 1.0f, -1.0f, &dark, USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI);

    // WinUI's DividerStrokeColorDefault along the band's bottom row: this
    // dialog has no Separator control of its own the way the About one
    // does. One pixel and no DPI scaling -- the bitmap's own coordinate
    // space is fixed at 96 dpi, and the static never stretches it.
    const RECT rule{ 0, info.bmHeight - 1, info.bmWidth, info.bmHeight };
    BlendPremultipliedPixels(dc, rule, dark ? 0x15151515u : 0x0F000000u);

    SelectObject(dc, prevBitmap);
    DeleteDC(dc);

    // GDI and D2D both leave the alpha channel at zero here. The static
    // ignores it, but anything that did honor it would draw nothing.
    if (info.bmBitsPixel == 32 && info.bmBits) {
        GdiFlush();
        BYTE* row = static_cast<BYTE*>(info.bmBits);
        for (LONG y = 0; y < info.bmHeight; ++y, row += info.bmWidthBytes) {
            for (LONG x = 0; x < info.bmWidth; ++x)
                row[x * 4 + 3] = 0xFF;
        }
    }
}

using BrandingLoadImage_t = HANDLE(WINAPI*)(LPCWSTR, UINT, UINT, INT, INT, UINT);
static BrandingLoadImage_t BrandingLoadImage_orig = nullptr;

static HANDLE WINAPI BrandingLoadImage_hook(LPCWSTR brand, UINT id, UINT type,
                                            INT cx, INT cy, UINT flags)
{
    HANDLE image = BrandingLoadImage_orig(brand, id, type, cx, cy, flags);
    if (!image || type != IMAGE_BITMAP || !brand ||
        id != kBrandingWindowsLogoId || _wcsicmp(brand, L"Basebrd") != 0 ||
        g_winverUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return image;
    }
    // Explorer's only caller is the Alt+F4 dialog, which gets no overlay
    // of its own -- the replacement logo is baked into the bitmap instead.
    if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer()) {
        if (g_settings.ExplorerSection && g_settings.ModernizeShellIcons)
            WinverBakeBrandingBitmap((HBITMAP)image);
    } else if (g_settings.WinverSection) {
        WinverBlankBrandingBitmap((HBITMAP)image);
    }
    return image;
}

// The hook stays out of every process with no surface for it: the hosts
// whose About dialog this mod paints, plus Explorer, whose Alt+F4 dialog
// asks winbrand for the very same bitmap.
// Keeps winbrand loaded while its export is hooked; released at unload,
// after Windhawk has removed the hooks.
static HMODULE g_winbrandModule = nullptr;

static void WinverHookBranding()
{
    if (g_winbrandModule)
        return;
    HMODULE winbrand = LoadLibraryExW(L"winbrand.dll", nullptr,
                                      LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32);
    if (!winbrand) {
        Wh_Log(L"winbrand.dll not available; About logo stays native");
        return;
    }
    auto proc = (BrandingLoadImage_t)GetProcAddress(winbrand,
                                                    "BrandingLoadImage");
    if (!proc || !WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(proc, BrandingLoadImage_hook,
                                                 &BrandingLoadImage_orig)) {
        if (!proc)
            Wh_Log(L"winbrand.dll has no BrandingLoadImage export");
        FreeLibrary(winbrand);
        return;
    }
    g_winbrandModule = winbrand;
}

// Paint policies that used to ask for winver.exe ask for the dialog now,

{
    return g_winverSubclassedDlg && IsWindow(g_winverSubclassedDlg);
