static RECT g_winverOriginalOkRect{};
static bool g_winverOriginalOkRectValid = false;
static bool g_winverSeparatorWasVisible = true;
static constexpr wchar_t kPropWinverTextSubclass[] =
    L"_WhWin32UiModernizerWinverText";
// SysLink hover/pressed pill (WinUI HyperlinkButton style): tracking-armed
// flag + 1-based pressed link index (0 = none). Hover itself lives in
// ExplorerSysLinkFadeState (shared with Explorer's own SysLink pill).
static constexpr wchar_t kPropWinverLinkTracking[] =
    L"_WhWin32UiModernizerWinverLinkTrack";
static constexpr wchar_t kPropWinverLinkPressIx[] =
    L"_WhWin32UiModernizerWinverLinkPress";

enum WinverTextControlKind : ULONG_PTR {
    WinverTextControlNone = 0,
    WinverTextControlStatic = 1,
    WinverTextControlSysLink = 2,
};

static std::wstring WinverSettingsBtnLabel()
{
    // Resource-only mappings preserve Windows' MUI lookup without running
    // the Settings handler's code or retaining a DLL reference.
    const auto loadLabel = [](LPCWSTR name, UINT id) -> std::wstring {
        HMODULE module = LoadLibraryExW(
            name, nullptr, LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32 |
                LOAD_LIBRARY_AS_DATAFILE | LOAD_LIBRARY_AS_IMAGE_RESOURCE);
        if (!module)
            return {};
        wchar_t text[512] = {};
        const int length = LoadStringW(module, id, text, ARRAYSIZE(text));
        FreeLibrary(module);
        if (length <= 0 || length >= static_cast<int>(ARRAYSIZE(text)) - 1)
            return {};
        return std::wstring(text, length);
    };

    if (auto label = loadLabel(L"AboutSettingsHandlers.dll", 1073);
        !label.empty()) {
        return label;
    }
    if (auto label = loadLabel(L"shell32.dll", 8770); !label.empty())
        return label;
    return L"System";
}

static WinverTextControlKind WinverGetTextControlKind(HWND hwnd)
{
    wchar_t cls[16] = {};
    if (!GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, ARRAYSIZE(cls)) ||
        GetWindowTextLengthW(hwnd) <= 0)
        return WinverTextControlNone;

    if (_wcsicmp(cls, L"SysLink") == 0)
        return WinverTextControlSysLink;
    if (_wcsicmp(cls, WC_STATICW) != 0)
        return WinverTextControlNone;

    const DWORD type = (DWORD)GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE) & SS_TYPEMASK;
    switch (type) {
    case SS_BLACKRECT:
    case SS_GRAYRECT:
    case SS_WHITERECT:
    case SS_BLACKFRAME:
    case SS_GRAYFRAME:
    case SS_WHITEFRAME:
    case SS_ICON:
    case SS_OWNERDRAW:
    case SS_BITMAP:
    case SS_ENHMETAFILE:
    case SS_ETCHEDHORZ:
    case SS_ETCHEDVERT:
    case SS_ETCHEDFRAME:
        return WinverTextControlNone;
    default:
        return WinverTextControlStatic;
    }
}

static UINT WinverStaticTextGdiFlags(DWORD style)
{
    UINT flags = DT_EXPANDTABS;
    switch (style & SS_TYPEMASK) {
    case SS_CENTER:
        flags |= DT_CENTER | DT_WORDBREAK;
        break;
    case SS_RIGHT:
        flags |= DT_RIGHT | DT_WORDBREAK;
        break;
    case SS_SIMPLE:
    case SS_LEFTNOWORDWRAP:
        flags |= DT_LEFT | DT_SINGLELINE;
        break;
    default:
        flags |= DT_LEFT | DT_WORDBREAK;
        break;
    }
    if (style & SS_CENTERIMAGE)
        flags = (flags & ~DT_WORDBREAK) | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_VCENTER;
    if (style & SS_NOPREFIX)
        flags |= DT_NOPREFIX;
    if (style & SS_ENDELLIPSIS)
        flags |= DT_END_ELLIPSIS;
    else if (style & SS_PATHELLIPSIS)
        flags |= DT_PATH_ELLIPSIS;
    else if (style & SS_WORDELLIPSIS)
        flags |= DT_WORD_ELLIPSIS;
    return flags;
}

static void WinverPaintTextControl(HWND hwnd, HDC hdc,
    WinverTextControlKind kind)
{
    RECT rc{};
    GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc);
    // Black marks a DWM color-key hole in backdrop modes; in the
    // plain solid mode it's just the real dialog background (same pattern
    // as WinverPaintBannerAnimFrame's own bg color pick).
    const COLORREF bg = WinverUsesBackdropHole()
        ? RGB(0, 0, 0)
        : WinverBgColor(GetAncestor(hwnd, GA_ROOT), hdc,
                        WinverIsDarkVisualMode());
    if (HBRUSH br = CreateSolidBrush(bg)) {
        FillRect(hdc, &rc, br);
        DeleteObject(br);
    }

    const int textLength = GetWindowTextLengthW(hwnd);
    if (textLength <= 0)
        return;
    std::wstring rawText((size_t)textLength + 1, L'\0');
    const int copied = GetWindowTextW(hwnd, rawText.data(), textLength + 1);
    if (copied <= 0)
        return;
    rawText.resize((size_t)copied);

    const bool isSysLink = kind == WinverTextControlSysLink;
    WinverParsedLinkText parsedLink;
    if (isSysLink)
        parsedLink = WinverParseSysLinkText(rawText);
    const std::wstring& text = isSysLink ? parsedLink.text : rawText;
    if (text.empty())
        return;

    HFONT font = (HFONT)SendMessageW(hwnd, WM_GETFONT, 0, 0);
    HGDIOBJ oldFont = font ? SelectObject(hdc, font) : nullptr;
    const DWORD style = (DWORD)GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE);
    DWORD formatStyle = style;
    if (isSysLink)
        formatStyle = (style & LWS_RIGHT) ? SS_RIGHT : SS_LEFT;
    auto format = WinverEnsureStaticTextFormat(hdc, formatStyle);
    bool drawn = false;

    if (format && EnsureD2DFactory()) {
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
        FPUGuard fpu;
        if (SUCCEEDED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rc, g_d2dFactory, &rt))) {
            const bool dark = WinverIsDarkVisualMode();
            const D2D1_COLOR_F textColor = dark
                ? D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f)
                : D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 1.f);
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> brush;
            if (SUCCEEDED(rt->CreateSolidColorBrush(textColor, &brush)) && brush) {
                bool ready = true;
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDWriteTextLayout> layout;
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> linkBrush;
                if (isSysLink) {
                    if (g_accentCacheDirty.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
                        RefreshAccentCache();
                    COLORREF linkColor = IsWindowEnabled(hwnd)
                        ? GetAccentFromPalette(dark ? 0 : 16)
                        : (dark ? RGB(125, 125, 125) : RGB(128, 128, 128));
                    auto factory = WinverGetDWriteFactory();
                    ready = factory &&
                        SUCCEEDED(factory->CreateTextLayout(text.c_str(),
                            (UINT32)text.size(), format.Get(),
                            (float)rc.right, (float)rc.bottom, &layout)) && layout &&
                        SUCCEEDED(rt->CreateSolidColorBrush(D2D1::ColorF(
                            GetRValue(linkColor) / 255.f,
                            GetGValue(linkColor) / 255.f,
                            GetBValue(linkColor) / 255.f, 1.f), &linkBrush)) && linkBrush;
                    if (ready) {
                        for (const auto& range : parsedLink.linkRanges) {
                            if (FAILED(layout->SetUnderline(TRUE, range)) ||
                                FAILED(layout->SetDrawingEffect(linkBrush.Get(), range))) {
                                ready = false;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (ready) {
                    rt->BeginDraw();
                    rt->SetTextAntialiasMode(D2D1_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_MODE_GRAYSCALE);
                    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
                    if (isSysLink) {
                        const int pressIx = (int)(INT_PTR)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropWinverLinkPressIx) - 1;
                        ExplorerSysLinkFadeState* fadeState = ExplorerSysLinkFadeGetState(hwnd);
                        const int hoverIx = fadeState ? fadeState->hotLinkIx : -1;
                        const int activeIx = pressIx >= 0 ? pressIx : hoverIx;
                        const float progress = fadeState
                            ? ExplorerSysLinkFadeProgress(*fadeState, TimerGetSeconds()) : 1.f;
                        if (activeIx >= 0 && (size_t)activeIx < parsedLink.linkRanges.size()) {
                            // Reuses the Explorer SysLink hover fade machinery
                            // as-is -- generic per-window fade timing/curve,
                            // nothing Explorer-specific inside it.
                            WinverFillSysLinkRange(rt.Get(), layout.Get(),
                                parsedLink.linkRanges[(size_t)activeIx], dark,
                                pressIx >= 0, DpiForPaintHdc(hdc), progress);
                        }
                        rt->DrawTextLayout(D2D1::Point2F(0.f, 0.f), layout.Get(),
                            brush.Get(), D2D1_DRAW_TEXT_OPTIONS_CLIP);
                    } else {
                        rt->DrawTextW(text.c_str(), (UINT32)text.size(), format.Get(),
                            D2D1::RectF(0.f, 0.f, (float)rc.right, (float)rc.bottom),
                            brush.Get(), D2D1_DRAW_TEXT_OPTIONS_CLIP);
                    }
                    const HRESULT hr = rt->EndDraw();
                    drawn = SUCCEEDED(hr);
                    if (hr == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET)
                        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (!drawn) {
        const int oldBkMode = SetBkMode(hdc, TRANSPARENT);
        const bool dark = WinverIsDarkVisualMode();
        COLORREF fallbackColor = dark ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(1, 1, 1);
        if (isSysLink) {
            if (g_accentCacheDirty.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
                RefreshAccentCache();
            fallbackColor = IsWindowEnabled(hwnd)
                ? GetAccentFromPalette(dark ? 0 : 16)
                : (dark ? RGB(125, 125, 125) : RGB(128, 128, 128));
        }
        const COLORREF oldTextColor = SetTextColor(hdc, fallbackColor);

        HFONT underlineFont = nullptr;
        HGDIOBJ oldUnderlineFont = nullptr;
        if (isSysLink) {
            LOGFONTW lf{};
            HFONT selectedFont = (HFONT)GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT);
            if (selectedFont && GetObjectW(selectedFont, sizeof(lf), &lf)) {
                lf.lfUnderline = TRUE;
                underlineFont = CreateFontIndirectW(&lf);
                if (underlineFont)
                    oldUnderlineFont = SelectObject(hdc, underlineFont);
            }
        }

        RECT textRect = rc;
        const UINT flags = isSysLink
            ? ((style & LWS_RIGHT) ? DT_RIGHT : DT_LEFT) |
                DT_WORDBREAK | DT_NOPREFIX
            : WinverStaticTextGdiFlags(style);
        if (DrawTextW_orig)
            DrawTextW_orig(hdc, text.c_str(), (int)text.size(), &textRect, flags);
        else
            DrawTextW(hdc, text.c_str(), (int)text.size(), &textRect, flags);

        if (oldUnderlineFont)
            SelectObject(hdc, oldUnderlineFont);
        if (underlineFont)
            DeleteObject(underlineFont);
        SetTextColor(hdc, oldTextColor);
        SetBkMode(hdc, oldBkMode);
    }

    if (oldFont)
        SelectObject(hdc, oldFont);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK WinverTextSubclassProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg,
    WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp, DWORD_PTR)
{
    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropWinverTextSubclass);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropWinverLinkTracking);
        RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropWinverLinkPressIx);
        ExplorerSysLinkFadeDestroyState(hwnd);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hwnd, WinverTextSubclassProc);
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
    }

    const auto kind = (WinverTextControlKind)(ULONG_PTR)
        GetPropW(hwnd, kPropWinverTextSubclass);
    const bool isSysLink = kind == WinverTextControlSysLink;

    // Pressed is captured so WM_LBUTTONUP still reaches us even if the
    // cursor drifts off the (small) link between down and up; a drag off
    // the pressed link itself cancels press early, matching a real button.
    // Hover fade reuses the Explorer SysLink fade machinery as-is (see its
    // own banner) -- generic per-window state, nothing Explorer-specific.
    if (isSysLink) {
        switch (msg) {
        case WM_MOUSEMOVE: {
            if (!GetPropW(hwnd, kPropWinverLinkTracking)) {
                SetPropW(hwnd, kPropWinverLinkTracking, (HANDLE)1);
                TRACKMOUSEEVENT tme = { sizeof(tme), TME_LEAVE, hwnd, HOVER_DEFAULT };
                TrackMouseEvent(&tme);
            }
            LHITTESTINFO hti = {};
            hti.pt.x = (short)LOWORD(lp);
            hti.pt.y = (short)HIWORD(lp);
            const int newIx = SendMessageW(hwnd, LM_HITTEST, 0, (LPARAM)&hti)
                ? hti.item.iLink : -1;

            const int pressIx = (int)(INT_PTR)GetPropW(hwnd, kPropWinverLinkPressIx) - 1;
            ExplorerSysLinkFadeRetarget(hwnd, newIx, pressIx >= 0 && pressIx == newIx);

            if (pressIx >= 0 && pressIx != newIx && RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropWinverLinkPressIx))
                InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
            break;
        }
        case WM_MOUSELEAVE:
            RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropWinverLinkTracking);
            ExplorerSysLinkFadeRetarget(hwnd, -1, false);
            break;
        case WM_LBUTTONDOWN: {
            LHITTESTINFO hti = {};
            hti.pt.x = (short)LOWORD(lp);
            hti.pt.y = (short)HIWORD(lp);
            if (SendMessageW(hwnd, LM_HITTEST, 0, (LPARAM)&hti)) {
                SetPropW(hwnd, kPropWinverLinkPressIx,
                    (HANDLE)(INT_PTR)(hti.item.iLink + 1));
                SetCapture(hwnd);
                ExplorerSysLinkFadeSnapToSettled(hwnd);
                InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
            }
            break;
        }
        case WM_LBUTTONUP:
            // Capture release must not depend on the prop still being set --
            // a drag off the link already clears it (see WM_MOUSEMOVE) while
            // capture itself stays held for the rest of the gesture. Gating
            // ReleaseCapture behind RemovePropW's success left capture stuck
            // on the window (and the whole app unresponsive) once the prop
            // had already been cleared before the button-up arrived.
            if (GetCapture() == hwnd)
                ReleaseCapture();
            if (RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropWinverLinkPressIx))
                InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
            break;
        case WM_CAPTURECHANGED:
            if (RemovePropW(hwnd, kPropWinverLinkPressIx))
                InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
            break;
        case WM_TIMER:
            if (wp == ExplorerSysLinkFadeTimerId()) {
                if (auto* state = ExplorerSysLinkFadeGetState(hwnd)) {
                    InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
                    if (state->startTime <= 0.0 ||
                        TimerGetSeconds() - state->startTime >= kExpLinkFadeDurationSeconds) {
                        ExplorerSysLinkFadeStopTimer(hwnd, state);
                        if (state->fadingOut) {
                            state->hotLinkIx = -1;
                            state->fadingOut = false;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return 0;
            }
            break;
        }
    }

    // WinverPaintTextControl now owns painting in every mode -- it already
    // picks the right background fill itself (DWM color-key black in
    // backdrop modes, the real dialog color otherwise), so there
    // is no separate native-passthrough path left here to keep in sync.
    switch (msg) {
    case WM_ERASEBKGND:
        // WM_PAINT below composes off-screen and does a single BitBlt, so
        // erasing here would just be an extra visible step -- skip it.
        return 1;
    case WM_PAINT: {
        PAINTSTRUCT ps{};
        HDC hdc = BeginPaint(hwnd, &ps);
        if (hdc) {
            RECT rc{};
            GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc);
            const int w = rc.right - rc.left, h = rc.bottom - rc.top;
            HDC memDC = (w > 0 && h > 0) ? CreateCompatibleDC(hdc) : nullptr;
            HBITMAP memBmp = memDC ? CreateCompatibleBitmap(hdc, w, h) : nullptr;
            HGDIOBJ oldBmp = memBmp ? SelectObject(memDC, memBmp) : nullptr;
            if (memDC && memBmp && oldBmp) {
                WinverPaintTextControl(hwnd, memDC, kind);
                BitBlt(hdc, 0, 0, w, h, memDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
            } else {
                WinverPaintTextControl(hwnd, hdc, kind);
            }
            if (oldBmp) SelectObject(memDC, oldBmp);
            if (memBmp) DeleteObject(memBmp);
            if (memDC) DeleteDC(memDC);
        }
        EndPaint(hwnd, &ps);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_PRINTCLIENT:
        if (wp)
            WinverPaintTextControl(hwnd, (HDC)wp, kind);
        return 0;
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

static BOOL CALLBACK WinverInstallTextSubclassEnum(HWND child, LPARAM)
{
    const WinverTextControlKind kind = WinverGetTextControlKind(child);
    if (kind == WinverTextControlNone ||
        GetPropW(child, kPropWinverTextSubclass))
        return TRUE;

    if (!SetPropW(child, kPropWinverTextSubclass,
            reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(static_cast<ULONG_PTR>(kind))))
        return TRUE;
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            child, WinverTextSubclassProc, 0))
        RemovePropW(child, kPropWinverTextSubclass);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK WinverRemoveTextSubclassEnum(HWND child, LPARAM)
{
    if (RemovePropW(child, kPropWinverTextSubclass)) {
        // Subclass first: the removal runs on the dialog's thread, so once it
        // returns no message there is still reading the fade state.
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            child, WinverTextSubclassProc);
        RemovePropW(child, kPropWinverLinkTracking);
        RemovePropW(child, kPropWinverLinkPressIx);
        ExplorerSysLinkFadeDestroyState(child);
    }
    return TRUE;
}

static void WinverInstallTextSubclasses(HWND hDlg)
{
    if (hDlg && IsWindow(hDlg))
        EnumChildWindows(hDlg, WinverInstallTextSubclassEnum, 0);
}

static void WinverRemoveTextSubclasses(HWND hDlg)
{
    if (hDlg && IsWindow(hDlg))
        EnumChildWindows(hDlg, WinverRemoveTextSubclassEnum, 0);
}

// Hides the resource-template Separator (off-center, >1px thick) and draws
// a full-width 1px line ourselves instead (see g_winverSeparatorY /
// WinverDrawSeparatorLine above WinverPaintNow).
static void WinverFixSeparator(HWND hDlg)
{
    HWND hSep = GetDlgItem(hDlg, kWinverSeparatorCtrlId);
    if (!hSep) return;

    RECT sepRect{};
    if (!GetWindowRect(hSep, &sepRect)) return;
    MapWindowPoints(HWND_DESKTOP, hDlg, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(&sepRect), 2);

    if (g_winverLayoutDlg != hDlg)
        g_winverSeparatorWasVisible = IsWindowVisible(hSep) != FALSE;
    g_winverSeparatorY = (sepRect.top + sepRect.bottom) / 2;
    ShowWindow(hSep, SW_HIDE);
}

// Gives OK the button size the rest of the mod draws at, and reports where
// a companion sized for its localized label sits beside it. Every host gets the
// size; only winver.exe gets the companion, so elsewhere OK keeps the
// template's own right edge instead of being re-centered around a pair that
// isn't there.
struct WinverButtonRow {
    int x;       // where a companion button starts
    int y;
    int width;
    int height;
    HFONT font;  // the OK button's own font
};

static bool WinverLayoutOkButton(HWND hDlg, bool withCompanion,
                                 WinverButtonRow* outRow,
                                 LPCWSTR companionLabel = nullptr)
{
    HWND hOk = GetDlgItem(hDlg, IDOK);
    if (!hOk) return false;
    RECT okRect{};
    if (!GetWindowRect(hOk, &okRect)) return false;
    MapWindowPoints(HWND_DESKTOP, hDlg, reinterpret_cast<POINT*>(&okRect), 2);
    if (g_winverLayoutDlg != hDlg || !g_winverOriginalOkRectValid) {
        g_winverLayoutDlg = hDlg;
        g_winverOriginalOkRect = okRect;
        g_winverOriginalOkRectValid = true;
    }

    RECT clientRect{};
    GetClientRect(hDlg, &clientRect);

    // Bigger than the template's cramped classic dialog-unit size, closer to
    // WinUI 3 proportions. With a companion the two are centered together as
    // one group; alone, OK stays anchored where the template put it.
    const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hDlg);
    const int gap = MulDiv(12, dpi, 96);
    const int width = MulDiv(140, dpi, 96);
    int companionWidth = width;
    HFONT font = reinterpret_cast<HFONT>(SendMessageW(hOk, WM_GETFONT, 0, 0));
    if (withCompanion && companionLabel) {
        if (HDC dc = GetDC(hOk)) {
            HGDIOBJ oldFont = font ? SelectObject(dc, font) : nullptr;
            SIZE textSize = {};
            if (GetTextExtentPoint32W(dc, companionLabel,
                                     lstrlenW(companionLabel), &textSize)) {
                companionWidth = std::max(width,
                    static_cast<int>(textSize.cx) + MulDiv(32, dpi, 96));
            }
            if (oldFont && oldFont != HGDI_ERROR)
                SelectObject(dc, oldFont);
            ReleaseDC(hOk, dc);
        }
    }
    const int height = MulDiv(30, dpi, 96);
    // Keep the row centered on the original OK button's own vertical
    // center rather than its top -- it's taller now than the template's.
    const int rowCenterY = (g_winverOriginalOkRect.top +
                            g_winverOriginalOkRect.bottom) / 2;
    const int upNudge = MulDiv(10, dpi, 96);
    const int top = rowCenterY - height / 2 - upNudge;

    int okX;
    int companionX = 0;
    if (withCompanion) {
        const int totalWidth = companionWidth + width + gap;
        companionX = (clientRect.right - totalWidth) / 2;
        okX = companionX + companionWidth + gap;
    } else {
        okX = (int)g_winverOriginalOkRect.right - width;
    }

    // SHOW repaints the finished layout once, after the backdrop is ready.
    MoveWindow(hOk, okX, top, width, height, FALSE);

    if (outRow) {
        outRow->x = companionX;
        outRow->y = top;
        outRow->width = companionWidth;
        outRow->height = height;
        // Inherit the OK button's own font -- a plain CreateWindowExW button
        // defaults to the stock "System" font otherwise, not whatever the
        // dialog template (and the rest of its controls) actually use.
        outRow->font = font;
    }
    return true;
}

static void WinverEnsureSettingsButton(HWND hDlg)
{
    if (g_winverSettingsBtn && IsWindow(g_winverSettingsBtn)) return;

    const std::wstring label = WinverSettingsBtnLabel();
    WinverButtonRow row{};
    if (!WinverLayoutOkButton(hDlg, true, &row, label.c_str()))
        return;

    g_winverSettingsBtn = CreateWindowExW(0, WC_BUTTONW, label.c_str(),
        WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | BS_PUSHBUTTON,
        row.x, row.y, row.width, row.height,
        hDlg, (HMENU)(INT_PTR)kWinverSettingsBtnId, GetModuleHandleW(nullptr), nullptr);
    if (g_winverSettingsBtn && row.font)
        SendMessageW(g_winverSettingsBtn, WM_SETFONT, (WPARAM)row.font, TRUE);
}

static void WinverPauseGradientAnimation()
{
    if (!g_winverGradientAnimating.exchange(
            false, std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
        return;
    }

    const ULONGLONG start =
        g_winverGradientAnimStart.exchange(0, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
    if (start) {
        g_winverGradientAnimPausedMs.store(
            (GetTickCount64() - start) % kWinverGradientAnimDurationMs,
            std::memory_order_release);
    }
}

static bool WinverCanAnimateGradient(HWND hWnd)
{
    return !g_winverUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
        g_settings.WinverSection && hWnd && IsWindow(hWnd) &&
        IsWindowVisible(hWnd) &&
        !IsIconic(hWnd) && GetForegroundWindow() == hWnd &&
        !g_winverLogoAnimPending.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
        SysAnimationsEnabled() &&
        !g_winverGradientHighContrast.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

static void WinverResetGradientAnimation()
{
    g_winverGradientAnimating.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    g_winverGradientAnimStart.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    g_winverGradientAnimPausedMs.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    g_winverAnimTimerInterval.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
}

static void WinverRefreshAnimationTimer(HWND hWnd)
{
    if (WinverCanAnimateGradient(hWnd)) {
        if (!g_winverGradientAnimating.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
            const ULONGLONG paused =
                g_winverGradientAnimPausedMs.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) %
                kWinverGradientAnimDurationMs;
            g_winverGradientAnimStart.store(
                GetTickCount64() - paused, std::memory_order_release);
            g_winverGradientAnimating.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        }
    } else {
        WinverPauseGradientAnimation();
    }

    const bool logoAnimating =
        g_winverLogoAnimating.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    const bool gradientAnimating =
        g_winverGradientAnimating.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (!logoAnimating && !gradientAnimating) {
        if (g_winverAnimTimerInterval.exchange(
                0, std::memory_order_acq_rel) != 0) {
            (void)KillTimer(hWnd, kWinverLogoAnimTimerId);
        }
        return;
    }

    const UINT interval = logoAnimating ? 16 : kWinverGradientAnimIntervalMs;
    if (g_winverAnimTimerInterval.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == interval)
        return;
    if (!SetTimer(hWnd, kWinverLogoAnimTimerId, interval, nullptr)) {
        WinverPauseGradientAnimation();
        g_winverLogoAnimating.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        g_winverAnimTimerInterval.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    } else {
        g_winverAnimTimerInterval.store(interval, std::memory_order_release);
    }
}

static LRESULT WinverStartLogoAnimNow(HWND hWnd)
{
    if (g_winverUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        g_winverLogoAnimPending.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        g_winverLogoAnimating.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        WinverPauseGradientAnimation();
        (void)KillTimer(hWnd, kWinverLogoAnimTimerId);
        g_winverAnimTimerInterval.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
        return 0;
    }

    if (!g_settings.WinverSection || !SysAnimationsEnabled()) {
        g_winverLogoAnimPending.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        g_winverLogoAnimating.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        WinverPauseGradientAnimation();
        (void)KillTimer(hWnd, kWinverLogoAnimTimerId);
        g_winverAnimTimerInterval.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
        WinverPaintBannerAnimFrame(hWnd);
        return 0;
    }

    const bool wasAnimating =
        g_winverLogoAnimating.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (!wasAnimating) {
        g_winverLogoAnimPending.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        g_winverLogoAnimStart.store(GetTickCount(), std::memory_order_release);
        g_winverLogoAnimating.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    WinverRefreshAnimationTimer(hWnd);
    if (!wasAnimating)
        WinverPaintBannerAnimFrame(hWnd);
    return 0;
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK WinverDialogSubclassProc(HWND hWnd, UINT uMsg,
    WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam, DWORD_PTR /*ref*/)
{
    if (const UINT startMsg = g_winverStartLogoAnimMsg.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        startMsg && uMsg == startMsg) {
        return WinverStartLogoAnimNow(hWnd);
    }
    if (const UINT eventMsg = g_winverDialogEventMsg.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        eventMsg && uMsg == eventMsg) {
        if (!g_winverUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
            g_settings.WinverSection) {
            WinverHandleDialogEvent(hWnd, static_cast<DWORD>(wParam), lParam != 0);
        }
        return 0;
    }

    if (uMsg == WM_TIMER && wParam == kWinverLogoAnimTimerId) {
        if (g_winverUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
            !g_settings.WinverSection) {
            g_winverLogoAnimating.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
            WinverPauseGradientAnimation();
            (void)KillTimer(hWnd, kWinverLogoAnimTimerId);
            g_winverAnimTimerInterval.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
            return 0;
        }
        if (!SysAnimationsEnabled() ||
            GetTickCount() - g_winverLogoAnimStart.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) >=
                kWinverLogoAnimDurationMs) {
            g_winverLogoAnimating.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        }
        WinverRefreshAnimationTimer(hWnd);
        WinverPaintBannerAnimFrame(hWnd);
        return 0;
    }

    const bool visualThemeChanged =
        uMsg == WM_THEMECHANGED ||
        (uMsg == WM_SETTINGCHANGE && lParam &&
         _wcsicmp(reinterpret_cast<LPCWSTR>(lParam), L"ImmersiveColorSet") == 0);
    if (visualThemeChanged) {
        AccentPaletteInvalidate();
        g_accentCacheDirty.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    if (uMsg == WM_SETTINGCHANGE) {
        g_animEnabled.store(-1, std::memory_order_release);
        const bool animationsEnabled = SysAnimationsEnabled();
        g_winverGradientHighContrast.store(
            animationsEnabled && SysHighContrastEnabled(),
            std::memory_order_release);
    }

    const bool refreshAnimation =
        uMsg == WM_ACTIVATE || uMsg == WM_SHOWWINDOW ||
        uMsg == WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGED || uMsg == WM_SIZE ||
        uMsg == WM_SETTINGCHANGE;

    LRESULT result = DefSubclassProc(hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam);

    if (uMsg == WM_PAINT) {
        WinverPaintNow(hWnd);
    } else if (visualThemeChanged && WinverUsesBackdropHole()) {
        RefreshAccentCache();
        WinverApplyCurrentBackground(hWnd);
        RedrawWindow(hWnd, nullptr, nullptr,
            RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
    } else if (uMsg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        (void)KillTimer(hWnd, kWinverLogoAnimTimerId);
        g_winverAnimTimerInterval.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
        WinverResetGradientAnimation();
        WinverRemoveTextSubclasses(hWnd);
        WinverDWriteCacheClear();
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            hWnd, WinverDialogSubclassProc);
        if (g_winverSubclassedDlg == hWnd)
            g_winverSubclassedDlg = nullptr;
        if (g_winverLayoutDlg == hWnd) {
            g_winverLayoutDlg = nullptr;
            g_winverOriginalOkRectValid = false;
            g_winverSettingsBtn = nullptr;
            g_winverSeparatorY = -1;
        }
    } else if (uMsg == WM_COMMAND &&
               LOWORD(wParam) == kWinverSettingsBtnId && HIWORD(wParam) == BN_CLICKED) {
        ShellExecuteW(hWnd, L"open", L"ms-settings:about", nullptr, nullptr, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
    } else if (WinverUsesBackdropHole() && uMsg == WM_CTLCOLORSTATIC) {
        // Backdrop modes: each static paints its own bg here because
        // the whole-client black fill only covers gaps around children
        // (WS_CLIPCHILDREN).
        HDC hdcStatic = reinterpret_cast<HDC>(wParam);
        SetBkMode(hdcStatic, TRANSPARENT);
        SetTextColor(hdcStatic,
            WinverIsDarkVisualMode() ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0));
        result = reinterpret_cast<LRESULT>(GetStockObject(BLACK_BRUSH));
    }

    if (refreshAnimation && uMsg != WM_NCDESTROY)
        WinverRefreshAnimationTimer(hWnd);

    return result;
}

// Centers the dialog on its current monitor's work area (respecting the
// taskbar) instead of wherever winver's own template/DefDlgProc would have
// placed it. Called at EVENT_OBJECT_CREATE, before the window is ever
// shown, so there's no visible jump from an old position to this one.
static void WinverCenterOnScreen(HWND hDlg)
{
    RECT wndRect{};
    if (!GetWindowRect(hDlg, &wndRect)) return;

    HMONITOR hMon = MonitorFromWindow(hDlg, MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST);
    MONITORINFO mi{ sizeof(mi) };
    if (!GetMonitorInfoW(hMon, &mi)) return;

    const int w = wndRect.right - wndRect.left;
    const int h = wndRect.bottom - wndRect.top;
    const int workW = mi.rcWork.right - mi.rcWork.left;
    const int workH = mi.rcWork.bottom - mi.rcWork.top;
    const int x = mi.rcWork.left + (workW - w) / 2;
    const int y = mi.rcWork.top + (workH - h) / 2;

    SetWindowPos(hDlg, nullptr, x, y, 0, 0, SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
}

// Owned by g_msgWnd's thread (WinEventHooksSync): an out-of-context hook
// belongs to the thread that installed it, and only that thread can remove it.
static HWINEVENTHOOK g_winverEventHook = nullptr;

static UINT WinverDialogEventMessage()
{
    UINT message = g_winverDialogEventMsg.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (!message) {
        message = RegisterWindowMessageW(L"Win32UIModernizer.WinverDialogEvent");
        g_winverDialogEventMsg.store(message, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    return message;
}

// Posted to the dialog's own thread, keeping HWND layout and timers thread-affine.
// CREATE prepares the backdrop; SHOW completes layout and repaints the children.
static void WinverHandleDialogEvent(HWND hWnd, DWORD event, bool justSubclassed)
{
    // A posted message runs in the process default context; see WinverDpiScope.
    WinverDpiScope dpiScope(hWnd);

    // Prepare the extended frame before centering/layout can trigger a client
    // paint, including while the localized button label is first loaded.
    if (event == EVENT_OBJECT_CREATE && WinverUsesBackdropHole())
        WinverBackdropSetup(hWnd);
    else if (event == EVENT_OBJECT_SHOW)
        WinverApplyCurrentBackground(hWnd);

    // Center it wherever it came from. winver.exe reaches this at CREATE,
    // before the dialog is shown; a host-opened one reaches it at SHOW, which
    // is the first moment the controls that identify it exist.
    if (justSubclassed)
        WinverCenterOnScreen(hWnd);

    if (event == EVENT_OBJECT_CREATE) {
        WinverResetGradientAnimation();
        const bool animationsEnabled = SysAnimationsEnabled();
        g_winverGradientHighContrast.store(
            animationsEnabled && SysHighContrastEnabled(),
            std::memory_order_release);
        g_winverLogoAnimPending.store(
            animationsEnabled, std::memory_order_release);
        g_winverLogoAnimating.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    } else if (event == EVENT_OBJECT_SHOW) {
        // OK button (and everything else) is only guaranteed to exist by
        // SHOW time, not at CREATE -- see WinverEnsureSettingsButton.
        // Only winver.exe gets the device-settings button; every About host
        // gets the modern OK button dimensions.
        if (IsCurrentProcessWinver())
            WinverEnsureSettingsButton(hWnd);
        else
            WinverLayoutOkButton(hWnd, false, nullptr);
        WinverFixSeparator(hWnd);

        if (!SysAnimationsEnabled()) {
            g_winverLogoAnimPending.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
            g_winverLogoAnimating.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
            WinverPauseGradientAnimation();
            (void)KillTimer(hWnd, kWinverLogoAnimTimerId);
            g_winverAnimTimerInterval.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
            RedrawWindow(hWnd, nullptr, nullptr,
                RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_UPDATENOW | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
            return;
        }

        g_winverLogoAnimPending.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        g_winverLogoAnimStart.store(GetTickCount(), std::memory_order_release);
        g_winverLogoAnimating.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        RedrawWindow(hWnd, nullptr, nullptr,
            RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_UPDATENOW | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
        WinverEnsureStartLogoAnimMessage();
        if (const UINT startMsg = g_winverStartLogoAnimMsg.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            PostMessageW(hWnd, startMsg, 0, 0);
        else
            WinverStartLogoAnimNow(hWnd);
    }
}

// Runs on g_msgWnd's thread, the hook's owner: it only recognizes the
// dialog, subclasses it and hands the event to the dialog's own thread.
static void CALLBACK WinverWinEventProc(HWINEVENTHOOK, DWORD event, HWND hWnd,
    LONG idObject, LONG idChild, DWORD, DWORD)
{
    if (g_winverUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !g_settings.WinverSection) {
        return;
    }
    if (idObject != OBJID_WINDOW || idChild != CHILDID_SELF)
        return;
    if (event != EVENT_OBJECT_CREATE && event != EVENT_OBJECT_SHOW)
        return;
    if (!hWnd || !IsWindow(hWnd) || !IsClassName(hWnd, L"#32770"))
        return;
    // winver.exe shows no other dialog, so an ownerless one there is the
    // About dialog even at CREATE time, before its controls exist. Every
    // other host opens it from its own window, so there it is recognized by
    // shell32's ShellAbout template once the controls are up.
    const bool winverOwnDialog =
        IsCurrentProcessWinver() && !GetWindow(hWnd, GW_OWNER);
    if (!winverOwnDialog && !IsShellAboutDialog(hWnd))
        return;
    const UINT message = WinverDialogEventMessage();
    if (!message)
        return;

    bool justSubclassed = false;
    if (hWnd != g_winverSubclassedDlg &&
        WindhawkUtils::SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(hWnd, WinverDialogSubclassProc, 0)) {
        g_winverSubclassedDlg = hWnd;
        justSubclassed = true;
    }
    if (hWnd == g_winverSubclassedDlg)
        PostMessageW(hWnd, message, event, justSubclassed ? 1 : 0);
}

static BOOL CALLBACK WinverApplyExistingEnum(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId()) return TRUE;
    WinverWinEventProc(nullptr, EVENT_OBJECT_SHOW, hwnd,
        OBJID_WINDOW, CHILDID_SELF, 0, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

static void WinverEnableRuntime(bool applyExisting)
{
    if (g_winverUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !g_settings.WinverSection || !WinverHostProcess()) {
        return;
    }
    if (SysAnimationsEnabled())
        WinverEnsureStartLogoAnimMessage();
    WinverDialogEventMessage();
    // Before g_msgWnd exists (Wh_ModInit) this is a no-op; Wh_ModAfterInit
    // syncs once the window's thread runs.
    WinEventHooksRequestSync();
    if (applyExisting)
        EnumWindows(WinverApplyExistingEnum, 0);
}

static void WinverDisableRuntime()
{
    // Removes the hook on its owning thread while g_msgWnd still runs; at
    // unload that thread already removed it on its way out.
    WinEventHooksRequestSync();

    HWND dialog = g_winverSubclassedDlg;
    if (dialog && IsWindow(dialog)) {
        // Restoring the OK button's rect is a layout change like the one
        // that applied it, so it needs the same context.
        WinverDpiScope dpiScope(dialog);
        (void)KillTimer(dialog, kWinverLogoAnimTimerId);
        g_winverAnimTimerInterval.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
        WinverRemoveTextSubclasses(dialog);
        WinverBackdropReset(dialog);
        WindhawkUtils::RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread(
            dialog, WinverDialogSubclassProc);

        HWND separator = GetDlgItem(dialog, kWinverSeparatorCtrlId);
        if (separator && g_winverSeparatorWasVisible)
            ShowWindow(separator, SW_SHOWNA);
        HWND ok = GetDlgItem(dialog, IDOK);
        if (ok && g_winverOriginalOkRectValid) {
            const RECT& rc = g_winverOriginalOkRect;
            MoveWindow(ok, rc.left, rc.top,
                rc.right - rc.left, rc.bottom - rc.top, TRUE);
        }
        if (g_winverSettingsBtn && IsWindow(g_winverSettingsBtn)) {
            DWORD_PTR ignored = 0;
            SendMessageTimeoutW(g_winverSettingsBtn, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0,
                SMTO_ABORTIFHUNG | SMTO_BLOCK, 1000, &ignored);
        }
        RedrawWindow(dialog, nullptr, nullptr,
            RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
    }

    g_winverLogoAnimating.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    g_winverLogoAnimPending.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    g_winverAnimTimerInterval.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    WinverResetGradientAnimation();
    g_winverSubclassedDlg = nullptr;
    g_winverSettingsBtn = nullptr;
    g_winverLayoutDlg = nullptr;
    g_winverOriginalOkRectValid = false;
    g_winverSeparatorY = -1;
    WinverDWriteCacheClear();
}

// The WinEvent hooks (About dialog, Disk Cleanup) live on g_msgWnd's thread:
// an out-of-context hook is owned by the thread that installed it, only that
// thread can remove it, and its callbacks arrive through that thread's queue.
// That thread pumps messages for the mod's lifetime, removes both hooks
// before it exits, and DestroyMsgWindow joins it, so no callback outlives
// the DLL. Called only on that thread.
static void WinEventHooksSync(bool removeAll)
{
    const bool wantWinver = !removeAll &&
        !g_winverUnloading.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
        g_settings.WinverSection && WinverHostProcess();
    if (wantWinver && !g_winverEventHook) {
        g_winverEventHook = SetWinEventHook(
            EVENT_OBJECT_CREATE, EVENT_OBJECT_SHOW, nullptr,
            WinverWinEventProc, GetCurrentProcessId(), 0,
            WINEVENT_OUTOFCONTEXT);
    } else if (!wantWinver && g_winverEventHook) {
        if (UnhookWinEvent(g_winverEventHook))
            g_winverEventHook = nullptr;
        else
            Wh_Log(L"About dialog: UnhookWinEvent failed (%u)", GetLastError());
    }

    const bool wantCleanmgr = !removeAll && IsCurrentProcessCleanmgr();
    if (wantCleanmgr && !g_cleanmgrEventHook) {
        g_cleanmgrEventHook = SetWinEventHook(
            EVENT_OBJECT_SHOW, EVENT_OBJECT_SHOW, nullptr,
            CleanmgrWinEventProc, GetCurrentProcessId(), 0,
            WINEVENT_OUTOFCONTEXT);
    } else if (!wantCleanmgr && g_cleanmgrEventHook) {
        if (UnhookWinEvent(g_cleanmgrEventHook))
            g_cleanmgrEventHook = nullptr;
        else
            Wh_Log(L"Disk Cleanup: UnhookWinEvent failed (%u)", GetLastError());
    }
}

// From any thread: brings the hooks in line with the settings on their
// owning thread. A no-op until g_msgWnd exists and once it's gone.
static void WinEventHooksRequestSync()
{
    const UINT message = g_winEventHooksSyncMsg.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    HWND hwnd = g_msgWnd.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (!message || !hwnd)
        return;
    if (GetCurrentThreadId() == g_msgWndThreadId.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        WinEventHooksSync(false);
    else
        SendMessageUnhooked(hwnd, message, 0, 0);
}

// Cache key packs codepoint + filled flag into one 32-bit value.
static std::unordered_map<uint32_t, Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry>> g_svgGeomCache;
static std::mutex g_svgGeomCacheMutex;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1RectangleGeometry> g_homeDoorMaskOuterGeometry;

static ID2D1PathGeometry* SvgGeomEnsure(wchar_t ch, bool filled) {
    const uint32_t key = (uint32_t(ch) << 1) | (filled ? 1u : 0u);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_svgGeomCacheMutex);
    auto it = g_svgGeomCache.find(key);
    if (it != g_svgGeomCache.end()) return it->second.Get();

    const auto& defs = SvgIconDefs();
    auto defIt = defs.find(ch);
    if (defIt == defs.end()) return nullptr;
    if (!EnsureD2DFactory()) return nullptr;

    const char* path = filled ? defIt->second.filled : defIt->second.normal;
    ID2D1PathGeometry* raw = nullptr;
    if (!SvgParsePathToGeometry(path, &raw) || !raw) {
        g_svgGeomCache[key] = nullptr;
        return nullptr;
    }
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> geom;
    geom.Attach(raw);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* result = geom.Get();
    g_svgGeomCache[key] = std::move(geom);
    return result;
}

// Music: a few quick decaying oscillations layered on top of the regular
// pop -- the note's outline/hole/accent-bar geometry can't be cleanly split
// into independent parts without new art, so this stays a single-geometry
// effect.
static const float MUSIC_SHIMMY_AMPLITUDE_DEG = 10.0f;
static const float MUSIC_SHIMMY_CYCLES        = 2.0f; // still slower than Phone's 4-cycle shake
static float MusicShimmyAngle(float animT) {
    if (animT < 0.0f) animT = 0.0f;
    if (animT > 1.0f) animT = 1.0f;
    static constexpr float kTwoPi = 6.283185307f;
    // sqrt decay holds the swing closer to full amplitude for longer than a
    // linear falloff would, so the motion stays legible before it dies out.
    float envelope = sqrtf(1.0f - animT);
    return MUSIC_SHIMMY_AMPLITUDE_DEG * sinf(animT * MUSIC_SHIMMY_CYCLES * kTwoPi) * envelope;
}

// NavPaneWinUIMetrics off forces these 5 icons to 1.0x scale; every intro
// function for them must apply the same rule via IconIntroApplyConfigScale
// or intro/settle will visibly jump.
static bool IconIntroApplyConfigScale(wchar_t ch, bool scaleOnlyInCabinet, bool inCabinetWClass)
{
    bool applyConfigScale = scaleOnlyInCabinet ? inCabinetWClass : true;
    if (!g_settings.NavPaneWinUIMetrics &&
        (ch == GLYPH_ONEDRIVE[0] || ch == GLYPH_DESKTOP[0] ||
         ch == GLYPH_VIDEOS[0] || ch == GLYPH_DRIVE[0] || ch == GLYPH_CDROM[0])) {
        applyConfigScale = false;
    }
    return applyConfigScale;
}

// Draws the SVG glyph for codepoint `ch` if one is registered.
// Returns false when no SVG is registered for this glyph (caller should
// fall back to DirectWrite text rendering). `popAnimT` (0..1, or negative
// when not animating) drives the Music shimmy; ignored by every other icon.
static bool DrawSvgGlyph(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, wchar_t ch, bool filled, bool inCabinetWClass, float extraScale, float popAnimT) {
    const auto& defs = SvgIconDefs();
    auto defIt = defs.find(ch);
    if (defIt == defs.end()) return false;
    ID2D1PathGeometry* geom = SvgGeomEnsure(ch, filled);
    if (!geom) return false;
    bool applyConfigScale = IconIntroApplyConfigScale(ch, defIt->second.scaleOnlyInCabinet, inCabinetWClass);
    float rotationDeg = (ch == GLYPH_MUSIC[0] && popAnimT >= 0.0f) ? MusicShimmyAngle(popAnimT) : 0.0f;
    // Pop frames change every paint, so only resting glyphs use the cache.
    const bool resting = popAnimT < 0.0f && extraScale == 1.0f;
    DrawSvgGeom(hdc, rc, cr, geom, (applyConfigScale ? defIt->second.scale : 1.0f) * extraScale,
        rotationDeg, resting ? ch : 0, filled);
    return true;
}

static bool SvgGlyphGeometryAvailable(wchar_t ch, bool filled) {
    return SvgGeomEnsure(ch, filled) != nullptr;
}

// ── Regedit TreeView icon replacement (RegeditSection.GlyphIcons) ────────
// Bakes the This Computer / Folder glyphs into standalone HICONs for
// RgSHDefExtractIconW_Hook. No filled-glyph swap: every entry shares the
// same Normal glyph shape and differs only by fill color (accent on the
// selected-item variant, matching the nav pane's own convention).
struct RgGlyphIconCacheEntry {
    UINT id;      // 109 (This Computer), or 3/4 (folder/key, imageres.dll index)
    int size;
    bool dark;
    COLORREF accent;
    bool useAccent;
    HICON icon;
};
static SRWLOCK g_rgGlyphIconCacheLock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static constexpr size_t kRgGlyphIconCacheMaxEntries = 32;
static std::vector<RgGlyphIconCacheEntry> g_rgGlyphIconCache;

// Caller holds g_rgGlyphIconCacheLock exclusively.
static void RgGlyphIconClearCacheLocked()
{
    for (RgGlyphIconCacheEntry& cached : g_rgGlyphIconCache)
        if (cached.icon)
            DestroyIcon(cached.icon);
    g_rgGlyphIconCache.clear();
}

static void RgThisPcAccentIconClear(); // defined below, alongside its cache

static void RgGlyphIconClearCache()
{
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_rgGlyphIconCacheLock);
    RgGlyphIconClearCacheLocked();
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_rgGlyphIconCacheLock);
    RgThisPcAccentIconClear();
}

// Bakes one standalone HICON via DrawGlyphDW (DirectWrite text render of a
// Segoe Fluent Icons codepoint) rather than SvgGeomEnsure/FillGeometry --
// lighter than the D2D geometry-fill pipeline and reuses the exact call
// every nav-pane icon's font fallback already goes through.
static HICON RgGlyphIconCreate(int size, wchar_t glyphCh, COLORREF color)
{
    if (size <= 0)
        return nullptr;

    HDC hScreen = GetDC(nullptr);
    if (!hScreen) return nullptr;
    HDC hDC = CreateCompatibleDC(hScreen);
    if (!hDC) { ReleaseDC(nullptr, hScreen); return nullptr; }

    BITMAPINFO bmi = {};
    bmi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
    bmi.bmiHeader.biWidth = size;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -size;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    bmi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

    void* bits = nullptr;
    HBITMAP hBmp = CreateDIBSection(hDC, &bmi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
    if (!hBmp) {
        DeleteDC(hDC);
        ReleaseDC(nullptr, hScreen);
        return nullptr;
    }
    HBITMAP hPrev = static_cast<HBITMAP>(SelectObject(hDC, hBmp));
    ZeroMemory(bits, static_cast<SIZE_T>(size) * size * 4);

    // fontSize at 80% of the canvas -- bigger than PinContentIcon's 70%
    // (tuned for a small secondary badge, not a primary tree glyph) but
    // short of the nav pane's full-canvas convention, which needed no
    // margin because NavMetricsGetIconArtSize already centers the art
    // inside a separately-computed text gap. Here the icon and text share
    // a single fixed-size TreeView image-list cell with no such margin
    // logic, so a small reserved edge keeps the glyph from visually
    // crowding into the text/selection padding.
    RECT rc = { 0, 0, size, size };
    const int fontSize = (size * 8) / 10;
    wchar_t buf[2] = { glyphCh, 0 };
    if (!DrawGlyphDW(hDC, rc, color, buf, fontSize)) {
        SelectObject(hDC, hPrev);
        DeleteObject(hBmp);
        DeleteDC(hDC);
        ReleaseDC(nullptr, hScreen);
        return nullptr;
    }

    ConvertPremultipliedDibToStraightAlpha(bits, size, size);
    HBITMAP hMask = CreateAlphaZeroMaskBitmap(size, size, bits);
    SelectObject(hDC, hPrev);

    HICON icon = nullptr;
    if (hMask) {
        ICONINFO ii = {};
        ii.fIcon = TRUE;
        ii.hbmColor = hBmp;
        ii.hbmMask = hMask;
        icon = CreateIconIndirect(&ii);
        DeleteObject(hMask);
    }
    DeleteObject(hBmp);
    DeleteDC(hDC);
    ReleaseDC(nullptr, hScreen);
    return icon;
}

// `useAccent` is explicit rather than inferred from `id`: index 4 (folder/
// key's iSelectedImage slot) always passes true from
// RgSHDefExtractIconW_Hook; index 109 (This Computer) has no such slot, so
// RgMainSubclassProc's paint code calls this directly with useAccent=true
// for the selected root row instead.
static HICON RgGlyphIconGetForLoad(UINT id, int size, bool dark, COLORREF accent, bool useAccent)
{
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_rgGlyphIconCacheLock);
    for (RgGlyphIconCacheEntry& cached : g_rgGlyphIconCache) {
        if (cached.id == id && cached.size == size && cached.dark == dark &&
            cached.accent == accent && cached.useAccent == useAccent) {
            HICON result = CopyIcon(cached.icon);
            ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_rgGlyphIconCacheLock);
            return result;
        }
    }
    if (g_rgGlyphIconCache.size() >= kRgGlyphIconCacheMaxEntries)
        RgGlyphIconClearCacheLocked();
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_rgGlyphIconCacheLock);

    const wchar_t glyphCh = (id == 109) ? GLYPH_THISPC[0] : GLYPH_FOLDER[0];
    const COLORREF neutralColor = dark ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(25, 26, 26);
    const COLORREF color = useAccent ? accent : neutralColor;

    HICON icon = RgGlyphIconCreate(size, glyphCh, color);
    if (!icon)
        return nullptr;

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_rgGlyphIconCacheLock);
    for (RgGlyphIconCacheEntry& cached : g_rgGlyphIconCache) {
        if (cached.id == id && cached.size == size && cached.dark == dark &&
            cached.accent == accent && cached.useAccent == useAccent) {
            HICON result = CopyIcon(cached.icon);
            ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_rgGlyphIconCacheLock);
            DestroyIcon(icon);
            return result;
        }
    }
    if (g_rgGlyphIconCache.size() >= kRgGlyphIconCacheMaxEntries)
        RgGlyphIconClearCacheLocked();
    g_rgGlyphIconCache.push_back({ id, size, dark, accent, useAccent, icon });
    HICON result = CopyIcon(icon);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_rgGlyphIconCacheLock);
    return result;
}

// Dedicated single-slot cache for the This Computer root-row accent icon,
// repainted on every redraw of that row (unlike every other glyph icon,
// baked once into the native image list at startup). Holds one real,
// uncopied HICON reused across paints instead of the general cache's
// lock+scan+CopyIcon+DestroyIcon cycle. Invalidated by RgGlyphIconClearCache
// so it shares that function's existing call sites.
static HICON g_rgThisPcAccentIcon = nullptr;
static int g_rgThisPcAccentSize = 0;
static bool g_rgThisPcAccentDark = false;
static COLORREF g_rgThisPcAccentColor = 0;
static std::mutex g_rgThisPcAccentMutex;

// Caller must hold g_rgThisPcAccentMutex -- see RgThisPcAccentIconDraw below.
static HICON RgThisPcAccentIconGet_Locked(int size, bool dark, COLORREF accent)
{
    if (g_rgThisPcAccentIcon && g_rgThisPcAccentSize == size &&
        g_rgThisPcAccentDark == dark && g_rgThisPcAccentColor == accent) {
        return g_rgThisPcAccentIcon;
    }
    HICON icon = RgGlyphIconCreate(size, GLYPH_THISPC[0], accent);
    if (!icon)
        return g_rgThisPcAccentIcon; // keep showing the stale icon over nothing
    if (g_rgThisPcAccentIcon)
        DestroyIcon(g_rgThisPcAccentIcon);
    g_rgThisPcAccentIcon = icon;
    g_rgThisPcAccentSize = size;
    g_rgThisPcAccentDark = dark;
    g_rgThisPcAccentColor = accent;
    return icon;
}

// Holds g_rgThisPcAccentMutex across the whole get-then-draw sequence, not
// just the cache lookup: RgThisPcAccentIconClear runs from
// RgGlyphIconClearCache/UpdateThemeColors on the message-window thread, and
// without this the handle it hands back could be DestroyIcon'd on that
// thread in the gap between returning here and the regedit UI thread's own
// DrawIconEx call below.
static bool RgThisPcAccentIconDraw(HDC hdc, int x, int y, int cx, int cy,
    bool dark, COLORREF accent)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_rgThisPcAccentMutex);
    HICON icon = RgThisPcAccentIconGet_Locked(cx, dark, accent);
    if (!icon)
        return false;
    DrawIconEx(hdc, x, y, icon, cx, cy, 0, nullptr, DI_NORMAL);
    return true;
}

static void RgThisPcAccentIconClear()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_rgThisPcAccentMutex);
    if (g_rgThisPcAccentIcon) {
        DestroyIcon(g_rgThisPcAccentIcon);
        g_rgThisPcAccentIcon = nullptr;
    }
    g_rgThisPcAccentSize = 0;
}

static bool RgGlyphIconShouldReplace(PCWSTR pszIconFile, int iIndex, UINT* outId)
{
    if (!g_settings.RegeditSection || !g_settings.RgGlyphIcons ||
        !IsCurrentProcessRegedit())
        return false;
    if (!pszIconFile || iIndex >= 0)
        return false;

    const int absIdx = -iIndex;
    if (absIdx != 109 && absIdx != 3 && absIdx != 4)
        return false;

    if (!ShellIconContainsI(pszIconFile, L"\\imageres.dll"))
        return false;

    *outId = static_cast<UINT>(absIdx);
    return true;
}

// DComp counterpart of DrawSvgGeom for a settled SVG frame. Keeping the same
// geometry bounds, fit, and per-icon scale avoids a visible geometry jump when
// the animated visual hands off to the TreeView's permanent Filled glyph.
static void DrawSvgGlyphCore(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr,
                             wchar_t ch, bool filled, bool inCabinetWClass,
                             float baseOffX, float baseOffY) {
    if (!rt)
        return;

    const auto& defs = SvgIconDefs();
    auto defIt = defs.find(ch);
    if (defIt == defs.end())
        return;

    ID2D1PathGeometry* geom = SvgGeomEnsure(ch, filled);
    if (!geom)
        return;

    D2D1_RECT_F bounds = {};
    if (FAILED(geom->GetBounds(nullptr, &bounds)))
        return;

    const float contentW = bounds.right - bounds.left;
    const float contentH = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
    const float targetW = float(rc.right - rc.left);
    const float targetH = float(rc.bottom - rc.top);
    if (contentW <= 0.0f || contentH <= 0.0f ||
        targetW <= 0.0f || targetH <= 0.0f) {
        return;
    }

    const bool applyConfigScale = IconIntroApplyConfigScale(
        ch, defIt->second.scaleOnlyInCabinet, inCabinetWClass);
    const float iconScale = applyConfigScale ? defIt->second.scale : 1.0f;
    const float scale = std::min(targetW / contentW, targetH / contentH) * iconScale;
    const float offX = baseOffX + (targetW - contentW * scale) * 0.5f -
                       bounds.left * scale;
    const float offY = baseOffY + (targetH - contentH * scale) * 0.5f -
                       bounds.top * scale;
    const D2D1_COLOR_F color = D2D1::ColorF(
        GetRValue(cr) / 255.0f, GetGValue(cr) / 255.0f,
        GetBValue(cr) / 255.0f, 1.0f);

    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0.0f, 0.0f, scale, offX, offY));
    if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, color))
        rt->FillGeometry(geom, brush);
    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
}

// ── OneDrive converge-wipe intro ──────────────────────────────────────────
// Blobs 0 (left) and 2 (right) reveal top-down; blob 1 (base, spans the
// full width along the bottom) reveals bottom-up -- the two side lobes
// drop onto the base as it rises, converging into the assembled cloud.
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_oneDriveBlobGeom[3];
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1Layer> g_oneDriveWipeLayer;
// Raw, non-owning: the RT g_oneDriveWipeLayer above was created from, so a
// staleness check can catch the thread-local cached RT being recreated by another
// caller (not just this function's own EndDraw failure below) -- an
// ID2D1Layer isn't valid across a render target it wasn't created from.
static ID2D1RenderTarget* g_oneDriveWipeLayerRT = nullptr; // identity check only, any RT type

static ID2D1PathGeometry* OneDriveBlobGeomEnsure(int idx) {
    if (g_oneDriveBlobGeom[idx]) return g_oneDriveBlobGeom[idx].Get();
    if (!EnsureD2DFactory()) return nullptr;
    static const char* const kPaths[3] = {
        kSvgOneDriveBlobLeft, kSvgOneDriveBlobBase, kSvgOneDriveBlobRight
    };
    ID2D1PathGeometry* raw = nullptr;
    if (!SvgParsePathToGeometry(kPaths[idx], &raw) || !raw) return nullptr;
    g_oneDriveBlobGeom[idx].Attach(raw);
    return g_oneDriveBlobGeom[idx].Get();
}

// Per-blob start delay within the wipe window (left, base, right). The
// base leads -- it starts immediately and finishes early -- so the two
// side lobes visibly drop onto an already-forming base a beat later, all
// landing by the ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_ONEDRIVE boundary.
static const float kOneDriveBlobDelay[3] = { 0.05f, 0.0f, 0.05f };

// Anchor point per blob (fraction of its own bounding box). A circular reveal
// avoids straight clip edges on the cloud's diagonal lobes.
static const float kOneDriveBlobAnchorFrac[3][2] = {
    { 0.80f, 0.0f }, // left  -- top-right, attaches to the base
    { 0.50f, 1.0f }, // base  -- bottom-center, symmetric trunk
    { 0.20f, 0.0f }, // right -- top-left, attaches to the base (mirror)
};

// Blobs converge within the first ONEDRIVE_BLOB_CONVERGE_FRAC of the total
// duration; the remaining tail just holds the assembled icon steady before
// handing off to the settled render (no grow-overshoot pop -- removed).
static const DOUBLE ONEDRIVE_BLOB_CONVERGE_FRAC = 0.65;

static void DrawOneDriveWipeInCore(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr,
                                    float elapsedSec, bool inCabinetWClass,
                                    float baseOffX, float baseOffY) {
    // Fit against the combined icon's bounds so the wipe pieces land where
    // the fully-assembled icon (drawn by DrawSvgGlyph right after) will be.
    ID2D1PathGeometry* fullGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_ONEDRIVE[0], true);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* normalGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_ONEDRIVE[0], false);
    if (!fullGeom || !normalGeom) return;
    D2D1_RECT_F fullBounds;
    if (FAILED(fullGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &fullBounds))) return;
    const float contentW = fullBounds.right - fullBounds.left;
    const float contentH = fullBounds.bottom - fullBounds.top;
    if (contentW <= 0 || contentH <= 0) return;
    // Normal has its own bounds, distinct from Filled's -- DrawSvgGeom fits
    // each render independently to its own bounding box, so the ghost below
    // needs its own fit transform (normalScale/normalOffX/Y) or it lands at
    // a different position than the Normal render on screen a moment ago.
    D2D1_RECT_F normalBounds;
    if (FAILED(normalGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &normalBounds))) return;
    const float normalContentW = normalBounds.right - normalBounds.left;
    const float normalContentH = normalBounds.bottom - normalBounds.top;
    if (normalContentW <= 0 || normalContentH <= 0) return;

    const auto& defs = SvgIconDefs();
    auto defIt = defs.find(GLYPH_ONEDRIVE[0]);
    float cfgScale = (defIt != defs.end() &&
        IconIntroApplyConfigScale(GLYPH_ONEDRIVE[0], defIt->second.scaleOnlyInCabinet, inCabinetWClass))
        ? defIt->second.scale : 1.0f;

    const float targetW = float(rc.right - rc.left);
    const float targetH = float(rc.bottom - rc.top);
    const float scale = std::min(targetW / contentW, targetH / contentH) * cfgScale;
    const float offX  = baseOffX + (targetW - contentW * scale) / 2.0f - fullBounds.left * scale;
    const float offY  = baseOffY + (targetH - contentH * scale) / 2.0f - fullBounds.top  * scale;
    const float normalScale = std::min(targetW / normalContentW, targetH / normalContentH) * cfgScale;
    const float normalOffX  = baseOffX + (targetW - normalContentW * normalScale) / 2.0f - normalBounds.left * normalScale;
    const float normalOffY  = baseOffY + (targetH - normalContentH * normalScale) / 2.0f - normalBounds.top  * normalScale;
    const D2D1_COLOR_F clr = {
        GetRValue(cr) / 255.f, GetGValue(cr) / 255.f, GetBValue(cr) / 255.f, 1.0f };

    // The Normal render (what was already on screen right before this item
    // got selected) fades out over the first 20% of the whole animation --
    // long enough to read as a deliberate cross-dissolve into the
    // assembling blobs rather than a blink, continuing what was already
    // visible instead of a ghost of the *future* Filled state, which would
    // be a jarring flash of something that was never actually on screen.
    // Icons whose animation already starts by drawing Normal (Desktop,
    // Documents, ...) don't need this; this only affects the ones that
    // build up from an empty canvas.
    const float oneDriveGhostFadeDur = (float)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_ONEDRIVE * 0.20f;
    const float startGhostP = 1.0f - EaseOutCubic(std::min(1.0f, elapsedSec / oneDriveGhostFadeDur));

    if (startGhostP > 0.001f) {
        // Uses the Normal-fitted transform above, not Filled's -- reusing
        // Filled's made the ghost jump to a different vertical position.
        rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F(normalScale, 0, 0, normalScale, normalOffX, normalOffY));
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(clr.r, clr.g, clr.b, startGhostP)))
            rt->FillGeometry(normalGeom, brush);
    }
    if (!g_oneDriveWipeLayer || g_oneDriveWipeLayerRT != rt) {
        g_oneDriveWipeLayer.Reset();
        ID2D1Layer* rawLayer = nullptr;
        rt->CreateLayer(nullptr, &rawLayer);
        if (rawLayer) { g_oneDriveWipeLayer.Attach(rawLayer); g_oneDriveWipeLayerRT = rt; }
    }
    const D2D1::Matrix3x2F blobsFitTransform = D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY);
    rt->SetTransform(blobsFitTransform);
    if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, clr)) {
        const float convergeWindow = (float)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_ONEDRIVE * (float)ONEDRIVE_BLOB_CONVERGE_FRAC;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            ID2D1PathGeometry* blob = OneDriveBlobGeomEnsure(i);
            if (!blob) continue;
            D2D1_RECT_F bb;
            if (FAILED(blob->GetBounds(nullptr, &bb))) continue;

            const float delay = kOneDriveBlobDelay[i];
            const float dur   = convergeWindow - delay;
            float raw = (dur > 0.0f) ? (elapsedSec - delay) / dur : 1.0f;
            if (raw < 0.0f) raw = 0.0f;
            if (raw > 1.0f) raw = 1.0f;
            const float t = EaseOutCubic(raw);
            if (t <= 0.001f) continue;

            if (t >= 0.999f) {
                // Fully revealed -- draw the whole blob directly, no clip.
                // Guarantees a complete shape regardless of any margin math.
                rt->FillGeometry(blob, brush);
                continue;
            }

            const float anchorX = bb.left + (bb.right - bb.left) * kOneDriveBlobAnchorFrac[i][0];
            const float anchorY = bb.top  + (bb.bottom - bb.top) * kOneDriveBlobAnchorFrac[i][1];
            const D2D1_POINT_2F corners[4] = {
                { bb.left, bb.top }, { bb.right, bb.top }, { bb.left, bb.bottom }, { bb.right, bb.bottom }
            };
            float maxDist = 0.0f;
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
                float dx = corners[c].x - anchorX, dy = corners[c].y - anchorY;
                float dist = sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                if (dist > maxDist) maxDist = dist;
            }
            const float r = maxDist * 1.05f * t; // 5% margin so full coverage lands slightly before t=1

            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1EllipseGeometry> circle;
            if (g_d2dFactory && r > 0.001f) {
                ID2D1EllipseGeometry* rawCircle = nullptr;
                if (SUCCEEDED(g_d2dFactory->CreateEllipseGeometry(
                        D2D1::Ellipse(D2D1::Point2F(anchorX, anchorY), r, r), &rawCircle))) {
                    circle.Attach(rawCircle);
                }
            }
            if (circle) {
                rt->PushLayer(D2D1::LayerParameters(D2D1::InfiniteRect(), circle.Get()), g_oneDriveWipeLayer.Get());
                rt->FillGeometry(blob, brush);
                rt->PopLayer();
            }
        }
    }
    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
}

static void DrawOneDriveWipeIn(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, float elapsedSec, bool inCabinetWClass) {
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    {
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* raw = nullptr;
        RECT rcCopy = rc;
        if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcCopy, g_d2dFactory, &raw)) || !raw) return;
        rt.Attach(raw);
    }
    rt->BeginDraw();
    DrawOneDriveWipeInCore(rt.Get(), rc, cr, elapsedSec, inCabinetWClass, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    if (rt->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        rt.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
        g_oneDriveWipeLayer.Reset(); // belongs to the old device; recreated lazily next call
        g_oneDriveWipeLayerRT = nullptr;
    }
}

// ── This PC cross-fade intro ──────────────────────────────────────────────
// Cheaper stand-in for a circular reveal: draws Normal (the old, hollow
// render) fading out while Filled (the new, solid render) fades in on top,
// via brush alpha only -- no per-frame geometry allocation.
static void DrawCrossfadeSingleCore(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, wchar_t ch,
                                     float t, bool inCabinetWClass, float baseOffX, float baseOffY) {
    const auto& defs = SvgIconDefs();
    auto defIt = defs.find(ch);
    if (defIt == defs.end()) return;
    ID2D1PathGeometry* filledGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(ch, true);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* normalGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(ch, false);
    if (!filledGeom || !normalGeom) return;
    D2D1_RECT_F bounds;
    if (FAILED(filledGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &bounds))) return;
    const float contentW = bounds.right - bounds.left;
    const float contentH = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
    if (contentW <= 0 || contentH <= 0) return;

    bool applyConfigScale = IconIntroApplyConfigScale(ch, defIt->second.scaleOnlyInCabinet, inCabinetWClass);
    float cfgScale = applyConfigScale ? defIt->second.scale : 1.0f;

    const float targetW = float(rc.right - rc.left);
    const float targetH = float(rc.bottom - rc.top);
    const float scale = std::min(targetW / contentW, targetH / contentH) * cfgScale;
    const float offX  = baseOffX + (targetW - contentW * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.left * scale;
    const float offY  = baseOffY + (targetH - contentH * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.top  * scale;
    const float r = GetRValue(cr) / 255.f, g = GetGValue(cr) / 255.f, b = GetBValue(cr) / 255.f;

    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY));
    if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 1.0f - t)))
        rt->FillGeometry(normalGeom, brush);
    if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, t)))
        rt->FillGeometry(filledGeom, brush);
    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
}

static void DrawCrossfadeSingle(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, wchar_t ch, float t, bool inCabinetWClass) {
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    {
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* raw = nullptr;
        RECT rcCopy = rc;
        if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcCopy, g_d2dFactory, &raw)) || !raw) return;
        rt.Attach(raw);
    }
    rt->BeginDraw();
    DrawCrossfadeSingleCore(rt.Get(), rc, cr, ch, t, inCabinetWClass, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    if (rt->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        rt.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
}

// ── Desktop bloom-rise intro (phase 2, after the fade) ────────────────────
// The Bloom mark rises from behind the taskbar into the screen area,
// fades in, holds, then fades out before the pop takes over. The taskbar
// block is redrawn on top of the bloom so it appears to emerge from
// behind it, the same occlusion trick as the Pictures mountain/sun.
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_desktopHoleGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_desktopTaskbarGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_bloomGeom;

static ID2D1PathGeometry* DesktopPartGeomEnsure(Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry>& cache, const char* path) {
    if (cache) return cache.Get();
    if (!EnsureD2DFactory()) return nullptr;
    ID2D1PathGeometry* raw = nullptr;
    if (!SvgParsePathToGeometry(path, &raw) || !raw) return nullptr;
    cache.Attach(raw);
    return cache.Get();
}

static const DOUBLE DESKTOP_BLOOM_RISE_END = 0.55; // bloom reaches rest position by here
static const DOUBLE DESKTOP_BLOOM_HOLD_END = 0.75; // then holds, then fades out
static const float  DESKTOP_BLOOM_HEIGHT_FRAC = 0.92f; // of the screen hole's height
static const float  DESKTOP_BLOOM_RISE_MARGIN = 2.5f;  // starting offset below the hole

static void DrawDesktopBloomRiseCore(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr,
                                      float t, bool inCabinetWClass, float baseOffX, float baseOffY) {
    ID2D1PathGeometry* fullGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_DESKTOP[0], true);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* holeGeom = DesktopPartGeomEnsure(g_desktopHoleGeom, kSvgDesktopScreenHole);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* taskbarGeom = DesktopPartGeomEnsure(g_desktopTaskbarGeom, kSvgDesktopTaskbar);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* bloomGeom = DesktopPartGeomEnsure(g_bloomGeom, kSvgBloomGlyph);
    if (!fullGeom || !holeGeom || !taskbarGeom || !bloomGeom) return;

    D2D1_RECT_F bounds, hole, bloomB;
    if (FAILED(fullGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &bounds))) return;
    if (FAILED(holeGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &hole))) return;
    if (FAILED(bloomGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &bloomB))) return;
    const float contentW = bounds.right - bounds.left;
    const float contentH = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
    if (contentW <= 0 || contentH <= 0) return;

    const auto& defs = SvgIconDefs();
    auto defIt = defs.find(GLYPH_DESKTOP[0]);
    bool applyConfigScale = defIt != defs.end() &&
        IconIntroApplyConfigScale(GLYPH_DESKTOP[0], defIt->second.scaleOnlyInCabinet, inCabinetWClass);
    float cfgScale = applyConfigScale ? defIt->second.scale : 1.0f;

    // Bloom fit: DESKTOP_BLOOM_HEIGHT_FRAC of the hole's height, bottom edge
    // glued to the screen/taskbar divider, horizontally centered.
    const float holeH = hole.bottom - hole.top;
    const float bloomH = bloomB.bottom - bloomB.top;
    const float bloomScale = (holeH * DESKTOP_BLOOM_HEIGHT_FRAC) / bloomH;
    const float bloomCX = (bloomB.left + bloomB.right) / 2.0f;
    const float bloomCY = (bloomB.top + bloomB.bottom) / 2.0f;
    const float restX = (hole.left + hole.right) / 2.0f;
    const float restY = hole.bottom - (bloomH / 2.0f) * bloomScale;
    const float riseFrom = hole.bottom + DESKTOP_BLOOM_RISE_MARGIN;

    float riseP = std::min(1.0f, t / (float)DESKTOP_BLOOM_RISE_END);
    float e = EaseOutCubic(riseP);
    float curY = riseFrom + (restY - riseFrom) * e;

    float opacity;
    if (t < (float)DESKTOP_BLOOM_RISE_END) opacity = std::min(1.0f, riseP * 1.4f);
    else if (t < (float)DESKTOP_BLOOM_HOLD_END) opacity = 1.0f;
    else opacity = std::max(0.0f, 1.0f - (t - (float)DESKTOP_BLOOM_HOLD_END) / (1.0f - (float)DESKTOP_BLOOM_HOLD_END));

    const float targetW = float(rc.right - rc.left);
    const float targetH = float(rc.bottom - rc.top);
    const float scale = std::min(targetW / contentW, targetH / contentH) * cfgScale;
    const float offX  = baseOffX + (targetW - contentW * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.left * scale;
    const float offY  = baseOffY + (targetH - contentH * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.top  * scale;
    const D2D1::Matrix3x2F fitTransform = D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY);
    const float r = GetRValue(cr) / 255.f, g = GetGValue(cr) / 255.f, b = GetBValue(cr) / 255.f;

    rt->SetTransform(fitTransform);
    if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 1.0f)))
        rt->FillGeometry(fullGeom, brush); // whole monitor, incl. taskbar -- base layer

    // Bloom: move its own center to origin, scale, then move to its
    // animated position (local space) before applying the shared fit.
    rt->SetTransform(
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(-bloomCX, -bloomCY) *
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Scale(D2D1::SizeF(bloomScale, bloomScale)) *
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(restX, curY) *
        fitTransform);
    if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, opacity)))
        rt->FillGeometry(bloomGeom, brush);

    // Taskbar redrawn on top -- occludes the bloom wherever it overlaps.
    rt->SetTransform(fitTransform);
    if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 1.0f)))
        rt->FillGeometry(taskbarGeom, brush);

    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
}

static void DrawDesktopBloomRise(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, float t, bool inCabinetWClass) {
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    {
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* raw = nullptr;
        RECT rcCopy = rc;
        if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcCopy, g_d2dFactory, &raw)) || !raw) return;
        rt.Attach(raw);
    }
    rt->BeginDraw();
    DrawDesktopBloomRiseCore(rt.Get(), rc, cr, t, inCabinetWClass, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    if (rt->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        rt.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
}

// ── This PC CRT-on intro ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Mimics an old CRT powering on: a dot expands horizontally into a thin
// full-width line, then that line expands vertically into the full
// picture. Normal (outline) is drawn underneath, full and unclipped, so
// the stand/base stays visible throughout instead of only appearing once
// the vertical expand reaches down that far.
static const DOUBLE THISPC_CRT_H_EXPAND_END = 0.12; // dot -> full-width line
static const DOUBLE THISPC_CRT_V_EXPAND_END = 0.65; // line -> full picture
static const float  THISPC_CRT_MIN_FRAC     = 0.045f; // thin sliver thickness
static const float  THISPC_CRT_FLICKER_END  = 0.45f;  // brightness stutters settle by here
static const float  THISPC_CRT_JITTER_AMP   = 0.035f; // horizontal instability, fraction of halfW
// The CRT fill overlaps slightly with the handoff motion: as the picture
// stabilizes, the glyph compresses, emits a ripple, then springs back.
static const DOUBLE THISPC_SHRINK_START = 0.54;
static const DOUBLE THISPC_SHRINK_END   = 0.78;
static const DOUBLE THISPC_RIPPLE_START = 0.62;
static const DOUBLE THISPC_RIPPLE_END   = 0.96;
static const DOUBLE THISPC_SETTLE_END   = 1.00;
static const float  THISPC_SHRINK_SCALE = 0.84f;
static const float  THISPC_SETTLE_OVERSHOOT = 0.050f;

// A couple of sharp brightness dips that fade out as the tube stabilizes,
// instead of a perfectly smooth power-on.
static float ThisPcCrtFlicker(float t) {
    if (t > THISPC_CRT_FLICKER_END) return 1.0f;
    float decay = 1.0f - t / THISPC_CRT_FLICKER_END;
    float spike = powf(std::max(0.0f, sinf(t * 34.0f)), 6.0f);
    return 1.0f - spike * decay * 0.45f;
}

static void DrawThisPcCrtOnCore(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr,
                                 float t, bool inCabinetWClass, float baseOffX, float baseOffY) {
    ID2D1PathGeometry* normalGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_THISPC[0], false);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* filledGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_THISPC[0], true);
    if (!normalGeom || !filledGeom) return;

    D2D1_RECT_F bounds;
    if (FAILED(filledGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &bounds))) return;
    const float contentW = bounds.right - bounds.left;
    const float contentH = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
    if (contentW <= 0 || contentH <= 0) return;
    const float cx = (bounds.left + bounds.right) / 2.0f;
    const float cy = (bounds.top + bounds.bottom) / 2.0f;

    const auto& defs = SvgIconDefs();
