    auto defIt = defs.find(GLYPH_THISPC[0]);
    bool applyConfigScale = defIt != defs.end() && (defIt->second.scaleOnlyInCabinet ? inCabinetWClass : true);
    float cfgScale = applyConfigScale ? defIt->second.scale : 1.0f;

    float hp = std::min(1.0f, t / (float)THISPC_CRT_H_EXPAND_END);
    float he = EaseOutCubic(hp);
    float halfW = (contentW * (0.02f + 0.98f * he)) / 2.0f;

    float vp = std::max(0.0f, std::min(1.0f,
        (t - (float)THISPC_CRT_H_EXPAND_END) / ((float)THISPC_CRT_V_EXPAND_END - (float)THISPC_CRT_H_EXPAND_END)));
    float ve = EaseOutBackGentle(vp); // slight bloom overshoot instead of a flat settle
    float frac = THISPC_CRT_MIN_FRAC + (1.0f - THISPC_CRT_MIN_FRAC) * ve;
    float halfH = (contentH * frac) / 2.0f;

    // Small decaying horizontal wobble while the line is still thin -- reads
    // as signal instability instead of a perfectly clean wipe.
    float jitter = (vp < 1.0f)
        ? sinf(t * 55.0f) * THISPC_CRT_JITTER_AMP * (1.0f - vp) * halfW
        : 0.0f;

    const float targetW = float(rc.right - rc.left);
    const float targetH = float(rc.bottom - rc.top);
    const float scale = std::min(targetW / contentW, targetH / contentH) * cfgScale;
    const float offX  = baseOffX + (targetW - contentW * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.left * scale;
    const float offY  = baseOffY + (targetH - contentH * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.top  * scale;

    float bodyScale = 1.0f;
    if (t >= (float)THISPC_SHRINK_START && t < (float)THISPC_SHRINK_END) {
        float sp = (t - (float)THISPC_SHRINK_START) /
            ((float)THISPC_SHRINK_END - (float)THISPC_SHRINK_START);
        bodyScale = 1.0f - (1.0f - THISPC_SHRINK_SCALE) * EaseInOutCubic(sp);
    } else if (t >= (float)THISPC_SHRINK_END) {
        float settleP = std::min(1.0f, (t - (float)THISPC_SHRINK_END) /
            ((float)THISPC_SETTLE_END - (float)THISPC_SHRINK_END));
        float grow = EaseOutCubic(settleP);
        float overshoot = THISPC_SETTLE_OVERSHOOT *
            sinf(settleP * 3.14159265f) * powf(std::max(0.0f, 1.0f - settleP), 0.35f);
        bodyScale = THISPC_SHRINK_SCALE +
            (1.0f - THISPC_SHRINK_SCALE) * grow + overshoot;
    }

    const D2D1::Matrix3x2F baseFitTransform =
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY);
    const D2D1::Matrix3x2F fitTransform =
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(-cx, -cy) *
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Scale(D2D1::SizeF(bodyScale, bodyScale)) *
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(cx, cy) *
        baseFitTransform;
    const float r = GetRValue(cr) / 255.f, g = GetGValue(cr) / 255.f, b = GetBValue(cr) / 255.f;
    const float flicker = ThisPcCrtFlicker(t);
    const D2D1_RECT_F clip = D2D1::RectF(cx - halfW + jitter, cy - halfH, cx + halfW + jitter, cy + halfH);

    rt->SetTransform(fitTransform);
    if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 1.0f)))
        rt->FillGeometry(normalGeom, brush);
    if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brushFlicker = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, flicker))) {
        rt->PushAxisAlignedClip(clip, D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_PER_PRIMITIVE);
        rt->FillGeometry(filledGeom, brushFlicker);
        rt->PopAxisAlignedClip();
    }
    if (t >= (float)THISPC_RIPPLE_START && t < (float)THISPC_RIPPLE_END) {
        float rp = (t - (float)THISPC_RIPPLE_START) /
            ((float)THISPC_RIPPLE_END - (float)THISPC_RIPPLE_START);
        rp = std::clamp(rp, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        const float eased = rp * rp * rp * (rp * (rp * 6.0f - 15.0f) + 10.0f);
        const float contentMax = std::max(contentW, contentH);
        const float radius = contentMax * (0.10f + 0.58f * eased);
        const float fadeIn = EaseOutCubic(std::min(1.0f, rp / 0.16f));
        const float fadeOut = std::max(0.0f, 1.0f - eased);
        const float alpha = fadeIn * fadeOut;
        const float stroke = std::max(1.0f / std::max(0.1f, scale),
            contentMax * (0.105f - 0.040f * eased));
        if (alpha > 0.01f && stroke > 0.01f) {
            rt->SetTransform(baseFitTransform);
            D2D1_ELLIPSE ripple =
                D2D1::Ellipse(D2D1::Point2F(cx, cy), radius, radius);
            const float lum = r * 0.2126f + g * 0.7152f + b * 0.0722f;
            const D2D1_COLOR_F separator = lum > 0.5f
                ? D2D1::ColorF(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.44f * alpha)
                : D2D1::ColorF(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.42f * alpha);
            if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brushSeparator = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, separator))
                rt->DrawEllipse(ripple, brushSeparator, stroke * 1.55f);
            if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brushRipple =
                    GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 0.78f * alpha))) {
                rt->DrawEllipse(ripple, brushRipple, stroke);
            }
        }
    }
    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
}

static void DrawThisPcCrtOn(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, float t, bool inCabinetWClass) {
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    {
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* raw = nullptr;
        RECT rcCopy = rc;
        if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcCopy, g_d2dFactory, &raw)) || !raw) return;
        rt.Attach(raw);
    }
    rt->BeginDraw();
    DrawThisPcCrtOnCore(rt.Get(), rc, cr, t, inCabinetWClass, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    if (rt->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        rt.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
}

// ── Drive border-trace + blink intro ─────────────────────────────────────
// The card's outer border traces itself in (like a pen drawing the edge,
// via a dashed stroke whose reveal length grows with t), then the contact
// dot blinks like a light being switched on, then the whole thing
// crossfades into the normal Filled render (which fills the interior and
// turns the dot into a real geometric cutout) to hand off to the pop.
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_driveOuterGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_driveInnerGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_driveDotGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1Layer> g_driveTraceLayer;
// See g_oneDriveWipeLayerRT for why this staleness check is needed.
static ID2D1RenderTarget* g_driveTraceLayerRT = nullptr; // identity check only, any RT type
static float g_driveOuterLen = -1.0f;
static float g_driveBorderThickness = -1.0f;

static ID2D1PathGeometry* DrivePartGeomEnsure(Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry>& cache, const char* path) {
    if (cache) return cache.Get();
    if (!EnsureD2DFactory()) return nullptr;
    ID2D1PathGeometry* raw = nullptr;
    if (!SvgParsePathToGeometry(path, &raw) || !raw) return nullptr;
    cache.Attach(raw);
    return cache.Get();
}

// Each blink phase is a real ~90-130ms at the default total duration --
// short phases (the original ~65-85ms) render too few frames to read as a
// distinct pulse.
static const DOUBLE DRIVE_TRACE_END  = 0.40; // border traces in
static const DOUBLE DRIVE_BLINK1_END = 0.53; // dot flashes on
static const DOUBLE DRIVE_DIP_END    = 0.64; // dips
static const DOUBLE DRIVE_BLINK2_END = 0.80; // flashes on again, settles
static const DOUBLE DRIVE_FADE_START = 0.80; // crossfade trace+dot -> Filled

static float DriveDotBlinkAlpha(float t) {
    if (t < (float)DRIVE_TRACE_END) return 0.0f;
    if (t < (float)DRIVE_BLINK1_END)
        return EaseOutCubic((t - (float)DRIVE_TRACE_END) / ((float)DRIVE_BLINK1_END - (float)DRIVE_TRACE_END));
    if (t < (float)DRIVE_DIP_END)
        return 1.0f - 0.85f * EaseOutCubic((t - (float)DRIVE_BLINK1_END) / ((float)DRIVE_DIP_END - (float)DRIVE_BLINK1_END));
    if (t < (float)DRIVE_BLINK2_END)
        return 0.15f + 0.85f * EaseOutCubic((t - (float)DRIVE_DIP_END) / ((float)DRIVE_BLINK2_END - (float)DRIVE_DIP_END));
    return 1.0f;
}

static void DrawDriveSwirlOnCore(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr,
                                  float t, bool inCabinetWClass, float baseOffX, float baseOffY) {
    ID2D1PathGeometry* ringGeom   = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_DRIVE[0], false); // hollow ring + dot; used as the trace's clip mask
    ID2D1PathGeometry* outerGeom  = DrivePartGeomEnsure(g_driveOuterGeom, kSvgDriveOuter);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* innerGeom  = DrivePartGeomEnsure(g_driveInnerGeom, kSvgDriveInner);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* dotGeom    = DrivePartGeomEnsure(g_driveDotGeom, kSvgDriveDot);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* filledGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_DRIVE[0], true);
    if (!ringGeom || !outerGeom || !innerGeom || !dotGeom || !filledGeom) return;

    D2D1_RECT_F bounds;
    if (FAILED(ringGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &bounds))) return;
    const float contentW = bounds.right - bounds.left;
    const float contentH = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
    if (contentW <= 0 || contentH <= 0) return;

    if (g_driveOuterLen < 0.0f) {
        FLOAT len = 0.0f;
        if (FAILED(outerGeom->ComputeLength(nullptr, &len))) return;
        g_driveOuterLen = len;
    }
    if (g_driveBorderThickness < 0.0f) {
        D2D1_RECT_F innerBounds;
        if (FAILED(innerGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &innerBounds))) return;
        float thicknessV = (contentH - (innerBounds.bottom - innerBounds.top)) / 2.0f;
        float thicknessH = (contentW - (innerBounds.right - innerBounds.left)) / 2.0f;
        g_driveBorderThickness = (thicknessV + thicknessH) / 2.0f;
    }

    const auto& defs = SvgIconDefs();
    auto defIt = defs.find(GLYPH_DRIVE[0]);
    bool applyConfigScale = defIt != defs.end() &&
        IconIntroApplyConfigScale(GLYPH_DRIVE[0], defIt->second.scaleOnlyInCabinet, inCabinetWClass);
    float cfgScale = applyConfigScale ? defIt->second.scale : 1.0f;

    float traceP = EaseOutCubic(std::min(1.0f, t / (float)DRIVE_TRACE_END));
    float dotA = DriveDotBlinkAlpha(t);
    float fadeP = 0.0f;
    if (t > (float)DRIVE_FADE_START)
        fadeP = EaseOutCubic((t - (float)DRIVE_FADE_START) / (1.0f - (float)DRIVE_FADE_START));
    // The Normal render fades out over the first 15ms (as a fraction of the
    // total duration) -- without it, the trace starts from zero length and
    // the dot/fade are also both zero at t=0, so the icon reads as a blank
    // flash the instant it's selected, instead of continuing from what was
    // already on screen.
    const float driveStartGhostP = 1.0f - std::min(1.0f, t / (0.015f / (float)ICON_POP_WIPE_DUR_DRIVE));

    if (!g_driveTraceLayer || g_driveTraceLayerRT != rt) {
        g_driveTraceLayer.Reset();
        ID2D1Layer* rawLayer = nullptr;
        rt->CreateLayer(nullptr, &rawLayer);
        if (!rawLayer) return;
        g_driveTraceLayer.Attach(rawLayer);
        g_driveTraceLayerRT = rt;
    }

    const float targetW = float(rc.right - rc.left);
    const float targetH = float(rc.bottom - rc.top);
    const float scale = std::min(targetW / contentW, targetH / contentH) * cfgScale;
    const float offX  = baseOffX + (targetW - contentW * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.left * scale;
    const float offY  = baseOffY + (targetH - contentH * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.top  * scale;
    const D2D1::Matrix3x2F fitTransform = D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY);
    const float r = GetRValue(cr) / 255.f, g = GetGValue(cr) / 255.f, b = GetBValue(cr) / 255.f;

    // Stroke width matches the ring's real border thickness (measured at
    // runtime above), with a small margin so the ring-shaped clip mask
    // fully covers it. A flat cap keeps the moving dash tip a clean edge --
    // a round cap at this width would bulge into the hollow center as it
    // traveled, which read as a jerky blob instead of a smooth-drawn line.
    const float strokeWidthPx = g_driveBorderThickness * 1.15f;
    const float revealedLen = g_driveOuterLen * traceP;
    FLOAT dashes[2] = {
        revealedLen / strokeWidthPx,
        (g_driveOuterLen * 2.0f) / strokeWidthPx
    };
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1StrokeStyle> strokeStyle;
    if (g_d2dFactory && dashes[0] > 0.0f) {
        g_d2dFactory->CreateStrokeStyle(
            D2D1::StrokeStyleProperties(D2D1_CAP_STYLE_FLAT, D2D1_CAP_STYLE_FLAT, D2D1_CAP_STYLE_FLAT,
                                         D2D1_LINE_JOIN_ROUND, 10.0f, D2D1_DASH_STYLE_CUSTOM, 0.0f),
            dashes, 2, &strokeStyle);
    }

    rt->SetTransform(fitTransform);
    if (driveStartGhostP > 0.001f) {
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, driveStartGhostP)))
            rt->FillGeometry(ringGeom, brush);
    }
    if (dashes[0] > 0.0f && strokeStyle) {
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 1.0f - fadeP))) {
            rt->PushLayer(D2D1::LayerParameters(D2D1::InfiniteRect(), ringGeom), g_driveTraceLayer.Get());
            rt->DrawGeometry(outerGeom, brush, strokeWidthPx, strokeStyle.Get());
            rt->PopLayer();
        }
    }
    if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, dotA * (1.0f - fadeP))))
        rt->FillGeometry(dotGeom, brush);
    if (fadeP > 0.0f) {
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, fadeP)))
            rt->FillGeometry(filledGeom, brush);
    }
    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
}

static void DrawDriveSwirlOn(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, float t, bool inCabinetWClass) {
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    {
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* raw = nullptr;
        RECT rcCopy = rc;
        if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcCopy, g_d2dFactory, &raw)) || !raw) return;
        rt.Attach(raw);
    }
    rt->BeginDraw();
    DrawDriveSwirlOnCore(rt.Get(), rc, cr, t, inCabinetWClass, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    if (rt->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        rt.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
        g_driveTraceLayer.Reset(); // belongs to the old device; recreated lazily next call
        g_driveTraceLayerRT = nullptr;
    }
}

// ── CD/DVD facet-spin intro ───────────────────────────────────────────────
// Phase 1: crossfade Normal (outline rings) -> Intermediate (solid disc+hub
// with two capsule holes near the edge). Phase 2: spins Intermediate a full
// turn at constant angular velocity (easing made the holes race/crawl
// unevenly). Phase 3: patches the holes back in, ending pixel-identical to
// Filled -- not a crossfade to Filled, since the two near-identical solid
// discs would double-expose and flash toward the background color mid-fade.
// Holes are baked into the static path (opposite winding), not runtime
// masks/boolean combines, which caused contour artifacts.
static const float CDROM_FADE1_FRAC = 0.30f; // fraction of the total duration spent crossfading to Intermediate
static const float CDROM_SPIN_FRAC  = 0.38f; // fraction spent spinning Intermediate (remainder patches the holes back in)
static const float CDROM_SPIN_DEG   = 360.0f; // one full turn -- ends at the same orientation it started

static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_cdromIntermediateGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_cdromHolesGeom;

static ID2D1PathGeometry* CdromIntermediateGeomEnsure() {
    if (g_cdromIntermediateGeom) return g_cdromIntermediateGeom.Get();
    if (!EnsureD2DFactory()) return nullptr;
    ID2D1PathGeometry* raw = nullptr;
    if (!SvgParsePathToGeometry(kSvgCdromIntermediate, &raw) || !raw) return nullptr;
    g_cdromIntermediateGeom.Attach(raw);
    return g_cdromIntermediateGeom.Get();
}

static ID2D1PathGeometry* CdromHolesGeomEnsure() {
    if (g_cdromHolesGeom) return g_cdromHolesGeom.Get();
    if (!EnsureD2DFactory()) return nullptr;
    ID2D1PathGeometry* raw = nullptr;
    if (!SvgParsePathToGeometry(kSvgCdromHoles, &raw) || !raw) return nullptr;
    g_cdromHolesGeom.Attach(raw);
    return g_cdromHolesGeom.Get();
}

static void DrawCdromFacetSpinInCore(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr,
                                      float t, bool inCabinetWClass, float baseOffX, float baseOffY) {
    ID2D1PathGeometry* normalGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_CDROM[0], false);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* interGeom  = CdromIntermediateGeomEnsure();
    ID2D1PathGeometry* holesGeom  = CdromHolesGeomEnsure();
    if (!normalGeom || !interGeom || !holesGeom || !g_d2dFactory) return;

    D2D1_RECT_F bounds;
    if (FAILED(normalGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &bounds))) return;
    const float contentW = bounds.right - bounds.left;
    const float contentH = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
    if (contentW <= 0 || contentH <= 0) return;

    const auto& defs = SvgIconDefs();
    auto defIt = defs.find(GLYPH_CDROM[0]);
    float cfgScale = (defIt != defs.end() &&
        IconIntroApplyConfigScale(GLYPH_CDROM[0], defIt->second.scaleOnlyInCabinet, inCabinetWClass))
        ? defIt->second.scale : 1.0f;

    const float targetW = float(rc.right - rc.left);
    const float targetH = float(rc.bottom - rc.top);
    const float scale = std::min(targetW / contentW, targetH / contentH) * cfgScale;
    const float offX  = baseOffX + (targetW - contentW * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.left * scale;
    const float offY  = baseOffY + (targetH - contentH * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.top  * scale;
    const D2D1::Matrix3x2F fitTransform = D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY);
    const float r = GetRValue(cr) / 255.f, g = GetGValue(cr) / 255.f, b = GetBValue(cr) / 255.f;

    float tc = std::clamp(t, 0.0f, 1.0f);

    if (tc < CDROM_FADE1_FRAC) {
        float fadeP = EaseOutCubic(tc / CDROM_FADE1_FRAC);
        rt->SetTransform(fitTransform);
        if (fadeP < 0.999f) {
            if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 1.0f - fadeP)))
                rt->FillGeometry(normalGeom, brush);
        }
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, fadeP)))
            rt->FillGeometry(interGeom, brush);
    } else if (tc < CDROM_FADE1_FRAC + CDROM_SPIN_FRAC) {
        // Linear, not eased -- a real spinning disc holds constant angular
        // velocity, and easing a full 360 makes the two visible holes race
        // through the middle of the turn then crawl at the ends, which reads
        // as uneven/stuttery rather than smooth.
        float spinT = (tc - CDROM_FADE1_FRAC) / CDROM_SPIN_FRAC;
        float spinDeg = spinT * CDROM_SPIN_DEG;
        // Rotation pivot is the target rect's own center (baseOffX/Y-relative,
        // since targetW/H are rc-local sizes, not absolute positions) -- same
        // point regardless of where rc sits within a larger shared surface.
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F rotate = D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Rotation(spinDeg,
            D2D1::Point2F(baseOffX + targetW * 0.5f, baseOffY + targetH * 0.5f));
        rt->SetTransform(fitTransform * rotate);
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 1.0f)))
            rt->FillGeometry(interGeom, brush);
    } else {
        // Linear, not eased, for the same reason as the spin above. The
        // disc body is drawn once at full alpha and never touched again --
        // only the holes-only patch fades in on top, so the two draws never
        // overlap and there's nothing to double-blend or flash.
        float fadeP = std::clamp((tc - CDROM_FADE1_FRAC - CDROM_SPIN_FRAC) / (1.0f - CDROM_FADE1_FRAC - CDROM_SPIN_FRAC), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        rt->SetTransform(fitTransform);
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 1.0f)))
            rt->FillGeometry(interGeom, brush);
        if (fadeP > 0.001f) {
            if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, fadeP)))
                rt->FillGeometry(holesGeom, brush);
        }
    }

    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
}

static void DrawCdromFacetSpinIn(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, float t, bool inCabinetWClass) {
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    {
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* raw = nullptr;
        RECT rcCopy = rc;
        if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcCopy, g_d2dFactory, &raw)) || !raw) return;
        rt.Attach(raw);
    }
    rt->BeginDraw();
    DrawCdromFacetSpinInCore(rt.Get(), rc, cr, t, inCabinetWClass, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    if (rt->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        rt.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
}

// ── Home shrink-door-fill intro ───────────────────────────────────────────
// The house shrinks slightly, holds there while it crossfades from Normal
// to Filled while the door cutout grows past its final size, then settles,
// then grows back to full size. Inverse layer masks keep the animated door
// transparent to the real item background without boolean geometry combines.
static const DOUBLE HOME_SHRINK_END   = 0.10; // brief hold before fill motion
static const DOUBLE HOME_FILL_END     = 0.75; // crossfade + door overshoot
static const DOUBLE HOME_RISE_END     = 0.90; // door motion handoff
static const DOUBLE HOME_BODY_DIP_END = 0.86; // body shrinks after the door settles
static const float  HOME_BODY_DIP_SCALE = 0.965f;
static const float  HOME_DOOR_UNDERSHOOT_SCALE = 0.96f;
// Fraction of the shrink-fill window that's a pure pause -- house just sits
// still (still Normal/outline) before the crossfade/door motion begins.
static const float HOME_DOOR_PAUSE_FRAC = 0.06f;
static const float HOME_CROSSFADE_START_FRAC = 0.50f;

static ID2D1Layer* HomeDoorHdcMaskLayerEnsure(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt)
{
    if (!rt)
        return nullptr;

    D2DThreadCache* cache = D2DGetThreadCache();
    if (!cache)
        return nullptr;

    if (!cache->homeDoorMaskLayer || cache->homeDoorMaskLayerRT != rt) {
        if (cache->homeDoorMaskLayer) {
            cache->homeDoorMaskLayer->Release();
            cache->homeDoorMaskLayer = nullptr;
        }
        cache->homeDoorMaskLayerRT = nullptr;

        ID2D1Layer* layer = nullptr;
        if (SUCCEEDED(rt->CreateLayer(nullptr, &layer)) && layer) {
            cache->homeDoorMaskLayer = layer;
            cache->homeDoorMaskLayerRT = rt;
        }
    }

    return cache->homeDoorMaskLayer;
}

// Called only from the DComp draw path while g_pillDCMutex is held.
static ID2D1Layer* HomeDoorDCompMaskLayerEnsureLocked(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt)
{
    if (!rt || rt != g_pillDC.pD2DDC)
        return nullptr;

    if (!g_pillDC.pHomeDoorMaskLayer) {
        ID2D1Layer* layer = nullptr;
        if (FAILED(rt->CreateLayer(nullptr, &layer)) || !layer)
            return nullptr;
        g_pillDC.pHomeDoorMaskLayer = layer;
    }

    return g_pillDC.pHomeDoorMaskLayer;
}

static ID2D1RectangleGeometry* HomeDoorMaskOuterGeometryEnsure(
    const D2D1_RECT_F& rect)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_svgGeomCacheMutex);
    if (!g_homeDoorMaskOuterGeometry) {
        if (!g_d2dFactory)
            return nullptr;

        ID2D1RectangleGeometry* geometry = nullptr;
        HRESULT hr = g_d2dFactory->CreateRectangleGeometry(rect, &geometry);
        if (FAILED(hr) || !geometry)
            return nullptr;
        g_homeDoorMaskOuterGeometry.Attach(geometry);
    }

    return g_homeDoorMaskOuterGeometry.Get();
}

static bool HomeBuildInverseDoorMask(
    ID2D1Geometry* outer, ID2D1Geometry* hole,
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GeometryGroup>& mask)
{
    if (!g_d2dFactory || !outer || !hole)
        return false;

    ID2D1Geometry* parts[] = {outer, hole};
    HRESULT hr = g_d2dFactory->CreateGeometryGroup(
        D2D1_FILL_MODE_ALTERNATE, parts, ARRAYSIZE(parts), &mask);
    return SUCCEEDED(hr) && mask;
}

static void DrawHomeDoorFillInCore(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr,
                                    float t, bool inCabinetWClass, float baseOffX, float baseOffY,
                                    ID2D1Layer* doorMaskLayer) {
    ID2D1PathGeometry* normalGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_HOME[0], false);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* filledGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_HOME[0], true);
    if (!normalGeom || !filledGeom || !g_d2dFactory) return;

    D2D1_RECT_F bounds;
    if (FAILED(normalGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &bounds))) return;
    const float contentW = bounds.right - bounds.left;
    const float contentH = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
    if (contentW <= 0 || contentH <= 0) return;

    const auto& defs = SvgIconDefs();
    auto defIt = defs.find(GLYPH_HOME[0]);
    bool applyConfigScale = defIt != defs.end() && (defIt->second.scaleOnlyInCabinet ? inCabinetWClass : true);
    float cfgScale = applyConfigScale ? defIt->second.scale : 1.0f;

    float bodyScale = 1.0f;
    float crossfadeP = 0.0f;
    if (t < (float)HOME_SHRINK_END) {
        bodyScale = 1.0f;
    } else if (t < (float)HOME_FILL_END) {
        bodyScale = 1.0f;
        float fillRaw = (t - (float)HOME_SHRINK_END) / ((float)HOME_FILL_END - (float)HOME_SHRINK_END);
        if (fillRaw < HOME_DOOR_PAUSE_FRAC) {
            crossfadeP = 0.0f; // pure pause before the door/fill begins
        } else {
            float dp = (fillRaw - HOME_DOOR_PAUSE_FRAC) / (1.0f - HOME_DOOR_PAUSE_FRAC);
            if (dp < HOME_CROSSFADE_START_FRAC) {
                crossfadeP = 0.0f;
            } else {
                crossfadeP = EaseOutCubic((dp - HOME_CROSSFADE_START_FRAC) /
                                          (1.0f - HOME_CROSSFADE_START_FRAC));
            }
            if (dp < 0.48f) {
                bodyScale = 1.0f - 0.010f * EaseOutCubic(dp / 0.48f);
            } else if (dp < 0.78f) {
                bodyScale = 0.990f + 0.020f * EaseOutCubic((dp - 0.48f) / 0.30f);
            } else {
                bodyScale = 1.010f - 0.010f * EaseInOutCubic((dp - 0.78f) / 0.22f);
            }
        }
    } else if (t < (float)HOME_BODY_DIP_END) {
        float p = EaseInOutCubic((t - (float)HOME_FILL_END) /
                                 ((float)HOME_BODY_DIP_END - (float)HOME_FILL_END));
        bodyScale = 1.0f - (1.0f - HOME_BODY_DIP_SCALE) * p;
        crossfadeP = 1.0f;
    } else {
        float p = EaseOutCubic((t - (float)HOME_BODY_DIP_END) /
                               (1.0f - (float)HOME_BODY_DIP_END));
        bodyScale = HOME_BODY_DIP_SCALE + (1.0f - HOME_BODY_DIP_SCALE) * p;
        crossfadeP = 1.0f;
    }

    const float targetW = float(rc.right - rc.left);
    const float targetH = float(rc.bottom - rc.top);
    const float scale = std::min(targetW / contentW, targetH / contentH) * cfgScale;
    const float offX  = baseOffX + (targetW - contentW * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.left * scale;
    const float offY  = baseOffY + (targetH - contentH * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.top  * scale;
    const float cx = bounds.left + contentW / 2.0f, cy = bounds.top + contentH / 2.0f;
    const D2D1::Matrix3x2F plainFitTransform = D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY);
    const D2D1::Matrix3x2F fitTransform =
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(-cx, -cy) *
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Scale(D2D1::SizeF(bodyScale, bodyScale)) *
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(cx, cy) *
        plainFitTransform;
    const float r = GetRValue(cr) / 255.f, g = GetGValue(cr) / 255.f, b = GetBValue(cr) / 255.f;

    const float finalDoorW = contentW * 0.215f;
    const float finalDoorH = contentH * 0.355f;
    const float finalDoorTop = bounds.bottom - finalDoorH;
    const float finalDoorBottom = bounds.bottom + finalDoorH * 0.42f;
    const float finalDoorRadius = finalDoorW * 0.26f;
    const float doorStroke = finalDoorW * 0.18f;

    float doorScale = 1.0f;
    bool doorActive = false;
    if (t >= (float)HOME_SHRINK_END && t < (float)HOME_RISE_END) {
        float fillRaw = (t - (float)HOME_SHRINK_END) / ((float)HOME_FILL_END - (float)HOME_SHRINK_END);
        if (fillRaw >= HOME_DOOR_PAUSE_FRAC) {
            float dp = (t - (float)HOME_SHRINK_END -
                        ((float)HOME_FILL_END - (float)HOME_SHRINK_END) * HOME_DOOR_PAUSE_FRAC) /
                       ((float)HOME_RISE_END - (float)HOME_SHRINK_END -
                        ((float)HOME_FILL_END - (float)HOME_SHRINK_END) * HOME_DOOR_PAUSE_FRAC);
            dp = std::clamp(dp, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            doorActive = true;
            if (dp < 0.48f) {
                doorScale = 0.50f + (1.60f - 0.50f) * EaseOutBackGentle(dp / 0.48f);
            } else if (dp < 0.78f) {
                doorScale = 1.60f - (1.60f - HOME_DOOR_UNDERSHOOT_SCALE) * EaseOutCubic((dp - 0.48f) / 0.30f);
            } else {
                doorScale = HOME_DOOR_UNDERSHOOT_SCALE +
                    (1.0f - HOME_DOOR_UNDERSHOOT_SCALE) * EaseOutBackGentle((dp - 0.78f) / 0.22f);
            }
        }
    }

    const float doorW = finalDoorW * doorScale;
    const float doorH = finalDoorH * doorScale;
    const float doorTop = bounds.bottom - doorH;
    const float doorBottom = bounds.bottom + doorH * 0.42f;
    D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT finalDoor = D2D1::RoundedRect(
        D2D1::RectF(cx - finalDoorW * 0.5f, finalDoorTop,
                    cx + finalDoorW * 0.5f, finalDoorBottom),
        finalDoorRadius, finalDoorRadius);
    D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT animatedDoor = D2D1::RoundedRect(
        D2D1::RectF(cx - doorW * 0.5f, doorTop,
                    cx + doorW * 0.5f, doorBottom),
        finalDoorRadius * doorScale, finalDoorRadius * doorScale);

    auto drawDoorOutline = [&](float alpha) {
        if (alpha <= 0.01f || !g_d2dFactory)
            return;

        ID2D1PathGeometry* raw = nullptr;
        if (FAILED(g_d2dFactory->CreatePathGeometry(&raw)) || !raw)
            return;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> doorGeom;
        doorGeom.Attach(raw);
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GeometrySink> sink;
        if (FAILED(doorGeom->Open(&sink)))
            return;

        const float left = cx - doorW * 0.5f;
        const float right = cx + doorW * 0.5f;
        const float top = doorTop;
        const float bottom = doorBottom;
        const float rad = (std::min)(finalDoorRadius * doorScale, doorW * 0.5f);
        const float k = 0.55228475f;

        sink->BeginFigure(D2D1::Point2F(left, bottom), D2D1_FIGURE_BEGIN_HOLLOW);
        sink->AddLine(D2D1::Point2F(left, top + rad));
        sink->AddBezier(D2D1::BezierSegment(
            D2D1::Point2F(left, top + rad * (1.0f - k)),
            D2D1::Point2F(left + rad * (1.0f - k), top),
            D2D1::Point2F(left + rad, top)));
        sink->AddLine(D2D1::Point2F(right - rad, top));
        sink->AddBezier(D2D1::BezierSegment(
            D2D1::Point2F(right - rad * (1.0f - k), top),
            D2D1::Point2F(right, top + rad * (1.0f - k)),
            D2D1::Point2F(right, top + rad)));
        sink->AddLine(D2D1::Point2F(right, bottom));
        sink->EndFigure(D2D1_FIGURE_END_OPEN);
        if (FAILED(sink->Close()))
            return;

        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, alpha)))
            rt->DrawGeometry(doorGeom.Get(), brush, doorStroke);
    };

    rt->SetTransform(fitTransform);
    const D2D1_RECT_F maskOuter = D2D1::RectF(
        bounds.left - contentW, bounds.top - contentH,
        bounds.right + contentW, bounds.bottom + contentH);
    ID2D1RectangleGeometry* maskOuterGeometry =
        HomeDoorMaskOuterGeometryEnsure(maskOuter);

    auto fillOutsideDoor = [&](ID2D1Geometry* geometry,
                               ID2D1Brush* brush,
                               ID2D1Geometry* doorHole) {
        if (!geometry || !brush || !doorMaskLayer || !maskOuterGeometry)
            return false;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GeometryGroup> mask;
        if (!HomeBuildInverseDoorMask(
                maskOuterGeometry, doorHole, mask))
            return false;

        rt->PushLayer(
            D2D1::LayerParameters(D2D1::InfiniteRect(), mask.Get()),
            doorMaskLayer);
        rt->FillGeometry(geometry, brush);
        rt->PopLayer();
        return true;
    };

    if (crossfadeP < 1.0f) {
        ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(
            rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 1.0f - crossfadeP));
        bool bodyDrawn = false;
        float outlineAlpha = 0.0f;
        if (doorActive) {
            float coverLeft = (std::min)(cx - finalDoorW * 0.5f, cx - doorW * 0.5f) - doorStroke;
            float coverTop = (std::min)(finalDoorTop, doorTop) - doorStroke;
            float coverRight = (std::max)(cx + finalDoorW * 0.5f, cx + doorW * 0.5f) + doorStroke;
            float coverBottom = (std::max)(bounds.bottom, doorBottom) + doorStroke;
            D2D1_RECT_F normalDoorCover = D2D1::RectF(
                coverLeft, coverTop, coverRight, coverBottom);
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1RectangleGeometry> doorHole;
            if (SUCCEEDED(g_d2dFactory->CreateRectangleGeometry(
                    normalDoorCover, &doorHole))) {
                bodyDrawn = fillOutsideDoor(normalGeom, brush,
                                             doorHole.Get());
            }
            outlineAlpha = 1.0f - crossfadeP;
        }
        if (!bodyDrawn && brush)
            rt->FillGeometry(normalGeom, brush);
        drawDoorOutline(outlineAlpha * outlineAlpha);
    }
    if (crossfadeP > 0.0f) {
        ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(
            rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, crossfadeP));
        bool bodyDrawn = false;
        if (doorActive && brush) {
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1RoundedRectangleGeometry> doorHole;
            if (SUCCEEDED(g_d2dFactory->CreateRoundedRectangleGeometry(
                    animatedDoor, &doorHole)) && doorMaskLayer) {
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GeometryGroup> mask;
                if (HomeBuildInverseDoorMask(
                        maskOuterGeometry, doorHole.Get(), mask)) {
                    rt->PushLayer(
                        D2D1::LayerParameters(D2D1::InfiniteRect(), mask.Get()),
                        doorMaskLayer);
                    rt->FillGeometry(filledGeom, brush);
                    rt->FillRoundedRectangle(finalDoor, brush);
                    rt->PopLayer();
                    bodyDrawn = true;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!bodyDrawn && brush)
            rt->FillGeometry(filledGeom, brush);
    }

    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
}

static void DrawHomeDoorFillIn(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, float t, bool inCabinetWClass) {
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    {
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* raw = nullptr;
        RECT rcCopy = rc;
        if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcCopy, g_d2dFactory, &raw)) || !raw) return;
        rt.Attach(raw);
    }
    rt->BeginDraw();
    ID2D1Layer* doorMaskLayer = HomeDoorHdcMaskLayerEnsure(rt.Get());
    DrawHomeDoorFillInCore(rt.Get(), rc, cr, t, inCabinetWClass,
                           0.0f, 0.0f, doorMaskLayer);
    if (rt->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        rt.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
}

// ── Documents fold-in intro ───────────────────────────────────────────────
// The resting shape is already folded (dog-ear, outline color) -- on
// selection it unfolds flat, then folds back in as it crossfades straight
// into the real Filled render (also folded + accent color). A small settle
// pulse makes it read as paper flexing rather than a flat crossfade.
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_docsFlatGeom;

static ID2D1PathGeometry* DocumentsPartGeomEnsure(Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry>& cache, const char* path) {
    if (cache) return cache.Get();
    if (!EnsureD2DFactory()) return nullptr;
    ID2D1PathGeometry* raw = nullptr;
    if (!SvgParsePathToGeometry(path, &raw) || !raw) return nullptr;
    cache.Attach(raw);
    return cache.Get();
}

static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_libraryLeftGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_libraryCenterGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_libraryRightGeom;

static void DrawFavoritesPulseFillInCore(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr,
                                          float t, bool inCabinetWClass, float baseOffX, float baseOffY)
{
    ID2D1PathGeometry* normalGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_FAVORITES[0], false);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* filledGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_FAVORITES[0], true);
    if (!normalGeom || !filledGeom || !g_d2dFactory)
        return;

    D2D1_RECT_F bounds;
    if (FAILED(normalGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &bounds))) return;
    const float contentW = bounds.right - bounds.left;
    const float contentH = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
    if (contentW <= 0 || contentH <= 0) return;

    const auto& defs = SvgIconDefs();
    auto defIt = defs.find(GLYPH_FAVORITES[0]);
    bool applyConfigScale = defIt != defs.end() && (defIt->second.scaleOnlyInCabinet ? inCabinetWClass : true);
    float cfgScale = applyConfigScale ? defIt->second.scale : 1.0f;

    const float targetW = float(rc.right - rc.left);
    const float targetH = float(rc.bottom - rc.top);
    const float scale = std::min(targetW / contentW, targetH / contentH) * cfgScale;
    const float offX = baseOffX + (targetW - contentW * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.left * scale;
    const float offY = baseOffY + (targetH - contentH * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.top * scale;
    const D2D1::Matrix3x2F fit = D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY);
    const float cx = bounds.left + contentW * 0.5f;
    const float cy = bounds.top + contentH * 0.5f;
    const float r = GetRValue(cr) / 255.f, g = GetGValue(cr) / 255.f, b = GetBValue(cr) / 255.f;

    float fillAlpha = 1.0f;
    float iconScale = 1.0f;
    float fillPulseScale = 1.0f;
    if (t < 0.72f) {
        float cycle = t / 0.36f;
        float phase = cycle - floorf(cycle);
        float wave = sinf(phase * 3.14159265f);
        float envelope = 1.0f - 0.22f * std::floor(cycle);
        envelope = std::clamp(envelope, 0.50f, 1.0f);
        fillAlpha = 0.18f + 0.78f * wave * envelope;
        iconScale = 0.94f + 0.07f * wave * envelope;
        fillPulseScale = std::clamp(0.82f + 0.19f * EaseOutBackGentle(wave),
                                    0.80f, 1.03f);
    } else {
        float settle = EaseOutCubic(std::clamp((t - 0.72f) / 0.28f, 0.0f, 1.0f));
        fillAlpha = 0.55f + 0.45f * settle;
        iconScale = 1.02f - 0.02f * settle;
        fillPulseScale = 1.03f - 0.03f * settle;
    }

    D2D1::Matrix3x2F iconFit =
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(-cx, -cy) *
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Scale(D2D1::SizeF(iconScale, iconScale)) *
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(cx, cy) *
        fit;

    D2D1::Matrix3x2F fillFit =
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(-cx, -cy) *
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Scale(D2D1::SizeF(fillPulseScale, fillPulseScale)) *
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(cx, cy) *
        iconFit;

    rt->SetTransform(iconFit);
    if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* outline =
            GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 1.0f - fillAlpha * 0.35f))) {
        rt->FillGeometry(normalGeom, outline);
    }
    rt->SetTransform(fillFit);
    if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* fill =
            GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, fillAlpha))) {
        rt->FillGeometry(filledGeom, fill);
    }
    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
}

static void DrawFavoritesPulseFillIn(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, float t, bool inCabinetWClass)
{
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    {
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* raw = nullptr;
        RECT rcCopy = rc;
        if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcCopy, g_d2dFactory, &raw)) || !raw) return;
        rt.Attach(raw);
    }
    rt->BeginDraw();
    DrawFavoritesPulseFillInCore(rt.Get(), rc, cr, t, inCabinetWClass, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    if (rt->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        rt.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
}

static void DrawLibraryBooksInCore(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr,
                                    float t, bool inCabinetWClass, float baseOffX, float baseOffY)
{
    ID2D1PathGeometry* fullNormal = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_LIBRARY[0], false);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* filledGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_LIBRARY[0], true);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* leftGeom = DocumentsPartGeomEnsure(g_libraryLeftGeom, kSvgLibraryLeft);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* centerGeom = DocumentsPartGeomEnsure(g_libraryCenterGeom, kSvgLibraryCenter);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* rightGeom = DocumentsPartGeomEnsure(g_libraryRightGeom, kSvgLibraryRight);
    if (!fullNormal || !filledGeom || !leftGeom || !centerGeom || !rightGeom || !g_d2dFactory)
        return;

    D2D1_RECT_F bounds;
    if (FAILED(fullNormal->GetBounds(nullptr, &bounds))) return;
    const float contentW = bounds.right - bounds.left;
    const float contentH = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
    if (contentW <= 0 || contentH <= 0) return;

    const auto& defs = SvgIconDefs();
    auto defIt = defs.find(GLYPH_LIBRARY[0]);
    bool applyConfigScale = defIt != defs.end() && (defIt->second.scaleOnlyInCabinet ? inCabinetWClass : true);
    float cfgScale = applyConfigScale ? defIt->second.scale : 1.0f;

    const float targetW = float(rc.right - rc.left);
    const float targetH = float(rc.bottom - rc.top);
    const float scale = std::min(targetW / contentW, targetH / contentH) * cfgScale;
    const float offX = baseOffX + (targetW - contentW * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.left * scale;
    const float offY = baseOffY + (targetH - contentH * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.top * scale;
    const D2D1::Matrix3x2F fit = D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY);
    const float r = GetRValue(cr) / 255.f, g = GetGValue(cr) / 255.f, b = GetBValue(cr) / 255.f;

    const float motionEnd = 0.78f;
    const float fadeStart = 0.56f;
    float motion = 0.0f;
    if (t < motionEnd) {
        float p = std::clamp(t / motionEnd, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        if (p < 0.46f) {
            motion = EaseOutBackGentle(p / 0.46f);
        } else {
            motion = 1.0f - EaseOutBackGentle((p - 0.46f) / 0.54f);
        }
    }

    float fade = 0.0f;
    if (t >= fadeStart) {
        fade = EaseOutCubic(std::clamp((t - fadeStart) / (1.0f - fadeStart), 0.0f, 1.0f));
    }

    float groupScale = 1.0f - 0.20f * std::min(1.0f, std::max(0.0f, motion));
    D2D1::Matrix3x2F groupFit =
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(-(bounds.left + contentW * 0.5f),
                                      -(bounds.top + contentH * 0.5f)) *
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Scale(D2D1::SizeF(groupScale, groupScale)) *
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(bounds.left + contentW * 0.5f,
                                      bounds.top + contentH * 0.5f) *
        fit;

    auto partTransform = [&](float px, float py, float dx, float dy, float rotDeg, float sx, float sy) {
        return D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(-px, -py) *
               D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Scale(D2D1::SizeF(1.0f + (sx - 1.0f) * motion,
                                                    1.0f + (sy - 1.0f) * motion)) *
               D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Rotation(rotDeg * motion, D2D1::Point2F(0.0f, 0.0f)) *
               D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(px + dx * motion, py + dy * motion) *
               groupFit;
    };

    if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* normalBrush =
            GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 1.0f - fade))) {
        rt->SetTransform(partTransform(6.5f, 16.0f, -2.4f, -3.4f, -10.5f, 0.96f, 1.07f));
        rt->FillGeometry(leftGeom, normalBrush);
        rt->SetTransform(partTransform(15.5f, 16.0f, 0.0f, -4.0f, 0.0f, 1.04f, 1.08f));
        rt->FillGeometry(centerGeom, normalBrush);
        rt->SetTransform(partTransform(25.5f, 18.0f, 2.8f, -2.7f, 11.0f, 1.04f, 1.06f));
        rt->FillGeometry(rightGeom, normalBrush);
    }

    if (fade > 0.0f) {
        rt->SetTransform(groupFit);
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* filledBrush =
                GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, fade))) {
            rt->FillGeometry(filledGeom, filledBrush);
        }
    }

    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
}

static void DrawLibraryBooksIn(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, float t, bool inCabinetWClass)
{
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    {

        rt.Attach(raw);

    }
}

static const DOUBLE DOCS_UNFOLD_END = 0.55;    // folded (rest) -> flat silhouette
static const DOUBLE DOCS_HANDOFF_START = 0.55; // flat -> real Filled (folded again)

static void DrawDocumentsFoldInCore(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr,
                                     float t, bool inCabinetWClass, float baseOffX, float baseOffY) {
    ID2D1PathGeometry* foldedGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_DOCUMENTS[0], false); // registered Normal = folded (matches the resting look)
    ID2D1PathGeometry* flatGeom = DocumentsPartGeomEnsure(g_docsFlatGeom, kSvgDocumentsNormal); // transitional-only asset
    ID2D1PathGeometry* filledGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_DOCUMENTS[0], true);
    if (!foldedGeom || !flatGeom || !filledGeom) return;

    D2D1_RECT_F bounds;
    if (FAILED(foldedGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &bounds))) return;
    const float contentW = bounds.right - bounds.left;
    const float contentH = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
    if (contentW <= 0 || contentH <= 0) return;

    const auto& defs = SvgIconDefs();
    auto defIt = defs.find(GLYPH_DOCUMENTS[0]);
    bool applyConfigScale = defIt != defs.end() && (defIt->second.scaleOnlyInCabinet ? inCabinetWClass : true);
    float cfgScale = applyConfigScale ? defIt->second.scale : 1.0f;

    float unfoldRaw = std::min(1.0f, t / (float)DOCS_UNFOLD_END);
    float unfoldP = EaseOutCubic(unfoldRaw);
    float handoffP = 0.0f;
    if (t > (float)DOCS_HANDOFF_START)
        handoffP = EaseOutCubic((t - (float)DOCS_HANDOFF_START) / (1.0f - (float)DOCS_HANDOFF_START));
    float pulseScale = 1.0f - 0.09f * sinf(unfoldRaw * 3.14159265f);

    const float targetW = float(rc.right - rc.left);
    const float targetH = float(rc.bottom - rc.top);
    const float scale = std::min(targetW / contentW, targetH / contentH) * cfgScale;
    const float cx = bounds.left + contentW / 2.0f, cy = bounds.top + contentH / 2.0f;
    const float offX  = baseOffX + (targetW - contentW * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.left * scale;
    const float offY  = baseOffY + (targetH - contentH * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.top  * scale;
    const D2D1::Matrix3x2F fitTransform =
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(-cx, -cy) *
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Scale(D2D1::SizeF(pulseScale, pulseScale)) *
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(cx, cy) *
        D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY);
    const float r = GetRValue(cr) / 255.f, g = GetGValue(cr) / 255.f, b = GetBValue(cr) / 255.f;

    rt->SetTransform(fitTransform);
    if (handoffP < 1.0f) {
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, (1.0f - unfoldP) * (1.0f - handoffP))))
            rt->FillGeometry(foldedGeom, brush); // fully visible at t=0 (resting look)
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, unfoldP * (1.0f - handoffP))))
            rt->FillGeometry(flatGeom, brush); // fades in as the corner unfolds
    }
    if (handoffP > 0.0f) {
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, handoffP)))
            rt->FillGeometry(filledGeom, brush);
    }
    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
}

static void DrawDocumentsFoldIn(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, float t, bool inCabinetWClass) {
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    {
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* raw = nullptr;
        RECT rcCopy = rc;
        if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcCopy, g_d2dFactory, &raw)) || !raw) return;
        rt.Attach(raw);
    }
    rt->BeginDraw();
    DrawDocumentsFoldInCore(rt.Get(), rc, cr, t, inCabinetWClass, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    if (rt->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        rt.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
}

// ── Videos fill-wipe + wedge undraw intro ─────────────────────────────────
// The body's Filled color grows in from the right over the Normal base,
// while the hollow wedge erases via a dashed border trace shrinking to 0
// (reverse of Drive's trace-in), springs back in solid, then everything
// crossfades into the real Filled render.
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_videosTriangleGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_videosBodyOuterGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_videosBodyInnerGeom;
static float g_videosTriangleLen = -1.0f;
static float g_videosBorderThickness = -1.0f;

static ID2D1PathGeometry* VideosPartGeomEnsure(Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry>& cache, const char* path) {
    if (cache) return cache.Get();
    if (!EnsureD2DFactory()) return nullptr;
    ID2D1PathGeometry* raw = nullptr;
    if (!SvgParsePathToGeometry(path, &raw) || !raw) return nullptr;
    cache.Attach(raw);
    return cache.Get();
}

static const DOUBLE VIDEOS_UNDRAW_END = 0.45;      // body fill-reveal + wedge undraw
static const DOUBLE VIDEOS_TRI_POP_START = 0.45;
static const DOUBLE VIDEOS_TRI_POP_END   = 0.75;
// Filled and Normal are separately authored assets with slightly different
// contours, so a short tail-only crossfade left a visible seam. Starting it
// at the undraw's halfway point and stretching it across most of the
// remaining animation blends the mismatch in gradually instead.
static const DOUBLE VIDEOS_HANDOFF_START = 0.093;
static const DOUBLE VIDEOS_HANDOFF_END   = 0.90;

static void DrawVideosBuildInCore(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr,
                                   float t, bool inCabinetWClass, float baseOffX, float baseOffY) {
    ID2D1PathGeometry* fullNormalGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_VIDEOS[0], false);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* triGeom  = VideosPartGeomEnsure(g_videosTriangleGeom, kSvgVideosTriangle);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* outerGeom = VideosPartGeomEnsure(g_videosBodyOuterGeom, kSvgVideosBodyOuter);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* innerGeom = VideosPartGeomEnsure(g_videosBodyInnerGeom, kSvgVideosBodyInner);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* filledGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_VIDEOS[0], true);
    if (!fullNormalGeom || !triGeom || !outerGeom || !innerGeom || !filledGeom || !g_d2dFactory) return;

    D2D1_RECT_F bounds, triBounds, outerBounds, innerBounds;
    if (FAILED(fullNormalGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &bounds))) return;
    if (FAILED(triGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &triBounds))) return;
    if (FAILED(outerGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &outerBounds))) return;
    if (FAILED(innerGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &innerBounds))) return;
    const float contentW = bounds.right - bounds.left;
    const float contentH = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
    if (contentW <= 0 || contentH <= 0) return;
    const float triCx = (triBounds.left + triBounds.right) / 2.0f;
    const float triCy = (triBounds.top + triBounds.bottom) / 2.0f;
    const float bodyClipRight = triBounds.left; // boundary between body-only region and wedge/notch region

    if (g_videosTriangleLen < 0.0f) {
        FLOAT len = 0.0f;
        if (FAILED(triGeom->ComputeLength(nullptr, &len))) return;
        g_videosTriangleLen = len;
    }
    if (g_videosBorderThickness < 0.0f) {
        float thicknessV = ((outerBounds.bottom - outerBounds.top) - (innerBounds.bottom - innerBounds.top)) / 2.0f;
        g_videosBorderThickness = thicknessV;
    }

    const auto& defs = SvgIconDefs();
    auto defIt = defs.find(GLYPH_VIDEOS[0]);
    bool applyConfigScale = defIt != defs.end() &&
        IconIntroApplyConfigScale(GLYPH_VIDEOS[0], defIt->second.scaleOnlyInCabinet, inCabinetWClass);
    float cfgScale = applyConfigScale ? defIt->second.scale : 1.0f;

    float revealP = EaseOutCubic(std::min(1.0f, t / (float)VIDEOS_UNDRAW_END));
    float undrawP = revealP;
    float triPopP = std::max(0.0f, std::min(1.0f, (t - (float)VIDEOS_TRI_POP_START) / ((float)VIDEOS_TRI_POP_END - (float)VIDEOS_TRI_POP_START)));
    float triScale = EaseOutBackGentle(triPopP);
    float handoffP = 0.0f;
    if (t > (float)VIDEOS_HANDOFF_START) {
        // EaseInOutCubic, not EaseOutCubic -- this window now starts very
        // early (right at undrawP==0.5), and EaseOutCubic's front-loading
        // would push it past 80% done by the time the wedge pop is only
        // half finished, making the pop barely visible. The in-out curve
        // keeps the ramp gradual through the middle of the animation.
        handoffP = EaseInOutCubic(std::min(1.0f, (t - (float)VIDEOS_HANDOFF_START) / ((float)VIDEOS_HANDOFF_END - (float)VIDEOS_HANDOFF_START)));
    }

    const float targetW = float(rc.right - rc.left);
    const float targetH = float(rc.bottom - rc.top);
    const float scale = std::min(targetW / contentW, targetH / contentH) * cfgScale;
    const float offX  = baseOffX + (targetW - contentW * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.left * scale;
    const float offY  = baseOffY + (targetH - contentH * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.top  * scale;
    const D2D1::Matrix3x2F fitTransform = D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY);
    const float r = GetRValue(cr) / 255.f, g = GetGValue(cr) / 255.f, b = GetBValue(cr) / 255.f;

    rt->SetTransform(fitTransform);
    if (handoffP < 1.0f) {
        // 1) Body base -- full Normal geometry, clipped to exclude the
        // wedge/notch region (always shown, unaffected by the wedge undraw).
        const D2D1_RECT_F bodyClip = D2D1::RectF(bounds.left, bounds.top, bodyClipRight, bounds.bottom);
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 1.0f - handoffP))) {
            rt->PushAxisAlignedClip(bodyClip, D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_PER_PRIMITIVE);
            rt->FillGeometry(fullNormalGeom, brush);
            rt->PopAxisAlignedClip();
        }
        // 2) Body fill-reveal -- Filled geometry, growing leftward from the
        // wedge boundary over the body region.
        float revealWidth = revealP * (bodyClipRight - bounds.left);
        const D2D1_RECT_F revealClip = D2D1::RectF(bodyClipRight - revealWidth, bounds.top, bodyClipRight, bounds.bottom);
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 1.0f - handoffP))) {
            rt->PushAxisAlignedClip(revealClip, D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_PER_PRIMITIVE);
            rt->FillGeometry(filledGeom, brush);
            rt->PopAxisAlignedClip();
        }
        // 3) Wedge undraw -- dashed border trace along the wedge's own
        // outline, width = the icon's real measured border thickness,
        // shrinking from full length to 0 (reverse of Drive's trace-in).
        if (undrawP < 1.0f && g_videosBorderThickness > 0.0f) {
            float drawnLen = g_videosTriangleLen * (1.0f - undrawP);
            if (drawnLen > 0.0f) {
                FLOAT dashes[2] = { drawnLen / g_videosBorderThickness, g_videosTriangleLen * 2.0f / g_videosBorderThickness };
                Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1StrokeStyle> strokeStyle;
                g_d2dFactory->CreateStrokeStyle(
                    D2D1::StrokeStyleProperties(D2D1_CAP_STYLE_ROUND, D2D1_CAP_STYLE_ROUND, D2D1_CAP_STYLE_ROUND,
                                                 D2D1_LINE_JOIN_ROUND, 10.0f, D2D1_DASH_STYLE_CUSTOM, 0.0f),
                    dashes, 2, &strokeStyle);
                if (strokeStyle) {
                    if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 1.0f - handoffP)))
                        rt->DrawGeometry(triGeom, brush, g_videosBorderThickness, strokeStyle.Get());
                }
            }
        }
        // 4) Wedge pop-in -- solid Filled-style, spring scale.
        if (triScale > 0.001f) {
            if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 1.0f - handoffP))) {
                rt->SetTransform(
                    D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(-triCx, -triCy) *
                    D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Scale(D2D1::SizeF(triScale, triScale)) *
                    D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(triCx, triCy) *
                    fitTransform);
                rt->FillGeometry(triGeom, brush);
                rt->SetTransform(fitTransform);
            }
        }
    }
    if (handoffP > 0.0f) {
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, handoffP)))
            rt->FillGeometry(filledGeom, brush);
    }
    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
}

static void DrawVideosBuildIn(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, float t, bool inCabinetWClass) {
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    {
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* raw = nullptr;
        RECT rcCopy = rc;
        if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcCopy, g_d2dFactory, &raw)) || !raw) return;
        rt.Attach(raw);
    }
    rt->BeginDraw();
    DrawVideosBuildInCore(rt.Get(), rc, cr, t, inCabinetWClass, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    if (rt->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        rt.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
}

// ── Gallery shrink+separate+reassemble intro ─────────────────────────────
// Front (frame+landscape+sun) and shadow shrink and pull apart, then snap
// back with a spring overshoot. Crossfades from Normal to Filled split parts
// early, then stays on them through t=1.0 -- deliberately never crossfades
// into the combined kSvgGalleryFilled render, since that shape was traced
// independently and doesn't line up pixel-for-pixel with the split parts
// recombined; blending two near-identical shapes flickered at the handoff.
// A hard cut when the wipe ends hides the mismatch far better.
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_galleryFrontGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_galleryShadowGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_galleryFrontFilledGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_galleryShadowFilledGeom;

static ID2D1PathGeometry* GalleryPartGeomEnsure(Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry>& cache, const char* path) {
    if (cache) return cache.Get();
    if (!EnsureD2DFactory()) return nullptr;
    ID2D1PathGeometry* raw = nullptr;
    if (!SvgParsePathToGeometry(path, &raw) || !raw) return nullptr;
    cache.Attach(raw);
    return cache.Get();
}

static const DOUBLE GALLERY_SEPARATE_END   = 0.40;
static const DOUBLE GALLERY_REASSEMBLE_END = 0.85;
static const DOUBLE GALLERY_STYLE_FILL_START = 0.10; // hold pure outline briefly so the intro visibly starts as Normal
static const DOUBLE GALLERY_STYLE_FILL_END   = 0.20; // then fast fade to Filled split parts
static const float  GALLERY_SHRINK_AMOUNT  = 0.14f;
static const float  GALLERY_SEPARATE_DIST  = 2.2f; // in the SVG's own ~48-unit coordinate space

static void DrawGalleryAssembleInCore(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr,
                                       float t, bool inCabinetWClass, float baseOffX, float baseOffY) {
    ID2D1PathGeometry* fullGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_GALLERY[0], false); // for overall fit bounds
    ID2D1PathGeometry* frontGeom = GalleryPartGeomEnsure(g_galleryFrontGeom, kSvgGalleryFront);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* shadowGeom = GalleryPartGeomEnsure(g_galleryShadowGeom, kSvgGalleryShadow);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* frontFilledGeom = GalleryPartGeomEnsure(g_galleryFrontFilledGeom, kSvgGalleryFrontFilled);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* shadowFilledGeom = GalleryPartGeomEnsure(g_galleryShadowFilledGeom, kSvgGalleryShadowFilled);
    if (!fullGeom || !frontGeom || !shadowGeom || !frontFilledGeom || !shadowFilledGeom) return;

    D2D1_RECT_F bounds, frontBounds, shadowBounds, frontFilledBounds, shadowFilledBounds;
    if (FAILED(fullGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &bounds))) return;
    if (FAILED(frontGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &frontBounds))) return;
    if (FAILED(shadowGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &shadowBounds))) return;
    if (FAILED(frontFilledGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &frontFilledBounds))) return;
    if (FAILED(shadowFilledGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &shadowFilledBounds))) return;
    const float contentW = bounds.right - bounds.left;
    const float contentH = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
    if (contentW <= 0 || contentH <= 0) return;
    const float frontCx = (frontBounds.left + frontBounds.right) / 2.0f;
    const float frontCy = (frontBounds.top + frontBounds.bottom) / 2.0f;
    const float shadowCx = (shadowBounds.left + shadowBounds.right) / 2.0f;
    const float shadowCy = (shadowBounds.top + shadowBounds.bottom) / 2.0f;
    const float frontFilledCx = (frontFilledBounds.left + frontFilledBounds.right) / 2.0f;
    const float frontFilledCy = (frontFilledBounds.top + frontFilledBounds.bottom) / 2.0f;
    const float shadowFilledCx = (shadowFilledBounds.left + shadowFilledBounds.right) / 2.0f;
    const float shadowFilledCy = (shadowFilledBounds.top + shadowFilledBounds.bottom) / 2.0f;

    const auto& defs = SvgIconDefs();
    auto defIt = defs.find(GLYPH_GALLERY[0]);
    bool applyConfigScale = defIt != defs.end() && (defIt->second.scaleOnlyInCabinet ? inCabinetWClass : true);
    float cfgScale = applyConfigScale ? defIt->second.scale : 1.0f;

    float sepP = 0.0f;
    if (t < (float)GALLERY_SEPARATE_END) {
        sepP = EaseOutCubic(t / (float)GALLERY_SEPARATE_END);
    } else if (t < (float)GALLERY_REASSEMBLE_END) {
        float p = (t - (float)GALLERY_SEPARATE_END) / ((float)GALLERY_REASSEMBLE_END - (float)GALLERY_SEPARATE_END);
        sepP = 1.0f - EaseOutBackGentle(p); // dips negative briefly (scale pops past 1.0) as it snaps together
    } // else: fully reassembled (sepP stays 0) for the remainder of the animation
    float shrink = 1.0f - GALLERY_SHRINK_AMOUNT * sepP;
    float gap = GALLERY_SEPARATE_DIST * sepP;
    // Outline -> Filled split-part style swap: holds pure outline through
    // GALLERY_STYLE_FILL_START so the intro visibly begins as Normal, then
    // fades fast to Filled by GALLERY_STYLE_FILL_END.
    float styleP = 0.0f;
    if (t > (float)GALLERY_STYLE_FILL_START) {
        styleP = EaseOutCubic(std::min(1.0f,
            (t - (float)GALLERY_STYLE_FILL_START) / ((float)GALLERY_STYLE_FILL_END - (float)GALLERY_STYLE_FILL_START)));
    }

    const float targetW = float(rc.right - rc.left);
    const float targetH = float(rc.bottom - rc.top);
    const float scale = std::min(targetW / contentW, targetH / contentH) * cfgScale;
    const float offX  = baseOffX + (targetW - contentW * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.left * scale;
    const float offY  = baseOffY + (targetH - contentH * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.top  * scale;
    const D2D1::Matrix3x2F fitTransform = D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY);
    const float r = GetRValue(cr) / 255.f, g = GetGValue(cr) / 255.f, b = GetBValue(cr) / 255.f;

    float outlineAlpha = 1.0f - styleP;
    float filledSplitAlpha = styleP;

    if (outlineAlpha > 0.001f) {
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, outlineAlpha))) {
            rt->SetTransform(
                D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(-shadowCx, -shadowCy) *
                D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Scale(D2D1::SizeF(shrink, shrink)) *
                D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(shadowCx + gap, shadowCy + gap) *
                fitTransform);
            rt->FillGeometry(shadowGeom, brush);

            rt->SetTransform(
                D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(-frontCx, -frontCy) *
                D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Scale(D2D1::SizeF(shrink, shrink)) *
                D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(frontCx - gap * 0.6f, frontCy - gap * 0.6f) *
                fitTransform);
            rt->FillGeometry(frontGeom, brush);
        }
    }
    if (filledSplitAlpha > 0.001f) {
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, filledSplitAlpha))) {
            rt->SetTransform(
                D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(-shadowFilledCx, -shadowFilledCy) *
                D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Scale(D2D1::SizeF(shrink, shrink)) *
                D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(shadowFilledCx + gap, shadowFilledCy + gap) *
                fitTransform);
            rt->FillGeometry(shadowFilledGeom, brush);

            rt->SetTransform(
                D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(-frontFilledCx, -frontFilledCy) *
                D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Scale(D2D1::SizeF(shrink, shrink)) *
                D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(frontFilledCx - gap * 0.6f, frontFilledCy - gap * 0.6f) *
                fitTransform);
            rt->FillGeometry(frontFilledGeom, brush);
        }
    }
    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
}

static void DrawGalleryAssembleIn(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, float t, bool inCabinetWClass) {
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    {
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* raw = nullptr;
        RECT rcCopy = rc;
        if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcCopy, g_d2dFactory, &raw)) || !raw) return;
        rt.Attach(raw);
    }
    rt->BeginDraw();
    DrawGalleryAssembleInCore(rt.Get(), rc, cr, t, inCabinetWClass, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    if (rt->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        rt.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
}

// ── Program Files square-hop intro ────────────────────────────────────────
// The badge (top-right, always solid in Filled) and the hollow frame render
// normally throughout; the fill hops as a solid pulse across the other
// three squares in turn (top-left, bottom-left, bottom-right), then
// crossfades into the real Filled render (where those three squares are
// hollow again -- only the badge is solid) to hand off to the pop.
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_progFilesSquareTLGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_progFilesSquareBLGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_progFilesSquareBRGeom;

static ID2D1PathGeometry* ProgFilesPartGeomEnsure(Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry>& cache, const char* path) {
    if (cache) return cache.Get();
    if (!EnsureD2DFactory()) return nullptr;
    ID2D1PathGeometry* raw = nullptr;
    if (!SvgParsePathToGeometry(path, &raw) || !raw) return nullptr;
    cache.Attach(raw);
    return cache.Get();
}

static const DOUBLE PROGFILES_HOP_TL_END = 0.20;
static const DOUBLE PROGFILES_HOP_BL_END = 0.40;
static const DOUBLE PROGFILES_HOP_BR_END = 0.60;
static const DOUBLE PROGFILES_HANDOFF_START = 0.60;

static float ProgFilesSquarePulse(float t, DOUBLE segStart, DOUBLE segEnd) {
    if (t < (float)segStart || t > (float)segEnd) return 0.0f;
    float p = (t - (float)segStart) / ((float)segEnd - (float)segStart);
    return sinf(p * 3.14159265f);
}

static void DrawProgFilesHopInCore(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr,
                                    float t, bool inCabinetWClass,
                                    float baseOffX, float baseOffY) {
    ID2D1PathGeometry* baseGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_PROGFILES[0], false);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* tlGeom = ProgFilesPartGeomEnsure(g_progFilesSquareTLGeom, kSvgProgFilesSquareTL);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* blGeom = ProgFilesPartGeomEnsure(g_progFilesSquareBLGeom, kSvgProgFilesSquareBL);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* brGeom = ProgFilesPartGeomEnsure(g_progFilesSquareBRGeom, kSvgProgFilesSquareBR);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* filledGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_PROGFILES[0], true);
    if (!baseGeom || !tlGeom || !blGeom || !brGeom || !filledGeom) return;

    D2D1_RECT_F bounds;
    if (FAILED(baseGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &bounds))) return;
    const float contentW = bounds.right - bounds.left;
    const float contentH = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
    if (contentW <= 0 || contentH <= 0) return;

    const auto& defs = SvgIconDefs();
    auto defIt = defs.find(GLYPH_PROGFILES[0]);
    bool applyConfigScale = defIt != defs.end() && (defIt->second.scaleOnlyInCabinet ? inCabinetWClass : true);
    float cfgScale = applyConfigScale ? defIt->second.scale : 1.0f;

    float alphaTL = ProgFilesSquarePulse(t, 0.0, PROGFILES_HOP_TL_END);
    float alphaBL = ProgFilesSquarePulse(t, PROGFILES_HOP_TL_END, PROGFILES_HOP_BL_END);
    float alphaBR = ProgFilesSquarePulse(t, PROGFILES_HOP_BL_END, PROGFILES_HOP_BR_END);
    float handoffP = 0.0f;
    if (t > (float)PROGFILES_HANDOFF_START)
        handoffP = EaseOutCubic((t - (float)PROGFILES_HANDOFF_START) / (1.0f - (float)PROGFILES_HANDOFF_START));

    const float targetW = float(rc.right - rc.left);
    const float targetH = float(rc.bottom - rc.top);
    const float scale = std::min(targetW / contentW, targetH / contentH) * cfgScale;
    const float offX  = baseOffX + (targetW - contentW * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.left * scale;
    const float offY  = baseOffY + (targetH - contentH * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.top  * scale;
    const D2D1::Matrix3x2F fitTransform = D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY);
    const float r = GetRValue(cr) / 255.f, g = GetGValue(cr) / 255.f, b = GetBValue(cr) / 255.f;

    rt->SetTransform(fitTransform);
    if (handoffP < 1.0f) {
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 1.0f - handoffP)))
            rt->FillGeometry(baseGeom, brush);
        if (alphaTL > 0.001f) {
            if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, alphaTL * (1.0f - handoffP))))
                rt->FillGeometry(tlGeom, brush);
        }
        if (alphaBL > 0.001f) {
            if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, alphaBL * (1.0f - handoffP))))
                rt->FillGeometry(blGeom, brush);
        }
        if (alphaBR > 0.001f) {
            if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, alphaBR * (1.0f - handoffP))))
                rt->FillGeometry(brGeom, brush);
        }
    }
    if (handoffP > 0.0f) {
        if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, handoffP)))
            rt->FillGeometry(filledGeom, brush);
    }
    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
}

static void DrawProgFilesHopIn(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, float t, bool inCabinetWClass) {
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    {
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* raw = nullptr;
        RECT rcCopy = rc;
        if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcCopy, g_d2dFactory, &raw)) || !raw) return;
        rt.Attach(raw);
    }
    rt->BeginDraw();
    DrawProgFilesHopInCore(rt.Get(), rc, cr, t, inCabinetWClass, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    if (rt->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        rt.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
}

// ── Google Drive facet-hop intro ──────────────────────────────────────────
// Each of the mark's three facets hard-swaps from hollow Normal to solid
// Filled at the peak of a small scale pop, one at a time -- opacity-
// crossfading instead reads as the shape gaining "weight" since the two
// don't share edges. The swapped facets already reproduce
// kSvgGoogleDriveFilled exactly, so no crossfade to the combined render is
// needed; the animation just holds until the pop.
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_gdriveTopNormalGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_gdriveRightNormalGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_gdriveLeftNormalGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_gdriveTopFilledGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_gdriveRightFilledGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_gdriveLeftFilledGeom;

static ID2D1PathGeometry* GDrivePartGeomEnsure(Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry>& cache, const char* path) {
    if (cache) return cache.Get();
    if (!EnsureD2DFactory()) return nullptr;
    ID2D1PathGeometry* raw = nullptr;
    if (!SvgParsePathToGeometry(path, &raw) || !raw) return nullptr;
    cache.Attach(raw);
    return cache.Get();
}

// Order: top, right, left -- matches the approved preview sequence.
static const DOUBLE GDRIVE_SEG_START[3] = { 0.02, 0.30, 0.58 };
static const DOUBLE GDRIVE_SEG_END[3]   = { 0.30, 0.58, 0.86 };
static const float  GDRIVE_POP_AMOUNT = 0.06f;

static void DrawGoogleDriveHopInCore(ID2D1RenderTarget* rt, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr,
                                      float t, bool inCabinetWClass,
                                      float baseOffX, float baseOffY) {
    ID2D1PathGeometry* baseGeom = SvgGeomEnsure(GLYPH_GOOGLEDRIVE[0], false); // for overall fit bounds
    ID2D1PathGeometry* normalGeoms[3] = {
        GDrivePartGeomEnsure(g_gdriveTopNormalGeom, kSvgGDriveTopNormal),
        GDrivePartGeomEnsure(g_gdriveRightNormalGeom, kSvgGDriveRightNormal),
        GDrivePartGeomEnsure(g_gdriveLeftNormalGeom, kSvgGDriveLeftNormal),
    };
    ID2D1PathGeometry* filledGeoms[3] = {
        GDrivePartGeomEnsure(g_gdriveTopFilledGeom, kSvgGDriveTopFilled),
        GDrivePartGeomEnsure(g_gdriveRightFilledGeom, kSvgGDriveRightFilled),
        GDrivePartGeomEnsure(g_gdriveLeftFilledGeom, kSvgGDriveLeftFilled),
    };
    if (!baseGeom) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        if (!normalGeoms[i] || !filledGeoms[i]) return;
    }

    D2D1_RECT_F bounds;
    if (FAILED(baseGeom->GetBounds(nullptr, &bounds))) return;
    const float contentW = bounds.right - bounds.left;
    const float contentH = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
    if (contentW <= 0 || contentH <= 0) return;

    float cx[3], cy[3];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        D2D1_RECT_F fb;
        if (FAILED(filledGeoms[i]->GetBounds(nullptr, &fb))) return;
        cx[i] = (fb.left + fb.right) / 2.0f;
        cy[i] = (fb.top + fb.bottom) / 2.0f;
    }

    const auto& defs = SvgIconDefs();
    auto defIt = defs.find(GLYPH_GOOGLEDRIVE[0]);
    bool applyConfigScale = defIt != defs.end() && (defIt->second.scaleOnlyInCabinet ? inCabinetWClass : true);
    float cfgScale = applyConfigScale ? defIt->second.scale : 1.0f;

    const float targetW = float(rc.right - rc.left);
    const float targetH = float(rc.bottom - rc.top);
    const float scale = std::min(targetW / contentW, targetH / contentH) * cfgScale;
    const float offX  = baseOffX + (targetW - contentW * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.left * scale;
    const float offY  = baseOffY + (targetH - contentH * scale) / 2.0f - bounds.top  * scale;
    const D2D1::Matrix3x2F fitTransform = D2D1::Matrix3x2F(scale, 0, 0, scale, offX, offY);
    const float r = GetRValue(cr) / 255.f, g = GetGValue(cr) / 255.f, b = GetBValue(cr) / 255.f;

    if (ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush = GetCachedSolidBrush(rt, D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, 1.0f))) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            float segStart = (float)GDRIVE_SEG_START[i];
            float segEnd   = (float)GDRIVE_SEG_END[i];
            float localP = 0.0f;
            if (t >= segStart)
                localP = std::min(1.0f, (t - segStart) / (segEnd - segStart));
            bool isSolid = (t >= segStart) && (localP >= 0.5f || t >= segEnd);
            float popScale = (t < segStart) ? 1.0f : 1.0f + GDRIVE_POP_AMOUNT * sinf(localP * 3.14159265f);

            rt->SetTransform(
                D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(-cx[i], -cy[i]) *
                D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Scale(D2D1::SizeF(popScale, popScale)) *
                D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(cx[i], cy[i]) *
                fitTransform);
            rt->FillGeometry(isSolid ? filledGeoms[i] : normalGeoms[i], brush);
        }
    }
    rt->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Identity());
}

static void DrawGoogleDriveHopIn(HDC hdc, const RECT& rc, COLORREF cr, float t, bool inCabinetWClass) {
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> rt;
    {
        ID2D1DCRenderTarget* raw = nullptr;
        RECT rcCopy = rc;
        if (FAILED(CreateBoundD2DRenderTarget(hdc, &rcCopy, g_d2dFactory, &raw)) || !raw) return;
        rt.Attach(raw);
    }
    rt->BeginDraw();
    DrawGoogleDriveHopInCore(rt.Get(), rc, cr, t, inCabinetWClass, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    if (rt->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) {
        rt.Reset();
        CachedTlsRTRecreate();
    }
}

// ── Network radar-sweep intro ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// The full Normal render (globe grid + monitor) is always drawn as the
// base, so there's never a blank frame at the switch -- a radar-style pie
// wedge then sweeps clockwise from 12 o'clock, clip-revealing the solid
// Filled grid underneath it, with a thin sweep-line accent for a "scanning"
// read. A brief whole-icon settle pulse marks the sweep's completion, then
// a short crossfade hands off to the real combined Filled render (the
// grid's exact facet boundaries differ slightly between Normal and Filled,
// so a hard cut would show a seam -- same fix as Videos).
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_networkGlobeNormalGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> g_networkGlobeFilledGeom;
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1Layer> g_networkSweepLayer;
// See g_oneDriveWipeLayerRT for why this staleness check is needed.
static ID2D1RenderTarget* g_networkSweepLayerRT = nullptr; // identity check only, any RT type
static float g_networkGlobeCx = 0.0f, g_networkGlobeCy = 0.0f, g_networkGlobeRadius = -1.0f;

static ID2D1PathGeometry* NetworkPartGeomEnsure(Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry>& cache, const char* path) {
    if (cache) return cache.Get();
    if (!EnsureD2DFactory()) return nullptr;
    ID2D1PathGeometry* raw = nullptr;
    if (!SvgParsePathToGeometry(path, &raw) || !raw) return nullptr;
    cache.Attach(raw);
    return cache.Get();
}

// Builds a pie-wedge geometry (in the icon's own SVG coordinate space)
// centered at (cx,cy), starting at 12 o'clock and sweeping clockwise by
// sweepDeg -- clamped just under a full turn since a single closed figure
// can't represent an exact 360 degree arc (zero-length closing edge).
static bool NetworkBuildSweepGeom(float cx, float cy, float radius, float sweepDeg,
                                   Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry>& out) {
    if (!EnsureD2DFactory() || sweepDeg <= 0.0f) return false;
    sweepDeg = std::min(sweepDeg, 359.9f);
    ID2D1PathGeometry* raw = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(g_d2dFactory->CreatePathGeometry(&raw)) || !raw) return false;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID2D1GeometrySink> sink;
    if (FAILED(raw->Open(&sink))) { raw->Release(); return false; }
    auto pointAt = [&](float deg) {
        float rad = deg * 3.14159265f / 180.0f;
        return D2D1::Point2F(cx + radius * sinf(rad), cy - radius * cosf(rad));
    };
