BOOL Wh_ModInit()
{
    // dwm.exe is excluded via @exclude in the mod metadata above, not here --
    // Wh_ModInit never runs in that process, so an in-code re-check would be
    // unreachable dead code.
    //
    // mmc.exe was excluded the same way for a while (MMC-based programs
    // crashed with the DrawThemeBackground/DrawEdge hooks); that no longer
    // reproduces in testing, so it's back to being injected, experimentally.
    // If an MMC-hosted program (Task Scheduler, Computer Management, Device
    // Manager, gpedit, ...) misbehaves or crashes, add mmc.exe to this mod's
    // own "Excluded programs" list in Windhawk's advanced settings -- that
    // blocks injection entirely, unlike this mod's internal dark-mode
    // process exclusion list, which only turns off dark coloring.

    // UWP/WinUI apps: their Win32 controls don't use standard theming so
    // our dark mode / button / border hooks would cause artifacts. BUT their
    // context menus are still classic #32768 popups that benefit from our
    // acrylic treatment. Instead of bailing out entirely (return FALSE),
    // we set a flag and skip only the heavy UI hooks — menu hooks are kept.
    // Explorer and Task Manager only host XAML islands (Task Manager's is
    // just its frame; its pages are DirectUI and Win32): on a mod reload
    // they already have the XAML runtime loaded, which must not demote them
    // to the menu-only path they never get when the mod loads with them.
    g_isXamlProcess = !IsCurrentProcessExplorer() &&
                      !IsCurrentProcessTaskManager() &&
                      (GetModuleHandleW(L"Windows.UI.Xaml.dll") != nullptr ||
                       GetModuleHandleW(L"Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll") != nullptr);

    LoadSettings();
    g_roundedSelectionHighContrast.store(
        SysHighContrastEnabled(), std::memory_order_release);
    g_listRenameHighContrast.store(
        SysHighContrastEnabled(),
        std::memory_order_release);

    // Only Explorer instances coordinate the session-wide color table. This
    // keeps restricted/AppContainer hosts out of the final restore path.
    //
    // A normal Explorer and one relaunched as administrator share these
    // objects, so the descriptor grants the current user (both instances run
    // as that user) and SYSTEM, with an explicit medium integrity label:
    // without it, objects an elevated instance created first would be out of
    // the normal one's reach under MIC's no-write-up rule. Other users and
    // sandboxed processes get no access, so nothing else can hold the mutex
    // or write into the table.
    if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer()) {
        PSECURITY_DESCRIPTOR darkSysColsSd = DarkSysColsCreateSecurityDescriptor();
        SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES darkSysColsSa = { sizeof(darkSysColsSa), darkSysColsSd, FALSE };
        if (darkSysColsSd) {
            g_darkSysColsMutex =
                CreateMutexW(&darkSysColsSa, FALSE, kDarkSysColorsMutexName);
            g_darkSysColsMap = CreateFileMappingW(
                INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, &darkSysColsSa, PAGE_READWRITE, 0,
                sizeof(SharedDarkSysColorsState), kDarkSysColorsMapName);
            LocalFree(darkSysColsSd);
        }
        if (!g_darkSysColsMutex || !g_darkSysColsMap)
            Wh_Log(L"Dark sys-colors Explorer coordination unavailable, "
                   L"falling back to the local SysMetrics baseline");
    }

    // Detect glyph font (Segoe Fluent Icons on Win11, MDL2 Assets on Win10)
    if (g_settings.GlyphIcons || g_settings.FluentPinIcon ||
        g_settings.RoundedButtons ||
        g_settings.ModernScrollbars ||
        g_settings.ExplorerMicaBackdrop || g_darkModeActive)
        GlyphDetectFont();

    // High-resolution timer for animation timestamps
    TimerInitialize();

    // Initial DPI from primary monitor
    g_Dpi = GetDpiFromMonitor();

    // Load DWM/SWCA API pointers for ComboBox DWM effects
    CbdLoadAPIs();
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DwmSetWindowAttribute,
            DwmSetWindowAttribute_hook, &DwmSetWindowAttribute_orig)) {
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook DwmSetWindowAttribute");
    }
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea,
            DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea_hook,
            &DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea_orig)) {
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea");
    }

    // Prime the accent indicator cache on startup
    RefreshAccentCache();

    g_lastSeenSystemDark = ReadSystemDarkModeFromRegistry();
    g_lastSeenSystemDarkValid = true;
    // CreateMsgWindow() is deliberately NOT called here: it spawns a real
    // background thread, and dozens of load-bearing SetFunctionHook calls
    // below can still fail and return FALSE -- since Wh_ModInit returning
    // FALSE means Windhawk never calls Wh_ModUninit (so DestroyMsgWindow
    // would never run), that thread would be orphaned. Created in
    // Wh_ModAfterInit instead, once Wh_ModInit has already succeeded.

    // GetThemeClass (uxtheme ordinal 74) -- for theme class name cache
    {
        HMODULE hUx = GetModuleHandleW(L"uxtheme.dll");
        if (!hUx)
            hUx = LoadLibraryExW(L"uxtheme.dll", nullptr, LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32);
        if (hUx) {
            pGetThemeClass = (GetThemeClass_t)GetProcAddress(hUx, "GetThemeClass");
            if (!pGetThemeClass)
                pGetThemeClass = (GetThemeClass_t)GetProcAddress(hUx, MAKEINTRESOURCEA(74));
        }
    }

    // D2D factory (multi-threaded; used by all processes for checkbox/progress drawing)
    {
        FPUGuard fpu; // prevent FPU state corruption in host process
        D2D1CreateFactory(D2D1_FACTORY_TYPE_MULTI_THREADED,
            __uuidof(ID2D1Factory1), nullptr, (void**)&g_d2dFactory);
    }
    // Checkbox checkmark stroke style: created once, here, while still
    // single-threaded. PaintCheckBox can run on many different threads
    // (one WH_CBT hook per UI thread that draws Buttons), and the
    // lazy check-then-create it used to do had no synchronization.
    if (g_d2dFactory) {
        D2D1_STROKE_STYLE_PROPERTIES ssp = D2D1::StrokeStyleProperties(
            D2D1_CAP_STYLE_ROUND, D2D1_CAP_STYLE_ROUND,
            D2D1_CAP_STYLE_FLAT,  D2D1_LINE_JOIN_ROUND,
            10.f, D2D1_DASH_STYLE_SOLID, 0.f);
        g_d2dFactory->CreateStrokeStyle(&ssp, nullptr, 0, &g_checkStrokeStyle);
    }
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(LoadImageW,
            LoadImageW_hook, &LoadImageW_orig)) {
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook LoadImageW for modern shell icons");
    }

    // Acrylic popup-menu border brush: created once, here, while still
    // single-threaded -- same reasoning as the checkbox stroke style above.
    // MenuAcrylicSubclassProc runs on whichever thread owns the #32768
    // popup being painted.
    g_acrylicMenuBorderBrush =
        CreateSolidBrush(MenuAcrylicDwmBorderColor(/*dark=*/true));
    g_acrylicMenuBorderBrushLight =
        CreateSolidBrush(MenuAcrylicDwmBorderColor(/*dark=*/false));

    // ── XAML process fast path: install ONLY menu-essential hooks ──────────
    // UWP/WinUI apps don't use Win32 theming for their controls, but their
    // context menus are still classic #32768 popups. Install only the hooks
    // needed for acrylic menus, then return.
    if (g_isXamlProcess) {
        // Set dark mode flag so GetSysColor_hook returns dark colors
        RecomputeCustomDarkModeActive();

        // Theme hooks for Menu parts (fill colors, hover, backgrounds).
        // These are load-bearing: every hook callback unconditionally calls
        // through its _orig trampoline, so a silently failed SetFunctionHook
        // would leave that pointer null and crash on first invocation.
        if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DrawThemeBackground,
                DrawThemeBackground_hook, &DrawThemeBackground_orig)) {
            Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook DrawThemeBackground");
            return FALSE;
        }
        WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DrawThemeBackgroundEx,
            DrawThemeBackgroundEx_hook, &DrawThemeBackgroundEx_orig);
        if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(GetThemeColor,
                GetThemeColor_hook, &GetThemeColor_orig)) {
            Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook GetThemeColor");
            return FALSE;
        }
        if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(BeginPaint,
                BeginPaint_hook, &BeginPaint_orig)) {
            Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook BeginPaint");
            return FALSE;
        }
        if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(EndPaint,
                EndPaint_hook, &EndPaint_orig)) {
            Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook EndPaint");
            return FALSE;
        }
        // Text hooks — needed for menu text color in dark mode
        WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DrawThemeText,
            DrawThemeText_hook, &DrawThemeText_orig);
        WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DrawThemeTextEx,
            DrawThemeTextEx_hook, &DrawThemeTextEx_orig);
        WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(ExtTextOutW,
            ExtTextOutW_hook, &ExtTextOutW_orig);
        // Load-bearing here too: several of this path's own hooks (ExtTextOutW's
        // opaque-bg fill, DefWindowProcW/A's UAH menu paint, DrawThemeBackground(Ex)'s
        // scrollbar handling, TrackPopupMenu(Ex)'s acrylic subclass) route their own
        // drawing through FillRect_orig instead of raw FillRect, specifically so
        // FillRect_hook's combo-edit-restyle logic can't reinterpret a mod-authored
        // fill -- which requires the hook to actually be installed.
        if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(FillRect,
                FillRect_hook, &FillRect_orig)) {
            Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook FillRect");
            return FALSE;
        }
        // System color hooks — COLOR_MENUTEXT must return white in dark mode
        if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(GetSysColor,
                GetSysColor_hook, &GetSysColor_orig)) {
            Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook GetSysColor");
            return FALSE;
        }
        if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(GetSysColorBrush,
                GetSysColorBrush_hook, &GetSysColorBrush_orig)) {
            Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook GetSysColorBrush");
            return FALSE;
        }
        // Menu detection: TrackPopupMenuEx + DefWindowProc for WM_UAHINITMENU
        WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(TrackPopupMenuEx,
            TrackPopupMenuEx_hook, &TrackPopupMenuEx_orig);
        WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(TrackPopupMenu,
            TrackPopupMenu_hook, &TrackPopupMenu_orig);
        WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DefWindowProcW,
            DefWindowProcW_hook, &DefWindowProcW_orig);
        WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DefWindowProcA,
            DefWindowProcA_hook, &DefWindowProcA_orig);
        WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DefDlgProcW,
            DefDlgProcW_hook, &DefDlgProcW_orig);
        WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DefDlgProcA,
            DefDlgProcA_hook, &DefDlgProcA_orig);
        // ANSI/frame/MDI variants, for the narrow case of a WinUI3 host
        // embedding classic dialog-based/MDI/frame content -- matches the
        // general (non-XAML-fast-path) hook set below so WM_UAHINITMENU-
        // based popup detection isn't silently missing just for those.
        WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DefFrameProcW,
            DefFrameProcW_hook, &DefFrameProcW_orig);
        WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DefFrameProcA,
            DefFrameProcA_hook, &DefFrameProcA_orig);
        WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DefMDIChildProcW,
            DefMDIChildProcW_hook, &DefMDIChildProcW_orig);
        WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DefMDIChildProcA,
            DefMDIChildProcA_hook, &DefMDIChildProcA_orig);
        // Queue the build-specific shell hooks only after all load-bearing
        // hooks above succeeded. Hooks registered during Wh_ModInit are
        // applied by Windhawk when this callback returns.
        MenuEnsureImmersiveHooks(false);
        // Per-thread hook for existing threads
        if (g_settings.ModernContextMenus)
            EnumWindows(MenuInitEnumProc, 0);
        return TRUE;
    }

    g_defViewBorderPaintMessage.store(
        RegisterWindowMessageW(L"Win32UIModernizer.DefViewBorderPaint"),
        std::memory_order_release);
    if (!g_defViewBorderPaintMessage.load(std::memory_order_relaxed))
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to register DefView border paint message");

    g_navHoverFadeResetMessage.store(
        RegisterWindowMessageW(L"Win32UIModernizer.NavHoverFadeReset"),
        std::memory_order_release);
    if (!g_navHoverFadeResetMessage.load(std::memory_order_relaxed))
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to register nav hover fade reset message");

    // Same treatment as the two above: these are posted to regedit's own
    // main window, so a hardcoded WM_APP+N could collide with the host's or
    // another mod's private message on that window.
    g_rgRefreshColorsMessage.store(
        RegisterWindowMessageW(L"Win32UIModernizer.RgRefreshColors"),
        std::memory_order_release);
    if (!g_rgRefreshColorsMessage.load(std::memory_order_relaxed))
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to register regedit refresh-colors message");

    g_rgResetDividerMessage.store(
        RegisterWindowMessageW(L"Win32UIModernizer.RgResetDivider"),
        std::memory_order_release);
    if (!g_rgResetDividerMessage.load(std::memory_order_relaxed))
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to register regedit reset-divider message");

    // Function hooks
    // These are load-bearing: every hook callback unconditionally calls
    // through its _orig trampoline, so a silently failed SetFunctionHook
    // would leave that pointer null and crash on first invocation.
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DrawThemeBackground,
            DrawThemeBackground_hook, &DrawThemeBackground_orig)) {
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook DrawThemeBackground");
        return FALSE;
    }
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DrawThemeBackgroundEx,
        DrawThemeBackgroundEx_hook, &DrawThemeBackgroundEx_orig);
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(GetThemeColor,
            GetThemeColor_hook, &GetThemeColor_orig)) {
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook GetThemeColor");
        return FALSE;
    }
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(GetThemeMargins,
        GetThemeMargins_hook, &GetThemeMargins_orig);
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(BeginPaint,
            BeginPaint_hook, &BeginPaint_orig)) {
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook BeginPaint");
        return FALSE;
    }
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(EndPaint,
            EndPaint_hook, &EndPaint_orig)) {
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook EndPaint");
        return FALSE;
    }
    if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer()) {
        StatusWidth::Init();
        WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(SetWindowRgn,
            StatusWidth::SetWindowRgnHook,
            &StatusWidth::g_setWindowRgnOriginal);
        DesktopCheckbox::Init();
        WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(GetThemePartSize,
            GetThemePartSize_hook, &GetThemePartSize_orig);
    }
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DrawThemeText,
        DrawThemeText_hook, &DrawThemeText_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DrawThemeTextEx,
        DrawThemeTextEx_hook, &DrawThemeTextEx_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DrawThemeIcon,
        DrawThemeIcon_hook, &DrawThemeIcon_orig);


    // UAH dark menu bar: hook DefWindowProc to intercept WM_UAHDRAWMENU/ITEM
    // Also hooks DefDlgProc/DefFrameProc/DefMDIChildProc for popup menu
    // detection via WM_UAHINITMENU in dialog-based and MDI apps (tray icons).
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DefWindowProcW,
        DefWindowProcW_hook, &DefWindowProcW_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DefWindowProcA,
        DefWindowProcA_hook, &DefWindowProcA_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(SetScrollInfo,
        SetScrollInfo_hook, &SetScrollInfo_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(SetScrollPos,
        SetScrollPos_hook, &SetScrollPos_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(SetScrollRange,
        SetScrollRange_hook, &SetScrollRange_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(ShowScrollBar,
        ShowScrollBar_hook, &ShowScrollBar_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(EnableScrollBar,
        EnableScrollBar_hook, &EnableScrollBar_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DefDlgProcW,
        DefDlgProcW_hook, &DefDlgProcW_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DefDlgProcA,
        DefDlgProcA_hook, &DefDlgProcA_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DefFrameProcW,
        DefFrameProcW_hook, &DefFrameProcW_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DefFrameProcA,
        DefFrameProcA_hook, &DefFrameProcA_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DefMDIChildProcW,
        DefMDIChildProcW_hook, &DefMDIChildProcW_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DefMDIChildProcA,
        DefMDIChildProcA_hook, &DefMDIChildProcA_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(ExtTextOutW,
        ExtTextOutW_hook, &ExtTextOutW_orig);
    // Menu item bitmaps that arrive without an alpha channel; see
    // MenuRepairIconAlpha. Both hooks leave immediately unless a popup is
    // currently handling a message.
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(BitBlt, MenuBitBlt_hook, &MenuBitBlt_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(StretchBlt, MenuStretchBlt_hook,
        &MenuStretchBlt_orig);
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(FillRect,
            FillRect_hook, &FillRect_orig)) {
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook FillRect");
        return FALSE;
    }
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(SetBkColor,
            SetBkColor_hook, &SetBkColor_orig)) {
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook SetBkColor");
        return FALSE;
    }
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(SetWindowTheme,
        SetWindowTheme_hook, &SetWindowTheme_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DrawTextW,
        DrawTextW_hook, &DrawTextW_orig);
    if (g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite && IsCurrentProcessExplorer()) {
        if (!DesktopTextEnsureDragImageMessage())
            Wh_Log(L"Desktop text: failed to register drag-image message");
        DesktopTextInstallShadowHook();
    }
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DrawTextExW,
        DrawTextExW_hook, &DrawTextExW_orig);
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(
            DrawFocusRect, DrawFocusRect_hook, &DrawFocusRect_orig)) {
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook DrawFocusRect");
        return FALSE;
    }
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(DrawEdge,
        DrawEdge_hook, &DrawEdge_orig);
    // Resolve ExplorerFrame capabilities only when the module is already
    // present and a matching feature/context needs them.
    ExplorerFrameEnsureSymbolsForLoadedModule(false);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(SendMessageW,
        SendMessageW_hook, &SendMessageW_orig);
    // Context menu hooks: always installed, g_settings.ModernContextMenus
    // checked inside each hook. Enables toggling without mod restart.
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(TrackPopupMenuEx,
        TrackPopupMenuEx_hook, &TrackPopupMenuEx_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(TrackPopupMenu,
        TrackPopupMenu_hook, &TrackPopupMenu_orig);

    // Resolve DirectUI only when dui70.dll is already present. Processes
    // that load it later request the required symbol groups when their first
    // DirectUIHWND is created, without forcing the DLL into unrelated apps.
    DirectUiEnsureSymbolsForLoadedModule(false);

    // Register optional Shell/GDI+/Uniscribe hooks only after both their
    // setting and matching UI context have been observed.
    LazyFeatureEnsureHooks(false);

    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(OpenThemeData,
        OpenThemeData_hook, &OpenThemeData_orig);
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(OpenThemeDataEx,
        OpenThemeDataEx_hook, &OpenThemeDataEx_orig);
    if (HMODULE hUxForDpi = GetModuleHandleW(L"uxtheme.dll")) {
        if (FARPROC forDpi = GetProcAddress(hUxForDpi, "OpenThemeDataForDpi")) {
            WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook((OpenThemeDataForDpi_t)forDpi,
                OpenThemeDataForDpi_hook, &OpenThemeDataForDpi_orig);
        }
    }
    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(CloseThemeData,
        CloseThemeData_hook, &CloseThemeData_orig);

    // OpenNcThemeData (ordinal 49): not exported by name, so it has no real
    // declaration WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook could deduce a Prototype
    // from directly -- resolve the address manually, same pattern as
    // gdiplusHooks elsewhere in this file, but cast the raw FARPROC to the
    // OpenNcThemeData_t typedef already declared above before handing it to
    // the type-safe wrapper, instead of going through Wh_SetFunctionHook's
    // untyped void*/reinterpret_cast form. uxtheme.dll is already loaded
    // (this mod links against uxtheme.lib), so GetModuleHandle is enough,
    // no LoadLibrary needed. Logged (not fatal) on failure -- this hook is
    // a fallback for a fallback (see its own comment), not required for the
    // mod's core function.
    if (HMODULE hUxForNc = GetModuleHandleW(L"uxtheme.dll")) {
        if (FARPROC ncProc = GetProcAddress(hUxForNc, MAKEINTRESOURCEA(49))) {
            if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook((OpenNcThemeData_t)ncProc,
                    OpenNcThemeData_hook, &OpenNcThemeData_orig)) {
                Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook OpenNcThemeData (uxtheme ordinal 49)");
            }
        }
    }

    WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(GetThemeTransitionDuration,
        GetThemeTransitionDuration_hook, &GetThemeTransitionDuration_orig);

    // GetSysColor/GetSysColorBrush: always installed, internal guards check
    // g_darkModeActive/AccentMarquee/AccentColorize. No-op when all are off.
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(GetSysColor,
            GetSysColor_hook, &GetSysColor_orig)) {
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook GetSysColor");
        return FALSE;
    }
    if (!WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(GetSysColorBrush,
            GetSysColorBrush_hook, &GetSysColorBrush_orig)) {
        Wh_Log(L"Failed to hook GetSysColorBrush");
        return FALSE;
    }

    // Nav divider hover reveal's SetCursor hook is intentionally NOT
    // installed here -- it's triggered lazily, the first time this process
    // shows a real nav-pane divider (see NavDividerTrackAndGetHwnd), so
    // processes that never display one never pay even the cheapest
    // per-call check. Only the actual Wh_ApplyHookOperations is deferred,
    // via a message posted to g_msgWnd.

    // Dark-mode/exclusion state must be known before RgInitResources() below:
    // RgRefreshColorResources() (and the RgApply*Style functions it
    // triggers) read RgIsDarkMode(), which reads g_darkModeExcluded --
    // still its zero-init default (false) here otherwise, so an excluded
    // regedit.exe with system dark mode on would build its
    // TreeView/ListView/search/menu brushes dark once and never rebuild
    // them, since that function only rebuilds on an actual value change.
    // Safe to call this early: it only touches g_settings (already loaded
    // above) and process-name/registry reads, no window or hook state.
    RecomputeCustomDarkModeActive();

    // RegeditSection: queue its required hooks and init resources
    // (regedit.exe only) BEFORE the NtUserCreateWindowEx_hook install below
    // -- that hook's regedit branch reads rg_lvBkBrush/rg_tvBkBrush/etc. via
    // RgApply*Style, so a late-injection scenario must not have the hook
    // live before these resources exist.
    if (g_settings.RegeditSection && IsCurrentProcessRegedit())
    {
        if (!RgQueueRequiredHooks())
            return FALSE;
        RgInitResources();
    }

    HMODULE hNtUser = GetModuleHandleW(L"win32u.dll");
    if (hNtUser) {
        auto pCreate = (NtUserCreateWindowEx_t)GetProcAddress(hNtUser, "NtUserCreateWindowEx");
        if (pCreate)
            WindhawkUtils::SetFunctionHook(pCreate,
                NtUserCreateWindowEx_hook, &NtUserCreateWindowEx_orig);
    }

    // "About Windows" dialog treatment (winver.exe and the Registry
    // Editor's Help > About, opt-in), plus the branding bitmap Explorer's
    // Alt+F4 dialog shares with it. Hooks can only be added during init, so
    // this one goes in whenever the host could show either dialog; the
    // settings are read per call.
    if (WinverHostProcess() || IsCurrentProcessExplorer())
        WinverHookBranding();
    // The WinEvent hooks themselves (About dialog, Disk Cleanup) are installed
    // on g_msgWnd's thread once it runs, in Wh_ModAfterInit.
    if (WinverHostProcess() && g_settings.WinverSection)
        WinverEnableRuntime(true);

    if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer())
    {
        ApplyAccentColorize();
        ApplyAccentMarquee();
        // Pill animation thread is started lazily on first real animation
        // (see the PillEnsureThreadStarted() call site near the pill
        // transition setup) -- that already covers every process with a
        // nav pane, so no eager start is needed here, and starting it
        // unconditionally would spin up an idle thread even with
        // NavPanePill off.
    }

    // Dark-mode hooks run in every eligible process; only Explorer owns the
    // session-wide SetSysColors call inside ApplyDarkSysColors.
    if (ShouldCustomDarkModeBeActive()) {
        RecomputeCustomDarkModeActive();
        if (IsCustomDarkModeAllowed()) {
            ApplyDarkSysColors();

        // Process-wide dark mode for scrollbars, menus, common controls.
        if (g_setAppMode) {
            g_setAppMode(IsCurrentProcessExplorer() ? 1 : 2);
            if (g_flushMenuThemes) g_flushMenuThemes();
            // Force uxtheme to re-read immersive color policy after mode change.
            // Without this, some controls may cache stale light-mode colors.
            if (g_refreshColorPolicy) g_refreshColorPolicy();
        }
        } // end IsCustomDarkModeAllowed guard

        if (IsCustomDarkModeAllowed()) {
            if (!g_win32MainDarkBrush)
                g_win32MainDarkBrush = CreateSolidBrush(Win32MainDark);
            SetPropertyDialogClassBrush(true);
        }
    }

    // ── Install CbtProc hooks on ALL existing threads ────────────────────
    // Processes/threads that were already running before the mod loaded
    // never trigger NtUserCreateWindowEx_hook for a top-level window, so
    // their threads never get the WH_CBT hook. EnumWindows at init
    // ensures every thread with a top-level window gets the hook right away.
    MenuEnsureImmersiveHooks(false);
    if (g_settings.ModernContextMenus || g_settings.RoundedButtons)
        EnumWindows(MenuInitEnumProc, 0);

    if (g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite) {
        EnumWindows(ExplorerDialogTextApplyTop, 0);
        EnumWindows(ExplorerTextInvalidateTop, 0);
        NavTreeUniscribeInit(false);
    }

    if (g_settings.DialogTextDirectWrite && IsCurrentProcessExplorer()) {
        EnumWindows(ExplorerDialogTextApplyTop, 0);
        NavTreeUniscribeInit(false);
    }
    if (g_settings.RoundedButtons) {
        EnumWindows(ModernComboTextApplyTop, 0);
        NavTreeUniscribeInit(false);
    }

    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK NavMetricsRestoreEnumProc(HWND hwnd, LPARAM);

void Wh_ModBeforeUninit()
{
    ShellCheckAnim::BeforeUninit();
    DesktopCheckbox::BeforeUninit();
    NavMetricsTransparentList::BeforeUninit();
    // Restores the status bar and pane on each window's thread while the
    // DirectUI hooks are still installed.
    StatusWidth::BeforeUninit();
    g_shellTextRasterUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    g_explorerDialogTextUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    g_menuImmersiveUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    // Under the lazy installers' own locks: one already past its check
    // finishes applying before this returns, and none starts afterwards.
    {
        std::scoped_lock hookLocks(g_navTreeUniscribeHookMutex,
                                   NavAnim::g_hookMutex, g_navDividerHookMutex,
                                   g_lazyControlHookMutex, g_directUiSymbolsMutex);
        g_lazyFeatureHooksUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        g_navDividerUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        g_directUiUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    g_explorerFrameUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    g_listRenameUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    g_shortcutOverlayActive.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    g_tooltipEffectsUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    g_tooltipTextUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    g_pillUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    NavAnim::BeforeUninit();
    g_diskPieAnimationUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    g_winverUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    g_singleLinePropertyTabsUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    g_tabFeaturesUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    g_defViewBorderUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    // Stop Winver's HWND timer before Windhawk begins draining hooks. Any
    // already-queued start/timer message also sees g_winverUnloading above.
    if (HWND dialog = g_winverSubclassedDlg;
        dialog && IsWindow(dialog)) {
        (void)KillTimer(dialog, kWinverLogoAnimTimerId);
    }
    g_winverLogoAnimating.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    g_winverLogoAnimPending.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    WinverResetGradientAnimation();
    // Hooks are still installed during this callback -- block a new glyph
    // background worker from starting before Windhawk finishes detaching
    // them.
    GlyphBgBeginUnload();
}

void Wh_ModUninit()
{
    ThemeEngineWatchStop();
    // Set first: lets ThemeMsgWndProc's kNavDividerApplyHooksMessage handler
    // skip Wh_ApplyHookOperations if a divider paint posted it moments ago
    // (see NavDividerTrackAndGetHwnd) right as the mod is being unloaded.
    g_navDividerUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    // Same reasoning: the WH_CBT/TrackPopupMenu(Ex)/NtUserCreateWindowEx
    // hooks that can install MenuAcrylicSubclassProc on a new popup are still
    // fully live for the several blocking waits below -- set this before them
    // so MenuTryInstallAcrylic refuses new installs for the rest of teardown,
    // and the EnumWindows(MenuRemoveSubclassEnum) sweep further down is
    // guaranteed to see everything that could ever be installed.
    g_menuAcrylicUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    // Block checkbox subclass installs before the one-shot cleanup sweeps.
    g_checkBoxAnimUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    // Block RegeditSection subclass installs before RgUninit's one-shot sweep.
    rg_unloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    // Block HdrDarkPaintInstall before AuxiliarySubclassCleanup's one-shot sweep.
    g_hdrDarkUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    GlyphBgBeginUnload();
    g_darkModeUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    // Set before ShortcutOverlayUninit() below, same reasoning as
    // g_navDividerUnloading above: a kShortcutOverlayActivateMessage posted
    // moments ago could otherwise still dispatch and re-activate on
    // g_msgWnd's thread before DestroyMsgWindow() stops it.
    g_shortcutOverlayUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    // No GDI+ startup from here on: a control still subclassed while the
    // sweeps below run must not restart what the shutdowns release.
    g_gdipUnloading.store(true, std::memory_order_release);

    NavAnim::Uninit();
    ShortcutOverlayUninit();

    // This thread executes mod code and must be fully joined before unload;
    // Windhawk doesn't allow pinning it past the DLL lifetime.
    DestroyMsgWindow();

    WinverDisableRuntime();
    if (g_winbrandModule) {
        FreeLibrary(g_winbrandModule);
        g_winbrandModule = nullptr;
    }
    ButtonPopCleanup();
    BreadcrumbChevronCleanup();
    PlacesBarCleanup();

    ListRenameCleanupAll(true);
    LvCacheDestroy();
    EditSpinBuddyCacheClear();
    DiskPieAnimationCleanupAll();
    LazyFeatureReleaseModules();
    MenuReleaseImmersiveHookModules();
    g_winUiTabFontCache.Clear();
    g_groupHeaderFontCache.Clear();
    WinUiTextDWriteCacheClear();
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_dragDropThemesLock);
    g_dragDropThemes.clear();
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_dragDropThemesLock);
    ShellIconClearCache();
    ShellIconClearModuleCaches();
    PinContentIconClearCache();
    ColorIconClearCache();
    // Stop pill animation thread first (must happen before DComp release).
    HANDLE pillThread = nullptr;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillThreadStartMutex);
        if (g_pillThread) {
            g_pillThreadStop.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
            if (g_pillWakeEvent)
                SetEvent(g_pillWakeEvent);
            pillThread = g_pillThread;
        }
    }
    // Joined without a timeout: the DLL is freed right after this callback,
    // and a thread still running mod code then crashes the host. A thread
    // stuck in a GPU call makes the unload slow, which beats a crash.
    if (pillThread)
        WaitForSingleObject(pillThread, INFINITE);
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillThreadStartMutex);
        if (pillThread) {
            CloseHandle(pillThread);
            if (g_pillThread == pillThread)
                g_pillThread = nullptr;
        }
        if (g_pillWakeEvent) {
            CloseHandle(g_pillWakeEvent);
            g_pillWakeEvent = nullptr;
        }
    }

    // Stop the icon scale-pop animation thread. It never messages a window
    // (see IconPopAnimThread), so the join is short.
    if (g_iconPopThread)
    {
        g_iconPopThreadStop.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        if (g_iconPopWakeEvent) SetEvent(g_iconPopWakeEvent); // idle wait is INFINITE
        WaitForSingleObject(g_iconPopThread, INFINITE);
        CloseHandle(g_iconPopThread);
        g_iconPopThread = nullptr;
        g_iconPopThreadStop.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    if (g_iconPopWakeEvent) {
        CloseHandle(g_iconPopWakeEvent);
        g_iconPopWakeEvent = nullptr;
    }

    // Wait for any in-flight glyph background build/drive-arrival threads
    // (GlyphBuildMapThreadProc, GlyphRefreshDriveArrivalThreadProc) to finish
    // before the DLL unloads out from under them. Handles are retained until
    // each thread signals, so this waits on the real thread exit instead of
    // polling a counter that can reach zero just before the thread's return
    // epilogue actually runs inside this DLL.
    GlyphBgWaitForWorkers();

    // Remove the nav-pane pill subclass and every tree's chevron subclass.
    PillTreeSubclassRemove();
    ChevronAnimRemoveAll();
    ListSelectFadeCleanup();

    // Restore system colors: the accent entries first, so the dark palette
    // restore that follows has the last word on the entries both write.
    if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer())
    {
        if (g_accentSaved) {
            SetSysColors(g_nAccentElems, g_accentElems, g_origAccentCols);
            g_accentSaved = false;
        }
        if (g_hotlightSaved) {
            INT      elems[2] = { COLOR_HOTLIGHT, COLOR_HIGHLIGHT };
            COLORREF cols[2]  = { g_origHotlight, g_origHighlight };
            SetSysColors(2, elems, cols);
            g_hotlightSaved = false;
        }
    }
    RestoreDarkSysColors();
    if (g_darkSysColsMap) { CloseHandle(g_darkSysColsMap); g_darkSysColsMap = nullptr; }
    if (g_darkSysColsMutex) { CloseHandle(g_darkSysColsMutex); g_darkSysColsMutex = nullptr; }
    // Revert the uxtheme app-mode preference too -- RestoreDarkSysColors only
    // reverts the color table, so without this a long-lived host process
    // (e.g. Explorer) keeps creating new standard controls in dark mode until
    // it restarts. Guarded on g_darkModeActive so we don't clobber another
    // dark-mode mod's own preference in a process where we never set it.
    if (g_darkModeActive.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        RevertPreferredAppMode();
        // Same pass as turning dark mode off in the settings: controls themed
        // and colored dark at creation go back to light.
        g_darkModeActive.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        if (g_refreshColorPolicy) g_refreshColorPolicy();
        if (g_flushMenuThemes) g_flushMenuThemes();
        EnumWindows(ModeSwitchEnumProc, kModeSwitchUnloading);
    }
    MicaRevertAll();
    EnumWindows(AeroWizardCaptionRevertEnum, 0);

    // Release context menu D2D hover resources

    // Glyph Icons cleanup
    g_iconPopDCHandoffPendingFor.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    g_iconPopDCClearFor.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    g_iconPopDCClearPending.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    g_iconPopHandoffEnd.store(0.0, std::memory_order_release);
    EnumWindows(NavMetricsRestoreEnumProc, 0);
    TravelBandFontCachesClear();
    PinFontCacheClear();
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_glyphTreeMutex);
        for (HWND h : g_glyphTrackedTrees)
            if (IsWindow(h)) InvalidateRect(h, nullptr, TRUE);
        g_glyphTrackedTrees.clear();
    }
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_glyphMapMutex);
        g_glyphIndexMap.clear();
        g_glyphFilledMap.clear();
        g_glyphKnownFolderNames.clear();
        g_glyphPhoneNames.clear();
        g_glyphProgFilesNames.clear();
    }
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_svgGeomCacheMutex);
        g_homeDoorMaskOuterGeometry.Reset();
        g_svgGeomCache.clear();
    }
    g_winverLogoGeom.Reset();
    GlyphDWriteCacheClear();
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_glyphActiveItemMutex);
        g_glyphActiveItem.clear();
    }


    // Unhook per-thread WH_CBT hooks (context menus / checkbox animation)
    InitCbtHooks_Cleanup();

    // Remove and clean up checkbox animation subclasses
    CheckAnims_Cleanup();

    // Remove only subclasses that were actually installed. Their owner sets
    // are maintained at install/WM_NCDESTROY time.
    RestoreSingleLinePropertyTabs();
    TabFlickerFixRemoveAll();
    AuxiliarySubclassCleanup();
    TreeDoubleBufferRemoveAll();
    ToolbarDoubleBufferRemoveAll();
    MmcStyleStripRemoveAll();

    // Remove all treeview insertion-mark subclasses
    EnumWindows(EnumWindowsRemoveSubclasses, 0);
    SetPropertyDialogClassBrush(false);
    SetFontViewClassBrush(false);
    // g_navDividerUnloading was already set at the very top of this function.
    NavDividerClearAll();

    // Remove ComboBox DWM subclasses
    EnumWindows(CbdRemoveEnum, 0);

    // Remove acrylic-menu subclasses from any popups still alive on unload.
    // Cheap: the EnumWindows pass already iterates top-levels, and most
    // #32768 popups are gone by the time the user disables the mod.
    EnumWindows(MenuRemoveSubclassEnum, 0);
    EnumWindows(TooltipAcrylicEnum, TRUE);

    // The brushes GetSysColorBrush_hook handed out, now that no subclass
    // or hook can hand them out again.
    SysColorBrushesRelease();
    ExcludedBrushCacheClear();
    if (g_modernLtEditBkBrush) { DeleteObject(g_modernLtEditBkBrush); g_modernLtEditBkBrush = nullptr; }

    // Its subclasses paint with the D2D thread caches, freed below.
    if (IsCurrentProcessRegedit())
        RgUninit(/*fullUnload=*/true);
    // After RgUninit: a repaint before it could put an icon back.
    RgGlyphIconClearCache();

    // Only now that every subclass and timer that paints with GDI+ is gone.
    DragDropBadgeCacheClear();
    FocusRectGdipShutdown();
    ExplorerSysLinkGdipShutdown();
    RoundedHdcGdipShutdown();
    DiskPieRingGdipShutdown();

    // The pill thread was joined above, so it no longer holds this mutex.
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillDCMutex);
        PillDCompRelease_Locked();
    }

    // Release the WinUI tab background cache. PaintTab keeps this mutex while
    // obtaining and stretching a cached DC, so cleanup can't free it mid-draw.
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_tabBgMutex);
        TabBgCacheClearWinUI();
    }

    PillGdiFadeCacheClear();
    // Hooks are removed before Wh_ModUninit. FlsFree now releases the cache of
    // every paint thread, not only the thread running this callback.
    if (!D2DThreadCachesClear())
        Wh_Log(L"D2D thread caches: FLS index not freed");
    ShellTextRasterConfigure();

    // Release checkbox stroke style
    g_checkStrokeStyle.Reset();

    StaticBrushCacheClear();
    // The dialog/font class brushes were restored in Wh_ModBeforeUninit.
    if (g_elevatedPaneDarkBrush) {
        DeleteObject(g_elevatedPaneDarkBrush);
        g_elevatedPaneDarkBrush = nullptr;
    }
    if (g_win32MainDarkBrush) {
        DeleteObject(g_win32MainDarkBrush);
        g_win32MainDarkBrush = nullptr;
    }
    CleanupResources();
    GraphicsModulesRelease();
}

static BOOL CALLBACK PinSettingsEnumChildProc(HWND child, LPARAM)
{
    HIMAGELIST ours = (HIMAGELIST)GetPropW(child, kPropPinList);
    const bool eligible = g_settings.FluentPinIcon
        && g_settings.ExplorerSection
        && GlyphIsNavPaneTreeView(child)
        && !PinIsDisabledDragDropTreeView(child);

    if (!eligible) {
        if (ours)
            PinRestoreOriginalList(child, true);
        return TRUE;
    }

    HIMAGELIST src = ours
        ? (HIMAGELIST)GetPropW(child, kPropPinOrigList)
        : TreeView_GetImageList(child, TVSIL_STATE);

    if (ours)
        PinRestoreOriginalList(child, true);

    PinInstallCustomList(child, src);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK PinSettingsEnumProc(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId()) return TRUE;
    EnumChildWindows(hwnd, PinSettingsEnumChildProc, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK NavMetricsEnumChildProc(HWND child, LPARAM)
{
    NavMetricsUpdateTree(child);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK NavMetricsEnumProc(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId()) return TRUE;
    EnumChildWindows(hwnd, NavMetricsEnumChildProc, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK NavMetricsRestoreEnumChildProc(HWND child, LPARAM)
{
    NavMetricsRestoreTree(child, true);
    return TRUE;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK NavMetricsRestoreEnumProc(HWND hwnd, LPARAM)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId()) return TRUE;
    EnumChildWindows(hwnd, NavMetricsRestoreEnumChildProc, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

BOOL Wh_ModSettingsChanged(BOOL* bReload)
{
    const bool wasDarkModeActive =
        g_darkModeActive.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    const bool tooltipTextWasEnabled = TooltipTextIsEnabled();
    const Settings oldSettings = LoadSettings();
    *bReload = FALSE;
    const bool tooltipTextEnabled = TooltipTextIsEnabled();
    const bool roundedHighContrast = SysHighContrastEnabled();
    g_roundedSelectionHighContrast.store(
        roundedHighContrast, std::memory_order_release);
    g_listRenameHighContrast.store(
        roundedHighContrast, std::memory_order_release);
    RecomputeCustomDarkModeActive();
    const bool nowDarkModeActive = IsCustomDarkModeAllowed();
    const bool darkPolicyChanged =
        wasDarkModeActive != nowDarkModeActive ||
        oldSettings.EnableDarkMode != g_settings.EnableDarkMode;
    if (!g_isXamlProcess) {
        LazyFeatureEnsureHooks(true);
    }
    if (g_settings.ModernContextMenus)
        MenuEnsureImmersiveHooks(true);
    ExplorerFrameEnsureSymbolsForLoadedModule(true);
    DirectUiEnsureSymbolsForLoadedModule(true);
    StatusWidth::SettingsChanged(oldSettings.StatusBarWidth);
    ShellTextRasterConfigure();
    if (!g_isXamlProcess && wasDarkModeActive && !nowDarkModeActive)
        RestoreDarkSysColors();
    UpdateThemeColors();

    if (oldSettings.ModernShortcutOverlay !=
        g_settings.ModernShortcutOverlay) {
        if (g_settings.ModernShortcutOverlay)
            ShortcutOverlayEnableForCurrentProcess();
        else
            ShortcutOverlayDisable();
    }

    if (!g_settings.LegacyRebarControls) {
        ButtonPopCleanup();
        BreadcrumbChevronCleanup();
        PlacesBarCleanup();
    }
    if (oldSettings.ExplorerMicaBackdrop != g_settings.ExplorerMicaBackdrop) {
        // The solid pane tiles carry the mode's color.
        g_explorerMicaSolidTileReady[0].store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        g_explorerMicaSolidTileReady[1].store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer() &&
        oldSettings.ExplorerMicaBackdrop !=
            g_settings.ExplorerMicaBackdrop &&
        g_settings.ExplorerMicaBackdrop) {
        EnumWindows(ExplorerMicaBackdropApplyEnum, 0);
    }
    if (oldSettings.ExplorerMicaBackdrop >= 1 &&
        oldSettings.ExplorerMicaBackdrop <= 3 && !ExplorerMicaActive()) {
        MicaRevertAll();
    }
    // The caption is set once per wizard in the mode of the moment; clearing
    // it lets the next paint set it again for the new mode, or not at all.
    if (darkPolicyChanged ||
        oldSettings.RoundedButtons != g_settings.RoundedButtons) {
        EnumWindows(AeroWizardCaptionRevertEnum, 0);
    }
    // AddrBarSyncSubclassProc install is gated on ExplorerSection AND
    // LegacyRebarControls both being on -- either going off needs the same
    // sweep, including the mid-suppression WM_SETREDRAW restore (see
    // AddrBarSyncRemoveChildEnum) so a disabled feature can't leave the
    // address bar frozen.
    if (!g_settings.ExplorerSection || !g_settings.LegacyRebarControls) {
        EnumWindows(AddrBarSyncRemoveEnum, 0);
    }
    if (oldSettings.RoundedButtons && !g_settings.RoundedButtons) {
        EnumWindows(SplitButtonChevronRemoveEnum, 0);
        TrackbarRemoveAllSubclasses();
        EditSpinBuddyCacheClear();
    }
    if (oldSettings.ModernSeparators && !g_settings.ModernSeparators) {
        StatusBarRemoveAllSubclasses();
    }
    if (oldSettings.ExplorerMicaBackdrop >= 2 && !ExplorerMicaPaneMode()) {
        PaneScrollBarRemoveAllSubclasses();
    }
    if (oldSettings.ExplorerSection && !g_settings.ExplorerSection) {
        EnumWindows(TreeCursorRemoveEnum, 0);
    }
    // Group-header and Spin chevrons share the icon-font DirectWrite cache
    // with GlyphIcons/FluentPinIcon. Detect the real fallback face when
    // either feature is enabled live instead of trusting the default name.
    if (!oldSettings.RoundedButtons && g_settings.RoundedButtons) {
        GlyphDetectFont();
    }
    // Each root has its own timer; disabling the visual or entering high
    // contrast makes every tracked selection fade unreachable.
    if ((oldSettings.RoundedButtons && !g_settings.RoundedButtons) ||
        roundedHighContrast) {
        ListSelectFadeCleanup();
    }
    if (!g_settings.GlyphIcons && !g_settings.FluentPinIcon &&
        !g_settings.RoundedButtons) {
        GlyphDWriteCacheClear();
    }
    ShellIconClearCache();
    PinContentIconClearCache();
    RgGlyphIconClearCache();
    ColorIconClearCache();
    if (!g_settings.ModernizeShellIcons && !g_settings.ColorNavIcons &&
        !g_settings.ModernShortcutOverlay) {
        ShellIconReleaseSvgResources();
    }

    const bool modernBordersChanged =
        oldSettings.ModernSeparators != g_settings.ModernSeparators;
    if (oldSettings.EditFocusLine != g_settings.EditFocusLine ||
        modernBordersChanged) {
        EnumWindows(ModernBorderApplyHotkeyEnum, 0);
    }
    if (!g_isXamlProcess &&
        (oldSettings.EditFocusLine != g_settings.EditFocusLine ||
         (IsCurrentProcessRegedit() &&
          (oldSettings.RegeditSection != g_settings.RegeditSection ||
           oldSettings.RgMicaBackdrop != g_settings.RgMicaBackdrop)))) {
        ListRenameCleanupAll(true);
        EnumWindows(ListRenameTrackTopEnum, 0);
    }
    if (modernBordersChanged &&
        (!g_isXamlProcess || !g_settings.ModernSeparators)) {
        EnumWindows(ModernBorderApplyGroupBoxEnum, 0);
    }
    if (oldSettings.ModernTooltips != g_settings.ModernTooltips ||
        tooltipTextWasEnabled != tooltipTextEnabled) {
        EnumWindows(TooltipAcrylicEnum, FALSE);
    }

    if (g_isXamlProcess) {
        if (g_settings.ModernContextMenus) {
            EnumWindows(MenuInitEnumProc, 0);
            EnumWindows(MenuReapplyCornerEnum, 0);
        } else {
            EnumWindows(MenuRemoveSubclassEnum, 0);
        }
        return TRUE;
    }

    if (modernBordersChanged) {
        if (g_settings.ModernSeparators)
            EnumWindows(DefViewBorderApplyEnum, 0);
        else
            EnumWindows(DefViewBorderRemoveEnum, 0);
    }

    // Dark system colors: setting is opt-in, system dark mode is the gate.
    if (nowDarkModeActive) {
        ApplyDarkSysColors();
        if (!g_win32MainDarkBrush)
            g_win32MainDarkBrush = CreateSolidBrush(Win32MainDark);
    } else {
        RestoreDarkSysColors();
    }
    if (darkPolicyChanged) {
        if (g_setAppMode) {
            if (nowDarkModeActive)
                g_setAppMode(IsCurrentProcessExplorer() ? 1 : 2);
            else
                RevertPreferredAppMode();
            if (g_refreshColorPolicy) g_refreshColorPolicy();
            if (g_flushMenuThemes) g_flushMenuThemes();
        }
        SetPropertyDialogClassBrush(nowDarkModeActive);
        SetFontViewClassBrush(nowDarkModeActive);
        EnumWindows(ModeSwitchEnumProc, 0);
    }

    if (g_settings.ModernContextMenus)
        EnumWindows(CbdReapplyEnum, 0);
    else
        EnumWindows(CbdRemoveEnum, 0);

    if (g_settings.ModernContextMenus) {
        EnumWindows(MenuInitEnumProc, 0);
        EnumWindows(MenuReapplyCornerEnum, 0);
    } else {
        EnumWindows(MenuRemoveSubclassEnum, 0);
    }

    // RegeditSection turned on/off while regedit.exe is already running --
    // without this, enabling it never styles the already-open window until
    // restart, and disabling it leaves subclasses/timers running until the
    // process closes. RgInitResources()/the hook installs are idempotent,
    // and TryApplyToWindow_Regedit's compare_exchange_strong claims make
    // re-scanning an already-styled window safe.
    if (g_settings.RegeditSection && IsCurrentProcessRegedit()) {
        RgInitResources();
        bool hooksQueued = false;
        const bool hooksReady = RgQueueRequiredHooks(&hooksQueued);
        if (hooksQueued)
            Wh_ApplyHookOperations();
        if (!hooksReady)
            Wh_Log(L"RegeditSection enabled with one or more hooks unavailable");
        EnumWindows(RgEnumWindowsAfterInitProc, 0);
        const HWND rgMain = rg_hwndMain.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (rgMain) {
            // Color resources are swapped in-place with no locking, so a refresh
            // must happen on rgMain's own UI thread (see RgInitResources) --
            // post, never call RgRefreshColorResources() directly from here.
            if (const UINT refreshMsg = g_rgRefreshColorsMessage.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
                PostMessageW(rgMain, refreshMsg, 0, 0);
            else
                Wh_Log(L"Skipping regedit color refresh: refresh-colors message not registered");
        }
    } else if (IsCurrentProcessRegedit()) {
        RgUninit(/*fullUnload=*/false);
    }

    // Flicker-fix subclass, gated by RoundedTabPane -- covers already-open
    // dialogs whose tab controls existed before this settings-changed pass.
    if (g_settings.RoundedTabPane)
        EnumWindows(TabFlickerFixApplyEnum, 0);
    else if (oldSettings.RoundedTabPane)
        TabFlickerFixRemoveAll();
    if (g_settings.SingleLinePropertyTabs)
        EnumWindows(ApplySingleLinePropertyTabsEnum, 0);
    else if (oldSettings.SingleLinePropertyTabs)
        RestoreSingleLinePropertyTabs();
    if (!g_settings.RoundedTabPane && !g_settings.RoundedButtons)
        RoundedHdcGdipShutdown();
    if (!g_settings.RoundedTabPane)
        g_winUiTabFontCache.Clear();
    if (!g_settings.RoundedButtons)
        g_groupHeaderFontCache.Clear();
    if (!g_settings.RoundedTabPane && !g_settings.RoundedButtons &&
        !g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite && !g_settings.DialogTextDirectWrite) {
        WinUiTextDWriteCacheClear();
    }
    if (!g_settings.DiskChartAccentColor)
        DiskPieAnimationCleanupAll();
    if (!g_settings.DiskChartAccentColor)
        DiskPieRingGdipShutdown();

    // Same "cover already-open windows" rationale as the tab flicker fix
    // above, for the two other creation-time-only double-buffer fixes.
    if (g_settings.RoundedButtons)
        EnumWindows(TrackbarDoubleBufferApplyEnum, 0);
    if (g_settings.ExplorerSection && g_settings.LegacyRebarControls)
        EnumWindows(ToolbarDoubleBufferApplyEnum, 0);

    // Stop an in-flight transition before changing any pill resource or
    // visual policy. The worker validates this generation at every handoff.
    const bool pillChanged =
        oldSettings.NavPanePill != g_settings.NavPanePill ||
        oldSettings.NavPillStyle != g_settings.NavPillStyle ||
        oldSettings.AccentGradients != g_settings.AccentGradients ||
        oldSettings.NavPillNoClip != g_settings.NavPillNoClip;
    if (pillChanged) {
        g_pillTimer.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
        g_pillNextTransitionId.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        g_pillDCClearPending.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
        g_pillDCClearRequested.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        PillWakeThread();
        PillGdiFadeCacheClear();

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillDCMutex);
        if (!g_settings.NavPanePill || g_settings.NavPillStyle == 0) {
            PillDCompRelease_Locked();
        } else {
            PillDCompHide_Locked();
            if (oldSettings.NavPillStyle != g_settings.NavPillStyle)
                PillDCompReleaseTarget_Locked();
            if (oldSettings.AccentGradients != g_settings.AccentGradients)
                g_pillDC.brushDirty = true;
        }
    }
    if (!g_settings.AnimatedArrows && PillAnimStyle() == 0)
        ChevronAnimRemoveAll();
    if (!g_settings.NavPanePill || g_settings.NavPillStyle == 0) {
        PillTreeSubclassRemove();
    } else if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer()) {
        // Device-only prewarm: no HWND target, visual, surface, root or commit.
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillDCMutex);
        PillDCompEnsureDevice_Locked();
    }

    // A renderer/motion-mode switch must not let an in-flight animation
    // continue under the new policy. This also detaches any DComp glyph
    // immediately when switching from GPU mode to static/native/disabled.
    if (oldSettings.GlyphIconMode != g_settings.GlyphIconMode) {
        g_iconPopTimer.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
        g_iconPopDCHandoffPendingFor.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
        g_iconPopDCClearFor.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
        g_iconPopDCClearPending.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
        g_iconPopHandoffEnd.store(0.0, std::memory_order_release);
        LPARAM shownFor = g_iconPopDCShownFor.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (shownFor) {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillDCMutex);
            IconPopDCompHideIfShown_Locked((HTREEITEM)shownFor);
        }
    }

    const bool dividerSettingsChanged =
        oldSettings.RemoveNavDivider != g_settings.RemoveNavDivider ||
        oldSettings.NavDividerHoverReveal != g_settings.NavDividerHoverReveal;
    if (dividerSettingsChanged)
        NavDividerClearAll();

    if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer()) {
        if (g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite && !oldSettings.ShellTextDirectWrite &&
            !DesktopTextEnsureDragImageMessage())
            Wh_Log(L"Desktop text: failed to register drag-image message");
        if (g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite &&
            !g_desktopDrawShadowTextExOrig) {
            DesktopTextInstallShadowHook();
            if (g_desktopDrawShadowTextExOrig)
                Wh_ApplyHookOperations();
        }
        if (oldSettings.ShellTextDirectWrite !=
            g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite) {
            EnumWindows(DesktopTextInvalidateTop, 0);
        }

        if (g_settings.ModernInsert && !oldSettings.ModernInsert &&
            !CCDrawInsertMark_orig &&
            g_insertMarkContextSeen.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
            InsertMarkInstallHook();
            if (CCDrawInsertMark_orig)
                Wh_ApplyHookOperations();
        }
    }

    if (oldSettings.ShellTextDirectWrite != g_settings.ShellTextDirectWrite) {
        EnumWindows(ExplorerDialogTextApplyTop, 0);
        EnumWindows(ExplorerTextInvalidateTop, 0);
    }

    if (oldSettings.DialogTextDirectWrite != g_settings.DialogTextDirectWrite &&
        IsCurrentProcessExplorer()) {
        EnumWindows(ExplorerDialogTextApplyTop, 0);
        EnumWindows(ExplorerTextInvalidateTop, 0);
    }
    if (oldSettings.RoundedButtons != g_settings.RoundedButtons)
        EnumWindows(ModernComboTextApplyTop, 0);
    if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer() &&
        (oldSettings.RoundedButtons != g_settings.RoundedButtons ||
         oldSettings.ExplorerSection != g_settings.ExplorerSection))
        DesktopCheckbox::SettingsChanged();

    if (WinverHostProcess()) {
        if (g_settings.WinverSection) {
            WinverEnableRuntime(!oldSettings.WinverSection);
            if (g_winverSubclassedDlg && IsWindow(g_winverSubclassedDlg) &&
                (oldSettings.WinverBackground != g_settings.WinverBackground ||
                 !oldSettings.WinverSection)) {
                WinverApplyCurrentBackground(g_winverSubclassedDlg);
                RedrawWindow(g_winverSubclassedDlg, nullptr, nullptr,
                    RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ERASE | RDW_FRAME | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
            }
        } else if (oldSettings.WinverSection) {
            WinverDisableRuntime();
        }
    }

    // Modern controls turned off: remove existing subclasses/timers now. The
    // WH_CBT hook is shared, so tear it down only when both features
    // are off, matching InstallCbtHookForThread's guard.
    if (!g_settings.RoundedButtons) {
        CheckAnims_Cleanup();
        if (!g_settings.ModernContextMenus)
            InitCbtHooks_Cleanup();
    } else if (!oldSettings.RoundedButtons) {
        EnumWindows(MenuInitEnumProc, 0);
    }

    // Rebuild the expensive image-index map only when glyph replacement is
    // toggled. Other visual settings only need existing TreeViews repainted.
    const bool glyphReplacementChanged =
        oldSettings.GlyphIcons != g_settings.GlyphIcons ||
        oldSettings.ColorNavIcons != g_settings.ColorNavIcons;
    if (glyphReplacementChanged) {
        g_glyphBgGeneration.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        g_glyphMapBuilt.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_glyphMapMutex);
            g_glyphIndexMap.clear();
            g_glyphFilledMap.clear();
            g_glyphKnownFolderNames.clear();
            g_glyphPhoneNames.clear();
            g_glyphProgFilesNames.clear();
        }
        if (g_settings.GlyphIcons)
            GlyphDetectFont();
        // Proactive cache warm-up only -- not the only path that builds the
        // map. TreeRuntimeApplyEnum below (and the per-TreeView
        // GlyphEnsureMap call it triggers) still covers any process that
        // later shows a real nav pane; a non-interactive host just has none
        // to warm the cache for.
        if (GlyphOrColorIconsActive() && IsCurrentProcessInteractive())
            GlyphEnsureMap();
    }
    EnumWindows(TreeRuntimeApplyEnum, 0);

    // Pin lists are separate image-list owners and must be rebuilt after the
    // glyph map/runtime TreeView state has been updated.
    const bool pinSettingsChanged =
        oldSettings.FluentPinIcon != g_settings.FluentPinIcon ||
        oldSettings.PinIconStyle != g_settings.PinIconStyle ||
        oldSettings.PinIconColor != g_settings.PinIconColor ||
        oldSettings.PinMarginRight != g_settings.PinMarginRight ||
        glyphReplacementChanged;
    if (pinSettingsChanged)
        EnumWindows(PinSettingsEnumProc, 0);
    return TRUE;
}

// Wh_ModAfterInit: scan existing windows for regedit late-attach.
void Wh_ModAfterInit()
{
    // All included processes need to follow live app-theme changes, not only
    // explorer.exe. A dedicated thread owns its hidden receiver and message
    // loop. Started here (not Wh_ModInit) so it's only ever created once
    // Wh_ModInit has already succeeded -- creating it earlier, ahead of
    // still-fallible hook registration, risked orphaning the thread.
    //
    // Deliberately unconditional, not gated behind any single setting:
    // ThemeMsgWndProc's WM_SETTINGCHANGE/WM_THEMECHANGED handling resets
    // g_animEnabled (read by SysAnimationsEnabled(), which gates most of
    // this mod's animated features) and invalidates the shared theme-color
    // caches that nearly every paint path reads -- gating window creation
    // behind a narrower OR (e.g. just EnableDarkMode/FluentPinIcon) would
    // silently starve those unrelated features of live-update reactivity
    // whenever that narrower condition happened to be false. The thread
    // itself is a plain GetMessageW pump, parked in the kernel at ~zero
    // cost while idle, so there's no real teardown benefit to chase here.
    CreateMsgWindow();
    ThemeEngineWatchStart();
    // Installed synchronously, before the host shows its first dialog.
    WinEventHooksRequestSync();

    // Catch Shell rendering modules loaded between Wh_ModInit's conditional
    // probes and the message window becoming available. Future DirectUIHWND
    // creation posts the same pending work to that window instead.
    ExplorerFrameEnsureSymbolsForLoadedModule(true);
    // DirectUI hooks registered during Wh_ModInit are applied by now.
    DuiElementLifetimeMarkLive();
    StatusWidth::MarkHooksLive();
    DirectUiEnsureSymbolsForLoadedModule(true);
    LazyFeatureEnsureHooks(true);

    ShortcutOverlayEnableForCurrentProcess();

    if (!g_isXamlProcess)
        EnumWindows(TreeRuntimeApplyEnum, 0);
    if (!g_isXamlProcess)
        EnumWindows(ScrollBarOwnerInstallEnum, 0);
    if (g_settings.SingleLinePropertyTabs)
        EnumWindows(ApplySingleLinePropertyTabsEnum, 0);
    if (!g_isXamlProcess && g_settings.ModernSeparators) {
        EnumWindows(ModernBorderApplyGroupBoxEnum, 0);
        EnumWindows(DefViewBorderApplyEnum, 0);
    }
    if (!g_isXamlProcess &&
        (g_settings.EditFocusLine ||
         ((ExplorerMicaActive() || RgMicaActive()) && !g_darkModeActive))) {
        EnumWindows(ListRenameTrackTopEnum, 0);
    }
    if (!g_isXamlProcess && g_settings.ModernTooltips)
        EnumWindows(TooltipAcrylicEnum, FALSE);
    if (g_settings.EditFocusLine || g_settings.ModernSeparators)
        EnumWindows(ModernBorderApplyHotkeyEnum, 0);
    if (g_settings.RegeditSection && IsCurrentProcessRegedit()) {
        EnumWindows(RgEnumWindowsAfterInitProc, 0);
    }
    if (!g_isXamlProcess && g_settings.NavPaneWinUIMetrics)
        EnumWindows(NavMetricsEnumProc, 0);
    if (g_settings.ExplorerMicaBackdrop) {
        EnumWindows(ExplorerMicaBackdropApplyEnum, 0);
    }
    if (IsCurrentProcessExplorer() && g_settings.NavPanePill &&
        g_settings.NavPillStyle != 0) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_pillDCMutex);
        PillDCompEnsureDevice_Locked();
    }
}

/*
# Windows 11 File Explorer Styler

Customize the File Explorer with themes contributed by others or create your
own.

Also check out the **Windows 11 Taskbar Styler**, **Windows 11 Start Menu

## Advanced styling

Aside from themes, the settings have two sections: control styles and resource
variables. Control styles allow to override styles, such as size and color, for
the target elements. Resource variables allow to override predefined variables.
For a more detailed explanation and examples, refer to the sections below.

The [UWPSpy](https://ramensoftware.com/uwpspy) tool can be used to inspect the
file explorer control elements in real time, and experiment with various styles.
To target file explorer with UWPSpy, select the `explorer.exe` process and the
WinUI 3 target framework.

For a collection of commonly requested file explorer styling customizations,
check out [The Windows 11 file explorer styling
guide](https://github.com/ramensoftware/windows-11-file-explorer-styling-guide/blob/main/README.md).

### Control styles

Each entry has a target control and a list of styles.

The target control is written as `Class` or `Class#Name`, i.e. the target
control class name (the tag name in XAML resource files), such as
`FileExplorerExtensions.NavigationBarControl` or `Rectangle`, optionally
followed by `#` and the target control's name (`x:Name` attribute in XAML
resource files). The target control can also include:
* Child control index, for example: `Class#Name[2]` will only match the relevant
  control that's also the second child among all of its parent's child controls.
* Control properties, for example:
  `Class#Name[Property1=Value1][Property2=Value2]`.
* Parent controls, separated by `>`, for example: `ParentClass#ParentName >
  Class#Name`.
* `*` between two `>` separators to match any number of intermediate parent
  controls, for example: `ParentClass > * > Class#Name` matches `Class#Name`
  when `ParentClass` is any of its ancestors (with zero or more controls in
  between). `*` must be in the middle of the target (not the leftmost or
  rightmost part), and consecutive `*` are not allowed.
* `:root` as the leftmost target part to require that the next part has no
  parent, i.e., it's a root element. For example: `:root > Class#Name` matches
  `Class#Name` only when it has no parent control. `:root` must be followed by a
  non-`*` target part.
* Visual state group name, for example: `Class#Name@VisualStateGroupName`. It
  can be specified for the target control or for a parent control, but can be
  specified only once per target. The visual state group can be used in styles
  as specified below.

Several target controls can be specified for the same styles by separating them
with commas, for example: `ParentClass > Class#Name1, ParentClass >
Class#Name2`. Commas inside `[...]` are part of the property value and don't
separate targets, for example: `Class[Margin=0,0,0,1]` is a single target.

**Note**: The target is evaluated only once. If, for example, the index or the
properties of a control change, the target conditions aren't evaluated again.

Each style is written as `Style=Value`, for example: `Height=5`. The `:=` syntax
can be used to use XAML syntax, for example: `Fill:=<SolidColorBrush
Color="Red"/>`. Specifying an empty value with the XAML syntax will clear the
property value, for example: `Fill:=`. In addition, a visual state can be
specified as following: `Style@VisualState=Value`, in which case the style will
only apply when the visual state group specified in the target matches the
specified visual state.

For the XAML syntax, in addition to the built-in taskbar objects, the mod
provides a built-in blur brush via the `WindhawkBlur` object, which supports the
`BlurAmount`, `TintColor`, `TintOpacity`, `TintLuminosityOpacity`,
`TintSaturation`, `NoiseOpacity`, `NoiseDensity`, and `FallbackColor`
properties. For example: `Fill:=<WindhawkBlur BlurAmount="10"
TintColor="#80FF00FF"/>`. Theme resources are also supported for `TintColor` and
`FallbackColor`, for example: `Fill:=<WindhawkBlur BlurAmount="18"
TintColor="{ThemeResource SystemAccentColorDark1}" TintOpacity="0.5"/>`. The
`FallbackColor` is used in place of the blur effect when battery saver is on or
when transparency effects are disabled in the system settings.

Targets and styles starting with two slashes (`//`) are ignored. This can be
useful for temporarily disabling a target or style.

#### Style variables

Beyond literal values, XAML values, and style constants, styles can reference
live property values via *style variables*. A capture rule of the form
`Property=>VarName` observes a control's property and publishes its value as
`VarName`; other styles then substitute it with `{{VarName}}`. Whenever the
captured value changes or the variable becomes undefined, every dependent style
is recomputed and reapplied.

Capture rules cannot be combined with `:=` or with the per-rule `@VisualState`
qualifier.

For example, these two styles on the same target keep it square, with the height
tracking the width:

```
ActualWidth=>width1
Height={{width1}}
```

A capture rule may match several controls at once. A style reading `{{VarName}}`
gets the value from whichever capturing control is closest to it in the control
tree, i.e. the one it shares the deepest common parent with; between equally
close controls, the one that appeared last wins. The variable only becomes
undefined once the last capturing control is gone.

A substitution can appear anywhere in a value, including alongside literal text:

```
Margin=0,{{x1}},0,{{x2 + 10}}
```

Inside `{{ ... }}`, the supported expression syntax is:

* Numbers (e.g. `42`, `3.14`).
* Backtick-delimited string literals (e.g. `` `Auto` ``, `` `*` ``), where a
  doubled backtick encodes one literal backtick. Backtick is used rather than a
  quote so literals don't clash with YAML or XAML quoting.
* Variable references (a previously captured `VarName`).
* Arithmetic `+`, `-`, `*`, `/` with standard precedence, and unary `+`, `-`.
* Comparisons `<`, `<=`, `==`, `>=`, `>`, `!=`, evaluating to `1` or `0`. The
  relational operators require numbers; `==` and `!=` compare two numbers or two
  strings by value and treat a number-versus-string mismatch as unequal.
* The conditional `cond ? a : b`: `a` when `cond` is non-zero, otherwise `b`.
  The condition must be numeric, but each branch may be a number or a string,
  e.g. `` {{width > 0 ? `*` : `Auto`}} `` selects a `GridLength` keyword.
* `min(a, b)` and `max(a, b)`.
* `skip()`: leaves the style unapplied, so the property keeps (or returns to)
  its original value, e.g. `{{width > 0 ? width : skip()}}` applies only once
  `width` is positive.
* Parentheses for grouping, and nesting such as `{{min(a, b + 1) * 2}}`.

Arithmetic, the unary sign, the relational comparisons, and `min` / `max`
require numeric operands. A string can only be produced by a literal or a
string-typed variable, compared with `==` / `!=`, and selected by the
conditional.

Brace pairs match innermost-first, so `{{{x}}}` is parsed as a literal `{`, the
substitution `{{x}}`, and a literal `}`, producing `{<value-of-x>}`.

A bare substitution `{{VarName}}` (with no operators) inserts the variable's
captured value verbatim. This works only for primitive captured types (numeric,
boolean, string); other types (brushes, thicknesses, etc.) are unsupported, and
substituting one skips the style, as does a bare reference to an undefined
variable.

Inside an expression, an undefined variable instead evaluates to the empty
string, letting a style supply its own default via the conditional, e.g. ```
{{width == `` ? 80 : width}} ``` yields `80` until `width` is captured. The
numeric operators above then fail on such a variable, skipping the style rather
than treating it as `0`.

### Resource variables

Some variables, such as size and padding for various controls, colors, and
brushes, are defined as resource variables. You can override existing resources
or define new theme-aware resources.

#### Overriding existing resources

Use `key=value` to override an existing resource.

#### Defining theme-aware resources

Use `Key@Dark=value` and `Key@Light=value` to define new resources with
different values for dark and light themes. These can then be referenced in
styles using `{ThemeResource key}`.

For example, to define a custom accent color that automatically adjusts based on
the system theme:

```
AutoAccent@Dark={ThemeResource SystemAccentColorDark1}
AutoAccent@Light={ThemeResource SystemAccentColorLight2}
```

Then use it in a style:

```
Background:=<SolidColorBrush Color="{ThemeResource AutoAccent}" />
```

The value will automatically update when the system accent color changes.

#### Using XAML syntax

The `:=` syntax can be used to set a XAML value as a resource, for example:
`MyBrush:=<SolidColorBrush Color="Red"/>`. This can be combined with theme
variants: `MyBrush@Dark:=<SolidColorBrush Color="#FF202020"/>`. Specifying an
empty value with the XAML syntax will clear the resource value, for example:
`MyBrush:=`.

### Style constants

Style constants allow defining a value once and referencing it in multiple
styles. Each entry contains a name and value, separated by `=`, for example:

```
mainColor=#fafad2
```

The constant can then be used in style definitions by prepending `$`, for
example:

```
Fill=$mainColor
Background:=<AcrylicBrush TintColor="$mainColor" TintOpacity="0.3" />
```

Some themes use style constants to allow easy customization. Refer to the theme
page for details on which constants are available.

## XAML diagnostics consumer handling

This mod uses XAML diagnostics to inspect and customize the File Explorer.
However, there can only be one XAML diagnostics consumer at a time. If another
program (such as ExplorerBlurMica) tries to use XAML diagnostics while this mod
is running, there will be a conflict.

The **XAML diagnostics consumer handling** setting controls how this mod handles
such conflicts:

* **Alert**: When another program tries to use XAML diagnostics, a message box
  will appear asking whether to block it. This allows you to decide on a
  case-by-case basis.
* **Block**: Automatically block other programs from using XAML diagnostics.
  This ensures this mod works correctly, but might break the other program.
* **Allow**: Allow other programs to use XAML diagnostics. This might break this
  mod's styling, but allows the other program to work.

## Implementation notes

The VisualTreeWatcher implementation is based on the
[ExplorerTAP](https://github.com/TranslucentTB/TranslucentTB/tree/develop/ExplorerTAP)
code from the **TranslucentTB** project.

The `WindhawkBlur` brush object implementation is based on
[XamlBlurBrush](https://github.com/TranslucentTB/TranslucentTB/blob/release/ExplorerTAP/XamlBlurBrush.cpp)
from the **TranslucentTB** project.

The GDI rendering with alpha and the accent blur behind setup for the entire
window translucent effect are based on the [Translucent
Windows](https://windhawk.net/mods/translucent-windows) mod.

// A weak reference for the object, or an empty one when the object is null or
// doesn't support weak references: cppwinrt's make_weak dereferences a null
// pointer for an object without that support instead of reporting it. Throws,
// as make_weak does, when the object supports weak references but one can't be
// made.
winrt::weak_ref<wf::IInspectable> TryMakeWeak(wf::IInspectable const& object)
{
    if (!object.try_as<::IWeakReferenceSource>())
    {
        return nullptr;
    }

    return winrt::make_weak(object);
}

static constexpr GUID IID_IXamlDiagnosticsTestHooks =

// The handle a mutation callback would report for an element, for elements
// which were reached some other way, e.g. by walking the visual tree. Derived
// the way the diagnostics derive it, by querying IInspectable and taking the
// pointer, and not through GetHandleFromIInspectable: that one creates the
// runtime object when none is cached, so asking it about an element whose
// reference was released would take a new reference and pin it again.
InstanceHandle HandleFromInspectable(wf::IInspectable const& instance)
{
    winrt::com_ptr<::IInspectable> inspectable;
    winrt::check_hresult(reinterpret_cast<::IUnknown*>(winrt::get_abi(instance))->QueryInterface(winrt::guid_of<wf::IInspectable>(), inspectable.put_void()));
    return reinterpret_cast<InstanceHandle>(inspectable.get());
}

VisualTreeWatcher::VisualTreeWatcher(winrt::com_ptr<IUnknown> site) :
    m_XamlDiagnostics(site.as<IXamlDiagnostics>())
{
    Wh_Log(L"Constructing VisualTreeWatcher");

    HRESULT hr = m_XamlDiagnostics->QueryInterface(IID_IXamlDiagnosticsTestHooks, m_XamlDiagnosticsTestHooks.put_void());
    if (FAILED(hr)) {
        Wh_Log(L"IXamlDiagnosticsTestHooks is unavailable, elements will be leaked: %08X", hr);
    }

    // winrt::check_hresult(m_XamlDiagnostics.as<IVisualTreeService3>()->AdviseVisualTreeChange(this));

    // Calling AdviseVisualTreeChange from the current thread causes the app to
    // hang in Advising::RunOnUIThread sometimes. Creating a new thread and
    // calling it from there fixes it.
    HANDLE thread = CreateThread(
        nullptr, 0,
        [](LPVOID lpParam) -> DWORD {
            auto watcher = reinterpret_cast<VisualTreeWatcher*>(lpParam);
            HRESULT hr = watcher->m_XamlDiagnostics.as<IVisualTreeService3>()->AdviseVisualTreeChange(watcher);
            watcher->Release();
            if (FAILED(hr)) {
                Wh_Log(L"Error %08X", hr);
            }
            return 0;
        },
        this, 0, nullptr);
    if (thread) {
        AddRef();
        CloseHandle(thread);
    }
}
